title: Claude for Excel is Transformative for Basic Spreadsheet Modeling and Analysis
summary: We used the Claude Excel plug-in to build and analyze spreadsheet models for five semi structured problem statements (including a test-piece teaching case with data in multiple exhibits) and evaluated performance on modeling (what is to be coded), spreadsheet engineering (quality of coding), analysis (algorithms applied to the spreadsheet), and insight generation. Claude's ability to create a high-quality spreadsheet model from a semi structured problem statement is astoundingly excellent. Given very simple prompts, Claude generates extensive, accurate sensitivity and scenario analyses and reasonable plain English insights. Claude is Solver-aware and builds optimization models without specific prompting. Analyst productivity gains will likely be high. Business school quant courses will have to change. The way we develop human expertise will have to change.

AI.tldr: 研究者使用Claude的Excel插件，针对五个半结构化问题（含一个多数据表的教学案例），构建并分析电子表格模型，从建模、表格工程、分析与洞察生成四个维度评估其表现。结果显示Claude能力"惊人地出色"，但认为商学院量化课程与人才培养方式需随之改变。
AI.motivation: 作者想探究大语言模型（Claude Excel插件）在真实、半结构化的商业建模任务中能否独立完成从问题描述到电子表格模型、敏感性分析、情景分析与优化建模的全流程，以评估其对分析师生产力与商科教育的影响。
AI.method: 使用Claude的Excel插件，对五个半结构化问题陈述（包括一个含多个数据展示表的测试教学案例）构建并分析电子表格模型；沿四个维度评估：建模（明确要编码的内容）、电子表格工程（编码质量）、分析（应用于表格的算法）与洞察生成。
AI.result: Claude仅凭非常简单提示即可生成高质量表格模型，并自动产出详尽准确的敏感性与情景分析以及合理的英文洞察；它具备"Solver意识"，无需专门提示即可构建优化模型。分析师生产力提升潜力大。
AI.conclusion: Claude在半结构化商业建模上表现卓越，将显著提升分析师生产力；但商学院量化课程及人类专业技能的培养方式必须相应变革。

title: VerusWeave: A Benchmark for Proof Repair in Concurrent Verus Programs
summary:
Concurrent software underpins critical infrastructure, including operating systems and databases, yet thread interactions can have bugs that bypass conventional testing. Verus extends Rust with formal verification capabilities, enabling developers to specify, implement and prove the correctness of concurrent code in the same language. Although coding agents have been explored for automated proof construction, existing Verus benchmarks offer limited coverage of concurrency-specific examples that connect atomic operations to abstract protocols.
  To address this gap, we introduce VerusWeave, the first benchmark dedicated to concurrent proof repair, derived from four open-source projects. It comprises 75 focused tasks and 17 full-module variants that exercise features used to verify low-level concurrent code. Tasks remove selected proof annotations and require agents to fill gaps, while preserving executable code and specifications. The evaluation harness validates repairs using Verus and a change checker, recording solutions, execution traces, and resource usage. An initial evaluation of four general-purpose coding-agent harnesses achieved 75-85% success on focused tasks and 29-47% on full-module variants, highlighting the challenge of autonomous module-wide repairs. VerusWeave provides a reusable foundation for evaluating automated proof construction for concurrent software.

AI.tldr: VerusWeave 是首个面向并发证明修复的基准，来自四个开源项目，含 75 个聚焦任务和 17 个整模块变体，用于评测编码智能体自动补全 Verus 并发证明的能力。
AI.motivation: 并发软件支撑关键基础设施，但线程交互缺陷难以被传统测试发现；Verus 允许在 Rust 中以同一语言编写规格与并发证明，然而现有 Verus 基准缺乏连接原子操作与抽象协议的并发示例，难以评估智能体的自动证明构建能力。
AI.method: 从四个开源项目构建基准：任务删除选定证明注解、保留可执行代码与规格，要求智能体填补证明空缺；提供基于 Verus 与变更检查器的评测框架，记录解答、执行轨迹和资源使用。
AI.result: 四个通用编码智能体框架在聚焦任务上成功率为 75–85%，在整模块变体上仅 29–47%，凸显模块级自主修复的困难。
AI.conclusion: VerusWeave 为评测并发软件的自动化证明构建提供了可复用的基础，并揭示了从局部证明填补到整模块修复之间的显著能力差距。

title: Software Change Request in AI-Orchestrated Software Evolution: Literature Review and Research Agenda
summary: In the emerging paradigm of holistic AI-orchestrated software maintenance and evolution, large-scale app stores continuously generate exponentially vast Software Change Requests (SCRs) streams through user feedbacks. These streams enable intelligent software evolution. Automating SCR extraction and classification is crucial with rapid growth of Mobile Apps (MA). However, significant challenges exist such as scare large-scale datasets, inconsistent classification schemes, limited data sharing and insufficient research. This study presents a first and thorough systematic survey of SCR identification from MA Reviews (MAR). In particular, we investigated how Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) enhanced identification and classification of SCR. This study has found pertinent datasets varying sizes from 5,000 to more than 18 million reviews. The key findings highlight the dominant use of Random Forest and Support Vector Machines, limited adoption of deep learning techniques, inconsistent F1-score results ranging from 0.08 to 1 and partial automation in existing SCR tools such as SURF and ChangeAdvisor. Finally, we have performed a synthesis of the studies to presents a comparative taxonomy of SCR methodologies, identify research gaps and annotation frameworks. We contend that classification schemes, shared datasets and annotation frameworks are essential for advancing SCRs and thereby improving the maintenance of mobile applications.

AI.tldr: 该文是首个针对移动应用评论(MAR)中软件变更请求(SCR)识别与分类的系统性综述，梳理了ML/DL方法、数据集、分类体系、工具自动化程度，并指出研究空白。
AI.motivation: 应用商店通过用户反馈产生海量SCR流，自动化提取与分类SCR对移动应用演化至关重要；但现有研究面临大规模数据集稀缺、分类方案不一致、数据共享不足及研究不充分等挑战，缺乏系统性梳理。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，考察ML与DL在SCR识别和分类中的应用；整理相关数据集规模、所用算法、评估指标及工具（如SURF、ChangeAdvisor）的自动化水平，并对各研究方法进行综合归纳，构建比较分类法、识别研究空白与标注框架。
AI.result: 数据集规模从5,000条到超1800万条评论不等；Random Forest与SVM使用最为主流，深度学习采用有限；F1分数差异大(0.08–1)；现有SCR工具仅实现部分自动化。
AI.conclusion: 统一的分类体系、共享数据集和标注框架对推进SCR研究、改进移动应用维护至关重要。

title: Hardware-Aware Conditional Code in Android Apps
summary:
Android OS runs on a highly diverse set of devices, spanning entry-level phones and flagships with substantially different hardware characteristics, including memory capacity, processors, displays, cameras, and sensors. Through APIs, apps can query device information at runtime, such as memory, hardware features, and manufacturer, among other device properties, allowing developers to execute different code paths on different devices. Existing studies cover only specific compatibility bugs or brand-specific behavior; however, the broader use of hardware information in app logic has not been comprehensively explored.
  We address this question with a large-scale empirical study of hardware-related if statements in Android apps. We statically analyze 50,000 apps to identify the if statements whose conditions depend on the values of hardware-related APIs, and extract their conditions together with the code of their branches. Our results show that 95% of successfully analyzed apps contain at least one such statement, with an average of 74 per app, which suggests that hardware-related logic is widespread. We then apply an LLM-assisted open-coding process to the extracted code to build a structured taxonomy of the purposes behind hardware-related conditional code. The resulting characterization shows that developers use hardware information for feature availability checks, UI adaptation, emulator detection, device tiering, and resource management, among others.

AI.tldr: 该论文对5万个Android应用进行大规模实证研究，静态提取依赖硬件API的if语句，发现硬件相关条件逻辑极为普遍（95%应用含此类语句，平均每应用74处），并用LLM辅助开放编码构建了其用途分类体系。
AI.motivation: Android设备硬件差异巨大（内存、处理器、屏幕、摄像头、传感器等），应用可通过API在运行时查询设备信息并走不同代码路径。已有研究仅覆盖特定兼容性bug或特定品牌行为，尚未全面探索硬件信息在应用逻辑中的广泛使用。
AI.method: 静态分析50,000个Android应用，识别条件依赖硬件相关API取值的if语句，提取其条件与分支代码；随后采用LLM辅助的开放编码（open-coding）对提取代码进行处理，构建结构化的用途分类体系。
AI.result: 95%成功分析的应用至少含一条此类语句，平均每应用74处，说明硬件相关逻辑十分普遍；分类结果显示开发者将硬件信息用于功能可用性检查、UI适配、模拟器检测、设备分级（device tiering）、资源管理等。
AI.conclusion: 硬件相关条件逻辑在Android应用中广泛存在，其用途多样且有结构；该研究为理解、测试与改进设备异构性下的应用行为提供了实证基础与分类框架。

title: Online Fair Division of Chores with Upgrade Recourse
summary: We study the online fair division of indivisible chores among $n$ agents under upgrade recourse, where earlier assignments may be revised but each chore previously assigned to an agent must be replaced by a distinct chore that she finds no more costly. We show that a simple adaptation of round robin maintains envy-freeness up to one chore (EF1) together with a $(2-1/n)$-approximation of the maximin share (MMS), and that no deterministic algorithm without predictions can do better, even when all agents rank the chores in the same order. This stands in contrast to the allocation of goods, where the optimal MMS factor vanishes as $n$ grows and cannot be achieved together with EF1. Moreover, knowing only the number of chores modulo a period of length $O(n)$ (and nothing about the costs) suffices to improve upon this factor at the final configuration, while the same algorithm retains a factor below $3$ even if this information is wrong. On the other hand, envy-freeness up to any chore (EFX) essentially requires the exact number of chores: uncertainty between two consecutive values already rules out every finite approximation, and even exact knowledge does not allow EFX to be combined with an MMS guarantee better than the trivial factor of $n$.

AI.tldr: 研究不可分杂务在线公平分配（可升级后悔），给出简单轮转算法同时保证EF1与(2-1/n)近似的MMS，并证明该界在无预测确定性算法下最优；进一步刻画预测信息（杂务数量模O(n)）对改进MMS因子的作用及EFX所需的精确信息。
AI.motivation: 在线分配中不可分杂务（chores）与商品（goods）性质迥异，需要在可修订早期分配的"升级后悔"模型下同时追求EF1与MMS，并弄清预测信息（如杂务数量）能否改善近似比、EFX要求多强的信息。
AI.method: 采用upgrade recourse模型：先前分配可修订，但每件被替换的杂务须换成该代理人认为不更昂贵的另一件不同杂务。方法是对round robin做简单改编，并在无预测、部分预测（仅知杂务数量模某个O(n)周期）、以及完全已知数量等设定下做上下界分析。
AI.result: 改编版round robin同时满足EF1与(2-1/n)-MMS；即使所有代理人对杂务工排序相同，任何无预测确定性算法也无法更好。知道杂务数量模O(n)周期即可在最终配置改进该因子，且信息错误时因子仍低于3；EFX则本质上需要精确数量——两个相邻值的不确定性就排除任何有限近似，即使数量精确，EFX与MMS结合也只能达到平凡的n因子。
AI.conclusion: 杂务在线分配中，简单轮转即可在升级后悔下取得EF1+近2倍MMS的最优确定性保证，与商品情形形成鲜明对比；预测信息对MMS的增益是稳健的（容错），而EFX对数量信息极为敏感甚至苛刻，揭示了不同公平性概念对信息的需求差异。

title: WeSearch: A Unified Model-Centric Retrieval Framework for WeChat Search
summary: We present WeSearch, a unified, model-centric retrieval framework for large-scale, continuously evolving content search. Prevailing methods assign documents fixed hierarchical Semantic IDs, implicitly assuming each document follows a single coherent semantic path-an assumption that often breaks down for multi-topic documents. WeSearch instead retrieves query-relevant clusters and then ranks atomic documents within the resulting query-specific candidate space, decoupling candidate pruning from fine-grained relevance modeling. Combined with relevance-aware training, compact document representations, and incremental index updates, this design enables weekly-or daily when needed-model refreshes. Deployed as the primary semantic retrieval path in WeChat Search alongside a lexical syntax tree, WeSearch shows consistent one-week A/B gains on corpora from hundreds of millions to billions of documents, and a one-month full-traffic A/B test confirms stable improvements of +0.68% CTR and +2.27% per-user article clicks, together with a 41% reduction in retrieval resource cost and a 19 ms reduction in graphic-text retrieval latency. WeSearch is now fully deployed in WeChat Search, serving 100% of production traffic.

AI.tldr: WeSearch 是微信搜索部署的模型中心式统一检索框架，先检索查询相关簇再在簇内对原子文档排序，解耦候选剪枝与细粒度相关性建模，支持快速模型刷新。
AI.motivation: 现有方法为文档分配固定层级 Semantic ID，隐含假设每篇文档沿单一连贯语义路径，对多主题文档失效。
AI.method: 检索查询相关簇，在生成的查询特定候选空间内对原子文档排序；结合相关性感知训练、紧凑文档表示与增量索引更新，支持周级/日级模型刷新；与词法语法树并列作为主语义检索路径。
AI.result: 数亿至数十亿文档语料上持续一周 A/B 提升；一个月全流量 A/B 显示 CTR +0.68%、人均文章点击 +2.27%，检索资源成本降 41%，图文检索延迟降 19 ms。
AI.conclusion: WeSearch 已全量部署于微信搜索，承载 100% 生产流量，验证了该框架在超大规模动态内容上的有效性与效率。

title: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
summary: Embedding models underpin virtually every modern AI system, from search engines to recommendation systems. Despite shared mathematical foundations, research on embedding models remains fragmented by modality: the communities develop largely in isolation, seldom exchanging insights. We argue that this fragmentation obscures a deeper convergence. Driven by contrastive learning, Transformer architectures, and a granularity shift, embedding research across modalities is converging toward a common set of principles, even as modality-specific challenges remain underexplored. To reason across this convergence without conflating it, we propose a framework of three progressively harder capabilities: coverage, comparability, and compositionality. Three paths toward unification satisfy these in turn: transformation broadens coverage, alignment enables comparability, and joint embedding, the terminus we advocate, aims at compositionality. This position paper traces the resulting evolution, providing the first unified, cross-cutting treatment of omnimodal embedding research.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，指出不同模态的嵌入模型研究正在收敛，并提出覆盖性、可比性、组合性三层能力框架及变换、对齐、联合嵌入三条统一路径。
AI.motivation: 嵌入模型是各类现代AI系统的基础，但研究按模态割裂，各社区孤立发展、少有交流，这种碎片化掩盖了由对比学习、Transformer架构和粒度转变驱动的深层收敛。
AI.method: 立场论文/综述性论证：梳理嵌入研究的跨模态演进，提出覆盖性、可比性、组合性三个递进能力（满足其一才能谈下一个），并对应变换（扩展覆盖）、对齐（实现可比）、联合嵌入（追求组合性）三条路径。
AI.result: 给出首个统一、跨切面的全模态（omnimodal）嵌入研究论述，说明各模态如何趋同于共同原则，同时指出模态特有挑战仍被忽视。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入研究应以联合嵌入为终点的统一框架来组织，以避免混淆收敛、推动跨模态洞见互通。

title: Beyond the Last Layer: Global Inter-Layer Aggregation for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: The rapid development of generative models has made AI-generated images increasingly close to real images. It has also brought several challenges to detectors, including rapid generator updates, large changes in data distribution, and limited cross-dataset generalization. Many existing methods based on pretrained vision encoders primarily use the global representation from the last layer, potentially leaving useful information from intermediate layers underexplored. To address this issue, we propose Global Inter-Layer Aggregation (GILA). GILA extracts global representations from different depths of a frozen encoder, models interactions among layer representations through inter-layer self-attention, and adaptively aggregates the resulting contextualized representations. The method is not tied to a single pretraining objective and does not require fine-tuning the pretrained encoder. We evaluated GILA on three vision backbones with different pretraining objectives, ten seen generators, and three external datasets. The experimental results show that GILA makes better use of multi-layer information in pretrained encoders and improves detection performance and cross-dataset generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出GILA（全局层间聚合）方法，通过提取冻结编码器不同深度的全局表示并用层间自注意力建模交互，提升AI生成图像检测与跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于预训练视觉编码器的检测方法主要使用最后一层的全局表示，忽略了中间层信息，难以应对生成器快速更新、数据分布变化大和跨数据集泛化差的问题。
AI.method: GILA从冻结编码器的不同深度提取全局表示，通过层间自注意力建模各层表示间的交互，再自适应聚合得到上下文表示；方法不依赖特定预训练目标，也无需微调预训练编码器。
AI.result: 在三种不同预训练目标的视觉骨干、十个已知生成器和三个外部数据集上评估，GILA更好地利用了预训练编码器的多层信息，提升了检测性能和跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 多层全局表示的有效聚合是提升AI生成图像检测鲁棒性与泛化性的有效途径，且具有良好的骨干无关性与免微调特性。

title: A Generalized Sparse Fuzzy Clustering Framework with Automated Cluster Cardinality Estimation Ability
comment: 25 pages, highlights, 14 figures, under review in Elsevier journal
summary: Fuzzy clustering provides a robust framework for handling ambiguous and overlapping data boundaries, yet its traditional formulation generates entirely dense membership assignments that limit noise resilience and prevent estimating the true number of clusters, when it is unknown. To address these limitations, we introduce in this paper the Generalized Sparse Fuzzy Clustering (GSFC) framework, which incorporates a continuous sparsity penalty into the fuzzy objective function. Because closed-form solutions are precluded by the simultaneous presence of fuzzifier and sparsity exponents, we propose an efficient primal-dual bisection search coupled with specialized analytic pathways to rigorously enforce the partition constraint while organically driving trace memberships to exact zero. This mathematically enforced sparsity empowers the algorithm to autonomously estimate the true number of clusters by dynamically pruning redundant clusters, provided that it is initialized by a larger than the true number of clusters. Furthermore, we integrate a virtual noise sink to insulate outliers from the rest of the data points. The usage of the proposed framework is also extended to line segment detection. Extensive empirical evaluations across synthetic toy datasets, high-noise geometric stress tests, and real-world benchmarks (UCI wine dataset and hyperspectral images) demonstrate that GSFC effectively exceeds conventional fuzzy benchmarks while autonomously resolving cluster cardinality. Additionally, it significantly outperforms existing sparse possibilistic and probabilistic soft-clustering alternatives in line detection tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出广义稀疏模糊聚类（GSFC）框架，在模糊目标函数中引入连续稀疏惩罚，实现自动估计真实簇数并提升抗噪性，并扩展到线段检测。
AI.motivation: 传统模糊聚类生成全稠密隶属度分配，限制抗噪能力，且在簇数未知时无法估计真实簇数。
AI.method: 在模糊目标函数中加入连续稀疏惩罚；因模糊指数与稀疏指数共存无闭式解，采用高效的原始-对偶二分搜索结合专门解析路径，严格满足划分约束并驱动微量隶属度精确归零；加入虚拟噪声汇隔离离群点；扩展至线段检测。
AI.result: 在合成玩具数据、高噪声几何压力测试及真实基准（UCI wine、高光谱图像）上超越传统模糊基准并自动确定簇数；在线检测任务中显著优于现有稀疏可能性/概率软聚类方法。
AI.conclusion: GSFC通过数学强制稀疏实现冗余簇动态剪枝与自主簇数估计，具备良好抗噪性，并可推广至线段检测等任务。

title: Output-Aware Block Influence: Jacobian-Lens Weighting for Depth Pruning
summary: Depth pruning removes entire transformer blocks and therefore depends on a reliable criterion for identifying which blocks can be removed. Block Influence (BI) ranks blocks by how minimally they rotate the hidden state. However, local redundancy does not necessarily imply downstream irrelevance. We address this limitation using the Jacobian Lens (J-Lens) neural artifact, a map transporting perturbations at a layer to the final residual stream. At a common sparsity level, pruning scores applying J-Lens transportation to $BI$, what we call $J-BI$, were found to improve post-pruning accuracy by up to 19 points over $BI$ while reducing damage to perplexity for Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-IT, and Gemma-3-12B-IT. We also perform a single-block ablation study and use J-Lens probing to explain why the proposed scores improved performance.

AI.tldr: 深度剪枝需要可靠指标判断哪些Transformer块可被移除；本文提出用Jacobian Lens(J-Lens)将Block Influence(BI)评分传播到最终残差流，形成J-BI，显著改善剪枝后性能。
AI.motivation: BI按块对隐藏状态的旋转程度排序，但局部冗余不等于下游无关；需要将局部指标与最终输出的影响联系起来。
AI.method: 提出J-Lens神经制品，把某一层的扰动映射到最终残差流；将J-Lens传输作用于BI得到J-BI评分用于深度剪枝；并进行单块消融与J-Lens探测分析。
AI.result: 在相同稀疏度下，J-BI相比BI使剪枝后准确率最高提升19个百分点，并减轻困惑度损伤，在Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B-IT与Gemma-3-12B-IT上验证。
AI.conclusion: 将局部剪枝评分经J-Lens传播到最终输出，可更准确衡量块的下游重要性，J-Lens探测也解释了性能提升原因。

title: Cultural Evolution Drives the Emergence of Conventions in Neural Emergent Communication
summary: Recent studies of language evolution with neural agents often use models where agents can either speak or listen, where there are only two agents in the population, or where agents can share internal representations. These choices prevent the study of how language emerges through cultural evolution, i.e. through the cumulative adaptation of individual behaviours to fit the communicative needs of the community. We tackle this issue with a new model that trains populations of bi-directional neural agents in a fully distributed fashion to solve a referential game. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach on multiple image datasets and show that it is able to scale to large populations. We also show that more conventional languages are easier to learn, providing a direct advantage for cultural transmission. Overall, this work provides a novel approach to neural emergent communication that opens up new directions for evolutionary linguistics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在完全分布式方式下训练双向神经智能体群体解决指称游戏的新模型，用于研究文化演化下的语言涌现，并在多图像数据集上验证有效性与大规模扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有神经智能体语言演化研究存在局限：智能体只能说话或倾听、种群仅两个智能体、或可共享内部表征，这些设定阻碍了研究语言如何通过文化演化（个体行为对社群交流需求的累积适应）而涌现。
AI.method: 构建一种新模型，让双向（既能说又能听）神经智能体群体以完全分布式方式训练，共同求解指称游戏（referential game），无需共享内部表征。
AI.result: 在多个图像数据集上验证了方法有效性；模型可扩展到大规模种群；发现更常规（conventional）的语言更易学习，从而为文化传播提供直接优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为神经涌现通信提供了新方法，为进化语言学开辟了新方向。

title: Lab2Sim: Turning Real-World Experiment Videos into Interactive Virtual Experiments
summary: Science experiment videos demonstrate how experiments are performed, but offer no direct interaction for learners. Turning them into virtual experiments requires not only reproducing the observed apparatus and state changes, but also enforcing the preconditions governing each operation. We introduce Lab2Sim, a benchmark of 218 science experiment videos with evidence-grounded specifications and 11,881 rubric items. To address this task, we propose EduVideo2Code, which extracts experimental procedures hierarchically, encodes them as explicit state machines to guide code generation, and refines the resulting pages through execution-based verification. Experiments show that existing multimodal models readily generate runnable pages but struggle to faithfully reconstruct experimental apparatus. EduVideo2Code consistently improves all four evaluation dimensions across two backbone models, with apparatus fidelity gains of 24.15 points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Lab2Sim基准（218个科学实验视频、带证据支撑的规范、11,881条评分项）与EduVideo2Code方法，将实验视频转化为可交互虚拟实验。
AI.motivation: 科学实验视频只展示过程，缺乏对学习者的交互；转为虚拟实验不仅要复现器材与状态变化，还需强制执行每个操作的前置条件。
AI.method: EduVideo2Code分层提取实验流程，将其编码为显式状态机以引导代码生成，并通过基于执行的验证对生成页面进行迭代精修。
AI.result: 现有多模态模型能生成可运行页面，但难以忠实重建实验器材；EduVideo2Code在两个骨干模型上全面提升四个评价维度，器材保真度提升24.15分。
AI.conclusion: 显式状态机与执行验证可将实验视频可靠地转化为遵循前置条件的虚拟实验，Lab2Sim为该任务提供了评测基础。

title: Autoformalization for Ambiguous Inputs: Precision, Coverage, and Cost across SQL and Logical Forms
summary: Agentic systems translate natural-language requests into executable artifacts while managing ambiguity and inference cost. We evaluate seven autoformalization workflows on SQL and first-order logic benchmarks for ambiguous inputs. Across five SQL workflows, the raw model leads with F1 of 53.35% on AMBROSIA and 60.85% on AmbiQT. On AmP, DRIFT gains 15.98 F1 points over the raw model at 2.03 times its token cost, whereas LoC uses 18.65 times the raw model's tokens with lower F1. Within AutoCedar, structured interpretation lowers F1 by 6.44-6.95 points and raises AMBROSIA token use 2.2-fold. Paired reviewer comparisons show modest Kimi K3 gains of 1.93 points on AMBROSIA and 2.04 on AmbiQT. Clear-ambiguous AMBROSIA analysis shows greater relative stability for AutoCedar, with a smaller F1 drop than the raw model (11.46 vs. 16.68 points), alongside lower aggregate F1 (50.16% vs. 53.35%). Autoformalization alone does not guarantee robustness to ambiguity: the tested additions offer no uniformly effective remedy, making accuracy, ambiguity handling, and inference cost joint design requirements.

AI.tldr: 论文系统评测了7种面向SQL与一阶逻辑的自动形式化工作流在歧义输入下的表现，发现各类"增强"手段均无法稳定改善准确率、歧义鲁棒性与推理成本。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统需将自然语言请求转化为可执行产物，同时处理歧义与推理成本；但自动形式化本身是否真能带来歧义鲁棒性尚不清楚，需对多种工作流进行统一评测。
AI.method: 在SQL（AMBROSIA、AmbiQT）与一阶逻辑（AmP、AutoCedar）歧义基准上，对比5种SQL工作流与AutoCedar等工作流（含DRIFT、LoC、结构化解释、Kimi K3配对评审等），报告F1、相对原始模型的增益、token成本倍数，并做清晰—歧义配对分析。
AI.result: 原始模型在SQL上领先（AMBROSIA 53.35%，AmbiQT 60.85%）；AmP上DRIFT较原始模型+15.98 F1但token为2.03倍，LoC用18.65倍token却F1更低；AutoCedar中结构化解释使F1下降6.44–6.95分、token增2.2倍；Kimi K3配对评审仅+1.93/+2.04分；AutoCedar歧义下F1降幅更小（11.46 vs 16.68）但总体F1更低（50.16% vs 53.35%）。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠自动形式化不能保证歧义鲁棒性，所测试的各类附加机制没有普遍有效的补救方案，准确率、歧义处理与推理成本需作为联合设计约束。

title: FIXP-Completeness in Second-Price Auctions
summary:
Computing equilibria is a fundamental algorithmic problem in game theory and economics. Although general frameworks are available for proving membership in FIXP, the class capturing exact fixed-point computation, establishing FIXP-completeness often remains challenging. We prove FIXP-completeness of exact equilibrium computation in three second-price auction models: (1). pacing with return-on-investment constraints, with multiplier cap $1+δ$ for every fixed rational $δ>0$ [Filos-Ratsikas, Hansen, Høgh, and Hollender (2024)]; (2). budget-constrained generalized second-price sponsored shopping [Hansen, Li, and Nie (2026)]; (3). budget-constrained throttling [Liu (2026)]. These results resolve open questions on the exact complexity of automated bidding.
  Our technical ingredient is a FIXP-complete generalized-circuit problem using only clipped affine gates and the reciprocal $x\mapsto1/(1+τx)$, for any fixed positive rational $τ$. This gate basis provides a common framework for the three auction reductions: simulating these gates in each model establishes FIXP-hardness without directly implementing multiplication or squaring.

AI.tldr: 论文证明三种第二价格拍卖模型中精确均衡计算是FIXP完全的。
AI.motivation: 精确均衡计算的FIXP完全性此前多为开放问题，尤其自动出价相关模型。
AI.method: 构造仅用截断仿射门与倒数门 x↦1/(1+τx) 的FIXP完全广义电路问题，再在各拍卖模型中模拟这些门。
AI.result: 证明ROI约束配速、预算约束广义第二价格赞助购物、预算约束限流三模型的精确均衡计算均为FIXP完全。
AI.conclusion: 统一的门基框架使FIXP困难性归约无需直接实现乘法或平方。

title: EduExplain: A Benchmark for Explanation-Set Retrieval and Storyboard Construction in Educational Explanation
summary: Generating an educational explanation for a learner's query is not a single retrieval step but a pipeline: a system must first retrieve a compact set of complementary resources--passages, figures, examples, activities--that jointly support an explanation, then structure that set into an ordered, timed, role-assigned plan before rendering it as a lesson or video. Existing retrieval benchmarks evaluate neither stage at the level these applications require: they score individual documents rather than explanation sets, and provide no ground truth for how a set should be organised into an explanation. We present EduExplain, a benchmark providing human-validated ground truth for both stages. Built from secondary-level science textbooks, it comprises 6,921 typed, multimodal resources and 2,123 concepts, and pairs each of 321 learner-oriented queries with one or more human-validated explanation sets (retrieval ground truth) and 741 reference storyboards (structuring ground truth). The benchmark exposes characteristics absent from prior datasets: heterogeneous multimodal retrieval units, multiple valid explanation sets per query, and plans whose quality depends on pedagogical role composition, grounding, and timing rather than relevance alone. We describe an LLM-assisted, human-validated construction pipeline, report inter-annotator agreement for both layers, and establish baselines for each stage--lexical, dense, multimodal, and cross-encoder retrieval paired with four selection strategies, and free-form and fixed-template storyboard construction. Our results show that first-stage retrieval quality dominates retrieval-stage performance, that off-the-shelf diversity-based selection underperforms simple top-ranked selection, and that unconstrained and rigidly templated structuring both fall short of the reference plans. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/data-iitd/eduexplain.

AI.tldr: 提出EduExplain基准，同时为教育解释生成的"检索解释集合"与"结构化编排故事板"两个阶段提供人工验证的真值数据。
AI.motivation: 教育解释生成是流水线而非单步检索：需先检索互补资源集（段落、图表、例子、活动），再组织成有序、带时间与角色分配的方案，最后渲染为课程/视频。已有检索基准只评分单文档、不评估解释集合，且缺乏"如何组织成解释"的真值。
AI.method: 基于中学科学教材构建：6,921个带类型的多模态资源、2,123个概念；321个学习者查询，各配一个或多个人工验证的解释集合（检索真值）与741个参考故事板（结构化真值）。采用LLM辅助、人工验证的构建流程，并报告两层标注者一致性。基准方法覆盖词法/稠密/多模态/交叉编码器检索×四种选择策略，以及自由形式与固定模板故事板构建。
AI.result: 基线结果显示：第一阶段检索质量主导检索阶段表现；现成的多样性选择策略不如简单的top-ranked选择；无约束与 rigid 模板化两种结构化方法均不及参考方案。
AI.conclusion: EduExplain填补了教育解释集合检索与结构化编排缺乏真值的空白，揭示现有检索与结构化方法的不足，为后续研究提供基准与方向。

title: MEMENTO: Learning Context Management for Long Context Processing Agents
summary: LLM agents that operate over long inputs must perform context management: deciding what to retain in a fixed-size context window. A common approach is compaction, where the model replaces its history with a self-generated note. Yet off-the-shelf agentic models, including GPT-5.5 and GLM-5.3, often write ineffective notes, and reinforcement learning (RL) alone rarely discovers useful note-taking behavior. We present MEMENTO, a long-context agent built on Qwen3-8B and trained to manage its context through compaction. We first bootstrap note-taking by fine-tuning on synthetic trajectories annotated with notes generated in hindsight, then reinforce it with RL using a reward that combines answer correctness, note-quality heuristics, and confidence calibration. Although trained only to compact into a fresh window, MEMENTO extends at test time to strategies such as context folding and confidence-based backtracking. On book-level question answering across four benchmarks, with books of up to 2.5M tokens, MEMENTO raises Qwen3-8B's accuracy from 36.9% to 67.8% while never holding more than 20K tokens in context. It outperforms GPT-5.5 agent in the same harness (13.1%) and full book context (56.7%) at less than 1/50 the cost. It also nearly matches a ~100x larger GLM-5.3 agent (69.3%) at 1/9 the cost, and comes within 6.4 points of GLM-5.3 full context at 1/26 the cost.

AI.tldr: MEMENTO 是一个基于 Qwen3-8B 的长上下文智能体，通过"压缩式上下文管理"（compaction）在固定窗口内保留关键信息：先用合成轨迹做笔记微调，再用 RL（奖励含答案正确性、笔记质量启发式、置信度校准）强化。在最长 2.5M token 的书籍级问答上把准确率从 36.9% 提升到 67.8%，且上下文始终不超过 20K token，成本远低于大模型方案。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在长输入场景下必须做上下文管理，决定在固定大小窗口中保留什么。常见做法是 compaction（用自生成笔记替换历史），但现成智能体模型（GPT-5.5、GLM-5.3）写出的笔记往往无效，单靠 RL 也很难自发学会有效的记笔记行为。
AI.method: 1) 先构造带"事后生成的笔记"标注的合成轨迹，对 Qwen3-8B 做监督微调，引导其学会记笔记（bootstrap）；2) 再用 RL 强化，奖励由三部分组合：答案正确性、笔记质量启发式、置信度校准；3) 虽然只用"压缩进全新窗口"训练，测试时可扩展到上下文折叠（context folding）与基于置信度的回溯（backtracking）等策略。
AI.result: 在四个基准的书籍级问答（书长达 2.5M token）上：Qwen3-8B 准确率从 36.9% 提升到 67.8%，上下文从不超 20K token；优于同套件 GPT-5.5 智能体（13.1%）与整本书全上下文（56.7%），成本不到其 1/50；接近约 100 倍大的 GLM-5.3 智能体（69.3%），成本仅 1/9；与 GLM-5.3 全上下文相比仅差 6.4 分，成本为 1/26。
AI.conclusion: 通过"合成笔记的监督微调 + 带笔记质量与置信度校准奖励的 RL"，一个 8B 小模型即可习得有效且可泛化的上下文压缩能力，测试时可自行组合出折叠、回溯等高级策略，以极低成本在超长文档问答上接近甚至超越大得多的模型与全上下文方案。

title: Intervenable Concept Dynamics for Video Activity Forecasting
summary: Concept bottleneck models route predictions through human-understandable concepts, making their intermediate states inspectable and editable. Extending this model family to forecasting requires modeling how concept activations evolve over time as objects, actions, and their interactions change, yet existing CBMs ground concepts only in observed inputs and do not forecast their future evolution. We study this problem using videos of ongoing activities and forecast future activities through a named-concept state. We propose TRACE-CBM (Temporal Relational Activity Concept Evolution), which first refines observed concept activations with sparse spatio-temporal graphs. It then recursively predicts future concept states, conditioning each transition on the prior activity distribution, and decodes both observed and predicted states with a shared activity classifier. At inference time, the model supports editing concept values, activity activations, and learned edges without parameter updates, exposing the relational spatio-temporal dependencies used for forecasting. Across multiple datasets, TRACE improves observed-activity Top-1 accuracy over concept-based methods by 1.2-8.5 percentage points and attains H3 forecast Top-1 accuracy within 1.9-2.2 points of matched black-box forecasters. Intervention experiments show concept-node edits correct 25.6-34.4% of initially incorrect H3 forecasts without flipping initially correct ones, and concept steering achieves the requested target activity in up to 90.0% of cases.

AI.tldr: TRACE-CBM 将概念瓶颈模型扩展到活动预测，通过稀疏时空图建模概念随时间演化，实现可解释、可编辑的未来活动预测。
AI.motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）仅将概念锚定于观测输入，无法预测概念的未来演化；而将CBM扩展到预测任务需要建模对象、动作及交互变化下概念激活随时间的演变。
AI.method: 提出 TRACE-CBM：先用稀疏时空图精炼观测概念激活，再递归预测未来概念状态（每次转移以上一时刻活动分布为条件），并用共享活动分类器解码观测与预测状态。推理时支持对概念值、活动激活及学习到的边进行无需参数更新的编辑。
AI.result: 多数据集上，观测活动Top-1准确率较概念类方法提升1.2-8.5个百分点；H3预测Top-1与匹配的黑盒预测器差距仅1.9-2.2个百分点；概念节点编辑纠正了25.6-34.4%的初始错误H3预测且不翻转原本正确的预测；概念引导在最高90.0%的情况下达成目标活动。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-CBM 证明概念瓶颈模型可用于可解释的活动预测，在保持接近黑盒预测器性能的同时提供可检查、可编辑的时空关系依赖。

title: Learning to bid and bundle: a posterior-sampling agent for online retail
comment: 37 pages, 5 figures; online supplement included as an ancillary file. Under review at Expert Systems with Applications
summary: An online retailer launching a perishable product bids for sponsored-search clicks, discounts a bundle with an always-stocked staple and displays its remaining stock, which raises willingness to pay. It knows neither how clicks respond to its bid nor how strong and dispersed its market is, and learns both over repeated seasons from data its own decisions censor: a zero bid reveals nothing about paid clicks, and choices follow only clicks. We design a posterior-sampling agent for it. Each period it draws a market from an exact posterior and posts the bid and discount of that market's exactly solved season plan, so every action is one a fully informed seller could take. In a simulated online florist it has the lowest regret averaged over markets. In weak markets it gives up 12% to 23% of one season's revenue over 500 seasons, four to seven times less than drawing once per season. A planner acting on point estimates can stop bidding and never learn that bidding pays. The agent escapes after about three seasons on average, against fifty with one draw per season. Where displayed scarcity keeps willingness to pay above the posted price, the discount needs no learning. Customers waiting for the discount to return to its recent level look like lost sales, so frequent waiting makes the agent underrate its market. One discount per season removes waiting at a cost of 5.9% of clairvoyant revenue in a weak market and none in a strong one.

AI.tldr: 本文为一个销售易腐品的在线零售商设计后验采样（posterior sampling）智能体，使其在反复销售季中同时学习"点击对出价的响应"和"市场规模强度与离散度"，且面对自身决策造成的数据截断问题，在弱市场下显著降低遗憾。
AI.motivation: 零售商既不知道点击如何随出价变化，也不知道市场强弱与分散程度；更关键的是数据被自身决策"截断"：出价为零时无法观测付费点击，而折扣选择又只依据实际产生的点击，导致学习困难。朴素方法（如按点估计行动的规划者）可能停止出价而永远学不到出价有效。
AI.method: 构建后验采样智能体：每期从精确后验中抽取一个市场参数，并执行该市场下精确求解的整季计划所对应的出价与折扣，从而保证每个动作都是完全知情卖家也可能采取的动作（避免离策略问题）。同时研究捆绑滞销品折扣、展示剩余库存抬高支付意愿、顾客等待折扣等机制，并考察每季一次折扣对"等待"行为的影响。
AI.result: 在模拟网上花店中平均遗憾最低。弱市场下500季仅损失单季收入的12%–23%，比每季只抽一次的方案低4–7倍；相比基于点估计的规划者（可能停止出价且永远学不到出价有效），该智能体平均约3季即脱离困境，而每季一抽需约50季。当展示稀缺性使支付意愿高于标价时，折扣无需学习。顾客等待折扣回落会被误判为流失，频繁等待使智能体低估市场。每季一次折扣可消除等待，弱市场代价为知情收益的5.9%，强市场无损失。
AI.conclusion: 在决策截断数据下，以"精确求解的整季计划"为动作集的后验采样能有效学习并显著降低遗憾；但顾客战略等待会引入偏差，需通过折扣频率设计加以权衡。

title: FB-MOAC: A Reinforcement Learning Algorithm for Forward-Backward Markov Decision Processes
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms are effective in solving problems that can be modeled as Markov decision processes (MDPs).
  These algorithms primarily target forward MDPs whose dynamics evolve over time from an initial state.
  However, several important problems in different scenarios including stochastic control and network systems exhibit both a forward and a backward dynamics. As a consequence, they cannot be expressed as a standard MDP, thereby calling
  for a novel theory for RL in this context.
  Accordingly, this work introduces the concept of Forward-Backward Markov Decision Processes (FB-MDPs)
  for multi-objective problems,
  develops a novel theoretical framework to characterize their optimal solutions,
  and proposes a general forward-backward step-wise template
  that allows to adapt RL algorithms for FB-MDP problems.
  A Forward Backward Multi Objective Actor Critic (FB-MOAC) algorithm is introduced accordingly
  to obtain optimal policies with guaranteed convergence and a competitive rate with respect to standard approaches in RL.
  FB-MOAC is evaluated on diverse use cases in the context of mathematical finance and mobile resource management.
  The obtained results show that FB-MOAC outperforms the state of the art across different metrics,
  highlighting its ability to learn and maximize rewards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出前向-后向马尔可夫决策过程（FB-MDP）概念，构建其最优解理论框架，并给出可将现有RL算法适配到FB-MDP的通用逐步模板，进而提出FB-MOAC算法，在金融与移动资源管理任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 标准RL面向仅从初始状态随时间前向演化的前向MDP，但随机控制、网络系统等场景同时具有前向与后向动态，无法建模为标准MDP，因此需要新的理论。
AI.method: 引入面向多目标问题的FB-MDP概念；建立刻画其最优解的理论框架；提出通用的前向-后向逐步模板以适配现有RL算法；据此设计前向-后向多目标Actor-Critic（FB-MOAC）算法，具备收敛保证并达到与标准RL相当的收敛速率。
AI.result: 在数学金融与移动资源管理等多个用例上评估，FB-MOAC在多项指标上优于现有最先进方法，展现出学习并最大化奖励的能力。
AI.conclusion: FB-MDP为兼具前向与后向动态的多目标问题提供了新的RL建模范式，所提模板具有通用性，FB-MOAC有效且收敛性有保障，可作为该类问题的实用解决方案。

title: SpikeAD: Toward Multiplication-Free Spike-Controlled Neuromorphic Architecture for Energy-Efficient Small Object Detection
summary: Energy-constrained aerial platforms require accurate object detection under strict power and latency budgets, yet conventional inference remains bottlenecked by multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations. While spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer bio-inspired efficiency, many SNN detectors retain hybrid MACs in intermediate layers, or use spike-driven inference where multi-level spikes are interpreted as repeated binary events. We propose SpikeAD, a direct-trained spike-controlled neuromorphic aerial detector. In SpikeAD, sparse bounded integer spikes act strictly as multiplexer control signals for multiplier-free shift-add inference, preserving spike boundaries throughout a four-scale bidirectional feature pyramid. We introduce the Spike-Gated Multi-Scale (SGMS) block, performing receptive field expansion with activity-driven channel selection, implementable with adders and comparators. Evaluated on VisDrone and DOTA and across Nano, Small, and Medium variants, SpikeAD achieves up to 46.2% mAP@50 on VisDrone (+4.8% over SNN prior art), and generalizes to oriented bounding box (77.6% mAP@50 on DOTA) using the proposed SpikeOBB head. Under the Horowitz 45nm arithmetic energy model following standard methodology in SNN literature, SpikeAD achieves up to 18.9x estimated reduction relative to an equivalent MAC-based implementation. We propose the Spike Processing Core (SPC), an RTL compute primitive to validate hardware realizability for reconfigurable and scalable custom accelerator chip design on FPGA/ASIC, highlighting a promising path toward next-generation ultra-low-power neuromorphic processors for aerial object detection. Link to the open-source and open-weight GitHub repository will be added upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出SpikeAD，一种直接训练的脉冲控制神经形态航空目标检测器，用稀疏有界整数脉冲作为多路复用控制信号实现无乘法器移位加推理，在VisDrone/DOTA上超越同类SNN方法并大幅降低能耗。
AI.motivation: 能量受限的航空平台需在严格功耗与延迟预算下做精确目标检测，但传统推理受乘累加（MAC）运算瓶颈制约。现有SNN检测器要么在中间层保留混合MAC，要么把多级脉冲当作重复二值事件处理，未能充分利用脉冲稀疏性。
AI.method: SpikeAD采用直接训练，稀疏有界整数脉冲仅作为多路复用控制信号驱动移位-加法推理，全程保持脉冲边界；构建四尺度双向特征金字塔；提出Spike-Gated Multi-Scale (SGMS)块，通过活动驱动通道选择实现感受野扩展（仅需加法器与比较器）；并提出SpikeOBB定向框检测头。
AI.result: VisDrone上mAP@50最高46.2%（较先前SNN方法+4.8%），DOTA上77.6% mAP@50；Nano/Small/Medium三个变体均验证。按Horowitz 45nm算术能耗模型估算，相对等效MAC实现能耗最高降低18.9倍。同时提出Spike Processing Core (SPC) RTL计算原语，验证FPGA/ASIC硬件可实现性。
AI.conclusion: SpikeAD展示了纯脉冲驱动、无乘法器航空检测的可行性与能效优势，结合RTL级验证，为下一代超低功耗神经形态处理器提供了有前景的路径；代码与权重将开源。

title: Monocular Badminton Speed Estimation with Air Drag and Court Geometry
summary: A single camera cannot distinguish between a slowly moving object nearby and a rapidly moving object in the distance without additional information. For a shuttlecock, air drag provides a strong deceleration cue that can be combined with known court geometry. We fit a gravity-and-drag trajectory to smartphone video and compare a free monocular fit with a fit constrained to cross the net plane. Camera calibration uses court lines, and the trajectory is fitted to observed shuttle positions and frame timestamps by robust nonlinear least squares. We evaluated 51 badminton shots from two recording sessions, spanning drop shots, drives, half-smashes and smashes. The net-plane fit reduced the median absolute speed difference from a drag-based stereo reference from 13.3% to 8.6%. A second reference, obtained by differentiating triangulated positions without a drag model, also gave a smaller median difference for the net-plane fit. The results support combining court geometry with flight dynamics for badminton speed estimation from a single camera.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结合空气阻力与球场几何约束的单目羽毛球速度估计方法，利用网平面约束求解轨迹，中位速度误差由13.3%降至8.6%。
AI.motivation: 单摄像头无法仅凭图像区分"近处慢速物体"与"远处快速物体"（尺度深度歧义），需引入额外信息才能估计羽毛球真实速度。
AI.method: 用手机视频拍摄羽毛球，以球场线标定相机；构建含重力与空气阻力的轨迹模型，基于观测位置与帧时间戳做鲁棒非线性最小二乘拟合；对比无约束单目拟合与"必须穿越网平面"的约束拟合。
AI.result: 在两次拍摄会话共51次击球（吊球、平推、半杀、杀球）上评估：以基于阻力的立体参考为基准，网平面约束将中位绝对速度差从13.3%降至8.6%；以三角化位置差分的无阻力模型参考为基准，约束拟合误差同样更小。
AI.conclusion: 将球场几何与飞行动力学相结合，可有效提升单摄像头羽毛球速度估计精度，为低成本单目测速提供可行方案。

title: Agent Stack for ML Training Lifecycle: Generation, Validation, and Optimization
summary: Production model development requires repeated architecture design, platform integration, debugging, training, and evaluation. We present an agent stack deployed at LinkedIn with two independently usable agent loops: AutoTorch for model generation and migration, and AutoResearch for model optimization. AutoTorch generates PyTorch models and training pipelines for TensorFlow migration, XGBoost replacement, and new-model development. Executable validation hooks check platform API compliance, trainability, and conversion fidelity on sampled data, guiding iterative repair before engineer review and full-scale distributed training. AutoResearch explores architecture and training-configuration changes through expert-steered or autonomous experimentation. An external orchestrator manages parallel trials, experiment history, candidate selection, and wall-clock budgets across agent sessions. A shared runtime preserves execution state independently of agent reasoning and allocates GPUs separately from agent execution. Across ranking, content understanding, and recommendation workloads, AutoTorch completed generation and full-scale training in 92 of 115 workflow runs (80%). Of these, 77 (83.7%) produced models meeting post-training quality requirements. In a separate cohort, AutoResearch improved the primary task metric on held-out data for 28 of 100 production pipelines. Engineering teams estimate that the stack reduced elapsed end-to-end migration time from approximately eight weeks to two weeks, a 4x speedup.

AI.tldr: LinkedIn 部署双智能体栈（AutoTorch 做模型生成/迁移，AutoResearch 做模型优化），AutoTorch 在 80% 工作流中完成生成与全量训练，其中 83.7% 达质量要求；AutoResearch 在 28% 生产管线提升主指标；端到端迁移从约 8 周缩短至 2 周（约 4 倍加速）。
AI.motivation: 生产模型开发需反复进行架构设计、平台集成、调试、训练与评测，流程冗长且依赖人工，迁移与优化成本高（如迁移约需 8 周）。论文希望用智能体栈自动化这些重复性工程环节。
AI.method: 构建两个可独立使用的智能体循环：AutoTorch 生成 PyTorch 模型与训练管线（支持 TF 迁移、替换 XGBoost、新模型开发），并通过可执行校验钩子检查平台 API 合规性、可训练性与采样数据上的转换保真度，驱动迭代修复后再由工程师审核并全量分布式训练；AutoResearch 通过专家引导或自主实验探索架构与训练配置。外部编排器管理并行试验、实验历史、候选选择与墙钟预算；共享运行时在智能体推理之外保存执行状态，并分离 GPU 分配与智能体执行。
AI.result: 在排序、内容理解与推荐负载中，AutoTorch 于 115 次工作流运行里 92 次（80%）完成生成与全量训练，其中 77 次（83.7%）训练后达到质量要求；另一组中 AutoResearch 在 100 条生产管线里 28 条于留出数据上提升主任务指标；工程团队估计迁移时间从约 8 周降至约 2 周，约 4 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体循环与可执行校验、外部编排和状态化运行时结合，可在真实生产环境中显著加速模型生成、迁移与优化，但自动化成功率仍有限，需人工审核把关。

title: Information Design for Behaviorally Stable Platooning
summary: Voluntary platoon formation requires vehicles to coordinate despite uncertain downstream fuel savings and private joining incentives. We study whether an informed operator can encourage participation by designing a public disclosure rule. A finite-vehicle coordination game links physical fuel savings to vehicles' joining decisions under two information environments: private joining costs and private observations of the common corridor state. Private costs yield a posterior-mean participation response, while private observations require richer posterior information and create correlated formation outcomes. We formulate persuasive disclosure problems and develop computational methods for both regimes. In a literature-anchored reference scenario, optimized two-message disclosure supports participation of 8.74% and 51.83%, respectively, compared with zero without disclosure and 5.15% and 39.27% under full disclosure. Gains concentrate in intermediate opportunities, depend on joining-cost calibration, and need not maximize welfare. Numerical sensitivity and trajectory checks quantify these effects. All gains are conditional on favorable symmetric equilibrium selection: public information alone cannot eliminate the no-participation equilibrium when joining requires a costly commitment without a guaranteed partner.

AI.tldr: 论研究信息设计者如何通过公开信息披露规则促进车辆自愿组队编队，比较私人成本与私人观测两种信息环境下的说服性披露问题。
AI.motivation: 自愿组队编队需车辆协调，但下游节油不确定且加入激励私有，单独公开信息或完全披露难以有效鼓励参与，故需设计最优披露规则。
AI.method: 构建有限车辆协调博弈，将物理节油与加入决策相连；针对私人加入成本（后验均值响应）与私人走廊状态观测（更丰富后验信息、相关结果）两类信息环境，建立说服性披露问题并开发计算方法。
AI.result: 在文献锚定参考场景中，优化两消息披露使参与率分别达8.74%与51.83%，而无披露为0、完全披露为5.15%与39.27%；收益集中于中等机会、依赖成本校准且不一定最大化福利。
AI.conclusion: 收益均以有利对称均衡选择为条件；当加入需昂贵承诺且无保证伙伴时，仅靠公共信息无法消除不参与均衡。

title: When 200 OK Is Not an Answer: Silent Fetch Failures in Agentic Web Content Acquisition
summary: Web agents and answer engines fetch pages at question time, and liveness checks of cited sources treat an HTTP 200 response as success. We measure how often that assumption fails and what it does to measurements built on fetched pages. We fetched 10,307 URLs in three days with a polite static client and a rendered browser client: pages from 1,507 sites in five strata, random non-existent paths on every site, and the 4,795 URLs cited by expert-verified claims in ExpertQA. We define a taxonomy of what a 200 response contains, label the static 200 responses automatically, and check the labels against 300 items reviewed by an LLM-based assistant; a human check of 60 of them retained every reviewed usability label after discussion. By the automatic labels, 20.9% of the pages that a static client receives with status 200 do not contain the page's main content: app shells, bot challenges, block pages, error and placeholder pages, and partial content. On the held-out test split, the reviewed sample lowers this estimate from 25.5% to 20.0%. 13.1% of the sites whose random-path probe was answered returned 200. The error propagates: for the cited sources, treating 200 as content overstates the share of claim-source pairs that can be checked against live content by 12.2 points and inflates the apparent silent citation-drift rate from 5.8% to 21.9%. Cheap heuristics catch most of it. Text length, probe comparison and redirect-to-root, combined and tuned on held-out sites, recover 86% of unusable reviewed responses at a false-alarm rate near 5%. Content-reading detectors perform comparably: the best, the text classifier, gains five to seven points of recall at more than twice the false-alarm rate. We argue that agents and their evaluations should report fetch outcomes explicitly instead of inferring them from the status line and will release the labelled data and code.

AI.tldr: 论文测量了网页与答案引擎抓取中"HTTP 200 即成功"这一假设的失效频率，发现约20.9%的200响应并不包含页面主要内容，且该误差会严重扭曲引用漂移等下游测量，并提出廉价启发式检测方法。
AI.motivation: 网页智能体与答案引擎在提问时抓取页面，且对引用来源的"存活检查"通常把HTTP 200当作成功。作者希望量化这一假设的失败频率及其对基于抓取页面的测量（如引用漂移率）造成的偏差。
AI.method: 三天内用礼貌的静态客户端与渲染浏览器客户端抓取10,307个URL，覆盖五层共1,507个网站的页面、每个网站的随机不存在路径，以及ExpertQA中专家验证论断引用的4,795个URL。建立"200响应内容"分类体系，自动标注静态200响应，并用LLM助手复核300项、人工复核其中60项。同时测试文本长度、探针比对、重定向到根路径等启发式，以及内容阅读型检测器。
AI.result: 按自动标注，静态客户端收到的200页面中20.9%不含主要内容（应用外壳、机器人挑战、封锁页、错误/占位页、部分内容）；审查样本在留出测试集上把估计从25.5%降到20.0%。随机路径探针返回200的网站占13.1%。对引用来源，把200当作内容会使"可对照实时内容核查的论断-来源对"比例高估12.2个百分点，并把隐性引用漂移率从5.8%虚增到21.9%。组合启发式（文本长度+探针比对+重定向到根）在留出网站上以约5%误报率召回86%的不可用响应；最佳文本分类器召回高5–7个点但误报率超过两倍。
AI.conclusion: "HTTP 200即内容成功"的假设频繁失效并向下游测量传播误差。作者主张智能体及其评测应显式报告抓取结果，而非从状态行推断，并将公开标注数据与代码。

title: Cross-Lingual Persona Effects in LLM Negotiation
comment: Accepted to SocialAgent Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 13 pages, 1 figure
summary: Tell an LLM negotiator to be "headstrong" and it should hold firm on price, but does that instruction retain the same behavior in every language? To test this, we use identical buyer and seller instances of Gemini 3.6 Flash to negotiate the same 12 CraigslistBargain scenarios in English and Korean. The pilot-scale 2 x 2 x 3 design crosses interaction language, seller urgency (none or strong), and buyer persona (cooperative, neutral, or headstrong), yielding 432 attempted negotiations. We call this property cross-lingual social-policy fidelity: whether a prompt-defined social policy produces the same behavioral effect regardless of interaction language. It often does not. Korean negotiations reached agreement far more often than English (77.3% vs. 52.5%, a 24.8-point gap, Holm-adjusted p = .0039), but only for neutral and headstrong buyers; cooperative buyers were already near-ceiling in both languages. Buyers' opening offers barely differed by language; the gap instead emerged later, through larger seller concessions and a smaller final gap in Korean, and agreed prices were also lower in Korean. Repeating the full design with Qwen3.7 Flash as both agents gives directional support: agreement was again higher in Korean (+13.9 points vs. Gemini's +24.8, with an interval whose lower bound is near zero), and sellers again conceded more. Pragmatic analysis reveals why: while both languages frequently featured face-threatening acts like rejections and counter-offers, Korean dialogue softened these threats with substantially more politeness mitigation, especially among sellers (11.7% vs. 3.6%). These results show that such a policy can produce different simulated negotiation behavior, not just different wording, when only the interaction language changes.

AI.tldr: 用Gemini 3.6 Flash双向代理在12个CraigslistBargain场景中做英/韩双语谈判实验（432场），发现"强势"这一提示定义的社交策略并非跨语言一致：韩语达成率比英语高24.8个百分点，且主要通过卖方更大让步实现，礼貌缓和语是重要机制。
AI.motivation: LLM代理常被赋予"强势""合作"等社交策略提示，但尚不清楚这些指令的行为效果是否会随交互语言改变；若会改变，则多语言部署与模拟研究的可比性都成问题。作者据此提出"跨语言社交策略保真度"这一待检验属性。
AI.method: 被试内同构设计：买卖双方均为同一模型（Gemini 3.6 Flash），在同一12个CraigslistBargain场景中进行英语与韩语谈判。2×2×3析因设计交叉交互语言、卖方紧迫性（无/强）、买方人格（合作/中立/强势），共432次谈判尝试。另用Qwen3.7 Flash作为双方代理完整复现以做模型层面的方向性验证，并对语用层面（面子威胁行为与礼貌缓和）进行编码分析。
AI.result: 韩语达成率显著高于英语（77.3% vs 52.5%，差24.8点，Holm校正 p=.0039），但该差距仅出现在中立与强势买方条件下，合作买方在两种语言中均已接近天花板。开局报价几乎无语言差异，差距产生于后期：韩语中卖方让步更大、最终价差更小、成交价更低。Qwen3.7 Flash复现得到方向一致的结果（+13.9点，置信区间下界近零），卖方同样让步更多。语用分析显示两种语言都高频出现拒绝、还价等面子威胁行为，但韩语用更多礼貌缓和手段加以软化，卖方尤其明显（11.7% vs 3.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 仅改变交互语言，提示定义的社交策略即可产生实质不同的模拟谈判行为，而非仅是措辞差异；这对多语言LLM代理的策略遵从性、跨语言实验可比性及基于LLM的社会模拟研究构成直接警示，并提示语用礼貌规范是关键的机制性中介。

title: Diagnosing Prototype Estimation in Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning: Training-Free Geometry Selection and Unlabeled-Query Prototype Rectification
summary: Frozen visual encoders make prototype heads competitive in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), but it remains unclear how much of the residual head gap is sensitive to noisy novel-class means rather than to the subsequent changes introduced by classifier refitting. On identical features, we construct a retrospective matched counterfactual: first replace each five-shot novel mean with its complete-data counterpart under fixed cosine scoring, then fit a linear probe. Across sixteen strong encoder dataset pairs, mean replacement accounts for the majority of this ordered gap. Shot and classwise diagnostics support a finite-sample mechanism, whereas a weaker base-only encoder does not satisfy the same criterion. This diagnosis motivates ShrinkSel, a support-only selector over prototype radius and covariance shrinkage whose family contains shared LDA as an exact fallback. Across sixteen evaluated pairs, it improves LDA on fifteen by 0.04-1.52 points and selects the exact LDA endpoint on Aircraft. We further introduce Query Prototype Rectification (QPR), a batch-transductive extension that uses gated unlabeled queries to update novel directions while preserving the selected geometry. On CLIP ViT-B/16, QPR adds 1.21-2.03 points; exact query-wise self-exclusion retains the benefit, showing that the gains do not require self-inclusion. The update repairs scarce novel prototypes at a measurable base-class cost and weakens with plentiful supports or very small cohorts. Thus, the evidence available for prototype estimation is a central constraint in frozen-feature FSCIL.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过匹配反事实实验证明冻结特征FSCIL中原型头残差主要源于新类均值的小样本噪声，并提出ShrinkSel选择器与Query Prototype Rectification提升原型估计。
AI.motivation: 冻结视觉编码器下原型头在FSCIL中仍与后续分类器重拟合存在差距，但不清楚这部分残差差距到底由新类均值的噪声主导，还是由重拟合本身引入。
AI.method: 在同特征上构造回顾式匹配反事实：先将每个五样本新类均值替换为完整数据均值（固定余弦打分），再拟合线性探针；并做shot与类内诊断。据此提出ShrinkSel——仅用support数据在原型半径与协方差收缩上做选择，家族包含共享LDA作为精确回退点；再加QPR，用门控无标签查询更新新方向但保持所选几何。
AI.result: 16对强编码器-数据集上，均值替换解释了该有序差距的大部分，支持有限样本机制；弱base-only编码器不满足同一判据。ShrinkSel在15/16对上较LDA提升0.04–1.52点，Aircraft上选到精确LDA端点。CLIP ViT-B/16上QPR再增1.21–2.03点，严格逐查询自排除仍保留增益。
AI.conclusion: 原型估计可用的证据量是冻结特征FSCIL的核心约束；QPR以可测的base类代价修复稀缺新原型，支持充分或类群极小时收益减弱。

title: Early Stopping in Large Reasoning Models: A Survey and Empirical Audit of Efficiency and Reliability
summary: Large reasoning models can improve accuracy by generating longer reasoning traces, but some of this computation may be unnecessary. Early-stopping methods aim to stop once enough reasoning is available to answer. Evaluating these methods requires accounting for the cost of deciding when to stop and the reliability of the resulting answer. We evaluate different methods across five reasoning models on mathematical and scientific reasoning, code generation, and factuality tasks by using a shared rollout replay protocol. We introduce Target-Integrated Token Efficiency (TITE) to measure efficiency relative to the oracle across accuracy targets. We also examine correctness at later exit positions, transfer across models and tasks, post-stop reasoning continuation, and retained justification quality. In our experiments, correctness can decrease at later positions beyond what the fitted decoding-noise model predicts. Reliability checks also reveal continued reasoning after forced termination and weaker supporting reasoning in some correct early-stopping outputs. The implementation can be found in https://github.com/hung20gg/audit-early-stopping.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测大推理模型的早停方法：在共享rollout replay协议下比较五种模型在数学/科学推理、代码生成、事实性任务上的表现，并提出Target-Integrated Token Efficiency（TITE）指标衡量相对oracle的效率，同时检验后位正确性、跨模型/任务迁移、停止后推理延续与理由质量。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型依赖更长的推理链提升准确率，但部分计算可能冗余；早停方法可在获得足够推理时停止，然而评估这些方法需计入"判断何时停止"的成本与答案可靠性，现有评测往往忽视这两点。
AI.method: 采用共享rollout replay协议对不同早停方法进行统一评估；覆盖五个推理模型与数学、科学推理、代码生成、事实性任务；提出TITE指标，测量在多个准确率目标下相对oracle的效率；并分析退出位置后续的正确性变化、跨模型与任务迁移、强制终止后的推理延续，以及保留理由的质量。
AI.result: 在较晚退出位置上，正确率下降幅度超出拟合的解码噪声模型预测；可靠性检查发现强制终止后模型仍继续推理，且部分正确早停输出中的支撑性推理较弱。
AI.conclusion: 早停方法的收益需在计入停止决策成本与可靠性后谨慎评估；现有方法存在后位正确性退化、强制停止不可靠、理由质量下降等问题，提示需要更严谨的评测协议与指标。

title: Interpretable structural temperature scaling for calibrating graph neural networks and point-cloud segmentation
comment: Under consideration at Pattern Recognition Letters. 7 pages, 6 tables, 1 figure; supplementary material in ancillary files
summary: Graph-aware calibrators make graph neural networks (GNNs) more trustworthy by predicting a temperature for each node, usually with auxiliary networks whose decisions are hard to inspect. We propose Interpretable Structural Temperature Scaling (ISTS), a twelve-parameter linear model that sets each node's temperature from named descriptors of its confidence, neighbourhood and closeness to labelled nodes, so every temperature traces back to descriptor contributions. ISTS preserves predictions, and cross-validated regularisation lets the calibration data decide how far the model departs from temperature scaling (TS). Its explanations are faithful at the level of node groups: on test nodes, ISTS softens groups that a global temperature leaves over-confident and sharpens under-confident ones (Spearman correlation 0.67 over 246 groups). On seven graphs with two backbones and eleven baselines, ISTS has the best average rank in negative log-likelihood (NLL) and Brier score and lowers NLL relative to TS by 1.8%, more than twice the gain of an identically fitted entropy-based temperature. It ranked first again on four held-out graphs under a protocol fixed in advance. From about 100 calibration nodes on, ISTS is a cheap and inspectable choice, and on point-cloud segmentation it significantly improves NLL, Brier score and the ranking of points for rejection.

AI.tldr: ISTS 是一个十二参数线性温度缩放模型，用节点置信度、邻域和接近标注节点的可解释描述符为每个节点预测温度，在七个图和多个基线上取得最优平均排名并显著降低 NLL。
AI.motivation: 现有图感知校准器用辅助网络为每个节点预测温度，决策过程难以审查，缺乏可信度。作者希望温度预测可追溯、可解释。
AI.method: 提出 ISTS，一个十二参数线性模型，基于命名描述符（节点置信度、邻域信息、与标注节点的接近程度）为每个节点设定温度，使每个温度可追溯到描述符贡献；保持预测不变，并用交叉验证正则化让校准数据决定偏离全局温度缩放（TS）的程度。
AI.result: 在测试节点上，ISTS 软化被全局温度过度自信的组、锐化欠自信的组（246 组上 Spearman 相关 0.67）；在七个图、两个骨干、十一个基线上，NLL 与 Brier 分数平均排名第一，相对 TS 降低 NLL 1.8%，超过同等拟合的基于熵的温度两倍；在四个预先设定协议的留出图上再次排名第一；在点云分割上显著改善 NLL、Brier 分数和拒绝排序。
AI.conclusion: 从约 100 个校准节点起，ISTS 是廉价且可检查的选择，兼具可解释性与校准性能优势。

title: State-Dependent Memristor Dynamics for Device-Informed Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity in Spiking Neural Networks
summary: This work investigates device-informed spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP) in spiking neural networks using a literature-derived threshold-memristor model. Local STDP commands determine programming polarity and a programming coordinate for state-dependent conductance updates in the first fully connected layer, while a backpropagation-trained readout performs classification. HSPICE simulations characterize thresholded, polarity- and state-dependent device dynamics and differential crossbar multiply-accumulate behavior. Experiments on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST compare the hybrid learning rule with direct clipped STDP and evaluate programming asymmetry, device-parameter variation, write noise, stuck-at faults, and input corruption. The hybrid model achieved 95.15% accuracy on MNIST and 85.92% on Fashion-MNIST. In a separate seed-matched comparison, it reached 95.02% and 84.79%, versus 92.33% and 83.25% for direct clipped STDP. Potentiation-dominant asymmetry reduced input-dependent feature selectivity, and endpoint faults introduced during training were less damaging than faults introduced after training. The network-level mapping is a reduced-order, validation-selected abstraction rather than a pulse-accurate physical programming implementation. These results quantify how state-dependent memristor dynamics shape local-STDP learning and its sensitivity to hardware nonidealities.

AI.tldr: 该工作用文献推导的阈值忆阻器模型，在脉冲神经网络第一全连接层实现器件感知的STDP局部学习，读出层用反向传播训练，并在MNIST/Fashion-MNIST上评估了器件非理想性影响。
AI.motivation: 将STDP与忆阻器交叉阵列结合是有前景的片上学习方案，但局部STDP受器件阈值、极性依赖、状态依赖动态等非理想特性影响，其网络级学习效果与鲁棒性尚缺量化研究。
AI.method: 采用文献推导的阈值忆阻器模型，用HSPICE仿真刻画阈值化、极性依赖与状态依赖的器件动态及差分交叉阵列乘累加行为。第一全连接层由局部STDP指令决定编程极性和编程坐标以进行状态依赖电导更新，读出层由反向传播训练。在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上与直接截断STDP对比，并评估编程不对称、器件参数变化、写噪声、固定故障与输入损坏。
AI.result: 混合学习在MNIST达95.15%、Fashion-MNIST达85.92%；同种子对比为95.02%/84.79%，直接截断STDP为92.33%/83.25%。增强占优的不对称性降低输入相关特征选择性；训练期引入的端点故障比训练后引入的损害更小。
AI.conclusion: 结果量化了状态依赖忆阻器动态如何塑造局部STDP学习及其对硬件非理想性的敏感性。作者指出网络级映射是降阶、经验证筛选的抽象，而非脉冲精确的物理编程实现。

title: SAMP: Self-Adaptive Margin Prioritization For Robust Diffusion Watermarking
summary: Diffusion models have made high-fidelity visual generation widely accessible, while also lowering the barrier to producing convincing visual forgeries and complicating content provenance. Existing watermarking methods typically use a fixed embedding strength throughout denoising or treat all watermark dimensions equally. As a result, they may introduce unnecessary distortion when some watermark dimensions are already reliable, while failing to sufficiently reinforce those that are more vulnerable to subsequent perturbations. Therefore, robust watermarking requires adapting both the embedding strength during denoising and the optimization priority across watermark dimensions. To address this problem, we present SAMP, a self-adaptive framework consisting of global margin regulation and vulnerability-sensitive allocation. Global margin regulation adjusts the embedding strength according to the separation between the target codeword and competing codewords, together with the estimated effects of common attacks. Vulnerability-sensitive allocation identifies watermark dimensions that are more easily weakened by local perturbations and gives them higher optimization priority. Experimental results demonstrate that SAMP achieves an average information recovery accuracy of 0.993. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, SAMP improves PSNR by 16.8% and reduces LPIPS by 47.1%. These results validate the effectiveness of SAMP for reliable and high-quality diffusion watermarking.

AI.tldr: SAMP是一种自适应扩散模型水印框架，通过全局间隔调节与脆弱性敏感分配，动态调整嵌入强度和码字维度优化优先级，实现高鲁棒、高质量的生成内容水印。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散水印方法在去噪过程中使用固定嵌入强度，或对所有水印维度一视同仁，导致部分维度已可靠时仍引入不必要失真，而对易受攻击的维度又强化不足，难以兼顾鲁棒性与视觉质量。
AI.method: 提出SAMP框架，包含两部分：全局间隔调节（根据目标码字与竞争码字的分离度及常见攻击的估计影响，自适应调整嵌入强度）和脆弱性敏感分配（识别易被局部扰动削弱的水印维度，给予更高优化优先级）。
AI.result: 平均信息恢复准确率达0.993；相比SOTA方法，PSNR提升16.8%，LPIPS降低47.1%。
AI.conclusion: SAMP通过自适应嵌入强度与维度级优化优先级，有效兼顾水印鲁棒性与生成质量，验证了其在可靠、高质量扩散水印中的有效性。

title: DERED: Enhancing Third-Party Library Detection in Binaries via Deceptive Reuse Mitigation
summary: This paper introduces the concept of deceptive reuse a misleading reuse relationship between recipient software that share common TPL code and proposes a novel approach, DERED, to enhance TPL detection by distinguishing between real reuse and deceptive reuse.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"欺骗性复用"概念，并设计DERED方法，通过区分真实复用与欺骗性复用来提升第三方库(TPL)检测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有TPL检测方法仅依据代码相似性判断复用关系，忽略了共享相同TPL代码的软件之间可能存在误导性的复用关系，导致检测误判。
AI.method: 提出欺骗性复用概念，并构建DERED方法，从代码相似关系中甄别真实复用与欺骗性复用，以改进TPL检测。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据或量化结果。
AI.conclusion: DERED通过引入欺骗性复用的区分能力，有望提升TPL检测的可靠性；但摘要信息有限，其效果仍需实验验证。

title: How Much Can Approximate Equilibria Change the Social Cost of Selfish Routing?
summary:
We study approximate Nash equilibria in nonatomic congestion games, with the goal of understanding how much the social cost can change when the equilibrium condition is relaxed. We consider $ε$-approximate Nash equilibria ($ε$-NE), in which each player uses a strategy whose cost is at most $1 + ε$ times the minimum available cost. We compare the social costs of $ε$-NE and exact Nash equilibria. This lets us quantify, for example, how much a navigation app can reduce total travel time when drivers tolerate routes slightly slower than the fastest available route.
  For degree-$d$ polynomial latencies in both general nonatomic congestion games and single-commodity routing games on series-parallel networks, we give tight lower and upper bounds on the relative change in social cost from an exact Nash equilibrium to any $ε$-NE, with matching instances for every $ε$. For small $ε$, the largest possible relative reduction and increase in general congestion games are both $Θ(\sqrt{dε})$, independently of the number of resources and populations. In contrast, on series-parallel networks of depth $h$, the largest possible relative reduction is $Θ(hε)$, while the largest possible relative increase is known to be $ε$. For the classes of games we study, these results give a tight and quantitative characterization of the possible changes in social cost and establish a separation between general and series-parallel networks.

AI.tldr: 研究非原子拥堵博弈中ε-近似纳什均衡（ε-NE）与精确NE的社会成本差异，对度d多项式时延在一般网络与串并联网络上给出紧的上下界。
AI.motivation: 旨在量化当均衡条件被放松时社会成本可能变化多少，例如导航应用使司机容忍略慢路线时能减少多少总通行时间。
AI.method: 定义ε-NE（每名玩家所用策略成本至多为可选最小成本的1+ε倍），比较ε-NE与精确NE的社会成本；针对度d多项式时延，在一般非原子拥堵博弈与单商品串并联网络路由博弈中推导相对社会成本变化的紧界，并对每个ε构造匹配实例。
AI.result: 小ε下，一般拥堵博弈中最大相对减少与增加均为Θ(√(dε))，与资源数和种群数无关；深度h的串并联网络上最大相对减少为Θ(hε)，最大相对增加为已知的ε。
AI.conclusion: 对所研究博弈类给出了社会成本可能变化的紧的定量刻画，并建立了一般网络与串并联网络之间的分离。

title: PACT: Defending Recommendation against Promotional News Rewriting via Attack-Diverse Score Consistency
summary: Personalized news recommenders are increasingly vulnerable to LLM-powered promotional attacks, where content providers rephrase headlines to manipulate rankings without altering underlying facts. Defending against such manipulation requires covering a wide spectrum of LLM generators and optimization strategies--ranging from stylistic prompting to reinforcement feedback--without incurring prohibitive training or inference costs. In this work, we present PACT (Pooled Attack Consistency Training), a model-agnostic defense that decouples relevance estimation from superficial rhetorical variations. PACT integrates three synergistic operations: it pools offline, fact-checked rewrites from multi-generator and multi-strategy attack sources; samples a constant number of variants at each training visit to yield an unbiased estimator of the pool-wide consistency objective under a fixed compute budget; and aligns original and rewritten ranking scores within the same user context jointly with click supervision. Requiring no architectural modifications or test-time filtering, PACT deploys the trained recommender with zero extra latency. Across nine experimental settings spanning three recommendation backbones and three unseen-generator attacks, PACT consistently achieves the lowest promotion rate and target exposure, outperforming the strongest defense baseline by up to 3.0 percentage points in promotion reduction under LANCE. Further evaluations verify that PACT's superiority holds robustly under unseen attack-strategy holdouts and adaptive white-box retraining, while keeping clean recommendation utility virtually intact.

AI.tldr: PACT是一种模型无关的新闻推荐防御方法，通过池化多生成器、多策略的改写攻击样本，并在训练中采样变体对齐原始与改写内容的排序分数，从而抵御LLM驱动的促销攻击，且零额外推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 个性化新闻推荐系统面临LLM驱动的促销攻击：内容提供方通过改写标题操纵排名而不改变事实。防御需覆盖广泛的LLM生成器与优化策略，同时避免过高的训练或推理成本。
AI.method: PACT（Pooled Attack Consistency Training）包含三项协同操作：1）池化来自多生成器、多策略攻击源的离线且经事实核查的改写样本；2）每次训练访问采样固定数量的变体，在固定计算预算下得到池级一致性目标的无偏估计；3）在同一用户上下文中，结合点击监督联合对齐原始与改写内容的排序分数。无需架构修改或测试时过滤。
AI.result: 在三个推荐骨干、三种未见生成器攻击共九个实验设置中，PACT均取得最低促销率和目标曝光，在LANCE下相较最强基线促销降低最多3.0个百分点。在未见攻击策略留出和自适应白盒重训练下依然稳健，且几乎不损失干净推荐效用。
AI.conclusion: PACT提供了一种高效、模型无关、零推理延迟的推荐系统抗促销攻击防御方案，具备良好的泛化性与实用性。

title: GAVAGAI: Referential Alignment for Infant-Scale Vision-Language Models via Balanced Optimal Transport
comment: Accepted in NeuriPs 2026 workshop "The BabyVLM Workshop Toward Developmentally Plausible Multimodal Systems"
summary: A child learns which words name which things from roughly 100 million words of input. Vision-language models trained at a comparable scale bind words to referents far less reliably, and we argue that part of the gap is structural: the usual next-token captioning objective has no variable standing for "this word refers to that region," so training applies no direct pressure to ground words. We add such a variable by treating each scene as a small assignment problem between the content words heard and the regions seen, solved as entropic optimal transport under two constraints. First, a word may be assigned to a special NOTHING column instead of any region, which matters because most content words in caregiver speech do not name anything visible. Second, no region may receive more than a bounded share of the assignment mass, a capacity constraint that encodes mutual exclusivity. The alignment step costs about eight Sinkhorn iterations, small next to the vision encoder. In controlled simulation, the naive version of the idea, a row-wise softmax that forces every word onto some region, collapses to 0.000 word-to-picture accuracy under realistic non-reference rates, below the 0.058 of captioning alone, while our two constraints reach 0.075 in that regime and 0.700 on clean input. A one-parameter version of the model reproduces adult cross-situational learning accuracy across three ambiguity conditions (RMSE 0.024). On the SAYCam infant video corpus, adding the alignment loss to a next-token captioning model raises word-to-picture accuracy from 32.4% to 48.7% and localization IoU from 0.18 to 0.38. A contrastive model trained on the same child's data remains stronger on its own benchmark, so our claim is that the loss improves a captioning objective under high non-reference rates, not that it sets a new best.

AI.tldr: 通过将“内容词—图像区域”映射建模为带 NOTHING 列与容量约束的熵最优传输，显式加入指代变量，使视觉-语言模型在高非指代率下实现可靠词—图对齐。
AI.motivation: 儿童约从1亿词输入中学会词所指，而同等规模训练的视觉语言模型在词—指代绑定上远不如儿童；作者认为部分是结构性问题：常规下一词预测/描述目标中不存在“此词指代该区域”的变量，训练对词接地无直接压力。
AI.method: 把每个场景视为“所听内容词”与“所见区域”之间的小型指派问题，用熵最优传输求解，并加两项约束：(1) 每个词可被分配到特殊 NOTHING 列而非任意区域，以处理看护语中多数内容词不指代可见物的情况；(2) 每个区域接收的指派质量有上界，编码互斥性。对齐步约需8次 Sinkhorn 迭代，开销远小于视觉编码器。
AI.result: 仿真中，强制每词必有区域的逐行 softmax 版本在现实非指代率下降到0.000词—图准确率（低于纯描述模型的0.058），而双约束版本在该情形达0.075、干净输入达0.700。单参数版本在三种歧义条件下复现成人跨情境学习准确率（RMSE 0.024）。在 SAYCam 婴儿视频语料上，将对齐损失加入下一词描述模型后，词—图准确率由32.4%升至48.7%，定位 IoU 由0.18升至0.38。
AI.conclusion: 对齐损失可在高非指代率下改进描述目标，但并非刷新最优：同一儿童数据训练的对比模型在其自身基准上仍更强。作者主张的是该损失对描述目标的增益，而非新的最佳结果。

title: FORCE: Factorized Object Relations for Counterfactual Editing in Video World Models
summary: World models predict how scenes evolve, but they are difficult to interrogate: given a model that forecasts a video, one cannot easily ask what would have happened had a particular interaction between two objects been different. We present Factorized Object Relations for Counterfactual Editing (FORCE), a world model that infers pairwise interactions from raw video without supervision and represents each as an explicit latent per object pair, so that a relation can be removed, changed, transferred or introduced directly. Objects are extracted by slot attention over frozen self-supervised features; a relation encoder infers each pair latent from a short observation window, and an interaction head turns it into a force. The latent is held fixed across the rollout, so an edit persists rather than being recomputed, and every edit acts on the model's own quantities with no mapping to simulator parameters. We evaluate in a simulated environment where the true outcome of an edit is available, scoring the change each edit induces against the change the simulator produces under the same operation. On held-out clips, FORCE's edits made from video agree with the simulator's response at 0.19 to 0.37 on our effect-based score; trained and scored on exact object positions instead, the same architecture reaches 0.57 to 0.85. The gap therefore lies not in the learned relational dynamics but in perception: what bounds an edit is how precisely objects can be located from video, and the precision editing needs lies just beyond what current object-centric perception delivers. Closing that gap is a concrete target for making counterfactual world models work from video.

AI.tldr: FORCE 是一种从原始视频无监督学习物体对显式关系潜变量的世界模型，可直接对关系进行删除/替换/迁移/新增等反事实编辑；实验表明瓶颈在感知精度而非关系动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型难以干预：给定能预测视频的模型，无法方便地询问"若两个物体的某种交互不同会怎样"。作者希望交互关系成为可显式编辑的量，且编辑能持续作用于模型自身内部量，无需映射回仿真器参数。
AI.method: 用槽注意力（slot attention）在冻结的自监督特征上提取物体；关系编码器从短观测窗口推断每对物体的关系潜变量，交互头将其转成力；该潜变量在 rollout 过程中保持固定，使编辑持续生效而非被重算；编辑操作直接作用于模型内部量。
AI.result: 在可获真实编辑结果的仿真环境中，以"编辑引发的改变 vs 仿真器同操作产生的改变"为效应分数：基于视频的编辑得分 0.19–0.37；同样架构改用精确物体位置训练与评分则达 0.57–0.85。
AI.conclusion: 性能差距不来自学习到的关系动力学，而来自感知：编辑的上限取决于从视频中定位物体的精度，而编辑所需精度略超当前物体中心感知能力；提升物体定位精度是让视频级反事实世界模型可行的明确目标。

title: PatchScout: Thematic Web Data Collection via Information Foraging
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, to be published in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 2026
summary: Researchers often need web corpora that are not answers to a single query, but reusable collections of documents spanning many decentralized sources. We refer to this problem as thematic web data collection: assembling semantically relevant documents that share a common theme but are scattered across heterogeneous and structurally disconnected regions of the web. Existing approaches, including traversal-based methods and LLM-driven web agents, are limited by local exploration or short-horizon stopping, preventing comprehensive collection. We formulate this task as a long-horizon information foraging problem over query-induced semantic patches, where the central challenge is deciding when to continue local exploitation and when to switch to new regions. We propose PatchScout, a multi-agent framework that instantiates a class of patch-switching policies to balance local exploitation and adaptive patch switching under a fixed budget. Experiments on four live-web topics show that PatchScout substantially improves yield and domain coverage over traversal-based and search-augmented reasoning agent baselines. In an applied social science setting with an incomplete prior collection, PatchScout discovers 102 previously unidentified entities, illustrating its ability to expand existing thematic datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出"主题式网络数据采集"任务，将其建模为语义补丁上的长时程信息觅食问题，用多智能体框架 PatchScout 通过补丁切换策略平衡局部开发与区域切换。
AI.motivation: 研究者常需要跨多个去中心化来源、围绕共同主题的可复用文档集合，而非单一查询的答案；现有基于遍历或 LLM 网页智能体的方法受限于局部探索和短时程停止，难以全面采集。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为查询诱导语义补丁（query-induced semantic patches）上的长时程信息觅食问题，核心是决定何时继续局部开发、何时切换到新区域；PatchScout 为多智能体框架，实例化一类补丁切换策略，在固定预算下平衡开发与自适应切换。
AI.result: 在四个实时网络主题上，PatchScout 在产出量和域名覆盖度上显著优于遍历式方法和搜索增强推理智能体基线；在带有不完整既有采集的社会科学应用中，新发现 102 个此前未识别的实体。
AI.conclusion: PatchScout 能有效实现全面主题采集并扩展现有主题数据集，验证了补丁切换策略在长时程网络信息觅食中的价值。

title: ProLand: A New Infeasible Manifold Optimization Method for LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning but can suffer from redundant basis directions. Constraining the basis factor to the Stiefel manifold addresses this redundancy through orthonormality. Landing methods allow temporarily infeasible iterates to explore a neighborhood of the manifold while progressively restoring orthogonality without per-step retractions. To improve optimization efficiency while retaining this flexibility, we introduce ProLand (Product-space Landing), a retraction-free optimizer that combines coordinated factor updates with Muon-style spectral directions. By designing the updates in the space of the represented weight increment, ProLand separates objective optimization from orthogonality restoration, supporting efficient feasibility recovery. This coordinated construction also enables Muon-style directions to guide objective optimization while preserving that separation. Experiments cover four GLUE validation tasks on DeBERTa-v3-base and seven language benchmarks on Qwen2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-3B, and Moonlight-16B-A3B across multiple adapter ranks. Across these 11 tasks, ProLand achieves the highest average score among the compared methods in every tested encoder and decoder model-rank configuration.

AI.tldr: ProLand 是一种无需 retraction 的 LoRA 优化器，通过在权重增量空间协调更新因子并结合 Muon 式谱方向，将目标优化与正交性恢复分离，从而高效地在 Stiefel 流形附近优化。
AI.motivation: LoRA 存在基方向冗余问题，将基因子约束到 Stiefel 流形可通过正交归一性缓解；landing 方法虽有灵活性但优化效率不高。
AI.method: 提出 ProLand（Product-space Landing）：在表示的权重增量空间中设计更新，协调因子更新并使用 Muon 式谱方向，使目标优化与正交性恢复解耦，无需每步 retraction，同时保持 Muon 方向对目标优化的引导。
AI.result: 在 DeBERTa-v3-base 的 4 个 GLUE 验证任务，以及 Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-3B、Moonlight-16B-A3B 的 7 个语言基准上，覆盖多个 adapter rank，ProLand 在所有 11 项任务及每种编码器/解码器-秩配置中平均分最高。
AI.conclusion: ProLand 兼顾流形约束的灵活性与优化效率，在多种模型与秩配置下稳定优于对比方法，是有效的参数高效微调优化方案。

title: Is Newborn Wiring Special? Separating Wiring from Weight Placement in Connectome Reservoirs
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Developmental Perspectives on AI (DevAI). 17 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/Riccardo8888/connectome-reservoir-nulls
summary: Reservoir computing offers a way to study the brain's wiring before it is even trained. The recurrent network remains fixed, while only a linear readout is trained. The human connectome is found to perform better than randomly rewired versions of itself, suggesting that biological wiring is special. To understand the source of this advantage, a mathematical graph-theoretic decomposition is introduced. Rewiring a weighted network changes both the regions that are connected and the weights assigned to those connections. The observed advantage therefore combines an effect of wiring with an effect of weight placement. These effects are separated by averaging the wiring term over the null model's weight rule, as a single draw introduces about one z-unit of noise. Adult and infant connectomes are then considered separately. In adult Human Connectome Project graphs, weight placement explains most of the reported effect, leaving a small but consistent wiring effect. Across the full dHCP release, a large wiring effect is found at every measured gestational age at birth, while gestational age explains almost none of its variance. The connectomes are also compared with non-brain networks. A Watts-Strogatz graph matched in size, edge count, weights, and strength performs as well as or better than the connectome. The newborn connectome's advantage is therefore real across all measured gestational ages, but it is not unique to the brain. The same separation can be applied whenever a weighted network is compared with rewired nulls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将重连加权网络的效应分解为"接线效应"与"权重放置效应"，发现成人连接组的优势主要来自权重放置，而婴儿连接组存在大且稳定的接线效应，但该效应并非大脑独有。
AI.motivation: 储层计算中固定网络、仅训练线性读出，人类连接组表现优于其随机重连版本，被解读为生物接线特殊。但重连加权网络同时改变了连接区域和权重，因此观察到的优势混杂了接线与权重放置两种效应，需加以分离。
AI.method: 引入图论分解，将接线项在零模型权重规则上取平均以消除权重混杂（单次抽样约引入1个z单位噪声）；分别分析成人HCP连接组与dHCP婴儿连接组，并跨孕龄比较；再与尺寸、边数、权重和强度匹配的Watts-Strogatz图对比。
AI.result: 成人HCP中权重放置解释了大部分已报道效应，接线效应小但一致；全dHCP数据中每个测得出生孕龄均有大接线效应，而孕龄几乎不解释其方差；匹配的Watts-Strogatz图表现与连接组相当或更好。
AI.conclusion: 新生儿连接组优势在所有测得孕龄均真实存在，但并非大脑独有；该分离方法可推广到任何加权网络与重连零模型的比较。

title: SHield: Watermarking 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spherical Harmonic Coefficient Perturbation
summary: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) models are computationally expensive to train but distributed as easily copied parameter files. Existing watermarks protect these assets by fine-tuning the scene against a neural decoder to extract bit strings from rendered video, a heavy process vulnerable to the temporal dynamics of dynamic scenes. However, if the threat model targets the redistributed file itself, verification can be vastly simplified. Because the canonical Spherical-Harmonic (SH) coefficients of 4DGS are time- and view-invariant, parameter-space perturbations can be recovered via deterministic arithmetic. We propose **SHield**, the first non-blind, decoder-free watermarking approach that natively embeds full-resolution RGB images into 4DGS files. SHield tiles a zero-mean payload across the SH coefficients of a key-selected Gaussian subset, applying a brief anchored optimization to preserve visual fidelity. To verify ownership, it geometrically re-associates the key using canonical Gaussian centres to survive file tampering and recovers the payload in closed form. Across 30 scenes (D-NeRF, HyperNeRF, DyNeRF), SHield guarantees near-perfect payload recovery (Pearson $r \geq 0.991$) on all 150 tested models with a mean rendering penalty of $\leq 0.13$~dB. Held-out evaluation yields perfect detection on 400 true trials and zero false positives across $1{,}600$ wrong-subset null trials. We also strictly bound the method's robustness: SHield survives INT8 quantization and $30\%$ opacity pruning for the image payload, and on aggressive SH-degree-1 truncation bit payloads are still decodable.

AI.tldr: SHield 是首个面向 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) 文件的非盲、无解码器水印方法，将全分辨率 RGB 图像载荷嵌入 spherical-harmonic 系数，可在参数空间闭式恢复。
AI.motivation: 4DGS 训练成本高但以易复制的参数文件分发；现有水印依赖微调场景+神经解码器从渲染视频提取比特串，代价高且受动态场景时序影响。若威胁模型针对的是被再分发的文件本身，验证可大幅简化。
AI.method: 利用 4DGS 的 canonical SH 系数具有时间与视角不变性，可用确定性算术恢复参数扰动。SHield 将零均值载荷平铺到密钥选定高斯子集的 SH 系数上，并用简短锚定优化保持视觉保真度；验证时通过 canonical Gaussian 中心几何重关联密钥以抵御文件篡改，并闭式恢复载荷。
AI.result: 在 30 个场景（D-NeRF、HyperNeRF、DyNeRF）、150 个模型上实现近乎完美的载荷恢复（Pearson r ≥ 0.991），平均渲染损失 ≤ 0.13 dB。留出评估中 400 次真试验全部检出、1,600 次错误子集零假阳性。鲁棒性方面：图像载荷可抵抗 INT8 量化与 30% opacity 剪枝，SH 度数-1 截断下比特载荷仍可解码。
AI.conclusion: 当威胁模型为文件级再分发时，参数空间水印比渲染视频解码更高效可靠；SHield 以无解码器、闭式恢复方式实现高保真嵌入与稳健验证，并严格界定了其鲁棒性边界。

title: AgentPRO: Coordinating Compiler Optimizations for LLM Agent Workflows
summary:
LLM agents repeatedly return to a model to generate actions and interpret tool results, incurring repeated context processing and generation overhead. Yet a value needed to execute an action need not be observed by the model to generate that action. This distinction creates an optimization opportunity: reconsider where model decisions are necessary, together with the work performed between them.
  We present AgentPRO, a compiler framework for optimizing agent workflows as execution information becomes available. AgentPRO organizes planned duties, generation regions, and concrete operations in a hierarchical representation, distinguishing execution dependencies from observations required for generation. Region transformations combine compatible duties into fewer model requests, while operation transformations reduce redundant context and tool work.
