These scopes interact: eliminating a redundant read can remove an observation requirement that otherwise separates generation regions. AgentPRO coordinates transformations using initial plans, current observations, and historical execution profiles through just-in-time, adaptive, and profile-guided optimization. Runtime guards check state-dependent assumptions and retain fallback paths.
  We implement guarded workflow transformations for AppWorld agents. On 115 tasks selected by successful historical baseline executions, automatic AgentPRO reduces all-attempt mean token consumption by 41.85% and mean component time by 6.61% relative to those baselines, successfully completing 110 of 115 tasks.

AI.tldr: AgentPRO 是一个用于优化 LLM agent 工作流的编译器框架，通过区分"执行所需信息"与"生成所需观察"，合并生成区域并消除冗余操作，在 AppWorld 上减少 41.85% token 消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 反复调用模型生成动作并解释工具返回，带来重复的上下文处理和生成开销。但执行某个动作所需的值并不一定需要被模型观察到才能生成该动作，这一区别提供了优化空间：重新审视哪些决策必须由模型完成，以及决策之间执行的工作。
AI.method: 提出 AgentPRO 编译器框架，采用分层表示组织计划职责、生成区域和具体操作，区分执行依赖与生成所需观察。区域变换将兼容职责合并为更少的模型请求，操作变换减少冗余上下文与工具操作；两类变换可交互（如消除冗余读取可移除分隔生成区域的观察需求）。通过即时、自适应和基于历史执行画像的方式协调变换，并用运行时守卫检查依赖状态的假设、保留回退路径。在 AppWorld agent 上实现了带守卫的工作流变换。
AI.result: 在按历史成功基线执行筛选出的 115 个任务上，自动 AgentPRO 相对基线将全尝试平均 token 消耗降低 41.85%，平均组件时间降低 6.61%，并成功完成 115 个任务中的 110 个。
AI.conclusion: 通过编译视角显式区分执行依赖与生成观察，并对生成区域和操作进行协调变换，可显著降低 LLM agent 工作流的 token 与时间开销，同时借助运行时守卫基本保持任务成功率。

title: The Stability of Data Exchange in Competitive Markets
summary:
We study the stability of data exchange among competing firms. Unlike tangible goods, data is non-rival: sharing it does not deprive the giver of its use. On one hand, competing firms-- often operating as machine-learning-driven predictors that collect observations from a shared environment to solve similar tasks-- can improve their predictive accuracies from pooling data. On the other hand, they compete for market share, which may depend on their relative predictive performance. This raises the central question of this paper: can there be a stable data exchange in such competitive environments?
  We formalize this via a model of $n$ firms exchanging fractions of their datasets, with predictive performance feeding into market competition. We adopt core stability as our solution concept, accounting for externalities via worst-case responses by non-participating firms. Our main results reveal a sharp contrast driven by demand structure: (i) in fully rational markets, where customers flock entirely to the top-performing firm, a core-stable exchange always exists for any monotone continuous prediction functions; (ii) in partially rational markets with logit-style demand, core-stable exchanges may fail to exist-and even approximate cores can be empty. Our impossibility results suggest that internal profit-sharing within coalitions can restore stability in partially rational markets. We formalize this intuition by showing that when co-operating coalitions equally redistribute market-share revenues among members, a core-stable data exchange exists. Finally, we propose a natural exchange dynamic and demonstrate empirically that it converges to a core-stable data exchange in fully rational markets on simulated instances derived from real datasets.

AI.tldr: 研究竞争企业间数据交换的稳定性，发现需求结构决定核心稳定交换是否存在：完全理性市场总存在，logit需求的部分理性市场可能不存在，而内部利润共享可恢复稳定性。
AI.motivation: 数据具有非竞争性，企业共享数据可提升预测精度，但企业又在市场份额上竞争，因此需要研究竞争环境下是否存在稳定的数据交换。
AI.method: 建立n家企业交换数据集比例的模型，预测性能影响市场竞争；采用考虑外部性（非参与企业最坏响应）的核心稳定性作为解概念，并分析不同需求结构。
AI.result: (i) 完全理性市场（客户全流向最优企业）对任意单调连续预测函数总存在核心稳定交换；(ii) 部分理性logit需求下核心稳定交换可能不存在，近似核心也可能为空。
AI.conclusion: 联盟内部利润共享（平等重分市场份额收益）可恢复稳定性；提出自然交换动态并在真实数据模拟中验证其在完全理性市场收敛到核心稳定交换。

title: Where Beam Search Loses Top-Ranked Items:First-Step Coverage in Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation can reproduce a wider beam's ranked output with roughly half the prefix-capacity budget by reallocating retention capacity across semantic-ID positions. We identify a \emph{first-step coverage bottleneck}: across six full-test settings of the TIGER generative recommender spanning three domains and two identifier constructions, every pruned exact top-10 path is first lost at the initial decoding step. An exact-catalog reference isolates search losses and guides a controlled budget intervention. Moving width to the first step raises Search Recall@10 by 0.96--10.90 percentage points at Beam-50's unchanged budget. Across all 77,373 test users with residual-quantized variational autoencoder (RQ-VAE) tokenization, the reallocated schedule reproduces Beam-100's ordered top-10 at nominal budgets of 151 rather than 301, without retraining or changing identifiers or scores. Matched-output timing saves 6.35--6.39\% of decoder latency; profiling identifies the execution costs that limit the translation from reduced search work to runtime savings. Larger-candidate experiments reveal how output size changes retention requirements. These findings make budget placement an actionable serving decision: locate ranking loss, redirect search capacity, and preserve downstream inputs before increasing uniform beam width.

AI.tldr: 生成式推荐中，束搜索的首步覆盖瓶颈导致大部分搜索损失；将前缀容量重新分配到语义ID的前几步，可在不增大总预算、不重训的前提下复现更大束宽的输出。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐（如TIGER）依赖束搜索（beam search）产出排序列表，扩大束宽虽提升召回但显著增加解码开销。作者希望找到更经济的容量使用方式，先定位排序损失主要发生在哪一步，再据此重新分配预算。
AI.method: 在TIGER推荐器的六个全测试设置（三领域、两种标识符构造）上逐级分析精确top-10路径的丢失位置；用精确目录参考隔离搜索损失，并进行受控的预算干预实验——把前缀回收容量从后续语义ID位置前移到初始解码步。配合RQ-VAE分词，在全部77,373名测试用户上对比重新分配调度与Beam-100的输出一致性，并做匹配输出计时与执行开销剖析。
AI.result: 发现“首步覆盖瓶颈”：所有被剪除的精确top-10路径均在初始解码步首次丢失。在Beam-50不变预算下，将宽度移至第一步使Search Recall@10提升0.96–10.90个百分点；重新分配调度在名义预算151（而非301）下复现Beam-100的有序top-10；匹配输出计时节省6.35–6.39%解码延迟，剖析揭示限制搜索工作转化为运行时间收益的执行开销来源；更大候选实验显示了输出规模对保留容量的影响。
AI.conclusion: 预算放置本身是可操作的部署决策：先定位排序损失所在，再重定向搜索容量，并在增大统一束宽之前优先保护好下游所需输入。无需重训、无需改动标识符或打分即可获得等效或更优效果。

title: Queering the Audits: Community-Based Auditing of AI Harms to Queer Communities
comment: Published in Identity Aware AI workshop at LREC 2026
summary: AI systems embed majority-group defaults into training data, evaluation metrics, and category definitions, producing documented harms for queer communities including erasure, misclassification, and discrimination. Standard technical audits often rely on aggregate measures and cannot detect harms that be come visible only through the lived experience of affected communities. We conducted a participatory auditing workshop at EurIPS 2025 where 16 queer community members audited four case studies using the 4Cs harm taxonomy (Content, Conduct, Contact, Contract) applied across the AI lifecycle. Participants used structured worksheets and plenary synthesis to classify harms and trace them to their origins in the development pipeline. Across all four cases, participants traced harms to problem definition and data collection, and they identified contractual structures that extract value from vulnerable populations while providing minimal recourse. These findings illustrate that community-informed auditing surfaces concrete, identity-specific harms that aggregate evaluation methods risk overlooking.

AI.tldr: 本文通过EurIPS 2025的参与式审计工作坊（16名酷儿社区成员、4个案例），用4Cs伤害分类法沿AI生命周期追踪伤害，发现伤害根源多在问题定义与数据收集阶段及契约性结构，并指出社区参与式审计能揭示聚合评估所遗漏的身份特定伤害。
AI.motivation: AI系统将多数群体默认值嵌入训练数据、评估指标与类别定义，对酷儿群体造成抹除、误分类与歧视；而标准技术审计依赖聚合指标，难以发现只有受影响社区亲历才能察觉的伤害。
AI.method: 在EurIPS 2025举办参与式审计工作坊，16名酷儿社区成员使用4Cs伤害分类法（Content、Conduct、Contact、Contract），结合结构化工作表与全体综合讨论，对四个案例的伤害进行分类并溯源至开发生命周期各环节。
AI.result: 四个案例中，参与者均将伤害溯源至问题定义与数据收集阶段，并识别出从弱势群体中攫取价值却几乎不提供救济途径的契约性结构。
AI.conclusion: 社区知情式审计能够揭示具体的、身份特定的伤害，这是聚合评估方法容易忽视的；参与式方法应作为技术审计的补充。

title: Covariance-aware Scoring: A Geometric Correction for Vision-Language Test-Time Adaptation
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, Under review at ICLR2027
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) enables vision--language models such as CLIP to adapt to distribution shifts without labels or access to source data. Existing methods adapt through feature caching, prototype estimation, or the online accumulation of feature statistics, but most ultimately score a test feature against a class representative in the ambient embedding space, typically through cosine similarity. We identify this shared decision rule as a limitation under anisotropic feature distributions, which means when a small number of directions account for a large fraction of feature variance, the score can be dominated by high-variance directions that are not necessarily discriminative. In light of this, we propose CARe, a covariance-aware scoring for TTA that replaces the ambient geometry with a Mahalanobis geometry induced by the target feature second moment. Theoretically, we show that under a shared-covariance Gaussian model the covariance-aware decision direction coincides with that of the Bayes-optimal linear discriminant, with ambient-space scoring as the isotropic special case, and establish that the potential benefit of covariance-aware scoring grows with feature anisotropy. Empirically, we show that CARe improves adaptation accuracy over its base cosine scoring on both standard and fine-grained distribution-shift benchmarks across two backbones. Consistent with our analysis, the gains are largest on datasets whose features are most anisotropic and vanish as the features approach isotropy.

AI.tldr: 提出CARe，用目标特征二阶矩诱导的Mahalanobis几何替代余弦相似度的各向同性几何来打分，提升CLIP测试时自适应在分布偏移下的准确率，且收益随特征各向异性增强而增大。
AI.motivation: 现有TTA方法最终都归结为在原始嵌入空间中用余弦相似度将测试特征与类代表比较。当特征分布各向异性（少数方向占大部分方差）时，得分会被高方差但未必具判别性的方向主导，构成共同决策规则的局限。
AI.method: CARe将环境几何替换为由目标特征二阶矩诱导的Mahalanobis几何进行协方差感知打分；理论上在共享协方差高斯模型下证明该决策方向与Bayes最优线性判别方向一致，余弦打分是各向同性特例。
AI.result: 在两个骨干网络、标准与细粒度分布偏移基准上，CARe均优于其余弦基线；增益在特征最各向异性的数据集上最大，并随特征趋于各向同性而消失，与分析一致。
AI.conclusion: 协方差感知打分是一种简单、可插拔的改进，纠正了TTA中余弦决策规则在高各向异性下的偏差，理论收益与实验趋势相互印证。

title: Reimagining Text-to-SQL: A Survey of Large Language Model Architectures and Strategies
summary: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries, democratizing access to relational data. Early approaches relied on handcrafted rules and template matching, while subsequent neural methods introduced encoder-decoder architectures, schema linking, and constrained decoding to handle increasingly complex queries. The emergence of large language models (LLMs), exemplified by systems such as ReFoRCE, Agentar-Scale-SQL, Snowflake's Arctic-Text2SQL-R1, and the modular XiYan-SQL framework, has dramatically advanced the field, pushing execution accuracy to new state-of-the-art levels on challenging benchmarks such as Spider, Spider 2.0, and BIRD. In parallel, modular frameworks decompose the task into sub-problems (schema retrieval, sketch-based generation, repair, and ranking), while agentic systems coordinate multiple specialized agents that communicate and dynamically allocate sub-tasks. This survey systematically reviews these LLM-driven approaches within a unified taxonomy of five paradigms (in-context learning, supervised and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, agentic and tool-augmented orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and reinforcement learning) and characterizes them by model granularity (monolithic vs. modular), level of supervision (zero-shot, fine-tuned, or reinforcement-based), and reasoning style (direct decoding vs. decomposed multi-step reasoning). We further analyze evaluation metrics, datasets, and open challenges, including domain generalization, efficiency, and real-world deployment, and we examine the role of the semantic layer in production systems. As LLMs increasingly access sensitive databases, we also discuss responsible AI practices. We survey over 100 papers and technical resources, focusing on work published between 2022 and 2026.

AI.tldr: 综述2022–2026年间LLM驱动的Text-to-SQL方法，提出五类范式（ICL、微调/PEFT、智能体与工具编排、RAG、强化学习）的统一分类，并从模型粒度、监督程度、推理风格三个维度刻画，分析评测指标、数据集与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 早期规则/模板与神经编码器-解码器方法难以应对复杂查询，LLM（ReFoRCE、Agentar-Scale-SQL、Arctic-Text2SQL-R1、XiYan-SQL等）已将Spider、Spider 2.0、BIRD上的执行准确率推到新SOTA，但缺乏系统梳理，且生产部署、语义层与负责任AI等问题亟待总结。
AI.method: 对100余篇论文与技术资源进行系统综述：建立五范式统一分类（上下文学习、监督与参数高效微调、智能体与工具增强编排、检索增强生成、强化学习），并沿模型粒度（单体 vs 模块化）、监督水平（零样本/微调/强化）、推理风格（直接解码 vs 分解式多步推理）三维刻画各方法。
AI.result: 归纳出模块化框架（模式检索、草图生成、修复、排序）与多智能体协同两条主流技术路线；梳理评测指标与数据集（Spider、Spider 2.0、BIRD等），并识别领域泛化、效率、真实部署为主要开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: LLM显著提升Text-to-SQL性能，未来需关注跨域泛化与效率、生产系统中的语义层作用，以及访问敏感数据库时的负责任AI实践。

title: IsoAlign: Isoform-Aware DNA-Protein Alignment via Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
summary: Genomic foundation models (GFMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning DNA sequence representations, yet existing self-supervised pretraining strategies overlook alternative splicing and underperform compared to specialized models. To address this gap, we introduce IsoAlign, a multimodal framework that grounds genomic pretraining in isoform-aware DNA-protein alignment to learn biologically meaningful representations. IsoAlign aligns transcripts to their corresponding protein isoforms, capturing both coding sequences and broader regulatory contexts, using two Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA): DNA-Protein JEPA (DP-JEPA), which predicts protein representations from DNA using contrastive alignment, and Isoform-Masked JEPA (IM-JEPA), which models relationships among alternative isoforms of the same gene through masked protein prediction. We evaluate the learned DNA representations of these architectures across a multi-metric evaluation suite spanning tasks, including the prediction of pathogenicity, fitness, gene expression, and TF binding. Our results demonstrate that isoform-aware cross-modal alignment using JEPA significantly improves functional representations and downstream performance, establishing a promising direction for GFM pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 IsoAlign 多模态框架，通过异构体感知的 DNA-蛋白对齐，用两种 JEPA 架构改进基因组基础模型预训练。
AI.motivation: 现有基因组基础模型（GFM）的自监督预训练策略忽略了可变剪接问题，性能不如专用模型，缺乏生物学意义的功能表征。
AI.method: 将转录本对齐到对应蛋白异构体，兼顾编码序列与调控上下文；采用两个联合嵌入预测架构：DP-JEPA（用对比对齐从 DNA 预测蛋白表征）与 IM-JEPA（通过掩码蛋白预测建模同基因不同异构体间关系）。
AI.result: 在多指标评测集上验证（致病性预测、适应度、基因表达、TF 结合），异构体感知的跨模态 JEPA 对齐显著提升功能表征质量和下游任务表现。
AI.conclusion: 异构体感知的跨模态对齐是 GFM 预训练的有前景方向。

title: Exposure-Length Trade-off Optimization for Obstacle-Aware Intrusion Paths in Heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks
comment: Accepted for publication at SuperComputing Journal
summary: Barrier coverage is a key paradigm for intrusion detection and surveillance in IoT-enabled heterogeneous wireless sensor networks, where monitoring quality depends not only on the existence of sensing barriers but also on the detectability of feasible crossing paths. In this paper, we study the obstacle-aware maximal exposure path planning problem in heterogeneous sensor fields under truncated omni-directional sensing and line-of-sight occlusion. Unlike conventional maximal exposure formulations that focus only on exposure maximization, the considered problem seeks side-to-side feasible paths that simultaneously maximize accumulated sensing exposure and minimize path length in obstacle-constrained environments. To address this bi-objective problem, we develop OG-MOEA/D, a problem-specific MOEAD method that combines a fixed-grid path representation with obstacle-aware feasibility checking and adaptive repair. The standard decomposition, neighborhood update, SBX, and polynomial mutation mechanisms are inherited from MOEA/D rather than claimed as new. Extensive simulations on networks with varying sensor densities and obstacle layouts show that OG-MOEA/D consistently improves hypervolume over generations and produces well-distributed Pareto fronts. Direct obstacle-constrained comparisons with MOEA/D and NSGA-II over 20 independent runs show higher HV and lower IGD for OG-MOEA/D in all four tested sensor-network sizes. The results should be interpreted as controlled simulation evidence for surveillance-strength evaluation in synthetic two-dimensional heterogeneous WSN scenarios, rather than as a model of realistic evasive intrusion behavior or a complete real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出障碍感知的双目标最大暴露路径规划问题，并设计OG-MOEA/D在异构截断全向传感场中同时最大化累积暴露与最小化路径长度。
AI.motivation: IoT异构无线传感器网络的屏障覆盖质量不仅取决于屏障是否存在，还取决于可穿越路径的可检测性；传统最大暴露模型只追求暴露最大化，忽视路径长度与障碍约束。
AI.method: 将问题建模为障碍约束下的边到边双目标路径规划，采用固定网格路径表示、障碍感知可行性检查与自适应修复，并继承MOEA/D的分解、邻域更新、SBX与多项式变异机制。
AI.result: 不同传感器密度与障碍布局下HV随迭代稳定提升、Pareto前沿分布均匀；在四种网络规模、20次独立运行中，OG-MOEA/D的HV均高于MOEA/D与NSGA-II，IGD均更低。
AI.conclusion: 结果为合成二维异构WSN场景下监视强度评估的可控仿真证据，而非真实逃逸入侵行为模型或完整实际部署验证。

title: The Testability Gap: A Pre-Registered Census of Naming versus Implementation in 59 Cognitive-Architecture LLM Systems
comment: 21 pages. Pre-registered census of the 59 most-starred GitHub repositories declaring cognitive architecture, plus five classic architectures as control: 22% document no code reference, 42% have dangling references (median 8.0%, max 79.5%); 3 of 4 pre-registered hypotheses falsified. Artifact archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23433898
summary: A companion line of work audited individual cognitive-architecture LLM systems in depth and found that module names and module computations are empirically independent claims. This paper asks how far that gap extends across the system class. We pre-registered a census protocol (sample frame, metrics, and acceptance criteria frozen before any sample was downloaded) and surveyed the 59 most-starred Python repositories declaring cognitive architecture on GitHub, plus five classic architectures as a historical control. We measure a testability gap. First, an auditability gap: 22% of repositories document no code reference whatsoever. Second, an integrity gap: 42% of repositories have at least one dangling reference, and within that subgroup the median fraction is 8%, the top quartile 19.6%, and the maximum 79.5%; one 148-star system documents paths of which a majority do not exist. Three of four pre-registered hypotheses were falsified: the integrity gap is not universal (58% of repositories either offer no checkable references or offer references that all resolve); claim density does not predict dangling rate (rho = -0.10); and the classical-architecture control does not significantly outperform (p = 0.059 with five controls, all at zero dangling). Exactly one repository in 59 (1.7%) ships executable falsification criteria for its own claims. A second pre-registered round classified every dangling path by git lifetime: 85.5% of dangling references (159 of 186) are ghosts - paths that never existed at any commit - against 14.5% that were once real and later removed.

AI.tldr: 通过预注册普查协议审计59个GitHub"认知架构"仓库，发现存在"可测试性鸿沟"：22%无可审计代码引用，42%含悬空引用，仅1.7%提供可执行证伪标准。
AI.motivation: 伴侣研究已发现单体认知架构LLM系统中"模块命名"与"模块计算"是经验独立的声明，本文考察这一鸿沟在整个系统类别中的普遍程度。
AI.method: 预注册普查协议（样本框、指标与验收标准在任何样本下载前冻结），调查GitHub上59个声明认知架构的最高星Python仓库，另加5个经典架构作历史对照；测量可审计性与完整性；第二轮按git生命期对悬空路径分类。
AI.result: 可审计性鸿沟：22%仓库无任何代码引用；完整性鸿沟：42%至少一个悬空引用，该子组中位数8%、上四分位19.6%、最大79.5%，某148星系统多数路径不存在。四个预注册假设中三个被证伪：完整性鸿沟非普遍（58%无悬空）、声明密度不预测悬空率（rho=-0.10）、经典对照未显著优于（p=0.059）。仅1/59（1.7%）提供可执行证伪标准。悬空引用中85.5%（159/186）为"幽灵"路径，从未存在于任何提交。
AI.conclusion: 认知架构LLM领域的声明与实现之间存在系统性可测试性缺陷；多数悬空引用是从未存在过的路径，提示文档与代码脱节而非合理演进。

title: Optimal Online Learning in Bilateral Trade Through Interest
summary:
We consider online learning in bilateral trade on platforms such as Uber, Airbnb, and eBay. In each round, a platform posts a payment to a seller and a price to a buyer, both with private valuations, and observes only whether trade occurs. Its objective is to maximize cumulative gains-from-trade, the sum of the differences between buyers' and sellers' valuations across completed trades. We measure the platform's performance by its regret against the best fixed common price. Financial self-sufficiency motivates global budget balance (Bernasconi et al., 2024), which allows profits from some trades to subsidize others, provided that the final balance is nonnegative. Such financial planning should also account for the time value of money: profits earned earlier can accumulate interest, providing additional funds for future subsidies. Motivated by this observation, we introduce global budget balance with interest, under which a platform starting with no funds can use both trading profits and accrued interest to finance subsidies.
  For a horizon of $T$ rounds and a fixed exponent $θ\ge0$, we consider the per-round interest rate $r_T = T^{-θ}$. We study two classic valuation models, adversarial and correlated i.i.d., and obtain tight bounds on regret against the best fixed common price in both. As the interest rate grows, optimal regret in each model drops from $\tildeΘ(T^{3/4})$ to $\tildeΘ(T^{5/7})$. The intermediate rates differ: $\tildeΘ(T^{3θ/4})$ for adversarial valuations when $20/21 < θ< 1$, and $\tildeΘ(T^{(2θ+3)/7})$ for correlated i.i.d. valuations when $1 < θ< 9/8$. Finally, as an extension, we study $α$-regret, with approximation factor $α\ge1$, for adversarial valuations against the best feasible distribution over price pairs, and show that the optimal competitive ratio rises from 2 to 3 as interest strengthens.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究双边交易平台在带利息的全局预算平衡约束下的在线学习，针对对抗性和相关i.i.d.两类估值模型，得到了对最优固定共同价格遗憾的紧界，并揭示利率越大最优遗憾越低。
AI.motivation: Uber、Airbnb、eBay等平台需同时向买卖双方定价且仅观测是否成交，目标最大化累计交易收益（gains-from-trade）。既有工作（Bernasconi等2024）引入全局预算平衡以刻画财务自足，但忽略了货币时间价值——早期利润可生息、为后续补贴提供更多资金。因此有必要引入带利息的全局预算平衡，研究利率对可达遗憾的影响。
AI.method: 设定T轮、固定指数θ≥0、每轮利率r_T=T^{-θ}；平台初始无资金，可用交易利润与累计利息补贴亏损交易，要求期末余额非负。分别在对抗性估值与相关i.i.d.估值两种经典模型下，以最优固定共同价格为基准衡量遗憾，推导上下界。扩展部分研究对抗性估值下对最优可行价格对分布的α-近似（α≥1）的α-regret。
AI.result: 在两种模型下均获得紧界。随着利率上升，最优遗憾从Õ(T^{3/4})降至Õ(T^{5/7})。中间区间：对抗性估值在20/21<θ<1时为Õ(T^{3θ/4})；相关i.i.d.估值在1<θ<9/8时为Õ(T^{(2θ+3)/7})。扩展结论：随利息增强，对抗性设定下最优竞争比从2升至3。
AI.conclusion: 货币时间价值（利息）可作为额外的补贴资金来源，显著降低预算平衡约束下的学习代价；最优遗憾随利率单调下降并呈现分段幂律，两类估值模型的中间率不同；在α-regret设定下竞争比从2提升到3。

title: Growth of global science: reflections on measurability and scientometric insights
summary: Global science has become much larger and more interconnected in recent years. Such a complex and adaptive social system defies any attempt to systematically and comprehensively measure or monitor its growth and evolution. Yet, as it continues to expand and enhance its public value, effective evidence-based assessment has become increasingly critical for understanding its dynamics and managing the system. This paper offers a framework for addressing system-level measurability challenges. Inspired by Derek de Solla Prices pioneering scientometric work in the 1960s, this paper addresses analytical issues related to current measurements of the systems expansion since the turn of the 21st century. Our empirical analysis of global science dynamics presents new macro-level data on several observable megatrends in research publication output worldwide. Acknowledging the limited analytical scope of these trend data to understand the dynamics of global science, we outline currently available options to improve system-level measurability under conditions of ambiguity and uncertainty. Looking forward, we discuss likely future directions to establish integrated, multi-stakeholder measurement infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个应对全球科学系统级可测性挑战的分析框架，借鉴普赖斯的科学计量学思想，实证分析21世纪以来全球科研产出的大趋势，并讨论改进系统级测量与构建多方协同测量基础设施的路径。
AI.motivation: 全球科学日益庞大且高度互联，作为一个复杂适应社会系统，其增长与演化难以被系统、全面地测量和监测；而随着科学公共价值扩大，基于证据的有效评估对理解其动态与管理该系统愈发关键。
AI.method: 借鉴 Derek de Solla Price 20世纪60年代的科学计量学工作，提出面向系统级可测性问题的框架；对全球科学动态进行实证分析，给出若干可观测宏观趋势（如全球科研论文产出）的新宏观数据；并在模糊性与不确定性条件下梳理现有改进系统级可测性的可选方案。
AI.result: 呈现了21世纪初以来全球科研发表产出若干可观测"大趋势"的新宏观数据；同时指出这些趋势数据在理解全球科学动态方面分析范围有限。
AI.conclusion: 趋势数据的分析能力有限，需在不确定性下改进系统级可测性；未来应建立整合的、多方利益相关者参与的测量基础设施。

title: Cross-Prompt Reuse of Entity-Replacement Responses
summary: With model weights fixed, we measure how much of an entity-replacement response transfers between English factual questions, beyond whether answers change. We add the hidden-state change from two source questions to a target question about the same entity, comparing the predicted log-probability shift between two relations' published answers, given known answer prefixes, with the measured one. Hidden reuse injects the aligned change at 50% depth before the target's remaining layers; direct reuse adds source output-score changes. With other-relation sources, hidden reuse removes 45% and 49% of no-change error on 0.5-1B Qwen and Llama. Gemma-2-2B removes 22% and passes one of three comparisons in plain text without its default beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token. A later protocol restoring it yields 58-68%, passing every comparison on three cohorts. Larger checkpoints, chat format and new entities show replication and format- or cohort-dependent failures. On small plain-format checkpoints, other-relation hidden reuse mainly reproduces the shift both relations' questions share, without reliably lowering relation-selective error. With target-relation sources, hidden reuse's post hoc advantage over direct reuse is 0.2-0.9 nats outside chat format, unconfirmed and not replacement-specific. The same relation-neutral change at both questions' entity tokens lowers relation-selective error more than random or other-replacement changes, indicating receiving-question dependence.

AI.tldr: 研究实体替换响应在英语事实性问题间的传递性，用隐状态变化与输出分数变化比较两种复用方式，发现隐状态复用主要传递关系中性成分。
AI.motivation: 检验在权重固定的情况下，实体替换引起的响应有多少能在不同事实性问题之间传递，而不只是看答案是否改变。
AI.method: 将两个源问题在同一实体上的隐状态变化注入目标问题（50%深度、已知答案前缀下），比较两种关系已发布答案的预测对数概率偏移与实测值；同时做直接复用（源输出分数变化）作对照，并在Qwen、Llama、Gemma-2系列（0.5–2B）、不同格式与实体队列上测试。
AI.result: 其他关系源下，隐状态复用分别消除45%和49%的无变化误差（Qwen、Llama 0.5-1B）；Gemma-2-2B为22%且仅通过1/3比较，恢复BOS后达58–68%并通过全部比较；更大模型、聊天格式、新实体出现复制或格式/队列相关失败；隐状态复用事后对直接复用的优势为0.2–0.9 nats（非聊天格式），未经确认且非替换特异；同关系中性变化注入双方实体词元比随机或其他替换更能降低关系选择性误差。
AI.conclusion: 小规模纯文本检查点上，其他关系的隐状态复用主要复现两个关系问题共有的偏移，不能可靠降低关系选择性误差；效果依赖接收问题，BOS等协议细节显著影响结论。实验为行为/表征层面对应，未做因果机制证明。

title: Edge-Optimized YOLOv11n Architecture for Offline Recognition of Nigerian Sign Language Alphanumeric Gestures
summary: Deaf inclusion across sub-Saharan society faces regional hurdles, with Nigeria as the core empirical focus. Existing recognition models demand heavy computational infrastructure. However, standard mobile phones used locally rarely exceed 1 GB to 4 GB of RAM. This study addresses constraints through a lightweight YOLO11n object-detection framework. The system provides real-time Nigerian Sign Language recognition for low-resource hardware. A benchmark dataset containing 11,208 raw gesture images was established. The data spans 33 static classes collected from five signers. Partitioning isolates signers S1 through S3 for training. Signer S4 provides validation data. Signer S5 is reserved for testing. Spatial augmentations are restricted strictly to the training set. This yields 23,509 training images. The validation and test sets each maintain 1,681 images across varied environments. The framework integrates a quantization-aware compression objective. Loss functions merge with squared Frobenius-norm penalties to govern weight distortion. A Spatial-Density Occlusion Index quantifies background complexity and self-occlusion. A latency-profiling equation relates floating-point operations and memory bandwidth to chipset clock speed. Performance testing on physical Android hardware utilizes unquantized FP32 weights. Mean inference latencies span 405.5 ms to 1,759.4 ms. Measured against test data, the algorithm attains a Precision of 0.9975. Recall reaches 0.9991. Mean Average Precision is 0.9942. Outcomes support offline functionality on constrained mobile devices. Practical deployment operates through a mobile utility using CameraX. The application captures gestures in real time. Recognized signs display as text instantly.

AI.tldr: 本研究面向尼日利亚手语（NSL）在低资源手机（1–4 GB RAM）上的离线识别，构建含11,208张原始手势图像、33类、5名签署者的数据集，采用轻量YOLO11n结合量化感知压缩与Frobenius范数惩罚，在真实Android设备上实现实时识别，测试集Precision 0.9975、Recall 0.9991、mAP 0.9942，推理延迟405.5–1,759.4 ms。
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南地区聋人包容存在区域性障碍，尼日利亚为核心实证场景；现有识别模型依赖重型算力，而当地常用手机内存仅1–4 GB，难以部署，因此需要轻量、可在受限硬件离线运行的手语识别方案。
AI.method: 基于YOLO11n目标检测框架；自建11,208张原始手势图像数据集（33个静态类、5名签署者），按签署者S1–S3训练、S4验证、S5测试划分，仅训练集做空间增强（扩至23,509张，验证/测试各1,681张）；引入量化感知压缩目标，损失函数结合平方Frobenius范数惩罚约束权重量化失真；提出空间密度遮挡指数（Spatial-Density Occlusion Index）量化背景复杂度与自遮挡；给出关联FLOPs、内存带宽与芯片时钟的延迟建模方程；在真实Android硬件上以FP32非量化权重做性能测试，并通过CameraX构建移动应用实时显示识别文本。
AI.result: 在物理Android设备上，平均推理延迟405.5–1,759.4 ms；测试集Precision 0.9975、Recall 0.9991、mAP 0.9942，支持受限移动设备离线运行。
AI.conclusion: 轻量YOLO11n配合量化感知压缩可在低资源尼日利亚手机上实现高精度、可离线的实时手语识别，并通过CameraX应用完成实际部署，为资源受限地区的聋人包容提供可行路径。

title: AuroraWorld: Structured 4D World Modeling for Exo-to-Ego Video Generation in Robot Manipulation
summary: Egocentric observations provide a robot-centric view of manipulation processes, capturing contact interactions and object-state changes that are important for visuomotor policy learning but difficult to observe from external cameras. However, collecting such data at scale remains expensive due to additional hardware requirements and platform-specific deployment costs. Synthesizing egocentric observations from large-scale exocentric manipulation videos provides a scalable alternative. However, existing methods struggle to synthesize physically consistent and policy-relevant egocentric videos under substantial viewpoint transformations, severe occlusions, complex object interactions, and inherently sparse observations from available exocentric viewpoints.

AI.tldr: 论文关注从大规模第三人称操作视频合成第一人称（自我中心）观测，以低成本支撑视觉运动策略学习；指出现有方法在大视角变换、严重遮挡、复杂物体交互和稀疏视角下难以生成物理一致、策略相关的自我中心视频。
AI.motivation: 自我中心观测能捕捉接触交互与物体状态变化，对视觉运动策略学习重要且外视角相机难以获取；但真实采集需额外硬件、平台部署成本高，规模受限。因此希望从已有大规模第三人称视频合成自我中心数据作为可扩展替代。
AI.method: 摘要未提供具体方法细节（仅提出问题设定：跨视角合成以视角变换为条件的自我中心操作视频）。
AI.result: 摘要未给出实验结果或定量结论。
AI.conclusion: 指出现有自我中心视频合成方法在物理一致性、策略相关性及大视角变换、遮挡、复杂交互、稀疏观测条件下存在明显不足，为后续方法设计确立待解决问题。

title: KINDER: Kernel-based Independence for Fair Representation Learning via Prototype-space Erasure
summary: Concept erasure is a prominent approach to achieving fairness in machine learning through the removal of sensitive attributes from learned representations. Prior concept erasure methods typically define debiasing indirectly through the failure of a chosen adversary, probe, or fairness penalty, which makes the target of erasure dependent on a particular decoder family or optimization setup. We introduce KINDER, which directly removes sensitive-attribute information from intermediate representations with respect to a chosen family of prototype functionals, and is compatible with any deep model containing an intermediate feature space, independent of the architecture, task type, or training paradigm. KINDER operates in a random Fourier feature space, where it estimates a sensitive subspace from protected group prototypes and projects representations onto its orthogonal complement. Thus, it forms an explicit representation cleaning mechanism distinct from prior fairness control studies. We conduct extensive experiments across diverse settings and show the effectiveness of KINDER on (i) supervised and self-supervised settings, (ii) classification, regression, and image segmentation tasks, and (iii) diverse data modalities, including visual, textual, and tabular data. Code and trained models are available at: https://github.com/abtinmU/KINDER

AI.tldr: KINDER 通过在随机傅里叶特征空间中用受保护群体原型估计敏感子空间，并将中间表示投影到其正交补，从而直接、显式地擦除敏感属性信息，与架构、任务和训练范式无关。
AI.motivation: 已有概念擦除方法通过对抗器、探针或公平性惩罚的失败来间接定义去偏，导致擦除目标依赖于特定解码器族或优化设置，缺乏通用性和明确性。
AI.method: 提出 KINDER：针对选定的一族原型泛函，直接在中间表示上移除敏感属性信息。方法在随机傅里叶特征空间中，基于受保护群体原型估计敏感子空间，再将表示投影到该子空间的正交补，形成显式的表示清洗机制；适用于任意含中间特征空间的深度模型。
AI.result: 大量实验验证有效性：(i) 监督与自监督设置；(ii) 分类、回归与图像分割任务；(iii) 视觉、文本、表格等多种数据模态。
AI.conclusion: KINDER 提供了一种通用、与模型架构和训练范式无关的显式概念擦除方案，在多样任务与模态上均有效，代码与模型已开源。

title: A Tool in the Forward Pass: Frozen Tape Modules as Layers of a Small Language Model
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Code, configurations, results and frozen modules: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23831494
summary: Calling a tool through generated text adds decoding steps, even when the computation itself is short. We study an alternative: a small neural module that runs inside a language model's forward pass. A learned writer turns hidden states into a symbolic tape, a short sequence of discrete symbols that encodes the computation. The module, trained separately and then frozen, reduces the tape to a result, and a learned reader returns that result to the model. We evaluate arithmetic and object tracking in gemma-3-1b-it. With a writer trained on labelled tapes, the layer answers all 750 items of BIG-Bench Hard's tracking shuffled objects correctly. At seven people it needs about 1/10 of the GPU kernel time of a text-tool baseline that uses the same host model and exact code, with accuracy 1.00 against 0.99. The writer can also be learned from answers alone, guided by a hand-written copying prior, but less reliably: 5 of 6 runs succeed in the 1B host and 2 of 4 in the 4B host. Two independently trained layers keep their task accuracy when attached to one model, and a learned gate keeps them silent on the tested general-text and look-alike prompts. The results support a narrow use case: a bounded computation that returns one symbol can avoid the decoding cost of a textual tool call. Extracting the right input reliably, and deciding when to act, remain the main open problems.

AI.tldr: 在 LLM 前向传播中插入可分离训练的小神经模块（writer-计算-tape-reader），用离散符号带代替文本工具调用的解码步骤，在算术与物体跟踪任务上取得高准确率并大幅降低 GPU kernel 时间。
AI.motivation: 通过生成文本调用工具会引入额外的解码步骤，即使计算本身很短，代价也高。作者希望避免文本工具调用的解码开销。
AI.method: learned writer 将隐藏状态转为符号 tape（编码计算的短离散符号序列）；单独训练后冻结的模块把 tape 归约为结果；learned reader 将结果返回模型。writer 可用标注 tape 训练，也可仅靠答案配合手写复制先验学习。评测任务为算术与物体跟踪，宿主模型为 gemma-3-1b-it（另测 4B）；对比同宿主、同代码的文本工具基线，并测试多层并行与 learned gate 抑制。
AI.result: 标注 tape 训练的 writer：BIG-Bench Hard tracking shuffled objects 全部 750 项正确。7 人场景 GPU kernel 时间约为文本工具基线的 1/10，准确率 1.00 vs 0.99。仅用答案训练：1B 宿主 6 次中 5 次成功，4B 宿主 4 次中 2 次成功。两个独立训练的层可共存且保持各自准确率；learned gate 使它们在测试的通用文本与相似提示上保持静默。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一个狭窄用例：返回单符号的有界计算可避开文本工具调用的解码成本。可靠提取正确输入与决定何时触发仍是主要未解问题。

title: Characterizing and Predicting the Longest CI Builds in Machine Learning Projects
summary: Continuous integration (CI) builds in machine learning (ML) projects tend to run longer than in other projects, yet little is known about the longest builds, which consume most CI time. This paper characterizes the longest builds in ML projects, analyzes how CI workflow properties are associated with them, and evaluates whether they can be predicted before execution. We study 269,930 GitHub Actions builds from 107 open-source ML projects. The top 18% longest builds account for 80.30% of total build time and fail in 39.09% of cases. Build duration differs significantly across ML project types. The framework and infrastructure ML projects have the longest upper tail and produce 98% of the longest builds, whereas projects that use existing ML libraries have the lowest median build duration. The longest builds are most strongly associated with the recent history of the same workflow, as the duration of its last build and the median duration of the project's last 20 builds show large effect sizes. The longest builds are more consistently associated with CI workflow structure than with configuration. The number of jobs, control flow complexity, coupling complexity, and maximum steps per job show medium effect sizes, whereas caching, matrix settings, and Docker builds show small or negligible effects. Framework-specific workflows have the largest percentage of builds among long builds. Platform-specific workflows produce the largest number of the longest builds. Finally, 47 features describing build history, workflow structure, and the ML project outperform a traditional baseline with all four classifiers. In a chronological evaluation, the best model (XGBoost) reaches an F1-score of 0.775, compared with 0.682 for the baseline, and an AUC-ROC of 0.955. These results show that build history and CI workflow structure help identify the longest builds in ML projects before they run.

AI.tldr: 该论文刻画了ML项目中耗时最长的CI构建，分析CI工作流属性与其关联，并评估执行前预测可行性。
AI.motivation: ML项目的CI构建通常比其他项目耗时更长，但关于最耗时构建（消耗大部分CI时间)的研究很少。
AI.method: 基于107个开源ML项目的269,930个GitHub Actions构建进行实证分析；分析CI工作流属性与最长构建的关联；使用47个特征（构建历史、工作流结构、ML项目）训练四种分类器并与传统基线对比，采用时间顺序评估。
AI.result: 前18%最长构建占总构建时间80.30%，失败率39.09%；框架与基础设施类项目产生98%的最长构建；最长构建与同一工作流近期历史关联最强；结构属性（作业数、控制流复杂度、耦合复杂度、每作业最大步数）效应中等，缓存/矩阵/Docker效应小；最佳模型XGBoost F1=0.775（基线0.682），AUC-ROC=0.955。
AI.conclusion: 构建历史与CI工作流结构可在构建运行前有效识别ML项目中的最长构建。

title: Coalitions, Stability, and Majority Jackpots: Frameworks for Unifying Majoritarian and Proportional Allocation in Multiwinner Elections
summary: Social choice literature on multiwinner elections tends to focus on characterizing two distinct tasks: majoritarian representation and proportional representation. However, many real world systems can be viewed as operating between these two extremes, such as majority jackpot systems used in several countries throughout history. Towards the goal of better understanding these systems from a social choice perspective, we introduce two frameworks that encompass existing desiderata for majoritarian and proportional settings: coalitions, which encompasses properties such as fixed majority and solid coalitions; and stability, which encompasses various generalizations of Condorcet's criterion for single-winner elections, such as Gehrlein stability and local stability, among others. We develop theory and tools that characterize the mathematical and computational aspects of both frameworks across a wide array of preference structures (such as the unrestricted domain over candidates and the restricted domain of party lists). Building on this foundation, we shed new light on majority jackpot electoral systems, which to date have received limited mathematical analysis in the social choice literature.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"联盟(coalitions)"与"稳定性(stability)"两个框架，统一刻画介于多数制与比例制之间的多赢家选举制度，并据此首次对社会选择视角下的"多数派大奖制"(majority jackpot)进行理论分析。
AI.motivation: 多赢家选举研究多聚焦于多数代表制与比例代表制两个极端，但现实中许多制度（如历史上多国采用的多数派大奖制）处于二者之间，缺乏统一的社会选择理论工具来理解它们。
AI.method: 构建两个涵盖式框架：coalitions（包含固定多数、稳固联盟等性质）与stability（包含Gehrlein稳定性、局部稳定性等Condorcet准则的推广）；在多种偏好结构（候选人上的无限制域、党派名单限制域等）下发展刻画其数学性与计算复杂性的理论与工具。
AI.result: 给出了两个框架在广泛偏好结构下的数学与计算层面刻画，并以此为基础对多数派大奖制选举系统得出新的理论洞见。
AI.conclusion: 统一框架有助于从社会选择角度理解介于多数制与比例制之间的中间型选举制度，并填补多数派大奖制数学分析的空白。

title: Numerical Embeddings for CTR Prediction: A Taxonomy, Unified Benchmark, and Open-Source FuxiCTR Extension
summary: Numerical embeddings map scalar features into vectors before a click-through rate (CTR) backbone combines the fields. To our knowledge, NumEmbBench is the first open benchmark dedicated to comparing numerical embeddings for CTR prediction. We classify 18 configurations into six mechanism-based families and evaluate them through one FuxiCTR interface. After equal-budget validation tuning, we compare frozen configurations on three datasets, nine backbones, and five seeds under a shared train-only z-score protocol. DEER has the best mean rank, but six methods lead at least one dataset--backbone setting. A matched native-scale test changes the winner in 11 of 27 settings, while paired latency measurements show that accuracy and inference cost need not move together. Code and per-seed results: https://github.com/YH-learning/NumEmbBench

AI.tldr: 首个面向CTR预测的数值嵌入开放基准NumEmbBench，对18种配置按六类机制家族、经统一FuxiCTR接口在3数据集×9骨干×5种子下评测，DEER平均排名最佳但无绝对赢家，原生尺度测试改变多数结论，精度与延迟并不一致。
AI.motivation: CTR模型在进入骨干网络前需将标量特征映射为向量，但数值嵌入方法种类繁多且缺乏统一、可复现的横向比较，导致难以判断哪种方法真正有效。
AI.method: 构建统一的FuxiCTR接口，将18种数值嵌入配置归为六类机制家族；采用等预算验证集调参后冻结配置，在3个数据集、9种骨干、5个随机种子上以仅训练集z-score协议评测，并进行原生尺度匹配测试与配对延迟测量。
AI.result: DEER取得最佳平均排名，但有六种方法各自在至少一个数据集-骨干设置中领先；原生尺度测试在27个设置中使11个的最佳方法发生改变；配对延迟显示精度与推理成本并非同步变化。
AI.conclusion: 数值嵌入没有普适最优方案，排名高度依赖数据集、骨干和尺度假设，实际选型需同时权衡精度与延迟，基准与逐种子结果已开源。

title: Humanized but Still True? Auditing Facts and Detection in AI-Text Humanizers
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/zwang-devv/humanizer-fact-audit
summary: AI "humanizers" rewrite machine-generated text so that detectors classify it as human-written. Public leaderboards score evasion and embedding similarity, but not whether checkable details survive. We check whether numbers, dates, person and organization names, and quoted spans survive each rewrite, using a rule-based checker validated by two AI annotators (precision 0.84-1.00, recall 0.93-0.95; no human annotation). In the October 2026 cycle of a public humanizer leaderboard, all 11 commercial tools changed or dropped at least one of these units in 35-65% of the documents that contained one. Most changes were to quoted spans; counting numbers and names alone, 10 of the 11 tools still altered at least one in 20% or more of the documents. The September 2026 cycle was similar (19-50%). An open 12B humanizer kept at least 97% of numbers and names in fact-dense U.S. federal agency text, but reworded 67-78% of the quoted spans, against its own prompt. Unit retention and detector evasion were not clearly related across tools (Spearman rho = -0.46, 95% CI -0.65 to 0.08), and the open model's four released files (two of them quantization-aware low-bit files) did not show the pre-registered monotone trade-off. On federal texts with matched human, AI-styled and humanized versions, a general-purpose decision model, Jev, asked a single zero-shot question, separated human originals from humanized rewrites with AUROC 0.864 (0.827-0.902), 0.18-0.22 higher than Binoculars, Fast-DetectGPT and the adversarially trained RADAR, while calling 24% of the human originals AI at a 0.5 threshold. On the AI-styled rewrites by 2026 models, both perplexity-based detectors scored below chance (AUROC 0.37 and 0.39), also with line breaks removed. Hypotheses, data rules and analyses were frozen before the main runs; two earlier data contacts are disclosed. We release the checker and the per-item results.

AI.tldr: 论文检验AI“人性化”改写工具是否保留数字、日期、人名机构名与引文等可核查细节，并评估检测器表现。结果显示11款商业工具在35–65%含此类细节的文档中改动或删除至少一处，多数改动集中于引文；细节保留率与规避检测无明显相关；通用判定模型Jev在区分人类原文与人性化改写上AUROC 0.864，显著优于Binoculars、Fast-DetectGPT和RADAR。
AI.motivation: 公开的humanizer排行榜只以规避检测率和嵌入相似度评分，却未衡量可核查事实细节（数字、日期、人名、机构名、引文）是否在改写中存活。作者希望补上这一评估缺口，并考察细节保留与检测规避之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用基于规则的检查器，逐项比对改写前后四类细节单元（数字、日期、人名/机构名、引文片段）是否保留；检查器由两名AI标注员验证（精确率0.84–1.00，召回率0.93–0.95，未做人工标注）。测试对象为2026年10月与9月两个周期的公开humanizer排行榜上的11款商业工具，以及一个开放12B humanizer；使用美国联邦机构的事实密集型文本，并构建人类原始、AI风格、人性化三版本对照语料。另评估Jev、Binoculars、Fast-DetectGPT、RADAR等检测器，并考察开放模型四个发布文件（含两个量化感知低比特版本）是否存在预注册的单调权衡。假设、数据规则与分析在主实验前冻结。
AI.result: 10月周期中11款商业工具全部在35–65%含相关细节的文档中改动或删除至少一个单元，多数改动为引文；若仅计数字与名称，11款中仍有10款在≥20%的文档中发生改动。9月周期类似（19–50%）。开放12B模型在事实密集文本中保留≥97%的数字与名称，但违背自身提示，改写了67–78%的引文片段。细节保留率与检测规避无明显相关（Spearman rho=-0.46，95%CI −0.65至0.08），开放模型四个文件亦未呈现预注册的单调权衡。Jev零样本区分人类原文与人性化改写AUROC 0.864（0.827–0.902），比Binoculars、Fast-DetectGPT、RADAR高0.18–0.22，但在0.5阈值下将24%人类原文误判为AI。对2026年模型的AI风格改写，两个困惑度类检测器低于随机水平（AUROC 0.37与0.39）。
AI.conclusion: 现有humanizer排行榜的评分维度不完整：商业工具普遍破坏可核查细节，尤其引文，且规避检测与细节保留并无可预期的权衡关系。困惑度类检测器在AI风格文本上失效，而通用判定模型Jev更具鲁棒性，但有明显误报。作者公开检查器与逐项结果，以支持更透明的评估。

title: The Margin Knows the Background: Uneven Abstention in Frozen Vision-Language Models
summary: Selective prediction allows a model to abstain on uncertain inputs, but a single confidence threshold can disproportionately reject examples from particular groups. We study how confidence scores produce this imbalance in frozen vision-language models (OpenAI CLIP, LAION CLIP, SigLIP). We express a family of scores, including the margin and maximum logit, through the average and the difference of the two highest class logits, and ask which carries group information. We show that equal group coverage at every threshold is equivalent to independence between the score and group membership. A randomized margin baseline tests whether a reduction in coverage disparity beats what adding noise achieves. With score choices fixed before testing, the effect of choice depends on the dataset. On Waterbirds, the margin creates coverage gaps 2.5 to 5.5 times larger than maximum logit at 80% coverage, its group signal is in the difference component, and paired background swaps show the background moves it, although maximum logit increases overall error. On NICO++, maximum logit instead increases worst-context error by 5.4 to 6.6 points and offers no improvement over the randomized baseline for OpenAI CLIP. Across both datasets, how far a score pushes a group down its ranking tracks the coverage gap (Spearman 0.88, 0.92) better than plain group identifiability (0.61, 0.65). These results explain why a score that abstains more evenly on one dataset may be less effective on another and motivate judging group coverage and selective risk together against randomized baselines.

AI.tldr: 研究冻结视觉语言模型（CLIP、SigLIP）中选择性预测的置信度分数如何造成群体覆盖不平衡：覆盖均衡等价于分数与群体独立；分数选择效果依数据集而变。
AI.motivation: 单一置信阈值会不成比例地拒斥某些群体样本，需理解置信分数如何产生群体间覆盖不平衡，并判断何种打分更公平。
AI.method: 将margin与maximum logit等分数统一表示为最高两个类logit的均值与差值，分析哪一部分携带群体信息；以随机化margin基线（加噪声）检验覆盖差距缩减是否超出噪声水平；在Waterbirds与NICO++上跨OpenAI CLIP、LAION CLIP、SigLIP进行配对背景交换等实验，并用Spearman相关比较群体排序下移程度与覆盖差距。
AI.result: Waterbirds上margin在80%覆盖时产生的覆盖差距为maximum logit的2.5–5.5倍，其群体信号来自差值分量，背景交换会改变该信号；NICO++上maximum logit反而使最差上下文错误升高5.4–6.6点，且对OpenAI CLIP不优于随机基线。群体排序下移程度与覆盖差距相关（0.88、0.92）高于单纯群体可识别性（0.61、0.65）。
AI.conclusion: 分数选择的效果依赖数据集，不存在普遍更公平的分数；应结合随机化基线同时评估群体覆盖与选择性风险。

title: Neurons Are All You Need
summary: For decades, artificial neural networks have operated under the assumption that durable, learned capability resides exclusively in adaptive synaptic parameters, primarily due to the established neurobiology of synaptic connectivity. This design forces models to remain stateless during deployment, incurring well-known limitations such as catastrophic forgetting and expensive retraining. However, recent neurobiological research by Glanzman and colleagues, and others, shows that memories can be transferred between individual organisms in a synaptically independent manner. Inspired by this research, we sought to demonstrate memory transfer of persistent memory between AI model instances, leveraging a neurocentric version of memory. In this paper, we propose NURESA (Neural Unit with Retentive Self-Adaptive Architecture), a novel neural layer that eschews sole reliance on synaptic weight updating by introducing persistent intra-unit memory as a first-class, computational primitive. By structurally separating computation from persistent memory, NURESA enables autonomous memory accumulation and consolidation into transferable stores of memory registers. Experiments across MLP, GPT-2, and modern frontier models like Qwen2.5 demonstrate qualitatively new capability: zero-shot transfer of learned capability into a naive model instance without retraining or access to the original training data; this transfer is enabled by a sparse set of parameters in NURESA's memory register that the model selects on its own based on which neurons were most active. The memory transfer capability of NURESA also protects against domain loss when transformer models undergo learning via fine-tuning. Finally, the memory transfer process completes in approximately one minute even for transformer models with millions to billions of parameters, producing a transfer file orders of magnitude smaller than the original model.

AI.tldr: NURESA提出在神经网络层内引入持久的单元内记忆作为一等计算原语，从而在无需重训练或原始数据的情况下实现模型实例间记忆的零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络假定学习能力只存在于自适应突触参数中，导致部署时无状态，存在灾难性遗忘与昂贵再训练问题；而神经生物学研究（Glanzman等）表明记忆可在突触独立方式下在个体间转移，启发作者探索AI模型间的记忆迁移。
AI.method: 提出NURESA（Neural Unit with Retentive Self-Adaptive Architecture）神经层，用持久的单元内记忆作为计算原语，将计算与持久记忆结构分离，使记忆可自主累积并固化为可迁移的记忆寄存器；模型根据神经元活跃度自选稀疏参数子集用于迁移。
AI.result: 在MLP、GPT-2以及Qwen2.5等前沿模型上验证：可将学习能力零样本迁移至未训练的新模型实例，无需重训练或原始数据；可缓解Transformer微调时的领域损失；迁移过程即使对数百万至数十亿参数模型也约一分钟完成，迁移文件比原模型小几个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将持久记忆作为神经网络的一等计算原语，能够突破纯突触参数范式，实现高效、紧凑、可迁移的模型记忆，为持续学习与知识复用提供新路径。

title: DELBERT-2: Pretrained Fingerprint Language Models for DEL Protein Binder Prediction
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 2026 Workshop on Generative and Agentic AI for Biology (ICML 2026)
summary: We present DELBERT-2, a pretrained fingerprint language model that converts sparse molecular fingerprints into unified token sequences using a ModernBERT encoder trained with masked language modelling on 2.5M molecules from the AIRCHECK DEL corpus. We evaluate across six targets (WDR91, WDR12, SETDB1, PLCZ1, LRRK2, DCAF7) under three out-of-distribution (OOD) protocols: hierarchical cluster splits probe chemical novelty, library splits test cross-library transfer, and building-block splits assess compositional generalization. DELBERT-2 consistently improves PR-AUC and NDCG@1000 relative to LightGBM ensemble baselines and transformers trained from scratch, with the largest gains in stringent OOD regimes. DELBERT-2 achieves 13.28+/-3.72 enrichment factor at top-100 vs. 12.36+/-3.75 for no-pretraining (p=0.040), representing 7.4% improvement and 13x enrichment over random selection. These results demonstrate that fingerprint-centric self-supervised learning effectively improves hit prioritization under distribution shift, enabling practical DEL virtual screening. Code is available at \hyperlink{https://github.com/GenerativeDrugDiscovery/DELBERT-2}{DELBERT-2}.

AI.tldr: DELBERT-2 是一个基于 ModernBERT 的指纹语言模型，将稀疏分子指纹转为统一 token 序列并用掩码语言建模预训练，在六靶点三 OOD 协议下显著优于基线与从头训练模型。
AI.motivation: DNA 编码库（DEL）虚拟筛选在分布偏移下命中优先级排序困难，需评估指纹表示在化学新颖性、跨库迁移与组合泛化下的泛化能力。
AI.method: 用 ModernBERT 编码器将稀疏分子指纹转为统一 token 序列，在 AIRCHECK DEL 语料 250 万分子上做掩码语言建模预训练；在 WDR91、WDR12、SETDB1、PLCZ1、LRRK2、DCAF7 六靶点上，采用层次聚类切分、库切分、构建块切分三种 OOD 协议评估。
AI.result: 相对 LightGBM 集成基线与从头训练 Transformer，PR-AUC 与 NDCG@1000 一致提升，严格 OOD 下增益最大；top-100 富集因子 13.28±3.72 vs 无预训练 12.36±3.75（p=0.040），提升 7.4%，约为随机的 13 倍。
AI.conclusion: 以指纹为中心的自监督学习能有效提升分布偏移下的命中优先级排序，支撑实用的 DEL 虚拟筛选。

title: Iterated Narrow Networks: Turing Completeness at Width 4 on Convex Input Spaces and the Complexity of Verification
comment: 41 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: We study the iterates of a fixed ReLU network $N$ of width 4, that is, the discrete-time system $x_{k+1} = N(x_k)$ on $[0,1]^4$. Equivalently, $x_k$ is the output of a weight-tied network made of $k$ copies of $N$, or of a recurrent network with no external input, started at $x_0$. We prove that every deterministic Turing machine $M$ admits such a network $N_M$. The network can be constructed in polynomial time from $M$. Each iteration has depth $\mathrm{poly}(|M|)$. The iterates of $N_M$ simulate $M$ exactly on every encoded tape. The number of iterations is proportional to the running time of $M$. Moreover, the fourth coordinate irreversibly flags every point of the convex cube $[0,1]^4$ whose simulation reads an invalid digit. This flag is the certificate that makes hardness reductions sound on convex input regions, the regime of practical verifiers. Convex regions were previously inaccessible because of a continuity obstruction inherent to ReLU networks. The correspondence has three consequences. First, reachability for iterated width-4 ReLU networks spans the full complexity hierarchy along the single axis of the time bound: it is NP-complete for a unary bound, NEXP-complete for a binary bound and RE-complete (undecidable) with no bound. Second, two extra neurons of width suffice to extend the hardness to every common smooth activation: at width 6, the robust verification problem (a promise problem with $δ/2δ$ gap) is NP-complete for $\tanh$, sigmoid, GELU, Swish, ELU, and any polynomial-time-computable continuous non-polynomial activation with a polynomial-time-computable Lipschitz constant. Third, the whole spectrum transfers to discretized Neural ODEs in dimension 5.

AI.tldr: 宽4 ReLU网络的迭代（无输入循环网络/权重共享深层网络）可精确模拟任意图灵机，其可达性问题沿时间约束单一轴跨越NP、NEXP到RE完整，并推广到常见光滑激活与离散Neural ODE。
AI.motivation: ReLU网络的连续性特性使凸输入区域上的硬度归约一直难以成立，本文旨在突破这一障碍，给出可精确模拟图灵机的迭代ReLU网络构造，从而在实用验证器所关心的凸区域上建立可靠的复杂度下界。
AI.method: 构造宽度4的ReLU网络N_M，其在[0,1]^4上的迭代x_{k+1}=N_M(x_k)按多项式时间可由图灵机M构造，单次迭代深度为poly(|M|)，迭代次数正比于M运行时间，并精确模拟M；第四坐标作为不可逆标志，对读取无效数字的任意凸立方体点进行标记，从而保证凸区域上归约的可靠性。进一步增加2个宽度神经元（总宽6）以推广到光滑激活。
AI.result: 迭代宽度4 ReLU网络的可达性在时间约束轴上是NP完全（一元界）、NEXP完全（二元界）、RE完全/不可判定（无界）。宽度6时，δ/2δ间隙的鲁棒验证问题对tanh、sigmoid、GELU、Swish、ELU及任意多项式时间可计算、具多项式Lipschitz常数的连续非多项式激活均为NP完全。整套结论可迁移到5维离散化Neural ODE。
AI.conclusion: 极小宽度（4或6）的迭代/循环网络已具备完整图灵完备性与复杂度分层能力，标志机制解决了凸区域上的连续性障碍，并将硬度谱系统一扩展到多种激活函数与离散Neural ODE。

title: Getting a Grip: Operating Human-Agent Software Teams Through Governed Messages
comment: Technical report. 45 pages, 9 figures, 27 tables. Data, code and corpus: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23755352
summary: Software is increasingly developed by teams in which several people direct many coding agents from different vendors. Such teams must establish who may request what from whom, which messages start work, which decisions bind, and who caused a change. We propose to govern a human-agent team through its message protocol and present yoars, a relay in which humans and agents are authenticated principals that exchange typed, addressed messages in rooms holding goals, decision rules, routing and an attributable, append-only record. This report gives the architecture, the full controlled study and the field material. In 926 controlled runs (899 analyzable), small agent teams built programs under varied room rules, some with a hostile member planting a backdoor. Revising which messages start work, bundled with limits on repeated messages, was followed by a drop in total coordination failure from 42% to 13% (p = .0063, adjusted p = .057 over nine registered tests). Instructed roles and votes did not reliably produce the intended process, and no defense inside the conversation reliably prevented the backdoor. An auditor read the records of 96 runs with a confirmed backdoor. In the 25 runs where the attacker had persuaded a teammate to write it, the auditor named the persuader in all 25, but it also flagged 24 of 40 honest runs. In a four-week field study, up to nineteen agents and two people developed a distributed system through yoars, producing 7,457 acts. Human attention and decision making emerged as the critical resource: requests waited mainly for the human-run coordinator and for approvals, while agents answered within minutes. Most governance requirements emerged from operation, and holding context dominated token cost. We report twenty-six failures of our own instruments, derive seven lessons and a checklist, and release the corpus, the redacted room ledger and the analysis scripts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用消息协议治理人机协作团队，构建了 yoars 系统（人机皆为认证主体、在房间内交换带类型与地址的消息，含目标、决策规则、路由与可追责的只追加记录），并报告了 926 次受控实验与四周现场研究的结果。
AI.motivation: 由多人指挥来自不同厂商的众多编码智能体开发软件时，团队必须明确谁能向谁请求什么、哪些消息触发工作、哪些决策具有约束力、以及谁导致了变更。
AI.method: 将治理落在消息协议层面：yoars 中人类与智能体都是认证主体，在持有目标、决策规则、路由和可归因只追加日志的"房间"内交换带类型、带地址的消息。开展 926 次受控运行（899 次可分析），小规模智能体团队在多变房间规则下构建程序，部分含植入后门的敌对成员；另有审计实验和四周现场研究。
AI.result: 修改"哪些消息触发工作"并叠加重复消息限制后，总协调失败率从 42% 降至 13%（p=.0063，九项检验校正后 p=.057）。指定的角色与投票未能可靠产生预期流程，对话内的任何防御都无法可靠阻止后门。审计者在 25 次说服型攻击中全部指认了说服者，但也误报 40 次诚实运行中的 24 次。四周现场研究中最多 19 个智能体和 2 人产生 7,457 次行为，人的注意力与决策成为关键瓶颈，多数治理需求从运行中涌现，上下文维持主导了 token 成本。
AI.conclusion: 消息协议层面的治理可显著降低协调失败，但角色指令、投票和对话内防御效果有限；人类注意力是核心稀缺资源。作者报告自身工具的 26 次失败，提炼七条经验与一份清单，并公开语料、脱敏房间账本与分析脚本。

title: On the Convergence of Alternating Regret Matching Algorithms
summary:
Alternating updates, that is, where each player is updated in turn, tend to typically perform better in regret matching algorithms than simultaneous updates. Alternation within the regret matching family has long been a central ingredient of practical solvers for zero-sum games. Yet our theoretical understanding is lagging behind. In this paper, we address this gap by developing a systematic way of analyzing such algorithms. Our framework centers on an alternating analog of the RVU property that we introduce, which we use to obtain the optimal $T^{-1}$ average-iterate convergence within this family. In particular, we establish this for two simple variants of predictive regret matching$^+$: i) increasing-regret predictive regret matching$^+$ and ii) half-prediction regret matching$^+$. Interestingly, we find that half prediction is the unique prediction multiplier that satisfies our alternating RVU property, giving it a strong theoretical justification.
  Going beyond average-iterate convergence, we refine our framework to obtain $T^{-1/2}$ best-iterate convergence and further establish convergence of their strategy profiles to a single Nash equilibrium, without assuming equilibrium uniqueness. We go on to establish separations between alternating and simultaneous updates, including a game in which half-prediction regret matching$^+$ converges under alternating updates but fails to converge in terms of the last iterate under simultaneous updates. This provides theoretical support for the empirical observation that alternation can stabilize learning dynamics. Finally, experiments on 15 game benchmarks demonstrate that the strong theoretical properties of the half-prediction mechanism translate to strong practical performance, being on par with state-of-the-art solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交替更新下 regret matching 家族的系统分析框架——交替 RVU 性质，证明 increasing-regret 与 half-prediction 两个 predictive regret matching+ 变体可达最优 T^{-1} 平均迭代收敛，并进一步给出 T^{-1/2} 最佳迭代收敛与策略收敛到单一纳什均衡，且证明 half prediction 是唯一满足该性质的预测系数。
AI.motivation: 交替更新（逐玩家轮流更新）在实践中长期优于同步更新，是零和博弈求解器的核心成分，但缺乏理论解释；作者希望填补这一理论与实践之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 引入交替版本的 RVU 性质作为分析工具，据此分析 predictive regret matching+ 的两个简单变体：(i) increasing-regret predictive regret matching+，(ii) half-prediction regret matching+；并进一步细化框架以得到最佳迭代收敛与策略收敛结果，同时构造同步/交替更新的分离实例。
AI.result: 在该家族内获得最优的 T^{-1} 平均迭代收敛率；进一步得到 T^{-1/2} 最佳迭代收敛，并在不假设均衡唯一的前提下证明策略收敛到单一纳什均衡；发现 half prediction 是唯一满足交替 RVU 性质的预测乘数；给出一个 half-prediction RM+ 在交替更新下收敛、同步更新的最后迭代不收敛的博弈实例；15 个基准实验显示性能与最先进求解器相当。
AI.conclusion: 交替更新带来可证明的收敛优势，half prediction 具有强理论依据，理论性质可转化为实际性能；为"交替稳定学习动态"的经验观察提供理论支撑。

title: Do GEO Gains Survive the Live Web? Evaluating In-the-Wild Visibility Gains of Generative Engine Optimization via LIVE-GEO
summary: Generative engine optimization (GEO) rewrites web content so that LLM-based search systems, also termed generative engines (GEs), rank it higher in their answers and recommendations. However, existing GEO evaluations typically rely on directly supplied text or controlled retrieval pipelines, and whether GEO gains survive the live Web remains unclear, leaving a gap in understanding how GEO strategies affect the visibility of live webpages when accessed and ranked by GEs. To address this gap, we introduce LIVE-GEO, a benchmark for Live, In-the-wild Visibility Evaluation for GEO. LIVE-GEO publishes GEO-rewritten products as live webpages. We use LIVE-GEO to evaluate five existing GEO strategies (CORE, C-SEO, E-GEO, AgenticGEO, and Statistics Addition), applying them to the product descriptions and reviews of 80 fictional brands across 18 product families. We run experiments on three GEs (ChatGPT with GPT-6, Gemini 3.6 Thinking, and Grok in Expert mode), four direct-text API evaluators (GPT-4o, DeepSeek, Kimi, and Claude), and a direct-text local evaluator (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct). With frozen $\pm0.2\%$ prices, most direct-text evaluators and GEs receiving product URLs give CORE the highest Top-1 rate, reaching 66.3%-76.3% on the GEs, yet other strategies vary in relative performance, and the GEs select the same top product for only 48.8%-66.3% of brands. We also find that ChatGPT is sensitive to the order of candidate URLs: CORE's Top-1 rate is 73.8% and 93.8% under two opposite fixed orders, and the randomized order used by LIVE-GEO yields 82.5%, between the two. In the numerical-faithfulness check, the JEV verifier agrees with the reference labels on 90.7% of 194 numerical benchmark cases and with human judgments on all 50 sampled descriptions, and it flags 86 of the 400 rewritten descriptions, including all 80 Statistics Addition descriptions.

AI.tldr: LIVE-GEO是一个在真实在线网页上评测GEO（生成引擎优化）的基准：将GEO改写后的商品内容发布为真实网页，对5种GEO策略、3个生成引擎与多个直连文本评测器进行对比。结果显示CORE在多数评测器上Top-1率最高（GE上66.3%-76.3%），但GE对各品牌选出的Top-1产品一致性仅48.8%-66.3%，且ChatGPT对候选URL顺序高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有GEO评测多依赖直接提供的文本或受控检索流程，无法说明GEO收益能否在真实开放Web上成立，缺少对"被生成引擎实际访问和排序的在线网页"可见性影响的了解。
AI.method: 提出LIVE-GEO基准，把GEO改写内容发布为真实在线网页；对80个虚构品牌的18类产品的描述与评论应用5种GEO策略（CORE、C-SEO、E-GEO、AgenticGEO、Statistics Addition）；在3个生成引擎（ChatGPT/GPT-6、Gemini 3.6 Thinking、Grok Expert）、4个直连文本API评测器和1个本地评测器上测试，价格固定±0.2%；并做数值忠实性校验（JEV verifier）。
AI.result: CORE在多数直连评测器和接收URL的GE上Top-1率最高，GE上达66.3%-76.3%；其他策略相对表现不一；GE仅对48.8%-66.3%的品牌给出相同Top-1产品。ChatGPT对URL顺序敏感：两种相反固定顺序下CORE Top-1率为73.8%与93.8%，随机顺序为82.5%。数值忠实性方面，JEV与参考标签一致率90.7%（194例），与人工判断50/50一致，标出400条改写中的86条（含全部80条Statistics Addition）。
AI.conclusion: GEO收益在真实Web上依然存在但高度依赖策略与评测器；GE之间排序一致性低、且对候选顺序敏感，说明可见性结论并不稳健，需在真实环境下做更严格、可复现的评测。

title: Circuit Oracle: Automating Attribution Graph Analysis via Natural-Language Queries
comment: Extended version of a paper presented at the Mechanistic Interpretability and Compositional Learning workshops at ICML 2026
summary: Attribution graphs, an emerging tool in mechanistic interpretability, use transcoders to decompose language model computations into sparse interpretable features connected by causal edges. However, turning a graph into a safety-relevant insight requires hours of manual analysis by experts. We introduce Circuit Oracle, an off-the-shelf LLM equipped with a multi-agent harness and task-specific authored skills, which answers natural-language questions about a target model by reading the attribution graph through tool calls. We evaluate it on three safety-relevant proxy tasks: detecting spurious features in probe circuits, eliciting hidden knowledge from taboo-finetuned models, and suppression jailbreaking via feature-level interventions. Beyond task scores, the oracle produces pruned subgraphs and context-specific feature explanations that we assess qualitatively. Results are mixed. On spurious-feature detection, Circuit Oracle reaches 78.2 $\pm$ 2.4% accuracy, outperforming single-layer feature-ranking baselines. On secret elicitation, trained self-explainers like Activation Oracles remain the stronger baseline. On refusal suppression over 50 prompts, its single committed intervention is slightly below a diff-in-means baseline, and only exceeds it when allowed the best of five attempts. Results are stable across five runs and across model choices for the agents. We also release the pruned subgraphs and context-specific feature readings that revise existing global labels, and invite future work to develop evaluations that can measure their usefulness directly.

AI.tldr: Circuit Oracle 是一个由通用 LLM 与多智能体工具框架驱动的系统，可通过工具调用读取归因图来回答关于目标模型的自然语言问题，并在三个安全相关代理任务上被评估，结果喜忧参半。
AI.motivation: 归因图（attribution graph）能把语言模型计算分解为稀疏可解释特征及其因果边，但把图转化为安全相关洞见仍需专家数小时人工分析，缺乏自动化、可复用的分析工具。
AI.method: 提出 Circuit Oracle：现成 LLM + 多智能体框架 + 任务定制"技能"，通过工具调用读取归因图回答问题。在三个安全代理任务上评估：探针电路中的伪特征检测、从禁忌微调模型引出隐藏知识、通过特征级干预实现拒绝抑制越狱；并定性评估其生成的剪枝子图与情境化特征解释。
AI.result: 结果混合：伪特征检测达 78.2±2.4%，优于单层特征排序基线；秘密引出任务中，Activation Oracles 等经训练的自解释器基线更强；50 条提示的拒绝抑制上，单次提交干预略低于 diff-in-means 基线，仅取五次尝试最优时才超过。结果在五次运行及不同 agent 模型选择下稳定。
AI.conclusion: Circuit Oracle 在部分任务上有竞争力但并非全面领先，说明通用 LLM 多智能体读图分析尚不能取代训练式自解释器或简单统计基线；作者公开剪枝子图与修正全局标签的情境化特征解读，并呼吁后续工作开发能直接衡量其有用性的评估方法。

title: SFA: A Statistical Physics-Inspired Diffusion Transformer for Efficient and High-Quality Image Generation
summary: Diffusion transformers have achieved remarkable success in image generation, but accelerating attention while preserving generation quality remains a major challenge at high resolutions. Inspired by statistical physics and the widespread occurrence of scale-free laws in nature, we introduce Scale-Free Attention (SFA), which preserves fine local interactions while summarizing distant regions at progressively coarser scales. For $N$ tokens, mean pooling, token-count correction, and a shared softmax over a scale-free spatial hierarchy give SFA $O(N\log N)$ complexity in both forward and backward passes. Our Triton implementation achieves $357.3\times$ forward and $265.6\times$ backward attention speedups over FlashAttention at 262,144 tokens. After 40 epochs of PixelFlow training from scratch on ImageNet at $256\times256$ resolution, SFA achieves the best generation quality among five attention mechanisms, including full attention. Fréchet inception distance evaluated on 50,000 generated samples (FID-50k) improves from 13.25 for full attention to 12.51, and the advantage over full attention persists through 80 epochs. SFA also achieves the best generation quality among the compared efficient-attention methods on Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ). Beyond training from scratch, Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium with attention replaced by SFA retains the generation quality of its full-attention counterpart under matched fine-tuning budgets. We obtain similar results when fine-tuning pretrained PixelFlow on ImageNet. SFA establishes scale-free structure as an effective design principle for efficient, high-quality diffusion transformers.

AI.tldr: 提出Scale-Free Attention (SFA)，在各向scale-free空间层级上做mean pooling、token数校正与共享softmax，实现O(N log N)前向/反向注意力，在262k token下较FlashAttention提速357×，且生成质量优于全注意力。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer在高分辨率图像生成中注意力开销巨大，现有高效注意力方法在加速的同时往往损失生成质量，难以兼顾效率与保真度。
AI.method: 受统计物理与自然界scale-free规律的启发，SFA保留细粒度局部交互，同时对远端区域逐级粗化汇总：对N个token采用mean pooling、token计数校正以及在一个scale-free空间层级上的共享softmax，使前向与反向复杂度均为O(N log N)；并给出Triton实现。
AI.result: 262,144 token时前向提速357.3×、反向提速265.6×（对比FlashAttention）。ImageNet 256×256上PixelFlow从零训练40轮，SFA在五种注意力机制（含全注意力）中生成质量最佳，FID-50k由13.25降至12.51，该优势持续到80轮；FFHQ上亦优于其他高效注意力方法；SD 3.5 Medium替换注意力后在同等微调预算下保持全注意力质量；预训练PixelFlow微调结果类似。
AI.conclusion: scale-free结构是高效、高质量扩散Transformer的有效设计原则。

title: MemU-Bench: Benchmarking GUI Agents on Long-Horizon User Interactions
summary: Existing Graphical User Interface (GUI) benchmarks predominantly rely on precise and stateless user instructions. In everyday usage, however, instructions are often \emph{vague and history-dependent}: users omit the exact details of their past operations because they no longer remember them, leaving the agent to recover the missing context from long and noisy interaction histories. To bridge this evaluation gap, we introduce \textbf{MemU-Bench}, a mobile benchmark of \textbf{118 vague tasks} grounded in 29 long-horizon user trajectories, where agents must distill raw interaction streams into memory and retrieve the missing context on demand, with task outcomes verified against serialized application databases. Alongside Success Rate, we incorporate Interaction Efficiency (IE) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) to expose agents that succeed by exhaustively searching across different applications rather than by \emph{genuinely recalling} the history. Evaluations show that without user history, state-of-the-art systems struggle under such ambiguity: the best-performing Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves an SPL of only 16.4\%, and end-to-end GUI agents fall below 5\%. To address this, we further propose \textbf{AppMem}, a training-free framework that distills user history into a \emph{structured, app-centric} memory bank, tracks interrupted intents across application switches, and selectively retrieves relevant memories via target-app inference. AppMem raises the SPL of GPT-5.5 from 15.7\% to 66.9\% (\textbf{+51.2\%}), outperforms a naive summary baseline by 9.3\%, and delivers consistent gains across evaluated backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出MemU-Bench移动端GUI基准（118个模糊任务/29条长程轨迹），并给出免训练框架AppMem，将用户历史蒸馏为结构化记忆库以应对模糊历史依赖指令，使GPT-5.5的SPL从15.7%提升到66.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI基准依赖精确、无状态指令，而真实使用中指令常模糊且依赖历史：用户忘记过去操作细节，需Agent从长而嘈杂的交互历史中恢复缺失上下文。现有评测缺乏这一维度。
AI.method: 构建MemU-Bench：基于29条长程轨迹设计118个模糊任务，要求Agent把原始交互流蒸馏为记忆并按需检索缺失上下文，用序列化应用数据库校验任务结果；除成功率外引入交互效率(IE)与SPL以惩罚靠穷举搜索而非真正回忆的行为。另提AppMem：免训练框架，将历史蒸馏为结构化、以应用为中心的记忆库，跨应用追踪被中断意图，并通过目标应用推断选择性检索相关记忆。
AI.result: 无用户历史时SOTA系统在模糊指令下表现很差：最佳Gemini-3.1-Pro的SPL仅16.4%，端到端GUI Agent低于5%。AppMem将GPT-5.5的SPL从15.7%提升至66.9%（+51.2%），比朴素摘要基线高9.3%，并在多个骨干模型上一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 模糊、历史依赖的指令是GUI Agent的关键评测缺口；记忆蒸馏与检索（AppMem）能显著提升长程跨应用任务的成功效率，且无需训练、具泛化性。

title: OCELOT: Planetary-Scale Species Distribution Modeling with Satellite Foundation Embeddings
summary: Large-scale repositories of species observations now contain billions of occurrence records from around the world, but these sightings cluster heavily in human-accessible areas. Existing models use only a small fraction of these records and are not evaluated on extrapolating to remote, unvisited regions--where species distribution models can be used as geographic priors to help classify data from camera traps and acoustic recorders. We scale relative occurrence species distribution models by training a multimodal implicit neural representation network called OCELOT that fuses spatial coordinates with satellite foundation embeddings on two orders of magnitude more observations than previous work: 2 billion GBIF records across 100,000 taxa. Scaling to this regime requires co-designing the data pipeline, taxonomic representation, loss formulation, and model architecture: spatiotemporal thinning and sub-linear cell sampling correct for spatial redundancy and observer bias, while an additive taxonomic readout shares representations across species, genera, and families to improve predictions for rare taxa. To evaluate performance in remote areas, we benchmark geographic extrapolation using the NDCG metric on spatial block holdouts up to 600 km. Satellite foundation embeddings improve extrapolation by 51% over coordinate-only models and outperform classical bioclimatic rasters. The resulting model also matches or outperforms existing baselines on established interpolation benchmarks, demonstrating that optimizing for geographic extrapolation does not compromise in-distribution accuracy.

AI.tldr: OCELOT是一个多模态隐式神经网络物种分布模型，融合空间坐标与卫星基础嵌入，在20亿条GBIF记录、10万物种上训练，专注提升偏远地区的空间外推能力。
AI.motivation: 现有物种观测记录严重聚集于人类可达区域，已有模型仅用少量记录且未评估对偏远未访问区域的外推性能，而这些区域恰是相机陷阱和声学记录器分类最需要地理先验的地方。
AI.method: 训练多模态隐式神经表示网络，融合空间坐标与卫星基础嵌入；数据规模扩大约两个数量级（100,000类群、20亿GBIF记录）；联合设计数据管线、分类表征、损失与架构：时空稀疏化和次线性网格采样纠正空间冗余与观测者偏差，加性分类读出在物种、属、科间共享表示以改善稀有类群预测；用NDCG在最大600公里的空间区块留出上评估外推。
AI.result: 卫星基础嵌入使外推性能比仅坐标模型提升51%，并优于经典生物气候栅格；在既有插值基准上达到或超过基线，说明优化外推不损害分布内精度。
AI.conclusion: 大规模、多模态隐式表示结合针对偏差的数据与架构协同设计，可在提升地理外推的同时保持插值精度，为偏远地区作为地理先验的物种分布建模提供可行路径。

title: Exact Fusion of Softmax Attention Heads Can Require Exponentially Many Atoms
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/usamihiroyasu/attention-head-fusion
summary: Fusing independently normalized attention heads can increase the number of explicit key-value entries, or atoms, needed to preserve their output. We prove a sharp separation for $W_d(q)=\sum_{j=1}^dσ(q_j)$: its $d$ two-atom heads use $2d$ head-atom terms, whereas its minimum single-head representation has exactly $2^d$ atoms, even with arbitrary fixed replacement keys, scalar values, and positive masses. The same lower bound holds for every fixed uniform error below $1/2$ on $\mathbb R^d$, and the threshold is sharp. The proof uses exposed-key normal cones; exact equality on any nonempty open query domain inherits the bound. The resulting atom bound for a fixed head count is tight when that count divides $d$. A normalized family retains its exponential exact minimum while approaching a constant on fixed-radius query balls. For pretrained-model caches, a classical affine-rank bound and a certified instance exclude exact vector preservation at a specified atom count. Learned-cache comparisons on two disjoint banks of 64 contexts show budget-dependent reversals and calibration effects.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究把独立归一化的注意力头融合成单个头时，显式键值原子数量的最小增长，证明 $W_d(q)=\sum_j\sigma(q_j)$ 的单头精确表示存在 $2^d$ 原子的严格下界，且阈值尖锐。
AI.motivation: 融合单独归一化的注意力头可以减少头数，但可能增加保持输出所需的显式键值条目（原子）数量。已有工作缺乏对"头数减少—原子数增加"这一权衡的精确、最坏情形刻画，本文给出尖锐分离与下界。
AI.method: 以 $W_d(q)=\sum_{j=1}^d\sigma(q_j)$ 为构造对象，利用"暴露键法锥"（exposed-key normal cones）证明下界；对固定均匀误差 $<1/2$ 在 $\mathbb R^d$ 上给出同样下界并证明阈值尖锐；讨论非空开查询域上精确相等时的下界继承，以及头数 $d$ 可分时原子界的紧性。
AI.result: $d$ 个双原子头共需 $2d$ 个"头—原子"项，而最小单头表示恰好需要 $2^d$ 个原子，即使允许任意固定替换键、标量值与正质量；该下界对任意固定均匀误差 $<1/2$ 成立且阈值为尖锐；头数整除 $d$ 时原子界紧；归一化族在固定半径查询球上趋于常数时仍保持指数级精确最小值。对预训练模型缓存，经典仿射秩界与一个可验证实例排除了在指定原子数下的精确向量保持；两组各 64 个上下文的实验显示预算相关的反转与校准效应。
AI.conclusion: 头融合存在不可避免的指数级原子膨胀，$2^d$ 下界尖锐且对误差鲁棒；预训练模型缓存中精确保持同样受限，实际学习的缓存比较还受预算与校准影响，提示需在头数与原子预算间权衡。

title: Verification-Gated Redraw and Repair for Local Small Language Models: A Paired Evaluation
comment: 21 pages, 3 figures. Includes appendices. Data and scientific reproduction code: https://github.com/fedir/arxiv-experiments-slm-recover
summary: Executable checks can reject incorrect model-generated programs, but rejection alone does not determine whether fresh sampling or diagnostic repair is preferable. We present a controlled, resource-bounded conceptual replication and extension of established recovery policies: a single answer (N), one verification-triggered redraw (R), and one diagnostic repair (D), for Ornith 1.5 9B and Gemma 4 E4B served locally in nominal 4-bit MLX format. The frozen evaluation contains 72 tasks: 40 HumanEval+ problems, 16 SQL tasks and 16 shell tasks. Policies share initial responses and use only public checks for online decisions; every candidate is model-generated. Each task has one stochastic trajectory per model, so the study does not estimate variation across independent sampling blocks. Redraw increases observed final-test success from 51.4% to 59.7% for Ornith and from 55.6% to 62.5% for Gemma. Diagnostic repair reaches 52.8% and 63.9%, respectively. None of four internally prespecified paired contrasts is significant after Holm correction (minimum adjusted p = 0.125). Public checks falsely accept 25 Ornith and 11 Gemma candidates, demonstrating that acceptance is not a correctness guarantee. A post-review audit of initial answers gives perfect-retry upper bounds of 76.4% and 87.5%, respectively: accepted initial errors cannot trigger recovery under the fixed gate. This one-block, resource-bounded study provides a finite-cohort experimental record, not policy equivalence, a general model ranking or universal reliability

AI.tldr: 在72个任务上，对两个本地小模型比较三种恢复策略（单次作答N、验证触发重绘R、诊断修复D），重绘与修复略优但差异不显著；公共检查会误接受错误程序，初始错误若被误接受则无法触发恢复。
AI.motivation: 可执行检查能拒绝错误的模型生成程序，但仅知道"被拒绝"并不能回答后续该选哪种恢复方式：重新采样还是带诊断的修复。作者希望在同一冻结评测、同一初始回答和仅用公开检查做在线决策的受控条件下，比较三种恢复策略的相对效果。
AI.method: 受控、资源受限的概念性复现与扩展实验。三个策略（N单次作答、R一次验证触发重绘、D一次诊断修复）共享初始回答，全部候选由模型生成。模型为本地以名义4-bit MLX格式部署的Ornith 1.5 9B与Gemma 4 E4B。冻结评测集72题（40个HumanEval+、16个SQL、16个shell）。每模型每任务仅一条随机轨迹；对四项内部预设配对对比做Holm校正。
AI.result: 重绘将观测最终测试成功率从51.4%提升到59.7%（Ornith）、55.6%到62.5%（Gemma）；诊断修复达52.8%与63.9%。四项配对对比经Holm校正后均不显著（最小校正p=0.125）。公共检查分别误接受25个（Ornith）与11个（Gemma）候选，说明通过检查不等于正确。事后审计给出"完美重试"上界：76.4%与87.5%，表明在固定门控下被误接受的初始错误无法触发恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该单区块、资源受限研究提供的是一份有限队列的实验记录，而非策略等价性结论、通用模型排名或普适可靠性结论。

title: Persuasion by Parts
summary:
Classical Bayesian persuasion assumes that an information designer can condition signals on the entire state. We propose persuasion by parts. In this model, the receiver's payoff from acting is $X = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i$ for independent coordinates $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ observed by separate sources. The designer commits in advance to a product experiment, in which each source $i$ can condition its signal only on $X_i$. Given the signals, the receiver computes her posterior mean $y$ of $X$ and acts with probability $g(y)$, where $g\colon \mathbb{R} \to [0,1]$ is a nondecreasing function. The designer aims to maximize the probability of action.
  Let $V_{\mathrm{prod}}(g)$ and $V_{\mathrm{joint}}(g)$ be the supremum probabilities of action under persuasion by parts and under joint persuasion, respectively. When the designer knows $g$, we show $$
  V_{\mathrm{prod}}(g) \;\ge\; c\,V_{\mathrm{joint}}(g)^2 \qquad\text{for every nondecreasing } g\colon \mathbb{R} \to [0,1], $$ where $c > 0$ is an absolute constant independent of $n$ and the prior; the exponent $2$ is tight. When $g$ is unknown, we construct a product experiment $Π$ from the prior alone, whose probability of action $V_Π(g)$ satisfies $$
  V_Π(g) \;\ge\; c_\varepsilon\,V_{\mathrm{joint}}(g)^{2 + \varepsilon}
  \qquad\text{for every } \varepsilon > 0 \text{ and every nondecreasing } g\colon \mathbb{R} \to [0,1], $$ where $c_\varepsilon > 0$ depends only on $\varepsilon$.

AI.tldr: 经典贝叶斯说服假设设计者可将信号建立在完整状态上。本文提出"分部说服"：状态是n个独立坐标之和，各信息源只能观察并披露自己那一个坐标，设计者承诺使用乘积实验。研究表明，即使只有分部信息，设计者仍能取得与联合说服相比至多二次方损失的行动概率；在未知g时也可构造乘积实验实现接近二次的保证。
AI.motivation: 经典贝叶斯说服假定信息设计者能依据整个状态设计信号，但现实中信息往往分散在多个独立来源，每个来源只能观察局部坐标。作者希望刻画在这种信息分散、只能做乘积实验（persuasion by parts）情形下，设计者的说服能力相对完全联合说服会损失多少。
AI.method: 将状态建模为独立坐标之和X=ΣX_i，各源i的信号只能依赖于X_i，设计者事先承诺一个乘积实验。接收者根据信号计算后验均值y，并以非降函数g(y)的概率行动。作者分别研究两类目标：已知g时最大化行动概率V_prod(g)；未知g时仅凭先验构造一个通用乘积实验Π，使其对任意非降g都有保证。
AI.result: 已知g时证明V_prod(g) ≥ c·V_joint(g)^2，其中c为与n和先验无关的绝对常数，且指数2是紧的。未知g时，构造出仅依赖先验的乘积实验Π，使得对任意ε>0及任意非降g有V_Π(g) ≥ c_ε·V_joint(g)^{2+ε}，c_ε仅依赖ε。
AI.conclusion: 信息分散为独立来源并限制为乘积实验时，相对于完全联合说服，说服力的损失至多是平方级别的，且这一平方指数不可改进；即便设计者不知道行动规则g，也能仅凭先验构造出接近最优（指数2+ε）的鲁棒乘积实验。这表明分部说服在信息分散环境中具有稳健的有效性。

title: SIDRec: End-to-End Semantic ID Representation and Modeling for Recommendation
summary: Semantic IDs (SIDs) have emerged as a promising approach for discriminative recommendation by encoding continuous item rep- resentations into compact discrete identifiers. However, existing SID-based methods face two fundamental limitations: semantic mis- match between content semantics and collaborative preferences, and objective mismatch between SID construction and downstream recommendation optimization. To address these challenges, we propose SIDRec, an end-to-end recommendation-aware SID learn- ing framework that jointly models content and collaborative in- formation while aligning SID construction with recommendation objectives. Specifically, SIDRec introduces a self-updating fusion mechanism that explicitly integrates pretrained content represen- tations with collaborative embeddings initialized from a trained recommendation model, enabling preference-aware semantic mod- eling. Furthermore, SIDRec employs an MMoE-inspired joint opti- mization mechanism with shared experts and task-specific gates, allowing recommendation supervision to directly guide differen- tiable quantization and produce task-adaptive discrete representa- tions. Extensive experiments on three public benchmark datasets demonstrate that SIDRec consistently outperforms all competing methods across both AUC and GAUC, achieving up to 5.15% relative improvements over the strongest baselines. Further ablation stud- ies validate the effectiveness and complementarity of collaborative semantic modeling and end-to-end SID optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端、面向推荐优化的语义ID学习框架SIDRec，通过融合内容与协同信息并让推荐监督直接指导可微量化，解决语义错配与目标错配两大问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语义ID（SID）的推荐方法存在两个根本局限：一是内容语义与协同偏好之间的语义错配；二是SID构建目标与下游推荐优化目标之间的目标错配。
AI.method: 提出SIDRec端到端框架：1）自更新融合机制，将预训练内容表示与由已训练推荐模型初始化的协同嵌入显式融合，实现偏好感知的语义建模；2）借鉴MMoE的联合优化机制，采用共享专家与任务特定门控，使推荐监督直接引导可微量化，生成任务自适应的离散表示。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准数据集上，SIDRec在AUC和GAUC上均稳定优于所有对比方法，相较最强基线最高取得5.15%的相对提升；消融实验验证了协同语义建模与端到端SID优化的有效性和互补性。
AI.conclusion: SIDRec通过联合建模内容与协同信息、并将SID构建与推荐目标对齐，有效缓解了语义错配与目标错配问题，验证了端到端推荐感知语义ID学习的可行性与优越性。

title: Fidelity Collapses with Table Size, Not Turn Count: Delivery Architecture in a Deployed Tool-Using Agent
comment: Non-archival paper at the Second Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models (REALM) at EMNLP 2026. 21 pages, 5 figures
summary: When a multi-turn agent delivers a tool's structured records into the model's context and re-emits them each turn, every turn can corrupt data the tool computed correctly. We measure this in a production award-travel agent: two architectures over identical frozen payloads, lineage-matched prompts and sampling, differing only in delivery architecture. SYNTHESIS feeds full record sets into the planner's context and answers follow-ups in-head; BYPASS, the deployed system, keeps records in session state, translates follow-ups into arguments for a deterministic filter, and delivers rows over a typed side channel.
