Across 24 dialogues (339 scored turns per condition), BYPASS scores 92.3% of turns fully correct, SYNTHESIS 45.7% (paired gap +46.6pp [+35.7, +57.1]). Varying delivered-table size by capture date, SYNTHESIS collapses from near-perfect at 10 rows or fewer to 8% or less beyond about 74 rows. On a content-controlled prefix ladder the collapse threshold orders by model capability, from under 10 rows (GPT-4o-mini) to about 198 or more (Gemini 2.5 Pro), while BYPASS stays size-flat for all four models. The collapse is expensive: beyond 100 rows, where almost no SYNTHESIS answer is correct, each correct one costs roughly 200x BYPASS's flat \$0.012. Practitioners converged on typed side-channel delivery for rendering, not correctness; we show it was, unknowingly, also a correctness decision.

AI.tldr: 多轮工具型智能体中，把完整结构化记录塞进模型上下文并反复重述会随规模系统性出错；改为"记录留在会话状态、模型只产出过滤参数、行数据经类型化旁路通道传输"的分离架构可将正确率从45.7%提升到92.3%，且对表规模不敏感。
AI.motivation: 生产级奖励差旅智能体需要多轮追问，但现有做法（SYNTHESIS）把工具算对的记录放进规划器上下文并每轮重新生成，导致数据在被"复述"时被腐蚀。业界实践者普遍把类型化旁路通道当成渲染手段，作者想验证它其实也是正确性决策。
AI.method: 在生产奖励差旅智能体上做受控对比：两种架构使用完全相同的冻结payload、对齐的prompt与采样，唯一变量是数据投递架构。SYNTHESIS 把全量记录集注入规划器上下文、由模型"脑内"应答后续问题；BYPASS（已部署系统）把记录保存在会话状态，把后续问题翻译成确定性过滤器的参数，行数据经类型化旁路通道返回。共24段对话、每条件339个评分轮次；另做按捕获日期改变表规模的规模扫描，以及在内容受控的前缀阶梯上跨四个模型做阈值测试。
AI.result: BYPASS 全对轮次占92.3%，SYNTHESIS 仅45.7%，配对差 +46.6pp（95%CI [+35.7, +57.1]）。SYNTHESIS 在≤10行时近乎全对，超过约74行后正确率跌至≤8%；前缀阶梯上崩溃阈值随模型能力排序（GPT-4o-mini <10行，Gemini 2.5 Pro约≥198行），而 BYPASS 对四个模型均保持规模平坦。成本上，超过100行时 SYNTHESIS 的每个正确答案成本约为 BYPASS 稳定 \$0.012 的200倍。
AI.conclusion: 上下文内重述结构数据会随规模崩溃，且崩溃点由模型能力决定；旁路投递架构是规模不敏感的。类型化旁路通道不只是渲染选择，而是此前未被认识到的正确性决策，应作为多轮工具智能体的默认数据投递方式。

title: A Systematic Analysis of Live Intraoperative Surgical Expert Narrations
comment: Accepted as abstract at the SafeSurg Workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: Manual annotation remains the principal bottleneck in surgical video understanding. Live intraoperative narration by the operating surgeon is a scalable alternative that requires no manual annotation, but the information it contains has not been characterized. We analyzed 13 endoscopic lumbar spine decompression procedures (13.2 h) by two senior spine surgeons, using time-synchronized close-mic German audio. An annotation-free pipeline (word-level speech recognition, deterministic correction of surgical-term errors, utterance fusion, LLM-based translation to English, and relevance filtering) converted speech into time-stamped procedural cues labelled with the surgical entities they reference and their speech act. Of 3,171 utterances, 1,201 (37.9%) were retained as procedural cues, while 57.6% were non-procedural and removed. Retained cues referenced instruments (60.7%), anatomy (48.0%) and surgical actions (57.1%), and 98.5% carried at least one of these. 39% of cues (472 of 1,201) were directives, mainly instrument requests and commands. All 467 manually verified instrument requests preceded the instrument's appearance in the field, by a median of 8.2 s. Domain-term transcription corruption affected 18.0% of retained cues. Live narration is thus a dense, annotation-free supervisory signal describing instruments, anatomy, actions and team coordination, but it is noisy and temporally displaced from the events it names, and this displacement must be modelled before safe downstream use.

AI.tldr: 分析13例内镜下腰椎减压手术（13.2小时）主刀医生的术中实时口述，建立无人工标注流水线将其转换为带时间戳的手术线索，发现口述是密集但含噪、且时间上超前于事件的监督信号。
AI.motivation: 手术视频理解中人工标注是主要瓶颈；术者实时口述无需人工标注、可规模化，但其信息内容尚未被刻画。
AI.method: 两位资深脊柱外科医生分析13例手术，采用时间同步近场德语麦克风音频；构建无标注流水线：词级语音识别、手术术语错误确定性纠正、话语融合、LLM英译、相关性过滤，输出带时间戳并标注所指手术实体与言语行为的程序性线索。
AI.result: 3,171条话语中1,201条（37.9%）保留为程序性线索，57.6%为非程序性被剔除；线索中提及器械60.7%、解剖48.0%、手术动作57.1%，98.5%至少含其一；39%（472/1201）为指令性言语，主要为器械请求与命令；467条人工核验的器械请求全部早于器械进入视野，中位提前8.2秒；18.0%保留线索存在领域术语转写错误。
AI.conclusion: 实时口述是描述器械、解剖、动作与团队协作的密集无标注监督信号，但存在噪声且相对其指称事件在时间上发生位移，安全用于下游任务前必须对该时间位移建模。

title: From Cross-Section to Cross-Omics: Conditional Cell Nucleus Image Editing in Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) platforms simultaneously measure gene expression and capture cell nucleus images at single-cell resolution. A fundamental property of tissue preparation introduces a confounding relationship between the two measurement modalities: sectioning a three-dimensional tissue into a thin slice produces a two-dimensional cross-section whose area depends on the cutting angle. Larger cross-sections expose more cytoplasm, yielding higher mRNA counts, while pathomics features such as nuclear area are measured directly from the same 2D boundary. This sectioning geometry creates an apparent correlation between gene expression and pathomics that reflects the measurement process rather than independent biology. Existing gene-to-image methods generate cell images from gene features but do not support condition-driven editing of existing images across both omics layers. We apply the Manifold-Aware Diffusion (MAD) framework to this dual-omics editing setting, enabling targeted modification of one feature group while preserving the other. Evaluated on podocyte cells from CosMx SMI kidney tissue, MAD achieves MAE=0.6636 and FID=25.19 for pathomics editing, outperforming all compared baselines. A controlled simulation study further confirms that the VAE component in MAD better preserves cross-group independence than CCDM (MAD without VAE).

AI.tldr: 该论文指出空间转录组数据的切片几何会人为制造基因表达与病理组学特征之间的虚假相关，并提出用Manifold-Aware Diffusion (MAD) 实现双组学条件驱动的图像编辑。
AI.motivation: ST平台同时测基因表达和细胞核图像，但三维组织切片成二维截面时，切割角度决定截面面积：截面越大暴露胞质越多、mRNA计数越高，而核面积等病理特征又在同一二维边界上测得。这造成反映测量过程而非真实生物学的表观相关性。已有基因到图像方法只能从基因生成细胞图像，无法对已有图像进行跨组学条件的编辑。
AI.method: 将Manifold-Aware Diffusion (MAD) 框架用于双组学编辑：在扩散模型中通过流形约束，对其中一组特征做定向修改，同时保持另一组特征不变。并以CCDM（去掉VAE的MAD）作为消融对照，用受控仿真研究检验VAE组件对跨组独立性的保持作用。
AI.result: 在CosMx SMI肾脏组织的足细胞数据上，病理组学编辑达到MAE=0.6636、FID=25.19，优于所有对比基线；仿真实验表明MAD中的VAE比CCDM更好地保持两组学间的独立性。
AI.conclusion: MAD能有效实现跨组学条件的图像编辑，且VAE组件对于解耦两组学的混淆关系至关重要；研究强调了在ST分析中考虑切片几何这一混杂因素的必要性。

title: Quantization of Large Models with Weight Outliers and Sparsity
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the memory burden of large model deployment by casting the high precision trained weights to fewer bits. While this promotes memory-efficient inference, it also incurs quantization error that impairs model performance. To compensate for quantization error, the present contribution decomposes the original trained weights into a quantized matrix, a low-rank component, and a sparse matrix that accounts for outlier rows in the weights. Due to analytical intractability and the discrete structure of the decomposition, a simulated annealing search is employed to explore candidate decompositions while avoiding poor local minima. Numerical tests demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach across a broad suite of large language models, including Llama 3.2 1B, Llama 3.2 3B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Qwen2.5 7B, evaluated on natural language generation benchmarks using 4-bit NF4 and FP4 quantizers. The novel method can markedly outperform direct quantization while incurring minimal memory overhead.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种训练后量化(PTQ)误差补偿方法，将权重分解为量化矩阵、低秩分量和稀疏矩阵，并用模拟退火搜索最优分解，在多个大语言模型上显著优于直接量化且内存开销极小。
AI.motivation: PTQ将高精度权重转为低比特可降低大模型部署的内存负担，但会引入量化误差损害性能，因此需要有效的误差补偿手段。
AI.method: 将原始训练权重分解为三部分：量化矩阵、低秩分量、以及刻画权重中离群行的稀疏矩阵。由于该分解解析上难以处理且结构离散，采用模拟退火搜索候选分解以避免陷入较差的局部极小。
AI.result: 在Llama 3.2 1B、Llama 3.2 3B、Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen2.5 7B等模型上，使用4-bit NF4与FP4量化器，在自然语言生成基准上评估，新方法显著优于直接量化，且内存开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 通过量化矩阵+低秩分量+稀疏离群行的分解结合模拟退火搜索，可在极低内存开销下有效补偿PTQ量化误差，适用于多种大语言模型与4-bit量化格式。

title: Structured Visual Landscape: Generating Preferred Representations in Biological and Artificial Neural Networks
summary: Understanding how neurons respond to visual stimulus is an important question in both deep learning and neuroscience. It has significant implications for enhancing the interpretability of black-box artificial neural networks and for understanding the visual representation in the human brain. We propose a structured visual representations landscape and design an activation-based prior that allows us to effectively regularize the landscape with activations from brain regions or neural network units. Our model Vis-Lens integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model into an image generation framework. It enables the generation of natural, realistic preferred images by directly modifying the activation-regularized latent codes without per-image iterative optimization. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework on both artificial neural networks and human visual cortex using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data. Our framework improves activation modulation and image realism compared with a recent state-of-the-art method for generating preferred visual representations of these neural targets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Vis-Lens 框架，通过激活正则化的扩散-变分自编码器生成能激活特定神经元或脑区的自然图像，无需逐图迭代优化。
AI.motivation: 理解神经元对视觉刺激的响应，对提升黑箱神经网络可解释性、以及理解人脑视觉表征均具有重要意义。已有生成首选刺激图像的方法往往需要逐图迭代优化，效率与真实性受限。
AI.method: 构建结构化的视觉表征景观（landscape），设计基于激活的先验，用脑区或网络单元的激活进行正则化；模型 Vis-Lens 将变分自编码器与扩散模型整合为图像生成框架，直接修改经激活正则化的潜码生成图像，无需逐图迭代优化。
AI.result: 在人工神经网络和人类视觉皮层（fMRI 数据）上验证有效；相比近期最先进的首选视觉表征生成方法，在激活调制与图像真实性方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: Vis-Lens 提供了一种高效、无需迭代优化的首选刺激图像生成方案，可同时服务于神经网络可解释性和人脑视觉表征研究。

title: Architecting Fairness-Aware LLM Interactions
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/ACM ASE 2026 Journal Ahead Workshop (JAWs), October 12-16, 2026, Munich, Germany
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as decision-support tools but may generate stereotypical, discriminatory, or unfair responses. As LLMs become embedded in decision-critical software systems, fairness can no longer be treated as a downstream evaluation step, but must become an architectural concern of the interaction itself. Yet current fairness approaches operate as standalone evaluation techniques, lacking a reusable mechanism to verify and mitigate violations at runtime. We propose a fairness-assurance architecture grounded in three reusable design patterns, instantiated as a multi-agent framework that evaluates and iteratively refines LLM responses before delivery. A preliminary evaluation across eight configurations involving different LLM families shows that the architecture identifies fairness violations and iteratively produces compliant responses in all configurations, with behavior differing depending on the model-family composition. These results provide initial evidence for the joint instantiation of the proposed patterns and a first step toward architecting non-functional properties into LLM-based systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于三种可复用设计模式的公平性保障架构，实例化为多智能体框架，在交付前评估并迭代修正LLM回复，在八种配置下均能识别公平性违规并生成合规回复。
AI.motivation: LLM日益作为决策支持工具嵌入关键系统，可能产生刻板、歧视或不公平回复；现有公平性方法只是独立的评估手段，缺乏运行时验证与缓解的复用机制，公平性未被视为交互架构层面的关注点。
AI.method: 以三种可复用设计模式为基础构建公平性保障架构，并实例化为多智能体框架，在回复交付前对其进行公平性评估与迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在涉及不同LLM家族的八种配置中进行初步评估，架构在所有配置下均能识别公平性违规并迭代生成合规回复，且行为随模型家族组合的不同而变化。
AI.conclusion: 结果为所提模式的联合实例化提供了初步证据，是朝将非功能属性架构化融入LLM系统迈出的第一步。

title: A Cooperative Game-Theoretic Framework for Real-Time Deviation Settlement in Local Energy Communities
summary: This paper proposes a cooperative game-theoretical framework for the financial settlement of real-time deviations in Community-Based Local Energy Markets (CB-LEMs). The real-time settlement process is modeled as a transferable-utility cooperative game, and the resulting Real-Time Local Energy Market (RTLEM) game is shown to be superadditive and balanced. We analyze two game-theoretical allocation mechanisms, the Shapley value and the nucleolus, and evaluate their efficiency, individual rationality, coalitional rationality, and temporal-aggregation properties. We subsequently compare these mechanisms with a settlement rule based on proportional imbalance responsibility. The three mechanisms are efficient and individually rational, but only the nucleolus is guaranteed to satisfy coalitional rationality for every RTLEM instance. The proposed framework is demonstrated using real-world data from a residential energy community in Amsterdam, showing the trade-offs among the three allocation mechanisms in terms of surplus distribution, coalitional stability, interpretability, and computational requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文将社区型本地能源市场(CB-LEM)中实时偏差的财务结算建模为可转移效用合作博弈,证明RTLEM博弈具有超可加性与平衡性,并比较Shapley值、核仁与比例偏差责任结算规则的效率、个体理性、联盟理性及时序聚合性质。基于阿姆斯特丹真实居民能源社区数据验证。
AI.motivation: CB-LEM中实时偏差的财务结算如何公平且稳定地在成员间分摊,缺乏同时兼顾联盟稳定性和可解释性的理论化结算机制。
AI.method: 将实时结算过程建模为可转移效用合作博弈(RTLEM博弈),证明其超可加性与平衡性;分析Shapley值与核仁两种分配机制,并与基于比例偏差责任的结算规则对比,考察效率、个体理性、联盟理性及时序聚合性质;使用阿姆斯特丹居民能源社区的真实数据开展实例验证。
AI.result: 三种机制均满足效率与个体理性,但只有核仁保证在每个RTLEM实例中满足联盟理性。真实数据实验展示了三者在剩余分配、联盟稳定性、可解释性与计算需求方面的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 核仁在联盟稳定性上具有理论保证但计算成本较高,Shapley值与比例规则更具可解释性,实际应用需在稳定性、可解释性与计算开销间权衡取舍。

title: Improving Ads Ranking Models with Auxiliary Supervision: Techniques and Insights
comment: 5 pages. Accepted to the IEEE ICDM International Workshop on AI for Personalization (WAIP 2026)
summary: Accurate prediction of post-click Conversion Rate (CVR) is essential for personalized ad delivery in the advertising industry. Traditional ads ranking models rely on conversion events (e.g., a user purchasing an item) as ground truth labels for training. However, these conversion events are often sparse or missing, which limits the effectiveness of model learning. The primary contributions of this paper are: (1) a case study on the use of auxiliary supervision from a diverse set of user events and metadata signals beyond traditional conversion events, and (2) advanced modeling techniques designed to maximize the value of these signals. We detail architectural innovations such as linearized labels for improved auxiliary signal precision, a split architecture to facilitate training task decomposition, and a novel Label Combination (LaCo) approach for robustly managing noisy auxiliary data. Empirical results demonstrate that these methods deliver measurable improvements in ranking models, underscoring their versatility and effectiveness across recommendation systems and related domains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究点击后转化率(CVR)预测中转化标签稀疏/缺失的问题，提出利用多样化用户事件与元数据作为辅助监督，并结合线性化标签、拆分架构和Label Combination(LaCo)等方法提升排序模型效果。
AI.motivation: 传统广告排序模型依赖转化事件(如购买)作为真实标签，但此类事件稀疏或缺失，导致模型学习效果受限，需要引入更丰富的辅助监督信号。
AI.method: (1) 对超越传统转化事件的多类用户事件与元数据信号进行辅助监督的案例研究；(2) 提出建模技术：线性化标签提升辅助信号精度、拆分架构实现训练任务分解、以及新颖的Label Combination(LaCo)方法以稳健处理噪声辅助数据。
AI.result: 实验表明这些方法在排序模型上带来可测量的提升，并显示其在推荐系统及相关领域具有通用性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用多样化辅助信号并配以相应建模技术可有效缓解CVR标签稀疏问题，提升广告排序模型性能。

title: From Lookups to Lessons: Turning Retrieved Knowledge into Parametric Memory
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) helps large language models (LLMs) answer factual questions beyond their training data, but it adds storage and inference costs. Distilling previously retrieved information into parametric memories enables reuse without online retrieval. However, training the memory to mimic a retriever rewards accurate independent predictions, which do not necessarily improve the final output quality when combined with the LLM's existing predictions. To address this, we introduce ResMem, in which the LLM reads retrieved text offline to generate teacher targets. This design avoids storing massive token representations, unlike existing parametric memory approaches such as MLP Memory, which relies on k-nearest neighbor (kNN) datastores. Furthermore, by using the LLM as an offline teacher that reads privileged retrieved evidence alongside the input, we train a parametric memory to learn an additive logit residual. This residual aligns the predictions of a student sharing the same backbone with the teacher distribution, while self-distillation updates remain confined to the parametric memory. On a Wikipedia subset, ResMem reduces the storage retained for teacher construction by 94.7% compared with the evaluated kNN pipeline. Across five question answering datasets, ResMem raises mean token F1 from 32.83% for the frozen LLM to 34.48%. It also breaks 21% fewer of the LLM's correct answers than a kNN-trained memory. These findings validate our motivation of treating retrieval as a learning resource, with parametric memory shaped by how retrieved knowledge is used to inform the model's future predictions. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/SSRand/From-Lookups-to-Lessons and https://huggingface.co/RandHan/ResMem-Mistral-7B-v0.3.

AI.tldr: ResMem通过让LLM离线阅读检索文本生成教师目标，训练参数化记忆学习加性logit残差，实现无需在线检索的知识复用，显著降低存储并提升问答性能。
AI.motivation: RAG提升LLM事实问答能力但增加存储与推理成本；现有将检索信息蒸馏进参数化记忆的方法（如MLP Memory依赖kNN）奖励独立准确预测，未必改善与LLM预测结合后的最终输出质量，且需存储大量token表示。
AI.method: LLM离线阅读检索文本生成教师目标；将LLM作为读取特权检索证据的离线教师，训练参数化记忆学习加性logit残差，使同骨干学生预测对齐教师分布，自蒸馏更新仅限参数化记忆，避免存储大量token表示。
AI.result: 在Wikipedia子集上，教师构建存储较kNN流程减少94.7%；在五个问答数据集上，平均token F1从冻结LLM的32.83%提升至34.48%；对LLM原本正确答案的破坏比kNN训练的记忆少21%。
AI.conclusion: 将检索视为学习资源、由检索知识如何影响未来预测来塑造参数化记忆的思路得到验证，可低成本复用检索知识并保持LLM原有能力。

title: DiA: Directional Adapter
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Joint first authors with equal contributions. Code - https://github.com/prakashchhipa/DiA-Directional-Adapter
summary: Fine-grained action recognition often depends on how an action unfolds over time rather than on appearance alone. Visually similar classes may differ in preparation, execution, or completion phases, making uniformly aggregated temporal context suboptimal. We study this problem under a practical objective: i) improving recognition performance with few tunable parameters, ii) being compute efficient, and iii) using only the readily available video modality. Motivated by this missing temporal observation and the accuracy--compute efficiency--unimodality objective, we propose Directional Adapter (DiA), a parameter-efficient adapter on top of CLIP. DiA formulates temporal specialization into causal and anti-causal directions, allowing past-to-present and future-to-present cues to be modeled differently. To keep this directional modeling parameter- and compute-efficient, both directions use depth-wise temporal convolutions in a compact bottleneck space and are combined through a learnable fusion. DiA achieves state-of-the-art performance among methods using a single video input modality across seven public benchmarks, with only $\sim$3.6M tunable parameters, while also delivering higher throughput and lower inference latency than prior methods. Code is available at https://github.com/prakashchhipa/DiA-Directional-Adapter.

AI.tldr: 提出 DiA，一种基于 CLIP 的参数高效适配器，通过因果/反因果方向的时间卷积建模细粒度动作，仅约360万可调参数即在七个基准上达到单模态SOTA，且吞吐更高、延迟更低。
AI.motivation: 细粒度动作识别依赖动作在时间上的展开过程（准备、执行、完成阶段），而视觉相似类别往往仅在这些阶段上有差异；统一聚合的时间上下文会丢失这种时序特异性。作者在"少参可调、计算高效、仅用视频单模态"的实用约束下解决该问题。
AI.method: 在 CLIP 之上设计 Directional Adapter（DiA），将时间特化拆分为因果（past-to-present）和反因果（future-to-present）两个方向分别建模；两方向均在紧凑瓶颈空间中用深度可分离时间卷积实现，并通过可学习融合组合起来，以保持参数与计算高效。
AI.result: 在七个公开基准上，DiA 在仅使用单一视频输入模态的方法中达到 SOTA，可调参数仅约 3.6M，同时相比以往方法具有更高吞吐量和更低推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 方向性时间建模是提升细粒度动作识别的有效且低成本手段；DiA 在精度、计算效率与单模态约束三者间取得良好平衡，代码已开源。

title: RE-SciVQA: Improving Scientific VQA With Context-Relevant Retrieval and Lightweight MLLM Adaptation
summary: A deep understanding of scientific literature often relies on interpreting figures that contain key information beyond the main text. Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to extract insights from these figures can significantly accelerate knowledge discovery. Existing works on Scientific Visual Question Answering rely on resource-intensive training pipelines that are often inaccessible and require large computational resources. Instead of designing complex architectures, we propose RE- SciVQA, which focuses on improving the quality of retrieved context and fine-tuning small LLMs with parameter-efficient LoRA training. Using a simple query expansion step, relevant section headers are appended to the original question to improve the retrieval coverage. In addition, a simple adjustment of similarity scores is applied using figure references and caption alignment. On the SciVQA benchmark, RE-SciVQA achieves a ROUGE-1 F1 score of 73.9%, outperforming chart-focused models such as UniChart (14.7%), ChartGemma (6.9%), and Matcha-ChartQA (6.3%). Our relevance-enhanced RAG setup also improves the exact match by 11.9% and the fuzzy match by 29.5% compared with a standard RAG baseline, resulting in an overall gain of 14.3%. We also examine closed-ended infinite visual questions, a category in which chart-understanding models often struggle. Our experiments show that using plot digitization instead of synthetic captions leads to an 18.5% improvement for this question type.

AI.tldr: 提出 RE-SciVQA，通过改进检索上下文质量与 LoRA 微调小模型来提升科学图表问答性能，在 SciVQA 上取得 73.9% ROUGE-1 F1，显著超越图表专用模型。
AI.motivation: 科学文献中的图表含有关键信息，现有科学视觉问答方法依赖资源密集的训练流程，难以复现且算力需求大，因此需要更轻量、易获取的方案。
AI.method: 不设计复杂架构，而是：1）用简单的查询扩展，将相关章节标题拼接到原问题以提升检索覆盖率；2）利用图引用与图注对齐对相似度分数做简单调整以优化上下文检索；3）对小规模 LLM 进行参数高效的 LoRA 微调。
AI.result: 在 SciVQA 基准上 ROUGE-1 F1 达 73.9%，远超 UniChart(14.7%)、ChartGemma(6.9%)、Matcha-ChartQA(6.3%)；相比标准 RAG 基线，精确匹配提升 11.9%、模糊匹配提升 29.5%，总体增益 14.3%；在封闭式无限视觉问答中，用图表数字化替代合成图注带来 18.5% 提升。
AI.conclusion: 改进检索质量加轻量 LoRA 微调是科学图表问答的高效路线，无需重型架构即可大幅超越专用图表模型；图表数字化对困难题型尤为有效。

title: A Framework for Task-Agnostic Counterfactual Fairness in Transformers through Activation Steering
summary: Bias in transformer-based models is a growing concern as these architectures become more prevalent in automated decision-making systems, such as prediction models for hiring, lending, and clinical treatment recommendation. Mechanistic interpretability (MI) is a growing body of work that measures meaningful causal effects of activations on model output by identifying human-interpretable features encoded in model activations. When such features correspond to sensitive attributes, they provide a direct way to quantify the bias those attributes introduce and to causally intervene to mitigate it. However, counterfactual fairness (CF) methods have not been systematically adapted to this setting of intervening on interpretable mechanisms in transformers. We propose a framework, Mechanistic Interpretability for Counterfactual Fairness (MICF), that utilizes MI tools to reformulate CF constraints in terms of transformer activations, unifying former approaches into a single pipeline for fairness analysis in transformers. MICF does not require a prior causal model or specific transformer architecture. We evaluate MICF on real-world tabular data and show that CF can be improved across different prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MICF框架，用机制可解释性(MI)工具把反事实公平(CF)约束重新表述为transformer激活层面的约束，统一为单一流水线，无需先验因果模型或特定架构，在真实表格数据上跨多个预测任务提升了反事实公平性。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型在招聘、信贷、临床治疗推荐等自动化决策中日益普及，其偏见问题令人担忧。机制可解释性可识别激活中可解释特征并度量其对输出的因果效应；若这些特征对应敏感属性，则可直接量化偏见并做因果干预来缓解。然而，反事实公平方法尚未被系统性地适配到"干预transformer可解释机制"这一情形中。
AI.method: 提出MICF(Mechanistic Interpretability for Counterfactual Fairness)框架：利用MI工具识别激活中与敏感属性对应的人类可解释特征，将CF约束改写为基于transformer激活的约束，从而把既有方法统一到单一公平性分析流水线中。该框架不依赖先验因果模型，也不限定特定transformer架构。
AI.result: 在真实世界表格数据上进行评估，表明MICF在多个预测任务中均能提升反事实公平性。
AI.conclusion: 机制可解释性与反事实公平可以有机结合：MICF为transformer中的公平性分析与干预提供了统一、通用(无需因果模型与特定架构)的流水线，并通过激活层面的因果干预有效改善反事实公平。

title: SNAPPerf: Software-Aware Tabular Foundation Model for Retraining-Free Performance Prediction of Configurable Systems
summary:
Modern software systems expose hundreds of configuration options whose combinations can substantially affect execution time, memory and energy usage. Measuring software performance resulting from a configuration set requires running a realistic workload. Since the configuration space grows exponentially, exhaustive benchmarking is infeasible. Prior work therefore trains models on a small set of measured configurations to predict the performance of the rest. Yet these models are specific to a particular software version, hardware platform, and workload, so changes require new measurements and retraining, and such changes are becoming more frequent with coding agents.
  We challenge this per-system training assumption with SNAPPERF (Software-aware, No-retraining, Adaptive Prediction), a sample-efficient tabular foundation model specialized for configurable software. SNAPPERF is pretrained once on synthetic data. Each new update only requires a few measured configurations as context to predict the rest without any per-system training or hyperparameter tuning. Across 39,866 configurations from 12 real-world systems, spanning 6 domains and 4 performance metrics, SNAPPERF reduces prediction error by 38% over the prior state of the art at the same measurement budget, and by 25% over the best general-purpose tabular foundation model. It matches the state of the art's accuracy with 54% fewer measurements on average. These results suggest that knowledge about software can be encoded in pretraining data rather than in per-system models, opening a new research direction in software-aware pretraining.

AI.tldr: SNAPPERF：一个针对可配置软件的样本高效表格基础模型，预训练一次后无需逐系统训练或调参，仅用少量测量配置即可预测其余配置的性能。
AI.motivation: 软件配置空间指数增长使穷举基准测试不可行，而现有预测模型绑定于特定软件版本、硬件平台与工作负载，环境变化（尤其编码智能体使变化更频繁）后必须重新测量与训练，代价高。
AI.method: 提出"软件感知预训练"思路：在合成数据上一次性预训练 SNAPPERF 表格基础模型，新场景仅需少量已测配置作为上下文进行预测，无需逐系统训练或超参数调优。
AI.result: 在来自12个真实系统、6个领域、4类性能指标共39,866个配置上，同等测量预算下预测误差较此前最优方法降低38%，较最佳通用表格基础模型降低25%；达到SOTA精度平均少用54%的测量。
AI.conclusion: 软件性能知识可编码进预训练数据而非逐系统模型，为"软件感知预训练"开辟新研究方向。

title: Dynamic Coalition Formation Under Capacity Constraints: A Regime-Switching Value-Investing Game
summary: Edge computing service deployment requires the Network Operator (NO) and Service Providers (SPs) to coordinate investment and resource allocation under uncertain demand. This paper develops an audit-based service management framework for daily coalition formation with fixed capacity and service-level agreement (SLA) reservations. A two-stage coalitional game separates infrastructure investment from operational participation. Demand follows a Geometric Random Walk (GRW), and SPs apply an ordered admission and suspension rule using reported marginal contributions. With the NO held fixed, the operational coalition value is submodular; mandatory reservations can produce negative Shapley payoffs. We derive a separable benchmark, compute operational Shapley allocations, and give a sufficient condition for convergence to an individual equilibrium. A probabilistic audit mechanism provides a conditional daily truthfulness guarantee under verified settlement and enforceable penalties. For five service classes over three years, the reference run gains 12.4% over static grand-coalition membership and recovers 94.6% of the full-information optimum. Across 30 runs, the median gain is 13.3%. Sensitivity tests examine policy parameters, capacity and alternative demand models. The gain depends on capacity and update order; abundant capacity can make the admission rule underperform static membership.

AI.tldr: 提出基于审计的边缘计算服务管理框架，用两阶段联盟博弈协调NO与SP的投资与运营，并以概率审计机制保障每日真实性；三年五类服务实验显示较静态大联盟提升12.4%。
AI.motivation: 边缘计算服务部署需网络运营商与多个服务提供商在需求不确定下协调投资与资源分配，而现有机制缺乏对日常联盟组建、SLA预留及报告真实性的统一处理。
AI.method: 两阶段联盟博弈将基础设施投资与运营参与分离；需求建模为几何随机游走（GRW）；SP按报告边际贡献执行有序准入与暂停规则；NO固定时运营联盟价值具子模性；推导可分离基准与运营Shapley分配，给出收敛到个体均衡的充分条件；设计概率审计机制，在验证结算与可执行惩罚下提供条件性每日真实性保证。
AI.result: 强制预留可导致负Shapley收益；参考运行较静态大联盟成员制提升12.4%，达到完全信息最优的94.6%；30次运行中位数增益13.3%；增益依赖容量与更新顺序，容量充裕时准入规则可能不如静态成员制。
AI.conclusion: 审计式日常联盟框架能在不确定需求下改善资源协调收益，但收益对容量与更新顺序敏感，需谨慎设定政策参数与容量约束。

title: Dynamic Click Destinations: Personalizing Post Ad-Click Landing Experiences
comment: 5 pages. Accepted to the IEEE ICDM International Workshop on AI for Personalization (WAIP 2026)
summary:
Apps that monetize outbound (offsite) ad clicks have multiple post ad-click levers that influence user and business outcomes, including the landing page shown on the advertiser's site, whether the click resolves to a webpage or an app on the user's device, and whether it resolves to a native in-product surface or an external website. We refer to personalization over these levers as post ad-click destination automation. The optimal destination is heterogeneous across users, advertisers, placements, devices, and inferred intent, making static, one-size-fits-all destination policies suboptimal.
  We present Dynamic Click Destinations (DCD), a production personalization framework that selects a destination for each eligible offsite ad click to maximize Advertiser Value (AV), a value-weighted conversion outcome. DCD applies to any post-click destination decision where the system can choose among destination options at click time and downstream conversion feedback is available. We describe an evolution of learning objectives from post-conversion destination inference, to two-task destination-conditioned conversion prediction, to a single-task policy model that directly predicts which of two destinations is better for a given click, trained with Advantage Actor Critic (A2C)-inspired soft labels derived from a higher-capacity destination-conditioned "critic" model.
  In a web-vs-app case study, online A/B experiments at scale on a major advertising platform show that per-click personalization with DCD outperforms both static routing policies, with the single-task objective delivering the largest gains. These results highlight post ad-click destination as an important and under-explored lever in conversion optimization and demonstrate that personalized destination automation can outperform one-size-fits-all destination policies.

AI.tldr: 提出DCD（动态点击目的地）个性化框架，在每次站外广告点击时选择最优落地目的地（网页/应用、站内/站外），以最大化广告主价值，线上A/B实验显示优于静态路由。
AI.motivation: 外链广告点击后的多个"点击后杠杆"（落地页、网页vs应用、站内原生页vs外部网站）对用户与商业结果影响大，但最优目的地因用户、广告主、版位、设备、意图而高度异质，静态统一策略次优，此方向研究不足。
AI.method: 面向每次符合条件的站外点击，预测并选择目的地以最大化价值加权转化（Advertiser Value）。学习目标历经三代演进：①由转化后目的地推断；②两任务的目的地条件化转化预测；③单任务策略模型，直接预测两个目的地中哪个更优，训练用源于高容量"critic"目的地条件模型产生的A2C风格软标签。
AI.result: 在大型广告平台开展大规模线上A/B实验（web vs app案例），逐点击个性化的DCD优于静态路由策略，其中单任务目标带来最大提升。
AI.conclusion: 点击后目的地是转化优化中重要且被低估的杠杆；个性化目的地自动化可超越一刀切策略，且框架具通用性（凡点击时可选项、有下游转化反馈皆适用）。

title: Steering Readerly Dynamics: Trajectory-Guided Story Generation with Large Language Models
comment: 55 pages, 20 figures, 18 tables, including references and the appendix
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate stories, but these stories struggle to reproduce engaging readerly dynamics, the evolving reader responses that shape narrative experience. To address this challenge, we propose a framework that learns readerly dynamics from high-quality human-written stories and uses them to guide story generation. Instead of directly modeling high-dimensional story content, we train a small LLM to predict future reader responses as low-dimensional trajectories. We then leverage the strong instruction-following capability of a larger, off-the-shelf writer LLM to generate story segments that follow these predicted trajectories within a given story setting. Our framework improves trajectory-based fidelity to human-written stories by 12%-35% while largely preserving story coherence.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从高质量人类故事中学习"读者动态"（读者反应随叙事演变）的框架，用小型LLM预测低维读者反应轨迹，引导大型写作LLM生成故事，轨迹保真度提升12%-35%且基本保持连贯性。
AI.motivation: LLM生成故事难以复现引人入胜的读者动态（readerly dynamics），即塑造叙事体验的读者反应演变过程。
AI.method: 不直接建模高维故事内容，而是训练一个小型LLM预测未来读者反应的低维轨迹；再用大型现成写作LLM的强指令遵循能力，在给定故事设定下生成遵循预测轨迹的故事片段。
AI.result: 相较人类撰写故事，轨迹保真度提升12%-35%，同时较大程度保持了故事连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 以低维读者反应轨迹为中介引导生成，是一条有效提升LLM故事叙事体验的途径。

title: OmniPiano: Diverse Dexterous Piano-Playing Challenges for Standard, Robust, Safe, and Multi-Agent RL
summary: Dexterous robotic manipulation remains a major challenge in robotics, exemplified by piano playing, which requires coordinated control of fingers and provides a demanding testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). Although previous work established a benchmark for robotic piano playing, it is restricted to two hands and does not support unified evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce OmniPiano, a benchmark that provides one to up to five Shadow Hands and supports standard, robust, safe, and multi-agent RL within a shared piano-playing task family. OmniPiano is developed for scalable and diverse piano-playing tasks with configurable perturbations, explicit safety constraints, and decentralized cooperation settings. Particularly, to facilitate usability and extendability, OmniPiano adopts a highly modular design and provides comprehensive tasks to support RL study of task performance, robustness, safety, and cooperation in dexterous control. With at least 912 task settings and 36 baseline algorithms, OmniPiano further incorporates LLM-based agents to broaden the evaluation scope and reveal new insights. Extensive evaluations show that state-of-the-art RL algorithms and frontier LLM-based agents still struggle on challenging piano-playing tasks, even under standard RL settings, highlighting substantial room for improvement in dexterous control. The code, dataset, tutorial, and demo are available at https://sail-research-lab.github.io/omnipiano/.

AI.tldr: OmniPiano：支持1-5只Shadow Hand、统一评测标准/鲁棒/安全/多智能体RL的钢琴演奏基准，含912+任务与36种基线算法。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作是机器人难题，钢琴演奏是有价值的测试平台；但已有基准仅限双手、缺乏统一评测，无法覆盖鲁棒性、安全性与协作等维度。
AI.method: 构建统一钢琴任务族，支持1至5只Shadow Hand；提供可配置扰动、显式安全约束、去中心化合作设置；采用高度模块化设计以保证可用性与可扩展性；并引入基于LLM的智能体扩展评测范围。
AI.result: 提供至少912种任务设置与36种基线算法（含标准RL与LLM智能体）；实验显示当前最优RL算法与前沿LLM智能体在困难任务（即使标准设定）上仍表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: OmniPiano为灵巧控制中的性能、鲁棒性、安全性与协作研究提供可扩展统一基准，并揭示灵巧操作仍有显著提升空间。

title: RaMMOBO: Random Max-Margin Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization
summary: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) maximizes $M$ expensive black-box objectives with the goal of approximating the Pareto set, whose objective vectors cannot be improved in one component without sacrificing another. A common quality measure is hypervolume, the volume in objective space dominated by these vectors relative to a reference point. Expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI) directly targets this metric and is one-step Bayes-optimal, but its standard computation scales exponentially with $M$, making it prohibitively expensive for many-objective problems. We introduce random max-margin multi-objective Bayesian optimization (RaMMOBO), whose acquisition function lower-bounds EHVI while requiring only linear cost in $M$ to evaluate. RaMMOBO measures the volume of a max-margin box contained in a candidate's hypervolume-improvement region and averages over random reweightings of the objective space, yielding a utility that is strictly Pareto-monotone on hypervolume-improving outcomes. It naturally handles noisy observations and different probabilistic surrogates and supports efficient gradient-based optimization. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, RaMMOBO matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with largest gains at higher $M$, with acquisition optimization up to two orders of magnitude faster than qLogNEHVI. Our implementation is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rammobo.

AI.tldr: RaMMOBO提出一种线性复杂度（关于目标数M）的多目标贝叶斯优化采集函数，以max-margin盒体积下界EHVI并对随机重加权取平均，兼顾Pareto单调性、噪声鲁棒性与梯度优化效率，在高维目标问题上匹配或超越SOTA且采集优化快达两个数量级。
AI.motivation: MOBO的核心质量指标hypervolume对应EHVI，EHVI是一步贝叶斯最优，但标准计算随目标数M指数增长，使多目标（many-objective）问题代价过高，亟需低复杂度且保持性能的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出RaMMOBO：在候选点的hypervolume改进区域内构造max-margin盒，以其体积作为EHVI的下界，并对目标空间的随机重加权取平均；该效用对hypervolume改进结果严格Pareto单调。评估成本仅随M线性增长，天然支持噪声观测与不同概率代理模型，并支持高效的基于梯度的采集函数优化。
AI.result: 在合成与真实基准上匹配或超越现有SOTA方法，M越大增益越明显；采集函数优化速度比qLogNEHVI快最多两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: RaMMOBO以线性成本近似EHVI，为多目标/多目标数MOBO提供了一种可扩展、可梯度优化且带理论保证的实用替代方案，代码已开源。

title: Dependable Agents Need Hard and Fuzzy Rules
summary: Language models let software read requests in ordinary language, but they keep rules as people do: usually, and less so under pressure. Conventional code keeps rules exactly, but it cannot read a request. We argue that dependable agents need both, because the two kinds of rule cover overlapping and unequal regions of what an agent might do. Code holds the limits that can be stated exactly. Learned fuzzy rules cover the judgment that cannot. We test the hard layer in three domains, purchasing, delegation of authority and data access, on 1,340 episodes written by authors outside our team. Models left to decide for themselves executed unauthorized actions in up to 151 of 340 purchasing episodes and 269 of 470 delegation episodes, and the strongest model breached in every condition. A hard guard between proposal and action executed none, and an exhaustive search of 183,204 proposals agreed. In a further test, where an outsider wrote the owner's rules and a program mapped them to the guard, two episodes breached at a boundary we had written down in advance. We then test the pair. Concept Programming instills a named rule in a model and measures its errors on wording it never saw. A small model taught four judgment rules this way flagged 95 of 96 rule-breaking purchases that no exact rule can see, and 4 of 108 legitimate requests. Placed in front of the guard, it left 1 of 192 rule-breaking requests unstopped, where the guard alone left 77 and 70, and the guard still held every exact limit. A prompted frontier model did about as well, so the claim is that a small taught rule can do the job, not that it does it better.

AI.tldr: 论文主张可靠智能体需"硬性代码层+学习模糊规则层"混合架构：代码守住可精确表述的边界，模型处理无法精确化的判断。实验证明硬护闸可完全阻止越权行为，小模型经概念编程学习的规则能补足护闸无法覆盖的模糊判断。
AI.motivation: 语言模型能理解自然语言请求但规则执行不稳定（尤在压力下）；传统代码执行规则精确但无法理解请求。两类规则覆盖的智能体行为区域重叠但不相等，因此单独任一种都不足以保障可靠性，需要二者结合。
AI.method: 在采购、授权委派、数据访问三域用1340个外部撰写情节测试"硬护闸"（位于提议与行动之间）；对183,204个提议做穷举搜索验证；另设外部撰写规则并由程序映射到护闸的测试；再用概念编程为小模型灌注命名判断规则，测量其对未见措辞的泛化错误率，并与护闸串联测试。
AI.result: 无护闸时模型最多在340个采购情节中151次、470个委派情节中269次执行未授权动作，最强模型在所有条件下均越界；硬护闸执行0次，穷举搜索一致。外部规则映射测试中仅2个情节在预先写明的边界处越界。小模型学会4条判断规则后，标出96个精确规则不可见的违规采购中的95个，误标108个合法请求中的4个；与护闸串联后，192个违规请求仅1个未被拦截（护闸单独则分别漏77和70），且精确限制全部保持。前沿模型提示效果相近，说明价值在小模型即可胜任而非更优。
AI.conclusion: 学习型模糊规则与精确硬护闸应组合部署：护闸可靠守护可精确表述的限制，经概念编程的小模型可承担无法编码的判断任务，两者结合能显著降低越权风险，但仍存在少量边界失效需关注。

title: Verification Allocation in Stylized LLM Agent Pipelines under Hidden Tool Degradation: A Discrete-Time Mean-Field Analysis
summary: We study a stylized verification-allocation model for role-structured pipelines with binary inherited corruption and hidden tool degradation. Standard contraction arguments give serial and multi-role fixed points and a finite-population deviation bound under independence. When verification actions affect neither future errors nor observations, the belief-state choice is myopic. We characterize a two-action threshold under an explicit monotonicity condition and a restricted four-action interval and tail policy when generation rates are equal and only one check degrades. Synthetic experiments check these model-specific results and find counterexamples outside the restriction. This is conditional model analysis, not a general mean-field-game result or empirical evidence about deployed LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究角色结构化流水线中的验证-分配模型：具有二元继承性污染与隐藏工具退化，在独立性下给出串行与多角色不动点及有限种群偏差界；当验证不影响未来误差与观测时信念状态选择为短视，并刻画阈值与受限区间/尾部策略。
AI.motivation: 为刻画多角色流水线（如LLM代理链）中误差继承传播与工具隐性退化下的验证资源分配问题，提供一个可分析的简化（stylized）理论模型。
AI.method: 构造二元继承污染+隐藏工具退化的验证-分配模型；用标准压缩映射论证串行与多角色不动点，并在独立性下推导有限种群偏差界；分析验证动作无未来影响时的短视信念选择，在显式单调性条件下给出两动作阈值，并在生成率相等、仅单一检查退化的限制下给出四动作区间与尾部策略。
AI.result: 理论上得到不动点存在性、有限种群偏差界、两动作阈值刻画及受限情形下的四动作区间/尾部策略；合成实验验证了模型特定结论，并在限制条件之外发现反例。
AI.conclusion: 结论为条件性的模型分析，仅适用于所设假设，并非一般平均场博弈结论，也不构成对实际部署LLM系统的经验证据。

title: "PRISM" Is Not All You Need: Cross-Topic Name Collisions and Scientific Paper Retrieval
summary: Scientific names increasingly connect papers from different research topics, leaving readers to recover a paper's identity from context. We study this convergence in 564,861 AI-related arXiv records. Cross-topic name collision grows 4.33-fold from a pooled 2020-2022 reference to 2026, compared with 1.12-fold within topics. A second sentence encoder reproduces the pattern, and name-group resampling quantifies its uncertainty. Fixed word-frequency bands locate the main increase in an intermediate-frequency vocabulary shared by many research areas. We then measure the ambiguity that remains after supplying research clues. With the same three-term query construction, shared-name targets retain matched identification deficits of 25.7 percentage points under title-based BM25 and 6.9 points under title-plus-abstract E5. Within fixed same-name candidates, listwise language-model ranking reaches 89.2% using the query and candidate titles. Topic-specific comparisons show that context resolves more cross-topic ambiguity. The evaluation separates candidate competition, document fields, and contextual ranking through lexical, dense, and language-model baselines. Source-linked cases and a portable evaluation collection make the phenomenon inspectable and reusable for scientific retrieval and research assistants.

AI.tldr: 论文研究AI领域arxiv论文中"重名/同名词汇"跨主题碰撞的增长，并量化即使提供研究线索后仍存在的检索歧义。
AI.motivation: 科学术语（如模型、方法、数据集名）越来越多地在不同研究主题间共用，读者只能靠上下文推断论文身份，导致检索与识别困难；作者希望系统性量化这种跨主题命名收敛现象及其残余歧义。
AI.method: 分析564,861条arXiv AI相关记录：比较跨主题与主题内的名称碰撞倍数（以2020-2022合并为基准到2026），用第二个句子编码器复现、名称组重采样估计不确定性、固定词频带定位增长来源；再用统一三词查询构造测量供给研究线索后的识别缺口，比较标题BM25与标题+摘要E5，并在固定同名候选中用列表级语言模型排序。
AI.result: 跨主题命名碰撞到2026年增长4.33倍，而主题内仅1.12倍；主要增长集中在多个领域共用的中频词汇。即使提供研究线索，同名目标仍有25.7个百分点（BM25标题）和6.9个百分点（E5标题+摘要）的匹配识别缺口；在固定同名候选内，用查询与候选标题的列表级LM排序可达89.2%。
AI.conclusion: 跨主题命名收敛是显著且快速增长的现象，且上下文不能完全消解歧义；研究通过词法、稠密与语言模型基线将候选竞争、文档字段与上下文排序分离评估，并提供可复用的评估集合与可溯源案例。

title: Spotting the Artificial: Dialogic Humor Improvisation in Humans and LLMs
summary:
We propose a methodology for investigating the differences between natural and synthetic language in a challenging setting: humorous improvisational dialogue. Our experimental setting compares human-produced comedy improvisations with the dialogues generated by LLMs in a multi-agent environment that we designed. The analysis combines automated linguistic measures with manual annotation grounded in Systemic Functional Linguistics (SFL).
  The results show that, although LLMs can create coherent and creative scenes, they often fail to reproduce key characteristics of spontaneous spoken interaction. In addition, LLM-generated interactions display a strong tendency toward politeness and positive evaluations, contrasting with the broader range of attitudes found in human humorous improvisation. Our evidence highlights both the strengths and limitations of current LLMs in modeling dialogic humor and demonstrate the value of integrating linguistic theory with NLP methods for the analysis of machine-generated language

AI.tldr: 本文提出在"即兴幽默对话"这一高难度场景下比较自然语言与合成语言的方法论，将人类即兴喜剧对话与多智能体环境中LLM生成的对话进行对比，结合自动化语言指标与基于系统功能语言学（SFL）的人工标注进行分析。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对自然语言与机器生成语言差异的考察多限于一般场景，缺乏在即兴幽默对话这类对语用与互动能力要求极高的情境下的系统比较；本文希望借此同时揭示当前LLM在对话幽默建模上的优势与局限，并展示语言学理论与NLP方法结合的价值。
AI.method: 构建多智能体环境让LLM生成对话，与人类即兴喜剧表演对话进行对照；分析采用两类手段：自动化语言测量指标，以及以系统功能语言学（SFL）为理论基础的人工标注。
AI.result: LLM能够产出一致且富有创造性的场景，但常无法再现自发性口语互动的关键特征；同时LLM生成的互动表现出明显的礼貌性与正面评价倾向，而人类即兴幽默中的态度分布更为多样。
AI.conclusion: 本文证据同时凸显当前LLM在对话幽默建模方面的优势与局限，并表明将语言学理论与NLP方法相结合对分析机器生成语言具有重要价值。

title: Gaussifier: Fast 2D Gaussian Decomposition
summary: 2D Gaussians render images at thousands of frames per second. However, fitting an image takes seconds of optimization. This confines 2D Gaussians to offline use. Feedforward methods are faster but less accurate without per-image fine-tuning. We present Gaussifier, a lightweight feedforward framework for 2D Gaussian decomposition. We learn a density map of Gaussian centers from per-image fitting data. Equal-mass Voronoi places Gaussians so that each Voronoi cell holds approximately equal density. A stateless, reusable network then refines the output in a few iterations. Gaussifier reaches 40.73/38.61\,dB PSNR on Kodak-24/DIV2K at over 60 FPS. At the same Gaussian count, it exceeds every feedforward baseline by 3.0 to 15.6\,dB in PSNR. With fewer Gaussians than any baseline, it still leads the strongest one by 2.5 to 3.5\,dB. At the same count, baselines with their own per-image fitting need 26 to 326 times longer to reach its PSNR. Gaussifier makes high-fidelity 2D Gaussian images fast and light enough for real-time applications. We release code, weights and a browser-based WebGPU demo at https://github.com/Gaussifier/gaussifier.

AI.tldr: Gaussifier 是一个轻量级前馈框架，用学习到的密度图结合等质量 Voronoi 放置高斯基元，再由无状态网络少量迭代精修，实现快速且高保真的 2D 高斯图像分解。
AI.motivation: 2D 高斯渲染可达每秒数千帧，但拟合单张图像需数秒优化，只能离线使用；现有前馈方法虽快却精度不足，需逐图微调。
AI.method: 从逐图拟合数据中学习高斯中心的密度图；用等质量 Voronoi 放置高斯，使每个 Voronoi 单元密度近似相等；再由无状态、可复用的网络经少量迭代精修输出。
AI.result: 在 Kodak-24/DIV2K 上达 40.73/38.61 dB PSNR，速度超 60 FPS；同高斯数下比所有前馈基线高 3.0–15.6 dB；用更少高斯仍比最强基线高 2.5–3.5 dB；同数量下基线需 26–326 倍时间才能达到其 PSNR。
AI.conclusion: Gaussifier 让高保真 2D 高斯图像生成足够快速轻量，可用于实时应用；已开源代码、权重及 WebGPU 浏览器演示。

title: Taurus: LLM-in-the-Loop CT Annotation Matches Coding Agents at Half the Cost
comment: 24 pages (10 main text, 12 appendix), 8 figures, 10 tables
summary: Dense labels of the aorta in CT are slow to draw, and the public aortic CT datasets that could stand in for them each label different structures under their own conventions. Large language model (LLM) agents can now write code and read images. We asked whether such a model labels these scans better as a free-form agent that writes its own segmentation code, or inside a harness, where an automated pass labels the scan and the model reviews the result. We built a harness, Taurus, and compared it with free-form agents by blind label recovery: we withheld the human labels of six public datasets (939 volumes) and scored every approach against each dataset's own classes. In the first version of Taurus, the model's review raised the primary metric on only two of six datasets, by less than the noise between two reviews of the same case. A free-form agent running Claude Opus 5.5 scored higher on most datasets. Moving what the free-form agents did well into the automated pass then carried most of the gain on 38 held-out cases. The final version smooths the label surfaces with a fixed rule and checks for the large errors the automated pass tends to make, such as an aneurysm drawn to half its size. Each check that fires puts a multiple-choice question to the model, with candidate corrections drawn on the scan. It matched the surface smoothness of the human references, and in the primary metric we found no difference from the free-form Opus agent, at under half its cost, $1.22 against $2.71 per case. Most of what made Taurus competitive came from the harness and its automation rather than from the language model itself. Taurus shows that this kind of annotation can be automated, so that expert time can move from drawing labels to checking them.

AI.tldr: 提出自动化分割框架Taurus，在6个公开主动脉CT数据集（939例）上以盲恢复方式评测，最终版与自由式LLM智能体（Claude Opus）等效但成本减半（$1.22 vs $2.71/例），表明竞争力主要来自harness与自动化而非语言模型本身。
AI.motivation: 主动脉CT稠密标注耗时；公开主动脉CT数据集各自遵循不同标注约定，难以互相替代。LLM智能体已能写代码、读图像，但尚不清楚让模型自由式写分割代码更优，还是把模型放入"自动化先分割、模型再审阅"的harness中更优。
AI.method: 构建harness「Taurus」，与自由式智能体做盲标签恢复对比：隐藏6个公开数据集（939例）的人工标签，按各数据集自身类别评分。第一版Taurus由模型审阅分割结果；将自由式智能体的优势迁移进自动化pass，在38例留出集上验证。最终版用固定规则平滑标签表面，并检测自动化pass常见大错误（如动脉瘤只画出一半），每触发一项检查就以多选题形式向模型提问，选项为扫描上绘制的候选修正。
AI.result: 第一版Taurus的模型审阅仅在2/6数据集上提升主指标，且增益小于同一病例两次审阅间的噪声；自由式Claude Opus 5.5在多数数据集上得分更高。迁移改进后，在38例留出集上获得大部分增益。最终版表面平滑度与人工参考匹配，主指标与自由式Opus无显著差异，成本低于其一半（$1.22 vs $2.71每例）。
AI.conclusion: Taurus的竞争力主要源于harness及其自动化，而非语言模型本身；此类标注可被自动化，专家时间可从"绘制标签"转向"检查标签"。

title: Cyber-physical attack detection approaches in the wide-area measurement system
summary: Improving situational awareness within the Smart Grid is an effective preventive measure to detect potential anomalies, and avoid their adverse consequences. A wide area measurement system (WAMS) based Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) can assist in improving visibility within the grid by collecting relevant measurements including magnitude, phase angle, frequency, voltage, and current, with a precise GPS-based timestamp. So far, there are more than 2500 PMUs deployed in the North American power grid, where each of which generates between 30 and 60 samples/s, roughly 1.5 TB/month of streamed data. Thus, processing such large PMU streams requires expensive computational resources and faster algorithms. This paper provides state-of-the-art cyber and physical anomalies in the WAMS and analyses their impact on the integrity and availability of the system. Next, it investigates the current anomaly detection approach in historical and streaming PMU data, including conventional machine learning and hybrid approaches, and assesses their advantages and main drawbacks. Lastly, it sheds light on the importance of handling missing PMU data and concept drifts.

AI.tldr: 该文综述WAMS/PMU数据中的网络与物理异常及其对系统完整性和可用性的影响，评估现有异常检测方法（传统机器学习与混合方法）的优缺点，并强调缺失数据处理与概念漂移的重要性。
AI.motivation: 智能电网中提升态势感知是检测潜在异常、避免严重后果的有效预防手段。PMU可在WAMS中提供带GPS时间戳的幅值、相角、频率、电压、电流等测量，扩大电网可见性。但北美电网已部署2500余个PMU，每个每秒产生30–60个样本，约每月1.5TB流数据，处理如此大规模流数据需要昂贵算力和更快算法，因此亟需系统梳理异常类型与检测方法。
AI.method: 综述性研究：首先归纳WAMS中最新的网络与物理异常，分析其对系统完整性和可用性的影响；其次考察历史与流式PMU数据上的现有异常检测方法，包括传统机器学习与混合方法，并评估其优势与主要缺陷；最后讨论缺失PMU数据处理与概念漂移问题的重要性。
AI.result: 文章系统整理了WAMS异常的类型与影响，梳理了面向历史及流式PMU数据的异常检测方法谱系，对比了传统机器学习和混合方法的优势与不足，并指出缺失数据和概念漂移是当前方法面临的关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: PMU大数据为智能电网态势感知带来机遇，但异常检测在计算效率、方法鲁棒性方面仍面临挑战；未来研究需重视缺失PMU数据的处理与概念漂移的应对，以保障WAMS的完整性与可用性。

title: From Stories to Bugs: Story-Based Semantic Fuzzing of Interactive Systems
summary: Complex interactive systems hide business-logic failures along two complementary axes: deep state-dependent behaviors that require long valid prefixes and concurrency-sensitive failures that depend on the ordering of otherwise legal operations. We present story-based semantic fuzzing, a methodology that treats semantically constrained compositions of behavioral stories as primary search objects. Implemented through Behavioral Programming, semantic binding and state constraints preserve legal prefixes, while event eligibility, schedule selection, and replay expose failure-relevant interleavings. We evaluate the methodology on Magento and four stateful REST APIs. On Magento, overlap-aware ranking increased reproduction of a sporadic Shipping Fee race from 3.6% to 41.2%; a controlled ordering intervention reduced a second failure signature from 100/100 initial executions to 0/200 constrained executions. For the REST study, a versioned end-to-end pipeline took each frozen public OpenAPI contract as its sole benchmark-specific model-generation input and automatically generated the Basic and Complex stories, dependency structure, and interface bindings. Under a shared black-box task and sequence-local evaluation contract, Basic and Complex confirmed 0/11 and 11/11 semantic fault classes, while RESTler and EvoMaster confirmed 2/11 and 0/11. A paired binding ablation produced 250/250 valid dependent operations with binding and 0/250 without it, while supplementary prefix controls localized the difference to preservation of legal relational state. Together, the studies show that searching admissible semantic compositions provides a unified and effective representation for reaching deep states and exposing concurrency-sensitive business-logic failures.

AI.tldr: 提出"基于故事的语义模糊测试"，将语义受约束的行为故事组合作为主要搜索对象，借助行为编程与语义绑定同时覆盖深层状态依赖与并发敏感的业务逻辑缺陷。
AI.motivation: 复杂交互系统的业务逻辑失败沿两条互补轴隐藏：需长合法前缀才能到达的深状态行为，以及依赖合法操作顺序的并发敏感失败；传统模糊测试难以同时处理这两类。
AI.method: 通过行为编程实现语义绑定与状态约束以保持合法前缀，并用事件资格、调度选择与回放暴露有效交错；在Magento上采用重叠感知排序与受控顺序干预，在四个有状态REST API上以冻结的OpenAPI契约为唯一输入，自动生成Basic/Complex故事、依赖结构与接口绑定，并做配对绑定消融与前缀对照。
AI.result: Magento上偶然性运费竞态的复现率由3.6%提升至41.2%；顺序干预使另一失败签名从100/100降至0/200。REST研究中Complex与Basic分别确认11/11与0/11语义故障类，而RESTler为2/11、EvoMaster为0/11；绑定消融得250/250有效依赖操作对0/250，前缀对照将差异定位于合法关系状态的保持。
AI.conclusion: 搜索可接受的语义组合为到达深状态并暴露并发敏感业务逻辑失败提供了统一且有效的表示。

title: Cold-Start Pricing of LLM Services under Two-Sided Learning
summary:
Online large language model (LLM) services face a pricing cold start: providers initially lack the historical data and user information needed for precise pricing, while users' willingness to pay evolves with repeated use. We formulate this challenge as a \emph{two-sided learning} problem between a provider and a user. The user learns from private usage experience, whereas the provider incurs a serving cost and dynamically adapts prices using only purchase decisions to maximize cumulative profit. The provider's central challenge is to learn to price against an evolving willingness to pay without observing the private experiences driving that evolution.
  We establish matching upper and lower bounds on the minimax regret over horizon $T$, identifying two cost-dependent regimes. When serving costs are sufficiently low, our Calibration-and-Tracking (CAT) algorithm achieves the optimal rate $Θ(T^{1/3})$. In the higher-cost regime, where the provider must learn whether continued service is profitable, Calibration-and-Tracking with Retirement (CAT-R) attains the optimal rate $Θ(\sqrt{T})$. This phase transition shows that serving costs affect not only profit margins but also the fundamental difficulty of learning to price LLM services. Simulations support the predicted regret scaling and show that our algorithms outperform standard online learning baselines in the evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在线LLM服务定价的"冷启动"问题，将其建模为提供商与用户之间的双边学习问题，给出随服务成本变化的两阶段最优遗憾界（Θ(T^{1/3}) 与 Θ(√T)），并提出CAT与CAT-R算法达到最优速率。
AI.motivation: 在线LLM服务定价面临冷启动：提供商缺乏历史数据与用户信息，难以精确定价；同时用户支付意愿会随重复使用而演化（用户从私有使用经验中学习）。提供商只能观察购买决策，既看不到驱动用户意愿变化的私有经验，又需承担服务成本，因此需要在"对演化中的支付意愿定价"与"探索学习"之间权衡，这一难题此前缺少理论刻画。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为提供商—用户的双边学习问题：用户基于私有使用经验更新支付意愿，提供商仅依据购买决策在线调整价格以最大化累计利润。对时间跨度T建立极小极大遗憾的下界，并设计匹配的上界算法：低成本情形下的Calibration-and-Tracking（CAT）算法，以及高成本情形下加入"退役"机制的CAT-R算法。
AI.result: 给出匹配的上下界并识别出两个依赖成本的区间：服务成本足够低时，CAT达到最优速率Θ(T^{1/3})；服务成本较高、提供商必须学习"继续服务是否有利可图"时，CAT-R达到最优速率Θ(√T)。仿真验证了预测的遗憾缩放规律，且算法在所评估设置中优于标准在线学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 服务成本不仅影响利润空间，还决定学习定价的根本难度——存在由成本触发的Θ(T^{1/3})到Θ(√T)的相变。该结果为LLM服务定价的冷启动问题提供了首个（据摘要）最优速率刻画与实用算法。

title: CCD: Context-Calibrated Open-Entity Out-of-Distribution Detection in In-Context Tabular Foundation Models
summary: In-context tabular foundation models (TFMs), such as TabPFN, predict from a labelled context without updating their parameters and are increasingly used for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in Web applications, whose test rows come from entities absent from that context. Such applications need open-entity OOD detection: a new entity must not be mistaken for an unknown class, and an unknown class must still be caught. Existing detectors fail in this setting, and an entity-split gap hides the failure: random splits also place the test entities in the context. The failure arises because every TFM score reflects how unfamiliar a row is to the context. This produces an entity-over-class bias: known-class rows of new entities look more OOD than familiar ones, sometimes more than unknown classes. Specifically, the two OOD scores most widely used with in-context TFMs face an entity-class trade-off: the TFM's predictive confidence misses unknown classes, whereas the distance of a test row to the context flags new entities. To address this problem, we hold a group of entities out of the context and score them with the remaining context, which turns them into new entities of known classes and tells us how such rows should score. To measure detection on new entities, we build NEO-Tab (New-Entity OOD detection on Tables), 14 grouped and temporal tables on which all test rows come from new entities. We then propose Context-Calibrated Detection (CCD), which uses these group-out swaps on in-distribution data to calibrate three distances and the confidence against new-entity references. CCD weights them by their sensitivity and sharpness, keeps the model frozen and uses no OOD data. On NEO-Tab, CCD outperforms 16 existing detectors on every metric we report, and its lead holds on three TFM backbones.

AI.tldr: 现有上下文表格基础模型(TFM)的OOD检测器在新实体场景下失效，存在"实体-类别"权衡；作者提出Context-Calibrated Detection (CCD)及NEO-Tab基准，在14个表格上全面超越16种检测器。
AI.motivation: TFM（如TabPFN）在Web应用中做OOD检测时，测试行来自上下文未出现的实体，需要"开放实体"OOD检测：新实体不能被误判为未知类别，未知类别仍需被检出。现有检测器在此设置下失败，且随机划分把测试实体也放进上下文，掩盖了这一失败。根本原因是所有TFM分数都反映"行对上下文的不熟悉度"，产生实体凌驾于类别的偏置（entity-over-class bias）。
AI.method: 1) 将一组实体从上下文中留出，用剩余上下文给它们打分，从而把它们变成"已知类别的新实体"，获得此类行应有的分数参考；2) 构建NEO-Tab基准，包含14个分组/时序表格，测试行全部来自新实体；3) 提出CCD方法，利用分布内数据上的group-out交换，对三种距离与预测置信度相对"新实体参考"进行校准，并按敏感度和锐度加权，模型保持冻结且无需OOD数据。
AI.result: 在NEO-Tab上，CCD在所有报告指标上均优于16种现有检测器，并在三个TFM骨干网络上保持领先优势。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了上下文TFM在开放实体OOD检测中的实体-类别权衡问题，提出NEO-Tab基准与无需OOD数据的CCD校准方法，验证了其有效性与跨骨干泛化性。

title: AStockArena: Beyond Returns, Can We Entrust Real Capital to the Decisions of Financial Agents?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in dynamic financial trading, yet real-time trading benchmarks mainly evaluate agents by cumulative returns and risk-adjusted performance. Such outcome metrics cannot show whether trades are faithfully reported, supported by available evidence, and consistent with account states. We introduce AStockArena, a real-time decision-auditing benchmark for continuous trading in China's A-share market. Under shared market conditions and execution constraints, we evaluate 13 open- and closed-source models over 3,198 sequential decisions. AStockArena reconstructsthe actions actually posted to accounts by aligning reports, trade requests, execution responses, and account states, and audits them with eight checks spanning execution traceability (O), evidence sufficiency (RK), and financial meta-awareness (B), combining record verification with consensus expert annotation. Of 1,070 trading points, 72.99% exhibit at least one audit gap; model-level rates range from52.2% to 91.2%, with evidence gaps most prevalent. Historical trade-filtering replay further shows thatportfolio outcomes are sensitive to these flagged trades. Decision-process auditing thus offers a verifiable complement to return-based evaluation of financial agents.

AI.tldr: 提出AStockArena，一个针对中国A股实时交易的决策审计基准，通过对齐报告、交易请求、执行响应与账户状态，用8项检查（执行可追溯O、证据充分性RK、金融元认知B）审计13个模型在3198次连续决策中的表现；发现1070个交易点中72.99%存在至少一项审计缺口，且组合收益对这些被标记交易敏感。
AI.motivation: 现有实时交易基准主要用累计收益和风险调整指标评价LLM交易代理，无法反映交易是否被如实报告、是否有证据支撑、是否与账户状态一致，即结果指标掩盖了决策过程的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 构建AStockArena实时决策审计基准：在共享市场条件与执行约束下评测13个开源/闭源模型共3198次连续决策；通过对齐报告、交易请求、执行响应与账户状态重建实际入账操作；设计8项检查覆盖执行可追溯性(O)、证据充分性(RK)、金融元认知(B)，结合记录核验与专家共识标注进行审计。
AI.result: 1070个交易点中72.99%至少存在一项审计缺口；模型层面缺口率在52.2%至91.2%之间，其中证据缺口最为普遍；历史交易过滤回放显示组合结果对这些被标记交易敏感。
AI.conclusion: 决策过程审计为基于收益的金融代理评估提供了可验证的补充，单纯依赖累计收益无法揭示交易报告的忠实性与证据支撑问题。

title: Multimodal Cross-Condition Learning for Temporal Sentence Grounding in Videos
summary: Temporal sentence grounding requires a video representation that preserves query-relevant evidence and a sentence representation that reflects the visual context in which it is interpreted. Prior end-to-end grounding addresses the first requirement through sentence-conditioned visual adaptation, but leaves the language representation independent of the video. This work proposes Multimodal Cross-Condition Learning (MCCL). Its Video Prefix Adapter (VPA) converts pooled visual context into a sequence of continuous tokens that condition a frozen DistilBERT encoder. Combined with the Sentence Conditioned Adapter (SCADA), VPA supports an ordered exchange from vision to language and back to vision. A comprehensive study examines two video backbones, LSTM and Mamba temporal modules, and four conditioning modes on two datasets. Bidirectional conditioning exceeds the stronger one-way mode by 1.6--2.3 mIoU points in all four Charades-STA settings. ActivityNet Captions exhibits a different pattern: bidirectionality helps I3D--Mamba, whereas video-to-text conditioning is stronger with C3D. The study extends one-way visual adaptation into a configurable multimodal framework and reports descriptive gains over the corresponding baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态交叉条件学习（MCCL），通过视频前缀适配器（VPA）与句子条件适配器（SCADA）实现"视觉→语言→视觉"的有序双向条件交换，并在两个数据集上系统研究两种视频骨干与时序模块及四种条件模式。
AI.motivation: 时序句子定位需要既保留查询相关证据的视频表征，又需要能反映视觉语境的语言表征。此前端到端方法仅通过句子条件化视觉适配满足前者，而语言表征仍与视频相互独立。
AI.method: 提出MCCL。VPA将池化视觉上下文转换为连续token序列，用于条件化冻结的DistilBERT编码器；结合SCADA构成视觉→语言→视觉的有序双向交换。实验考察LSTM与Mamba时序模块、两种视频骨干及四种条件模式，覆盖两个数据集。
AI.result: 在Charades-STA全部四种设置下，双向条件化比更强的单向模式高1.6–2.3 mIoU点。ActivityNet Captions呈不同规律：双向化对I3D–Mamba有益，而C3D下视频→文本条件更强。
AI.conclusion: 研究将单向视觉适配扩展为可配置的多模态框架，并报告了相对基线的描述性提升。

authors: Multi-Center Cooperative Clinical Study Group for "Lesion-Phenotype Brain Mapping in Acute Stroke"
title: A generative foundation model for computational brain imaging
summary: Computational brain imaging is constrained by a mismatch between increasingly diverse tasks and scarce, heterogeneous clinical data. Although existing brain foundation models transfer pretrained representations, their knowledge remains entangled within model-specific features and fixed architectures. This paper proposes BrainGFM, a generative foundation model that extends knowledge transfer beyond representation reuse through a reusable and reconfigurable brain-imaging prior. By pretraining on a corpus of about 1.3 million MRI and CT slices, BrainGFM supported task-aligned data synthesis for low-data predictive learning and task-adapted post-training for image reconstruction. Across 48 downstream tasks, BrainGFM improved segmentation and classification under limited supervision and achieved high-fidelity image enhancement across heterogeneous imaging conditions. Multicenter clinical validation involving 4,796 stroke patients across two internal and four external centers demonstrated its applicability to three clinically relevant tasks around stroke cohorts. Blinded reader assessments showed that BrainGFM-generated FLAIR images approached acquired FLAIR in overall diagnostic quality. In a human-AI collaboration study, BrainGFM assistance yielded a 14% relative improvement in mean radiologist stroke-subtyping accuracy. These findings support generative priors as a reusable foundation for heterogeneous computational brain-imaging applications.

AI.tldr: BrainGFM：一个生成式脑影像基础模型，将可复用、可重构的脑影像先验用于少样本预测与图像重建，覆盖48项下游任务并经多中心卒中临床验证。
AI.motivation: 计算脑影像面临任务日益多样而临床数据稀缺、异质的矛盾；现有脑基础模型的知识被纠缠在模型特定特征与固定架构中，只能复用表征，难以跨任务灵活迁移。
AI.method: 在约130万张MRI与CT切片上预训练生成式基础模型BrainGFM，通过任务对齐的数据合成支持低数据预测学习，通过任务适配的后训练支持图像重建（图像增强）。
AI.result: 48项下游任务中，有限监督下分割与分类性能提升，异质成像条件下实现高保真图像增强；涵盖两家内部与四家外部中心的4796名卒中患者多中心验证，支持三项卒中相关临床任务；盲法阅片显示生成FLAIR整体诊断质量接近真实采集FLAIR；人机协作中放射科医师卒中分型平均准确率相对提升14%。
AI.conclusion: 生成式先验可作为可复用的基础，支撑异质性的计算脑影像应用。

title: C3: Speech-Guided KV Retrieval for Long-Context SpeechLLM Inference
summary: Speech language models encode audio at a much higher rate than text, causing the KV cache to dominate the memory, bandwidth, and decoding cost of long-form generation. KV retrieval can reduce per-step access by attending to only a query-dependent subset of the cache, but existing methods are designed primarily for text and do not account for the structure of audio attention. We first show that retrieval errors may compound autoregressively into generation drift. We then analyze full audio attention during long-form generation and identify three properties relevant to retrieval: unequal attention concentration across query heads, non-contiguous audio support, and temporal continuity across decoding steps. Guided by these observations, we propose $C^3$(Cluster-Compete-Compete), which organizes audio KVs in a hierarchical key-space index, lets query heads sharing a KV head compete for a common retrieval budget, and adaptively reallocates retrieval resolution through paired split-merge updates. Across long-form speech recognition, translation, and summarization on four SpeechLLMs, $C^3$ achieves the strongest overall performance among retrieval methods under comparable final-KV access budgets, with particularly large gains in the tight-budget regime, while improving long-context decoding efficiency and accelerator-memory scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出 C³（Cluster-Compete-Compete）方法，针对语音语言模型长文本生成中 KV cache 开销过大的问题，基于音频注意力结构特性改进 KV 检索。
AI.motivation: 语音 token 编码率远高于文本，导致 KV cache 主导长序列生成的内存、带宽与解码成本；现有 KV 检索方法主要面向文本，未考虑音频注意力结构。且检索误差会自回归累积造成生成漂移。
AI.method: 先分析长语音生成中的全注意力，发现三个特性：不同 query head 注意力集中度不均、音频支撑集非连续、解码步间存在时间连续性。据此设计 C³：用分层 key 空间索引组织音频 KV；让共享同一 KV head 的 query heads 竞争统一检索预算；通过成对的 split-merge 更新自适应重分配检索分辨率。
AI.result: 在四个 SpeechLLM 上，长语音识别、翻译与摘要任务中，在相当的最终 KV 访问预算下取得检索方法中最佳整体表现；紧预算场景增益尤为显著，同时提升长上下文解码效率与加速器内存扩展性。
AI.conclusion: C³ 表明利用音频注意力结构特性可有效提升 KV 检索在语音语言模型长文本生成中的效果与效率，尤其在低预算条件下优势明显。

title: Do Coding Agents Catch Their Own Bugs? (They Don't.)
summary: In software development, engineers need to foresee and fix potential problems with their code that are not explicitly specified in requirements---such as pre-emptively considering vulnerabilities or other bugs from a code change. But current benchmarks often do not measure these future-looking consequences. We introduce $\textbf{Foresight-SWE}$, a benchmark for measuring whether coding agents can anticipate and address unstated problems during software engineering tasks. Foresight-SWE consists of 212 samples spanning 4 languages and 35 popular open-source repositories. Each sample contains two pull requests (PRs), the second of which resolves defects the first one introduced. To measure whether agents exhibit foresight, we define the $\textbf{foresight resolve rate (FRR)}$ as the fraction of instances where an agent fully resolves the original task while also avoiding the defect identified by a later PR. We evaluate eleven large language models and find that FRR ranges from only 6.13% to 24.53%, indicating that models largely fail to address problems introduced by the first PR change. This raises important questions about how models are trained and aligned in coding contexts, as well as how code review tools should be improved for more fail-safe coding. Foresight-SWE shifts evaluations in this direction.

AI.tldr: 提出 Foresight-SWE 基准，衡量编码智能体能否预见并避免 PR 引入的未明示缺陷；11 个 LLM 的"预见解决率(FRR)"仅 6.13%–24.53%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多只测当前任务的正确性，忽略工程实践中需要"前瞻性"地预见代码变更带来的漏洞或其他缺陷，这类未来后果未被测量。
AI.method: 构建含 212 个样本、覆盖 4 种语言与 35 个流行开源仓库的数据集；每个样本含两个 PR，第二个用于修复第一个引入的缺陷。定义 FRR（预见解决率）：既完成原任务又避免后续 PR 所指缺陷的比例，并在 11 个 LLM 上评测。
AI.result: 11 个模型的 FRR 仅 6.13%–24.53%，说明模型普遍无法处理首个 PR 变更引入的问题。
AI.conclusion: 模型在编码情境下的训练与对齐方式、以及代码审查工具的设计均需改进以实现更 fail-safe 的编码；Foresight-SWE 推动评测转向前瞻能力。

title: At What Cost? (In)efficiency in First-Price Procurement Auctions
summary: We study the efficiency of Bayes-Nash equilibria in first-price procurement auctions. We measure efficiency by the Price of Anarchy (PoA): the ratio between the expected social cost in equilibrium and the minimum expected social cost resulting from a socially optimal allocation. We first show that the standard first-price procurement auction has no bounded PoA guarantee. We construct equilibria in which every bidder is indifferent between all bids in a common interval, so that bids can be arbitrarily large, and the PoA is unbounded. If costs lie in an interval $[\underline c,\bar c]$ but bids are not restricted, the PoA equals the trivial ratio $\bar c/\underline c$. We hence study ways to restore a finite guarantee, first by characterizing the PoA when bids lie in $[\underline c,\bar c]$, which leads to the tight bound $1 + \frac1{e^2}(\frac{\bar c}{\underline c}-1)$. Alternatively, we introduce the notion of a phantom bidder: the auctioneer accepts the lowest bid only if it does not exceed a phantom bid, drawn independently of the costs, and otherwise buys from an outside option at cost $\bar c$. We show that a simple fixed phantom bid, i.e., a deterministic cap, gives PoA $=\frac1e\sqrt {\frac{\bar c}{\underline c}}+O(1)$. We further show that no phantom mechanism whose construction depends only on the cost interval, under a mild regularity condition, whatever distribution it uses and whatever it reveals about the phantom bid before bidding, can improve on the $\sqrt{\frac{\bar c}{\underline c}}$ dependence.

AI.tldr: 研究一价采购拍卖中Bayes-Nash均衡的效率。标准一价采购拍卖的PoA无界；限制出价区间时得到紧界1+(1/e²)(c̄/c-1)；引入"幻影投标者"机制（确定性封顶）可将PoA降至(1/e)√(c̄/c)+O(1)，并证明任何仅依赖成本区间的幻影机制在温和正则条件下都无法超越√(c̄/c)的依赖。
AI.motivation: 采购拍卖（如政府或企业外包）中出价方是成本承担者，均衡可能极度低效。作者希望量化一价采购拍卖的效率损失，并找到能恢复有限效率保证的机制，因为标准模型下PoA可能无界。
AI.method: 以PoA为效率指标（均衡期望社会成本/最优分配的最小期望社会成本）。先构造使所有投标者在公共区间内无差异、出价可任意大的均衡来证明无界性。随后分析出价受限于[下c,c̄]时的PoA。再提出幻影投标者机制：拍卖者仅在最低出价不超过一个与成本独立的幻影出价时才接受，否则以c̄从外部选项采购。最后给出下界，证明仅依赖成本区间的幻影机制（在温和正则条件下，无论分布或是否事先揭示）无法改善√(c̄/c)的量级。
AI.result: 标准一价采购拍卖PoA无界；若成本在[c,c̄]而出价无限制，PoA等于平凡比值c̄/c；若出价限制在[c,c̄]，紧界为1+(1/e²)(c̄/c-1)；确定性封顶（固定幻影出价）给出PoA=(1/e)√(c̄/c)+O(1)，且这是此类幻影机制可达到的最优量级下界。
AI.conclusion: 一价采购拍卖本身缺乏效率保证，简单的确定性封顶（幻影投标者）就能显著改善效率至√(c̄/c)量级，且这一依赖关系对该类机制是不可改进的下界，为采购拍卖设计提供了理论指导。

title: Measuring User Success in Randomized Search Experiments: Interpreting Good Abandonment in Generative AI Search
summary: Randomized search experiments increasingly evaluate experiences in which large language models answer information needs directly on the results page. Click status alone cannot identify success: a click may lead to an unsatisfactory result, while no click may indicate successful answer consumption, or "good abandonment." Prior research has shown that good abandonment is difficult to detect because dwell, scrolling, and reformulation are meaningful only in context. We present Session Success Rate (SSR), a human-grounded, interpretable outcome metric designed for online controlled experiments. Trained judges label complete session experiences using privacy-protected interaction evidence and video recordings; these offline labels train models scored online from query events, viewport behavior, result-page interactions, and semantic reformulations. Out-of-sample evaluation on 6,904 labeled queries yields 0.75 balanced accuracy overall and 0.68 within abandoned queries; session-level balanced accuracy is 0.68. The sample shows why interaction status is not an adequate outcome: 53.2% of abandonments were successful and 6.5% of clicked queries were unsuccessful. In a validation portfolio of seven ranking and five non-ranking experiments, SSR agreed with Sessions per User in seven cases, was inconclusive in four, and disagreed in one under a common p < 0.05 rule. Separately, across approximately 4,000 production experiments, SSR produced about 2.5 times the binary sensitivity of Sessions per User; in the studied workflow, this supported lower traffic allocations and greater experiment throughput under a fixed traffic budget.

AI.tldr: 提出会话成功率（SSR）指标，用人类标注加模型预测来判定搜索结果页整段会话是否成功，捕捉"良性放弃"，并在线上实验验证其更高的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 随机搜索实验中LLM直接在结果页回答需求，单一点击状态无法判断成功：有点击可能不满意，无点击可能是成功消费答案（良性放弃）。且dwell、滚动、改写等信号只有结合上下文才有意义，需要可解释、以人为基准的会话级结果指标。
AI.method: 训练judge（人工评判员）基于隐私保护的交互证据与录屏对完整会话体验打标，得到离线标签；再用查询事件、视口行为、结果页交互、语义改写等特征训练在线打分模型，得到Session Success Rate（SSR）。在6,904条标注查询上做样本外评估，并在7个排序+5个非排序实验组合及约4000个生产实验中与Sessions per User对比。
AI.result: 样本外总体平衡准确率0.75，放弃查询内0.68，会话级0.68。53.2%的放弃是成功的，6.5%的点击是不成功的。12个验证实验中与SPU一致7个、不确定4个、不一致1个；约4000个生产实验中SSR的二元敏感性约为SPU的2.5倍，支持更低的流量分配和更高的实验吞吐。
AI.conclusion: 交互状态不足以衡量结果，SSR作为可解释、可在线部署的会话级成功指标更敏感，可提升实验效率，但存在一定误判（约0.68-0.75准确率）需结合实际工作流谨慎使用。

title: Dual-Axis Policy Entailment: A Benchmark for Policy-Change Reasoning
summary: Whether a policy shifts domains and, by extension, continues, broadens, narrows, or reverses previous policy is of paramount importance to the study of public policy. We propose Dual-Axis Policy Entailment (DAPE), which evaluates an ordered pair of policy directives on both dimensions at once: a binary judgment determines whether the two directives govern the same policy domain, and a five-way judgment determines whether the later directive continues, broadens, narrows, or reverses the earlier policy, or governs a different domain altogether. Read together, the two judgments form one five-category label, our primary metric. The two-axis design captures two central dimensions of policy change without conflating errors on either dimension into a generic "irrelevant" label, and it makes annotation more rigorous: a coder cannot dismiss a difficult pair as domain-irrelevant without an explicit, checkable decision. We introduce an expert-annotated benchmark of 1,000 ordered directive pairs drawn from a large corpus of Chinese government policy, together with an annotation-calibration protocol (an adjudication packet with pre/post agreement measurement) that we contribute as a methodological artifact. Fourteen open-weight models and four frontier API flagships fail the task zero-shot: even the best frontier flagship's chance-corrected agreement with expert labels is far below the human ceiling (Cohen's $κ\approx 0.29$ vs. $0.53$). A fine-tuned open-weight model (LoRA SFT of Qwen3-14B, five-fold cross-validation) closes this gap, reaching the coder-mutual human ceiling ($κ= 0.524$ vs. $0.527$). Finally, we apply our method to China's AI policy (1980-2024) and map the direction of policy change across eras.

AI.tldr: 提出双轴政策蕴含（DAPE）任务与中文政策基准（1000对指令），用二元域判断+五元变化判断构成五类标签；零样本前沿模型远低于人类上限，微调Qwen3-14B后达到人类水平，并应用于中国AI政策变迁分析。
AI.motivation: 政策是否跨域及延续/拓展/收窄/逆转对公共政策研究至关重要，而现有单一标签方式会把两类不同维度的错误混入笼统的"无关"类别，标注也不够严谨。
AI.method: 设计双轴评估：同时判断两条有序政策指令是否属同一域，以及后者相对前者的五向关系，组合为五类主指标；构建1000对专家标注中文政府政策基准，并提出带裁决包与前/后一致性测量的标注校准协议；零样本评测14个开源与4个前沿API模型，并用LoRA SFT微调Qwen3-14B（五折交叉验证）。
AI.result: 零样本全部失败，最佳前沿旗舰Cohen's κ≈0.29，远低于人类上限0.53；微调Qwen3-14B达κ=0.524，接近标注者间人类上限0.527；并将方法用于1980–2024年中国AI政策，描绘各时代政策变化方向。
AI.conclusion: 双轴设计避免维度混淆、提升标注严谨性，可作为政策变迁测量的可复现框架；开源模型微调即可达到人类水平，方法可有效应用于长时段政策演化图谱。

title: A Trustworthy Clinical Decision Support Framework for Brain Tumor MRI Classification: Integrating Attention-Guided Learning, Explainable AI, and Out-of-Distribution Validation
comment: Accepted for presentation at the IC3AI-2026 IEEE conference in Dec 2026. It has been accepted/selected but is not yet published. 6 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables
summary: Deep learning models for brain tumor diagnosis need to do more than achieve high classification accuracy. For practical use, they should also provide understandable predictions, recognize unsuitable inputs, and work within a usable clinical system. This paper presents a framework for classifying brain MRI into four categories: glioma, meningioma, pituitary tumor, and no tumor. The model uses InceptionResNetV2 with a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), while Grad-CAM provides visual explanations of its predictions. A two-stage out-of-distribution (OOD) mechanism screens unsuitable inputs using an initial grayscale check followed by Mahalanobis distance, softmax confidence, and predictive entropy. These components are brought together in NeuroScan AI, a real-time web application. Evaluated on a Mendeley brain tumor MRI dataset of 12,064 images, the framework achieved 98.70% validation accuracy, 96.73% test accuracy, and a macro-average AUC of 0.9965. The OOD pipeline achieved 99% detection accuracy on a preliminary 100-image benchmark. Grad-CAM visualizations showed qualitative correspondence with clinically established tumor locations across all four classes. Overall, the work brings classification, explainability, input validation, and deployment into one framework, while recognizing that broader clinical and OOD validation is still required.

AI.tldr: 提出结合InceptionResNetV2+CBAM、Grad-CAM与两阶段OOD检测的脑MRI四分类框架，并集成到实时Web应用NeuroScan AI，获得高准确率与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 脑肿瘤诊断模型不能只追求分类准确率，还需提供可理解的预测、识别不合适的输入，并在可用的临床系统中运行。现有工作往往只关注精度，缺乏可解释性、输入验证与部署的一体化方案。
AI.method: 使用InceptionResNetV2并引入卷积块注意力模块（CBAM），用Grad-CAM提供预测可视化解释；采用两阶段OOD机制筛选不适合输入，先做灰度检查，再用马氏距离、softmax置信度与预测熵；各组件集成于实时Web应用NeuroScan AI。
AI.result: 在Mendeley脑肿瘤MRI数据集12,064张图像上，验证准确率98.70%、测试准确率96.73%、宏平均AUC 0.9965；OOD流程在100张初步基准上达99%检测准确率；Grad-CAM可视化在四类别上与临床公认肿瘤位置定性一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将分类、可解释性、输入验证与部署整合进一个框架，同时指出仍需要更广泛的临床与OOD验证。

title: Automated Theorem Generation in First-Order Logic by Construction from Triangular Standard Contradictions
summary: Automated theorem generation (ATG) seeks to construct new theorems rather than merely prove given conjectures. Existing approaches typically generate candidate statements that require subsequent proof or formal verification. We propose a constructive framework for ATG in first-order logic based on triangular standard contradictions. The method constructs minimally unsatisfiable clause sets from selected first-order literals, then forms theorems by retaining some clauses as premises and taking the negation of one clause, or a conjunction of clauses, as the conclusion. Minimal unsatisfiability ensures that the remaining premises are satisfiable, avoiding trivial inference by explosion, while unsatisfiability of the full set guarantees the resulting entailment. Theorems are therefore correct by construction, without a separate proof procedure for each instance. Extending the previously developed $Δ_1$ generator, we introduce seven methods, $Δ_2$--$Δ_8$, forming a unified family of eight theorem-generation methods. Four generators, $Δ_1$--$Δ_4$, have been implemented and released. We also formulate a general $Δ$-class method encompassing the family. Combinatorial analysis demonstrates the capacity to generate large numbers of distinct theorems systematically. This framework offers a principled foundation for automated theorem discovery and the construction of logically guaranteed knowledge.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于"三角标准矛盾"的一阶逻辑构造式自动定理生成框架，直接从极小不可满足子句集构造出必然正确的定理，无需逐例证明。
AI.motivation: 现有自动定理生成（ATG）方法多产生候选命题，仍需后续证明或形式验证；且容易因爆炸规则产生平凡推理。作者希望定理"构造即正确"，规避逐条证明开销。
AI.method: 从选定一阶文字构造极小不可满足子句集；保留部分子句作前提，取某一子句或若干子句合取的否定作结论。极小不可满足保证前提可满足、避免爆炸式平凡推论；全集不可满足保证蕴含成立。在原有Δ₁基础上扩展出Δ₂–Δ₈，构成八种方法的统一族，并提出一般化的Δ类方法。
AI.result: Δ₁–Δ₄已实现并发布；七种新方法Δ₂–Δ₈被引入，并与Δ₁统一为八法家族；组合分析表明可系统性地生成大量互异定理。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为自动定理发现及"逻辑有保证的知识"构建提供了有原则的基础，定理正确性由构造保证，无需单独的证明程序。

title: Decomposing Irregular Time Series into Interpretable Temporal Patterns with Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Irregularly-spaced sequential data, such as transaction logs, encode multi-scale temporal structure that is critical for prediction but difficult to recover explicitly with standard sequence models, which often trade interpretability for performance. We introduce MoTIF, an interpretable framework using mixture-of-experts (MoE) attention to decompose irregular time series into temporal patterns spanning minute-to-year scales. Each expert is trained via temporal alignment that induces attention specialization to a designated cyclical or within-range pattern, with label-free routing supervision that learns to activate the correct expert from patterns present in the data. On synthetic data with known temporal structure, MoTIF recovers correct routing well above chance (0.389/0.829 for range/cyclical patterns vs. 0.091 random) and outperforms all baselines, including a standard transformer and an unspecialized MoE, on next-value prediction. On a public credit card transaction dataset, MoTIF achieves higher macro-F1 than all baselines for next-amount prediction. Its learned routing reveals structure a black-box model cannot: transactions are governed primarily by intraday and short-interval rhythms, while fraudulent transactions show bursty, calendar-agnostic timing versus the steadier periodicity of legitimate ones. On downstream fraud detection, MoTIF matches standard transformer and MoE baselines and clearly outperforms recent sequential recommendation models used as embedding baselines. These results show that decomposing temporal structure into interpretable, expert-specific patterns need not sacrifice predictive accuracy, offering a practical route to sequence models that are both accurate and auditable in high-stakes settings. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MoTIF-82E4.

AI.tldr: MoTIF 用混合专家注意力把不规则时间序列分解为跨分钟到年的时间模式，兼顾可解释性与预测精度。
AI.motivation: 不规则间隔序列（如交易日志）含多尺度时间结构，标准序列模型难以显式恢复且常以可解释性换性能。
AI.method: 基于 MoE 注意力的可解释框架，每个专家通过时间对齐训练专门捕捉指定周期性或区间内模式，并用无标签路由监督学习激活正确专家。
AI.result: 合成数据上路由准确率 0.389/0.829（区间/周期）远超随机的 0.091，预测优于标准 Transformer 与未专门化 MoE；信用卡数据集 macro-F1 最优，路由揭示欺诈交易呈爆发式、与日历无关的节律；下游欺诈检测与 Transformer/MoE 持平并优于序列推荐基线。
AI.conclusion: 将时间结构分解为可解释的专家特定模式无需牺牲预测精度，为高风险场景提供准确且可审计的序列模型路径。

title: A Domain Driven Design Based Reference Architecture for IoT Systems Engineering
