summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) paradigm continues to gain significant traction across diverse do-mains, primarily driven by its transformative and socio-economic benefits. However, engineering robust IoT systems remains a formidable challenge, largely due to the inherent dynamism, volatility, and uncertainty of their operational environments. To mitigate this architectural complexity, microservices have emerged as a viable alternative to traditional, rigid monolithic frameworks, offering a scalable mechanism to fulfill critical quality attributes. To maximize the efficacy of a microservices architecture, its technical boundaries must align precisely with domain-specific business requirements. Domain-Driven Design (DDD) addresses this need by strategically decomposing complex domains into modular, highly manageable subdomains that map directly to individual microservices. Furthermore, to minimize architectural coupling, enhance system integrability, and optimize device energy efficiency, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) serves as a critical operational enabler. This paper proposes a comprehensive reference architecture for IoT systems engineering, systematically leveraging DDD and EDA principles to harmonize business logic with decoupled, event-driven microservices.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合领域驱动设计(DDD)与事件驱动架构(EDA)的IoT系统参考架构，通过微服务按业务子域解耦，降低架构耦合、提升可集成性与设备能效。
AI.motivation: IoT运行环境具有动态性、波动性与不确定性，工程化构建健壮IoT系统困难；传统单体架构僵化，微服务虽可扩展但技术边界须与业务需求对齐，且需降低耦合、提升可集成性与能效。
AI.method: 采用DDD将复杂领域战略分解为可管理的子域并映射到各微服务；以EDA作为运行支撑机制，实现解耦的事件驱动微服务，使业务逻辑与技术架构协调一致，形成完整的IoT系统工程参考架构。
AI.result: 摘要性质文章，未给出具体实验结果；预期效果为减少架构耦合、增强系统可集成性、优化设备能耗，并实现业务与技术边界的精准对齐。
AI.conclusion: 该参考架构通过DDD+EDA+微服务的系统化组合，为应对IoT架构复杂性提供了可参考的设计范式，有助于构建可扩展、松耦合的IoT系统。

title: On inverse aggregate network assignment games
summary: To design platforms for multi-operator mobility markets coordinating their operations or infrastructure to support them, models are needed to understand the behavior of these operators and travelers in a shared network. Assignment games can prove useful, but operationalizing them requires adopting a more generalized aggregate assignment game framework that allows for identification and estimation. We extend such a framework to aggregate network assignment games, proposing a path-based formulation and a PURC-based formulation along with solution algorithms. An inverse optimization model is proposed for the link-based formulation. It is solved by a quadratic program that separates into a buyer block, which retains the node potentials and imposes every observed zero-flow cell, and a seller block. This estimator, introduced in the literature for uncapacitated route choice, is extended here to a capacitated two-sided market, with rationing prices supported on observed binding links and operator supply scales estimated by group. Computational tests with a toy network demonstrate the economic value of these models. A large-scale Long Island Rail Road network example (897 nodes, 671 census tracts, 123 LIRR stations, 8,320 directed links) is calibrated to 2026 fares, timetabled seat supply and National Transit Database operating costs. With 10-50% of links sampled, the misspecified inverse model fits oracle link flows with R^2>=96%. Held-out link error falls from 29% to 19%, correlations with the true rationing prices rise from 49% to 75%, and social optimal gross surplus is recovered within 6%. Deadweight loss is overestimated by 10-17%. Ablation tests show that ignoring the inactive cells more than doubles the held-out error and, at 30-50% sampling, roughly halves the correlation of the pricing wedge, while ignoring the rationing prices degrades every metric.

AI.tldr: 该论文将聚合网络分配博弈推广为基于路径与基于PURC（价格-使用-配给-容量）的两种表述，并提出逆优化估计方法，用于在共享多运营商网络中由观测流量和供给/成本数据识别运营者行为参数，在纽约长岛铁路大规模网络上验证了估计精度与经济价值。
AI.motivation: 多运营商出行市场的平台设计需要理解运营商与旅客在共享网络上的行为；现有分配博弈虽有用，但缺乏可用于识别与估计的广义聚合框架，且已有估计器仅适用于无容量路线选择，无法处理有容量的双边市场。
AI.method: 提出聚合网络分配博弈框架，包括路径型表述和基于PURC的表述及相应求解算法；对基于路段（link-based）的表述构建逆优化模型，求解一个可分离为买方块（保留节点势函数并施加所有观测到的零流量单元）与卖方块（配给价格支撑于观测到的紧约束路段、按组估计运营者供给规模）的二次规划。
AI.result: 玩具网络验证了模型经济价值；在897节点、671普查区、123座车站、8320条有向路段的长岛铁路网络上（按2026票价、时刻表座位供给与NTD运营成本标定）：10–50%路段采样下，误设逆模型对oracle流拟合R^2≥96%，留出路段误差由29%降至19%，与真实配给价格相关性由49%升至75%，社会最优总剩余恢复误差在6%以内，无谓损失高估10–17%。消融显示忽略非活跃单元使留出误差翻倍以上、30–50%采样下定价楔子相关性约减半，忽略配给价格则所有指标恶化。
AI.conclusion: 将逆优化估计扩展到有容量的双边市场是可行且有效的，零流量单元与配给价格两类信息对参数识别至关重要，所提框架可为多运营商出行平台的规划与政策评估提供可操作工具。

title: IncVNM: An Interactive Recommender System with Incremental von Neumann-Morgenstern Utility Learning
summary: In modern recommender systems, users are often presented with products whose outcomes are random. The values of such products depend on their entire outcome distributions and on users' attitudes toward risk, making them difficult to evaluate using traditional product-level recommendation methods. We propose \textsc{IncVNM}, an interactive recommender system that incrementally learns a user-specific von Neumann--Morgenstern (VNM) utility function from ordinal click feedback generated during ordinary webpage browsing. At each interaction, \textsc{IncVNM} converts the click order within a displayed product list into pairwise comparisons between outcome distributions and updates the nominal utility by minimizing its deviation from the previous estimate while incorporating the newly observed pairwise comparisons. To close the interaction loop, an entropy-regularized sampling policy balances exploitation of the learned utility against exploration for additional preference information. We evaluate \textsc{IncVNM} in a rolling-window experiment with different response-error probabilities and show that it substantially outperforms the expected-return, mean--variance, discounted-UCB, and distribution-aware BPR baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出IncVNM，一种交互式推荐系统，从普通网页浏览中的序数点击反馈增量学习用户特有的VNM效用函数，并用熵正则采样策略平衡利用与探索。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐系统中产品结果具有随机性，其价值取决于整个结果分布与用户风险态度，传统产品级推荐方法难以评估这类随机结果产品。
AI.method: 将列表内点击顺序转为结果分布间的成对比较；通过最小化与上次估计的偏差并注入新比较来更新名义效用；用熵正则化的采样策略平衡对已学效用的利用与为获取偏好信息的探索。
AI.result: 在不同响应错误概率的滚动窗口实验中，IncVNM显著优于期望回报、均值-方差、discounted-UCB及分布感知BPR等基线。
AI.conclusion: IncVNM可在自然浏览行为中增量学习风险感知的VNM效用，实现随机结果产品的有效推荐。

title: Distinguishing among reasoning levels of GPT 5.5 Pro via a grammar lens benchmark
summary: Does the level of test-time processing effort affect a language model's computational capability? A formal grammar-lens benchmark method, derived from the theory of computation, generates novel data at specified levels, each successively more computationally powerful than the levels below. Using this data, we tested GPT-5.5, and GPT-5.5-Pro-Medium, -High, and -XHigh, showing incrementally increased acceptance of test data: 16, 40, 43, and 52\%, respectively, illustrating the benchmark's ability to discern fine-grained differences among models' added test-time reasoning levels. Additionally, as test-time compute effort increases, model responses diverge from human responses to the same data. This increasing disagreement may turn out to be broadly characteristic of more capable language models, introducing the potential of a general capability-versus-alignment conflict.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于形式语法/计算理论的分级基准，检验测试时推理投入是否提升语言模型的计算能力，并在 GPT-5.5 系列上验证其可分性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准难以精细区分模型在不同测试时计算投入下的能力差异，且缺少从计算理论角度刻画"计算能力"的手段；同时作者关心能力提升是否伴随与人类判断的偏离。
AI.method: 从计算理论推导形式语法透镜（grammar-lens）基准，按计算能力递增生成分层新颖数据；用其测试 GPT-5.5 及 GPT-5.5-Pro-Medium/-High/-XHigh，比较各档接受率，并与人类在同一数据上的回答做一致性对比。
AI.result: 随测试时推理档位提升，测试数据接受率依次为 16%、40%、43%、52%，说明基准能分辨细粒度的测试时推理水平差异；同时测试时计算投入越大，模型回答与人类回答的偏离越大。
AI.conclusion: 形式语法基准可细粒度衡量测试时计算带来的能力变化；能力增强可能伴随与人类判断的系统性分歧，提示存在潜在的一般性"能力—对齐"冲突。

title: Selective Positional Allocation for Noise-Robust Query Retrieval in Small-Object Detection
summary: In aerial and remote-sensing imagery, detecting tiny targets is frequently hampered less by the representational capacity of the backbone network than by the manner in which positional priors are distributed across ill-defined foreground and background regions. We introduce SPAR (Selective Positional Allocation and Retrieval), a detection framework that re-conceptualizes positional cues as an allocatable resource: they are intensified at semantically meaningful locations while responses driven by scene clutter are actively attenuated. At the heart of SPAR lies Selective Positional Embedding (SPE), an interpretable embedding mechanism paired with an activation-bar visualization that facilitates direct inspection and hyper-parameter tuning. The encoder branch, termed MOHFE, fuses heatmap-modulated positional signals with category-specific and box-level evidence to yield more compact multi-scale features; the decoder branch, termed HIDQ, employs a foreground gating operation to discard background-dominated candidates prior to query decoding. To cope with the extreme sparsity of small-object evidence, we additionally design DPSConv (Dual-Path Sampling Convolution), which augments retrieval-oriented representations through two geometrically complementary sampling routes. Notably, all heatmap supervision is derived from existing detection objectives and consumed exclusively during training, requiring no auxiliary heatmap annotations and leaving inference as an ordinary forward pass with no additional gradient overhead. Comprehensive evaluations on DOTA, DIOR, VisDrone, PASCAL VOC, NWPU VHR-10, and AITOD demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design: relative to the baseline, SPAR attains an improvement of up to 9.1 percentage points, shortens the decoder from eight layers to three, and reduces model parameters by 59.4% (66.3M versus 163M).

AI.tldr: SPAR将位置先验视为可分配资源，强化语义有意义位置、抑制背景杂波响应，在小目标遥感检测中取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 航空/遥感图像中的小目标检测瓶颈不在于骨干网络表达能力，而在于位置先验在前景/背景界定不清区域的分布方式。
AI.method: 提出SPAR框架，包含：可解释的选择性位置嵌入SPE（配激活条可视化便于调参）；编码分支MOHFE融合热图调制位置信号与类别/框级证据生成紧凑多尺度特征；解码分支HIDQ用前景门控在查询解码前剔除背景候选；DPSConv双路径采样卷积补充小目标稀疏证据。热图监督由现有检测目标导出，仅训练时使用，无需额外标注。
AI.result: 在DOTA、DIOR、VisDrone、PASCAL VOC、NWPU VHR-10、AITOD上验证有效；相对基线最高提升9.1个百分点，解码器由8层缩短至3层，参数量减少59.4%（66.3M vs 163M）。
AI.conclusion: 将位置线索作为可分配资源进行选择性强化与抑制，是提升小目标检测效率与精度的有效思路，且不增加推理开销。

title: Quantifying Local and Global Fidelity of Nonlinear Embeddings
summary: Dimension reduction methods are chosen by a common claim: t-SNE and UMAP preserve local structure, and PCA preserves global structure. Checking it on given data takes local and global scores on one scale and a test that compares two maps. Both scores come from one curve. The locality profile is the chance-corrected share of each point's k nearest neighbors that a map keeps, over all neighborhood sizes. Its value at k = 10 is the local fidelity L, and its mean over 30 to 50 percent of the data is the global fidelity G. We prove that at the midpoint the profile is the agreement on which half of the data is near each point, a rank correlation of the distances. Because L and G are one statistic, two maps can be tested against each other. The LG reversal test applies to any two dimension reduction methods. It decides, with a block-jackknife p-value, whether one map is more local and the other more global, and returns the scale at which to change maps. On 156 maps of twelve datasets with up to 1.38 million points, G agrees with established global scores at 0.89 and 0.96, and 2,000 points estimate it. The test confirms the usual claim on seven datasets. On both retail datasets and both rolled-up manifolds, it finds the neighbor embeddings more global. In an agent memory of one million passages, the two maps cross at 150,000 passages (p = 2.6e-5). Applications span pathology, single cells, supply chains and AI agent memory.

AI.tldr: 提出"局部性剖面"单一曲线，用其k=10处值L与30–50%数据均值G分别度量局部/全局保真，并据此设计LG反转检验比较任意两种降维方法。
AI.motivation: 降维方法选择常依赖"t-SNE/UMAP保局部、PCA保全局"这一说法，但缺乏在同一尺度上量化局部与全局保真并可直接比较两张映射的统计工具。
AI.method: 局部性剖面：对每个点在各邻域规模k下计算映射保留其k近邻的份额（经机会校正）；k=10处为局部保真L，对30–50%数据取均值为全局保真G。证明剖面中点对应"哪一半数据更近"的一致性（距离的秩相关）。LG反转检验用块刀切法给出p值，判断一图更局部、另一图更全局，并返回换图尺度。
AI.result: 在12个数据集156张映射（最多138万点）上，G与既有全局分数一致性达0.89与0.96，2000点即可估计。七个数据集上证实传统说法；两个零售数据集与两个"卷起"流形上邻居嵌入更全局；百万段落agent记忆中两图在15万段落处交叉（p=2.6e-5）。应用涵盖病理、单细胞、供应链与AI agent记忆。
AI.conclusion: L与G为同一统计量，使局部/全局保真的比较统一且可检验；LG反转检验提供带尺度定位的显著性判断，验证并修正了常见经验说法，具备广泛实证适用性。

title: DEPLOY-RL: Active Boundary Discovery and Conservative Certification for Deployable Reinforcement Learning in Safety-Critical Continuous Processes
comment: 8 pages; published in IJCAI-ECAI 2026, AI4Tech track. This version adds a publication notice
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies often outperform classical controllers in simulation, yet rarely reach production in safety-critical processes. The barrier is that there is no principled way to answer "Is this policy safe to deploy?" with statistical guarantees. We introduce DEPLOY-RL, a post-training certification framework built on one key insight: deployment certification requires discovering where failures occur (boundary discovery), not measuring how much everywhere (uniform reconstruction). Our contributions: (1) a contract-coupled acquisition function that concentrates sampling on certification-critical boundaries, achieving approximately 2x sample efficiency with a semi-empirical ambiguity reduction bound (domain-calibrated convergence guarantee); (2) conformal risk control providing finite-sample false-go guarantees (<= alpha) under explicit deployment contracts; (3) a three-way decision framework (Deploy/No-Deploy/Abstain) with fail-safe PID/MPC fallback. In simulations on papermaking (industrial digital twin) and Tennessee Eastman (public benchmark), DEPLOY-RL achieves 4.4% false-go rate (vs. 8.6% for the best baseline) while retaining 88.6% policy coverage, the only method achieving <5% false-go with >85% coverage among 14 baselines under our evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出 DEPLOY-RL 后训练认证框架，通过边界发现、保形风险控制和三路决策，为 RL 策略部署提供统计安全保证，在造纸与 TE 基准上实现 4.4% false-go 率、88.6% 覆盖率。
AI.motivation: RL 策略在仿真中优于经典控制器，但因缺乏"策略能否安全部署"的统计保证而难以进入安全关键生产环境。
AI.method: (1) 契约耦合采集函数，将采样集中于认证关键边界（约 2 倍样本效率，含半经验歧义缩减界）；(2) 保形风险控制，在显式部署契约下给出有限样本 false-go ≤ α 保证；(3) Deploy/No-Deploy/Abstain 三路决策及 PID/MPC 失效安全回退。
AI.result: 造纸数字孪生与 Tennessee Eastman 仿真中，false-go 率 4.4%（最佳基线 8.6%），覆盖率 88.6%；14 个基线中唯一同时满足 false-go <5% 且覆盖率 >85%。
AI.conclusion: 将认证重心从"全域精确重建"转向"边界发现"，结合保形统计保证，可为安全关键 RL 部署提供可落地的认证方案。

title: AdapBench: Adaptive Early-Stopping and Prioritization for Efficient Microbenchmarking in Cloud-based CI/CD
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 19th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Utility and Cloud Computing (UCC 2026). Code and data: https://github.com/s3bastiankoch/adapbench
summary: Cloud-based software systems frequently release new versions, a fact further accelerated through agentic coding. Each new release, however, brings the risk of performance regressions which can irritate end users, increase infrastructure costs, and increase carbon footprints. Therefore, developers strive to catch such regressions in testing stages, usually through so-called continuous benchmarking. The standard way of doing this is using microbenchmark suites which, however, take notoriously long to execute. Optimizing the execution of microbenchmark suites is, hence, an active field of research. In this paper, we propose AdapBench, an online scheduling system for reducing the execution duration of microbenchmark suites. AdapBench is the first approach which dynamically makes at-runtime decisions for prioritizing the most informative benchmarks and early-stopping each one once enough evidence has accumulated to accept or reject a performance change hypothesis. We evaluate our prototype on eight popular Java projects, commonly used by microbenchmark research, and four additional Go projects. At matched 90% change detections and false-positive rate compared to an optimistic uniform run, AdapBench saves 42% of the aggregate execution duration on the Java projects, with negligible scheduling overhead (below 0.001% of the total runtime). On the Go projects, AdapBench finds every performance change with zero false positives while saving 85% of the full run.

AI.tldr: AdapBench 是一个在线调度系统，通过运行时动态优先执行最有信息量的微基准并在证据充分时提前终止，从而缩短微基准套件的执行时长。
AI.motivation: 云软件频繁发版（智能体编码进一步加速），每次发版都可能带来性能回退，影响用户、增加基础设施成本与碳足迹。开发者靠持续基准测试在测试阶段捕获回退，但微基准套件执行时间极长，优化其执行是研究热点。
AI.method: 提出 AdapBench：首个在运行时动态决策的方法，一方面优先调度最有信息量的基准，另一方面在积累足够证据以接受/拒绝性能变化假设时对每个基准提前停止；在 8 个常用 Java 项目和 4 个额外 Go 项目上评估原型。
AI.result: 在 Java 项目上，与乐观的均匀运行在 90% 变化检出率和相同假阳性率下匹配，节省 42% 总执行时长，调度开销可忽略（低于总运行时 0.001%）；在 Go 项目上检出全部性能变化且零假阳性，节省 85% 的完整运行时间。
AI.conclusion: 运行时自适应调度与提前停止能显著降低微基准套件执行成本，同时保持检测质量，适用于 Java 与 Go 等多种语言生态。

title: A Compute Center Anyone Can Join: A Peer-to-Peer System for AI Inference
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Ancillary files: model script reproducing all numerical results, and black-box probe data
summary: Today, most people obtain AI inference by buying it from a small number of organizations that run large data centers, while many GPUs owned by individuals and small institutions sit idle for much of the day. Bitcoin showed that strangers can contribute resources under shared rules and receive checkable rewards, but it relies on an asymmetry: proof-of-work is expensive to produce and cheap to verify. Useful inference has no such asymmetry. We propose the Open Inference Market (OIM), which replaces the missing asymmetry with an economic mechanism. A worker delivers a result without knowing whether it will be audited; its unsettled earnings serve as collateral during a challenge window; and confirmed cheating forfeits all of it. We call this principle earnings as collateral. In a simplified model we show three things. The number of audits needed for deterrence is a constant per worker per day, independent of the worker's throughput, so the audited share falls as the network gets busier. A new worker can join with a short period of intensive auditing and a very small bond. And whether the mechanism works at all depends only on the ratio of the audit judge's false-flag rate to its detection rate. Under example parameters, about 0.3 replays per worker per day are enough to make cheating unprofitable for a rational worker. On this basis we lay out a path that hands four powers back to participants one at a time: owning compute, writing history, judging work, and releasing value. A compute center need not be a building; it can be a protocol that anyone can join.

AI.tldr: 提出开放推理市场OIM，用"收益即抵押"机制替代PoW的不对称性，让分散GPU提供可验证的AI推理。
AI.motivation: AI推理被少数数据中心垄断，而个人与小机构的GPU大量闲置。比特币证明了陌生人可在共享规则下贡献资源并获得可核查奖励，但其依赖"算力昂贵、验证廉价"的不对称性，而有用推理缺乏这种不对称性，因此需要新的机制设计。
AI.method: 提出"收益即抵押"原则：工作者提交结果时不知是否被审计，未结算收益在挑战窗口内充当抵押，确认作弊则全部没收。作者在简化模型中分析威慑所需审计数量、新工作者准入条件及机制有效性的决定因素。
AI.result: 三点结论：(1) 每个工作者每日所需审计次数为常数，与吞吐量无关，故网络越繁忙被审计比例越低；(2) 新工作者可凭短期密集审计加极小保证金加入；(3) 机制是否有效仅取决于审计判定者误报率与检出率之比。示例参数下，每工作者每日约0.3次重放即可使理性工作者无利可图。
AI.conclusion: 据此规划逐步将四项权力归还参与者：拥有算力、书写历史、判定工作、释放价值。计算中心不必是建筑，而可以是任何人可加入的协议。

title: EAGR: Evidence-Guided Adaptive Graph Retrieval
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for multi-hop reasoning requires retrieval to adapt as intermediate evidence reveals new information needs. Existing approaches support such retrieval through explicit graph structures or iterative query reformulation, introducing graph-construction or query-time overhead. We present Evidence-Guided Adaptive Graph Retrieval (EAGR), a framework in which accumulated evidence dynamically determines which semantic directions to explore next, and which requires no dedicated graph database and no explicit graph materialization. EAGR operates over an implicit semantic graph induced by compact passage metadata pre-ingested into a standard VectorDB. Starting from dense-retrieval seed passages, an LLM iteratively assesses accumulated evidence, identifies promising semantic directions, expands the retrieval frontier through metadata-based neighborhood lookup, and terminates once sufficient evidence has been collected. By precomputing semantic metadata, EAGR enables evidence-conditioned graph exploration without materializing an explicit graph, maintaining a dedicated GraphDB, or iteratively rewriting the query. Across three widely used multi-hop QA benchmarks, EAGR achieves the highest LLM-based answer accuracy among evaluated methods, outperforming the vanilla RAG by 17\% and strongest graph-aware baseline by 4\% percentage points averaged across three popular benchmarks HotPotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue.

AI.tldr: EAGR：利用预存于向量库的段落元数据构建隐式语义图，由累积证据动态引导图检索，无需图数据库或显式建图，在三个多跳QA基准上取得最高答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 多跳推理的RAG需要检索随中间证据揭示的新信息需求而自适应；现有方法依赖显式图结构或迭代查询改写，带来建图成本或查询时开销。
AI.method: 在标准VectorDB中预先写入紧凑的语义元数据以诱导隐式语义图；从稠密检索的种子段落出发，LLM迭代评估已累积证据、识别有前景的语义方向，通过基于元数据的邻域查找扩展检索前沿，证据充分后终止。无需专用图数据库、无需显式图物化、无需查询改写。
AI.result: 在HotPotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue三个多跳QA基准上LLM答案准确率最高，平均较vanilla RAG高17个百分点，较最强图感知基线高4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过预计算语义元数据，EAGR以低开销实现证据条件下的图探索，是多跳RAG中兼顾效果与效率的可行方案。

title: From Apparent Search Gains to Selection Failures: Auditing Test-Time Inference in Structured Workflow Planning
summary: Test-time search can improve structured planning, but when methods differ in prompts, post-processing, and selection, it is unclear what an observed gain should be attributed to. We study this question on DisasterBench, where models compose typed multi-tool workflows, by decomposing inference into three observable stages: whether a correct workflow is discovered, whether it survives structural validation, and whether it is finally selected. Comparing independent sampling, a nominal tree-search configuration, and multi-operator search under controlled inference budgets on two model families, we find that (i) the nominal tree-search configuration realizes non-adaptive complete-workflow sampling, and independent sampling with its expansion prompt reproduces its candidate discovery without constructing a tree; (ii) structural validation never removes the last correct workflow in our evaluated candidate pools, whereas majority voting leaves a discovered correct workflow unselected on 10-19% of tasks per pool, with an audit confirming substantive tool-choice or information-flow errors in 57 of 60 examined cases; and (iii) a tool-specification-aware verifier recovers some of these losses but overturns more correct decisions than it fixes. Our results motivate auditing realized rather than nominal inference pipelines, and reporting discovery, validity, and selection separately.

AI.tldr: 研究在DisasterBench上将推理分解为发现、结构校验、选择三阶段，发现名义树搜索实为非自适应的完整工作流采样，主要损失来自选择阶段而非校验阶段。
AI.motivation: 测试时搜索的增益常被混杂归因：各方法在提示、后处理、选择方式上不同，难以判断性能提升究竟来自搜索、验证还是选择，因此需在可控预算下拆解推理管线的各个可观测阶段。
AI.method: 在DisasterBench（多类型工具工作流组合任务）上，将推理拆为三个阶段：正确工作流是否被发现、是否通过结构校验、是否最终被选中；在两族模型上、固定推理预算下比较独立采样、名义树搜索配置和多算子搜索，并辅以人工审计与工具规范感知验证器实验。
AI.result: (i) 名义树搜索实际等同于非自适应完整工作流采样，独立采样配其扩展提示即可复现候选发现；(ii) 结构校验从未移除最后一个正确工作流，而多数投票在每池10–19%任务上未选中已发现的正确工作流，审计60例中57例确有实质工具选择或信息流错误；(iii) 工具规范感知验证器挽回部分损失，但推翻的正确决策多于修复的错误。
AI.conclusion: 应审计实际运行的推理管线而非名义配置，并分别报告发现、有效性与选择三阶段的指标。

title: From Single-Shot QA to Continuous Perception: Revisiting the Energy Composition and Optimization Boundary of Edge VLMs
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Data Mining 2026 Teen Research Track
summary: Visual-prefill energy conclusions for edge vision-language models (VLMs) are commonly drawn under single-shot workloads; we revisit them under continuous perception. Profiling nine VLMs across three architecture families on Jetson AGX Thor and Orin (4,508 records, calibrated with a pure-text task), we find two mutually independent energy laws: the per-output-token decode cost grows monotonically with model scale, whereas the visual-prefill (image-encoding) cost is dominated by visual-encoder architectural efficiency, not scale. Under continuous perception ($N{=}10$) with sparse output, visual-prefill energy reaches 92--97\% of total. We derive optimization strategies---visual frame reuse, adaptive output truncation, task-aware routing, and encoder throughput optimization---for edge VLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 在连续感知负载下重新审视边缘视觉语言模型(VLM)能耗：发现两条相互独立的能耗规律——解码成本随模型规模单调增长，而视觉预填充成本由视觉编码器架构效率主导而非规模；N=10稀疏输出时视觉预填充能耗占总能耗92–97%。
AI.motivation: 现有边缘VLM的"视觉预填充能耗"结论多基于单次推理(single-shot)负载得出，未必适用于连续感知(continuous perception)这一真实边缘部署场景，因此需要重新评估能耗规律。
AI.method: 在Jetson AGX Thor与Orin上对3个架构家族共9个VLM进行性能剖析，采集4,508条记录，并用纯文本任务做校准，分离解码与视觉预填充能耗。
AI.result: 识别出两个相互独立的能耗规律：每输出token的解码成本随模型规模单调增长；视觉预填充成本由视觉编码器架构效率主导，与规模关系不大。在N=10连续感知且输出稀疏时，视觉预填充能耗占总能耗92–97%。
AI.conclusion: 提出四项边缘VLM部署优化策略：视觉帧复用、自适应输出截断、任务感知路由、编码器吞吐优化。

title: Decentralized Multi-Agent Coordination and Communication in Shared Codebases
comment: First two authors contributed equally. Project Page: https://lingyunxiao18.github.io/ParallACT/
summary: Coding agents working in shared repositories may receive separate, independently-motivated requests from human developers, creating a setting that is multi-agent by necessity. When this scenario happens, their individual implementations may work separately but conflict when combined. To study this setting, we introduce ParallACT, a benchmark of orchestrator-free multi-agent coding tasks. ParallACT contains both complementary and contradictory tasks. In complementary tasks, each agent's task is separately useful and implementations must share an interface to be productively combined. In contradictory pairs, both agents' tasks require editing the same code in incompatible ways, and naively combining independent solutions fails to produce a useful implementation. We compare a single-agent oracle given the combined set of tasks against multi-agent settings that vary execution order, visibility, awareness of other agents, and access to a communication channel. We find that the oracle solves most tasks while parallel agents perform substantially worse. Their performance drop is notable for complementary tasks, and particularly sharp for contradictory tasks (e.g., from 62% to 16% for Claude Code with Claude Opus 4.8) where merged code typically satisfies only one specification, and the same gap appears in all six further configurations pairing two agent harnesses with three open-weight models. Simply telling an agent that a peer exists does not help significantly, and giving agents access to a communication channel recovers only a small part of the performance, at an additional token cost. ParallACT thus identifies and isolates a core challenge that will become more common as multi-agent coding by independent principals becomes standard, and provides a controlled test of which coordination strategies help, and at what cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ParallACT 基准，研究无编排器（orchestrator-free）的多智能体编码任务：多个独立开发者向共享仓库提出请求，各智能体独立实现后合并时发生冲突。实验显示单智能体 oracle 大幅优于并行多智能体（矛盾任务上由 62% 降至 16%），仅告知“存在同伴”无显著帮助，通信通道只能挽回少量性能且增加 token 成本。
AI.motivation: 现实场景中，同一共享代码库常被多个编码智能体分别处理独立提出、动机各异的请求，这本质上就是多智能体情形。各自实现单独可用，但合并后可能互相冲突，而现有研究缺乏针对此情形的受控测试。
AI.method: 构建 ParallACT 基准，包含互补任务（各任务单独有用、须共享接口才能有效组合）与矛盾任务（两个智能体需以不兼容方式修改同一代码，朴素合并失效）。对比单智能体 oracle（获得合并后的完整任务集）与多种多智能体配置，变化执行顺序、可见性、对其他智能体的感知、通信通道等维度；并在两个智能体框架 × 三个开放权重模型的六种组合上复现。
AI.result: oracle 能解决大多数任务，而并行智能体表现显著更差；互补任务下降明显，矛盾任务尤为突出（Claude Code 配 Claude Opus 4.8 从 62% 降至 16%），合并代码通常只满足其中一个规格；该差距在六种附加配置中均再现。仅告知智能体存在同伴帮助不大，通信通道只挽回小部分性能并带来额外 token 开销。
AI.conclusion: ParallACT 识别并隔离出多智能体编码中的一个核心挑战，随着独立主体驱动的多智能体编码成为常态将愈发普遍；它为评估何种协调策略有效及其代价提供了受控测试平台。

title: On the Limits of Test-Time Compute for Self-Evaluation
summary: Self-verification and aggregation have emerged as popular approaches for bridging the gap between pass@1 and pass@N. However, increasing the number of candidates does not consistently narrow the gap between final-answer accuracy and pass@N. To understand this limitation, we use ranking error to measure how reliably models distinguish their correct generations from incorrect ones. We show that ranking error admits a bias-variance decomposition, with both components shaped by algorithmic design choices and inference compute. Across our experiments, additional compute reduces variance, while bias initially decreases before approaching a plateau. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Scorpio, a simple and general method that jointly scores randomly grouped candidates. Across math, code, and puzzle benchmarks, Scorpio improves verification, tree search, and aggregation. For verification, Scorpio improves accuracy over the strongest baseline by up to 7 percentage points while matching or exceeding that baseline's peak accuracy with 17-42% lower inference cost. For tree search, using Scorpio to score partial solutions and select the final answer improves accuracy by up to 10 percentage points over prior methods. Finally, Scorpio improves the scaling of aggregation-based methods by 11 percentage points on coding tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文用排序误差的偏差-方差分解分析自验证/聚合中pass@1与pass@N的差距，提出联合打分的Scorpio方法，在数学、代码、谜题任务上提升验证、树搜索与聚合效果。
AI.motivation: 自验证与聚合旨在缩小pass@1与pass@N的差距，但增加候选数量并不能稳定缩小最终答案准确率与pass@N的差距，作者希望理解这一局限的根本原因。
AI.method: 用ranking error衡量模型区分自身正确与错误生成的能力，并对其进行偏差-方差分解，分析算法设计与推理算力对两个分量的影响；据此提出Scorpio——对随机分组的候选进行联合打分。
AI.result: 验证任务上比最强基线提升最多7个百分点，并以低17-42%的推理成本达到或超过其峰值准确率；树搜索中为部分解打分并选最终答案提升最多10个百分点；在代码任务的聚合方法上提升11个百分点的扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 增加算力主要降低方差，偏差先降后趋于平台；基于该洞察的Scorpio是简单通用的方法，可同时改进验证、树搜索与聚合。

title: Toward Bounding Coding-Agent Autonomy in Software Maintenance: A Pilot Study of Boundary Contracts
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Joint Workshop on AI for Software Engineering (JAWS 2), co-located with ASE 2026, Munich, Germany
summary:
As coding agents gain greater autonomy to modify software repositories, relevant context alone does not define their operational authority. An artifact may be relevant to a maintenance task while being inappropriate to edit; conversely, another artifact may be required even when it is not explicitly mentioned in the request. We explore Boundary Contracts, a machine-readable abstraction that makes task-specific artifact roles (editable, inspect-only, required, and protected) explicit before repository modification begins.
  We conduct a pilot study on 40 maintenance tasks from a real enterprise repository, comparing the same Codex-based coding agent with and without Boundary Contract information. The boundary-informed condition improves macro edit-selection F1 from 0.440 to 0.682, required-behavior coverage from 0.429 to 0.673, and the number of strictly acceptable patches from 9 of 40 to 18 of 40. To probe whether these gains are explained only by improved file localization, we additionally analyze 21 tasks in which both conditions modify at least one identical file. Differences remain in edit selectivity and patch outcomes, providing initial evidence that explicit artifact roles may influence maintenance behavior beyond localization alone.
  This pilot does not establish the general effectiveness of Boundary Contracts. Rather, it provides initial evidence for a broader research question: how should the operational boundaries of coding agents be generated, validated, revised, and ultimately enforced as repository-level maintenance becomes increasingly autonomous?

AI.tldr: 探索"Boundary Contracts"——一种在修改代码前显式声明任务相关工件角色(可编辑/仅检查/必需/受保护)的机器可读抽象,试点研究显示可显著提升编码代理的编辑选择与补丁质量。
AI.motivation: 编码代理自主性增强后,"相关上下文"不等于"操作权限":相关工件未必该改,未提及的工件却可能必须改。需要显式界定代理的操作边界。
AI.method: 在真实企业仓库的40个维护任务上做试点,对比同一Codex代理有无Boundary Contract信息;并额外分析21个两种条件下均修改了同一文件的任务,以排除仅靠文件定位改善的解释。
AI.result: 宏观编辑选择F1由0.440升至0.682,必需行为覆盖率由0.429升至0.673,严格可接受补丁数由9/40升至18/40;在共同文件任务中差异仍存在,说明作用不止于定位。
AI.conclusion: 试点不足以证明普遍有效性,但为更广泛研究问题提供初步证据:编码代理的操作边界应如何生成、验证、修订并最终强制执行。

title: EvoRec: A Unified Self-Evolving Agentic Recommender with Dynamic Reflection Trees
summary: Conventional recommender systems rely on fixed cascaded pipelines, limiting their ability to adapt to evolving user needs and feedback. Existing agentic recommenders introduce reasoning and tool use but often lack end-to-end decision control and systematic failure reflection. We propose EvoRec, a unified agentic recommendation framework that combines autonomous decision-making with reflection-driven self-evolution. A Need Agent infers user needs from long-term, short-term, and working memory. A Planning Agent adaptively allocates retrieval budgets between Behavior Continuation and Need Satisfaction, selects retrieval tools, and sets ranking-fusion weights. An Acting Executor executes the plan and records decision traces. Following user feedback, a Dynamic Reflection Tree identifies failures in need inference, planning, or previous repairs, proposes personalized corrections, and validates them through replay. Verified repairs update working memory and are distilled into reusable cross-user strategies, enabling continual improvement without parameter updates. Experiments on a Kuaishou local-services advertising dataset show a 15.7% Hit@50 improvement over the strongest baseline. Hierarchical reflection further improves Hit@50 by 13.1% among users with prior repairs. In a seven-day online A/B test, nearline EvoRec increases advertising revenue by 4.6% and CTCVR by 3.5%, with a 14.5% revenue gain for high-intent users. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of reflection-driven self-evolution in industrial-scale recommendation.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoRec——融合自主决策与反思驱动自我进化的统一智能体推荐框架，通过需求推断、自适应规划、执行与动态反思树实现无需参数更新的持续改进，离线 Hit@50 提升 15.7%，在线广告收入 +4.6%。
AI.motivation: 传统推荐系统采用固定级联流水线，难以适应用户需求与反馈的变化；已有智能体推荐引入推理与工具调用，但缺乏端到端决策控制与系统性失败反思。
AI.method: 构建四模块统一框架：Need Agent 基于长/短期与工作记忆推断用户需求；Planning Agent 自适应分配"行为延续"与"需求满足"的检索预算、选择检索工具并设定排序融合权重；Acting Executor 执行计划并记录决策轨迹；Dynamic Reflection Tree 依据用户反馈定位需求推断/规划/历史修复中的失败，提出个性化修正并经回放验证，验证通过的修复更新工作记忆并蒸馏为跨用户可复用策略，实现无参数更新的持续进化。
AI.result: 快手本地服务广告数据上 Hit@50 较最强基线提升 15.7%；分层反思使有修复历史用户的 Hit@50 再提升 13.1%；七天在线 A/B 测试中近线 EvoRec 广告收入 +4.6%、CTCVR +3.5%，高意图用户收入 +14.5%。
AI.conclusion: 反思驱动的自我进化在工业级推荐场景中有效，可在线动态适配并带来显著业务收益。

title: Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large: Fine-Tuning a 560M Embedder for Tajik Retrieval
comment: 10 pages, 5 tables, 1 figure. Technical report. Model: https://huggingface.co/Tohirju/Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large
summary: Finding the passage that answers a question is the first step of most practical systems built on documents, and for Tajik we found no openly described model for it. We present Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large, a Tajik text embedder built from multilingual-e5-large-instruct (560M parameters). We asked our own Tajik language model to write questions for passages from Tajik laws, tax documents, Wikipedia and web text, and trained on 235,140 question and passage pairs for one epoch, with hard negatives chosen by another embedder and English and Russian pairs mixed in so the model would not forget those languages. On laws the model had never seen, the right passage is among the top ten results for 93.6% of questions, up from 80.2%; on tax documents, 94.5% against 82.6%. On Belebele, the one test we have that was written by people, the gain is smaller and not confirmed (92.2% to 95.2%, with touching intervals), and Russian and English do not change. On law and tax questions written in the same style as its training questions, it is tied with Giga-Embeddings-3B, a model five times its size; on Belebele the 3B and 8B models score slightly higher, and only after we fine-tuned them on our data are they clearly ahead. We also report what failed: training in bfloat16 broke the model, and replacing Tajik letters with similar Russian ones did not help. Our law, tax and Wikipedia test questions come from the same model that wrote the training questions, so we treat those scores as an upper limit until questions written by Tajik speakers are available.

AI.tldr: 提出首个公开的塔吉克语文本嵌入模型 Saidzoda-Tajik-E5-Large（基于 multilingual-e5-large-instruct），用自建塔吉克语LLM生成的23.5万问答对训练，在律法与税务文档检索上大幅超过基线，但人工撰写测试集上的提升尚不确定。
AI.motivation: 检索"回答问题所需的段落"是大多数文档系统的第一步，而塔吉克语此前没有任何公开描述的检索/嵌入模型，存在明显空白。
AI.method: 以 multilingual-e5-large-instruct（560M）为底座，用自家塔吉克语LLM为法律、税务、维基和网页文本生成查询，构建235,140个问-段对，训练1个epoch；使用另一嵌入模型挖掘难负例，并混入英俄语对以防遗忘。消融/失败尝试包括 bfloat16 训练（使模型崩溃）和塔吉克字母替换为相似俄文字母（无效）。
AI.result: 未见过的法律文档：top-10命中率 80.2%→93.6%；税务文档 82.6%→94.5%。人工撰写的 Belebele：92.2%→95.2%（置信区间重叠，提升不显著）；俄语、英语性能不变。与5倍参数量的 Giga-Embeddings-3B 在训练同风格问题上持平；Belebele 上3B/8B略优，仅在其用本数据微调后才明显领先。
AI.conclusion: 小模型配合高质量合成数据可显著提升低资源语言检索能力，但法律/税务/维基的高分来自与训练同源的生成问题，应视为上限；需待塔吉克语母语者撰写测试问题后才能确认真实性能。

title: Deep Learning for Detecting Building Setback Rule Violations in Urban Planning: A Case Study on Bangladesh
summary: Dhaka's rapid urban growth has made building setback violations common, narrowing footpaths and blocking emergency access. RAJUK, responsible for building control in the Dhaka Metropolitan Area, enforces setback rules mainly through manual field inspection, which scales poorly. We present a systematic comparison of four machine learning approaches for classifying building setback conditions from street-level photographs: negative (compliant), moderate (borderline), and positive (violation). We built a labeled dataset of 372 geo-tagged images from sixteen Dhaka neighborhoods and expanded it with 5,968 augmented copies for training. We trained and evaluated a multi-layer perceptron (MLP), a Random Forest ensemble on frozen ResNet50 embeddings, a support vector machine on frozen ResNet18 embeddings, and a fine-tuned ResNet18 CNN. On a 1,275-image test set, the fine-tuned CNN achieved 65.4% accuracy (macro-F1 0.50), followed by Random Forest at 59.9% (macro-F1 0.44) and SVM at 58.2% (macro-F1 0.45). All models classify the compliant class reliably but struggle with the borderline moderate class due to visual ambiguity. These results establish reference performance levels for automated setback-compliance screening in a South Asian regulatory setting.

AI.tldr: 该文系统比较四种机器学习方法，用街景照片对达卡建筑退距合规情况做三分类，微调ResNet18表现最佳（65.4%准确率）。
AI.motivation: 达卡城市快速扩张导致建筑退距违规普遍，RAJUK依赖人工实地检查，难以规模化，需要自动化筛查手段。
AI.method: 收集16个社区372张带地理标签街景图，增广至5968张训练图；比较MLP、基于冻结ResNet50嵌入的随机森林、基于冻结ResNet18嵌入的SVM及微调ResNet18 CNN，在1275张测试集上评估三分类（合规/边缘/违规）。
AI.result: 微调CNN准确率65.4%（macro-F1 0.50）最佳，随机森林59.9%（0.44）、SVM 58.2%（0.45）；各模型对合规类识别可靠，但因视觉模糊难以区分边缘类。
AI.conclusion: 结果为南亚监管场景下自动化退距合规筛查建立了基准性能水平。

title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Atomic Creator Tokens for Large-Scale Generative Recommendation
summary: Recommending creators that a user does not yet follow is a cold-start problem: from hundreds of thousands of popular creators and only a short trail of prior engagements, the system must predict the next creator worth surfacing. The prevailing generative recommendation recipe tokenizes each creator into a \emph{Semantic ID} (SID) by quantizing a frozen embedding and trains a language model to generate SIDs. We show that this SID layer, not the language model, is the binding constraint. The creator-to-SID map is many-to-one, so colliding creators must be resolved by a popularity tie-break that caps creator-level recall and favors already-popular creators, and the frozen quantizer stops the training gradient from reaching the creator representation. We propose Atomic Creator Token (ACT), which gives every creator its own vocabulary token trained end-to-end. The map is bijective, so collisions are impossible and inference is a direct top-$k$ over creator logits. In a controlled comparison on production data in which the token layer is the only variable, ACT improves creator-level Recall@15 by 19.8 points ($1.84\times$) over a matched SID baseline, still leads when the SID codebook is enlarged $64\times$, and serves at ${\sim}2.7\times$ lower per-user latency. The advantage carries over to the public KuaiRand dataset, where ACT is the only method that beats a global-popularity baseline, provided each creator token sees enough training examples. In a live A/B test, ACT is directionally positive on every reported metric against both the SID-enhanced and the classic production rankers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Atomic Creator Token（ACT），用一对一的可学习词表token替代生成式推荐中的Semantic ID（SID）量化层，在冷启动创作者推荐上大幅超过SID基线并降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐把创作者量化成SID时是多对一映射，会发生碰撞，需靠热度打破平局，从而限制创作者级召回并偏向已热门创作者；同时冻结的量化器阻断了梯度回传到创作者表示，SID层成为真正的性能瓶颈而非语言模型。
AI.method: 为每个创作者分配专属词表token并端到端训练，使创作者到token的映射为双射，消除碰撞，推理时直接在创作者logits上做top-k。仅以token层为唯一变量，在生产数据上与匹配的SID基线做受控对比。
AI.result: 创作者级Recall@15提升19.8个百分点（1.84倍）；SID码本扩大64倍时仍领先；每用户延迟约低2.7倍。在公开KuaiRand数据集上，ACT是唯一能击败全局热度基线的方法（前提是每个创作者token有足够训练样本）。线上A/B测试中，相对SID增强版与经典生产排序器在所有报告指标上均为正向。
AI.conclusion: SID量化层是生成式创作者推荐的关键约束，用一对一原子token替代可消除碰撞、打通梯度并显著提升召回与效率；但效果依赖每个创作者token获得足够训练样本。

title: Unlearning by Extrapolating a Shrink-and-Heal Lookahead
summary: Unlearning aims to make a large language model behave like one retrained without its forget set. Prevailing likelihood-suppression objectives, however, lack an explicit forgetting target: they continually reward lower forget-set likelihood, making forgetting sensitive to the optimization budget. We address this limitation by estimating the direction toward the oracle without training it. Our key idea is to shrink the fine-tuned model toward its pre-fine-tuning weights and briefly re-learn the retain set, thereby removing the forget-specific contribution; in the linearized regime, this shrink-and-heal lookahead moves the model a fixed fraction of the way to the retrained model, its unique fixed point. Our method, SHIFT, extrapolates the lookahead's per-token changes into distillation targets and iteratively refines them. Evaluated against eleven baselines under a unified OpenUnlearning protocol, SHIFT achieves the highest aggregate score across all TOFU settings and the closest oracle alignment, 3.7x closer on average than the next-best method; on MUSE, it preserves the most retain knowledge. Under larger optimization budgets, baselines overshoot the oracle, while SHIFT remains near it, even under relearning attacks.

AI.tldr: SHIFT通过"收缩-愈合"前瞻估计朝向Oracle模型的方向，解决现有似然抑制型遗忘目标缺乏明确遗忘终点、对优化预算敏感的问题，在TOFU和MUSE上均优于十一个基线。
AI.motivation: 现有主流遗忘方法采用似然抑制目标，只持续压低遗忘集似然，却没有明确的遗忘终点（target），导致遗忘效果对优化预算高度敏感：预算不足则未遗忘，预算过大则过度遗忘、损害保留知识。
AI.method: 核心思想是无需训练Oracle即可估计其方向。将微调模型向其预微调权重收缩，再短暂重学保留集（shrink-and-heal lookahead），以去除遗忘集特有贡献；在线性化情形下，该前瞻恰好使模型朝重训练模型（唯一不动点）移动固定比例。SHIFT进一步将前瞻的逐token变化外推为蒸馏目标，并迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在统一的OpenUnlearning协议下对比11个基线：所有TOFU设置聚合得分最高，与Oracle对齐程度平均比次优方法近3.7倍；在MUSE上保留知识最多。增大优化预算时基线会越过Oracle，而SHIFT仍保持在Oracle附近，甚至在重学习攻击下依然稳定。
AI.conclusion: 为遗忘任务引入明确的Oracle方向估计目标，可显著提升遗忘的稳定性与精确性，使遗忘行为对优化预算不再敏感，并增强抗重学习攻击能力。

title: Causality-Based Fault Localization
summary: We introduce Causality-Based Fault Localization (CBFL), a novel approach to fault localization grounded in the theory of actual causality. We use the notion of causal responsibility to formalize and define the contribution of a given location in the source code under the context of a failing test. We also utilize a distance metric to prioritize minimal fixes and penalize broken tests, leading to more interpretable and fixable fault localization. We implemented CBFL in a tool, SoftReX, and our evaluation results demonstrate that SoftReX outperforms state-of-the-art Mutation-Based Fault Localization (MBFL) tools based on Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and Top-1 by 16% on both metrics, when using the same set of mutants. We also propose a sophisticated mutation generation strategy based on the structure and representation of the program to improve the accuracy of our ranked list, which outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 2.6x in terms of required mutants evaluated while remaining competitive in performance.

AI.tldr: 提出基于实际因果理论的故障定位方法CBFL，用因果责任量化代码位置对失败测试的贡献，并结合距离度量优先最小修复，工具SoftReX在MRR和Top-1上均超越MBFL方法16%。
AI.motivation: 现有故障定位（如基于变异的MBFL）缺乏可解释性和可修复性，难以说明某代码位置为何导致测试失败。本文希望借助实际因果理论，更本质地刻画代码位置与失败之间的因果关系。
AI.method: 引入因果责任（causal responsibility）概念，形式化定义失败测试上下文中各源码位置的贡献；使用距离度量对最小修复优先排序并惩罚破坏测试的变异；实现工具SoftReX；并提出基于程序结构与表示的变异生成策略以提升排序准确性。
AI.result: 在相同变异体集合下，SoftReX在MRR和Top-1上均比最先进MBFL工具高16%；其变异生成策略以约2.6倍更少需评估的变异体达到竞争性性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于因果性的故障定位可提升定位准确性与可修复性，并通过结构化变异生成显著降低开销，为可解释、可修复的自动故障定位提供了新思路。

title: Same Trajectory, Different Knowledge: Information-State-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Search Agents
summary: On-policy distillation trains search agents with teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories. Recent methods augment the teacher's context with supporting evidence, reference answers, or hindsight information. However, this privileged information may allow the teacher to rely on facts that the student cannot reliably recover from its current state. The resulting information-state mismatch can lead the teacher to undervalue retrieval that helps the student establish those facts. To address this mismatch, we introduce Information-State-Aware Distillation (ISA-Distill), which adapts teacher feedback to the student's factual recoverability. ISA-Distill estimates how reliably the student can recover action-relevant knowledge and derives teacher feedback for the same sampled action from two complementary views. The fact-use view supplies the teacher with the relevant fact, producing feedback that guides the student in using knowledge. The evidence-seeking view instead presents the information need, producing feedback that guides the student in acquiring supporting evidence. The two signals are weighted toward fact use when recoverability is high and toward evidence seeking when it is low, and the resulting feedback guides policy optimization. Experiments across diverse QA benchmarks and model scales demonstrate improved answer accuracy and retrieval efficiency. Our code and model checkpoints will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息状态感知蒸馏（ISA-Distill），通过双视角教师反馈（事实利用 vs. 证据获取）并按学生事实可恢复性加权，解决on-policy蒸馏中师生信息状态不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏方法给教师注入支持证据、参考答案或后见信息等特权信息，导致教师依赖学生无法从当前状态可靠恢复的事实，产生信息状态不匹配，进而低估对学生建立事实有帮助的检索行为。
AI.method: ISA-Distill估计学生对动作相关知识的可恢复性；对同一采样动作从两个互补视角生成教师反馈：事实利用视角（提供相关事实，引导学生使用知识）与证据获取视角（呈现信息需求，引导学生获取证据）；按可恢复性高低对两信号加权（高→事实利用，低→证据获取），用于策略优化。
AI.result: 在多样QA基准与多种模型规模上，答案准确率和检索效率均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过使教师反馈适配学生的事实可恢复性，ISA-Distill缓解了信息状态不匹配，提升了搜索智能体的准确性与检索效率；代码与模型将开源。

title: Multi-Estimate Elicitation Does Not Uniformly Debias Language Model Judgments
summary: Does eliciting five weighted estimates within a single response change how a language model responds to information? Across anchoring, hindsight, base-rate, conjunction, and status-quo/default tasks, we compare direct numerical answers with a multi-estimate response format, contrasting source framings, explicitly random cues, and probability-consistency constraints. We evaluate three completed configurations--gpt-6.1-sol, claude-sonnet-5.5, and Qwen3-8B (reasoning disabled, analyzed descriptively). In the first two configurations, direct elicitation yielded near-zero irrelevant-anchor indices and status-quo effects, while remaining responsive to informative sources and informed advice. Of 23 preregistered confirmatory tests, six rejected after Holm adjustment; however, all six absolute point estimates fell below their prespecified smallest effect sizes of interest without establishing equivalence. Moreover, while separate versus joint elicitation shifted conjunction judgments, interpretation is constrained by between-call noise. Ultimately, multi-estimate elicitation failed to produce uniform debiasing or response attenuation across tasks and models, though post hoc correlations between candidate spread and anchoring error motivate independent predictive validation. Materials: https://github.com/asj252/llm-judgment-studies

AI.tldr: 该文研究在单次回答中要求模型给出五个带权重的估计，是否会改变语言模型对信息的反应方式；结果显示多估计启发并不能在所有任务和模型上实现一致的去偏或反应衰减。
AI.motivation: 探究多估计式回答格式（一次给出五个带权重估计）能否作为通用的去偏手段，改变模型对锚定、后见、基率、合取、现状/默认等偏差任务中信源的敏感性。
AI.method: 在锚定、后见之明、基率、合取、现状/默认五类任务上，对比直接数值作答与多估计作答格式，并操纵来源框架、显式随机提示、概率一致性约束；评测 gpt-6.1-sol、claude-sonnet-5.5 与 Qwen3-8B（关闭推理，描述性分析）。共 23 项预注册验证性检验，采用 Holm 校正。
AI.result: 前两个配置中直接启发得到接近零的无关锚定指数与现状效应，同时对有信息量的来源与建议保持敏感。23 项检验中 6 项经 Holm 校正后显著，但其绝对点估计均低于预设最小效应量且未建立等价性；分离式与联合式启发会改变合取判断，但受跨调用噪声限制难以解释。多估计启发未产生一致去偏或反应衰减；事后发现候选分布离散度与锚定误差相关。
AI.conclusion: 多估计启发不是跨任务、跨模型通用的去偏或反应衰减机制；候选离散度与锚定误差的事后相关提示需独立预测性验证，材料已公开。

title: Beyond Black Boxes: An Ontology Based Vision Framework for Transparent Fruit Disease Detection
summary: Efficiency and reliability in the timely identification of phytopathogens would help minimize crop loss in agricultural sectors but existing deep learning based methods, although accurate, would require a large annotated dataset and are black-boxed in their operation, thus, restricting flexibility and transparency. The current paper presents a hybrid detection framework that is able to overcome these drawbacks through the unified real-time vision with a semantic knowledge base. Web Ontology Language (OWL) was used to develop a comprehensive ontology of the disease of fruits that formally codifies phytopathological knowledge, such as symptom phenotype, spectral phenotype (HSV), and morphological phenotype. Such knowledge-guided configuration guides the image processing pipeline, making it possible to diagnose using this knowledge under expert specified rules without a large training dataset. The ontology underwent a computationally verified test of its structural soundness and commonsensical practical usefulness and scored an overall of 7.4/10. On the public set of MangoFruitDDS, the diagnostic performance was an F1 Score of 85.00%, precision of 85.00%, and a recall of 85.23%. These findings are very competitive and similar to other known deep learning models like the VGG16 that prove that the knowledge-driven approach provides an accurate, transparent, and scalable solution on automated fruit disease diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于OWL疾病本体的混合检测框架，用知识引导图像处理流程，无需大规模标注数据即可诊断水果病害，在MangoFruitDDS上F1约85%。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习病害识别方法虽准确，但依赖大量标注数据且为黑箱，缺乏灵活性与透明性，难以控制农业损失。
AI.method: 构建水果病害OWL本体，形式化编码症状表型、光谱表型（HSV）与形态表型知识；以知识引导配置驱动实时视觉图像处理流程，在专家规则下诊断，无需大量训练数据；并对本体进行结构正确性与实用性计算化验证。
AI.result: 本体实用性评分7.4/10；在公开MangoFruitDDS数据集上F1 85.00%、精确率85.00%、召回率85.23%，与VGG16等深度学习模型竞争力相当。
AI.conclusion: 知识驱动方法可实现准确、透明、可扩展的自动化水果病害诊断，是有前景的深度学习替代或补充方案。

title: Efficient NPN Classification for Large Functions using Graph Neural Network
summary: Two Boolean functions are considered NPN equivalent if one can be transformed into the other by negating inputs, permuting inputs, or negating the output. Efficient NPN classification is valuable in fields such as logic synthesis, quantum computing, and information theory. However, exact NPN classification demands exhaustive enumeration of all possible input permutations and negations. Its complexity grows exponentially, making it impractical for larger functions with more inputs. In this paper, we introduce the first learning-based formulation for NPN classification by recasting it as NPN action prediction. Our method represents Boolean functions as AND-Inverter Graphs (AIGs) and applies a bidirectional heterogeneous graph neural network to predict input negations, output negation, and input permutations. To mitigate the non-canonicity of logic networks, we further introduce graph rewriting techniques that reduce structural ambiguity and recover useful symmetries before prediction. Experimental results show that NPN action prediction is learnable, that the resulting canonicalization quality improves over heuristic baselines, and that on practical benchmarks our method approaches exact methods on tractable cases while scaling to functions with up to 16 inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文将NPN等价分类重新表述为NPN动作预测问题，用AIG表示布尔函数并结合双向异构图神经网络预测输入取反、输出取反与输入置换，配合图重写技术降低结构歧义，在可达16输入的函数上接近精确方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 精确NPN分类需穷举所有输入置换与取反组合，复杂度指数增长，难以用于输入数较大的布尔函数；而NPN分类在逻辑综合、量子计算与信息论中有重要价值，因此需要可扩展的高效方法。
AI.method: 首次提出基于学习的NPN分类形式化，将其转化为NPN动作预测：以AND-Inverter图（AIG）表示布尔函数，采用双向异构图神经网络预测输入取反、输出取反和输入置换；并引入图重写技术以缓解逻辑网络非规范性、减少结构歧义并恢复有用的对称性，再进行预测。
AI.result: 实验表明NPN动作预测是可学习的，所得规范化质量优于启发式基线；在实际基准上，对可处理案例接近精确方法的效果，并可扩展到最多16个输入的函数。
AI.conclusion: 基于学习的NPN动作预测为NPN分类提供了可扩展的新范式，在保持规范化质量的同时突破了精确枚举的复杂度限制，展现出在较大规模布尔函数上的应用潜力。

title: MXCode: Vector Quantization for MX-Native Inference at Scale
summary: Memory capacity and bandwidth are major bottlenecks in LLM inference, motivating weight compression beyond conventional 4-bit quantization. Vector quantization (VQ) enables approximately 2-bit weight storage but often relies on codebooks incompatible with native FP4 computation. We introduce MXCode (MX-Native Codebook Quantization), a framework bridging ultra-low-bit VQ compression with MicroXcaling (MX)-native FP4 computation. MXCode proposes three strategies: PostScale, which quantizes learned codebooks to MXFP4; PreScale, which extracts MX scales before codebook learning; and PreScale+, which further compresses these scales using VQ. These strategies explore tradeoffs among quantization quality, scale overhead, and codebook granularity. All reconstruct MX-native W4A4 operands without materializing intermediate high-precision weights. We evaluate MXCode on Qwen3 (235B), DeepSeek-R1 (671B), and GLM-5.2 (753B) using the Microsoft MX Emulation Library. MXCode achieves approximately 2 bits per weight with competitive, workload-dependent model quality. On GB300 hardware, experiments with Qwen3 (235B) show approximately 50% lower model-load memory than Native FP4 while maintaining near-Native-FP4 serving throughput. Under memory-constrained prefix reuse, P90 TTFT improves by up to 94.5%. These results demonstrate software-based reconstruction on existing FP4 hardware and inform the development of future MX-native inference systems.

AI.tldr: MXCode 通过将超低比特向量量化(VQ)与 MX 原生 FP4 计算桥接，实现约 2 bit/权重存储，同时保留 FP4 硬件推理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 推理受限于显存容量与带宽，4-bit 量化不足，VQ 可达约 2-bit 但码本与原生 FP4 计算不兼容。
AI.method: 提出三种策略：PostScale（将学习到的码本量化为 MXFP4）、PreScale（在码本学习前提取 MX 缩放因子）、PreScale+（进一步用 VQ 压缩缩放因子）；三者均直接重建 MX 原生 W4A4 操作数，无需物化高精度中间权重。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-235B、DeepSeek-R1-671B、GLM-5.2-753B 上评估，达约 2 bit/权重且质量具竞争力。GB300 上 Qwen3-235B 模型加载显存比 Native FP4 低约 50%，吞吐接近原生 FP4；内存受限前缀复用场景下 P90 TTFT 最高提升 94.5%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了在现有 FP4 硬件上通过软件重构实现超低比特压缩的可行性，为未来 MX 原生推理系统设计提供参考。

title: WFDB-x: Conformance-Tested Implementations of the WFDB Software Package in Seven Programming Languages
summary: The WFDB format is widely used to store and exchange physiological waveforms and annotations. However, existing software implementations are limited to C, Python, and MATLAB/Octave, can produce different results in corner cases and checksum calculations, and have defaults such as sampling frequency and gain, that can lead to silent misinterpretation of recordings. We developed WFDB-x, a cross-language, performance-optimized reimplementation of WFDB in seven programming languages, with extensive unit tests, to provide consistent WFDB processing across programming languages. We reimplemented the WFDB Software Package 10.7.0 natively in Python, C++, Rust, Julia, R, MATLAB/Octave, and Kotlin, using AI-assistance under human direction and review. Each implementation has library functions, a high-level interface, and command-line tools. We compared their outputs with those of the original C programs using 1098 conformance cases, 877 legacy-mode cases, unit tests, and differential fuzzing. Deliberate changes remove implicit waveform parameters, restrict file and network access, and prevent annotation loss. A legacy mode retains the original behavior. All seven implementations passed every conformance and legacy-mode case on the tested Linux platform, with matching outputs. The unit tests contain 9353 assertions. C++, Rust, and Julia read records 1.5-6.9 times faster than the original C library, while the Python implementation wrote records 9.2 times faster than the existing wfdb-python library in the benchmark. WFDB-x provides a tested, open-source basis for reading and writing physiological recordings consistently across seven languages, supporting reproducible research and software development without requiring a shared programming environment. We also share details of the AI-assisted development process and token utilization, which may be useful for other applications.

AI.tldr: WFDB-x 是 WFDB 生理波形与注释格式在七种语言（Python、C++、Rust、Julia、R、MATLAB/Octave、Kotlin）中的跨语言高性能重实现，通过 1098 个一致性用例、877 个兼容模式用例与差分模糊测试验证，输出与原 C 程序一致，并在读取速度上提升 1.5–6.9 倍。
AI.motivation: WFDB 格式虽广泛使用，但现有实现局限于 C/Python/MATLAB，在边角情况和校验和计算上结果不一致，采样频率、增益等隐式默认值会导致录音被静默误解，影响可复现研究。
AI.method: 在人类指导与审核下借助 AI 辅助，原生重实现 WFDB Software Package 10.7.0 于七种语言，每种包含库函数、高层接口与命令行工具；与原始 C 程序比对 1098 个一致性用例、877 个旧版模式用例、单元测试及差分模糊测试；刻意移除隐式波形参数、限制文件与网络访问、防止注释丢失，并保留 legacy 模式以复现原行为。
AI.result: 七种实现在 Linux 平台全部通过一致性与 legacy 用例且输出相同，单元测试含 9353 条断言；C++、Rust、Julia 读取记录比原 C 库快 1.5–6.9 倍，Python 写记录比 wfdb-python 快 9.2 倍。
AI.conclusion: WFDB-x 为跨七种语言一致读写生理记录提供了经测试的开源基础，支持可复现研究与开发且无需共享编程环境；论文还公开了 AI 辅助开发流程与 token 使用的细节，可供其他应用参考。

title: Multi-criteria Rating and Review based Recommendation Model
comment: 10 pages. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2022 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (Big Data). (c) 2022 IEEE
summary: These days, due to the advancement of information technology, recommendation system has become one of the key tools for e-commerce business. E-commerce platforms allow users to provide feedback in both written comments and numerical ratings. Recommendation systems are utilized to recommend users to new or unseen items based on these previously collected comments or ratings. In recent years, multi-aspect or multi-criteria based recommendation systems have been studied a lot by the recommendation research community. However, these research works are conducted either with reviews or ratings, not with both. In this project, we argue that integrating both textual reviews (with multiple aspects) and numerical multi-criteria ratings can further enhance the overall rating prediction accuracy. We propose a Multi-criteria Rating and Review based Recommendation model (MRRRec). We show that incorporating multi-criteria ratings into multi-aspect ratings from reviews has a great impact on performance. Our proposed model outperforms several state-of-the-art models such as ANR, DeepCoNN, and Deep Multi-criteria Recommendation System in terms of MSE, MAE, precision, recall, and F1. We show that our proposed model achieves an average of 19% and 23.0% lower MSE and MAE respectively and 7.0%, 1.0% and 3.8% higher precision, recall, and F1 score respectively. We further show that our model performs significantly better with Word2Vec word embedding than the GloVe word embedding method.

AI.tldr: 提出MRRRec模型，融合多准则数值评分与多方面的文本评论，提升评分预测精度，性能优于ANR、DeepCoNN和多准则深度推荐系统。
AI.motivation: 现有电商推荐系统中，多准则/多方面推荐研究要么只用评论、要么只用评分，未将二者结合。作者认为同时整合多方面的文本评论与多准则数值评分可进一步提升整体评分预测准确率。
AI.method: 提出基于多准则评分与评论的推荐模型MRRRec，将评论文本抽取的多方面评分与数值多准则评分进行融合，用于评分预测与推荐。
AI.result: 相比ANR、DeepCoNN、Deep Multi-criteria Recommendation System等先进模型，MSE平均降低19%、MAE降低23.0%，precision、recall、F1分别提升7.0%、1.0%、3.8%；且Word2Vec词向量效果显著优于GloVe。
AI.conclusion: 融合多准则评分与多方面评论文本能有效提升推荐性能，MRRRec在多项指标上优于现有方法，且词向量选择对性能有显著影响。

title: Enhancing Language Model Reasoning with Structured Multi-Level Modeling
summary: Inference-time scaling enhances a model's reasoning by extending its chain-of-thought (CoT). However, existing approaches typically rely on a single policy trained with outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL), which often suffers from long-horizon plan failures where the implicit plan drifts from valid strategies, especially for small LMs with limited capacity. To address this, we propose Multi-Level Reasoning (MLR), which reformulates long-CoT generation as a two-level stochastic process. A high-level planner generates structured step descriptors specifying both the reasoning mode and the semantic subgoal. The low-level executor then produces detailed reasoning conditioned on these descriptors, forming an alternating plan--execute loop. To maintain scalability, we adopt a minimal design where the base model serves as the low-level policy and a lightweight LoRA module implements the high-level policy. For training, we observe that outcome-reward RL provides sparse and delayed feedback for long trajectories (e.g., several thousand tokens), hindering credit assignment. We therefore introduce iterative Step-DPO, a process-level preference optimization scheme that leverages Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo (TSMC) to provide scalable stepwise supervision. This yields more effective training, improved stability, and higher accuracy. Extensive experiments on challenging math, science, and logical reasoning benchmarks show that, under the same reduced data budget (10% SFT and 5% preference relative to the DeepSeek-R1 distillation setup), MLR outperforms both SFT-based distillation and strong RL/preference-optimization baselines across multiple base models and tasks. Moreover, MLR exhibits slower performance degradation on long-horizon reasoning, demonstrating stronger robustness under extended CoT generation.

AI.tldr: 提出多层级推理MLR框架，将长链推理重构为"高层规划器+低层执行器"的两级随机过程，并用迭代Step-DPO提供步级监督，降低数据需求并提升长视野推理稳健性。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时扩展依赖单一策略做结果奖励强化学习，长视野规划易失效（隐式计划偏离有效策略），小模型尤为严重；且结果奖励对数千token的长轨迹反馈稀疏、延迟，信用分配困难。
AI.method: 将长CoT生成建模为两级随机过程：高层规划器输出结构化步骤描述（推理模式+语义子目标），低层执行器据此生成详细推理，交替形成"规划—执行"循环；基座模型作低层策略，轻量LoRA模块作高层策略以保证可扩展性；训练上提出迭代Step-DPO，借助Twisted Sequential Monte Carlo（TSMC）提供可扩展的步级偏好监督。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、逻辑推理等挑战性基准上，相同小数据预算（相对DeepSeek-R1蒸馏设定仅10% SFT、5%偏好数据）下，MLR在多基座模型与多任务上优于SFT蒸馏及强RL/偏好优化基线；长视野推理性能退化更慢，延长CoT时更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 显式分层规划配合过程级偏好优化可缓解长CoT规划漂移与信用分配难题，在低数据成本下实现更强、更稳定的推理时扩展。

title: Real-Time Obstacle Detection and Distance Estimation on Smartphones for Visually Impaired and Distracted Pedestrians
summary: According to the World Health Organization, at least 2.2 billion people worldwide live with visual impairment, including tens of millions with severe vision loss. Traditional aids such as white canes or guide dogs remain costly, limited in capability, and inaccessible to many. At the same time, smartphone distraction in public spaces has been linked to elevated risks of collisions with vehicles, trips, and falls. These dual challenges motivate lightweight, smartphone-based solutions that combine accessibility with low latency. We present a Kotlin-based Android application that uses a YOLOv8 detector, retrained to recognize eighteen common urban obstacle classes, to deliver real-time obstacle alerts for both user groups. The detector was optimized with pruning, quantization, and early-exit branches, and deployed through the Android Neural Networks API (NNAPI), which can dispatch inference to GPU, NPU, or DSP accelerators when available. On a mid-range smartphone, these optimizations reduced average inference latency from about 3.2 s for the off-the-shelf YOLOv8n to 0.39-0.48 s; the recommended configuration (INT8 quantization with early exit) runs in 0.42-0.48 s while retaining a recall of 0.81. The application combines the optimized detector with ARCore-based or monocular focal-length distance estimation, so it works with a single smartphone camera and requires no LiDAR, depth camera, or other specialized sensor. Multimodal feedback, including Text-to-Speech guidance for visually impaired users and vibration alerts for distracted pedestrians, supports use across different contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于Kotlin的Android应用，用经剪枝、量化、早退优化的YOLOv8检测器（18类城市障碍物）配合NNAPI部署，为视障人士与分心行人提供实时障碍告警，推理延迟从约3.2s降至0.42-0.48s且召回率0.81。
AI.motivation: 全球至少22亿人有视力障碍，白手杖/导盲犬昂贵且能力有限；同时公共空间中看手机分心导致碰撞、绊倒和跌倒风险上升。两类需求都呼唤轻量、低延迟、基于手机的方案。
AI.method: Kotlin Android应用；YOLOv8重训练识别18类常见城市障碍物；采用剪枝、量化、早退分支优化；通过Android NNAPI部署（可调度GPU/NPU/DSP）；结合ARCore或单目焦距测距，无需LiDAR或深度相机；多模态反馈（视障用户TTS语音，分心行人振动）。
AI.result: 中端手机上平均推理延迟由现成YOLOv8n的约3.2s降至0.39-0.48s；推荐配置（INT8量化+早退）为0.42-0.48s，召回率保持0.81。
AI.conclusion: 轻量化的手机端检测方案可在无专用传感器的条件下实现低延迟障碍告警，兼顾视障辅助与行人安全两类场景，具备实用可行性。

title: Dependence-Aware Risk Assessment and Optimal Design of AI-Agent Safeguard Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on safeguards to prevent unauthorized actions while preserving legitimate service. However, existing risk assessments often focus on individual safeguard performance while overlooking dependence among safeguard decisions. This paper develops a dependence-aware framework for risk assessment and optimal design of multi-component AI safeguard systems, jointly selecting configurations and operating policies for sequential layered screening and selective verification. We establish stochastic comparisons of layered-screening error probabilities and invocation costs under lower-orthant ordering. For selective verification, we characterize exactly which policies have error probabilities and review costs that respond monotonically to stronger dependence under supermodular ordering. For a fixed first stage and reviewer, we show that the optimal routing map is a two-threshold rule in the first-stage likelihood ratio. An accompanying open-source software package, Dependence-Aware Policy Optimization Algorithms (DAPOA), facilitates the practical implementation of the proposed framework. Numerical experiments show that ignoring dependence can lead to inaccurate risk assessments and infeasible safeguard designs, with independence-based selections violating security requirements in six of eight scenarios. An empirical study using four LLM safeguards on benchmark-derived agent actions further demonstrates the practical implications of dependence modeling. Under the principal operating setting, dependence-aware selection lowers held-out total cost by 39.6% relative to independence-based selection.

AI.tldr: 提出依赖感知的多组件AI防护系统风险评估与最优设计框架，联合优化分层筛选与选择性验证的配置与策略。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体防护评估多关注单个防护组件性能，忽视防护决策间的相互依赖，可能导致风险评估不准与设计不可行。
AI.method: 在下正交序下建立分层筛选错误概率与调用成本的随机比较；对选择性验证，刻画在超模序下错误概率与审核成本随依赖增强单调变化的策略；对固定首阶段与审核器，证明最优路由映射为首阶段似然比的双阈值规则；并发布开源工具包DAPOA。
AI.result: 忽略依赖会导致风险评估偏差与不可行设计，基于独立性的选择在8个场景中有6个违反安全要求；在4个LLM防护组件的实证中，依赖感知选择使留出总成本相对独立假设降低39.6%。
AI.conclusion: 依赖建模对多组件AI防护系统的风险与成本评估至关重要，本文框架与DAPOA可实现更安全、更低成本的设计。

title: TileWeave: Heterogeneous Tiling for Sparse Prefill on Mobile SoCs
summary: Smartphone applications increasingly require large language models to process long contexts, whereas high prefill latency and memory demands constrain local inference. Block-sparse attention reduces computation and memory traffic, but its irregular selections conflict with mobile NPUs' preference for large, regular tiles. Efficient execution must exploit cross-query reuse while avoiding redundant computation and preserving selections needed for accuracy. In this paper, we present TileWeave, which partitions sparse attention by this cross-query reuse: highly shared key blocks run in coarse NPU tiles, while low-reuse blocks run on the GPU only for the query blocks that selected them. In addition, we design an NPU-native pooled-key selector that keeps selection inexpensive, and a runtime that publishes GPU partials in the order the NPU consumes them and merges them in its existing output store. On RULER, HeteroSparse matches XAttention's accuracy with Qwen3-1.7B and improves it with Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct; its mean LongBench scores match XAttention as well. On Snapdragon SM8750 and SM8850 phones, it achieves 1.35--3.23$\times$ faster full-model prefill than XAttention over 1k--16k tokens and up to 1.58$\times$ faster than dense attention.

AI.tldr: TileWeave 是一种面向手机 NPU 的块稀疏注意力执行方案，按跨查询复用程度划分 tile，在保持精度的同时显著降低长上下文 prefill 延迟。
AI.motivation: 手机端长上下文 LLM 推理受限于 prefill 高延迟与内存开销。块稀疏注意力虽能降低计算与访存，但其不规则的块选择与移动 NPU 偏好大而规则的 tile 相冲突，因此需要一种既能利用跨查询复用、又避免冗余计算并保精度的执行方式。
AI.method: 按跨查询复用来划分稀疏注意力：高共享的 key 块在 NPU 上以粗粒度 tile 执行，低复用块仅在选择了它的 query 块上由 GPU 执行；同时设计 NPU 原生的 pooled-key 选择器降低选择开销，并设计运行时按 NPU 消费顺序发布 GPU 部分结果，在其既有输出存储阶段完成合并。
AI.result: 在 RULER 上，HeteroSparse 与 XAttention 精度相当（Qwen3-1.7B），在 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上精度更高；LongBench 平均分也与 XAttention 持平。在 Snapdragon SM8750 与 SM8850 手机上，1k–16k token 范围内全模型 prefill 比 XAttention 快 1.35–3.23 倍，比稠密注意力最多快 1.58 倍。
AI.conclusion: 按跨查询复用对稀疏注意力进行异构分工（NPU 粗粒度 tile + GPU 低复用补算）可有效缓解不规则稀疏与移动 NPU 规则化偏好之间的矛盾，在几乎不损失精度的前提下取得显著的 prefill 加速。

title: CrossSWE: Benchmarking Cross-Repository Joint Development for Coding Agents
summary: As coding agents achieve increasingly high success rates on software engineering benchmarks, recent efforts have sought to increase task complexity through longer horizons and more extensive code modifications. However, real-world software development often spans multiple interdependent repositories, introducing additional challenges in dependency reasoning, change propagation, and interface consistency. Rather than further increasing complexity within individual repositories, we introduce CrossSWE, a benchmark for cross-repository joint development comprising 171 real-world instances spanning 165 repositories, 20 technical domains, and 13 programming languages. CrossSWE verifies the necessity of coordinated changes by testing whether partial repository modifications are insufficient to achieve the intended behavior. Our evaluation of five LLMs reveals substantial challenges, with the strongest model, GPT-6.1 Sol, achieving only 58.48% Pass@1. Furthermore, cross-repository inconsistencies emerge as the most prevalent failure mode (44.2%), highlighting the difficulty of maintaining consistency across interdependent repositories.

AI.tldr: 提出 CrossSWE，首个面向跨仓库联合开发的基准，含 171 个真实实例（165 仓库、20 领域、13 语言），通过验证“部分仓库修改不足以实现目标行为”来确保任务需协同修改；最强模型 GPT-6.1 Sol 仅 58.48% Pass@1，跨仓库不一致为最大失败模式（44.2%）。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体基准多在单仓库内提升任务复杂度（更长horizon、更大规模改动），但真实软件开发常跨多个相互依赖的仓库，带来依赖推理、变更传播和接口一致性等额外挑战，缺少相应评测。
AI.method: 构建跨仓库联合开发基准 CrossSWE，覆盖 171 个真实实例、165 个仓库、20 个技术领域、13 种编程语言；通过测试“仅修改部分仓库无法达成预期行为”来验证任务确实需要协同改动；并评测 5 个 LLM。
AI.result: 最强模型 GPT-6.1 Sol 仅达 58.48% Pass@1；跨仓库不一致为最普遍的失败模式，占 44.2%。
AI.conclusion: 跨仓库场景对现有编码智能体构成显著挑战，维持相互依赖仓库间一致性是核心难点；CrossSWE 为跨仓库软件开发能力评测提供了新方向。

title: Multicriteria Recommendation System by Leveraging Predefined, Implicit, and Undefined Criteria
comment: 9 pages. Preprint (submitted version, prior to peer review). The Version of Record is published in Social Networks Analysis and Mining (ASONAM 2024), Lecture Notes in Computer Science, Springer, https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-78538-2_6
summary: Data sparsity, a long-standing problem in the recommendation system, occurs when the user-item utility matrix is sparse. For years, many approaches have been experimented with, including utilizing user's textual reviews and multiple criteria ratings. In a review-based recommendation system, user preferences and item attributes are learned from reviews, while in multi-criteria recommendation systems, criteria ratings are used for the recommendation task. Multi-criteria are domain-specific pre-defined explicit criteria and users are bound to provide feedback only on these criteria with discrete values. On the contrary, users are free to express their opinions through textual reviews, which can cover multiple perspectives or aspects. It is possible that these pre-defined, domain-specific explicit criteria are not enough to fully capture the multi-faceted user preferences. To this end, we propose a novel multi-criteria recommendation model that utilizes predefined, implicit, and undefined criteria. We use a semantic similarity-based sentence clustering method to identify the predefined and implicit criteria and a sentiment analyzer to estimate their ratings. The criteria that are extracted from the review and are aligned with predefined criteria are referred to as implicit criteria. A sentence is considered as expressing opinions on an undefined criterion if the similarity score between this sentence and all the predefined criteria is lower than a predefined threshold. Ratings are computed for each extracted implicit criterion and the undefined criterion based on the review content. Finally, we use all three types of criteria and an aggregation model to make the final rating prediction for the recommendation system. Our proposed method demonstrates the superiority compared to several baselines on TripAdvisor and Beer Advocate datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用预定义、隐式与未定义三类准则的多准则推荐模型，通过句聚类和情感分析从评论中估计准则评分，提升稀疏场景下的推荐效果。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统长期受数据稀疏困扰。现有研究分别使用文本评论或多准则评分，但多准则系统中的准则是领域相关的预定义显式准则，用户只能在离散选项上反馈，难以完整刻画多方面的用户偏好；而评论文本可自由表达多视角观点。
AI.method: 基于语义相似度的句子聚类识别预定义准则与隐式准则（与预定义准则对齐的评论准则）；若句子与所有预定义准则的相似度均低于阈值，则视为表达未定义准则。用情感分析器为各隐式准则和未定义准则估计评分，最后结合三类准则与聚合模型进行评分预测。
AI.result: 在 TripAdvisor 和 Beer Advocate 数据集上相比多个基线方法表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 将预定义显式准则与从评论中挖掘的隐式、未定义准则结合，可更充分捕获多面用户偏好，有效缓解多准则推荐中的数据稀疏问题。

title: ElectroChemLLM: A Multimodal LLM Pipeline for High-Fidelity Electrochemical Informatics
summary: Electrochemistry is central to solving many modern-day challenges, including energy storage systems for a sustainable future, and its advancement relies heavily on the data from past findings. Existing automated pipelines are limited by text-only architectures, context fragmentation, and numerical hallucinations - collectively preventing accurate, large-scale curation of property databases. We introduce ElectrochemLLM, a multimodal information extraction pipeline that jointly identifies structured electrochemical records encompassing electrolyte compositions, electrode materials, cell configurations, and their measured physicochemical properties from unstructured scientific PDFs at scale. By combining hybrid document parsing with vision-capable LLM orchestration, the pipeline extracts verifiable, structured data across text, tables, and figures. Evaluated on the battery-electrolyte subset of our manually annotated benchmark of 232 papers, ElectrochemLLM achieves an F-1 score of 0.97, and has been applied to curate ElectroChemDB, a structured database spanning 15,000 electrochemical research articles. We demonstrate the utility of this resource by training machine learning models for electrolyte property prediction, illustrating a complete pathway from unstructured literature to predictive materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态信息抽取流水线ElectrochemLLM，从PDF中联合抽取电化学结构化记录（电解液、电极、电池构型及性质），在232篇论文基准上F-1达0.97，并构建覆盖1.5万篇文献的ElectroChemDB数据库用于电解液性能预测。
AI.motivation: 电化学发展依赖历史数据，但现有自动化抽取流水线受限于纯文本架构、上下文碎片化和数值幻觉，难以大规模、准确地构建性质数据库。
AI.method: 结合混合文档解析与具备视觉能力的LLM编排，实现跨文本、表格、图像的端到端抽取；联合识别电解液组成、电极材料、电池构型及物化性质，产出可验证的结构化记录。
AI.result: 在自建232篇人工标注基准的电池-电解液子集上F-1为0.97；已用于构建ElectroChemDB，覆盖15,000篇电化学研究文章；并基于该资源训练电解质性质预测模型。
AI.conclusion: 验证了从非结构化文献到预测性材料发现的完整路径，为电化学领域大规模数据驱动研究提供了可行方案。

title: Think Before You Locate: Clinical Chain-of-Though Supervision for Sequential Medical Image Grounding
summary: Clinicians rarely localize a finding from one image alone. They compare current and prior scans, follow structures across slices, and match regions across views or modalities. Yet vision-language models for sequential medical grounding usually learn only from bounding boxes. Boxes show where the target is, but they do not explain why that region in that image answers the question. We study whether explicit, image-grounded reasoning can improve localization, and which tasks benefit from it. We introduce method, whose core is MedChain, a corpus of 182,573 filtered rationales spanning eight sequential grounding tasks and ten imaging modalities. A medical VLM (FlemingVL-38B) first drafts a caption-like rationale, and a multimodal refiner (Qwen3.5-397B-A17B) then re-examines the images, question and annotated box to write a box-conditioned explanation with explicit cross-image reasoning. We fine-tune Qwen3.5 on these rationales with deliberative chain-of-thought supervision (dCoT-SFT). Across 4B, 9B, and 27B models, dCoT-SFT sets a new state of the art on MedSG-Bench. The 27B model reaches 77.24 mIoU and 85.20 Acc@0.5, improving over the strongest prior model by 4.69 and 5.49 points. In a paired comparison using fixed 4B checkpoints, dCoT-SFT improves over answer-only SFT by 3.56 mIoU (95% CI 3.13--4.00). The gains mainly come from change detection and object tracking, while performance drops on three appearance-matching tasks. Replacing a model's own rationale with a rationale from another task reduces mIoU by 12.2 points, showing that localization depends strongly on the reasoning context. Finally, adding GRPO with an IoU reward after dCoT-SFT gives only small and task-dependent gains, which we analyze through controlled multi-seed development experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究显式、图像接地的推理能否提升序列医学定位，并构建了MedChain（182,573条过滤后的理由说明，覆盖8类序列定位任务、10种影像模态），提出dCoT-SFT对Qwen3.5模型进行链式思维监督微调。4B/9B/27B各规模均刷新MedSG-Bench最佳结果，27B模型达77.24 mIoU、85.20 Acc@0.5。
AI.motivation: 临床医生定位病灶从不只看单张图像：他们对比当前与既往扫描、跨层面追踪结构、在不同视角或模态间匹配区域。然而面向序列医学定位的视觉-语言模型通常只从边界框中学习——框只表明"目标在哪里"，却不解释"为何该图像中的该区域能回答此问题"，缺乏可解释的推理依据。
AI.method: 构建MedChain数据集：先用医学VLM（FlemingVL-38B）起草类字幕式理由说明，再由多模态精炼器（Qwen3.5-397B-A17B）结合图像、问题与标注框重写为带显式跨图像推理的"框条件解释"，最终获得182,573条过滤后的理由，覆盖8个序列定位任务和10种模态。随后以审慎链式思维监督（dCoT-SFT）微调Qwen3.5的4B/9B/27B模型；并额外尝试在dCoT-SFT后加入以IoU为奖励的GRPO。
AI.result: dCoT-SFT在4B、9B、27B上均刷新MedSG-Bench的SOTA：27B模型达77.24 mIoU与85.20 Acc@0.5，较此前最强模型分别提升4.69和5.49点。固定4B检查点的配对比较中，相比仅答案SFT，mIoU提升3.56点（95% CI 3.13–4.00）。增益主要来自变化检测和物体追踪，而三个外观匹配任务性能下降。将模型自身理由替换为来自其他任务的理由后，mIoU下降12.2点，说明定位强烈依赖推理上下文。dCoT-SFT后再加IoU奖励的GRPO仅带来小幅且随任务变化的增益，作者通过受控多种子开发实验对此进行了分析。
AI.conclusion: 显式、图像接地的推理监督确实能显著提升序列医学定位，且收益具有任务异质性（利于变化检测与追踪，不利于外观匹配）。定位高度依赖与任务匹配的推理上下文，而非通用文本线索；额外强化学习（GRPO）在SFT后收益有限，说明推理质量本身是关键瓶颈。

title: CalVLA: Shaping Native Confidence in Vision-Language-Action Policies with Outcome Supervision
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the Science of Physical AI Safety (SPAIS) Workshop, CoRL 2026
summary: Can a vision-language-action (VLA) policy signal likely task failure from its own action probabilities? We introduce CalVLA, which shapes native action-token confidence using successful and failed rollouts and an Action-Confidence Alignment (ACal) squared margin-ranking loss. Low-rank adapters update OpenVLA-7B without an auxiliary failure detector. Observations are paired within tasks at similar normalized elapsed times, not necessarily equivalent physical progress. On a held-out test split from 500 LIBERO-10 configurations, adapted confidence achieves a joint failure-discrimination AUROC of $0.7392\pm0.0480$ over three seeds, averaging scores at 130 and 260 steps. Frozen-policy probes reach 0.6146--0.6436, but superiority over the linear probe is statistically inconclusive. For the same confidence summary, AUROC rises from 0.4485 before adaptation to 0.7327 after adaptation. Mean task success decreases from 58% to 55%. These results show improved failure discrimination, not improved control or established safety benefits.

AI.tldr: CalVLA 利用成功/失败轨迹配对与平方 margin-ranking 损失，对 OpenVLA-7B 的原生动作 token 置信度进行低秩适配，使 VLA 策略自身置信度具备失败判别能力，但代价是成功率略降。
AI.motivation: 探索 VLA 策略能否直接由其自身动作概率信号提前预示任务失败，从而在不引入额外失败检测器的情况下获得失败判别能力。
AI.method: 构建动作置信度对齐（ACal）平方 margin-ranking 损失，在任务内按相近归一化已用时间配对成功与失败观测；用低秩适配器微调 OpenVLA-7B，重塑原生动作 token 置信度，无辅助失败检测器。
AI.result: LIBERO-10 的 500 个配置的留出测试集上，三随机种子联合失败判别 AUROC 为 0.7392±0.0480（130 与 260 步得分平均）；冻结策略探针 0.6146–0.6436，但相对线性探针的优势统计上不显著；同一置信度汇总下 AUROC 从适配前 0.4485 升至适配后 0.7327；平均任务成功率由 58% 降至 55%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明置信度适配改善了失败判别能力，但并未改善控制性能，也未确立安全性收益；方法局限在于配对仅基于时间而非物理进度对等。

title: RankLane: Efficient MoE Prefill on Accelerators with Ranked Expert Capacities
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand model capacity by activating only a subset of experts for each token. On accelerators with static execution plans, expert capacities and placement are fixed before routing reveals each expert's load. Uniform worst-case capacities waste work on padding; smaller capacities tied to expert identities can overflow. We present RankLane, which ranks each device's experts by current load and assigns them to fixed-capacity lanes. Runtime indices select experts and token rows while tier populations, shapes and device placement remain fixed. An aggregation graph preserves device ownership and reduces each token's local contributions on one core. Routing calibration and measured execution costs guide tier selection; overflowing chunks rerun at full capacity. We evaluate full-model prefill of Qwen3-30B-A3B and Gemma 4 26B-A4B with MXFP6 weights on four Cloud AI 100 Ultra SoCs, using 128-2048-token chunks and including overflow detection and in-program recovery support. Against a dense baseline, RankLane achieves end-to-end prefill speedups of 1.27-4.18x on Qwen3 and 1.93-3.46x on Gemma.
