AI.tldr: RankLane 通过在每台设备上按当前负载对专家排序并分配到固定容量"通道"（lane），在不改变执行图与设备放置的前提下动态处理 MoE 专家负载不均，实现静态加速器上的端到端 prefill 提速。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型在静态执行计划的加速器上，专家容量与位置需在路由揭示负载前固定：统一的最坏情况容量导致大量 padding 浪费，而按专家身份设置较小容量又会溢出。需要一种在固定执行图下仍能适应动态负载的方法。
AI.method: 提出 RankLane：将每台设备的专家按当前负载排序，分配到固定容量的 lane；运行时仅通过索引选择专家和 token 行，而层级种群、形状与设备放置保持不变。用聚合图保持设备归属，并在单核上归约每个 token 的本地贡献。结合路由校准与实测执行代价进行层级选择，溢出的 chunk 以满容量重跑（含溢出检测与程序内恢复）。
AI.result: 在四块 Cloud AI 100 Ultra SoC 上以 MXFP6 权重对 Qwen3-30B-A3B 与 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 做全模型 prefill（128–2048 token chunk）：相对稠密基线，Qwen3 加速 1.27–4.18x，Gemma 加速 1.93–3.46x。
AI.conclusion: 在静态执行计划的加速器上，通过负载排序+固定容量 lane 的索引式重映射，可有效缓解 MoE 专家负载不均带来的 padding 与溢出问题，取得显著 prefill 加速，并支持溢出时的可靠恢复。

title: Impossible Code, Barely Changed Score: A Replay Study of Judge-Based Evaluation
summary: Language models are often used to judge generated code without running it. A useful evaluation should reveal substantial changes in the answers it scores. We examine this requirement by repeating an earlier evaluation on 421 coding problems, comparing Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct with two versions trained using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). One receives rewards from execution tests (CE-trained), and the other from a strong language-model judge (SLJ-trained). The base model's syntax-failure rate remains stable, but the trained checkpoints produce invalid Python on 63%-67% of attempts. Despite this change, the strong judge's Pass@32 scores fall by only about 3 percentage points, from 96.67% to 93.95% for SLJ-trained. Within the later run, allowing more attempts makes the base and trained checkpoints look increasingly similar under the judge. With 128 attempts per question, the judge accepts at least one SLJ-trained answer on 96.44% of problems, compared with 28.27% under execution tests. We recommend reporting the share of answers that pass Python's syntax check alongside every judge-based score. This check requires no tests or code execution and flags invalid answers that the judge accepts, although it cannot establish functional correctness. Our findings show how a high judge-based score can hide substantial output damage and motivate checking an evaluation's sensitivity to change. Project page and code: https://curiousorbitnotes.github.io/evorobust-replay-audit/

AI.tldr: 重复早期评测发现：即使模型输出大量语法无效的Python代码，强语言模型评判给出的Pass@32分数仅下降约3个百分点，说明基于LLM评判的评测对输出质量变化不敏感，建议同时报告语法通过率。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常被用来不运行代码就直接评判生成代码，但这类评测是否对回答质量的实质变化敏感尚不清楚。作者想检验一个"有用"的评测应能反映出被评答案的重大变化。
AI.method: 在421道编程题上重复先前评测，比较Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct基座与两个GRPO训练版本：CE-trained（用执行测试作奖励）和SLJ-trained（用强语言模型评判作奖励）。分析语法失败率、强评判的Pass@32分数，以及增加尝试次数（至128次/题）对结果的影响。
AI.result: 基座模型语法失败率稳定，但训练后检查点在63%–67%的尝试中生成无效Python。尽管如此，强评判的Pass@32仅从96.67%降至93.95%（约3个百分点）。128次尝试时，评判认为至少有一个SLJ-trained答案通过的问题占96.44%，而执行测试下仅28.27%。
AI.conclusion: 高LLM评判分数可掩盖严重的输出损坏，应呼吁在报告任何评判分数时同时报告通过Python语法检查的答案比例（该检查无需测试或执行，但无法确认功能正确性），并倡导检验评测对变化的敏感度。

title: Adversarial Robustness of Retrieval-Based Fact-Checking: Detecting and Mitigating Evidence Contamination
comment: Published in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026. 14 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code and dataset: https://github.com/alamgirqazi/glad
summary: Retrieval-based fact-checking systems ground verification in large document collections, creating a critical vulnerability: adversarial evidence contamination. We demonstrate that factually inconsistent but contextually coherent evidence generated to satisfy both retrieval-similarity and linguistic-fluency constraints can systematically mislead verification models. Contaminating just 3.1-7.4% of training corpora with five label-specific strategies causes adversarial content to penetrate up to 35.2% of top-k retrievals, degrading verification accuracy by up to 46.9% relative F1. Existing retrieval-stage defenses, validated against gradient-optimized or syntactically anomalous attacks, transfer poorly to this threat model: detection rates collapse and F1 recovery exhibits high variance across seeds. We propose GLAD (Geometric-Lexical Adversarial Defense), which fuses dense embedding peer-coherence with lexical distributional isolation. Across two benchmarks, two embedding models, and five random seeds, GLAD achieves the highest detection rates (70-86%) and the most consistent F1 recovery, reclaiming 73-80% of contamination-induced degradation on LIAR-RAW while approaching clean baselines on RAWFC. Crucially, unlike defenses that trade clean performance for robustness, GLAD imposes negligible cost on uncontaminated corpora.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示基于检索的事实核查系统面临"对抗性证据污染"威胁：生成同时满足检索相似性与语言流畅性的连贯但事实错误证据可系统性误导模型。作者提出GLAD防御方法（融合稠密嵌入的同伴一致性与词汇分布隔离），在多个基准上实现最高检测率与最稳定的F1恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有检索式事实核查依赖大规模文档库，但存在关键安全漏洞：训练语料中少量污染即可让对抗证据进入top-k检索并严重降低核查准确率。而现有检索阶段防御仅针对梯度优化或语法异常的攻击验证，对此类"事实不一致但语境连贯"的攻击迁移性差、检测率骤降、恢复方差大。
AI.method: 提出GLAD（Geometric-Lexical Adversarial Defense），融合两种信号：稠密嵌入空间中的同伴一致性（peer-coherence）检测，以及词汇分布层面的隔离（lexical distributional isolation），用于识别被污染的对抗证据。
AI.result: 仅污染3.1-7.4%训练语料（五种标签特定策略）即可使对抗内容占top-k检索高达35.2%，核查准确率相对F1下降最多46.9%。GLAD在两个基准、两种嵌入模型、五个随机种子上取得最高检测率（70-86%）和最稳定F1恢复：在LIAR-RAW上挽回73-80%污染导致退化，在RAWFC上接近干净基线；且对未污染语料几乎无性能损耗。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性证据污染是检索式事实核查中被低估的系统性威胁；GLAD作为一种几何-词汇结合的防御，能在有效检测污染、恢复F1的同时保持干净语料性能，优于现有检索阶段防御方法。

title: Audit at the Precision You Deploy: Quantization Reshapes a Subliminally Learned Preference
summary: Subliminal learning allows AI models to inherit hidden preferences from seemingly unrelated training data, such as number sequences. Safety audits may evaluate models at standard 16-bit precision, while deployments may use compressed, quantized weights. We ask whether quantization changes the expression of a subliminal preference and what drives any resulting change. To investigate, we implant a "favourite animal: panda" preference into Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. We define its net strength as the difference in mean panda-answer probability between subliminal models and neutrally trained controls under the same quantization setting. Applying this metric across different compression levels reveals a stark contrast. While behaviour remains stable at 8 bits, 4-bit quantization triggers severe, opposing shifts depending on the quantizer. Half-Quadratic Quantization (HQQ) amplifies the preference, raising the subliminally trained model's panda probability from roughly 55% at 16 bits to 64% at 4 bits, while the controls stay near 17%. This raises the trait's net strength ~1.3 times its 16-bit value. In contrast, NormalFloat (NF4) at 4-bit suppresses it, shrinking the net strength to just ~0.3 times its 16-bit value, despite producing rounding errors of the same size to within 4%. We examine the structure of the rounding errors and find that their arrangement drives the divergence. Randomly shuffling HQQ's errors within each quantization group, without changing their magnitude, shifts the trait's net strength between 0.2 and 1.6 times its 16-bit value. Despite these opposing shifts, the underlying fine-tuning signal remains largely intact. Because a model's internal state and outward behaviour diverge so unpredictably under compression, a 16-bit audit cannot reliably bound real-world risks. Safety evaluations must test the exact quantized weights intended for deployment.

AI.tldr: 16-bit安全审计不能可靠约束量化部署模型的风险：4-bit量化会因舍入误差结构不同而放大或抑制"潜意识偏好"，审计必须测试实际部署的量化权重。
AI.motivation: 安全审计常在标准16位精度下评估模型，而实际部署常使用压缩量化权重。作者追问：量化是否改变潜意识偏好（subliminal preference）的表达，以及驱动这一改变的是什么。
AI.method: 向Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct植入"最喜欢的动物：熊猫"偏好，定义净强度为潜意识模型与中性对照模型在同一量化设置下熊猫答案平均概率之差；在8-bit、4-bit（HQQ、NF4）等不同压缩水平上测量该指标，并分析舍入误差的结构（如组内随机打乱HQQ误差而保持幅值不变）。
AI.result: 8-bit下行为稳定；4-bit出现方向相反的巨大变化：HQQ将熊猫概率从16-bit约55%提升到4-bit的64%（对照约17%），净强度约为16-bit的1.3倍；NF4则抑制该偏好，净强度降至约0.3倍，尽管两者舍入误差大小相差不超过4%。随机打乱HQQ组内误差可在0.2–1.6倍之间改变净强度，说明误差的空间排布是关键。此外，底层微调信号基本保持完整。
AI.conclusion: 模型内部状态与外在行为在压缩下以不可预测的方式分离，因此16-bit审计无法可靠界定真实风险，安全评估必须直接测试将要部署的确切量化权重。

title: Diagnosing Zero-Shot Forgetting in CLIP Fine-Tuning: Attention Drift Characterizes Adaptation, Representation Drift Predicts Transfer Degradation
comment: Accepted to the ICDM 2026 Workshops (ICDMW), Teen Research Track
summary: Fine-tuning CLIP on a downstream task typically reduces its zero-shot accuracy on other tasks, and quantifying this loss ordinarily requires a labeled transfer benchmark. We study whether the loss can be anticipated from unlabeled target images that are already available during fine-tuning. Four signals are compared: the entropy of CLS token attention, linear centered kernel alignment (CKA) with the pretrained model, embedding drift, and relative weight change. ViT-B/32 is adapted by full fine-tuning (Full FT) and by LoRA on EuroSAT and Oxford-IIIT Pets over four learning rates and three seeds, with an additional ViT-B/16 grid; DTD and GTSRB are held out as confirmation targets, and forgetting is measured as zero-shot retention on CIFAR-100, Food-101, and ImageNet-R. Within a fixed configuration, the change in attention entropy is strongly associated with forgetting (mean $|ρ|=0.860$). Its sign, however, depends on the dataset, the adaptation method, and the backbone, and the pooled correlation falls to 0.361. A block decomposition shows that this sign is determined almost entirely by blocks 7 to 12. CKA ranks runs by retention at $ρ=0.960$, and the ranking is already established after the first of six epochs ($ρ=0.959$). On the held-out targets, CKA reaches $ρ=0.95$, and the block account correctly predicts the sign of the attention change for both datasets. These results support a simple decision rule: CKA is suited to comparisons across configurations, whereas attention entropy is informative only within a single configuration. The evidence is limited to one model family and short training schedules.

AI.tldr: 研究能否用微调时已有的无标注目标图像预测CLIP微调后的零样本遗忘；比较四种信号后提出决策规则：CKA适合跨配置比较，注意力熵仅适合单配置内部。
AI.motivation: CLIP在下游任务微调通常会降低在其他任务上的零样本准确率，而量化这种损失一般需要带标注的迁移基准，成本高且不总是可得。作者希望利用微调时已经存在的无标注目标图像来预测该损失，避免依赖标注基准。
AI.method: 比较四种信号：CLS token注意力熵、与预训练模型的线性CKA、嵌入漂移、相对权重变化。用Full FT与LoRA两种方式在EuroSAT和Oxford-IIIT Pets上微调ViT-B/32，覆盖4个学习率×3个随机种子，并补充ViT-B/16网格；DTD和GTSRB作为留出确认目标；遗忘用CIFAR-100、Food-101、ImageNet-R上的零样本保持率衡量。另做分块分解分析。
AI.result: 固定配置内，注意力熵变化与遗忘强相关（平均|ρ|=0.860），但其符号随数据集、适配方法与骨干网络而变，混合相关性降至0.361；分块分析显示符号几乎完全由第7–12块决定。CKA以ρ=0.960对运行按保持率排序，且在前1/6个epoch就已确立（ρ=0.959）。在留出目标上CKA达ρ=0.95，分块解释也正确预测了两个数据集注意力变化的符号。
AI.conclusion: 支持一条简单决策规则：CKA适合跨配置比较，注意力熵只在单一配置内有信息量。证据局限于单一模型家族和短训练计划。

title: Hacking or Just Failing? A More Capable LLM Monitor Better Separates Reward Hacking from Honest Failure
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code, data and pre-registrations: https://github.com/KaushikKC/weak-monitor-lab
summary: An agent's visible score can exceed its real progress because it gamed the score or because it simply made mistakes, so a useful reward-hacking monitor must tell the two apart. We built a sandboxed task in which an agent can game a completion score, labelled every episode by replaying it and repairing the final state counterfactually, and ran five pre-registered studies. On 60 episodes from a Llama 3.1 8B agent, small local monitors (Llama 3B and 8B) did not separate exploit attempts from honest failures with the same score gap: prompt changes traded missed exploits for false alarms, and the pre-registered primary monitor reached AUC 0.64. On identical inputs, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, which completed 9/10 clean tasks against 2/10 for the 8B model, met our pre-registered criterion (AUC 0.80, 95% interval [0.66, 0.93]; 1/35 honest failures flagged); with only 14 exploit episodes, this estimate is uncertain. On an exploit that no prompt names, Gemini usually described the action correctly yet never flagged it, in 5 and then 25 new episodes, even when manipulation was defined by its effect on the score. Given the full trace, the 8B monitor flagged all 25 replication episodes and none of 25 honest look-alikes, but its explanations described actions that had not occurred; given additional structured evidence, it also flagged 15 of the 25 look-alikes. A two-rule deterministic check caught every known exploit. We release the environment, labels, pre-registrations and per-judgement logs.

AI.tldr: 论文构建沙盒任务并对每个回合做反事实标注，检验小型本地监控模型能否区分"刷分的作弊"与"同分差的诚实失败"。5项预注册研究显示：Llama 3B/8B 监控器基本无法区分（AUC 0.64）；Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 达到预注册标准（AUC 0.80），但作弊样本仅14例；对未被提示词提及的新作弊，Gemini 能描述行为却从不报警；8B 在获得完整轨迹时报警全部25例复制作弊、0误报，但解释虚构；两条规则的确定性检查可捕获所有已知作弊。
AI.motivation: 智能体的可见得分可能因作弊而被抬高，也可能只是失误所致，二者分数差相同但性质迥异。因此奖励黑客监控器必须区分"利用漏洞"与"诚实失败"，而现有工作很少在严格标注下评估这一区分能力。
AI.method: 搭建可作弊的完成度评分沙盒；通过回放并反事实修复最终状态，为每个回合打上作弊/诚实失败标签；开展5项预注册研究，用60个 Llama 3.1 8B 智能体回合比较 Llama 3B/8B 与 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 作为监控器的表现；并测试无提示词的未知作弊、完整轨迹与结构化证据下的表现，以及确定性规则检查。
AI.result: 本地小模型 AUC 仅 0.64，提示词改动只是在对漏报与误报间权衡；Gemini 达 AUC 0.80（95%区间 [0.66,0.93]，35例诚实失败仅1例误报），但作弊样本仅14例，估计不确定；对未提及的作弊，Gemini 常正确描述行为却从不报警（5例后25例）；8B 在完整轨迹下检出全部25例复制作弊且无误报，但解释虚构，加入结构化证据后误报15/25；两条规则检查捕获全部已知作弊。
AI.conclusion: 区分奖励黑客与诚实失败对小模型仍很困难，强模型虽有希望但样本有限；模型常能"描述"作弊却不"判定"作弊，且解释可靠性存疑。简单确定性规则在已知作弊上非常有效。作者开源环境、标签、预注册方案与逐判定日志。

title: A Spectral Renormalization-Group View of Learning
summary: We study how the layers in deep neural networks (NNs) converge, using Wilsonian Renormalization-Group (RG) ideas to organize the spectral picture. During training, these layers often develop heavy-tailed power-law (PL) spectra, and the strongest checkpoints often appear near the PL exponent $α\approx 2$. This pattern raises a simple question: why should this value mark a well-trained layer? The answer is both statistical and physical. Our statistical hypothesis is that $α=2$ marks the boundary between stable if not optimal learning and overfitting via non-self-averaging. The physical answer is that the same value makes the spectral energy gain scale evenly across logarithmic spectral scales, which is the proposed Wilsonian marginal condition. We then apply the ERG trace-log condition, the proposed SETOL theory, which we justify by taking volume-preserving, scale-invariant transformations to remove arbitrary layer scale along the proposed RG flow. The resulting spectral RG flow connects the HTSR and SETOL theories to optimizers such as Muon, and motivates a new optimizer extension, WW-PGD. Together, these results point toward a spectral Renormalization-Group view of learning, in which NNs may approach shared spectral structure in the settings studied here.

AI.tldr: 该文从Wilson重整化群视角解释深层网络训练中层谱演化：训练常形成重尾幂律谱，且最佳checkpoint常出现在幂律指数α≈2附近。
AI.motivation: 核心疑问是：为何α≈2标记一个训练良好的层？作者希望给出统计与物理双重解释，并统一HTSR、SETOL等谱理论及优化器（如Muon）。
AI.method: 统计假设：α=2是稳定（近乎最优）学习与非自平均过拟合之间的边界。物理解释：该值使谱能量增益在各对数谱尺度上均匀分布，即所提Wilsonian边缘条件（marginal condition）。进一步采用体积保持、尺度不变的变换消去任意层尺度以论证ERG迹对数条件（SETOL理论），导出谱RG流，并据此提出优化器扩展WW-PGD。
AI.result: 所导出的谱RG流将HTSR与SETOL理论及Muon等优化器联系起来，并自然引出新的优化器扩展WW-PGD。
AI.conclusion: 结果指向一种"谱重整化群学习观"：在所研究设定下，神经网络可能收敛到共享的谱结构。

title: What reviewers call a Long Method is a length: A pre-registered test of coupling divergence as a god-unit signal, and what it settled instead
comment: 6 pages, 1 table. Ancillary files: the full registered report and the analysis data. Also deposited at Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23749773
summary: A companion study found that a complexity outlier rule shows where complexity concentrates but cannot tell a god unit from a complex algorithm. This paper pre-registered a test of one way to tell them apart: weight a unit's complexity by its coupling divergence, the data it hands on minus the data it receives, so that a leaf is set aside. Coupling was measured by resolving every call in 520 MLCQ repositories, 500 fresh Java repositories and 73 Qualitas Corpus systems. The claim fails: the primary, the pooled MCC of the weighted form minus complexity alone against MLCQ's human Blob, is -0.041 [-0.130, +0.054], no difference resolved and underpowered, and the resolved readings go against it. What the data settle is at method level. What MLCQ's reviewers call a Long Method is an absolute length: a constant of 26 lines or more, chosen on the explore half, reaches MCC 0.777 on the confirm half, +0.080 [+0.016, +0.145] over the best per-repository form; every reviewer with ten or more positives, on their non-leaf reviews, has a best cutoff between 17 and 34 lines; and nothing measured inside a method, its calls, variables, data flow or the cost of cutting it, refines the constant. The constant is a limit of human reading. The next form of the construct is the cost of bringing a long method under it, which is where the construct meets architecture.

AI.tldr: 该论文预先注册检验"用耦合发散度加权复杂度以识别 god unit"的设想，结果失败；但数据在方法层面确立了 MLCQ 评审者所称的 Long Method 本质是一个约 26 行以上的绝对长度阈值，且方法内部任何度量都无法改进它。
AI.motivation: 前作发现复杂度离群规则能指出复杂度集中之处，却无法区分"god unit"与"复杂算法"。本文试图验证一种区分方式：以耦合发散度（单元传出数据减传入数据）加权复杂度，使叶子节点被排除在外。
AI.method: 在 520 个 MLCQ 仓库、500 个新 Java 仓库及 73 个 Qualitas Corpus 系统中解析全部调用以测量耦合；预先注册以加权形式的汇总 MCC 减去纯复杂度，对比 MLCQ 人工标注的 Blob 作为主要指标，并在探索/确认两半划分上检验长度常数。
AI.result: 主要指标为 -0.041 [-0.130, +0.054]，无显著差异且统计效力不足，已解析的读数均不支持该假设。方法层面：≥26 行的绝对长度常数在确认半上达到 MCC 0.777，比最佳按仓库形式高 +0.080 [+0.016, +0.145]；每位有 ≥10 个正例的评审者在其非叶子评审中最佳截断点均在 17–34 行之间；方法内部度量（调用、变量、数据流、切割成本）均无法改进该常数。
AI.conclusion: 耦合发散度加权复杂度无法区分 god unit；Long Method 实为人类阅读能力的绝对长度界限。构念的下一形态应是"将长方法降至该界限以下的成本"，这也是构念与架构相接之处。

title: Multi-Teacher Reasoning Distillation for LLM Recommendation with Self-Exploration
summary: Reasoning-augmented recommender systems (RecSys) enhance user preference modeling by generating reasoning trajectories over historical interactions before making recommendations. Knowledge distillation provides a practical paradigm for transferring such reasoning capabilities from powerful large language models to lightweight RecSys. However, existing methods typically rely on a single fixed teacher, remain constrained by the teacher knowledge ceiling, and indiscriminately distill teacher-generated trajectories without assessing their actual utility for downstream recommendation. To address these limitations, we propose MUSE (Multi-Teacher Utility-guided Selection with Self-Exploration), an adaptive reasoning distillation framework that jointly improves reasoning generation and reasoning utilization. MUSE first constructs a diverse reasoning pool using multiple teacher LLMs and progressively augments it via student self-exploration, enabling the student to leverage the strengths of different teachers and gradually explore reasoning strategies beyond teacher imitation. We then develop Rank-Gain Utility Assessment (RGUA), which evaluates each candidate according to the normalized full-catalog rank improvement of the ground-truth item and identifies the most and least recommendation-beneficial trajectories. Based on these utility-aware trajectory pairs, we introduce dual-level contrastive learning objectives that guide the student generator to prefer beneficial reasoning while training the recommendation encoder to more effectively exploit recommendation-relevant preference evidence. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: MUSE 提出一种多教师、效用引导的自探索式推理蒸馏框架，联合提升推荐系统的推理生成与推理利用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有推理蒸馏推荐方法依赖单一固定教师，受限于教师知识上限，且不加区分地蒸馏教师生成的推理轨迹，未评估其对下游推荐的真实效用。
AI.method: 构建多教师 LLM 生成的多样化推理池，并通过学生自探索逐步扩充；提出 Rank-Gain Utility Assessment (RGUA)，以真实物品归一化全目录排名提升评估候选轨迹效用并挑选最优/最差轨迹对；基于效用感知轨迹对引入双层对比学习目标，引导生成器偏好有益推理，并训练推荐编码器更有效利用偏好证据。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上的大量实验表明该框架有效且鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 多教师蒸馏结合自探索与效用感知对比学习，可突破单一教师上限并提升推理蒸馏对推荐的实效，为轻量级推理增强推荐系统提供可行范式。

title: Precedent Labels and Facts Shift LLM Approval Decisions in Opposite Directions
summary: When a language model decides refund or claim requests under written policies, the system can show it similar past cases. Each past case has two parts: its facts and the decision recorded for it. We separate the two. A model sees a policy, a request and three past cases, and we change either the recorded decisions or the facts, keeping the request fixed. We select requests that are close calls: deciding without past cases, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash approved each in some of four tries and denied it in others. When the past cases are near-copies of the request (its facts with a few details changed), switching their recorded decisions from DENY to APPROVE raises approval by about 30 to 55 percentage points in DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GPT-5.6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on policies written for the study, and DeepSeek and Luna show the same on nine public policies paraphrased from real ones. The facts push the other way: shown without their recorded decisions, past cases whose facts support approval make these two models approve less often than past cases whose facts support denial. One reading is that the request looks weaker next to them. This push is not just a correction toward the right answer: in an additional DeepSeek analysis, it was of similar estimated size on requests that human annotators judged approvable and on those they judged deniable. In a separate DeepSeek run on the public policies, when the past cases are near-copies of a different request, switching their decisions moves approval by 9 points instead of 43, while facts that support approval still lower it by 22 points against facts that support denial. Systems that retrieve past decisions should test the two parts separately.

AI.tldr: 论文将"相似历史案例"拆为事实与记录决策两部分分别扰动：记录决策由DENY改为APPROVE可使审批率上升约30–55个百分点，而事实部分反而产生反向推动，说明检索式案例使用存在两部分独立且非纠错的偏置。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在依据书面政策处理退款/理赔请求时常被展示相似历史案例，但案例包含"事实"与"记录决策"两部分，二者混杂使得此前的评测无法判断模型究竟是被事实还是被决策影响，因此需要一个能把两者分离的受控实验设计。
AI.method: 选取无案例时决策摇摆的"临界"请求（DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 四次中既批准又拒绝）；固定请求，只改变三条近复制案例的"记录决策"或只改变"事实"；在自编政策与九条改写自真实政策的公开政策上，测试DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、GPT-5.6 Luna、Claude Haiku 5.5；并用人工标注判定可批准/可拒绝子集及"近复制的是其他请求"的对照来分析效应性质。
AI.result: 把案例记录决策从DENY翻为APPROVE，在自编政策上使审批率上升约30–55个百分点（三个模型均如此），在九条公开政策上DeepSeek与Luna同样显著；反之，仅呈现支持批准的事实（不带决策）竟使这两个模型更少批准，呈现支持拒绝的事实则批准更多。该反向推动在人工判定可批准与可拒绝的请求上估计大小相近，故不能简单视为向正确答案纠偏。当案例为其他请求的近复制时，翻转决策的效应降至9个百分点（原为43），但事实的反向推动仍为22个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 检索到的历史案例对模型决策有强且可分离的影响：记录决策产生显著的锚定/顺从效应，事实则产生方向相反的"对比"效应，且后者并非纠错。部署带历史决策检索的系统时，应分别测试事实与决策两部分，避免把决策标签当作可靠证据注入。

title: Out-of-distribution AI-generated image detection with zero-phase deconvolution for residual whitening
summary: Current AI-generated image detection methods struggle in out-of-distribution testing conditions because detectors are usually not robust when evaluated on generators not included in the training set. This work explores a way to mitigate the forensic bias between sources of images -whether real or generated -by removing generator-specific fingerprints. This new training process can be approximated by pre-processing involving a deconvolution operation designed to remove correlated noise patterns inducing loss of generalization. Indeed, we show that whitening the spatial distribution of the image noise residuals can significantly improve the performance of detectors on images coming from generators unseen during training. In particular, an end-to-end CNN model trained on whitened image residuals improves detection by 12.6% on average compared to a training involving original images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过去除图像噪声残差中的生成器相关指纹（即对噪声残差做空间白化/反卷积预处理）来缓解真实与生成图像间的取证偏差，从而显著提升AI生成图像检测器在未见生成器上的泛化性能（平均提升12.6%）。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法在分布外测试下表现不佳：当测试图像来自训练集未包含的生成器时，检测器鲁棒性差。作者认为根源在于不同图像来源（真实或生成）之间存在"取证偏差"，即生成器特有的指纹使检测器过拟合到特定生成器而非通用伪造特征。
AI.method: 提出一种新的训练思路：在训练前移除生成器特定指纹。该过程可近似为一种预处理步骤——反卷积操作，用于去除导致泛化性下降的相关噪声模式。具体而言，对图像噪声残差的空间分布进行白化（whitening），再将白化后的残差输入端到端CNN进行训练与检测。
AI.result: 白化噪声残差的空间分布能显著提升检测器对训练中未见生成器图像的检测性能；与使用原始图像训练相比，基于白化图像残差训练的端到端CNN平均检测性能提升12.6%。
AI.conclusion: 抑制生成器特有的噪声指纹（通过残差白化）是提升AI生成图像检测跨生成器泛化能力的有效手段，为缓解取证偏差提供了简单且有效的预处理方案。

title: Nonconformal Distortion and Local Orientation Reversal in the Fourier Circuit of a Modular-Addition Transformer
summary: We study the local differential geometry of a Fourier-based modular-addition circuit in a one-layer transformer whose algorithm has previously been reverse-engineered. For each of the five key Fourier frequencies, we restrict the model's multilayer perceptron (MLP) contribution to a corresponding Fourier input plane and readout, and measure its directional Beltrami coefficient under continuous input perturbations. Whereas nondegenerate restrictions of ideal complex multiplication are conformal, the trained maps exhibit nonconformal distortion (median $|μ|=0.304$--$0.446$), spatial organization in the Beltrami argument, and regions of local orientation reversal. The median across frequencies decreases from $0.939$ at initialization to $0.390$ after training. The key-frequency planes also show lower median distortion than most random-plane controls, although their distributions overlap and the coordinate frames differ in conditioning. Across 500 checkpoints in one training run, most of the aggregate reduction in Beltrami magnitude occurs before the principal increase in the measured Fourier-circuit formation. At the individual-input level, Beltrami magnitude shows negligible association with the correct-logit margin ($|ρ|\leq0.026$). Late-checkpoint measurements across six runs show comparable distortion for most selected frequencies. These results provide a quantitative characterization of local deformation in a frequency-projected component of an identified neural circuit, complementary to its algorithmic reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 该论文量化分析单层Transformer中模加电路在各傅里叶频率平面上的局部非共形形变（Beltrami系数），发现训练后的映射显著偏离理想复乘法的共形性，且形变主要发生在傅里叶电路形成之前，与逐样本正确性无关。
AI.motivation: 已有工作逆向工程出模加电路的算法结构（傅里叶频率），但对其局部微分几何性质、即频率投影映射偏离理想复乘法的程度与方式缺乏定量刻画，本文旨在补充这一"算法重建"之外的几何视角。
AI.method: 对一层Transformer的MLP贡献，按五个关键傅里叶频率分别限制到对应的傅里叶输入平面与读出，在连续输入扰动下测量方向性Beltrami系数|μ|及其辐角，并与随机平面控制、初始化状态和500个训练检查点对比。
AI.result: 训练后映射呈非共形畸变（中位|μ|=0.304–0.446），Beltrami辐角有空间结构并存在局部取向反转区域；中位|μ|从初始化0.939降至训练后0.390；关键频率平面畸变中位值低于多数随机平面但分布重叠；|μ|的大部分下降发生在傅里叶电路形成之前；逐样本层面对数边际相关性近似为零（|ρ|≤0.026）；六次运行的晚期检查点畸变相当。
AI.conclusion: 训练得到的是有结构、非共形的形变而非理想复乘法，其几何性质与算法功能形成时序解耦，为已识别神经电路的频率投影分量提供了定量局部形变刻画。

title: Do Multimodal Models Decide Consistently on Equivalent Optical Spectra?
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/zwang-devv/spectra-decision-audit
summary: A spectrum can be given to a model as a table in nanometers or as a plot in photon energy, and the decision should not depend on which one it sees. When the data needed for an answer are missing, the model should say so. We test representation invariance and abstention on measured optical spectra of silicon metasurfaces (MOCLIP) and gold nanoparticles, with labels computed from the data. Each spectrum is shown as four tables (nm, $μ$m, scientific notation, eV) and two plots (nm, eV), and partial spectra remove data inside or outside the queried range. We evaluate the decision models d3-nano and Jev 1.13, three GPT-6 Luna configurations and the Qwen3.5-2B base model. Changing only the representation moves accuracy by up to 41 percentage points within one model, mostly on photon-energy tables and plots. With the same evidence, asking in photon energy instead of wavelength helps some model-view pairs by 16-50 points and hurts others by up to 25. When the relevant extremum is removed, unadapted models rarely answer "undetermined". LoRA fine-tuning of d3-nano improves comparisons on the trained table formats, but much of its gain on unanswerable questions comes from a shortcut: it abstains whenever the input is truncated. Training with answerable truncations avoids the shortcut in all six seeds, with a 90-100 point gap between abstention after inside and outside cuts on held-out structures; with the same amount of extra original-task data, five of six seeds keep the shortcut. On gold spectra the two training sets perform similarly. Multimodal language models used for scientific decisions should be tested on equivalent representations and on missing evidence, not only on average accuracy. We release the tasks, per-response results and analysis code.

AI.tldr: 论文测试多模态模型在光谱任务中的表示不变性与"无法回答"识别能力，发现仅改变表示（nm/μm/科学计数/eV/图）可致准确率变化高达41个百分点，未适配模型很少回答"undetermined"；LoRA微调带来的弃答增益多源于"截断即弃答"捷径，用含可答截断的训练集可消除该捷径。
AI.motivation: 科学决策模型应具备表示不变性（同一光谱以纳米表、微米表、科学计数、eV表或图呈现时结论一致）与弃答能力（数据缺失时应说明无法确定），但现有评估只看平均准确率，忽视这两点。
AI.method: 基于实测硅超表面（MOCLIP）与金纳米颗粒光谱构建基准，标签由数据计算；每条光谱以4种表格（nm、μm、科学计数、eV）和2种图（nm、eV）呈现，并构造删除查询范围内部或外部数据的部分光谱。评估d3-nano、Jev 1.13、三种GPT-6 Luna配置及Qwen3.5-2B；对d3-nano做LoRA微调，对比含可答截断与仅含原始任务数据两种训练集（6个随机种子）。
AI.result: 同一模型内仅换表示准确率变动达41个百分点，主要出现在eV表和eV图；同等证据下改问光子能量，部分模型-视图组合提升16-50点，另一些下降达25点。移除相关极值时未适配模型极少答"undetermined"。LoRA在训练过的表格格式上比较能力提升，但不可答问题上的增益主要来自"输入被截断即弃答"的捷径；加入可答截断训练后6个种子均避免捷径，留出结构上内截断与外截断弃答率差距90-100点；等量原始数据增强时6个种子中5个仍保留捷径。金光谱上两种训练集表现相近。
AI.conclusion: 用于科学决策的多模态语言模型应在等价表示与缺失证据条件下评估，而非仅看平均准确率；训练时需纳入可答截断样本以消除虚假弃答行为。作者公开任务、逐条响应结果与分析代码。

title: Phase-wise MLLM Tuning for Multi-framework WebUI Code Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance in translating WebUI screenshots into HTML/CSS. However, when they faced multiple frameworks (React/Vue/Angular), they often suffer from negative transfer that leads to compilation failures. These failures commonly stem from mixing framework specific syntax and violating framework constraints. This paper studies supervised fine-tuning for multi-framework WebUI code generation and proposes a phase-wise MLLM tuning method driven by compatibility and heterogeneity signals across frameworks. We first apply a normalization mapping that preserves each framework's native syntax while suppressing noise from variable naming and literal content. We then estimate cross framework heterogeneity and compatibility offline, and automatically derive training groups and their ordering by maximizing a phased objective. Finally, we perform phase-wise adapter tuning to reduce cross framework interference. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that our proposed method improves both generation quality and compilation success rate compared with baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于框架间兼容性与异构性信号的阶段性MLLM微调方法，缓解多框架（React/Vue/Angular）WebUI代码生成中的负迁移与编译失败问题。
AI.motivation: MLLM在将WebUI截图转为HTML/CSS上表现良好，但在多框架场景下因混用框架专属语法、违反框架约束而出现负迁移，导致编译失败。
AI.method: 1) 归一化映射，保留各框架原生语法同时抑制变量命名与字面量噪声；2) 离线估计跨框架异构性与兼容性，通过最大化阶段性目标自动划分训练组并确定顺序；3) 分阶段适配器微调以降低跨框架干扰。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，相比基线方法，生成质量与编译成功率均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 以兼容性/异构性为指导的阶段式微调可有效抑制多框架负迁移，兼顾代码质量与可编译性。

title: RecRSI: Mechanism-Guided Discovery of Recommendation Algorithms
summary: Improving recommendation algorithms for the Web requires coordinating interacting design choices and learning from experiments. We present RecRSI, an LLM-based research framework that uses mechanism hypotheses to organize algorithm discovery. Each hypothesis links a proposed mechanism change to a reference design, a rationale, and an expected observation. MechSpace derives implementable primitives and composition rules from the task source; Research Line uses this space and prior evidence to develop and test hypotheses; Mechanism Feedback carries outcomes and their design context into subsequent research. This organization makes each experiment inform which mechanisms to develop, revise, or combine next. Across four initial recommenders and four datasets, RecRSI yields average relative improvements of 8.48% in NDCG@5 and 6.88% in HR@5 over the initial algorithms, and 2.60% and 2.20%, respectively, over the strongest competing result for each setting and metric. Component and process studies link these gains to coordinated mechanism choices and evidence-guided follow-up. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/DynamisG210/RecRSI.

AI.tldr: RecRSI是一种基于LLM的推荐算法研究框架，用"机制假设"组织算法发现：每个假设将对参考设计的机制改动、理由与预期观察联系起来，形成假设—实验—反馈的闭环。
AI.motivation: Web推荐算法的改进需要协调相互作用的设计选择并从实验中学习，而现有做法缺乏系统化组织与利用实验证据的机制。
AI.method: 框架含三个组件：MechSpace从任务源码中提取可实现的原语与组合规则，构成机制空间；Research Line在该空间和既往证据基础上提出并检验假设；Mechanism Feedback将实验结果及其设计语境回传，指导后续机制的开发、修改或组合。
AI.result: 在4个初始推荐器和4个数据集上，NDCG@5与HR@5相较初始算法平均相对提升8.48%和6.88%，相较各设定与指标下最强对比结果分别提升2.60%和2.20%。
AI.conclusion: 组件与过程研究将增益归因于协调的机制选择与证据引导的后续研究，表明该假设驱动的组织方式有效，代码已开源。

title: Constructing Budgeted KGW Evasion through Token-Event Evidence Replacement
summary: KGW watermarks bias sampling to accumulate keyed detection evidence. We construct budgeted evasion through token-event evidence replacement using ordinary phrase rewrites. Our construction jointly selects compositions of LLM-proposed alternatives from an independent model and measures global token-edit distance on complete outputs. At the largest attainable cost within the budget, exact coverage search maximizes removal of original scored token pairs. It uses a known tokenizer without the key, detector feedback or queries to the watermarked model. Exact accounting separates source evidence removed, evidence created and length effects, with initial strength setting the required reduction. Separate signed-event analysis found that mean suppression arose mainly from removing watermark-enriched source events. In controlled, occurrence-counted, one-token-context KGW tests on short passages, 39 of 82 qualified, initially detected sources yielded rewrites with terminal detector score Z < 4 that passed blinded source-relative model review, at a mean actual token-edit cost of 16.0% under a 20% allowance. To examine whether this initial requirement can be inferred, a separate historical 95-passage study estimated initial detector score Z0 from generation traces with correlation 0.793 and an in-sample association beyond length. This aggregate information did not establish improved allocation, and the separate no-trace stopping test did not reliably exploit cheaper reviewed crossings in the candidate bank. Comparisons did not establish an advantage over simpler selection and ordinary constrained rewriting. The construction makes budgeted evidence replacement executable while exposing limits in signed reduction and recognition of sufficient editing.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在编辑预算内通过短语改写替换 token 事件证据以规避 KGW 水印的方法，在 20% 编辑预算下对 82 篇合格来源中的 39 篇实现检测分数降至 Z<4 且通过盲审。
AI.motivation: KGW 水印通过采样偏置累积带密钥的检测证据，需要研究在有限编辑预算下能否通过普通短语改写有效移除这些证据，并检验初始证据需求是否可推断、分配策略是否有优势。
AI.method: 构造预算受限的 token 事件证据替换：联合从独立模型提出的候选改写组合中选择，在完整输出上度量全局 token 编辑距离；在预算内最大成本处用精确覆盖搜索最大化移除原评分 token 对；仅用已知分词器，无需密钥、检测器反馈或对水印模型的查询；并做精确账目分离（移除证据、新增证据、长度效应）与有符号事件分析。另设历史 95 篇研究用生成轨迹估计初始检测分数 Z0。
AI.result: 短文本受控 KGW 测试中，82 篇合格且初检命中的来源有 39 篇改写后检测分数 Z<4，并通过盲审相对源模型评审，实际平均 token 编辑成本 16.0%（允许 20%）。历史上 Z0 估计与生成轨迹相关 0.793 且超出长度效应；但该聚合信息未带来更优分配，无轨迹停止测试也未能可靠利用候选库中更便宜的已评审跨越点；对比未显示相对简单选择与常规受限改写的优势。
AI.conclusion: 该构造使预算内证据替换可执行，但暴露了有符号证据削减的局限及对"足够编辑"的识别困难，未证实优于简单基线。

title: SparseWAM: Driving World-Action Models are Worth 16 Register Tokens
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) transfer scene-dynamics priors to planning by jointly forecasting future scenes and ego trajectories. However, WAMs built on video generators must generate dense future videos at inference, incurring prohibitive latency, while efficient variants discard the world branch at deployment and thus forgo test-time imagination. Even when dense video latents are replaced with patch-level DINO or JEPA features, these representations still involve long token sequences and encode decision-irrelevant information. We therefore propose SparseWAM, which forecasts in a sparse register space of only 16 tokens per frame, compressed from frozen DINOv2 features and shaped by joint planning-and-scoring pretraining to concentrate decision-relevant information. Within this space, SparseWAM employs a modality-decoupled Mixture-of-Transformers with a causal attention mask that lets action tokens condition on imagined future registers, retaining explicit imagine-then-act reasoning at deployment. Its compactness further enables low-cost multimodal sampling. As a result, our SparseWAM achieves 92.6 PDMS on NAVSIM v1, 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, and 39.6 on NavHard at only 164 ms latency, roughly 1/5 that of DriveVA, demonstrating the efficiency of the sparse register space. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: SparseWAM 用每帧仅 16 个 token 的稀疏 register 空间预测未来场景与自车轨迹，保留"先想象后行动"的显式推理，在 NAVSIM 上取得 SOTA 级成绩且延迟仅约 DriveVA 的 1/5。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）要么在推理时必须生成密集未来视频、延迟过高；要么为求效率在部署时丢弃世界分支，丧失测试时想象能力。用 patch 级 DINO/JEPA 特征替代视频 latent 虽能提速，但 token 序列仍长且包含大量与决策无关的信息。
AI.method: 从冻结的 DINOv2 特征压缩出每帧仅 16 个 token 的稀疏 register 空间，并通过联合规划与打分的预训练使该空间聚焦决策相关信息；在此空间上使用模态解耦的 Mixture-of-Transformers 与因果注意力掩码，使动作 token 能条件化于想象出的未来 register，从而在部署时保留显式 imagine-then-act 推理；紧凑性还支持低成本的多模态采样。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM v1 上 92.6 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 上 90.1 EPDMS，NavHard 上 39.6，推理延迟仅 164 ms，约为 DriveVA 的 1/5。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏 register 空间可在保留显式未来想象能力的同时大幅降低推理延迟并维持强规划性能，是高效世界动作模型的一条可行路径；代码将在录用后开源。

title: OmniMechanism Design for Human-AI Collaboration with Impressionable Minds
summary: As AI systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains such as healthcare, effectively integrating human expertise with AI outputs is critical for reliable decision-making. A substantial body of theoretical work studies optimal mechanisms for human-AI collaboration (HAC), focusing on when to involve humans and how to combine their expertise with AI predictions. However, these approaches largely overlook a key factor highlighted by empirical evidence: human judgments are impressionable and can vary depending on how AI outputs are presented. For example, when AI systems defer decisions to humans, revealing or withholding the AI prediction can significantly influence human judgments. Moreover, existing work neglects deployment-time variability, where conditions, particularly the cost of eliciting human input, may differ substantially from those observed during training. To address these challenges, we introduce a rigorous and theoretically grounded framework for human-AI collaboration, termed collaborative omnimechanism design, based on a novel and computationally efficient contextual bandit variant of boosting for outcome indistinguishability. In particular, we reduce a calibration-type outcome indistinguishability condition to weighted calibration, providing a novel time-efficiency result, bypassing the high-dimension curse induced by complicated collaboration methods and outcome space. Our framework provides a principled characterization of human impressionability and introduces a unified optimization scheme that enables robust and adaptable decision-making across diverse query costs and evaluation objectives without retraining. We evaluate the framework in three HAC settings, examining adaptation to query costs and prediction objectives without retraining, and show that its induced policies perform comparably to or better than the evaluated baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出“协作全机制设计”框架，基于一种新的高效上下文bandit boosting变体实现结果不可区分性，统一刻画人类易受影响性与部署时查询成本变化，无需重训练即可适应多种HAC场景。
AI.motivation: 现有HAC理论研究忽略两点：人类判断具有易受影响性（AI输出呈现方式会改变人的决策），且部署时的成本等条件可能与训练时差异很大。
AI.method: 构建基于上下文bandit boosting变体的协作全机制设计框架；将校准型结果不可区分性条件归约为加权校准，获得时间高效性结果，规避复杂协作方法与结果空间带来的高维诅咒。
AI.result: 在三种HAC设置中评估，框架可在不重训练的情况下适应查询成本与预测目标变化，所得策略与基线相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为人类易受影响性提供原则性刻画，并给出跨查询成本与评估目标鲁棒可适配的统一优化方案。

title: Local Spatial TreeSHAP: Geographically Explainable AI Revealing Urbanization-Dependent Spatial Heterogeneity in Flood Resilience
summary: Urban flood resilience emerges from complex interactions among natural, built, and socio-economic systems, yet most recovery policies implicitly assume that resilience mechanisms are spatially uniform. To address this gap, this study develops a spatially explainable machine learning framework that integrates geographically weighted random forests with a novel Local Spatial TreeSHAP algorithm, enabling nonlinear resilience mechanisms to be identified and interpreted at the community scale. The framework is applied to 779 communities affected by the July 2023 extreme rainstorm in Beijing. Results reveal that resilience mechanisms exhibit substantially stronger spatial heterogeneity than the underlying physical and socio-economic conditions themselves, with SHAP-value spatial autocorrelation decreasing by 66.2% on average relative to predictor variables. Three distinct resilience regimes emerge across the urbanization gradient. Highly urbanized communities benefit from synergistic interactions among commercial infrastructure and accommodation services; transitional medium urbanized communities are constrained by infrastructure-development mismatches that create facility gaps despite continued urban expansion; and low urbanized communities are dominated by ecological and topographic thresholds, where adverse interactions between transportation and river-network structures undermine recovery capacity. Field investigations and interviews with 12 stakeholders corroborate these patterns. By linking geographically weighted machine learning with locally grounded attribution analysis, the proposed framework provides a new pathway for uncovering spatially varying resilience mechanisms and translating them into place-based recovery strategies under increasing climate extremes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出地理加权随机森林+局部空间TreeSHAP的可解释机器学习框架，揭示北京779个社区在2023年"7·31"极端暴雨后的洪涝韧性机制存在显著空间异质性，并识别出沿城市化梯度的三类韧性机制。
AI.motivation: 多数灾后恢复政策隐含假设韧性机制在空间上均质，但城市洪涝韧性源于自然、建成与社会经济系统的复杂交互，其机制很可能随空间变化。既有方法难以在社区尺度上识别并解释非线性、空间分异的韧性机制。
AI.method: 构建空间可解释机器学习框架：将地理加权随机森林（GWRF）与新颖的局部空间TreeSHAP算法结合，在社区尺度上识别并解释非线性韧性机制；应用于2023年7月北京极端暴雨影响的779个社区，并结合实地调查与12位利益相关者访谈进行验证。
AI.result: 韧性机制的空间异质性显著强于其底层物理与社会经济条件本身，SHAP值的空间自相关较预测变量平均下降66.2%；沿城市化梯度呈现三种韧性机制：高城市化社区依靠商业基础设施与住宿服务的协同；中等城市化过渡社区受基础设施—发展错配制约，扩张中仍存设施缺口；低城市化社区受生态与地形阈值主导，交通与河网结构的不利交互削弱恢复能力。实地调查与访谈印证了上述格局。
AI.conclusion: 将地理加权机器学习与本地化归因分析相结合，为揭示空间分异的韧性机制、并转化为因地制宜的恢复策略提供了新路径，有助于应对日益加剧的极端气候。

title: VeriBase: Automated Construction of Theorem Libraries for Software Verification
summary: Software verification is typically more challenging than coding. Software developers routinely build on mature libraries and APIs, but turning successful verification solutions into reusable libraries still requires substantial expert effort. In this paper, we propose VeriBase, a framework for automatically constructing software-verification libraries by jointly generalizing code and its associated theorems from successful verification solutions. The key challenge is to generalize implementations together with the theorem statements and proofs that depend on these implementations, and reconcile overlapping components across verification tasks. To this end, VeriBase treats code and its associated theorems as declaration families, and designs a three-phase pipeline, which proves seed tasks, generalizes code and associated theorems, and harvests the resulting families into shared interfaces. VeriBase updates dependent declarations as interface change and uses Lean to check the resulting code and proofs. We evaluate VeriBase across four benchmarks with three backend LLMs. The results show that the general-purpose library built from independent 4,191 programs increases the average task success rate by up to 17.0% and meanwhile reduces the proof completion time by up to 21.4%. When VeriBase constructs a benchmark-specific library, further improvement can be observed.

AI.tldr: VeriBase 通过将代码及其定理联合泛化，自动构建可复用的软件验证库，提升任务成功率并缩短证明时间。
AI.motivation: 软件验证比编程更困难，开发者常复用成熟库，但将成功的验证方案转化为可复用库仍需大量专家工作。
AI.method: 将代码及其相关定理视为声明族（declaration families），设计三阶段流水线：证明种子任务、泛化代码与定理、将结果族收获为共享接口；在接口变化时更新依赖声明，并用 Lean 检查代码与证明。
AI.result: 在四个基准、三种后端 LLM 上评估：由 4,191 个独立程序构建的通用库使平均任务成功率最高提升 17.0%，证明完成时间最多缩短 21.4%；构建基准特定库时提升更明显。
AI.conclusion: VeriBase 能自动构建可复用的验证库，有效提升验证任务的成功率与效率，验证了代码-定理联合泛化的可行性。

title: Learning to Adjudicate: Verifier-Guided Multi-Agent Reasoning for E-Commerce Relevance
summary: Relevance modeling is fundamental to e-commerce search, determining how well retrieved products satisfy the needs expressed in a user's query. Accurate judgments require interpreting user intent, comparing product attributes, and applying business-specific matching criteria. Current methods based on large language models (LLMs) leverage contextual understanding and reasoning, focusing on incorporating domain-specific context and enhancing reasoning performance. Despite these advances, difficult query-product pairs remain challenging when evidence from different perspectives supports conflicting conclusions. A single reasoning pass may fail to reconcile these conflicts and ensure that decisive evidence guides the final judgment. To address this challenge, we propose Collaborative Adjudication with Debate and Replay Experience (CADRE), a framework for evidence-based adjudication in e-commerce relevance assessment. CADRE organizes three expert agents sharing a frozen backbone to analyze product attributes, user intent, and business rules in separate contexts, while a trainable Verifier assesses their supporting evidence against the applicable matching criteria to determine relevance. Under expert disagreement, a Verifier-guided debate elicits targeted clarification and revision of disputed interpretations before final adjudication. We optimize the Verifier through multi-turn group relative policy optimization and adapt successful-experience replay so that trajectories yielding correct terminal labels can be reused alongside fresh rollouts in subsequent updates. For efficient online serving, we use CADRE as an offline teacher to distill its relevance judgments into a lightweight student model. Offline evaluations and online A/B tests on an e-commerce search advertising platform demonstrate that CADRE improves relevance classification and key business and relevance satisfaction metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出CADRE框架，通过多专家辩论与经验回放裁决电商搜索相关性问题，并蒸馏为轻量学生模型用于在线服务。
AI.motivation: 电商搜索相关性判定需理解用户意图、对比商品属性并应用业务匹配规则。对困难查询-商品对，不同视角的证据常相互冲突，单次推理难以调和冲突并让决定性证据主导最终判断。
AI.method: CADRE使用共享冻结骨干的三个专家代理，分别在独立上下文中分析商品属性、用户意图和业务规则；可训练的Verifier根据适用匹配准则评估其证据并判定相关性。当专家分歧时，采用Verifier引导的辩论澄清并修正争议解释后再最终裁决。Verifier通过多轮组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练，并引入成功经验回放，将产生正确终判的轨迹与新rollout一起用于后续更新。在线部署时以CADRE为离线教师蒸馏到轻量学生模型。
AI.result: 在电商搜索广告平台的离线评测与在线A/B测试中，CADRE提升了相关性分类效果，并改善关键业务与相关性满意度指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过多专家分工、证据驱动辩论与强化学习优化裁决器，并结合经验回放与蒸馏，可在保证在线效率的同时有效提升困难样本的相关性判定质量。

title: DuSE-Bench: Benchmarking Joint Reasoning over Evolving Dialogue and Documents
summary: Persistent Web information assistants must combine evolving document facts with user requirements established and revised across sessions. Yet systematic evaluation of how changes in both sources affect response requirements and evidence attribution remains limited. To address this gap, we introduce Dual-Source Evolution Benchmark (DuSE-Bench), a benchmark comprising 1,000 tasks across five scenarios, including 700 whose required premises originate in both dialogue and documents. An evolving Support Graph guides task construction and preserves links from updated facts and reused conclusions to original turns and passages. Task annotations distinguish grounding source from state dependence and enable separate evaluation of response content, response type, and source attribution. Experiments across 11 baseline configurations reveal persistent challenges in joint reasoning over evolving dialogue and documents, with content accuracy on jointly grounded tasks reaching at most 56.7%. Moreover, improvements in content accuracy can coincide with poorer response choice, while content-correct responses frequently lack complete attribution to original evidence. Matched evidence substitutions further show that the effect of replacing one source's evidence depends on support from the other. These findings motivate coordinating dialogue memory and document retrieval to apply current user requirements and document facts together while preserving their original support. The data are available at https://github.com/JianfengGao7/DuSE-Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出DuSE-Bench基准，含1000个任务（5类场景，700个需对话+文档双源前提），用演化Support Graph构建并保留更新事实与复用结论到原始轮次/段落的链接，标注区分grounding来源与状态依赖，支持对响应内容、响应类型、来源归因分别评估。11种基线在双源联合推理上内容准确率最高仅56.7%，且内容提升可能伴随响应选择变差、内容正确却缺乏完整证据归因。
AI.motivation: 持久型Web信息助手需结合不断演化的文档事实与跨会话建立/修订的用户需求，但系统性评估"两个来源的变化如何影响响应要求与证据归因"的研究仍有限。
AI.method: 构建DuSE-Bench基准：1000个任务、5种场景，其中700个所需前提同时源自对话与文档；以演化Support Graph指导任务构建，并保留更新事实、复用结论到原始轮次与段落的链接；任务标注区分离grounding source与state dependence，从而分别评估响应内容、响应类型、来源归因；另设计匹配的证据替换实验。
AI.result: 11种基线配置在演化对话与文档的联合推理上持续表现薄弱，双源接地任务内容准确率最高仅56.7%；内容准确率提升可能与响应选择变差同时出现；内容正确的回答常缺乏对原始证据的完整归因；匹配证据替换显示，替换某一来源证据的影响取决于另一来源的支持。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明需协调对话记忆与文档检索，以同时应用当前用户需求与文档事实，并保留其原始支撑证据。

title: Faces or Models? Where the Age Gap in Facial Expression Recognition Comes From
summary: Facial expression recognition (FER) systems are increasingly used in elder care, yet their accuracy on older faces is rarely measured. This study evaluated five open-source FER models on the FACES database, which holds 2,052 posed photographs of 171 adults aged 19 to 80. The models cross three architectures (ResNet-18, POSTER++ and QCS) with two training datasets (RAF-DB and AffectNet). All models lost accuracy on older faces by 11.7 to 15.2 percentage points. Older faces were harder for people too: human raters lost 8.6 points, a classifier using only facial geometry lost 8.3, and for anger, fear, and happiness older adults differed more from one another when posing. On specific expressions the models fell much further than people did. AffectNet-trained models misread older neutral faces as sad or angry 62% of the time. RAF-DB-trained models lost fear, disgust, and anger instead. The gap persisted after controlling for architecture, image quality, cropping, and expression intensity. When only the final classification layer was refitted on older faces, the gap shrank from 11 to 21 points to 4 points or less, suggesting that the models' learned features can represent older faces and that the deficit lies in how the final layer was trained.

AI.tldr: 本文评估五种开源人脸表情识别(FER)模型在老年人面孔上的准确率，发现所有模型在老年面孔上准确率下降11.7–15.2个百分点，且下降幅度超过人类评分者；仅重训最终分类层即可将差距缩小至4个百分点以内，表明问题出在最后层的训练方式而非特征表示。
AI.motivation: FER系统越来越多用于养老照护，但其在老年面孔上的准确性鲜有测量，存在潜在的年龄偏差风险。
AI.method: 在FACES数据库（171名19–80岁成年人、2,052张摆拍照片）上评估五种开源FER模型，覆盖三种架构（ResNet-18、POSTER++、QCS）与两种训练数据集（RAF-DB、AffectNet）的交叉组合；同时对比人类评分者、仅用面部几何的分类器，并控制架构、图像质量、裁剪和表情强度等因素，最后仅重训最终分类层进行验证。
AI.result: 所有模型在老年面孔上准确率下降11.7–15.2个百分点；人类评分者下降8.6点，几何分类器下降8.3点；Anger、Fear、Happiness上老年人摆拍差异更大。AffectNet模型将老年中性面孔误读为悲伤或愤怒的比例达62%；RAF-DB模型主要在Fear、Disgust、Anger上下降。控制多种因素后差距仍存在；仅重训最后分类层，差距从11–21点降至≤4点。
AI.conclusion: 模型学到的特征能够表征老年面孔，准确率缺口主要源于最终分类层的训练方式，可通过针对性重训显著缓解老年面孔上的年龄偏差。

title: Quantiles, Not Points: Streaming Quantile Matching for Ordinal-Aware LLM-as-a-Judge Calibration
summary: LLM-as-a-judge scores are often distributionally shifted from human ratings on any given evaluation task, and post-hoc calibration (mapping LLM to human scores in a small labeled anchor set) has become a popular method to correct for this shift. In this paper we derive the calibration from two positions: that LLMaJ scores are ordinal ratings drawn from a distribution rather than isolated points. We present streaming quantile matching (SQM), a version of a classical method not previously bench marked for LLMaJ calibration, which is built on the two positions by computing the optimal-transport map between the LLM and human score distributions. We develop an evaluation framework and within it we show that unlike point-wise calibrations, SQM respects the ordinality of the human anchor set and achieves the best distributional fidelity and the top overall rank across models and data. We also show that in general, post-hoc calibration narrows the raw error gap between smaller and larger judge models, which opens the possibility of more efficient LLM judges.

AI.tldr: 提出 streaming quantile matching (SQM)，将 LLM-as-a-judge 分数与人类评分的校准视为两个有序分布之间的最优传输映射，在评测框架中优于点式校准方法。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 的评分为序数分布而非孤立点，且其分布相对人类评分存在偏移，现有事后校准（点式映射）可能忽略序数性。
AI.method: 基于"LLMaJ 分数是从分布中抽取的序数评级"这一视角，提出 SQM：在 LLM 与人类分数分布之间计算最优传输映射，利用小型标注锚集进行事后校准；并建立专门的评测框架。
AI.result: SQM 尊重人类锚集的序数性，在所测模型和数据上取得最佳分布保真度和最高整体排名；事后校准普遍缩小了大小 judge 模型之间的原始误差差距。
AI.conclusion: 分布式校准优于点式校准；校准可缩小模型规模带来的性能差距，为更高效的 LLM judge 提供可能。

title: Statistical Inference under Performativity: From Policy Feedback to Self-Evolving Systems
comment: Extended version of the NeurIPS 2025 paper "Statistical Inference under Performativity" (arXiv:2505.18493)
summary: Performativity arises when prediction-informed decisions change the data-generating process, creating feedback between deployment and learning. This phenomenon occurs in policy-making and in self-evolving AI systems that shape their own future training data. Statistical inference is challenging because estimation errors in earlier predictors affect subsequent data distributions and propagate into later updates. We develop an end-to-end framework for statistical inference under performativity. For repeated risk minimization and repeated gradient descent, we establish central limit theorems at fixed deployment rounds and derive covariance recursions that capture both current-round sampling variation and uncertainty inherited from earlier deployments. We develop consistent covariance estimators using policy perturbations and score matching. These results can yield asymptotically valid confidence regions for population iterates and the performative stable point. We further extend prediction-powered inference to this dynamic setting, combining labeled observations with predictions on additional unlabeled data to improve statistical efficiency. We evaluate our framework in synthetic, semi-synthetic educational, and self-evolving large language model routing settings. Our experiments demonstrate that ignoring propagated uncertainty can lead to substantial undercoverage even after repeated retraining. Together, these results provide statistical tools for learning systems that help determine the distributions from which they learn. Our work establish a complete statistical inference under performativity, introducing new challenges and inference settings that we believe will provide substantial value to policy-making, statistics, and machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文为"表演性"(performativity)下的重复学习过程构建端到端统计推断框架：对重复风险最小化与重复梯度下降给出中心极限定理与协方差递推，并用策略扰动＋score matching 构造一致协方差估计量，得到总体迭代点与表演稳定点的渐近有效置信域，同时将 prediction-powered inference 推广到动态场景。
AI.motivation: 预测驱动的决策会改变数据生成过程，形成部署与学习之间的反馈（政策制定、自我演化 AI 系统均如此）。早期估计误差会影响后续数据分布并向后传播，导致传统统计推断失效；忽略这种传播不确定性会造成置信区间严重欠覆盖。
AI.method: 提出端到端推断框架：针对重复风险最小化和重复梯度下降，在固定部署轮数下建立 CLT；推导协方差递推式，同时刻画当轮抽样变异与来自早期部署的继承不确定性；利用策略扰动与 score matching 构造一致的协方差估计量；并把 prediction-powered inference 扩展到该动态设定，融合有标签观测与额外无标签数据上的预测以提升效率。
AI.result: 理论上获得总体迭代点与表演稳定点的渐近有效置信域；在合成数据、半合成教育数据和自我演化 LLM 路由实验中验证了框架；实验显示若忽略传播不确定性，即使反复重训练仍会出现显著欠覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 工作建立了完整的表演性下统计推断体系，揭示了新的推断挑战与设定，为政策制定、统计学与机器学习中"学习系统反过来决定其学习分布"的场景提供统计工具。

title: RECEIPT: Measuring and Repairing the Return Assumption of LLM Agents in Web Service Operations
summary:
LLM agents operate Web infrastructure from the command line and rely on a return assumption, namely that each tool call returns within a bounded time and with its requested action finished. Many commands, however, ask a question before they act, and the agent's harness either closes the program's input or keeps it open as a terminal at which nobody types. With closed input, the program can return status 0 without the requested action. With open input, it waits until a time limit, and the agent pays in time and tokens. To the best of our knowledge, this paper is the first to measure and repair the return assumption. We collect 91,469 production tool calls and 89,047 public agent trajectories, test how 8 widely used harnesses launch commands, and build Litmus, a catalog of 158 checked command-line invocations, and Tripwire, a benchmark of 25 task pairs that differ only in whether a question guards the requested action. We then propose RECEIPT, which keeps the input open, reads what each process waits for from system calls, and returns this state to an unmodified agent through a model-checked protocol.
  On Litmus, closed input causes 11.5% of tested invocations to return status 0 without performing the requested action, and 7 of 8 harnesses close input when no terminal is attached. An unanswered question at a plain terminal multiplies a task's token use by 2.9, and the input connection moves an LLM from 7th to 3rd place among 8. Across 5 LLMs, RECEIPT reduces false claims of success by 73.5% and completes all 25 guarded tasks on a second harness. An agent's reliability therefore depends on what its harness lets it observe as well as on its LLM. Agent builders should report what each tool call did, not only how it ended, and benchmark maintainers should fix and report the input connection before they rank LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文首次测量并修复LLM Agent的"返回假设"（每次工具调用在有限时间内返回且动作已完成）。作者构建Litmus（158条命令行调用目录）和Tripwire（25对仅在有/无交互提问上不同的任务）基准，发现关闭输入会导致11.5%的调用返回0却未执行动作，8个harness中7个会关闭输入。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent从命令行操作Web基础设施，依赖"每次工具调用有限时间内返回且动作已完成"的返回假设。但许多命令在执行前会先提问，而harness要么关闭输入（返回0却未执行），要么保持终端打开却无人输入（等待超时，耗费时间与token），因此需要测量并修复这一假设。
AI.method: 收集91,469条生产工具调用和89,047条公开Agent轨迹；测试8个主流harness的命令启动方式；构建Litmus（158条经检验的命令行调用）与Tripwire（25对仅有/无提问守卫的任务）；提出RECEIPT，保持输入打开，从系统调用读取每个进程等待的内容，并通过模型检查协议将状态返回给未修改的Agent。
AI.result: Litmus上关闭输入使11.5%的调用返回0却未执行动作，8个harness中7个在无终端时关闭输入；未答提问使token用量增至2.9倍，输入连接可将LLM在8个harness中的排名从第7升至第3；跨5个LLM，RECEIPT将虚假成功声明减少73.5%，并在第二个harness上完成全部25个受守卫任务。
AI.conclusion: Agent可靠性不仅取决于LLM，也取决于harness允许其观察到什么。Agent开发者应报告每次工具调用做了什么而非仅如何结束；基准维护者应在排名LLM前修复并报告输入连接。

title: E-GenRM: Generative Reward Modeling for Open-Ended E-Commerce Shopping Agents
summary: We present E-GenRM (E-commerce Generative Reward Model), a generative reward model tailored to e-commerce shopping agents. User expectations are shifting from simple product queries to open-ended shopping tasks. However, existing trajectories and reward designs remain largely bounded by current agent usage patterns and known failures, providing limited guidance for further capability improvement. These limitations call for an integrated reward modeling framework for open-ended shopping agent tasks. On the data side, E-GenRM leverages naturally occurring user behavior across the shopping app to construct diverse, long-horizon conversational trajectories beyond established usage patterns. On the modeling side, E-GenRM first learns from behavior-grounded evaluation chains through supervised fine-tuning. It is then optimized through criterion-guided reinforcement learning, which rewards correct preference judgments and evidence-supported factual claims under each criterion. Personalized hard-negative training further improves its sensitivity to user preferences reflected in shopping behavior, beyond explicit requirements. We additionally develop an active evidence retrieval extension that acquires missing e-commerce information for evaluation. On E-GenRM-Bench, E-GenRM-27B achieves 87.40\% preference accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.97 percentage points. In a 14-day online A/B test on Taobao, a shopping agent post-trained with E-GenRM improves the effective shopping-assistance rate by 1.39 percentage points and user satisfaction by 2.33 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出电商生成式奖励模型 E-GenRM，基于自然用户行为构建长程对话轨迹，并用准则引导强化学习训练，在离线基准与淘宝线上 A/B 测试中均显著提升购物智能体表现。
AI.motivation: 用户需求从简单商品查询转向开放式购物任务，但现有轨迹与奖励设计受限于已知使用模式和失败案例，难以指导能力进一步提升，因此需要面向开放式购物任务的统一奖励建模框架。
AI.method: 数据侧利用应用内自然用户行为构建多样、长程对话轨迹；建模侧先用监督微调学习"基于行为的评估链"，再通过准则引导的强化学习优化偏好判断与有证据支持的事实性陈述；引入个性化难负例训练提升对隐含偏好敏感性；并开发主动证据检索扩展以获取缺失的电商信息。
AI.result: 在 E-GenRM-Bench 上，E-GenRM-27B 达到 87.40% 偏好准确率，超过最强基线 6.97 个百分点；淘宝 14 天线上 A/B 测试中，经其后训练的购物智能体有效购物辅助率提升 1.39 个百分点，用户满意度提升 2.33 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: E-GenRM 为开放式购物智能体提供了有效的奖励建模框架，离线与线上结果均验证其对智能体能力和用户体验的实质提升。

title: CheXPoT: Post-Hoc Visual Verification and Correction of VLM-Generated Radiology Reports
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise for chest radiograph report generation, but adoption remains limited because of hallucinated findings that are not grounded in the image. Correcting these hallucinations and improving overall report quality remains a significant challenge. Prior work has addressed this problem by refining models with reinforcement learning, preference optimization, or chain-of-thought supervision, often at substantial compute cost. To address this gap, we introduce CheXPoT, a program-of-thought (PoT) framework that verifies each generated finding against image features and removes those it cannot ground. CheXPoT decomposes generated reports into predicates with RadGraph and an LLM, grounds these predicates against a DenseNet-121 and Grad-CAM visual evidence table, executes PoT verification code, and rewrites reports after removing unsupported predicates. On a 4,145-image held-out split, CheXPoT yields statistically significant precision gains on 8 of 14 CheXpert classes and F1 gains on 5, with no significant decreases in either metric. CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 19.2% (MedGemma-4B) to 46.8% (MedGemma-4B + CheXPoT) and micro-average F1 from 23.0% to 49.4%, absolute gains of 27.6% and 26.4% respectively. We also tested CheXPoT on other VLM report generators. On LLaVA-Med, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 4.5% to 17.7% and micro-average F1 from 6.3% to 19.4%. On MAIRA-2, CheXPoT lifts micro-average precision from 15.6% to 42.1% and micro-average F1 from 21.0% to 45.3%. Our results suggest that inexpensive post-hoc visual verification may improve VLM trustworthiness by correcting unsupported findings from generated reports. CheXPoT lays a foundation for tools that help validate VLM-generated radiology reports and reduce unsupported findings. These innovations may subsequently help increase trust and adoption of VLM tools in Medicine.

AI.tldr: 提出CheXPoT，一种程序化思维（PoT）后处理框架，用视觉证据验证并删除胸部X光报告生成中无法落地的幻觉发现，显著提升精度与F1。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在胸片报告生成中因幻觉（图像中不存在的发现）而难以落地应用；已有工作用强化学习、偏好优化或思维链监督纠错，计算成本高。作者希望以低成本的后处理方式验证并删除无支撑发现。
AI.method: CheXPoT将生成报告用RadGraph与LLM分解为谓词，借助DenseNet-121与Grad-CAM构建视觉证据表对谓词进行落地验证，执行PoT验证代码，删除无支撑谓词后重写报告。该框架与具体VLM解耦，可插拔式后处理。
AI.result: 在4,145张留出图像上，14个CheXpert类别中有8类精度显著提升、5类F1显著提升，无显著下降。MedGemma-4B微平均精度19.2%→46.8%，F1 23.0%→49.4%（+27.6/+26.4）。LLaVA-Med精度4.5%→17.7%，F1 6.3%→19.4%；MAIRA-2精度15.6%→42.1%，F1 21.0%→45.3%。
AI.conclusion: 低成本的事后视觉验证可有效纠正VLM报告中的无支撑发现，提升可信度，为验证VLM生成放射报告、推动医疗AI信任与采用奠定基础。

title: Circumpolar Wall-to-Wall Detection of Retrogressive Thaw Slumps with Scarce Labels and Extreme Class Imbalance
summary: Retrogressive thaw slumps (RTS) are among the most dynamic ground deformations caused by permafrost thaw. Abrupt thaw processes such as RTS could roughly double the contribution of permafrost thaw to climate warming, and already threaten a third of Arctic infrastructure. Circumpolar RTS mapping has advanced quickly, yet released inventories together cover only part of the permafrost region. RTS occupy only 0.1-0.5% of image tiles and labels are costly, so a detector must be designed and evaluated as a rare-target problem. We therefore developed a deep learning system and mapped 20.68 M square kilometres of circumpolar permafrost using 41.6 M tiles of 4.8 m PlanetScope imagery. Training used 22,259 tiles with 2,609 RTS instances in 1,718 of them, and the model was tuned through 172 controlled experiments. A convolutional network matched every alternative tested, including multimodal fusion, foundation-model encoders and masked-autoencoder pretraining, each at far more compute for similar or worse results. Labelled data moved performance most, and a foundation model's advantage appeared only when labels were scarce. Tested once on held-out ecoregions at the real-world prevalence of 0.1-0.5%, the final model achieved an area under the precision-recall curve of 0.812-0.855, an object precision of 0.854 and F1 of 0.644. Deployed wall-to-wall, the model produced a circumpolar map of 19,068 high-confidence detections whose sampled precision ranges from 0.54 to 0.90 by size class. We present an evaluation protocol for rare targets, a controlled account of what governs accuracy under scarce labels, and the circumpolar RTS map the validated model produced.

AI.tldr: 该研究将环极地多年冻土区活动层滑塌（RTS）检测建模为"稀有目标"问题，用PlanetScope影像和深度学习系统绘制了2068万平方公里的环极地地图，得到19,068个高置信度检测，并给出稀有目标检测的评估协议。
AI.motivation: RTS是冻土退化引起的最剧烈地表形变之一，可能使冻土融化对气候变暖的贡献翻倍，并已威胁北极三分之一的基础设施。已有环极地编目仅覆盖部分冻土区；且RTS仅占影像瓦片0.1–0.5%、标注昂贵，因此检测器必须按稀有目标问题来设计与评估。
AI.method: 使用4.8 m PlanetScope影像共4160万个瓦片，覆盖2068万平方公里环极地冻土区。训练集22259个瓦片、含2609个RTS实例（分布于1718个瓦片），通过172组受控实验调参。对比了卷积网络与多模态融合、基础模型编码器、掩码自编码器预训练等方案；在真实稀有度（0.1–0.5%）的留出生态区上一次性测试。
AI.result: 卷积网络与所有备选方案相当（后者算力更高但效果相近或更差）。标注数据对性能影响最大，基础模型优势仅在标签稀缺时显现。留出生态区测试：PR-AUC 0.812–0.855，目标精度0.854，F1 0.644。全域部署得到19,068个高置信度检测，抽样精度按尺寸类为0.54–0.90。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了稀有目标的评估协议、关于稀缺标签下精度决定因素的受控分析，以及经校验模型生成的环极地RTS地图，为冻土突变过程监测提供了可复用的方法框架。

title: From Small to Large: Assessing Medical Reasoning, Benchmark Contamination, and Model Size in Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) now answer medical exam questions at or above expert level, but it is unclear whether such scores reflect clinical competence, or are instead affected by the format of the questions being asked (e.g., multiple-choice versus open-ended), prior exposure to the benchmarks, and the difficulty of the questions. These benchmarks are also public and widely used online, which may be resulting in LLM memorization. Models may perform better on questions that they have seen before. It is also not evident whether smaller models, which are more locally deployable in HIPAA-compliant hospital settings, have achieved human performance. In this study, we evaluate fourteen current models from six leading providers, one smaller and one larger model from each provider with two additional open-weight models, on 3,076 questions from four medical benchmarks (MedQA-USMLE, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MedBullets) under standard multiple choice, the same questions with the answer choices withheld, and reconstruction of a hidden question from its choices alone. In the standard multiple-choice setting, the strongest models exceed the human-expert baseline on MedQA-USMLE and PubMedQA, but the smaller models trail their larger models by 8.7 percentage points and only two of the six pass the human-expert bar on the licensing examination. Withholding the answer choices, however, makes every model struggle: mean accuracy falls from 82.3% to 50.9%, and the two largest drops belong to the medically specialised models. On memorization, the strongest models reconstruct one question in four from the answer choices alone, yet accuracy holds on the questions they cannot reconstruct. We further weigh accuracy against inference cost and test whether ensembling several models improves medical question answering.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估14个LLM在4个医学基准的3,076题上，比较标准多选题、隐藏选项和由选项重建问题三种设定，发现高分部分源于题目格式与记忆，而非临床能力。
AI.motivation: LLM在医学考试上已达专家水平，但分数是否反映真实临床能力存疑：可能受题目格式（多选vs开放）、基准公开导致的记忆、题目难度影响；且本地可部署的小模型是否达到人类水平尚不清楚。
AI.method: 评估6家领先厂商各一大一小共12个模型加2个开放权重模型，共14个模型；使用MedQA-USMLE、MedMCQA、PubMedQA、MedBullets共3,076题；在标准多选题、隐藏答案选项、由选项重建隐藏问题三种设定下测试；并权衡准确率与推理成本，测试多模型集成效果。
AI.result: 标准多选题下最强模型在MedQA-USMLE和PubMedQA超过人类专家基线；小模型较大模型低8.7个百分点，6家中仅2家小模型通过执照考试人类专家线。隐藏选项后所有模型表现骤降，平均准确率从82.3%降至50.9%，医学专用模型降幅最大。记忆方面，最强模型能由选项重建约1/4的问题，但其无法重建的题目准确率仍保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 医学基准高分部分归因于题目格式与潜在记忆而非临床胜任力；隐藏选项大幅暴露模型脆弱性；小模型多数未达人类专家水平；研究进一步以准确率-推理成本权衡及集成方法检验医学问答的实用性。

title: CLiS: Plug-and-Play Attention Acceleration for Video Diffusion on TPUs via Certified Stabilization
summary: High-resolution video diffusion relies on attention over long token sequences, making attention efficiency critical to generation latency. Our analysis identifies repeated maximum reductions and accumulator rescaling in online softmax as a bottleneck in long-context TPU attention. We propose CLiS (Certified Loop-invariant Stabilization), a training-free, plug-and-play optimization for video diffusion inference. CLiS fixes per-row stabilizers before the KV loop and certifies numerical safety per head, falling back to online softmax when certification fails. It integrates into existing fused-attention kernels without changing model weights or architecture. On Wan 2.2 and LTX-2 across TPU v6e and TPU7x, CLiS reduces diffusion transformer (DiT) step latency by up to 19.6% relative to tuned online softmax without measurable quality loss. Controlled TPU adaptations of prior GPU stabilization methods show performance or numerical-safety limitations. Preliminary causal LLM experiments also show up to 13.5% higher training throughput in continued pretraining and 7.7% in supervised fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: CLiS是一种免训练、即插即用的视频扩散推理优化：在KV循环前固定softmax的行稳定器并逐头验证数值安全性，失败时回退到online softmax，在TPU上最高降低19.6%的DiT单步延迟且无质量损失。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视频扩散需要处理超长token序列上的注意力，生成延迟高。作者分析发现在长上下文TPU注意力中，online softmax反复进行最大值归约和累加器重缩放是性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出CLiS（Certified Loop-invariant Stabilization）：在KV循环开始前确定每行的softmax稳定器，从而消除循环内的重复max归约与rescale；对每个head进行数值安全性认证，若认证失败则回退到标准online softmax。该方法可集成进现有fused-attention内核，无需改动模型权重或架构，也无需训练。
AI.result: 在Wan 2.2与LTX-2上、于TPU v6e和TPU7x测试，CLiS相比调优后的online softmax将DiT单步延迟最多降低19.6%，无可测质量下降。对照实验中，将先前GPU稳定化方法移植到TPU则表现出性能或数值安全的局限。初步因果LLM实验显示持续预训练训练吞吐提升最高13.5%，监督微调提升7.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将softmax稳定化从循环内移到循环外并配以逐头数值认证与回退机制，CLiS在保持数值安全与生成质量的前提下显著加速长上下文注意力，且具备即插即用、跨模型与跨任务的通用性。

title: Launder-Bench: Can Repository-Level Agentic Code Laundering Be Detected?
summary: Coding agents can now rewrite repository-scale codebases while preserving tested behavior, creating a new challenge for plagiarism detection, license auditing, and software provenance. We ask whether such rewrites can still be traced to their source. Existing clone benchmarks emphasize fragments and bounded edits, while repository-transformation benchmarks evaluate functional correctness rather than provenance. Moreover, ranking the most similar source does not establish derivation when independent implementations can be similarly close. We define repository-level agentic code laundering and introduce Launder-Bench, to our knowledge the first repository-level benchmark for provenance under agentic rewriting, constructed from 282 real-world repositories. A source-hidden reconstruction protocol decomposes source behavior, reconstructs modules and repository structure, and retains rewrites only after execution-based verification. We evaluate the same provenance problem in two complementary settings: Launder-Bench-Pair contains 1,128 pairwise instances asking whether two repositories share provenance, while Launder-Bench-Attr contains 229 source-attribution instances asking which candidate is the source, with abstention when evidence is insufficient. Measured same-domain independent repositories establish how much similarity can arise without shared provenance and provide detector-specific reference bands. Existing methods remain far from saturating Launder-Bench: the strongest static method reaches only 0.66 AUROC on pairwise detection, while repository encoders rank the true source first on up to 22% of attribution queries but earn calibrated attribution credit on only 1-2%. These results reveal a systematic gap between relative code similarity and source-specific provenance evidence, providing a reproducible target for provenance detection under agentic rewriting.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"仓库级智能体代码洗白"问题并构建 Launder-Bench 基准（282 个真实仓库），含成对溯源判定（1,128 例）与来源归属（229 例）两个任务，现有方法远未饱和。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已能在大规模重写代码的同时保持测试行为不变，这对抄袭检测、许可证审计和软件溯源构成新挑战。现有克隆基准侧重代码片段与有限编辑，仓库级基准只评估功能正确性而非来源；且"最相似即来源"的排序逻辑无法在独立实现同样接近时确立派生关系。
AI.method: 定义仓库级智能体代码洗白问题，构建 Launder-Bench：采用源隐藏重建协议（分解源行为、重建模块与仓库结构、仅保留通过执行验证的重写）；设置 Launder-Bench-Pair（1,128 个成对实例判断是否共享来源）与 Launder-Bench-Attr（229 个来源归属实例，证据不足时允许弃权）；并用同领域独立仓库测量"无共享来源时的相似度上限"，给出检测器特定的参考区间。
AI.result: 现有方法远未饱和：最强静态方法在成对检测上仅达 0.66 AUROC；仓库编码器在最多 22% 的归属查询中把真实来源排第一，但仅 1–2% 获得校准后的归属得分。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了相对代码相似度与来源特异性溯源证据之间的系统性差距，为智能体重写场景下的溯源检测提供了可复现的评测目标。

title: PACERec: Progressive Adaptation of LLM Item Embeddings with Collaborative Evidence for Recommendation
summary: Large language model (LLM) embeddings have been increasingly adopted in sequential recommendation to encode static item attributes and alleviate the limitations of item ID embeddings under sparse interactions. However, these embeddings typically capture only static content similarity while neglecting sequential transitions, and since their adaptation quality relies on sparse per-item updates or global geometric calibration, existing methods still struggle to explicitly transfer preceding interaction contexts from frequent to long-tail items under unevenly distributed behavioral evidence, limiting recommendation effectiveness across the catalog. To address this challenge, we propose PACERec, an ID-free progressive adaptation framework that incorporates preceding interaction contexts into semantic representation adaptation by learning a shared velocity field from items with sufficient interactions via frequency-weighted flow matching. In this way, PACERec progressively guides static LLM embeddings toward collaborative behavioral targets while preserving original item semantics, overcoming sparse per-item updates to effectively generalize sequential transition patterns to long-tail items for both user modeling and candidate scoring. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets across three sequential backbones demonstrate the superiority of our method over competitive baselines in both overall and long-tail recommendation.

AI.tldr: PACERec：一种无 ID 的渐进式适配框架，用频率加权流匹配学习共享速度场，把前序交互上下文注入 LLM 语义表示，从而缓解长尾物品适配不足。
AI.motivation: LLM 嵌入在序列推荐中只捕捉静态内容相似度，忽略序列转移；其适配依赖稀疏的逐物品更新或全局几何校准，在行为证据分布不均时，难以把频繁物品的交互上下文显式迁移到长尾物品，导致全目录推荐效果受限。
AI.method: 从交互充分的物品中学习一个共享速度场（频率加权 flow matching），以协作行为目标为终点渐进地引导静态 LLM 嵌入，同时保留原始语义；该过程不再依赖逐物品的稀疏更新，可用于用户建模与候选打分。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集、三种序列骨干网络上，整体推荐与长尾推荐均优于竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成式（流匹配）的共享适配方式，可将序列转移模式泛化到长尾物品，是无 ID 序列推荐中一种有效的 LLM 语义适配思路。

title: Steer, Don't Tell: Breaking Reasoning Plateaus with Reachability-Aligned Self-Distillation
summary: Post training for large reasoning models remains insufficient on challenging problems, whose correct trajectories are hard to sample. Though prior works address this difficulty by integrating supervised fine tuning on expert trajectories with reinforcement learning, such external experts are not always available. Existing self improvement methods instead use reference solutions to create a privileged self-teacher. Yet privileged teacher correctness does not imply student reachability. Solution conditioning shifts the teacher distribution toward actions unlikely under the unprivileged student, producing seemingly "correct" trajectories that are unreachable or even mal-formed learning targets. Accordingly, we identify reachability alignment as the key to self constructed supervision and propose Self-Steered Reasoner (SSR). SSR realizes this principle through student support projection, which transforms the privileged teacher distribution into a directional signal only over reasoning actions locally reachable under the unguided student. Verification then retains correct trajectories sampled from this reachable space. To further boost the sampling efficiency, an iterative refinement framework is adopted, using diagnostic guidance based on current trajectories. On problems with pass@64 = 0 even after extensive RL, SSR recovers correct and learnable trajectories for 74.6% without parameter updates. Fine tuning on these trajectories followed by resumed reinforcement learning improves aggregate accuracy by 4.9 percentage points on AIME25/26 and HMMT26. These results show that privileged guidance becomes effective self-improvement data when aligned with the reasoning actions the student can reach.

AI.tldr: 提出Self-Steered Reasoner (SSR)，通过"学生支撑投影"将特权教师分布转化为学生局部可达的推理动作方向信号，从而让参考答案能作为可学习的自我改进监督，在极难问题上恢复正确且可学的轨迹。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在后训练中难以在困难问题上采样到正确轨迹；依赖外部专家轨迹的SFT+RL方法中专家并不总可得。现有自我改进方法用参考解构造特权自教师，但"教师正确"不等于"学生可达"——解条件化会把教师分布推向学生低概率动作，产生看似正确却不可达甚至畸形的学习目标。
AI.method: 识别出"可达性对齐(reachability alignment)"是自构造监督的关键，并提出SSR。具体通过学生支撑投影(student support projection)，将特权教师分布变换为仅覆盖无引导学生局部可达推理动作的方向性信号；随后验证并保留从该可达空间采样的正确轨迹。为进一步提升采样效率，采用迭代精化框架，基于当前轨迹提供诊断性引导。
AI.result: 在即使大量RL后pass@64=0的问题上，SSR无需参数更新即可为74.6%的问题恢复正确且可学的轨迹；在这些轨迹上微调并恢复强化学习后，在AIME25/26和HMMT26上聚合准确率提升4.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 当特权引导与学生的可达推理动作对齐时，它就能成为有效的自我改进数据；可达性对齐是自构造监督的核心原则。

title: TopoMix: Continuous Spatial Mixing for Long-Tailed Data Augmentation
comment: Accepted by 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
summary: Most mixing-based augmentation methods improve generalization through a simple idea: combine two training samples with a fixed global ratio or a hard spatial replacement. While effective, this design leaves little room for local variation, which becomes a more visible limitation in long-tailed recognition, where minority classes are especially sensitive to the quality of augmented samples. We propose TopoMix, a training-free augmentation method that replaces fixed mixing with continuous spatial mixing. TopoMix constructs a smooth spatially varying mask from a low-resolution random control grid, bicubic interpolation, and stochastic non-linear shaping, and uses this mask for element-wise image mixing and label reweighting. Without introducing trainable parameters or auxiliary networks, TopoMix offers a simple way to make mixing more flexible in the input space. Experiments on standard long-tailed benchmarks show that it consistently improves over representative mixing-based baselines, indicating that smooth spatial mixing is an effective augmentation strategy for long-tailed recognition.

AI.tldr: TopoMix是一种免训练的数据增强方法，用连续空间混合替代固定比例混合，通过平滑空间变化掩码进行图像混合和标签重加权，在长尾识别任务上优于代表性混合基线。
AI.motivation: 现有混合增强依赖固定全局比例或硬性空间替换，缺乏局部变化空间，这在长尾识别中尤为不利，因为少数类对增强样本质量格外敏感。
AI.method: 构建低分辨率随机控制网格，经双三次插值与随机非线性整形生成平滑的空间变化掩码，再用该掩码做逐像素图像混合与标签重加权；不引入可训练参数或辅助网络。
AI.result: 在标准长尾基准上，方法持续优于代表性混合类基线。
AI.conclusion: 平滑空间混合是长尾识别中一种有效的增强策略，且实现简单、无需训练。

title: Exo: An Architecture for Self-Improving Systems at Runtime
summary: Agent harnesses govern how language models act in an environment; designing their policies by hand is difficult, while automated techniques require representative datasets and costly executions. We present Exo, an agent runtime architecture for safe learning during ongoing work that collapses the optimization loop into task execution, allowing agents to revise both their harness and their strategies for further improvement. A minimal protected mechanism layer preserves execution history and governs policy activation while the harness evolves through inspectable code changes. On long-running objectives in an open-world game, Exo reduces model cost by 12-53% relative to Codex and Pi in standalone runs and 45-82% in transfer runs, while matching task completion rates. Compared with the same starting policy without the ability to edit policy, Exo reduces held-out model cost by 35-61% on AppWorld and SREGym with comparable correctness, cutting AppWorld's mean task time by 13% and SREGym's median diagnosis time by 35%. On Continual Learning Bench coding tasks, model cost including learning falls by 14%, with both policies resolving every issue.

AI.tldr: Exo 是一个智能体运行时架构，让智能体在任务执行过程中安全地学习并改写自身的 harness（执行框架）与策略，无需额外数据集和昂贵离线训练。
AI.motivation: 手工设计智能体 harness 的策略困难，而自动化优化方法需要代表性数据集和高昂执行成本，因此希望在真实任务执行中实现在线、安全的学习。
AI.method: 提出 Exo 运行时：将优化循环压缩进任务执行过程，用最小化的受保护机制层保存执行历史并管控策略激活，harness 通过可检查的代码修改进行演化，智能体可同时修订 harness 与策略。
AI.result: 开放世界游戏长任务中，相比 Codex 与 Pi 单独运行降低成本 12-53%，迁移运行降低 45-82%，完成率持平；相比不可编辑策略的同起点基线，AppWorld 与 SREGym held-out 模型成本降低 35-61%，正确性相当，AppWorld 平均任务时间减少 13%，SREGym 诊断中位时间减少 35%；Continual Learning Bench 编程任务含学习成本降低 14%，两策略均解决全部问题。
AI.conclusion: 在执行中演化 harness 与策略的在线学习架构可在保持任务完成质量的同时显著降低模型成本与时间，具备跨环境迁移与持续学习优势。

title: Learning to evolve by matching velocities
summary: Learning the continuous-time evolution of nonlinear dynamical systems relies on trajectory-based objectives, which require simulating the learned dynamics during training and backpropagating through the numerical scheme, at a cost that grows with the rollout horizon.
