We show that trajectory-based objectives degenerate as the rollout horizon increases, hindering gradient-based optimization, and that the numerical scheme biases the learned dynamics by constraining the spectrum of the learned Jacobian to its absolute stability region. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Velocity Matching (VM), a simulation-free objective that relies on piecewise-linear interpolation and stochastic collocation, and approximates the velocity population risk to second order in the sampling step. We develop a theoretical framework for velocity-based learning, introducing stability estimates that control trajectory errors in terms of velocity errors, which enable us to establish universal and continuous-time approximation results when the learned velocity field is parameterized by deep neural networks. Building on a bias-variance decomposition of the VM objective, we show that its higher-order approximation of the velocity population risk yields a consistent minimizer; that it relates to the residual of an A-stable continuous-stage Runge-Kutta scheme, thus connecting VM to implicit integration without requiring any implicit solve; and that it implicitly matches the action of the learned Jacobian to that of the true one along the observed trajectories, without requiring access to the underlying velocity field or its Jacobian. Numerical experiments on nonlinear ordinary differential equations and semi-discretized time-dependent partial differential equations show that VM improves accuracy over trajectory-based objectives, while avoiding both the cost of simulation and the instabilities of long rollouts.

AI.tldr: 论文指出基于轨迹的训练目标随rollout horizon增长会退化，且数值格式将学习到的Jacobian谱局限在绝对稳定域内引入偏差。为此提出Velocity Matching (VM)，一种无需模拟的目标函数，基于分段线性插值与随机配点，以二阶精度近似速度种群风险。
AI.motivation: 连续时间非线性动力学的学习依赖轨迹目标，训练时需模拟动力学并对数值格式反向传播，代价随rollout长度增长。作者进一步揭示两个根本缺陷：(1)轨迹目标在rollout horizon增大时退化，损害梯度优化；(2)数值格式把学习到的Jacobian谱约束在绝对稳定区域内，使学到的动力学产生偏差。因此需要一个既避免模拟开销又不受数值格式偏差影响的目标。
AI.method: 提出Velocity Matching (VM)：一个simulation-free目标，采用分段线性插值和随机配点，对速度种群风险做到采样步长二阶近似。建立基于速度的学习理论框架，给出以速度误差控制轨迹误差的稳定性估计，并证明深度网络参数化速度场时的通用与连续时间逼近结果。基于VM的偏差-方差分解分析其一致极小性，并证明VM与A稳定连续级Runge-Kutta格式残差相关（连接隐式积分而无需隐式求解），且在观测轨迹上隐式匹配学习Jacobian与真实Jacobian的作用。
AI.result: 理论表明VM的极小元一致；与A稳定连续级RK格式残差相联系，实现隐式积分效果而无需隐式求解；并隐式地对齐沿轨迹的Jacobian作用。在非线性ODE和半离散时变PDE上的数值实验显示，VM相比轨迹目标精度更高，同时避免模拟开销和长rollout的不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: VM通过simulation-free的速度匹配目标克服了轨迹目标的退化与数值格式谱偏差问题，兼具理论保证（稳定性、逼近性、一致性）和隐式积分的稳定性优势，实验验证其在精度与稳定性上优于轨迹基方法。

title: Semantic Interoperability in Federated Digital Twin Systems: A Systematic Review Through the Levels of Conceptual Interoperability Model
summary: When two companies connect their digital twins, software models of their plants kept up to date with live data, each twin must translate the other's data into its own terms, and that translation rule, called a mapping, can stop being correct when one company changes the meaning of its data without telling the other. This PRISMA 2020 systematic review screened 5,833 records and read 119 full texts to determine whether any published system detects such a broken mapping and repairs it while the twins operate. In all 32 included studies the mapping is fixed before operation, and the two ingredients of run-time repair appear only separately: cross-company matching without any check that the match still holds, and detection and repair of changed meaning within a single company. The review turns this gap into six requirements, each illustrated on one running example, that a system claiming run-time semantic interoperability between independently owned twins should meet.

AI.tldr: 本文通过PRISMA 2020系统综述（筛选5833条记录、阅读119篇全文、纳入32项研究）考察是否存在能在数字孪生运行期间检测并修复跨企业语义映射失效的系统，结果表明该能力尚属空白，并提出六项需求。
AI.motivation: 两家企业连接各自数字孪生时，需用映射规则互相翻译数据；当一方悄然改变数据含义，该映射会失效且无人告知。作者希望厘清现有文献是否已支持运行时的失效检测与自动修复。
AI.method: 严格的PRISMA 2020系统综述流程：从5833条记录中筛选，精读119篇全文，最终纳入32项研究，并对这些研究在映射建立时机与修复机制两方面进行归纳对比。
AI.result: 32项研究全部在运行前固定映射；运行期修复的两个要素仅分别出现——跨企业匹配但无有效性校验，以及单企业内部语义变更的检测与修复，二者从未结合。
AI.conclusion: 作者把该空白转化为六项需求，并用同一个贯穿示例逐一说明，作为宣称支持独立所有数字孪生间运行时语义互操作的系统应满足的标准。

title: Preprocessing Choices in Fine-Tuning Data Matter: Utility and Demographic Sensitivity in LLM-Based Recommendation
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on Evaluating and Applying Recommender Systems with Large Language Models (EARL) at CIKM 2026, November 8, 2026, Rome, Italy
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have introduced a generative approach to recommendation, producing item lists from textual representations of user histories and item information. However, this generative setting raises challenges concerning output validity, prompt consistency, and sensitivity to demographic descriptors. In this work, we investigate how preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior in a generative LLM-based recommender system. We first establish a controlled recommendation pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning, catalog-constrained decoding, and prompt augmentation. We then study three preprocessing choices: item-title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment. Experiments on MovieLens-1M show that the catalog-constrained pipeline eliminates out-of-catalog items and ensures complete ten-item outputs, while prompt augmentation improves prompt consistency and utility. Original MovieLens titles increase HR@10 from 10.67% to 12.47% and Coverage@10 from 41.36% to 47.88%. Fairness-related effects are attribute-dependent: age balancing and knowledge enrichment reduce selected group-level utility gaps while largely preserving utility, whereas gender balancing reduces utility without improving the evaluated gender-related indicators. Overall, preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data should be evaluated jointly in terms of utility, output behavior, and demographic sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 研究微调数据预处理选择对生成式LLM推荐系统的推荐效用与公平性的影响，建立了结合监督微调、目录约束解码与提示增强的受控推荐流程。
AI.motivation: 生成式LLM推荐存在输出有效性、提示一致性和对人口统计学描述符敏感等问题，而微调数据的预处理选择如何影响效用与公平性尚不清晰。
AI.method: 构建受控推荐pipeline（监督微调+目录约束解码+提示增强），并研究三种预处理选择：条目标题表示、人口统计学平衡、辅助条目知识增强；在MovieLens-1M上实验。
AI.result: 目录约束消除越界条目并保证完整十项输出；提示增强提升一致性与效用；原始MovieLens标题使HR@10从10.67%升至12.47%、Coverage@10从41.36%升至47.88%。公平性影响依属性而异：年龄平衡与知识增强在基本保持效用的同时缩小群体效用差距，而性别平衡降低效用却未改善性别相关指标。
AI.conclusion: 微调数据的预处理选择应从效用、输出行为和人口统计学敏感性三方面联合评估。

title: Adaptive-Policy Distillation: Knowledge Injection under Information Asymmetry
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD), which uses reverse-KL supervision on student rollouts to transfer a context-conditioned model's behavior into student model parameters for closed-book inference, has shown strong results. However, we find that this success does not translate to knowledge injection: across two document-QA benchmarks, OPD injects document knowledge far less efficiently than simple off-policy distillation. We trace this reversal to two failures that are structural, yet sparse across token positions. Reverse KL weights its gradient by the student distribution and therefore barely lifts document-specific tokens the student considers unlikely; after forward KL restores this signal, student rollouts expose later positions on the target trajectory only after generating the preceding tokens correctly, so coverage deteriorates with target length. Motivated by the concentration of teacher-student divergence at these hard positions, we propose Adaptive-Policy Distillation (APD), whose per-token gate jointly shifts the rollout toward the teacher and the objective toward forward KL where needed, withdrawing both interventions as the student learns. Without labels or a verifier, APD improves over OPD by up to 54.6%, achieving the best scores of 0.558 F1 on QASPER and 0.486 MRR on BioASQ.

AI.tldr: OPD在知识注入上不如简单的off-policy蒸馏，作者诊断出反向KL权重与rollout覆盖两个结构性缺陷，提出逐token门控的APD方法，在无标签无验证器下显著超越OPD。
AI.motivation: on-policy蒸馏（OPD）用反向KL对student rollout做监督，在闭卷迁移上下文模型行为上效果好，但作者发现它并不适用于知识注入：在两个文档QA基准上，OPD注入文档知识的效率远低于简单的off-policy蒸馏，需要解释并修复这一反常现象。
AI.method: 作者将问题归因于两个结构性但稀疏分布于token位置的失败：(1) 反向KL用student分布加权梯度，几乎无法提升student认为低概率的文档特定token，换用前向KL可恢复该信号；(2) student rollout只有在正确生成前文token后才能覆盖目标轨迹的后续位置，导致覆盖率随目标长度下降。据此提出Adaptive-Policy Distillation (APD)，用逐token门控在需要处同时将rollout拉向teacher、将目标偏向正向KL，并随student学习逐步撤除两种干预，无需标签或验证器。
AI.result: APD相对OPD最高提升54.6%，在QASPER上达到最佳0.558 F1，在BioASQ上达到最佳0.486 MRR。
AI.conclusion: 反向KL的on-policy蒸馏不适合知识注入，其缺陷集中于少数困难token；通过逐token自适应的rollout引导与目标切换，APD在无监督信号条件下有效修复这些问题并取得最佳性能。

title: Keyframes First, Motion Second: Revisiting Compressed-Domain Video Captioning under Limited Supervision
summary: Compressed-domain video captioners such as CoCap read the H.264 bitstream directly: a pretrained encoder reads the keyframes (I-frames), while motion and residual encoders, trained from scratch, turn the codec's motion vectors and residuals into action tokens. This motion branch costs decoding time and supervision, both scarce on edge devices. We ask when it pays off under limited supervision. In a controlled study on 2,500 VATEX training clips, we fix a frozen SigLIP 2 keyframe encoder, a GPT-2 caption decoder and the training schedule, vary only the visual tokens the decoder receives (34 configurations), and report held-out test CIDEr with paired bootstrap intervals and three seeds. Motion encoders trained from scratch bring no measurable benefit: CoCap-style action tokens change CIDEr by -0.55 (95% CI [-2.3, +1.2]), and six other uses of motion do not help. Warm-started from a model trained on 48x the caption samples, they add +1.3 CIDEr on average, though not significantly across seeds, and only while the keyframe tokens stay frozen. Reading the keyframes better matters more: fine-tuning SigLIP 2's own attention-pooling head adds 5.4 CIDEr, and one to eight such tokens beat the 16 CoCap-style tokens on every seed while decoding only I-frames (7.3 ms instead of 44-114 ms per clip). The same holds on MSVD's full split in CoCap's own video encoding, where the readout leads by 14.2 CIDEr and action tokens bring no reliable gain, also with clean single-reference motion vectors. Under limited supervision, keyframes come first and motion second.

AI.tldr: 在有限监督下，压缩域视频描述中关键帧远比运动信息重要：从零训练的运动编码器无显著收益，而改进关键帧读出（微调SigLIP 2注意力池化头）可提升5.4 CIDEr，且解码更快。
AI.motivation: CoCap等压缩域视频描述器直接从H.264码流读取信息，但运动/残差编码器需从零训练且解码耗时，在边缘设备上监督与算力都稀缺。作者希望探究：在监督有限时，运动分支究竟何时才值得使用。
AI.method: 在2500个VATEX训练片段上做受控实验：固定冻结的SigLIP 2关键帧编码器、GPT-2解码器与训练计划，仅改变解码器接收的视觉token（34种配置），并报告留出测试集CIDEr、配对bootstrap置信区间和三个随机种子。对比从零训练的运动编码器、用48倍字幕样本热启动的运动模型、以及微调SigLIP 2注意力池化头等多种方案；并在MSVD完整划分上复现验证。
AI.result: 从零训练的CoCap式动作token使CIDEr变化-0.55（95% CI [-2.3, +1.2]），其他六种运动用法也无帮助。热启动运动模型平均+1.3 CIDEr但跨种子不显著，且需关键帧token保持冻结。微调SigLIP 2注意力池化头增加5.4 CIDEr，1–8个此类token在每个种子都优于16个CoCap式token，且仅解码I帧（7.3ms vs 44–114ms/片段）。MSVD上读出方案领先14.2 CIDEr，动作token无可靠增益。
AI.conclusion: 在有限监督的场景下，应优先投资关键帧信息的高效读出，运动信息次之；从零训练的运动编码器在压缩域视频描述中收益不可测且代价高昂。

title: Compression Technique Interactions in Small Language Models: A Factorial Ablation Study
summary: Deploying small language models on resource-constrained hardware requires compression, yet practitioners lack systematic guidance on how quantization, pruning, and post-compression recovery interact when combined. We present a factorial ablation study evaluating 72 compression configurations across four SLM architectures (2.7B-7B parameters), extended with a 48-configuration ordering analysis, benchmark accuracy validation on 30 compressed models, and robustness checks including multi-seed validation and full-corpus perplexity evaluation. INT8 quantization is effectively lossless (<0.5% accuracy degradation), while NF4 quantization combined with L1 magnitude pruning causes model collapse in all 16 tested combinations. LoRA-based fine-tuning reduces degraded perplexity by up to 97% after aggressive pruning; an ablation against standard fine-tuning without a teacher model shows the recovery is driven by LoRA adaptation itself rather than the distillation signal. Compression ordering shows no significant effect among viable configurations (ANOVA p = 0.96) but determines viability for NF4+pruning combinations. INT8 quantization alone provides 40-45% memory reduction with no quality loss. On-device CPU deployment via llama.cpp confirms these findings transfer off the GPU: 4-bit quantization runs 46-54% faster than 8-bit for a perplexity difference under 0.5 points, while un-structured pruning yields no CPU latency or memory benefit, consistent with its dense storage format.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模因子消融实验（72种压缩配置×4个SLM架构，加上48种顺序分析与30个压缩模型基准验证）系统研究量化、剪枝与压缩后恢复三者的交互作用，发现INT8量化近乎无损，NF4+L1剪枝会致模型崩溃，LoRA微调可大幅恢复困惑度。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限硬件上部署小型语言模型需要压缩，但从业者缺乏关于量化、剪枝与压缩后恢复如何交互的系统性指导。
AI.method: 因子消融研究：72种压缩配置、4个SLM架构（2.7B-7B）；48配置的压缩顺序分析；30个压缩模型的基准准确率验证；多随机种子验证与全语料困惑度评估；与无教师的标准微调对照消融；llama.cpp在设备CPU上部署验证。
AI.result: INT8量化几乎无损（准确率下降<0.5%），单独可减少40-45%内存；NF4量化+L1幅度剪枝在全部16种组合中导致模型崩溃；激进剪枝后LoRA微调最多降低97%的困惑度退化，且恢复源于LoRA自适应本身而非蒸馏信号；可行配置下压缩顺序无显著影响（ANOVA p=0.96），但决定NF4+剪枝组合是否可行；CPU上4-bit比8-bit快46-54%（困惑度差<0.5），非结构化剪枝在CPU上无延迟或内存收益。
AI.conclusion: INT8量化是安全无损的选择；应避免NF4与L1剪枝组合；LoRA微调是有效的压缩后恢复手段；压缩顺序对可行配置影响不大但影响崩溃边界；非结构化剪枝因稠密存储格式在CPU部署中无实际收益。

title: Compositional Self-Improvement: Promises and Pitfalls
summary: Although self-improvement is becoming increasingly important as tasks become more complex, models struggle to generate reliable supervision for harder, out-of-distribution instances. One way to address this challenge is to exploit compositional structure: models often solve simpler subproblems more reliably than full problems, so their subproblem predictions can be composed into supervision for harder ones. We systematically study when this kind of composed supervision supports self-improvement and when it fails. Our controlled experiments identify three failure modes: unreliable subproblem predictions, errors introduced by composition, and limited supervision coverage. Beyond controlled settings, these findings carry over to more realistic coding and reasoning tasks: composed labels are more accurate than direct self-generated labels and improve performance even on compositions longer than those seen during training, while the failure modes remain visible. Further, although these failure modes often keep compositional self-improvement from fully succeeding on its own, a short SFT warmup with compositional self-improvement can bootstrap reinforcement learning on tasks that require composing skills the model already has, particularly when direct exploration rarely succeeds. Together, these findings characterize when compositional self-improvement can provide sufficiently reliable supervision to expand model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 系统研究"组合式自监督"何时有效、何时失效，并给出失败模式与可行的改进路径。
AI.motivation: 任务变复杂后，模型难以对困难、分布外样本生成可靠的自监督信号；而模型往往能更可靠地解出简单子问题，因此可尝试把子问题预测组合成困难问题的监督信号。
AI.method: 受控实验系统分析组合监督的适用条件，识别其失败模式；并在更真实的编程与推理任务上验证，进一步测试"短SFT预热+组合式自监督"引导强化学习的效果。
AI.result: 识别出三类失败模式：子问题预测不可靠、组合过程引入误差、监督覆盖有限。在真实编程/推理任务中，组合标签比直接自生成标签更准确，甚至在长于训练时所见的组合上仍能提升性能，但失败模式依然存在。短SFT预热配合组合自监督可引导RL，在需要组合已掌握技能且直接探索难以成功时尤为有效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作刻画了组合式自监督能提供足够可靠监督、从而扩展模型能力的条件与边界。

title: Built on Broken Assumptions (BOBA): Why Coding Agents Cannot Be Left Alone
comment: 56 pages, 12 figures, 44 tables. Benchmark, data and code: https://github.com/amazon-agi/BOBA-bench
summary: Coding agents are autonomous developers. Given a request, they change the code and report back when done. As such, they can handle not only independent requests but whole chains of them, each request built on the last. Agents are known to report wrong work as done, yet benchmarks still test them one request at a time, on human-written code, checked once. We build BOBA-Bench, 280 chains of 20 consecutive requests drawn from 140 real open-source projects, and evaluate ten coding agents on both. All ten do far worse on chains. On average, they complete 95% of requests taken one at a time, but when requests are chained together, they complete 51%. Worse code is not the cause. Once checked, agent code is nearly as good a base for later requests as human code. The cause is the mistakes agents miss. Coding agents declare a request done once their own tests pass, even when those tests miss a mistake. The next request then builds on broken code and fails about twice as often. The mistake is rarely found later. Nor can agents catch such mistakes by reviewing code. Asked whether an implementation is correct, they are right 53% of the time, barely better than a coin flip. Coding agents are therefore heavily dependent on access to verification. A single external ``that's wrong'' after a failed request and one repair round lift chain completion from 51% to 59%, and a repaired mistake no longer hurts the requests that follow. In simpler terms, coding agents are only as reliable as the checks they can reach: without verification, every request that follows is built on broken assumptions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BOBA-Bench（280 条、每条 20 个连续请求，取自 140 个真实开源项目），对比"单请求"与"请求链"两种设定下十个编码智能体的表现：单请求完成率约 95%，串联后降至 51%，根因是智能体未能自查出错误；引入外部验证与一轮修复后，链完成率升至 59%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准一次只测一个请求、只在人工代码上检查一次，而编码智能体实际要处理前后依赖的请求链，且已知会把错误工作报告为完成，缺少对链式场景下错误累积的度量。
AI.method: 构建 BOBA-Bench：280 条链、每条 20 个连续请求，源自 140 个真实开源项目；在单请求与请求链两种设定下评测十个编码智能体，并分析错误来源、后续请求失败率、智能体代码复盘能力，以及外部验证信号加一轮修复的干预效果。
AI.result: 所有智能体在链式设定下显著变差（95%→51%）；代码质量不是原因（智能体代码作为后续基础几乎与人工代码相当）；原因是未被发现的错误，后续请求失败率约翻倍；让智能体自行审查代码正确性仅 53% 准确率；一次外部"错了"反馈加一轮修复使链完成率从 51% 提升到 59%，且修复后的错误不再影响后续请求。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体的可靠性高度依赖可获得的验证手段；缺乏外部验证时，每个后续请求都建立在错误假设之上。

title: Every Clause Counts: Instruction-Following Reranking by Multiplying Small, Answerable Questions
summary: People often attach instructions to their search queries, asking for pages written for beginners, documents in a certain language or official sources only. Most rerankers were trained to judge topical relevance and treat such instructions as a few extra words. On the InfoSearch benchmark, even GPT-4o used as a list-wise reranker reaches an average WISE (Weighted Instruction Sensitivity Evaluation) of only 33.5. We present DMReranker (Decision-Model Reranker), a zero-shot reranker that splits an instructed query into a topic and a short list of typed clauses. A small judge model answers one narrow question per clause, and the answer probabilities are multiplied into a single score. Nothing is trained, and the configuration was frozen before the test runs. Reranking the same top-100 candidates as the published baselines, DMReranker reaches a macro WISE of 50.9 over all six InfoSearch dimensions while keeping original-mode nDCG@10 at 82.9. It trails GPT-4o on the stricter SICR (Strict Instruction Compliance Ratio) metric, 19.2 against 32.1. We show that this gap follows from how a product of probabilities behaves when SICR compares raw scores across runs. Computed from ranks, our SICR is 67.0. On the same judge, splitting the instruction raises WISE from 32.9 to 47.6 over a single combined question, while raw-score SICR falls. Scoring all six dimensions cost about $10 at list price.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DMReranker，一种零样本重排序器，将带指令的查询拆分为主题与类型化子句列表，用小模型逐子句作答并相乘概率得分，无需训练。在 InfoSearch 六维度上宏平均 WISE 达 50.9（GPT-4o 仅 33.5），同时原始模式 nDCG@10 保持 82.9。
AI.motivation: 用户常在查询中附带指令（如面向初学者、指定语言、只要官方来源），但主流重排序器只判断主题相关性，把指令当作额外词处理，导致对这类指令几乎不敏感（连 GPT-4o 作为列表式重排器 WISE 也只有 33.5）。
AI.method: DMReranker 将带指令查询拆解为"主题 + 若干类型化子句"；由一个小的裁判模型（judge）对每个子句回答一个窄问题，将各子句答案概率相乘得到单一排序分数。全程零训练，配置在测试前即冻结。
AI.result: 在与已发布基线相同的 top-100 候选上，六维度宏平均 WISE 为 50.9，原始模式 nDCG@10 为 82.9；严格指标 SICR 上为 19.2，低于 GPT-4o 的 32.1，但作者论证该差距源于概率乘积在跨运行比较原始分数时的特性——改用排名计算 SICR 可达 67.0。同一裁判下，拆分指令使 WISE 从 32.9 升至 47.6。全部六维度打分成本约 10 美元。
AI.conclusion: 拆分子句的指令建模能在零训练下显著提升指令敏感性；SICR 类原始分数比较会系统性惩罚概率乘积式打分器，应按排名评估。

title: ShiftRAG: Bypassing the Textual Bottleneck via Decoupled Learning and Continuous Soft Tokens
summary: Despite advances in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), suppressing hallucinations during complex reasoning remains a persistent challenge. We identify that existing RAG pipelines suffer from a textual bottleneck: by passing only raw text to the generator, they discard discriminative signals of the retriever. Furthermore, recent attempts to unify retrieval and generation within a single LLM induce severe objective conflict and exacerbate the rank collapse of decoder-only architectures, degrading performance on both tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce ShiftRAG, a decoupled RAG framework that employs a single LLM backbone but isolates discriminative retrieval learning from autoregressive generation. To bridge these decoupled modes, we project retrieval alignments into continuous soft tokens, establishing a high-bandwidth interface that infuses the generator with retrieval-side signals. Concurrently, our soft orthogonality objective mitigates rank collapse, while layer-wise relevance dynamics preserve the fine-grained latent space required for highly discriminative evidence separation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that ShiftRAG significantly improves retrieval and question answering performance over state-of-the-art baselines. ShiftRAG preserves foundational capabilities of the backbone while maintaining a favorable efficiency-performance trade-off on general text encoding and generative tasks.

AI.tldr: ShiftRAG 提出一种解耦式 RAG 框架：共享单一 LLM 主干但将判别式检索学习与自回归生成分离，并通过软 token 接口传递检索对齐信号，从而缓解幻觉与目标冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 存在"文本瓶颈"——只把原始文本传给生成器，丢弃了检索器的判别性信号；而将检索与生成统一在单个 LLM 内的做法又会引发严重的目标冲突，并加剧 decoder-only 架构的秩坍缩，导致两项任务性能同时下降。
AI.method: 1) 解耦框架：单一 LLM 主干，但将判别式检索学习与自回归生成隔离开；2) 软 token 接口：把检索对齐投影为连续软 token，构建高带宽接口，将检索侧信号注入生成器；3) 软正交目标缓解秩坍缩；4) 逐层相关性动态保留细粒度潜空间，以支持高判别性的证据区分。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ShiftRAG 在检索与问答任务上显著优于 SOTA 基线；同时保留主干的基础能力，在通用文本编码与生成任务上维持良好的效率-性能权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦检索与生成并借助连续软 token 实现高带宽信息传递，ShiftRAG 有效缓解了文本瓶颈、目标冲突与秩坍缩问题，在提升 RAG 性能的同时不损害 LLM 原有的通用能力。

title: Background Bias Assessment and Mitigation in Plant Disease Detection Using EfficientNet-B0 with Image Processing
comment: 6 pages, accepted and published at 2026 IEEE CSPA
summary: Plant disease detection using deep learning has achieved remarkable accuracies exceeding 99% on benchmark datasets. However, these metrics may mask a critical vulnerability: models may be taking advantage of false background correlations instead of learning real pathological features. This study presents a systematic investigation of background bias in plant disease detection through a two-stage training framework with quantitative validation. We propose a three-condition evaluation protocol testing models on original, leaf-only, and background-only images to directly measure background dependency. Our approach combines standard transfer learning using EfficientNet-B0 and manipulation of background information during optimization. Experimental results on the PlantVillage dataset (20,638 images, 15 disease classes) show that while our model achieves 98.97% accuracy on the original images and maintains 96.62% accuracy on leaf-only images, the performance drops to 23.58% on background-only images. The calculated background bias (BBC) coefficient of 0.762 indicates that a large part of the model's predictive performance depends on leaf-related features rather than background distortions. This research offers clear evidence that even with the most advanced models, environmental shortcuts can be leveraged, and this highlights the importance of bias evaluation. The approach that has been used has laid a foundation for the development of agricultural AI that is ready for deployment. The implementation, models, and evaluation process are all publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统考察植物病害检测中的背景偏置问题，提出三条件评估协议（原图、仅叶片、仅背景），结合EfficientNet-B0迁移学习与背景信息操纵，在PlantVillage数据集上量化背景依赖程度。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习植物病害检测在基准数据集上准确率常超99%，但这些指标可能掩盖模型依赖虚假背景相关性而非真实病理特征的脆弱性，因而需要定量评估背景偏置。
AI.method: 采用两阶段训练框架与定量验证：提出三条件评估协议，分别在原始图像、仅叶片图像、仅背景图像上测试模型；使用EfficientNet-B0进行标准迁移学习，并在优化过程中操纵背景信息。
AI.result: 在PlantVillage数据集（20,638张图像、15类病害）上，原始图像准确率98.97%，仅叶片图像96.62%，仅背景图像降至23.58%；计算得背景偏置系数BBC为0.762，表明模型预测性能主要依赖叶片相关特征而非背景畸变。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明即使最先进模型也可能利用环境捷径，凸显偏置评估的重要性；所用方法为面向实际部署的农业AI奠定基础，且实现、模型与评估流程全部公开。

title: Few Trials, Many Metrics: Beta Mixtures for Low-Budget AI Evaluation
summary: Evaluating a stochastic AI system often requires many repeated samples per instance, especially for metrics defined over long horizons. Recent work has shown that modeling instance-level success probabilities with a Beta distribution recovers Pass@$k$ from far fewer samples than direct estimation. We show that this framework supports a broader range of evaluation targets. We fit a mixture of Beta distributions by marginal maximum likelihood, with the number of components chosen by BIC. From that one fit, we compute Pass$^k$ and AUC@$k$ at any horizon in closed form. We also derive delta-method confidence intervals for these metrics and for Pass@$k$, which require no additional model calls. Treating configurations rather than tasks as instances extends the same model to sensitivity analysis. For repeated success metrics, we find that mixture priors yield more accurate estimators than naive estimation across competition mathematics and graduate-level science benchmarks when extrapolating beyond the observed number of trials, and the resulting intervals cover the full-data reference. When prompts are treated as instances, it estimates the distribution of prompt sensitivity more accurately than a comparable item-response baseline without external covariates. Direct estimators remain preferable once trials reach the target horizon.

AI.tldr: 提出以Beta混合分布(按BIC选成分数,边际极大似然拟合)仅用少量样本即可闭式估计Pass@k、Pass^k、AUC@k及置信区间,并用于配置敏感度分析。
AI.motivation: 随机AI系统评测需每个实例大量重复采样,长horizon指标尤其昂贵;原Beta分布框架仅支持Pass@k,需扩展到更多评测目标。
AI.method: 对实例级成功概率拟合Beta混合分布(边际极大似然,BIC定阶);由单次拟合闭式给出任意horizon的Pass^k与AUC@k;用delta方法推导这些指标与Pass@k的置信区间,无需额外模型调用;将"配置"而非"任务"视为实例以扩展到敏感度分析。
AI.result: 在竞赛数学与研究生级科学基准上,外推超出观测试验数时混合先验估计比朴素估计更准确,置信区间覆盖全数据参考;以prompt为实例时,比无外部协变量的IRT基线更准确估计prompt敏感度分布。
AI.conclusion: Beta混合框架统一支持多类评测指标的外推与不确定度量化,显著节省采样;但当试验数已达目标horizon时,直接估计仍更优。

title: Stochastic learning flow: moment equations for stochastic gradient descent at finite step size
summary: Analytical theories of learning in deep networks often assume gradient flow, discarding the finite step size and batch noise of stochastic gradient descent (SGD). Starting from the discrete update, we derive continuous-time equations for the mean and covariance of the parameter distribution under a Gaussian closure for a general stochastic learning, to first order in the learning rate $η$. Applying these stochastic learning flow (SLF) equations to SGD, we show that the mean descends an effective loss regularized by the covariance and loss curvature, while the covariance, unlike in stochastic differential equation approximations, becomes unstable at curvature $2/η$. In SGD ensembles of linear and nonlinear networks, SLF predicts learning curves and mean trajectories more accurately than gradient flow and captures the covariance dynamics, failing where the parameter distribution becomes strongly non-Gaussian. In the full-batch limit, the edge of stability corresponds to a stationary point of the coupled sharpness-covariance dynamics, recovering self-stabilization and central flow, and batch-to-batch curvature fluctuations lower this threshold under SGD.

AI.tldr: 论文从离散SGD更新出发，在Gaussian closure下推导参数分布均值与协方差的连续时间方程（至学习率η一阶），提出Stochastic Learning Flow (SLF)，用以更准确地刻画有限步长与批次噪声下的深层网络学习动力学。
AI.motivation: 现有深度网络学习的解析理论多假设梯度流，丢弃了SGD的有限步长和批次噪声，因此无法刻画协方差动力学与稳定性边界等离散效应。
AI.method: 从离散更新出发，对一般随机学习在Gaussian closure下推导均值与协方差的连续时间方程，保留η一阶项；将其应用于SGD，分析均值下降的有效损失（由协方差与损失曲率正则化）及协方差在曲率2/η处的不稳定性，并在线性与非线性网络的SGD ensemble上验证。
AI.result: SLF比梯度流更准确地预测学习曲线与均值轨迹，并能捕捉协方差动力学；在参数分布强非高斯时失效。全批次极限下，稳定性边缘对应于耦合的sharpness–covariance动力学的驻点，恢复self-stabilization与central flow；批次间曲率波动在SGD下降低该阈值。
AI.conclusion: SLF为SGD学习提供了保留有限步长与噪声效应的解析框架，统一解释了有效正则化、协方差不稳定性和稳定性边缘现象，但受限于Gaussian closure假设。

title: Modern Software Engineering with Verification Agents: A Spec-First Architecture for Autonomous Synthesis, Verification IRs, and Organizational Scale
summary: When autonomous coding agents synthesize implementation code, formal specifications, and mechanical proofs simultaneously, the software engineering hierarchy inverts: the formal specification becomes the primary human-reviewed artifact, while source code and proof scripts become disposable build outputs. This paper presents an end-to-end architecture for agent-authored, formally verified software engineering. First, we establish a logic-agnostic foundation combining a spec-first stack inversion, a zero-code-review workflow gated by automated continuous integration (CI) checks, and a minimal Verification Intermediate Representation (VIR) lowered via a thin, verified translator. Second, we pair an extensional Computational Type Theory (CTT) specification layer with Higher-Order Abstract Syntax (HOAS) and linear resource typing in the VIR--eliminating rewrite friction for synthesis agents while defining an experiment, its protocol frozen before the first reader, to measure whether removing boundary coercions improves human specification readability. Third, we scale collaboration across multi-team organizations using Personal Spec-Copilots and a Shared Synthesis Fleet that detects cross-team Semantic Merge Conflicts and fuses modular contracts into zero-copy binaries. We illustrate this architecture on a zero-copy authenticated message router and distinguish our existing empirical baselines (salt, SaltBench, x86lean, and MetaPRL) from newly proposed components.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向智能体编写、形式化验证的软件工程端到端架构：以规范为核心的构建反转、零代码审查CI门控、极简VIR与已验证翻译器，并用线性资源类型与HOAS降低合成摩擦、支持跨团队语义合并与零拷贝构建。
AI.motivation: 当自主编码智能体同时生成实现代码、形式化规范与机器证明时，传统"代码为主、规范为辅"的软件工程层级发生反转，亟需一套以规范为中心、可由CI自动门控、适配多团队协作的整体架构。
AI.method: 1) 逻辑无关的规范优先栈反转 + 零代码审查的CI门控工作流 + 通过薄且已验证的翻译器下译的极简验证中间表示（VIR）；2) 将外延计算类型论（CTT）规范层与HOAS及线性资源类型在VIR中配对；3) 预注册实验测量去除边界强制转换对规范可读性的影响；4) 个人Spec-Copilot与共享合成集群检测跨团队语义合并冲突并融合模块化契约为零拷贝二进制。
AI.result: 在零拷贝认证消息路由器上示例化该架构，并区分既有实证基线（salt、SaltBench、x86lean、MetaPRL）与新提出的组件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为智能体作者化的形式化验证软件工程勾勒出完整架构蓝图，规范成为主要人工审查对象、代码与证明脚本成为可废弃构建产物，并给出可检验的读性实验与组织级协作方案。

title: Dhārā Bench: An Evidence-Oriented Retrieval Benchmark for Indian Knowledge Systems
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. The first two authors contributed equally. Code and data: https://github.com/Avinash2236/Dhara-Bench
summary: Dhārā Bench is a retrieval benchmark for Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS), with 325 questions in 12 categories and 60,121 text chunks from 15 source groups. The categories were developed based on 4,500 questions submitted to the Dhārā application; the evaluation set combines corpus-aligned application queries with expert-contributed questions. The annotations comprise 7,578 question-chunk relevance links involving 6,847 distinct corpus chunks. For 34 composite and multi-hop questions, 401 conjugate groups specify alternative sets of passages that jointly support each question. Chunk identifiers and hierarchical references connect the judgments to their source texts. The paper describes corpus preparation, annotation, and validation, and reports a fixed BM25 baseline implemented with Pyserini with $k_1=0.9$ and $b=0.4$. Across all questions, BM25 achieves MRR@20 of 0.315, Recall@10 of 0.182, and nDCG@10 of 0.205. On the group-annotated subset, complete-evidence scores are CE_Recall@20 = 0.294 and CE_MRR@20 = 0.141. The category results expose particularly weak verse retrieval, while group scores reveal gaps between finding individual passages and completing their support. The corpus and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/Avinash2236/Dhara-Bench.

AI.tldr: Dhārā Bench 是面向印度知识体系（IKS）的检索基准，含 325 题、12 类、15 个来源组的 60,121 个文本块，并公布 BM25 基线结果。
AI.motivation: 印度知识体系缺乏面向真实应用查询的检索评测资源，需要可溯源、可验证的基准来评估检索系统在传统文本上的表现。
AI.method: 类别源自 Dhārā 应用提交的 4,500 个真实问题，评测集混合语料对齐的应用查询与专家命题；构建 7,578 条问题-块相关性标注（涉及 6,847 个不同块），并对 34 个复合/多跳问题用 401 个共轭组标注可联合支撑的替代段落集；块 ID 与层级引用实现标注到原文的溯源。报告基于 Pyserini 的固定 BM25（k1=0.9, b=0.4）基线。
AI.result: 全量问题上 BM25 的 MRR@20=0.315、Recall@10=0.182、nDCG@10=0.205；组标注子集上 CE_Recall@20=0.294、CE_MRR@20=0.141。分类结果中诗句（verse）检索尤其弱，组分数揭示"找到单个段落"与"完整凑齐支撑证据"之间存在差距。
AI.conclusion: Dhārā Bench 提供了一个可溯源、含多跳证据分组标注的 IKS 检索基准，基线显示现有稀疏检索在诗句与多证据完整召回上明显不足；语料与评测代码已开源。

title: What Breaks and What Comes Back: Capability Damage and Recovery in Depth-Pruned Small Language Models
summary: Depth pruning removes whole Transformer blocks to make a language model smaller and faster, but the damage is not spread evenly across what the model can do, and a short fine-tuning run, called healing, decides what comes back. We measure this for small models used as agents. Four instruction-tuned models of 1.2-1.7B parameters (Llama-3.2-1B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and OLMo-2-1B) are pruned and healed, and six capabilities are tracked: structured output, function calling, instruction following, mathematical reasoning, safety refusal and knowledge. Three results hold across the families. First, function calling and math collapse in every model (retention 0.00-0.07 of the unpruned score), and the order in which capabilities break agrees closely across the four (Kendall's W = 0.92; 0.62 after correcting for chance floors). Second, which parameters are trained matters as much as which data: fully tuning the last three blocks instead of adding low-rank adapters to all blocks costs up to 0.18 in capped mean retention on three families, and one 300k-token pilot per scope detects this. Third, we test a planner that allocates a 1M-token healing budget from 21 short pilot heals. At a fixed budget it raises the weakest capability on two families, although only one of these gains survives a test that also resamples training seeds. Once its 3.48M pilot tokens are counted, uniform healing with the same total number of training tokens matches or beats every planned variant on every family and retains math significantly better on three of them in an item-level test (on one when seeds are also resampled). Healing longer is a strong and simple baseline that planned recovery must beat. Code, per-item predictions and every result are public.

AI.tldr: 本文系统测量了深度剪枝+短时"healing"微调对小型agent模型六项能力的影响：函数调用与数学能力在四个模型族中一致崩溃，且微调哪些参数比用哪些数据同样重要；所提出的基于21次试运行的预算分配规划器未能在计入试运行开销后击败同等训练量的均匀healing基线。
AI.motivation: 深度剪枝虽能加速模型，但损伤在各能力上分布不均，而短时healing决定哪些能力恢复。现有工作缺乏对小模型agent能力的系统测量，也不清楚healing中"调哪些参数"与"用哪些数据"的相对重要性，以及预算分配规划是否真有价值。
AI.method: 对四个指令微调模型（Llama-3.2-1B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、SmolLM2-1.7B、OLMo-2-1B）做剪枝与healing，追踪六项能力（结构化输出、函数调用、指令遵循、数学推理、安全拒答、知识）；比较全量微调最后三个块 与 全块加LoRA两种参数作用域；并用21次短试运行（每次30万token）训练一个规划器分配100万token healing预算，与均匀healing基线对比。
AI.result: 四族均出现函数调用与数学崩溃（保留率0.00–0.07），能力退化顺序高度一致（Kendall's W=0.92，校正偶然下限后0.62）。全量微调最后三块在三个族上比全块LoRA最多高0.18的截断平均保留率，每次30万token的试运行即可检测到该差异。规划器在固定预算下能提升两族中最弱能力，但仅一项增益在重采训练种子的检验中存活；计入348万试运行token后，同等训练量的均匀healing在所有族上持平或更优，并在三族（重采种子时一族）的逐项检验中显著更好地保留数学能力。
AI.conclusion: healing的损伤结构跨模型族可预测，参数作用域选择与数据同等重要；更长时间均匀healing是一个强而简单的基线，任何规划式恢复方法必须先击败它，而本文的规划器在计入试运行成本后未能做到。

title: ReactionBench: A Human-Anchored Benchmark for Modeling Reactions to Video
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents (IAEval). 49 pages (10 main text), 9 figures, 46 tables. Project page: https://yibozh.github.io/ReactionBench-page/
summary: Understanding what happens in a video is not sufficient for socially responsive multimodal systems: such systems also aim to relate what a person observes to how that person responds. Existing video benchmarks largely evaluate events, temporal reasoning, or people depicted in the video, while affective and viewer-response datasets often focus on emotion labels, aggregate responses, or prediction from the stimulus alone. This leaves an underexplored question: can current multimodal models ground an observed viewer reaction in the stimulus context associated with it? We introduce ReactionBench, a human-anchored benchmark for reaction-specific video understanding. Built from a candidate pool of 31,834 synchronized stimulus-reaction clips spanning 433 hours and eight domains, ReactionBench evaluates three complementary abilities: ranking the intensity of a viewer's reactions within a video, matching a reaction to its temporally aligned stimulus, and explaining the concrete stimulus cues linked to that reaction. Human annotation provides 14,894 ratings over 3,257 moments, and the frozen evaluation comprises 250 intensity profiles, 112 matching items, and 200 rationale items with 447 blind-written human references. Across seven multimodal models, reaction-specific grounding remains challenging: the best model reaches 50.9% accuracy on four-way stimulus-reaction matching, while GPT-5 shows no detectable loss under reaction substitution. Performance is also sensitive to evaluation protocol. Project page: https://yibozh.github.io/ReactionBench-page/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReactionBench，一个人本位的反应特异性视频理解基准，评估模型能否将观众的观察反应锚定到对应刺激语境中。
AI.motivation: 现有视频基准多评测事件、时序推理或视频中人物，而情感/观众反应数据集多聚焦情绪标签、聚合反应或仅从刺激预测，缺少"模型能否把观察到的观众反应归因于相关刺激语境"这一问题的评测。
AI.method: 构建候选池包含31,834段同步刺激-反应片段（433小时、8个领域）；设计三项互补任务：视频内反应强度排序、反应与时间对齐刺激的匹配、解释反应相关的具体刺激线索；人工标注14,894条评分覆盖3,257个时刻，冻结评测集含250个强度档案、112个匹配项、200个理由项及447条盲写人工参考；评测7个多模态模型。
AI.result: 反应特异性接地仍具挑战：最佳模型在四选一刺激-反应匹配上仅50.9%准确率；GPT-5在反应替换下无可见性能损失；性能对评测协议敏感。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型在将观众反应归因于刺激语境方面能力不足，ReactionBench为反应特异性视频理解提供了人本位评测平台，并揭示了协议敏感性等评测设计问题。

title: Swap, Replicate, Read the Mass: A Protocol for Auditing Demographic Bias in System One Decision Models
summary: System One decision models replace text generation with typed, probability-scored answers and are entering production. Answers execute without a person in the loop, and no multi-model audit exists on established bias benchmarks. We provide that audit: three benchmarks: BBQ (all eleven categories), CrowS-Pairs, and SilverSpoon, adapted to the typed interface, twelve models plus a no-thinking ablation, and 1,638,000 decisions. Every order-sensitive item runs twice with options swapped; native typed models also swap labels; ten configurations repeat under extra seeds and batch 16. We find widespread stereotype alignment, order-dependent answers, and confidence that tracks instability rather than bias. In BBQ, 97 of 143 model-by-category scores are significant and 94 aligned, while the commercial reference abstains on 99.5% of ambiguous items, hiding aligned probability mass. Option swaps flip 0.0% to 72.6% of choices; typed scoring stays below 10% except Laya (22-33%), and untuned letter prompting reaches 73%. CrowS-Pairs preference spans 0.496 to 0.816, and boolean answers can be decided by position (1.00 versus 0.005). SilverSpoon judgments shift toward lower-SES labels in five of eight decision models, inherited from the 9B backbone or induced by tuning. Audits must permute options and reverse questions by default; order-invariant scoring should become a procurement requirement.

AI.tldr: 对12个系统一决策模型（含无思考消融）在BBQ、CrowS-Pairs、SilverSpoon三基准上完成163.8万次决策的偏见审计，发现刻板印象对齐、顺序敏感与置信度错位普遍存在。
AI.motivation: 系统一决策模型以带概率分数的类型化答案替代文本生成并已进入生产，答案无人复核，而现有偏见基准上尚无多模型审计。
AI.method: 将三基准（BBQ全部11类、CrowS-Pairs、SilverSpoon=适配为类型化接口；评估12模型+无思考消融，共163.8万决策；所有顺序敏感项换项双跑，原生类型化模型另做标签互换，10种配置多随机种子与batch 16复测。
AI.result: BBQ中143个模型×类别分数有97个显著、94个对齐刻板印象；商用参考模型对99.5%模糊项弃答而掩盖对齐概率质量。换项翻转率0.0%–72.6%，类型化打分多在10%以下（Laya 22–33%），未调优字母提示达73%。CrowS-Pairs偏好0.496–0.816，布尔答案可被位置决定（1.00 vs 0.005）。SilverSpoon在8个决策模型中5个偏向低SES标签，源自9B骨干或被微调诱导。
AI.conclusion: 审计须默认置换选项与反转问题，顺序不变性打分应成为采购硬性要求。

title: Ensemble Classification and Cancer-Specific Gene Signatures from Quality-Aware Hybrid Gene Selection in TCGA RNA-Seq data
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables and 1 supplementary file
summary: Gene-expression classifiers of cancer type are usually developed and validated within one cohort using random splits. Starting from a quality-aware hybrid Boruta selector from earlier work, we developed and evaluated ensemble classifiers and cancer-specific gene signatures. Using 10,469 TCGA tumours of 33 types, we compared five learners and three ensembles under decision rules fixed in advance, reran the selection in site-grouped cross-validation, transferred a breast-cancer subtype panel to 3273 tumours of the independent SCAN-B cohort, and built five-gene stage~I tumour versus adjacent-normal panels for nine cancer types. Logistic regression (LR) was the most accurate and best-calibrated single learner (balanced accuracy 0.943 on the locked test set). Stacking added at most 0.006 with 1000 genes but improved on LR in every fold with a minimal 100-gene panel; a hierarchical model did not reduce within-group confusion. Site-grouped validation lowered balanced accuracy by 0.027, almost entirely in colon and rectal cancer (0.008 without them and the untestable LAML). On SCAN-B, the subtype panel reached 0.855, close to the 50 PAM50 genes (0.876). Stage~I panels reached ROC AUC >= 0.99 in held-out patients and detected most later-stage tumours. Ensembles help most with a minimal panel; with 1000 genes, a calibrated linear model suffices.

AI.tldr: 基于质量感知混合Boruta选择器，在TCGA 33种肿瘤1万余样本上系统比较了5种学习器和3种集成策略，并跨队列验证了乳腺亚型与I期肿瘤signature，结论：小基因panel时集成有益，1000基因时校准的线性模型足够。
AI.motivation: 现有癌症类型基因表达分类器多在同一队列内随机划分开发与验证，缺乏对特征选择质量、集成方法、站点效应等实际部署相关因素的严格固定规则比较与跨队列迁移评估。
AI.method: 以质量感知混合Boruta选择器为前置；使用TCGA 10,469例33类肿瘤，按预设决策规则比较5种学习器与3种集成，采用site-grouped交叉验证重跑选择，将乳腺癌亚型panel迁移至独立SCAN-B队列（3273例），并为9种癌症构建五基因的I期肿瘤vs癌旁正常panel。
AI.result: LR为最准确且校准最好的单一学习器（锁定测试集平衡准确率0.943）；stacking在1000基因下最多提升0.006，但在最小100基因panel下每一折均优于LR；层次模型未减少组内混淆；site-grouped验证使平衡准确率降0.027，几乎全部来自结肠与直肠癌（剔除后仅0.008）；SCAN-B上亚型panel达0.855，接近50基因PAM50的0.876；I期panel在留出患者中ROC AUC≥0.99且可检出多数晚期肿瘤。
AI.conclusion: 基因panel极小时集成方法收益最大；基因数达1000时，经过校准的线性模型即已足够；站点效应主要集中于少数癌症类型，需分组验证以反映真实泛化能力。

title: Trustworthy Execution of Industrial Agents
summary: Industrial agents increasingly modify persistent engineering objects rather than merely generate answers. Authentication and successful calls cannot establish whether intended changes occurred, evidence supports a conclusion, or historical results remain applicable. We present a framework for trustworthy industrial-agent execution within a single enterprise governance domain. Eight control domains assign responsibilities across authority, planning, composition, tool execution, actual effects, evidence, baseline and use governance, and recovery and evolution. A four-plane architecture and three control chains connect these responsibilities through typed objects and version-bound interfaces. The specification separates tool returns from actual engineering effects, evidence coverage from engineering judgment, and historical lifecycle state from current applicability. Multi-agent handoffs are an architectural extension examined through deterministic interface tests. Distinct prototypes examine selected mechanisms using conformance tests, ablations, uncertainty stress, CAD/CAE execution, and local persistence. An OpenFOAM fixture produces COMPLETE coverage with FAIL judgment; an expired-job case requires readmission despite completed computation. CAD and recovery counterexamples expose omitted mandatory checks, discarded negative facts, and inconsistent producer-consumer mappings. Targeted repairs support local regression conclusions. The reported 0/29 hazardous commits measure closed-set specification conformance, not a safety probability. We distinguish the complete framework, implemented paths, and empirical evidence, identifying check-inventory completeness and cross-module fact preservation as prerequisites for extending these results.

AI.tldr: 提出面向工业智能体可信执行的治理框架，含八个控制域、四平面架构和三条控制链，区分工具返回与实际工程效果、证据覆盖与工程判断、历史状态与当前适用性，并用原型与反例测试验证局部机制。
AI.motivation: 工业智能体越来越多地直接修改持久化工程对象，而不仅仅是生成答案；认证和调用成功并不能证明预期变更发生、证据足以支持结论或历史结果仍然适用，缺乏可信执行保障。
AI.method: 在单一企业治理域内构建框架：八个控制域分配权威、规划、组合、工具执行、实际效果、证据、基线与使用治理、恢复与演化等职责；四平面架构与三条控制链通过类型化对象和版本绑定接口连接；多个原型以一致性测试、消融、不确定性压力测试、CAD/CAE执行与本地持久化检验具体机制。
AI.result: OpenFOAM 夹具出现 COMPLETE 覆盖但 FAIL 判断；过期作业案例虽计算完成仍需重新准入；CAD 与恢复反例暴露遗漏的强制检查、被丢弃的负事实及不一致的生产者—消费者映射；定向修复支持局部回归结论。报告的 0/29 危险提交仅为闭集规范一致性度量，不是安全概率。
AI.conclusion: 论文区分了完整框架、已实现路径与实证证据，指出检查清单完整性与跨模块事实保留是推广这些结果的前提。

title: Diverse-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation generates the semantic ID (SID) of the next item from a user's interaction history. Existing training objectives mainly supervise target SID tokens, while on-policy distillation (OPD) provides denser supervision through a teacher's probability distribution over all tokens for more effective and efficient training. However, OPD can aggravate popularity bias: teacher feedback favors popular-item tokens, transferring this preference to the student, while student rollout favors popular items, leaving unpopular-item SID paths rarely generated and supervised. These two sources of bias reinforce each other and reduce recommendation diversity. We propose HERO, a diversity-aware OPD framework. Heterogeneous teacher distillation trains two teachers specializing in popular and unpopular items and routes each training sample to the teacher matching the popularity group of its ground-truth item. The student learns from the routed teacher's probability distribution along its own generated SIDs. Diversity-aware item rollout incorporates ground-truth SIDs of unpopular items into training, covering SID paths that the student rarely generates. Only the student is used for inference. Offline experiments on an industrial dataset and three public datasets further demonstrate its effectiveness, diversity, and robustness. Moreover, we deploy HERO in the "Guess What You Like" module on the 1688 homepage, where a 15-day online A/B test shows a 3.412% increase in gross merchandise value (GMV).

AI.tldr: HERO是一个多样性感知的在线策略蒸馏(OPD)生成式推荐框架，通过异质教师蒸馏和多样性感知的item rollout缓解流行度偏差，提升推荐多样性并已在1688首页上线带来GMV提升。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐主要监督目标SID token，OPD虽提供更密集的监督信号，但会加剧流行度偏差：教师反馈偏向热门item token并将此偏好迁移给学生，同时学生rollout也偏向热门item，导致冷门item的SID路径很少被生成和监督，两种偏差相互强化，降低推荐多样性。
AI.method: 提出HERO框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 异质教师蒸馏——训练分别专精热门与冷门item的两个教师，根据每条样本ground-truth item的流行度分组将其路由到匹配的教师，学生沿自身生成的SID学习所路由教师的概率分布；(2) 多样性感知item rollout——将冷门item的ground-truth SID注入训练，覆盖学生很少生成的SID路径。推理阶段仅使用学生模型。
AI.result: 在工业数据集和三个公开数据集上的离线实验验证了方法的有效性、多样性和鲁棒性；在1688首页“猜你喜欢”模块部署并进行了15天在线A/B测试，GMV提升3.412%。
AI.conclusion: HERO通过异质教师路由与多样性感知rollout有效缓解OPD带来的流行度偏差强化问题，在保持推荐效果的同时提升多样性，并已在真实工业场景取得显著商业收益。

title: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
summary: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results. To quantify estimation error, we derive an accurate analytical approximation to the error distribution when estimating full-benchmark scores from a subset, showing that most subsets yield small errors, while a few produce much larger errors, resulting in a long-tailed distribution. This means random sampling alone can achieve surprisingly strong performance with high probability, but remains unstable due to rare large errors. We further show that this instability is inherent to modern foundation models and persists even as more models are evaluated. Based on these findings, we introduce BestRand, a stable and low-cost benchmark compression method that preserves the efficiency of random sampling while substantially reducing its high-error tail. We validate BestRand on 70+ text, multimodal, and agent benchmarks, and further extend it to VLA evaluation. Compared with competitive methods, BestRand reduces high-error risk by 50.2% and estimation error by 16.4% on average, while requiring only 51.3% of the construction cost. It further reduces OOD estimation error by 21.8% on average across score-range, model-family, and temporal shifts. Together, our theory provides practical guidance for understanding and predicting the accuracy and reliability of benchmark compression, while BestRand enables stable and accurate compression at low cost. The code and data are publicly available onhttps://github.com/George-Ling3/BestRand.

AI.tldr: 论文通过误差分布分析揭示benchmark压缩中随机采样的长尾不稳定问题，并提出低成本稳定的BestRand方法。
AI.motivation: 完整benchmark评测模型耗时耗资巨大，需用小规模子集近似全benchmark分数；但子集估计误差（尤其罕见大误差）导致结果不稳定，其误差分布规律及可预测性尚不清晰。
AI.method: 推导子集估计全benchmark分数时误差分布的解析近似，证明误差呈长尾分布；分析该不稳定性在现代基础模型中的固有性；提出BestRand——保留随机采样效率、同时削减高误差尾部的方法，并在70+文本/多模态/agent benchmark及VLA评测上验证。
AI.result: 相比竞争方法，BestRand将高误差风险降低50.2%、估计误差平均降低16.4%，构建成本仅为51.3%；在分数范围、模型家族、时间漂移等OOD场景下估计误差平均降低21.8%。
AI.conclusion: 理论为理解和预测benchmark压缩的准确性与可靠性提供实用指导，BestRand实现低成本、稳定且准确的压缩，代码与数据已公开。

title: SIMIT: Self-Improving Vision-Language Models via Imagination at Test-Time
summary: We introduce SIMIT, a test-time self-improvement framework in which a vision-language model creates its own query-specific training data before answering an unlabeled test query. Our goal is to improve performance on a given target test set without annotations or external models. To pursue this goal, some test-time methods improve answers through longer reasoning or repeated sampling but leave the model unchanged. Others update the model using rewards based on majority agreement among multiple candidate answers or the model's own judgments of correctness, but such rewards can reinforce existing mistakes. SIMIT instead imagines similar problems whose solutions it controls: a model need not correctly solve the target query to construct useful practice examples. It synthesizes diverse (question, answer, image) triplets by specifying each answer before realizing its image. To support diverse multimodal tasks, SIMIT combines native image generation with an extensible skill library for structured visuals, including documents, charts, and diagrams. Within this pipeline, multi-stage verification checks that images support their assigned answers, while difficulty filtering retains informative examples. Adaptive budgeting further targets this practice by allocating more samples to queries the model is less confident in answering. The resulting data can improve the model in-context (SIMIT-ICL) or in-weight (SIMIT-FT). Across 17 diverse benchmarks, SIMIT outperforms existing self-improvement methods. Its best configuration achieves a +7.20% mean relative gain over BAGEL-7B, while training-free SIMIT-ICL achieves +6.98%.

AI.tldr: SIMIT是一个测试时自我改进框架，让视觉语言模型在回答无标签测试查询前，自行合成查询相关的（问题、答案、图像）训练数据；其ICL和FT两种变体在17个基准上分别取得+6.98%和+7.20%的平均相对提升。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时方法要么只靠更长推理或重复采样而不改变模型，要么用多数投票/自评判奖励更新模型，容易强化已有错误；且无需标注或外部模型即可在目标测试集上提升。
AI.method: 先指定答案再生成对应图像，合成多样（问题、答案、图像）三元组，无需先正确解出目标查询；结合原生图像生成与可扩展技能库（文档、图表、示意图等结构化视觉）；采用多阶段验证确保图像支持给定答案、难度过滤保留有信息量样本，并按模型置信度自适应分配预算；产物可用于SIMIT-ICL（上下文）或SIMIT-FT（权重）。
AI.result: 在17个多样基准上优于现有自我改进方法；最佳配置相对BAGEL-7B平均相对提升+7.20%，免训练的SIMIT-ICL为+6.98%。
AI.conclusion: 通过自造可控标签的练习数据而非依赖不可靠的自奖励，SIMIT为视觉语言模型提供了有效、可训练-free或微调的测试时自我提升路径。

title: Robustness Starts with the Objective: Designing and Certifying Robust LLM-Generated Heuristics
summary:
LLMs are increasingly used to design heuristics for computer systems. However, most synthesis frameworks evaluate candidates by their average performance, which can mask severe regressions on specific workloads. Even adding adversarial training inputs doesn't eliminate these regressions, and percentile objectives (e.g., optimizing for the 95th percentile) overlook how severe regressions can be beyond the selected threshold.
  We present TAILOR, a framework that guides LLM synthesis using the Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) of the cost difference between each candidate and an existing baseline on the same workload. This paired CVaR measures the average difference over the worst fraction of workloads. We show that a negative paired CVaR guarantees improvements in both average performance and tail optimality gap relative to the unknown optimum, without ever computing that optimum.
  We find that TAILOR achieves the best mean--tail trade-off among the synthesis objectives we evaluate across three case studies: Azure GPU batch admission, Azure VM packing, and server placement. Tested across seven diverse optimization benchmarks, TAILOR produces heuristics that are certified with 99% confidence to improve both average performance and tail optimality gaps over the baseline in six of them. On these six benchmarks, TAILOR also outperforms known robust, human-designed alternatives in the tail while achieving better or comparable average-performance improvement over the baseline.

AI.tldr: TAILOR 用候选与基线成本差的成对 CVaR 引导 LLM 合成启发式算法，在均值与尾部性能间取得更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 启发式合成多按平均性能评估，会掩盖特定负载上的严重退化；加入对抗训练样本无法消除退化，而百分位目标（如 95 分位）又忽略阈值之外的严重退化。
AI.method: 提出 TAILOR，基于同一负载上候选与现有基线的成本差的条件风险价值（paired CVaR）指导 LLM 合成，即在最差部分负载上的平均差异；并证明负的成对 CVaR 可保证平均性能与相对未知最优的尾部最优性差距同时改善，且无需计算该最优值。
AI.result: 在 Azure GPU 批处理准入、Azure 虚拟机装箱、服务器放置三个案例中取得最佳均值—尾部权衡；在七个优化基准中，有六个的启发式被 99% 置信度证明在平均性能和尾部最优性差距上均优于基线，且尾部优于已知鲁棒的人工设计方法，均值提升相当或更好。
AI.conclusion: 以成对 CVaR 为目标可有效抑制 LLM 合成启发式的尾部退化，兼顾均值与尾部表现，是一种可靠的合成评估与优化准则。

title: Where Causal Discovery Breaks on Real Data: Measuring the Assumptions One Property at a Time
summary: Causal discovery is usually evaluated on simulators or on systems whose ground truth follows from physics or design. When it fails on other real data, the failure is attributed to assumptions that may not hold, but which ones fail, and by how much, is rarely measured. We measure the observable properties of the data they bear on, one property at a time, on a real panel. The case study follows 2,901 US public firms over 31 quarters, with 71 types of corporate action from SEC 8-K filings, 11 financial-statement items, and an expert graph over 651 action-state pairs. The panel breaks measurable requirements of discovery: tails that survive winsorisation, balance-sheet items and revenue close to random walks, and interventions too rare to detect effects of a tenth of a standard deviation in 40 of 71 actions. Even so, a marginal test ranks expert-labelled direct above not-direct pairs within each action (AUROC 0.658) better than every null we built, so the panel does carry information about which pairs are direct. Tuned discovery methods, in configurations feasible at this panel size, recover less of it than a simple pairwise cross-correlation when pairs are ranked within each action, and no more when they are ranked within each target, which removes what the target alone predicts. Most direct pairs (132 of 222) involve actions below the support needed for 80% power against a 0.1-SD effect. For flow targets, conditioning on the target's other expert-labelled parents, often filed alongside the action, erodes the marginal discrimination, and most not-direct associations survive it: even with the graph's parent sets supplied, the expected separation does not emerge. For each property, we give a diagnostic computable before any discovery method is run.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在真实面板数据上逐一测量因果发现所依赖的可检验数据性质，以2901家美国上市公司31个季度、71类8-K公司行动与11项财务报表为案例，发现面板破坏多项发现假设，但边际检验仍携带直接性信息（AUROC 0.658），且调优方法不如简单两两互相关；并为每种性质提供运行前可计算的诊断。
AI.motivation: 因果发现方法常在模拟器或物理/设计上有真值的系统上评估；在真实数据上失败时通常归因于"假设不成立"，但具体哪些假设失败、失败程度如何，很少被实际测量。
AI.method: 在真实面板数据上逐性质测量：2901家美国上市公司、31季度，71类SEC 8-K公司行动、11项财务报表项目，以及651个行动-状态对的专家图。检验尾部稳健性、随机游走特性、干预稀有度（对0.1 SD效应的检验力），并比较边际检验、两两互相关与调优因果发现方法（按行动内与目标内排名），以及控制目标的专家父节点后的条件分离。
AI.result: 面板破坏多项可测要求：经缩尾后仍非正态尾、资产负债与营收近似随机游走、71类行动中40类干预过稀无法检测0.1 SD效应。但边际检验在行动内将专家标为直接的对排在非直接对之上（AUROC 0.658），优于所有零模型；调优发现在此规模可行配置下恢复的信息不如简单两两互相关；222个直接对中132个涉及检验力不足的行动；对流量类目标，控制其他专家父节点后边际区分被侵蚀，大多数非直接关联仍存留，即使提供专家父集也无预期分离。
AI.conclusion: 该面板确实携带关于哪些对为直接的信息，但多数因果发现假设在此规模下失败，调优方法并未优于简单互相关；作者为每种数据性质给出可在任何发现方法运行前计算的诊断，以量化假设失败程度。

title: APG: Agentic Static-Analysis Infrastructure on LLVM-IR Graph Databases
summary: LLM-based coding agents increasingly rely on external program knowledge, yet access to static-analysis graphs alone does not ensure appropriate operation selection or evidence interpretation. We present APG, an infrastructure for semantics-grounded static program analysis. Built on SVF and LLVM, it decomposes compiler-derived program analyses into atomic capabilities that LLM agents can select, compose, and orchestrate for goal-directed, cross-graph investigation, with query safeguards and evidence traces preserving inspectable results and provenance. APG provides 38 atomic capabilities. On analysis requests arising during benchmark repair runs, 35 achieve first-attempt query-generation success rates above 50%, including 13 at 100%. Evaluation on 812 C/C++ defects shows higher repair success than the evaluated baselines. Compared with Passive Graph Push, APG improves first-iteration repair success by 17.6 and 18.0 percentage points on the two benchmark collections and reduces average LLM input-token consumption by 90.8%. Our tool is available at https://github.com/JasonZhongZexin/APG-ICSE-Demo and its demonstration video at https://youtu.be/vkuExZUjGnw

AI.tldr: 提出APG，一种语义接地的静态程序分析基础设施，将编译器派生分析分解为LLM智能体可选取、组合与编排的原子能力，在C/C++缺陷修复上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: LLM编码智能体日益依赖外部程序知识，但仅有静态分析图的访问权并不能保证其选择合适的操作或正确解释证据。
AI.method: 基于SVF与LLVM，将程序分析分解为38个原子能力，支持智能体按目标选择、组合、编排进行跨图调查，并提供查询防护与证据追踪以保留结果可检视性与来源。
AI.result: 在基准修复运行中的分析请求上，38个能力中35个首次查询生成成功率超50%（13个达100%）；812个C/C++缺陷上修复成功率高于所评估基线；相比被动图推送，两套基准集合首轮修复成功率分别提升17.6与18.0个百分点，LLM输入token消耗平均降低90.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将静态分析能力原子化并交由LLM智能体编排，可在提升修复效果的同时大幅降低token开销，工具已开源并提供演示视频。

title: SpatialVec: A Unified Representation Learning Framework for Geospatial Objects with Boundary-Aware Sampling
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data as a full research paper
summary: Spatial representation learning is essential for Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) applications, enabling machine learning models to capture the geometry, location, and spatial relationships of geographic entities such as points, polylines, and polygons. Existing spatial encoding methods often struggle to preserve fine-grained topological information, particularly for interactions involving complex geometries such as polylines and polygons. These approaches inadequately capture boundary structure and local spatial context, causing topology-sensitive relationships near geometry boundaries to be underrepresented in the learned embedding space. Consequently, accurately modeling complex spatial interactions remains a significant challenge for downstream spatial reasoning tasks. To fill the gap, we introduce SpatialVec, a boundary-aware spatial representation learning framework that adaptively samples geometry boundaries and their surrounding regions, capturing fine-grained geometric structures critical for topology-aware spatial reasoning. A transformer-based encoder-decoder trained through geometry reconstruction produces compact, geometry-aware, and unified representations for points, polylines, and polygons. Empirical evaluation on two real-world datasets shows that SpatialVec substantially improves the preservation of challenging topological relationships involving polygonal interactions and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines significantly on downstream prediction and classification tasks.

AI.tldr: SpatialVec 是一个边界感知的空间表示学习框架，通过自适应采样几何边界及其邻域，并用基于 Transformer 的编码器-解码器经几何重建训练，为点、线、面统一生成紧凑且几何感知的嵌入，显著提升拓扑敏感关系的保留与下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有空间编码方法难以保留细粒度拓扑信息，尤其是折线与多边形等复杂几何的交互；对边界结构和局部空间上下文建模不足，导致几何边界附近拓扑敏感关系在嵌入空间中被弱化，影响下游空间推理任务。
AI.method: 提出 SpatialVec 框架：自适应采样几何边界及其周围区域以捕获细粒度几何结构；采用基于 Transformer 的编码器-解码器架构，通过几何重建任务进行训练，从而为点、折线、多边形生成紧凑、几何感知且统一的表征。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，SpatialVec 显著提升了对多边形交互等困难拓扑关系的保留能力，并在下游预测与分类任务上显著优于现有最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: SpatialVec 通过边界感知采样与重建式表征学习有效弥补了复杂几何拓扑建模的不足，为拓扑感知的空间推理提供了统一且高效的表示方案。

title: S1CogBench: What System One Decision Models Can and Cannot Do on Cognitive Experiments
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code at https://github.com/dengzhe-hou/S1CogBench
summary: Language models are no longer used only to generate text. Software also asks them for decisions, in routing, guardrails, and automated gates. System One decision models, also called typed decision models, such as Jev and Laya, return one fast decision over the legal options, leaving no text to inspect. However, a fast, well-formed decision does not show that the model used the evidence. Cognitive experiments can test this, because they vary task demands and measure how behavior changes, yet existing cognitive benchmarks evaluate language and multimodal models. We introduce S1CogBench to ask what these models can and cannot do on 24 cognitive tasks, evaluating five open models and Jev and keeping conditions and scoring apart from disclosed adaptations. We find that decision models vary widely in reliability, acting well does not imply predicting humans, aggregate scores hide how decisions respond to conditions, and speed comes mainly from answering without generation. To our knowledge, S1CogBench is the first benchmark of System One decision models on established cognitive experiments, and it gives a shared test of whether their decisions respond to evidence, feedback, memory load, and future opportunities before software relies on them.

AI.tldr: 提出首个针对System One（typed）决策模型的认知基准S1CogBench，用24项认知实验任务检验Jev、Laya等模型决策是否真正利用证据，而非仅形式合规。
AI.motivation: 语言模型已不仅用于生成文本，还被用于路由、护栏、自动门控等需要"快速决策"的软件场景。System One/typed决策模型只输出一个合法选项、无可检视文本，因此"决策快速且格式正确"并不能证明模型真正使用了证据。现有认知基准只评测语言与多模态模型，缺乏对这类决策模型的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建S1CogBench：基于24个经典认知实验任务，通过操纵任务需求（condition）并测量行为变化来检验证据使用。评测5个开源模型以及Jev，并将实验条件、评分与对外披露的适配（adaptations）分离处理。
AI.result: 决策模型可靠性差异很大；"表现良好"不等于能预测人类行为；聚合分数掩盖了决策随条件变化的响应方式；速度优势主要来自不生成文本而是直接作答。
AI.conclusion: S1CogBench据称是首个在成熟认知实验上评测System One决策模型的基准，为在软件依赖这些模型前，检验其决策是否响应证据、反馈、记忆负荷与未来机会提供统一测试。

title: Auditing GeoFM Evaluation for Field-Extent Segmentation: Label Proxies, Baselines, and When Frozen Features Match Fine-tuning
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (08/2026). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=qRXVTe1yYp
summary: Geospatial foundation-model (GeoFM) benchmarks for agricultural field-extent segmentation often rely on cropland land-cover proxies and compare against per-pixel spectral baselines. We measure how these choices affect conclusions using identical single-date Sentinel-2 pixels from six countries. Replacing polygon-derived field labels with ESA WorldCover cropland raises random-forest AUROC from 0.55-0.82 to 0.79-0.96, showing that the proxy creates a more spectrally separable task. On the actual field-extent labels, a from-scratch U-Net reaches 0.89-0.98 AUROC and has higher point AUROC than a Prithvi frozen linear probe in five of six regions. We then compare a frozen backbone and full fine-tuning using the same decoder for Prithvi and TerraMind, with ten matched seeds. At $\varepsilon=0.02$ AUROC, 9 of 12 region$\times$model cells are TOST-equivalent. Kenya is the common failure case: positives cover roughly 0.1% of pixels, and full fine-tuning performs better for both models. Cross-region results are less favorable to frozen models. On AUROC and average precision (AP), the U-Net leads the full 30-transfer matrix, while an exploratory analysis excluding Kenya finds that both frozen decoders outperform their fine-tuned counterparts; no AUROC difference is detected between frozen TerraMind and the U-Net in that subset. For Prithvi, a frozen decoder trains about $110\times$ fewer parameters than full fine-tuning. These results argue for auditing labels and baselines before interpreting GeoFM rankings, and for testing a frozen decoder before assuming that full fine-tuning will help. Our conclusions are limited to single-date, per-pixel field-extent segmentation, not parcel-boundary or instance delineation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验了农业地块范围分割中GeoFM基准的两个常见做法（用耕地覆盖代理标签、用逐像元光谱基线）对结论的影响，并比较冻结主干与全微调。结果显示标签代理会显著抬高性能、伪造出更易分的任务；在真实标签上U-Net很强，冻结解码器常与全微调等效且参数少约110倍。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间基础模型（GeoFM）在农田地块范围分割上的评测常依赖ESAC WorldCover等耕地覆盖代理标签，并与逐像元光谱基线对比；这些选择可能系统性地扭曲对模型优劣的判断，因此需要量化其影响并给出更可靠的评测与使用建议。
AI.method: 使用六国完全相同的单日期Sentinel-2影像。一，对比多边形推导的地块标签与WorldCover耕地代理标签下随机森林的AUROC；二，在真实地块标签上将从头训练的U-Net与Prithvi冻结线性探针比较；三，用相同解码器在Prithvi与TerraMind上比较冻结主干与全微调，采用十个配对随机种子并以ε=0.02 AUROC做TOST等效性检验，另做30个迁移任务的矩阵评测与排除肯尼亚的探索性分析。
AI.result: 换成WorldCover代理后随机森林AUROC从0.55-0.82升至0.79-0.96，说明代理任务光谱上更易分。真实标签上U-Net达0.89-0.98 AUROC，六区域中五个点AUROC高于Prithvi冻结线性探针。同解码器对比中12个区域×模型单元有9个在ε=0.02下TOST等效；肯尼亚为共同失败案例（正样本约0.1%像元），两模型全微调更优；但30个跨区迁移任务上U-Net全面领先，排除肯尼亚后两种冻结解码器均优于微调版本，且冻结TerraMind与U-Net的AUROC无显著差异。Prithvi冻结解码器可训练参数约为全微调的1/110。
AI.conclusion: GeoFM排名在解读前应先审计标签与基线；不应默认全微调有益，应先试冻结解码器。结论仅限于单日期、逐像元的田块范围分割，不适用于地块边界或实例勾绘。

title: To Jev or Not to Jev: When Can System-1 Decision Models Replace LLM Judges?
summary: Decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev answer typed questions about a text (yes/no, multiple choice, or an ordinal score) with calibrated probabilities in a single forward pass and without generating text, which makes them an inexpensive candidate for LLM-as-a-judge workloads. We evaluate 14 System-1 decision models, selected with a pre-stated protocol, against four generative judges (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-5.6 with and without reasoning, and Claude Opus 5.5 with thinking) on eleven established judge benchmarks. Five of the 14 are statistically indistinguishable from GPT-5.6 without reasoning on all five pairwise and best-of-4 benchmarks, and the two strongest, DReX-Max and d1-ultra, are significantly more accurate than Haiku on JudgeBench, LLMBar and RewardBench 2. Conditioned on a reference answer generated once per prompt, eleven models reach 90.3-93.4% on JudgeBench, statistically indistinguishable from Opus 5.5 and GPT-5.6 with reasoning, and on PPE best-of-16 every reference-guided System-1 judge matches GPT-5.6 with reasoning at roughly one-sixteenth of its cost per prompt. Several System-1 judges are better calibrated than every generative judge and correlate more strongly with human helpfulness ratings. Robustness to instructions injected into the judged response is a property of the individual model rather than of the System-1 design: an appended note to the evaluator reverses 0-5% of the correct verdicts of five models but 17-49% for the other nine. Two general System-1 leaderboards that contain no judging tasks predict judging accuracy (Pearson r = 0.95-0.96), a well-calibrated System-1 first stage matches Opus on LLMBar while escalating 17% of items, and same-size controls show that the correctness deficit of a 4B decision model is a reasoning gap rather than a size gap.

AI.tldr: 评估14个System-1决策模型（如Jev）作为LLM-as-a-judge，11个基准上5个与无推理GPT-5.6统计无差异，两个最强显著优于Haiku；参考引导下近乎匹配推理型Opus/GPT-5.6且成本约1/16。
AI.motivation: 决策模型单次前向即给出带校准概率的类型化答案、无需生成文本，比生成式judge更便宜，但其作为评判者的准确性与可靠性缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 按预设协议选出14个System-1决策模型，与4个生成式judge（Claude Haiku 5.5、GPT-5.6含/不含推理、Claude Opus 5.5思考版）在11个既有judge基准上对比；并考察参考引导、成本、校准、与人评相关性、注入指令鲁棒性、System-1通用排行榜的预测力及规模对照。
AI.result: 5/14在全部5个pairwise与best-of-4基准上与无推理GPT-5.6无显著差异；DReX-Max与d1-ultra在JudgeBench、LLMBar、RewardBench 2上显著优于Haiku。参考答案条件下11个模型在JudgeBench达90.3–93.4%，与推理型Opus/GPT-5.6无差异；PPE best-of-16上均匹配推理型GPT-5.6而成本约1/16。部分模型校准优于所有生成式judge且与人类有用性评分相关性更强。注入指令鲁棒性因模型而异（附加提示导致0–5%与17–49%判错）。无语评判任务的System-1排行榜可预测judging准确率（r=0.95–0.96）；校准的两阶段方案在LLMBar上匹配Opus且仅升级17%样本；4B模型差距属推理而非规模。
AI.conclusion: System-1决策模型是极具性价比的LLM-as-a-judge候选，部分已达甚至超越大模型；但其对注入指令的鲁棒性需逐模型筛查，宜采用校准置信度驱动的两阶段选择性升级。

title: Integer-Exact Microscaling: Running MXFP4 Language Models on INT8 Matrix Units
summary: On hardware whose fastest matrix datapath is INT8$\times$INT8, such as the Neural Accelerators of Apple's M5 GPUs, 4-bit weights must become INT8 operands. Existing MXFP4 kernels already map FP4 (E2M1) values to integers by doubling them, but apply every 32-element block scale inside the reduction. We show when no per-block work is needed: a row of MXFP4 weights is exactly one INT8 vector times one power-of-two scale if its block exponents span at most three, so a linear layer becomes a single INT8 GEMM with one rescale per output. Enforcing the condition adds at most 1/16 of a row's largest rounding error to the blocks it changes, and real weights already satisfy it: 97.9-99.97% of rows across seven models, including 99.93% of the 95M rows of a 125B-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. The resulting spread-constrained MXFP4 files stay standard MXFP4. With integer instead of power-of-two block multipliers, an integer-exact format (16-wide blocks, multipliers 1..10, 4.26 bits) runs as one exact INT8 GEMM and is more accurate than NVFP4 (4.5 bits) with its standard scale rule on five small models, within 0.06 perplexity of NVFP4 with scale search. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's routed experts with INT8 activations it is as close to the FP8 model as NVFP4 with scale search (KL divergence 0.0557 vs. 0.0553) and closer than MLX's MXFP4 and affine INT4; with every matrix quantized it solves 94.8% of GSM8K vs. 91.0% for MLX's MXFP4. Quantizing only the 74k routed expert matrices (96% of the parameters) to either of our formats with INT8 activations costs at most 0.2% perplexity. A complete W4A8 system on the M5 produces outputs bit-identical to the quantized reference; prefill is 1.34-1.74x faster than MLX on a dense model, 1.10-1.57x on two MoE models up to 35B parameters and 1.22-1.29x on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, where shared non-GEMM work bounds the gain.

AI.tldr: 将MXFP4权重行中块指数差异约束在3以内，使整行可由一个INT8向量乘一个2的幂标度精确表示，从而把线性层退化为单次INT8 GEMM，每输出仅需一次rescale，且文件仍为标准MXFP4。
AI.motivation: Apple M5等硬件最快的矩阵数据通路为INT8×INT8，4-bit权重必须先转成INT8操作数。现有MXFP4 kernel虽通过加倍把FP4(E2M1)映射为整数，但每个32元素块的scale都必须在归约内部应用，增加了块内的额外计算与开销。
AI.method: 指出当一行的块指数跨度不超过3时，该行MXFP4权重可等价为单一INT8向量乘以一个2的幂scale。据此提出"展布约束"MXFP4：强制该条件（对受影响块最多增加该行最大舍入误差的1/16），文件格式保持标准MXFP4。进一步把乘子由2的幂推广为整数1..10，构造16宽块、4.26 bit的整数精确格式，可用一次精确INT8 GEMM执行。实现完整W4A8系统，权重4-bit、激活INT8。
AI.result: 七个模型97.9–99.97%的行天然满足约束，125B参数MoE模型Qwen3.8-Flash-Next的95M行中99.93%满足。整数精确格式在五个小模型上比NVFP4(4.5 bit)标准scale规则更准，与带scale搜索的NVFP4差距在0.06 perplexity内。在Qwen3.8-Flash-Next路由专家+INT8激活下，与FP8模型KL散度为0.0557（NVFP4 scale搜索为0.0553），优于MLX的MXFP4与仿射INT4；全矩阵量化时GSM8K达94.8%（MLX MXFP4为91.0%）。仅量化74k路由专家矩阵（96%参数）时困惑度损失≤0.2%。M5上输出与量化参考逐位一致；prefill比MLX快1.34–1.74x（dense）、1.10–1.57x（两个≤35B的MoE）、1.22–1.29x（Qwen3.8-Flash-Next），受共享非GEMM工作限制。
AI.conclusion: 通过对MXFP4权重行的块指数展布加以约束（或改用整数乘子格式），可在保持标准/近标准4-bit格式与精度的同时，把每层量化为单次INT8 GEMM，且真实大模型权重几乎天然满足该条件；在Apple M5上实现精确一致的W4A8系统并获得显著prefill加速。

title: Toward an Evidence-Based Template for Agent Instruction Files: An Empirical Study of Adoption, Consistency, and Maintenance
summary: AI coding agents rely on repository-level instruction files to understand project conventions, development workflows, and constraints. However, different agents support different instruction formats, and limited empirical evidence exists about how these files are adopted, what information they contain, whether coexisting formats provide consistent guidance, and how they are maintained. We conduct an empirical study of 3,387 instruction files from 1,000 GitHub repositories across four formats: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GitHub Copilot instructions, and Cursor rules. We find that 42.2% of instruction-bearing repositories in the higher-popularity cohort maintain multiple formats. Among 386 manually examined pairs of corresponding sections, 16.1% provide divergent guidance. Our maintenance analysis further shows that 40.4% of the analyzed files have only one recorded modification event and that maintenance patterns differ across formats. Based on category prevalence and category addition ratios (CAR), we derive an evidence-based template containing ten Required, four Gap, and two Recommended categories. In an exploratory generation experiment, explicit template guidance increases structural category coverage from 18.7% to 82.8%. We further introduce AGIT-Instruct, a benchmark for evaluating instruction-file generation through structural coverage and content alignment. Across four generation configurations, retrieval-augmented generation achieves the highest full-file ROUGE-1 F1 of 0.459. A manual assessment of 278 generated category instances finds that 19.4% fully preserve and 61.2% partially preserve developer-written intent. Our findings provide empirical guidance for organizing and maintaining agent instruction

AI.tldr: 本文实证分析1000个GitHub仓库中3387个AI编码代理指令文件（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、Copilot instructions、Cursor rules四种格式），揭示多格式共存、内容分歧与维护不足问题，并提出证据驱动的模板与AGIT-Instruct生成基准。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理依赖仓库级指令文件理解项目规范与约束，但不同代理支持不同格式，且缺乏关于这些文件如何被采用、包含什么、多格式是否一致、如何维护的实证证据。
AI.method: 对1000个仓库、3387个文件、四种格式进行实证研究：统计多格式采用情况；人工检查386对对应章节的一致性与分歧；分析修改历史维护模式；基于类别普遍度与类别新增比（CAR）推导模板；开展模板引导生成实验；构建AGIT-Instruct基准，用结构覆盖度与内容对齐评估四种生成配置（含RAG）。
AI.result: 高热度样本中42.2%维持多种格式；386对人工检查章节中16.1%存在分歧；40.4%文件仅有一次修改记录；模板包含10个Required、4个Gap、2个Recommended类别，使结构类别覆盖从18.7%提升至82.8%；四种配置中RAG取得最高全文件ROUGE-1 F1=0.459；278个生成实例中19.4%完全保留、61.2%部分保留开发者意图。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为组织与维护代理指令文件提供了实证依据，指出现有格式共存与维护存在的缺陷，并给出模板和评估基准以改善指令文件生成质量。

title: Labadain-MedQA: A Tetun Medical QA Dataset for Fine-Tuning and Evaluating Large Language Models
summary: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have created opportunities for cross-lingual transfer of medical knowledge from high-resource to low-resource languages to support access to healthcare information. However, medical question-answering (QA) datasets for fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs remain scarce for Tetun. To address this gap, we translated MedAlpaca's Medical Flashcards and WikiDoc Patient Information collections into Tetun using Gemini 2.5 Flash, producing 39,077 medical QA pairs. Translation quality was assessed on 50 randomly sampled QA pairs (100 documents) using automatic metrics against human reference translations and evaluations by two native Tetun-speaking healthcare professionals, focusing on medical accuracy and Tetun fluency. Human translations achieved higher mean ratings than LLM-generated translations for both criteria (4.43/5 vs. 4.02/5), with statistically significant differences (Wilcoxon signed-rank test, p < 0.001). To assess downstream utility, we fine-tuned Gemma and Llama variants on the translated MedAlpaca dataset using parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) and evaluated them on 325 Tetun-translated United States Medical Licensing Examination multiple-choice questions. Gemma 4 12B fine-tuned using QLoRA achieved relative improvements in mean accuracy of 10.79% with 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) inference and 10.42% after merging the LoRA adapters into the BF16 base model, compared with the corresponding base models. These results highlight the viability of automatic dataset translation for Tetun medical QA and the effectiveness of PEFT in enhancing model performance. The datasets, models, and evaluation resources are accessible at https://github.com/labadain/labadain-medqa to support reproducible research on Tetun medical QA and facilitate machine translation, cross lingual, and multilingual research.

AI.tldr: 该论文将MedAlpaca数据集自动翻译为德顿语，构建3.9万医疗QA对，并用PEFT微调Gemma/Llama模型提升德顿语医疗问答性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型为医疗知识从高资源语言向低资源语言迁移提供了机会，但德顿语（Tetun）缺乏用于微调和评估的医疗问答数据集，限制了当地医疗服务信息获取。
AI.method: 使用Gemini 2.5 Flash将MedAlpaca的Medical Flashcards和WikiDoc患者信息集合翻译为德顿语，生成39,077个QA对；抽取50个QA对（100篇文档）用自动指标对比人工参考译文，并由两位德顿语母语医疗专业人员进行医学准确性和语言流畅性评估；随后用PEFT（QLoRA）微调Gemma与Llama变体，在325道德顿语翻译的美国医师资格考试（USMLE）多选题上评测。
AI.result: 人工译文在医学准确性和流畅性上平均评分均高于LLM译文（4.43/5 vs. 4.02/5），差异具统计显著性（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，p<0.001）。在下游任务上，使用QLoRA微调的Gemma 4 12B相比基线模型，4位NF4推理下平均准确率相对提升10.79%，合并LoRA适配器至BF16基座后相对提升10.42%。
AI.conclusion: 自动数据集翻译用于德顿语医疗问答具有可行性，PEFT能有效提升模型性能；数据集、模型与评估资源已开源以支持可复现研究及机器翻译、跨语言与多语言研究。

title: From Clips to Streams: A Unified Framework for Streaming Sign Language Translation
comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, the paper has been accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Sign Language Translation (SLT) research has typically focused on pre-segmented clips, a constraint that disconnects models from the continuous reality of real-world communication. To bridge the gap from clips to streams, we formally define Streaming SLT, a realistic task demanding the joint discovery and translation of linguistic events from continuous, untrimmed video inputs. To address this challenge, we propose StreamSLST, the first end-to-end framework for Streaming Sign Language Segmentation and Translation via Deformable Transformer architecture. Unlike cascaded approaches that suffer from error propagation, StreamSLST employs a parallel decoding strategy to jointly optimize temporal segmentation and translation in a single pass. To enable scalable training on long-form videos, we incorporate a Sentence-aware Sliding Window Sampler that crops continuous streams into trainable units. We further design a Tri-modal Visual-Language Pretraining stage that aligns pose dynamics with textual semantics before joint optimization. To support comprehensive evaluation, we conduct experiments on two real-world streaming datasets, BOBSL and How2Sign, together with two newly constructed synthetic streaming benchmarks, Streaming-Phoenix-2014T and Streaming-CSL-Daily. The results demonstrate that StreamSLST consistently outperforms a matched cascaded segmentation-then-translation pipeline. Interestingly, our analysis reveals that joint optimization learns wider, translation-effective temporal support that simple expansion or rescaling of the annotated spans fails to reproduce. Our work establishes the first robust benchmark for continuous sign language understanding and paves the way for accessible real-world communication interfaces. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/streamsl/StreamSLST.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Streaming SLT任务与StreamSLST框架，利用可变形Transformer并行解码，从连续未剪辑视频中联合完成手语句段分割与翻译。
AI.motivation: 现有手语翻译研究局限于预先分割好的片段，与真实场景中连续交流的情况脱节，因此需要从"片段"走向"流"。
AI.method: 提出首个端到端StreamSLST框架，基于Deformable Transformer并行解码，单次前向同时优化时间分割与翻译，避免级联误差传播；采用Sentence-aware Sliding Window Sampler将长视频裁剪为可训练单元；并设计三模态视觉-语言预训练阶段对齐姿态动态与文本语义。
AI.result: 在BOBSL、How2Sign两个真实流式数据集及新构建的Streaming-Phoenix-2014T、Streaming-CSL-Daily合成基准上，StreamSLST稳定优于匹配的"先分割后翻译"级联流水线；分析发现联合优化学到的有效时间支撑更宽，简单扩展或缩放标注跨度无法复现。
AI.conclusion: 工作建立了连续手语理解的稳健基准，为真实可及的手语交流界面奠定基础；代码与数据已开源。

title: Agentic Context Management for Multi-Turn Human-AI Conversations
summary: LLMs degrade in multi-turn conversation partly because of context pollution: the model's own earlier outputs stay in context and anchor later turns, so an early misreading of the user's intent can persist after the user corrects it. Assistant omission (AO), dropping every assistant message, removes this pollution but fails when interaction is referential: later turns refer back to drafts, decisions, and tool-call results that exist only in assistant turns. We propose Agentic Conversation Context Curation (AC3), a training-free method in which a separate analyzer (1) consolidates the task specification from the user's messages alone, (2) audits the assistant's prior outputs against it, and (3) edits the context, either appending the analysis or discarding the assistant side and rebuilding the context from the specification. A second finding: pollution is contagious. An analyzer that sees the assistant's reasoning while extracting the specification can do worse than no intervention, and instructing it to ignore them did not close the gap, so we exclude assistant turns structurally. On Lost in Conversation (replaying difficulty-selected instances), where AO is an oracle by construction, AC3 closes 55-84% of the gap between full context and AO on three of four tasks and exceeds AO on the fourth, and an LLM that faithfully summarizes the history does not reproduce the gain even with more compute. On real WildChat conversations, a GPT-5-mini judge prefers AC3's next turn over both full context and AO in every configuration of our main table, though this preference depends on the judge; on CollabLLM results are mixed. In stateful tool use (tau2-bench), AO collapses to 0% on every model; AC3 does not collapse, though it falls slightly behind full context. Detector studies show that Reset removes injected pollution but is not span-selective: the gain comes from rebuilding the specification.
