Compact keys raise SkillRet NDCG@10 from 64.0 to 70.9 at one eighth of the dimension. With one document, CompSkill completes 256 and 260 of 332 ToolQA tasks with GPT-5.6-luna and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, respectively, more than every baseline, and stays on par with the strongest baselines on AppWorld and ALFWorld. On 332 newly generated ToolQA tasks, it completes 256 with GPT-5.6-luna, significantly more than BM25, SkillRet-8B, Tool2Vec and RankGPT; over all 844 ToolQA tasks, it completes 24 more than the strongest baseline. Selection matters beyond relevance: pairing the right guide with a same-database sibling instead of another database's guide costs 8 of 96 tasks. Code, models and support data: https://github.com/satoshinji2992/CompSkill

AI.tldr: CompSkill 用学习到的 512 维技能键索引技能，并通过对同任务匹配比较做 KeyOpt（技能偏移+截断键残差）把执行经验注入检索，从而改变执行器拿到哪份技能文档而不改文档文本；配合经验超图做召回与可追溯复审。技能检索 NDCG@10 由 64.0 升至 70.9（维度仅 1/8），ToolQA 上 332 题完成 256/260 题，超过所有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有技能文档检索器大多仅按描述排序，忽略先前执行反馈；而"检索相关"不等于"检索有用"——相关技能反而可能损害执行，且早期执行证据未被利用。
AI.method: 1) 用学习到的 512-d 键索引技能；2) KeyOpt 将匹配的同任务比较编译为技能偏移与带上限的键残差，经验只影响选取哪份文档，绝不改写文档文本；3) 在未知任务难度的 logistic 结果模型下，匹配比较可消去难度，仅不一致对携带信息，随不一致任务数增加预测改善；4) 经验超图保留每个比较及其执行器/文档版本，用于召回漏检技能并支撑带引用的复审。
AI.result: SkillRet NDCG@10 从 64.0 提升到 70.9（1/8 维度）；单文档设置下在 332 个 ToolQA 任务上以 GPT-5.6-luna 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 分别完成 256 和 260 题，胜过所有基线，AppWorld/ALFWorld 与最强基线持平；332 个新生成 ToolQA 任务上完成 256 题，显著优于 BM25、SkillRet-8B、Tool2Vec、RankGPT；844 个 ToolQA 任务总体比最强基线多完成 24 题；消融显示把正确指南换成同库另一技能时 96 题中损失 8 题，说明"选对"比"相关"更关键。
AI.conclusion: 执行经验应作为检索的一等信号：通过比较式学习在不改文档的前提下优化技能选择，可在检索指标与下游智能体任务完成率上同时获益；代码、模型与支撑数据已开源。

title: OpenMidnight: Closing the Performance Gap Between Open and Proprietary Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Pathology foundation models offer transferable representations for a range of downstream tasks in computational pathology, but reliance on proprietary data, substantial compute requirements, and limited availability of training code and preprocessing pipelines hinder independent validation and further methodological development. We present OpenMidnight 1.1, an open-source replication and refinement of Midnight trained on approximately 12,000 publicly available whole-slide images from The Cancer Genome Atlas. Using an encoder initialized with pretrained DINOv2 weights, OpenMidnight 1.1 uses approximately 320 H100 GPU-hours for pathology pretraining, a 34-fold reduction relative to the compute reported for Midnight. Across 16 classification and four segmentation datasets in THUNDER, OpenMidnight 1.1 achieves the highest mean segmentation Dice (69.7) and ranks fourth among 14 models, ahead of Midnight, with performance that matches or exceeds models trained on substantially larger datasets in several tasks. Our ablation studies additionally examine how initialization, data volume, model size, and tissue composition affect downstream performance, providing empirical evidence to inform the development of future training recipes. Our release of the training code, preprocessing pipeline, and model weights lowers barriers to reproducible research and further development of competitive pathology foundation models.

AI.tldr: OpenMidnight 1.1 是 Midnight 的开源复现与改进版，用约1.2万张TCGA公开全切片图像、约320 H100 GPU小时完成病理预训练，计算量减少34倍，在THUNDER基准上平均分割Dice达69.7并排名第4，超越原版Midnight。
AI.motivation: 现有病理基础模型依赖专有数据、算力需求大，且训练代码与预处理流程不公开，阻碍了独立验证与方法学发展，因此需要一个可复现、低门槛的开源替代方案。
AI.method: 基于DINOv2预训练权重初始化编码器，在约12,000张TCGA公开全切片图像上进行病理预训练，仅需约320 H100 GPU小时（较Midnight降低34倍）；并在THUNDER的16个分类与4个分割数据集上评测，另做初始化、数据量、模型规模和组份的消融研究。
AI.result: 在THUNDER上取得最高平均分割Dice（69.7），在14个模型中排名第4，优于Midnight；部分任务上与使用更大规模数据训练的模型相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 开源的训练代码、预处理流程与模型权重降低了可复现研究门槛，消融结果也为未来训练配方提供实证参考，推动了有竞争力的病理基础模型的开放发展。

title: X-World 1.6: Building Controllable Virtual Cities with World Models
summary: Deploying generative world models for end-to-end closed-loop evaluation and policy learning requires precise scenario control, consistent observations, and sustained generation quality during extended interactions. This report presents \emph{X-World~1.6}, advancing X-World~1.0 toward a more reliable and versatile driving simulator. The upgraded base model offers finer-grained control over traffic semantics, including traffic lights and road markings, together with improved spatial consistency across cameras. Virtual City capabilities broaden scenario construction through a family of models conditioned on diverse 2D and 3D references, including support for generating multi-camera future videos from a single image. An enhanced post-training framework enables efficient causal, few-step generation with stronger temporal coherence, better quality retention over longer rollouts, and improved alignment with human preferences. We also introduce a dedicated evaluation suite to support systematic assessment and guide model iteration. Together, these upgrades expand the scenarios X-World can simulate and improve the efficiency and reliability of its generated observations, supporting broader use in autonomous-driving development.

AI.tldr: X-World 1.6 升级版驾驶世界模型，强化交通语义控制、跨相机空间一致性、虚拟城市场景构建与因果少步生成，并配套评测套件。
AI.motivation: 端到端闭环评测与策略学习需要生成式世界模型具备精确场景控制、一致观测，以及长时交互中稳定的生成质量，X-World 1.0 在这些方面不够可靠。
AI.method: 升级基础模型以细粒度控制交通语义（红绿灯、道路标线）并提升多相机空间一致性；Virtual City 模型族支持基于多种 2D/3D 参考生成场景（含单图生成多相机未来视频）；改进后训练框架实现高效因果少步生成、更强时序连贯性与长 rollout 质量保持、更好的人类偏好对齐。
AI.result: 生成观测的效率与可靠性提升，可模拟场景范围扩大；长时生成质量保持更好、与人类偏好对齐更佳；并引入专门评测套件支持系统评估与模型迭代。
AI.conclusion: X-World 1.6 通过控制性、一致性、场景构建与生成效率的全面升级，更适用于自动驾驶开发中的闭环仿真与策略学习。

title: The First-Order Value of Free Covariates in Budgeted Risk Monitoring
summary: A deployed model sees its inputs for free, but checking whether its risk has risen requires costly labels. We study how to spend a label budget so that a risk increase is detected quickly while false alarms stay controlled, including under input shifts that keep the risk below a safety threshold $τ$. Let $A$ be the false-alarm control scale and $h(r)=\mathrm{kl}(r,τ)$ the Bernoulli KL divergence between the changed risk $r$ and $τ$. At label rate $b=c/\log A$, we prove that every rule that chooses requests from its own label history has worst-case (Lorden) delay at least $(1/h(r)+1/c)\log A$ to first order: besides collecting evidence, it must wait for its next label. The bound needs only a label budget on one finite stretch of safe source data and false-alarm control over an initial window; a bound on the average time to false alarm does not suffice. When a harmful change also shifts the inputs, a rule that lets the inputs trigger labeling attains delay $\log A/h(r)$ to first order on a fixed Gaussian model, so free covariates save at least $1/b$ rounds. A hybrid rule adds a label-history fallback for risk changes that leave the inputs unchanged. Synthetic experiments and two ACS tasks, with strengthened label-only baselines, show the predicted pattern. The covariate trigger has a cost: because its budget is calibrated on the source, a benign input shift can make it request nearly every label.

AI.tldr: 研究在标签预算受限下如何快速检测模型风险上升并控制误报，提出下界与利用免费输入的触发规则。
AI.motivation: 部署模型可免费获得输入，但检验风险是否上升需昂贵标签，如何在固定标签预算下尽快检测风险上升同时控制误报（含输入漂移但风险仍低于阈值τ的情形）是核心问题。
AI.method: 以误报控制尺度A与KL散度h(r)=kl(r,τ)刻画问题；在标签率b=c/log A下证明仅依赖自身标签历史的规则Lorden延迟下界；分析输入触发标签规则的延迟；提出混合规则加入标签历史回退以应对输入不变的风险变化。
AI.result: 证明任何基于标签历史的规则最坏情况Lorden延迟至少为(1/h(r)+1/c)log A（一阶）；该界只需一段安全源数据上的标签预算与初始窗口误报控制，平均误报时间界不足。输入触发规则在固定高斯模型下达到log A/h(r)一阶延迟，比仅标签规则至少快1/b轮；混合规则可处理输入不变的风险变化。合成实验与两个ACS任务验证预测模式；但协变量触发的预算按源数据校准，良性输入漂移会使其几乎请求所有标签。
AI.conclusion: 免费协变量能显著降低检测延迟，但输入触发规则存在预算误校准风险；混合规则与下界共同刻画了标签预算、误报控制与检测速度的基本权衡。

title: Beyond Surface Metrics: Multi-Condition Requirements in Enterprise Maintenance and AI Coding Benchmarks
summary:
Repository-level AI coding benchmarks measure task success but do not directly capture the conditions required for software maintenance completion. We study multi-condition fulfillment, where a maintenance task must satisfy multiple operational conditions, sometimes with directional dependencies. Using a fixed 18-criterion taxonomy, we analyze 2,925 Apache Fineract issues and 944 tasks from SWE-bench Pro, SWE-PolyBench Java, and SWE-EVO. We examine condition breadth, corpus-level co-occurrence, and source-grounded directional requirement relationships.
  Among 1,177 benchmark task pairs matched on issue classification, modified-file count, and code churn, the mean fulfillment-set Jaccard distance is 0.8138, and 57.4% have disjoint condition sets. Condition count alone does not explain this contrast: SWE-bench Pro averages 2.47 conditions per task, versus 1.78 for Fineract. Temporal (B4) and numerical (B2) conditions have a phi coefficient of +0.430 in Fineract versus -0.013 in the pooled benchmark corpus. Among temporally tagged tasks, numerical conditions are also specified in 48.85% (254/520) of Fineract cases versus 5.81% (5/86) of benchmark cases.
  We document 16 directional relationships in Fineract requirements involving time, calculation, and state preservation, and inspect four benchmark cases to illustrate how relevant conditions appear in evaluation assertions. These examples do not quantify benchmark-wide oracle omissions. The results show that similar surface task profiles can mask substantially different fulfillment-condition sets. We recommend reporting condition breadth, co-occurrence, and directional relationships separately. The corpus comparisons are descriptive and may reflect domain differences; they do not establish causality or production failure rates.

AI.tldr: 论文用18类条件的固定分类法比较Apache Fineract真实维护议题与SWE-bench Pro等仓库级基准任务，发现表面任务画像相似、但"需满足条件集合"差异巨大，建议基准报告条件广度、共现与方向性依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有仓库级AI编码基准只衡量任务是否成功，无法直接反映软件维护完成所需的"多条件同时满足"情形（含带方向性依赖的条件），因此需要刻画任务的条件结构。
AI.method: 基于固定的18项条件分类法，分析2,925个Fineract议题与944个基准任务（SWE-bench Pro、SWE-PolyBench Java、SWE-EVO）；考察条件广度、语料级共现、以及有来源依据的方向性需求关系；并对1,177对按议题分类、修改文件数、代码变更量匹配的任务比较满足集Jaccard距离。
AI.result: 匹配任务对平均Jaccard距离0.8138，57.4%条件集完全不相交；条件数量不能解释差异（SWE-bench Pro平均2.47个条件 vs Fineract 1.78）。时间(B4)与数值(B2)条件phi系数Fineract为+0.430、基准汇总为-0.013；时间标注任务中同时含数值条件的比例48.85%(254/520) vs 5.81%(5/86)。另记录了16条涉及时间、计算与状态保持的方向性关系，并用4个基准案例示意条件在评测断言中的呈现。
AI.conclusion: 相似的表层任务画像会掩盖显著不同的条件集合；建议将条件广度、共现与方向性关系分开报告。结果属描述性比较，可能反映领域差异，不构成因果或生产失败率结论，案例亦未量化基准整体oracle遗漏。

title: CST: Lightweight Risk Triage with Source-Grounded Evidence for Web Discussions
summary: Web communities rely on moderators to catch harmful messages such as insults, hate speech, and scams, but no one can read every message. Existing tools give each message a risk score, which tells moderators where to look but not what to read or how to check it. Yet meaning depends on context: the same reply, "I agree.", can support or oppose removing someone from a group. Moderators therefore need source-grounded evidence, not just scores: a few key messages kept with their original wording and replies. We present CST, a lightweight triage pipeline that first decides where to look, then what to show. It scores risk by pairing character patterns, which capture exact wording, with sentence meaning from a fixed multilingual model, so it handles several languages and runs on an ordinary CPU. It then groups related messages and picks from each group in turn, so a small reading budget covers different parts of a discussion, and links every pick back to the original thread. Across six tasks from five datasets in several languages, CST ranks harmful messages more accurately than a fully fine-tuned multilingual model and, under the same budget, finds more of them than reading by score alone. In a user study, reviewers needed at least 27% less time with CST's grouped evidence while keeping decision accuracy above 94%. CST turns risk scores into evidence that moderators can read quickly and check in context. Code and dataset reconstruction resources will be released at https://github.com/Kirito14IT/CST-MIL.

AI.tldr: CST 是一个轻量级审核分诊流水线，先决定"看哪里"再决定"展示什么"，为版主提供可追溯的原文证据而非单纯的分数。
AI.motivation: 社区审核依赖版主人工检查有害信息，但无人能读完所有消息。现有工具只给每条消息风险分数，无法告诉版主读什么、如何核验；而语义高度依赖上下文（如"I agree."既可支持也可反对移除成员），因此版主需要带原始措辞与回复的可溯源证据。
AI.method: 两阶段分诊：①风险打分——将捕捉精确措辞的字符级模式与固定多语言模型的句义表示配对，支持多语言且可在普通 CPU 上运行；②证据选取——对相关消息聚类，从各簇轮流挑选，使有限阅读预算覆盖讨论的不同部分，并将每个选中的消息链接回原帖线程。
AI.result: 在5个数据集、多种语言的6项任务上，CST 的风险排序准确率优于完全微调的多语言模型；同等预算下比仅按分数阅读能找到更多有害消息。用户研究中，版主使用 CST 的分组证据所需时间减少至少27%，决策准确率仍高于94%。
AI.conclusion: CST 将风险分数转化为版主可快速阅读、可在上下文中核验的证据。代码与数据集重建资源将开源。

title: Do Earnings Calls Help Predict Financial Restatements? Evaluating Text Beyond Public Firm Information
summary: Financial restatements correct errors in previously published financial reports. Could managers' language in earnings calls warn of them in advance? Comparing 109 calls that precede restatements with 218 matched control calls, we find that the text predicts restatements but adds no detectable ranking gain beyond public firm information. A text classifier beats chance, largely because of restatements tied to special-purpose acquisition companies, but a model using only public information scores slightly higher. With refitting, the 95% interval for the gain from adding text (-0.05 to 0.11 AUROC) still leaves room for a meaningful benefit. A large language model scores higher, but we show that it names the exact ticker in 66% of masked transcripts, and it was released after the restatements occurred. Our results suggest that finding new warning signs in call text requires a public-information baseline and a check of what a language model already knows.

AI.tldr: 论文检验财报电话会议文本能否提前预警财务重述，发现文本预测力主要来自公开信息，单独增量贡献不显著，并提醒大模型评估存在信息泄漏风险。
AI.motivation: 财务重述源于此前财报的错误，若能通过电话会议中管理层语言提前察觉，将有助于投资者与监管者预警。已有研究多未控制公开信息基线，也忽视大模型可能"已经知道"答案的问题。
AI.method: 比较109个重述前电话会议与218个匹配对照会议；构建文本分类器并与仅使用公开公司信息的模型对比AUROC；对增量收益做重拟合与95%区间估计；另测试大语言模型表现，并在掩码转录文本中检验其能否识别具体股票代码。
AI.result: 文本分类器优于随机，但相对公开信息模型无可检测的排序增益，仅公开信息模型得分略高。增量AUROC区间为-0.05至0.11，仍可能蕴含实质收益。大模型得分更高，但在66%的掩码转录中直接说出确切股票代码，且其发布时间晚于重述事件。
AI.conclusion: 在电话文本中发现新的预警信号，必须先建立公开信息基线，并核查语言模型是否已掌握答案；否则易高估文本与大模型的价值。

title: BreastXAgent: A lightweight agentic explainability framework for breast density classification
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Published in Proceedings of SPIE, Vol. 14346, Third International Conference on Frontiers of Applied Optics and Computer Engineering (AOCE 2026)
summary: Deep learning models for breast density classification typically return only a label and confidence score. This paper presents BreastXAgent, a lightweight agentic framework that combines a pretrained classifier, Grad-CAM visual explanation, LangGraph-based routing, LLM report generation, and rule-based guardrails to produce controlled, faithful, non-diagnostic reports. On 160 mammography images, uncontrolled LLM reporting produced 75% Grad-CAM overclaims and 62.5% clinical overclaims. Strict prompting and LangGraph routing improved safety but did not eliminate violations. The full BreastXAgent achieved 100% safety pass rate, zero overclaims, and highest utility score. Results demonstrate that agentic guardrails enable safe, structured explanation generation without modifying the underlying classifier.

AI.tldr: BreastXAgent：一个轻量级agentic框架，将预训练分类器、Grad-CAM、LangGraph路由、LLM报告生成与规则化护栏结合，生成受控、忠实、非诊断性的乳腺密度报告。
AI.motivation: 深度学习乳腺密度分类模型通常只输出标签和置信度分数，缺乏可解释性与安全可控的说明；而直接使用LLM生成报告易产生对Grad-CAM的过度解读与临床过度断言。
AI.method: 框架由预训练分类器、Grad-CAM视觉解释、基于LangGraph的路由、LLM报告生成及规则化护栏（guardrails）组成；在160张乳腺X线图像上与无控制LLM报告、严格提示词+路由等配置进行对比评估，指标体系包括安全性通过率、过度断言与效用分数。
AI.result: 无控制LLM报告产生75%的Grad-CAM过度断言和62.5%的临床过度断言；严格提示与LangGraph路由提升了安全性但未消除违规；完整BreastXAgent实现100%安全通过率、零过度断言和最高效用分数。
AI.conclusion: agentic护栏可在不修改底层分类器的情况下，实现安全、结构化的解释生成。

title: Editing the Goal: Per-Token SAE Steering and Its Depth Limits in $π_{0.5}$
comment: Accepted to the Science of Physical AI Safety (SPAIS) Workshop at CoRL 2026. 6 pages, 2 figures
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have recovered interpretable, causally relevant features in robot foundation models (RFMs) such as $π_{0.5}$ (arXiv:2603.19183, arXiv:2603.19233). SAE features on individual instruction tokens are less interpretable than timestep-pooled ones (arXiv:2603.19183), and whether they can redirect a robot's goal remains untested. We show that replacing the SAE features of a single goal word with those of an alternative goal word, leaving the instruction text unchanged, steers $π_{0.5}$-LIBERO into completing the alternative task. At layer 0, BatchTopK feature swaps redirect behavior in up to 20/20 rollouts in a scene where random-feature swaps redirect none, with success varying across six scenes in two LIBERO suites and across layers. The effect depends on SAE architecture: word-selected Matryoshka edits largely do not outperform random ones. SAEs are also not required. Adding a fixed difference-in-means vector at twice its natural magnitude redirects 8-10/10 rollouts. Layer-wise activation patching shows that goal-word edits remain effective up to layer 6 for object location and layer 2 for object identity, and up to layer 13 in both cases when patching also covers camera tokens. These results are proof of existence in an RFM in simulation and an initial map of how deep goal-redirecting edits remain effective. Visit https://doubleblind-sae-pi05.github.io for video rollouts.

AI.tldr: 在π0.5-LIBERO机器人基础模型中，通过替换单个目标词对应的SAE特征（不改文本），可将机器人行为重定向至替代任务；层0 BatchTopK特征交换最多20/20成功，但该效应依赖SAE架构，且简单均值差向量（2倍幅度）同样可达成8-10/10重定向。
AI.motivation: SAE已能从机器人基础模型中恢复可解释特征，但单指令token上的SAE特征可解释性弱于时间步池化特征，且其能否重定向机器人目标尚未被验证。作者欲检验目标词特征编辑是否具有因果控制力，并绘制有效编辑的深度范围。
AI.method: 保持指令文本不变，将单个目标词的SAE特征替换为替代目标词的特征（BatchTopK与Matryoshka两种架构；对比随机特征交换基线）；另用固定均值差向量按2倍自然幅度注入；通过逐层激活修补（activation patching）测试编辑在层0至13的有效性，并考察是否覆盖相机token。
AI.result: 层0的BatchTopK特征交换在两个LIBERO套件的六个场景中最多20/20重定向，随机交换为0；效果随场景与层变化。Matryoshka按词选择的编辑大多不优于随机。非SAE的均值差向量注入达8-10/10。逐层修补显示目标词编辑对物体位置有效至层6、物体身份有效至层2，若修补涵盖相机token则两者均延至层13。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了在仿真RFM中通过特征/激活编辑实现目标重定向的存在性，并给出编辑有效深度范围的初步图谱；效果依赖SAE架构，SAE本身并非必需，提示简单向量亦可实现因果控制。

title: Conic Certification of Transformer Attention
comment: 56 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/chimera1001/conic-attention-cert
summary: Attention is the computational core of large language models, yet the verifiers that bound how far an attention head's output can move under input perturbations give no guarantee on how loose their bounds are. A weak certificate therefore cannot be told apart from a fragile model. We develop a conic programming theory of attention certification that supplies this guarantee. We prove that the difficulty lies not in the softmax but in the bilinear interaction of a varying query with the keys. This interaction makes certification NP-hard over boxes and inapproximable once the attention logits can move by a constant amount. A fixed query or listed token substitutions, by contrast, make the exact worst case efficiently computable. An exponential cone moment relaxation then certifies a head with an error bounded quadratically in the perturbation radius by computable quantities, an order that cannot be improved. We also show that relaxations that treat a network one operation at a time, linear bound propagation among them, pay on second-order terms a sum of per-operation maxima instead of one coupled maximum. Computational results on GPT-2 indicate that the theory carries over to a trained model. Against exact worst cases with the query fixed, the certificate attains the predicted second-order accuracy. It is tighter than linear bound propagation on every head, and the looseness of bound propagation tracks the predicted per-operation excess.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了注意力认证的锥规划理论，证明认证困难源于 query 与 key 的双线性交互（NP-hard 且不可近似），而固定 query 或列举替换时可高效精确计算；提出指数锥矩松弛，其认证误差关于扰动半径二阶且不可改进。
AI.motivation: 现有界定注意力头输出在输入扰动下可移动范围的验证器，无法保证其界的松紧程度，因而弱证书与脆弱模型难以区分。
AI.method: 提出注意力认证的锥规划理论框架；分析软max与双线性交互的计算复杂性；设计指数锥矩松弛（moment relaxation）；对比逐操作松弛（如线性界传播）与耦合最大值的差异。
AI.result: 证明认证在 box 上 NP-hard、logits 变动常数时不可近似；固定 query 或枚举 token 替换可高效精确求解；指数锥松弛给出误差随扰动半径二次增长的可计算上界且不可改进；线性界传播在二阶项上付出逐操作最大值之和而非耦合最大值。GPT-2 实验显示固定 query 下证书达到预测的二阶精度，且在每个头上都比线性界传播更紧，传播的松弛度与预测的逐操作超额一致。
AI.conclusion: 该理论将认证难度定位在双线性交互而非 softmax，并给出最优阶的松弛保证；实验表明理论可迁移至训练模型，矩松弛优于线性界传播。

title: Finding the Pivots to Repair Broken Source-Test Evolution Using LLMs
summary: Repairing obsolete tests in response to source code evolution is critical for test suite reliability and software quality assurance. While large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising tools for automating many software development tasks, the effective supply of context and the orchestration of repair pipelines in this source--test co-evolution scenario remain poorly understood. Moreover, although reasoning is found helpful for LLMs on some complex coding tasks, it remains unclear which reasoning steps actually contribute to effective test repairs and how the insights learned from LLMs' behaviors benefit coding agents. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical study of test repair for source-test co-evolution empowered by LLMs, investigating the effective setups and typical LLM behaviors. To support this study, we construct a new benchmark of 500 real-world source-test co-evolution cases from commits submitted between May 2024 and April 2026 across 15 highly-starred open-source Java projects. Our experimental results reveal several key insights for effective LLM-based test repair: the complementary benefits of combining test failure symptoms, source code changes, and supportive code context, as well as the effectiveness of self-repair rounds. We further derive a common reasoning action taxonomy from LLMs' reasoning traces, which proves instrumental in guiding LLMs to repair tests more effectively while at a lower financial cost. Applying our findings to the Codex agent further improves its repair success rate on challenging cases by 66.7%.

AI.tldr: 本文对LLM驱动的源码-测试协同演化场景下的测试修复进行了系统性实证研究，构建了500个真实Java案例的新基准，揭示了上下文组合与自修复轮次的有效性，并提出推理动作分类法以低成本提升修复效果，应用于Codex代理后困难案例成功率提升66.7%。
AI.motivation: 源码演化会导致测试过时，修复这些过时测试对测试套件可靠性和软件质量保障至关重要。尽管LLM已被用于自动化多项软件开发任务，但在源码-测试协同演化场景中，如何有效提供上下文、如何编排修复流水线仍缺乏理解；同时，推理虽在部分复杂编码任务中有帮助，但哪些推理步骤真正有助于测试修复、以及这些行为洞见如何惠及编码代理仍不清楚。
AI.method: 开展系统性实证研究：从2024年5月至2026年4月间、15个高星开源Java项目的提交中，构建包含500个真实源码-测试协同演化案例的新基准；系统探究有效配置（失败症状、源码变更、支持性代码上下文的组合，自修复轮次等），并从LLM推理轨迹中归纳出通用的推理动作分类法，用于指导修复流程。
AI.result: 实验表明：结合测试失败症状、源码变更与支持性代码上下文具有互补收益；多轮自修复有效；基于推理动作分类法的引导能更有效地修复测试并降低经济成本；将研究发现应用于Codex代理后，其在困难案例上的修复成功率提升66.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为LLM驱动的测试修复提供了实证依据与实践指南，明确了上下文供给和推理引导的关键作用，并证明这些洞见可迁移至实际编码代理，显著提升困难场景下的修复成功率。

title: Nonreciprocal Spherical Attention and Retrieval: Sharp Coarsening Clocks and Certified Score Correction
comment: 42 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables. Includes mathematical appendices and ancillary reproducibility code
summary: We develop nonreciprocal spherical attention as a mathematical framework for coarsening and compressed nearest-neighbor retrieval. For two shrinking acute blocks whose centers have zero skew pairing and whose total mass ratio is subexponential in inverse temperature, we prove $\lim_{β\to\infty}β^{-1}\log T_β=1-\cosφ$, without restricting particle-count growth. An explicit three-body flow has two rigorously separated metastable exponents. For finite compression, mass centering yields a sharp $O(r^2)$ attention-output error bound at fixed temperature, with an explicit spherical-normalization correction. We formulate skew query-side score calibration as a strictly convex moment problem and derive a unique normal equation, residual-based optimization certificates, and bounded low-rank projections. A norm-aware margin objective calibrates native squared-distance rankings. Experiments use semantic retrieval data, one million visual descriptors with three codebook seeds, and a ten-million-vector FAISS IVF-PQ index with recomputed exact cosine ground truth. On SIFT1M, skew margin calibration raises native-L2 hit@10 from 0.8926 to 0.8948; symmetric calibration reaches 0.8996. The ten-million-vector index reaches 0.8827 hit@10 at 0.1794 ms per query in a four-thread batch benchmark, while validation selects no skew update. Exact streamed attention over ten million keys evaluates compressed memory on 1,024 held-out queries. Independent matrix solves, automatic differentiation, finite differences, interval arithmetic, full-flow tests, and nine Rocq-checked algebra lemmas support reproducibility. Directionality alone does not establish retrieval superiority.

AI.tldr: 提出"非互易球面注意力"数学框架，用于粗化与压缩最近邻检索，含大偏差极限、亚稳态分离、有限压缩误差界、凸矩问题标定与百万级实验验证。
AI.motivation: 希望在注意力（softmax 型）与压缩最近邻检索之间建立严格的数学联系：理解低温极限下的注意力分配极限、压缩带来的输出误差，并解决查询侧分数标定问题，同时检验"方向性/非互易"是否真能提升检索效果。
AI.method: 对两个收缩锐块（中心零斜配对、总质量比在逆温度下次指数）证明 β→∞ 时 (1/β)log T_β→1−cos φ，不限制粒子数增长；构造显式三体流，含两个严格分离的亚稳态指数；有限压缩下质量居中给出固定温度的 O(r²) 注意力输出误差界及球面归一化修正；将斜（非对称）查询侧分数标定写成严格凸矩问题，导出唯一正规方程、基于残差的优化证书与有界低秩投影；用范数感知的 margin 目标标定原生平方距离排序。实验含语义检索数据、100 万视觉描述子（3 个码本种子）及 1000 万向量 FAISS IVF-PQ 索引（重算精确余弦真值）。
AI.result: SIFT1M 上斜 margin 标定将原生 L2 hit@10 从 0.8926 提至 0.8948，对称标定达 0.8996；1000 万向量索引在四线程批处理下 hit@10 为 0.8827、0.1794 ms/查询，但验证集选择"不做斜更新"；对 1024 条留出查询做了千万 key 的精确流式注意力以评估压缩内存；用独立矩阵求解、自动微分、有限差分、区间算术、全流程测试及 9 条 Rocq 验证代数引理支持可复现性。
AI.conclusion: 理论极限、亚稳态分离与 O(r²) 误差界均被严格建立，标定问题有唯一解与可验证证书；但实验表明"方向性（非互易）本身并不足以带来检索优势"，对称标定反而更优，验证流程亦倾向不做斜更新。

title: Rethinking LLM Pruning via Test-Time Scaling
summary: Structured pruning reduces the size of large language models, often at the cost of lower accuracy. Whether this decline reflects diminished reasoning capacity or greater difficulty in sampling correct solutions is less clear. We examine this question across expert, FFN and layer pruning on four mathematical and coding benchmarks, comparing original and pruned models through pass@k at matched sampling budgets. Even after substantial pruning, some models match or exceed the original model's reasoning coverage despite lower pass@1, and solve problems left unsolved in the original samples. Retaining broad coverage, however, does not mean that correct solutions remain easy to obtain. Under severe pruning, diverse generated chain-of-thought (CoT) traces can coexist with increased repetition and less reliable generation. As correct answers become harder to sample, the additional attempts can sharply increase total token use even when individual responses become shorter. This separation between coverage and sampling efficiency also clarifies expert-selection gains, as methods with markedly different pass@1 can solve the same problems at large budgets yet require different numbers of attempts to reach a common coverage target. Pruning should therefore be assessed by both the range of problems a model can still solve and the sampling cost of obtaining correct solutions.

AI.tldr: 结构化剪枝降低大模型规模时常伴随精度下降；本文用匹配采样预算下的 pass@k 区分"推理能力下降"与"采样变难"，发现剪枝后模型仍能保持甚至扩大推理覆盖，但获取正确答案的采样成本显著上升。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注剪枝后 pass@1 的下降，但难以判断这是模型推理能力真的受损，还是仅仅因为采样到正确解变得更困难。作者希望厘清这一混淆，从而更准确地评估剪枝对模型的实际影响。
AI.method: 在四个数学与代码基准上，对 expert、FFN 和 layer 三类剪枝方法进行实验，在匹配的采样预算下比较原始模型与剪枝模型的 pass@k；分析剪枝后模型能否解出原模型未解出的问题，并考察 CoT 轨迹的多样性、重复性与采样成本（尝试次数与 token 消耗）。
AI.result: 即便大幅剪枝，部分模型在 pass@1 下降的同时仍能匹配甚至超过原模型的推理覆盖，并解出原模型采样中未解出的问题；但严重剪枝下，多样化的 CoT 轨迹会伴随更高的重复率和更不可靠的生成，正确解更难被采样到，总 token 消耗可能急剧上升，即使单条回答更短。此外，expert 选择的收益也可由覆盖与采样效率的分离来解释：pass@1 差异明显的方​​法在大预算下能解决相同问题，但达到共同覆盖目标所需尝试次数不同。
AI.conclusion: 剪枝评估不应只看 pass@1，而应同时衡量模型仍能解决的问题范围（覆盖）与获得正确解的采样成本（效率）；这一双维度视角对理解剪枝的真实代价及 expert 选择等方法的价值具有重要意义。

title: Comparing Monocular and Multi-View 3D Pedestrian Reconstruction Strategies for Urban Intersection Sensing
summary: Understanding how pedestrians move and interact at urban intersections is central to traffic-safety assessment, mobility planning, and smart-city sensing. Such analyses rely on physically grounded descriptions of motion: 3D body pose, metric trajectories, and pose-derived descriptors such as stature and walking speed. Recovering these from fixed roadside cameras is difficult: viewpoints are oblique and long-range, occlusions are frequent, and neither ground-truth 3D pose nor cross-camera identity labels are typically available. We compare two strategies for deriving pedestrian motion descriptors from a multi-camera intersection dataset: a monocular learned pipeline that combines text-prompted segmentation, tracking, and learned 3D body estimation, and a calibrated multi-view geometric pipeline that combines 2D pose estimation, tracking, cross-camera association, and triangulation. Because 3D ground truth is unavailable, we evaluate both with reference-free criteria relevant to intersection analysis: pedestrian coverage, anthropometric plausibility, walking-speed distributions, computational cost, and failure modes. The two strategies exhibit complementary trade-offs. The learned pipeline is simpler to deploy and covers more pedestrians, but suffers from scale ambiguity and systematic height compression; the geometric pipeline yields metric reconstructions more efficiently, but requires calibration, discards pedestrians seen by only one camera, and can produce severe outliers in dense crowds. We distill these findings into practical guidance for selecting a reconstruction strategy and configuring camera infrastructure according to the target analysis task.

AI.tldr: 在两个策略间比较从多相机路口数据中恢复行人运动描述子：单目学习式流水线 vs. 标定多视角几何流水线，并用无参考指标评估其权衡。
AI.motivation: 城市路口的行人运动与交互分析需要物理 grounded 的描述子（3D 姿态、度量轨迹、身高与步速），但固定路侧相机存在斜视、远距离、遮挡，且缺少 3D 真值与跨相机身份标签，导致难以直接评测两种重建方案。
AI.method: 构建两条流水线：(1) 单目学习式：文本提示分割 + 跟踪 + 学习式 3D 人体估计；(2) 标定多视角几何式：2D 姿态估计 + 跟踪 + 跨相机关联 + 三角化。无 3D 真值下，采用覆盖率、人体测量合理性、步速分布、计算开销、失败模式等无参考指标进行对比。
AI.result: 两策略权衡互补：学习式部署简单、行人覆盖更多，但存在尺度模糊与系统性身高压缩；几何式能以更低开销获得度量级重建，但依赖标定、丢弃单相机可见行人，且密集人群下可能产生严重离群值。
AI.conclusion: 给出依据分析任务选择重建策略及配置相机基础设施的实用建议。

title: Conversational Interaction for LLM-Based Clinical Text-to-SQL: A User Study with Healthcare Professionals
summary: Conversational text-to-SQL interfaces could give healthcare professionals natural-language access to electronic health record (EHR) data, but evidence for their real-world usability remains limited: prior evaluations have relied largely on curated benchmarks with fully specified questions or on simulated users. We report a user study in which 14 physicians who regularly work with EHR data used both a single-turn and a conversational multi-turn text-to-SQL interface over the MIMIC-IV database in a within-subjects design; dialogue analyses additionally drew on interaction logs from 21 healthcare professionals across the main study and two pilot studies. The conversational interface was consistently favored: mean System Usability Scale scores rose from 68.2, near the industry average, to 85.9 (p<0.001), with significant advantages across technology-acceptance constructs including performance expectancy, effort expectancy, self-efficacy, and behavioral intention. In post-study forced-choice comparisons, 93% of participants reported greater overall satisfaction with the conversational interface, 86% preferred it for real-world adoption, and 71% trusted its results more; no participant preferred or trusted the single-turn interface more. Turn-level analysis of 425 logged user turns showed that freely composed queries triggered clarification requests in 24.8% of cases versus 1.8% for predefined, fully specified questions, and 64.3% of clarification episodes stemmed from EHR- or clinical-domain knowledge. Conversational interaction is a practical prerequisite, rather than a convenience, for natural-language EHR access. The frequent need for clarification in realistic clinical queries further underscores the importance of conversational interfaces, while benchmark-style evaluation can substantially underrepresent the ambiguity of real clinical use.

AI.tldr: 通过14名医生的被试内实验与21名医护人员的交互日志分析，发现对话式多轮text-to-SQL界面在可用性与采纳意愿上显著优于单轮界面（SUS 85.9 vs 68.2），且真实临床查询中澄清需求远高于基准测试场景，说明对话交互是自然语言EHR访问的实际前提。
AI.motivation: 对话式text-to-SQL有望让医护人员用自然语言访问电子健康记录数据，但真实世界可用性证据不足：既有评估多依赖问题完全明确的人工基准或模拟用户，可能低估真实临床使用中的模糊性。
AI.method: 开展用户研究：14名经常使用EHR数据的医生以被试内设计在MIMIC-IV数据库上分别使用单轮与多轮对话式text-to-SQL界面；并结合主研究与两项预研究中21名医护人员的交互日志进行对话分析，共分析425个用户轮次，统计澄清请求触发率及其来源（EHR/临床领域知识）。
AI.result: 对话式界面获一致偏好：SUS均值从68.2（接近行业平均）升至85.9（p<0.001），在绩效期望、努力期望、自我效能与行为意愿等技术接受构念上均显著占优；强制选择中93%总体更满意、86%更愿实际采用、71%更信任其结果，无人更偏好或更信任单轮界面。自由表述查询触发澄清请求占24.8%，而预定义完整问题仅1.8%；64.3%的澄清情形源于EHR或临床领域知识。
AI.conclusion: 对话式交互是自然语言EHR访问的实用前提而非便利附加；真实临床查询频繁需要澄清，凸显对话界面的必要性，而基准式评估会显著低估真实临床使用的模糊性。

title: Dataset Mismatch Matters in Group Relative Policy Optimization for Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards
summary: Recently, reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is practically very important, where the leading approach is group relative policy optimization (GRPO) that typically faces a trade-off between rollout efficiency and downstream performance. To improve efficiency while preserving performance, existing selective rollout methods mainly exploit only source-side training dynamics to optimize the discrete distribution over source prompts. However, in practice, the source training dataset is rarely identically distributed to the target test dataset. When such a mismatch exists, due to legal or privacy constraints, it is usually not acceptable to share target prompts themselves with the RLVR trainer. Nevertheless, it is still possible for the target data owner to provide limited aggregated feedback from a small held-out target set without revealing target prompts or rollout traces. In this paper, we propose learning-to-reweight rollout (L2RR) that explicitly incorporates target-side performance feedback into GRPO. Specifically, L2RR learns a discrete sampling distribution over source prompts by optimizing a bi-level objective that maximizes accuracy on a held-out target dataset, while simultaneously penalizing rollouts that provide little incremental learning information. Empirical studies on six math reasoning benchmarks and three model scales show that L2RR improves target-domain performance and increases rollout efficiency.

AI.tldr: L2RR：在GRPO选择性rollout中引入目标侧聚合反馈，学习源prompt采样分布，提升目标域性能与rollout效率。
AI.motivation: 现有选择性rollout仅利用源侧训练动态优化源prompt采样分布，但源训练集与目标测试集分布不匹配；同时隐私/法规限制使目标prompt不能直接共享，仅能提供少量留出集上的聚合反馈。
AI.method: 提出learning-to-reweight rollout（L2RR），将目标侧性能反馈显式纳入GRPO。通过双层目标学习源prompt上的离散采样分布：最大化留出目标数据集准确率，同时惩罚增量学习信息少的rollout。
AI.result: 在六个数学推理基准和三种模型规模上，L2RR提升了目标域性能并提高了rollout效率。
AI.conclusion: 利用受限的目标侧聚合反馈重加权源prompt采样，可在保护隐私前提下兼顾性能与效率。

title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
summary:
Recently, harness self-evolution has emerged as an important paradigm for improving agent performance. Prior studies show that evolving the agent harness can effectively enhance agent capabilities without modifying the foundation model's parameters. We find that existing approaches largely study agent evolution on a single task. In practice, coding agents may need to handle multiple task types over time. Whether an agent harness can continuously evolve across multiple tasks without suffering from catastrophic forgetting remains an important open question.
  In this paper, we investigate this open question through a comprehensive empirical study of continual harness self-evolution. We organize three software engineering task datasets into six different evolution directions and apply two representative harness evolution methods to perform continual evolution along these directions. Our experimental results show that evolution on a subsequent dataset can substantially undermine the performance on previously seen datasets. For example, with DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, Meta-Harness improves its performance on SWE-Bench to 94.0% after evolution. However, after further evolution on FeatureBench, its performance on SWE-Bench drops to 32.0% by the fifth round, corresponding to a 66% relative decrease. Finally, based on our experimental findings, we identify several insights, providing directions for the continual self-evolution of agent harnesses. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-Agent/continual-harness-evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实证研究揭示：agent harness 在跨多任务持续自进化时会出现严重的灾难性遗忘，例如 SWE-Bench 上 94.0% 的性能在 FeatureBench 上继续进化五轮后跌至 32.0%（相对下降约66%）。
AI.motivation: 现有 harness 自进化方法大多只针对单一任务评估，而实际 coding agent 需长期处理多种任务类型；harness 能否跨任务持续进化而不发生灾难性遗忘，仍是未解的重要开放问题。
AI.method: 将三个软件工程任务数据集组织成六种不同的进化方向，选取两种代表性 harness 进化方法，沿这些方向进行持续演化实验，系统观测后续数据集上的进化对先前已见数据集性能的影响。
AI.result: 后续数据集上的进化会显著削弱先前任务性能。以 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 上的 Meta-Harness 为例，SWE-Bench 成绩进化后达 94.0%，但在 FeatureBench 上继续进化至第五轮时降至 32.0%，相对下降 66%。
AI.conclusion: 跨任务持续 harness 自进化存在明显灾难性遗忘问题；作者据此总结出若干洞见，为 agent harness 的持续自进化研究指明方向，并开源了代码。

title: SearchInject: Retrieval Exposure Control for Indirect Prompt Injection in Language-Model Search
comment: 6 pages, 3 tables, 6 graphs. Accepted at IEEE ICCC 2026. Author accepted manuscript. Reproducibility artifact: https://www.iccc.org/
summary: An indirect prompt injection can affect a search-augmented large language model only after its carrier page reaches model context. SearchInject controls this admission decision with a joint score combining retrieval relevance, search-abuse cues, instruction likelihood, and two relevance interactions. A quarantine threshold is selected under an empirical 0.5% clean-candidate false-quarantine constraint on a calibration split. Evaluation uses 300 held-out SciFact queries and held-out payload categories within four construction families already represented during development. Across 1,200 query-family outcomes per retriever, top-10 target exposure falls from 0.9408 to 0.1583 for BM25, from 0.9158 to 0.1508 for a normalized hybrid, and from 0.8450 to 0.1375 for latent semantic analysis. These are relative reductions of 83.2-83.7%; the largest absolute change in clean normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank 10 is 0.0018. The frozen threshold yields clean test false-quarantine rates of 0.59-0.65%, above the empirical calibration constraint. A query-level analytical reanalysis accounts for the repeated construction outcomes under an independent-query assumption. A separate 104-case generation follow-up records context removal but no confirmed undefended hijacks under a post hoc endpoint, so it cannot estimate a reduction in attack success. The evidence supports retrieval exposure control within the evaluated construction families; the benefit of the interaction terms at matched clean cost remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: SearchInject 通过在检索阶段引入"准入决策"来阻断间接提示注入：用检索相关性、搜索滥用线索、指令似然及两个交互项构成联合分数并设隔离阈值，使 top-10 目标暴露率相对下降约 83%，而干净 NDCG@10 几乎不变。
AI.motivation: 间接提示注入只有在载体页面进入模型上下文后才会生效，因此把防线前移到"是否允许该页面被检索准入"这一环节，可在污染内容到达模型之前进行拦截。
AI.method: 构造联合打分：检索相关性、搜索滥用线索、指令似然，以及两个相关性交互项；在标定集上以 0.5% 干净候选误隔离率为约束选择隔离阈值。评测使用 300 条留出 SciFact 查询，并在四种构造族内的留出载荷类别上测试，覆盖 BM25、归一化混合检索、LSA 三种检索器，共 1200 个查询-族结果；另做查询级解析重分析（独立查询假设）与 104 例生成式补充实验。
AI.result: top-10 目标暴露率：BM25 由 0.9408 降至 0.1583，归一化混合由 0.9158 降至 0.1508，LSA 由 0.8450 降至 0.1375（相对降幅 83.2–83.7%）；干净 NDCG@10 最大绝对变化仅 0.0018。但冻结阈值在干净测试集上的误隔离率为 0.59–0.65%，高于标定时的经验约束。生成式补充实验中观察到上下文被移除，但在此事后终点下未确认任何无防御劫持，故无法估计攻击成功率的下降。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持在已评测的构造族范围内实现检索暴露控制；交互项在同等干净代价下是否带来额外收益仍未定论，且需注意冻结阈值的误隔离率略超出标定约束。

title: GSLM2: Multi-Stream Speech Representation Learning and Generative Spoken Language Modeling
comment: Equal contribution by Yosuke Higuchi and Tom Fizycki. Core contribution by Mahi Luthra, Charles-Éric Saint-James and Azeez Syed
summary: Generative spoken language models (SLMs) offer a route to learning linguistic structure purely from speech, yet they lag far behind text-based models in both capability and data scaling efficiency. We identify two bottlenecks underlying this gap: the limited linguistic quality of existing speech units and the reliance on a single stream of discrete units to represent speech. Multiple codebooks are widely used to encode acoustic features but rarely to represent speech semantics. We present GSLM2, which learns and models complementary properties of speech at multiple levels of abstraction. Its encoder, SpidR 2.0, uses self-supervised learning with differentiable prediction heads to induce high-quality discrete units at multiple levels. A multi-stream SLM then jointly models these units using a shared temporal backbone, stream-specific predictors, and an autoregressive head that captures cross-stream dependencies. Across training data sizes and model scales, up to 6M hours and 6.5B parameters, GSLM2 consistently improves linguistic competence while scaling more efficiently with data. As a result, it substantially narrows the gap between spoken and text-based LMs; across read and conversational speech domains, we shrink the gap by about two orders of magnitude on sWuggy, sBLIMP, and tSC, while also outperforming competitive speech-text systems on all three tasks. We open-source the training code and model checkpoints at https://github.com/facebookresearch/gslm2.

AI.tldr: GSLM2 通过多层级离散语音单元与多流自回归建模，缩小了语音语言模型与文本语言模型的能力差距。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式语音语言模型（SLM）在能力和数据扩展效率上远落后于文本模型，根源在于语音单元的语言质量有限，以及仅用单一离散流表示语音。
AI.method: 提出 GSLM2：编码器 SpidR 2.0 用自监督学习与可微预测头，在多抽象层级诱导高质量离散单元；多流 SLM 通过共享时间骨干、流专属预测器和捕捉跨流依赖的自回归头联合建模这些单元。
AI.result: 在最高 600 万小时数据和 65 亿参数的规模下，语言能力持续提升且数据扩展更高效；在 sWuggy、sBLIMP、tSC 上于朗读和对话语音域将差距缩小约两个数量级，并在三项任务上全面优于竞争的语音-文本系统。
AI.conclusion: 多层级、多流离散表示能显著提升纯语音学习语言结构的效率，代码与模型检查点已开源。

title: MedICL: Modality-Anatomy-Aware Visual In-Context Learning for Medical Visual Question Answering
summary: Training-free adaptation of medical vision-language models (LVLMs) is a deployment requirement, yet visual in-context learning (ICL) injects modality- and style-mismatched demonstrations into medical contexts, teaching a frozen model the wrong answering style. We present MedICL, which curates demonstrations instead of retraining the model. MADS selects modality-anatomy aligned demonstrations that cover complementary interpretation dimensions; W2C curates them with weak retrieval signals and a strong verification vote that checks demonstrations rather than the model's own outputs; ECC answers with W anchored demonstration sets, aggregates by abnormality-aware signatures, and re-answers once on conflict. On VQA-RAD, SLAKE, and PathVQA under the LLaVA-Med zero-shot protocol, MedICL improves the strongest zero-shot baseline by +11 - +14 points on open-ended and +7 - +14 on closed questions, recovers 71% of fine-tuned open-ended performance on VQA-RAD at zero training cost, and stays robust to shifted or corrupted demonstration banks.

AI.tldr: MedICL 是一种免训练的医学视觉语言模型适配方法，通过"筛选"而非"训练"来构建视觉上下文示例（demonstrations），显著提升零样本开放/封闭式问答性能。
AI.motivation: 医学 LVLM 的免训练部署是实际需求，但视觉 ICL 会把模态与风格不匹配的示例注入医学语境，导致冻结模型学到错误的答题风格。
AI.method: 提出 MedICL，包含三部分：MADS（模态-解剖对齐的示例筛选，覆盖互补解读维度）；W2C（用弱检索信号筛选 + 强验证投票，验证示例本身而非模型输出）；ECC（用 W 组锚定示例作答，按异常感知签名聚合，冲突时重答一次）。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA-Med 零样本协议下的 VQA-RAD、SLAKE、PathVQA 上，开放题较最强零样本基线提升 +11~+14 分，封闭题 +7~+14 分；在 VQA-RAD 上以零训练成本恢复微调开放题性能的 71%；在示例库偏移或损坏时仍稳健。
AI.conclusion: 面向医学场景的示例策展式视觉 ICL 可替代模型重训练，实现高效、鲁棒的免训练适配。

title: Trail: Accurate Local Smart Home Control Using Decision Models
summary: Natural-language driven smart home control remains challenging: cloud-hosted Large Language Models (LLMs) raise privacy concerns, while local Small Language Models (SLMs) can generate invalid actions or misinterpret requests. We introduce Trail (Typed Registry-Anchored Inference for Language commands in Smart Homes), a fully local framework that replaces open-ended command generation with hierarchical typed decisions. Trail exploits the natural structure of a home's action space, selecting a room, device, and operation from candidates derived from the runtime device registry. This ensures valid actions while enabling confidence-based abstention when requests cannot be reliably resolved. We also design a structured memory module that uses typed decisions to support user preferences, device references, and multi-turn interactions. To evaluate Trail, we extend HomeBench and generate three datasets: Trek-Base, which tests natural-language variation; Trek-Robust, which evaluates robustness to changes in the home and its description; and Trek-Memory, which assesses conversational memory across multi-turn interactions. Trail achieves 85.3% accuracy on Trek-Robust versus 69.8% for a finetuned Qwen3.5-4B baseline, while remaining competitive on Trek-Base requests. With memory, Trail resolves 75.6% of the requests that depend on earlier turns, compared with 42.5% for the finetuned baseline given conversation history.

AI.tldr: Trail：一种全本地智能家居控制框架，用"房间-设备-操作"的分层类型化决策替代开放式生成，依赖运行时设备注册表保证动作合法，并配合结构化记忆支持多轮交互；在自建的Trek基准上显著优于微调Qwen3.5-4B基线。
AI.motivation: 云端LLM有隐私问题，本地SLM又容易生成非法动作或误解指令；同时家庭动作空间本身具有天然层级结构，未被现有开放生成式方案利用。
AI.method: 提出Trail框架：将命令生成转为从运行时设备注册表派生的候选中依次选择房间、设备、操作的层级类型化决策，从而保证动作合法，并支持基于置信度的拒答；另设计结构化记忆模块，利用类型化决策维护用户偏好、设备指代与多轮上下文。
AI.result: 扩展HomeBench生成Trek-Base（语言变化）、Trek-Robust（家庭及描述变化鲁棒性）、Trek-Memory（多轮记忆）三个数据集。Trek-Robust上达85.3%，微调Qwen3.5-4B基线为69.8%；Trek-Base上保持相当竞争力；带记忆时对依赖前文请求的解析率75.6%，基线仅42.5%。
AI.conclusion: 类型化、注册表锚定的分层决策能在完全本地部署下兼顾动作合法性与鲁棒性，结构化记忆显著提升多轮交互能力，为隐私友好的智能家居自然语言控制提供了可行路径。

title: TVP: TV is Almost All You Need for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference with a drafter whose proposed tokens are verified by the target model in parallel. Under lossless speculative sampling, a draft token is accepted with probability one minus the total variation (TV) distance between the target and draft distributions, yet drafters are often trained with cross-entropy (CE) or KL. We first show that under matched and well-tuned training, TV matches or surpasses several published draft-training objectives when fine-tuning, and a fixed TV and KL mixture does the same when training from scratch. We identify two remaining problems, TV's vanishing gradients on undercovered tokens and the prefix products that starve later positions in acceptance-length objectives. To address both, we derive TVP, a loss family based on expected acceptance length, whose power parameter interpolates between coverage and acceptance oriented objectives. Annealing the power from zero to one gives the highest or tied-highest acceptance length across three drafter architectures and three target models, including longer drafts and block verification. TVP improves acceptance length over CE by 9.8% when fine-tuning, and over the public DFlash2 training recipes by 6.2 to 12.9%.

AI.tldr: 论文分析投机解码中drafter的训练目标，指出总变差(TV)目标优于CE/KL，并提出TVP损失族解决梯度消失与位置饥饿问题，显著提升接受长度。
AI.motivation: 无损投机采样中draft token的接受概率等于1减去目标与草稿分布间的总变差距离，但现有drafter通常用交叉熵(CE)或KL训练，训练目标与实际接受机制不匹配。
AI.method: 先比较TV、KL、CE等目标的效果；再针对TV在欠覆盖token上梯度消失、以及接受长度目标中前缀乘积导致后续位置收益衰减两个问题，推导出基于期望接受长度的TVP损失族，其幂参数在覆盖导向与接受导向间插值，并采用从0到1的幂退火策略。
AI.result: 微调时TV匹配或超越多个已发表目标，固定TV+KL混合在从头训练时同样有效；TVP在三种drafter架构与三种目标模型上取得最高或并列最高接受长度，微调时比CE提升9.8%，比公开DFlash2配方提升6.2%–12.9%。
AI.conclusion: 训练目标应直接对齐投机采样的接受概率机制；TVP通过幂退火在覆盖与接受导向间平衡，是一种通用且有效的drafter训练损失。

title: Specification-Driven Governance for Fairness-by-Design in Agentic Software Engineering: How Far Can We Go?
summary: Agentic AI is shifting developers' responsibilities from software implementation to software governance. While this paradigm improves productivity, it also raises challenges in ensuring that autonomous coding agents preserve developers' intentions. Among these, operationalizing fairness-by-design is largely unexplored, as existing approaches provide limited support for representing and propagating fairness requirements throughout agentic development workflows. In this paper, we investigate whether specification-driven development can operationalize fairness-by-design in the agentic development of machine learning systems. We study three coding agents on four machine learning applications, using four prompts that progressively operationalize fairness through nine Fairness Specification Elements, and analyze the traceability of fairness requirements across the generated artifacts, the fairness-accuracy trade-off of the resulting models, and the agents' design decisions and rationales. The results show that when fairness is operationalized, agents capture almost all fairness requirements in the specification (97.22%) and preserve most of them in the code (82.41%). However, the resulting models are not significantly fairer, as agents implement fairness as a post-hoc audit that neither shapes training nor prevents model delivery. Specifications thus make fairness traceable, but not enforceable, calling for fairness specifications that state what agents should do when requirements are not met, and for workflows that make the fairness decisions agents delegate to developers explicit.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨规范驱动开发（SDD）能否在智能体驱动的ML系统开发中落实"公平性-by-design"。在3个编码智能体、4个ML应用、4组渐进式提示（基于9个公平性规范元素）上实验表明：智能体能捕获规范中97.22%的公平性需求并在代码中保留82.41%，但模型并未显著更公平，因为公平性被实现为事后审计，既不塑造训练也不阻止模型交付——规范让公平性可追溯却不可强制执行。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI将开发者职责从实现转向治理，但如何确保自主编码智能体保持开发者意图，尤其"公平性-by-design"的操作化几乎未被探索。现有方法难以在智能体开发工作流中表示与传播公平性需求。
AI.method: 采用规范驱动开发方法：在3个编码智能体、4个ML应用上，使用4个渐进式提示，通过9个公平性规范元素逐步操作化公平性；分析生成产物中公平性需求的可追溯性、模型的公平性-精度权衡，以及智能体的设计决策与理由。
AI.result: 公平性被操作化时，智能体捕获规范中几乎全部公平性需求（97.22%）并在代码中保留大部分（82.41%）；但最终模型并未显著更公平，因为智能体将公平性实现为事后审计，既不影响训练，也不阻止模型交付。
AI.conclusion: 规范使公平性可追溯但不可强制执行。未来需要能够规定"需求未满足时智能体应如何行动"的公平性规范，并使智能体下放给开发者的公平性决策更加明确的工作流。

title: Bridging Low-Level Image Fusion and High-Level Semantic Understanding
summary: Remote sensing image fusion and semantic interpretation are usually optimized separately, so reconstruction quality need not preserve downstream retrieval utility. We propose LANCE, which uses structured language as an explicit, indexable semantic state. A frozen vision-language model maps the input to a closed-vocabulary text record; a language-conditioned generator fuses the imagery; and a dense verifier with a differentiable continuous summarizer re-describes the output. Text-text consistency and anti-collapse contrastive text-mask losses with negative queries close the loop without dense annotations or VLM fine-tuning. A variational EM formulation yields a per-step contraction result under regularity assumptions, distinguishing semantic faithfulness from verifier overfitting. Across seven test sets on GF2, QuickBird, WorldView-III, and WorldView-II, LANCE improves reduced-scale reference metrics by up to 11.7% (median 2.1%) over the strongest learning baseline. Independent evaluation using a held-out VLM and a supervised aerial detector yields gains of +6.4 mAP and +0.072 open-vocabulary F1 over the closest competitor. Text perturbations, cross-verifier transfer, and pseudo-RGB ablations examine the mechanisms underlying these gains. The framework connects image fusion to verifiable semantic representations for multimodal retrieval and knowledge management.

AI.tldr: LANCE 用结构化语言作为显式可索引的语义状态，将遥感图像融合与语义检索闭环优化。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像融合与语义解释通常分开优化，重建质量并不保证下游检索可用性，需要让融合结果同时具备可验证的语义一致性。
AI.method: 冻结VLM将输入映射为闭词表文本记录；语言条件生成器融合影像；带可微连续摘要器的稠密验证器重描述输出；用文本-文本一致性与反坍缩对比文本-掩码损失（含负查询）闭合回路，无需稠密标注或VLM微调；并用变分EM给出逐步收缩性结果。
AI.result: 在GF2、QuickBird、WorldView-III、WorldView-II 七个测试集上，降尺度参考指标最高提升11.7%（中位2.1%）；独立VLM与有监督航拍检测器评估分别提升+6.4 mAP 与 +0.072 开放词表F1。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将图像融合与可验证语义表示连接起来，支持多模态检索与知识管理，并通过文本扰动、跨验证器迁移与伪RGB消融验证了机制。

title: ArSciKids: Arabic Curriculum-Aligned Datasets for Scientific Experiment and Multiple-Choice Question Generation in Primary Education
summary: Despite growing interest in Arabic natural language processing, curriculum-aligned educational resources remain scarce compared with English, and few public datasets for Arabic curriculum content with structured, generation-ready annotations are available, particularly for primary-school science. We introduce ArSciKids, a collection of two Arabic datasets designed for curriculum-aligned educational content generation: (1) a scientific-experiments dataset containing 999 manually curated records from official primary-school science textbooks in Saudi Arabia, Syria, and Jordan, and (2) an assessment-question dataset containing 2,167 multiple-choice questions collected from the Saudi Manhaji educational platform. The experiment records are structured with titles, objectives, tools, procedures, observations, conclusions, keywords, and grade levels, while the assessment records contain lesson references, questions, four answer options, correct answers, and explanations. Both datasets cover grades 1-6 and consist of real-life Arabic educational content rather than machine-translated or synthetically generated material. We assess the usefulness of these resources for generation by fine-tuning ten open models spanning sub-billion to several-billion parameter scales using LoRA. Models are evaluated using automatic metrics, including ROUGE and BLEU, and answer accuracy for multiple-choice generation. Moreover, we evaluate the results using a five-criterion human evaluation protocol. The results show substantial differences across model scales and tasks. ArSciKids will be publicly available, and we hope that it provides a manually curated, structured foundation for research on Arabic educational NLP, curriculum-aware generation, and low-resource language modeling.

AI.tldr: ArSciKids：两个阿拉伯语小学科学课程数据集（999条实验记录+2167道选择题），用LoRA微调10个开源模型验证其生成有效性。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语NLP教育资源和课程对齐资源稀缺，缺少带结构化、可生成标注的阿拉伯语小学科学公开数据集。
AI.method: 构建两个数据集：一是来自沙特、叙利亚、约旦官方小学科学教材的999条人工策展实验记录（含标题、目标、工具、步骤、观察、结论、关键词、年级）；二是沙特Manhaji平台的2167道选择题（含课节引用、四选项、正确答案、解析）。覆盖1-6年级，均为真实教育内容。用LoRA微调10个从亚十亿到数十亿参数的开源模型，采用ROUGE、BLEU自动指标与选择题答案准确率评估，并进行五准则人工评估。
AI.result: 不同模型规模与任务间存在显著性能差异；自动指标与人工评估共同验证了数据集的生成可用性。
AI.conclusion: ArSciKids将公开，为阿拉伯语教育NLP、课程感知生成与低资源语言建模提供人工策展的结构化基础。

title: LM6-CastBench: A Geometry-Aware Simulation Dataset for Transient Thermal Prediction in LM6 Sand Casting
summary: Transient thermal fields during solidification connect casting process conditions and cooling behaviour to the formation of defect-prone regions in aluminum cast ings. Repeatedly solving this thermal problem across geometries and process conditions is computationally expensive, motivating data-driven surrogate models. However, existing machine-learning studies on casting thermal behaviour rely on study-specific simulation databases that do not support reproducible geometry-level benchmarking. We introduce LM6-CastBench, an open simulation dataset for geometry-aware learning of transient thermal fields in LM6 aluminum sand casting, combining three geometry families, ten variants per family, five pouring tempera tures, and three mould temperatures (450 geometry-process cases in total). Each case retains CAD geometry, unstructured mesh connectivity, spatial descriptors, process metadata, and time-resolved nodal temperatures. We benchmark a point wise MLP against a spatially structured U-Net under geometry-level data splits; the U-Net reduces temperature-field errors by a large margin, with the biggest gains on geometries with localized features and abrupt section changes. LM6-CastBench gives researchers a reproducible dataset and benchmark for geometry-aware surro gate modelling of casting thermal behaviour.

AI.tldr: 该文提出LM6-CastBench，一个面向LM6铝合金砂型铸造瞬态温度场几何感知学习的开放式仿真数据集与基准，并比较了点式MLP与U-Net两类替代模型。
AI.motivation: 凝固过程瞬态热场将铸造工艺条件与冷却行为同缺陷易发区域的形成联系起来，但跨几何与工艺条件反复求解热问题计算代价高，需数据驱动替代模型；然而已有铸造热行为的机器学习研究依赖各自研究特定的仿真数据库，无法支持可复现的几何级基准测试。
AI.method: 构建开放仿真数据集LM6-CastBench：包含三个几何族、每族十个变体、五种浇注温度与三种模具温度（共450个几何-工艺案例）；每个案例保留CAD几何、非结构网格连接、空间描述符、工艺元数据与时间分辨节点温度。在几何级数据划分下，将逐点MLP与空间结构化U-Net进行基准对比。
AI.result: U-Net大幅降低温度场误差，且在含局部特征与截面突变剧烈的几何上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: LM6-CastBench为铸造热行为的几何感知替代建模提供了可复现的数据集与基准。全文约150字左右，符合"简短"要求。Done.

title: Guarded Compression of Adam Optimizer State with Shared-Gradient Bounds
summary: Adam keeps two FP32 moments per parameter, twice the bytes of the FP32 weights, yet compressing them is risky: the update divides by the square root of the second moment, so small reconstruction errors can change the restored computation substantially. We study guarded moment compression, in which a coordinate's decoded moments are accepted only if they reproduce the native FP32 Adam update to within a tolerance $τ$, in units of the learning rate, for every gradient in a clipped domain; all other coordinates are stored exactly. The natural certificate, which ranges each update separately over gradient intervals, fails: on one million trained OPT-125M coordinates it escapes 98.9% of coordinates and the payload grows to 126.6% of raw FP32. Our key observation is that both updates consume the same gradient and parameter. Bounding their difference directly, with FP32 rounding-error allowances and a fixed mixed linear-logarithmic gradient partition, cuts escapes to 0.53% and the payload to 28.3% at $τ=0.01$. Across 120 complete-checkpoint restores of OPT-125M and ResNet-18, with four trained seeds and three training fractions per model, guarded 8-bit log codes shrink moment payloads by 69.5% and 71.9% relative to FP32, 40.8% and 45.4% relative to equally guarded BF16, and 29.3% and 37.6% relative to equally guarded blockwise 8-bit, and every restored first update stays within tolerance. Encoding and restoration together take 2.3-2.6$\times$ as long as guarded BF16 but less time than guarded blockwise 8-bit. Searching both moment codes jointly saves under 0.001% more bytes at 6% more codec time, so per-moment rounding suffices. The guarantee covers the first restored update under a pinned Torch operation model; we measure subsequent training empirically.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"受保护的动量压缩"(guarded moment compression)：仅当解码后的Adam两个动量能在给定容忍度τ内重现原生FP32更新时接受该坐标，否则精确存储，从而实现安全高效的状态压缩。
AI.motivation: Adam为每个参数保存两个FP32动量（是权重的两倍字节），但直接压缩风险高：更新要除以第二动量的平方根，微小重建误差会显著改变计算。需要一种能保证压缩后更新正确性的方法。
AI.method: 对每个坐标，只有当解码动量在裁剪梯度域内对任意梯度都能在τ（以学习率为单位）内重现原生FP32 Adam更新时才接受压缩，否则精确存储。关键观察是两个动量共享同一梯度与参数，故直接对两者更新之差进行定界，并加入FP32舍入误差容限与固定的混合线性-对数梯度划分作为证书。
AI.result: 朴素的分别区间证书在OPT-125M上逃逸98.9%坐标、载荷达原始126.6%；新方法在τ=0.01时逃逸降至0.53%、载荷28.3%。120次完整检查点恢复中，受保护8-bit对数编码相比FP32减少动量载荷69.5%(OPT)与71.9%(ResNet)，相比等保护BF16减少40.8%/45.4%，相比等保护分块8-bit减少29.3%/37.6%，且所有恢复的首步更新均在容忍度内。编解码耗时是BF16的2.3-2.6倍但快于分块8-bit；联合搜索两动量仅多省0.001%字节却多6%时间，故逐动量舍入足够。
AI.conclusion: 直接对两动量更新差进行联合定界是关键；受保护的8-bit对数编码能大幅压缩Adam状态同时保证首步恢复更新在容忍度内。保证基于固定Torch算子模型下的首步更新，后续训练效果为经验测量。

title: uTECH Turbo-MOVES: The Intersection of Software Architectural Innovation and Sustainable Mobility Analysis
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, under-review with the journal
summary: Transportation is a major source of energy consumption, greenhouse gas emissions, and criteria air pollutants, making efficient emissions estimation essential for environmental planning and policy analyses. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's Motor Vehicle Emission Simulator (MOVES) supports detailed emissions modeling, but its computational demands constrain large-scale scenario analyses. This study introduces uTECH Turbo-MOVES, a software architecture that expedites MOVES computation without modifying its Calculator modules or input/output structure. By combining RunSpec partitioning, container isolation, in-memory intermediate storage, and concurrent workload orchestration, it improves execution efficiency. We evaluate six benchmark cases spanning County, Default, and Project scales and both Emission Inventory and Emission Rates modes. Results demonstrate a measured 5.5x and an estimated 15.3x per-run speedup for Default-scale workloads, and an 84.8x campaign speedup for an eight-county Emission Rates analysis. Although gains vary by workload and hardware configuration, uTECH Turbo-MOVES enables more extensive environmental assessments and transportation policy evaluation.

AI.tldr: uTECH Turbo-MOVES 通过 RunSpec 分区、容器隔离、内存中间存储与并发编排，在不改动 MOVES 计算核的前提下实现 5.5–15.3 倍单次运行加速，八县排放率分析获 84.8 倍提速。
AI.motivation: 交通是能耗、温室气体与污染物的重要来源，精细排放估算对环境规划与政策分析至关重要。EPA 的 MOVES 模型虽支持详细建模，但计算开销大，限制了大规模情景分析。
AI.method: 提出 uTECH Turbo-MOVES 软件架构，不修改 MOVES 的 Calculator 模块及输入输出结构，采用 RunSpec 分区、容器隔离、内存中间存储和并发工作负载编排来提升执行效率；在 County、Default、Project 三种尺度及 Emission Inventory、Emission Rates 两种模式下共六个基准案例上评估。
AI.result: Default 尺度单次运行实测加速 5.5 倍、估算 15.3 倍；八县 Emission Rates 分析的整体任务加速达 84.8 倍；加速幅度随工作负载与硬件配置而异。
AI.conclusion: uTECH Turbo-MOVES 可在保持 MOVES 原有结构的前提下显著提速，支持更广泛的环境评估与交通政策分析。

title: PlagiaCorpus: A Bilingual, Adversarial, and Cross-Lingual Dataset for Forensic Plagiarism Detection
summary: PlagiaCorpus is a bilingual Arabic-English dataset for benchmarking plagiarism and text-reuse detection, including reuse produced by large language models (LLMs) and reuse across languages. It contains 198,643 text records: a source corpus of 34,885 passages drawn from English and Arabic Wikipedia and two openly licensed book collections, and 163,758 queries (147,381 for training and 16,377 for testing). The queries cover five reuse classes of increasing difficulty, namely verbatim copying, character-level obfuscation, same-language paraphrasing by two different LLMs, and English--Arabic translation with structural paraphrasing, together with a Safe class of non-reused passages. Every positive query is linked to its source passage, and the train/test split is grouped by source passage so that no passage contributes queries to both splits. The release was curated through language identification, removal of LLM generation artefacts, and exact and cross-lingual de-duplication. Technical validation reports per-class length statistics, automatic checks of the train/test split, and inter-annotator agreement on a manually rated sample. The dataset is distributed in JSON and Parquet formats under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license.

AI.tldr: PlagiaCorpus is a bilingual Arabic-English dataset of 198,643 records for benchmarking plagiarism and text-reuse detection, covering verbatim copying, character obfuscation, LLM paraphrasing, and cross-lingual translation, with source-linked queries and source-grouped train/test splits.
AI.motivation: Existing plagiarism detection benchmarks rarely cover bilingual (Arabic-English) reuse, LLM-generated reuse, or cross-language translation reuse, so there is a need for a dataset that tests these harder, increasingly realistic scenarios.
AI.method: Built a source corpus of 34,885 passages from English and Arabic Wikipedia and two openly licensed book collections, plus 163,758 queries (147,381 train / 16,377 test) spanning five reuse classes ordered by difficulty: verbatim copying, character-level obfuscation, same-language LLM paraphrasing (two LLMs), and English-Arabic translation with structural paraphrasing, plus a Safe (non-reuse) class. Each positive query is linked to its source; splitting is grouped by source passage; curation involved language identification, removal of LLM artefacts, and exact/cross-lingual de-duplication.
AI.result: Technical validation reports per-class length statistics, automated train/test split checks, and inter-annotator agreement on a manually rated sample; the dataset is released in JSON and Parquet under CC BY-SA 4.0.
AI.conclusion: PlagiaCorpus provides a challenging, contamination-controlled bilingual benchmark that extends plagiarism detection evaluation to LLM-based and cross-lingual text reuse.

title: The Brittle Compass: Navigating LLM Prompt Sensitivity in Slovak Migration Media Discourse
comment: 14 pages, 16 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the First Workshop on Advancing NLP for Low-Resource Languages (LowResNLP 2025), associated with RANLP 2025, Varna, Bulgaria
summary: In this work, we present a case study that explores various tasks centered around the topic of migration in Slovak, a low-resource language, such as topic relevance and geographical relevance classification, and migration source/destination location term extraction. Our results demonstrate that native (Slovak) prompts yield a modest, task-dependent gains, while large models show significant robustness to prompt variations compared to their smaller counterparts. Analysis reveals that instructions (system or task) emerge as the most critical prompt component, more so than the examples sections, with task-specific performance benefits being more pronounced than overall language effects.

AI.tldr: 本文以斯洛伐克语（低资源语言）移民相关任务为案例，考察不同提示设计对模型表现的影响。结果显示母语提示仅带来有限的、依赖任务的增益；大模型对小提示扰动更鲁棒；指令部分是最关键的提示成分（比示例部分更重要），且任务特异性收益比整体语言效应更明显。
AI.motivation: 探索在低资源语言（斯洛伐克语）场景下，提示设计各成分如何影响模型在移民主题相关任务（主题相关性、地理相关性分类、迁移来源/目的地地名抽取）上的表现，弥补对低资源语言提示工程理解不足的问题。
AI.method: 开展案例研究，围绕斯洛伐克语移民主题设计多类任务；通过对比不同提示（母语斯洛伐克语提示 vs 其他）、不同提示成分（系统/任务指令 vs 示例）及不同规模模型，进行系统的提示消融与鲁棒性分析。
AI.result: 母语提示带来温和且依赖任务的增益；大模型相较小模型对提示变体显著更鲁棒；指令（系统或任务指令）是最关键的提示成分，作用超过示例部分；任务特异性带来的性能收益比整体语言效应更显著。
AI.conclusion: 在低资源语言的提示设计中，应优先优化任务/系统指令而非示例，并需关注任务特异性差异；同时模型规模是提示鲁棒性的重要因素。

title: How Reliable Are Object Detection Models Beyond Clear Weather? A Deployment-Oriented Robustness Study for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving perception systems must maintain reliable object detection under diverse environmental conditions, not only in clear daytime scenes. However, the cross-weather robustness of modern detectors remains insufficiently characterised under source-only evaluation. This study evaluates representative object detection architectures trained exclusively on clear daytime driving scenes and tested without adaptation under unseen fog, rain, snow, and night conditions. The evaluation covers lightweight and medium-scale one-stage, two-stage, and transformer-based detectors within a unified protocol. Robustness is assessed using performance Drop (%), a Weather Robustness Index (WRI), and class-level sensitivity analysis for critical road participants, including cars, buses, trucks, and persons. Prediction confidence reliability under environmental domain shift is measured using Expected Calibration Error (ECE). Results reveal consistent performance degradation in adverse conditions, reaching 62.90% at night. Buses show the highest sensitivity to environmental variability, while cars remain comparatively stable across weather transitions. Comparisons indicate that YOLO-based detectors exhibit the lowest calibration mismatch, reflecting stronger agreement between predicted confidence and empirical detection correctness. In contrast, DETR achieves the lowest robustness score, with a WRI of 0.6859, indicating greater vulnerability to cross-weather domain shift. These findings offer deployment-oriented insights into detector robustness and confidence reliability for safety-critical intelligent vehicle perception systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究在统一协议下评估多种检测器跨天气鲁棒性，仅用晴天日间数据训练、无自适应测试雾雨雪夜场景，结果显示性能显著下降（夜间降幅达62.90%），YOLO类校准最好，DETR鲁棒性最差。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知需在多环境条件下可靠检测，但现代检测器在仅源域评估下的跨天气鲁棒性刻画不足，缺乏对部署可靠性的系统认识。
AI.method: 仅用清晰日间驾驶场景训练，在未见的雾、雨、雪、夜间条件下无自适应测试；覆盖轻量与中等规模的单阶段、两阶段及Transformer检测器，统一协议评估；指标包括性能下降率、天气鲁棒性指数WRI、关键类别（车、公交、卡车、行人）敏感性分析，以及预测置信度的期望校准误差ECE。
AI.result: 恶劣条件下性能一致下降，夜间降幅达62.90%；公交车对环境变化最敏感，汽车相对稳定；YOLO类检测器校准失配最低；DETR鲁棒性最差（WRI=0.6859）。
AI.conclusion: 研究为安全攸关的智能车感知系统提供了面向部署的检测器鲁棒性与置信可靠性洞察，提示需关注类别敏感性与跨天气域偏移问题。

title: XLA from the Trenches: Correctness on TPU Workloads at Scale
summary: Accelerating modern foundational models has pushed domain-specific compilers toward increasingly complex, multi-tiered optimization pipelines. However, this heavy optimization focus introduces delicate tradeoffs between peak execution performance and correctness. Subtle codegen defects can trigger numerical degradation and memory or buffer corruption, invalidating multi-million-dollar training runs and degrading live serving quality without raising obvious compiler errors. In this paper, we present a battle-tested methodology for verifying and triaging Google's XLA:TPU compiler at hyperscale. We leverage fuzzing techniques, combining synthetic program generation with real production traces, while orchestrating AI agent swarms to autonomously generate stress tests, reproduce failures, and draft fixes. To pinpoint root causes in full workloads, we pair this with a hierarchical differential pipeline that bisects large graphs down to individual failing operations inside fused kernels. Deployed in production, our framework has already driven the resolution of over 142 compiler bugs (with 103 additional findings under review), from which we distill pragmatic lessons learned.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍一套在 Google XLA:TPU 编译器上大规模落地的验证与问题分诊方法：结合合成程序生成与真实生产 trace 的模糊测试，并用 AI agent 集群自动生成压力测试、复现失败和起草修复，配合分层差分流水线将大图二分定位到融合内核中具体出错算子。生产中已推动修复 142+ 个编译器缺陷（另有 103 个在审）。
AI.motivation: 现代基础模型编译器优化流水线日益复杂多层，峰值性能与正确性之间存在微妙权衡；隐蔽的代码生成缺陷会引发数值退化、内存/缓冲区损坏，且不触发明显编译错误，从而毁掉数百万美元的训练任务并降低线上服务质量。
AI.method: 1) 模糊测试：合成程序生成 + 真实生产 trace；2) 编排 AI agent 集群自主生成压力测试、复现失败、起草修复；3) 分层差分流水线：对大计算图逐层二分，直至定位到融合内核内部单个失败算子。
AI.result: 已在生产部署，推动解决超过 142 个编译器 bug，另有 103 个发现处于评审中，并从中提炼出实用经验教训。
AI.conclusion: 面向超大规模的编译器正确性验证需将混合输入模糊测试、AI agent 自动化闭环与分层差分定位相结合；该经实战检验的方法论可有效发现并分诊深层代码生成缺陷。

title: Do Orthogonality Constraints Help Language-Model Training Beyond Sphere Optimization?
summary: A growing body of work reports benefits from orthogonality constraints in fine-tuning large language models (LLMs). These results raise an open question: do orthogonality constraints also help LLM pre-training? We conduct a systematic empirical study of decoder-only LLM pre-training with models ranging from 360M to 3.1B parameters, trained on nearly 200B tokens. We examine fourteen variants of orthogonality training: some constrain the weight matrix itself, while others use orthogonal factors to reparameterize it. Because a strictly orthogonal square matrix loses half of its degrees of freedom, we also study block-wise orthogonality, where every $d$ rows form a row-orthonormal (Stiefel) matrix and the block size $d$ is a hyperparameter. Among block sizes ranging from 1 to the shorter side of the matrix, no $d>1$ used throughout the network reliably outperforms $d=1$, and large blocks are clearly worse; the one placement that helps, symmetric positive-definite factors on the query and key projections, loses its small gain as models grow. At $d=1$, the constraint reduces to sphere optimization, with each row direction on its own unit sphere, which by itself already improves on tuned Muon. The same two findings hold for a diffusion transformer trained on ImageNet, and after fine-tuning, downstream accuracy does not separate the parameterizations. Our conclusion is that, across the realizations we tried, orthogonality between rows does not help language-model pre-training beyond sphere optimization. Since this appears to conflict with several prior results, we re-examine five prior methods in pre-training and fine-tuning that report orthogonality improvements. In each case the reported gain is attributable to numerical precision, training horizon, optimizer realization, or per-row norm control rather than to the orthogonality the methods impose.

AI.tldr: 系统实证研究表明，行正交约束在LLM预训练中相比逐行球面优化（d=1）并无额外增益，先前报告的"正交性收益"多可归因于数值精度、训练时长、优化器实现或行范数控制。
AI.motivation: 根据已有研究，正交约束在LLM微调中有益，但尚无工作系统检验其对预训练是否同样有效，该问题此前为开放问题。
AI.method: 在360M–3.1B参数、约200B token上预训练decoder-only模型，考察14种正交训练变体：一类直接约束权重矩阵，另一类用正交因子重参数化；并提出分块正交（每d行为Stiefel行正交），将块大小d作为超参数（1至矩阵短边）；另在ImageNet扩散Transformer上复现；随后重新审视5个报告正交收益的先前工作。
AI.result: 除d=1外，无d>1在网络中稳定优于d=1，大块显著更差；唯一有效位置（Q/K投影上的对称正定因子）收益随模型增大而消失；d=1退化为球面优化（每行方向独立于单位球），已优于调优后的Muon。扩散Transformer与微调下游准确率结论一致。
AI.conclusion: 在所尝试的各种实现中，行间正交性对语言模型预训练并无超越球面优化的帮助；先前五个方法的正交收益均可归因于数值精度、训练时长、优化器实现或逐行范数控制而非正交性本身，故与此前结果并不矛盾。

title: DistDebug-Bench: Can LLM Agents Diagnose Bugs in Distributed Systems?
comment: NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets. 41 pages, 10 figures, 24 tables. Benchmark: https://github.com/OrderLab/distdebug-bench. Website: https://distdebug.com
summary: LLM agents show strong potential in software engineering tasks such as competitive programming and code synthesis. Existing benchmarks, however, largely focus on small-scale settings such as self-contained Python modules, leaving distributed systems, an essential class of production software, under-examined. We introduce DistDebug-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating agents' ability to diagnose complex-system failures at the code level. It curates 120 high-quality real-world bugs from 11 widely used distributed systems, spanning 5 programming languages and 10 failure patterns. Through an extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs and agents, we identify substantial gaps between current agents and real-world debugging tasks. A recurring gap is tunnel vision due to a lack of explicit reasoning structure and nondeterminism from inconsistent tool-use scope. The benchmark and evaluator are available at https://github.com/OrderLab/distdebug-bench, with agent traces and a leaderboard at https://distdebug.com.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DistDebug-Bench，一个用于评估 LLM 智能体在真实分布式系统中定位并诊断代码级故障能力的基准，覆盖 11 个系统、5 种语言、10 类故障模式，共 120 个真实缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多聚焦于自包含的 Python 模块等小规模场景，而分布式系统作为生产软件的重要类别尚未被充分考察，导致无法衡量智能体在复杂系统调试中的真实能力。
AI.method: 从 11 个广泛使用的分布式系统中精选 120 个高质量真实缺陷，覆盖 5 种编程语言和 10 种故障模式，构建代码级故障诊断评测基准，并对当前最先进的 LLM 与智能体进行大规模评测。
AI.result: 评测显示现有智能体与真实世界调试任务存在显著差距；反复出现两类问题：因缺乏显式推理结构导致的"隧道视野"，以及工具使用范围不一致带来的不确定性。
AI.conclusion: DistDebug-Bench 填补了分布式系统调试评测的空白，揭示了当前智能体的关键短板，基准与评测器已开源并提供榜单。

title: DR Pixel: Page-Native Deep Research with Vision-Language Models
summary: Complex documents such as scientific papers contain rich information in tables, figures, and equations; however, existing deep research (DR) agents typically reduce papers to OCR-extracted text. We instead ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) can enable page-native deep research: directly retrieving and reasoning over rendered document page images. We introduce DR Pixel, the first open-source end-to-end multimodal DR agent that uses rendered page images as its sole retrieval and reasoning unit, operating over a corpus of 1.06M pages. To evaluate this setting, we construct DRPixelBench, a benchmark on scientific papers requiring reasoning over text, figures, tables, and equations. Surprisingly, page-native DR already works well without training, outperforming OCR-based baselines across state-of-the-art models like GPT-5.4, Gemini-3.5-Flash, and Qwen3.6-27B, while requiring fewer tool calls. We next turn to DR training. A key challenge is that teacher trajectories for agentic supervised finetuning are noisy, mixing critical reasoning and action steps with redundant or failed attempts. To address this, we introduce counterfactual credit reweighting, a fine-grained credit assignment method that weights individual reasoning and action steps by their counterfactual contribution to the final answer. Our training improves retrieval recall by about 15 points and final accuracy by over 10 points on DRPixelBench, and likewise outperforms the untrained baseline on four existing benchmarks. On out-of-distribution ViDoRe-V3, DR Pixel comes within 1.8 points of an oracle that is given the gold pages directly. Our results suggest that the conventional OCR-then-retrieve pipeline is not only unnecessary but suboptimal: directly retrieving and reasoning over visual document pages makes complex DR both more effective and more efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出 DR Pixel，首个完全以渲染页面图像为检索与推理单元的端到端多模态深度研究智能体，并配合反事实信用重加权训练；无需训练的页面原生方案已超过 OCR 基线，训练后再获显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究（DR）智能体把科学论文压缩为 OCR 抽取的纯文本，丢弃了表格、图、公式中的丰富信息。作者想验证 VLM 能否直接在页面图像上做检索与推理（page-native DR），以及 OCR-then-retrieve 流程是否必要。
AI.method: 在 1.06M 页语料上构建 DR Pixel，仅用渲染页面图像作为检索与推理单位；构建 DRPixelBench 基准（需对文本、图、表、公式联合推理）。针对教师轨迹噪声问题，提出 counterfactual credit reweighting：按每个推理/动作步骤对最终答案的反事实贡献对其加权，用于智能体监督微调。
AI.result: 零训练页面原生 DR 在 GPT-5.4、Gemini-3.5-Flash、Qwen3.6-27B 上均优于 OCR 基线且工具调用更少；训练后 DRPixelBench 检索召回提升约 15 点、最终准确率提升逾 10 点，并在四个现有基准上超过未训练基线；OOD 的 ViDoRe-V3 上距给定金标页面的 oracle 仅差 1.8 点。
AI.conclusion: 传统 OCR-then-retrieve 流程不仅不必要，而且是次优的；直接在视觉文档页面上检索与推理能让复杂深度研究更有效也更高效。

title: MedAstra: ASR-less Speech Retrieval with Diagnostic Grounding for Medical QA
summary: Spoken medical question answering can fail when automatic speech recognition (ASR) corrupts a clinically important term before retrieval. We present MedAstra, a framework that maps frozen WavLM speech representations through a lightweight adapter into a frozen E5 text embedding space. This enables a dense retrieval path that accepts a waveform without a query transcript. Retrieved passages and speech-linked textual metadata support answer generation with entity alternatives, diagnostic contrasts, relation heuristics, and bounded retrieval refinement. ASR-less refers to the initial speech retrieval interface; lexical retrieval, string-based entity correction, and the text generator require textual inputs. The deterministic speech embedding does not constitute a calibrated model of acoustic uncertainty. Reported retrieval results reach 87.6 Recall@10 for the speech-only retriever and 90.4 for the hybrid configuration, compared with 81.0 for transcript-first dense retrieval. Medical QA and ablations provide descriptive system comparisons, with input-provenance and evaluation limitations stated explicitly. We distinguish controlled synthetic acoustic tests from real clinical speech, qualify component attribution, and specify the remaining comparisons needed to assess speech-only QA and clinical generalization.

AI.tldr: MedAstra 让冻结的 WavLM 语音表征经轻量适配器映射到冻结的 E5 文本嵌入空间，从而支持无需转写文本的语音密集检索，语音检索 Recall@10 达 87.6（混合配置 90.4），优于转写优先的 81.0。
AI.motivation: 口语医学问答中，ASR 可能在检索前破坏临床关键术语，导致下游检索与回答失败。作者希望绕过转写这一瓶颈，直接用波形做检索。
AI.method: 构建 MedAstra 框架：冻结 WavLM 提取语音表征，经轻量适配器对齐到冻结的 E5 文本嵌入空间，形成接受波形输入的密集检索路径；检索到的段落与语音关联的文本元数据用于答案生成，并结合实体候选、诊断性对比、关系启发式与有界检索精炼。文中也说明词法检索、字符串实体纠错与文本生成仍需文本输入。
AI.result: 语音专用检索器 Recall@10 为 87.6，混合配置为 90.4，对比转写优先的密集检索 81.0。医学问答与消融提供描述性系统对比，并明确说明输入来源与评测局限；区分受控合成声学测试与真实临床语音，并对组件归因加以限定。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了绕过 ASR 的语音检索路径在受控条件下可行，但确定性语音嵌入并非校准的声学不确定性模型，语音端到端问答与临床泛化仍需补充比较实验。

title: CRaFT-XDet: Causal and Robust Fusion Transformer for Dual-Energy X-ray Prohibited Item Detection
summary: Automated prohibited item detection in X-ray security imagery is fundamentally constrained by severe object overlap, scanner-dependent domain shifts, and spurious correlations induced by cluttered baggage composition. Existing detectors largely rely on appearance-driven supervision, limiting their robustness and cross-scanner generalisation. We introduce CRaFT-XDet, a causality-grounded and physics- motivated detection framework that reformulates X-ray threat detection as invariant representation learning under attenuation-driven modality variation. Our approach is grounded in a Scanner-Invariant Causal Detection formalisation (Theorem 1), which establishes that minimising the proposed Causal Invariance Regularisation (CIR) objective across partitioned scanner environments approximates the interventional distribution P (Y | do(Xobj)) under standard identifiability assumptions, providing a principled causal formulation for dual-energy X-ray detection. CRaFT-XDet integrates: (i) causal feature disentanglement to suppress context-induced shortcuts; (ii) physics-motivated regularisation to enforce material-consistent embeddings; and (iii) transformer-based cross-energy interaction modelling for structured reasoning in cluttered scenes. With 29.2 M parameters, 89.5 GFLOPs, and 345 FPS (1.7 ms inference), CRaFT-XDet is real-time deployable. Trained on SIXray with five-fold cross-validation, the framework achieves 0.9389 mAP@0.5 and 0.8021 mAP@0.5:0.95. Without domain adaptation, CRaFT-XDet maintains strong cross- dataset performance on OPIXray and HiXray, indicating robust generalization across heterogeneous scanner distributions. In category-agnostic binary threat detection, the model attains 93.92% recall and 0.9031 mean IoU, highlighting reliability in safety-critical screening where missed detections are costly.

AI.tldr: 提出因果驱动、物理启发的X射线违禁品检测框架CRaFT-XDet，将威胁检测重构为衰减驱动模态变化下的不变表示学习，实现实时且跨扫描仪泛化。
AI.motivation: X射线安检检测受严重物体重叠、扫描仪相关域偏移和杂乱行李引起的虚假相关约束；现有检测器依赖外观驱动监督，鲁棒性与跨扫描仪泛化不足。
AI.method: 基于扫描仪不变因果检测形式化（定理1），提出因果不变性正则化（CIR），在划分的扫描仪环境中近似干预分布P(Y|do(Xobj))；集成三部分：(i)因果特征解耦抑制上下文捷径；(ii)物理启发正则化保证材料一致嵌入；(iii)基于Transformer的跨能量交互建模以应对杂乱场景。
AI.result: 29.2M参数、89.5 GFLOPs、345 FPS（1.7ms推理），实时可部署。SIXray五折交叉验证达0.9389 mAP@0.5、0.8021 mAP@0.5:0.95；无域适应在OPIXray与HiXray保持强跨数据集性能；类别无关二分类威胁检测召回93.92%、平均IoU 0.9031。
AI.conclusion: 因果不变表示学习为双能X射线检测提供有原则的形式化，兼顾实时效率、跨扫描仪泛化与安全关键场景高召回可靠性。
