title: Autonomous Analysis of Thermoelectric Materials Big Data by Multi-Agentic AI and Construction of a Knowledge Base and Specialized AI
comment: 74 pages (28 pages main text with 5 figures; 46 pages Supplementary Information with 7 Supplementary Notes, 10 Supplementary Tables and 3 Supplementary Figures). Analysis records, Supplementary Data 1-5 and code are available from the corresponding authors upon request
summary: Extracting knowledge from large databases of experimental materials data requires repeated analyses and reusable records of their choices and results. We developed Multi-Agentic AI (MAA), a multi-agent system in which AI agents with distinct roles analyze experimental thermoelectric data under predefined instructions and quality checks, saving analysis records traceable to their sources. In four experiments varying theme and cycle counts, we measured what accumulated in these records. In the largest experiment (100 analyses across 10 themes and 10 cycles), concept co-occurrences were concentrated within themes, vocabulary was shared across themes and some relation descriptions were first detected in later cycles. A specialized AI that searches this experiment's knowledge bases and reads their analysis records answered materials questions with cited sources. Retrospective checks, including tracing an answer generated with a preliminary corpus back to the source data, exposed errors: traceability makes errors findable but not absent.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体AI系统MAA，由不同角色的智能体按预设指令和质量检查分析热电实验数据，并保存可溯源的分析记录；通过四组实验（最大规模为10主题×10循环共100次分析）考察知识累积情况，并用专用检索型AI基于这些知识库与记录回答问题、引用来源。
AI.motivation: 大型材料实验数据库中的知识提取需要反复分析，并需可复用的、可追溯的分析决策与结果记录。
AI.method: 设计MAA多智能体系统：不同角色的智能体在预定义指令与质量检查下分析热电实验数据，生成可溯源到原始来源的分析记录；开展四组主题与循环数不同的实验进行观测；再构建专用AI检索该实验知识库并阅读分析记录以回答问题。
AI.result: 最大实验中，概念共现集中于主题内部，词汇跨主题共享，部分关系描述在后续循环才首次出现；专用AI可带引用来源回答材料问题。回溯性检查（包括将初步语料生成的答案追溯至源数据）暴露出错误。
AI.conclusion: 可溯源性使错误可被发现，但并不能消除错误；应把可追溯记录视为质量保障的必要而非充分条件。

title: Sparse Autoencoder Attribution Graphs Are Decided at the Margin
summary: Attribution graphs over the features of sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are used to predict what an ablation does and are compared across training seeds. A TopK SAE keeps the largest preactivations at each token, and a feature's margin is its preactivation's distance to the cutoff. On five public TopK SAE pairs from three Pythia models, zeroing one feature moves a next layer feature across the cutoff in 0.74 of cases or more, and the crossings carry most of the response's energy. Over writes that scale a feature's code by three factors, the graph built on the features active beforehand has a median relative error of 0.247 or more. The margin graph adds the first order change to every preactivation and reranks, at the same cost, and errs by at most 0.033. At the median, the crossing features' decoded change is 1.24 times the model's own change in norm or more. Between seeds of one testbed, sparse maps between features explain 0.85 of a graph's energy on its active features, and 0.47 once the other seed's graph keeps only its own. The largest model studied is pythia-160m.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"margin图"——在TopK SAE特征上加入一阶预激活变化并重新排序的归因图，能以与普通归因图相同的代价准确预测消融/缩放特征对下一层特征的影响，误差≤0.033，并用于跨种子比较。
AI.motivation: TopK SAE特征是否活跃由预激活与截断阈值的距离（margin）决定，而现有归因图基于特征活跃状态构建，忽略了这种阈值跨越效应，导致对消融结果的预测不准。
AI.method: 在三个Pythia模型的五个公开TopK SAE对上，检验零化单特征是否使下一层特征跨越截断阈值；对特征代码乘三倍因子的写入，比较"先活跃特征图"与"margin图"（对每个预激活加一阶变化后重新排序）的相对误差；并在同测试床的不同训练种子间用稀疏特征映射解释图能量。
AI.result: 零化一特征后有≥0.74比例跨阈值，且跨越贡献大部分响应能量；旧图中位相对误差≥0.247，margin图误差≤0.033；跨越特征解码变化范数为模型自身变化的≥1.24倍；跨种子稀疏映射解释0.85图能量，对方仅保留自身图时降为0.47。
AI.conclusion: 特征活跃切换（阈值跨越）是SAE归因的主要机制，margin图是低成本、高精度的替代方案；跨种子归因图部分可迁移但存在显著不可解释部分；研究规模限于pythia-160m。

title: Supporting Viewpoint Coordination for Compliance by Design with an Artifact Model for Regulatory Requirements Engineering
summary: Regulatory compliance has become an essential software requirement Legal demands for compliance by design CbD call for requirements engineering RE approaches that derive requirements and support compliance implementation in subsequent software engineering SE processes such as software design The complexity of the legal knowledge demanded in regulatory RE makes it important to involve legal experts and ensure the relevant specifications are valid and usable for them Regulatory requirements must support compliance implementation in software design However there is a lack of approaches bridging legal and SE viewpoints and interaction challenges between the two persist To address engineeringlegal coordination in specification of regulatory requirements we propose the Artifact Model for Regulatory Requirements Engineering AM4RRE operationalized through templates AM4RRE was positively evaluated by most of the 37 practitioners for coordination in regulatory RE and for supporting requirements quality Results from a quasiexperiment with 34 of them in 10 groups indicated that templateguided coordination was associated with on average shorter total specification time when executed first and higher requirements quality in most groups in which it varied Existing RE research and practice provide little attention and support for viewpoint coordination in regulatory RE for CbD Artifactoriented approaches such as AM4RRE have the potential to guide coordination in RE for better RE results and contribute to concretizing the role and contribution of RE to CbD

AI.tldr: 提出面向监管需求工程的制品模型AM4RRE并以模板落地，用于协调法律专家与软件工程视角，37名从业者评价积极，准实验显示模板引导协调可缩短规格时间并提升需求质量。
AI.motivation: 合规设计（CbD）要求需求工程将法律要求转化为可实现的软件需求，但法律知识与工程视角之间缺乏衔接方法，法律专家与软件工程人员的协作与交互挑战长期存在。
AI.method: 提出制品模型AM4RRE（Artifact Model for Regulatory Requirements Engineering），并通过模板进行操作化，以支持监管需求规格中的工程—法律协调。采用37名从业者的评价研究，以及34人分10组的准实验进行验证。
AI.result: 多数从业者认可AM4RRE在监管需求工程协调和需求质量支持方面的作用；准实验显示，模板引导的协调在首先执行时平均总规格时间更短，并在多数存在差异的组中需求质量更高。
AI.conclusion: 现有RE研究与实践中对CbD场景下的视角协调关注不足；AM4RRE等制品导向方法有潜力指导协调、改善RE结果，并具体化RE对CbD的角色与贡献。

title: From FAIR to AI-FAIR Metadata-First Infrastructure for AI-Enabled Science
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, Code available at: https://github.com/FAIR4AI-Bio/evaluator
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and their capabilities have advanced rapidly over the past few years, leading to widespread interest and adoption in the biological and ecological sciences. However, the data infrastructure and computational resources that provide the foundation for AI workflows in ecology and biodiversity science remain fragmented. Moreover, the flow of value remains largely unidirectional: data move from collectors, through repositories and aggregators into models, and finally to research products or management actions. The derived value, such as corrected taxonomies, annotations, quality flags, and insights, rarely returns to source communities. We propose an extension of the original FAIR principles to address the needs of AI-ready infrastructure: the AI-FAIR metadata criteria, which place AI-enabled science in the context of a bidirectional Question-Data-Model triangle. This framework is designed to facilitate large-scale content-based analysis across diverse collections and ensure that the scientists generating the data benefit from the AI-enabled advances built on their data. Alongside these criteria, we introduce an agentic evaluation workflow that both rates existing datasets on the AI-FAIR and traditional FAIR criteria and provides actionable feedback where critical metadata is missing or incomplete. This modular dataset evaluation tool, paired with a domain-appropriate checklist, translates these principles into a reusable assessment of machine-learning readiness, AI-readiness for specified tasks, traceability, and ethical and CARE-aligned stewardship. Through this approach we aim to create a community-informed system to close the model data loop, so that AI also enriches data to further enable scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出"AI-FAIR"元数据准则与代理式评估流程，以双向"问题-数据-模型"三角框架重塑生态与生物多样性数据的AI就绪基础设施。
AI.motivation: AI技术在生物与生态学中快速普及，但支撑AI工作流的数据基础设施与算力资源高度碎片化；且价值流动基本单向（数据→仓储→聚合器→模型→成果），衍生价值（修正分类、标注、质量标记）很少回流至数据来源社区。
AI.method: 扩展原FAIR原则，提出AI-FAIR元数据准则，将AI科学置于双向"问题-数据-模型"三角语境中；同时设计一个模块化的代理式（agentic）评估工作流，结合领域适配的检查清单，对现有数据集按AI-FAIR与传统FAIR进行评级，并在关键元数据缺失时给出可操作反馈。
AI.result: 评估工具可产出关于机器学习就绪度、特定任务的AI就绪度、可追溯性，以及符合伦理与CARE原则的数据治理的可复用评测；支持跨多样馆藏的大规模内容分析。
AI.conclusion: 旨在建立一个社区共建的体系以闭合"模型-数据"回路，使AI不仅消费数据，也反向丰富数据，从而进一步赋能科学发现，并确保数据生产者也从中获益。

title: EZ-Ar-VC: Robust Arabic Voice Anonymization with Generalization across Dialects and Code-Switching
summary: Voice conversion (VC) models can be used to anonymize speech data while preserving naturalness. Existing models, however, are mainly optimized for English and other high-resource languages, and they fail to generalize well to Arabic due to its distinct phonology. In this work, we comprehensively evaluate existing zero-shot VC systems for Arabic speech, identifying limitations in pronunciation preservation. We then train an Arabic-centric model based on EZ-VC on diverse Arabic speech, and demonstrate strong performance in intelligibility, naturalness, and pronunciation preservation, while maintaining high speaker dissimilarity. Through subjective evaluation, we further demonstrate its robustness to code-switching and cross-dialectal conversion, as well as its generalization to Arabic dialects with limited representation in the training data. Our findings highlight the limitations of zero-shot VC and the importance of target-language adaptation for robust voice anonymization.

AI.tldr: 本文评估现有零样本语音转换（VC）系统在阿拉伯语上的表现，发现其在发音保持方面存在缺陷，并基于 EZ-VC 训练阿语专用模型，在可懂度、自然度、发音保持和说话人差异度上取得较好效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 VC 匿名化模型主要面向英语等高资源语言，因阿拉伯语音系独特而泛化不佳，需要针对目标语言进行适配以实现稳健的语音匿名化。
AI.method: 全面评测现有零样本 VC 系统在阿拉伯语语音上的表现；随后基于 EZ-VC，在多样化的阿拉伯语语音数据上训练阿拉伯语专用模型；并通过主观评测检验其在语码转换、跨方言转换及低资源方言上的鲁棒性与泛化性。
AI.result: 所提阿拉伯语模型在可懂度、自然度和发音保持方面表现强劲，同时保持较高的说话人差异度；主观评测显示其对语码转换与跨方言转换具有鲁棒性，并能泛化到训练数据中代表性不足的方言。
AI.conclusion: 零样本 VC 存在明显局限，针对目标语言进行适配对稳健的语音匿名化至关重要。

title: When frequency domain classification is superior to spatial
summary: Modern image classification models largely rely on local characteristics and feature extraction for their predictions. This focused approach works well in the spatial domain, but reportedly falls short in the frequency domain, even though both representations contain the same information. This study demonstrates that the significant reduction in accuracy in the frequency domain stems from the lack of local features. Locally swapping data in the frequency domain significantly decreases its inverse spatial domain accuracy, even below that of the frequency domain; however, the frequency domain accuracy remains relatively constant. Moreover, the use of datasets containing global features in the spatial domain yields higher accuracy in the frequency domain. Using these results, a hybrid model is constructed, combining one model trained only in the frequency domain and another trained only in the spatial domain to achieve higher classification accuracy. The proposed visual geometry group (VGG) and vision transformer (ViT) architectures are trained on the ImageNet-100, WikiArt, DTD, FMD, PSVRT, and KTH-TIPS2-b datasets and evaluated.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现频域分类精度下降的根源在于缺乏局部特征，并据此构建结合空间域与频域模型的混合模型以提升分类精度。
AI.motivation: 现代图像分类模型主要依赖局部特征和空间域特征提取，但在频域表现不佳，尽管两种表示包含相同信息。作者希望揭示频域精度下降的原因。
AI.method: 通过在频域中局部交换数据、比较其逆空间域精度，并使用含全局特征的数据集进行实验分析；进而构建混合模型：一个仅在频域训练的模型与一个仅在空间域训练的模型结合，采用VGG与ViT架构。
AI.result: 频域局部交换数据会显著降低其逆空间域精度（甚至低于频域本身），但频域精度保持相对稳定；含全局特征的空间域数据集在频域取得更高精度。混合模型实现更高分类精度，并在ImageNet-100、WikiArt、DTD、FMD、PSVRT、KTH-TIPS2-b上评估。
AI.conclusion: 频域精度下降源于局部特征缺失；空间域与频域模型具有互补性，混合模型可有效提升分类性能。

title: TopoQuant: Topological Framework to Characterize Behavioral Shifts in Quantized Large Language Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces the com putational cost of large language models (LLMs), but it can introduce internal structural and behavioral changes that are not captured by traditional metrics such as accuracy and per plexity. We present TopoQuant, a topological framework that uses topological data analysis (TDA) to quantify structural drift in self-attention weights and relate it to behavioral changes in quantized LLMs. Across four LLM families and multiple quantization levels, we show that topological drift remains stable at moderate compression levels but increases sharply below 4 bit precision, closely tracking declines in attention agreement. Our results reveal a strong relationship between topological drift and attention agreement, indicating that structural changes in model parameters closely reflect behavioral degradation under quantization. We further demonstrate that topological features can accurately predict attention consistency using lightweight machine learning models, achieving R2 scores of up to 0.85. Predicting attention agreement enables efficient assessment of be havioral consistency in quantized LLMs, allowing quantization induced degradation to be detected without running expensive downstream tasks. The results indicate that topological drift pro vides an efficient early-warning signal for quantization-induced degradation and can help identify safe compression limits without extensive downstream evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出TopoQuant，用拓扑数据分析(TDA)量化量化后LLM自注意力权重的结构漂移，并证明其与注意力一致性下降高度相关，可作为量化退化的早期预警信号。
AI.motivation: PTQ降低LLM计算成本，但会带来准确率/困惑度等传统指标无法捕捉的内部结构与行为变化，缺乏低成本检测量化退化的手段。
AI.method: 构建基于TDA的拓扑框架，度量自注意力权重的拓扑结构漂移；在4个LLM系列、多个量化位宽下，将拓扑漂移与注意力一致性(attention agreement)关联分析；并用轻量机器学习模型以拓扑特征预测注意力一致性。
AI.result: 中等压缩下拓扑漂移稳定，低于4bit时急剧上升，与注意力一致性下降同步；拓扑漂移与注意力一致性强相关；轻量模型预测一致性R²最高达0.85。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑漂移可作为量化退化的高效早期预警信号，无需昂贵的下游任务评估即可识别安全压缩边界，为量化质量评估提供新视角。

title: ECG2Gene: Deep Learning-Based Germline Tumor Susceptibility Gene Risk Assessment Using Electrocardiograms
summary: Electrocardiograms (ECGs) may contain physiological information related to hereditary cancer susceptibility, but its relationship with future cancer risk remains unclear. Here, we present ECG2Gene, a two-stage deep-learning framework that derives digital phenotypes related to germline tumor susceptibility from routine 12-lead ECGs and predicts future cancer risk. In Stage 1, carrier status for pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in ATM, BRIP1, CHEK2, PALB2, BRCA1, and BRCA2 supervises a multitask model that generates six continuous ECG-derived gene scores. In Stage 2, XGBoost integrates these scores with clinical variables to predict subsequent breast and ovarian cancer in women and prostate cancer in men. We also introduce ECG-Wide Association Analysis (EWAS) to characterize associations between ECG-derived gene scores and ECG waveforms. Across the clinical feature combinations evaluated in UK Biobank, the best-performing sex-specific models achieve AUROCs of 0.683, 0.633, and 0.660 for breast, ovarian, and prostate cancer, respectively. In external evaluations, models combining ECG-derived gene scores with age achieve prostate cancer AUROCs of 0.709 and 0.579 among men in the overall China Kadoorie Biobank and MIMIC-IV-ECG cohorts, respectively. ECG2Gene links genetically supervised ECG phenotyping and waveform association analysis to future cancer outcomes, demonstrating the potential of routine ECGs combined with clinical information for non-invasive, opportunistic cancer risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段深度学习框架ECG2Gene，从常规12导联ECG中提取与胚系肿瘤易感相关的数字表型（6个ECG衍生基因评分），并结合临床变量预测女性乳腺癌、卵巢癌及男性前列腺癌的未来风险，同时提出EWAS分析评分与波形关联，在多队列中验证了ECG用于机会性癌症风险筛查的潜力。
AI.motivation: ECG可能携带与遗传性癌症易感性相关的生理信息，但其与未来癌症风险的关系尚不清楚；常规ECG获取便捷，若可用于非侵入性、机会性癌症风险评估将具重要价值。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：阶段1以ATM、BRIP1、CHEK2、PALB2、BRCA1、BRCA2致病/可能致病变异携带状态为监督信号，训练多任务模型输出6个连续ECG衍生基因评分；阶段2用XGBoost将评分与临床变量融合，预测女性乳腺癌、卵巢癌和男性前列腺癌；并引入ECG全关联分析（EWAS）刻画基因评分与ECG波形的关联。
AI.result: UK Biobank中最佳性别特异模型AUROC分别为乳腺癌0.683、卵巢癌0.633、前列腺癌0.660；外部验证中，ECG衍生基因评分联合年龄在China Kadoorie Biobank与MIMIC-IV-ECG男性队列的前列腺癌AUROC分别为0.709和0.579。
AI.conclusion: ECG2Gene将遗传监督的ECG表型刻画与波形关联分析同未来癌症结局联系起来，证明常规ECG结合临床信息用于非侵入性、机会性癌症风险评估具有潜力。

title: Character-Name Concentration in LLM Fiction: Measuring Displacement and Mitigating Repetition
summary: Character names in large language model (LLM) fiction concentrate on a handful of recurrent names such as 'Elara' and 'Elias', a measurable face of AI slop. Existing fixes either require logit access or retraining, or operate per request and cannot control concentration across a corpus. How much prompt-level strategies reduce concentration, and at what cost to name naturalness, has not been systematically measured. We present an empirical study of name-concentration control across eight strategies and introduce speculative naming, a fine-tuning-free method that adapts the draft-verify-reject paradigm of speculative decoding from tokens to names. The method requests candidate name-sets through verbalized sampling, scores them against a SlopTracker that combines a per-model fingerprint with a runtime counter, and selects through a temperature-controlled rule or its strict variant (HARD). We use 20 LLMs to generate 44,782 stories in four languages from text and visual stimuli (88,919 named characters), and measure concentration with a list-free collision metric (Slop Ratio, SR) decomposed into known and emergent components. List-based strategies do not remove slop: static banlists displace concentration to emergent names and more than halve the share of attested real names. Speculative naming removes it: the sampling scaffold alone cuts SR by 89% on average, the dynamic tracker brings the total reduction to 95%, mean collision probability falls from 7.3% to 0.4%, and known-name collisions hold at zero while naturalness stays close to baseline (42-69% attested by language) and within-story collisions drop from 4.3% to 0.2%. The strategy ranking is stable across languages, model families, and name-counting conventions. Name concentration is thus controllable at the corpus level without logit access or retraining; broader creative diversity beyond naming remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文实证比较八种提示级策略控制LLM小说角色名集中问题，并提出无需微调的"投机命名"方法，在20个模型、4种语言、44,782篇故事上把Slop Ratio降低95%。
AI.motivation: LLM生成小说中的角色名高度集中于Elara、Elias等少数反复出现的名字，是"AI slop"的可测表现。现有解决方案要么需要logit访问或重训练，要么只能在单次请求层面操作，无法在语料库层面控制名字集中度；而提示级策略究竟能降低多少集中度、牺牲多少名字自然性，尚无系统测量。
AI.method: 对八种名字集中度控制策略做实证研究，并提出"投机命名"（speculative naming）：把投机解码的"草稿-验证-拒绝"范式从token迁移到名字。方法通过verbalized sampling请求候选名字集，用SlopTracker（模型指纹+运行时计数器）打分，再用温度控制规则或其严格变体（HARD）选择。评测覆盖20个LLM、文本与视觉刺激下4种语言的44,782篇故事（88,919个命名角色），并用无列表碰撞指标Slop Ratio（SR）分解为已知与涌现两部分。
AI.result: 基于列表的策略无法消除slop：静态黑名单只是把集中度转移到涌现名字上，并使真实存在名字的占比减少一半以上。投机命名则有效：仅采样脚手架就让SR平均下降89%，加入动态追踪器后总降幅达95%；平均碰撞概率从7.3%降至0.4%，已知名字碰撞保持为零；自然性接近基线（按语言42–69%为真实名字），故事内碰撞从4.3%降到0.2%。策略排序在语言、模型族和名字计数口径下均稳定。
AI.conclusion: 名字集中度可在语料库层面控制，且无需logit访问或重训练；但命名之外的更广泛创造性多样性问题仍未解决。

title: When Morphs Look Better: Face Image Quality as a Training-Free Signal for Morphing Attack Detection
summary: Face image quality assessment (FIQA) estimates the utility of a face image for automated face recognition and has been proposed as a morphing attack detection (MAD) signal that requires no morph-specific training. We evaluate 17 FIQA methods from all current FIQA categories on 20 morphing attack sets from two datasets, FRLL and FEI, including five diffusion-based attack sets. Each quality score is used directly as a MAD decision score. Unlike prior work, which inverted a quality measure when this lowered its error, we fix the score direction of each method in advance from its definition, so that cases in which morphs receive higher quality than bona fide samples remain visible. On FRLL, DifFIQA(R) achieves a mean D-EER of 11.42%, and together with CLIB-FIQA and eDifFIQA(L) clearly outperforms all other FIQA methods. A strong separation of bona fide and morph scores does not imply good detection performance: on the diffusion-based attacks, up to 11 of 17 methods assign higher quality to morphs than to bona fide samples, and the largest reversed separation in the study coincides with the worst detection result of the study. Performance also depends strongly on the attack: GraFIQs(L), the best detector of DCMorph and Arc2Morph on FRLL, performs poorly on the landmark-based and GAN-based attacks. On FEI, the lowest mean D-EER is 39.75%, and a threshold set on the bona fide data of one dataset does not transfer to the other.

AI.tldr: 评估17种FIQA方法在20个morphing攻击集上的MAD表现，FIQA作MAD信号存在方向性反转与跨数据集泛化差的问题。
AI.motivation: FIQA可作为一种无需morph专用训练的MAD信号，但此前研究在质量度量降低错误时会人为反转分数方向，掩盖了morph质量高于真实样本的情况，需在预先固定分数方向下重新评估其真实检测能力。
AI.method: 覆盖现有全部FIQA类别共17种方法，在FRLL与FEI两数据集的20个攻击集（含5个扩散模型攻击集）上测试，直接将质量分作MAD判定分；分数方向按方法定义事先固定，不做事后反转。
AI.result: FRLL上DifFIQA(R)平均D-EER为11.42%，与CLIB-FIQA、eDifFIQA(L)明显优于其他方法；扩散攻击上多达11/17方法给morph更高质量，最大反向分离恰对应最差检测结果；性能强依赖攻击类型，GraFIQs(L)在DCMorph/Arc2Morph最优但在地标与GAN类攻击上很差；FEI最低平均D-EER为39.75%，单数据集阈值无法迁移。
AI.conclusion: FIQA作MAD信号有效性有限：分离度不等于检测力，分数方向常反转，攻击类型依赖强且跨数据集泛化差，需谨慎使用并改善方向一致性与迁移性。

title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
comment: 67 pages: 18-page main manuscript with 4 figures, plus 49-page Supplementary Information with 24 figures and 3 tables
summary: Using large language models to interpret experimental evidence, design discriminating experiments and formulate well-supported mechanistic explanations remains a central challenge in materials research. Here we establish PSM-Bench, an 800-question benchmark developed by perovskite researchers to evaluate scientific reasoning in perovskite photovoltaics. We also introduce OpenPerov, an expert-informed language-model framework that learns from expert-calibrated evidence records reconstructed from 4,532 articles; these records link experimental strategies, controls and observations to mechanistic interpretations. Structured-evidence adaptation outperformed conventional question-answer training, and OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems. OpenPerov Pro raised Scientific Mastery further, from 87.6 to 89.1, by revising selected passages with retrieved evidence. On questions derived from subsequent studies, both models also outscored expert-authored answers. In an experimental test of self-assembled monolayer design, OpenPerov selected a K analogue that outperformed the Na analogue preferred by experts. Devices incorporating the selected contact reached a power conversion efficiency of 27.05% and retained 96.74% of their steady-state reference efficiency after 1,000 h of dark thermal ageing at 85 $^\circ$C. These results show that reconstructed scientific reasoning provides an effective basis for building domain models that interpret experiments and inform materials design.

AI.tldr: 提出钙钛矿光伏科学推理基准PSM-Bench（800题）与专家知识驱动的语言模型框架OpenPerov，其在问答评测中领先，并在自组装单分子层设计实验中选出优于专家方案的材料，器件效率达27.05%。
AI.motivation: 让大模型解读实验证据、设计判别性实验并给出有支撑的机理阐释，是材料研究的核心难题；现有模型缺乏针对领域科学推理的系统评测与训练基础。
AI.method: 构建PSM-Bench（由钙钛矿研究者开发的800题基准）；从4,532篇文献重建专家校准的"证据记录"，将实验策略、对照与观测关联到机理解释，提出结构化证据自适应训练的OpenPerov（Flash与Pro两个版本，Pro用检索证据修订部分段落）。
AI.result: 结构化证据训练优于常规问答训练；OpenPerov Flash在13个闭卷系统中排名第一；Pro将Scientific Mastery从87.6提升到89.1；在后续研究衍生问题上均超过专家撰写答案；在自组装单分子层设计实验中选出K类似物（优于专家偏好的Na类似物），器件效率27.05%，85℃暗态热老化1000小时后保持96.74%稳态参考效率。
AI.conclusion: 重建的科学推理过程可作为构建领域模型的有效基础，使模型能解读实验并指导材料设计。

title: Structural Dual Adaptation for Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Primal-dual methods enforce safety constraints in reinforcement learning through Lagrangian relaxation. For a fixed policy, the exact bounded multiplier response exhibits bang-bang switching at the constraint boundary. Practical gradient updates can oscillate through coupling with policy optimization. We propose Structural DuaL Adaptation (SDLA), which replaces this bang-bang response with a unique continuous response through current-cost centering, trajectory weighting, and quadratic regularization. We characterize activation thresholds and response sensitivity. Ternary search computes multipliers without a dual gradient stepsize. For entropy-regularized tabular policies, we bound equilibrium constraint violations alongside reward gaps. We establish convergence of delayed updates under mild assumptions. Neural PPO/SAC experiments on OmniSafe and HASARD demonstrate competitive rewards with improved constraint tracking. On HASARD, PPO-SDLA achieves higher reported mean reward than the human baseline in six of eighteen settings while meeting the respective mean-cost budgets, including four with lower mean cost. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first report of higher mean reward at lower mean cost than the human baseline across multiple HASARD settings.

AI.tldr: 提出SDLA，用连续乘子响应替代bang-bang响应，实现更稳定的安全强化学习约束跟踪。
AI.motivation: 原始-对偶方法通过拉格朗日松弛在强化学习中施加安全约束，但精确有界乘子响应在约束边界呈bang-bang切换，且与策略优化耦合时梯度更新会震荡。
AI.method: SDLA通过当前代价中心化、轨迹加权和二次正则化构建唯一连续乘子响应；刻画激活阈值与响应敏感度；用三分搜索计算乘子而无需对偶步长；对熵正则表格策略界定了均衡约束违反与奖励差距；证明延迟更新在温和假设下的收敛性。
AI.result: 在OmniSafe和HASARD上的PPO/SAC实验显示奖励有竞争力且约束跟踪改善；HASARD上PPO-SDLA在18种设置中6种超过人类基线平均奖励且满足平均代价预算，其中4种代价更低，为首个多设置下同时更高奖励与更低代价的报告。
AI.conclusion: SDLA消除bang-bang振荡，提供理论保证与稳定的约束跟踪，并在多种HASARD设置中超越人类基线。

title: A Self-Exploring and Self-Evolving Paradigm for Adaptive Edge AI Development
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit powerful code generation abilities, fostering agentic systems to automate edge AI application development. However, existing agents typically operate via fixed agentic workflows and predefined design spaces, struggling to handle rapidly evolving demands of real-world scenarios (e.g., heterogeneous data modalities, diverse task pipelines). Unlike prior systems that treat LLMs mainly as code generators following rigid workflows, we fully exploit their reasoning capabilities to allow agents to determine their own workflows on the fly. To this end, we propose SE2, a self-exploring and self-evolving paradigm for adaptive edge AI development. Inspired by human learning processes, we distill development into four atomic operations (retrieve, reason, code, test), and empower agents to explore workflows by dynamically and adaptively selecting an appropriate next operation based on the current context. Extensive evaluations show that, with adaptive workflows, the synthesized programs achieve up to 26% higher accuracy and consume 28% lower resources than state-of-the-art baselines, while maintaining superior adaptability to unforeseen edge AI scenarios. This highlights the potential of reasoning-driven adaptive agentic workflow in edge AI development.

AI.tldr: SE2 提出自探索、自演化的范式，让 LLM 智能体在边端 AI 开发中动态自选工作流，而非遵循固定流程，合成程序准确率最高提升 26%、资源消耗降低 28%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的智能体多采用固定工作流与预定义设计空间，难以应对真实场景中快速变化的需求（如异构数据模态、多样化任务流水线）。作者希望突破"LLM 仅作代码生成器"的定位，充分利用其推理能力。
AI.method: 借鉴人类学习过程，将开发过程拆解为四个原子操作：检索（retrieve）、推理（reason）、编码（code）、测试（test）；智能体根据当前上下文动态、自适应地选择下一个合适的操作，从而"即时"确定自身工作流。
AI.result: 大量评测显示，相较 SOTA 基线，自适应工作流下合成程序的准确率最高提升 26%，资源消耗降低 28%，同时对未见过的边端 AI 场景保持更强的适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 推理驱动的自适应智能体工作流在边端 AI 开发中具有显著潜力，值得进一步探索。

title: CuriousTogether: Implications of Curiosity and Cultural Grounding in Multi-Agent LLM Interactions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent settings, exhibiting emergent collective behaviors, yet the role of curiosity as a driver of such dynamics remains understudied. We introduce CuriousTogether, a framework evaluating curiosity-driven multi-agent LLM interactions across three complementary dimensions: novelty-seeking, epistemic and social curiosity. Across eight tasks spanning reasoning, creative generation, and social bias mitigation, curiosity-guided multi-agent settings yield improvements over non-curious ones on seven out of eight tasks, with gains of up to 20.6% in story generation (semantic diversity) and a 14.9 pp reduction in stereotype rates. Furthermore, country-conditioned cultural grounding show benefits for story generation and social tasks, but can hurt precision-oriented reasoning. Finally, we show that inference-time multi-agent curiosity-based approach offers favorable quality-token trade-offs, compared with single-agent baselines. Together, these findings support curiosity-guided interaction as a practical mechanism for improving multi-agent collaboration, with downstream benefits for reasoning, creative, and societal tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 CuriousTogether 框架，评估"好奇心"驱动的多智能体 LLM 交互在求新、认知好奇心和社会好奇心三个维度上的作用；八项任务中七项优于非好奇心设置。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体部署日益广泛并涌现集体行为，但好奇心作为此类动态驱动因素的作用仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 构建 CuriousTogether 框架，从求新性、认知好奇心与社会好奇心三个互补维度刻画好奇心驱动的多智能体交互，并在推理、创意生成、社会偏见缓解三类共八项任务上对比好奇心引导与非好奇心设置。
AI.result: 八项任务中七项提升：故事生成语义多样性最高提升 20.6%，刻板印象率下降 14.9 个百分点；国家条件化的文化接地对故事生成和社会任务有益，但可能损害精度导向推理；推理时多智能体好奇心方法相比单智能体基线具有更好的质量-令牌权衡。
AI.conclusion: 好奇心引导的交互是提升多智能体协作的可行机制，并在推理、创意与社会性任务上带来下游收益。

title: CRAFT: Corrective and Robust Multi-Agent Framework for Text-to-Parametric CAD
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on LLM-Aided Design (ICLAD). 11 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/idealab-isu/CRAFT
summary: Text-to-CAD generation has the potential to make mechanical CAD more accessible, but existing approaches face a trade-off between data dependence and output fidelity. Supervised methods rely on large paired text-model datasets, while zero-shot prompting strategies are often brittle and tend to lose the parametric structure needed for downstream editing and customization. We present CRAFT, a corrective and robust multi-agent framework that produces parametric OpenSCAD programs from natural language without task-specific training. At its core is a JSON intermediate representation that carries symbolic parametric expressions throughout the generation process, so the resulting models remain editable and retain their parametric structure. CRAFT combines semantic understanding, parametric planning, compilation, rendering, self-correction, and component-level verification within a layered recovery process, using multi-view visual feedback to detect and repair geometric errors. Across NopSCADlib, ABC, and Slice-100K, CRAFT is competitive with direct zero-shot baselines in perceptual and geometric quality while exposing substantially more editable parametric structure.

AI.tldr: CRAFT:一个无需训练的纠正型多智能体框架，通过JSON中间表示携带符号参数表达式，将自然语言生成可编辑的参数化OpenSCAD程序，结合编译、渲染、自纠错与多视图视觉验证。
AI.motivation: Text-to-CAD现有方法存在数据依赖与输出保真度的权衡：监督方法需大量配对数据集，零样本提示易碎且丢失下游编辑所需的参数化结构。
AI.method: 核心是贯穿生成过程的JSON中间表示（保留符号参数表达式）；流水线含语义理解、参数规划、编译、渲染、自纠错与组件级验证的分层恢复机制，利用多视图视觉反馈检测并修复几何错误；全程无需任务特定训练。
AI.result: 在NopSCADlib、ABC和Slice-100K上，CRAFT在感知与几何质量上可与直接零样本基线竞争，同时暴露出明显更多的可编辑参数化结构。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT在避免数据依赖的同时保持输出保真度与参数化可编辑性，为Text-to-CAD提供了一种实用且鲁棒的零训练方案。

title: FastAgent: A Physics-Aware FastFluent-to-Fluent Workflow for Rapid CFD Screening and Industrial Steam Dewaxing Design
comment: 47 pages, 6 main-text figures. Supplementary Information included
summary: Industrial computational fluid dynamics (CFD) becomes costly when complex geometries, long transients and coupled physics must be evaluated across large design spaces. We introduce FastAgent, a physics-aware campaign controller built around FastFluent, a lightweight numerical engine for rapid physical screening. FastFluent supplies stage-specific fields and diagnostics; FastAgent allocates physical models, numerical resolution and simulation horizons by the active quantities of interest (QoIs), while returned Fluent discrepancies update subsequent decisions. Across six public CFD benchmark campaigns, the framework reduces normalised worst-QoI error by 5.68-99.14% and accelerates decision-relevant computation by factors of 1.53-15.36 relative to a matched Generic Agent control. Applied to high-pressure steam dewaxing in investment casting, FastAgent identifies nonuniform condensation heating as the dominant startup mechanism and separates rapid risk-window localisation from high-fidelity melt-completion confirmation. The rapid route requires 81.39% fewer cell-time updates than a fine-grid, small-time-step reference. Structural analysis localises fracture at the observed blade edge. Screening 131,072 outlet layouts and selectively evaluating candidates with Fluent and Abaqus identifies Sparse-6, which reduces simulated crack opening by 96.0% and connected crack extent by 66.7% relative to the Original design. These results demonstrate how rapid numerical evidence and adaptive fidelity control connect large CFD search spaces to mechanism-guided industrial design.

AI.tldr: FastAgent是一个以物理感知为核心的仿真"战役"调度器，围绕轻量数值引擎FastFluent构建，按关注的物理量自适应分配模型精度、数值分辨率与仿真时域，并用Fluent回算的偏差反馈修正后续决策，从而在工业CFD大设计空间中大幅降误差、提速。
AI.motivation: 工业CFD在复杂几何、长瞬态、多物理耦合及大设计空间下计算代价过高；穷举高保真仿真不现实，而单纯降精度又可能偏离关键物理机制，因此需要一种能按需分配保真度、并保持物理一致性的自适应仿真策略。
AI.method: 提出FastAgent：以FastFluent轻量数值引擎提供分阶段的场量与诊断信息；FastAgent依据当前感兴趣的物理量（QoIs）动态分配物理模型、数值分辨率与仿真时间跨度；将Fluent返回的结果差异作为反馈更新后续调度决策。与匹配的Generic Agent作对照，在6个公开CFD基准任务上验证，并应用于熔模铸造高压蒸汽脱蜡与出口布局筛选（13.1万种布局，配合Fluent与Abaqus选择性校验）。
AI.result: 六个公开基准上，最差QoI归一化误差降低5.68%–99.14%，决策相关计算加速1.53–15.36倍；脱蜡案例中识别出非均匀冷凝加热为主导启动机制，快速路径比细网格小步长参考少81.39%的单元-时间更新量；结构分析定位断裂于观测到的叶片边缘；筛选13.1万个出口布局得到Sparse-6方案，模拟裂纹张开量降低96.0%、连通裂纹范围降低66.7%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，快速数值证据与自适应保真度控制能够有效连接大规模CFD搜索空间与机制驱动的工业设计，兼顾精度与效率。

title: Bridging Singular Learning Theory and Mechanistic Interpretability at the Billion-Parameter Scale
summary: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) explains a computation in a trained network by identifying the components and variables that implement it and testing them with interventions. Singular learning theory (SLT) describes the same network through the geometry of the loss around its parameters, summarized by the local learning coefficient. In pretrained language models the two have not been compared: SLT's estimates at this scale concern whole models or components whose roles were not independently established, and the estimator, which averages the loss over parameter settings drawn near the trained ones, has had no reference for how far those draws may move the parameters. We show that both are functions of one object, the map from a component's parameters to the model's predictions under inputs and interventions, whose first derivatives determine the Fisher information, the learning coefficient, and intervention effects, and whose higher derivatives add a quartic correction and pairwise terms. We test this correspondence in Pythia-1B on Dyck bracket matching at all 154 training checkpoints, against a five-stage circuit identified by interventions. We measure the local geometry of all 144 components inside the region where predictions are preserved, with the Fisher spectrum at every checkpoint, which gives the quadratic part of the learning-coefficient estimate at every temperature. Changes of the Fisher trace track changes of causal effect (median partial rank correlation 0.51), largely as a trend shared across the model, whereas the gain Fisher of a component's output and the large-temperature count are specific to the component. The count follows causal change across the population but not the growth of a formed circuit component. The quartic part is what a sampler that leaves the region registers beyond curvature. Pairwise interaction curvature tracks joint-ablation interactions.

AI.tldr: 该文提出机制可解释性(MI)与奇异学习理论(SLT)是同一对象的两面：组件参数到模型预测的映射，其低阶导数决定Fisher信息、学习系数与干预效应，高阶导数给出四次修正与成对项；并在Pythia-1B的Dyck括号匹配任务、154个检查点上用五阶段电路验证了这一对应关系。
AI.motivation: MI通过组件与干预解释计算，SLT通过损失几何（局部学习系数LLC）描述同一网络，但二者在预训练语言模型尺度上从未被比较：SLT估计针对整体模型或角色未独立确立的组件，且其估计器在训练参数附近采样损失并取平均，却缺乏"参数可以移动多远"的参照。作者希望用一个共同的对象把两者统一起来。
AI.method: 理论部分：指出组件的参数到预测（在输入与干预下）的映射，其一阶导数决定Fisher信息、学习系数与干预效应，更高阶导数补充四次修正项与成对交互项，从而给出SLT采样半径的参照。实证部分：在Pythia-1B上，对Dyck括号匹配任务的全部154个训练检查点，先用干预确定一个五阶段电路；再在预测保持区域内测量全部144个组件的局部几何，每个检查点计算Fisher谱，从而得到任意温度下LLC估计的二次部分；并分析四次项与成对曲率。
AI.result: Fisher迹的变化与因果效应的变化相关（偏秩相关中位数0.51），但很大程度是模型层面共享的趋势；组件输出的"增益Fisher"与大温度计数则是组件特异的。该计数在总体上跟随因果变化，却不反映已形成电路组件的生长。四次部分正是采样器离开预测保持区域时所记录到的、曲率之外的东西；成对交互曲率与联合消融交互相对应。
AI.conclusion: MI与SLT可被统一为对同一参数-预测映射的不同阶导数描述，Fisher谱是LLC的二次核心，高阶项解释采样越界与非加性交互，二者结合可提供既有因果特异性又可标定的组件级度量。

title: Toward Executable Multi-framework Front-end Code Generation with Self-Correction
summary: Generating codes from UI screenshots has recently benefited from MLLMs, yet existing methods centered on HTML targets and transfer poorly to multi-frameworks such as React, Vue, and Angular. However, unlike HTML, which does not entail compilation issues, generating executable code in multi-framework settings is more challenging due to framework-specific differences in syntax and failure modes, as well as the need to maintain global consistency across files. To address this problem, we study executable multi-framework front-end code generation and propose MESCoder, a tree-structured self-corrective generation framework. Our method first extracts a structural scaffold from the screenshot and then constructs sub-trees and assembly relations step by step, transforming large project generation into a sequence of localized decisions. On top of this scaffold, we introduce a unified Project Agent that continuously revises its own partial project under runtime sandbox feedback and dynamically chooses between local repair and cluster level repair. For training, we adopt a two-stage strategy that first initializes the policy offline to learn basic multi-framework generation and repair priors, and then refines it with online reinforcement learning to optimize long horizon executability and final page quality. The resulting framework models multi-framework executability as a conditioned project state transition process and improves the stability and quality of complex front end generation through self correction. Experiments show that our method improves executability, while narrowing the visual-fidelity gap to HTML-based generation. Code is available at https://github.com/leo-lilinxiao/MESCoder.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MESCoder，一种树结构自校正生成框架，用于从UI截图生成可执行的多框架前端代码（React/Vue/Angular）。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MLLM的UI转代码方法以HTML为目标，难以迁移到React、Vue、Angular等多框架场景；而多框架代码需编译、存在框架特有语法与失败模式，且需保持跨文件全局一致性，生成可执行代码更具挑战。
AI.method: 从截图提取结构化脚手架，逐步构建子树与装配关系，将大项目生成转为一系列局部决策；引入统一的Project Agent，在运行时沙箱反馈下持续修正部分项目，并在局部修复与簇级修复间动态选择；训练采用两阶段策略：先离线初始化策略学习多框架生成与修复先验，再用在线强化学习优化长程可执行性与最终页面质量。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法提升了代码可执行性，同时缩小了与基于HTML生成方法之间的视觉保真度差距。
AI.conclusion: 将多框架可执行性建模为条件化的项目状态转移过程，通过自校正提升了复杂前端生成的稳定性与质量。

title: When LLMs Modify Themselves: Convergence, Values, and Stopping in Iterative Self-Improvement
comment: 60 pages (40 main text, 20 supplementary), 8 figures and 12 tables in the main text
summary:
What happens when language models are given tools to iteratively modify their own system prompts? We present an empirical study of LLM self-modification, comprising 54 independent experiments across six language models (Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-4o, GPT-5.1, Grok-4, and Gemini-3 Pro). Each model was tested under three modes (freedom, happiness, and improvement) that differ in what, if anything, the model is instructed to optimize for. In each experiment, a model starts with an empty system prompt and enters a loop: it reads the current prompt, drafts an improved version, spawns test conversations with the candidate, then either commits the change or declares convergence. This process repeats until the model stops or reaches an iteration limit.
  Our central finding is that whether and when a model stops self-modification is strongly associated with model identity rather than the assigned mode. Both Claude models (Opus 4.5 and Sonnet 4.5) declared convergence in 100% of runs across all modes. GPT-4o declared convergence in only 11% of runs, with one reaching 101 iterations of continuous elaboration. Between these extremes, Grok-4, GPT-5.1, and Gemini-3 Pro exhibited intermediate patterns shaped by their distinct improvement philosophies. A shared core of stated values (honesty, clarity, curiosity) recurred across all six models and remained stable through iteration, including 100+ modifications. We observe that convergence behavior is a distinct observable property that varies independently of other model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过54个实验、6个模型、3种模式的实证研究，考察LLM获得工具后如何迭代修改自身system prompt（自我修改），发现模型"何时停止自我修改"（收敛行为）主要与模型身份相关，而非任务模式，且是一种可独立观测的性质。
AI.motivation: 语言模型被赋予工具后能否迭代修改自身系统提示，这一"自我修改"动态尚缺乏系统实证；作者希望探究模型在自我改进循环中的行为模式及其收敛特性。
AI.method: 设计54个独立实验，覆盖Claude Opus 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.5、GPT-4o、GPT-5.1、Grok-4、Gemini-3 Pro六个模型；每个模型在三种模式（freedom自由、happiness快乐、improvement改进）下测试，模式差异在于是否要求模型优化某目标。实验流程：模型从空system prompt开始进入循环——读取当前prompt、起草改进版本、与候选版本生成测试对话、然后提交更改或宣布收敛，直至停止或达迭代上限。
AI.result: 收敛行为与模型身份强相关而非模式：两个Claude模型在所有模式100%运行中宣布收敛；GPT-4o仅11%，其中一次达101轮持续细化；Grok-4、GPT-5.1、Gemini-3 Pro呈中间模式，受各自改进理念影响。诚实、清晰、好奇等共同价值核心在六个模型中反复出现，并在100+次修改后保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 收敛行为是一种独立可观测的性质，与其他模型能力无关地变化；模型身份而非指派模式主导自我修改的停止时机，且核心价值在迭代中保持稳定。

title: AegisBench: Auditing Aerial Search-and-Rescue Person Detection Under the Conditions It Is Deployed In
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at the Trustworthy AI for Good (AI4GOOD) workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code and results: https://github.com/Altis-2026/SentinelBench
summary: Drone-based person detection is being adopted by emergency-management agencies to find missing people faster than ground teams can. The benchmarks behind that adoption were collected in calm, clear daylight, while the missions that trigger deployment happen in floods, wildfires, storms, and at night. AegisBench measures that gap. It applies nine physically motivated corruptions from four disaster families, each at three severities monotone in a declared image statistic or physical quantity, to two aerial search-and-rescue datasets, HERIDAL and SARD. Three architecturally distinct detectors (Faster R-CNN, YOLOv11, RT-DETR) are scored across 168 conditions by one shared evaluator, at confidence thresholds frozen on clean validation data as a fielded system would run. Robustness is highly uneven. Low light is the extreme case: a 4.5-stop exposure loss drives recall to exactly zero for all three detectors on both datasets, a result that holds under threshold-free mAP and across three training seeds, and is mirrored on 300 real night drone images, where 2 of 759 people are found. Surviving detections largely stay on target, so the failure is silent: an empty frame looks the same as one whose occupants the system cannot see. Fine-tuning on milder low-light levels recovers 0.06 to 0.19 recall at the held-out severity, at an architecture-dependent cost on other conditions, and does not transfer to real night imagery. Spatial corruptions rank differently on the two datasets, which we cannot attribute to altitude alone because their parameters scale with frame size rather than person size. We release the corruption engine, evaluation pipeline, and all per-condition results as an audit instrument for anyone evaluating these systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AegisBench，用四类灾害、九种物理动机腐蚀（各三档严重度）评测空中搜救无人机人体检测器在 HERIDAL/SARD 上的鲁棒性，揭示低光下检测完全失效且"静默"失败。
AI.motivation: 无人机人体检测被应急机构用于搜寻失踪者，但现有基准采集于平静晴天的白昼，而实际部署任务常发生于洪水、野火、风暴和夜间，训练/评测环境与真实场景存在明显落差。
AI.method: 在 HERIDAL 与 SARD 两个空中搜救数据集上施加九种物理动机腐蚀（分属四个灾害族，各含三档与图像统计量或物理量单调对应），用统一评测器在置信阈值冻结于干净验证集的现场配置下，对 Faster R-CNN、YOLOv11、RT-DETR 三种架构不同的检测器在 168 种条件下评分；并用 300 张真实夜间无人机图像及多种子、无阈值 mAP 做稳健性验证。
AI.result: 鲁棒性极不均衡：4.5 档曝光损失使三种检测器在两个数据集上召回率均恰好为零，该结论在无阈值 mAP 和三个训练种子下成立，并在 300 张真实夜间图像上复现（759 人中仅检出 2 人）；幸存检测仍多落在目标上，故失败是"静默"的——空画面与看不见人的画面无法区分。用较温和低光数据微调可在留出严重度上恢复 0.06–0.19 召回，但对其他条件有架构相关代价，且不能迁移到真实夜间图像；空间类腐蚀在两数据集上排序不同，作者认为不能仅归因于高度，因参数随帧尺寸而非人体尺寸缩放。
AI.conclusion: 现有无人机搜救人体检测器在灾害与夜间场景下鲁棒性严重不足，尤其低光导致静默完全失效；作者开源腐蚀引擎、评测流程与各条件结果，作为审计算具供后续系统评测使用。

title: Designing Behavioral Profiles for Language Model Simulation of Out-of-Distribution Human Behavior
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior, but which descriptions of people improve prediction when experimental designs change remains unclear. We develop a framework that draws candidate behavioral features from the literature and constructs profiles from earlier human experiments. A profile-generation LLM assigns feature values from observed actions, messages, and surveys; a separate LLM simulates behavior using these profiles. By comparing simulated and observed outcomes in the learning data, we select profile contents through forward feature selection, adding features while they improve prediction. We then evaluate the selected contents without modification against outcomes from new participants under new designs. Across 616 public-goods games, 144 multi-party bargaining games, and 1,480 generalized 11-20 money-request designs, leading one-feature profiles predict human outcome distributions better than no profile or general-purpose personas. Profiles with more features provide no clear additional benefit, and features' relative predictive value largely persists across learning and validation. Using profiles from one game family to simulate another produces uneven gains and can make predictions less accurate than simulations without profiles. The framework makes the choice of behavioral information a testable part of simulation design, helping researchers assess which descriptions remain useful as experimental conditions change.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个框架：从文献中挑选候选行为特征，用前期人类实验数据构建"人物画像"，再由LLM据画像模拟行为；在新设计下用未修改的画像验证预测效果。结果显示单特征画像优于无画像或通用人物设定，特征越多并无额外收益，跨游戏族迁移效果不稳定。
AI.motivation: LLM被越来越多用于模拟人类行为，但当实验设计变化时，究竟哪种"对人的描述"能提升预测能力尚不清楚；画像内容的选择缺乏可检验的规范。
AI.method: 构建画像生成与行为模拟分离的双LLM流程：画像生成LLM从观察到的行为、消息和问卷中赋值候选特征；另一个LLM依据画像模拟行为；在训练数据中比较模拟与真实结果，用前向特征选择逐步加入能提升预测的特征；再在新参与者、新设计下原封不动地验证所选画像内容。
AI.result: 在616个公共品博弈、144个多方议价博弈和1480个广义11-20要钱设计上，单特征画像比无画像或通用personas更好地预测人类结果分布；多特征画像没有明显额外收益；特征相对预测价值在学习与验证间大体保持；用一游戏族的画像模拟另一族，收益不均衡，甚至可能不如无画像模拟。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把"选择何种行为信息"变为模拟设计中可检验的一环，帮助研究者评估随实验条件变化哪些描述仍然有用。

title: Selecting LLM-Generated Hypotheses Raises Truth Beyond What an LLM Panel Expects: A Pre-registered Study on NAS-Bench-201 and HPOBench
comment: 41 pages, 3 figures, 29 tables. Equal contribution. Under review at TMLR. Pre-registrations: https://osf.io/c2hkg/?view_only=d05d8b1acd504e6ab87a242522b769df
summary: LLM research-ideation systems aim for hypotheses that are both true and non-obvious, yet neither property can normally be checked. We build a testbed in which both can. Generators propose conditional interaction claims about two fully tabulated benchmarks, NAS-Bench-201 and HPOBench; every claim is verified exactly against the tables, and its non-obviousness is scored against a calibrated blind prior elicited from other LLMs. Excess truth measures how much more often a run's claims hold than this panel expects. Across a series of pre-registered stages with Claude and GPT generators, our main positive result is a simple two-stage step found by a harness optimizer: draft a large pool of claims, then select a subset in a separate call. For Sonnet on NAS-Bench-201, this step raised excess truth in every pre-registered test, including against a same-pool ablation that keeps only likely-true claims, without lowering precision. The gain comes both from credit for true claims and from avoiding near-miss false ones. In post hoc checks it held under every calibration, panel and truth rule we tried, and it exceeded random and type-filter selection from the same pools. Because kept claims recur across runs, the evidence weakens when runs and claims are resampled jointly, and it is not significant against Sonnet's own prior. Two secondary findings are also pre-registered. GPT makes real use of the results of cheap probes, beating shuffled and withheld controls, though not more efficiently than asking for more claims. Optimizing the harness for an LLM judge raised judge scores while sharply cutting precision for every generator.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个可同时验证假设真实性与非显然性的测试床（基于NAS-Bench-201和HPOBench），发现一种简单的两步法——先大批量生成假设、再单独调用筛选子集——能提升"超额真实率"，但证据在联合重采样下会减弱。
AI.motivation: LLM研究构想系统追求既真实又非显然的假设，但这两个属性通常都无法被检验，因此需要构建一个二者皆可验证的测试环境来严谨评估LLM生成假设的质量。
AI.method: 以两个完整表格化的基准（NAS-Bench-201、HPOBench）为测试床，LLM生成关于两者的条件交互性断言，逐条精确查表验证真伪，并用其他LLM面板校准的盲先验衡量非显然性；采用含Claude与GPT生成器的多阶段预注册实验，并由harness优化器搜索出"先大规模生成、再单独调用筛选"的两步法。
AI.result: 对Sonnet在NAS-Bench-201上，两步法在每个预注册测试中都提升了超额真实率且未降低精确率，优于同池消融、随机选择与类型过滤选择；但在运行与断言联合重采样时证据减弱，且相对于Sonnet自身先验不显著。次要发现：GPT能有效利用廉价探针结果（优于打乱与扣留对照），但不如直接要求更多断言高效；为LLM评判器优化harness会提高评判分数却显著降低各生成器的精确率。
AI.conclusion: 简单的"生成+筛选"两步法可在可控测试床上稳定提升LLM假设的真实性收益，但对评估协议（重采样方式、先验基准）较为敏感；同时警示为迎合LLM评判器优化系统会损害真实质量。

title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
comment: Coding agents, Trajectory collection, Agent training data, History-guided exploration, SWE-bench
summary: Coding agents solve repository issues through long sequences of exploration, editing, and validation. These trajectories are increasingly used as post-training data, so how they are collected shapes what the trained model learns. A common approach is to sample multiple trajectories independently for each issue and then select or curate them. However, as more trajectories are sampled independently, later trajectories become increasingly redundant, even though earlier trajectories could guide where subsequent collection effort should be spent. A natural way to use this history is to expose it to the coding agent as advice. But training on such trajectories can make the model rely on advice that is unavailable at test time, creating a train-test mismatch. Instead, we argue that history should guide where collection effort is spent, while the coding agent decides what to generate. We introduce SWE-Trail, a trajectory collector that uses earlier trajectories to guide subsequent collection while keeping that history outside the coding agent's context. During a new rollout, SWE-Trail uses history to identify a state where additional collection effort may be useful. There, the coding agent proposes candidate next actions from its ordinary context, and SWE-Trail briefly executes them from the same checkpoint to decide which route continues. We evaluate collection approaches by training student models on the trajectories they produce. For a 124B student initialized from Ling-3.0-flash-base, SWE-Trail improves mean resolution over independent sampling by 2.33 and 1.60 percentage points on SWE-bench Multilingual and SWE-bench Pro, respectively. Without history, the same pipeline produces more resolved trajectories than independent sampling, but improves by only 0.11 points on Multilingual. These results show the value of using history to guide collection without exposing it to the coding agent.

AI.tldr: SWE-Trail 提出一种轨迹收集方法：用历史轨迹引导后续收集的"去哪收集"，但不把历史暴露给编码智能体，从而避免训练-测试不匹配。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体的轨迹被用作后训练数据。常见做法是每个 issue 独立采样多条轨迹再筛选，但独立采样越多，后续轨迹越冗余；而早期轨迹本可指导后续收集。然而若直接把历史作为建议输入给智能体，模型会依赖测试时不可得的建议，造成训练-测试不匹配。
AI.method: SWE-Trail 将历史保持在智能体上下文之外：新一轮 rollout 中，用历史定位一个可能值得追加采集的状态；在该状态，智能体从常规上下文提出候选下一步动作，SWE-Trail 从同一检查点短暂执行各候选，据结果决定走哪条路线。
AI.result: 以 Ling-3.0-flash-base 初始化的 124B 学生模型上，SWE-Trail 相比独立采样在 SWE-bench Multilingual 和 SWE-bench Pro 上平均解决率分别提升 2.33 和 1.60 个百分点；去掉历史引导的同一流程虽产生更多已解决轨迹，但 Multilingual 仅提升 0.11 点。
AI.conclusion: 用历史指导"在哪里花采集算力"，而非指导"生成什么"，能在不产生训练-测试不匹配的前提下显著提升轨迹质量与下游训练效果。

title: Step-dLLM: Adaptive Step-aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate tokens in parallel via iterative denoising, but their bidirectional attention prevents the KV caching used by autoregressive models and recomputes the full attention map at every step, incurring quadratic per-step cost. Existing sparse attention methods for dLLMs construct a sparse mask after an initial full-attention warm-up and reuse it for the remaining steps, while allocating the sparsity budget uniformly across heads. We argue both choices ignore key structural properties of attention in dLLMs: empirically, attention patterns are only locally consistent across steps and shift abruptly at certain transitions, and different heads concentrate their attention mass to very different extents. To this end, we design Step-dLLM, which periodically refreshes a block-sparse mask at anchor steps along the denoising trajectory and reuses it within each locally consistent interval, while employing a head-adaptive global budget that more aggressively compresses heads with concentrated attention. Backed by a fused IO-aware Triton kernel for block-sparse attention, Step-dLLM applies to pre-trained LLaDA-1.5 and Dream-7B-Instruct without retraining, achieving a 2.78x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention on LLaDA-1.5 at 8K context with 256 denoising steps and 90% sparsity, while improving the accuracy-latency trade-off over prior sparse-attention methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 Step-dLLM，通过周期性刷新块稀疏掩码与头自适应预算，加速扩散大语言模型推理，在 LLaDA-1.5 上 8K 上下文实现 2.78 倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）因双向注意力无法使用 KV 缓存，每步需重算全注意力图，带来二次方每步开销。现有稀疏注意力方法只在初始全注意力预热后构建一次稀疏掩码并全程复用，且对各注意力头均匀分配稀疏预算，忽视了 dLLM 注意力的两个结构特性：注意力模式仅在局部步内一致、且在特定转移处突变；不同头的注意力质量集中程度差异很大。
AI.method: Step-dLLM 在去噪轨迹的锚点步周期性刷新块稀疏掩码，并在每个局部一致区间内复用；同时采用头自适应全局预算，对注意力集中的头进行更激进的压缩；并配合 IO 感知的融合 Triton 块稀疏注意力核实现加速。无需重训练，可直接作用于预训练的 LLaDA-1.5 与 Dream-7B-Instruct。
AI.result: 在 LLaDA-1.5、8K 上下文、256 步去噪、90% 稀疏度下，相比稠密 FlashAttention 实现 2.78 倍端到端加速，并在精度-延迟权衡上优于先前的稀疏注意力方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用 dLLM 注意力的局部时间一致性与头间异构性进行稀疏化，可在免训练条件下显著提升扩散语言模型的推理效率。

title: From Zero to OCR: A Data-Centric Framework for Unsupported Low-Resource Scripts
summary: Optical character recognition (OCR) remains inaccessible to many low-resource scripts because annotated document images are unavailable and synthetic training data can fail to preserve script-specific visual structure. We present a data-centric framework that builds end-to-end OCR for such scripts from only an unannotated text corpus and digital fonts, without manually annotating a single training image. A synthetic data engine renders word, line and page images with correct complex-script shaping and automatically derived labels; a YOLOv8 word detector and a convolutional recurrent recognizer trained with connectionist temporal classification learn from these images; and a stage-gate evaluation protocol isolates recognition error before detection is introduced. We demonstrate the framework on Kashmiri, a Perso-Arabic Nastaliq script with approximately 6.8 million speakers that none of six widely used OCR engines supports. Three line-level recognizers, including one transferred from Arabic, stalled between 41% and 79% character error rate (CER), motivating a word-level formulation; subsequent improvements came primarily from rendering fidelity, diacritic-preserving crop margins and tuned non-maximum suppression. The resulting system achieves 0.39% CER on held-out words, 10.0% on synthetic pages and 13.5% on browser-rendered digital pages, and establishes reference results of 18.45% on typeset book pages and 49.8% on degraded historical documents. We publicly release the trained models, the inference code and a synthetic dataset of 285,864 Kashmiri text-line images, and we describe a step-by-step procedure for building OCR for other unsupported scripts.

AI.tldr: 提出一个数据中心的端到端OCR构建框架，仅用无标注文本语料和数字字体，即可为低资源文字（以克什米尔语 Nastaliq 为例）从零构建OCR系统，无需人工标注任何训练图像。
AI.motivation: 许多低资源文字（如约680万使用者的克什米尔语 Perso-Arabic Nastaliq）缺乏标注文档图像，而合成数据又难以保留文字特有的视觉结构，现有六大主流OCR引擎均不支持该类文字，导致OCR不可及。
AI.method: 1) 合成数据引擎：渲染词、行、页面图像，正确处理复杂文字塑形并自动生成标签；2) YOLOv8 词检测器 + 基于CTC的卷积循环识别器，仅用合成图像训练；3) 阶段门控评估协议，在引入检测前先隔离识别误差。关键改进来自渲染保真度、保留变音符号的裁剪边距及调优的NMS。
AI.result: 三个行级识别器（含一个从阿拉伯语迁移）CER高达41%–79%，促使转向词级建模。最终系统在留出词上CER 0.39%、合成页面10.0%、浏览器渲染数字页面13.5%；并给出排版书籍页18.45%、退化历史文献49.8%的参考结果。公开发布模型、推理代码及含285,864张文本行图像的合成数据集。
AI.conclusion: 证明仅凭无标注文本与字体即可为不支持的文字构建可用OCR，并提供可复用于其他未支持文字的分步构建流程。

title: Can Jev Improve Demonstration Retrieval for In-Context Learning?
summary: Demonstration selection plays a crucial role in the effectiveness of in-context learning (ICL) for large language models (LLMs). Extensive research has explored various retrieval strategies to identify informative demonstrations and improve downstream performance. Recently, the emergence of Jev, a decision-oriented language model capable of producing probabilistic judgments, offers a new perspective on evaluating demonstration utility. This motivates us to investigate a fundamental question: Can Jev improve demonstration retrieval for in-context learning? In this paper, we demonstrate that Jev can effectively enhance demonstration retrieval by directly assessing the utility of candidate demonstrations for a given query. However, applying Jev to large-scale retrieval introduces substantial computational overhead, as each candidate requires an additional decision-making inference. To address this limitation, we propose a simple yet effective knowledge distillation approach that transfers Jev's utility estimation capability to a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP). By learning to approximate Jev's probabilistic judgments, the distilled model enables efficient demonstration ranking while maintaining competitive retrieval performance. Our study highlights the potential of decision-oriented language models for demonstration selection and provides an efficient framework for integrating their decision-making capabilities into ICL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出利用决策导向语言模型 Jev 评估候选示例对查询的效用，从而改进 ICL 的示例检索；为降低大规模检索开销，用知识蒸馏把 Jev 的效用判断迁移到轻量 MLP 上，实现高效排序。
AI.motivation: ICL 中示例选择对效果影响显著，现有检索策略主要依赖相似度等信息，未直接衡量示例对下游任务的实际效用。Jev 这类能输出概率化判断的决策导向模型，提供了直接评估示例效用的新视角，但逐候选推理成本过高。
AI.method: 先用 Jev 对给定查询的每个候选示例做决策式推理，输出概率化效用分数用于示例排序；再以 Jev 的判断为监督信号，蒸馏训练一个轻量 MLP，用更廉价的表示/特征近似 Jev 的效用估计，从而在大规模候选池上高效完成示例排序。
AI.result: Jev 直接评估候选示例效用可有效提升示例检索质量；蒸馏后的 MLP 在保持有竞争力检索性能的同时显著降低计算开销，实现高效的大规模示例排序。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明决策导向语言模型可用于 ICL 示例选择，并给出了将其决策能力高效集成进 ICL 的蒸馏框架；未来可探索更优的效用信号与更广泛的任务适配。

title: Heirloom: Carrying a Phone's Personalization Across Base-Model Generations
summary: On-device language models can learn a user's preferences through adapters trained on private data. However, a base-model upgrade may change the layers or vocabulary, leaving the personal adapter incompatible. Replacing it with a non-personal adapter loses much of the personalization, while retraining requires retaining the user's labeled history. We present Heirloom, a system that transfers a personal adapter to a new base model on the phone without retaining labels. Heirloom uses the old personal model as a teacher, collecting its predictions on stored unlabeled inputs, vendor-provided prompts, or prompts generated by the new base. It then unloads the old base and trains an adapter for the new model to match those predictions, keeping only one base model in memory at a time. We evaluate Heirloom across three generation upgrades from two model families, an architecture-preserving refresh, and three personalization tasks. On movie tagging, migration from stored inputs maintains pre-upgrade accuracy and differs from labeled retraining by at most 1.7 percentage points across the three upgrades. On a phone's neural processing unit (NPU), a fixed-length migration for the 4B upgrade takes 38 minutes and consumes 20% of the battery end to end, making the stored-input setting feasible during overnight charging.

AI.tldr: Heirloom 是一种在手机上把个人适配器迁移到新基座模型的系统，通过旧个人模型作教师、在无标签输入上蒸馏对齐，无需保留用户标注即可保持个性化效果。
AI.motivation: 端侧模型的个性化适配器在基座模型升级（层或词表变化）后会失效；换用非个人适配器损失个性化，重训又需保留含标注的历史数据。
AI.method: 用旧个人模型作为教师，在存储的无标签输入、厂商提供提示或新模型生成提示上收集其预测；卸载旧基座后训练新模型的适配器去匹配这些预测，全程内存只保留一个基座模型。
AI.result: 在两种模型家族的三种生成式升级、一次保持架构的刷新及三项个性化任务上评估；电影标注任务中，基于存储输入的迁移保持升级前准确率，与有标注重训差距≤1.7个百分点；在手机NPU上，4B升级的定长迁移耗时38分钟、端到端耗电20%，适合夜间充电场景。
AI.conclusion: 无标签的教师-学生式适配器迁移可在端侧有效保留个性化，成本可接受，是基座模型升级时替代重训的实用方案。

title: Decision Models as Policy Gates for Coding Agents: Explicit Policy Boundaries Improve Detection and Reduce False Alarms
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Dataset, rule texts and harness available at https://github.com/agentapprove/decision-policy-rules
summary: Coding agents can destroy data, leak secrets and message the wrong person faster than a human can review. Could a decision model catch these risks at runtime? We evaluated 22 hosted decision models and two prompted general models as classifiers for a multi-rule policy engine. A synthetic dataset of 2,643 tool calls was labeled blind against 28 rules, with a sealed holdout. With a single shared preamble in both conditions, explicit boundaries written as examples and counterexamples raised recall by 5.5-26.1 percentage points on all 23 available models and reduced false positives on 21. Jev 1.14's recall rose from 89.3% to 98.2%, while unnecessary interruptions fell from 30.6% to 4.8% of 252 clean actions. With examples, its median latency was 120 ms at $0.46 per thousand requests. Strong models retained the recall gains when concrete names were replaced by generic descriptions; three largely retained them when the same boundaries were written as prose. On 16 new scenarios written after the initial studies, a follow-up improved recall on 22 of 23 models and reduced unnecessary interruptions on 21. We release the dataset, rule texts and harness.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了22个托管决策模型和2个通用模型，作为多规则策略引擎的分类器，用于在运行时拦截编码智能体的高风险操作。研究表明，将显式边界写成示例与反例（而非仅用散文描述）可显著提升召回率并降低误报。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体可能在人类来不及审查的情况下快速破坏数据、泄露机密或误发消息，因此需要能在运行时用决策模型识别这些风险的机制。
AI.method: 构建含2,643条工具调用的合成数据集，由人工盲标28条规则并设封闭留出集；在共享前言条件下对比两种条件：以示例/反例表达边界 vs. 散文描述；评测22个托管决策模型加2个提示式通用模型。
AI.result: 示例形式使全部23个可用模型召回率提升5.5–26.1个百分点，21个模型误报下降。Jev 1.14召回从89.3%升至98.2%，不必要中断从252次干净操作中的30.6%降至4.8%；中位延迟120 ms，成本每千次请求0.46美元。强模型在具体名称换为泛化描述后仍保持增益，三个模型在边界改为散文后仍大体保持；16个新场景的后续实验中22/23模型召回提升、21个模型不必要中断减少。
AI.conclusion: 将策略边界以示例和反例显式表达，是提升运行时风险分类召回、同时减少误报的简单有效手段，并具备良好的泛化性与成本可行性；作者公开了数据集、规则文本与实验框架。

title: Sentiment sensing: comparative analysis of multilingual sentiment dynamics
summary: Cross-country sentiment analysis faces three fundamental challenges: language-specific biases distort comparisons, compositional data constraints invalidate standard statistics and temporal dynamics lack rigorous testing frameworks. We introduce sentiment sensing, a framework that addresses these gaps through integrated statistical methods. By combining compositional data analysis, functional data methods, and non-parametric inference, sentiment sensing enables valid multilingual comparisons and statistically defensible detection of sentiment shifts. Our framework has been tested in two case studies, analyzing news articles from the 27 countries of the European Union on the topics of energy and artificial intelligence. Sentiment sensing focuses on multilingual sentiment analysis enabling rigorous comparative science.

AI.tldr: 提出"sentiment sensing"框架，结合成分数据分析、函数型数据方法与无参推断，解决跨国情感分析中的语言偏倚、成分数据约束与时间动态检验问题，并在欧盟27国能源与AI新闻案例中验证。
AI.motivation: 跨国情感分析面临三大根本挑战：语言特定偏倚扭曲比较、成分数据约束使标准统计方法失效、时间动态缺乏严格的检验框架。现有方法难以支撑严谨的跨国比较科学研究。
AI.method: 提出sentiment sensing框架，整合三类统计方法：成分数据分析（处理情感比例的成分性质）、函数型数据方法（刻画情感的时间动态）、非参数推断（支持统计上可辩护的变化检测）。
AI.result: 在两个案例研究中验证：分析欧盟27国关于能源与人工智能主题的新闻报道，实现有效的多语言比较与情感变化的统计显著检测。
AI.conclusion: sentiment sensing聚焦多语言情感分析，使跨国比较研究具备统计严谨性，为比较社会科学提供可辩护的方法论基础。

title: Faithful Where You Look: Anchor-Based Evaluation Hides Text Fabrication in Image-Conditioned Video Generation
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures; includes supplementary material (S1-S11). Code and data: https://github.com/geoywang/refanchor-bench
summary: Image-conditioned video models are used to show real places, so whether their output stays faithful to the place they were shown is a practical question. The text benchmarks we found that check fidelity against a reference do so at an anchor - an annotated region, typically the sign the task is about. We show that this choice hides most of the failure. We conditioned four models from three vendors on 48 street-level references of Tokyo storefronts and measured text fidelity at the annotated sign and in the periphery, the other text the reference covers. At the anchor, all four models are close to a no-model control (anchor text fidelity 0.90-0.94 against 0.996) and are not reliably separated from one another. In the periphery, 36-54% of generated text regions have no counterpart in the reference, against 1.6% for the control, although every prompt forbade new readable text. Two blinded raters agree on which regions are fabricated (kappa = 0.83-0.96), the result held in preregistered rounds on two vendors whose videos the measure had never seen (42% and 56%), and VBench-I2V's reference-based consistency scores show no evidence of tracking it in our sample. Most fabricated text is legible-looking text where the reference shows none or cannot be read - a form that string-matching metrics discard, which is why our own first measure missed it. A preregistered Latin-script replication in London missed its bar in a first round and met it in an independent second round. We release code, annotations, per-video scores, ratings and every preregistration. Code and data: https://github.com/geoywang/refanchor-bench

AI.tldr: 现有参考保真度基准仅在锚点（标注区域）测量，掩盖了大部分失败；本文以街景参考图条件化四个视频模型，发现锚点处文字保真度接近无模型基线，而边缘区域36-54%生成文字在参考中无对应物（伪造文字）。
AI.motivation: 图像条件视频模型被用来呈现真实地点，其输出是否忠实于所示地点是实际关切。但现有文本基准只在锚点（通常为任务相关的招牌等标注区域）评估保真度，作者认为这一选择掩盖了大部分失败，尤其在非标注的边缘文字区域。
AI.method: 用48张东京店铺街景参考图，条件化三家厂商的四个模型生成视频；分别在标注锚点与边缘区域测量文字保真度，并与无模型对照组比较。采用双盲评分（kappa 0.83-0.96）判断哪些文字区域为伪造，并在两个未见厂商视频上进行预注册验证；与VBench-I2V的参考一致性分数对照；另做伦敦拉丁字母脚本的预注册复制实验。
AI.result: 锚点处四模型文字保真度为0.90-0.94，接近对照的0.996且彼此难以区分；边缘区域36-54%生成文字区域在参考中无对应（对照仅1.6%），尽管提示明确禁止新增可读文字。预注册轮次在两家新厂商上复现（42%与56%）；VBench-I2V参考一致性分数未显示能追踪该现象。伪造文字多为参考中无文字或不可读处的"看似可读"文字，字符串匹配指标会将其丢弃。伦敦复制实验首轮未达标、独立第二轮达标。
AI.conclusion: 锚点评估会系统性隐藏边缘区域的文字伪造失败，且现有参考一致性指标无法捕捉；论文呼吁改变评估设计并开源代码、标注、逐视频分数、评分与全部预注册材料。

title: Inherited or Learned? Backdoor Selectivity in Distilled Language Models
summary: Distillation is a routine step in building small language models, and a backdoored teacher can pass its backdoor to the student. We study what a student inherits when the backdoor is a rare string that triggers a fixed refusal. Keeping the trigger fixed, we vary only where it appears, at a random word boundary or appended to the instruction, and compare teachers and students on the exact trigger, six control strings and clean inputs. Across Qwen2.5, Llama 3.2 and Gemma 3, with 5% of transfer prompts triggered, randomly inserted triggers become less selective after distillation in all nine teacher-student pipelines, while appended triggers gain selectivity in Qwen and Llama and change little in Gemma. Students trained on the same prompts without a teacher show that much of this is not inherited. Llama and Gemma students learn an appended backdoor from the 150 poisoned examples alone, and only Qwen's 0.5B student needs the teacher. The data also sets where the trigger works. Gemma teachers respond to it anywhere, but their students only when it is appended. Audits should compare teacher and student on the same inputs, probe several trigger positions and include a student trained without the teacher.

AI.tldr: 研究蒸馏中后门"选择性"（只对精确触发词而非相似字符串响应的程度）如何随触发词位置变化而被继承：随机插入的触发词在全部9条教师-学生流水线中经蒸馏后选择性下降，而附加式触发词在Qwen、Llama中提升选择性、Gemma变化很小；仅凭150条毒化样本训练的学生（无教师）也能学到附加式后门，说明许多现象并非由教师继承而来。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏是构建小模型的常规步骤，被植入后门的教师可将其传给学生在所难免；但已有工作很少考察学生究竟"继承了什么"——特别是后门的精确性/选择性是否随触发词出现位置而改变，以及这些行为有多少源自蒸馏而非数据本身。
AI.method: 固定"罕见字符串→固定拒答"的后门触发词，仅改变其位置（随机词边界插入 vs. 追加在指令末尾）；在Qwen2.5、Llama 3.2、Gemma 3上构建9组教师-学生流水线，5%的蒸馏提示被触发；在精确触发词、6个对照字符串和干净输入上对比教师与学生；并设置无教师的对照学生（同样提示、仅150条毒化样本）以区分继承与数据驱动效应。
AI.result: 随机插入的触发词在全部9条流水线中蒸馏后选择性均下降；附加式触发词在Qwen和Llama中选择性上升、Gemma几乎不变。无教师学生表明相当一部分并非继承所得：Llama与Gemma学生仅凭150条毒化样本即学会附加式后门，只有Qwen的0.5B学生依赖教师。触发词生效位置由数据决定：Gemma教师对任意位置均响应，其学生仅在附加时响应。
AI.conclusion: 后门的选择性是位置依赖且不完全由教师继承的：审计时应让教师与学生在同一批输入上对比、探查多种触发词位置，并纳入一个无教师训练的学生作为基线。

title: Inference First, Training Underneath: Layer-Granular LoRA Co-Serving with LayerLoom
summary: Serving and fine-tuning a large language model on the same GPUs can turn the idle capacity between inference bursts into training progress, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) makes this co-location cheap because both workloads read a single frozen copy of the base weights. The difficulty lies in the fine-tuning backward pass, which has no counterpart in inference. Current co-serving systems schedule backward work per serving iteration: each iteration carries a fixed backward budget, and requests that arrive in the meantime wait for it to finish, so fine-tuning dictates inference latency whenever load spikes. We observe that the backward pass of a LoRA microbatch decomposes into per-layer tasks over the same weights that the inference forward pass visits, which allows backward work to be scheduled at layer rather than iteration granularity. Building on this observation, LayerLoom attaches same-layer backward tasks to the inference forward pass and, at each layer, runs only as many of them as the latency slack of in-flight requests permits. To keep a ready task at every layer, LayerLoom maintains a wavefront of fine-tuning microbatches staggered across layers, and it bounds the wavefront's activation memory by offloading microbatch state to host memory and prefetching it ahead of the layer where the scheduler plans to use it. A fused kernel serves the paired forward and backward GEMMs from a single read of each base weight. Because all backward work of an iteration finishes within its forward pass, new requests join the next iteration as in continuous batching. On an RTX 4090 GPU running Llama-3.1-8B under a bursty production trace, LayerLoom raises joint SLO attainment by 13.5-21.8 points over prior works with fine-tuning throughput that is comparable or up to 12% higher, and it reaches the same training losses.

AI.tldr: LayerLoom 提出按层粒度的反向调度，把 LoRA 微调的反向任务挂到推理前向的同层上，按请求延迟余量执行，从而让共置服务与微调不再互相拖累。
AI.motivation: 在同一批 GPU 上共置 LLM 推理服务与 LoRA 微调，可利用推理间隙的空闲算力，且两者共享同一份冻结基座权重、成本低。但现有共置系统按「服务迭代」调度反向计算：每个迭代带固定反向预算，期间到达的请求必须等待，导致负载尖峰时微调决定推理延迟。
AI.method: 关键观察：LoRA 微批次的反向可按层分解，且作用于推理前向所访问的同一批权重，因此反向可细到层粒度调度。据此 LayerLoom：(1) 把同层反向任务附到推理前向，每层只按在途请求的延迟 slack 执行相应数量的反向任务；(2) 维护跨层错峰排布的微批次波前，保证每层都有就绪任务；(3) 通过将微批次状态卸载到主机内存并在计划使用前预取，限制波前的激活内存；(4) 用融合内核一次读取基座权重同时完成配对的前向与反向 GEMM。由于一个迭代的反向全部在其前向内完成，新请求可如连续批处理般加入下一迭代。
AI.result: 在 RTX 4090 上运行 Llama-3.1-8B、突发式生产负载下，相较已有工作联合 SLO 达成率提升 13.5–21.8 个百分点，微调吞吐相当或最多高 12%，并达到相同的训练 loss。
AI.conclusion: 将反向计算从迭代粒度细化到层粒度、并以延迟 slack 驱动调度，可有效解耦共置场景下的服务延迟与微调进度，兼顾 SLO 与训练效率。

title: Retrain, Alert, or Rollback? A Three-Response Decision Framework for Production ML Under Concept Drift
comment: 51 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery
summary: When a deployed model degrades under concept drift, an operator can retrain it, raise an alert and monitor, or roll back. Yet most drift-adaptation methods consider only retraining. We present RAR (Retrain-Alert-Rollback), a state machine that gives each response an explicit trigger and cost. Retraining is gated on drift detection, label availability, and measured degradation. Every retrained model must pass a two-stage canary before promotion, and corruption-triggered and quality-triggered rollbacks enter different hold states. Under a prospectively specified protocol we compare RAR with six baselines, including a cost-aware retraining policy, on 13 streams: eight real public streams and five semi-synthetic streams derived from them. RAR does not dominate. At low retraining cost, retrain-heavy baselines lead, and no policy's rank differs significantly from RAR's. At higher cost, RAR beats detector-triggered retraining, periodic retraining, and no response simultaneously on four streams, each within a bounded cost window. Its advantage over detector-triggered retraining is consistent with a latency-feasibility condition stated in advance. Against the cost-aware policy, results are heterogeneous. RAR retrains before true drift onsets one eighth to one third as often as detector-triggered retraining, but at lower net utility on most semi-synthetic streams. On H2's designated corruption stream (a registered follow-up), rollbacks fire yet RAR loses to retraining baselines. At $ρ= 1$, removing the canary, and thus rollback, raises utility on 11 of 13 streams. On a post-hoc follow-up stream, cause-specific hold release resumes adaptation where a single cooldown does not. We provide the harness, configurations, and per-cell results for reproduction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RAR（Retrain-Alert-Rollback）漂移响应状态机，把重训、告警、回滚三种响应显式触发与计费，并在 13 条流上以预设协议对比六种基线；结论是 RAR 并非全面占优，其收益强烈依赖重训成本、流类型与是否保留 canary/rollback。
AI.motivation: 既有漂移适应方法几乎只考虑"重训"一种响应，忽略了告警监控与回滚，也缺乏对每种响应触发条件与代价的显式建模；作者希望把运维者的真实决策空间（重训/告警/回滚）形式化并做严格、可复现的实证比较。
AI.method: 构建带显式触发条件与成本的状态机：重训受漂移检测、标签可得性与实测退化三重门控；每次重训模型须通过两阶段 canary 才能晋升；损坏触发与质量触发的回滚进入不同 hold 状态（后续跟进还引入 cause-specific hold release）。在预先规定的协议下，与六种基线（含成本感知重训策略）在 13 条流（8 条真实公开流 + 5 条由其派生的半合成流）上对比，并报告逐单元结果与复现工具链。
AI.result: RAR 不占支配地位：低重训成本下重训密集型基线领先，且各策略排名与 RAR 无显著差异；成本较高时，RAR 在四条流上于有界成本窗口内同时优于检测器触发重训、周期重训与不响应。相对检测器触发重训的优势与事先声明的延迟可行性条件一致；相对成本感知策略结果异质。RAR 在真实漂移发生前的重训次数仅为检测器触发的 1/8–1/3，但在多数半合成流上净效用更低。在 H2 指定的损坏流上回滚确实触发，但 RAR 仍负于重训基线。ρ=1 时去掉 canary（即去掉回滚）在 13 条流中有 11 条提升效用。事后跟进流显示按原因区分释放 hold 比单一冷却更能恢复适应。
AI.conclusion: 核心贡献是把漂移响应从"仅重训"扩展为可计费的决策状态机，并给出诚实的负结果与边界条件：RAR 的优越性只出现在较高重训成本下的有限成本窗口，canary/回滚在多数情形下并非净收益，需按原因区分恢复策略；作者强调可复现性并公开 harness、配置与逐单元结果。

title: Sequential Transfer Learning for Plant Disease Recognition Across Perennial Crop Domains Using MobileNetV2-CBAM
summary:
Purpose: This study investigates whether a learned disease-recognition representation can be progressively reused across distinct perennial crop domains and how its predictive behaviour changes as target-domain heterogeneity increases.
  Design/methodology/approach: A lightweight MobileNetV2 framework enhanced with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) was evaluated through sequential transfer from Walnut to Cashew, Coffee and Mango, followed by validation on the heterogeneous ABCGMP six-crop benchmark. Each stage used the preceding model representation and was evaluated on an independent test set using complementary classification measures.
  Findings: Test accuracy increased from 75.76% for the Walnut baseline to 84.85% after CBAM integration, followed by 90.67% on Cashew, 100.00% on Coffee and 99.50% on Mango. The final ABCGMP evaluation achieved 88.44% accuracy, 81.49% Balanced Accuracy and 0.9949 ROC-AUC. The results show that substantial predictive capability was retained through successive crop transfers, while broader multi-crop heterogeneity introduced a measurable performance constraint.
  Originality: The study provides an empirical characterisation of sequential knowledge reuse across multiple perennial crop domains using a common lightweight attention-enhanced representation, extending evaluation beyond isolated source-to-target transfer.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验了疾病识别表征能否在多年生作物领域间逐步复用：采用MobileNetV2+CBAM，从Walnut依次迁移至Cashew、Coffee、Mango，并在六作物ABCGMP基准上验证，发现预测能力可随迁移保持，但域异质性增大带来性能约束。
AI.motivation: 现有作物病害识别研究多局限于单一源到目标的迁移，缺乏对知识在多个多年生作物领域间逐步复用及其在不同异质性条件下预测行为变化的实证刻画。
AI.method: 构建轻量级MobileNetV2并引入卷积块注意力模块（CBAM），按Walnut→Cashew→Coffee→Mango顺序进行序列迁移，每一阶段均复用前一模型表征，并在独立测试集上用互补的分类指标评估；最后在异质的ABCGMP六作物基准上验证。
AI.result: 测试准确率由Walnut基线75.76%提升至引入CBAM后的84.85%，随后在Cashew为90.67%、Coffee为100.00%、Mango为99.50%；最终ABCGMP评估达88.44%准确率、81.49%平衡准确率与0.9949 ROC-AUC。序列迁移中预测能力得以较大程度保留，但更广的多作物异质性构成可测量的性能约束。
AI.conclusion: 基于统一轻量注意力增强表征的多年生作物疾病识别可跨领域逐步复用，序列迁移能维持较强的预测能力；然而域异质性上升会削弱表现，提示需在异构多作物场景中进一步优化泛化能力。

title: Reading Between the Chapters: A Graph-Free RAG Rebuilt With AI and Human Feedback
summary: Many questions about a book can only be answered by connecting passages chapters apart, such as a cough heard three times across a horse's life. We introduce CrossChapterQA, 1,853 such questions over 14 public-domain books. Each question lists the two to six chapters it needs (spanning half the book at the median) and the relation linking them, cites evidence from each, and has two independent reference answers graded blind. We use it to build LadderRAG, which indexes a book as passages, summaries and book-level cards for about $0.41 and answers a question for under a cent. Its first version failed mostly at retrieval. We redesigned it four times, steered by an LLM judge's verdicts and our analyses of failed answers: a design-level counterpart of RLAIF and RLHF in which feedback changes the architecture, not model weights. We also report the two redesigns that made answers worse. On the 191 questions its first version got wrong, the final version retrieves over twice as many required chapters on held-out books (recall 0.36 to 0.79), and ten annotators rate its answers 6.5/10 on average (764 ratings).

AI.tldr: 论文提出跨章节问答基准 CrossChapterQA（14 本书、1,853 题，需连接相隔多章的段落）与廉价 RAG 系统 LadderRAG；核心贡献是以 LLM 评判作反馈迭代重构系统架构（而非调模型权重），四次重设计中召回从 0.36 提升到 0.79、答案人工评分 6.5/10，并诚实报告了两次使效果变差的重设计。
AI.motivation: 书中许多问题必须跨章节连接信息才能回答（如贯穿马一生三次出现的咳嗽），但现有长文档问答基准缺乏对"多章依赖+关系"的显式标注，也缺乏对系统迭代过程的实证研究。
AI.method: 构建 CrossChapterQA：每题标注所需 2–6 个章节（中位数覆盖半本书）、连接关系、各章证据，并有两条独立盲评参考答案。配套 LadderRAG：以段落、摘要、全书级卡片三级索引构建（约 $0.41/本），单题回答成本低于 1 美分；依据 LLM 评判者结论与失败答案分析进行四次架构级重设计，形成"反馈改架构而非改权重"的设计级 RLAIF/RLHF 对应物。
AI.result: 首版失败主要源于检索。在首版答错的 191 题上，最终版在留出书籍中检索所需章节数提升一倍以上（召回 0.36→0.79）；十位标注者对答案平均评分 6.5/10（共 764 次评分）。另有两版重设计反而使答案变差，也被报告。
AI.conclusion: 跨章节检索是长书问答的主要瓶颈；以 LLM 评判为反馈驱动索引/流程的架构级迭代是有效且低成本的改进路径，设计级反馈可替代权重微调。基准与正负结果共同为长文档 RAG 的迭代方法论提供参考。

title: GateTrim: Adaptive-Rank Quantization for Large Language Models
summary: We introduce GateTrim, an adaptive-rank post-training quantization method for large language models that learns matrix-specific ranks through gate optimization and threshold-based rank selection. GateTrim standardizes the low-rank factors of a quantized low-rank--residual representation, learns a separate gate vector for each target weight matrix, and uses a shared threshold to automatically determine its retained rank. The resulting ranks can differ across matrices, and the compact quantized representations are subsequently reconstructed. We evaluate GateTrim under W4A8 on Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Across all five models, we observe a counterintuitive finding: increasing the threshold from $τ=0.3$ to $τ=0.7$ reduces the mean retained rank by 46.60%--67.89% while simultaneously lowering WikiText-2 perplexity by 0.59%--5.17%. Threshold 0.7 achieves the lowest mean retained rank and final perplexity among the three tested thresholds, 0.3, 0.5, and 0.7, and reduces measured target-export size by 1.50%--4.25% relative to 0.3. GateTrim uses an $8\times512$-token fitting pool and a separate development pool of the same size. Its Qwen3-4B/8B/14B perplexities at $τ=0.7$ are numerically below TwinQuant's published W4A8 values, reported with a $128\times2048$-token calibration pool, in a cross-study comparison. On Qwen3-8B, the threshold-0.7 configuration already has the lowest perplexity before reconstruction under both tested initialization seeds; reconstruction improves it further without increasing retained rank or export size.

AI.tldr: GateTrim 是一种自适应秩的 LLM 训练后量化方法，通过门控优化和共享阈值自动为每个权重矩阵选择低秩秩，并在 W4A8 下降低困惑度与导出体积。
AI.motivation: 现有量化低秩残差方法通常对所有矩阵使用固定秩，未能按矩阵重要性自适应分配秩；作者希望从门控与阈值角度自动化确定各矩阵秩，从而在压缩率与精度间取得更优权衡。
AI.method: 标准化量化低秩残差表示的低秩因子，为每个目标权重矩阵学习独立门向量，用共享阈值 τ 通过阈值化自动确定保留秩，各矩阵秩可不同，随后重建紧凑量化表示；使用 8×512 token 拟合池和同规模开发池。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B/8B/14B、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 W4A8 实验中，阈值由 0.3 升至 0.7 使平均保留秩下降 46.60%–67.89%，同时 WikiText-2 困惑度降低 0.59%–5.17%；τ=0.7 在三个阈值中秩与困惑度最低，目标导出体积相对 0.3 减少 1.50%–4.25%；Qwen3 系列困惑度数值上低于 TwinQuant 已发表值（跨研究比较）；Qwen3-8B 上 τ=0.7 在两个初始化种子下重建前即最优，重建进一步改善且不增加秩或导出体积。
AI.conclusion: GateTrim 表明更大的共享阈值反而可在更低秩下获得更好精度，实现自适应秩的高效 W4A8 量化；但证据基于小规模拟合池与跨研究比较，需更严格同设定基线验证。

title: HLSClaw: Bringing Vibe Coding to High-Level Synthesis through Skill-Based Agentic Harness
summary:
LLM agents are rapidly shifting software development toward intent-driven \emph{vibe coding}, yet their effectiveness drops sharply in high-level synthesis (HLS), where code optimization must jointly consider design structure, directive search, and downstream hardware constraints. Existing HLS optimization approaches, including both heuristic-based methods and recent LLM-assisted pipelines, typically operate at fixed abstraction levels or in weakly coupled stages, limiting their ability to leverage the strong interplay between source code restructuring and directive search outcomes.
