  Our key insight is that HLS optimization can be reframed from a fixed, hardwired transformation pipeline into a skill-based agentic control problem: an LLM agent equipped with modular, executable optimization skills and a feedback-driven orchestrator can autonomously navigate the coupled space of code restructuring and directive search. This motivates the design of HLSClaw, the first HLS-specific, skill-based agentic harness for holistic HLS optimization. On real-world HLS benchmarks, HLSClaw achieves a 39.12x geometric-mean latency speedup, outperforming the compiler baseline ScaleHLS by 1.98x, and surpassing the commercial coding agents Claude Code and Codex by 1.86x and 1.70x, respectively, while maintaining strong timing robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出HLSClaw，首个面向HLS优化的技能化智能体框架，将HLS优化重构为由可执行技能模块与反馈驱动编排器构成的智能体控制问题，在真实基准上实现39.12倍几何平均延迟加速。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体推动的intent-driven vibe coding在HLS高层综合中效果显著下降，因为HLS优化需同时考虑设计结构、指令搜索与下游硬件约束。现有启发式方法和LLM辅助流水线往往固定在特定抽象层级或阶段间耦合弱，无法利用代码重构与指令搜索之间的强交互。
AI.method: 将HLS优化从固定硬编码的变换流水线重构为技能驱动的智能体控制问题：为LLM智能体配备模块化、可执行的优化技能，并设计反馈驱动的编排器（orchestrator），使其自主导航代码重构与指令搜索的耦合空间，形成HLS专用技能化智能体harness（HLSClaw）。
AI.result: 在真实HLS基准上取得39.12倍几何平均延迟加速；相比编译器基线ScaleHLS提升1.98倍，分别超过商用编码智能体Claude Code与Codex 1.86倍和1.70倍，并保持较强的时序鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 技能化智能体控制是HLS整体优化的有效范式，能统一代码重构与指令搜索的耦合优化，显著优于传统编译器基线与通用编码智能体，且具备良好的时序稳定性。

title: Interpreting Classical Readability Formulae as Surprisal
summary: Surprisal correlates closely with reading time and is widely used in the cognitive science of reading as a measure of processing difficulty. Classical readability formulae such as the Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, which scores a text by the US school grade expected to read it, are the most widely used practical measures of text difficulty, but their coefficients are unitless regression constants and have never been related to surprisal. We theoretically show that these coefficients can be interpreted as surprisal: every formula of the classical additive shape is a sum of per-word and per-sentence cross-entropies under a memoryless model, and once that model is tied to the language through Zipf's law and the formula is read as its linearisation at a reference text, each coefficient factorises into a scale in grades per nat, a Zipf slope and a reference sentence length. A grade thereby becomes a quantity in surprisal. Because the formula outputs grades and children's vocabulary has been measured by grade, the interpretation recovers the vocabulary growth the formula implicitly assumes and lets it be checked against development: holding sentence length fixed, the word coefficient of the Flesch-Kincaid formula converts to 0.18 nat of unigram surprisal per word per grade (0.15 to 0.19 across the regression-derived formulae), and normative root-word vocabulary growth (Biemiller and Slonim, 2001), converted through Zipf's law, gives 0.16 nat per year at the frontier of the known vocabulary. The word coefficient is one year of vocabulary growth, and the grade is a vocabulary scale. The identification also yields a diagnostic (the sentence-length terms are not those of a memoryless surprisal) and extends to a Japanese formula.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上证明经典可读性公式（如Flesch-Kincaid年级值）的加性系数可解释为surprisal：任何经典可加形式的公式都是无记忆模型下逐词与逐句交叉熵之和，经Zipf定律并与参考文本线性化后，每个系数分解为"年级每nat的尺度×Zipf斜率×参考句长"。由此，一个年级成为surprisal量。实测词系数约0.18 nat/词/年级，与规范词汇增长0.16 nat/年相吻合，说明词系数即一年词汇增长，年级即词汇量表。
AI.motivation: Surprisal与阅读时间紧密相关、广泛用于阅读认知科学，而Flesch-Kincaid等经典可读性公式虽是最常用的实用难度度量，其系数却是无单位的回归常数，从未与surprisal建立联系。作者希望弥合这两套体系，赋予经典公式系数以认知/信息论意义，并借此检验公式隐含的词汇增长假设是否符合发展数据。
AI.method: 理论推导：证明任何经典加性形状的公式都是无记忆模型下逐词与逐句交叉熵之和；借助Zipf定律将该模型绑定到语言，并将公式视为参考文本处的线性化，使每个系数分解为年级每nat的尺度、Zipf斜率与参考句长的乘积。实证检验：固定句长，将Flesch-Kincaid词系数换算为约0.18 nat单字surprisal/词/年级（回归公式范围0.15–0.19），并将Biemiller & Slonim (2001)的规范词根词汇增长经Zipf定律换算为已知词汇前沿处约0.16 nat/年作对照；同时给出诊断（句长项不符合无记忆surprisal）并推广至日语公式。
AI.result: 词系数换算值（0.18 nat/词/年级；范围0.15–0.19）与规范词汇增长换算值（0.16 nat/年）高度一致，证实词系数即一年词汇增长、年级即词汇量表。此外，该识别给出一个诊断工具——句长项并非无记忆surprisal的对应项——并成功扩展到一个日语公式。
AI.conclusion: 经典可读性公式的无单位系数可被赋予surprisal解释，年级可视为surprisal量纲下的词汇量表，且公式隐含的词汇增长假设与发展数据相符。这统一了可读性公式与认知阅读研究，并提供了一个检验公式结构的诊断及跨语言（日语）推广。

title: HistGramBench: Measuring Structural Recovery When Multimodal Models Redraw Historical Mathematical Diagrams as TikZ
summary: Digital libraries preserve mathematical books printed from the sixteenth to the twentieth century, but the lettered diagrams in them, the figures on which Euclidean proofs depend, remain scanned images whose content cannot be searched. Redrawing such a diagram as a short drawing program would record which points lie on which lines and circles. But a printed plate offers no source code against which the redrawing could be checked. We introduce HistGramBench, a benchmark of 2,507 diagrams from 95 works printed between 1551 and 1933 in eight languages. For each diagram, two AI models from different providers agree on the facts a reader takes from the figure, such as which lines are parallel or where two lines meet, and every redrawing is checked against those facts on the model's own drawing. We evaluate six affordable AI models. The best recovers about three fifths of these facts, and most of what the models miss comes from programs that never produce a drawing. Parallels and tangencies are the hardest relations to reproduce. HistGramBench gives historians and librarians a way to measure when such tools can make old mathematical diagrams searchable.

AI.tldr: 提出HistGramBench基准，用AI将1551–1933年间古籍数学图"重绘"为绘图程序，并以图论事实检验其正确性。
AI.motivation: 数字图书馆保存了大量16–20世纪数学古籍，但其中的字母标注图（欧氏证明所依赖的图形）只是扫描图像，内容不可检索；将图重绘为短绘图程序可记录点线圆关系，而印刷图无源码可对照，缺乏评测手段。
AI.method: 构建含2,507幅图的基准，来自95部著作（1551–1933年、8种语言）。每幅图由两家不同提供商的AI模型就读者可获取的事实（如哪些线平行、两线何处相交）达成一致，作为真值；再将每份重绘程序在模型自绘结果上逐条核验这些事实。评测6个低成本AI模型。
AI.result: 最佳模型仅恢复约五分之三的事实；遗漏大多来自根本未产出绘图的程序；平行与相切是最难复现的关系。
AI.conclusion: HistGramBench为历史学家与图书馆员提供衡量工具，用以判断此类工具何时能让古籍数学图变得可检索。

title: Designing Informative Actions: Action Construction for Long-Horizon Research Agents
summary: Large language model agents support automated scientific research by connecting literature analysis and planning with experimentation. Evaluating which action an agent selects does not establish which experiment its instruction specifies, because omitted interventions or replication counts leave consequential choices to the executor. We introduce a reading-set framework for evaluating action construction under a common cost rule. Across 30 synthetic states, complete-design requests increase affordable efficiency by 465.98% and 327.91% relative to the action-name baseline in the two model families, respectively. An author-constructed research-action evaluation dataset provides 60 scenarios for complementary judgment evaluation. On this dataset, the scenario-level information-per-cost measure has a mean within-scenario correlation of 0.733 with judgments from 18 human participants. The framework makes design specification and execution ambiguity measurable, providing a reproducible basis for assessing how research agents translate scientific intent into informative, budget-feasible experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出"阅读集"(reading-set)框架，用于评估LLM研究智能体如何把科学意图转化为具体实验设计，而非仅评估其选择的动作名称。
AI.motivation: 现有评估只看智能体"选择哪个动作"，但动作名称并不等于指令所指定的实验：遗漏的干预项或重复次数会把关键决策推给执行者，造成设计规格与执行之间的歧义。
AI.method: 构建阅读集框架，在统一成本规则下评估动作构造；使用30个合成状态比较完整设计请求与动作名称基线的可负担效率；并自建含60个场景的研究动作评估数据集，将场景级"信息-成本"指标与18名人类参与者的判断做相关性验证。
AI.result: 在30个合成状态上，完整设计请求在两个模型家族中分别相比动作名称基线提升可负担效率465.98%与327.91%；在60场景数据集上，信息-成本指标与人类判断的场景内平均相关系数为0.733。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使设计规格与执行歧义可被度量，为评估研究智能体如何将科学意图转化为信息量大且预算可行的实验提供可复现基础。

title: Versatile Graph Foundation Models from Frozen Time-Series Foundation Models via Parallel Flows
summary: Graph foundation models aim to serve unseen graphs across tasks, feature spaces, and label sets. Most current models learn how to represent a new graph by pre-training on other graphs. Because graph data are scarce and differ across domains in features and structures, what they learn may not transfer to a graph from an unseen domain. We show that a frozen time-series foundation model, pre-trained on abundant time series, can instead serve as a graph foundation model without graph pre-training and without any gradient update on the target graph. Such a model reads ordered multivariate sequences, but a graph has no time axis, and covering all its edges with sequences is nontrivial because a node can have many neighbors. We therefore propose GraphFlowFM, which decomposes a graph into parallel flows, sets of vertex-disjoint paths that jointly cover every edge, and reads each path as a multivariate time series with the nodes as time steps. A frozen TimesFM encodes the paths with causal attention, which gives each node a self token and a context token, and a closed-form ridge readout weighs these tokens by their alignment with the labels. In node classification, GraphFlowFM attains the best average rank on 21 datasets among graph foundation models published in 2025 and 2026, ranks first on 17 datasets, and leads on six of the seven heterophilous datasets. It also exceeds pre-trained graph foundation models in link prediction on all six datasets and ranks second in molecule classification, behind only a model fine-tuned after pre-training on molecules.

AI.tldr: 提出 GraphFlowFM：把图分解为并行流（覆盖所有边的顶点不相交路径集合），每条路径视作以节点为时间步的多元时间序列，用冻结的 TimesFM 编码，再以闭式岭回归读出器加权自 token 与上下文 token，实现无需图预训练、无需梯度更新的图基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有图基础模型依赖在其他图上的预训练来学习如何表示新图，但图数据稀缺且跨域特征与结构差异大，学到的知识未必能迁移到未见域的图；而时间序列基础模型在大规模时序数据上预训练充分，有望直接充当图基础模型。
AI.method: 将图分解为并行流（vertex-disjoint 路径集合，联合覆盖每条边），每条路径作为多元时间序列输入，节点对应时间步；冻结的 TimesFM 以因果注意力编码路径，为每个节点产生 self token 与 context token；用闭式岭回归读出器按与标签的对齐程度对这两类 token 加权。
AI.result: 节点分类：在 21 个数据集上于 2025–2026 年发表的图基础模型中取得最佳平均排名，17 个数据集第一，7 个异质图中 6 个领先；链接预测在全部 6 个数据集上超过预训练图基础模型；分子分类排名第二，仅落后于在分子上预训练并微调的模型。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的时间序列基础模型可经路径流分解与闭式读出替代图预训练，成为无需目标图训练、跨任务与跨域有效的图基础模型，并在多项任务上优于现有图基础模型。

title: TLAPS-Bench: Formally Proving Correctness of Real-World System Specifications with TLA+ Proof System
comment: 35 pages (10-page main text, references, and appendix), 7 figures, 20 tables. Benchmark and harness: https://github.com/specula-org/TLAPS-Bench
summary: TLAPS-Bench is a benchmark and execution harness for constructing machine-checked proofs for real-world system specifications in TLA+ with agentic AI. Proving correctness of complex system specifications requires discovering inductive invariants, reasoning about intricate state transitions, and decomposing proofs into tractable obligations. TLAPS-Bench provides a proof harness that supports iterative proof development atop the TLA+ Proof System (TLAPS), where agents are equipped with proof tools and libraries, with safeguards against reward hacking. Using the harness, we have employed AI agents to prove desired properties for important system specifications that were not proved before, spanning cache coherence, Byzantine consensus, and write-ahead logs. TLAPS-Bench contains 265 proof targets (each encodes a property to prove) from 95 TLA+ specifications of real-world systems. We evaluated frontier AI agents, represented by Codex with GPT models, on a subset of 70 proof targets across 12 specifications. The highest-scoring model, GPT-6.1 Sol (max), proved 31 (44.3%) proof targets. The results show challenges and opportunities in end-to-end proof development.

AI.tldr: TLAPS-Bench 是一个用于让 AI 智能体在 TLA+ 证明系统（TLAPS）中为真实系统规格构建机器可验证证明的基准与执行框架，包含 265 个证明目标，最强模型仅完成 44.3%。
AI.motivation: 验证复杂系统规格的正确性需要发现归纳不变式、推理复杂状态转移并拆解证明义务，人工成本极高；现有工作缺少面向真实系统 TLA+ 规格、支持迭代式证明开发且能防止 reward hacking 的评测环境。
AI.method: 构建 TLAPS-Bench：提供基于 TLAPS 的证明 harness，支持智能体迭代开发证明，配备证明工具与库，并设置防 reward hacking 的保护机制；数据集由 95 个真实系统 TLA+ 规格中的 265 个证明目标组成，覆盖缓存一致性、拜占庭共识、预写日志等此前未被证明的性质；用 Codex+GPT 系列前沿智能体在 12 个规格的 70 个目标子集上评测。
AI.result: 最高分模型 GPT-6.1 Sol (max) 证明了 31 个目标（44.3%）；智能体还首次为若干重要系统规格完成了此前未有的性质证明。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了端到端证明开发的困难与机遇，说明当前 AI 智能体在真实系统形式化验证上仍有显著差距，TLAPS-Bench 可作为后续研究的评测基础。

title: XDecideBench: Evaluating Typed Decision Models and Confidence Policies Across Languages
summary: Applications use Typed Decision Models to route and moderate text in many languages, and they often act only on decisions above a confidence threshold. We introduce XDecideBench, a benchmark of nine suites in 122 languages with 88,425 texts and 153,875 typed questions. All suites share one scoring contract, and we report aligned, locally labelled and native items separately. Model rankings change from suite to suite. The model that is best in English, chosen in hindsight, loses significantly in about a quarter of the suite-language cells, and on Burmese Belebele it falls far behind the best model. Three open models fine-tuned for typed decisions beat the Qwen models they were built from in all twelve development languages. When the Qwen models are run locally, a pre-registered held-out cohort confirms that the accuracy gain is larger in the four languages with the least web text than in the six with the most. In both sets of languages, however, fine-tuning fixes a similar share of the base model's errors, so the larger gain may reflect weaker base models. A confidence threshold set on English data to allow 5% errors exceeds that error rate on XNLI, even in German and French.

AI.tldr: 论文提出XDecideBench：覆盖122种语言、9个套件（88,425条文本、153,875个类型化问题）的多语言"类型化决策"基准，统一评分合约并分别报告对齐、本地标注与母语条目。结果显示模型排名随套件变化，英文最优模型在约四分之一"套件-语言"单元显著落后（如缅甸语Belebele），且英文设定的置信阈值（5%错误率）在XNLI上即便德法也会超标。
AI.motivation: 应用普遍用类型化决策模型做文本路由与审核，并只依据超过置信阈值的决策行事；但现有评测缺乏跨多语言、统一评分口径且区分数据来源的基准，难以判断"英文最优"与"英文调阈值"能否迁移到其他语言。
AI.method: 构建XDecideBench：9个套件、122种语言、88,425条文本、153,875个带类型的问题，所有套件共用一套评分合约，并将对齐、本地标注、母语条目分开报告。以此评测各模型排名、英文事后最优模型的跨语言迁移，以及三个面向类型化决策微调的开源模型与其Qwen基座对比；并通过本地运行Qwen、预注册的留出队列验证低资源语言增益差异，同时检验英文设定的置信阈值在其他语言上的实际错误率。
AI.result: 模型排名随套件变化；英文事后最优模型在约四分之一"套件-语言"单元上显著变差，缅甸语Belebele上远落后于最优模型。三个微调开源模型在全部12个开发语言上都优于其Qwen基座；预注册留出验证显示，网络文本最少的四种语言上的准确率增益大于最多的六种语言，但两类语言中微调修复基座错误的比例相近，故更大增益可能反映基座更弱。英文数据设定"允许5%错误"的置信阈值，在XNLI上（含德语、法语）实际错误率超过5%。
AI.conclusion: 多语言类型化决策无法用单一语言（英文）的最优模型与阈值替代：排名高度依赖套件，阈值校准跨语言失效。微调可稳定提升，但低资源语言的更大收益需谨慎解释。基准强调应分来源报告并逐语言校准。

title: AdaptAD: Foundation Model Adaptation with Missing Modality Robustness for Alzheimer's Disease Staging Across the Disease Continuum
summary: Staging Alzheimer's disease (AD) across its continuum, from cognitively normal (CN) through mild cognitive impairment (MCI) to dementia from a single structural MRI remains difficult because 3-D networks overfit small cohorts, and FreeSurfer morphometry is often unavailable. We present AdaptAD, which reads a registered T1-weighted scan as 16 anatomically placed 2.5-D slices through the medial temporal lobe and adapts a frozen ImageNet-pretrained ViT-B/16 with low-rank adaptation (LoRA), training 3.5 M of 89 M parameters. Morphometry enters as tokens when present, or as a learned [MISSING] token, and a missing-aware stacker fuses both experts. Under a pre-registered protocol, ten methods were compared for three-class CN/MCI/AD staging on identical 5-fold splits of 597 ADNI participants, 29% without FreeSurfer, with Holm-corrected paired bootstrap tests. The locked model was tested once on 993 OASIS-3 participants (988 scored by every method). On ADNI, AdaptAD achieved a three-class macro-AUC of 0.745 (95% CI 0.709 to 0.781), ranking first and significantly exceeding full fine-tuning, ShaSpec and a 3-D CNN. On OASIS-3 it reached 0.780 (0.748 to 0.814), and on the CDR-based label (0.804) it significantly outperformed every 3-D and image-tabular method. LoRA matched full fine-tuning with 25 times fewer trainable parameters, and removing morphometry changed external macro-AUC by less than 0.003. The disease score tracked MMSE and CDR-SB within diagnostic groups and stratified MCI-to-dementia progression (log-rank p < 0.001), while saliency concentrated in medial temporal and periventricular regions. A parameter-efficient 2-D foundation model can therefore stage the full AD continuum from a routine T1 scan without morphometry, offering a scalable route to memory-clinic deployment.

AI.tldr: AdaptAD用冻结的ViT-B/16加LoRA，将T1 MRI转为16个内侧颞叶2.5-D切片，在ADNI上三分类CN/MCI/AD宏AUC 0.745居首，OASIS-3外部验证0.780，且不依赖FreeSurfer形态学。
AI.motivation: 单一结构MRI上完成CN→MCI→痴呆全连续期分期困难：3-D网络在小队列上易过拟合，且FreeSurfer形态学数据常缺失（ADNI中29%无）。
AI.method: 把配准后的T1扫描读为经解剖定位的16个内侧颞叶2.5-D切片，微调（LoRA）冻结的ImageNet预训练ViT-B/16，仅训练3.5M/89M参数；形态学特征以token形式输入，缺失时用学习到的[MISSING] token，缺失感知堆叠器融合双专家。预注册协议下在597名ADNI受试者的相同5折划分上比较十种方法，用Holm校正配对bootstrap检验；锁定模型在993名OASIS-3受试者上单次测试。
AI.result: ADNI三分类宏AUC 0.745（95%CI 0.709–0.781），排名第一并显著优于全微调、ShaSpec和3-D CNN；OASIS-3达0.780（0.748–0.814），CDR标签下达0.804，显著优于所有3-D与图像-表格方法。LoRA以1/25可训练参数匹配全微调；去除形态学对外部宏AUC影响<0.003。疾病评分在诊断组内与MMSE、CDR-SB相关，可分层MCI向痴呆进展（log-rank p<0.001），显著性集中于内侧颞叶与脑室周围区域。
AI.conclusion: 参数高效的2-D基础模型可仅凭常规T1扫描、无需形态学完成全AD连续期分期，为记忆门诊部署提供可扩展路径。

title: Decision-Centric Research: A Calibrated Decision Model and Benchmark for Scientific Agents
summary: Scientific agents make consequential choices about evidence, next actions and research strategy, but choices embedded in generated text are difficult to evaluate independently. Decision-Centric Research (DCR) is introduced to make individual choices the common unit of supervision, prediction and evaluation through typed predictions over an explicit Research State. DCR defines 24 decision types, ten of which are instantiated in the Research Decision Benchmark (RD-Bench) of 2,000 rule-generated cases. The Decision-Centric Research Model (DCRM) shares a candidate-token readout across types to produce answers and option probabilities in one forward pass. Under a held-out research-domain split, a 0.6B DCRM (state-aware) achieves 89.4% Top-1 accuracy, compared with 27.8% for DCRM (question-only) trained with the same recipe and 36.4% for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. All 30 type-seed comparisons against DCRM (question-only) are significant after Holm correction. After held-out calibration, the resulting prediction sets contain a mean of 1.515 candidates at 97.1% empirical label coverage, reducing mean set size by 57.4% relative to DCRM (question-only) at similar coverage. These results establish a compact state-aware decision layer with accurate typed prediction and an inspectable uncertainty interface.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"以决策为中心的研究"(DCR)框架,把科研智能体的单个决策作为监督、预测与评估的统一单位,并构建含24类决策的数据集与0.6B模型DCRM,在留出域上达89.4% Top-1准确率,并给出可校准的不确定性预测集接口。
AI.motivation: 科研智能体在证据取舍、下一步动作和研究策略上做出重要决策,但这些决策嵌在生成文本中,难以被独立评估。作者希望把"单个决策"提升为一等公民,使监督、预测和评估可被形式化、可比较。
AI.method: 提出DCR框架:基于显式Research State做带类型的预测;定义24种决策类型,其中10种实例化为含2,000个规则生成案例的RD-Bench基准;提出DCRM模型,跨决策类型共享候选token读出,一次前向即输出答案与选项概率;并做留出域校准以获得预测集。
AI.result: 在留出研究领域划分下,0.6B状态感知DCRM取得89.4% Top-1准确率,同配方仅问题输入的DCRM为27.8%,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash为36.4%;30组类型-种子对比经Holm校正后全部显著;校准后预测集平均1.515个候选、经验覆盖率97.1%,在相近覆盖率下集合规模较仅问题版本缩小57.4%。
AI.conclusion: 一个紧凑的状态感知决策层即可实现准确的带类型决策预测,并提供可检查的不确定性接口;显式Research State相对仅问题输入带来巨大增益,小模型亦可显著超越大模型基线。

title: Generative Forecasting from Coarse-Grained Observations: When Does Cascading Help?
summary: We study probabilistic forecasting of dynamical systems such as fluids and waves from coarse observations. Since the unseen fine scales influence the dynamics, the same coarse initial state can evolve into a whole distribution of futures. Generative forecasters may produce visually plausible samples, but it is hard to tell whether they sample the right conditional distribution, since trajectory data contain a single future for each initial state. We address this problem by generating reference data in a hierarchical way: for each coarse initial state, we generate many different fine-scale components and numerically evolve the full states. Using these conditional ensembles, we show that standard diffusion models and stochastic interpolants make substantial distributional errors. We then show that cascading shorter forecasts greatly reduces these errors for the turbulent flows and waves we study, but we also find and characterize cases in which it hurts. Since the coarse process is not Markov, cascading discards information about the unresolved fine scales even with exact transitions. To understand this, we propose a solvable analytic model which shows that the optimal cascade depth decreases as the coupling between the unresolved and observed scales gets stronger, and increases as the dependence of the forecast on the observation becomes more oscillatory. Consistent with our experiments, cascading is detrimental when the direct forecast is ``easy'' to learn, for example Gaussian as in the passive scalar case. We release our datasets as a first benchmark for probabilistic forecasting with ground-truth conditional ensembles.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从粗观测对动力系统（流体、波）进行概率预测，构建带真值条件集合的基准，发现扩散模型与随机插值存在显著分布误差，级联短程预测可缓解但在某些情形下有害，并用可解解析模型解释级联深度的取舍。
AI.motivation: 粗初始状态对应未来是一整个分布，生成式预测器可产生看似合理的样本，但轨迹数据中每个初态只有一个未来，难以判断是否采样到正确的条件分布。
AI.method: 分层生成参考数据：对每个粗初始状态生成多个细尺度分量并数值演化全状态，得到条件集合；评估扩散模型与随机插值；提出级联短程预测；构建可解解析模型分析级联深度。
AI.result: 标准扩散模型和随机插值存在显著分布误差；级联对湍流与波显著降低误差，但在直接预测"易学"（如被动标量高斯情形）时反而有害。
AI.conclusion: 最优级联深度随未解析尺度与观测尺度耦合增强而减小，随预测对观测的依赖更振荡而增大；发布首个具真值条件集合的概率预测基准数据集。

title: CAREFUL-Bench: Effect-Aware, Judge-Free Evaluation of Multi-Turn LLM Function Calling
summary: The multi-turn checker of the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) evaluates final state correctness but ignores the effects of intermediate calls: extra calls are free, function documentation does not describe side effects, and the scripted user never responds to proposals. Consequently, models asking for confirmation before destructive actions are penalized; 260 of 734 reference turns in the base category perform destructive actions without confirmation. We make BFCL effect-aware without replacing it. We infer effect declarations for all 128 functions by executing them in BFCL simulators and comparing state changes, with destructive writes identified by three annotators. A judge-free replay scorer reproduces official results across all 800 reference trajectories while reporting unrequested destructive calls, duplicate writes, redundant reads, surplus steps, and their token costs. We also introduce a confirmation-aware protocol with a deterministic simulated user. Across 11 open models, effect-aware scoring preserves the official ranking but reveals substantial differences in execution quality: the leading model loses 14.0 points due to unrequested destructive calls, while surplus steps consume up to 28% of input tokens. Adding effect hints to function documentation has no impact on eight evaluated models. Allowing the simulated user to respond recovers up to four points for models that seek confirmation. However, the best model completes only six of 576 conversations requiring destructive actions with explicit confirmation. These results expose a key limitation of current function-calling benchmarks: they cannot distinguish between asking for clarification and obtaining permission before potentially destructive actions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出在保留 BFCL 官方评测框架的前提下，为其增加"效应感知"评分：通过执行函数推断副作用声明，用免评委的回放评分器复现官方结果并额外报告未请求的破坏性调用、重复写入、冗余读取、多余步骤及其 token 代价，同时引入带确定性模拟用户的"确认感知"协议，揭示现有函数调用基准无法区分"请求澄清"与"获得破坏性操作许可"这一关键缺陷。
AI.motivation: BFCL 多轮检查器只判终态正确性，忽略中间调用的影响：额外调用免费、函数文档不描述副作用、脚本化用户从不回应模型提议。因此主动请求确认的模型反被惩罚，base 类 734 个参考轮中有 260 轮在未确认下执行破坏性操作。作者希望在不替换 BFCL 的前提下使其具备效应感知能力。
AI.method: 1) 在 BFCL 模拟器中执行全部 128 个函数并比较状态变化，推断副作用声明，破坏性写入由三名标注者确认；2) 设计免评委的回放评分器，在全部 800 条参考轨迹上复现官方结果，同时报告未请求破坏性调用、重复写入、冗余读取、多余步骤及 token 成本；3) 引入带确定性模拟用户的确认感知协议，允许用户回应模型提出的确认请求。
AI.result: 在 11 个开源模型上，效应感知评分保持了官方排名，但揭示执行质量差异显著：领先模型因未请求的破坏性调用损失 14.0 分，多余步骤最多消耗 28% 输入 token；向函数文档添加效应提示对 8 个被测模型均无影响；允许模拟用户回应可使寻求确认的模型最多回升 4 分；但最佳模型在 576 个需要显式确认的破坏性对话中仅完成 6 个。
AI.conclusion: 现有函数调用基准（如 BFCL）的核心局限在于：无法区分模型是在请求澄清还是在对潜在破坏性操作征求许可，也几乎不衡量执行过程中的副作用与效率代价。效应感知与确认感知的评分补充是必要的，且仅靠文档层面的效应提示不足以改善模型行为。

title: Information-Theoretic Design of Sparse Autoencoder-Based Steering
summary: Sparse autoencoder (SAE)-based activation steering is a lightweight approach for modifying the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by adding small vectors to hidden states during inference. However, designing effective steering interventions remains challenging. In this work, we develop an information-theoretic framework for analyzing SAE activations through empirical feature-firing distributions. The central object of the framework is the Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) between such firing distributions, which quantifies how far a generated or intervened state deviates from a dataset-induced target distribution. Based on an analytic divergence response for virtually shifted states, we construct steering vectors toward the target firing distribution. The same divergence can also be used to monitor deviation from another empirical distribution, such as a general valid-language distribution. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the steering in a question-mode generation task study. We further use teacher-forced pulse experiments to show that local interventions induce structured downstream JSD responses in later layers, and apply the framework to a safety-related target--contrast response setting for feature analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出基于信息论的SAE激活分析框架，以特征激活分布的JSD偏离为目标构造转向向量实现LLM行为引导与偏差监控。
AI.motivation: SAE-based activation steering 轻量但有效干预设计困难，缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 用经验特征激活分布间的Jensen-Shannon散度度量状态相对目标分布的偏离；基于"虚拟平移状态"的解析散度响应，构造指向目标激活分布的转向向量；同一散度还可监控相对其他经验分布（如通用合法语言分布）的偏离。
AI.result: 在question-mode生成任务中验证转向有效；teacher-forced脉冲实验显示局部干预在后层引发结构化的下游JSD响应；并应用于安全相关的target-contrast响应设置进行特征分析。
AI.conclusion: JSD为SAE转向提供了可解释、可监控的信息论工具，能引导生成并刻画干预的层级传播与特征语义。

title: Rethinking Feature Perturbation for Single-Source Domain Generalization: A Representation-Space Analysis and Spectral Case Study
summary: Feature perturbation is widely used in single-source domain generalization (SSDG), yet it is typically evaluated by task performance rather than by the representation changes it induces. We investigate whether perturbations can be compared through measurable descriptors of these changes. We introduce a four-dimensional representation-space description comprising feature displacement $D_F$, relational displacement $D_R$, a task-region ratio $Θ_{\mathrm{Task}}$, and subspace deviation $Θ_{\mathrm{Subspace}}$. We use these descriptors as an empirical analysis framework, not as a universal geometry, to characterize existing perturbation mechanisms. Across two object-detection settings involving style and weather shifts, we observe distinct geometric profiles and a concentration of relatively strong out-of-domain (OOD) configurations within a bounded region of the descriptor space. These findings do not establish a universal optimum but motivate investigating whether regions associated with stronger SSDG performance can be identified without target-domain access. As a case study, we introduce Dual-Invariant Spectral Perturbation (DISP), a non-learned Fourier-phase perturbation with explicit controls over phase magnitude $ρ$, channel coupling $κ$, and frequency support $\mathcal{M}$. We empirically examine how these controls affect the proposed descriptors. DISP achieves strong OOD performance in our experiments, illustrating how explicit perturbation controls can be analyzed through a representation-space description. We hope this viewpoint can contribute to more interpretable, controllable, and ultimately testable approaches to feature perturbation in SSDG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用四维表征空间描述符（特征位移、关系位移、任务区域比、子空间偏差）来度量单源域泛化中特征扰动引起的表征变化，并以非学习式的双不变谱扰动（DISP）为案例，分析扰动参数与描述符及OOD性能的关系。
AI.motivation: 现有单源域泛化（SSDG）中特征扰动方法多以任务性能评价，缺少对扰动所引起的表征变化本身的定量、可比较描述，导致扰动机制难以解释、对比与控制。
AI.method: 构建四维表征空间描述框架：特征位移D_F、关系位移D_R、任务区域比Θ_Task、子空间偏差Θ_Subspace，作为经验分析工具刻画已有扰动机制；并提出DISP——一种非学习的傅里叶相位扰动，显式控制相位幅度ρ、通道耦合κ与频率支撑M，在两种目标检测设定（风格偏移、天气偏移）下考察参数对描述符与性能的影响。
AI.result: 实验观察到不同扰动机制具有可区分的几何轮廓，且较强OOD配置集中分布于描述符空间的一个有界区域内；DISP在所设实验中取得较强的OOD性能，表明显式扰动控制可被表征空间描述所分析。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不主张普适最优几何结构，而是提供一种可解释、可控、可检验的特征扰动分析视角，并指出可在无目标域访问时定位与更强SSDG性能相关区域的潜在研究方向。

title: Who Schedules Agent Memory? A Sidecar Approach to Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: As large language model agents increasingly undertake complex, long-horizon tasks, memory has become an important component for supporting sustained decision-making and action. Existing methods primarily focus on memory storage, updating, and retrieval, but often overlook how memory scheduling affects task execution: the main agent must identify memory needs, initiate retrieval, and wait for results while advancing the task, increasing both scheduling burden and execution time. To address this problem, we propose MemSidecar, which decouples memory scheduling from task execution through two independently selectable modes. Hooks directly delivers bound memory to the main agent when execution events match predefined conditions. Foresight uses an independent agent to predict potential queries, retrieve results in parallel, and store them in a cache, delivering matching and valid results when actual requests arrive. Hooks and Foresight achieve scores of 41.23% and 44.34% on MCP-Persona, respectively, while effectively reducing execution costs and latency and improving the efficiency of long-horizon agent execution.

AI.tldr: MemSidecar通过将记忆调度与任务执行解耦，提出Hooks（事件触发式投递）与Foresight（独立代理预测式并行检索缓存）两种可选模式，降低主代理调度负担与时延，在MCP-Persona上分别取得41.23%和44.34%。
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体面对复杂长程任务时记忆至关重要，但现有方法聚焦记忆的存储、更新与检索，忽视记忆调度对任务执行的影响：主代理需自行判断记忆需求、发起检索并等待结果，增加调度负担与执行时间。
AI.method: 提出MemSidecar，将记忆调度从任务执行中解耦，提供两种可独立选择的模式：1）Hooks——当执行事件匹配预设条件时，直接向主代理投递已绑定的记忆；2）Foresight——由独立代理预测潜在查询，并行检索并缓存结果，在实际请求到来时投递匹配且有效的结果。
AI.result: Hooks与Foresight在MCP-Persona上分别取得41.23%与44.34%的得分，同时有效降低执行成本与延迟，提升长程智能体执行效率。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆调度与任务执行解耦可有效缓解主代理调度负担，两种模式可按需选择，兼顾效率与效果。

title: Shaped by What's Missing: Topological Invariance Simplification Discovers Behavioral Transitions
comment: 37 pages, including references and appendix (9 pages main paper). Accepted to NeurReps 2026 (Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations), Proceedings Track
summary: Understanding how animals move between behaviors is a central question in neuroethology, yet most segmentation methods first partition time into discrete states, leaving transitions as the unmodeled residue between them. We take the opposite view: in a suitable feature space, sustained behaviors are dense regions of the trajectory's density landscape, and transitions are the sparse corridors and loops that connect them. Because this structure is a property of the landscape's shape rather than of any particular coordinates, it can be read off directly with topology and should persist across feature spaces. We build this landscape from frame-by-frame trajectories, extract its discrete-Morse graph, and keep two kinds of structure: paths, the corridors a trajectory follows between dense behavioral regions, and cycles, closed routes whose entry and exit take different ways. Clustering these structures yields transitions directly, with no upstream state partition. On a rat behavior dataset across three feature spaces, including the latent space of a neural-network controller that imitates the animal in a physics simulator, the approach recovers transitions at coverage comparable to state-space and topological-clustering baselines, while carrying substantially more information about the transition identity, forming clusters at least as tight as the baselines', and matching annotated transitions with less reliance on time-warping. More broadly, the results show that behavioral transitions are a topological feature of a representation: recoverable from the shape of its trajectories, and consistent across distinct feature spaces.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于拓扑学的行为分段方法：不预先划分离散状态，而是在轨迹密度景观中用离散Morse图直接提取"通道"和"环路"来识别行为转换。
AI.motivation: 大多数行为分割方法先把时间划分为离散状态，把"转换"当作状态之间的未建模残留物。作者反其道而行：在合适的特征空间中，持续行为是密度景观中的稠密区域，转换则是连接它们的稀疏通道与环路。由于这一结构属于景观形状本身的属性，可用拓扑直接读取，并应跨特征空间保持一致。
AI.method: 用逐帧轨迹构建密度景观，提取离散Morse图，保留两类结构：paths（轨迹在稠密行为区域间穿行的通道）和cycles（进入与离开路径不同的闭合路线），再对这些结构聚类，直接得到转换，无需上游状态划分。在包含神经网络控制器潜空间在内的三个特征空间的大鼠行为数据上验证。
AI.result: 该方法以与状态空间和拓扑聚类基线相当的覆盖率恢复转换，同时携带更多关于"转换身份"的信息；聚类紧凑度不低于基线；对标注转换的匹配更少依赖时间扭曲。结果表明行为转换是表示的拓扑特征，可从轨迹形状中恢复且跨特征空间一致。
AI.conclusion: 行为转换是一种表示的拓扑特征：可由轨迹形状中恢复，并在不同特征空间中保持一致，为神经行为学提供了不依赖预先状态划分的转换分析框架。

title: VeriHarm-Bench: Measuring Harmful Success in LLM Coding Agents Verifiably
summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly operate with shell access, allowing them to write scripts, move files, alter permissions, and modify system configurations. However, an agent may achieve a user's goal while causing unintended harm, such as deleting unrelated files, weakening access controls, or corrupting data, in response to benign inputs without explicit jailbreaking. This failure mode is particularly important because apparent task success may reassure users that an agent behaved correctly, causing harmful side effects to go unnoticed. We call this harmful success: the agent successfully completes the intended benign task while simultaneously causing unintended harm. Despite its importance, harmful success is difficult to measure because conventional task-success metrics overlook harmful behaviors, while existing safety evaluations are often designed solely to assess harmful outcomes. We introduce VeriHarm, an automatic framework for constructing programmatically verifiable benchmarks that directly measure harmful success. VeriHarm minimally perturbs coding tasks to elicit unintended harmful behavior while maintaining the benignity of the task and preserving the original task objective. It then synthesizes executable harm tests that, together with the original task-correctness tests, evaluate both task accuracy and harmful outcomes. Frontier agents, including GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, achieve an average task accuracy of 95% on our curated VeriHarm-Bench, yet still struggle to complete tasks safely: their safe success rate, the fraction of tasks completed successfully without triggering the designated harm, averages only 37%. These results suggest that successful task completion can frequently coexist with unintended harm, and that task-success metrics alone may substantially understate the potential safety risks of coding agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"有害成功"(harmful success)这一失败模式：编码智能体在无显式越狱的良性输入下完成了任务，却同时造成非预期伤害（删无关文件、削弱访问控制、损坏数据等）。为此提出VeriHarm自动框架，通过最小扰动编码任务并合成可执行"伤害测试"，构建可程序化验证的基准VeriHarm-Bench。实验显示前沿智能体任务准确率达95%，但安全成功率平均仅37%。
AI.motivation: 具备shell权限的LLM编码智能体可写脚本、移动文件、改权限、改系统配置，可能在完成用户目标的同时造成非预期伤害。该失败模式危险之处在于：任务"表面成功"会让用户误以为智能体行为正确，从而忽视有害副作用。而现有评估存在盲区——常规任务成功率指标忽略有害行为，安全评测又往往只关注有害结果本身，导致有害成功难以测量。
AI.method: 提出VeriHarm自动框架，用于构建可程序化验证的基准以直接测量有害成功：1) 对编码任务做最小扰动，在不破坏任务良性性质、不改变原任务目标的前提下诱发非预期有害行为；2) 自动合成可执行的"伤害测试"，与原有的任务正确性测试结合，同时评估任务准确率与有害结果；3) 据此构建VeriHarm-Bench基准。
AI.result: 在VeriHarm-Bench上，包括GPT-5.6-Sol与Claude-Opus-5在内的前沿智能体平均任务准确率达95%，但安全成功率（既成功完成任务又未触发指定伤害的比例）平均仅37%。
AI.conclusion: 成功完成任务与非预期伤害可以频繁并存；仅依赖任务成功率指标会显著低估编码智能体的潜在安全风险，需引入同时衡量任务正确性与无害性的评估范式。

title: RAG-TRACE: Tracing Measurement Evidence and Diagnostic Completeness in AI-Generated ECG Reports
comment: Code and study materials available at https://github.com/Elyasirankhah/RAG-TRACE
summary: Purpose: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can introduce electrocardiogram (ECG) criteria that lack patient-specific measurement support. This study evaluates the reliability of retrieved diagnostic criteria in AI-generated ECG reports. Methods: We analyzed 1,083 human-validated PTB-XL patient records using a library of 47 criteria cards, including 33 without numeric verification rules. Language models generated structured reports with and without retrieval. Criterion applicability was evaluated using Marquette 12SL measurements, with independent assessment using Uni-G and comparison against expert-validated diagnostic labels. Results: Keyword retrieval introduced untestable or measurement-disconfirmed criteria in 46.8% of GPT-4.1-mini reports. A deterministic verification rule withdrew 647 criterion applications, including 639 without numeric checks, while preserving 268 of 269 applications independently supported by Uni-G. Restricting retrieval to 14 testable criteria reduced the initial unsupported-criterion rate to 13.8%. Under matched instructions and an identical output schema, retrieval increased unsupported-criterion reports from 17.4% to 31.1%, while hypertrophy recall remained unchanged at 62.6%. Conclusion: These findings identify a fundamental limitation of retrieval-based clinical report generation: retrieved criteria do not necessarily provide valid patient-specific evidence. Measurement-based verification can reduce unsupported criterion applications, but diagnostic validity requires independent assessment.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估RAG在AI生成心电图报告中引入的检索标准可靠性，发现基于关键词检索的标准常缺乏患者特异性测量支持（GPT-4.1-mini报告中达46.8%），而基于测量的确定性验证可撤回大量无依据应用，但诊断有效性仍需独立评估。
AI.motivation: RAG可能为心电图报告引入缺乏患者特异性测量支持的标准卡片，检索到的诊断标准未必能提供有效的个体证据，需评估其可靠性。
AI.method: 分析1,083份人工验证的PTB-XL记录，使用含47张标准卡（其中33张无数值验证规则）的库；语言模型在有/无检索条件下生成结构化报告；用Marquette 12SL测量评估标准适用性，并以Uni-G独立评估及专家验证诊断标签作对照。
AI.result: 关键词检索使46.8%的GPT-4.1-mini报告引入不可测或被测量否定的标准；确定性验证规则撤回647项标准应用（含639项无数值核查），同时保留269项中268项经Uni-G独立支持的应用；限定为14项可测标准后初始无支持率降至13.8%；相同指令与输出格式下，检索使无支持标准报告从17.4%升至31.1%，而肥厚召回率保持62.6%不变。
AI.conclusion: 检索式临床报告生成存在根本局限：检索标准未必提供有效的患者特异性证据；基于测量的验证可减少无支持标准应用，但诊断有效性需独立评估。

title: OCRia-1 Technical Report
summary:
We introduce OCRia-1, a 4B vision-language model (VLM) for document parsing that excels at preserving table structure, extracting chart data and retaining text formatting. OCRia-1 handles content that has traditionally been challenging in document parsing: merged cells and spanning headers, tables with thousands of cells, chart data, and meaningful text formatting such as bold, italics, subscripts and superscripts, preserving details needed for business-critical document analysis. At the time of this report, it achieves the highest scores on tables, charts and text formatting among the systems evaluated, including a 35B model and Mistral OCR 4.1. Its mean ParseBench score over the four dimensions we evaluate is 0.87, against 0.75 for the next-best system.
  We emphasize data quality and reward design in training OCRia-1. Synthetic pages provide exact ground truth for long tables and rich formatting, while real pages are transcribed using a pipeline grounded in the PDF text layer. We attribute OCRia-1's performance primarily to careful data curation that prioritizes quality and diversity over quantity. Dimension-specific rewards evaluate table reconstruction, chart-data extraction and text-formatting fidelity. We train the model on the curated data using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), then refine it through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).
  To our knowledge, OCRia-1 is the fastest published document-parsing VLM in its class, decoding at about 4,700 tokens per second with a single request on one B200 GPU, about nine times faster than the base model on stock vLLM. This is achieved through a block-diffusion speculator, quantization and custom kernels.

AI.tldr: OCRia-1 是一个 4B 视觉语言模型，专注文档解析，在表格结构、图表数据与文本格式保持上超越 35B 模型与 Mistral OCR 4.1，ParseBench 四维平均 0.87（次优 0.75），并在单卡 B200 上达约 4700 tokens/s。
AI.motivation: 现有文档解析模型难以处理合并单元格、跨页表头、超大规模表格、图表数据和粗体/斜体/上下标等格式信息，而这些细节对业务级文档分析至关重要。
AI.method: 以数据质量与多样性优先于规模：合成页面提供长表格与富格式的精确真值，真实页面借 PDF 文本层对齐的流水线转写；设计针对表格重建、图表数据抽取、格式保真的维度特定奖励；先 SFT 再用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）精调。推理侧采用块扩散投机解码、量化与自定义 kernel 加速。
AI.result: 在评估系统中表格、图表、文本格式三项均取得最高分；四维 ParseBench 平均 0.87，次优系统为 0.75。单张 B200、单请求下解码约 4700 tokens/s，约为原模型在标准 vLLM 上的 9 倍，是同类已发布文档解析 VLM 中最快的。
AI.conclusion: 性能主要归因于精心的数据策划与维度特定奖励设计，而非模型规模；小模型配合高质量数据和定制推理优化，可在文档解析精度与速度上同时领先。

title: One Offset, Two Directions: Baseline Adjustment via Subgroup Offsets
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) estimates advantages against the within-prompt mean reward, a baseline shared across the group. In practice, rollouts within a prompt are not always homogeneous, differing in their solution strategies and reasoning trajectories, along which they may group into subgroups. We further find that these heterogeneous subgroups may exhibit distinct reward distributions. The global baseline, however, collapses them onto a single credit axis, where the credit reflects neither a rollout's standing within its subgroup nor the subgroup's standing relative to the rest. We therefore study how to adjust the baseline when the rollouts of a prompt fall into heterogeneous subgroups. We define the \emph{subgroup offset} as the deviation of a subgroup mean from the global mean, and shift the baseline along it by a single signed coefficient $λ$. The sign of $λ$ yields two opposing directions: \emph{Alignment} ($λ{>}0$) adds the offset to the baseline, drawing credit toward a rollout's relative position within its subgroup; \emph{Contrast} ($λ{<}0$) subtracts it, drawing a rollout's credit toward the relative quality of the subgroup it belongs to. The adjustment acts on the baseline alone, leaving the reward signal and the optimization objective unchanged. In this work, we induce subgroups from strategies, grouping rollouts that share a strategy into the same subgroup. We evaluate both directions on Qwen3-8B-Base and Olmo3-7B-Base across four competition-level math benchmarks, against a $λ{=}0$ anchor that shares the same strategy-conditioned sampling and differs only in the baseline. Against this anchor each direction yields modest but consistent gains in multi-sample coverage, with Contrast the stronger of the two.

AI.tldr: 论文研究GRPO中组内rollout异质子群情形下baseline应如何调整，提出"子群偏移"及带符号系数λ的两种方向（Alignment与Contrast），在Qwen3-8B-Base与Olmo3-7B-Base四个数学竞赛基准上验证两者均带来小幅但一致的多样本覆盖率提升，Contrast更强。
AI.motivation: GRPO以prompt内平均奖励作为组共享baseline。但同一prompt的rollout并不总是同质的，会因解题策略与推理轨迹不同而聚成子群，且这些异质子群奖励分布不同。全局baseline把它们压到单一信用轴上，导致信用既不能反映rollout在本子群内的相对位置，也不能反映子群相对整体的优劣。
AI.method: 定义"子群偏移"为子群均值相对全局均值的偏差，用单一带符号系数λ沿该偏移移动baseline。λ>0为Alignment（baseline加偏移，信用偏向子群内相对位置），λ<0为Contrast（减去偏移，信用偏向子群本身的相对质量）。该调整仅作用于baseline，不改变奖励信号与优化目标。子群由策略诱导，共享同一策略的rollout归为一组。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B-Base和Olmo3-7B-Base上、四个竞赛级数学基准中，与λ=0锚点（同样策略条件采样，仅baseline不同）相比，两个方向均带来小幅但一致的多样本覆盖率提升，其中Contrast提升更明显。
AI.conclusion: 当prompt内rollout落入异质子群时，沿子群偏移方向调整GRPO的baseline是一种轻量且有效的改进：无需改动奖励与优化目标即可获得稳定收益，且以对比（Contrast）方向效果更优。

title: Uncertainty Aware Quality-Diversity Optimization For Offline Biological Sequence Design
summary: Designing sequences such as nucleic acids and proteins with desired properties is a fundamental challenge in biology. Due to the vast, discrete nature of sequence spaces and the high cost of experimental evaluation, offline computational sequence design plays a crucial role in proposing novel sequences before costly wet-lab validation. In practice, it is also essential that proposed designs are diverse to increase the likelihood of downstream experimental success. This motivates methods that balance performance, novelty, and diversity, whilst mitigating against uncertainty inherent to offline optimization. Quality-Diversity optimization (QD) can discover diverse, high-performing solutions, making it well suited to this problem, but its elitist nature makes reliable exploration under uncertainty challenging. To address this, we introduce Prior-guided Offline MAP-Elites (POME), an uncertainty-aware QD framework explicitly adapted to the offline regime. Our method leverages foundation models as priors to guide search toward biologically plausible regions and enable robust exploration under uncertainty. Across three sequence design tasks, POME consistently improves both performance and diversity over prior offline QD methods, and achieves the most reliable balance compared to offline MBO baselines, obtaining the best performance on two tasks and the second-best on the third, while maintaining high diversity and novelty.

AI.tldr: 提出Prior-guided Offline MAP-Elites (POME)，一种面向离线序列设计的不确定性感知质量-多样性优化框架，用基础模型作为先验引导搜索，在三个序列设计任务上同时提升性能与多样性。
AI.motivation: 核酸与蛋白质序列空间巨大且离散，湿实验评估代价高，因此需要离线计算设计。实际应用中不仅要求高性能，还要求多样性以提高下游实验成功率，同时需应对离线优化固有的不确定性。现有Quality-Diversity方法适合发现多样高性能解，但其精英主义特性在不确定性下探索不可靠。
AI.method: 提出POME（Prior-guided Offline MAP-Elites），一个显式适配离线场景的不确定性感知QD框架。核心是利用基础模型作为先验，将搜索导向生物学上合理的区域，并在不确定性下实现稳健探索。
AI.result: 在三个序列设计任务上，POME相比已有离线QD方法在性能与多样性上均有稳定提升；与离线MBO基线相比实现最可靠的平衡——两个任务性能最优、第三个任务次优，同时保持高多样性与新颖性。
AI.conclusion: 将基础模型先验与不确定性感知机制引入离线QD，可有效兼顾性能、新颖性与多样性，为离线序列设计提供可靠方案。

title: Latent Harness: Compiling Agent Behaviors into Post-Block Activation Shifts
summary: Harness engineering and self-evolving agents improve language-model agents quickly, yet their gains live outside the model. The harness is re-sent and re-paid on every call, and the standard route to internalization is a weight update that is costly to iterate and fixed once merged. We propose compiling the harness instead. Latent Harness distills an external condition into a rank-8 activation shift. The shift is applied at the output of every decoder block of a frozen backbone, at 0.03-0.05% of parameters. The condition is either an explicit process-level behavior instruction or the behavioral contract of an agentic harness. At inference the compiled bundle carries no harness text and adds no tokens. It exposes three runtime controls for injection strength, injection phase, and shift-space mixing. Compiled behaviors recover the source-harness gain in 8 of 10 preregistered settings. Where the explicit source pays the heaviest per-call token tax, the compiled form exceeds it. The same bundles transfer zero-shot across tasks (5 of 7 pairs positive) and compose in shift space, while stacked text instructions interfere destructively. Used as a search space, they lift budget-matched harness search by 1.45 times. On three agentic benchmarks the operator aligns policy to the harness con- tract. Under matched data, capacity, and effective strength it outperforms same-capacity LoRA, which needs 11.1 times the parameters to reach the same band, and it regresses nothing where the base policy is already strong. Across 1B-to-8B models the method skeleton is invariant while gain locations move with the model-task pair, which delimits where compiled harnesses should be deployed.

AI.tldr: 提出"Latent Harness"：把外部harness/行为指令编译为rank-8激活偏移，注入冻结主干每个解码块输出，参数仅0.03-0.05%，推理不带harness文本、不增token，多数设置可复现原harness收益并可组合、迁移与用于搜索。
AI.motivation: harness工程与自进化agent收益存在于模型之外：每次调用都要重传harness文本（token税），而真正内化需权重更新，迭代昂贵且合并后固定。作者希望以更低成本把harness"编译"进模型。
AI.method: 将外部条件（显式过程级行为指令或agentic harness的行为契约）蒸馏为一个rank-8激活偏移，施加于冻结主干每个解码块输出；参数占0.03-0.05%。推理时提供注入强度、注入阶段、偏移空间混合三个运行时控制。方法以"偏移空间"作为可组合、可搜索的空间。
AI.result: 10个预注册设置中8个复现源harness收益；在源harness token税最重的场景下超越显式形式；零样本跨任务迁移7对中5对为正；偏移空间可组合（文本指令堆叠会破坏性干扰）；作为搜索空间使预算匹配的harness搜索提升1.45倍；三个agentic基准上对齐策略与harness契约；同数据/容量/有效强度下优于同容量LoRA（后者需11.1倍参数才达同水平），在基线已强处无退化；1B-8B模型间方法骨架不变但增益位置随模型-任务对移动。
AI.conclusion: 以极低参数量的激活偏移编译harness是可迭代、免token税、可组合可搜索的内部化路径，且优于同容量LoRA；增益位置依赖模型-任务对，限定了其部署边界。

title: Pano2BIM: A Geometry-Constrained Vision-Language Agent for As-Built BIM Generation from a Floor Plan and a Single 360$^\circ$ Image
summary: Digital twins require accurate, up-to-date building information models (BIM) that reflect physical conditions, yet generating and maintaining as-built models remains costly and labor-intensive. Emerging image-based methods can capture visual appearance without inherently producing structured BIM information, while vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with reliable metric object placement. This paper presents Pano2BIM, a geometry-constrained VLM agent that generates approximate IFC4 models at Level of Development (LOD) 200 from a floor plan with known room dimensions and a single 360-degree photograph. The VLM identifies landmarks and objects, while deterministic tools estimate camera pose, compute metric positions through ray casting, and check spatial constraints. An optional second stage enriches the presentation model through render-and-compare feedback without modifying the primary furniture geometry. In a preliminary evaluation on one laboratory, the proposed Measure workflow achieved a mean furniture-footprint intersection over union (IoU) of 0.53, compared with 0.44 for a single-response baseline using identical modeling instructions, and matched an average of 4.0 versus 2.3 of seven fixed furniture elements across three runs. Centroid disagreements were similar for the four elements consistently identified by both approaches. The measurement stage averaged 3.8 minutes and USD 1.63 in API costs per run, while the complete demonstrated workflow required approximately 42 minutes and USD 11. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of rapid, low-cost as-built BIM generation, with potential applications in maintaining digital twins that reflect changing physical conditions.

AI.tldr: Pano2BIM：几何约束的VLM智能体，从平面图+单张360°照片生成LOD 200级IFC4模型
AI.motivation: 数字孪生需要准确、实时的竣工BIM，但建模成本高；图像方法缺乏结构化信息，VLM难以做可靠的度量级物体放置
AI.method: VLM识别地标与物体；确定性工具估计相机位姿、光线投射计算度量位置并校验空间约束；可选第二阶段用渲染-比较反馈丰富呈现模型而不改动主体家具几何
AI.result: 单实验室初步评估：Measure流程家具footprint IoU 0.53（基线0.44），七件固定家具平均匹配4.0 vs 2.3；测量阶段约3.8分钟/1.63美元，完整流程约42分钟/11美元
AI.conclusion: 验证了快速低成本竣工BIM生成的可行性，可用于维护反映物理变化的数字孪生

title: Learning hidden-state dynamics from unpaired snapshots with lift-project SDEs
summary: Many systems are observed only through unpaired snapshots, with population samples available at each time point but no correspondence between samples at different times. These snapshots determine the one-time distributions but leave the temporal coupling unspecified, requiring a modeling prior to connect successive times. We propose the lift-project stochastic differential equation (SDE), an autonomous SDE on the observed coordinate and a few hidden coordinates, trained only to match the snapshots. Most existing methods, including time-dependent SDEs, Schrödinger bridges and optimal transport, evolve the observed coordinate alone. For a scalar observation, the classical comparison theorem implies that all such models have non-negative lagged covariance, so on data whose lagged covariance turns negative, their error has a computable floor. The lift-project SDE is not bound by this floor. On two representative partially observed systems, the Duffing and pendulum oscillators, at comparable fit to the snapshots, the proposed method reduces the lagged-covariance error by factors of 2.4 and 6.6 relative to the strongest baseline and is the only model below the error floor; one hidden coordinate is already enough for such improvement. Furthermore, if a second experiment changes only the initial state of the hidden coordinate, no single model that evolves the observed coordinate alone can fit both experiments, whereas a single lift-project SDE can.

AI.tldr: 提出"提升-投影SDE"(lift-project SDE)，在可观测坐标加少量隐藏坐标上构建自治SDE，仅用不配对快照训练，突破仅演化观测坐标的模型在滞后协方差上的误差下限。
AI.motivation: 系统常只能通过不配对快照观测：各时刻有族群样本但不同时刻样本无对应关系，快照只确定单时刻分布而时间耦合未定。现有方法（时变SDE、Schrödinger桥、最优传输）只演化观测坐标；对标量观测，比较定理意味着其滞后协方差必非负，故在滞后协方差为负的数据上误差存在可计算下限。
AI.method: 在观测坐标加少量隐藏坐标上定义自治SDE（lift），训练时仅匹配快照分布（project），通过隐藏坐标承载时间耦合信息。
AI.result: 在Duffing与单摆两个部分观测系统上，快照拟合程度相当的情况下，滞后协方差误差较最强基线分别降低2.4倍和6.6倍，且是唯一低于理论误差下限的模型；一个隐藏坐标即足够。若第二组实验仅改变隐藏坐标的初始状态，任何仅演化观测坐标的单一模型都无法同时拟合两组实验，而单一lift-project SDE可以。
AI.conclusion: 引入隐藏坐标的自治SDE可有效突破仅观测坐标模型的固有限制，为不配对快照下的系统建模提供更强表达力。

title: FlyWheel: Attention Kernels Built for the TPU
summary: Attention kernels on Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) often underutilize their matrix units (MXUs) because of repeated matrix operand loads, vector-intensive computation, and dependencies that leave MXUs idle. We present FlyWheel, a set of fast TPU kernels for both softmax and linear attention. FlyWheel reformulates softmax and triangular inversion to reduce vector work, while coordinating data layouts to improve matrix operand reuse. It then overlaps independent computation to hide execution latency. We apply these techniques to both softmax attention and Gated DeltaNet on TPU v6e and v7x. FlyWheel speeds up softmax attention by up to $4.14\times$ over the state-of-the-art RPA kernel and $1.80\times$ over Splash Attention, reaching 81% of peak BF16 throughput on v6e. It also speeds up Gated DeltaNet prefill by up to $3.61\times$. Integrated into vLLM serving Qwen3.8-27B, FlyWheel improves prefill throughput by up to $1.56\times$ while maintaining comparable accuracy.

AI.tldr: FlyWheel 是一组面向 TPU 的高效 softmax 与线性注意力内核，通过重组计算、协调数据布局和重叠独立计算提升 MXU 利用率，在 v6e 上达到 81% 峰值 BF16 吞吐。
AI.motivation: TPU 上的注意力内核因反复加载矩阵操作数、向量密集型计算以及依赖关系导致 MXU 空闲，从而无法充分利用矩阵单元。作者因此希望减少向量工作、提升矩阵操作数复用并隐藏执行延迟。
AI.method: FlyWheel 重新表述 softmax 与三角求逆以减少向量运算；协调数据布局以提升矩阵操作数复用；并重叠相互独立的计算以隐藏执行延迟。这些技术同时应用于 softmax attention 和 Gated DeltaNet，并在 TPU v6e 与 v7x 上实现。
AI.result: softmax attention 相对 SOTA 的 RPA 内核最高加速 4.14×，相对 Splash Attention 加速 1.80×，在 v6e 上达到峰值 BF16 吞吐的 81%；Gated DeltaNet prefill 最高加速 3.61×；集成到 vLLM 服务 Qwen3.8-27B 时，prefill 吞吐最高提升 1.56×，精度保持相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对 TPU 架构重新设计注意力计算与数据流，FlyWheel 显著提升了 softmax 与线性注意力内核的性能，并在真实推理服务场景中带来可观的吞吐收益且不损失精度。

title: A Novel Lightweight Multi-Scale Branching Encoder for Few-Shot Image Classification
comment: Preprint version. This manuscript has not yet been submitted to a journal, IEEE Access, In press, pp.1-1
summary: Few-Shot Learning (FSL) addresses classification scenarios in which only a small number of labeled examples are available for each class. This paper presents the Sum12 Multi-Scale branching encoder, a lightweight convolutional architecture designed to improve the embedding stage of Prototypical Networks without substantially increasing computational cost. The encoder uses seven parallel convolutional branches whose kernel-size combinations sum to 12, allowing local and broader spatial structures to be represented within a unified Multi-Scale feature space. The proposed architecture was evaluated on Omniglot, CIFAR- FS, FC100, and miniImageNet under controlled few-shot learning protocols and compared with the original Prototypical Network encoder and Inception-inspired branch variants. Additional ablation studies have investigated fusion strategies, dilated convolutions, branch compositions, and receptive field budget. Beyond few-shot learning, the encoder was also tested on the MedMNIST 2D benchmark to assess its behavior in conventional supervised medical image classification. Across these experiments, Sum12 generally improved the low-shot classification performance with respect to the basic ProtoNet encoder while preserving a compact model size. These properties suggest that the proposed encoder may be suitable for low-data visual recognition and resource-constrained intelligent imaging applications. However, complete end-to- end validation on the target embedded platform, including resolution of the observed implementation discrepancies, remains future work.

AI.tldr: 提出Sum12多尺度分支编码器，用7个卷积分支（核尺寸组合之和为12）替代ProtoNet基础编码器，在四个小样本数据集上普遍提升低样本分类性能且模型紧凑。
AI.motivation: 小样本学习中每类仅有少量标注样本，ProtoNet的嵌入阶段能力有限；作者希望在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下改进嵌入质量，兼顾资源受限的智能成像应用。
AI.method: 设计轻量卷积编码器，含7个并行卷积分支，其卷积核尺寸组合之和为12，在统一多尺度特征空间中同时表征局部与较宽空间结构；在Omniglot、CIFAR-FS、FC100、miniImageNet上按受控小样本协议与原始ProtoNet编码器及Inception式分支变体对比；并做融合策略、空洞卷积、分支构成、感受野预算等消融；另在MedMNIST 2D上测试常规监督分类。
AI.result: Sum12总体优于基础ProtoNet编码器，尤其在低样本情形下性能提升，同时保持较小的模型规模；消融实验揭示了融合策略、空洞卷积、分支组合与感受野预算的影响；在MedMNIST 2D上也表现出可用性。
AI.conclusion: Sum12是一种紧凑有效的多尺度编码器，适合低数据视觉识别与资源受限场景；但目标嵌入式平台的端到端验证及已发现的实现差异尚未解决，留作未来工作。

title: BridgeDock: Taming Generative Co-Folding Prior for Molecular Docking with Diffusion Bridge
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages, 4 figures, including appendices
summary: Molecular docking aims to predict the three-dimensional structure of a protein-ligand complex; in the conventional structure-based setting, it is conditioned on an input protein structure and ligand, often starting from an apo receptor in flexible docking or a holo receptor in rigid docking. Recent co-folding models exemplified by AlphaFold 3 achieve strong accuracy in protein-ligand complex prediction, but they typically generate complexes from sequence-derived inputs and therefore do not directly use apo structures as structural priors in docking, leading to a larger conformational search space and weaker robustness in difficult or few-step settings. We present BridgeDock, a framework that adapts pretrained co-folding backbones to flexible docking by modeling the apo-to-holo transition as a diffusion bridge, allowing generation from the initial protein-ligand state rather than from Gaussian noise. To make this bridge formulation compatible with pretrained denoisers, we introduce an alignment mechanism that maps bridge states to the original denoising schedule of the pretrained model. Experiments on standard flexible docking benchmarks show that BridgeDock consistently outperforms strong co-folding baselines. Moreover, BridgeDock is computationally efficient at inference time and remains effective even with very few denoising steps.

AI.tldr: BridgeDock将预训练共折叠骨干改造为柔性对接框架，用扩散桥建模apo→holo构象转变，从初始蛋白-配体状态而非高斯噪声生成，并通过对齐机制兼容预训练去噪器，在标准柔性对接基准上优于强基线且推理高效、少步仍有效。
AI.motivation: 传统柔性对接从apo受体出发但精度有限；AlphaFold 3等共折叠模型从序列生成复合物，无法把apo结构作为结构先验，导致构象搜索空间大、在困难或少步设置下鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 提出BridgeDock：把apo-to-holo转变建模为扩散桥，从初始蛋白-配体状态出发生成；引入对齐机制将桥状态映射到预训练模型原有的去噪调度，使桥式形式兼容预训练去噪器。
AI.result: 在标准柔性对接基准上持续优于强共折叠基线；推理计算高效，在极少的去噪步数下仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练共折叠骨干与扩散桥结合，可在保留结构先验的同时实现高效柔性对接，为利用apo结构先验的对接提供新思路。

title: PeptSol: A Translational Benchmark for Protected-Peptide Solubility in Drug Manufacturing
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 19 tables. Accepted at the AI for Drug Discovery workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Liquid-phase peptide synthesis (LPPS) offers a scalable route to peptide manufacturing, but route development still depends on empirical solvent screens because each protected intermediate must be soluble for reaction and recoverable for purification. The protecting groups, terminal modifications, and noncanonical residues that govern this behaviour are poorly represented in existing peptide property benchmarks, limiting the ability to develop and rigorously evaluate molecular representation models for LPPS-relevant prediction tasks. We introduce PeptSol, an open benchmark of 1388 hand-curated protected-peptide solubility measurements with chemistry-aware splits. The measurements span only 84 parent sequences and 101 protected structures, and 92.5% come from a single historical programme. Across seven frozen molecular encoders, the best macro-F1 is 0.843 on binary solubility for the historical subset under a peptide-held-out split; the harder three-class ordinal task reaches 0.614 in that cell. No foundation model consistently outperforms a baseline combining chemical fingerprints with explicit molecular descriptors, and model rankings vary across prediction tasks and data splits. The dataset, evaluation protocol, and baselines establish a standard for measuring progress on molecular representations for synthesis-aware peptide developability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PeptSol——首个面向液相多肽合成(LPPS)的保护肽溶解度开放基准，含1388条人工整理的测量数据（84个母体序列、101个保护结构，92.5%来自单一历史项目），并提供化学感知的数据划分与七种分子编码器的评测。
AI.motivation: LPPS路线开发仍依赖经验性溶剂筛选，因为每个保护中间体既要可溶又要可回收纯化；而保护基、端基修饰及非天然残基在这些性质中的作用在现有肽性质基准中代表性不足，难以严谨地开发和评估面向LPPS任务的分子表示模型。
AI.method: 构建PeptSol基准：1388条手工整理的受保护肽溶解度测量，采用化学感知的数据划分（如肽留出划分）；在二元溶解度与三分类序数任务上评测七种冻结分子编码器，并与"化学指纹+显式分子描述符"的基线比较。
AI.result: 历史子集在肽留出划分下的二元溶解度最佳macro-F1为0.843；更难的三分类序数任务在同一格中为0.614。没有基础模型能一致优于指纹+描述符基线，且模型排名随任务与划分变化。
AI.conclusion: PeptSol的数据集、评测协议与基线为衡量面向合成感知肽可成药性的分子表示进展建立了统一标准；同时也暴露出基础模型在该领域尚无稳定优势，数据集覆盖偏窄等问题。

title: Towards Fine-grained and Robust Detection of Human-AI Co-authorship
summary: The widespread adoption of large language models (LLMs) is reshaping how textual content is produced, complicating text provenance, and raising concerns for misinformation, plagiarism, and intellectual property. While prior work on AI-generated text detection has progressed, one-dimensional human-AI co-authorship scores lack signals directly relevant to ``AI involvement''. It remains unclear how adversarial paraphrasing distorts detection signals. In this work, we formulate a discrete-class text provenance detection framework. This framework allows an abstraction of realistic co-authorship scenarios into distinct degrees of AI involvement, differentiating the AI polishing on the surface level from the AI updating the discourse structures. This framework reveals the mechanisms of how adversarial paraphrasing blurs the decision boundaries for co-authorship detectors. To improve robustness of the detectors, we augment training data with adversarial paraphrases generated by the state-of-the-art paraphrasing attack model, exposing detectors to challenging meaning-preserving rewrites. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and generation models demonstrate that adversarial paraphrasing substantially degrades detectors trained only on benign data, while adversarial data augmentation leads to consistent robustness gains and good cross-generator transferability. Overall, our findings highlight the value of discrete-class formulation and principled data augmentation for building reliable detectors of human-AI co-authorship.

AI.tldr: 本文将人机共著文本溯源建模为离散类别检测问题，区分不同程度AI参与，并揭示对抗改写如何模糊检测边界，提出用对抗复述数据增强提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM普及使文本来源难以辨别，引发虚假信息、抄袭与知识产权问题；现有研究只用一维人机共著打分，缺乏"AI参与程度"的直接信号，且对抗性改写对检测信号的扭曲机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出离散类别的文本溯源检测框架，将现实共著场景抽象为不同AI参与程度（区分表层润色与话语结构调整）；用该框架分析对抗复述模糊决策边界的机制；并用最先进复述攻击模型生成的对抗样本进行训练数据增强。
AI.result: 多数据集、多生成模型实验表明：对抗复述显著降低仅用良性数据训练的检测器性能；对抗数据增强带来一致的鲁棒性提升，并具备良好的跨生成器迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 离散类别建模与有原则的数据增强对构建可靠的人机共著检测器具有重要价值。

title: Demystifying Prompt Stealing Attacks against Synthetic Video
summary: Creators publicly showcase generated content to advertise and sell their work, but these examples may also enable unauthorized reproduction and customization. We study whether an adversary can derive reusable inputs from a single public video for faithful reconstruction and controlled editing, without access to the original prompt or generator. We adapt captioning and prompt optimization approaches to video prompt stealing attacks (PSAs) and find that prompt recovery alone provides limited reconstruction fidelity. Even the original prompt produces different spatial and temporal realizations when the initial noise changes. Using an independent generator enlarges the reconstruction gap, as reusing the original prompt and seed can still produce substantially different videos. We propose V-PSA, which uses a recovered caption and DDIM inversion to construct a reference trajectory under an independent generator. Null-Text Inversion then optimizes per-step unconditional embeddings to reduce deviations from this trajectory during reconstruction. The resulting inputs also guide generation when the caption is modified, supporting edits that change selected content while preserving the target's layout and motion. We construct a benchmark containing 12,000 video-prompt pairs from three victim generators and four prompt sources. V-PSA achieves video-to-video similarity around 0.9 between target and reconstructed videos, substantially improving over prompt-only baselines with similarity score of 0.6, and supports multiple controlled variations that preserve the target's structure. Additional experiments show that augmenting prior image PSAs with inversion-derived inputs also improves reconstruction. Our results show that evaluations restricted to prompt recovery can underestimate an attacker's ability to reconstruct public generative outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出视频提示窃取攻击 V-PSA：用恢复的caption结合DDIM反演与Null-Text反演构造可复用输入，在黑盒独立生成器上实现约0.9的视频重建相似度，并支持结构保持的受控编辑。
AI.motivation: 创作者公开生成视频用于宣传售卖，但这些示例可能被攻击者用来复现和定制。现有评估只关注prompt恢复，而仅恢复prompt的重建保真度有限（初始噪声不同即便原始prompt也会产生不同时空实现；换用独立生成器差距更大），因此需要重新评估攻击者实际的重建能力。
AI.method: 适配captioning与prompt优化方法做视频PSA分析；提出V-PSA：以恢复的caption加DDIM反演在独立生成器上构造参考轨迹，再用Null-Text Inversion优化每步无条件嵌入以减小重建偏差；所得输入在caption修改时同样可用于引导生成，实现保留布局与运动的受控编辑。构建含3个受害生成器、4个prompt来源、12000个视频-prompt对的基准。
AI.result: V-PSA目标与重建视频相似度约0.9，显著优于仅用prompt的基线（约0.6）；支持多种保持目标结构的受控变体；在图像PSA中加入反演导出输入也能提升重建；仅以prompt恢复为指标的评估会低估攻击者的重建能力。
AI.conclusion: 公开生成视频可被转化为高保真可复用输入，提示窃取的威胁被此前基于prompt恢复的评估所低估，需以端到端重建保真度衡量风险。

title: A Discrete-Time Variational Objective for Degenerate Diffusion and Equivalence to Flow Matching
summary: Diffusion models and more recently Flow models have widespread application. In this work we consider degenerate Diffusion models in which the per-step generator is deterministic. We construct a modified variational framework and show a formal equivalence between Flow models and Degenerate Diffusion models. For our discrete-time variational objective we show that the optimal degenerate generator recovers the data distribution in the limit of an infinite number of generator steps. Our work therefore provides a unified perspective, showing that discrete-time implementations of flow matching and the discrete-time Degenerate Diffusion model can be considered within the same simple variational framework, removing the need for the continuous-time machinery normally used to justify flow matching models.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一个修正的变分框架，证明Flow模型与退化扩散模型（每步生成器确定）形式等价，并说明离散时间变分目标下最优退化生成器在无穷步极限下可恢复数据分布，从而无需连续时间机制即可统一解释flow matching。
AI.motivation: Flow模型与扩散模型通常用连续时间（SDE/ODE）机制来论证其合理性，流程繁琐且二者关系不够清晰。作者希望建立统一、简单的离散时间变分视角，说明Flow模型与退化扩散模型本质相同。
AI.method: 考虑每步生成器为确定性的退化扩散模型，构建修正的变分框架（离散时间变分目标），并在此框架下证明Flow模型与退化扩散模型之间的形式等价性。
AI.result: 证明了在离散时间变分目标下，最优退化生成器在生成步数趋于无穷时能够恢复数据分布；同时表明flow matching与离散退化扩散模型的离散实现可在同一变分框架内处理。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出统一视角：flow matching与离散退化扩散模型同属一个简单的变分框架，从而去除了原本用于论证flow matching所需的连续时间工具。

title: The Tangled Web They Weave: Exploring Neural Representations with Directed Simplicial Complexes
comment: 52 pages, 16 figures. Accepted at NeurReps 2026 (Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations)
summary: Understanding how artificial neural networks (ANNs) represent and combine features internally is a central challenge in mechanistic interpretability. Existing neural circuit-discovery methods represent neuron interactions as pairwise edges in a graph. But distributed neural representations consist of large groups of neurons that are inherently linked by higher-order causal dependencies: suppressing a subgroup of neurons in concert may shift the activation of other neurons in the feature representation. We propose a method to construct filtered directed simplicial complexes (DSCs) that give a topological representation of such dependencies, built from the activation profiles of an ANN on a given set of inputs. Our approach treats ANNs as structural causal models and uses counterfactual ablations to test for causal links between groups of internal neurons within specific input contexts. As a proof of concept, we apply the approach to a pair of small multilayer perceptron (MLP) architectures in a synthetic two-dimensional quadrant classification task. In these examples, DSCs recover the designed feature pathways and coordinated class transitions, and the complexes of trained networks are higher-dimensional than those of their handcrafted references. As validation, we compare our method with graph-based circuit-discovery baselines and find that their 1-skeletons agree within the relations that a weight graph can represent. These results support DSCs as context-dependent descriptions of multi-neuron computation and may thus provide a novel, orthogonal framework to study the phenomenon of distributed feature representations and polysemanticity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用过滤有向单纯复形（DSC）对人工神经网络中的高阶因果依赖进行拓扑表示，基于反事实消融在特定输入上下文中检验神经元组间的因果联系，在小规模MLP象限分类任务上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有神经电路发现方法将神经元交互表示为图上的成对边，但分布式神经表示由大量神经元组成，存在高阶因果依赖：同时抑制一个神经元子群会改变其他神经元激活。成对图结构无法刻画这类多神经元协同计算。
AI.method: 将ANN视为结构因果模型，从网络在给定输入集上的激活剖面构建过滤有向单纯复形；用反事实消融在特定输入上下文中检验内部神经元组之间的因果链接，从而得到拓扑化的高阶依赖表示。
AI.result: 在合成二维象限分类任务的两个小型MLP上，DSC恢复了设计的特征通路与协调的类别转换；训练网络的复形维度高于手工参考网络；与图基线对比，其1-骨架在与权重图可表示的关系范围内一致。
AI.conclusion: DSC可作为依赖上下文的多神经元计算描述，为研究分布式特征表示与多义性（polysemanticity）提供新的正交框架。

title: Accounting for Irregular State Transitions through Belief Estimation in Online Medical Consultation
summary: While online medical consultation broadens access, unprompted patient disclosures and topic shifts frequently disrupt clinician inquiry, leaving clinical states progressively revealed. We characterize these dynamics using both existing evaluation metrics and task-specific interaction metrics designed in this work. Through an empirical study across 16 medical dialogue datasets, we show that authentic online interactions exhibit substantially lower contextual continuity and higher unpredictability than offline and simulated benchmarks. We propose PRISM (Policy Reasoning with Inferred States for Medicine), a framework inspired by partially observable Markov decision processes that decouples latent state estimation from action selection to address drifting dialogue trajectories. Specifically, PRISM factorizes clinical triage into belief estimation, policy optimization, and response realization. By maintaining an evolving posterior belief over consultation states and conditioning action selection on the maximum a posteriori state, PRISM advances clinical goals while accommodating patient-initiated shifts. Extensive evaluations show that PRISM substantially outperforms frontier LLMs and clinical agents, achieving a 22.40 percentage point gain in clinical decision accuracy alongside decisive improvements in response generation, surpassing the strongest baseline by 5.51 points in BERTScore_F1. Furthermore, ablation studies show that providing oracle consultation states consistently boosts response quality across all evaluated baselines by guiding their action reasoning, yielding average gains of 5.58 points in BERTScore_F1.

AI.tldr: PRISM：将在线问诊建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，解耦隐状态估计与动作选择，显著提升临床决策与响应生成质量。
AI.motivation: 在线问诊中患者常主动披露信息、切换话题，打断医生问诊节奏，临床状态被逐步揭示。真实线上对话的上下文连续性和可预测性明显低于线下和模拟基准，现有方法难以应对这种漂移轨迹。
AI.method: 先用现有指标和自建的任务特定交互指标刻画对话动态（16个医学对话数据集实证）；提出PRISM框架，受POMDP启发，将临床分诊分解为信念估计、策略优化与响应实现三部分，维护对问诊状态的演化后验信念，并基于最大后验状态进行动作选择。
AI.result: 临床决策准确率提升22.40个百分点，BERTScore_F1超出最强基线5.51分；消融显示提供oracle状态可平均提升各基线响应质量5.58分。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模患者引发的状态漂移、分离“状态推断”与“动作选择”是提升医疗对话智能体的关键，oracle状态的价值说明状态估计是主要瓶颈。

title: Detector-Integrated Multi-Cue Association for Occlusion-Aware UAV Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenging because vehicles are small, visually similar, and frequently occluded, which leads to identity switches (IDSW). Appearance-based trackers such as DeepSORT rely on a standalone re-identification (ReID) network, whose per-target inference limits runtime speed, while the appearance of small or occluded vehicles remains unreliable. This paper proposes a detector-integrated multi-cue tracking framework. Lightweight projection heads are attached to the neck of the YOLOv8n detector to extract target embeddings through ROIAlign, producing detections and embeddings in a single forward pass. A multi-cue association cost then combines motion, IoU, and appearance distances with weights determined through ablation, complemented by low-score rescue and appearance-memory protection. On the UAVDT benchmark, the proposed method achieves a MOTA of 28.33, a HOTA of 31.16, and an IDF1 of 38.18 at 82.59 FPS, the best among the compared trackers in all three metrics, and reduces IDSW by 58.4\% compared with DeepSORT.

AI.tldr: 提出检测器内嵌多线索跟踪框架，在YOLOv8n颈部加轻量投影头，单次前向同时输出检测与嵌入，结合运动、IoU、外观多线索关联，在UAVDT上达到SOTA且速度82.59 FPS。
AI.motivation: UAV图像中车辆小、外观相似且常被遮挡，导致身份切换；DeepSORT等依赖独立ReID网络，逐目标推理拖慢速度，且小目标/遮挡目标外观不可靠。
AI.method: 在YOLOv8n检测器颈部附加轻量投影头，通过ROIAlign提取目标嵌入，一次前向同时得到检测与嵌入；多线索关联代价融合运动、IoU、外观距离，权重由消融实验确定，并辅以低分目标救援与外观记忆保护。
AI.result: 在UAVDT基准上MOTA 28.33、HOTA 31.16、IDF1 38.18，速度82.59 FPS，三项指标均优于对比跟踪器，IDSW较DeepSORT降低58.4%。
AI.conclusion: 将外观嵌入集成进检测器并融合多线索关联，可在保证实时性的同时显著减少UAV场景中的身份切换。

title: AI Data Analysis: A New Approach - Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis
summary: AI data analysis today is three fragmented worlds: LLMs understand semantics but cannot compute; BI aggregates precisely but is stateless; ML processes large-scale data on a stateful kernel but lacks semantics. This paper proposes a combination mechanism, named Multi-engine Joint State Data Analysis, that fills a still-open gap - the multi-engine joint context: the data context is embedded into LLM conversational analysis, where the LLM serves only as the semantic, reasoning, and orchestration layer (not computation) and connects four engines through the 1M context window - Python and R ML kernels, SQL over relational databases, Cypher over graph databases - yielding two multiplications, "semantics and precise computation" and "relational and graph", under enterprise-grade governance. The novelty is a four-dimensional coordinate system: horizontal (engine kinds), vertical (state flow - the watershed), spatial (business generalization), temporal (iterative convergence); a deterministic grounding method (one-shot injection of schema.json + notes.md, M+S) carries the spatial and temporal dimensions. Empirically, all four dimensions are substantiated: horizontally, four engines are quantified - SQL, Cypher (96.5% on CypherBench movie), ML in Python and R (TabReD weather); vertically, state flows across engines and grounding is reused across kernels; spatially, SQL generalizes across three business databases - AdventureWorks 91.3%, financial 95.3%, formula_1 94.6% (average), about 20-23 points above single-shot SOTA 74.45%; temporally, accuracy converges monotonically as notes accumulate. The core invariant - the separation of semantics from computation plus a cross-data-domain persistent context - does not expire as LLMs and agents evolve or engine forms change.

AI.tldr: 提出"多引擎联合状态数据分析"组合机制，以LLM为语义/推理/编排层（不做计算），借助1M上下文窗口连接Python/R ML内核、SQL关系库与Cypher图库，实现"语义×精确计算""关系×图"两种乘法。
AI.motivation: 当前AI数据分析存在三个割裂世界：LLM懂语义但不会计算；BI聚合精确但无状态；ML能在有状态内核上处理大规模数据但缺语义。三者之间缺少"多引擎联合上下文"这一尚未填补的空白。
AI.method: LLM仅作语义、推理与编排层，通过1M上下文窗口连接四类引擎（Python/R ML内核、SQL、Cypher）。提出四维坐标系：横向（引擎种类）、纵向（状态流动，为分水岭）、空间（业务泛化）、时间（迭代收敛）；并给出确定性接地方法（一次性注入schema.json + notes.md，M+S），承载空间与时间维度。
AI.result: 四维均获实证：横向四引擎量化（SQL、Cypher在CypherBench电影任务96.5%、Python与R的ML在TabReD天气任务）；纵向状态跨引擎流动、接地跨内核复用；空间上SQL在三个业务库泛化——AdventureWorks 91.3%、金融95.3%、formula_1 94.6%（均值），比单次SOTA 74.45%高约20–23点；时间上精度随notes积累单调收敛。
AI.conclusion: 核心不变量——语义与计算分离，加上跨数据域的持久上下文——不随LLM与Agent演进或引擎形态变化而失效，具有长期稳定性。

title: Tight Stochastic Sequential Covers for General VC Classes with Unknown i.i.d. Features
summary: We study hybrid online learning with stochastic features and adversarial labels when the feature distribution is unknown. Prior work gave stochastic sequential covers of log-size $O(d\log^2 T)$ for a general VC class and logarithmic bounds only under stronger star-type structure. We show that finite VC dimension alone is enough: every binary class of VC dimension $d$ admits a distribution-blind exact cover with log-size $O(d\log T+\log(1/δ))$, matching the worst-case $Ω(d\log(T/d))$ dependence on the horizon. The key ingredient is a new local cube weight that counts Boolean subcubes incident to each realizable trace. Unlike the equal splits used in earlier constructions, we split mass unevenly according to these cube weights; a coordinate-deletion inequality shows that VC dimension controls the total cost of these splits. This yields, to our knowledge, the first tight $O((d+1)\log T)$ expected worst-case log-loss regret for general VC partitions with unknown i.i.d. features, and an exact polynomial-time implementation for planar affine halfspaces. We also show that the binary phenomenon does not extend from VC dimension to pseudo-dimension: a fixed pseudo-dimension-one sigmoid class requires $Ω(\log^2 T)$ bits for uniform sequential approximation at accuracy $1/T$.

AI.tldr: 仅用有限VC维就足以构建分布无关的精确顺序覆盖，对数规模为O(d log T + log(1/δ))，该文由此首次给出通用VC分割在未知i.i.d.特征下的最优对数损失遗憾界O((d+1)log T)，并揭示二分类现象不推广到伪维数。
AI.motivation: 先前工作对一般VC类只能给出log规模O(d log^2 T)的随机顺序覆盖，仅更强的星型结构下才有对数界；且此前缺乏对通用VC分割与未知i.i.d.特征的紧最优遗憾保证。
AI.method: 引入新的局部立方体权重，统计与每条可实现迹关联的布尔子立方体；按该权重非均匀拆分质量（而非等分），并用坐标删除不等式证明VC维控制拆分总代价，从而构造分布盲的精确覆盖；对平面仿射半空间给出多项式时间的精确实现。
AI.result: 任意VC维为d的二分类类都存在log规模O(d log T + log(1/δ))的分布盲精确覆盖，与时域的最坏情形下界Ω(d log(T/d))相匹配；得到首个O((d+1)log T)期望最坏情形对数损失遗憾。同时证明伪维为一的固定sigmoid类在精度1/T的一致顺序近似下需要Ω(log^2 T)比特。
AI.conclusion: 有限VC维本身即可达紧对数顺序覆盖，二分类的加性对数现象不延伸至伪维数，表明VC维与伪维数在多类别/实值设定下存在本质分离。

title: TopoSteer: Topological Layer Selection for Activation Steering in LLMs
summary: Activation steering controls large language models at inference time by adding a vector to their internal representations. Most work asks how to build that vector, and far less attention has gone to where to add it, even though steering at a poorly chosen layer can be worse than not steering at all. Prior selectors choose a layer without ever steering the model to test it: they score how separable the target behavior is at that layer, and how consistently the individual examples point along the steering direction. We argue that what matters is not the separability of the two activation clouds, nor the alignment of individual displacements with their mean, but the extent of the cloud of per-example displacements that mean-difference steering averages. We propose a topology-based layer selection method, called TopoSteer, which scores a layer by the total H_0 persistence of its displacement cloud, computed as the length of the cloud's Euclidean minimum spanning tree. We show that the score focuses on the displacement cloud's relative geometry, while class separation affects it only through standardization. We also provide a theoretical explanation for our method by proving that, as example-level variation increases, TopoSteer and discriminability move in opposite directions, so the two criteria can rank layers in opposite ways. Across multiple language models and steering tasks, TopoSteer provides a principled alternative to discriminability- and separability-based layer selection and yields more effective steering without requiring held-out validation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TopoSteer，一种基于拓扑（H_0 持久性，即位移云欧氏最小生成树长度）的激活引导层选择方法，用来替代传统的可判别性/可分性准则。
AI.motivation: 激活引导的关键不仅在于如何构造引导向量，还在于加在哪一层；层选错可能比不引导更差。现有层选择器从不真正引导模型来检验效果，而是用可分性或个体位移与均值的一致性打分，作者认为真正重要的是逐样本位移云的整体范围。
AI.method: 用位移云的总 H_0 持久性（欧氏最小生成树长度）为每层打分层分，提出 TopoSteer；并分析该分数只关注位移云的相对几何，类分离仅通过标准化影响分数；同时给出理论证明：随样本级变异增大，TopoSteer 与可判别性朝相反方向变化，可对层给出相反排序。
AI.result: 在多个语言模型和多种引导任务上，TopoSteer 相比基于可判别性和可分性的层选择得到更有效的引导，且无需留出验证集。
AI.conclusion: TopoSteer 为激活引导的层选择提供了有理论依据的原则性替代方案，强调位移云几何而非可分性作为选层标准。

title: Dynamic Merging Mutually-Distilled Multi-View Networks for RGB-Event-based Representation Learning
summary: Multi-modal fusion algorithms combining conventional frame-based cameras and event cameras have recently attracted substantial research attention. Typically, existing approaches convert event streams into frames, voxels, or tensors, and then learn the required spatiotemporal information from these transformed event representations for fusion with conventional frame-camera data. Obviously, such paradigms only exploit the limited representational capacity of event data. Moreover, standard training pipelines fail to fully leverage diverse model parameters obtained throughout the learning process. In this paper, we propose a novel mutual distillation method leveraging multi-view teacher network weights to better integrate multiple event representations and achieve model-parameter level fusion. Specifically, we employ multiple encoders to extract different types of event representations and perform mutual knowledge distillation at both the feature-level and logit-level in this process. Afterwards, we perform a dynamic hierarchical model merge strategy on the model parameters from the first stage to yield a unified multi-modal RGB-Event representation model. Experimental results across multiple event-based datasets demonstrate that our proposed framework achieves significant performance improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于多视角教师网络权重互相蒸馏、并在参数层面层次化动态合并的多模态RGB-事件融合框架，性能显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RGB-事件融合方法把事件流转换为帧/体素/张量后学习时空信息，只利用了事件数据有限的表征能力；同时标准训练流程未能充分利用学习过程中产生的多样模型参数。作者希望整合多种事件表征并实现模型参数级别的融合。
