AI.method: 1）用多个编码器分别提取不同类型的事件表征；2）在此过程中于特征级和logit级进行互相知识蒸馏；3）随后对第一阶段得到的模型参数执行动态层次化模型合并策略，得到统一的多模态RGB-事件表征模型。
AI.result: 在多个基于事件的数据集上实验，所提框架取得显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过多视角教师网络权重的互相蒸馏并结合参数级层次化合并，可更充分地利用多种事件表征与训练中的模型参数，形成统一且更强的RGB-事件融合模型。

title: VCoT-SQL: Enhancing Text-to-SQL Generation through Dual Chain-of-Thought Validation Training
summary: Open-source LLMs provide a flexible alternative to closed-source models for Text-to-SQL but still struggle with complex queries. Finetuning with chain-of-thought (CoT) data improves reasoning, yet standard datasets lack CoT annotations, requiring synthetic generation. Existing synthesis methods only verify the final answer, allowing flawed reasoning steps to corrupt the training data. We propose VCoT-SQL, a framework that improves Text-to-SQL generation through intermediate-step validated CoT supervision and a dedicated SQL validator, which enables small open-source models to outperform frontier closed-source models. VCoT-SQL trains two complementary models on curated reasoning traces: an SQL generator using clause-level CoT templates where reasoning steps are verified via execution and schema alignment checks, and an SQL validator using diagnostic CoT templates to detect syntactic, semantic, and type level errors. We further design a hierarchical schema filtering pipeline that integrates and refines complementary retrieval strategies to distill relevant database elements. VCoT-SQL achieves 66.82% execution accuracy on challenging dataset BIRD dev and 86.8% on Spider test, improving the base 7B model by 7% on BIRD. Notably, our CoT synthesis relies on 7B models yet outperforms methods that use 72B-scale or even proprietary closed source teachers for data generation, demonstrating that rigorous step-level validation can be more effective than scaling up teacher model size. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/INTREBID/VCoT-SQL.

AI.tldr: VCoT-SQL 通过中间步骤验证的 CoT 监督和专用 SQL 校验器，使小型开源模型在 Text-to-SQL 上超越前沿闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 开源 LLM 用于 Text-to-SQL 灵活但难处理复杂查询；CoT 微调可提升推理，但缺乏标注需合成生成，而现有合成方法仅验证最终答案，错误推理步骤会污染训练数据。
AI.method: 训练两个互补模型：基于子句级 CoT 模板的 SQL 生成器（推理步骤经执行与模式对齐检查验证），以及基于诊断式 CoT 模板、可检测语法/语义/类型错误的 SQL 校验器；并设计分层模式过滤流水线，融合精炼互补检索策略以提炼相关数据库元素。
AI.result: BIRD dev 执行准确率 66.82%，Spider test 86.8%，7B 基座模型在 BIRD 上提升 7%；仅用 7B 模型合成的 CoT 数据即超越使用 72B 甚至专有闭源教师的方法。
AI.conclusion: 严格的步骤级验证比扩大教师模型规模更有效；数据集与代码已开源。

title: Crop Mapping Evaluation under Sampling Bias
summary: Government agencies use crop maps to estimate production, monitor food security, and set agricultural policy. These crop maps are usually validated against field labels, but these labels are rarely a random sample of the area the map covers. Field teams tend to label parcels near roads and skip ones that are small or hard to reach, so performance measured on held-out labels mainly describes the places they visited. We call the difference between this reported performance and performance over the whole mapped region the deployment performance gap. To estimate performance over the whole region, we use a weighted form of prediction-powered inference (PPI). The classifier's predictions on unlabeled points across the region give a first estimate, and its errors on the labeled points correct that estimate, with more weight on labels from under-sampled conditions. We test this in five European regions where crop registers label every declared parcel, so the true performance is known. Simulating six documented collection practices there produces gaps of up to 0.20 macro-F1. On the collection rule that creates the largest gap in each region, 5 km block cross-validation still overestimates macro-F1 by as much as 0.18, while PPI with weights estimated from satellite embeddings reduces the largest error across regions to 0.07. Importance-weighted cross-validation with the same weights does almost as well, so most of the improvement comes from the weights themselves. We also apply the method to three Kenyan datasets that have no region-wide reference labels. For a roadside dataset collected with helmet-mounted cameras, the estimated macro-F1 falls from 0.93 under random cross-validation to 0.61, although the correction relies on a small number of heavily weighted labels. Our code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/pappi.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"部署性能差距"概念：作物地图验证所用野外标签多非随机采样（偏向路边、忽略小块难达地块），导致报告性能只反映被访问区域。作者用加权版PPI（结合未标注区域预测与加权纠错标签）估计全区性能，并证明其优于5km块交叉验证。
AI.motivation: 政府用作物地图估产、监测粮食安全和制定政策，但验证标签常来自非随机采样（如路边、易达地块），使报告性能无法代表整个制图区域，形成"部署性能差距"，需方法估计全区真实性能。
AI.method: 采用加权形式的prediction-powered inference (PPI)：先用分类器对全区未标注点的预测作初步估计，再用标注点上的误差纠正该估计，对欠采样条件下的标签赋更高权重；权重由卫星embedding估计。与5km块交叉验证及等权重/重要性加权交叉验证对比，在五个标签全覆盖的欧洲地区验证，并应用于三个肯尼亚数据集。
AI.result: 模拟六种已记录的采集方式产生最多0.20 macro-F1的差距。在最大差距的采集规则下，5km块交叉验证仍高估macro-F1达0.18，而加权PPI将跨区最大误差降至0.07；加权交叉验证表现接近，说明改进主要来自权重本身。肯尼亚路边数据集估计macro-F1从随机交叉验证的0.93降至0.61（依赖少量高权标签）。
AI.conclusion: 野外采集偏差会显著高估作物制图性能，加权PPI可有效校正并逼近全区真实性能，权重是改进关键；但极端欠采样时校正依赖少量高权重标签，需谨慎解读。代码已开源。

title: Write Facts the Way Models Read Them: Lifting the Two-Hop Curse
summary: A language model that learns a new fact by fine-tuning can repeat it but cannot reason with it: taught that a person is a citizen of a new country, it still cannot say, without chain-of-thought, who the head of state of that person's country is. This two-hop curse is widely treated as a reasoning deficit, and the strongest knowledge editors answer it with synthesized reasoning data. We show that the reasoning is intact and the writing is wrong. Fine-tuning writes a new fact as an answer to be said, whereas the second hop reads the bridge ("that person's country") as an entity, from the middle layers on: patching the model's own representation of the entity into the bridge at those layers largely restores the second hop, yet after fine-tuning the bridge there is no closer to the new entity than before the edit. We therefore propose read-equivalent writing (Legible): one loss term makes the bridge phrase, at the layer where the second hop finishes reading it, match the model's own reading of the new entity, and keeps the same relation's other subjects unchanged. Phrases and targets come from the edited model itself, and no multi-hop training data is used. Across Qwen2.5, Llama-3 and Qwen3, Legible (I) composes learned facts more often than the model composes its own knowledge, on MQuAKE's two-hop-curse questions; (II) reaches 1.8-2.6x the bridge accuracy of CaKE, whose reasoning data composes no better than plain fine-tuning, and has the best average over composition, accuracy and locality against four families of writers; and (III) lifts the curse on RippleEdits, on the benchmark of Balesni et al., who named the curse, and at 14B.

AI.tldr: 论文指出微调习得新事实后无法进行两跳推理（"两跳诅咒"）并非推理缺陷，而是"书写"问题；提出Legible方法，将桥接短语的中间层表示对齐到模型对新实体的自有读取，从而修复组合能力。
AI.motivation: 现有观点将两跳诅咒视为推理能力缺失，知识编辑领域用合成推理数据来缓解，但效果有限。作者通过表示层分析发现模型推理能力本身完好，问题在于微调把新事实写成"可陈述的答案"，而第二跳需要在中间层将桥接短语（如"那个人的国家"）当作实体读取，微调后该桥接处并未更接近新实体。
AI.method: 提出"读取等价书写"（Legible）：增加一个损失项，使桥接短语在第二跳完成读取的层上与模型自身对新实体的表示匹配，同时保持同一关系的其他主语不变。短语与目标均由被编辑模型自身生成，不使用任何多跳训练数据。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5、Llama-3、Qwen3上：在MQuAKE两跳诅咒问题上，Legible组合学到事实的频率高于模型组合自身知识；桥接准确率为CaKE的1.8–2.6倍（CaKE的推理数据组合效果不优于普通微调）；在组合、准确性、局部性综合指标上优于四类写入方法；并在RippleEdits及Balesni等人提出该诅咒的基准上、直至14B规模解除诅咒。
AI.conclusion: 两跳诅咒是表示对齐问题而非推理缺陷，只需将书写方式改为"读取等价"即可在无需多跳数据的前提下恢复组合推理，为知识编辑提供了新方向。

title: A New Formulation of the Elastica Model with Application to Image Inpainting
summary: Curves and interfaces play a central role in computer vision and image processing, and Euler's elastica energy is one of the most successful tools to model and manipulate them. The elastica energy is usually computed through a level-set or a phase field representation of the curve, in which the curvature term makes the energy nonlinear, non-convex and, in the level-set case, non-differentiable, so that its minimization is notoriously difficult. In this paper, we propose a new formulation of the elastica model based on a binary representation of curves. The key ingredient is a very simple formula for the curvature: if $φ$ is the $\pm1$ binary function associated with a curve $Γ$, then along $Γ$ the curvature is given by $-\frac{1}{C_0ε}\left(R_ε*φ\right)+O(ε)$, where $R_ε$ is a radial kernel supported in a ball of radius $ε$ and $C_0$ is an explicit constant. No derivative of $φ$ is involved and the convolution is evaluated by FFT. The resulting energy is a weighted total variation, so that formally the new formulation is a generalization of the well-known ROF model; a phase field type model is obtained from the same curvature formula. Combining FFT with the split Bregman iteration, which for the present problem coincides with an augmented Lagrangian method (ALM), we obtain efficient algorithms whose subproblems are either linear systems solved by conjugate gradient or explicit pointwise formulas. Numerical experiments on the inpainting of binary images are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于曲线的二值（±1）表示来重构Euler弹性（elastica）模型：利用一个仅依赖径向核卷积的简单曲率公式，将弹性能力写作加权全变差，从而得到可用FFT+分裂Bregman/ALM高效求解的模型，并在二值图像修补实验中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 曲线与界面在计算机视觉与图像处理中极为重要，而Euler弹性能力是建模与操控曲线最成功的工具之一。但传统上弹性能力通过level-set或phase field表示计算，曲率项导致能量非线性、非凸，在level-set情形下还不可微，最小化非常困难，因此需要一个更易优化的弹性模型表述。
AI.method: 核心是一个极简曲率公式：若φ是与曲线Γ对应的±1二值函数，则沿Γ有曲率 ≈ -1/(C0ε)·(Rε*φ)+O(ε)，其中Rε是支撑在半径ε球内的径向核，C0为显式常数，且不涉及φ的导数，卷积用FFT计算。由此得到的能量是加权全变差，形式上推广了ROF模型；同样的曲率公式还可导出phase field型模型。数值上用FFT结合分裂Bregman迭代（此处等价于增广拉格朗日法ALM），子问题或为用共轭梯度求解的线性系统，或为逐点显式公式。
AI.result: 所得算法子问题简单高效（CG求解线性系统或显式逐点更新）；在二值图像修补（inpainting）上的数值实验表明所提算法有效。
AI.conclusion: 基于二值曲线表示的elastica新表述避免了显式导数与level-set的不可微困难，把弹性模型化为加权全变差，并与FFT/分裂Bregman–ALM自然匹配，给出高效求解框架，为曲线与界面的弹性建模与优化提供了新途径。

title: AdKnob: Ad Intensity Control and Labeling for LLM-Native Advertising
summary: Large language model (LLM)-native advertising has emerged as a viable monetization channel as LLM service providers seek sustainable revenue streams. However, integrating native ads into LLM responses introduces two largely understudied challenges: (1) controlling ad intensity -- how prominently advertising content appears -- and (2) ad labeling -- identifying which segments of the generated text constitute advertising. We propose AdKnob, a framework jointly addressing both challenges. For ad intensity control, we introduce new ad control tokens without pretrained semantic associations and align the model via direct preference optimization to generate ads at each desired level. For ad labeling, we propose an attention rollout-based attribution mechanism that identifies ad segments by tracing their attribution to input ad-related tokens, requiring no additional inference cost. We further construct MI-KnobSet, the first multi-level ad intensity preference dataset for LLM-native ads. Experiments across six LLMs and human evaluations show that AdKnob achieves uniformly spaced ad intensities where baselines collapse to a narrow range, achieves the highest ad labeling accuracy while being over 500x faster than the strongest baseline, and is preferred over baselines by human evaluators up to 89.6% of the time.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdKnob 框架，用可学习的广告控制 token 与 DPO 实现 LLM 原生广告的强度分级控制，并用基于 attention rollout 的归因方法零额外推理成本地标注广告片段，同时构建首个多级广告强度偏好数据集 MI-KnobSet。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务商需要可持续变现渠道，原生广告成为可行方案，但广告强度控制（广告显著程度）与广告标注（识别生成文本中哪些部分是广告）两个关键问题缺乏研究。
AI.method: 1) 广告强度控制：引入无预训练语义关联的新广告控制 token，通过直接偏好优化（DPO）对齐模型，使其按指定强度等级生成广告；2) 广告标注：提出基于 attention rollout 的归因机制，将生成片段归因到输入中的广告相关 token 来识别广告段，无额外推理开销；3) 构建 MI-KnobSet——首个 LLM 原生广告多级强度偏好数据集。
AI.result: 在 6 个 LLM 与人评实验中：AdKnob 实现均匀分布的广告强度，而基线坍缩到狭窄区间；广告标注准确率最高，且比最强基线快 500 倍以上；人工评估中偏好率最高达 89.6%。
AI.conclusion: AdKnob 以统一框架同时解决广告强度可控性与广告可识别性问题，兼顾效果、效率与用户偏好，为 LLM 原生广告变现提供了可行方案。

title: Private Uniform Language Generation
summary: We study uniform language generation under approximate differential privacy. Given a uniformly bounded number of distinct examples from an unknown target language, a generator must produce infinitely many new examples from that language with probability one while protecting the privacy of its input. We introduce a new combinatorial dimension termed the nested branching dimension and prove that a language class is privately uniformly generatable if and only if both its closure dimension and nested branching dimension are finite. Previous work characterizes non-private uniform generation by the finiteness of the closure dimension alone. Our results therefore identify an additional combinatorial obstruction imposed by privacy.

AI.tldr: 研究近似差分隐私下的均匀语言生成，提出"嵌套分支维数"，证明语言类可私密均匀生成当且仅当闭包维数与嵌套分支维数均有限，从而揭示隐私带来的额外组合障碍。
AI.motivation: 已有的非隐私均匀生成刻画只需闭包维数有限。作者希望弄清加入差分隐私约束后，哪些语言类仍能被均匀生成，即隐私是否额外引入了组合学上的限制。
AI.method: 在给定来自未知目标语言的均匀有界数量不同示例的前提下，要求生成器以概率1产生无穷多个该语言的新示例并保护输入隐私。引入新的组合维数——嵌套分支维数，并给出充要条件刻画。
AI.result: 证明了语言类可被私密均匀生成，当且仅当其闭包维数与嵌套分支维数都有限：闭包维数有限与既有非隐私结论一致，嵌套分支维数有限则是隐私所需的额外条件。
AI.conclusion: 隐私在均匀语言生成中引入了非隐私情形所没有的组合障碍，并在闭包维数之外给出了完整刻画。

title: The Structure of Disagreement in Emotion Annotation
summary: Calculating inter-annotator agreement is an established practice in NLP, and disagreement-aware work increasingly retains the distribution of human judgments rather than reducing annotations to a single gold label. Keeping the distribution, however, does not explain why annotators disagree. This paper examines the types of disagreement that occur in emotion annotation, starting from multilabel annotations of 1,677 sentence-level units from Ernest Hemingway's The Old Man and the Sea and testing the patterns they reveal against individual-level annotations from BRIGHTER and GoEmotions. Across the three datasets, we find three main recurring disagreement structures. Emotion categories overlap systematically; annotators differ both in how broadly they apply labels and in how they treat particular category boundaries, while sparse participation and explicit abstention can look like disagreement. Where intensity is rated, disagreement over whether an emotion is present can be separated from disagreement over its intensity once recognized. Similar aggregate disagreement can therefore arise from qualitatively different annotation processes. Hard aggregation removes most of this structure, while annotator vote-share representations keep marginal label frequencies but not the co-occurrence, annotator-specific, or procedural patterns that produced them. We argue that disagreement should be understood in terms of its underlying patterns before it is summarized, aggregated, or used as a modeling target, and propose a vocabulary for disagreement structure.

AI.tldr: 本文分析情感标注中标注者分歧的"结构类型"，基于《老人与海》1,677条多标签句级标注，并在BRIGHTER与GoEmotions上验证，识别出三类主要分歧结构，并主张先理解分歧模式再进行汇总或建模。
AI.motivation: 现有NLP实践虽保留人工判断分布（disagreement-aware），但保留分布并不能解释标注者为何分歧；聚合为单一金标签会丢失结构信息，投票占比表示也仅保留边际频率而丢失共现与标注者特异性信息。
AI.method: 从《老人与海》1,677个句级单元的多标签情感标注出发，归纳分歧模式，并在BRIGHTER与GoEmotions的个体级标注上检验这些模式；此外区分"情感是否出现"与"强度分歧"两类情形，并分析稀疏参与与显式弃权的影响。
AI.result: 三个数据集上发现三类反复出现的分歧结构：(1) 情感类别系统性重叠；(2) 标注者在标注宽泛度与特定类别边界处理上存在差异；(3) 稀疏参与与显式弃权会被误判为分歧。强度标注中，"是否出现"的分歧可与"强度"分歧分离。相似的整体分歧可能源于性质不同的标注过程；硬聚合消除大部分结构，投票占比表示则保留边际频率但丢失共现、标注者特异与程序性模式。
AI.conclusion: 分歧在汇总、聚合或作为建模目标之前，应先按其底层模式加以理解；本文为此提出一套描述分歧结构的词汇体系。

title: Can Agentic AI Undermine Its Own Assurance Loop? Closed-Loop Dependency Assurance for Cognitive Network Digital Twins
summary: Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Network Digital Twins (NDTs) are increasingly combined to form Cognitive Digital Twins (CDTs) that translate operational intents into network changes and support closed-loop management. However, a network change may achieve its intended objective while disrupting the monitoring or recovery mechanisms needed for subsequent decisions. For example, a service may be rerouted while its latency-monitoring traffic continues along the original path, producing measurements that no longer reflect the service's performance. We propose Closed-Loop Dependency Assurance (CLDA), an assurance mechanism that augments agentic AI-enabled NDTs with dependency-aware validation. In our framework, an agentic AI planner generates and refines network plans, while the NDT evaluates the projected network outcomes of these plans. CLDA extends this analysis using a Loop Dependency Graph (LDG) that connects service requirements to monitoring mechanisms, forwarding paths, failure domains, and recovery prerequisites. CLDA projects candidate actions onto these dependencies, checks intermediate states of multistep plans, and supports deterministic make-before-break repairs using temporary monitoring mechanisms. Unlike the Large Language Model (LLM)-based planner, CLDA uses explicit, deterministic rules for assurance decisions and repair. We evaluate CLDA through controlled reconfigurations, a 240-trial LLM-based planning campaign, and live network execution. A separate synthetic study examines deterministic assurance scalability across network models representing up to 1,024 routers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出闭环依赖保障（CLDA），在Agentic AI+网络数字孪生（NDT）构成的认知数字孪生中，用确定性的循环依赖图（LDG）对规划动作进行依赖感知校验与修复，避免"达成目标却破坏监控/恢复机制"的问题。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI与NDT结合形成认知数字孪生，将运维意图转为网络变更并支持闭环管理。但变更可能在实现目标的同时破坏后续决策所需的监控或恢复机制；例如服务被重路由而其时延监控流量仍走原路径，导致测量不再反映真实性能。
AI.method: CLDA：agentic AI规划器生成并迭代网络计划，NDT评估计划投影结果。CLDA在其上增加循环依赖图（LDG），将服务需求与监控机制、转发路径、故障域、恢复前提相连；把候选动作投影到这些依赖上，检查多步计划的中间状态，并借助临时监控机制实现确定性的make-before-break修复。与LLM规划器不同，保障决策与修复采用显式确定性规则。
AI.result: 通过受控重配置实验、240次试次的LLM规划测试活动以及真实网络执行进行评估；另用合成研究检验确定性保障在最多1,024台路由器的网络模型上的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: CLDA以确定性依赖分析补强agentic AI驱动的NDT，使闭环网络变更在满足意图的同时不破坏监控与恢复能力，并具备大规模网络下的可扩展性。

title: Streaming Virtual Metrology via Lightweight Adaptation under Temporal Distribution Shifts
summary: Virtual metrology (VM) aims to estimate costly or delayed metrology variables from heterogeneous sensor signals and in-line measurements, and it acts as a critical component of semiconductor manufacturing. While recent data-driven models have improved VM accuracy, most are trained in batch settings and assume stationary data distributions. In practice, however, production environments evolve continuously due to equipment degradation, process adjustments, and maintenance events, making conventional batch-trained VM models difficult to maintain under temporal distribution shifts. In this work, we propose GRAPE (Global Regression with Adaptive Prediction Enhancement), a practical online learning framework for VM in evolving wafer-processing environments. GRAPE integrates a stable global predictor based on interpretable representations with two lightweight streaming adapters that correct feature-level and environment-level shifts through online updates. Experiments on two real-world semiconductor manufacturing datasets, including chronologically held-out blind-test streams, show that GRAPE improves robustness and generalization under real temporal drift compared with both conventional batch-learning methods and existing online learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRAPE——面向演化晶圆制程环境的在线学习虚拟量测框架，通过稳定全局预测器与两个轻量流式适配器分别校正特征级与环境级漂移，在真实半导体数据集的时间序列盲测上优于批处理方法和现有在线学习方法。
AI.motivation: 虚拟量测（VM）需从异构传感信号估计昂贵或滞后的量测变量。现有数据驱动模型多在批处理设定下训练并假设数据分布平稳，但实际产线因设备退化、工艺调整与维护而持续演化，导致批训练模型在时间分布漂移下难以维护。
AI.method: GRAPE包含：(1) 基于可解释表示的稳定全局预测器；(2) 两个轻量级流式适配器，通过在线更新分别纠正特征级漂移与环境级漂移。
AI.result: 在两个真实半导体制造数据集（含按时间划分的留出盲测流）上，GRAPE在真实时间漂移下相比传统批处理方法和现有在线学习基线，鲁棒性与泛化性更优。
AI.conclusion: 在演化制程环境中，采用"稳定全局模型+轻量在线适配"的策略可有效应对时间分布漂移，为VM的长期可维护部署提供实用方案。

title: Revisiting LLM Homogeneity Through a Multidimensional Lens
summary: Concerns about LLM homogeneity are typically quantified with embedding similarity, which reduces two texts to a single score. We revisit homogeneity with 25 interpretable metrics spanning five dimensions: semantic, lexical, syntactic, structural, and stylistic & presentational. A human study shows that perceived similarity depends on both content (what responses say) and form (how they say it), yet embedding similarity correlates less with human meaning judgments than sentence-level matching ($ρ=0.417$ vs. $0.606$) and not significantly with form judgments ($ρ=0.140$). Across 18 contemporary LLMs, models say similar things in different words: they share global semantics and broad linguistic profiles but remain distinct in lexical characteristics, structural patterns, and interactional conventions. Across releases from 2024 to 2026, models become more like themselves but not more like one another: among significantly changing metrics, intra-model distances decrease for 17 of 22, and inter-model distances increase for 14 of 21. Across two post-training pipelines, model-specific conventions emerge during SFT and are selectively reshaped by preference optimization. These results suggest that homogeneity is multidimensional and evolving, and that embedding similarity alone can overstate cross-model homogeneity while concealing diverging intra- and inter-model trends.

AI.tldr: 用25个可解释指标从五个维度重新量化LLM同质性，发现模型"内容相似、形式各异"，且随版本迭代更"像自己"而非更像彼此。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM同质性研究通常用embedding相似度把两段文本压缩成单一分数，既难以对应人类对"相似"的多维感知，也可能掩盖模型间与模型内的差异化趋势，因此需要更细粒度、可解释的度量体系。
AI.method: 构建涵盖语义、词汇、句法、结构、风格与呈现五个维度的25个可解释指标；开展人类评估，比较embedding相似度与句级匹配对人类"内容/形式"判断的相关性；在18个当代LLM及2024–2026多个版本上分析模型内/间距离变化；并追踪两条后训练流程（SFT与偏好优化）中各模型特有惯例的形成。
AI.result: 人类感知相似性同时依赖内容与形式；embedding相似度对人类意义判断的相关性低于句级匹配（ρ=0.417 vs 0.606），对形式判断相关性不显著（ρ=0.140）。18个模型共享全局语义与总体语言画像，但在词汇特征、结构模式和交互惯例上仍彼此不同。在显著变化的指标中，模型内距离在22项里有17项下降，模型间距离在21项里有14项上升。模型特有惯例在SFT阶段出现，并被偏好优化选择性重塑。
AI.conclusion: 同质性是多维且动态演化的；仅用embedding相似度会高估跨模型同质性，并掩盖模型内收敛与模型间分化的相反趋势，应采用多维度可解释指标进行更全面的评估。

title: Predicting Cognitive Profiles from Structural MRI using Spatial Graph Representation Learning
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. This work has been submitted to the Elsevier Array for possible publication
summary: Predicting cognitive abilities from structural neuroimaging remains challenging due to the high dimensionality and geometric complexity of brain morphology. Conventional models typically flatten regional morphometry into tabular features, failing to explicitly represent spatial relationships. We propose a Spatial-Topological Graph Neural Network (ST-GNN) to predict four distinct cognitive phenotypes across large pediatric cohorts (N = 2,378 to 2,424). By projecting regional morphometry onto a population-level standardized spatial graph, ST-GNN restricts message passing to defined neighboring regions. Evaluations demonstrate that ST-GNN effectively fuses spatial morphology with systemic covariates, outperforming linear baselines and topology-free deep models. Ablations reveal that imposing a sparse geometric topology (K-nearest neighbors) and utilizing global feature scaling - which preserves absolute morphometric scale - outperform fully connected networks and region-normalized approaches. These choices provide transferable architectural inductive biases, revealing differences between computational routing and morphometric feature attribution. Integrated Gradients analysis identified distinct morphological features consistent with neuroanatomical evidence, such as cerebellar volume for working memory and superior frontal surface area for executive function. These findings suggest standardized structural MRI provides useful information for task-specific cognitive prediction, establishing a foundation for MRI-based neurodevelopmental assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出空间-拓扑图神经网络（ST-GNN），将区域形态学投影到群体标准化空间图上，限定消息传递于相邻脑区，用于预测四种认知表型，优于线性基线与无拓扑深度模型。
AI.motivation: 结构神经影像预测认知能力面临脑形态高维与几何复杂的挑战；传统方法把区域形态学展平为表格特征，无法显式表达空间关系。
AI.method: ST-GNN：将区域形态学投影到群体级标准化空间图，使消息传递仅在定义好的相邻区域间进行；并融合空间形态与系统性协变量。消融考察稀疏几何拓扑（KNN）、全局特征缩放（保留绝对形态尺度）与全连接/区域归一化的对比，并用Integrated Gradients做特征归因。
AI.result: 在大型儿童队列（N=2,378–2,424）上预测四种认知表型，ST-GNN优于线性基线与无拓扑深度模型；稀疏KNN拓扑与全局尺度缩放优于全连接和区域归一化；归因揭示与神经解剖证据一致的特征（工作记忆—小脑体积，执行功能—上额叶表面积）。
AI.conclusion: 标准化结构MRI可为任务特异的认知预测提供有效信息，ST-GNN的架构归纳偏置具可迁移性，为基于MRI的神经发育评估奠定基础。

title: Benchmarking Machine-Learning Classifiers for Neoantigen Immunogenicity Prediction and the Limits of SHAP Interpretability
summary:
Personalized cancer vaccines require prioritizing, among hundreds of candidate mutant peptides, the few that will induce a T-cell response. This study asks what general-purpose machine learning achieves on that task, and whether the features such models identify as important can be trusted.
  We make three contributions. The first is a benchmark of sixty models: twelve supervised classifier families, each in five configurations, evaluated on the Immunogenic Tumor Specific Neoantigen database (ITSNdb; 199 experimentally validated neoantigens, 129 immunogenic and 70 non-immunogenic). All sixty are compared under one stratified k-fold cross-validation protocol, in which the data used to choose a configuration are never the data used to score it. The second is an interpretability study that combines SHAP with feature ablation. The third is a shuffled-label control that tests whether a SHAP value has been earned.
  Two results follow, and both run against current practice. First, the classical linear models lead the ranking. The gradient-boosted ensembles and neural networks that dominate recent work bring no advantage. Second, SHAP can fail on high-cardinality categorical features. Ablation establishes the presenting HLA allele as the dominant input and the source gene as dispensable. SHAP reports the opposite, assigning 68.7% to 81.7% of its total value to the source gene in every model that gives each gene its own weight. Shuffling the gene labels at random among the peptides resolves the contradiction: the meaningless column earns the same SHAP value as the real one. That value measures only that ITSNdb contains 173 genes for 199 peptides. We therefore recommend that SHAP values for high-cardinality categorical annotations in cohorts of this size always be reported against such a shuffled-label control, and we describe one in full.

AI.tldr: 本文基准测试60个机器学习模型用于新抗原免疫原性预测，发现经典线性模型最优，且SHAP对高基数类别特征（源基因）会产生虚假重要性，需用标签打乱对照验证。
AI.motivation: 个性化癌症疫苗需从数百候选突变肽中筛选少数能引发T细胞响应的肽，作者想检验通用机器学习在该任务上的真实表现，并判断模型识别出的重要特征是否可信。
AI.method: 构建60个模型（12类监督分类器×5种配置）的基准，在ITSNdb（199个验证新抗原，129免疫原性/70非免疫原性）上采用统一分层k折交叉验证（选配置与评分数据分离）；结合SHAP与特征消融做可解释性研究；并设计标签打乱对照检验SHAP值是否"名副其实"。
AI.result: 经典线性模型排名领先，梯度提升集成和神经网络无优势；消融显示呈递HLA等位基因是主导输入、源基因可弃，而SHAP却相反，在每种逐基因加权模型中将68.7%–81.7%总值归于源基因；随机打乱基因标签后，无意义列获得与真实列相同的SHAP值——该值仅反映ITSNdb中199个肽对应173个基因这一事实。
AI.conclusion: 通用ML在该任务上并不需要复杂模型；SHAP在高基数类别注释、小样本队列中会失效，建议此类SHAP值必须对照标签打乱控制报告，并给出了完整实施方案。

title: HamFormer: A Hamiltonian Flow-based SE(3)-Transformer for Conformation Optimization
summary: The Transformer architecture plays a central role in modern deep learning, and its SE(3)-equivariant variants have been widely applied to molecular conformation modeling and optimization. Given its importance, many methods attempt to interpret and improve the Transformer through the lens of dynamics. However, they mainly focus on a single attention head rather than the full Transformer architecture and seldom consider SE(3)-equivariance in their proposed models. In this study, we propose an improved SE(3)-Transformer architecture, called HamFormer, which revisits the design of SE(3)-Transformer through the lens of Hamiltonian flow. In particular, we define a parametrized Hamiltonian flow in the phase space of position and velocity, corresponding to optimizing an energy functional that combines an optimal transport-based potential with a damped momentum. The Lie-Trotter splitting framework of the Hamiltonian flow leads to the proposed HamFormer architecture, whose feedforward computation achieves the optimization step of the proposed energy functional. Furthermore, we combine HamFormer with Equivariant Graph Neural Network (EGNN), build a new model for molecular conformation optimization. Extensive experiments on molecular ground-state conformation prediction show that HamFormer provides a strong and physically interpretable surrogate for classic SE(3)-Transformer and generally outperforms state-of-the-art competitors.

AI.tldr: HamFormer：从哈密顿流视角重新设计SE(3)-Transformer，将前馈计算解释为带阻尼动量的最优传输能量泛函优化步骤，并与EGNN结合用于分子构象优化，在基态构象预测上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有通过动力学视角解释和改进Transformer的工作主要关注单个注意力头，而非完整Transformer架构，且很少考虑SE(3)等变性，因此需要更完整的、兼具等变性的动力学解释框架。
AI.method: 在位置-速度相空间中定义参数化哈密顿流，对应优化一个由最优传输势能与阻尼动量组成的能量泛函；利用Lie-Trotter分裂框架推导出HamFormer架构，使前馈计算等价于该能量泛函的优化步；再将HamFormer与EGNN结合构建分子构象优化新模型。
AI.result: 在分子基态构象预测任务上，HamFormer 作为经典SE(3)-Transformer的强替代模型且具备物理可解释性，总体优于当前最优竞争者。
AI.conclusion: 哈密顿流视角为SE(3)-Transformer提供了有物理意义的理论解释与改进路径，HamFormer是有效的等变架构，可成功应用于分子构象优化。

title: Can Large Language Models Extend Their Agentic Capabilities to Goal Pursuit in Open-Ended Multi-Turn Interaction?
summary: Goal pursuit in open-ended dialogue requires agents to adapt their actions to interaction feedback across successive exchanges. We investigate whether agentic capabilities developed for multi-step tool use carry over to dialogue organized through the model's native tool interface, and how this changes interaction behavior. We define Tool-Mediated Interaction (TMI) as a training-free protocol that represents dialogue actions as tool calls and counterpart responses as tool results, maintaining a continuous reasoning-action-observation loop with retained reasoning and interaction history. We evaluate TMI across social interaction, emotional support, persuasion, and price negotiation using two models and 15,678 main-experiment episodes. Across both models, TMI improves social goal attainment, emotional-support preference, donation amounts, and buyer negotiation margins over conversational baselines with and without thinking. A Qwen ablation further shows that TMI outperforms ordinary conversation with retained reasoning on all four primary outcomes. Behavioral analyses associate the improvements with task-specific patterns in initial proposals and responses to interaction feedback. Alongside these gains, TMI reduces mean reasoning tokens per decision by 42.0-81.5% relative to the thinking baseline and lowers mean cross-turn phrase reuse across all eight model-environment pairs. These findings show that interaction organization shapes both goal attainment and reasoning across dialogue turns.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Tool-Mediated Interaction (TMI)，一种免训练协议，将对话动作表示为工具调用、对方回应表示为工具结果，形成持续推理-行动-观察循环。在社交、情感支持、说服、价格谈判四类任务、两个模型、15678个主实验回合上，TMI相比对话基线提升了目标达成、情感支持偏好、捐款金额与买方谈判收益，同时将每次决策的推理token减少42.0-81.5%。
AI.motivation: 开放式对话中的目标追求需要智能体根据交互反馈不断调整行动。作者想探究：为多步工具使用而发展出的agentic能力能否迁移到通过模型原生工具接口组织的对话中，以及这种组织方式如何改变交互行为。
AI.method: 提出TMI训练无关协议：将对话动作编码为工具调用、对方回应编码为工具结果，维持保留推理与交互历史的连续推理-行动-观察循环。评测涵盖社交互动、情感支持、说服、价格谈判四个场景，使用两个模型、共15678个主实验回合，并与有/无thinking的对话基线对比，另做Qwen消融实验。
AI.result: 两个模型上TMI在社交目标达成、情感支持偏好、捐款金额、买方谈判利润上均优于对话基线。Qwen消融显示TMI在四项主要结果上均优于保留推理的普通对话。相比thinking基线，TMI将每次决策平均推理token降低42.0-81.5%，并在全部八个模型-环境组合中降低跨轮短语复用率。行为分析将提升归因于初始提案与对交互反馈回应的任务特定模式。
AI.conclusion: 对话的交互组织方式（TMI）同时影响目标达成与跨轮推理，表明应为多步工具使用训练的agentic能力可有效迁移至对话场景，并带来效率提升。

title: Brain-Behavior Modeling from Multimodal MRI using Opportunistic Pretraining and Common-Cohort Adaptation
comment: 39 pages, 4 figures. This work has been submitted to the Elsevier NeuroImage for possible publication
summary: Incomplete imaging coverage limits sample sizes for multimodal cognitive prediction. We evaluated a two-stage opportunistic deep ensemble using baseline Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study data to predict fluid, crystallized, and total cognition. Separate neural models processed structural/diffusion, resting-state, and task-based MRI data with covariates. Models were pretrained on eligible modality cohorts (up to 9,686 participants), adapted to common training cohorts, and fused via Ridge regression (trimodal cohort: 4,216 participants). Five-fold family-aware cross-validation compared this approach against constituent and covariate-only models. Two-stage training increased mean test coefficient of determination (R^2) in 24 of 27 comparisons (median gain: 0.0081). Fusion increased mean R^2 by 0.0051-0.0333 over the strongest constituent and reduced mean absolute error by 0.0067-0.0976. Task-plus-resting-state and trimodal ensembles reduced absolute error across all targets (nominal p <= 0.0108). Task-plus-resting-state fusion achieved the highest mean R^2 for fluid (0.2222) and total cognition (0.3665), while structural-plus-resting-state led for crystallized cognition (0.3706), yielding R^2 gains of 0.0805, 0.1180, and 0.0890 over covariate-only references. Ablations showed expanded pretraining drove most improvements. Gradient-based attribution identified target-dependent input patterns. These findings support using partially observed cohorts for model development to achieve modest fusion gains. Pending external validation, this approach may support MRI-informed cognitive phenotyping.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用ABCD基线数据，提出两阶段机会性深度集成框架，在多模态MRI部分缺失的情况下预测流体、晶体和总体认知，融合可稳定带来小幅性能提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态认知预测常受影像覆盖不全限制，导致可用样本量小；作者希望利用"部分观测"队列扩大训练数据规模。
AI.method: 分别对结构/弥散、静息态、任务态MRI训练独立神经网络（含协变量），先在各自可用模态的大队列（最多9,686人）上预训练，再适配到共同训练队列，最后用Ridge回归融合（三模态队列4,216人）；采用五折家庭感知交叉验证，并与单模态及仅协变量模型对比，辅以消融和梯度归因。
AI.result: 两阶段训练在27项比较中24项提升平均测试R²（中位增益0.0081）；融合比最强单模态R²提升0.0051–0.0333，MAE降低0.0067–0.0976。任务态+静息态融合在流体（R²=0.2222）与总体认知（0.3665）最优，结构+静息态在晶体认知最优（0.3706），较仅协变量基线分别提升0.0805、0.1180、0.0890。消融显示扩大预训练贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 部分观测队列可用于模型开发并带来适度融合增益；该方法有望支持MRI辅助的认知表型刻画，但仍需外部验证。

title: Pulse: Long-Horizon Tasks Need Streaming Personalization
summary: Large language model agents increasingly undertake complex, long-horizon tasks that benefit from sustained personalized support through long-term memory. Existing memory-augmented methods retrieve and use memory primarily from the initial request, with limited awareness of ongoing execution and emerging personalization needs. Agents may therefore overlook user preferences and project constraints during multistep tasks. We propose Pulse, a streaming personalization method for long-horizon tasks. An independent, lightweight memory agent continuously monitors execution, identifies emerging personalization needs and potential preference conflicts, and uses user and project memories to provide targeted interventions at appropriate stages. Reinforcement learning optimizes when and how the memory agent intervenes, improving the timeliness and accuracy of personalized support. Pulse scores 71.9% on $π$-Bench and 46.4% on MCP-Persona, achieving the highest overall scores among the compared methods on both datasets while improving task execution efficiency.

AI.tldr: Pulse：一种面向长时程任务的流式个性化方法，独立的轻量记忆智能体在任务执行中持续监控并按需介入，结合强化学习优化介入时机与方式。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强方法主要在初始请求时检索和使用记忆，缺乏对执行过程和新出现的个性化需求的感知，导致多步任务中容易忽略用户偏好与项目约束。
AI.method: 提出 Pulse，用一个独立轻量记忆智能体持续监控执行，识别新出现的个性化需求与潜在偏好冲突，并利用用户和项目记忆在合适阶段进行针对性介入；用强化学习优化介入的时机与方式。
AI.result: 在 π-Bench 上得分 71.9%，在 MCP-Persona 上得分 46.4%，两数据集总体得分均为对比方法中最高，同时提升了任务执行效率。
AI.conclusion: 流式、执行感知的个性化记忆介入能有效弥补初始检索式记忆的不足，提升长时程任务的个性化支持质量与效率。

title: Foresight: Learning Twisted SMC for Rare Events from Reversed Relaxations
summary: We consider the probability that a reversible Markov chain started in a set $A$ is in a rare set $B$ after a fixed horizon, a quantity often needed for many start laws, down to single states. Twisted sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) estimates such probabilities without bias, with small variance when its proposal and twist approximate the dynamics conditioned on reaching $B$, but these components are usually learned from forward simulations, which contain almost no successful paths when the event is rare. We introduce Foresight-SMC, which learns both components from the target side: under reversibility, relaxations started in $B$ that return to $A$ are, read backwards, exact samples of the conditioned paths, and their number is governed by the return probability rather than by the rare probability. Extending this reversal to the recorded propose--accept decisions of a Metropolis-adjusted sampler, we fit a controlled Langevin proposal with exact likelihood ratios by maximum likelihood, together with a classifier twist; the resulting estimator is unbiased for any start law. A variance analysis shows that resampling reduces the variance when the importance weights degenerate, as they do over long horizons. On an Allen--Cahn field, the learned proposal alone suffices, and one trained model is more accurate than splitting at equal cost. On alanine tripeptide, resampling with the learned twist is necessary, and Foresight-SMC needs less computation per query than adaptive multilevel splitting on localized start sets.

AI.tldr: 提出 Foresight-SMC：利用可逆性从目标侧（B 集）反向学习 twist 和 proposal，构造无偏估计器，用于估计马尔可夫链从 A 集出发在固定时域抵达稀有集 B 的概率。
AI.motivation: 估计 P_A(τ_B ≤ n) 这类稀有事件概率时，twisted SMC 需要 proposal 和 twist 近似"条件于到达 B 的路径"，但常规前向模拟在稀有事件下几乎不产生成功路径，导致无法学习这些组件。
AI.method: 在可逆性假设下从 B 出发做松弛采样，反向读取即条件路径的精确样本，其数量由返回概率而非稀有概率控制。进一步将该反向思想扩展到 Metropolis 校正采样器的 propose–accept 记录上，用极大似然拟合带精确似然比的受控 Langevin proposal，并训练分类器 twist，得到对任意起始分布均无偏的估计器；同时进行方差分析（重采样在权重退化时的作用）。
AI.result: Allen–Cahn 场上仅用学到的 proposal 即可，同等计算量下单个训练模型的精度优于 splitting；alanine tripeptide 上必须结合学到的 twist 做重采样，且在局部化起始集上每查询计算量少于自适应多层 splitting。
AI.conclusion: 从目标侧学习 twist 与 proposal 是学习稀有事件 SMC 组件的有效途径，Foresight-SMC 在多个高维分子/场系统上优于 splitting 类方法。

title: Halal-NeSyNet: Clause-Scoped Neuro-Symbolic Cross-Attention for Automated Food Ingredient Auditing and Risk-Aware Halal Logistics Triage
summary: Verifying that a packaged food is Halal requires reading ingredient declarations and E-number additives before goods enter certified warehouses. Dual-origin additives such as E471, E422, E441 and E920 are Mushbooh (doubtful) unless a botanical, microbial or certified-Halal qualifier appears in the same ingredient clause, so a plant-based qualifier on one clause must not clear an unqualified additive in another. We call a failure to respect this scope cross-clause modifier confounding and build a benchmark of 3,199 items (277 Open Food Facts records and 2,922 template-generated clause-swap items, labelled by an explicit 50-code rule base rather than by a certification authority) with a 540-item counterfactual suite. We propose Halal-NeSyNet, which couples a DistilBERT encoder with a 16-dimensional rule-derived symbolic vector through cross-attention and gated fusion, trained with an asymmetric false-Halal risk loss. Over five seeds, text-only TF-IDF baselines reach 86.25-86.71 % accuracy with 13.42-21.73 % false-Halal leakage and 6.33-26.00 % counterfactual triad consistency, whereas Halal-NeSyNet reaches 97.04+/-0.34 % and 99.67+/-0.50 %. Gradient boosting given the same symbolic vector reaches 96.25+/-1.24 % (+0.59 points from Halal-NeSyNet, 95 % CI [-1.11, +2.28]), so most of the gain comes from clause-scoped symbolic features and not from the network, and the risk loss did not help. Holding out whole template families, text-only models fall to 61.91-78.35 %, Halal-NeSyNet to 90.87+/-11.76 % and logistic regression with the symbolic vector to 91.11+/-2.88 %, with far more spread for Halal-NeSyNet. A three-lane receiving simulation auto-clears 49.33 % of cargo at 0.76 % green-lane contamination. Because labels and features come from one rule engine and 91.3 % of the items are templated, the results measure fidelity to a rule policy, not religious certification.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"跨子句修饰语混淆"问题，构建3,199项清真认证基准（含540项反事实测试集），并提出Halal-NeSyNet（DistilBERT+16维规则符号向量+交叉注意力门控融合+非对称假清真风险损失）。结果显示主要增益来自子句范围的符号特征而非网络结构本身。
AI.motivation: 包装食品的清真核验依赖阅读配料表与E编码添加剂。E471、E422、E441、E920等双重来源添加剂在缺少植物、微生物或认证清真限定词时属于Mushbooh（存疑）。一个子句中的植物性限定词不应"清除"另一子句中无限定词的添加剂——现有方法（及纯文本模型）未能尊重这一子句范围，作者将其定义为"跨子句修饰语混淆"（cross-clause modifier confounding）。
AI.method: 1）构建基准：3,199项（277条Open Food Facts真实记录 + 2,922条模板生成的子句交换项），标签由50条规则的显式规则库给出而非认证机构；另设540项反事实测试套件。2）模型Halal-NeSyNet：DistilBERT编码器 + 16维规则导出符号向量，经交叉注意力与门控融合，并用非对称假清真风险损失训练。3）对比：TF-IDF文本基线、给定同款符号向量的梯度提升/逻辑回归、留出整个模板族的分布外测试、以及三通道收货模拟。
AI.result: 五种子平均：纯文本TF-IDF基线准确率86.25–86.71%，假清真泄漏13.42–21.73%，反事实三元组一致性仅6.33–26.00%；Halal-NeSyNet达97.04±0.34%，一致性99.67±0.50%。梯度提升（同符号向量）96.25±1.24%，仅低0.59点（95% CI [-1.11, +2.28]），说明增益主要来自子句范围的符号特征而非网络，且风险损失无帮助。留出整族模板时，纯文本降至61.91–78.35%，Halal-NeSyNet 90.87±11.76%，符号向量+逻辑回归91.11±2.88%（Halal-NeSyNet波动更大）。收货模拟中绿通道自动放行49.33%货物，绿通道污染率0.76%。
AI.conclusion: 子句范围的符号规则特征是性能提升的核心，复杂融合网络与风险损失贡献有限，且分布外泛化不稳。由于标签与特征同源于一套规则引擎且91.3%样本为模板生成，结果衡量的是对规则策略的保真度（fidelity），而非宗教意义上的清真认证有效性。

title: DTP-OPSD: Reinforcement Learning with Distractor-Aware Temporal-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation for Temporal Video Grounding
summary: Temporal Video Grounding (TVG) aims to localize the start and end times of an event described by a language query in a video. The task becomes particularly challenging when the same video contains multiple repeated, similar, or opposite events. On these hard examples, all responses sampled by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) may miss the target and receive zero temporal Intersection-over-Union (tIoU). Their group-relative advantages are then all zero, leaving no useful policy gradient signal. To address this, we propose DTP-OPSD, a reinforcement learning framework with distractor-aware temporal-privilege on-policy self-distillation. The student observes the clean video and generates responses on-policy, while a shared-weight teacher observes a privileged video in which the target window is marked by red full-frame borders and same-video distractor windows by blue full-frame borders. For the distillation loss, the teacher evaluates student-generated prefixes and provides dense token-level Jensen-Shannon divergence supervision. This supervision remains informative even when GRPO provides no policy gradient signal. We suppress distillation when the teacher does not outperform the student and strengthen it for groups where the teacher performs better but all student rollouts receive zero tIoU. We also construct a compact hard-interference training set through VLM screening and human verification. With only 300 additional post-training examples, DTP-OPSD achieves the highest mIoU among the compared open-source 8B models on Charades-TimeLens, ActivityNet-TimeLens, and QVHighlights-TimeLens, reaching 55.93, 54.77, and 66.71, respectively. Compared with Pure GRPO trained on the same data, DTP-OPSD improves all 12 reported metrics, with R1@0.7 gains of 1.28, 1.62, and 1.78 points on the three benchmarks. Code will be released at https://github.com/nian1125/DTP-OPSD

AI.tldr: 提出DTP-OPSD强化学习框架，用干扰感知的时序特权在线自蒸馏解决GRPO在难样本上优势全零无梯度的问题，仅300条后训练样本即在三个时序视频定位基准上取得开源8B模型最佳mIoU。
AI.motivation: 时序视频定位中，同一视频常含重复、相似或相反事件，属难样本。此时GRPO采样的所有回复都可能错过目标、tIoU为0，组内相对优势全为0，导致策略梯度信号缺失，训练停滞。
AI.method: 提出DTP-OPSD：学生看干净视频并在线生成回复；共享权重教师看特权视频，目标窗口用红色全帧边框标注、同视频干扰窗口用蓝色边框标注，从而具备干扰感知能力。蒸馏损失上，教师对学生的生成前缀打分，提供稠密的token级Jensen-Shannon散度监督；当教师不优于学生时抑制蒸馏，当教师更优但学生全部rollout为0 tIoU时加强蒸馏。此外通过VLM筛选与人工核验构建紧凑的难干扰训练集。
AI.result: 仅增加300条后训练样本，在Charades-TimeLens、ActivityNet-TimeLens、QVHighlights-TimeLens上mIoU分别达55.93、54.77、66.71，为对比开源8B模型中最高。相比同数据训练的Pure GRPO，DTP-OPSD提升全部12项指标，R1@0.7三基准分别提升1.28、1.62、1.78。
AI.conclusion: 利用教师对特权干扰信息的观察提供稠密token级蒸馏信号，可在GRPO零优势难样本上补足监督；配合小规模精选难干扰数据，能稳定提升TVG性能，且全面优于纯GRPO。

title: GURU: A Hierarchical Neuro-Symbolic Multi-Agent System for Verification-Aware Automation of Mission-Critical Digital Engineering and Operations
summary: An AI can find a safe action faster than any human, but it must never decide what counts as safe. We present GURU, a hierarchical neuro-symbolic multi-agent system for mission-critical digital engineering and operations, built on one partition of authority: learned models propose, rank, and accelerate; a symbolic rules engine checks every consequential action against hard limits before it executes; and validated physics confirms and decides. GURU runs a workflow as a closed control loop, with Navigation, Action, and Planning agents sharing one Common Internal Language and one training factory. Nuclear, aviation, and national-security guidance now requires this pattern; a harnessed language model keeps the model at the center, GURU puts a validated reference there. In computational fluid dynamics, the workflow raised the converged-simulation rate on unseen aircraft geometries from under 1 percent to 74 percent over 100 single-attempt cases, ran 54 live cases to Mach 6 on three facilities, and an ablation put the symbolic layer at 13 points of boundary-layer capture. Knowledge-graph retrieval and role adapters raised ParaView control success from 55 to 75 percent. In space domain awareness, where a language model cannot be trusted to decide, a frozen self-supervised world model under validated propagation scored highest of five methods at conjunction risk, including fully fine-tuned language models, with several-times-lower seed variance: the trustworthy design gives up nothing in accuracy, and the recipe transferred to reactor anomaly detection. A radar-to-avoidance debris pipeline was demonstrated in stages on a 2026 reentry; the hierarchy coordinates simulated teams of 200 aircraft. Training scaled near-linearly past 1,000 Aurora nodes and ran at 8,000. The approach extends to a control-grade microreactor digital twin with validated physics, not a learned model, as the safety basis.

title: Benchmarking Classical Machine Learning Models for Shading-Fault Detection in Rooftop Photovoltaic Systems Using Real Sensor Data
summary: Most published comparisons of machine-learning classifiers for photovoltaic (PV) fault detection are validated on simulated faults. We compare seven classical and ensemble-tree classifiers on the Réunion dataset, a 4 kW domestic rooftop plant on which shading faults were physically staged and logged. Readings within a staged episode are near-duplicates, so every train/test split is grouped by episode. A 20,800-row subsample that retains all 17 fault episodes was evaluated with three repeats of five-fold group-aware nested cross-validation, with synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE) applied inside the training folds. Random Forest and XGBoost gave the highest mean accuracy (0.838 and 0.831) and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC; 0.526 and 0.522). After Holm correction across the 21 pairwise Wilcoxon tests, only Random Forest's accuracy advantage over k-nearest neighbours and the multi-layer perceptron remained significant. Logistic Regression and the Decision Tree (accuracy 0.820) could be separated neither from the ensembles nor from the weakest models. SMOTE lowered binary MCC for six of the seven classifiers. Errors were concentrated in whole episodes: the Random Forest almost entirely missed four of the 17 fault episodes, including one of two uniform-shading and two of five intermittent-shading episodes. A post-hoc diagnostic shows that the no-fault rows were sampled over a wider range of times of day and output levels than the fault rows. Clock time alone reaches an MCC of 0.44, and PV-side voltage alone 0.72. The reported scores therefore reflect operating-condition differences as well as shading signatures. We release the pipeline and the diagnostics, and identify matched no-fault sampling as the step needed before the classifier ranking can be generalised.

AI.tldr: 在留尼汪岛4 kW屋顶光伏电站的物理遮挡故障数据上，以按故障事件分组的嵌套交叉验证比较七种分类器，随机森林与XGBoost平均准确率最高（0.838/0.831），但事后诊断表明无故障行与故障行的工作条件分布不匹配，所得排名尚不能推广。
AI.motivation: 已发表的光伏故障检测分类器比较大多基于仿真故障，缺乏物理实采故障数据上的可靠评估；本文旨在真实遮挡故障数据上给出更严谨的分类器比较，并检验评估本身的有效性。
AI.method: 在Réunion数据集（4 kW户用屋顶电站，遮挡故障经物理设置并记录）上比较7种经典与集成树分类器。因同一故障事件内的读数近似重复，所有训练/测试划分按事件分组；取保留全部17个故障事件的20,800行子样本，采用5折分组感知嵌套交叉验证重复3次，SMOTE仅在训练折内应用；统计检验为21组两两Wilcoxon检验并作Holm校正；另做事后诊断（分别用钟点时间、直流侧电压单独建模）。
AI.result: 随机森林与XGBoost平均准确率最高（0.838、0.831），MCC分别为0.526、0.522；Holm校正后仅随机森林相对kNN与MLP的准确率优势显著。逻辑回归与决策树（0.820）既不能与集成模型区分，也不能与最弱模型区分。SMOTE使7个分类器中有6个的二分类MCC下降。错误集中于整段事件：随机森林几乎完全漏掉17个故障事件中的4个（含2个均匀遮挡中的1个、5个间歇遮挡中的2个）。事后诊断显示无故障行在时刻与输出水平上的采样范围比故障行更宽，仅用钟点时间MCC即达0.44，仅用光伏侧电压达0.72。
AI.conclusion: 报告的分数既反映遮挡特征也反映工作条件差异，分类器排名无法直接推广；作者发布流程与诊断代码，并指出匹配采样的无故障数据是推广排名的前提。

title: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
summary: Anticipating financial outcomes requires synthesizing evolving evidence and reasoning under uncertainty, making deep research systems promising tools for forecasting. Yet evaluating forecasting ability is challenging because historical backtests may reward memorized outcomes or information retrieved after the forecast date. Live forecasting avoids direct access to realized outcomes, but feedback arrives only after events resolve. To obtain timely feedback and assess historical scores, we introduce FinForesight, a diagnostic backtesting benchmark for financial deep research systems. Across the Chinese, U.S., and Hong Kong markets, the benchmark evaluates four forecasting tasks: valuation, return ranking, event direction, and future financial fundamentals. Two capability diagnostic tasks assess counterfactual reasoning and financial calculation, scored separately from forecasting performance. Our harness-compatible framework restricts retrieved evidence to information available at the forecast date. We compare pretraining-era, resolved post-cutoff, and live evaluations to test whether controlled backtests approximate future performance. Pretraining-era scores exceed post-cutoff scores in most temporal comparisons, and stronger retrieval controls narrow the gap between post-cutoff backtests and live results. Forecasting attribution and robustness analyses reveal how scores respond to retrieval policy and how predictions respond to prompt rewrites and numerical perturbations. The code and benchmark data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinForesight，一个用于金融深度研究系统的诊断性回溯测试基准，可在中、美、港三地市场评估估值、收益排序、事件方向、未来财务基本面四类预测任务，并通过限制检索证据到预测日可用信息、对比预训练期/后截止期/实时三种评估，检验受控回溯能否近似未来表现。
AI.motivation: 金融预测需综合演进证据并在不确定下推理，深度研究系统因而有望用于预测。但评估预测能力困难：历史回溯可能奖励记忆化的结果或检索到预测日之后的信息；实时预测虽避免直接接触已实现结果，但反馈只有在事件揭晓后才能获得。因此需要能及时反馈、且可评估历史得分的受控诊断性回溯基准。
AI.method: 构建FinForesight基准：覆盖中国、美国、香港市场，设四类预测任务（估值、收益排序、事件方向、未来财务基本面），另设两个能力诊断任务（反事实推理、金融计算，与预测性能分开计分）。框架与harness兼容，严格将检索证据限制为预测日时可得信息；对预训练期内、已解析的后截止期、实时评估三类设置进行比较。
AI.result: 多数时间对比中，预训练期得分高于后截止期得分；更强的检索控制可缩小后截止期回溯与实时结果之间的差距。归因与鲁棒性分析揭示了得分如何随检索策略变化，以及预测如何随提示重写和数值扰动而变化。
AI.conclusion: 受控回溯本身存在高估风险（预训练期分数偏高），更严格的检索控制能提升回溯对未来表现的近似度；基准与代码公开，可用于诊断和改进金融深度研究系统的预测与推理能力。

title: CDBM: Complexity-Diversity Framework for Building Morphology Analysis
summary: We introduce Complexity-Diversity Building Metrics (CDBM), twelve interpretable descriptors for building massings represented as vertical extrusions. They measure how strongly geometric detail is expressed (complexity) and how unevenly it varies across one- and two-dimensional elements (diversity). Computed for 482,241,306 OpenStreetMap buildings and compared with 3D Building Metrics (3DBM) and the LION shape latent on task-specific samples, CDBM is tested on function, region, contextual relevance, real-generated discrimination, human preference and geometry-conditioned generation. With gradient boosting, CDBM best separates generated from mapped massings and best matches human preference; with logistic regression it matches 3DBM on realism. 3DBM leads on the other three tasks. As generation targets, the descriptors show that models struggle to produce strongly expressed and heterogeneous forms. CDBM complements existing indicators.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CDBM（Complexity-Diversity Building Metrics），12个可解释的描述子，用于刻画垂直拉伸建筑体量的复杂度与多样性；在4.8亿OSM建筑上计算并与3DBM及LION形状隐变量对比，在功能、区域、情境相关性、真假判别、人类偏好与几何条件生成等任务上评估。
AI.motivation: 现有建筑体量指标（如3DBM、形状隐变量）不足以刻画几何细节表达强弱及其在一维/二维元素上分布的不均匀性，且缺乏可解释性，难以为生成模型提供有效诊断。
AI.method: 构建12个可解释描述子，分别度量复杂度（几何细节表达强度）与多样性（在一维和二维元素间变化的不均匀程度）；在482,241,306个OpenStreetMap建筑的垂直拉伸体量上计算；与3DBM和LION形状隐变量在任务特定样本上对比，采用梯度提升与逻辑回归，测试六类任务。
AI.result: 梯度提升下CDBM在区分生成体量与真实测绘体量、拟合人类偏好上表现最佳；逻辑回归下其在真实性上追平3DBM；3DBM在另外三项任务上领先。作为生成目标时，描述子显示模型难以生成表达强烈且异质的形态。
AI.conclusion: CDBM是对现有指标的补充而非替代，可与3DBM等互补使用；其可解释性有助于诊断生成模型在复杂性与多样性上的不足。

title: Leap-VLA: High-Rate Robot Control from a Low-Rate VLM Backbone
comment: 21 pages, 14 figures. Corresponding author: Lin Yang
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models re-encode the full observation through a multi-billion-parameter vision-language model (VLM) at every control step, even though scene semantics evolve at roughly 1 Hz while reactive control requires 20-50 Hz. We present a VLA that decouples the two: a VLM runs as a low-frequency semantic anchor whose cached context is reused across control steps, while a flow-matching action expert operates at high frequency, consuming the cached semantics with a fresh, low-latency visual stream from a compact encoder pretrained on robot video with masked reconstruction, optical flow, and depth. The measured age $τ$ of the cache conditions the expert through adaptive layer normalization. Reusing the cache makes the policy a function of its age, and training covers that function explicitly: cache ages sampled from real episode history, plus an age-ramped pixel corruption that erases the stale snapshot the way deployed staleness corrupts content. On the asynchronous deployment stack, the recipe closes most of the staleness gap: on LIBERO-Spatial, 61.4% to 95.5% at a 2 s semantic refresh (95.9% at 1 s, within 1.6 points of the frequency-matched anchor); averaged over the four LIBERO suites, the deployed policy holds 95.2% at a 1 s refresh and 94.5% at 2 s against a 96.3% matched anchor. A forward-only chunk-boundary correction (soft-nudge), an autograd-free reformulation of real-time-chunking guidance, carries per-control-step re-planning without loss (97.1%) at zero added latency. The same lens exposes a second defect: under an instruction-scene mismatch the policy keeps manipulating the scene, and a chain-of-thought verdict gate trained on zero-cost negative episodes freezes execution exactly on mismatched instructions without hurting feasible success.

AI.tldr: 提出解耦的VLA架构：低频VLM作为语义锚点复用缓存上下文，高频流匹配动作专家消费缓存语义并配合低延迟视觉流，通过缓存年龄条件的自适应层归一化与训练时年龄采样/像素腐化，显著缩小异步部署下的陈旧性差距。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA在每个控制步都用数十亿参数VLM重编码完整观测，但场景语义变化约1Hz，而反应式控制需20-50Hz，造成巨大算力浪费；同时异步部署中缓存陈旧会劣化策略，且指令-场景不匹配时策略仍会错误执行。
AI.method: VLM低频运行并复用缓存语义；紧凑编码器（机器人视频预训练，掩码重建+光流+深度）提供高频新鲜视觉流；流匹配动作专家以实测缓存年龄τ经自适应层归一化调制；训练覆盖缓存年龄函数：采样真实episode历史年龄+年龄递增的像素腐化；推理采用前向-only的soft-nudge块边界校正（无梯度的实时分块引导重构）实现零延迟重规划；另训练链式思维判定门控处理指令-场景不匹配。
AI.result: LIBERO-Spatial上2s刷新从61.4%提升到95.5%（1s为95.9%，距频率匹配锚点差1.6点）；四套LIBERO平均1s刷新95.2%、2s 94.5%，匹配锚点为96.3%；soft-nudge保持97.1%成功率且零额外延迟；指令-场景不匹配时门控可精确冻结执行且不影响可行任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过频率解耦与显式建模缓存年龄，可在异步部署下以极低算力代价接近频率匹配性能；前向式分块校正实现零延迟重规划；同一框架还能用于指令-场景不匹配的安全门控。

title: TreePIN$^{2}$: Tree-Prior Initialized Neural Networks
summary: Fitted decision trees provide predictive knowledge for neural network initialization. We present Tree-Prior Initialized Neural Networks (TreePIN$^{2}$), a method that translates split rules, decision paths and leaf predictions into initial network weights and biases for classification and regression. Sigmoid units encode split responses, hidden units combine them along decision paths, and leaf predictions initialize the output layer. We calibrate split softness using local training margins, sample support and impurity reduction, relating the initial responses to the data at each node. All weights and biases remain trainable, allowing gradient-based optimization to refine the transferred decisions and their combinations. Across six classification and six regression tasks with twenty paired seeds, TreePIN$^{2}$ improves mean initial and early validation performance over initialization baselines on most tasks. After fifty epochs, it achieves the best or tied-best mean validation performance among the six compared methods on ten tasks. Paired ablations show how split calibration and leaf-informed output initialization contribute to the starting predictor and its subsequent learning.

AI.tldr: 提出TreePIN²，把拟合决策树的划分规则、决策路径与叶子预测转译为神经网络初始权重与偏置，在分类与回归任务上取得更好的初始与早期验证性能。
AI.motivation: 拟合好的决策树蕴含可迁移的预测知识，但如何将其有效转化为神经网络初始化（而非仅作后处理或蒸馏）尚缺系统方法。
AI.method: 用Sigmoid单元编码分裂响应，隐藏单元沿决策路径组合这些响应，叶子预测初始化输出层；并利用局部训练间隔、样本支持度与不纯度下降校准分裂的"软度"。所有参数保持可训练，可用梯度优化进一步精炼所迁移的决策。
AI.result: 在6个分类与6个回归任务、20组配对种子上，多数任务的平均初始与早期验证性能优于初始化基线；训练50轮后在10个任务上取得最佳或并列最佳的平均验证性能；配对消融验证了分裂校准与叶子输出初始化的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 决策树到网络的初始化转译是可行且有效的，且与后续梯度学习良好衔接；分裂软度校准与叶子输出初始化是关键组成部分。

title: BanglishDepYT: Depression Detection in Native Bengali Social Media with Emotion-Preserving Preprocessing and Domain-Adaptive Pretraining
summary: Depression affects millions of Bengali speakers across South Asia, yet automated detection systems have relied almost entirely on datasets translated from English. Such datasets cannot capture the emoticons, romanized Bengali words, and elongated spellings that characterize real expressions of distress. We introduce BanglishDepYT, a Bengali depression dataset collected natively from YouTube, comprising 191,000 unlabeled comments and 1,000 samples verified through dual bilingual annotation. We propose EPH (Emotion-Preserving Hybrid preprocessing), which converts emoticons to semantic tags, preserves Banglish tokens, protects negation words, and normalizes emotional elongation. A key finding is that preprocessing choice substantially affects performance on informal text: standard cleaning reduces the Banglish Survival Rate to zero (SVM F1: 0.7062), while EPH preserves signals (CESS: 0.9996 vs. 0.6694) and raises SVM F1 to 0.8570, an improvement of 0.1508. We further apply domain-adaptive pretraining (DAPT), continuing SahajBERT pretraining on unlabeled in-domain comments. DAPT-SahajBERT achieves the highest mean F1 (0.8161) and MCC (0.6272), significantly outperforming the baseline (F1: 0.7805, p = 0.0013, d = 1.450) and matching MuRIL (p = 0.589). These results suggest that targeted domain pretraining is a competitive alternative to large-scale multilingual pretraining. LLM-assisted annotation using Qwen2.5-7B achieves substantial human agreement (kappa = 0.611), enabling pseudo-labeling of 96,071 comments. Semi-supervised training improves AUC from 0.8499 to 0.8731 (p = 0.044), offering a scalable path to expanding annotation. All code, models, and datasets are publicly released to support reproducible research.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了原生的孟加拉语抑郁检测数据集 BanglishDepYT，并提出保情感预处理 EPH 与领域自适应预训练 DAPT，显著提升非正式文本上的检测性能，并验证 LLM 辅助标注 + 半监督的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有孟加拉语抑郁检测数据集几乎全由英文翻译而来，无法捕捉表情符号、罗马化孟加拉语（Banglish）和拉长拼写等真实表达特征，导致模型在非正式真实文本上性能受限。
AI.method: 1) 从 YouTube 原生采集 BanglishDepYT（191,000 条无标签评论 + 1,000 条经双语文双人标注的样本）；2) 提出 EPH 预处理：表情符转语义标签、保留 Banglish 词元、保护否定词、规范化情感性拉长拼写；3) 在无标签领域评论上对 SahajBERT 继续预训练（DAPT）；4) 用 Qwen2.5-7B 辅助标注生成伪标签并做半监督训练。
AI.result: 标准清洗使 Banglish 存活率降为 0（SVM F1=0.7062），EPH 保持信号（CESS 0.9996 vs 0.6694）并将 SVM F1 提至 0.8570（+0.1508）。DAPT-SahajBERT 取得最高平均 F1（0.8161）与 MCC（0.6272），显著优于基线（F1 0.7805, p=0.0013, d=1.450），与 MuRIL 持平（p=0.589）。LLM 标注与人类一致性 kappa=0.611，伪标注 96,071 条，半监督将 AUC 从 0.8499 提升至 0.8731（p=0.044）。
AI.conclusion: 预处理策略对非正式文本性能影响巨大，保情感预处理是关键；针对性的领域预训练可成为大规模多语言预训练的有竞争力替代方案；LLM 辅助标注结合半监督为扩大标注规模提供了可扩展路径。代码、模型与数据集均已公开。

title: SketchBloom: Training-Free Vector Sketch Outpainting with Stroke-Level Style Control
summary: Outpainting sparse sketches while preserving contour coherence and stroke style remains challenging. We present SketchBloom, a training-free framework that combines pretrained raster outpainting and style-transfer guidance with per-instance vector optimization. Given a sketch, a scene prompt, and an optional reference style, it produces an editable Scalable Vector Graphic (SVG) composed of Bezier strokes. Adaptive latent blending balances content contours and reference texture without model retraining. A reference-derived stroke vocabulary initializes contour- and DINO-attention-guided strokes, which are optimized separately for structure and texture before contour-emphasizing multiply fusion. As in prior optimization-based vector sketching, no task-specific network is trained; our contribution is the synthesis design specialized to sketch outpainting. On LineArtOut-1K, comprising 1,024 input and style combinations, SketchBloom improves perceptual, semantic, and structural fidelity over the evaluated vector baselines when all methods vectorize the same outpainted raster. This protocol evaluates vector synthesis rather than end-to-end outpainting or reference-style superiority. Runtime is approximately six minutes per pair on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU. Project page: https://khangcntn123.github.io/SketchBloom/

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 SketchBloom，将预训练栅格外扩与风格迁移引导结合逐实例矢量优化，对稀疏草图外扩生成可编辑 SVG 贝塞尔笔画。
AI.motivation: 稀疏草图外扩需同时保持轮廓连贯与笔画风格，现有方法难以兼顾。
AI.method: 免训练框架：自适应潜空间混合平衡内容轮廓与参考纹理；由参考图构建笔画词表初始化轮廓与DINO注意力引导的笔画；分别优化结构与纹理后用轮廓强调乘性融合，不训练任务专用网络。
AI.result: 在 LineArtOut-1K（1024 组输入-风格组合）上，在统一栅格外扩+矢量化的协议下，感知、语义与结构保真度优于所评测矢量基线；单张 H200 约 6 分钟/组。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于面向草图外扩的矢量合成设计；该协议评估矢量合成而非端到端外扩或风格优劣，且运行时间较长。

title: IJev: Order-Invariant Decisions via Iterated Cyclic Reordering
summary: System One decision models answer a choice question in one forward pass, but their answer depends on the order in which options are listed, and their probabilities carry a prior over answer labels. An invariant ordering operator is any fixed function that returns the same ordered option list for every input order of a fixed option set. Starting from any such order and averaging a listwise readout over its K cyclic shifts removes the input order, but the decision still depends on the chosen cyclic class: those $K$ shifts are only one of the (K-1)! classes, and different invariant operators can select different classes. We propose IJev, which repeatedly reorders the options by the cyclic-averaged, label-prior-corrected distribution and runs another cyclic average. Every iterate is exactly input-order-invariant. When the iteration does not converge, we average the round distributions rather than return the last round. On five benchmarks and five models, IJev has flip rate zero in every cell. The default uniform average over T=20 rounds substantially improves calibration over a single cyclic average, and its accuracy is comparable. A descriptive choice of horizon and averaging rule is best or tied-best for accuracy in all 25 settings.

AI.tldr: 提出IJev方法，通过对选项顺序做循环平均与迭代重排，构造严格的输入顺序不变决策模型，并在五个基准、五个模型上实现零翻转率且改善校准。
AI.motivation: System One式单次前向选择模型存在两个问题：答案依赖选项排列顺序，且概率中携带答案标签的先验。单次循环平均只能消除输入顺序，但决策仍依赖于所选的循环等价类（K个移位仅是(K-1)!个等价类之一），不同不变排序算子可能选到不同等价类。
AI.method: IJev反复用"循环平均+标签先验校正"后的分布对选项重排，再做一次循环平均；每次迭代结果都严格满足输入顺序不变性。当迭代不收敛时，对多轮分布取平均而非返回最后一轮结果。实验设置T=20轮，采用默认均匀平均。
AI.result: 在5个基准、5个模型共25个设置中，IJev翻转率全部为零。默认T=20轮均匀平均相比单次循环平均显著提升校准，准确率相当；描述性选择的horizon与平均规则在全部25个设置中取得最佳或并列最佳准确率。
AI.conclusion: 迭代重排加多轮平均能超越单次循环平均的等价类依赖限制，获得严格顺序不变、零翻转且校准更好的决策模型，对超参数选择具有稳健性。

title: What matters in classical machine learning for non-intrusive load monitoring? A factorial benchmark on REFIT with validation on unseen houses
summary: Published classical machine-learning results for appliance ON/OFF classification in nonintrusive load monitoring (NILM) range from F1-type scores of 0.53 to 0.98, and the sources of this spread have not been separated. This study separates them with a factorial benchmark on REFIT: seven models, two feature sets and four class-imbalance strategies for five appliances (270 fitted configurations), each evaluated by pooled nested cross-validation and on houses unseen during training, with robustness checks. An analysis of variance shows that the appliance explains 38% of the variance in F1, the feature set 13% and the model only 8%. Engineered rolling-window features raised the mean F1 score by 52% under both protocols. Other conclusions changed on unseen houses: the support-weighted F1 score of the best pooled configurations fell from 0.548 to 0.447, the differences between the models selected by pooled validation were no longer significant, and the benefit of class weighting over no correction rose from 32% to 69%. In a nested comparison, house-grouped selection on the training houses improved F1 on unseen houses for three of five appliances, by up to 0.110, and was within 0.007 for the other two. These findings held across four house partitions and without the solar-affected houses. A same-protocol convolutional network reached a weighted F1 score of 0.50, about 0.05 above the classical models (0.45) and far below the published deep-learning scores of 0.78 to 0.91, which were obtained under a different protocol. The results support low-cost appliance monitoring in buildings and yield a NILM reporting checklist.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过因子基准实验系统拆解 NILM 家电开关分类中 F1 分数差异的来源，发现家电类型影响最大（38%），特征集次之（13%），模型仅占 8%；并揭示混池验证与未见房屋结果存在显著偏差。
AI.motivation: 已发表的 NILM 家电 ON/OFF 分类机器学习结果 F1 分数跨度大（0.53–0.98），但此前研究未分离这些差异的具体来源，导致方法间比较缺乏公平依据。
AI.method: 在 REFIT 数据集上开展因子基准：7 种模型 × 2 种特征集 × 4 种类别不平衡策略 × 5 种家电，共 270 个配置；采用池化嵌套交叉验证与训练中未见房屋两种评估协议，并用方差分析归因，配以四种房屋划分和无太阳能影响房屋的稳健性检验，另做同协议 CNN 对照。
AI.result: 方差分析显示家电解释 38% 的 F1 方差，特征集 13%，模型仅 8%；工程化滚动窗口特征在两种协议下均使平均 F1 提升 52%。在未见房屋上，最优配置的支持加权 F1 由 0.548 降至 0.447，池化验证选出的模型间差异不再显著，类别加权相对无纠正的收益由 32% 升至 69%；按房屋分组的选择使其在三类家电上提升最多 0.110，其余两类差异在 0.007 内。同协议 CNN 加权 F1 为 0.50，仅比经典模型（0.45）高约 0.05，远低于不同协议下已发表的深度学习分数（0.78–0.91）。结论在四种房屋划分及剔除太阳能房屋后均稳健。
AI.conclusion: NILM 结果的巨大差异主要源于数据与特征选择而非模型，且池化验证会系统性高估泛化性能；研究支持低成本家电监测应用，并提出 NILM 报告清单以规范协议披露。

title: EEG-HealthLLM: Hierarchical Adaptation of Large Language Models for Unified Heterogeneous EEG Health Assessment
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive means for neurological and mental health assessment, yet existing EEG models are typically developed for individual tasks and are difficult to unify across heterogeneous signal configurations and assessment objectives. Large language models (LLMs) offer a common interface for multiple tasks, but adapting heterogeneous EEG signals to a shared LLM raises a key challenge: how to preserve task-specific signal characteristics while enabling effective language-side parameter sharing. To address this problem, we propose EEG-HealthLLM, a unified and parameter-efficient framework for heterogeneous EEG health assessment. We introduce an Asymmetric Hierarchical Adaptation Strategy: task-specific EEG adapters preserve heterogeneous spatio-temporal dynamics, while a unified shared LoRA is injected into the LLM backbone (e.g., Phi-3) to capture shared high-level assessment semantics across tasks. We further establish EEG-HealthBench by reorganizing five existing EEG resources into paradigms covering epileptic seizure detection, major depressive disorder assessment, anxiety risk assessment, depressive symptom risk assessment, and emotional state assessment under a unified subject-independent protocol. Extensive experiments show that EEG-HealthLLM achieves an average balanced accuracy (BAC) of 69.58%, ranking first among the evaluated methods in both average BAC and macro-F1. Compared with independent single-task LoRA adaptation, it improves average BAC from 67.70% to 69.58% while reducing the aggregate language-side adapter footprint by 80.0%. Further analyses reveal task-dependent cross-task interactions and trade-offs, supporting the proposed hierarchical adaptation strategy. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/Marui-88/EEG-HealthLLM.

AI.tldr: 提出 EEG-HealthLLM，用非对称分层适配策略统一异构 EEG 健康评估任务，平均 BAC 69.58% 排名第一，同时语言侧适配器体积减少 80%。
AI.motivation: 现有 EEG 模型多为单任务设计，难以统一异构信号配置与不同评估目标；LLM 虽可提供通用接口，但如何将异构 EEG 对齐到共享 LLM 并保留任务特定信号特性仍是关键难题。
AI.method: 非对称分层适配策略：任务特定 EEG 适配器保留异构时空动态，LLM 主干（如 Phi-3）注入统一共享 LoRA 以捕捉跨任务高层评估语义；并将五个 EEG 资源重组为统一被试独立协议下的 EEG-HealthBench 基准。
AI.result: 平均平衡准确率 69.58%，平均 BAC 与 macro-F1 在评估方法中均排名第一；相比独立单任务 LoRA，平均 BAC 从 67.70% 提升至 69.58%，语言侧适配器总体积减少 80.0%。
AI.conclusion: 分层适配可有效兼顾任务特异与跨任务共享，验证了存在任务相关的跨任务交互与权衡；代码已开源。

title: SketchForge: Training-Free Scene-to-Vector Sketching via Decoupled Structure and Texture Optimization
summary: Converting a raster image into a resolution-independent, stroke-editable vector sketch while faithfully preserving both structural contours and tonal texture remains challenging: raster-space rendering pipelines are difficult to edit at the stroke level, while generation-from-scratch vectorization methods struggle to remain faithful to an arbitrary input image. We present SketchForge, a training-free framework that converts an input raster image into a resolution-independent SVG sketch through per-instance test-time optimization of Bezier curves, requiring no additional training or fine-tuning. Strokes are seeded via a contour and attention-guided initialization, then refined by a vector-native differentiable rendering pipeline that decouples structural contour strokes from free-form texture strokes under dedicated objectives, composited via multiply-blend layering. Extensive experiments show that SketchForge consistently outperforms existing vector-based baselines in structural fidelity and generation quality. Project page: https://khangcntn123.github.io/SketchForge

AI.tldr: SketchForge：免训练框架，通过逐实例测试时优化Bezier曲线将栅格图像转为分辨率无关、可笔触编辑的SVG素描，同时保留结构轮廓与色调纹理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法两端受限：栅格空间渲染流程难以在笔触级编辑；从零生成的矢量化方法难以忠实还原任意输入图像，兼顾结构轮廓与色调纹理仍是挑战。
AI.method: 免训练框架，无需额外训练或微调。以轮廓与注意力引导进行笔触初始化，再用矢量化原生可微渲染管线迭代优化Bezier曲线，将结构轮廓笔触与自由纹理笔触解耦并用各自目标函数优化，通过正片叠底混合分层合成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SketchForge在结构保真度与生成质量上持续优于现有基于矢量的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 逐实例测试时优化可实现忠实且可编辑的矢量化素描，为免训练、笔触级可控的图像转SVG提供了有效方案。

title: Constraint Dependency Graph Retrieval for Compliance Detection on Long SKILL Documents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents carry out business operations under enterprise documents we refer to as SKILL documents, which take the form of standard operating procedures (SOPs) that state the conditions to verify and the actions to take before an operation proceeds. Long, densely cross-referenced SKILL documents exceed the context budget of small deployed auditors. Similarity-based retrieval then brings in irrelevant rules while omitting mandatory prerequisites, and the two-stage audit policy provides no trainable signal for the retrieval stage. We present SkillCDG, a compliance detection framework that reformulates each SKILL document as a constraint dependency graph, shifting rule retrieval from similarity-based matching to closure-based selection under the deployment's context budget. Each atomic rule is anchored to its source text span as a graph node, and mandatory prerequisite relations form the sole edge type. Policy-generated retrieval keywords activate seed rules, whose dependency closure yields a compact and conditionally complete rule context within that budget. The same graph also supports a joint optimization scheme. The retrieval stage is trained with group-relative policy optimization using a verifiable reward that combines output-format validity with downstream verdict correctness, with closure non-emptiness serving as a validity gate, while selective on-policy distillation concentrates teacher supervision on high-entropy reasoning tokens, with verdict and termination tokens always included, to improve verdict accuracy. Experiments on three enterprise datasets and two public benchmarks show that SkillCDG improves accuracy and F1 over the full-document and retrieval-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 将SKILL/SOP文档建模为约束依赖图，用依赖闭包替代相似度检索做规则选择，并用GRPO+选择性策略蒸馏联合优化检索与审计。
AI.motivation: 企业审计场景中，SKILL文档（SOP）长且交叉引用密集，超出小型部署审计模型的上下文预算；相似度检索会引入无关规则且漏掉强制前置条件；两阶段审计策略中检索阶段缺乏可训练信号。
AI.method: (1) 把每条原子规则锚定到源文本片段作为图节点，仅以“强制前置依赖”为边，构建约束依赖图；(2) 策略生成的关键词激活种子规则，通过依赖闭包在上下文预算内得到紧凑且条件完备的规则上下文；(3) 检索阶段用GRPO训练，奖励结合输出格式有效性与下游判决正确性，以闭包非空作为有效性门控；(4) 选择性on-policy蒸馏，将教师监督集中于高熵推理token，判决与终止token始终纳入。
AI.result: 在三个企业数据集和两个公开基准上，SkillCDG 相比全文档输入与基于检索的基线，在准确率和F1上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于依赖闭包的图式规则选择可替代相似度检索，在有限上下文下保证条件完备性；联合优化检索与审计阶段可有效提升合规判定性能。

title: Solvable dynamics model of in-context learning
summary: Pretrained Transformer architectures display a surprising in-context learning ability without additional training. How the learning process guides the network to achieve this intriguing capability remains unsolved. In this study, we focus on a single-layer, single-head linear attention model, where empirical risk minimization is defined for learning. Given a finite amount of training examples, we determine the exact solution of network parameter dynamics, which is linked to the training error and generalization error, characterizing how memorization and generalization emerge from learning and how these transitions are related to curvatures of the empirical risk landscape. Furthermore, we calculate a data-dependent free energy, from which the training and generalization errors in the long-time limit of learning dynamics can be well predicted. Our work adds insights toward understanding the mechanism of in-context learning, especially from a learning dynamics perspective.

AI.tldr: 该文针对单层单头线性注意力模型，在经验风险最小化下推导参数动力学的精确解，揭示记忆与泛化的涌现机制及其与损失景观曲率的关系。
AI.motivation: 预训练Transformer展现出惊人的上下文学习能力，但其学习过程如何引导网络获得该能力尚不清楚，作者希望从学习动力学视角理解这一机制。
AI.method: 以一个单层、单头线性注意力模型为研究对象，在有限训练样本下，用经验风险最小化定义学习目标，解析求解网络参数随时间的精确动力学演化。
AI.result: 得到与训练误差和泛化误差相关联的参数动力学精确解，刻画了记忆与泛化如何在学习过程中涌现，并将这些转变与经验风险景观的曲率联系起来；同时计算了一个数据依赖的自由能，可较好预测长时间极限下的训练误差与泛化误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从学习动力学角度增进了对上下文学习机制的理解。

title: Seeing Less in a Sparse World: Cross-View Geolocalization from Limited Field-of-View Observations
summary:
Cross-view geolocalization aims to determine the geographic location of a ground-level image by retrieving its corresponding satellite image, offering a promising alternative for localization in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-denied or degraded environments such as urban canyons, dense forests, and disaster scenarios. Despite recent progress, existing approaches remain limited by the lack of globally diverse training datasets and benchmarks that are often geographically restricted. Furthermore, most benchmarks rely on panoramic ground views, which do not reflect the limited field-of-view imagery captured by real world cameras.
  To address these challenges, we introduce Cross-View World 500k (CVW500k), a large-scale globally distributed dataset containing over 500,000 ground-satellite image pairs collected across diverse geographic regions and environments. Unlike previous datasets, CVW500k uses limited field-of-view ground images, providing a more realistic and challenging setting for cross-view geolocalization. In addition, we propose GeoQueryNet, a query-based cross-view fusion transformer framework designed to bridge the viewpoint gap between ground and satellite images. The model leverages a CLIP-based visual encoder with parameter-efficient LoRA adaptation and introduces a Cross-View Alignment Module that uses learnable query tokens to extract geographically consistent features across viewpoints. Our code can be found here: https://github.com/Fahim17/Cross_View_World_Dataset.git .

AI.tldr: 提出全球分布式数据集CVW500k（50万+地-卫星图像对，采用有限视场地面图像）及GeoQueryNet查询式跨视角融合Transformer，用于GNSS拒止环境下的地-卫星跨视角地理定位。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法受限于训练数据与基准地理分布单一，且多数基准使用全景地面图像，不符合真实相机的有限视场情况，导致实际部署困难。
AI.method: 构建CVW500k数据集：覆盖多样地理区域与环境的50万余地-卫星图像对，地面图像采用有限视场；提出GeoQueryNet：基于CLIP视觉编码器并加入参数高效LoRA微调，设计Cross-View Alignment Module，用可学习查询token提取跨视角地理一致特征。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标；数据集与模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过更真实、更具挑战性的数据集与查询式跨视角融合框架，推动跨视角地理定位在真实GNSS受限场景中的实用化。

title: Temperature, Not Knowledge: What Recursive Self-Training and Its Remedies Do to a Language Model's Confidence
summary: Recursive self-training can collapse language models, and many proposed remedies target overconfidence, yet their effects on confidence are rarely measured. We study a five-round self-training loop on Qwen3-1.7B, using three seeds per compared method, and distinguish confidence temperature (drift from a calibrated starting point) from discrimination (ranking correct answers above incorrect ones). Accuracy and overall discrimination remain nearly unchanged, but confidence sharpens and the most confident answers become less reliable. Matching predictive entropy to the calibrated starting model each round recalibrates nearly as well as label-based temperature fitting, at both 1.7B and 8B. Sharpening is not inherent to self-training: exact samples from a model's distribution have zero expected gradient. Instead, most drift comes from fitting each generated answer twice, with top-p truncation contributing the rest; removing both keeps entropy on generated outputs flat. Remedies affect the two properties differently: truncated cross-entropy, an entropy bonus, and single-pass training preserve temperature without improving discrimination, while focal loss and multi-sample targets improve discrimination but cause underconfidence. Reference-data mixing also overshoots. Pairing a ranking-improving loss with label-free recalibration achieves both.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Qwen3-1.7B五轮递归自训练中的置信度漂移，区分"温度"（相对校准起点的漂移）与"判别力"（正确/错误答案排序）。发现准确率与判别力几乎不变，但置信度锐化、最自信答案更不可靠；锐化源于每轮生成答案被拟合两次及top-p截断，而非自训练本身。结合提升排序的损失与无标签重校准可同时改善两者。
AI.motivation: 递归自训练可能导致语言模型崩溃，现有补救措施多针对"过度自信"，但其对置信度的实际影响很少被直接测量；需厘清自训练中置信度漂移的来源及其与判别力的关系。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-1.7B上运行五轮自训练循环，每种对比方法使用三个随机种子；将置信度温度（相对校准起点的漂移）与判别力分开度量。通过理论分析（精确采样期望梯度为零）与消融实验定位漂移来源：每轮拟合生成答案两次、top-p截断；并对比截断交叉熵、熵奖励、单次训练、focal loss、多样本目标、参考数据混合等多种补救方案。
AI.result: 准确率与整体判别力几乎不变，但置信度明显锐化、最自信答案可靠性下降。实验表明锐化并非自训练固有：主要漂移来自对生成答案的重复拟合，top-p截断贡献其余；去除二者后生成输出上的熵保持平稳。将每轮预测熵匹配到校准起点模型，其重校准效果接近基于标签的温度拟合（1.7B与8B均成立）。各补救措施效果分化：截断交叉熵、熵奖励、单次训练保持温度但不提升判别力；focal loss与多样本目标提升判别力却导致欠自信；参考数据混合会过度校正。
AI.conclusion: 自训练中的置信度锐化主要源于训练流程细节（重复拟合与截断）而非递归自训练本质；温度与判别力是相互独立、需分别处理的两个性质。将提升排序的损失与无标签重校准配对使用，可同时保持校准与提升判别力。

title: MarkovTS: Pretrained State-Transition Representations for Zero-Shot Time Series Generation
summary: Across heterogeneous real-world domains, time-series generation supports simulation, model development, and data augmentation by generating sequences that preserve target-domain statistics and temporal dependencies when real observations are scarce or costly. However, existing methods predominantly address in-domain generation, limiting their reuse in unseen domains. We study reference-conditioned zero-shot time series generation: target domains are unseen during pretraining, generation uses a single target-domain reference sequence, and no model parameters are updated. MarkovTS characterizes sequence evolution through local morphologies and their ordered transitions at multiple temporal scales. Its pretrained encoder quantizes normalized time-series patches into multiscale morphological states with a state codebook, while a transition codebook encodes contextual transitions between adjacent intervals. These transferable state-transition representations condition a pretrained flow-matching model. At generation, the frozen model combines a reference-derived condition with independent Gaussian noise to produce stochastic samples that retain the reference's temporal organization. Across 12 unseen target datasets, MarkovTS outperforms strong baselines in most distributional comparisons and generates diverse, reference-consistent sequences. As downstream augmentation, its samples yield overall gains across forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection benchmarks and diverse model families. Our code is available at https://github.com/blisky-li/MarkovTS.

AI.tldr: MarkovTS 提出"参考条件零样本时间序列生成"，用多尺度形态状态与状态转移码本的可迁移表征，配合冻结的 flow-matching 模型，仅凭一条目标域参考序列即可生成保留其时间组织的样本，并在 12 个未见数据集上多数指标优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中时间序列生成对仿真、模型开发和数据增强有价值，但现有方法大多只做域内生成，难以迁移到未见域；观测稀缺或获取昂贵时更需要零样本能力。
AI.method: 定义参考条件零样本生成任务（目标域预训练未见、仅用一条参考序列、不更新参数）。MarkovTS 通过多尺度局部形态及其有序转移刻画序列演化：预训练编码器将归一化 patch 量化到多尺度形态状态码本，另一转移码本编码相邻区间的情境转移；这些可迁移的状态-转移表征条件化预训练 flow-matching 模型，生成时将参考导出的条件与独立高斯噪声结合得到随机采样。
AI.result: 在 12 个未见目标数据集上，多数分布对比中优于强基线，生成样本多样且与参考一致；作为下游数据增强，在预测、分类与异常检测基准及多种模型族上总体带来增益。
AI.conclusion: 以离散状态-转移码本作为可迁移先验是零样本时间序列生成的有效路径，可复用于跨域数据增强；代码已开源。

title: EarlySelectKV: Anticipatory KV Selection via Cross-Layer Query Proxies
summary: Query-conditioned sparse KV selection reduces long-context inference cost by attending to a subset of historical KV entries at each decoding step. Existing selectors must wait for the target-layer query before scoring candidates and generating indices, placing routing on the immediate pre-attention path. We introduce EarlySelectKV, a training-free transformation that uses proxy queries from earlier hidden states to precompute selected KV indices while retaining the real target-layer query for final attention.
