Tests with RocketKV, Quest, and Loki show no consistent pattern of quality degradation across the evaluated settings. In the primary RocketKV evaluation, ES-RocketKV differs by +0.018 points on LongBench, approximately -0.01 points on RULER, and +0.25 percentage points on representative NIAH/Passkey settings. In a TensorRT-LLM deployment with CPU-offloaded routing, ES-RocketKV improves end-to-end output throughput by up to 12.4% and reduces GPU-resident memory by 11.1% of the combined KV/K-summary pool. This makes routing timing an explicit optimization target alongside KV subset selection in sparse long-context decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/sea-with-sakura/EarlySelectKV.

AI.tldr: EarlySelectKV 用早期隐藏状态的代理查询提前预计算被选中的 KV 索引，把稀疏 KV 路由从注意力前路径移开，在几乎不损失质量的前提下提升吞吐、降低显存。
AI.motivation: 查询条件式稀疏 KV 选择虽能降低长上下文推理成本，但现有选择器必须在打分前等待目标层真实查询，使路由处在注意力计算的直接前导路径上，形成关键延迟。
AI.method: 提出免训练转换 EarlySelectKV：用更早层隐藏状态生成的代理查询预先计算选中的 KV 索引并提前路由，最终注意力仍使用真实目标层查询完成计算；可与 RocketKV、Quest、Loki 组合。
AI.result: RocketKV 主评测中 ES-RocketKV 在 LongBench 差 +0.018 分、RULER 约 -0.01 分、NIAH/Passkey 约 +0.25 个百分点，无一致退化规律；TensorRT-LLM CPU 卸载路由部署下端到端输出吞吐最高提升 12.4%，GPU 常驻显存减少相当于 KV/K-summary 池的 11.1%。
AI.conclusion: 路由时机应与 KV 子集选择并列为稀疏长上下文解码的显式优化目标；EarlySelectKV 以零训练代价实现该优化，代码已开源。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Unified Visible--Invisible Motion for Physically Consistent Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in video generation have achieved impressive visual quality, yet they often fail to produce physically consistent dynamics due to the lack of explicit modeling of underlying physical processes. Existing approaches either rely on simulators with strong assumptions or use coarse semantic guidance, and further struggle to effectively inject physical priors into generation models. In this work, we propose Seeing the Unseen, a unified framework for physics-grounded video generation. Our approach decomposes the problem into two stages: learning physical dynamics and injecting them into video synthesis. First, we introduce a lightweight Particle-based Graph Dynamics Simulator (PGDS) that learns generalizable physical interactions from data and predicts plausible 3D motion trajectories. Second, we propose a Visible--Invisible Motion Field (VIMF) that captures both motion observable in the input frame and motion that emerges over time due to object dynamics. This representation enables more complete and structured motion guidance compared to conventional physical signals. By integrating these trajectories into a diffusion-based generator, our method produces videos that are both visually coherent and physically consistent. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved motion accuracy, interaction consistency, and reduced physical artifacts compared to strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出"Seeing the Unseen"统一框架，先学习物理动力学再注入视频生成：用轻量的基于粒子的图动力学模拟器(PGDS)预测3D运动轨迹，并用可见—不可见运动场(VIMF)表示完整运动引导，从而生成视觉连贯且物理一致的视频。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成视觉质量高但物理一致性差，缺乏对底层物理过程的显式建模；已有方法要么依赖强假设的模拟器，要么仅用粗糙语义引导，难以有效将物理先验注入生成模型。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 轻量级Particle-based Graph Dynamics Simulator (PGDS)，从数据中学习可泛化的物理交互并预测合理的3D运动轨迹；(2) 提出Visible–Invisible Motion Field (VIMF)，同时刻画输入帧中可观测运动与随时间涌现的物体动力学运动，形成更完整、结构化的运动引导；再将这些轨迹注入基于扩散的生成器中。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，相比强基线，方法在运动准确性、交互一致性上更优，并减少了物理伪影。
AI.conclusion: 将显式学习的物理动力学轨迹作为结构化引导注入扩散生成器，是提升视频物理一致性的有效途径。

title: Appointed-Time Fault-Tolerant Fast Terminal Sliding Control for UAVs with a Tracking Error-Based Disturbance Observer
summary: This paper addresses the critical challenge of high-performance fault-tolerant tracking control for quadrotor UAVs under complex conditions including external disturbances, parameter uncertainties, and actuator faults. A synergistic control framework is proposed by decoupling the system into position and attitude loops, each governed by the following three innovations. First, an Appointed-Time Prescribed Performance Function (AT-PPF) is developed to strictly constrain the tracking error within a predefined funnel boundary, ensuring convergence within a fixed time regardless of initial conditions. Second, a Tracking Error-Based Fixed-Time Composite Disturbance Observer (TFxTCDO) is developed to enable fast and accurate estimation of lumped disturbances without requiring full-state information or precise system modeling. This observer directly couples disturbance estimation with the control objective, thereby enhancing robustness and convergence. Third, a Fast Second-Order Terminal Sliding Mode Controller (NFSO-TSMC) is designed to achieve faster convergence and effective chattering mitigation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed control strategy significantly outperforms conventional methods in terms of tracking accuracy, fault recovery speed, and robustness against uncertainties.

AI.tldr: 针对四旋翼无人机在外扰、参数不确定和执行器故障下的容错跟踪控制，提出位置/姿态解耦的协同控制框架，融合指定时间预设性能函数、基于跟踪误差的固定时间复合干扰观测器与快速二阶终端滑模控制器，仿真验证在跟踪精度、故障恢复速度与鲁棒性上优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼在外部扰动、参数不确定性与执行器故障并存的复杂工况下，需同时保证高精度跟踪、快速故障恢复与强鲁棒性，传统控制方法难以兼顾这些需求。
AI.method: 将系统解耦为位置环与姿态环，每个回路采用三项创新：(1) 指定时间预设性能函数(AT-PPF)，将跟踪误差约束在预设漏斗边界内，不依赖初始条件在固定时间内收敛；(2) 基于跟踪误差的固定时间复合干扰观测器(TFxTCDO)，无需全状态信息与精确建模即可快速精确估计集总扰动，并将扰动估计与控制目标直接耦合；(3) 快速二阶终端滑模控制器(NFSO-TSMC)，实现更快收敛并有效抑制抖振。
AI.result: 仿真结果显示，所提策略在跟踪精度、故障恢复速度和抗不确定性鲁棒性方面显著优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 该解耦协同控制框架可有效应对多源扰动与执行器故障，实现四旋翼高性能容错跟踪控制，具有较好的工程应用潜力。

title: HieraNTP: Structured Risk Representations for Time-Series Anomaly Detection via Hierarchical Next-Token Prediction
summary: Time-series anomaly detection commonly converts deviations from learned temporal regularities into anomaly scores. This practice can conflate violations of temporal regularity with task-specific anomaly judgments: the same deviation may be anomalous under one task definition and benign under another. Aggregating heterogeneous deviations into a single score before task-specific adaptation can obscure the evidence needed to distinguish these cases. We introduce HieraNTP, a Hierarchical Next-Token Prediction framework that separates self-supervised predictive modeling from task-specific risk interpretation. HieraNTP pretrains a hierarchical tokenizer and a causal next-token predictor to capture temporal regularities at multiple scales. It then organizes prediction discrepancies into a structured risk representation, preserving complementary evidence across temporal scales in token, local-statistic, and observation spaces. A task-adaptive detector uses anomaly labels to select and combine this evidence for the target task. Across anomaly detection benchmarks, HieraNTP improves VUS-PR by 12.0% on TSB-AD-U and 15.5% on TSB-AD-M relative to the strongest baselines, and achieves the highest composite score on both TAB tracks, with controlled comparisons supporting the value of retaining distinct evidence. Our code is available at https://github.com/blisky-li/HieraNTP.

AI.tldr: HieraNTP将自监督预测建模与任务特定风险解释分离：先分层tokenizer+因果下一token预测学习多尺度时序规律，再把预测偏差组织成结构化风险表示（token/局部统计/观测三空间），最后用带标签的任务自适应检测器选择组合证据。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测把偏离时序规律的程度直接转为异常分数，会混淆"违反时序规律"与"任务特定的异常判定"——同一偏差在不同任务定义下可能异常也可能正常；提前把异质偏差聚合成单一分数会掩盖区分所需的证据。
AI.method: HieraNTP框架：预训练分层tokenizer与因果下一token预测器，捕获多尺度时序规律；将预测差异组织为结构化风险表示，在token、局部统计量、观测三种空间保留互补证据；任务自适应检测器利用异常标签为目标任务选择和组合这些证据。
AI.result: 在异常检测基准上，VUS-PR较最强基线在TSB-AD-U提升12.0%、TSB-AD-M提升15.5%；在两个TAB赛道上取得最高综合得分，控制实验支持保留独立证据的价值。
AI.conclusion: 解耦"预测建模"与"任务风险解释"并保留多空间证据，比单一聚合分数更有效，验证了该设计在多种异常检测任务上的泛化与收益。

title: Less but Sufficient: Relation Knowledge Selects Compact Knowledge-Graph Contexts, and What External Checks Can and Cannot Catch
summary: Large language models (LLMs) read knowledge-graph facts ranked by relevance, leaving open whether they suffice or conflict. Our checks use relation knowledge, written by hand or learned from training questions labelled with their relation paths. It selects a compact context of facts yielding an answer, and derives it; a derivability check tests whether an answer follows, a consistency check whether facts conflict, and a validation-chosen routing gate decides where the derived answer replaces the LLM's. Seven open LLMs read the compact context better in exact match than relevance-ranked facts; on ComplexWebQuestions (CWQ) they match SubgraphRAG's facts at a quarter of the prompt tokens, and stronger LLMs read SubgraphRAG's better. Where the routing gate passes, ours leads SubgraphRAG's in exact match in all 53 LLM, benchmark and prompt settings. A precision gate, returning the derived answer only when the check passes with exactly one derived entity, answered 18 and 5 percent of held-out WebQSP and CWQ questions in a pre-specified test, right for 90 and 96 percent. The consistency check judges facts by path evidence only where another path joins their entities, true of 2.5 percent of named-entity facts in our compact WebQSP and CWQ contexts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用关系知识筛选紧凑知识图谱事实，并通过可推导性检查、一致性检查与验证选出的路由门控，决定是否用推导答案替换LLM答案。
AI.motivation: LLM按相关性排序读取知识图谱事实，但无法确定这些事实是否充分或彼此冲突，因此需要机制判断事实能否推出答案、是否相互矛盾。
AI.method: 用人工编写或从标注训练问题中学习的关系知识选择紧凑事实上下文并推导答案；设置可推导性检查（答案是否成立）、一致性检查（事实是否冲突），以及基于验证集选择的精确度门控，当检查通过且仅导出唯一实体时返回推导答案。
AI.result: 七个开源LLM读取紧凑上下文时精确匹配优于相关性排序事实；在CWQ上以约四分之一提示token达到SubgraphRAG事实的效果，强LLM则更擅长读取SubgraphRAG。门控通过时，在全部53种LLM、基准与提示设置中精确匹配优于SubgraphRAG。预注册测试中精确度门控分别回答WebQSP和CWQ的18%与5%留出问题，正确率90%和96%。一致性检查仅在另一条路径连接实体时依据路径证据判断，这在紧凑上下文的命名实体事实中占2.5%。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑、可验证的事实上下文能在更少token下提升LLM读取效果，结合门控可安全替换LLM答案，但一致性检查实际适用比例很低。

title: Déjà Vu: Cycle-Consistent Re-ranking for Semantic Correspondence
summary: We propose \emph{Déjà Vu}, a test-time decoding module for semantic correspondence. Matching semantically equivalent keypoints across images of the same object category is challenging due to variations in appearance, viewpoint, and scale. While features from large pretrained vision models carry strong zero-shot correspondence ability, existing methods reduce final matching to greedy top-$1$ nearest-neighbor selection. We show that the correct correspondence appears among the top-ranked candidates far more often than top-$1$ matching achieves: with $30$ candidates, zero-shot features exceed the top-$1$ accuracy of a supervised model. This reveals a \textit{decoding bottleneck} rather than a limit of the representation. Motivated by this observation, we formulate semantic correspondence as a \textit{recall-then-rerank} problem. Our method first nominates an adaptive candidate set, larger when the similarity distribution is ambiguous and smaller when it is confident, then re-ranks the candidates with a graded cycle-consistency score: each candidate is matched back to the source image and penalized by how far its reverse match lands from the original keypoint. The module operates entirely on the similarity matrix already computed by the base method. It consistently improves three representative baselines on SPair-71k, its geometric subset, and PF-Pascal under both unsupervised and weakly supervised settings, with gains of up to $+1.8$ PCK@0.10 on SPair-71k and $+3.4$ PCK@0.15 on PF-Pascal, and $+4.9$ under Keypoint Average Precision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Déjà Vu，一个用于语义对应的测试时解码模块，将语义对应重构为"先召回再重排"问题，以突破现有方法贪心top-1匹配的解码瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 语义对应任务中，大预训练视觉模型的特征具有强零样本对应能力，但现有方法将最终匹配简化为贪心top-1最近邻选择。作者观察到正确对应出现在前30个候选中的频率远高于top-1精度——零样本特征在30候选时甚至超过有监督模型的top-1精度，说明瓶颈在于解码而非表征。
AI.method: 将语义对应形式化为recall-then-rerank问题：(1)先提名自适应候选集，相似度分布模糊时候选集更大、置信时更小；(2)用分级循环一致性分数对候选重排——将每个候选匹配回源图像，并按反向匹配落点与原始关键点的距离进行惩罚。该模块完全基于基础方法已计算的相似度矩阵运行。
AI.result: 在SPair-71k、其几何子集和PF-Pascal上，于无监督和弱监督设置下均持续提升三个代表性基线：SPair-71k上PCK@0.10最高+1.8，PF-Pascal上PCK@0.15最高+3.4，Keypoint Average Precision下+4.9。
AI.conclusion: 语义对应的性能限制主要来自top-1贪心解码而非特征表征能力；通过自适应的"召回-重排"解码策略并利用循环一致性重排，可在不改变基础方法权重的前提下显著且一致地提升对应精度。

title: Robust Reward Machine Learning and Execution in Noisy Environments
comment: 44 pages, 21 figures, 5 tables. Published in the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research. Code: https://github.com/rparac/Prob-IRM
summary:
Background: Reward machines (RMs) represent non-Markovian reward functions as finite-state machines over high-level propositional events. Traditionally, these events are generated by a deterministic labelling function that maps environment states to proposition sets. However, real-world labelling functions are inherently noisy.
  Objectives: Design and implement a method that learns RMs in the presence of noisy labelling functions and exploits them for policy learning in both discrete and continuous environments.
  Methods: We propose Prob-IRM, a method that learns RMs from noisy proposition histories using inductive logic programming (ILP) and exploits them for policy learning. Noisy proposition histories are represented as training examples for ILP, which learns an RM that maximises coverage of low-uncertainty histories. RM learning is interleaved with policy optimisation. Prob-IRM uses a belief over RM states to determine when to relearn the RM and to provide additional guiding rewards.
  Results: Prob-IRM is evaluated on environments with discrete and continuous state spaces under varying levels of labelling noise. Prob-IRM performs comparably to baselines using handcrafted RMs and outperforms approaches that use recurrent neural networks to encode history, despite operating with noisy labels.
  Conclusions: Prob-IRM represents a step towards deploying reward machines in noisy, real-world environments.

AI.tldr: Prob-IRM：在标签含噪情况下用ILP从带不确定性的命题历史中学习奖励机，并与策略优化交替进行，在离散/连续环境中媲美手工RM基线。
AI.motivation: 传统奖励机假设标签函数是确定、无噪声的，但真实环境的标签（命题事件生成）本质上有噪声，导致RM学习与利用失效。
AI.method: 将带噪命题历史表示为ILP训练样例，学习最大化低不确定性历史覆盖率的奖励机；RM学习与策略优化交替进行；用RM状态的信念分布决定何时重新学习RM，并提供额外引导奖励。
AI.result: 在离散与连续状态空间、不同标签噪声水平下评估；性能与使用手工RM的基线相当，并优于用RNN编码历史的方法，尽管其使用的是含噪标签。
AI.conclusion: Prob-IRM是让奖励机走向噪声真实环境的一步，证明了在噪声标签下学习并利用RM的可行性。

title: ISBC: Interpretable Sparse Binary Coding of Pretrained Text Embeddings
summary: Pretrained text embeddings encode semantic structure in high-dimensional continuous spaces whose coordinates are difficult to interpret. We introduce Interpretable Sparse Binary Coding (ISBC), which learns a small set of binary dimensions from frozen embeddings without taxonomy labels or downstream outcomes. A trainable encoder and affine decoder combine reconstruction with controls on activity, factor utilization, dependence, and activation uncertainty. Individual bits and their conjunctions select overlapping document groups; complete activation profiles provide finer contexts for conditional comparisons. We evaluate these representations across corpora, backbones, and code configurations through reconstruction, geometry, predictive probes, and document inspection. Empirical cases identify both distinctions within existing categories and shared content across their boundaries. In a mixed-domain corpus, the most frequent profiles predominantly identify source collections, while selected within-source comparisons reveal sentiment and migration contrasts. Selected associations persist in additional documents encoded without refitting. In an engagement application, bits alone improve prediction of log-transformed outcomes over a constant reference, while their combinations identify within-event content contrasts associated with engagement. The results support using binary coordinates and their combinations for empirical interpretation, with complete profiles providing a fine, partly initialization-dependent description rather than a unique discrete taxonomy.

AI.tldr: ISBC 从冻结文本嵌入中学习少量二元维度，用可训练编码器+仿射解码器结合重构与多重控制，实现可解释的稀疏二元编码，并验证其在多语料、多主干上兼具可解释性与预测性。
AI.motivation: 预训练文本嵌入位于高维连续空间，其坐标难以解释；现有可解释方法往往依赖分类标签或下游结果，缺乏不依赖监督的语义可解释表示。
AI.method: 提出 Interpretable Sparse Binary Coding（ISBC）：在冻结嵌入上训练编码器与仿射解码器，目标为重构加上对活跃度、因子利用率、依赖性和激活不确定性的控制，得到少量二元维度；单比特及其合取用于选择重叠文档组，完整激活画像提供条件比较的细粒度语境。
AI.result: 通过重构、几何、预测探针与文档检查在多语料/主干/配置上评估：能识别已有类别内的区分与跨类别共享内容；混合领域语料中高频画像主要对应来源集合，源内比较揭示情感与移民差异，且关联可在不重训的新文档上保持；在互动应用中比特可优于常数基线的对数结果预测，其组合可识别与互动相关的文档内内容对比。
AI.conclusion: 二元坐标及其组合可用于经验性解释；完整激活画像提供细粒度但部分依赖初始化的描述，而非唯一离散分类体系。

title: A Bounded Evaluation Protocol for Representational Systematicity
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track
summary: Multiple studies have shown that neural networks can be behaviorally systematic, producing correct outputs for novel combinations of familiar parts. Whether they are also representationally systematic, that is, whether they represent these parts and their roles and use them to produce the outputs, remains hard to test, because each kind of evidence can mislead on its own: correct outputs can come from shortcuts, a decodable signal need not be used, an intervention can act through unintended pathways, and a failed search does not show absence. We propose a bounded evaluation protocol for representational systematicity (Bounded-RS): for an explanation that attributes a systematic behavior to a declared representation, it tests on a matched behavioral contrast whether that representation is recoverable and whether it is causally used, checks the validity of this evidence, and assigns the explanation one of four bounded states, Unsupported, Present-only, Causal-use, or Undetermined, through control-calibrated scores, gates, and stop rules. On a semantic-parsing testbed of 96 matched sets that we release, the tested role-filler Binding explanation of fine-tuned T5 models is Causal-use and the distributed Geometry explanation is Unsupported within its declared search space, verdicts that hold across calibration-compatible parameter configurations, training seeds, and T5-base. On 41 cases with known causal status, full adjudication licenses a false Causal-use in 1 of 34 noncausal cases, against 13 when recoverability is taken as use, without missing any causal case. Bounded-RS thus turns the question of representational systematicity, debated since Fodor and Pylyshyn, into comparable and falsifiable verdicts on declared explanations, each reported with the evidence pattern that licenses it and, for a negative, the search space that bounds it.

AI.tldr: 提出 Bounded-RS 评估协议，通过控制校准的分数、门控与停止规则，判定某个"声明表征"在匹配行为对比上是否可恢复、是否被因果使用，并给出四种受限状态之一，从而把表征系统性之争转化为可比较、可证伪的裁决。
AI.motivation: 神经网络行为上可能系统化，但"表征系统性"难以检验：正确输出可能来自捷径、可解码信号未必被使用、干预可能走非预期通路、搜索失败也不等于不存在，单一证据都会误导。
AI.method: Bounded-RS：针对把某种系统行为归因于某声明表征的解释，在匹配行为对比上同时检验该表征是否可恢复、是否被因果使用，并校验证据有效性；用控制校准的分数、门控和停止规则，输出 Unsupported / Present-only / Causal-use / Undetermined 四态之一；在自建的 96 组语义解析测试床上应用于微调 T5。
AI.result: 角色-填充绑定解释判为 Causal-use，分布式几何解释在其声明搜索空间内判为 Unsupported，结论跨校准兼容参数配置、训练种子与 T5-base 稳定；在 41 个已知因果状态的案例上，34 个非因果案例仅 1 例误判为 Causal-use（仅凭可恢复性则误判 13 例），且未漏掉任何因果案例。
AI.conclusion: Bounded-RS 将自 Fodor 与 Pylyshyn 以来的表征系统性争论，转为对声明解释的可比较、可证伪裁决；每个裁决附带许可其成立的证据模式，否定结论则给出界定它的搜索空间。

title: SIEVE: Preserving Cross-Image Evidence via Depth-Aware Token Compression
comment: 19 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/nitishshukla86/SIEVE
summary: Multi-image vision-language models (VLMs) incur substantial computation when processing long visual sequences. Compressing these sequences must preserve complementary evidence across images and keep tokens from different images separate. Global selection can underrepresent question-relevant images, and pruning in early decoder layers risks removing relevant content before sufficient multimodal processing, yet existing methods spend most of the budget on these early layers. We propose SIEVE, a training-free, single-pass framework that jointly allocates visual tokens across images and decoder depth. SIEVE first pools each image into a compact spatial grid to reduce early processing cost. It then progressively selects representatives using prompt attention under equal per-image quotas and aggregates unselected tokens into similar representatives from the same image. These operations keep every image represented and its tokens separate from other images, while refining the retained representations. A closed-form schedule sets retention counts to target a prescribed average token budget across decoder layers. Across four VLM backbones, SIEVE achieves the highest average at a 6.25% budget on five multi-image benchmarks and four single-image benchmarks, and the highest mean on two video benchmarks. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, it outperforms the strongest baseline by 9.96 and 9.03 points at 6.25% and 12.5% budgets, and at 12.5% it exceeds the uncompressed model by 2.01 points with 6.6x fewer prefill FLOPs.

AI.tldr: SIEVE 是一个免训练、单次前向的视觉 token 压缩框架，在多图/单图/视频任务上以 6.25% 预算达到最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 多图 VLM 处理长视觉序列计算开销大；压缩需保留跨图互补证据并保持各图 token 分离。全局选择会低估与问题相关的图像，而早期解码层剪枝会在多模态充分处理前误删相关内容，但现有方法却把大部分预算花在早期层。
AI.method: 先对每张图池化为紧凑空间网格以降低早期开销；再用 prompt attention 在每图等额配额下逐步选择代表 token，并把未选中 token 聚合同图相似代表，保证每张图都被表示且 token 不跨图混合；最后用闭式调度设定各层保留数量以命中给定平均 token 预算。
AI.result: 在四种 VLM 骨干上，五个多图与四个单图基准 6.25% 预算下取得最高平均，两个视频基准平均最优。LLaVA-OneVision-7B 上比最强基线分别高 9.96 和 9.03 分（6.25%/12.5%）；12.5% 时比未压缩模型高 2.01 分，prefill FLOPs 减少 6.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: 按图像配额分配并跨解码深度联合分配视觉 token 的免训练单次方案，能同时保证图像覆盖与 token 分离，在极低预算下优于现有压缩方法甚至未压缩模型。

title: HiGenTrans: Hierarchical LLM Knowledge Transfer for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation promises to simplify conventional multi-stage recommender systems by generating item Semantic IDs (SIDs) autoregressively. However, two obstacles limit its effective- ness in industrial settings: interaction-only supervision underuses the semantic knowledge encoded in pretrained language models, while beam-search likelihood ranks token sequences rather than directly estimating item relevance. To address these limitations, we propose HiGenTrans, a three-level framework that introduces LLM knowledge at the input, representation, and decision levels. First, Global Semantic Priming (GSP) adds an LLM-derived user representation to the beginning-of-sequence embedding, provid- ing a semantic prior before SID generation. Second, Hierarchi- cal Representation Transfer (HRT) aligns intermediate LLM representations with depth-matched GenRec layers through mean- centered projections and gated residual connections. Finally, Multi- Signal Decision Calibration (MDC) uses a lightweight mixture- of-experts calibrator to combine semantic relevance, generation confidence, and candidate-set context when reranking beam-search outputs. All semantic features are computed only from the observ- able interaction prefix, preventing target leakage, and can be cached offline. Experiments on three public benchmarks show that HiGen- Trans improves Recall@10 by up to 12.9% and NDCG@10 by up to 33.7% over the strongest baselines. These results demonstrate the value of transferring LLM knowledge at complementary stages of the generative recommendation pipeline.

AI.tldr: HiGenTrans 是一个三级生成式推荐框架，在输入、表示、决策三个层面注入 LLM 知识，缓解交互监督信息不足和 beam-search 排序与相关性不一致的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐（自回归生成 SID）存在两个工业落地障碍：一是仅用交互数据监督，浪费了预训练语言模型中的语义知识；二是 beam-search 似然只对 token 序列排序，而非直接估计物品相关性。
AI.method: 提出三级框架：1) 全局语义引导 GSP，把 LLM 导出的用户表示加到序列起始嵌入中，作为生成前的语义先验；2) 层级表示迁移 HRT，通过去均值投影与门控残差，将 LLM 中间层表示与深度对齐的 GenRec 层对齐；3) 多信号决策校准 MDC，用轻量 MoE 校准器在重排 beam-search 输出时融合语义相关性、生成置信度与候选集上下文。语义特征仅由可观测交互前缀计算以避免目标泄漏，并可离线缓存。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准上，Recall@10 最高提升 12.9%，NDCG@10 最高提升 33.7%（相对最强基线）。
AI.conclusion: 在生成式推荐流程的互补阶段迁移 LLM 知识具有明确价值，能有效提升推荐效果。

title: Jet-QSparse: Accelerating Agentic LLM Inference with 4-Bit Sparse Attention
summary: Long-horizon reasoning and agentic workloads strain KV-cache capacity and decode attention throughput. We present Jet-QSparse, a training-free method that combines compact NVFP4 cache storage with native FP4 query-key computation on Blackwell tensor cores. A dense scan scores the full key history and selects 128-token blocks for sparse FP16 value aggregation with FP32 accumulation, preserving higher precision in the output-forming step while enabling contiguous tile loads. Calibrated key centering and at most two BF16 pages per sequence and layer address quantization error; FP8 prefill uses a temporary arena while the persistent cache is packed directly from BF16 activations. Across four hybrid LLMs, a budget of 128 blocks per KV head shows no detected accuracy loss on the evaluated mathematical reasoning, coding, and agentic benchmarks, although some smaller budgets incur losses. With 64 blocks, Qwen3.8-27B achieves a $1.94\times$ end-to-end decode speedup over dense BF16 at 128K context and batch size 16 on one GB300, and the measured Qwen KV pools provide $2.58$-$2.76\times$ BF16's token capacity.

AI.tldr: Jet-QSparse：免训练方法，用NVFP4紧凑缓存+Blackwell原生FP4 QK计算，配合128-token块稀疏FP16值聚合，在128K长上下文下实现1.94×解码加速与2.58–2.76×显存容量提升，且128块预算下未见精度损失。
AI.motivation: 长程推理与智能体负载对KV-cache容量和解码注意力吞吐造成压力，需要在长上下文和大batch下同时降低显存占用与提升解码速度，且不希望重新训练模型。
AI.method: 训练无关方案：KV缓存以NVFP4存储，QK计算直接使用Blackwell张量核上的FP4；稠密扫描对全部key历史打分并选出128-token块，仅对这些块做FP16值聚合+FP32累加，保留输出形成阶段的高精度并支持连续tile加载。误差控制包括校准式key中心化、每序列每层至多两个BF16页；预填充用FP8临时arena，持久缓存直接由BF16激活打包。
AI.result: 在四个混合LLM上，每KV头128块的预算在数学推理、代码和智能体基准上未检测到精度损失（更小预算会有损失）。64块时，Qwen3.8-27B在单张GB300、128K上下文、batch 16下相对稠密BF16取得1.94×端到端解码加速；Qwen的KV池提供BF16的2.58–2.76×token容量。
AI.conclusion: FP4量化缓存与块稀疏注意力结合可在保持精度的同时显著提升长上下文解码效率和KV容量，是免训练部署的可行路径；但稀疏预算过小会带来精度风险，需按场景选择块数。

title: MemRole: From Memories to Decisions for Long-Horizon Reasoning in Role-Playing Agents
summary: LLM-based role-playing agents are fluent at imitating a character's style, yet struggle to make role-consistent decisions over long narrative horizons. Such decisions are shaped by experiences spanning many prior scenes, which are often partial and may point in different directions. Existing methods inject cross-scene memories as context, but do not reason about how past events shape a character's current motivations and behavior. We propose MemRole, a framework that makes this memory-to-decision process explicit. It introduces Long-Horizon Memory Thinking (LHMT), a reasoning schema that decomposes hidden reasoning into context understanding, memory activation, and response strategy planning, trained on a novel-derived dataset whose character-grounded, timeline-constrained memory pools limit each character to what it could plausibly know at the current narrative point. Beyond supervised fine-tuning, we propose Self-Refining On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD): the model critiques its own rollouts against the reference under a data-driven rubric, and a critique-conditioned teacher view of the same model distills token-level guidance back into the policy. MemRole-32B improves over its backbone by 15.2 points on memory-grounded role-playing, performs on par with frontier LLMs such as GPT-5.4, and achieves the best character-motivation recognition accuracy on CroSS-MR.

AI.tldr: 提出MemRole框架，通过显式的"长程记忆思考"推理模式与自精炼在线自蒸馏，使角色扮演智能体在长叙事中做出角色一致的决策，MemRole-32B在记忆驱动的角色扮演上显著提升并媲美前沿LLM。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM角色扮演智能体擅长模仿角色风格，但在长程叙事中难以做出一致的角色决策；跨多场景、部分且方向可能冲突的经历未被有效推理。已有方法仅把跨场景记忆作为上下文注入，未显式推理过去事件如何塑造角色当前动机与行为。
AI.method: 1) 提出Long-Horizon Memory Thinking（LHMT）推理模式，将隐式推理分解为上下文理解、记忆激活、回复策略规划三步；2) 构建新数据集，其记忆池以角色为依据、受时间线约束，限定角色在叙事当前节点合理可知的信息；3) 在SFT之外提出Self-Refining On-Policy Self-Distillation（SR-OPSD）：模型依据数据驱动评分标准对自己的rollout对照参考进行自我批评，再由"带批评条件的教师视角"（同一模型）将token级指导蒸馏回策略。
AI.result: MemRole-32B在其基座模型上于记忆驱动的角色扮演任务提升15.2分，性能与GPT-5.4等前沿LLM相当，并在CroSS-MR上取得最佳的角色动机识别准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆到决策的过程显式化（LHMT）并结合自精炼在线自蒸馏训练，可有效提升长程叙事中角色扮演的角色一致性；该框架在记忆驱动角色扮演与角色动机识别上均取得强表现。

title: MoRE-GS: Motion-Regime Experts for Future Gaussian Splatting
summary:
Future dynamic novel-view synthesis requires extrapolating multiple motion regimes within the same scene. A single dynamics model may not simultaneously represent stationary regions, coordinated motion, local interactions, and articulated trajectories. We introduce Motion Regime Expert Routing for Gaussian Splatting (MoRE-GS), a causal, render-aware framework for forecasting dynamic 3D Gaussian scenes. MoRE-GS freezes a Gaussian representation reconstructed exclusively from the observed temporal prefix and forecasts its control-keypoint motion using four complementary experts: persistence, a coefficient-space Transformer, a graph convolutional network, and a structured Transformer with rigid and non-rigid motion constraints. A compact routing table assigns expert mixtures across soft motion groups and forecast-horizon bins, while a persistence gate suppresses unreliable extrapolation. Across D-NeRF and HyperNeRF scenes, MoRE-GS achieves improved performance against other methods, and these results demonstrate that renderer-calibrated composition of complementary motion predictors improves causal dynamic Gaussian forecasting across heterogeneous motion regimes.
  Project page: https://advanced-vision-and-learning-lab.github.io/MoRE-GS-website/

AI.tldr: MoRE-GS 提出一种因果、渲染感知的动态3D高斯预测框架，通过四种互补运动专家（持续预测、系数空间Transformer、图卷积网络、带刚/非刚约束的结构化Transformer）的路由组合，在D-NeRF和HyperNeRF上提升异构运动场景的外推性能。
AI.motivation: 未来动态新视角合成需在同一场景内外推多种运动模式（静止区域、协同运动、局部交互、关节化轨迹），单一动力学模型难以同时表示，因此需要互补的多个预测器并进行合理组合。
AI.method: 冻结仅由已观测时间前缀重建的高斯表示，对控制关键点运动进行预测；使用四个专家：persistence、系数空间Transformer、GCN、带刚性与非刚性约束的结构化Transformer；用紧凑路由表按软运动分组与预测时域分箱分配专家混合，并用persistence门控抑制不可靠外推。
AI.result: 在D-NeRF与HyperNeRF场景上相比其他方法取得更优表现。
AI.conclusion: 经渲染器校准的互补运动预测器组合能有效改善异构运动模式下的因果动态高斯预测。

title: Compile as Hypothesis: A Headroom Typology for Prompt Optimization on Real Reasoning Models
summary: Automated prompt compilers search for or rewrite prompts under the implicit assumption that optimization consistently improves downstream task performance. We evaluate this assumption on frontier reasoning models through rigorous paired, same-day measurements. Across four optimizer families (genome search, profile-guided mutation, GEPA, and ESPO) and eight tasks, structured search yields no statistically significant accuracy gains on strong reasoners. However, a discrete structural genome provides essential architectural stability, preventing catastrophic bimodal seed-collapse (where unconstrained search collapses toward the judge floor in 3/5 runs). Through 190-problem evaluations on knowledge-intensive benchmarks, we establish a three-dimensional headroom typology: prompt optimization cannot compensate for intrinsic knowledge deficits or physical token truncation, but successfully resolves protocol and formatting errors. On gpt-6, while free-text reflective search (GEPA) yields a +.14 gain on a task where structured search remains flat, qualitative ablation reveals that ~.035 stems from judge-rubric reconstruction while ~.105 reflects genuine instruction refinement. Our pre-registered AutoAPC-Select deployment gate matches the oracle policy in 5/7 groups and rescues seed-collapse arms with zero regret. Finally, we expose silent backend-mixing in commercial APIs during outage windows and provide automated per-call audit verification tools to ensure empirical evaluation fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文用严格的同日配对测量，检验"提示优化总能提升下游任务表现"这一隐含假设，发现结构化提示搜索在强推理模型上没有显著准确率增益，并提出三维余量分类法与部署门控方法。
AI.motivation: 自动化提示编译器普遍假设优化必然带来性能提升，但这一假设缺乏严格验证。作者希望在前沿推理模型上检验该假设是否成立，并厘清提示优化究竟能解决什么问题、不能解决什么问题。
AI.method: 采用同日配对测量，覆盖四类优化器（基因组搜索、profile引导变异、GEPA、ESPO）和八个任务；使用离散结构基因组建模以维持架构稳定性；在知识密集型基准上做190题评估；对GEPA的自由文本反思搜索进行定性消融，分离评判量表重建与真实指令精炼的贡献；并预注册AutoAPC-Select部署门控，与oracle策略对比。
AI.result: 结构化搜索在强推理模型上无统计显著准确率增益；但离散结构基因组可防止灾难性双峰种子崩溃（无约束搜索在3/5次运行中向评判下限塌缩）。190题评估得出三维余量分类：提示优化无法弥补内在知识缺陷或物理token截断，但能解决协议与格式错误。在gpt-6上GEPA获得+.14增益，其中约.035来自评判量表重建，约.105来自真实指令精炼。AutoAPC-Select门控在5/7组匹配oracle策略，并以零遗憾挽救种子崩溃分支。此外还揭示商业API在故障窗口的静默后端混用问题。
AI.conclusion: 提示优化并非万能：对强推理模型，结构化搜索的准确率提升有限；其价值在于稳定搜索架构、修复协议/格式错误和做真实指令精炼。作者提出部署门控与逐调用审计工具，以保障评估保真度并规避种子崩溃与后端混用等问题。

title: Hierarchical Asynchronous Federated Learning over Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks
summary: With the emerging 6G paradigm where AI services operate over decentralized and resource-constrained edge infrastructure, performance of distributed learning algorithms remains a significant challenge. This paper proposes HAFL, a Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite-assisted hierarchical asynchronous Federated Learning (FL) framework, enabling resource-limited terrestrial clients to collaborate via Ground-Satellite Links (GSLs). Within this framework, LEO satellites serve multiple roles: as edge servers aggregating and broadcasting models, as clients accelerating training, and as high-throughput relays managing inter-satellite routing through Inter-Satellite Links (ISLs). Unlike conventional synchronous Jacobian-type updates, HAFL employs asynchronous Gauss-Seidel-type updates to enhance convergence speed. We provide theoretical convergences for convex, strongly convex, and nonconvex objectives, respectively, and formulate optimization problems to jointly determine optimal hyperparameters to minimize global training latency. Evaluations demonstrate that HAFL achieves faster initial convergence and comparable final performance for benchmark DNNs and datasets, offering promising FL systems across remote areas with 6G technologies, but much less global rounds and communication cost.

AI.tldr: HAFL：一种基于LEO卫星辅助的分层异步联邦学习框架，利用星地链路与星际链路，采用异步Gauss-Seidel式更新并联合优化超参数以最小化全局训练时延。
AI.motivation: 6G下AI服务运行于去中心化、资源受限的边缘基础设施，分布式学习算法性能仍面临挑战；偏远地区客户端资源有限且缺乏高效协同手段。
AI.method: 提出HAFL框架：LEO卫星承担边缘服务器（聚合与广播模型）、客户端（加速训练）和高吞吐中继（经ISL进行星间路由）多重角色；用异步Gauss-Seidel式更新替代传统同步Jacobian式更新以加快收敛；分别针对凸、强凸、非凸目标给出理论收敛性分析，并构建优化问题联合确定最优超参数以最小化全局训练时延。
AI.result: 在基准DNN与数据集上评估，HAFL实现更快的初期收敛和可比的最终性能，同时显著减少全局轮次与通信开销。
AI.conclusion: HAFL为6G技术下偏远地区的联邦学习提供了有前景的系统方案，兼顾收敛速度、最终精度与通信成本。

title: Shared relations, specific choices: conditional sensitivity and competing pathways in language models
summary: How does a relational representation shared across queries drive a query-specific choice? Controlled entity-binding experiments with GPT-2 Small, Qwen2.5-1.5B and Llama-3.2-1B reveal a low-dimensional relational background that is predominantly shared across query roles and transfers to new names. Same-domain interactions persist when another attribute domain is queried. After removing this component, restoring independently trained relation directions brings output contrasts closer to their original values than sign-reversed or equal-norm random controls in all three models. Yet a transferable relational representation need not have a transferable functional sign. In Qwen2.5, fixing model weights, the training-mean relation vector and edit dose yields opposite selection effects across binary and lexical-mapping prompts with different answer vocabularies. A factorial contrast of downstream sensitivities across attribute-query combinations determines the shared direction's local signed selection gain. In a separate eight-condition protocol, mean local gain is positive in Qwen2.5 and negative in Llama3.2. Late-component clamps resolve opposing pathway contributions: in Llama3.2, negative transmission through selected attention-only paths is partially offset by positive transmission through paths traversing both selected attention and MLP sets. Source-coordinate analyses establish distributed factor coverage, hidden-receiver readouts reveal layout-dependent combination, and instance-geometry interventions separate response direction from amplitude. These findings show how conditional sensitivity and competing pathways give shared relational structure its effect on specific choices.

AI.tldr: 共享的低维关系表征跨查询角色普遍存在，但其功能符号依赖查询条件与通路竞争。
AI.motivation: 探究跨查询共享的关系表征如何驱动特定查询的选择，即共享结构是否具有可迁移的功能性符号。
AI.method: 在GPT-2 Small、Qwen2.5-1.5B、Llama-3.2-1B上做受控实体绑定实验；移除共享成分后恢复独立训练的关系方向；二元与词汇映射提示对比；因子化对比下游敏感性；八条件协议与后期组件clamp分析，以及源坐标、隐藏接收端读出和实例几何干预。
AI.result: 移除共享成分后恢复关系方向可使输出对比更接近原始值；但Qwen2.5中同一关系向量与编辑剂量在二元和词汇映射提示上产生相反选择效应；本地选择增益在Qwen2.5为正、Llama3.2为负；Llama3.2中注意力通路的负向传递被注意力+MLP通路的正向传递部分抵消。
AI.conclusion: 可迁移的关系表征不一定有可迁移的功能符号；条件敏感性与竞争通路共同决定共享关系结构对具体选择的影响。

title: LF-VideoQA: Evaluating Long-Video Understanding with Long-Form Theory-of-Mind Questions
summary: The hardest part of understanding a long video is not pinpointing any one moment but synthesizing many, e.g., answering a question that requires tracking what develops across hours of content and articulating how the pieces fit together. To date, most long-video QA datasets require only a short answer or a multiple-choice selection, oversimplifying the long-video understanding task to retrieval. We introduce LF-VideoQA, a dataset for long-form, open-ended question answering over long narrative videos built on theory-of-mind questions: a character's belief depends on everything they have seen or been told, so each question demands assembling and reasoning from evidence distributed across the video. The dataset contains more than 6,300 questions on 94 recent films; each requires reasoning over scenes spanning an average of 23 minutes and comes with a question-specific rubric for recall and precision scoring. The dataset is created entirely automatically by annotating screenplays with scene events and each character's first-order beliefs and meta-beliefs, then generating (question, answer, rubric) triples through LLM-based question generation and verification; human studies validate their quality. We evaluate four families of state-of-the-art open-source VLMs across three settings and find the task highly challenging: (i) even an oracle with access to the screenplay falls well short of complete answers; (ii) the best non-oracle model attains barely half of the recall level of the oracle; (iii) unlike on prior long-video benchmarks, captions and subtitles underperform the video itself, indicating that the questions need visual evidence; and (iv) recall is the predominant bottleneck, with answers omitting many required rubric claims.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LF-VideoQA，一个基于心理理论（Theory-of-Mind）问题的长篇叙事视频开放式问答数据集（6,300+问题、94部电影），需跨平均23分钟场景整合证据；实验表明现有开源VLM表现远不及oracle，且recall是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频QA数据集多只需简短答案或选择题，把长视频理解简化为检索任务，忽视了"综合整合多时刻信息"这一真正的难点。
AI.method: 利用心理理论问题构建数据集：角色信念依赖其所见所闻的全部信息，因此每个问题都需整合全片分布式证据。全自动流程：为剧本标注场景事件及各角色的一阶信念与元信念，再由LLM生成并验证（问题, 答案, 评分标准）三元组，并提供问题专属rubric用于recall和precision评分；经人类研究验证质量。在三种设置下评测四类SOTA开源VLM。
AI.result: 任务极具挑战：(i) 即使能访问剧本的oracle也远未达到完整答案；(ii) 最佳非oracle模型recall仅约为oracle的一半；(iii) 与以往长视频基准不同，字幕和说明文本表现不如视频本身，说明问题需要视觉证据；(iv) recall是主要瓶颈，答案遗漏了大量rubric要点。
AI.conclusion: LF-VideoQA 将长视频理解从"检索式"推向"综合推理式"，揭示现有VLM在长程证据整合上的显著不足，为未来长视频开放式推理研究提供了新基准与评测框架。

title: EMG-Hybrid: A Dual-Engine Elite Memory--Guided Adaptive Optimization Framework for High-Dimensional Feature Selection
summary: Feature selection in ultra-high-dimensional, noisy datasets remains a critical challenge due to exponential search space growth, where conventional binary metaheuristics often suffer from premature convergence. To address this, EMG-Hybrid is introduced as a novel three-level hierarchical optimization architecture designed around decoupled operational planes, feedback-driven scheduling, and isolated state refinement. At Level 1, a Dual-Engine Controller monitors population Shannon entropy and empirical fitness velocity, functioning as an architectural master-switch that dynamically routes execution between global exploration and local intensification. This control loop conditions the Level 2 active optimization plane, where an Adaptive Black Hole Gravity (ABHG) execution layer performs aggressive feature manifold pruning via a distance-decoupled penalty kernel driven by fitness similarities and Hamming metrics. To structurally isolate macro-exploration from micro-exploitation, Level 3 encapsulates an autonomous Elite Memory Archive that preserves high-fidelity sub-schemas and hosts a discrete bitwise Differential Evolution (DE) micro-refinement sandbox for resolving complex parameter epistasis. Theoretically, uniform combinatorial bounds derived via Vapnik--Chervonenkis (VC) dimension criteria demonstrate that this multi-level restriction mitigates high-dimensional overfitting. Empirical results across manifolds scaling up to $d > 100{,}000$ features, complemented by high-performance computing (HPC) profiling under lock-free atomic Compare-and-Swap (CAS) primitives, indicate strong performance gains over state-of-the-art baselines. The framework exhibits near-linear parallel speedups, sub-quadratic runtime scaling, and substantial dimensionality reduction, offering a scalable and structurally innovative paradigm for large-scale data mining.

AI.tldr: 提出三级层次化优化架构EMG-Hybrid，用于超高维噪声数据集的鲁棒特征选择，通过解耦操作平面与反馈调度避免早熟收敛。
AI.motivation: 超高维噪声数据下搜索空间指数增长，传统二元元启发式算法易早熟收敛，需要一种可扩展、结构化的特征选择范式。
AI.method: 三层架构：L1双引擎控制器以种群香农熵与适应度速度作为主开关，在全局探索与局部强化间动态路由；L2自适应黑洞引力(ABHG)层用距离解耦惩罚核（基于适应度相似度与汉明距离）做特征流形剪枝；L3精英记忆档案保存高保真子模式，并以离散逐位差分进化(DE)微进化沙盒处理参数上位效应。理论上用VC维给出组合界分析。
AI.result: 在d>100,000维数据集上优于SOTA基线；HPC锁自由原子CAS剖析显示近线性并行加速、亚二次运行时间扩展与显著降维。
AI.conclusion: EMG-Hybrid为大规模数据挖掘提供了可扩展、结构创新的特征选择范式；证据主要来自摘要自述，缺少具体数值与统计检验细节。

title: ParaBlock++: Communication-Computation Parallel Blockwise Hierarchical Federated Learning
comment: A journal version extended from the published conference version
summary: In the emerging 6G paradigm, where AI-driven services operate over decentralized and resource-constrained infrastructures, the convergence of distributed learning algorithms remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces $\mathrm{ParaBlock}$++, a low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite-assisted hierarchical federated learning (HFL) framework, enabling resource-limited terrestrial clients to collaboratively engage in federated learning (FL) via ground-satellite links (GSLs) supported by LEO satellite megaconstellations. Within this architecture, LEO satellites serve multiple roles: as edge servers aggregating and broadcasting models, as clients accelerating training, and as high-throughput relays managing inter-satellite routing through inter-satellite links (ISLs). Departing from conventional synchronous Jacobian-type updates, $\mathrm{ParaBlock}$++ employs asynchronous BCD-type updates to enhance convergence speed. We provide theoretical convergence guarantees for convex, strongly convex, and non-convex objectives, and formulate optimization problems to determine optimal cluster resource allocation and model partitioning for minimizing global training latency. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that $\mathrm{ParaBlock}$++ achieves faster initial convergence and comparable final performance for deep neural networks (DNNs) such as ResNet-18, offering promising directions for federated learning across geographically remote areas enabled by 6G technologies, but much less global rounds and communication cost.

AI.tldr: ParaBlock++ 是一个基于 LEO 卫星巨型星座的分层联邦学习框架，用异步 BCD 更新替代同步 Jacobian 更新，加速收敛并降低通信开销与全局轮次。
AI.motivation: 6G 中 AI 服务运行于去中心化、资源受限的基础设施，分布式学习算法在其中的收敛仍是重大挑战；地面客户端资源有限，难以高效协同训练。
AI.method: 构建 LEO 卫星辅助的 HFL 架构：卫星同时充当边缘聚合服务器、加速训练的客户端及经 ISL 的高吞吐中继；采用异步 BCD 型更新替代同步 Jacobian 型更新，并为凸、强凸、非凸目标给出理论收敛保证；建立优化问题以求解最优簇资源分配与模型划分，最小化全局训练时延。
AI.result: 实验表明 ParaBlock++ 在 ResNet-18 等 DNN 上实现更快的初始收敛，最终性能相当，且全局轮次与通信成本大幅更少。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为 6G 赋能的地理偏远地区联邦学习提供了有前景的方向，兼顾收敛速度与通信效率。

title: LegoEnv: Self-Evolving Agentic Environments via Modular Recombination
summary: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet existing environments are designed for specific tasks and fail to generalize to new ones. Recent methods automate environment construction with LLMs. However, they generate each environment from scratch, neither reusing parts shared across environments nor carrying a fix from one environment to the rest. To address this, we propose a new paradigm of evolving environment atoms, which composes environments from reusable atoms (intent, rule, data and server) and evolves the atoms when an environment fails to give reliable feedback (e.g., an application lacks a tool the task requires). To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce LegoEnv, which builds 5,465 verified environments over 223 applications, and one round of evolution raises the share of solvable environments from 71.6% to 88.3%. On AutomationBench, SFT on these environments lifts Qwen3.6-27B from 16.0% to 32.0%, and RL with their verifiers lifts Qwen3.8-27B from 37.6% to 40.3%. Further analyses show steady gains with corpus size, transfer to unseen applications, and failures concentrated in a few shared root causes.

AI.tldr: 提出"可进化环境原子"(intent/rule/data/server)新范式,并实现 LegoEnv,构建 5,465 个可验证环境、覆盖 223 个应用。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 通过与环境交互学习,但现有环境面向特定任务设计、难以泛化;现有用 LLM 自动构建环境的方法每次从零生成,既不复用跨环境共享部件,也无法把一个环境中的修复迁移到其他环境。
AI.method: 将环境拆解为可复用的原子(意图、规则、数据、服务器),组合成环境;当环境无法给出可靠反馈(如应用缺少任务所需工具)时,对环境原子进行"进化"而非重头生成。
AI.result: LegoEnv 在 223 个应用上构建 5,465 个验证过的环境;一轮进化使可解环境占比从 71.6% 提升到 88.3%。AutomationBench 上,用这些环境做 SFT 使 Qwen3.6-27B 从 16.0% 升至 32.0%,用其验证器做 RL 使 Qwen3.8-27B 从 37.6% 升至 40.3%。
AI.conclusion: 性能随语料规模稳步提升、可迁移到未见应用,且失败集中在少数共享根因上,印证了原子化复用与进化的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Evaluating SAM-based and Convolutional Architectures in Thin Retinal Vessel Segmentation: Model Capacity, Computational Cost and Foundation Pre-training
summary: In retinal vessel segmentation, plain Vision Transformers (ViTs) are commonly expected to perform worse than convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on thin vessels, for reasons such as their coarse patch tokenization, their weak locality bias and their need for large training sets. Although this expectation is widely shared in the literature, how plain ViTs actually compare with CNNs on thin vessels has not been systematically quantified. We address this question by comparing a model with a plain ViT encoder (MedSAM), a hybrid Transformer (LiteMedSAM) and three CNNs of different sizes on three retinal datasets (DRIVE, HRF, FIVES) and, as a second-domain check, a microscopy dataset (VessMap). We measured the centerline recall and precision of thin vessels and compared the models while also considering their computational cost and how many epochs they needed to train. We found that the pre-trained MedSAM had a centerline recall of thin vessels that was not significantly different from that of the best CNN on all four datasets (-0.6 to +2.5 percentage points). A compact plain ViT obtained through architecture search but trained from scratch did not retain this performance. For pre-trained plain ViTs, our results do not support the expectation that they miss thin vessels, although similar thin-vessel performance can be obtained with much smaller models.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统量化比较了plain ViT与CNN在视网膜细血管分割上的表现，发现预训练plain ViT（MedSAM）的细血管中心线召回率与最佳CNN无显著差异，不支持"ViT漏检细血管"的普遍预期。
AI.motivation: 文献中普遍认为plain ViT因粗粒度patch tokenization、弱局部性偏置及需大数据训练而在细血管上劣于CNN，但这一预期从未被系统量化验证。
AI.method: 在DRIVE、HRF、FIVES三个视网膜数据集及显微图像数据集VessMap上，比较plain ViT编码器模型（MedSAM）、混合Transformer（LiteMedSAM）与三种不同规模CNN，测量细血管中心线召回率与精确率，并考虑计算成本与训练所需epoch数。
AI.result: 预训练MedSAM的细血管中心线召回率在四个数据集上与最佳CNN均无显著差异（-0.6至+2.5个百分点）；通过架构搜索得到但从头训练的紧凑plain ViT未能保持该性能。
AI.conclusion: 对预训练plain ViT而言，结果不支持其漏检细血管的预期；但相似细血管性能可由更小的模型实现，提示ViT的优势主要来自预训练而非架构本身。

title: CivicBench: A Benchmark and Memory Framework for Web-Based Civic Data Analytics
summary: Municipalities publish service requests, geographic boundaries, weather observations, demographic estimates, and operational guidance through independently maintained Web portals. Civic analysis must combine these sources while preserving their schemas, source links, spatial and temporal scopes, and interpretive limits. Tool-using language agents can perform this integration, but existing task benchmarks rarely test whether a computed claim remains supported by the records used. We present CivicBench, a 400-task benchmark over four cities and two years that materializes civic Web data into frozen bundles for reproducible evaluation. Executable contracts score computation, source linkage, coverage, scope, qualified answers, and refusal when the requested conclusion is not supported. We also introduce Task-State Memory (TSM), which compiles tool observations into typed assertions, reconciles records only within compatible scopes, and retrieves a bounded state organized around unresolved constraints. Across nine completed model pairs, eight yield positive mean-score differences with 95\% semantic-contract-cluster bootstrap intervals excluding zero; the ninth interval crosses zero. The benchmark and memory framework make the records behind a claim inspectable at the point of decision.

AI.tldr: 提出 CivicBench（400 任务、4 城 2 年、冻结数据包）与 Task-State Memory (TSM)，用可执行契约评估工具型语言智能体在市政数据整合中"声明是否仍被记录支持"，9 组模型中 8 组显著正向提升。
AI.motivation: 市政服务请求、地理边界、气象观测、人口估计与运营指南分散在各自独立维护的门户中，公民分析须整合这些来源同时保留 schema、来源链接、时空范围与解释边界。工具型语言智能体可做这种整合，但现有基准很少检验"计算出的结论是否仍被所用记录支持"。
AI.method: 构建 CivicBench：将市政网络数据物化为冻结数据包以保证可复现评估，覆盖四城市两年、400 个任务。采用可执行契约，对计算、来源链接、覆盖度、范围、带限定条件的回答、以及结论不被支持时的拒答进行打分。同时提出 Task-State Memory（TSM）：将工具观测编译为带类型的断言，仅在兼容范围内对齐记录，并围绕未解决约束检索有界状态。
AI.result: 在九个完整模型配对中，八个的平均分差为正且 95% 语义契约簇自助法区间不含零；第九个区间跨越零。
AI.conclusion: 该基准与记忆框架使结论背后的记录在决策时点可被审视，推动可溯源的公民数据分析。

title: Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for the Regime-Switching Consumption-Investment Problem
summary: This paper establishes an entropy-regularized reinforcement learning (ERRL) framework for the continuous-time consumption-investment problem under a regime-switching market model with general utility functions. By incorporating randomized exploratory policies and Shannon entropy regularization into the stochastic optimal control formulation, we derive closed-form representations for the optimal exploratory consumption and investment strategies. Specifically, the optimal investment strategy follows a multivariate Gaussian distribution, whereas the optimal consumption strategy takes the form of a Gibbs measure---which specializes to a Gamma distribution under logarithmic utility and a non-standard exponential distribution under power utility. Crucially, our theoretical analysis reveals that the classical deterministic optimal decisions correspond to the mode---rather than the mean---of these exploratory distributions. Furthermore, we establish the convergence of the exploratory value function to its classical unregularized counterpart as the temperature parameter vanishes. For algorithmic design, we develop a continuous-time q-learning framework grounded in a novel continuous-time q-function, prove the policy improvement theorem, and establish martingale characterizations for both on-policy and off-policy learning. We find that parameterizing the actor network based on theoretical distribution families can help accelerate convergence and enhance numerical stability. Furthermore, numerical experiments across regime-switching environments provide empirical support for our theoretical findings, demonstrating stable loss convergence as well as the monotonicity and concavity of the learned value functions.

AI.tldr: 本文在体制切换市场下构建熵正则化强化学习框架求解连续时间消费-投资问题，给出闭式探索策略与连续时间q-learning算法。
AI.motivation: 经典连续时间消费-投资问题只给出确定性最优策略，缺乏探索机制，难以与强化学习结合；需在体制切换市场与一般效用函数下引入熵正则化以刻画随机探索行为。
AI.method: 将随机探索策略与Shannon熵正则项融入随机最优控制，推导最优探索消费与投资策略的闭式表示；建立基于新连续时间q函数的q-learning框架，证明策略改进定理及on-policy/off-policy的鞅刻画，并依据理论分布族参数化actor网络。
AI.result: 最优投资服从多元高斯分布，最优消费为Gibbs测度（对数效用下为Gamma分布，幂效用下为非标准指数分布）；经典确定性最优解对应探索分布的众数而非均值；温度参数趋于零时探索值函数收敛于经典值；数值实验显示损失稳定收敛、学习值函数具单调性与凹性，理论分布参数化的actor可加速收敛并提升稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 熵正则化为连续时间消费-投资问题提供了兼具理论闭式解与可学习算法的一致框架，并揭示探索分布与经典解的众数关系。

title: Don't Guess, Ask Wisely: Benchmarking and Training Proactive Elicitation in Open-Domain LLM Conversations
summary: When user queries are incomplete, large language models should ask targeted questions before committing to an answer, a capability we call proactive elicitation, yet evaluation on real user-assistant queries across seven LLMs (8B to frontier) shows that fewer than 11% of underspecified queries trigger a follow-up question. To benchmark and train this capability, we introduce VagueBench, where each seed query is annotated with structured intent and detail units then degraded into intent-vague and fully-vague variants via controlled removal of linguistic cues, yielding known hidden information sets for evaluating both when and what to ask. We propose DialogGRPO, an offline reinforcement learning method that organizes multi-turn elicitation as a dialogue-state directed acyclic graph, where candidate questions at each node receive dense turn-level rewards combining immediate information gain with lookahead value through group-relative comparison, enabling fine-grained credit assignment without runtime simulation. DialogGRPO elicits missing information on over 88% of vague queries with substantial gains in both recovery efficiency and answer coverage, without over-asking on complete queries, outperforms prompting and test-time-scaling baselines, and generalizes zero-shot to MultiWOZ 2.4 and AmbigQA.

AI.tldr: 论文指出LLM在用户查询欠明确时很少主动追问（<11%），提出基准VagueBench（含意图模糊/完全模糊变体）与离线RL方法DialogGRPO，将多轮追问建模为对话状态DAG并做密集团体相对奖励，使88%以上模糊查询能补全缺失信息且不over-ask。
AI.motivation: 真实用户查询常不完整，模型应针对性追问（proactive elicitation）再作答，但7个8B至前沿规模LLM实测不到11%的欠明确查询会触发追问，缺乏评测与训练手段。
AI.method: 构建VagueBench：对种子查询标注结构化意图与细节单元，通过可控删除语言线索生成intent-vague与fully-vague变体，从而已知隐藏信息集，可评测"何时问"与"问什么"。提出DialogGRPO：离线强化学习，将多轮elicitation组织为对话状态DAG，每个节点候选问题获得稠密的轮级奖励（即时信息增益+通过组相对比较的lookahead价值），实现细粒度信用分配且无需运行时仿真。
AI.result: 在超过88%的模糊查询上成功引出缺失信息，信息恢复效率与答案覆盖率显著提升；对完整查询不过度追问；优于prompting与test-time scaling基线；零样本泛化到MultiWOZ 2.4与AmbigQA。
AI.conclusion: 主动追问能力当前严重不足，VagueBench提供了可量化"何时问/问什么"的基准，DialogGRPO以DAG式离线RL有效训练该能力并具备泛化性。

title: TAP-Out: Tracking Any Point in 360° via Outpainting
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. 22 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://finlay-hudson.github.io/tapout/
summary: Tracking points that leave the camera's field of view (FoV) requires reasoning about unobserved scene dynamics, a fundamentally different problem from tracking visible correspondences. We present TAP-Out, an offline method that makes this out-of-view (OOV) reasoning explicit by leveraging generative video outpainting as a world-model prior. Given a narrow-FoV input video, TAP-Out outpaints a complete 360° equirectangular video, locates target objects within the panoramic scene via video object segmentation, and synthesises object-centred perspective crops on which standard in-frame trackers operate. This decoupled design composes off-the-shelf foundation models without requiring task-specific architectural modifications. On the TAPVid360 benchmark, TAP-Out achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving OOV tracking accuracy by approximately 3x over the best prior method. We demonstrate its flexibility on out-of-frame object segmentation and detection and we provide detailed diagnostic analyses across motion regimes, static versus dynamic content, and hallucination quality, characterising when and why the approach succeeds or fails.

AI.tldr: TAP-Out 是一个离线方法，利用生成式视频外扩（outpainting）作为世界模型先验，将视野外（OOV）点跟踪显式化：先把窄视野视频外扩为360°全景视频，再用视频目标分割定位目标并生成以目标为中心的透视裁剪，交由现成的帧内跟踪器处理。
AI.motivation: 跟踪离开相机视野的点需要推理未观测到的场景动态，这与跟踪可见对应点本质不同。现有方法缺乏对这种视野外推理的显式建模。
AI.method: 解耦式流水线，组合现成基础模型、无需任务专用架构改动：1）对窄视野输入视频做生成式外扩，得到完整360°等距柱状投影视频；2）通过视频目标分割在全景场景中定位目标；3）合成以目标为中心的透视裁剪，由标准帧内跟踪器完成跟踪。
AI.result: 在 TAPVid360 基准上达到 SOTA，视野外跟踪精度较最佳先前方法提升约3倍；并在出框目标分割与检测任务上展示了灵活性；还提供了跨运动模式、静态/动态内容、幻觉质量的详细诊断分析，刻画方法的成功与失败条件。
AI.conclusion: 将 OOV 跟踪重构为"外扩-分割-再投影"的显式推理流程，借生成式世界模型先验弥补未观测区域，可在不改进基础模型的前提下显著提升 OOV 跟踪性能，并揭示了其适用边界。

title: Capacity Planning for Resource-Constrained Clinical LLM Serving
comment: Accepted to the 9th Special Session on Healthcare Data at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026)
summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) under a fixed accelerator budget requires jointly deciding how computational capacity is allocated across model sizes and how incoming requests are routed across that capacity. Although prior work has extensively studied LLM routing and serving efficiency, the relative importance of fleet composition and routing under resource constraints remains less understood. We investigate this question using a controlled four-GPU serving environment with heterogeneous clinical NLP workloads spanning short factual verification, biomedical semantic matching, and long-context clinical summarization. We systematically vary fleet composition, routing policy, and offered load while holding the workload trace and hardware budget fixed. Across 24 configurations, descriptive main-effect shares attribute more variation to fleet composition than to the evaluated routing policies in time to first token, latency, and long-context coverage. All-small fleets provide the best responsiveness and throughput but substantially lower long-context coverage, whereas larger-model capacity improves coverage at the cost of serving efficiency. Heterogeneous fleets provide intermediate operating points but can introduce strong-model bottlenecks when large-model capacity is scarce. In a focused evaluation of this bottleneck, capacity-aware routing reduces mean latency and increases throughput while incurring a small reduction in long-context coverage. Within this measured regime, the results support prioritizing capacity allocation, with routing managing demand within the provisioned capacity.

AI.tldr: 在固定4-GPU预算的受控实验中，系统比较"集群构成（模型规模分配）"与"路由策略"对LLM服务性能的影响，发现构成对TTFT、延迟和长上下文覆盖率的解释力大于路由；容量感知路由只在强模型瓶颈时起到缓解作用。
AI.motivation: 现有工作已大量研究LLM路由与服务效率，但在资源受限条件下，"计算容量如何按模型规模分配（fleet composition）"与"请求如何路由（routing）"二者的相对重要性仍不清楚。作者希望在固定硬件预算与工作负载轨迹的前提下，厘清应优先优化哪一环节。
AI.method: 构建4-GPU受控服务环境，工作负载为异构临床NLP任务（短事实核查、生物医学语义匹配、长上下文临床摘要）。系统变化三个因子：集群构成、路由策略、负载强度，同时固定工作负载轨迹与硬件预算，共24组配置；用描述性主效应份额量化各因子对TTFT、延迟、长上下文覆盖率的方差贡献，并对"强模型容量稀缺"瓶颈做专门评估。
AI.result: 24组配置中，集群构成对首token时间、延迟和长上下文覆盖率的变异解释份额高于所评测的路由策略。全小模型集群响应性与吞吐最佳，但长上下文覆盖率显著偏低；大模型容量提升覆盖率却牺牲服务效率；异构集群提供折中工作点，但在大模型容量稀缺时易形成强模型瓶颈。针对该瓶颈，容量感知路由降低平均延迟、提升吞吐，代价是覆盖率小幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 在本文所测范围内，应优先进行容量（模型规模）分配决策，路由的作用是在已配置容量内管理需求；路由优化无法弥补容量配置的结构性缺口。

title: Infinite Worlds from One Example: What Local Generators Must Share
comment: 35 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables; further results in a supplementary file (47 pages, ancillary)
summary: Seeded noise lets games generate any region of an unbounded world on demand. We ask what such a generator needs when every small window must come from one example, the constraint behind Wave Function Collapse. The difficulty is that local constraints can require agreement over arbitrary distances: in a brick wall, each row keeps its place between the mortar lines. We study local generators, each cell a fixed function of the randomness near it. When the constraints carry a quantity that varies across the example, no generator that applies one rule, ignoring position, to independent randomness at every cell can be both exactly valid and faithful to the example's statistics, however far each cell reads. At radius r, staying faithful forces forbidden windows at a density of at least order 1/r, and a construction attains this order. To vary the quantity between exactly valid worlds, a generator needs randomness shared along its direction. We give a finitely checkable condition under which row types drawn from the seed and the position modulo a fixed period suffice for exact validity without learning. A search over the example's patches certifies these quantities and names the input each needs. Across 52 public examples of Wave Function Collapse and 27 from other implementations, it certifies only examples where a learned generator on independent randomness stays far from valid after repair. Given that input, a neural cellular automaton and a diffusion model become valid on 10 and 8 of the 12 certified examples that receive one, and on none from independent randomness. Valid means at most one forbidden window in a thousand after repair. With octaves of seeded noise elsewhere, the automaton is valid on 45 of the 52 public examples and 21 of the 27 from other implementations, and repair keeps random access.

AI.tldr: 论文研究局部生成器（每格是附近随机性的固定函数）在满足局部约束（如 Wave Function Collapse 的"每个小窗口来自同一示例"）时的统计保真与精确有效性之权衡，指出携带跨示例变化量（如砖墙行相位）的约束下，忽略位置的单一规则加独立随机性无法同时做到精确有效与统计忠实，并给出共享随机性与可有限检验的充分条件。
AI.motivation: 无限世界按需生成时，希望用种子噪声局部生成任意区域，且每个小窗口都必须取自同一示例（Wave Function Collapse 约束）。但局部约束可能在任意距离上要求一致（如砖墙每行需在灰缝间保持相位），因此需要弄清：这样的局部生成器究竟需要什么条件才能既精确有效又忠实于示例统计。
AI.method: 将局部生成器形式化为每格由附近随机性决定的固定函数；理论分析半径 r 下独立随机性与位置无关单规则的极限，给出忠实性所需禁窗密度下界并构造达到该阶的方案；提出沿变化方向共享随机性的必要机制，以及一个可有限检验的充分条件（种子抽取的行类型 + 固定周期下的位置取模即可精确有效、无需学习）；用示例patches搜索来证明这些量并为各量指定所需输入；实验在 52 个公开 WFC 示例与 27 个其他实现示例上验证，并对比神经细胞自动机与扩散模型（独立随机性 vs 提供输入），以"修复后千窗至多一个禁窗"为有效标准。
AI.result: 理论上：半径 r 处保持忠实迫使禁窗密度至少为 1/r 阶，且存在达到该阶的构造；忽略位置的单规则加独立随机性不能同时精确有效与统计忠实。检验上：在示例patches上搜索仅能认证那些"学习式独立随机生成器修复后仍远不有效"的示例，共认证 12 个。实验中：给定所需输入时，神经细胞自动机与扩散模型分别在 12 个认证示例中的 10 个和 8 个上达到有效，而在独立随机性下一个都达不到；结合种子噪声倍频后，自动机在 52 个公开示例中 45 个、27 个其他实现示例中 21 个有效，且修复保持随机访问。
AI.conclusion: 局部约束中的跨距离变化量决定了独立随机性下"精确有效 + 统计忠实"不可兼得；解决之道是沿变化方向共享随机性，辅以可有限检验的条件与搜索认证来指明所需输入。实验表明提供该输入可使学习式生成器（神经细胞自动机、扩散模型）达到精确有效性，且结合倍频种子噪声可在大规模示例集上保持有效与随机访问。

title: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
summary: LLM-based agentic systems are increasingly combined with CoT reasoning to solve tasks that require accurate reasoning, external knowledge, and multi-step deliberation. Yet, explicit CoT incurs substantial generation overhead, while implicit CoT, which replaces textual rationales with compact continuous tokens, does not naturally support the explicit communication interface required for agentic tool-use. We propose TAC-CoT, a tool-empowered adaptive implicit CoT framework that replaces explicit reasoning traces with compact latent reasoning segments while retaining textual tokens only for tool calls, observations, and final answers. This interleaved design enables agentic tool-use without verbalizing every intermediate reasoning step. Experiments on agentic math and QA benchmarks show that TAC-CoT improves accuracy by up to 8.8 points while reducing model forward passes by up to 6.8x. Furthermore, analyses show that TAC-CoT improves tool-use quality in both single- and multi-tool settings.

AI.tldr: TAC-CoT：用紧凑隐式CoT片段替代显式推理文本，仅在工具调用、观察和最终答案处保留文本，实现无需逐字推理的智能体工具使用。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体结合CoT可提升推理，但显式CoT生成开销大；隐式CoT以连续token替代文本推理，却缺乏智能体工具调用所需的显式通信接口。
AI.method: 提出TAC-CoT工具赋能的自适应隐式CoT框架，将推理轨迹压缩为潜在推理片段，与工具调用、观察、最终答案的文本token交错排列，兼顾隐式推理与工具交互。
AI.result: 在智能体数学与QA基准上准确率提升最多8.8个百分点，模型前向次数最多减少6.8倍；单工具与多工具场景下工具使用质量均提升。
AI.conclusion: 隐式CoT与工具调用交错设计可同时提升准确率与工具使用质量，并显著降低生成开销，为高效智能体推理提供新思路。

title: PAM-Mamba - Efficient Dense Action Detection using Mamba
summary: Dense action detection requires precisely localising multiple overlapping actions in long untrimmed videos. Transformer-based methods achieve strong accuracy but their $O(T^2)$ self-attention cost limits scalability. We present PAM-Mamba, a linear-time $O(T)$ architecture built on Mamba with a multi-branch temporal encoder. Gated Learnable Positional Encoding (GLPE) controls positional signal injection via a scalar gate initialised to zero, starting training without added positional signal. A Hub-and-Spoke Funnel extends the non-hierarchical multi-scale design of PAT with a direct residual from the original full-resolution input to each coarse branch, providing each coarse branch with a projection of the input features. Bi-TemBa (Bidirectional Temporal Mamba) first extracts local motion cues with a shallow Temporal Convolution Module, then applies a cascaded bidirectional Mamba scan; the backward pass refines the forward-scanned representation from the opposite direction, giving each temporal position access to context from both directions in linear time. Uncertainty-Based Mixup uses prediction entropy to guide the selection of mixup partners. Using the PAT evaluation implementation, we obtain 26.82 (Charades I3D), 34.59 (Charades CLIP), 46.56 (MultiTHUMOS I3D), and 46.92 mAP (MultiTHUMOS CLIP), with 26.1-27.9M parameters, 61-63% fewer than PAT.

AI.tldr: PAM-Mamba 提出一种线性时间 O(T) 的密集动作检测架构，用多分支 Mamba 编码器替代 Transformer 的 O(T²) 自注意力，在参数减少 61-63% 的情况下取得有竞争力甚至更优的 mAP。
AI.motivation: 密集动作检测需在长未裁剪视频中精确定位多个重叠动作。Transformer 方法精度高，但自注意力 O(T²) 的计算成本限制了其在长视频上的可扩展性。
AI.method: 基于 Mamba 构建多分支时序编码器：1) GLPE 门控可学习位置编码，标量门初始化为 0，训练初期不注入位置信号；2) Hub-and-Spoke Funnel 在 PAT 非层级多尺度设计基础上，为每个粗粒度分支增加来自原始全分辨率输入的直接残差投影；3) Bi-TemBa 双向时序 Mamba，先用浅层时序卷积提取局部运动线索，再级联双向 Mamba 扫描，反向扫描从相反方向精炼前向表示，线性时间获得双向上下文；4) 基于不确定性的 Mixup，用预测熵指导 mixup 伙伴选择。
AI.result: 采用 PAT 评测实现：Charades I3D 26.82、Charades CLIP 34.59、MultiTHUMOS I3D 46.56、MultiTHUMOS CLIP 46.92 mAP；参数量 26.1-27.9M，比 PAT 少 61-63%。
AI.conclusion: PAM-Mamba 以线性复杂度 Mamba 架构替代 Transformer，在显著降低参数量的同时保持密集动作检测的强精度，验证了线性时间多分支时序编码的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Concept-Guided Prompting Strategies Increase Diversity in LLM-Generated Recipe Populations
summary: Novelty in solution generation supports automated discovery, but LLM outputs can remain repetitive. To address this, we propose a simple concept-guided prompting method that generates thematic concepts before responses within each of these concepts. To demonstrate, we generated 1,000 recipes for a recipe book task and compared the results against a human-authored corpus. Two naive prompting strategies were compared as baselines. Concept-guided prompting outperformed both baselines in all cases and reached semantic coverage of 47.0% versus 35.1% and 13.1% in respective prior-title and nonce prompt strategies. These findings suggest broader population exploration and diversity, but remain contained to this specific task. Further work is needed to determine the quality of solutions and generalizability.

AI.tldr: 提出"概念引导提示"方法：先生成主题概念再在概念引导下生成回答，以提升LLM输出的多样性；在食谱生成任务上语义覆盖率达47.0%，优于两种基线（35.1%、13.1%）。
AI.motivation: LLM用于方案生成可支撑自动发现，但输出往往重复、缺乏新颖性，需要简单可行的提示方法来提升探索广度与多样性。
AI.method: 概念引导提示（concept-guided prompting）：在每次响应前先生成主题概念，并在各概念引导下生成内容。实验生成1,000份食谱，与人类编写语料及两种朴素提示基线（prior-title、nonce prompt）比较，指标为语义覆盖率。
AI.result: 概念引导提示在所有情况下均优于两个基线，语义覆盖率达47.0%，对比prior-title的35.1%与nonce prompt的13.1%，显示更广的种群探索与多样性。
AI.conclusion: 方法有效提升生成多样性，但结论仅限于该特定任务；方案质量与可推广性仍需进一步研究。

title: Efficient Conformal Calibration for Paired Recommendation Decisions
summary: Risk control can suppress useful changes to a frozen recommendation rule. We study how to recover valid activation from the same observed fractional losses. Two specified internal calibrators can lose efficiency by compressing losses into their sum or clipping auxiliary inverse counts before averaging. We propose Averaged Conformal Risk Calibration, or ACRC, which averages before clipping. A product identity proves expected-risk validity, while pointwise bounds characterize the additional activation. For fixed populations sampled without replacement, we connect activation to signed utility under heterogeneous users and switching constraints. Near the budgets, positive population mean gain and the stated nondegeneracy conditions give positive leading-order utility increments despite sampling dependence. Across six datasets, changing only calibration improves discounted net utility by $0.010226$ over raw and $0.008337$ over RB. A separately frozen Jester confirmation gives $0.011025 \pm 0.001082$ over raw with the rule and filter fixed, using a five-seed approximate 95 percent paired interval. Against information-matched SCoRE selecting risk or reward scores, the mean utility difference is $+0.015934 \pm 0.001440$. These gains use more mean realized risk within the declared budgets. Upstream failures delimit the benefit: efficient calibration releases useful modifications when the proposals themselves have value.

AI.tldr: 提出 Averaged Conformal Risk Calibration (ACRC)：先平均再裁剪，从而从同样的分数损失中恢复被风控压制的有效激活，并证明其风险有效性及效用增益。
AI.motivation: 风险控制会压制对冻结推荐规则的有益改动。已有内部校准器（把损失压缩为其总和、或对辅助逆计数先裁剪再平均）会因效率损失而过度保守，导致有效激活被浪费。作者希望在相同的观测分数损失下，恢复更多有效激活。
AI.method: 提出 ACRC，核心是"先平均、后裁剪"的校准顺序。通过一个乘积恒等式证明期望风险有效性，并用逐点界刻画额外获得的激活量。对无放回抽样的固定总体，在异质用户与切换约束下把激活与带符号效用联系起来；在预算附近，正总体平均增益与非退化条件下给出正的一阶效用增量，尽管存在采样依赖。
AI.result: 六个数据集上仅改变校准即可使折现净效用提升：相比 raw 提升 0.010226，相比 RB 提升 0.008337。单独冻结的 Jester 确认实验（规则与过滤器固定，五种子近似 95% 配对区间）相比 raw 提升 0.011025 ± 0.001082；与信息匹配的 SCoRE（选择风险或奖励分数）相比均值效用差为 +0.015934 ± 0.001440。这些增益来自在申报预算内使用更多平均实际风险。
AI.conclusion: 高效校准能在提案本身有价值时释放有益改动，但收益受上游失败限制；ACRC 以平均后裁剪的方式在预算内换取更优效用。

title: Tracing How Language Models Integrate Temporal Anchors into Factual Recall
summary: Factual recall in language models is typically framed as retrieving a factual association: a subject--relation pair maps to a single object. However, many facts are context-dependent: the same pair maps to different objects depending on a condition such as time. We introduce anchored factual recall, in which the model receives an explicit conditioning expression, an anchor, and must select the object valid under it. This raises questions that single-object recall does not: where the anchor enters the computation, what it changes, and how that change selects the answer. Focusing on temporal anchors, we answer them with causal interventions on four open-weight models on English prompts and identify two routes. In a subject-mediated route, the anchor resolves the final subject-token representation to the queried year, and the relation redistributes the readout of this state across attention heads. In a direct route] the final position attends to the anchor, and upper-layer MLPs turn this signal into a preference for the time-appropriate object. The two routes are parallel channels: their contributions add up, most queries use both, and their balance depends on the query, e.g., on the relation, consistently across models. This reframes mechanistic accounts of factual recall from retrieving a single stored object to selecting among context-dependent alternatives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"锚定事实回忆"任务：模型需根据显式条件（锚，如时间）选择在该条件下成立的对象，并通过因果干预识别出两条并行机制路径。
AI.motivation: 传统观点把事实回忆视为"主语-关系→单一客体"的检索，但许多事实是条件依赖的（同一对主语-关系在不同时间对应不同客体），现有单客体框架无法解释这种条件选择过程。
AI.method: 在四个开源权重模型上用英文提示做因果干预（如激活/消融），定位锚信息进入计算的位置、改变了什么、以及如何据此选定答案。
AI.result: 发现两条路径：(1) 主语介导路径——锚把最终主语token表示解析为所问年份，关系通过注意力头重新分配该状态的读出；(2) 直接路径——最终位置直接关注锚，上层MLP把该信号转为对时间相符客体的偏好。二者为并行通道，贡献相加，多数查询同时使用，且两者比重随查询（如关系类型）变化，跨模型一致。
AI.conclusion: 将事实回忆的机制解释从"检索单一存储客体"重构为"在条件依赖的备选之间做选择"。

title: Spoofing the Latent State: Imperceptible Goal-Image Attacks Derail Planning in LeWorldModel
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) have recently emerged as general-purpose visual world models for control. A prominent example is LeWorldModel (LeWM), which trains end-to-end from pixels using an isotropic Gaussian anti-collapse regularizer (SIGReg) and plans by minimizing the squared Euclidean distance between predicted and goal embeddings. In this work, we investigate the test-time robustness of this latent planning interface. Analyzing the learned metric on Push-T, we first find that task-relevant object state heavily dominates latent distance: shifting the block by a single pixel displaces the embedding $3\times$ further than an equivalent agent shift, and swapping the block pose alone accounts for $99\%$ of the distance between scene pairs. However, because this pose information is distributed across a curved, high-dimensional manifold rather than a fixed linear subspace, the encoder cannot be trivially edited post-hoc to isolate or redirect it. We next demonstrate that this geometry is highly vulnerable at test time. A white-box $\ell_\infty$ perturbation of just $ε{=}4/255$ applied to a single input frame causes the encoder to register the block at an arbitrary, attacker-chosen pose in $73$--$95\%$ of scenes without disturbing the encoded agent state. Perturbing either the goal image or the live camera observation drops Push-T planning success from $87\%$ to $32\%$, whereas uniform random noise at twice the magnitude has negligible impact. This vulnerability persists across all four standard LeWM benchmarks (Push-T, Two-Room, Reacher, and OGBench-Cube). At $ε{=}8/255$, the attack bridges $82$--$97\%$ of the squared latent distance to the target embedding in every environment, inducing planning degradation proportional to each task's reliance on the spoofed entity.

AI.tldr: 研究LeWorldModel(JEPA类视觉世界模型)在测试时的鲁棒性。发现潜空间中目标物状态主导距离，但分布于弯曲高维流形难以编辑；单帧ε=4/255白盒扰动即可任意伪造物块位姿，使Push-T成功率从87%降至32%，并在四个基准上一致存在。
AI.motivation: JEPA类视觉世界模型已作为通用控制世界模型流行，其规划依赖潜空间中的欧氏距离。作者希望检验这一潜空间规划接口在测试时是否稳健，即这种距离度量是否可被对抗扰动操纵。
AI.method: 分析Push-T上学到的潜度量（单像素位移、位姿交换的贡献）；指出位姿信息分布在弯曲高维流形上故无法事后线性编辑；在单帧图像上施加ε=4/255的ℓ∞白盒扰动，可令编码器把物块登记为攻击者指定的位姿；扰动目标图或实时观测图，并与两倍幅度均匀随机噪声对照；在Push-T、Two-Room、Reacher、OGBench-Cube四个基准上验证。
AI.result: 物块位移1像素造成的嵌入位移是智能体等效位移的3倍，位姿交换解释场景对间99%距离；ε=4/255扰动在73–95%场景中伪造任意物块位姿而不影响编码的智能体状态；Push-T规划成功率从87%降至32%，而两倍幅度随机噪声影响可忽略；在ε=8/255时，攻击在全部四环境桥接82–97%的平方潜距离到目标嵌入，规划退化与任务对该伪造实体的依赖程度成正比。
AI.conclusion: JEPA式潜空间规划接口对微小对抗扰动高度脆弱，且该脆弱性跨基准普遍存在。由于位姿的弯曲高维表示难以直接编辑，需要从训练或架构层面提升潜几何的鲁棒性，而非事后修补。

title: On Sparse Graph Limits for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Graph neural networks are often trained on small graphs and deployed on larger ones, raising the question of which graph information must be preserved for combinatorial optimization values to transfer across sizes. We establish size-transfer guarantees for normalized graph optimization values using finite collections of energy features. For affine objectives, including MAX-CUT, coloring defect, and independent-set density, differences in task value are controlled by discrepancies in normalized scalar energy probes on all bounded-degree graphs. For general Lipschitz objectives, such as those with balance penalties, an additional representation error appears; this error vanishes on hyperfinite graph families but can remain bounded away from zero on expanders. Thus, at fixed degree bound, state space, Lipschitz constant, and target accuracy, a finite energy representation independent of graph size suffices universally for affine tasks and asymptotically for general Lipschitz tasks on hyperfinite families. These results yield prediction guarantees under explicit conditions on encoder accuracy, readout stability, and representation coverage, together with statistical generalization bounds. Theoretically, we prove Shapley-Folkman bounds with sharp parameter dependence, including a dimension-free $\ell_2$ regime, and realize the resulting energy features with a fixed-weight message-passing network using random node initialization on bounded-treewidth graphs. Experiments with exact solvers and trained models test the resulting transfer guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文建立图神经网络的"尺寸迁移"理论保证：用有限个能量特征即可在度数有界图上控制归一化组合优化值的跨尺寸差异，仿射目标（如MAX-CUT）可普适迁移，一般Lipschitz目标在超有限图上渐近迁移、在扩张图上则可能失效。
AI.motivation: GNN常在小子图上训练却部署到大图上，需要明确哪些图信息必须保留才能让组合优化值随尺寸迁移。论文要回答：固定度数上界、状态空间、Lipschitz常数与目标精度时，是否存在不依赖于图规模的有限表示可保证迁移。
AI.method: 以有限个归一化标量能量探针（energy features）刻画图；对仿射目标（MAX-CUT、着色缺陷、独立集密度）用能量探针的偏差控制任务值差异；对一般Lipschitz目标引入额外表示误差项；证明具尖锐参数依赖的Shapley-Folkman界（含无维数依赖的ℓ₂情形）；用固定权重消息传递网络加随机节点初始化在有界树宽图上实现能量特征。
AI.result: 仿射任务在度数有界图上由与规模无关的有限能量表示普适保证迁移；一般Lipschitz任务仅在超有限图族上渐近成立，在扩张图上表示误差可保持有界远离零。给出显式编码器精度、读出稳定性、表示覆盖度条件下的预测保证及统计泛化界；并用精确求解器与训练模型实验验证迁移界。
AI.conclusion: 尺寸迁移可行性取决于目标类型与图族结构：仿射目标可通用，一般Lipschitz目标需超有限性假设。有限能量特征与可证明的Shapley-Folkman界为GNN跨尺寸部署提供了理论与实证基础。

title: Towards Self-Evolving Narrative Systems: Real-Time Adaptation and Long-Term Optimization with LLMs
comment: Under review at the ACL Rolling Review (ARR) October 2026 cycle
summary: Traditional interactive narrative systems offer strong authorial control and structural coherence but often restrict player agency. In contrast, LLM-driven narratives enable open-ended generation and greater flexibility, yet frequently suffer from inconsistency and diminished narrative control. To navigate this trade-off, we propose a hybrid narrative framework that dynamically balances pre-authored content with real-time LLM generation via semantic similarity alignment. Additionally, sustaining narrative quality over extended gameplay remains a core challenge in LLM-based storytelling. To address this, we introduce a self-evolving, feedback-driven optimization framework that leverages in-context learning to iteratively refine prompts, eliminating the need for manual prompt engineering. Through a case study and participant-based evaluation, we show that our framework enhances narrative coherence while preserving player agency, effectively aligning generated content with both authorial intent and evolving player behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合叙事框架，用语义相似度对齐动态平衡预写内容与实时LLM生成，并引入基于上下文学习的自演化反馈优化机制自动精炼提示词，在提升叙事连贯性的同时保留玩家能动性。
AI.motivation: 传统交互叙事系统作者控制强、结构连贯，但限制玩家能动性；LLM驱动的叙事开放灵活，却常出现不一致、叙事控制减弱。同时，LLM讲故事在长时间游玩中维持质量困难，且需大量人工提示词工程。
AI.method: 1) 混合叙事框架：通过语义相似度对齐动态平衡预写内容与实时生成；2) 自演化反馈驱动的优化框架：利用上下文学习迭代精炼提示词，无需人工提示工程；3) 案例研究与参与者评估。
AI.result: 案例研究和用户评估表明，框架在保留玩家能动性的同时增强了叙事连贯性，生成内容能有效对齐作者意图与不断变化的玩家行为。
AI.conclusion: 混合与自演化反馈机制可有效缓解作者控制与玩家自由度之间的权衡，并为长时LLM叙事质量维持提供可行方案。

title: Real-VAS: a Real-World Video Amodal Segmentation Dataset
comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://finlay-hudson.github.io/real_vas
summary: Amodal video object segmentation is fundamentally limited by the absence of datasets that combine real-world complexity with precise ground-truth annotations. To address this, we present Real Video Amodal Segmentation (Real-VAS), a new large-scale, zero-shot evaluation dataset built from composited real-image video. We introduce a novel data generation pipeline that enables the creation of programmatically consistent amodal ground truth for real-world footage, in which the object mask, occlusion boundary, and composited image are all derived from a single unoccluded source, without relying on human estimation or expensive 3D reconstruction. Our dataset is structured into two challenging scenarios: dynamic Occlusion, created by compositing two clips of moving objects, and a unique Container category featuring complex, physically constrained interactions. These container scenarios--On Surface Containment, Articulated Containment, and Mobile Containment--allow us to generate precise ground truth by simulating an object's motion based on its container's tracked transformation. As a result, Real-VAS provides a diverse and challenging benchmark for evaluating amodal segmentation models on realistic video with the precision of synthetic data. The dataset and our generation code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 Real-VAS，一个基于真实图像合成视频的大规模零样本评估数据集，通过新颖数据生成流程获得程序化一致的 amodal 真值，覆盖动态遮挡与三类容器包含场景。
AI.motivation: Amodal 视频目标分割缺乏兼具真实世界复杂度与精确真值标注的数据集。
AI.method: 构建由真实图像合成的视频数据集，设计生成流水线：对象掩码、遮挡边界与合成图像均源自同一未遮挡源，无需人工估计或昂贵3D重建；分为动态遮挡（合成两段运动物体片段）与容器包含（表面包含、铰接包含、移动包含），通过容器跟踪变换模拟物体运动以生成精确真值。
AI.result: Real-VAS 提供了多样且具挑战性的基准，可在真实视频上以合成数据级别的精度评估 amodal 分割模型。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集与生成代码将公开，填补真实复杂场景下 amodal 视频分割评测的空白。

title: What Do LLM Judges Actually Verify? Matched Controls and Record Gaps for Document Currency
comment: 37 pages, 6 figures, including a 13-page supplementary case study. Code, data and all judge replies: https://github.com/unnatibshah/what-do-llm-judges-verify
summary: LLM judges often check, against an amendment record, whether the documents an answer cites are still in force. Such records are rarely complete. From a table of replacements, our test generates matched answers citing a replaced document, its successor, the replaced document before its replacement, and an older document that a newer one updated without replacing; it removes links from the record and scores each finding by its stated reason. On 48 replacements from the IETF RFC index, judges given a correct record caught nearly every replaced citation, as a lookup would. On the 24 faults whose link we removed, every judge caught more from the texts alone than with the record: Gemini 3.1 Pro 23/24 against 1/24, GPT-5.5 23/24 against 9/24, Claude Opus 4.5 17/24 against 9/24 and Gemma 4 26B 13/24 against 0/24. The drop recurred on a second draw of removed links. Most misses carried no finding; in an exploratory run with a conflict code, only Gemini used it often. Rewording the gap as "no replacement recorded" did not help; presenting the record as an unverified note, or warning that it was incomplete, restored most lost catches for Gemini, GPT-5.5 and Claude (significant after correction for the first two) but at most 5 of 13 for Gemma; where catches returned, so did false alarms on updates. With both texts, judges mostly told replacements from updates; every update flagged had a near-identical title. A descriptive case study on Indian rooftop-solar rules is appended; we release the harness.
