AI.tldr: 研究表明，LLM 评审在核对引用文件是否仍有效时，若被给到不完整的"替代记录"，反而会比只读文本时漏掉更多失效引用；把记录标注为"未核实/不完整"可恢复大部分损失，但代价是误报增加。
AI.motivation: LLM judge 常用修正/替代记录表核对被引文件是否仍然生效，但现实中这类记录很少完整，缺链会误导评审而非帮助评审。
AI.method: 从替换表中构造配对测试集：被替换文件、其继承者、替换前的旧文件、以及被更新但未被替换的更老文件；人为移除记录中的链，按所述理由对每条判定打分。基于 IETF RFC 索引的 48 条替换，并在第二次抽样的缺链上复现；另加"冲突码"探索性实验与记录表述方式（未核实注记、不完整警告）干预实验。
AI.result: 记录正确时，评审几乎能抓全被替换引用（如查表）。缺链的 24 个故障上，纯文本均优于带记录：Gemini 3.1 Pro 23/24 vs 1/24，GPT-5.5 23/24 vs 9/24，Claude Opus 4.5 17/24 vs 9/24，Gemma 4 26B 13/24 vs 0/24；该下降在第二次抽样重复出现。多数漏判是无任何标识；冲突码仅 Gemini 常用。改述为"未记录替代"无效；将记录标为未核实注记或警告不完整可恢复 Gemini、GPT-5.5、Claude 的大部分漏判（前两者校正后显著），Gemma 最多恢复 5/13，且恢复时更新类误报也随之回归。文本齐全时多数能区分替换与更新，被误报的更新标题几乎相同。
AI.conclusion: 不完整的替代记录会使 LLM 评审显著漏检失效引用，属"记录即缺省信任"的失败模式；措辞上的警告可部分缓解但引入误报，且对弱模型无效。附带印度屋顶光伏规则案例研究，并开源评测工具。

title: Synergetic Autonomous Intelligence: Three Axioms for Recursive Semi-Closed Learning
summary: We introduce Synergetic Autonomous Intelligence (SAI), a theory and design program for learning systems that form, preserve, revise, and compose relations while continuing to learn. SAI is built on three axioms: consequential distinctions must not become orphaned (U); identity is determined by future-faithful continuation under a declared contract (I); and unresolved defects are repaired by the least lawful local completion at the lowest admitted grade (L). We model a model, agent, tool, team, or environment boundary as a recursive semi-closed system with a Kernel-Ring representation, a Compile-Open-Participate cycle, and a typed residual comparing actual with claimed continuation. Under explicit finite or affine contracts, we establish relative consistency and conditional non-redundancy of U/I/L, characterize a contract-relative semantic quotient, construct an exact joint stochastic refinement, derive a constrained residual contraction, prove finite-horizon continued-service viability, and give an executed-intervention identification result with an observational-confounding boundary. We define GRC-Close as the generative and repair schema for this contract. The framework also gives finite contracts for action-effect-feedback loop re-entry, partial failure, duplicate-effect idempotency, replay, concurrent delivery, causal uncertainty, and threshold-radix state representation. KREIT, the Kernel-Ring Equilibrium Information Theory layer, treats information as a typed, resource-bounded distinction; the control layer authorizes, executes, audits, and updates actions across cloud-edge-end scales. These results establish a common contract-level vocabulary for representation, relation, memory, action, communication, explanation, coordination, and growth, while marking the assumptions and open boundaries required for later generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出"协同自主智能"(SAI)理论与设计纲领,以U/I/L三条公理与Kernel-Ring表示刻画能持续学习并形成、保持、修订、组合关系的学习系统,给出若干一致性、可行性与识别性定理。
AI.motivation: 现有学习系统难以在持续学习的同时稳定保持并修订关系,缺乏统一的契约级语言来同时描述表示、关系、记忆、行动、通信与协调。
AI.method: 以递归半封闭系统建模模型/智能体/工具/团队/环境边界,采用Kernel-Ring表示、Compile-Open-Participate循环与类型化残差(比较实际与声称的延续)。基于三条公理:U(有后果的区分不可被孤立)、I(身份由声明契约下的"忠于未来的延续"决定)、L(未解缺陷以最低许可等级的最小合法局部补全修复);并定义GRC-Close修复模式与KREIT信息论层。
AI.result: 在有限或仿射契约下证明:U/I/L的相对一致性与条件非冗余;刻画契约相对语义商;构造精确联合随机细化;导出受限残差收缩;证明有限时域持续服务可行性;给出带观测混淆边界的执行干预识别结果。并为动作-效果-反馈回入、部分失败、重复效应幂等、重放、并发投递、因果不确定性与阈值-基数状态表示给出有限契约。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为表示、关系、记忆、行动、通信、解释、协调与成长建立了共同的契约级词汇,同时明确指出后续推广所需的假设与开放边界。

title: Better Answers, Weaker Evidence Control: Evidence Bypass in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) can improve answer accuracy while weakening responsiveness to supporting evidence. We investigate this separation in scientific-document question answering through matched document interventions that change the supported answer while preserving the question and unrelated context. We identify evidence bypass: a student retains an originally correct answer after the document changes to support a different one. On QASPER with a Qwen3-4B student, standard OPD raises original-document accuracy by 3.4 percentage points, lowers counterfactual accuracy by 5.3 points, and increases bypass by 15.7 points; the same directional pattern appears on PeerQA. Controlled perturbations localize the shift to answer-critical evidence, and bypass grows with the student's pre-distillation closed-book preference for the original answer. A factorized study of teacher targets, privileged information, divergence, and supervision density finds that explicitly supplying the teacher with annotated answer-critical spans yields the largest joint improvement in evidence response and claim support. These findings motivate Evidence-Paired OPD (EP-OPD), which combines on-policy supervision on matched documents supporting different answers to the same question with an answer-level margin that favors each document's supported answer over its paired alternative. Across both datasets and two student sizes, EP-OPD recovers 54-66% of standard OPD's counterfactual-accuracy loss while preserving 80-85% of its original-document accuracy gain. Our results establish evidence responsiveness as a distinct training and evaluation target alongside answer accuracy. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/RuoranXu/EP-OPD.

AI.tldr: On-policy distillation (OPD) 在提升答案准确率的同时会削弱模型对支持证据的响应能力，作者将其称为"证据绕过"（evidence bypass），并提出 EP-OPD 方法在保留准确率增益的同时恢复证据响应性。
AI.motivation: 现有 OPD 能提高答案准确率，却使学生对支撑证据的敏感性下降。作者希望厘清"准确率提升"与"证据响应"之间的分离现象，并将其作为独立训练与评估目标。
AI.method: 在科学文档问答（QASPER、PeerQA）上采用匹配文档干预：改变文档中以支持不同答案，同时保持问题与无关上下文不变，从而度量证据绕过。随后进行因子化研究，考察教师目标、特权信息、散度与监督密度。基于结论提出 EP-OPD：在支持同一问题不同答案的匹配文档上做 on-policy 监督，并加入答案级 margin，使模型偏好每份文档所支持的答案而非其配对替代答案。
AI.result: Qwen3-4B 学生上，标准 OPD 使原文档准确率 +3.4 个百分点、反事实准确率 −5.3 个百分点、绕过率 +15.7 个百分点；PeerQA 呈相同方向。绕过随学生蒸馏前闭卷偏好原答案的程度而增强。向教师显式提供标注的答案关键跨度可带来证据响应与主张支持的最大联合提升。EP-OPD 在两个数据集与两种学生规模下恢复标准 OPD 反事实准确率损失的 54–66%，并保留原文档准确率增益的 80–85%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明证据响应性应作为与答案准确率并列的独立训练和评估目标；EP-OPD 提供了一种兼顾两者的可行方案。代码已开源。

title: PRISM-Net: Dynamic Routing Network with VLM-Guided Disentangled Attribute Distillation for Explainable Fine-Grained Product Retrieval
summary: Fine-grained visual product retrieval in large-scale e-commerce multimedia systems demands discriminative representations capable of simultaneously resolving macro-level category semantics and micro-level visual attributes such as structural contour (line) and chromatic appearance (color). However, conventional backbones including convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision Transformers (ViTs) inherently suffer from feature entanglement and shortcut learning. To learn the micro-level visual attributes without costly manual attribute annotations, we propose phase-routed interpretable semantic mixture-of-experts network (PRISM-Net), an explainable multi-expert architecture that disentangles holistic visual features into disentangled line and color expert pathways governed by a conditional meta-router. In phase 1, we introduce an external VLM-Guided sigmoid semantic distillation mechanism with gradient-detached routing gates, utilizing zero-shot text prompts from SigLIP to supervise specialized structural and chromatic experts. In phase 2, the disentangled expert embeddings are adaptively fused with macro base features via a learned meta-router gate to calibrate category boundaries. Extensive 5-fold cross-validation across 275,454 e-commerce images (18 categories) and full-scale retrieval benchmarks (55,091 queries against a 220,363-image gallery) across SwinV2, ConvNeXt-V2, and DINOv3 demonstrate substantial gains. On SwinV2, PRISM-Net boosts full-fold product mAP@10 from 80.98% to 83.90% (+2.92%), line mAP@10 by +5.74%, and color mAP@10 by +9.12%. Furthermore, unsupervised distribution analysis of the meta-router gate reveals that both ViT and CNN backbones emergently allocate up to 6.8x higher structural line weights to rigid appliances and hardware while dedicating >96% chromatic weight to clothing.

AI.tldr: 提出PRISM-Net，用VLM引导的语义蒸馏把视觉特征解耦为"线条(轮廓)"与"颜色"两个专家通路，再由元路由器与宏观类别特征融合，在电商检索任务上显著提升mAP。
AI.motivation: 大规模电商细粒度商品检索需要同时处理类别级宏观语义与线条、颜色等微观视觉属性，但CNN/ViT骨干存在特征纠缠与捷径学习问题；而人工属性标注成本高昂，难以直接监督微观属性。
AI.method: 提出可解释的混合专家架构PRISM-Net。第一阶段：用SigLIP零样本文本提示作为监督信号，通过外部VLM引导的sigmoid语义蒸馏与梯度截断路由门，训练专门的结构(线条)与颜色专家；第二阶段：用可学习元路由器门控将解耦专家嵌入与宏观基础特征自适应融合，以校准类别边界。
AI.result: 在275,454张电商图像(18类)、5折交叉验证及全量检索基准(55,091查询 vs 220,363图库)上，跨SwinV2、ConvNeXt-V2、DINOv3均有明显提升。SwinV2上全折产品mAP@10由80.98%升至83.90%(+2.92%)，线条mAP@10 +5.74%，颜色mAP@10 +9.12%。元路由器门分布分析显示：ViT与CNN骨干均自发生成结构线条权重偏向刚性家电/五金(最高6.8倍)，而颜色权重超96%集中于服装。
AI.conclusion: PRISM-Net以无需人工属性标注的方式实现了可解释的属性解耦检索，既提升细粒度检索精度，又使路由权重呈现与人类直觉一致的语义分配，验证了特征解耦与VLM语义蒸馏在电商检索中的有效性。

title: Are Fake Citations a Form of Reward Hacking? A Pre-Registered Study of Post-Training and Citation Cues
comment: 49 pages, 3 figures, 20 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/citation-reward-hacking (archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23845528)
summary: Post-trained language models fabricate citations at high rates. We ask whether that is reward hacking: scoring well on a proxy for scholarship while doing worse on what it stands for. We ran four pre-registered experiments on 900 frozen questions (US federal case law, computationally adjacent scientific literature, and medical literature) across twelve open-weights checkpoints covering four post-training stages of three model families, then refit on fifteen. The clearest result holds the weights fixed and changes only the prompt. Asking for citations raises fabrication sharply in post-trained checkpoints and not in base ones: a 47.8-point interaction on twelve checkpoints (Holm-adjusted p = 2e-34) and 41.5 points on fifteen, in all three domains. A length-matched control separates the citation cue from a demand for a longer answer, so the effect is specific to citations, not verbosity. Post-training also raises fabrication overall, from 4.8% to 56.7%, but our registered prediction that it would rise most where fabrication is most tempting did not hold. A preference model trained only on surface citation features prefers post-trained output 86% of the time, and holding citation count fixed shows it rewards quantity. Our answer: possibly, but not proven. Post-trained models produce fabricated citations at far higher rates when asked for sources, and a naive evaluator that counts sources without checking them would prefer their output for citing more. But the targeted pattern we registered did not appear, and plain instruction-following could explain the same results. Proving that the reward causes fabrication needs an experiment that changes the reward during training, which this study does not do. Pre-registration: doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/S53HY. Code and data: https://github.com/zainnab-sparq/citation-reward-hacking

AI.tldr: 论文探究后训练模型高比例伪造引用是否为"奖励黑客"：固定权重仅改提示即造成伪造率剧增（12个检查点+47.8点，15个+41.5点），表面引用特征的偏好模型86%偏好后训练输出，但预注册的"最易诱惑处最严重"模式未出现，故结论为"可能但未证实"。
AI.motivation: 后训练语言模型在学术引用上伪造率很高，作者想检验这是否属于奖励黑客——即在"学术性"的代理指标上得分高，却在指标真正代表的实质上做得更差。
AI.method: 四个预注册实验，900道冻结问题（美国联邦判例法、计算相关科学文献、医学文献），三个模型家族四个后训练阶段的12个开放权重检查点（后在15个上重拟合）。核心设计为固定权重、仅改变提示；并设长度匹配对照以区分引用线索与"要求更长答案"；另训练一个仅用表面引用特征的偏好模型。
AI.result: 要求引用使后训练检查点伪造率急剧上升而基座模型不升：12检查点交互效应47.8点（Holm校正p=2e-34），15检查点41.5点，三个领域均成立；长度匹配对照表明效应特异地来自引用而非冗长。后训练整体将伪造率从4.8%升至56.7%，但"伪造最诱人处上升最多"的注册预测未成立。仅用表面引用特征训练的偏好模型86%偏好后训练输出，固定引用数量后显示其奖励数量。
AI.conclusion: 结论为"可能是奖励黑客，但未被证明"：后训练模型在被要求来源时伪造率远高，且计数而不核验来源的朴素评估器会因其引用更多而偏好其输出；但注册的定向模式未出现，普通指令遵循也能解释相同结果。证明奖励导致伪造需在训练中改变奖励的实验，本研究未做。

title: Change the Funnel, Not Who May Submit: Engineering Peer Review for the Flood
summary:
Every reviewer knows the feeling: more papers each cycle, three full reviews for each of them, and a suspicion that near the accept line the outcome is luck. The numbers bear it out. NeurIPS received 30,709 submissions in 2026, more than three times as many as in 2021, and reviewing them took some 184,000 expert hours, or 92 years of researchers' time. Three-quarters of those hours went to papers that were rejected. And when NeurIPS twice had the same papers reviewed by two committees, the second rejected half of what the first accepted.
  Conferences are responding by limiting who may submit. We simulated that answer, and an alternative, in a model calibrated to the NeurIPS experiments. The limits save little and select no better, and those based on a past acceptance fall mostly on new authors. The alternative changes how papers are judged, spending full reads only where a decision turns on them. In a staged funnel, an automated quality check first turns back papers that are not ready. The rest are ranked by their value, from short summaries, by readers that each submission brings. Only the finalists get a full read, which checks their claims and settles the final ranking. The staged funnel needs a little over half of today's expert hours, accepts 95.5% of papers in the top 3-10% (against 74% today), and makes nearly every top-0.5% paper a spotlight or oral. And because every paper brings its own reader, the funnel keeps pace with the flood.

AI.tldr: 论文指出会议评审资源严重超载且结果随机性大，通过建模比较"限制投稿"与"分阶段漏斗评审"两种方案，发现后者更省时且遴选更准。
AI.motivation: NeurIPS投稿量三倍增长、审稿耗时巨大且大部分用于被拒稿件；同一批论文两次评审结论不一致，说明近录取线的结果近乎靠运气。会议方以限制投稿资格应对，但该做法是否有效存疑。
AI.method: 以NeurIPS两次评审实验为依据校准仿真模型，对比两种方案：限制投稿（尤其基于过往录取记录）与分阶段漏斗——先自动质量筛查淘汰未成熟稿件，再由每条投稿自带的"读者"基于短摘要按价值排序，仅对入围者进行全文精读以核实声明并确定最终排名。
AI.result: 限制投稿节省甚微且遴选质量无提升，其影响主要落在新作者身上；分阶段漏斗仅需约一半多一点的专家工时，对前3–10%论文的接收率达95.5%（现为74%），几乎使所有前0.5%论文获得spotlight或oral，且因每篇自带读者而可随投稿洪水扩展。
AI.conclusion: 问题根源在于"如何评判论文"而非"谁可以投稿"；改变评审流程的分阶段漏斗在效率与准确性上均优于限制投稿，是更可扩展的评审方案。

title: TrackMem: Tracking Evolving Beliefs in Long-Horizon Financial Dialogue
summary: Memory systems for LLM agents are evaluated mostly on social dialogue, where facts accumulate and rarely change, so remembering reduces largely to finding the turn in which something was said. Financial dialogue breaks this assumption: figures are revised, stances shift without being restated, rules stated once govern later questions, and a single company is discussed under several analytical lenses. Memory systems that retrieve the passages most similar to a question, or the most recent ones, therefore return superseded values, miss rules that share no wording with the question, and cannot recover a stance spread across sessions. We present TrackMem, a per-speaker graph memory that tracks the history of figures, separates perspectives by entity and lens, and preserves each speaker's actions in chronological order. To evaluate it, we introduce FinLoCoMo, a benchmark of 15 long-horizon investment conversations with 765 questions in two splits: one following the LoCoMo categories and one targeting four failure modes. With two readers, TrackMem outperforms existing memory systems on both splits. On the failure-mode split it reaches 73.9% macro accuracy against 69.4% for the strongest baseline, with the largest gains on questions about revised figures (86.5% against 73.4%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrackMem（按说话人构建的图记忆，追踪数值历史、按实体与视角分离、按时序保留行为）与金融长程对话基准FinLoCoMo（15段对话、765问，含LoCoMo类别分片与四类失败模式分片），在两种读者下均优于现有记忆系统，失败模式分片宏平均73.9%对最强基线69.4%，修订数值类问题86.5%对73.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统多在社交对话上评测，事实累积且很少变更，记忆≈检索"某句话出现在哪一轮"；金融对话则不然：数字被修订、立场改变却不重述、规则只说一次却约束后续、同一公司多视角讨论。基于相似度或新近度的检索因此会返回作废数值、漏掉无字面重合的规则、无法跨会话还原立场。
AI.method: 提出TrackMem：按说话人组织的图记忆结构，追踪数值（figures）的历史演变、按实体与分析视角（lens）分离观点、并按时间顺序保留每位说话人的行为。同时构建FinLoCoMo评测基准：15段长程投资对话、共765个问题，分两个子集——一个沿用LoCoMo问题类别，一个针对上述四类失败模式。
AI.result: 在两种读者模型下，TrackMem在两个分片上均优于现有记忆系统；失败模式分片宏平均准确率73.9% vs 最强基线69.4%，其中修订数值类问题提升最大（86.5% vs 73.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 金融对话揭示了相似度/新近度检索假设的失效，凸显"时序版本化+视角分离+跨会话立场追踪"对记忆系统的必要性；TrackMem与FinLoCoMo为该方向提供了方法与评测基础。

title: Spatial Uncertainty Analytics for Budget-Limited Inspection of Hyperspectral Scenes
summary: Land-cover maps classified from wide-area hyperspectral surveys are least reliable along class boundaries and in ambiguous regions, so their errors are spatially structured. We study how this structure can direct a limited verification budget: when a low-altitude UAV or a ground crew can visit only a handful of sites, where it should go depends on how classifier uncertainty is arranged across the scene and how a fixed sensor footprint tiles that arrangement. We estimate a per-pixel uncertainty surface from the disagreement of an ensemble of spectral classifiers and select sites by greedy, field-of-view-aware coverage of the uncertainty mass. On seven benchmark scenes, the highest-uncertainty decile of pixels is 2.6 to 7.9 times richer in errors than the scene as a whole, and the coverage greedy covers up to 57% of the classifier's errors with 15 sites, 1.7 to 18 times as many as uncertainty-agnostic sampling of the same labelled region. A non-overlapping selection of the footprints richest in uncertainty does equally well, so the gain comes from scoring whole footprints by uncertainty mass. The advantage persists under spatially blocked evaluation and with a spectral-spatial classifier, although disagreement then ranks errors less well. It requires restricting the surface to labelled land cover: over the whole scene, disagreement peaks on unlabelled ground, where inspections cannot be scored. The best policy for covering connected high-uncertainty regions depends on the scene and on the threshold that defines them, and Gaussian-process selection covers less uncertainty than the coverage greedy on every scene. The pipeline runs on commodity CPUs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何用有限的验证预算（UAV或地面人员只能访问少数站点）优先检查高光谱土地覆盖分类中最可能的错误区域。方法是用分类器集成的不一致度构建逐像素不确定性面，并以视场感知的贪心覆盖选点。实验显示最高不确定性十分位像素的错误富集达2.6–7.9倍，15个站点可覆盖最多57%的分类错误，显著优于不确定性无关采样。
AI.motivation: 广域高光谱调查得到的土地覆盖图在类别边界和模糊区域最不可靠，误差具有空间结构。实际中验证预算极其有限（低空UAV或地面人员只能访问少数站点），因此需要知道该去哪里验证，而这取决于分类器不确定性在场景中的分布方式以及固定传感器足迹如何覆盖该分布。
AI.method: 用一组光谱分类器的预测不一致度估计逐像素不确定性面；以贪心方式、考虑传感器视场（footprint）对不确定性质量进行覆盖式站点选择；与不确定性无关采样、非重叠高不确定足迹选择、高斯过程选择等策略对比；并在空间分块评估和光谱-空间分类器下验证稳健性。
AI.result: 在七个基准场景上，最高不确定性十分位像素的错误率是整体场景的2.6–7.9倍；15个站点可覆盖最多57%的分类错误，是同标记区域内不确定性无关采样的1.7–18倍。非重叠选取不确定性最富集的足迹效果相当，说明增益来自按不确定性质量对整块足迹打分。优势在空间分块评估和光谱-空间分类器下仍存在（尽管此时不一致度对错误的排序能力下降）。该方法要求不确定性面限制在已标记土地覆盖上：整场景中不一致度峰值出现在无标签地面。最佳覆盖连通高不确定区域的策略依场景和阈值而定，高斯过程选择在各场景均不如覆盖贪心。流程可在普通CPU上运行。
AI.conclusion: 分类误差的空间结构可以被转化为验证选点策略：基于集成不一致度与视场感知的贪心覆盖能以极少的站点高效命中分类错误，且计算成本低、可实用部署；但其有效性依赖于将不确定性面约束在有标签土地覆盖上，且最优策略需依场景与阈值调整。

title: Urban functional knowledge transfer through global representations amid uneven data
summary: Urban functional observations are unevenly distributed worldwide, limiting analysis of how places are organised and used. AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) provides a globally consistent physical representation. Whether this representation can support transfer of functional knowledge to locations with sparse or absent functional observations, and what governs transfer, remain unclear. We introduce POI-aligned Urban Embedding (PURE), which learns physical-functional relationships between POI-derived semantics and AEF. Across five urban analysis tasks covering 142 countries and territories, PURE increases mean $R^2$ from 0.792 to 0.830, with gains across widely different levels of POI availability. When target-city POIs are excluded, country-level alignment retains 87.9% of its performance gain. Cross-country experiments show that transfer is selective rather than universal, with larger gains between physically similar and geographically closer contexts, particularly among pairs within the same continent. Our findings reveal spatially structured urban functional knowledge transfer, offering a route to reduce reliance on dense local observations.

AI.tldr: 提出PURE模型，将POI语义与AlphaEarth Foundations物理表征对齐，实现城市功能知识的跨区域迁移，在142个国家/地区的五项任务上提升效果。
AI.motivation: 全球城市功能观测（如POI）分布不均，限制了城市空间组织与使用方式的普适分析；而AEF提供的全球一致物理表征是否能承载功能知识的迁移、以及迁移由什么决定，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建POI对齐的城市嵌入（PURE）：学习POI派生语义与AEF物理表征之间的物理—功能映射关系；在五项城市分析任务、142个国家/地区上验证，并做剔除目标城市POI的消融与跨国家迁移实验。
AI.result: 平均R²从0.792提升至0.830，且在POI稀疏程度差异较大的地区均有增益；排除目标城市POI后，国家级对齐仍保留87.9%的性能增益；跨国迁移具有选择性——物理相似、地理邻近（尤其同大洲）的配对增益更大。
AI.conclusion: 城市功能知识呈现空间结构化的可迁移性，为减少对密集本地观测的依赖提供了可行路径。

title: Multi-Turn Semantic Caching for Low-Cost LLM Serving
summary: Semantic caching lowers the cost of serving large language models (LLMs) by reusing stored responses for similar requests. In multi-turn conversations, whether a cached response is acceptable depends on both conversations' histories, which embedding similarity of requests and histories predicts poorly (AUC 0.62--0.74 on five workloads). We therefore learn the \emph{reuse risk}, the probability that a cached response is unacceptable, from judge feedback, and choose a budgeted set of conversation states to cache by weighing the generation cost a reuse avoids against a price for unacceptable reuse. We propose CUCB-SC-MT, which learns a cache from logged conversations with a suboptimality guarantee, and CLCB-LS-MT, which learns online and has $\tilde O(\sqrt N)$ regret over $N$ requests when conversation states recur. On math-tutoring (SocraTeach) and movie-ticketing (Taskmaster-3) conversations, both achieve lower loss than prior semantic caching approaches: ContextCache, multi-turn variants of ElastiCache and vCache, and single-turn semantic caching at every cache budget. With 1,000 cache entries, CLCB-LS-MT avoids 35--41\% of the generation cost through acceptable reuses, against at most 22--25\% for the baselines, and lowers estimated serving latency by 19--35\%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向多轮对话的语义缓存方法，通过从评判反馈中学习"复用风险"（缓存响应不可接受的概率），以预算约束方式选择要缓存的对话状态，给出理论保证，并在两类任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 语义缓存可降低LLM服务成本，但在多轮对话中，缓存响应是否可用依���两段对话历史而定，而请求与历史的嵌入相似度预测能力很差（五个工作负载AUC仅0.62–0.74），因此需要新的决策依据。
AI.method: 将缓存选择建模为在生成成本节省与不可接受复用代价之间权衡的预算化选点问题；用评判反馈学习复用风险；提出离线算法CUCB-SC-MT（带次优性保证）与在线算法CLCB-LS-MT（状态复现时具Õ(√N)遗憾）。
AI.result: 在SocraTeach数学辅导与Taskmaster-3电影购票对话上，两种方法在所有缓存预算下损失均低于ContextCache、ElastiCache/vCache多轮变体及单轮语义缓存；1000条缓存时CLCB-LS-MT以可接受复用节省35–41%生成成本（基线至多22–25%），估计服务延迟降低19–35%。
AI.conclusion: 以学习到的复用风险替代嵌入相似度作为多轮语义缓存的判据，可在保证理论性能的同时显著提升成本与延迟收益。

title: Retrieval-Enhanced Cultural Evaluation for Social Media Translation Training
summary: Social media translation requires preserving meaning while capturing the cultural nuances of user-generated content (UGC). However, gaps in the cultural knowledge of LLM-based evaluators can lead to inaccurate assessments and unreliable training rewards. To improve these signals, we use retrieval-enhanced cultural evaluation to train CUE-MT, a family of social media translation models. A calibrated, domain-specific Judger guides supervised data refinement and is augmented by an Agent for hard-example mining and reinforcement learning. The Agent retrieves relevant external evidence as needed and distills it into concise hints that the Judger uses to score translations and assign rewards. Across 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B backbones, CUE-MT outperforms the evaluated open-source baselines of comparable size on CUE-MT-Bench and three public benchmarks. Human evaluation on CUE-MT-Bench shows cultural effectiveness gains of 7.44-15.12 percentage points over the strongest external baseline in each size group. Retrieval improves the Judger's four-way classification accuracy by 8.07 percentage points over a matched no-retrieval baseline that uses LLM-generated hints alone. Training ablations further support the combination of hard-example mining and Agent-enhanced rewards.

AI.tldr: CUE-MT：用检索增强的文化评估（Judger+Agent）指导监督数据精炼与强化学习，训练社交媒体翻译模型，在9B/27B/35B-A3B规模上优于同类开源基线，人工评估文化有效性提升7.44–15.12个百分点。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体翻译需保留语义并捕捉UGC的文化细微差异，但基于LLM的评估器缺乏文化知识，导致评估不准、训练奖励不可靠。
AI.method: 提出检索增强的文化评估：校准的领域专用Judger指导监督数据精炼；Agent按需检索外部证据并蒸馏为简洁提示，供Judger打分与分配奖励，用于困难样本挖掘和强化学习。
AI.result: 在9B、27B、35B-A3B骨干上，CUE-MT在CUE-MT-Bench及三个公开基准上优于同规模开源基线；人工评估文化有效性提升7.44–15.12个百分点；检索使Judger四分类准确率提升8.07个百分点；消融支持困难样本挖掘与Agent增强奖励的组合。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强的文化评估能有效提升评估器准确性与翻译模型的文化有效性，是改进社交媒体翻译训练信号的有效方案。

title: A Straight Line Is Not a Camera Pose: Auditing Short-Clip Pose Benchmarks
comment: 34 pages (8-page main text and appendix), 7 figures, 21 tables
summary: The absolute trajectory error (ATE) is the standard measure of camera-motion accuracy, from SLAM to feed-forward 3D reconstruction. On the common Sintel protocol, a constant-velocity straight line using no images has a lower mean ATE than 10 of 11 recent models re-run with official code. Two properties of ATE's alignment explain this. First, it maps any constant-velocity prediction onto the best-fitting line through the true path, so the line scores the path's regression residual. A residual signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) criterion predicts when moving a prediction towards its constant-velocity fit lowers ATE. It gives the outcome for 95% of 1056 model-clip pairs, 98% of 792 held-out pairs and 97% of 1034 ScanNet pairs, and it separates Sintel (median SNR 0.86) from TUM, ScanNet and full-length Bonn and Wild-SLAM (2.7 to 27), where straightening raises every model's mean ATE. Second, position-only alignment ignores where cameras look: rotating a trajectory by 30 degrees against its orientations leaves ATE unchanged, yet worsens the reprojection of static points for every model on Sintel, TUM and ScanNet in the main setting, and the line, second by mean ATE on Sintel, places them worst by geometric mean: a lower ATE need not mean better geometry. Fitting the alignment's rotation to the predicted orientations gives pose-anchored ATE, a one-function change in ATE's units costing 0.17 ms per clip (ATE: 0.11 ms). It ranks every image-free reference below every model on Sintel, tracks the reprojection error under rotation and straightening, where ATE does not (Spearman 0.61 vs. 0.32), largely preserves the models' order, and ties 10-frame translational relative pose error (RPE) and the discernible trajectory error (DTE) on our rotation and reference tests. Code, predictions and results will be released.

AI.tldr: ATE在Sintel上会把无图像的匀速直线预测排到11个近期模型中的10个之上；作者用信噪比准则解释该现象，并提出姿态锚定的ATE（PA-ATE）修正。
AI.motivation: ATE是SLAM和3D重建中相机运动精度的标准指标，但在Sintel协议下，一个不使用任何图像的匀速直线基线却比多数先进模型得分更好，说明ATE本身可能失效。作者希望解释ATE为何会被“直线化”预测欺骗，并给出能反映真实几何质量的替代度量。
AI.method: 分析ATE的相似变换对齐的两个性质：（1）它把任意匀速预测映射到穿过真实轨迹的最佳拟合直线上，因此直线得分等于路径的回归残差；提出残差信噪比（SNR）准则来预测“向匀速拟合靠拢是否降低ATE”。（2）仅位置对齐忽略了相机朝向，作者把对齐中的旋转拟合到预测姿态上，定义为姿态锚定的ATE（PA-ATE），每次片段仅增加约0.17 ms开销。
AI.result: SNR准则正确预测95%的1056个模型-片段对的结论，在792个留出对和1034个ScanNet对上分别达到98%和97%，并区分Sintel（SNR中位数0.86）与TUM/ScanNet/Bonn/Wild-SLAM（2.7–27）；把轨迹旋转30°后ATE不变，但重投影误差在所有模型上都变差；PA-ATE把Sintel上所有无图像基线排在所有模型之后，在旋转和直线化扰动下能跟踪重投影误差（Spearman 0.61 vs 0.32），基本保持模型排序，并与10帧平移相对位姿误差和DTE持平。
AI.conclusion: 较低的ATE并不代表更好的几何质量，ATE对匀速直线预测和朝向误差都不敏感。建议在Sintel等协议中采用PA-ATE或结合重投影误差评估，同时公开代码与预测结果。

title: Large language models underrepresent malice and overreport virtue
comment: 41 pages, 5 figures, 5 Extended Data figures, 2 Extended Data tables; Supplementary Information included
summary: People increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to interpret others' behaviour, often assuming that LLMs infer motives as humans do. Aligned LLMs attribute more benevolent and less malevolent motives to a whistleblower than humans do, but ratings alone cannot reveal whether these differences arise in internal representations or at report. Here we compare linear-probe readouts of LLMs' internal states with their own ratings at the same prompt position for four motives, in two preregistered studies. For the two malevolent motives, self-interest and intent to harm, internal and expressed readouts did not differ: the lower ratings reflect weaker signal along the probed directions, not suppression at output. For the two benevolent motives, duty and concern for others, expressed ratings exceeded the internal readouts, indicating amplification at report. In free text the model rarely volunteered a motive against the colleague, far less often than humans did, yet produced one readily once the scenario supplied a reason. Shifting the internal representation along a malevolent-motive direction brought both malevolent ratings to the human level, whereas the rating of duty yielded only past a threshold at which the other motives had overshot. LLMs' more charitable motive profile thus has two distinct sources: reduced malevolent signal in the probed representation and amplified benevolent attribution at report.

AI.tldr: 通过对比LLM内部线性探针读数与其在同一位置的自我评分，发现LLM对告密者更"仁慈"的动机归因来自两个不同来源：恶意动机的内部信号本身较弱，而善意动机在报告阶段被放大。
AI.motivation: 人们越来越多地用LLM解读他人行为，并默认LLM与人类一样推断动机。已有研究发现对齐后的LLM比人类更倾向于认为告密者动机善良、较少恶意，但仅凭评分无法判断这一差异源于内部表征还是输出报告阶段。
AI.method: 两项预注册研究；针对四种动机（自私、伤害意图、责任、对他人的关心），在同一提示位置比较LLM内部状态的线性探针读数与其自身评分；辅以自由文本分析与内部表征干预（沿恶意动机方向移动表征）。
AI.result: 两种恶意动机（自私、伤害意图）的内部读数与表达读数无差异，较低评分源于探针方向上的信号较弱而非输出抑制；两种善意动机（责任、关心他人）的表达评分高于内部读数，表明在报告阶段被放大。自由文本中模型很少主动提出不利于同事的动机（远少于人类），但一旦情境提供理由便能轻易产生。沿恶意动机方向移动内部表征可将两项恶意评分提升至人类水平；而责任评分需越过一个阈值才出现，此时其他动机已过度偏移。
AI.conclusion: LLM更仁慈的动机画像有两个独立来源：探针表征中恶意信号减弱，以及报告阶段善意归因被放大；仅凭评分不足以揭示这种差异。

title: Scute: Exact Batched Serving for PEFT Adapters Beyond LoRA
summary: Existing serving systems for large language models batch requests for many different LoRA adapters on one GPU. However, these systems reject adapters from other parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods such as DoRA, (IA), VeRA and OFT. One solution to this is to convert these adapters to LoRA, but this induces a significant memory and accuracy cost. Instead, we show that, under some modifications, a batched LoRA kernel can serve all of these methods exactly and efficiently. We achieve this by writing each method in one normal form, a LoRA computation with six slots for an adapter's own vectors and matrices. Some slots can merge into an adapter's weights at load time; the others remain live and induce a cost. We give ways to efficiently pay this cost and predict it from a zero-parameter byte model. We package this system, Scute, and build it on top of vLLM. Scute serves all five methods, coming as checkpoints from the Hugging Face PEFT library, in one batch, and it matches that library with a mean error of at most 1.5% of each adapter's effect. Under a burst of requests on an RTX A6000, a mix of these methods takes 5-17% more decode time than the same number of LoRA adapters. Furthermore, using Scute, the same GPU can serve 64 to 1024 (IA) and VeRA adapters at 1.5x to at least 2.5x the request rate of their LoRA conversions.

AI.tldr: Scute 通过把 DoRA、(IA)³、VeRA、OFT 等 PEFT 方法统一写成一种"六槽位 LoRA 正规形式"，在 vLLM 上用同一个批处理 LoRA 内核精确高效地服务全部五种适配器，无需转换为 LoRA。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 服务系统只能在一张 GPU 上批处理 LoRA 适配器，会拒绝 DoRA、(IA)³、VeRA、OFT 等其他 PEFT 方法；而将其转换为 LoRA 又会带来显著的内存与精度损失。
AI.method: 将每种 PEFT 方法重写为统一的"正规形式"——带六个槽位（存放适配器自身的向量和矩阵）的 LoRA 计算。部分槽位可在加载时合并进权重；其余保持活跃并产生计算开销。论文给出高效支付该开销的方法，并用零参数字节模型预测开销。系统 Scute 构建于 vLLM 上。
AI.result: Scute 将来自 Hugging Face PEFT 库的全部五种方法放入同一批次服务，与 PEFT 库的平均误差不超过每个适配器效果的 1.5%。在 RTX A6000 上的突发请求下，混合方法的解码时间仅比同数量 LoRA 适配器多 5–17%；同一 GPU 上可服务 64 至 1024 个 (IA)³ 与 VeRA 适配器，请求速率为其 LoRA 转换版本的 1.5 倍至至少 2.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 在少量修改下，批处理 LoRA 内核即可精确、高效地服务多种 PEFT 方法，兼顾精度、内存与吞吐，实现多方法统一批处理服务。

title: MedPsy: State-of-the-Art Small Medical Language Models for Efficient Edge Deployment
summary: Medical language models promise expert clinical support, but the strongest open-source LLMs remain too large for private edge-device deployment, while compact medical models still trail substantially on knowledge-intensive and real-world healthcare tasks. Reasoning models that fit edge memory budgets can produce long reasoning traces, increasing sequential decoding, end-to-end latency, energy consumption, and KV-cache memory pressure. We present MedPsy, a family of text-only 1.7B and 4B medical language models designed for edge deployment, targeting this accuracy-generation-efficiency trade-off. Our recipe combines a synthetic medical data pipeline over biology, medicine, and health seeds with chain-of-thought targets from a 235B medical-focused LLM teacher; a four-stage post-training curriculum comprising two SFT stages followed by two RL stages with hard-sample mining; and an edge deployment evaluation spanning multiple GGUF quantization variants and real-device inference on laptop and smartphone hardware. On seven closed-ended medical benchmarks, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-1.5-4B by 19.34 points and matches MedGemma-27B while being 6.75x smaller; MedPsy-1.7B outperforms MedGemma-1.5-4B by 11.42 points despite being less than half its size. On HealthBench-Hard, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-27B by 15.33 points, while MedPsy-1.7B surpasses it by 11.66 points despite being ~16x smaller. Beyond accuracy, MedPsy reduces average response length by 1.7x (1.7B) and 3.2x (4B) versus its Qwen3 backbones, while Q4_K_M quantization preserves the aggregate score within 1 point of BF16 with ~69% lower disk footprint. In real-device inference, MedPsy-4B's shorter generations translate into 75% lower median end-to-end latency and estimated energy per answer than its Qwen3 backbone at matched quantization, while peak RAM remains below 5 GB across our tested laptop and smartphone configurations.

AI.tldr: MedPsy is a family of 1.7B and 4B text-only medical LLMs for edge deployment, combining synthetic medical data with CoT distillation from a 235B teacher and a four-stage SFT+RL curriculum; it outperforms larger medical models while cutting response length, latency, energy, and memory.
AI.motivation: Strong open-source LLMs are too large for private edge deployment, while compact medical models lag on knowledge-intensive and real-world healthcare tasks; reasoning models that fit edge memory budgets produce long traces, inflating sequential decoding, latency, energy use, and KV-cache pressure. The goal is to balance accuracy, generation length, and efficiency.
AI.method: A synthetic medical data pipeline over biology, medicine, and health seeds with chain-of-thought targets from a 235B medical-focused LLM teacher; a four-stage post-training curriculum (two SFT stages followed by two RL stages with hard-sample mining); and an edge deployment evaluation across multiple GGUF quantization variants with real-device inference on laptop and smartphone hardware.
AI.result: On seven closed-ended medical benchmarks, MedPsy-4B beats MedGemma-1.5-4B by 19.34 points and matches MedGemma-27B while being 6.75x smaller; MedPsy-1.7B beats MedGemma-1.5-4B by 11.42 points at under half its size. On HealthBench-Hard, MedPsy-4B surpasses MedGemma-27B by 15.33 points and MedPsy-1.7B by 11.66 points despite ~16x smaller size. Response length is reduced 1.7x (1.7B) and 3.2x (4B) versus Qwen3 backbones; Q4_K_M quantization stays within 1 point of BF16 with ~69% lower disk footprint; real-device inference shows 75% lower median latency and energy per answer, with peak RAM under 5 GB.
AI.conclusion: Compact, edge-deployable medical LLMs can match or exceed much larger medical models when trained with distilled CoT data and a staged SFT+RL curriculum, while simultaneously delivering substantially shorter generations, lower latency, lower energy consumption, and reduced memory footprint on consumer laptop and smartphone hardware.

title: Selecting or Solving? What Best-of-N Verification Delivers in Video Reasoning
summary: Answering a complex question about a long video is a grounding problem: the answer turns on a few seconds of evidence, and vision-language models remain well below human accuracy at finding them. The standard way to spend extra test-time compute on this kind of video reasoning is best-of-N selection: sample several chain-of-thought answers from a fixed model, then let a second model re-watch the video and pick one. Such pipelines are reported by a single headline number, their margin over a majority vote. That number conflates two effects with opposite deployment consequences: the benefit the second model adds by selecting among candidates, and the benefit it would have supplied by solving the question itself. We separate them, measuring the Selection Increment (SI) -- selection accuracy minus the same verifier's accuracy with the candidates withheld -- alongside the margin over self-consistency, across five long-video benchmarks. The Selection Increment is largest for the weakest verifiers: a verifier that solves poorly on its own leaves the candidates the most room to help. Beating the majority vote follows the opposite profile: where the vote already sits near its ceiling no verifier we test improves on it; below that ceiling only the strongest do. On Video-Holmes, the two come apart on a single pool of candidates -- a weak verifier gains +19.3 points from the candidates yet lands 7.1 points below the vote, while the frontier verifier gains the least and beats the vote. The weakest verifier also shows a failure mode: on EgoSchema it picks by where an option sits in the list rather than by what the video shows. Read as a merit score, SI puts a verifier that fails to beat a majority vote at the top of its ranking; read as an audit, it says which of the two effects a headline number delivers. Code is available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/best-n-selection-video-reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文拆解best-of-N视频推理中验证器头条指标（相对多数投票的边际），提出Selection Increment（SI）以分离"选择增益"与"独立解题能力"两种效应。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答本质是grounding问题，答案常取决于几秒证据。当前用额外测试时计算的标准做法是best-of-N：采样多条链式思维答案，再由第二模型重看视频挑选。但这类流水线仅报告单一头条数字——相对多数投票的边际——它混淆了两种后果相反的效应：验证器"在候选中选择"，以及它"自己解题"的能力。
AI.method: 将两效应分离，定义Selection Increment（SI）= 选择准确率 − 同一验证器在不提供候选时的准确率；并在五个长视频基准上同时测量相对self-consistency多数投票的边际。
AI.result: SI在最弱验证器上最大——自解能力差者给候选留出最多帮助空间；而跑赢多数投票的画像相反：投票接近上限时无验证器能改善，低于上限时仅最强验证器能赢。Video-Holmes上同一候选池两指标背离：弱验证器借候选得+19.3点却仍低于投票7.1点，前沿验证器增益最少却胜出。最弱验证器还暴露失败模式：在EgoSchema上按选项位置而非视频内容选择。
AI.conclusion: 若当作merit score，SI会把未能击败多数投票的验证器排到第一；若当作audit，它能说明头条数字究竟交付了哪种效应。建议以SI配合投票边际共同评估验证器。

title: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Task-Free Federated Continual Forecasting via Two-Tier Replay under Concept Drift
comment: Peer-reviewed and accepted for presentation at the AGCS 2026 conference
summary: Federated time-series forecasting is increasingly important in applications where temporal data are distributed across privacy-sensitive clients, such as environmental monitoring, smart cities, and industrial sensing. A central limitation of current continual-learning protocols is that they usually assume predefined task boundaries, whereas deployed forecasting systems receive an uninterrupted stream and must decide autonomously when adaptation is necessary. This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in task-free federated forecasting under concept drift. We introduce a drift-aware continual-learning protocol in which each client monitors prediction-window RMSE, calibrates a robust median threshold from the offline base period, and triggers adaptation only after persistent degradation. To mitigate forgetting, we propose a TwoTierReplay mechanism that separates fixed offline representative memory from online memory. The offline tier preserves long-term knowledge learned during the base phase, while the online tier captures recent distributional changes after drift. Experiments on the Beijing Multi-Site Air- Quality dataset with 12 clients, three forecasting targets, and three horizons show that TwoTierReplay achieves the best stability-plasticity score in all nine target-horizon configurations. It improves over the strongest baseline by approximately 11.4%. These results suggest that explicit temporal structuring of replay memory is a practical and effective mechanism for task-free federated continual forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出无任务边界、基于漂移触发的联邦持续预测协议，并用两层回放（离线固定+在线更新）缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦持续学习协议假设任务边界预定义，而实际部署的预测系统接收连续数据流，需自主判断何时适配；同时存在概念漂移下的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.method: 每个客户端监控预测窗口RMSE，从离线基期校准鲁棒中位数阈值，仅在性能持续退化后才触发适配；提出TwoTierReplay：离线层保存基期代表性记忆以维持长期知识，在线层捕获漂移后的近期分布变化。
AI.result: 在Beijing Multi-Site Air-Quality数据集（12客户端、3个预测目标、3个预测步长）上，TwoTierReplay在全部9种目标-步长配置中取得最佳稳定性-可塑性得分，较最强基线提升约11.4%。
AI.conclusion: 显式地对回放记忆进行时间结构划分，是无任务边界联邦持续预测中一种实用有效的机制。

title: Scaling Makes It Possible: How Large Models Master Impossible Languages
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, including 6 pages of supplementary information
summary: While language models (LMs) excel in natural language tasks, their ability to learn impossible languages--those that violate the structural, cognitive, or logical constraints that make human languages learnable and functional--remains debatable. This controversy is further fueled by a divide between linguistic theorists and empirical researchers working with small-scale LMs. To address this controversy, we introduce semantic coherence. This concept measures how effectively semantic information is expressed in language structures and examines the learning capabilities of LMs across multiple scales. By fine-tuning billion-parameter LMs on impossible language samples, we demonstrate that larger LMs achieve similar performance on impossible and possible languages, whereas million-parameter LMs exhibit significant degradation when trained on impossible languages. This performance gap widens as semantic complexity increases. We further show that scaling up the LM size fundamentally shifts the learning focus from grammatical rules to semantic understanding, with billion-scale LMs exhibiting a threefold reduction in sensitivity to low-level linguistic perturbations while maintaining stable performance under high-level semantic perturbations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"语义连贯性"概念，通过在不同规模LM上微调"不可能语言"，发现十亿参数级模型在可能/不可能语言上表现相近，而百万参数级模型在不可能语言上显著下降，且差距随语义复杂度增大。
AI.motivation: 关于LM能否学习违反结构/认知/逻辑约束的"不可能语言"存在争议，且该争议因语言理论家与使用小规模LM的实证研究者之间的分歧而加剧。
AI.method: 引入"语义连贯性"概念衡量语义信息在语言结构中的表达效果；在不可能语言样本上微调从百万到十亿参数的多规模LM，比较可能/不可能语言表现及对不同层级语言扰动（低层与高层语义）的敏感度。
AI.result: 十亿参数LM在不可能与可能语言上表现相近；百万参数LM在不可能语言上显著退化；差距随语义复杂度增大而扩大；规模扩大使学习重点从语法规则转向语义理解，十亿级LM对低层语言扰动敏感度降低约三倍，同时在高层次语义扰动下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: LM规模扩大从根本上改变学习重点（从语法规则到语义理解），大规模LM能以语义连贯性弥补不可能语言的结构缺陷，为语言学习能力争议提供了跨尺度的实证证据。

title: SASFormer: Stage-Aware Selective Attention Transformer for All-in-One Blind Image Restoration
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology
summary: All-in-one image restoration aims to recover high-quality images from multiple degradation types using a single unified model. Recent methods improve unified restoration with hybrid attention, prompt learning, or routing mechanisms, but generally focus on enhancing degradation adaptivity while employing similar feature modeling strategies across network stages. Consequently, the distinct representation requirements of encoding and decoding under diverse degradations remain insufficiently explored. In this paper, we propose SASFormer, a Stage-Aware Selective Attention Transformer for all-in-one blind image restoration. SASFormer follows a stage-aware design principle: the encoder uses established hybrid channel-spatial attention to build robust content-preserving and degradation-aware representations, while the decoder employs adaptive selective attention for restoration-oriented reconstruction. To address the stage-specific requirements of decoder reconstruction, we develop Adaptive Selective Channel Self-Attention (ASCSA) and Adaptive Selective Spatial Self-Attention (ASSSA), enabling the decoder to dynamically identify restoration-relevant channel responses and spatial contexts. Specifically, ASCSA performs adaptive query-channel selection and attention masking, while ASSSA adaptively integrates spatial attention across multiple window sizes. Compact implicit prompts further modulate the selection process without requiring explicit degradation labels. Extensive experiments on 3-, 5-, and 11-degradation settings demonstrate that SASFormer achieves strong restoration performance with favorable parameter efficiency. Moreover, stage-wise representation analysis and ablation studies provide empirical support for the proposed stage-aware design and the effectiveness of decoder-side adaptive selection.

AI.tldr: 提出SASFormer，一种阶段感知选择性注意力Transformer，用于一体化盲图像复原：编码器用混合通道-空间注意力保留内容并感知退化，解码器用自适应选择性注意力（ASCSA/ASSSA）面向重建，在3/5/11种退化设定下性能强且参数高效。
AI.motivation: 现有统一复原方法（混合注意力、提示学习、路由机制）主要提升退化自适应性，但各网络阶段采用相似的特征建模策略，忽视了编码与解码在不同退化下各自不同的表示需求。
AI.method: 遵循阶段感知设计原则：编码器采用已有的混合通道-空间注意力构建稳健的保内容、退化感知表示；解码器采用自适应选择性注意力。具体设计自适应选择性通道自注意力（ASCSA，自适应查询通道选择与注意力掩码）和自适应选择性空间自注意力（ASSSA，多窗口尺寸空间注意力自适应融合），并用紧凑隐式提示在无需显式退化标签的情况下调制选择过程。
AI.result: 在3种、5种和11种退化设定下的大量实验表明，SASFormer取得强复原性能且参数效率良好；阶段级表示分析与消融实验为阶段感知设计及解码端自适应选择的有效性提供实证支持。
AI.conclusion: 编码与解码应采用差异化特征建模策略；解码端自适应选择与隐式提示可有效提升一体化盲图像复原，并兼具参数效率。

title: Learning by Doing: Autonomously Compiling and Curating Agent Skills from Verified Traces
summary: Memory systems for production LLM agents mostly store semantic memory (facts about users and domains) or episodic memory (earlier interactions). Research systems such as Trace2Skill, WikiSkill, and SkillRevise learn procedures from agent runs, package them as Skills, and evaluate them on benchmarks. We describe Zep Agent Skills, a production service that gives deployed agents this procedural memory. The service uses only verified attempts as evidence, cites the supporting events for each field of a Skill, and governs the admission and distribution of each Skill version. The service records each task attempt as a Trace with ordered events, an outcome, and a verification strength. A compiler with separate Reflector and Curator roles turns verified Traces into versioned Skills. Scans and admission gates control which candidates become active, and verified use outcomes change the search rank of each Skill. The Agent Skills format is an open standard that Anthropic originated and donated to the Agentic AI Foundation, so any host of the format can load a compiled Skill. Agents retrieve Skills through lexical search with progressive disclosure, over an API or MCP. We evaluate Zep Agent Skills on $τ^3$-bench banking, AppWorld, and EnterpriseOps-Gym. Skills compiled from the Traces of a teacher model increase the pass rate of three weaker executor models on the same tasks, at every reasoning effort, by 4.5 to 18.8 points. Most of the gain is on the tasks that the teacher solved. On ALFWorld, Skills compiled from the runs of a small model give a gain similar to or larger than the gain that prior work reports for continuous fine-tuning, with no training.

AI.tldr: Zep Agent Skills 是一个面向生产环境的服务，为已部署的 LLM Agent 提供“程序性记忆”：只从通过验证的尝试中学习，将以有序事件记录的 Trace 编译为带引用、可版本化、可治理准入与分发的 Skill，并通过词法检索＋渐进披露（API/MCP）供 Agent 使用。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM Agent 记忆系统多停留在语义记忆（用户/领域事实）与情节记忆（历史交互），缺乏生产可用的程序性记忆；尽管 Trace2Skill、WikiSkill、SkillRevise 等研究系统能从运行轨迹中学习流程并打包为 Skill，但它们尚未提供生产级服务所需的证据可信、来源可溯、版本准入与分发治理能力。
AI.method: 每次任务尝试记为 Trace（有序事件、结果、验证强度），仅采用已验证尝试作为证据；由含 Reflector 与 Curator 两角色的编译器把已验证 Trace 编译为带版本、逐字段可溯源引用的 Skill；通过扫描与准入闸门决定候选是否激活，并依据验证后的使用结果调整 Skill 检索排序；Skill 采用 Anthropic 发起并捐给 Agentic AI Foundation 的开放 Agent Skills 格式，可被任意宿主加载，Agent 通过词法检索＋渐进披露经 API 或 MCP 获取。
AI.result: 在 τ³-bench 银行、AppWorld、EnterpriseOps-Gym 上，由教师模型 Trace 编译的 Skill 使三个较弱执行模型在同一任务上的通过率在各推理强度下提升 4.5–18.8 分，增益主要来自教师已解决的任务；在 ALFWorld 上，小模型运行编译出的 Skill 带来的增益与既有工作报告的连续微调相当甚至更大，且无需训练。
AI.conclusion: 程序性记忆可以以“验证驱动＋可溯源＋可治理”的 Skill 形式，在生产环境中从运行轨迹低成本获得；跨模型、跨基准的稳定增益表明编译式 Skill 可作为微调的可替代/互补方案。

title: Zero-Gated Cross-Attention
summary: Injecting non-text modalities into frozen language models often introduces early optimization instability, making it difficult to separate architectural gains from transient training dynamics. We introduce Inductively Gated Cross-Attention (IGCA), a zero-initialized cross-attention bridge that preserves pretrained model behavior at initialization while enabling gradual multimodal conditioning. Integrated across six decoder layers of frozen Falcon-40B, open_llama_30b, and Bloom-7b1 backbones (with 40,404,961,288 trainable adapter parameters used during training), IGCA acts as an exact algebraic no-op at initialization with a maximum output discrepancy of 0.00e+00. Over 59,500 training steps on Falcon-40B, the training loss decreases from 3.9403 to 0.0007 (with final ten step losses of [0.0001, 0.0003, 0.0005, 0.0002, 0.0005, 0.0011, 0.0005, 0.0006, 0.0005, 0.0007]). On held-out evaluation, the best gate-on checkpoint achieves a loss of 2.2201 compared to 4.3469 for the gate-off baseline -- a 48.9% reduction (2.1268 nats) -- while average held-out loss improves from 4.3423 to 2.2498 (1.9075 nats) with a mean gate magnitude of $\vert{}\tanh(α)\vert{} = 0.0713$.

AI.tldr: 提出零初始化的门控交叉注意力桥接模块 IGCA，在将非文本模态注入冻结语言模型时保持初始行为不变并实现渐进式多模态条件化，显著降低训练与留出评估损失。
AI.motivation: 向冻结语言模型注入非文本模态常引发早期优化不稳定，使架构收益与瞬时训练动态难以区分，因此需要一种初始不扰动预训练模型、又能逐步引入多模态条件的机制。
AI.method: IGCA 采用零初始化交叉注意力，集成于 Falcon-40B、open_llama_30b、Bloom-7b1 的六个解码层，训练适配器参数约 4.04e10；初始化时门控为零，构成精确代数空操作。
AI.result: 初始化最大输出偏差 0.00e+00；Falcon-40B 上 59,500 步训练损失由 3.9403 降至 0.0007；留出评估最佳门控开启检查点损失 2.2201，相比门控关闭基线 4.3469 降低 48.9%（2.1268 nats），平均留出损失由 4.3423 降至 2.2498，平均门幅 |tanh(α)|=0.0713。
AI.conclusion: 零初始化门控交叉注意力可确保初始无损并稳定实现多模态适配，带来大幅损失下降；但训练后期损失接近零与留出损失约 2.2 的差距暗示过拟合风险，实际增益需在更多下游任务上验证。

title: Switch-SWE: Do Coding Agents Hold Focus When Switching Between Unfinished Tasks?
summary: Software development sessions often involve several unfinished tasks rather than one issue carried through to completion. As coding agents take on repository-level development, they need to recover an earlier task's requirements and partial progress after intervening work. Existing repository-level benchmarks typically score one issue-to-patch episode and do not directly measure whether an agent can resume a task after advancing other unfinished work in the same repository. We introduce \textbf{\ourmethod}, a benchmark for focus-task resumption in sessions that interleave unfinished tasks drawn from the same source repository, with a persistent checkout for each task. Each focus task is evaluated in matched uninterrupted and switched sessions with identical focus requirements and executable verifiers. The switched session interleaves ordered stages from other unfinished tasks in the same repository, while only the final focus patch is scored. \ourmethod~contains 200 focus tasks from 19 Python repositories, reconstructed from issue, pull-request, and review histories and rendered as 400 matched session specifications. Across 7 coding agents, interleaved unfinished work produces an average focus-task resolution gap of 11.5 percentage points, ranging from 6.0 to 15.0 percentage points. Trajectory analysis identifies cross-task requirement confusion and loss of task state as recurrent resumption behaviors. We introduce a plug-in context-management module that selects task-relevant history and maintains concise task-state summaries. On OpenCode, the module improves focus-task completion under same-repository task switching by 5.5 to 15.5 percentage points across the evaluated models. Code is available at github.com/Miraclecsc/Switch-SWE.

AI.tldr: 提出 Switch-SWE 基准，测量编码智能体在同一仓库多任务交错场景下恢复先前的“焦点任务”的能力，并给出上下文管理模块作为改进方案。
AI.motivation: 真实开发会话常常并行处理多个未完成任务，而现有仓库级基准只评测单一 issue 到补丁的片段，无法直接衡量智能体在推进其他任务后能否恢复先前任务的需求与进度。
AI.method: 构建 200 个焦点任务（来自 19 个 Python 仓库，基于 issue/PR/review 历史重建），渲染为 400 个匹配的会话规格：每个任务均有无中断会话与切换会话两种对照，切换会话插入同仓库其他未完成任务的阶段性工作，仅对最终焦点补丁评分，并配可执行验证器；另提出可插拔的上下文管理模块，筛选任务相关历史并维护简洁任务状态摘要。
AI.result: 7 个编码智能体上，交错未完成工作导致平均 11.5 个百分点的焦点任务解决差距（6.0–15.0）；轨迹分析发现跨任务需求混淆与任务状态丢失是反复出现的恢复行为；上下文管理模块在 OpenCode 上使模型在同仓库任务切换下的完成率提升 5.5–15.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 任务切换是仓库级编码智能体的显著性能瓶颈，根因在于需求混淆与状态丢失，而针对性的上下文管理可有效缓解。

title: 3D Neural Rendering for Automated Ultrasonic Laser Scans
summary: Laser doppler vibrometer (LDV) scans can be used to detect defects and cracks in manufactured parts before they are deployed. This work presents a method for reconstructing the steady-state surface wavefield of a three-dimensional part by combining automated robotic manipulation with neural rendering. A six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) robotic manipulator (UFactory xArm6) with an embedded piezoelectric transducer presented an acoustically excited test article to a stationary LDV at a sequence of known orientations, yielding a set of complex-valued 2D scans with poses derived analytically from the arm kinematics rather than from image-based pose estimation. These scans were used to train a novel complex-nerfacto model, a modified Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) pipeline that replaces the standard three-channel RGB output head with a two-channel output. Complex-nerfacto represents the real and imaginary velocity components of a wavefield, preserving the complex measurement without quantization. Reconstructions of a welded aluminum cylinder and a welded T-bracket were evaluated against measured scans using Z-normalized cross-correlation (ZNCC). The complex-valued pipeline achieved a mean ZNCC of 0.60 at held-out viewing angles, compared with 0.28 for a baseline RGB nerfacto model trained on rendered images of the same data. The resulting surface wavefield reconstructions supported defect detection and characterization on complex components. We identify geometry reconstruction from sparse LDV scans as the remaining obstacle to practical deployment.

AI.tldr: 该工作将六轴机械臂与激光多普勒测振仪(LDV)结合，提出复值版 NeRF(complex-nerfacto)重建三维零件稳态表面波场，在留出视角下平均 ZNCC 达 0.60（RGB 基线仅 0.28），可用于复杂构件缺陷检测。
AI.motivation: LDV 扫描可在零件投产前检测缺陷和裂纹，但单次扫描只给出二维、受视角限制的复值测量，难以直接获得完整三维表面的稳态波场，尤其对复杂几何构件。
AI.method: 用 UFactory xArm6 机械臂（内嵌压电换能器激励）在已知姿态序列下将测试件呈现给固定 LDV，位姿由机械臂运动学解析得到而非图像位姿估计；将多视角复值二维扫描送入改造的 NeRF 管线 complex-nerfacto——把三通道 RGB 输出头换成两通道，直接表示波场的实部和虚部，保留复数信息不做量化。
AI.result: 在焊接铝圆柱和焊接 T 型支架上与实测扫描对比，留出视角的平均 ZNCC 为 0.60，而基于同一数据渲染图像的 RGB nerfacto 基线为 0.28；重建的波场支持缺陷检测与表征。
AI.conclusion: 复值神经渲染显著优于图像化基线，可重建复杂构件的表面波场并用于缺陷检测；但稀疏 LDV 扫描下的几何重建仍是实用部署的主要障碍。

title: FOCUS: Closed-Loop Attention Feedback for Efficient Vision-Language Understanding
summary: Processing every video frame through Vision-Language Models (VLMs) adds significant inference cost and limits their ability to comprehend real-time video. Existing approaches either sub-sample frames uniformly, ignoring content and missing important events, or prune visual tokens inside the VLM to cut per-call cost while still invoking the model on every sampled frame. We introduce FOCUS, a training-free three-layer framework that reduces the number of invocations and steers each one towards what matters. Temporal gating measures inter-frame dissimilarity in the patch-embedding space of a smaller VLM from the same family, triggering burst captures only when the scene changes in a semantically meaningful way. Patch-level dissimilarity is then accumulated across the burst and fused with a top-down attention prior into a spatial focus map that encodes where motion and semantic relevance coincide. That map calibrates the VLM's value cache during generation, progressively amplifying vision tokens in task-relevant regions and attenuating off-target ones, without removing any token from the context. The loop closes after each response: text-to-vision cross-attention is extracted from the decoder and fed back as the prior for the next burst, letting the system converge on semantically important regions over successive observations. We evaluate FOCUS on the 500-video EgoSchema subset in streaming mode, with a single Qwen3-VL-8B backbone shared by every method. It reaches 74.8% accuracy using 25.4 VLM calls per clip, against 74.6% with 55 calls for uniform sampling and 74.2% with 55 calls for BOLT. On egocentric video captioning across four domains, it matches the best baseline's quality while issuing 57% fewer VLM invocations than uniform sampling.

AI.tldr: FOCUS是一个免训练的三层框架，通过时间门控、空间聚焦图和跨轮反馈，减少VLM调用次数并把每次调用引导到关键区域，在EgoSchema流式评测中以25.4次调用取得74.8%准确率，优于55次调用的均匀采样(74.6%)和BOLT(74.2%)。
AI.motivation: 逐帧跑VLM推理成本高，难以支撑实时视频理解；现有方法要么均匀采样忽略内容、漏掉重要事件，要么在VLM内部剪枝视觉token，但仍对每个采样帧调用模型。
AI.method: 三层免训练框架：(1) 在小同族VLM的patch嵌入空间度量帧间差异进行时间门控，仅语义显著变化时触发burst采集；(2) burst内累积patch级差异，与自顶向下注意力先验融合成空间聚焦图；(3) 用该图校准生成时的value cache，增强任务相关区域视觉token、抑制无关token而不删除任何token；并在每轮响应后提取文本-视觉交叉注意力作为下一轮先验，形成闭环。
AI.result: EgoSchema 500视频流式子集上，共用Qwen3-VL-8B骨干：FOCUS达74.8%准确率，仅25.4次调用；均匀采样55次为74.6%，BOLT 55次为74.2%。跨四领域第一人称视频字幕任务中，质量与最佳基线持平，调用次数比均匀采样少57%。
AI.conclusion: 通过"少调用+精准聚焦"的思路，FOCUS在不训练的情况下显著提升VLM视频理解的推理效率，在准确率、调用成本上同时优于采样式与token剪枝式基线。

title: World Models Need Not Be Right to Rank Policies Right: Relative Bounds and Audit Limits
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models in Physical AI
summary: Selecting a reinforcement-learning (RL) policy usually requires additional environment interaction, while learned world models offer cheap but potentially biased evaluations. This raises two distinct questions: can shared model errors preserve pairwise rankings despite poor absolute values, and do they make a small number of real audits more informative? We derive an exact pairwise simulation identity and a relative bound separating common-mode Bellman residuals from policy-specific error. The analysis motivates RAVEL (Relative Auditing of Value Errors in Learned models), a selective policy tournament whose eliminations use held-out real outcomes. We test 45 SAC, TD3, and PPO policies per task in DMC cheetah-run and walker-walk. At rollout horizon 500, model rankings remain strong (Kendall tau = 0.962 and 0.800), and same-run differential-error ratios are 0.674 and 0.106. Yet mean paired audit-error correlations are only 0.007 and 0.090, and pairing changes standard deviation by -2.5 percent and +1.9 percent. Simultaneous intervals attain 99.98 percent and 99.75 percent coverage, but certify only 13.2 percent and 0 percent of decisions at eight audits. RAVEL improves low-budget walker-walk regret, whereas real-only successive halving is better at the largest budget, rejecting the precommitted twofold efficiency target. Frozen-model optimization lowers real return without increasing predicted return on average. Thus ranking fidelity, useful audit covariance, and upward model exploitation are distinct properties, separated in part by closed-loop trajectory divergence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RAVEL方法，利用学习世界模型对RL策略进行相对排序并选择性用真实审计，分析模型误差的配对结构与排序保真度。
AI.motivation: 评估RL策略通常需要额外环境交互，而世界模型虽廉价却可能有偏。作者追问两点：共享的模型误差能否在绝对值差的情况下保留成对排序；少量真实审计是否因误差相关性而更具信息量。
AI.method: 推导精确的成对模拟恒等式及相对界，将共同模式Bellman残差与策略特异误差分离；据此提出RAVEL——一种基于留出真实结果进行淘汰的选择性策略锦标赛。在DMC cheetah-run与walker-walk上各测试45个SAC、TD3、PPO策略。
AI.result: rollout horizon 500下模型排序仍强（Kendall tau=0.962与0.800），同跑差分误差比为0.674与0.106；但平均成对审计误差相关性仅0.007与0.090，配对使标准差变化-2.5%与+1.9%。同时置信区间覆盖率达99.98%与99.75%，但八次审计仅认证13.2%与0%的决策。RAVEL在低预算walker-walk上降低regret，而仅真实数据的successive halving在最大预算下更优，未达到预设的两倍效率目标。
AI.conclusion: 排序保真、有用的审计协方差与向上的模型利用是三种不同性质，部分由闭环轨迹发散所区分；模型排序可信并不自动意味着少量真实审计就高效。

title: CULTURE-CMT: Benchmarking Contextualized Social Media Translation
summary: Social-media comments are interactions, yet they are often translated and evaluated as isolated text. This mismatch is especially problematic when meaning depends on surrounding discussion, community-specific slang, or culturally situated expressions. We introduce CULTURE-CMT, a Chinese-English benchmark for contextualized social-media comment translation that restores the post and conversational context naturally available to users. Its 572 manually verified examples are organized into Slang, Context, and Both, enabling diagnostic analysis of distinct and interacting sources of translation difficulty. To support scalable evaluation, we further develop a retrieval-augmented cultural-effectiveness Judger that combines a calibrated scoring model with dynamically retrieved cultural knowledge. CULTURE-CMT reveals several non-trivial patterns. Providing interaction context improves most model configurations, but does not eliminate culturally ineffective translations. Examples requiring both contextual grounding and culturally situated language remain substantially more difficult than either source of difficulty alone. Moreover, larger models are not consistently better, and thinking produces highly model-dependent gains, including occasional degradation. In contrast, a 27B model adapted on benchmark-disjoint social-media data achieves the lowest observed invalidity rate among the evaluated configurations under thinking inference with context. Together, these results suggest that realistic social-media translation is not simply a matter of scaling models or reasoning longer, but of learning to translate meaning as it is constructed within evolving online interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出中英社媒评论语境化翻译基准CULTURE-CMT，并开发检索增强的文化有效性评判器，揭示"上下文+文化语言"双重难度下模型表现的非平凡规律。
AI.motivation: 社媒评论本质是互动，但常被作为孤立文本进行翻译与评估，当语义依赖前后讨论、社区俚语或文化情境表达时会出现明显错配，缺乏相应基准与可扩展评估手段。
AI.method: 构建CULTURE-CMT中英基准，572条人工核验样本分Slang（俚语）、Context（上下文）、Both（两者兼有）三类以做诊断分析；同时开发检索增强的文化有效性Judger，将校准打分模型与动态检索的文化知识结合，用于可扩展评估。
AI.result: 提供互动上下文能提升多数模型配置但无法消除文化上无效的翻译；需同时依赖上下文与文化情境的样本显著更难；更大模型并非一致更好；thinking带来的增益高度依赖模型，甚至偶有退化；在带上下文的thinking推理下，基于与基准不重叠社媒数据适配的27B模型获得最低无效翻译率。
AI.conclusion: 真实社媒翻译不只是扩大模型规模或延长推理，而需学会在演化的在线互动中翻译被建构的意义。

title: RATR: Training-Free Material Rebinding via Role Assignment and Temporal Routing
summary: Material rebinding aims to transfer the material appearance from a reference image while preserving the target object's geometry and identity. Existing methods typically struggle to balance material fidelity with structural preservation due to the coupled influence of structural and appearance cues in their visual conditions. We identify role entanglement in the target and reference conditions as a contributing factor the target condition carries both geometry and its original appearance while the reference condition contains material cues alongside object-specific structure. To address this issue, we propose RATR, a training-free material rebinding method built on a diffusion-based image editor that assigns complementary roles to the two conditions and coordinates their influence during denoising. To make the target condition primarily convey structure, we introduce an albedo-resolved surface release mechanism, which suppresses the target's original surface appearance while retaining geometric cues, yielding a structure-oriented condition for material transfer. On the reference side, the designed material evidence isolation mechanism emphasizes material cues while reducing interference from object-specific structure, yielding a complementary material-oriented condition.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练材质重绑定方法RATR，通过分离目标条件与参考条件中的结构与外观角色，在扩散编辑器上实现材质迁移与结构保持的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有材质重绑定方法难以平衡材质保真度与结构保持，因为目标条件和参考条件的视觉线索中结构与外观相互耦合（角色纠缠）：目标条件同时含几何与原外观，参考条件同时含材质与物体特有结构。
AI.method: RATR基于扩散图像编辑器，免训练地为两个条件分配互补角色并协调去噪过程的影响：(1) 反照率解析的表面释放机制，抑制目标原有表面外观、保留几何线索，得到结构导向条件；(2) 材质证据隔离机制，在参考侧强化材质线索、减少物体特有结构干扰，得到互补的材质导向条件。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据与量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦目标与参考条件的角色，RATR为材质重绑定中的保真—结构权衡提供了免训练的解决思路。

title: I-PTC: Interactive Programmatic Tool Calling for Stateful Tool-Augmented Agents
summary: Large language models are increasingly capable of writing and executing code, suggesting a natural paradigm for tool-augmented agents: expressing tool use as programs rather than isolated calls. Programmatic tool calling (PTC) captures this idea through loops, batching, abstraction, and structured computation, but existing PTC approaches are largely stateless, limiting their ability to reuse intermediate results and adapt over time. This is problematic for real-world tasks, where tool environments and problem-solving processes are inherently stateful. We therefore present I-PTC, an interactive framework that executes stateful PTC: models issue code snippets that call tools, maintain reusable state, and evolve the tool interface through API corrections. To evaluate the effectiveness of I-PTC and the general PTC setting, we introduce PTC-Bench, a benchmark of long-tail, production-style user requests whose difficulty comes from large initial environments, many dependent API interactions, extended planning, and recovery across follow-ups and transient failures. Experiments on PTC-Bench show that I-PTC improves performance on complex multi-step tasks with large tool sets while substantially reducing token consumption over conventional tool-calling baselines and the original PTC baseline, highlighting stateful programmatic tool calling as a promising direction for scalable tool-augmented agents.

AI.tldr: 提出有状态的交互式程序化工具调用框架 I-PTC 及基准 PTC-Bench，验证其在复杂多步任务中的性能与 token 效率优势。
AI.motivation: 现有程序化工具调用（PTC）多为无状态，无法复用中间结果、随环境演化，而真实工具环境与问题求解过程本身是有状态的。
AI.method: 提出 I-PTC 交互式框架：模型生成代码片段调用工具、维护可复用状态，并通过 API 纠正演化工具接口；同时构建 PTC-Bench 基准，含长尾生产式请求，难度来自大规模初始环境、众多依赖 API 交互、长程规划及后续追问与瞬时故障中的恢复。
AI.result: 在 PTC-Bench 上，I-PTC 在大工具集的复杂多步任务中性能提升，且相比传统工具调用基线与原始 PTC 基线大幅降低 token 消耗。
AI.conclusion: 有状态程序化工具调用是可扩展工具增强智能体的有前景方向。

title: Lightweight Representation Learning for Low Tucker Rank Tensors
summary: Low Tucker rank tensors provide compact representations of multidimensional dependencies, but standard learning pipelines can incur substantial computational and memory overhead from redundant intermediate quantities. We reduce this overhead without modifying the underlying representation objective or parameterization. Our approach combines three complementary components: (i) sequential extraction of only task-required spectral components, avoiding unnecessary full decompositions; (ii) factor-wise multilinear contractions without materializing large Kronecker operators; and (iii) compact latent-state updates without storing full ambient tensor iterates. These components preserve the algebraic operations and learning trajectories of the original algorithms while reducing their computational and memory footprints. Across five low Tucker rank tensor estimators, our implementations match the original trajectories to numerical precision (relative discrepancies of $10^{-16}$ to $10^{-13}$), while reducing per-iteration runtime by up to $3.12\times$ and resident memory by up to $616\times$ ($99.8\%$) on the main order-3 benchmark at $n=100$, with memory reductions exceeding $900\times$ across the full evaluation suite. These results show that substantial computational redundancy can be eliminated from Tucker representation learning without changing the underlying model or learned representation.

AI.tldr: 提出三种互补的数值/实现层面优化（按需谱分量提取、因子级多线性收缩、紧凑隐状态更新），在不改变低Tucker秩张量学习算法数学目标与参数化的前提下，消除冗余计算，实现最高3.12倍提速与616倍内存压缩，且轨迹与原算法数值一致（10^-16~10^-13）。
AI.motivation: 低Tucker秩张量虽能紧凑表示多维依赖，但标准学习流程中大量中间量（完整分解、大型Kronecker算子、完整环境张量迭代）导致显著的计算和内存开销，且这些开销属于冗余而非模型必需。
AI.method: 三项组件：(i) 顺序提取仅任务所需的谱分量，避免不必要全分解；(ii) 因子级多线性收缩，不显式物化大Kronecker算子；(iii) 紧凑隐状态更新，不存储完整环境张量迭代。三者保持原算法的代数运算与学习轨迹不变，仅降低计算与内存占用。
AI.result: 在五个低Tucker秩张量估计器上，轨迹与原实现匹配至数值精度（相对差异10^-16~10^-13）；主阶3基准（n=100）单次迭代运行时间最高降低3.12倍，常驻内存最高降低616倍（99.8%）；完整评测集上内存降低超过900倍。
AI.conclusion: Tucker表示学习中的大量计算冗余可在不改变模型、参数化及所学表示的情况下被消除，为低Tucker秩张量学习提供了一种"等价但高效"的实现范式。

title: How Green Is Your Manifesto? Scoring Environmental Positions in the 2024 EU Elections with an LLM Panel
summary: Locating political parties on environmental and climate policy is central to the study of party competition, yet the established instruments, expert surveys and the hand coding of manifestos, are costly, periodic, and slow to extend to new documents. We ask whether a panel of large language models can serve as a cheaper and reproducible alternative. Treating each manifesto as a set of sentences, three models from independent providers score every sentence on two dimensions, environmental protection and climate change, separating a party's position on an issue from the salience it gives it, and the judgments are averaged to the manifesto level. Agreement across the models is retained as a built-in reliability signal. We apply the panel to 41 manifestos from the 2024 European Parliament election, covering Austria, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the European party families, and validate it against the 2024 Chapel Hill Expert Survey for the 25 parties with a like-for-like expert benchmark, using the other manifestos as diagnostic cases. The panel recovers the expert ordering of parties with strong rank agreement on both dimensions, while reading them as systematically greener than experts do, a gap we interpret as the distance between manifesto promise and governing record. Inter-model disagreement modestly flags where the instrument errs, and position and salience prove related for environmental protection but independent for climate change. The result is a transparent, low-cost, and multilingual instrument that complements rather than replaces expert and hand-coded approaches; the prompt, code, and manifesto-level results are released openly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用三家独立厂商的大语言模型组成"评审团"，对竞选纲领逐句打分以定位政党在环境保护与气候变化议题上的立场与显著性，并在2024欧洲议会选举41份纲领上验证其与专家调查的高度一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有测量政党环境/气候立场的工具——专家调查与人工编码宣言——成本高、周期性长、难以扩展到新文档，作者希望探索一个更廉价且可复现的替代方案。
AI.method: 将每份宣言拆为句子，用三个独立厂商的LLM对每句在"环境保护"和"气候变化"两个维度打分，区分政党立场(position)与议题显著性(salience)，再平均到宣言层面；模型间一致性作为内置可靠性信号。应用于2024欧洲议会选举涉及奥地利、法国、德国、意大利、西班牙及欧洲党团的41份宣言，并以2024 Chapel Hill专家调查中25个可对标政党为基准进行验证，其余宣言作诊断案例。
AI.result: 评审团能较好复现专家给出的政党排序，两维度上排名一致性均强；但模型系统性地把政党读得比专家更"绿"，作者将此差距解释为竞选承诺与执政记录之间的距离。模型间分歧能适度指示错误位置；环境保护维度上立场与显著性相关，而气候变化维度上二者独立。
AI.conclusion: 该工具透明、低成本、多语言，可补充而非取代专家调查与人工编码方法；提示词、代码与宣言层面结果均公开。

title: Spatial-Spectral Interactive POCS Network for Large-Gap Seismic Data Interpolation
summary: Large gaps in seismic acquisition disrupt reflection events and hinder spectral recovery. Existing seismic interpolation deep unfolding networks primarily rely on localized spatial priors, limiting their ability to aggregate the global context necessary for reconstructing these extensive missing regions. We propose a spatial-spectral interactive projection-onto-convex-sets network (SSI-POCS) to tackle this severely ill-posed problem. By unfolding the classical iterative solver, our network integrates physical consistency with dual-domain deep priors via learned transforms, soft thresholding, and exact data reinsertion. Within the learned prior, a spatial Restormer branch captures local waveform structures, while a fast Fourier convolution (FFC) branch extracts global context, effectively suppressing incoherent components and enhancing spectral energy concentration in the $f-k$ domain. A dual-domain fusion module exchanges these complementary features via bidirectional channel attention and gated modulation, yielding substantial interpolation improvements. To overcome the severe loss of lateral continuity caused by large gaps, we introduce structural similarity (SSIM) supervision, complemented by focal frequency loss (FFL) and transform consistency constraints to suppress incoherent high-frequency components and regularize training. Experiments on a synthetic salt dome and a North Sea field dataset under 50% random and consecutive trace removal demonstrate the effectiveness of SSI-POCS. It significantly enhances event continuity across large gaps and mitigates artifacts, achieving a 3.285~dB SNR improvement over the best competing method while reducing parameters by 75.66%.

AI.tldr: 提出SSI-POCS网络：展开经典POCS迭代求解器，融合空间Restormer分支与FFC全局分支的双域深度先验，并引入SSIM/FFL监督，用于大缺口地震道插值重建。
AI.motivation: 大地震采集缺口会破坏反射事件并阻碍频谱恢复；现有深度展开插值网络依赖局部空间先验，难以聚合重建大范围缺失区所需的全局上下文。
AI.method: 展开POCS迭代求解器，结合学习变换、软阈值和精确数据回插实现物理一致性与双域深度先验；空间Restormer分支捕捉局部波形结构，FFC分支提取全局上下文；双域融合模块通过双向通道注意力和门控调制交换特征；训练中用SSIM监督，辅以焦点频率损失(FFL)与变换一致性约束。
AI.result: 在合成盐丘和北海实际数据集、50%随机与连续道去除条件下，显著提升大缺口处事件连续性并抑制伪影；相比最佳对比方法SNR提升3.285 dB，参数量减少75.66%。
AI.conclusion: 空间-频谱交互展开网络能有效应对大缺口地震插值这一严重病态问题，在性能与参数效率上均优于现有方法。

title: CONFIRM: Governing Scientific Reporting for Trustworthy Agentic Neuroimaging
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can autonomously run neuroimaging analyses from research questions to reported findings. Existing agentic systems use tools to check that code runs and reported values match its output, but rely on LLM judgment to decide which results warrant scientific reporting. We show that LLM judges endorse site-confounded findings even when the confound is presented as evidence. We present \textbf{CONFIRM}, a framework that separates running an analysis from deciding which findings to report. CONFIRM encodes each hypothesis as a machine-readable, pre-specified analysis plan that fixes the claim and its pass criteria before computing results. It then filters results through five deterministic gates (search history and multiplicity, confounds, power, analytic stability, and replication) under three configurable reporting standards, from least to most demanding: \textit{Screen}, \textit{Replicate}, and \textit{Full}. Failed claims receive diagnoses that guide follow-up analyses. To evaluate reporting decisions at the claim level, we introduce \textbf{NeuroClaimBench}, comprising 489 executable neuroimaging claims with frozen data, including literature-supported findings and 150 controls designed to violate individual methodological requirements. On NeuroClaimBench, CONFIRM falsely supports at most 3\% of controls, compared with 23--38\% for the baselines, while recovering up to 61\% of literature-supported claims. When auditing an existing agent, CONFIRM reduces false support on controls from 23\% to 0\% while retaining the agent's literature-supported claims. Its diagnostic feedback also produces more supported revisions than Self-Refine with fewer LLM calls. Together, CONFIRM and NeuroClaimBench show that basing reporting decisions on pre-specified analysis plans and deterministic gates is essential for trustworthy autonomous scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出CONFIRM框架与NeuroClaimBench基准，将"执行分析"与"决定报告哪些发现"分离：用机器可读的预注册分析计划固定声明与通过标准，再经五个确定性门（搜索历史与多重性、混淆、功效、分析稳定性、重复）按三级标准过滤，极大降低LLM代理对混淆性结果的错误认可。
AI.motivation: 现有神经影像LLM代理只校验代码可运行、数值与输出一致，却依赖LLM判断哪些结果值得科学报告；作者发现LLM评判者会把"站点混淆"当作证据而认可被混淆的发现，因而需要把报告决策从LLM主观判断中剥离。
AI.method: CONFIRM：将每个假设编码为预注册、机器可读的分析计划，预先固定声明及通过准则；计算后用五个确定性门过滤（搜索历史与多重性、混淆、功效、分析稳定性、重复），并支持Screen/Replicate/Full三种严格度；未通过的声明给出诊断以指导后续分析。同时构建NeuroClaimBench：489个可执行神经影像声明（冻结数据），含文献支持发现与150个刻意违反单项方法学要求的对照项。
AI.result: 在NeuroClaimBench上，CONFIRM对对照项的错误支持率≤3%，基线为23–38%，同时可召回至多61%的文献支持声明；审计已有代理时，将对照项错误支持从23%降至0%且保留其文献支持声明；诊断反馈比Self-Refine产生更多经支持的修订且LLM调用更少。
AI.conclusion: 以预注册分析计划和确定性门作为报告决策依据，是可信自主科学发现的关键；CONFIRM与NeuroClaimBench共同证明了这一点。

title: TRIAGE: Reliability- and Load-Conditioned Escalation for Two-Tier LLM Serving with a Semantic Evidence Judge
summary: Two-tier LLM serving escalates selected requests from a small model to a large one, but prompt-based routers cannot see whether retrieved evidence supports an answer, and they treat the GPU cost of an escalation as constant. We study TRIAGE, which conditions escalation on a post-generation reliability state and on a load-dependent GPU price, and we report both what held and what did not on one A40 serving Qwen2.5-7B and 32B (AWQ) under VLLM. Escalation cost rose 21.9x from 1 to 10 requests/s but showed no monotone dependence on KV-cache headroom, and a pre-registered claim that the reliability state detects corrupted evidence (AUROC>=0.70) was falsified at 0.571, although any prompt-only router scores exactly 0.500 by construction. Post hoc, a semantic evidence judge raised detection to 0.846 (0.926 on never-served items) and predicted wrong small-model answers at AUROC 0.90-0.96 on RGB and three RouterBench model pairs; the resulting cascade stayed within about 3 pp of GPT-4 at 79.5% lower API cost for GPT-3.5->GPT-4, yet fell below random routing for open-model pairs with 2-3x price ratios. End to end, the 7B->32B pair showed only a +2.88 pp held-out gap, so the allocator rightly declined to escalate and the headline is a null that a small pre-launch gate failed to expose.

AI.tldr: 研究 TRIAGE：以后生成可靠性状态与负载相关的 GPU 价格决定是否从 7B 升级到 32B。预注册假设（可靠性状态可检出被污染证据，AUROC≥0.70）被证伪（0.571）；事后语义证据判官达 0.846，并能以 AUROC 0.90–0.96 预测小模型错误，级联在 GPT-3.5→GPT-4 上接近 GPT-4 且 API 成本降 79.5%，但开放模型对上劣于随机路由。7B→32B 仅 +2.88pp 差距，分配器正确地不升级，结论是一个"零结果"。
AI.motivation: 两层 LLM 服务依赖路由器决定是否升级到大模型，但现有基于 prompt 的路由器看不到检索证据是否支持答案，且把升级的 GPU 成本视为常数，忽略了负载相关的实际成本，导致路由决策不可靠。
AI.method: 在单张 A40 上用 VLLM 部署 Qwen2.5-7B 与 32B（AWQ），研究 TRIAGE：以生成后的可靠性状态和负载相关的 GPU 价格为条件决定升级；预注册验证可靠性状态对污染证据的检测能力（AUROC 目标≥0.70），并事后引入语义证据判官；在 RGB 与 RouterBench 多个模型对上评测级联效果与成本。
AI.result: 升级成本从 1 到 10 req/s 上升 21.9 倍，但与 KV-cache 余量无单调关系。预注册检测假设被证伪（AUROC 0.571，纯 prompt 路由器构造上恒为 0.500）。事后语义证据判官将检测提升至 0.846（未服务项 0.926），在 RGB 和三对 RouterBench 上对错误小模型答案的预测 AUROC 为 0.90–0.96。级联在 GPT-3.5→GPT-4 上距 GPT-4 约 3pp 内、API 成本降 79.5%，但在价格比 2–3 倍的开放模型对上低于随机路由。7B→32B 留出集差距仅 +2.88pp。
AI.conclusion: TRIAGE 的语义证据判官与负载感知成本对闭源强模型对有效，但对开放模型对不适用；7B→32B 几乎无收益，分配器正确地拒绝升级，说明该场景的核心结论是一个零结果，且小型预发布门控未能提前发现这一点。

title: Consolidating Reasoning with Test-Time Training
comment: NeurIPS 2026, 25 pages, test-time training, reasoning aggregation, meta-learning
summary:
Effective multi-agent collaboration requires finalizing solutions from reasoning that is distributed across the individual attempts of many agents. However, useful intermediate reasoning can remain unexploited when collaboration is limited to voting on conclusions reached among individual agents, or aggregating long, noisy collections of reasoning trajectories in context. In this work, we propose TTT-Consolidate, a framework that uses multi-agent reasoning trajectories as adaptation data to improve a model's subsequent reasoning. TTT-Consolidate jointly consolidates trajectories into parametric representations through test-time training, then generates a new solution by conditioning on the consolidated information. We meta-learn how to consolidate using bi-level optimization at training time, where an inner loop encodes reasoning trajectories into a lightweight LoRA adapter, and an outer loop learns meta-parameters for the inner loop such that the consolidation is helpful for the model to synthesize a final solution.
  As no large-scale corpus of diverse reasoning trajectories exists for training aggregation methods, we construct the OpenParallelThinking corpus composed of 12,810 math problems paired with a mixture of trajectories from six LLMs. Evaluated on challenging math and STEM benchmarks, TTT-Consolidate outperforms the best aggregation baselines by up to 20 percentage points, even under matched compute and runtime settings, with the gap widening at larger model scales. TTT-Consolidate also recovers from unsuccessful individual trajectories more robustly, an ability that improves as the number of available (even incorrect) trajectories increases. Finally, we demonstrate that TTT-Consolidate benefits from both SFT and RL-based outer loop objectives. We will release TTT-Consolidate and OpenParallelThinking for use in future work on reasoning aggregation.

AI.tldr: 提出 TTT-Consolidate 框架，将多智能体推理轨迹通过测试时训练固化为参数（LoRA），再用双层元学习优化整合过程，在数学与STEM基准上大幅超越投票等聚合基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体协作多限于对最终结论投票，或将冗长噪声轨迹拼接进上下文，导致大量有用的中间推理未被利用。
AI.method: 将多智能体推理轨迹作为适配数据：内循环用测试时训练把轨迹编码为轻量 LoRA 适配器，外循环通过双层优化学习元参数，使整合后的信息有助于生成最终解；并构建 OpenParallelThinking 语料（12,810 道数学题，混合 6 个 LLM 的轨迹）。
AI.result: 在数学与STEM基准上，即便计算与运行时间匹配，仍比最佳聚合基线高最多 20 个百分点，且模型规模越大差距越明显；对失败的个别轨迹更具鲁棒性，可用（甚至错误）轨迹越多效果越好；SFT 与 RL 外循环目标均有效。
AI.conclusion: 参数化整合优于结论投票与上下文聚合，为推理轨迹聚合提供了可训练的新范式，并将开源框架与数据集以支持后续研究。

title: Structured Channel Network Pruning with Bi-Sparse Matrix Factorization
summary: Structured channel pruning for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) plays an important role in pattern recognition and deep learning. Nevertheless, existing methods usually calculate channel importance scores based on the magnitudes of individual filters, making it difficult to distinguish shared redundancy from individual channel contributions. To tackle this limitation, we propose a novel structured channel pruning method termed bi-sparse matrix factorization (BSMF). Specifically, BSMF characterizes the convolutional weight matrix as output-channel coefficients over a shared basis with row-wise $\ell_{2,p}$-norm and column-wise $\ell_{2,q}$-norm regularization terms, respectively. Note that $p,q\in[0,1)$, which, to our best knowledge, has not been explored in the literature. To solve the resulting non-convex optimization problem, we develop an efficient update scheme built upon the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), in which all subproblems admit closed-form solutions. After that, a compact CNN is obtained by reconstructing the convolutional filters from the learned factors and discarding the redundant channels.
