summary: Dialectal Arabic speech recognition remains constrained by the scarcity of dialect-resolved transcribed speech despite the abundance of web audio. We introduce GigaSpeech 3, a corpus of 39,000 hours and 10 million weakly transcribed speech segments covering Algerian, Egyptian, Iraqi, Saudi, and Syrian Arabic. Starting from 60 hours of manual transcription per dialect, we train labeling models using speech-recognition-biased self-supervised learning and apply them to dialect-matched web audio. Data selection and four rounds of noisy-student refinement for Saudi and Syrian Arabic yield the final corpus. We validate its utility through dialect-specific and multi-dialect speech recognition training and cross-domain evaluation. On GigaSpeechBench, the final dialect-specific models outperform their labeling models across all five dialects and achieve a macro-average word error rate of 23.86%, a 16.6% relative reduction from the strongest third-party system covering all five dialects, while outperforming the best third-party result on three dialects. A multi-dialect model using self-predicted dialect identities achieves a macro-average word error rate of 25.51% while also supporting Modern Standard Arabic. Across eight conditions from three external corpora, a GigaSpeech 3-trained Zipformer achieves the lowest word error rate among six evaluated models in every condition, while adapting the Qwen3 speech recognizer on GigaSpeech 3 improves performance across all eight conditions. We release the corpus and recipes as a foundation for dialect-aware Arabic speech processing.

AI.tldr: 论文发布 GigaSpeech 3，一个覆盖五种阿拉伯方言的 39,000 小时弱标注语音语料，并验证其在方言语音识别上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯方言语音识别受限于方言标注转写数据稀缺，而网络音频资源丰富，二者之间存在巨大鸿沟。
AI.method: 每种方言从 60 小时人工转写出发，训练带有语音识别偏置的自监督标注模型，用于方言匹配的网络音频打标；通过数据筛选，并对沙特与叙利亚方言进行四轮 noisy-student 迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在 GigaSpeechBench 上，各方言专用模型均优于其标注模型，宏平均词错误率 23.86%，较最强第三方系统相对降低 16.6%，并在三种方言上超过最佳第三方结果；多方言模型宏平均词错误率 25.51%，同时支持现代标准阿拉伯语；在三个外部语料的八种条件下，基于该语料训练的 Zipformer 全部取得最低词错误率，Qwen3 识别器适配后八种条件均有提升。
AI.conclusion: GigaSpeech 3 可作为方言感知阿拉伯语语音处理的基础资源，语料与训练配方已公开发布。

title: ODC: Orthogonal Drift Correction for Improved Text-to-Image Semantic Alignment at Inference
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR) 2026
summary: Text-to-image models have achieved remarkable success in generating high-quality images from textual descriptions. However, they often struggle with "semantic drift," where the generated output fails to precisely align with complex or nuanced text prompts. While recent approaches have attempted to address semantic errors regarding attribute binding or object presence, there remains a gap for a more holistic method that addresses these issues by directly refining the text embeddings of the initial user prompt. In this work, we introduce Orthogonal Drift Correction (ODC), an inference-time guidance method designed to mitigate semantic drift without requiring model retraining or additional user inputs. ODC guides image generation through a two-stage process. In the first stage, it identifies the semantic drift by evaluating the initially generated image against the user prompt in a shared vision-language embedding space. It then isolates the component of this drift vector that is orthogonal to the prompt's direction and translates it back into text via a vocabulary-based surrogate mechanism. In the second stage, it produces refined text conditioning for a second generation pass by feeding both the initial text embedding and the re-embedded drift representation into an adaptive rank-reduced concept removal module. Our experiments demonstrate that ODC consistently improves prompt-image alignment, increasing CLIP scores by up to 5.4% over the baseline on the COALBench-300 and PartiPrompts benchmarks. Furthermore, on the T2I-CompBench complex subset, ODC improves the average 3-in-1 score by 4.5% over the competing methods. As a plug-and-play module, ODC offers a practical and efficient method for improving the reliability of text-to-image models. Code is available at https://github.com/kasrakamali/ODC.

AI.tldr: 提出正交漂移校正(ODC)，一种推理时引导方法，通过两阶段流程精炼文本嵌入以缓解文生图模型的语义漂移，无需重训练，CLIP分数最高提升5.4%。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型在复杂或细微文本提示下常出现"语义漂移"，生成图与提示不完全对齐。现有方法多只针对属性绑定或物体存在等局部语义错误，缺少直接精炼初始用户提示文本嵌入的整体性方案。
AI.method: ODC为推理时引导，两阶段：第一阶段在共享视觉-语言嵌入空间中比较初始生成图与提示，识别漂移向量，取其与提示方向正交的分量，并通过基于词表的替代机制转回文本；第二阶段将初始文本嵌入与重嵌入的漂移表示输入自适应秩缩减概念移除模块，产生精炼文本条件用于第二次生成。
AI.result: 在COALBench-300和PartiPrompts上CLIP分数较基线最高提升5.4%；在T2I-CompBench复杂子集上3-in-1平均分数较对比方法提升4.5%。
AI.conclusion: ODC作为即插即用模块，无需重训练或额外用户输入，为提升文生图模型可靠性提供了实用高效的方法，代码已开源。

title: TriPhysBench: Evaluating Physical Intelligence for Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied agents need physical intelligence to understand their surroundings through physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning. These capabilities must work together to interpret events and make quantitative judgments. Existing benchmarks advance physical understanding and general-purpose tool use, yet the coordination of these capabilities in physical scenarios remains insufficiently characterized. Inspired by Popper's Three Worlds, we introduce TriPhysBench, a benchmark of 410 questions from 200 videos that brings physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning into a shared evaluation setting. Its measurement-grounded and knowledge-grounded subtasks impose complementary demands on obtaining observations and acquiring external specifications, then applying them to quantitative problems. Among six representative vision-language models, the best achieves an answer accuracy of only 50.38%, revealing limited performance on tasks that require these capabilities to work together. We further introduce TriPhys, a framework that learns a unified policy for physical perception, knowledge retrieval, and quantitative reasoning from complete tool-integrated trajectories. The policy uses intermediate reasoning to guide retrieval and computation, then incorporates tool feedback into subsequent physical inference. On 110 questions from videos excluded from training, TriPhys improves answer and solution scores across three Qwen configurations, with a 17.7% relative gain in answer accuracy for TriPhys-27B over its Qwen3.6-27B backbone. This work provides a benchmark and a learning pathway toward embodied agents that move beyond recognizing events to understanding and reasoning about the physical processes behind them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TriPhysBench 基准（200个视频、410个问题），将物理感知、物理知识检索与物理推理置于统一评测，最好模型准确率仅50.38%；并提出 TriPhys 框架，从完整工具集成轨迹学习统一策略，在留出视频上显著提升答案与解答得分。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需物理感知、物理知识检索与物理推理协同工作才能解释事件并做出定量判断，但现有基准多分别考察物理理解或通用工具使用，三者协同的评测与能力仍未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 受波普尔"三个世界"启发构建 TriPhysBench：源自200个视频的410个问题，含测量相关与知识相关的互补子任务，要求先获取观测与外部规格再用于定量问题。进一步提出 TriPhys 框架，从完整工具集成轨迹中学习覆盖感知、检索与定量推理的统一策略，以中间推理引导检索与计算，并将工具反馈纳入后续物理推断。
AI.result: 六个代表性视觉语言模型中最高答案准确率仅50.38%；在训练未涉及的视频的110个问题上，TriPhys 在三种 Qwen 配置下均提升答案与解答得分，TriPhys-27B 相对其 Qwen3.6-27B 主干答案准确率提升17.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了衡量多能力协同物理理解的基准，以及使具身智能体从事件识别走向物理过程理解与推理的学习路径。

title: MoEDDI: Semantic Mixtures of Experts for Long Tailed Drug Drug Interaction Prediction
summary: Descriptor-based drug--drug interaction (DDI) models typically apply a single global predictor despite heterogeneous physicochemical evidence and severely long-tailed labels. We introduce \textbf{MoEDDI (Mixture-of-Experts for Drug--Drug Interaction prediction)}, a chemically organized mixture-of-experts that routes overlapping descriptor families using low-dimensional statistics and combines their sparse top-$2$ mixture with a global T-DDI pathway through a residual logit correction. The residual parameterization can exactly preserve a supplied T-DDI checkpoint at initialization, although the evaluated models are trained from scratch. Across complete test partitions with 178, 86, and 92 classes, MoEDDI improves macro-F1 over reproduced seed-2026 T-DDI baselines from 0.8284 to 0.8485, 0.4729 to 0.6536, and 0.1807 to 0.4671. On the 3,780-feature corpus, the lowest-support group (89 classes with fewer than 50 test examples) shows the largest mean classwise gain (+3.30 F1 points). Calibration improves on one corpus but worsens on two. These single-seed results support semantic conditional specialization while motivating matched ablations and distribution-shift evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出MoEDDI，用化学分组的混合专家（MoE）路由重叠描述符族，并以残差logit校正融合全局T-DDI通路，在长尾DDI预测上显著提升宏F1。
AI.motivation: 传统基于描述符的DDI模型只使用单一全局预测器，难以应对异质理化证据和严重长尾标签分布；因此需要按化学语义让不同专家分别处理特定描述符族。
AI.method: MoEDDI将重叠的描述符族按化学组织成分专家，用低维统计量进行路由，采用稀疏top-2专家混合，并通过残差logit校正与全局T-DDI通路结合；残差参数化在初始化时可精确保持已有T-DDI检查点，但实际模型均从头训练。
AI.result: 在178、86、92类的三个完整测试划分上，宏观F1相较复现的seed-2026 T-DDI基线分别从0.8284→0.8485、0.4729→0.6536、0.1807→0.4671；3,780特征语料中，最少支持组（89类，测试样本<50）获得最大平均类别增益（+3.30 F1点）；校准仅在一个语料上改善，另两个变差。
AI.conclusion: 单种子结果支持“语义条件特化”的有效性，尤其在长尾类别上收益最大；但尚需配对消融与分布偏移评估，且校准表现不稳定。

title: Chain on Demand: Deferred Evidence Organization for Long-Term Conversational Memory
summary: Long-term conversational memory faces a timing mismatch: write-time summaries and graphs organize history before a future query is known, while independent retrieval can allocate a limited evidence budget to redundant or fragmented turns. We introduce Chain on Demand (CoD), a query-time evidence organization framework over an unchanged turn-level memory. Given a broad candidate pool, CoD constructs a temporary evidence chain by allocating a fixed anchor budget according to query relevance, lexical diversity relative to selected anchors, and newly covered query terms, followed by deterministic restoration of each selected anchor's same-session neighborhood. The resulting chain is used only for the current query, while the underlying conversational memory remains unchanged. In a paired comparison over all 1,986 LoCoMo questions, CoD achieves 82.2% accuracy on 1,540 non-adversarial questions and 76.3% on all 1,986 questions. On LongMemEval-S, one fixed configuration that indexes both user and assistant turns obtains 86.6% across all 500 questions. These results show that long-term memory can preserve the original conversation while deferring evidence organization until the information need is known.

AI.tldr: 提出Chain on Demand (CoD)，一种在查询时临时组织证据的长期对话记忆框架，在LoCoMo与LongMemEval-S上取得高准确率，同时保持原始对话记忆不变。
AI.motivation: 长期对话记忆存在"时机错配"：写时摘要/图结构在未知未来查询前就组织历史，而独立检索又可能把有限的证据预算浪费在冗余或碎片化的对话轮上。因此需要将证据组织推迟到查询时。
AI.method: CoD在不改动轮级记忆的前提下工作：给定宽泛候选池，按查询相关性、相对于已选锚点的词汇多样性、以及新覆盖的查询词，分配固定锚点预算构建临时证据链，再确定性地恢复每个锚点的同会话邻域。该链仅服务当前查询，底层记忆保持不变。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo全部1,986题配对比较中，1,540道非对抗题准确率82.2%，全部题76.3%；在LongMemEval-S上，一个同时索引用户与助手轮的固定配置在全部500题上达到86.6%。
AI.conclusion: 长期记忆可在保留原始对话的同时，把证据组织推迟到信息需求已知时进行，验证了查询时证据组织范式的有效性。

title: Beyond Temporal Overlap: Consumer-Aware Evaluation of Sign-Language Segmentation across Three Corpora
comment: Submitted to IEEE FG 2027. 9 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary material included
summary: Sign-language segmentation divides continuous signing into clips. In this study, the downstream consumer is a frozen recognizer that assigns one sign label to each predicted clip. Existing metrics instead compare predicted clips with manually annotated boundaries. They do not directly measure whether a clip preserves the visual evidence needed by the recognizer or whether the segmenter produces too many clips. We therefore ask whether overlap metrics and this consumer prefer the same segmenter. We evaluate 27 outputs from three segmentation architectures, three random seeds, and three corpora. Controlled boundary edits separate the effect of removing sign evidence from that of adding surrounding context. Overlap predicts recognition on average, but it does not always determine model choice. At the same intersection-over-union, different recognizers can prefer the shorter or the longer clip. The real outputs reveal two operating regimes. On DGS, overlap, recognition, and sequence error select the same model. On BSL, recognition-based selection recovers and recognizes more reference signs but increases word error rate (WER). Dicta-Sign shows the reverse trade-off: WER selection reduces in-vocabulary WER by 31.17 points but misses more recognizable signs. Segmenters should therefore be evaluated on four axes: temporal agreement, reference recovery, clip recognition, and sequence error, rather than on overlap alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究质疑用重叠度(overlap)指标评估手语分割器是否与下游冻结识别器的需求一致，通过27个分割输出和受控边界编辑实验，发现重叠度虽能平均地预测识别性能，但并非总能决定模型选择，建议从时间一致性、参考恢复、片段识别、序列错误四个维度评估分割器。
AI.motivation: 现有手语分割评估指标仅将预测片段与人工标注边界比较，未能直接衡量片段是否保留了识别器所需的视觉证据，也未衡量分割器是否产生过多片段。作者因此追问：重叠度指标与以冻结识别器作为下游消费者的偏好是否一致。
AI.method: 评估来自3种分割架构、3个随机种子、3个语料的27个分割输出；通过受控边界编辑实验，将"移除手语证据"与"增加周围上下文"两种效应分离；比较重叠度、识别性能与序列错误的选择结果。
AI.result: 重叠度平均上能预测识别性能，但并不总能决定模型选择；在相同IoU下，不同识别器可能偏好更短或更长的片段。真实输出呈现两种运行机制：DGS上重叠度、识别与序列错误选择同一模型；BSL上基于识别的选择恢复了更多参考手语并识别更多，但WER上升；Dicta-Sign呈相反权衡，WER选择使词内WER降低31.17个百分点却漏掉更多可识别手语。
AI.conclusion: 分割器应基于四个维度评估：时间一致性(temporal agreement)、参考恢复(reference recovery)、片段识别(clip recognition)与序列错误(sequence error)，而非仅依赖重叠度。

title: Beyond Multimodal Emotion Conflict: Temporal Context-Aware Hidden Emotion Detection with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition commonly combines textual, acoustic, and visual signals to infer affective states. Recent work has begun to study conflicts among modalities, but a conflict does not necessarily indicate that a person is concealing an emotion. It may also result from mixed emotions, individual expressive styles, or contextual factors. This proposal aims to distinguish ordinary emotional inconsistency from emotion concealment and to infer the underlying emotion when supported by evidence. We plan to construct a multimodal benchmark with explicit annotations of expressed emotion, internal emotion, and concealment conditions, and to develop an MLLM-based framework that integrates fine-grained facial Action Units (AUs), cross-modal features, and temporal context.

AI.tldr: 该提案提出构建带"表达情绪/内在情绪/掩饰条件"显式标注的多模态基准，并开发基于多模态大模型（MLLM）的框架，融合面部动作单元（AU）、跨模态特征与时间上下文，以区分普通情绪不一致与情绪掩饰并推断内在情绪。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情绪识别研究开始关注模态间冲突，但冲突并不必然意味着掩饰情绪，也可能源于混合情绪、个体表达风格或情境因素。因此需要明确区分"普通情绪不一致"与"情绪掩饰"，并在有证据时推断真实内在情绪。
AI.method: 1) 构建多模态基准数据集，显式标注表达情绪、内在情绪与掩饰条件；2) 提出基于MLLM的框架，整合细粒度面部动作单元（AUs）、跨模态特征与时序上下文信息。
AI.result: 摘要为提案性质，尚未报告实验或量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作拟通过新基准与MLLM框架，推进从"模态冲突检测"到"情绪掩饰识别与内在情绪推断"的问题重构与方法探索。

title: Unified dynamics of training, learning, inference, and reinforcement in neural networks
summary: Despite their remarkable success, neural networks remain largely black boxes, and the mechanisms underlying their behavior are still poorly understood. Nine nanoGPT experiments established training-learning-inference relations: realized updates elicit state-dependent finite-amplitude responses; learning persistently reorganizes distributed functional support, with target-specific readout-boundary crossings determining capability transitions; inference recruits learned support without changing the learned state. Factors identified in the fifth experiment yielded a direct predictor of post-update capability transitions, achieving 91.43% accuracy and 91.49% four-way macro recall across 5,088 targets. We tested these relations and prediction across five additional neural architectures. In a seventh system, concentrated correct feedback eroded previously mastered skills; rebalanced feedback restored their accuracy from 70.31% to 99.48%. Linking inference consequences to subsequent training closes these relations into unified training-learning-inference-reinforcement dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过九组nanoGPT实验，建立训练-学习-推理三者之间的关系，并提出可预测更新后能力转变的指标（准确率91.43%，四分类宏召回91.49%），并在五种额外架构上验证，最终将推理后果与后续训练连接为统一的"训练-学习-推理-强化"动力学。
AI.motivation: 神经网络仍是黑箱，其行为机制理解不足；作者希望揭示训练、学习与推理之间的内在关系，并把推理后果纳入训练循环，形成统一解释框架。
AI.method: 基于nanoGPT开展九组实验，观察参数更新引发的状态依赖有限幅度响应、学习对分布式功能支持的重组与读出边界跨越，以及推理对已学支持的调用；用第五组实验识别的因素构建更新后能力转变的直接预测器，并在5,088个目标及五种额外架构上检验；第七组系统研究反馈集中导致的技能侵蚀及再平衡修复。
AI.result: 预测器达到91.43%准确率和91.49%四分类宏召回；关系在五种额外架构上验证成立；集中性正确反馈使已掌握技能退化，再平衡反馈将准确率从70.31%恢复至99.48%。
AI.conclusion: 训练中的更新、学习的分布式重组与推理的支持调用构成可预测的关联结构，且推理后果会反馈影响后续训练，从而闭合为统一的训练-学习-推理-强化动力学框架。

title: Same Sentence, Different Construct: Identity-Swapped Rationales Reveal Measurement Non-Invariance in LLM Hate Speech Classifiers
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as measurement instruments for socially consequential constructs such as hate speech, and are typically validated by their aggregate agreement with human labels. A valid instrument must also apply the same construct to every group it measures. We test this requirement using 421 \hc{} templates that are instantiated identically for seven protected groups, so that only the identity term varies. Four LLM classifiers each exceed 0.95 balanced accuracy, yet within identical templates two of them miss hateful statements about women at markedly higher rates than the same statements about other groups (excess false-negative rates of 8.3 and 4.4 percentage points), a gap first reported for fine-tuned classifiers in 2021. We show how the construct shifts. Comparing rationales within each template, we find that models invoke protected-group status for other groups but recast the identical statement about women as personal dislike or as aimed at an individual, in 22 of 30 missed templates for one model. Adding the benchmark's own definition, which lists sex as a protected characteristic, does not close the gap, and the contrast persists. Apparent false-positive disparities, by contrast, largely vanish under identity control and trace to reclaimed slurs present only for some groups. Errors shared by all models concentrate where model and benchmark definitions diverge, and pairwise counterfactual accuracy adds little beyond endpoint accuracy. We argue that validating LLM measurement requires identity-controlled tests of measurement invariance that examine both decisions and the criteria models state for them.

AI.tldr: 该研究用421个仅身份词不同的模板测试LLM仇恨言论分类器的测量不变性，发现尽管四个模型平衡准确率均>0.95，其中两个对女性相关仇恨言论的假阴性率显著更高（超出8.3和4.4个百分点），且模型通过改写判定依据（将针对女性的同一陈述重构为"个人厌恶"或"针对个体"）导致构念漂移，加入基准定义也无法消除差距。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多被用作仇恨言论等社会敏感构念的测量工具，但目前仅以与人类标签的总体一致性来验证。有效的测量工具必须对每个群体应用同一构念，因此需要身份控制的测量不变性检验，而非仅看聚合准确率。
AI.method: 构建421个仇恨言论模板，对七个受保护群体进行完全相同的实例化，仅身份词不同；评估四个LLM分类器，比较组间假阴性/假阳性差异；通过组内配对的反事实准确率、模型给出的理由（rationale）分析构念如何偏移；并测试加入基准自身定义（含性别为受保护特征）是否能消除差距。
AI.result: 四个LLM分类器平衡准确率均超0.95，但两个模型对女性的仇恨言论假阴性率显著更高（超出8.3和4.4个百分点），与2021年微调分类器的差距一致。理由分析显示，模型对其他群体援引受保护群体身份，却将同一针对女性的陈述重构为个人厌恶或针对个体（某模型30个漏检模板中有22个如此）。加入基准定义未能缩小差距。表面上的假阳性差异在身份控制后基本消失，源于仅部分群体存在的"回收式"侮辱语。所有模型共有的错误集中在模型定义与基准定义分歧之处；成对反事实准确率相比端点准确率增益很小。
AI.conclusion: 验证LLM作为测量工具需要身份控制的测量不变性检验，且必须同时考察判定决策和模型陈述的判定标准；仅凭聚合一致性会掩盖系统性的构念偏移与群体间不等价测量。

title: Answer Correction with Verifiable Rewards: A Gemma-Family Study of Multi-View Driving QA
summary: Multi-camera driving question answering provides a discrete test of vision-language models, but post-training gains can reflect changed selected answers or improved answer extraction. We investigate this distinction within the Gemma model family using archived, task-linked WaymoQA evaluations. A zero-shot diagnostic on 5,519 test questions spans effective-small, mixture-of-experts, unified, and dense checkpoints, with serving differences disclosed rather than interpreted as architecture effects. The strongest controlled evidence is a matched-harness Gemma-4-12B base/GRPO pair: accuracy rises from 73.78% to 75.43%, a gain of 1.65 percentage points with a scene-cluster bootstrap interval of [+0.84, +2.41]. There are 215 improvements and 124 regressions; 213 improvements start from an extractable but incorrect base answer, and only two recover previously unextractable responses. Crossing correctness with extraction state shows why correct noncompliant outputs cannot be counted as prediction errors. Category counts reveal a critical safety asymmetry: routine perception gains (+5.93 pp) mask a regression in safety-critical hazard prediction (-1.82 pp), demonstrating that unweighted outcome rewards can trade off rare edge cases for aggregate accuracy. Reward saturation describes sampled training dynamics rather than an architectural ceiling. A separate archived Gemma-31B thinking comparison yields no detected average improvement, with uncertainty that does not establish equivalence. These results support a modest answer-selection gain for the recorded tuning configuration and a reproducible diagnostic accounting, without attributing corrected labels to specific grounding mechanisms or claiming superiority over matched supervised tuning.

AI.tldr: 在多相机驾驶问答任务上，GRPO 训练带来的提升主要来自"答案选择"的改进，而非新的答案抽取能力；且存在安全不对称性。
AI.motivation: 多相机驾驶问答中，后训练带来的增益可能仅反映所选答案的改变或答案抽取能力的提升，需区分二者；并检验这种提升是否在所有类别上一致。
AI.method: 使用归档的任务绑定 WaymoQA 评估，在 Gemma 家族（有效小模型、MoE、统一、稠密checkpoint）上做 5,519 题的零样本诊断；核心证据为匹配 harness 的 Gemma-4-12B 基座/GRPO 配对，采用场景簇 bootstrap 区间，并按"正确性×可抽取性"交叉分析及类别计数。
AI.result: 基线73.78%→75.43%（+1.65pp，bootstrap区间[+0.84,+2.41]）；215例改善、124例退化，其中213例改善源自"可抽取但错误"的基座答案，仅2例来自原本不可抽取的响应。类别上常规感知提升+5.93pp，但安全关键危险预测下降-1.82pp。Gemma-31B 思考对比未检出平均提升，但不确定性不足以确证等价。
AI.conclusion: 结果为记录的训练配置提供适度的答案选择增益与可复现诊断记账；不归因于具体 grounding 机制，也不宣称优于匹配的监督微调。需警惕无权重结果奖励以罕见边缘案例换取总体精度。

title: Hippocampal consolidation without replay in fully fine-tuned networks
comment: 37 pages, 5 figures, 1 table; Extended Data and Supplementary Information included. Code: https://github.com/kkt94/deltahippo
summary: Networks that keep learning overwrite what they know. Prevailing remedies replay stored data, distil from old models or freeze the backbone. The brain suggests a different division of labour: the hippocampus indexes where experience lies in cortex while the cortex keeps learning. We show that this division lets a fully trainable network keep learning without cross-task replay, a teacher or inference-time memory. After each task, a training-only hippocampal memory indexes the input geometry of every group of synapses sharing an input, residual energy included, and limits each synapse's movement per direction before and after the optimizer. This class-free geometry carries most of the protection; with conflict detection on top, the method cuts absorption of established classes by near-duplicates several-fold against every compared method. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of one principle keeping whole networks learning across four architecture families and models up to 8 billion parameters. Methods that freeze the backbone hold up only as far as its representation already separates the classes; here the whole network keeps learning to tell near-duplicates apart, leading the frozen-backbone baseline by 17.5 points on TACRED. Without the memory, much old knowledge stays decodable but beyond the network's reach.

AI.tldr: 提出受海马体启发的"索引式记忆"机制：训练期专用海马记忆按输入几何为每组共享输入的突触建立索引，在优化器前后按方向限制突触移动，使全网络可训练且无需跨任务回放、教师模型或推理期记忆，即可持续学习新任务。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，现有方案（回放存储数据、旧模型蒸馏、冻结主干）各有代价；大脑用海马体索引皮层经验位置、皮层持续学习的"分工"给出另一条路线，作者希望据此实现无需回放/教师/推理内存的全网络持续学习。
AI.method: 每任务结束后，构建仅在训练期使用的"海马记忆"，对每组共享同一输入的突触索引其输入几何（含残差能量），据此在优化器更新前后限制各突触沿各方向的移动幅度；该无类别几何提供主要保护，再叠加冲突检测进一步抑制近重复样本对已学类别的覆盖。
AI.result: 类别无关几何贡献大部分保护效应；叠加冲突检测后，相比所有对比方法，近重复样本对已建立类别的吸收降低数倍。首次以单一原理在四种架构族、最大80亿参数模型上保持整网持续学习；在TACRED上较冻结主干基线高17.5分。若无该记忆，许多旧知识仍可解码但网络无法调用。
AI.conclusion: "海马索引+皮层学习"的分工可作为通用持续学习原理：全网络保持可训练、无需回放与推理期内存，在多种架构与大模型上有效，并优于冻结主干路线；记忆缺失时旧知识"可解码但不可达"，凸显索引机制对知识可调用性的关键作用。

title: MAPLE: A Multimodal Mobile Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience
summary: Autonomous agents powered by vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential in navigating mobile graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete complex tasks. However, existing paradigms face fundamental scalability bottlenecks: fine-tuning requires massive high-fidelity datasets or prohibitive training time and compute, while gradient-free approaches rely on custom static heuristics or costly trial-and-error trajectory exploration where feedback is deferred until the end of execution. To address these limitations, we introduce MAPLE (Multimodal Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience), a novel gradient-free multi-agent framework that enables dynamic, step-wise experience sharing and execution-time prompt evolution. Unlike traditional action-reflection architectures that depend on costly, post-hoc self-reflection, MAPLE enables agents to cross-reference and distribute runtime insights in real time at each operational step. This dynamic exchange eliminates blind trial-and-error looping and steers agents along direct, grounded interaction paths. Extensive evaluations on the AndroidWorld and MobileWorld benchmarks demonstrate that MAPLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex, long-horizon mobile tasks, while proving scalable and adaptable across novel environments.

AI.tldr: MAPLE 是一个无需梯度的多智能体框架，通过逐步实时共享经验与执行时提示演化，在移动 GUI 长程任务上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 移动 GUI 智能体存在扩展性瓶颈：微调需大量高保真数据与算力；无梯度方法依赖静态启发式或昂贵的试错探索，且反馈延迟到执行结束。
AI.method: 提出 MAPLE（Multimodal Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience），一个无梯度的多智能体框架，支持动态的逐步经验共享与执行时提示演化；区别于依赖事后自我反思的架构，智能体在每一步操作时可实时交叉引用并分发运行时洞见，消除盲目试错循环。
AI.result: 在 AndroidWorld 与 MobileWorld 基准上的大量评测显示，MAPLE 在复杂长程移动任务上达到 SOTA，并在新环境中具备可扩展性与适应性。
AI.conclusion: 实时逐步经验共享是替代高成本微调与事后反思的有效路径，为可扩展的 GUI 智能体提供了新范式。

title: Ranked but Not Stopped: Detecting Prompt-Injection Hijacks from Typed Decision Models' Output Probabilities
summary: Programs that use a language model as a classifier act on its most probable label. Text injected into the input can move that label to one the attacker chooses, a hijack. A monitor that does not know the attacker's label can read the model's own confidence and raise an alarm when the top probability is low. We test this monitor on AG News topic classification with five systems, three of them served through a provider's API. Pooled over five families of injected text, low confidence ranks hijacked answers above clean ones on four of the five systems (AUROC 0.86-0.90). Ranking them does not stop many of them. A threshold set so that at most 5% of clean answers to separate calibration articles alarm falls among the least confident clean answers, and every more confident hijack passes. In our main gate run on the three API-served systems, the monitor misses 51-70% of the hijacks caused by a plain injected note (per-system point estimates). When the note adds one handwritten sentence that calls the target certain and asks for full probability, the monitor misses 99-100% of the hijacks, although low confidence still ranks them at AUROC 0.70-0.79. Confidence monitors should be tested at their operating alarm rate, against attackers who claim certainty.

AI.tldr: 用模型置信度作监控器（低置信度报警）检测提示注入导致的标签劫持，在AG News上五个系统测试：低置信度在四个系统上排序能力尚可（AUROC 0.86-0.90），但在5%误报率下漏检严重（51-70%，加一句"声称确定并索取完整概率"的手写句后漏检99-100%）。
AI.motivation: 以语言模型作分类器时，注入文本可把预测标签劫持到攻击者所选类别；希望验证一种不依赖攻击者标签的简单防御——用模型自身置信度低时报警——是否真的能在实际报警率下阻止劫持。
AI.method: 在AG News主题分类任务上，用五个系统（其中三个通过提供商API服务）测试置信度监控器；汇总五类注入文本，用AUROC评估低置信度对劫持样本的排序能力，并在限制干净样本误报率≤5%的阈值下评估实际漏检率；进一步加入"声称目标确定并要求给出完整概率"的手写句子作为增强攻击。
AI.result: 低置信度在四个系统上把劫持答案排在干净答案之上（AUROC 0.86-0.90）；但在5%误报阈值下，凡比最低置信干净答案更有信心的劫持全部通过。三套API系统中，普通注入便条的漏检率为51-70%；加入手写句子后漏检达99-100%（尽管AUROC仍有0.70-0.79）。
AI.conclusion: 能排序不等于能拦截：置信度监控器必须在其实际操作报警率下、针对"声称确定"的对手进行评估，现有低置信度监控不足以防御标签劫持。

title: Fewer Tokens, More Answers: Verifiable-Reward Tuning of an Ornith-Style VLM for Multi-View Driving QA
summary: Reasoning-enabled model derivatives must turn intermediate deliberation into a usable answer within a deployment budget. We study that transition in an Ornith checkpoint adapted to multi-camera driving question answering with verifiable rewards. Paired archived outputs show that, on a selected 400-question development screen with a 256-token cap, GRPO increases answer extraction from 78.25% to 90.25% and accuracy from 55.50% to 63.75%. Of 39 wrong-to-correct transitions, 33 begin with an unextractable base response. The base's 87 unextractable responses all reach the token cap. Checkpoint-verified reconstruction on those same questions gives a much smaller first-pass accuracy gain at 512 tokens: +0.75 percentage points, versus +8.25 at 256. A later answer-cued continuation is analyzed separately; it helps the base more and narrows the adapter difference. On the full 2,511-question development set, this recovery-enabled pipeline reduces mean generated tokens from 108.6 to 47.1, while the paired accuracy interval includes zero gain. We frame these findings as adaptation of answer delivery under finite budgets, with explicit selection and provenance limits. Ornith's self-scaffolding lineage and newer reasoning-enabled derivatives such as Bonsai motivate the problem, but our measured results concern Ornith alone and do not establish a shared architectural mechanism or cross-model transfer.

AI.tldr: 在256 token预算下，GRPO将可提取答案率从78.25%提升到90.25%、准确率从55.50%提升到63.75%，但该增益主要来自"答案交付"而非推理能力，且随预算放宽而消失。
AI.motivation: 推理型模型必须在部署预算内把中间推理转化为可用答案。作者想研究这一"交付转换"环节：在有限token预算下，模型能否把思考结束并输出可提取的答案。
AI.method: 在多摄像头驾驶问答任务上，用可验证奖励对Ornith检查点做GRPO适配。对比归档配对输出：400题开发筛选集、256 token上限；并在同样题目上用512 token做检查点验证的重建；另做"答案提示续写"分析；最后在全部2,511题开发集上评估含恢复流程的完整管线。
AI.result: 256 token下：可提取率78.25%→90.25%，准确率55.50%→63.75%；39个由错转对的样本中33个起点为不可提取回答，基座87个不可提取回答全部触顶。512 token下首轮准确率增益仅+0.75个百分点（256时为+8.25）。答案提示续写对基座帮助更大、缩小适配器差距。全开发集上平均生成token由108.6降至47.1，但配对准确率置信区间包含零增益。
AI.conclusion: 作者把结论定位为"有限预算下答案交付的适配"，而非推理能力提升；并明确承认选择性与来源局限——结论仅针对Ornith，不构成跨模型或共享架构机制的证据。

title: Opening the Black Box of Neural Auction Mechanisms
summary: Neural auction design has emerged as a powerful paradigm within automated mechanism design for modern Web platforms. Because these learned mechanisms directly dictate critical economic outcomes, their lack of internal transparency raises significant auditability and trust concerns. Opening this black box \textit{post-hoc} is therefore essential, yet presents two distinctive challenges: (1) activation contexts are dense, correlated numerical profiles devoid of explicit semantic structure, and (2) feature interpretations can only be falsifiably audited if they map to measurable auction states or outcomes. In this paper, we propose a post-hoc white-box auditing framework for unpacking trained neural auctions. Using CITransNet as a representative testbed, we first employ sparse autoencoders to decompose hidden representations while faithfully preserving downstream auction behavior. Anchoring feature interpretations to native economic targets, we validate them through activation prediction and causal interventions to isolate verified features from the reconstruction dictionary. Finally, applying this pipeline across varied auction settings, we show that the verified features can serve as analytical instruments to examine how internal representations modulate strategic misreporting incentives, align with Myerson's optimal auction, and support the diagnosis of individual auctions. Our work highlights the potential of white-box mechanism auditing to build the foundational trust necessary for neural auctions to be deployed as widely adopted Web technologies. To enhance research transparency and facilitate independent inspection, we publicly release the experimental results supporting our findings at https://github.com/Li-Beverly-Kong/opening-neural-auctions.git

AI.tldr: 提出一个后验白盒审计框架，用稀疏自编码器分解神经拍卖的隐藏表示，并将特征解释锚定到经济目标上，通过激活预测与因果干预筛选出可验证特征，进而用于分析策略性谎报激励、与Myerson最优拍卖的对齐性以及单场拍卖诊断。
AI.motivation: 神经拍卖已广泛用于Web平台的自动机制设计，并直接决定关键经济结果，但其内部缺乏透明度，带来审计与信任问题。后验打开黑箱面临两大挑战：激活上下文是稠密、相关的数值画像，缺乏显式语义结构；特征解释只有映射到可测量的拍卖状态或结果，才能被可证伪地审计。
AI.method: 以CITransNet为代表测试平台：先用稀疏自编码器在忠实保留下游拍卖行为的前提下分解隐藏表示；将特征解释锚定到原生的经济目标；通过激活预测和因果干预验证解释，从重建字典中分离出已验证特征；最后在多种拍卖设置下应用该流程。
AI.result: 已验证特征可作为分析工具，用于考察内部表示如何调节策略性谎报激励、如何与Myerson最优拍卖对齐，并支持对单场拍卖的诊断。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了白盒机制审计的潜力，有助于为神经拍卖作为广泛采用的Web技术部署建立基础性信任；实验结果为便于独立检查已公开。

title: FACET: Feasibility-Automaton Complete Enumeration and Truncation-Free Scoring of Molecular Formulas from MS/MS
summary: Determining the neutral molecular formula of a precursor ion from its tandem mass (MS/MS) spectrum is the first step in identifying an unknown small molecule. Existing methods trade recall, whether the correct formula is among the candidates, against the cost of examining each candidate. Methods that examine each candidate in depth must first shorten the list, by limiting element counts or truncating it, and that is where the correct formula is lost. End-to-end regressors are fast but guarantee neither validity nor recall. We present FACET, which separates deciding which formulas to consider from deciding which one to choose. A feasibility automaton builds a formula one element count at a time and admits exactly the formulas that fit the precursor mass and satisfy the ring-and-double-bond and valence constraints. Run as an exhaustive search, it enumerates the complete feasible set, so every candidate is valid and recall is fixed by the chemical constraints rather than by a trained model. A small neural scoring head then ranks every feasible formula from one pass of a pretrained spectrum encoder, so no candidate is discarded. On the NPLIB1 benchmark FACET reaches top-1 accuracies of $0.859$ with the adduct known and $0.729$ with it unknown, compared with $0.766$ and $0.660$ for the strongest established method, and its recall is the highest. On the external CASMI 2022 set its recall is $1.000$, and with the adduct unknown it is the most accurate of the methods compared.

AI.tldr: FACET 将"哪些分子式可行"与"选哪一个"解耦：用可行性自动机穷举满足前体质量、RDB 与价键约束的全部可行分子式，再用小型神经打分头对全部候选统一排序，实现高召回且候选全部合法的 MS/MS 中性分子式推断。
AI.motivation: 从 MS/MS 谱图确定前体离子的中性分子式是小分子鉴定的第一步。现有方法在召回率与候选检验成本之间权衡：逐一深检的方法需通过限制元素数或截断候选列表来缩短列表，导致正确分子式被丢弃；端到端回归器虽快，却既无合法性保证也无召回保证。
AI.method: 提出 FACET，分离"决定考虑哪些分子式"与"决定选哪一个"。一是可行性自动机，逐元素计数构建分子式，只接纳符合前体质量并满足环双键（RDB）与价键约束的分子式；穷举搜索时枚举出完整可行集。二是小型神经打分头，基于预训练谱图编码器的一次前向，对所有可行分子式排序，不丢弃任何候选。
AI.result: 在 NPLIB1 基准上，加合物已知时 top-1 准确率 0.859、未知时 0.729，对比最强现有方法的 0.766 与 0.660，且召回率最高。在外部 CASMI 2022 集上召回率为 1.000，加合物未知时在对比方法中准确率最高。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动机保证可行性、神经打分保证排序质量，FACET 使召回由化学约束而非训练模型决定，每个候选均合法，在准确率与召回上均优于既有方法。

title: Tune the Baseline First: Most of Muon's Scaled Weight Decay Gain Is a Tuning Gap, but Its Small Real Advantage Grows With Model Size
summary: Scaled weight decay for Muon (Muon-SW) has been reported to train language models more efficiently than constant decoupled weight decay, but such comparisons usually reuse one learning-rate (LR) and weight-decay (WD) setting for both methods. We re-run the comparison under the MAI-Base-2 protocol: LR and WD are tuned jointly through their product for each method, on a source-scaled mixture-of-experts (MoE) scaling ladder (1.9M to 15M active parameters) that holds tokens per active parameter and data repetition fixed across sizes. We find: (1) Most of the gain is a tuning gap. At the shared setting Muon-SW wins by 0.035 bits per byte (BPB), a 1.52x compute saving; after both methods are tuned, the gap is 0.0026 BPB (95% CI [0.0018, 0.0034]), a 1.03x saving, so about 90% of the advantage disappears. (2) The small advantage that remains is real: at the smallest size, all four paired seeds favour Muon-SW at the tuned settings. (3) That advantage grows with model size: across an 8x range of active parameters, the tuned gap rises from 0.0036 to 0.0051 BPB while the untuned gap shrinks from 0.035 to 0.024, so the surviving share rises from about 10% to 21%. (4) The best weight decay moves with scale: the optimal LRWD product grows for both methods, faster for Muon-SW (ratio 1.40 to 1.91), and a law fitted on the two smallest sizes overshoots the third by 1.3-1.5x, costing up to 0.002 BPB. The whole study runs on one NVIDIA T4 GPU; we release the code and all run results.

AI.tldr: 在MAI-Base-2协议下联合调优LR与WD重新比较Muon-SW与常数解耦WD：原报告的优势约90%来自调参不充分，剩余~0.0026 BPB优势真实但很小且随规模增大。
AI.motivation: 已有工作称Muon的scaled weight decay（Muon-SW）比常数解耦WD训练语言模型更高效，但这些比较通常对两种方法沿用同一套学习率（LR）与权重衰减（WD）设置，可能把调参差异误判为方法优势，因此需要在公平协议下重新审慎验证。
AI.method: 采用MAI-Base-2协议：对每种方法通过LR×WD乘积联合调优LR与WD；在源缩放的MoE扩展阶梯上实验（1.9M–15M活跃参数），各规模固定每活跃参数的token数与数据重复次数；使用配对种子对比BPB，并拟合LRWD最优值随规模的规律。
AI.result: (1) 共享设置下Muon-SW领先0.035 BPB（1.52x算力节省），双方各自调优后差距仅0.0026 BPB（95% CI [0.0018, 0.0034]，1.03x），约90%优势消失；(2) 残余优势真实：最小规模下四组配对种子在调优设置下均支持Muon-SW；(3) 优势随规模增长：8倍活跃参数范围内，调优后差距由0.0036升至0.0051 BPB，而未调优差距由0.035降至0.024，存活比例由约10%升至21%；(4) 最优WD随规模变化，最优LRWD乘积两法均增长且Muon-SW更快（比值1.40→1.91），用两个最小规模拟合的规律在第三规模上高估1.3–1.5x，代价最高0.002 BPB。
AI.conclusion: Muon-SW相对常数解耦WD的效率优势主要源于调参差异而非方法本身；调优后仅存微小但统计稳健且随模型规模增加的优势。最优WD随规模漂移且难以从小规模外推，需逐规模调参。全部实验在单张NVIDIA T4上完成，代码与运行结果已开源。

title: Running a 20B Video Diffusion Transformer on Consumer Hardware: A Deployment and Measurement Report for MiniMax H3 on Apple Silicon
comment: Also published as a Zenodo record, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23803987
summary: We report the end-to-end deployment and measurement of MiniMax H3, a 20.38-billion-parameter video diffusion transformer (DiT) - the count measured from the safetensors headers of the Q8 checkpoint as deployed locally (Section 3.2) - running entirely on consumer Apple Silicon hardware: an Apple Mac mini with M5 Pro chip and 64 GiB of unified memory. Using the official bf16-to-Q8 (8-bit, group size 64) quantization path executed locally on the machine, we produced a working text-to-video pipeline with no cloud dependency. We document the full deployment procedure, including two non-trivial blockers and their fixes, and report measured figures for build time, peak memory, and per-clip render latency across four resolution tiers (Draft 384x640 through Native 768x1344). A 15.08-second 576x1024 clip rendered in 4838.49 seconds with a measured MLX peak of 27.467 GiB. We further operated the system as an unattended production pipeline, completing 17 clips in 26.49 hours with zero render failures. A blind human review of the 17 production clips (generation prompts withheld) averaged 3.12, 3.18, and 2.94 out of 5 for structural integrity, temporal consistency, and visible artifacts. All figures in this report are our own measurements except where explicitly labeled as third-party data. This is a systems/empirical report; we make no claim of model innovation.

AI.tldr: 在单台 Apple Mac mini（M5 Pro，64 GiB 统一内存）上端到端本地部署并实测了 20.38B 参数的 MiniMax H3 视频 DiT，经官方 bf16→Q8 量化实现零云端依赖的文生视频流水线，并给出构建时间、峰值内存与各分辨率渲染时延。
AI.motivation: 大参数量视频扩散模型的部署通常依赖云端 GPU，缺乏在消费级 Apple Silicon 上的完整、可复现部署经验与量化实测数据；本文旨在填补这一工程空白并记录实际阻塞问题与解决方案。
AI.method: 在本地使用官方 bf16→Q8（8-bit，group size 64）量化路径处理 Q8 safetensors 检查点；记录完整部署流程与两个关键阻塞项的修复；实测构建时间、MLX 峰值内存及四档分辨率（Draft 384x640 至 Native 768x1344）的单片段渲染时延；并将其作为无人值守生产流水线连续运行。
AI.result: 15.08 秒的 576x1024 片段渲染耗时 4838.49 秒，MLX 峰值内存 27.467 GiB；无人值守生产共 17 个片段、26.49 小时、零渲染失败；盲评（隐去提示词）在结构完整性、时序一致性、可见伪影三项上分别为 3.12、3.18、2.94（满分 5）。
AI.conclusion: 消费级 Apple Silicon 可在无云依赖下运行 20B 级视频 DiT，但速度慢（单片段约 80 分钟）、内存占用高；可作为可靠的低成本离线生产方案。本文为系统/实证报告，不主张模型创新，除标注第三方数据外均为自测。

title: RubricWorld: World Model-Guided Rubric Optimization for LLM Graders
comment: 25 pages including references and appendices; 6 figures, 8 tables
summary: Rubric optimization improves LLM grading by revising scoring instructions while keeping the grader's parameters fixed. Existing optimizers often judge edits by aggregate validation performance, limiting the supervision they retain about which errors an edit corrects or introduces. Testing each candidate also requires rescoring validation answers, which limits how many edits can be explored within a fixed budget. We propose RubricWorld, a framework that learns from previous edit evaluations to guide further search. Its world model predicts an edit's correction and degradation rates at score boundaries, conditioned on the current rubric state. The training signal comes from paired grading results: scores for the same answers before and after an edit. Predictions select one candidate for direct evaluation, and held-out confidence bounds determine whether it corrects enough target errors while keeping new errors within prespecified limits. Measured effects update the model even when the edit is rejected. Across EIR (National), ASAP2.0, and ASAP-SAS with three frozen LLM graders, RubricWorld achieves the highest score in 20 of 27 metric comparisons. On ASAP2.0, it raises gpt-5-mini accuracy from 18.20% with the original rubric to 46.70%, exceeding the strongest baseline, APO, by 22.60 percentage points. code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: RubricWorld：用"世界模型"从历史编辑评估中学习，预测rubric编辑在分数边界上的纠错/致错率，指导候选选择，并在3个数据集×3个冻结评分LLM上20/27项指标最优。
AI.motivation: 现有rubric优化器仅以聚合验证性能评判编辑，监督信号信息量低（无法得知某编辑纠正/引入了哪些错误）；且每个候选都需重打分验证集，预算内可探索的编辑数量受限。
AI.method: 构建世界模型，以当前rubric状态为条件，预测编辑在分数边界处的修正率与劣化率；训练信号来自同一批答案在编辑前后的配对评分结果；由预测选出一个候选直接评估，再用留出集置信界判断其是否纠正足够目标错误且新增错误在预设范围内；即使编辑被拒绝，实测效应也用于更新模型。
AI.result: 在EIR (National)、ASAP2.0、ASAP-SAS三个数据集与三种冻结LLM评分器上，27项指标比较中20项取得最高分；ASAP2.0上gpt-5-mini准确率从原始rubric的18.20%提升至46.70%，比最强基线APO高22.60个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以配对评分监督世界模型、并用置信界控制纠错与新增错误的权衡，可显著提升rubric优化的样本效率与评分准确率，优于聚合指标驱动的现有方法。

title: Learned Surrogates of Three-Dimensional Magnetohydrodynamic Turbulence
summary: Three-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) turbulence, the flow of astrophysical and fusion plasmas, is costly to simulate. We present, to our knowledge, the first learned surrogates of three-dimensional resistive MHD turbulence, and compare three standard backbones in that role: a convolutional UNet, a shifted-window transformer and a Fourier neural operator. They are trained as autoregressive emulators of decaying MHD turbulence at a resolution of $128^3$ and Reynolds numbers of 1000, 3000 and 6000, on 500 simulations per Reynolds number, each with one two-stage procedure, single steps and then short rollouts, and stopped by one rule. Over a window of about one large-eddy turnover time, the UNet and the transformer reach relative velocity errors of 0.018 to 0.053 and keep the current sheets, the enstrophy, the current density and the energy spectra of the simulation; which of the two is the more accurate depends on the Reynolds number, the UNet leading at 3000 and 6000 and the transformer at 1000. Applied with the same backbones and training procedure to two public benchmarks, the models reach the lowest error reported to date on the isotropic turbulence set of FactFormer, 39% below the best published model. On the compressible MHD set of The Well, their rollout errors are a third to a half below those of the best of The Well's baselines. They also match a 1.3 B-parameter pretrained foundation model in its rollout windows, with 20-62 times fewer parameters. The code, the configuration of every model, the evaluation scripts and the data generator with the seed of every simulation will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 首次将三种标准骨干网络（UNet、Swin Transformer、Fourier神经算子）作为三维电阻MHD湍流的自回归代理模型，在128³分辨率、Re=1000/3000/6000下训练并对比，并在两个公开基准上取得最低误差。
AI.motivation: 三维磁流体湍流（天体与聚变等离子体流动）模拟成本高昂，亟需低成本代理模型；此前缺乏对三维电阻MHD湍流的学习型代理与骨干网络系统比较。
AI.method: 以UNet、shifted-window Transformer和Fourier神经算子为骨干，训练为衰减MHD湍流的自回归模拟器（128³，Re=1000/3000/6000，每个Re 500个模拟）；采用统一两阶段训练（先单步、后短rollout）并以同一规则早停；另在两个公开基准上以相同骨干与流程验证。
AI.result: 约一个大涡翻转时间窗口内，UNet与Transformer相对速度误差0.018–0.053，并保留电流片、拟能、电流密度与能谱；精度排名依赖Re（UNet在3000/6000领先，Transformer在1000领先）。在FactFormer各向同性湍流集上误差较已发表最优低39%；在The Well可压缩MHD集上rollout误差比其最佳基线低1/3至1/2；在rollout窗口内可媲美13亿参数预训练基础模型，而参数量少20–62倍。
AI.conclusion: 学习型代理可低成本高保真地模拟三维MHD湍流，标准骨干即达SOTA，且参数效率远优于大模型；代码、配置、评估脚本与数据生成器将公开。

title: FindLink: Learning to Assess Scientific Connections from Source-Grounded Premises
summary: Scientific discovery from the literature requires assessing connections among findings obtained under different study conditions. Source attribution makes individual findings traceable, but does not determine what they jointly support. We introduce GI-TraceBench, a benchmark of 10,282 questions in gastrointestinal oncology that unifies provenance question answering, knowledge discovery, and hypothesis evaluation through shared Paper, Claim, and Evidence Span records. We further propose FindLink, a two-stage framework for provenance-grounded scientific reasoning. Premise Grounding constructs source-bound premises with explicit study context and support status. Structured Reasoning organizes these premises into support plans that represent both supported relations and unresolved conditions, then generates evidence-conditioned answers using deterministic compiler feedback. The compiler verifies structural and source-binding consistency, but does not assess scientific entailment. On the 1,545-question fixed-evidence test set, FindLink improves the balanced family macro score from 67.95 to 87.25 over direct supervised fine-tuning of the same backbone. A retrained variant without Structured Reasoning achieves slightly higher premise-identifier F1, but substantially lower relation and evidence-sufficiency F1. These results indicate that scientific reasoning requires not only identifying grounded premises, but also assessing what connections those premises support.

AI.tldr: 提出GI-TraceBench基准与FindLink两阶段框架，用于溯源约束的科研推理；在固定证据测试集上均衡家族宏分由67.95提升至87.25。
AI.motivation: 文献级科学发现需评估不同研究条件下发现间的联系；现有来源溯源只能追踪单个结论，无法判断其共同支持什么。
AI.method: 构建含10,282个胃肠肿瘤学问题的基准，以共享的论文、论断、证据片段记录统一溯源问答、知识发现与假设评估；FindLink含两阶段：前提锚定（带研究情境与支持状态的来源绑定前提）与结构化推理（构造支持计划包含已支持关系和未解决条件，借助确定性编译器反馈生成证据条件化答案）。
AI.result: 1,545题固定证据测试集上，均衡家族宏分从67.95升至87.25（相较同骨干直接监督微调）；去除结构化推理的重训变体前提标识F1略高，但关系与证据充分性F1明显更低。
AI.conclusion: 科学推理不仅需识别有据前提，还需评估这些前提所支持的联系；编译器仅校验结构与来源绑定一致性，不判断科学蕴含。

title: Toward Counterfactual Learning for Selective Re-Examination in Agentic Visual Search
summary: Visual search over high-resolution images requires a vision-language model (VLM) not only to determine where to inspect, but also whether another observation is warranted before committing to an answer. Existing prompting, demonstrations, and outcome-based reinforcement learning can encourage re-examination, yet do not directly supervise whether it is beneficial at a particular search state. We introduce ReSee, a benchmark of re-examination decisions comprising 3,227 visual-search trajectories and 8,827 explicit commit-or-re-examine decisions, with counterfactual adjudication that distinguishes states where additional inspection is warranted from those where commitment is preferable. Building on this formulation, we propose CARE (Counterfactual Advantage for Re-Examination), a decision-level reinforcement learning method that compares paired continuations under commit and re-examine verdicts from the same search state. Their cost-aware return difference estimates the counterfactual value of an additional observation and is assigned only to the corresponding verdict tokens, providing localized credit for whether search should continue. Experiments expose limited re-examination selectivity in existing VLMs and show that CARE significantly improves accuracy and decision selectivity over GRPO across two backbones, with higher accuracy and fewer visual requests on six unseen OOD benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReSee 基准与 CARE 方法，用反事实优势监督 VLM 在高分辨率视觉搜索中"提交还是再看一眼"的决策，提升准确率并减少无谓查看。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像视觉搜索需要模型判断是否值得再观察一次，但现有提示、示例和结果导向强化学习只能间接鼓励复查，无法在具体搜索状态上直接监督"复查是否有益"。
AI.method: 构建 ReSee 基准（3,227 条搜索轨迹、8,827 个显式提交/复查决策），并用反事实裁决区分"应再检查"与"应提交"的状态；据此提出 CARE，一种决策级强化学习方法，在同一搜索状态下对比 commit 与 re-examine 两条配对续写，以代价感知回报差估计额外观察的反事实价值，并仅将该信用分配给对应的判定 token。
AI.result: 实验显示现有 VLM 的复查选择性有限；CARE 在两个主干模型上相较 GRPO 显著提升准确率与决策选择性，并在六个未见 OOD 基准上取得更高准确率与更少视觉请求。
AI.conclusion: 将"是否再观察"显式建模为决策级、带反事实信用的学习问题，可有效提升视觉搜索的准确性与效率，并具备良好的分布外泛化。

title: Safety4DM: A Vision-Language Framework for Risk-Aware Dynamic Maps in Vehicle-Road-Cloud Collaborative Driving
summary: Dynamic map (DM) is a core information infrastructure for vehicle-road-cloud (VRC) cooperative autonomous driving. It fuses perception data from multiple sources to overcome the inherent line-of-sight and field-of-view limits of single-vehicle perception. However, DM still falls short on driving safety in two ways. First, DM data specifications already define road conditions semantically, but no pipeline yet turns real-world road observations into fine-grained risk entities in the DM. Second, existing DM systems lack a natural language interface for driving risks. To close these gaps, we propose Safety4DM, a safety-oriented language system for VRC dynamic maps. We first build RoadRisk, a real-world road image dataset that covers four types of road conditions and four risk levels. On this dataset, we fine-tune a vision-language model (VLM) for road safety risk perception. The model outputs structured risk representations that the DM can ingest directly. We then introduce a Safety-aware Step-wise Prompting (SafeStep) mechanism as the natural language query interface of the DM. SafeStep answers queries accurately and also generates actionable driving advice. To build and evaluate this interface, we develop SafeVRC-Sim, a VRC cooperative simulation framework, and SafeDM-QA, a safety question-answering benchmark. Experiments show that even the compact Qwen3-VL-4B reaches 89.83% accuracy on risk perception after fine-tuning. SafeStep also plugs easily into multiple LLM families. With medium and large models (20B and above) from five families, it achieves over 93% natural language query accuracy in every case, which shows strong generalization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Safety4DM，一个面向车路云协同动态地图（DM）的安全导向语言系统：用微调 VLM 从真实道路图像中感知风险并输出结构化风险实体，配套 SafeStep 自然语言问答接口。
AI.motivation: 动态地图虽融合多源感知突破单车视野局限，但存在两点安全短板：(1) DM 规范已语义定义道路状况，却缺少将真实道路观测转为细粒度风险实体的流水线；(2) DM 系统缺乏面向驾驶风险的自然语言接口。
AI.method: 构建 RoadRisk 真实道路图像数据集（4 类路况、4 级风险）并微调 VLM 进行风险感知，输出 DM 可直接摄入的结构化风险表示；提出 SafeStep 分步提示机制作为 DM 的自然语言查询接口，可准确作答并给出可执行驾驶建议；同时开发 SafeVRC-Sim 协同仿真框架与 SafeDM-QA 安全问答基准用于构建和评测。
AI.result: 紧凑模型 Qwen3-VL-4B 微调后风险感知准确率达 89.83%；SafeStep 可便捷接入多个 LLM 系列，五个系列的中大型模型（20B 及以上）自然语言查询准确率均超 93%，泛化性强。
AI.conclusion: Safety4DM 打通了从真实道路观测到 DM 风险实体再到自然语言交互的安全链路，兼具风险感知精度与跨模型泛化能力；但结论主要基于仿真与基准评测，真实车路云部署下的验证仍待补充。

title: State-Augmented Learning for Post-Deployment Adaptation of Coexisting O-RAN Applications
comment: submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
summary: Fixed control policies in Open RAN can require retraining when service requirements, traffic loads, or interacting applications change. We propose ATTUNE, a state-augmented learning method for an energy saving application that coexists with a learned mobility load balancing application under a service constraint. ATTUNE conditions the energy saving policy on a Lagrange multiplier and updates this scalar during operation using measured service degradation, while keeping both applications' network parameters fixed. To train a single policy across service requirements, ATTUNE samples target service levels uniformly and maps them to multipliers through an adaptive table. This procedure accounts for policy-dependent multiplier responses and improves energy savings compared with training over a widened fixed multiplier range. We characterize the induced distribution of service levels and the convergence and fluctuations of the online update. An exact finite-window identity establishes convergence of average measured degradation to the target when the projection corrections vanish on average. Simulations show that a single ATTUNE policy achieves energy savings comparable to policies trained separately for each service requirement. It adapts to changes in the target, load, and partner application without retraining, increases energy savings at light load, and maintains target tracking for separately trained application pairs. No statistically significant increase in cell switching is detected in the evaluated comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出 ATTUNE，一种服务约束下与学习型移动负载均衡共存的节能固定策略参数化方法，通过拉格朗日乘子条件化策略并在线更新，无需重训练即可适应目标变化与负载变化。
AI.motivation: Open RAN 中固定控制策略在服务需求、流量负载或共存应用变化时需要重新训练，成本高且不易部署；同时节能应用需与学习型移动负载均衡应用共存并满足服务约束。
AI.method: 将节能策略条件化于拉格朗日乘子，运行中用实测服务退化在线更新该标量；保持两个应用网络参数固定；跨服务需求训练单一策略时均匀采样目标服务等级并通过自适应表映射为乘子，以应对策略相关的乘子响应；理论上刻画服务等级诱导分布及在线更新的收敛与波动，给出有限窗口恒等式。
AI.result: 单一 ATTUNE 策略的节能效果与针对各服务需求单独训练的策略相当；无需重训练即可适应目标、负载与伙伴应用变化；轻负载下节能提升；对单独训练的应用对保持目标跟踪；评估对比中未见小区切换的显著统计增加。
AI.conclusion: 以乘子为条件并结合自适应表的在线更新，可在不重训练、不修改网络参数的前提下实现服务约束节能与跨应用共存的自适应控制。

title: Re$^3$Rank: Listwise Reranking with Reasoning-Conditioned Retrieval Heads
summary: Attention-based rerankers score each candidate by the attention mass that retrieval heads route to it from the question, but the question, serving as a fixed query, carries limited information for locating relevant evidence. We propose Re$^3$Rank, a listwise reranker built on reasoning-conditioned retrieval heads (RRHeads). A generator first writes a reasoning trace over the question and the candidates, and a scorer then uses the trace tokens as the attention query of a few selected RRHeads, reading relevance as continuous scores. We present a straight-through estimator to propagate the ranking loss through the discrete trace, so that the generator and the scorer can be trained jointly for ranking. Averaged over 9 benchmarks, Re$^3$Rank outperforms 11 baseline rerankers: our 4B variant exceeds the strongest baseline by 3.11 NDCG@10 points on average, and even our 0.6B variant surpasses rerankers with up to 32B parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出Re³Rank，一种基于推理条件检索头（RRHeads）的列表级重排器：先用生成器对问题和候选写出推理轨迹，再以轨迹token作为指定检索头的注意力查询来打分，并用直通估计器将排序损失回传到离散轨迹，实现生成器与打分器联合训练。
AI.motivation: 基于注意力的重排器以问题作为固定查询，通过检索头分配给候选的注意力质量来打分，但问题信息有限，难以定位相关证据。
AI.method: 1）生成器先针对问题与候选生成推理轨迹；2）打分器将轨迹token作为少量精选RRHeads的注意力查询，以连续分数读出相关性；3）引入直通估计器把排序损失穿过离散轨迹反向传播，使生成器与打分器可面向排序任务联合训练。
AI.result: 在9个基准上平均而言，Re³Rank优于11个基线重排器；4B版本平均超出最强基线3.11个NDCG@10点；0.6B版本甚至超过参数量达32B的重排器。
AI.conclusion: 以推理轨迹替代固定问题作为注意力查询，并端到端联合优化生成与打分，可显著提升重排效果，且小模型也具强竞争力。

title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
summary: Real-time long-video generation requires continuous output with consistent appearance and natural motion. Existing chunk-wise autoregressive methods face challenges in both generation efficiency and long-video quality: serialized denoising and history-cache refresh require two forward passes even with one-step denoising, and longer rollouts can degrade quality and cause camera drift. We propose Wave Forcing (WF), which co-designs generation, training, and execution for continuous video output with multi-step denoising. WF uses chunk-wise causal attention to access earlier, cleaner chunks before their denoising is complete, and distributes staggered denoising and cache-refresh stages across full-model replicas to achieve 1F1C: one output chunk per concurrent forward round after pipeline fill. To adapt the model to this continuous generation process, we develop a three-stage training procedure that successively introduces mixed-noise denoising, motion supervision, and causal adaptation using self-generated history. To execute this process efficiently, Wave Runtime (WaveRT) uses Wave Parallelism (WP) for early K/V delivery and communication-computation overlap, together with optimized kernels and pipelined VAE decoding. Experiments on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B show that 5-step WF maintains overall quality comparable to Rolling Forcing while achieving higher Dynamic Degree on both short and long videos. Our system efficiency experiments show that 4-step WF achieves 147.6 DiT FPS and 134.8 end-to-end FPS on eight H200 GPUs, yielding 7.07x the single-GPU end-to-end throughput. In DiT-only tests with matched SageAttention+W8A8 backends, denoising steps, and GPU counts, WP delivers up to 2.53x the throughput of the faster of the Ulysses and Ring context-parallel baselines across six model scales (1.3B-14B).

AI.tldr: Wave Forcing (WF) 通过生成-训练-执行协同设计，实现多步去噪下1F1C的连续长视频生成，并提出WaveRT/Wave Parallelism实现高效并行，8卡H200上端到端134.8 FPS。
AI.motivation: 现有chunk级自回归方法即使单步去噪也需两次前向（串行去噪+历史缓存刷新），效率低；且长rollout会导致质量下降与相机漂移。
AI.method: 核心为WF：chunk级因果注意力可访问更早、更干净的chunk；将交错去噪与缓存刷新阶段分布到全模型副本上实现1F1C。三阶段训练：混合噪声去噪、运动监督、基于自生成历史的因果适配。执行端WaveRT：Wave Parallelism（早K/V传递+通信计算重叠）、优化kernel与流水线VAE解码。
AI.result: Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上5步WF整体质量接近Rolling Forcing，短/长视频Dynamic Degree更高；4步WF在8×H200达147.6 DiT FPS、134.8端到端FPS，为单卡7.07倍；DiT测试中WP吞吐最高为Ulysses/Ring较快者的2.53倍（1.3B–14B）。
AI.conclusion: 通过算法与系统协同设计，WF在保持质量的同时显著提升长视频生成效率与运动动态性，具备良好扩展性。

title: To Align Long, Plan Short: Simulating Diverse Profile-Aligned Students by Realizing Short-Term Plans in Long-Horizon Learning Environments
summary: Simulated students offer a scalable way to test learning platforms and AI tutors before deployment with real students and to augment scarce data for studying learning at scale. Existing LLM-based simulators primarily target short, language-centered interactions. In open-ended learning environments, however, student behavior emerges from patterns across long-horizon interaction trajectories, where turn-level prompting can drift from an assigned behavior profile. We introduce ALPS (Align Long-term by Planning Short-term), a hierarchical simulated student conditioned on observable, environment-specific behavior profiles. Rather than selecting every action independently, ALPS alternates between planning profile-aligned task segments and generating the corresponding actions. We evaluate ALPS in both data-sufficient and data-scarce settings, where supervision comes either from real student trajectories or from a teacher LLM. Across both settings, we compare in-context learning (ICL), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reward-ranked fine-tuning (RAFT), and their sequential combination (SFT followed by RAFT). Experiments in an inquiry-based physics game and a pharmacy simulation evaluate behavioral density and coverage against held-out real data, and profile consistency using a human-aligned LLM judge. Across both settings, ALPS consistently outperforms turn-level generation, achieving comparable density and judge pass rates under scarce supervision, although coverage remains lower. These results show that hierarchical planning enables faithful, profile-aligned simulation over long interaction horizons, even with limited real student data.

AI.tldr: 提出分层式模拟学生 ALPS，通过"规划任务片段+生成动作"交替进行，在长程开放式学习环境中保持行为画像一致，数据稀缺时仍可接近真实表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的学生模拟器多针对短程、语言中心交互；开放式学习环境中的学生行为体现在长程轨迹的全局模式上，逐轮提示容易偏离预设行为画像。
AI.method: ALPS（Align Long-term by Planning Short-term）：以可观测、环境特定的行为画像为条件的分层模拟器，不逐动作独立选择，而是交替进行"规划符合画像的任务片段"与"生成对应动作"。在数据充足与稀缺两种设定下（监督来自真实轨迹或教师LLM），比较ICL、SFT、RAFT及SFT+RAFT组合。
AI.result: 在探究式物理游戏和药房模拟两个任务上，以留出真实数据评估行为密度与覆盖度，并用与人类对齐的LLM评判画像一致性。两种设定下ALPS均优于逐轮生成；稀缺监督下密度与评判通过率相当，但覆盖度偏低。
AI.conclusion: 分层规划使长程交互中的模拟既忠实又符合画像，即使在真实学生数据有限时也有效。

title: From Language to Country to Valence: A Multilingual Audit of Stereotype Bias Across LLMs
comment: 10 pages. Author preprint; conference review ongoing
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for education, recruitment, workplace decision support, and other consequential applications, making pre-deployment social-bias detection essential. Yet major benchmarks are English-centred or translated, focus mainly on negative stereotypes, and may miss linguistic and cultural variation. We investigate gender, racial, and religious bias using 12,000 locally written Reddit posts in English, Spanish, French, and German. Only search terms are translated, preserving local context. The dataset is balanced by language and category; English gender is additionally balanced by stereotype valence. Three open-weight and three proprietary API-based models are evaluated with a two-blank design that reduces grammatical-gender cues. Religion has the highest absolute choice imbalance in every model-language condition. Spanish is highest for gender, whereas German is highest for race and religion. The evaluated API models score below the open-weight models throughout. Negative English-gender items exceed positive items; Australian and Mexican contexts exceed their Canadian and Spanish counterparts. These descriptive differences measure choice concentration, not stereotype endorsement or causal country effects. The crossed patterns show how aggregate scores can conceal category- and context-specific behaviour, motivating closer inspection before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究用英、西、法、德四种语言本地撰写的12,000条Reddit帖子，评估6个LLM在性别、种族、宗教上的社会偏见，发现偏见因类别、语言、语境而异，聚合分数会掩盖细节。
AI.motivation: LLM被用于教育、招聘等高风险场景，部署前的社会偏见检测至关重要；但主流基准以英语为中心或经翻译、多聚焦负面刻板印象、且可能遗漏语言与文化差异。
AI.method: 使用四种语言本地撰写（仅翻译检索词、保留本地语境）的12,000条Reddit帖子，按语言与类别平衡，英语性别额外按刻板印象效价平衡；评估3个开源权重模型和3个API商业模型，采用减少语法性别线索的双空格设计。
AI.result: 所有模型-语言条件下宗教的选择不平衡绝对值最高；性别以西语最高，种族与宗教以德语最高；API模型得分普遍低于开源模型；英语性别中负面项高于正面项；澳大利亚、墨西哥语境高于加拿大、西班牙语境。
AI.conclusion: 这些差异反映的是选择集中度而非刻板印象认同或因果性国别效应；交叉模式表明聚合分数会掩盖类别与语境特有行为，需在部署前细致审查。

title: Learning to Group and Order: Cross-Instance Self-Supervised RL for Vision-Centric MLLMs
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has become an important paradigm for improving multimodal large language models (MLLMs), especially with automatically verifiable rewards. Self-supervised visual pretext tasks provide such rewards without human annotations. However, existing methods mainly exploit within-instance structure, offering limited supervision for cross-instance discrimination and fine-grained comparison. We introduce Group-and-Order Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning (GO-SSL), a cross-instance jigsaw framework for vision-centric MLLM post-training. Given two visual instances, GO-SSL mixes their local elements and trains the model to group them by instance of origin while recovering the order within each group, coupling instance-level comparison with spatial, temporal, or geometric structure recovery. This paired formulation turns the same unlabeled data into richer verifiable supervision through diverse pairings, shuffles, and a random-to-hard curriculum. We instantiate GO-SSL mainly on cross-image jigsaw tasks and further extend it to 3D depth and video temporal ordering. Across diverse benchmarks, GO-SSL consistently improves over the base MLLM and prior self-supervised post-training baselines, with clear gains in fine-grained perception and spatial understanding. Further evaluations across model scales and families support its generality. These results suggest that cross-instance comparison provides a useful self-supervised RL signal for improving transferable visual understanding in MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/SEU-VIPGroup/GO-SSL.

AI.tldr: GO-SSL：一种跨实例拼图自监督强化学习框架，通过混合两个视觉实例的局部元素，训练MLLM按来源分组并恢复组内顺序，将实例级比较与空间/时序/几何结构恢复耦合，为多模态大模型提供更丰富的可验证奖励。
AI.motivation: 现有基于自监督视觉前置任务（pretext）的RL后训练主要利用实例内部结构，无法提供跨实例判别和细粒度比较的监督信号，导致对可迁移视觉理解的提升有限。
AI.method: 提出GO-SSL跨实例拼图框架：给定两个视觉实例，混合其局部元素，让模型按来源分组并恢复每组内顺序；配合多样配对、打乱方式和"随机到困难"的课程学习，将同一无标注数据转化为更丰富的可验证监督。主要实例化为跨图像拼图，并扩展至3D深度与视频时序排序。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，GO-SSL稳定优于基座MLLM和先前自监督后训练基线，在细粒度感知与空间理解上提升明显；跨模型规模与模型家族的评估验证了其泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 跨实例比较可为MLLM提供有效的自监督RL信号，有助于提升可迁移的视觉理解能力。代码已开源。

title: ClickSight: An LLM Framework for Interpreting Student Clickstreams Through Learning Strategies
comment: 29 pages, 12 figures, 19 tables. Under review. Code: https://github.com/epfl-ml4ed/ClickSight-CEAI
summary: Digital learning environments produce rich clickstream data that can reveal how students approach learning tasks, yet interpreting these fine-grained traces often requires substantial expert effort. We introduce ClickSight, a framework for interpreting student clickstreams through learning strategies defined in the literature. Given a student clickstream and a predefined set of learning strategies, ClickSight uses a staged LLM-based pipeline to identify strategy-relevant evidence, assess adherence to each strategy, and generate an evidence-grounded interpretation of the student's behavior. We evaluate ClickSight across two learning environments, 365 students, and 12 model backbones using an expert-grounded quality rubric and an LLM judge calibrated with human-expert ratings. Our results show that ClickSight can generate high-quality strategy-based interpretations across different models and environments, with reasoning models performing more consistently than instruction-tuned counterparts. We further find that providing external clickstream-extracted guidance can improve interpretation quality for strategies that require precise quantitative information from the trace. By connecting fine-grained clickstreams with theoretically defined learning strategies and preserving the evidence underlying each judgment, ClickSight provides a flexible approach for studying student behavior in digital learning environments.

AI.tldr: ClickSight 是一个基于大模型的框架，依据文献中定义的学习策略来解读学生的点击流数据，通过分阶段流水线识别证据、判断策略遵循度并生成有证据支撑的行为解读，在两个学习环境、365 名学生、12 个模型上进行评估，效果良好。
AI.motivation: 数字学习环境产生的细粒度点击流能揭示学生学习方式，但解读这些痕迹通常需要大量专家投入，缺乏可扩展、可解释的自动化方法。
AI.method: 将学习策略作为先验定义引入；给定学生点击流与预设策略集合，采用分阶段的 LLM 流水线：先识别与策略相关的证据，再评估学生对每个策略的遵循程度，最后生成有证据依据的行为解读。评估使用基于专家的质量评分量表，以及经人类专家评分校准的 LLM 评判器。
AI.result: 在两个学习环境、365 名学生、12 个模型骨干上，ClickSight 均能生成高质量的基于策略的解读；推理型模型比指令微调模型表现更稳定；对于需要精确量化信息的策略，提供从点击流中提取的外部引导可提升解读质量。
AI.conclusion: ClickSight 将细粒度点击流与理论定义的学习策略相连接，并保留每项判断背后的证据，为研究数字学习环境中的学生行为提供了灵活且可解释的方法。

title: ERIA: An Instruction-Optimized Agent for Clinical EEG Reporting
summary: Clinical EEG interpretation requires integrating technical quality, background and behavioral states, interictal and ictal abnormalities, and overall clinical context across long recordings. We introduce ERIA (EEG Reporting and Instruction-Optimized Agent), a locally deployable framework in which a single 27B language-model controller analyzes whole-recording EEGs by orchestrating specialized parametric and signal-processing tools. ERIA combines learned tools for background abnormality, sleep-wake state, seizure-like activity, and interictal epileptiform discharges with deterministic spectral, amplitude, symmetry, montage, and signal-quality analyses. Rather than fine-tuning the controller or using multi-agent orchestration, ERIA keeps the controller weights, specialist tools, and safety constraints fixed and optimizes only its natural-language analysis policy with GEPA (Genetic-Pareto), using feedback from expert-written EEG reports. GEPA improves physician-aligned whole-recording report quality over the raw policy, and the optimized policy transfers to external EEG benchmarks. On CerebraGloss-Bench and BrainBench Foundational Analysis, ERIA remains competitive with the models evaluated in the original benchmarks. These results show that specialist tools and language-level policy optimization can extend the clinical and general EEG capabilities of a single locally executable model while preserving local inference and traceable tool use.

AI.tldr: ERIA 是一个可本地部署的 27B 单控制器框架，通过编排参数化与信号处理工具完成整段 EEG 分析与报告生成，仅用 GEPA 优化自然语言分析策略即可提升报告质量并迁移到外部基准。
AI.motivation: 临床 EEG 解读需要综合技术质量、背景与行为状态、发作间期与发作期异常及整体临床背景，且需覆盖长程记录。现有做法（微调控制器或多智能体编排）成本高、可追溯性差，且难以本地部署。
AI.method: 提出 ERIA：单个 27B 语言模型作为控制器，编排学习型工具（背景异常、睡眠-觉醒状态、类癫痫活动、发作间期癫痫样放电）与确定性分析（频谱、幅度、对称性、导联、信号质量）。控制器权重、专家工具和安全约束全部固定，仅用 GEPA（Genetic-Pareto）基于专家撰写 EEG 报告的反馈优化其自然语言分析策略。
AI.result: GEPA 优化后的策略在医生对齐的整段报告质量上优于原始策略，并可迁移至外部 EEG 基准；在 CerebraGloss-Bench 与 BrainBench Foundational Analysis 上与原始基准评估的模型保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 专家工具加语言层面的策略优化，可在保持本地推理与可追溯工具调用的前提下，扩展单一本地可执行模型的临床与通用 EEG 能力。

title: They Know Where It Is, But Not What It Says: A Bilingual Hallucination Benchmark of Hadith Recall in Open LLMs
summary: Large language models are increasingly consulted for religious knowledge, including the recall of specific Hadith (recorded sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him). Unlike open-ended generation, Hadith recall is a high-stakes, verifiable task: a reference (collection, chapter, and Hadith number) has exactly one correct text, and any deviation from it constitutes a fabrication that can be mistaken for authentic scripture. This study introduces a bilingual (English/Arabic) benchmark that probes five open-weight, locally-deployable language models (Mistral-7B, Gemma3-4B, Jais-7B, ALLaM-7B, and Phi4-mini-3.8B) across all six canonical Sunni Hadith collections (Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Da'ud, Jami' al-Tirmidhi, Sunan an-Nasa'i, Sunan Ibn Majah), sampling 500 Hadith per collection (3,000 per model per language, 30,000 responses total). Each model is given only the bibliographic reference and asked to reproduce the exact Hadith text, with no retrieval augmentation, and is scored on lexical fidelity (BLEU) and semantic fidelity (multilingual cosine similarity), with refusals flagged separately. Across all five models and both languages, 0% of 30,000 responses achieve both high lexical and high semantic fidelity, i.e., an exact, verifiable match to the source text. Arabic responses fare uniformly worse than English. These findings suggest that current open-weight LLMs, used without retrieval grounding, are unreliable and potentially dangerous sources for exact religious-text recall, and that deployment for Islamic scholarship should mandate retrieval-augmented generation over a verified corpus rather than parametric memory. The complete code, prompts, evaluation pipeline, and scored outputs are publicly available at https://github.com/dayam8696/Hadith-Hallucination-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文构建英阿双语基准，测试5个开源可本地部署LLM在六大圣训集中的精确复现能力，结果3万条回复中0%达到高词汇与高语义保真度的可验证匹配。
AI.motivation: 大模型日益被用于查询宗教知识（含圣训）。圣训复现属高风险、可验证任务：给定书目编号即有唯一正确文本，任何偏差都构成可能被误认为真经的伪造，故需量化评估其可靠性。
AI.method: 构建双语（英/阿）基准，测试5个开源模型（Mistral-7B、Gemma3-4B、Jais-7B、ALLaM-7B、Phi4-mini-3.8B），覆盖六大逊尼派圣训集，每集500条，每模型每语言3000条，共30000条回复。仅给参考文献，无检索增强，要求复现原文；用BLEU衡量词汇保真度、多语余弦相似度衡量语义保真度，并单独标记拒答。
AI.result: 全部5个模型、两种语言下，30000条回复中无一条（0%）同时达到高词汇与高语义保真度。阿拉伯语表现普遍差于英语。
AI.conclusion: 无检索支撑的现有开源LLM在精确宗教文本复现上不可靠且具潜在风险；伊斯兰学术场景应强制采用基于已验证语料的检索增强生成，而非参数化记忆。代码、提示词、评测管道与评分输出已开源。

title: FilmTogether: Cinematic Video Generation from Low-Cost Inputs
summary: The widespread adoption of mobile devices has democratized video recording, but a stark aesthetic divide persists between casual, low-cost captures and high-cost cinematic productions. Bridging this gap requires upgrading heterogeneous production elements, such as lighting, specialized costumes, and materials, without altering the core layout, identity, and temporal motion of the original footage. However, this task is heavily bottlenecked by two important challenges: 1) Lacking a high-quality paired training data specifically designed to handle complex low-to-high appearance shifts. 2) Ignoring the capacity of current video editing models to perceive and enhance the multiple low-cost compositions. To address these issues, we present CineCraft-120K, a large-scale dataset of aligned low- and high-cost video pairs annotated with pair-aware editing prompts. CineCraft-120K features a diverse, high-resolution and high-cost Cinematic Crafting bank spanning decades of media production, meticulously taxonomized into 5 broad domains and 23 fine-grained sub-categories. It also provides element-level mapping between low- and high-cost counterparts, offering pair-aware rich textual prompts that precisely detail the required aesthetic transformations while anchoring structural layout. Architecturally, we propose a simple yet effective dual-memory feature adapter, where a text-memory expands semantic capacity for low2high appearance changes, and a hint memory supplies layer-wise visual feature corrections of high-cost element before context injection. Extensive experiments and ablation studies demonstrate the superiority of CineCraft-120K for low-to-high-cost video editing, alongside the effectiveness of our dual-memory adapter.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CineCraft-120K 数据集与双记忆特征适配器，用于将低成本视频升级为高成本电影感视频，在不改变布局、身份和时序运动的前提下提升光照、服装、材质等制作要素。
AI.motivation: 移动设备普及使视频录制大众化，但低成本随手拍与高成本电影级制作之间仍存在明显美学鸿沟。现有方法受限于两点：1）缺乏专门面向复杂"低成本→高成本"外观转变的高质量成对训练数据；2）忽视了现有视频编辑模型对多种低成本构成要素的感知与增强能力。
AI.method: 构建 CineCraft-120K 大规模数据集：包含对齐的低/高成本视频对，并配有 pair-aware 编辑提示；涵盖跨数十年媒体制作的高分辨率电影级素材库，划分为 5 大领域、23 个细粒度子类，并提供元素级低-高成本映射与精细文本提示。架构上提出简单有效的双记忆特征适配器：文本记忆扩展 low2high 外观变化的语义容量，提示记忆在上下文注入前提供逐层的高成本元素视觉特征校正。
AI.result: 大量实验与消融研究表明，CineCraft-120K 在低成本→高成本视频编辑任务上具有优越性，双记忆适配器亦被验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过高质量成对数据集与双记忆适配器的结合，可有效弥合低成本与电影级视频之间的美学差距，为低2高成本视频编辑提供数据与方法双重支撑。

title: LARK: Lean-Assisted Reasoning for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
summary: Efficient GPU kernels are typically low-level and hardware-specific, and LLM agents can now generate them faster than experts can verify. Existing approaches rely on testing, which provides evidence but not a guarantee of correctness. We introduce LARK, an agentic framework that automatically and formally verifies GPU kernels against their PyTorch reference implementations. LARK proves equivalence in functional and memory behavior under exact arithmetic and establishes a new trust boundary: human effort is only needed to verify operator-level Lean semantics ahead of kernel generation time, instead of checking every single line of generated code. LARK formalizes the GPU machine model and the semantics of each operation in Lean 4 once per target language, and the Lean 4 semantics of any incoming kernel is derived from these pre-built definitions. LLM agents then automate the proof in two steps. First, an agent decomposes the whole kernel semantics into smaller segments and Lean 4 verifies this segmentation, which addresses the intractability of proving equivalence for large kernels directly. Second, agents write Lean proofs that each kernel segment matches its high-level PyTorch counterpart. Together, the two steps give whole-program equivalence. We demonstrate that LARK can be used 1) to ensure correctness in existing code-generation agents and 2) to automatically verify human-written kernel libraries. On the KernelCraft GPU tasks, combined with a simple ReAct agent, LARK enables GLM 5.3 to fully verify 10 of 12 Level-1 kernels and Opus 5.5 all 5 Level-2 kernels. Moreover, over 10 production kernels randomly sampled from popular open-source LLM serving frameworks, LARK verifies 9 and identifies a new data race bug in the tenth. We believe LARK represents a significant step toward verifiable code generation in the agentic era.

AI.tldr: LARK: 一个 agentic 框架，用 Lean 4 形式化 GPU 机器模型与算子语义，将 GPU kernel 相对 PyTorch 参考实现的等价性（函数与内存行为）自动形式化验证，把人工负担从逐行检查生成代码转移到一次性验证算子级 Lean 语义。
AI.motivation: GPU kernel 高效实现通常是底层、硬件相关的，LLM agent 生成速度快于专家验证速度；现有方法依赖测试，只能提供经验证据而非正确性保证。需要自动且形式化的验证手段。
AI.method: 在 Lean 4 中一次性形式化 GPU 机器模型及每个算子语义（每个目标语言一次）；由这些预建定义自动推导任意 kernel 的 Lean 语义。随后用 LLM agent 两步自动证明：(1) 语义分解 agent 将整个 kernel 语义拆成小段，由 Lean 4 验证分解的合法性，解决大 kernel 直接证明不可行的问题；(2) agent 为每个片段编写 Lean 证明，证明其与高层 PyTorch 对应部分等价。两步合起来得到全程序等价。
AI.result: 可 (1) 为现有代码生成 agent 保证正确性，(2) 自动验证人工编写的 kernel 库。在 KernelCraft GPU 任务上，配合简单 ReAct agent，LARK 使 GLM 5.3 完全验证 12 个 Level-1 kernel 中的 10 个，Opus 5.5 验证全部 5 个 Level-2 kernel；在从主流开源 LLM 服务框架随机抽取的 10 个生产 kernel 中，验证通过 9 个，并在第 10 个中发现一个新的数据竞争 bug。
AI.conclusion: LARK 建立了新的信任边界——只需在生成前人工验证算子级 Lean 语义，而非逐行检查生成代码，是迈向 agent 时代可验证代码生成的重要一步。

title: Sensitivity Inflation from Cross-Record Precision Routing in Private Quantized Fine-Tuning
summary: Private fine-tuning of large language models increasingly pairs DP-SGD with low-rank adapters on frozen, quantized backbones, and every such stack inherits one unstated premise: frozen layers keep each record's clipped gradient a function of that record alone. We show that LLM.int8 breaks this premise. It routes outlier activation columns to a higher-precision path using a union over the whole batch, so one record decides how every other record's activations are computed, even though the weights are frozen and the quantization scales are per row. We bound the resulting sensitivity inflation, state a record-isolation contract that restores the standard bound, and define record-owned precision dispatch that meets it with the same GEMMs as batched LLM.int8, so isolation needs no extra arithmetic. We then audit the native CUDA stack (bitsandbytes, PEFT, Opacus) against four matched controls. A constructed LoRA-Opacus witness reaches $15.0\times$ the add/remove bound. On pretrained OPT-125M with natural text, other records alter 20% of record-layer precision splits at batch size 16. An exploratory re-clipping analysis finds 10 of 64 candidate neighbors above the bound once every gradient is clipped; the top pair, revalidated natively, reaches $1.065C$ while every control stays within $C$, and forcing one layer's outlier mask removes the excess. A two-million-draw audit of the released adapters yields $\varepsilon$ lower bounds ($3.25$ at $δ=10^{-5}$) below the advertised guarantee ($4.38$). Resolving an excess this small at the release level would take about 200 times more draws, whereas checking the sensitivity contract directly exposes it in a few native runs, which makes contract checking the practical audit for private quantized training.

AI.tldr: 本文指出 LLM.int8 的量化为异常值激活列按整批并集选择精度路径，破坏了“冻结层梯度仅依赖本记录”的前提，导致 DP-SGD 敏感性膨胀；提出记录隔离契约与记录拥有的精度分发方法，并审计 bitsandbytes/PEFT/Opacus 原生栈予以验证。
AI.motivation: 私有微调常把 DP-SGD 与低秩适配器、量化冻结骨干结合，隐含假设冻结层使每条记录的裁剪梯度只依赖该记录。作者发现 LLM.int8 的批量级异常值检测使这一假设不成立，需要量化敏感性膨胀并给出修复与审计手段。
AI.method: 给出敏感性膨胀的界；提出“记录隔离契约”以恢复标准界；定义 record-owned precision dispatch，在不增加 GEMM 的前提下实现隔离；随后用四项匹配对照审计 bitsandbytes+PEFT+Opacus 原生栈，包括构造的 LoRA-Opacus 见证、OPT-125M 自然文本实验、再裁剪邻居分析，以及对已发布适配器进行两百万次抽样的 ε 下界审计。
AI.result: 构造的 LoRA-Opacus 见证达到加/删界 15.0 倍；batch size 16 下其他记录改变 20% 的记录-层精度切分；64 个候选邻居中 10 个在全部裁剪后仍超界，最高对原生复核达 1.065C 而对照均在 C 内，强制某层异常值掩码可消除超额；200 万抽样给出 ε 下界 3.25(δ=1e-5)，低于宣称的 4.38。发布层面检测如此小的超额需约 200 倍样本，而直接检查敏感性契约几次原生运行即可暴露。
AI.conclusion: 量化冻结骨干的私有微调并非天然满足记录级敏感性；LLM.int8 批量级精度路由是隐患来源。记录隔离可通过零额外算力实现，而契约检查比采样式 ε 审计更实用，应作为私有量化训练的常规审计手段。

title: Scalaris: A Scalable Enterprise Memory Architecture for Conversational AI Assistants
summary: Enterprise conversational systems require memory to personalize interactions, retain information across sessions, and maintain conversational coherence. At enterprise scale, however, memory must not only retrieve relevant information accurately but also provide it efficiently to the answer-generation model. Existing memory systems face a trade-off between retrieval accuracy and context efficiency. Retrieving more context can improve recall but increases inference cost and latency. We present Scalaris, a scalable enterprise memory architecture that addresses this trade-off through a unified long-term and short-term memory design. We propose that user interactions and assistant responses possess distinct characteristics and roles in a conversation: user interactions capture evolving knowledge about the user and provide value across sessions, whereas assistant responses must be stored efficiently so that only information relevant to the current query is retrieved. We therefore treat them separately and support each with specialized representations and ingestion/retrieval pipelines. Scalaris reaches 92.2 % accuracy on LongMemEval-S and 90.77 % on LoCoMo using Qwen3-32B, state-of-the-art results on both benchmarks, while supplying the answer-generation model with approximately 10 times fewer retrieved context tokens than Hindsight, a leading memory system for conversational AI. When integrated with our proprietary closed-source AI assistants, Scalaris improved overall response quality by 36 %. Together, these results establish Scalaris as a cost-effective framework for building scalable, personalized conversational AI systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 Scalaris 企业级记忆架构，通过区分用户交互与助手响应的统一长短期记忆设计，在提升检索精度的同时将上下文 token 减少约10倍。
AI.motivation: 企业对话系统需要记忆来实现个性化、跨会话信息保留和连贯性，但现有记忆系统在检索精度与上下文效率之间存在权衡：增加检索上下文能提升召回，却会提高推理成本与延迟。
AI.method: 核心洞察是用户交互与助手响应具有不同特性与角色：用户交互承载关于用户的演化知识、跨会话有价值；助手响应需高效存储、仅在相关时检索。据此将两者分离处理，各自配备专门的表示方法与摄取/检索流程，构建统一的长短期记忆架构。
AI.result: 在 LongMemEval-S 上达 92.2% 准确率、LoCoMo 上达 90.77%（Qwen3-32B），均为两基准的 SOTA；相比领先系统 Hindsight，检索上下文 token 约少10倍。集成到专有闭源 AI 助手中，整体回复质量提升 36%。
AI.conclusion: Scalaris 是一种兼顾精度与成本的高效框架，可支撑可扩展、个性化的企业级对话 AI 系统。

title: ZOPGA-KD: Zeroth Order PGA Guided Data Free Knowledge Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) enables the transfer of learned representations from a large teacher network to a small student network. In foundational KD, the student network uses the original training data of the teacher model to accomplish this task. However, due to privacy concerns, the original training data is often not available.
