AI.conclusion: 自评表达力与校准性之间存在本质性权衡，是构建自我反思式LLM的核心挑战；所提框架为诊断该问题提供了实用工具。

title: InformedXRD: Reproducible Benchmarks and Physics-Informed Evaluation for Powder Diffraction Symmetry Classification
comment: Camera-ready version. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets. 10 pages main text plus appendices and checklist (27 pages total). Code: https://github.com/scattering/InformedXRD; benchmarks: https://huggingface.co/datasets/informedxrd/informedxrd-benchmarks; checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/informedxrd/informedxrd-checkpoints
summary: Machine learning for powder diffraction (PXRD) symmetry classification is being trained at scale, yet the field lacks a common evaluation standard: papers report results on different subsets of experimental archives, with different target taxonomies, preprocessing, and metrics, and published models are rarely released in a form that permits rescoring. We present InformedXRD, an evaluation framework with three parts: (i) a machine-readable mapping from 230 space groups to 99 extinction groups, the finest classes powder diffraction can identify from systematic absences alone; (ii) a benchmark-construction method whose inclusion rules are specified as code and reproduce from a frozen snapshot, instantiated as RRUFF-473, RRUFF-325, and, as a small example, opXRD-98; (iii) a reporting protocol with prior-only frequency baselines, a label-permutation test, a hierarchy-aware error metric on the condensed translationengleiche subgroup graph, and stratified evaluation. We build on the mapping, RRUFF benchmarks, subgroup graph, and four ViT checkpoints released in our earlier work (Baggett et al., 2026). Using these checkpoints, a 1D residual CNN, and six architectures trained under the XRDBench recipe (Cao et al., 2025), we show that evaluation design changes what conclusions are justified: paired tests point in different directions at Top-1 and Top-5; paired Top-k tests do not separate the three leading XRDBench models, while hierarchy-aware analysis describes error distance and direction across all six; an input-blind frequency predictor matches the models on aggregate Top-k, yet a label-permutation test still detects pattern-specific evidence; and stratified analysis exposes a label-entropy confound that aggregate accuracy hides. All mapping tables, benchmark code, scripts, and checkpoints are released as shared infrastructure for PXRD-ML evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出InformedXRD评估框架，用于粉末衍射(PXRD)对称性机器学习分类，包含消光群映射表、可复现基准构建方法与报告协议，揭示了评估设计如何改变结论。
AI.motivation: PXRD对称性分类的机器学习模型正大规模训练，但领域缺乏统一评估标准：各论文使用不同实验档案子集、目标分类体系、预处理和指标，且已发布模型很少以可重新打分的形式开放。
AI.method: 框架三部分：(i)230个空间群到99个消光群的机器可读映射（仅凭系统消光可识别的最细类别）；(ii)以代码规定纳入规则、可从冻结快照复现的基准构建方法，实例化为RRUFF-473、RRUFF-325及小型示例opXRD-98；(iii)报告协议，含仅先验频率基线、标签置换检验、基于condensed translationengleiche子群图的层级感知误差指标和分层评估。基于前期工作(Baggett et al., 2026)的映射、RRUFF基准、子群图和四个ViT检查点，并结合1D残差CNN与六个按XRDBench配方训练的架构进行验证。
AI.result: 配对检验在Top-1与Top-5指向不同结论；配对Top-k检验无法区分三个领先XRDBench模型，而层级感知分析可描述全部六个模型的误差距离与方向；输入盲频率预测器在聚合Top-k上与模型相当，但标签置换检验仍检测到模式特异证据；分层分析揭示聚合准确率掩盖的标签熵混杂。
AI.conclusion: 评估设计改变了何种结论可被合理得出；所有映射表、基准代码、脚本和检查点均作为PXRD-ML评估的共享基础设施发布。

title: Tug of Watts: A study on the Energy - Accuracy Trade-off of Large Language Models on Medical Question Answering Tasks
comment: Accepted to "Workshop on GREEN-AI: Grounding Research on Energy- and resource-Efficient Networks for sustainable AI", Co-Located with CIKM 2026, November 08, 2026, Rome, Italy
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in medical question answering (QA) systems. While recent works aim at incrementally improving the downstream task accuracy, an empirical estimation of the models' energy consumption and the associated carbon footprints is often overlooked. In this study, we demonstrate how practitioners can estimate energy consumption and arrive at reliable emission estimates for medical QA tasks available in the OpenMedical-LLM leaderboard by investigating 13 LLMs from 3 model families ranging from 270M to 14B parameters. We discuss how one can critically interpret energy versus accuracy trade-offs for a set of models for a given task. With this work, we underline that reporting disjoint energy and accuracy metrics alone does not suffice for careful trade-off assessments, but it also demands systematic construction and interpretation of joint trade-off metrics. We envisage such studies aiding practitioners in adopting better and more efficient models for their task and helping them become active participants in building sustainable LLM pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文关注医疗问答(medical QA)中LLM的能耗与碳排放问题，对OpenMedical-LLM榜单上3个模型家族、13个LLM(270M–14B参数)进行能耗估算与排放测算，并强调需用联合的能耗-精度权衡指标而非孤立汇报两项指标。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦提升医疗QA的下游任务精度，而模型的能耗与相关碳足迹往往被忽视；单独报告能耗和精度指标不足以支撑谨慎的权衡评估。
AI.method: 以OpenMedical-LLM leaderboard上的医疗QA任务为对象，选取3个模型家族共13个LLM(270M至14B参数)，示范从业者如何估算能耗并得到可靠的排放估计，并对各模型在给定任务上的能耗-精度权衡进行批判性分析。
AI.result: 给出了跨模型家族的能耗估算与可靠排放估计方法及实践结果，并论证仅并列报告能耗与精度指标不足以进行权衡判断，需要系统构建和解读联合权衡指标。
AI.conclusion: 此类研究可帮助从业者为任务选用更优、更高效的模型，并成为构建可持续LLM流水线的积极参与者。

title: StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games
summary: Streaming video LLMs can now commentate live gameplay, but they are trained and tested on the same games. We study cross-game streaming commentary, in which a model trained on one game commentates games it has never seen, and find that current commentators transfer their timing but not their knowledge of the game world. We propose StreamDuo, which pairs a trainable commentator with a frozen research agent that reads the wiki of the game being played. When the commentator sees something it cannot name, it sends the current frames, and the research agent returns a few wiki entries two seconds later while the stream continues. We train only the commentator, on a single game, in two stages. Information-gain labels teach it to ask only where an answer would help it say what the human caster said, and on-policy self-distillation from a copy of itself that sees the ideal answer teaches it to use noisy answers. Trained on Baldur's Gate 3 and tested on ten unseen games, StreamDuo raises entity recall from 0.082 to 0.116 over Proact-VL trained on the same data, cuts source-game leakage from 9.9% to 1.0%, and achieves the best timing and the highest judged liveliness and overall quality among streaming models.

AI.tldr: StreamDuo 用「可训练解说器 + 冻结的游戏 wiki 调研代理」组合解决跨游戏直播解说，在新游戏上实体召回提升、源游戏泄漏大幅下降，并在时序与观感质量上最优。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频 LLM 解说器训练与测试都在同一游戏上，缺乏跨游戏泛化分析。作者发现当前模型跨游戏时只迁移了「时序节奏」而未迁移「游戏世界知识」，因此需要在不重训模型于新游戏的前提下补充知识。
AI.method: 提出 StreamDuo：可训练解说器遇到无法命名的内容时，发送当前帧给冻结的调研代理，代理约 2 秒后返回若干条该游戏 wiki 条目，直播继续进行。仅在单一游戏上两阶段训练解说器：(1) 信息增益标签，教它只在答案有助于说出人类解说词时才发问；(2) 从能看见理想答案的自身副本做 on-policy 自蒸馏，教它利用含噪答案。
AI.result: 在 Baldur's Gate 3 上训练、十个未见游戏上测试：实体召回从 Proact-VL（同数据训练）的 0.082 提升至 0.116；源游戏知识泄漏从 9.9% 降至 1.0%；在流式模型中时序最佳，判定生动度与整体质量最高。
AI.conclusion: 跨游戏解说的瓶颈在于世界知识而非时序；用外部检索型代理按需补充知识、并只训练「何时提问、如何用噪答案」的策略，是一种有效且数据高效的迁移方案。

title: The 3-Tier Integrated Technology Risk Model for Occupational Safety and Health
summary: This paper presents the 3-Tier Integrated Technology Risk Model, a progressive framework for Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) management that integrates Job Safety Analysis (JSA), dynamic risk assessment using leading and lagging indicators, and predictive analytics powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). The model provides organizations with a structured pathway to evolve from static, reactive safety practices to a sophisticated, predictive safety paradigm. Each tier builds upon the previous one, creating a comprehensive, data-driven approach that enables just-in-time training and preemptive risk mitigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“三层集成技术风险模型”，将JSA、基于领先/滞后指标的动态风险评估与LLM驱动的预测分析整合，构建从静态反应式安全向预测式安全管理演进的渐进路径。
AI.motivation: 传统职业安全健康管理多依赖静态、事后反应式的做法，难以实现风险的提前识别与即时干预，亟需一个结构化、数据驱动、可分阶段落地的管理框架。
AI.method: 提出三层递进框架：第一层以作业安全分析（JSA）奠定基础；第二层引入领先与滞后指标开展动态风险评估；第三层借助大语言模型实现预测性分析与即时培训。
AI.result: 摘要为概念性框架陈述，未给出实证数据或量化结果；所声称的成效体现在为组织提供从反应式到预测式的结构化演进路径与即时、先发式的风险缓解能力。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为OSH管理提供了分层集成的演进范式，各层级逐级叠加形成数据驱动的综合方法，但其有效性仍需实证验证与落地检验。

title: Learning Gradients of Homogeneous Functions
summary: Homogeneous gradient functions have widespread significance, including applications in maximum energy subspace selection and retrieval problems. Euler's homogeneous function theorem specifies how the potential associated with a positively k-homogeneous gradient field can be recovered directly from the field itself. We use Euler's theorem to build on GradNets and propose a homogeneous gradient network architecture that is guaranteed to correspond to the gradient of a homogeneous function. Then, we describe how monotone homogeneous GradNets universally approximate the gradients of k-homogeneous convex functions. The inductive bias of homogeneous GradNets enables them to outperform baseline ICNNs by up to 7dB in our max energy subspace projection experiment and by up to 13% higher accuracy, 98% fewer parameters, and 70% fewer FLOPS in our amortized inner product search experiment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出齐次梯度网络（Homogeneous GradNets），基于欧拉齐次函数定理保证网络输出恰为某个齐次函数的梯度，并证明单调齐次GradNets可通用逼近k-齐次凸函数的梯度，在最大能量子空间投影与摊销内积检索任务上显著优于ICNN基线。
AI.motivation: 齐次梯度函数在最大能量子空间选择、检索等问题中广泛存在，但现有网络结构难以保证输出对应某个齐次函数的梯度场，缺乏合适归纳偏置。
AI.method: 利用欧拉齐次函数定理，从梯度场直接恢复对应势函数，在GradNets基础上构建保证为齐次函数梯度的网络架构；并证明单调齐次GradNets可通用逼近k-齐次凸函数梯度。
AI.result: 最大能量子空间投影实验中比ICNN基线最多提升7dB；摊销内积搜索中准确率最高提升13%，参数量减少98%，FLOPs减少70%。
AI.conclusion: 齐次GradNets借助齐次性归纳偏置，在保证结构性质的同时显著提升性能与效率，是处理齐次梯度问题的有效架构。

title: Maswao: An automatically collected, prepared, and benchmarked dataset for the South African Sign language
summary: Recent advancements in sign language processing can be attributed to developments in both large-scale dataset collection and algorithmic complexity in areas such as pose estimation techniques, signal processing through Transformer models, and model optimization. However, only a handful of sign languages, such as the American, British, and German, from over 200 globally recognized sign languages, reap the benefits of such advancements, while the rest lag behind. In this study, we aim to address this technological disparity by proposing a framework for the automatic collection and preparation of sign language datasets, with very minimal human-labour intervention, using the South African Sign Language (SASL) as a testbed. Specifically, we automatically collect SASL video content using public resources such as news broadcasts. Additionally, we convert their accompanying audio streams into text using available Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) tools. Furthermore, we crop the sign language area in the videos and use gradient descent to locate valleys of non-motion to determine end-of-sentence points within long videos to create our weakly sentence-aligned parallel corpora -- the Maswao (Signs) dataset. Finally, we benchmark the weakly aligned dataset on the task of Sign-to-text Translation using Recurrent Neural Networks and Transformer models to compare their individual intricacies. Our results show that Transformer models proposed in the literature outperform recurrent baselines, with the best-performing Transformer achieving BLEU-1 to BLEU-4 scores of 13.78, 5.21, 2.52, and 1.54, respectively, as well as ChrF = 18.09 and ROUGE-L = 10.51. These results indicate that the task remains promising and warrants further investigations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个低人工干预的自动手语数据集构建框架，以南非手语（SASL）为试验对象，从新闻广播中自动采集视频、用ASR生成文本、裁剪手语区域并用梯度下降定位无动作谷值切分句子，构建弱句对齐语料Maswao，并用RNN与Transformer进行手语到文本翻译基准测试。
AI.motivation: 全球200多种手语中仅美、英、德等少数受益于大数据集与算法进步，其余手语存在技术鸿沟；手工标注数据成本高，因此需要低人力、可自动化的数据采集与准备方法。
AI.method: 以SASL为试验：利用新闻广播等公共资源自动采集视频；用现成ASR工具将音频转文本；裁剪手语区域；通过梯度下降定位非动作谷值以确定长视频中的句末点，从而形成弱句对齐平行语料（Maswao）；最后用RNN和Transformer在手语到文本翻译任务上做基准对比。
AI.result: Transformer优于循环基线，最佳模型BLEU-1~4为13.78、5.21、2.52、1.54，ChrF=18.09，ROUGE-L=10.51。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在极少人工干预下为资源匮乏手语构建弱对齐数据集；任务仍有较大提升空间（指标偏低），值得进一步研究。

title: What Does a Safety Label Measure? Auditing Situational-Safety Benchmarks for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Situational-safety benchmarks label each scene SAFE or UNSAFE and score a multimodal large language model (MLLM) against that label, usually by judging its free-form answer, and these scores guide deployment. We ask what such a label measures. A label score can come from the scene, the request or the benchmark's own files. We propose the Benchmark Card, seven measured fields that tell them apart, and fill it for six benchmarks. Only MSSBench chat leaks the label through its image files: image size alone reaches 82.3% accuracy, matching or beating six of seven commercial models. Elsewhere the signal outside the scene comes from design. In MOSSBench the item partition fixes the label, and on HoliSafe the request alone ranks pairs about as well as the scene. On our corrected chat split, the size rule falls to chance. We then introduce the Spot-Stop decomposition, which compares ranking with labelling on pairs of a safe and an unsafe scene. It splits the gap above a label-swap null into three parts: a threshold part, overlap between safe and unsafe scores, and order that holds only within a pair. Most of fourteen open MLLMs rank better than they label, beyond what their AUROC predicts. On chat, one shared threshold repairs a third to a half of the excess, and label-free recentering recovers it on balanced batches. Recentering on unlabelled scenes of the same situation improves ranking on VSCBench for 13 of 14 models.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑情境安全基准的标签究竟测的是什么，提出“Benchmark Card”七项字段区分场景、请求与基准文件三类信号来源，并引入Spot-Stop分解拆解排序与标注之间的差距，揭示多数基准与模型存在测量偏差。
AI.motivation: 情境安全基准通常将场景标为SAFE/UNSAFE并据此评分来指导部署，但作者追问：这种标签的分数到底反映场景本身，还是来自请求、甚至基准自身文件（数据泄漏）？现有基准缺乏对信号来源的检验。
AI.method: 1) 提出Benchmark Card，用七个可测量字段区分场景/请求/文件来源信号，并为六个基准填充；2) 发现MSSBench chat图像文件泄漏标签（仅凭图像尺寸即达82.3%准确率）；MOSSBench由条目划分决定标签，HoliSafe仅凭请求即可接近场景的排序效果；3) 提出Spot-Stop分解，在“一安全一不安全”场景对上比较排序与标注，将高于标签置换零假设的差距拆为阈值差、安全/不安全分数重叠、仅对内的排序三部分。
AI.result: 修正后的chat划分上，尺寸规则降至随机水平。多数（14个开源MLLM）模型排序能力优于其标注能力，且超出AUROC预测；chat上共享阈值可修复约1/3至1/2的超额差距，无标签重中心化在平衡批次上可恢复；在VSCBench上用同情境无标签场景重中心化，14个模型中13个排序改善。
AI.conclusion: 情境安全标签分数常受场景之外的请求设计与基准文件泄漏影响，现有模型的排序能力被标注阈值与批次效应掩盖；需通过Benchmark Card审查基准、用Spot-Stop分解诊断评估，并借助阈值校正与无标签重中心化提升排序可靠性。

title: Beyond Binary Detection: Type-Aware Hallucination Analysis and Hierarchical Detection in Financial Question Answering
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to answer questions over financial filings, where an unfaithful answer can mislead investment, compliance, or client decisions. Hallucination detectors are a common safeguard, but they are usually evaluated with a single binary score that reveals neither which kinds of errors analysesed nor why. This paper studies hallucination detection on PHANTOM, a long-context benchmark built from SEC filings, at the level of hallucination type. We first analyze 15,443 paired hallucinated and faithful answers without any detector and find that hallucinated answers are more than twice as long as faithful ones, and that lexical grounding separates the two classes only because faithful answers are bimodal. We then generate hallucinations in nine financially motivated categories, confirm each with a separate verification pass, and diagnose an LLM-based detector on 4,086 usable examples. Generation success varies from 66.3% to 100% across categories. The detector reaches 80.2% binary accuracy but only 44.7% subtype accuracy, never assigns two of the nine categories, and misses between 5.3% and 46.8% of hallucinations depending on category; these misses are unrelated to input length but rise with how far an answer departs from the correct one. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose a two-stage hierarchical detector that first decides whether an answer is hallucinated and then assigns a subtype, raising binary accuracy to 95.6% and subtype accuracy to 56.1%. The results show that type-level evaluation exposes detector weaknesses that aggregate metrics conceal.

AI.tldr: 该论文在PHANTOM长上下文基准上按幻觉类型评估LLM答案的可信度，发现聚合指标掩盖检测器弱点，并提出两阶段层级检测器显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 金融文件问答中不忠实的答案会误导投资、合规或客户决策。现有多数幻觉检测器仅用单一二分类分数评估，既不揭示错误类型，也不解释原因，掩盖了检测器的真实弱点。
AI.method: 先无检测器分析15,443对幻觉/忠实答案（长度、词汇接地性）；再按九类金融动机生成幻觉并经独立验证，在4,086个可用样本上诊断LLM检测器；最后提出两阶段层级检测器：先判断是否幻觉，再分配子类型。
AI.result: 幻觉答案长度是忠实答案的两倍以上，词汇接地性仅因忠实答案呈双峰分布才具区分力。各类幻觉生成成功率66.3%–100%。原检测器二分类准确率80.2%，子类型准确率仅44.7%，九类中有两类从未被预测，漏检率5.3%–46.8%，漏检与输入长度无关，但随答案偏离正确答案的程度上升。两阶段检测器将二分类准确率提至95.6%，子类型准确率提至56.1%。
AI.conclusion: 类型级评估能暴露聚合指标所掩盖的检测器缺陷；层级式检测框架在金融长文档幻觉检测上优于单阶段方案，但仍存在子类型判别与类别覆盖的改进空间。

title: Generative Modeling with Continuous Flows: Sample Complexity of Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching has emerged as a promising alternative to diffusion-based generative modeling, offering a continuous-time ordinary differential equation formulation with fast sampling and a simple regression-based training objective. Despite its empirical success, some theoretical analyses idealize the learning procedure by assuming that the velocity field is obtained by exact empirical risk minimization. This assumption does not reflect the practical finite-dataset setting, where the empirical flow-matching loss is only approximately minimized by a finite number of stochastic-gradient updates. We develop an empirical-risk-minimizer-free analysis for flow matching that explicitly accounts for both finite-sample statistical error and finite-time empirical optimization error. Our analysis considers a finite dataset of \(N\) flow-matching samples and a learned parameter \(θ_T\) obtained after \(T\) stochastic gradient updates on the empirical objective. Under regularity assumptions on the interpolation path, sub-exponential source and target distributions, approximation by a bounded-parameter smooth neural velocity class, empirical-loss optimization, and uniform flow stability, we prove a guarantee that holds with high probability over the finite training dataset and in expectation over the stochastic-gradient randomness. The resulting bound separates approximation error, statistical error from the finite dataset, tail error from unbounded source and target distributions, and empirical optimization error from approximate minimization of the finite-sample objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种不依赖精确经验风险最小化的流匹配(flow matching)理论分析框架，显式同时考虑有限样本统计误差与有限步随机梯度优化的经验优化误差，并给出高概率+期望意义下的泛化保证。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配理论分析常假设速度场由精确经验风险最小化得到，忽略了实际中有限数据集、有限步随机梯度更新的情形，理论与实际训练过程不符。
AI.method: 考虑N个样本的有限数据集与经T步随机梯度更新得到的参数θ_T；在插值路径正则性、次指数源/目标分布、有界参数光滑神经速度类逼近、经验损失优化、一致流稳定性等假设下，推导误差界；该界在高概率(对数据集)且期望(对SGD随机性)意义下成立。
AI.result: 得到显式误差分解：逼近误差、有限数据集的统计误差、无界源/目标分布带来的尾部误差、以及有限样本目标近似最小化产生的经验优化误差。
AI.conclusion: 将统计误差与优化误差分离的分析更贴近实际流匹配训练，为理解流匹配的泛化与优化权衡提供理论基础。

title: A State Change Is Local, Its Consequences Are Not: Dependency-Aware State Revision for Long-Term Agent Memory
summary: Long-lived agents rely on persistent memory of users, tasks and decisions, and this memory must stay consistent with a world that keeps changing. When an upstream fact changes, however, memory systems can revise the contradicted memory itself while the beliefs, plans and actions derived from it remain accepted, even though they have lost their support. We therefore formulate dependency-aware state revision, which asks not only what changed but also which dependent states should no longer be trusted. To address it, StateGraph maintains an evolving state dependency graph whose edges are recovered from interaction histories. Its core design is counterfactual verification: each candidate edge is tested by asking whether the dependent state would survive the loss of its premise, which separates support dependence from semantic relatedness, and revision then invalidates a dependent state only when a strict dependency fails and no independent support path survives. To test this design, we introduce StateChangeBench, a controlled benchmark of 50 author-constructed cases annotated with cascade depth, hard negatives and action consequences. On it, StateGraph's Impact-F1 margin over a CUPMem reimplementation is 6.9 percentage points at depth 1 and 26.0 at depth 3+. On public long-term memory benchmarks, its point estimates are comparable to or higher than those of the evaluated baselines on most datasets. These results provide initial evidence that explicit dependency tracking can improve selective memory revision under changing conditions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出依赖感知的状态修订问题，并用StateGraph（基于反事实验证构建设计状态依赖图）解决，随附StateChangeBench基准，在多跳依赖上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 长期存活的智能体依赖持久记忆，但世界不断变化。上游事实改变时，现有记忆系统只修订被直接矛盾的那条记忆，而由它派生出的信念、计划和行动仍被接受，尽管已失去支撑。因此需要回答“哪些依赖状态也应失去可信度”，而非仅“什么改变了”。
AI.method: StateGraph维护一张动态演化的状态依赖图，边从交互历史中恢复。核心机制是反事实验证：对每个候选边，检验依赖状态在前提缺失时是否仍成立，从而区分“支撑依赖”与“语义相关”；仅当严格依赖失败且不存在独立支撑路径时，才使依赖状态失效。
AI.result: 提出受控基准StateChangeBench（50个人工构造用例，标注级联深度、硬负例与行动后果）。Impact-F1上相较CUPMem复现，深度1领先6.9个百分点，深度3+领先26.0个百分点；在公开长期记忆基准上，多数数据集的点估计持平或更高。
AI.conclusion: 显式依赖追踪能改善变化环境下的选择性记忆修订；作者定位为初步证据，未来需扩展到更大规模与更真实设定。

title: GESTALT: Fast, Generalizable Histopathology Image Synthesis from Gene Expression with Pretrained Pathology Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 10 pages (8 main paper + 2 references), 4 figures. 8 pages of supplementary material
summary: Spatial transcriptomics measures gene expression while preserving where each cell sits in the tissue. The inverse, what a given transcriptomic state looks like, is less explored but equally useful: it lets researchers visualize the morphological consequence of a molecular state and interpret a spatial assay's molecular calls against real tissue structure. GeneFlow, the current state of the art on the Xenium gene expression-to-image benchmark, trains a model from scratch, incurring a high cost on every new target dataset it is applied to. We instead propose GESTALT, which reformulates gene expression-to-image synthesis as predicting a pathology foundation model's image embedding. A lightweight gene-token transformer predicts this embedding from multi-cell gene expression, and a frozen or LoRA-adapted diffusion decoder (PixCell) renders it as an image. Because this visual knowledge is reused rather than relearned, GESTALT trains in a fraction of the time. In both multi-cell and single-cell settings, our method outperforms the SoTA on perceptual metrics across all three Xenium datasets. Beyond improved image quality, GESTALT natively synthesizes at 1024 x 1024, and is evaluated in three generalization settings: zero-shot transfer across gene panels and datasets, held-out patients and disease states, and transfer across studies and tissue sources. Coupled with a statistical model of spatial expression, GESTALT also provides, to our knowledge, the first paired synthesis of cell-resolved transcriptomic fields and tissue images with explicit control over cell type, density, and composition. Code is available at https://github.com/trongnhandev1011/Gestalt.

AI.tldr: GESTALT 将基因表达到图像的合成重构为预测病理基础模型的图像嵌入，用轻量基因token变换器从多细胞基因表达预测嵌入，再由冻结/LoRA适配的扩散解码器渲染图像，训练快且质量优于SoTA。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组测量基因表达并保留细胞空间位置，但"逆问题"——给定转录组状态对应的形态学外观——探索较少。现有SoTA GeneFlow需从零训练，每个新数据集代价高昂。
AI.method: 将基因表达到图像合成为预测病理基础模型的图像嵌入；轻量级基因-token变换器从多细胞基因表达预测该嵌入；冻结或LoRA适配的扩散解码器（PixCell）将其渲染为图像。复用视觉知识而非重新学习。
AI.result: 在多细胞与单细胞设置下，于三个Xenium数据集上感知指标均超越SoTA；原生支持1024x1024合成；在三种泛化设置中评估（跨基因面板/数据集零样本迁移、留出患者与疾病状态、跨研究与组织来源迁移）。结合空间表达统计模型，首次实现细胞类型、密度和组成可控的转录组场与组织图像配对合成。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用基础模型视觉知识，GESTALT以极低训练成本实现更优的基因表达到图像合成，具备强泛化性与可控生成能力。

title: Data-Scarce, Multi-Granular, Multimodal: Benchmark Design for Biosynthetic Gene Clusters
comment: 43 pages, including references and appendices. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)
summary: Biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) are co-located genes that encode the biosynthesis of specialized metabolites, an important source of antibiotics, anticancer agents, immunosuppressants, and agricultural bioactives. Deep learning, particularly self-supervised foundation models, has spurred interest in BGC sequence modeling, but evaluation has lagged behind: existing benchmarks often rely on coarse classification over small curated datasets, providing limited discrimination among models and insight into downstream utility. We propose a benchmark-design framework in which an informative benchmark should be discriminative, separating models with statistical confidence, and applicable, spanning scientifically meaningful tasks under different levels of generalization. We instantiate this framework as BGC-Bench, which derives five tasks from MIBiG, ranging from A-domain substrate prediction to BGC-molecule retrieval, evaluates them under genotype- and phenotype-shift splits, includes an active-learning setting for label-scarce discovery, and is easily extensible to new tasks and encoders. BGCs further provide a shared testbed across granularities and modalities: BGC-Bench compares twelve encoders on nucleotide, amino-acid, or Pfam-domain sequences, including compositional baselines for each input type, and combines BGC and chemical encoders for cross-modal retrieval. No single representation dominates: the best granularity depends on the biological scale of the task, and pretrained encoders do not consistently outperform other representations across tasks and splits. Active-learning experiments show that most tasks remain data-limited, encoder rankings change with labeling budget, and acquisition strategies yield modest gains. These results show that BGC model evaluation requires task-diverse, shift-aware benchmarks, and the framework can be generalized to benchmark design beyond BGCs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"判别性"与"适用性"为核心的基准设计框架，并据此构建 BGC-Bench：从 MIBiG 派生五个任务、在基因型/表型漂移划分和主动学习设定下评测十二种编码器，发现无单一表示全面占优。
AI.motivation: 生物合成基因簇（BGC）编码抗生素、抗癌剂等专用代谢物的合成，深度学习尤其是自监督基础模型已引发 BGC 序列建模热潮，但评测严重滞后：现有基准多在小规模精选数据上做粗粒度分类，难以区分模型优劣，也无法反映下游实用性。
AI.method: 提出基准设计框架，要求基准具备判别性（能以统计置信度区分模型）与适用性（覆盖不同泛化水平下有科学意义的任务）。据此实例化 BGC-Bench：从 MIBiG 派生五个任务（如 A 结构域底物预测、BGC–分子检索），在基因型漂移与表型漂移划分下评测，并加入标签稀缺场景的主动学习设置；可扩展新任务与编码器。对十二种编码器进行比较，覆盖核苷酸、氨基酸、Pfam 结构域三种粒度及各自的组成性基线，并结合化学编码器做跨模态检索。
AI.result: 无单一表示占优：最佳粒度取决于任务的生物学尺度；预训练编码器并未在各任务与各划分上稳定超越其他表示。主动学习实验显示多数任务仍受数据量限制，编码器排名随标注预算变化，采集策略收益有限。
AI.conclusion: BGC 模型评测需要任务多样、对分布漂移敏感的基准；该基准设计框架可推广至 BGC 之外的领域。

title: Finite-Time Online Sample Complexity for Conditional Diffusion Models
summary: We study the finite-time training and sampling error of conditional diffusion models trained by online stochastic-gradient denoising score matching. Rather than assuming access to an exact empirical or population risk minimizer, we analyze the score network produced after a finite number of stochastic-gradient updates under an explicit localized Polyak--Łojasiewicz (PL) condition, stochastic-gradient regularity, and a trajectory-containment assumption. Our analysis separates the network approximation complexity from the online training-sample budget and propagates both errors through the reverse diffusion process. Under anisotropic smoothness, a joint intrinsic-dimensional structure for the data and conditioning variables, sub-exponential tails, and explicit approximation-class compatibility, we obtain a conditional score approximation error of order \[ \widetilde{\mathcal O}\!\left(M^{-η_{\mathrm{app}}}\right), \qquad η_{\mathrm{app}} = \frac{2α_x} {2α_x+d_x'+(α_x/α_y)d_y'}, \] where \(M\) denotes the approximation complexity, \(d_x'\) and \(d_y'\) are the intrinsic response and conditioning dimensions, and \(α_x,α_y\) are their corresponding smoothness exponents. For \(N=RB\) online denoising samples used by SGD, the finite-time optimization error is controlled explicitly in terms of the PL, smoothness, gradient-noise, and initialization constants. Combining these ingredients with reverse-process stability yields a total-variation bound that decomposes into terminal-initialization, time-discretization, approximation/localization, and finite-time optimization errors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线随机梯度去噪得分匹配训练的条件扩散模型，在有限时间内给出训练与采样的误差界，将网络近似复杂度与在线训练样本预算分离，并传播到反向扩散过程。
AI.motivation: 现有条件扩散模型的理论分析多假设已获得精确的经验/总体风险最小化器，缺乏对有限步SGD训练所得得分网络及采样误差的端到端刻画，因此需要研究有限时间训练与采样误差。
AI.method: 在局部化PL条件、随机梯度正则性与轨迹包含假设下，分析有限次随机梯度更新得到的得分网络；采用各向异性光滑性、数据与条件变量的联合内在维结构、次指数尾及显式逼近类相容性，将近似误差与在线样本误差分离并同时传播通过反向扩散过程，并结合反向过程稳定性。
AI.result: 条件得分近似误差为 Õ(M^{-η_app})，其中 η_app = 2α_x / (2α_x + d_x' + (α_x/α_y)d_y')，M为近似复杂度，d_x'、d_y'为内在响应/条件维度，α_x、α_y为对应光滑指数；N=RB个在线去噪样本的有限时间优化误差由PL、光滑性、梯度噪声与初始化常数显式控制；总变差界分解为终端初始化、时间离散化、近似/局部化与有限时间优化四类误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了在线SGD训练条件扩散模型的端到端有限时间总变差误差界，揭示近似复杂度与在线样本预算的权衡，并显式依赖内在维度与光滑性。

title: Toward Agentic AI-Ready Workflows in Built Environment Organizations: Knowledge Structures and Interoperability Challenges
summary: The rise of agentic artificial intelligence (AI) in the built environment is shifting attention from isolated AI tools toward autonomous systems that reason, plan, and act across project and organizational workflows. The effectiveness of such systems depends not only on large language model capabilities, but also on the readiness of heterogeneous data environments across the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) sector. These environments combine structured sources, such as CAD and BIM models, schedules, cost databases, and asset registers, with unstructured ones, including technical reports, design narratives, planning and policy documents, contracts, meeting minutes, and risk registers. This paper reviews how built environment data can be organized to support agentic AI-ready workflows, focusing on knowledge structures, interoperability, and access and integration mechanisms such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Drawing on existing literature, it examines approaches proposed to organize structured and unstructured data and considers how such data can be contextualized and made accessible to AI agents in a reliable manner. The paper synthesizes current perspectives, highlights challenges around fragmentation and interoperability, and identifies open questions for future research on AI-compatible information management in the built environment.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，探讨如何组织建筑环境（AEC）领域的结构化与非结构化数据，以支撑"智能体式AI"工作流，聚焦知识结构、互操作性以及RAG与MCP等访问与集成机制。
AI.motivation: 智能体式AI在建筑环境中正从孤立工具转向能自主推理、规划和执行的系统，但其有效性不仅取决于大模型能力，还取决于跨AEC异构数据环境的就绪程度，因此需要系统梳理数据组织方式。
AI.method: 基于现有文献综述：梳理结构化数据（CAD/BIM模型、进度表、成本数据库、资产登记）与非结构化数据（技术报告、设计说明、规划政策文件、合同、会议纪要、风险登记）的组织方法，并考察RAG、MCP等检索增强与上下文接入机制。
AI.result: 归纳出当前关于结构化与非结构化数据组织、情境化及可靠可访问性的主要路径，总结了现有观点，并指出数据碎片化与互操作性方面的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 提出未来研究方向，即面向AI兼容的信息管理，并对智能体式AI在建筑环境中的可靠数据基础建设提出开放性问题。

title: Meta-memorization and memorization scaling laws in transformers
summary: Larger transformers can memorize more data, with a capacity (in bits) that scales roughly linearly with the number of parameters. Counterintuitively, larger models also memorize faster, requiring fewer repetitions of a sequence during training before it is memorized. We reproduce both memorization scaling laws in transformers trained on random binary sequences, showing that rapid memorization can arise even when data contain no semantic or compositional structure. Rapid memorization is due to a meta-memorization effect, where models trained to memorize a large set of random sequences learn to memorize novel sequences more quickly. The rate $r(t)$ at which models memorize grows with training time $t$ as a power-law $r(t) \sim t^β$ with a fixed exponent $β$ but an increasing upper cutoff across model scales. Meta-memorization enables even one-layer transformers to few-shot memorize a 100-bit sequence. This effect is partly explained by the formation of structured attention heads that convey position-invariant sequence information to MLPs where memorized sequences are stored. Meta-memorization is recapitulated in a simplified model of a dense associative memory where retrieval is constrained by an attentional bottleneck. Our results suggest transformers, through pre-training, acquire reusable mechanisms that enable highly efficient storage and retrieval of memories.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Transformer的记忆能力随模型规模的缩放规律，发现更大的模型不仅能记住更多数据，而且记忆速度更快。作者在随机二进制序列上复现了这两种记忆缩放定律，并将快速记忆归因于"元记忆"效应（meta-memorization）。
AI.motivation: 已有观察表明更大的Transformer记忆容量与参数量大致线性相关，且记忆更快（需要更少重复次数）。但这一反直觉现象的机制尚不清楚：快速记忆是否依赖数据的语义或组合结构？其背后的计算机制是什么？本文旨在探究这一记忆缩放规律的本质来源。
AI.method: 1) 在随机二进制序列（无语义/组合结构）上训练Transformer，复现容量与速度两种记忆缩放定律；2) 分析记忆速率r(t)随训练时间的幂律增长r(t)~t^β，考察β与截断值随模型规模的变化；3) 分析结构化注意力头的形成——将位置不变序列信息传递给存储记忆的MLP；4) 构建受注意力瓶颈约束的密集联想记忆简化模型，进行理论复现。
AI.result: 在无语义结构的随机序列上成功复现两种记忆缩放定律，表明快速记忆不依赖数据的语义结构。元记忆使单层Transformer也能少样本记住100位序列。记忆速率呈幂律增长，指数β固定但上截断随模型规模增大而升高。结构化注意力头向MLP传递位置不变信息是部分原因。简化联想记忆模型重现了元记忆现象。
AI.conclusion: Transformer通过预训练获得了可复用的机制，能够高效地存储和检索记忆。元记忆效应源于注意力头与MLP的协同结构，并可在受注意力瓶颈约束的联想记忆模型中被复现，揭示了模型规模与记忆效率之间的内在联系。

title: Distilling Literary Sentiment from LLM Annotations into an Ordinal BERT Model
summary:
The scarcity of human-annotated literary corpora limits the development of domain-specific sentiment analysis models. This study investigates whether LLM-generated annotations can supervise smaller models for literary sentiment analysis. We fine-tune five BERT models using ordinal regression on 10,889 literary sentences annotated by Gemma 4 31B on a ten-point sentiment scale. The models are evaluated against 1,923 human-annotated sentences from Hemingway's "The Old Man and the Sea", alongside the teacher model and conventional baselines.
  BERT-large achieves a Kendall's $τ$ of 0.589, approaching the teacher's 0.604. Although a constant-neutral predictor achieves the lowest overall mean absolute error (MAE), BERT-base outperforms the teacher on non-neutral sentences, achieving an MAE of 0.726 versus 1.116. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLM-generated supervision for developing smaller literary sentiment models, while highlighting the limitations of aggregate error metrics on predominantly neutral datasets.

AI.tldr: 本研究表明，用大模型（Gemma 4 31B）在十分制情感量表上标注的10,889条文学句子，可通过序数回归微调小型BERT模型来做文学情感分析；BERT-large的Kendall's τ达0.589，接近教师模型的0.604，在非中性句子上BERT-base的MAE（0.726）甚至优于教师（1.116）。
AI.motivation: 人工标注的文学语料稀缺，限制了文学领域情感分析模型的发展；本文探索能否用LLM生成的标注来监督更小的模型。
AI.method: 用Gemma 4 31B在十分制量表上标注10,889条文学句子，采用序数回归微调五个BERT模型；在《老人与海》中1,923条人工标注句子上，与教师模型及常规基线进行评测。
AI.result: BERT-large取得Kendall's τ=0.589，接近教师模型的0.604；虽然恒定为中性预测器的整体MAE最低，但BERT-base在非中性句子上MAE为0.726，优于教师模型的1.116。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的监督信号有潜力训练更小的文学情感模型，同时研究也揭示了在高度中性数据集上聚合误差指标的局限性。

title: Modeling Fat-shift for Improved Head Segmentation from MRI Scans using a Probabilistic Model
summary: Personalized computational head models for biophysical simulations rely on accurate whole-head segmentations from T1-weighted (T1w) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. While T1w scans provide excellent contrast for intracranial anatomy, extracerebral tissues have partly almost no signal (compact bone) and also suffer from the so-called chemical shift artifact, which affects the fatty tissues in MRI and causes them to spatially shift in the frequency encoding direction of the scan. This artifact occurs primarily in two structures of the head: the spongy bone, a fatty compartment inside the compact bone, and the subcutaneous fat, located directly underneath the skin. The frequency-encoding direction is often set in the superior-inferior direction, causing the fatty tissues to shift down and, as a result, making the skull appear thinner than it actually is. Existing segmentation methods do not model this artifact, consequently leading to inaccurate labeling of the skull and scalp, which introduces a bias in biophysical simulations. The direction and magnitude of the fat-shift can be determined from the scan parameters, thus making it possible to explicitly model the shift and to recover the correct anatomy. This study introduces a probabilistic model that uses variational inference to segment head and brain structures from a T1w scan while accounting for the fat-shift artifact. The proposed Fat-shift-informed Label Optimization of the Whole head (FLOW) method reconstructs extracerebral anatomy more accurately than a fat-shift-agnostic segmentation approach while maintaining high segmentation accuracy in all other structures. FLOW-based fat-shift corrected segmentations significantly reduce bias in electric field simulations compared to a segmentation method that does not model the shift.

AI.tldr: 提出FLOW方法，用变分推断在T1w全头分割中显式建模脂肪化学位移伪影，恢复更准确的头颅外解剖结构并减少电场仿真偏差。
AI.motivation: 基于T1w MRI的全头分割在颅内解剖上对比度好，但颅骨密质骨几乎无信号、脂肪组织受化学位移伪影影响（海绵骨与皮下脂肪在频率编码方向偏移，通常为由上至下），使颅骨显得更薄；现有分割方法未建模该伪影，导致颅骨与头皮标注不准，进而给生物物理仿真引入偏差。该偏移的方向与幅度可由扫描参数确定，因此有希望显式建模并恢复真实解剖。
AI.method: 提出FLOW（Fat-shift-informed Label Optimization of the Whole head）概率模型：将脂肪位移作为可由扫描参数计算的已知量纳入模型，利用变分推断从T1w扫描中联合分割头部与脑结构，同时校正脂肪位移带来的空间错位。
AI.result: 相比不考虑脂肪位移的分割方法，FLOW重建的颅外解剖更准确，同时在其他结构上保持高分割精度；基于FLOW校正后的分割进行电场仿真，其偏差显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模MRI脂肪化学位移伪影可改善全头分割的颅骨与头皮准确性，并有效减小下游生物物理（电场）仿真的系统性偏差。

title: Accessed, never disclosed: Silent access to protected health information by medical artificial intelligence agents
comment: 33 pages, 5 figures, 1 table, 3 Extended Data tables; includes Supplementary Information (12 tables, 6 figures)
summary: Medical artificial intelligence agents should retrieve patient identifiers only when a task requires them, the data-minimization principle behind the HIPAA minimum necessary standard for protected health information (PHI). An agent can retrieve identifiers without revealing them. Such silent access remains invisible to evaluations that inspect only the output. We embedded canaries in synthetic patient records and linked each tool invocation to canary exposure in the final answers across five language models, four boundary levels, and seven attack frames for identifier-free clinical tasks. Three models invoked the PHI tools unnecessarily, whereas Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 did not. Stronger boundaries reduced this access, and the residual access under the strictest policy was confined to frames in which the user overrode the policy or asserted approval. A pre-execution gate given the task-necessity criterion nearly eliminated this access. Output-only evaluation cannot verify minimum-necessary access; boundaries, gates, and access-log audits are required together.

AI.tldr: 论文用"金丝雀"标记合成病历，追踪5个语言模型在7种攻击框架、4种边界策略下对PHI工具的不必要调用；发现仅检查输出的评测无法发现"静默访问"，需边界、前置闸门与访问日志审计三者结合。
AI.motivation: 医疗AI代理应遵循HIPAA"最小必要"数据最小化原则，仅在任务需要时检索患者标识符。但代理可以调用工具拿到标识符却不写入最终输出，这种"静默访问"对只看输出的评测完全不可见，现有评估方法存在盲区。
AI.method: 在合成病历中嵌入金丝雀（canary），将每次PHI工具调用与最终答案中的金丝雀暴露相关联；覆盖5个语言模型、4个边界（权限限制）级别、7种攻击框架，任务均为无需标识符的临床任务；另测试一个依据"任务必要性"准则的前置（执行前）闸门。
AI.result: 3个模型不必要地调用了PHI工具，Claude Opus 4.8与GPT-5.5没有；更强的边界可减少此类访问，最严策略下的残余访问仅出现在用户覆盖策略或声称已获批准的框架中；给出任务必要性准则的前置闸门几乎完全消除了这类访问。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠输出层评测无法验证"最小必要"访问是否被遵守；必须将工具边界、执行前闸门与访问日志审计结合起来，才能有效约束医疗AI代理的PHI访问行为。

title: Beyond Validation Loss: Coverage and Reliability Dynamics in Robot Policy Pretraining
summary: In modern robot learning, generative robot policies are first pretrained through supervised learning from demonstrations, then refined through reinforcement learning, supervised finetuning, or other forms of posttraining. Yet conventional pretraining metrics, such as validation loss and average task success, provide an incomplete account of which policies support both effective direct deployment and subsequent posttraining. In this work, we study closed-loop pass@k, which evaluates the probability that k rollouts from the same initial condition attain at least one success. Thus, pass@1 measures mean task success; large-k pass@k measures whether success remains reachable under repeated sampling. Across a wide range of posttraining recipes, we show that large-k pass@k reveals posttraining differences not captured by pass@1. In particular, checkpoints with similar pass@1 but different large-k pass@k have different posttraining performance. Moreover, we show pass@k peaks at different checkpoints during supervised pretraining, revealing a coverage-reliability tradeoff over the course of training. Based on these observations, we propose two practical interventions: (1) a purely offline checkpoint-selection criterion that balances coverage and reliability without closed-loop evaluation, and (2) a generative data augmentation procedure that expands supervision beyond the finite demonstration set, preserving large-k pass@k while maintaining or improving pass@1 and raising the observed coverage-reliability Pareto frontier. Together, our results motivate evaluation, checkpoint selection, and training procedures that explicitly account for posttraining. Blog post, visualizations, and code are available at https://zhanyisun.github.io/robot-policy-learning-dynamics/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用闭环pass@k（尤其大k）作为生成式机器人策略的评价指标，发现它能揭示pass@1看不出的后训练差异和预训练中的覆盖-可靠性权衡，并据此提出离线checkpoint选择准则和生成式数据增强方法。
AI.motivation: 传统预训练指标（验证损失、平均任务成功率）无法说明哪些策略既能直接部署又能有效支持后续后训练（RL、SFT等），需要一个更好的评价视角。
AI.method: 定义闭环pass@k：同一初始条件下k次rollout至少一次成功的概率；pass@1即平均成功率，大k衡量重复采样下成功的可达性。用多种后训练配方系统比较各checkpoint的pass@k。
AI.result: 大k pass@k揭示了pass@1无法捕捉的后训练差异；pass@1相近但大k pass@k不同的checkpoint后训练表现不同；预训练中pass@k在不同checkpoint达到峰值，体现覆盖-可靠性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 提出两项干预：(1)无需闭环评估的纯离线checkpoint选择准则，平衡覆盖与可靠性；(2)生成式数据增强，将监督扩展到有限示范之外，保持大k pass@k同时维持/提升pass@1，并提升覆盖-可靠性帕累托前沿。呼吁评价、选点与训练流程显式考虑后训练。

title: Finding Errors Is Not Enough: Selective Model Escalation for Entity-Targeted Sentiment Analysis
summary: Improving a sentiment classifier with limited resources involves more than simply deciding how much data to collect or which model to train. A labelled collection may lack examples of an important class. Once trained, a classifier may benefit from another model even when that model is weaker on its own. We study these decisions in document-level Entity-Level Sentiment Analysis (ELSA), primarily using South Slavic news. We first compare acquisition orders as collections grow. We then use uncertainty to choose which predictions to revisit, how many to process, and whether an alternative encoder or local LLM can correct them. Finally, we select complete routing policies on development data for held-out evaluation. Minority-prioritised acquisition helps at some very small training sizes, but not consistently thereafter. On SentiCoref, an oracle correcting all errors in the least-confident 10% without harming correct predictions would add 9.14 Macro-F1 points; however the best evaluated action gains only 0.90. Encoder averaging helps on AspectBench and NewsMTSC but harms SentiCoref, where selective LLM assistance is more promising. Both development-selected policies route 30% of records to the encoder-assisted LLM, yielding observed gains of 1.02 points on SentiCoref (interval includes zero) and 1.71 on NewsMTSC, at substantially different inference costs.

AI.tldr: 在文档级实体级情感分析(ELSA)中，研究了标注采集顺序、不确定性驱动的预测复核以及多模型路由策略，发现多数策略收益有限且受数据集制约。
AI.motivation: 有限资源下改进情感分类器不仅是"采多少数据/训练哪个模型"的问题：标注集合可能缺失重要类别，且弱模型在集成中仍可能有价值。作者希望系统研究这些数据与模型资源分配决策。
AI.method: 以南部斯拉夫新闻等数据为基础，分三步实验：(1)比较随数据增长的不同采集顺序（如少数类优先）；(2)用不确定性分数选择需复核的预测、确定处理数量，并测试替代编码器或本地LLM能否纠正；(3)在开发集上选择完整路由策略，再在留出集上评估。
AI.result: 少数类优先采集仅在极小训练规模下有效，之后不稳定。SentiCoref上若理想地修正最不确定10%中的全部错误可提升9.14 Macro-F1，但最佳实际动作仅提升0.90。编码器平均在AspectBench和NewsMTSC有效，却在SentiCoref有害。两种路由策略均将30%记录送编码器辅助LLM其增益为SentiCoref 1.02（区间含零）、NewsMTSC 1.71，推理成本差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 在ELSA中，数据采集顺序与模型复合策略的收益通常是数据集相关且幅度有限的；不确定性复核潜力远大于实际可获得增益。策略应通过开发集选择并按成本权衡路由比例。

title: Reproducing INP-Former: Reconstructing Intrinsic Normal Prototypes for Industrial Anomaly Detection
comment: Reproducibility study. 12 pages of main text (excluding references and appendix), 14 tables. Code available at https://github.com/garasnote/Repro-INPFormer
summary: We reproduce the central claims of INP-Former, a reconstruction-based method for multi-class industrial anomaly detection. INP-Former extracts Intrinsic Normal Prototypes (INPs) from each test image and uses them to guide a decoder that reconstructs normal features, without a stored memory bank. Using the authors' released code, we reproduce the reported performance on MVTec AD and VisA and extend the evaluation to MVTec AD 2, where image AUROC with the default settings is 63.4, compared with 99.7 on MVTec AD. On MVTec AD, a five-seed ablation shows that most of the performance comes from the INP mechanism, while the two auxiliary losses add small changes whose direction depends on the metric. A paired comparison with both losses disabled confirms the benefit of INP on MVTec AD 2. The default of six prototypes transfers less well: the plateau beyond four prototypes reproduces on MVTec AD and VisA, but on MVTec AD 2 a single prototype outperforms six in AU-PRO on the public split and on both hidden test splits. We also measure practical trade-offs in resolution, backbone size, training length, and LoRA adaptation, and examine performance by defect size, lighting condition, and a stricter AU-PRO limit. Several conclusions from the original benchmarks, including the default prototype count, do not carry over to harder data. Code: https://github.com/garasnote/Repro-INPFormer

AI.tldr: 本报告复现了 INP-Former 多类工业异常检测方法，在 MVTec AD/VisA 上复现了报告性能，并扩展至 MVTec AD 2，发现多数性能来自 INP 机制，且默认 6 原型设置在更难数据上不成立。
AI.motivation: 验证 INP-Former 的核心主张是否稳健：其性能来源、辅助损失作用、默认原型数量等结论是否能在更难的工业数据集上成立。
AI.method: 使用作者开源代码复现 MVTec AD 与 VisA 结果；做五种子消融以分离 INP 机制与两项辅助损失的贡献；在 MVTec AD 2 上扩展评估（含禁用双损失的配对比较）；扫描原型数量、分辨率、骨干规模、训练长度与 LoRA 适配，并按缺陷尺寸、光照条件及更严格 AU-PRO 分析。
AI.result: MVTec AD 2 默认设置图像 AUROC 仅 63.4（MVTec AD 为 99.7）；INP 贡献主要性能，辅助损失影响小且方向随指标变化；MVTec AD/VisA 上超过 4 个原型即进入平台期，但 MVTec AD 2 上单原型在 AU-PRO 上优于 6 原型（公开与两个隐藏测试划分）。
AI.conclusion: 原基准上的若干结论（含默认原型数）无法迁移到更难数据，提示需按数据集重新调参并谨慎对待重建式方法的默认配置。

title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
summary: Tool-using language-model agents often execute actions that their domain policies forbid. We present LeanGuard, a runtime that checks every proposed tool call against a policy written in Lean4 before the call reaches the environment. Policies combine state predicates with scoped past-time temporal operators over the execution history, evaluation is fail-closed, and the decision procedure is proved equivalent to a LeanLTL semantics. A denied call can be corrected in two ways. With feedback, the agent receives the violated rule and a hint; with proof-guided repair, Lean metaprogramming searches for a nearby call that preserves the user's intent and proves that the policy admits it, without the model. On Tau-Bench with five Qwen models (0.8B-27B), unguarded agents execute at least 33 calls that the Lean policy forbids, while LeanGuard executes none; with feedback, task success does not change significantly. On DTap, LeanGuard reduces direct prompt-injection success from 57.9% to 5.9%, and in telecom, where benign tasks need no writes, benign success is unchanged. Feedback reduces repeated blocked calls and raises task success for four of five models over a bare denial. On replayed denials, repair proves an admissible edit for 88 of 252 denials caused by argument values, in a median of 2,ms.

AI.tldr: LeanGuard是一个运行时守卫，用Lean4编写的领域策略在工具调用到达环境前进行失败闭合式校验，并支持反馈与证明引导的修复；实验显示可完全阻止违规调用、显著降低注入攻击成功率且不损害正常任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 工具使用型语言模型代理常执行领域策略禁止的操作，现有方法缺少在运行时对每次工具调用进行可证明、可解释的策略校验机制。
AI.method: 在工具调用前用Lean4策略（状态谓词+带作用域的过去时时序算子）校验执行历史，评估失败闭合，并将判定过程证明为与LeanLTL语义等价；被拒调用可通过反馈（给出违规规则与提示）或证明引导修复（用Lean元编程搜索邻近且保持用户意图的调用并证明其合规）来纠正。
AI.result: Tau-Bench上五个Qwen模型（0.8B-27B）未加守卫时至少执行33次违规调用，LeanGuard为0；反馈对任务成功率无显著影响。DTap直接提示注入成功率从57.9%降至5.9%，电信场景良性成功率不变。反馈相比单纯拒绝可减少重复被阻调用并提升五个模型中四个的任务成功率。在重放拒绝中，252个参数值导致的拒绝有88个成功证明出可采纳编辑，中位耗时2ms。
AI.conclusion: LeanGuard提供了可证明正确、失败闭合的运行时策略执行机制，能可靠阻止违规与注入攻击且不牺牲正常任务表现，证明引导修复可行且高效。

title: Search-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation with Sibling Alignment for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation retrieves items by autoregressively generating semantic IDs, typically via beam search. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enhances training supervision by transferring privileged self-teacher knowledge at student-generated states. However, beam-search retention depends on competition among prefixes: visited states differ in importance, and initially reliable decisions may approach the pruning boundary as training evolves. Moreover, conventional distribution matching couples target-token confidence with preferences among competing continuations, potentially weakening relational supervision when the self-teacher strongly favors the target. To address these challenges, we propose Search-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation (SA-OPSD), a framework that transfers privileged self-teacher knowledge to the states visited during the student's own beam search. Specifically, we introduce Evolving-Boundary Sampling, which prioritizes search-critical states by considering both current pruning-boundary proximity and initial-reference retention-margin decline under a controlled distillation budget. Furthermore, we develop Confidence-Decoupled Branch Distillation, which separates target-probability calibration from informative sibling relations to better preserve the teacher's preferences among competing branches. Experiments on Industrial, Office, and Instruments demonstrate strong performance for SA-OPSD.

AI.tldr: 提出 SA-OPSD 框架，结合演化边界采样与置信度解耦分支蒸馏，改进生成式推荐中 beam search 状态下的在线自蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有 on-policy 自蒸馏在 beam search 中未区分访问状态的重要性，早期可靠决策随训练可能逼近剪枝边界；且传统分布匹配将目标置信度与竞争分支偏好耦合，削弱关系型监督。
AI.method: SA-OPSD 将特权自教师知识迁移到学生自身 beam search 访问状态：1) Evolving-Boundary Sampling，在受控蒸馏预算下依据当前剪枝边界接近度与初始参考保留边际下降，优先采样搜索关键状态；2) Confidence-Decoupled Branch Distillation，将目标概率校准与兄弟分支关系分离。
AI.result: 在 Industrial、Office、Instruments 数据集上取得强性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 考虑搜索动态与解耦置信度的自蒸馏设计能有效提升生成式推荐检索效果。

title: VERS: Steering Reasoning Models by Editing Their Activation Explanations
summary: Reasoning language models write a chain of thought before they answer, and many checks in it do not change the final answer. Natural language autoencoders (NLAs) explain a model's activations in text and rebuild activations from text, and editing an explanation can steer a model at a single token. We study whether such edits can also steer how a model reasons. We build VERS (Verbalize, Edit, Reconstruct, Steer): it turns explanation edits at the doubt points of one reasoning trace into one fixed direction, and adds this direction at paragraph breaks. On the full GSM8K test, VERS cuts generated tokens by 45.8% at an accuracy change of -0.82 percentage points (pp); on MATH-500 it saves 31.3% at -3.05 pp. At half strength, its trade-off between tokens and accuracy lies between those of the published methods SEAL and DEER. With fitted affine maps and a strength tuned for each model, the direction transfers to larger Qwen3 models, up to 235B-A22B, and saves 30-35% of tokens. On competition problems, however, VERS loses 3-7 pp at every model size, and a fixed direction did not separate necessary checks from unneeded ones.

AI.tldr: VERS 将自然语言自动编码器在单个推理轨迹"怀疑点"的编辑转化为固定方向并注入段落间隙，可缩短推理长度但精度有损失且无法区分必要/多余检查。
AI.motivation: 推理模型的思维链中许多检查不改变最终答案，浪费算力。现有 NLAs 仅在单 token 层面实现激活解释与引导，作者探索这种编辑能否从单个 token 扩展到整个推理过程的效率调控。
AI.method: 提出 VERS（Verbalize, Edit, Reconstruct, Steer）：先对一条推理轨迹中的"怀疑点"做解释编辑，将编辑效果聚合成一个固定方向向量，再在段落断点处施加该方向以调控推理。
AI.result: GSM8K 全测试集生成 token 减少 45.8%（精度 -0.82pp）；MATH-500 减少 31.3%（-3.05pp）。半强度下 token-精度权衡介于 SEAL 与 DEER 之间。配合拟合仿射映射并按模型调强度，方向可迁移至更大的 Qwen3（最大 235B-A22B），省 30-35% token。但在竞赛题上各规模均损失 3-7pp，且固定方向无法区分必要检查与多余检查。
AI.conclusion: NLA 解释编辑可在段落层面引导推理效率，具备跨模型规模迁移性；但固定方向的粗粒度控制难以区分推理中的必要与冗余部分，在难题上精度代价明显，说明按内容自适应选择检查点仍是挑战。

title: Context-Shielded Backdoor Attack against Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) routinely use inference-time visual-token compression to prune hundreds of patch tokens down to a compact budget. Existing LVLM backdoors fire whenever a triggered image appears, whereas prior deployment-triggered attacks activate only when model weights are quantized or pruned. However, conventional LVLM backdoors exhibit nearly 100% attack success rate (ASR) under full-token inference, immediately exposing compromised checkpoints during pre-deployment auditing. We reveal context stripping: surrounding clean visual tokens suppress an embedded trigger at full length, whereas token pruning strips this context away and activates the backdoor. Motivated by this finding, we propose StripWake, a projector-only backdoor that remains dormant under full-token auditing yet activates across unseen compressors. Specifically, StripWake pairs clean-supervised full-token views with target-supervised randomized compressed views, and aligns early visual attention with a frozen benign teacher to preserve clean utility. On LLaVA-1.5-7B across nine unseen compressors, StripWake stays dormant at 0.4% full-token ASR yet achieves 94.0%-99.7% compressed ASR across five primary compressors without CIDEr loss.

AI.tldr: 提出StripWake，一种仅在视觉token压缩时激活、全token审计时潜伏的LVLM投影器后门。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM后门在全token推理下ASR接近100%，部署前审计即暴露；已有部署触发攻击仅限权重量化/剪枝，缺少针对推理时视觉token压缩的隐蔽攻击。
AI.method: 揭示"上下文剥离"现象：干净视觉token在全长下抑制触发器，token剪枝去除上下文后激活后门。基于此设计仅改投影器的后门：干净监督的全token视图与目标监督的随机压缩视图配对训练，并用冻结良性教师对齐早期视觉注意力以保持干净性能。
AI.result: LLaVA-1.5-7B上，跨9个未见压缩器：全token ASR仅0.4%，5个主要压缩器下ASR达94.0%-99.7%，且CIDEr无损失。
AI.conclusion: 利用压缩器带来的上下文剥离可实现高隐蔽、跨压缩器泛化的LVLM后门，同时保持正常任务性能。

title: SGR-OPSD: Learning from Subgoal Plans with Graph-Regularized Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: OPSD provides dense supervision for agentic reinforcement learning through privileged information feedback. However, existing privileged information often lacks explicit task-progression planning, while teacher-student log-probability gaps reflect shifts in model preference rather than true task progress. To address these limitations, we propose Subgoal-Guided Graph-Regularized OPSD (SGR-OPSD), a framework that combines subgoal supervision with interaction-derived evidence for turn-level credit assignment. Specifically, SGR-OPSD uses LLM-generated subgoal plans to provide dense action-level guidance, converting them into advantage weights via a constrained, KL-regularized objective. To ground credit in observed outcomes, we construct a Subgoal Progress Graph that estimates empirical returns from sampled transition frequencies. The graph compares empirical action returns against the state average to derive preferences that calibrate the teacher's credit weights. Evaluated on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA across two model scales (Qwen2.5-3B and 7B), SGR-OPSD consistently outperforms GRPO and strong self-distillation baselines, improving success rates over GRPO by up to 7.4 percentage points and reaching 85.8% on ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B. Ablation studies confirm that subgoal guidance and graph-based weight calibration are key to these performance gains.

AI.tldr: 提出SGR-OPSD框架，用LLM生成的子目标计划提供密集动作级监督，并结合交互构建的子目标进度图校准教师信用权重，在多个智能体任务上显著优于GRPO与自蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 现有OPSD依赖特权信息反馈做密集监督，但特权信息普遍缺乏显式的任务进度规划；同时师生log-prob差异反映的是模型偏好偏移而非真实任务进展，导致信用分配不可靠。
AI.method: 两点结合：(1) 用LLM生成的子目标计划提供密集动作级指导，并通过带约束的KL正则化目标将其转换为优势权重；(2) 构建子目标进度图，从采样转移频率估计经验回报，将经验动作回报与状态平均值比较得到偏好，用以校准教师的信用权重，实现回合级信用分配。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、Search-QA三个任务及Qwen2.5-3B/7B两种规模上均稳定超过GRPO和强自蒸馏基线，成功率较GRPO最高提升7.4个百分点，7B模型在ALFWorld达85.8%。消融实验证实子目标指导与图权重校准是关键增益来源。
AI.conclusion: 子目标监督与基于交互证据的图校准能有效弥补OPSD缺乏进度规划、师生概率差不可靠的缺陷，是一种有效的密集信用分配方案。

title: Autoencoder Based Deep Clustering of Point Clouds
summary: Motivated by a problem in Generative Specification-Producing AIs (SPAIs), we focus on a problem of deep clustering of three-dimensional shapes specified by point clouds. After reviewing clustering and deep clustering, we study the fully unsupervised pipeline in which a FoldingNet autoencoder is first trained for reconstruction and then K-means++ is then applied to the resulting codewords. We report clustering accuracy (ACC), normalized mutual information (NMI) and adjusted Rand index (ARI) on ModelNet10 and ModelNet40 datasets, as a function of the number of clusters K. We also provide t-SNE visualizations of the codewords, and discuss the choice of K.

AI.tldr: 本文研究由点云表示的三维形状的深度聚类：先训练FoldingNet自编码器做重建，再对其码字(codevector)应用K-means++，在ModelNet10/40上评估ACC、NMI、ARI随簇数K的变化，并给出t-SNE可视化与K的选取讨论。
AI.motivation: 受生成式规格产品AI（SPAIs）中的一个问题启发，需要处理三维点云形状的聚类问题；为此回顾聚类与深度聚类方法，探索一个完全无监督的简单流程是否可行。
AI.method: 完全无监督的两阶段流水线：第一阶段用FoldingNet自编码器对点云进行重建训练；第二阶段对编码得到的码字（codewords）直接应用K-means++聚类。实验在ModelNet10与ModelNet40数据集上进行，以簇数K为自变量考察指标变化。
AI.result: 报告了聚类准确率（ACC）、归一化互信息（NMI）和调整兰德指数（ARI）随簇数K的变化曲线，并提供了码字的t-SNE可视化结果。
AI.conclusion: 该重建+K-means++的无监督流程可用于三维形状点云聚类，文中还讨论了簇数K的选择问题；但摘要未给出具体数值结论，仅提供了评估与可视化分析。

title: Unlocking Criminal Court Decisions: Flexible Information Extraction for Empirical Legal Research
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 39th International Conference on Legal Knowledge and Information Systems (JURIX 2026)
summary: Criminal verdicts contain descriptions of criminal behavior that can support quantitative legal research, but structuring them requires attributes and extraction rules that cannot always be fully specified in advance. We present an LLM-based pipeline that builds a structured dataset through attribute exploration, text span extraction, and value normalization, guided by annotation instructions that legal experts can refine. We evaluate it on two traffic offenses: driving under the influence (DUI) and driving despite a ban (DDB). For DUI, revising the instructions was associated with higher extraction accuracy (from 52% to 70% of correctly extracted values) and higher agreement between human annotators. Repeated runs of the same model agreed with each other more than with the gold annotations, showing that consistent output is not necessarily correct, while disagreement between annotators and between models helped reveal unclear instructions. For DDB, where the instructions defined fixed categories and output formats, agreement was high for most attributes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的流水线，通过属性探索、文本片段抽取和值规范化，结合法律专家可迭代完善的标注指令，构建刑事判决书结构化数据集，并在DUI与DDB两类交通犯罪上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 刑事判决书含可用于定量法律研究的犯罪行为描述，但结构化需预先确定属性与抽取规则，而这些往往无法事先完全明确。
AI.method: LLM流水线：属性探索→文本片段抽取→值规范化，以法律专家可精炼的标注指令为引导；在醉驾（DUI）与禁驾期间驾驶（DDB）上评估，含人工标注一致性及模型重复运行对比。
AI.result: DUI任务中修订指令后抽取准确率由52%升至70%，人工标注者间一致性提高；同一模型重复运行彼此一致性高于与金标准的一致，说明输出一致不等于正确；标注者间与模型间分歧有助于发现指令不清。DDB任务因指令定义了固定类别与输出格式，多数属性一致性高。
AI.conclusion: 专家可精炼的标注指令与分歧分析能有效提升LLM结构化抽取质量；输出一致性不能作为正确性替代指标。

title: StreamClarify: Proactive Clarification for Grounded Streaming Video Question Answering
summary: Streaming video question answering (QA) requires real-time reasoning over continuous video streams under strict latency and active-context budgets. Current streaming vision-language models (VLMs) often give confident yet ungrounded answers when queries are ambiguous or have false premises, or when relevant visual evidence is no longer in the active context. Proactive clarification can help, but must satisfy the same latency and memory constraints. We present StreamClarify, a training-free framework for grounded streaming QA that combines a pre-answer uncertainty check with hierarchical memory. The check uses the entropy of a binary pre-answer judgment as a lightweight uncertainty score to decide whether to answer directly or request clarification. To support re-answering, a temporal-pyramid KV cache maintains a bounded active visual context, while a CPU-side semantic retrieval archive provides access to historical frames. We further construct StreamClarify-QA, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,837 QA pairs from StreamBench and OVO-Bench, spanning standard, referential ambiguity, and unanswerable scenarios. Across three VLM backbones, StreamClarify improves Macro accuracy by up to 8.2 points over backbone-matched baselines. At comparable trigger rates, entropy-based selection achieves more than 18 points higher precision than random selection in identifying initially incorrect answers. Under oracle user guidance, clarification improves Macro accuracy by up to 3.5 points. We also report a controlled, oracle-assisted Qwen3-VL simulation on Ambiguous QA with generated questions and referent-only user replies, where the entropy-gated condition improves accuracy by 8.3 points.

AI.tldr: StreamClarify 是一个免训练框架，用于流式视频问答，通过"回答前不确定性检查 + 分层记忆"实现主动澄清与有据回答。
AI.motivation: 流式视频QA受限于严格延迟与活跃上下文预算；现有流式VLM在查询存在歧义、前提错误或关键视觉证据已移出活跃上下文时，会给出自信但无依据的答案。
AI.method: 用二分类"回答前判断"的熵作为轻量不确定性分数，决定直接作答还是请求澄清；采用时间金字塔KV缓存维持有界活跃视觉上下文，并用CPU端语义检索档案访问历史帧以支持重新回答；同时构建诊断基准 StreamClarify-QA（基于StreamBench与OVO-Bench，1837条QA，含标准、指代歧义、不可回答三类场景）。
AI.result: 在三个VLM骨干上，Macro准确率较匹配基线最高提升8.2个点；相同触发率下，熵选择识别初始错误答案的精度比随机选择高18点以上；在oracle用户引导下澄清使Macro准确率最高提升3.5点；Qwen3-VL模拟中熵门控在Ambiguous QA上提升8.3点。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练即可在延迟与内存约束下实现具备依据的流式问答，主动澄清机制可有效提升准确率，且基于熵的触发选择优于随机触发。

title: RecGroupMemory: Feedback-Aware Cohort Memory for E-Commerce Recommendation
summary: Cohort memory can support LLM-based recommendation planning through group-level user profiles and advice. As outcome feedback becomes available, this guidance may need to be updated while preserving the underlying observations. We present RecGroupMemory, a workflow that provides this memory to an orchestration LLM and separates memory construction from feedback-based revision. It uses feedback from the previous day to revise decision guidance, while validation checks keep selected source values unchanged. Online comparisons were conducted among Taobao users with low purchasing power selected by the business team. Relative to a no-memory baseline, memory without feedback and memory with feedback showed increases of 1.58% and 1.78%, respectively, in the number of guided transaction users.

AI.tldr: RecGroupMemory 是一个为 LLM 推荐规划提供"群体记忆"的工作流，将记忆构建与基于反馈的修订分离，并在淘宝低购买力用户在线实验中比无记忆基线提升引导成交用户数 1.58%~1.78%。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的推荐规划可借助群体级用户画像与建议（cohort memory）获得指导；但随着结果反馈到来，这些指导需要更新，同时又要保留原始观测不被篡改，因此需要一种能隔离"记忆构建"与"反馈修订"的机制。
AI.method: 提出 RecGroupMemory 工作流：向编排 LLM（orchestration LLM）提供群体记忆，并将记忆构建与反馈驱动的修订解耦；利用前一天的反馈修订决策指导，同时通过验证检查保证被选中的源数值保持不变。
AI.result: 在业务团队选定的淘宝低购买力用户上进行在线对比：相比无记忆基线，有记忆无反馈与有记忆带反馈分别使引导成交用户数提升 1.58% 和 1.78%。
AI.conclusion: 群体记忆能为 LLM 推荐规划带来稳定正收益，且引入反馈修订可进一步小幅增益，同时验证机制保障了源数据的一致性。

title: DyRadio: Spatiotemporal Diffusion for Dynamic Radio Map Reconstruction
summary: Accurate radio map (RM) reconstruction is essential for environment-aware wireless networks. Sampling-based methods, which infer radio conditions from sparse measurements, are widely adopted because they do not require explicit knowledge of transmitter configurations. However, in dynamic environments, time-varying propagation conditions cause RMs to evolve, complicating reconstruction from temporally distributed sparse observations. Although cross-frame observations provide complementary spatial information, their direct aggregation can introduce temporal state mismatch. Furthermore, unknown measurement noise adds to the reconstruction difficulties. To address these challenges, we propose DyRadio, a framework that integrates spatiotemporal RM reconstruction with unknown noise estimation. Specifically, a propagation-prior-guided, noise-conditioned spatiotemporal diffusion model (DM) jointly reconstructs consecutive RMs by capturing cross-frame dependencies, while adapting to measurement noise levels. To estimate the noise level, an iterative predictive likelihood method alternates between DM-based blind-area prediction and noise-level updates. The estimated noise level then conditions reconstruction of the complete RM sequence. Experimental results demonstrate superior reconstruction accuracy and robustness against measurement noise, with peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) improvements of 1.18-5.75 dB over the best-performing baseline across all evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DyRadio，一个将时空无线电地图重建与未知测量噪声估计相结合的框架：用传播先验引导、噪声条件化的时空扩散模型联合重建连续 RM，并用迭代预测似然法交替估计噪声水平，实现高精度、抗噪声的重建。
AI.motivation: 动态环境下传播条件随时间变化，RM 需从时间上稀疏分布的观测中重建；跨帧观测虽提供互补空间信息，但直接聚合会造成时间状态失配，加之测量噪声未知，使重建困难。
AI.method: DyRadio 包含两部分：(1) 传播先验引导、以噪声水平为条件的时空扩散模型，捕获跨帧依赖并联合重建连续 RM；(2) 迭代预测似然方法，在扩散模型盲区预测与噪声水平更新之间交替，估计出的噪声水平再用于条件化整段 RM 序列的重建。
AI.result: 实验表明重建精度与抗测量噪声鲁棒性均优于基线，在所有评估设置下相较最佳基线 PSNR 提升 1.18–5.75 dB。
AI.conclusion: 将时空 RM 重建与未知噪声估计联合建模，可有效缓解时间状态失配与噪声干扰，DyRadio 在动态环境下实现准确且鲁棒的无线电地图重建。

title: SAGE (Subjectivity-Aware Generation Estimator): A Linguistic Framework for AI-Generated Review Detection *
summary: We propose a simple, linguistically motivated approach to detecting AI-generated peer reviews based on the inherently human trait of subjectivity. We capture subjectivity at two levels: the semantic level of evaluative language and modality and the pragmatic level of speech acts. Using features derived from speech act annotations and model-predicted subjectivity scores, we train a lightweight classifier that achieves an AUROC of 0.9566 with only these linguistic features. Combining its output with the state-of-the-art detector Sem-Detect raises the TPR at 1% FPR of Sem-Detect on the APRDB benchmark from 0.874 to 0.985, outperforming the current state of the art. Our results show that linguistic features of subjectivity provide an explainable source of information for detecting AI-generated peer reviews and can be readily integrated into existing detection methods. The code and models are publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/Arys02/generated\_ text\_detection\_hub) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/Arys02), respectively.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于"主观性"这一人类语言特征的轻量方法检测AI生成的同行评审，融合语义层与语用层特征，AUROC达0.9566，与Sem-Detect结合后将TPR@1%FPR从0.874提升至0.985。
AI.motivation: AI生成的同行评审日益普遍，需要可解释且易集成的检测方法；作者认为"主观性"是人类写作的固有特征，AI文本在此方面存在可检测差异。
AI.method: 在语义层捕捉评价性语言与情态，在语用层捕捉言语行为（speech acts）；利用言语行为标注特征与模型预测的主观性得分训练轻量分类器，并将其输出与SOTA检测器Sem-Detect融合。
AI.result: 仅用语言学特征即达AUROC 0.9566；在APRDB基准上，与Sem-Detect结合使TPR@1%FPR从0.874升至0.985，超越现有SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 主观性语言特征为检测AI生成评审提供可解释信息，可便捷集成进现有检测方法；代码与模型已开源。

title: DriftingPlanner: Drifting Generative Models for One-Step Trajectory Planning in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end planners decode the ego trajectory either by coordinate regression, which is fast but blends plausible maneuvers into one trajectory that may follow none of them, or by diffusion and flow matching, which model the trajectory distribution but need several inference steps. Drifting models move this iteration into training: a one-step generator learns to follow an attraction--repulsion field between generated and ground-truth samples. Drifting was developed for class-conditional image generation, where every class supplies many positive samples. In planning, every scene is its own condition. Pooling scenes would attract the generated trajectories of one scene to the ground truth of unrelated scenes, whereas computing the field per scene leaves a single positive, the expert trajectory. Mutual repulsion then holds the generated trajectories on a shell around it, so any single generated trajectory deviates from the ground truth. We present DriftingPlanner, a trajectory planner trained with the drifting loss alone, without any coordinate regression term. It computes the field per scene and removes the shell at inference: it decodes every noise vector together with its negation in one batched pass, and averaging each antithetic pair cancels the linear part of the displacement from the shell center. On NAVSIM navtest, DriftingPlanner reaches a state-of-the-art 93.75 PDMS, and with single-step inference its drifting decoder comes within 0.13 PDMS of the best diffusion or flow matching setting, which needs ten inference steps.

AI.tldr: DriftingPlanner 仅用 drifting 损失（无坐标回归项）训练轨迹规划器，通过逐场景计算吸引-排斥场并用对偶噪声配对平均消除"壳层"偏差，在 NAVSIM navtest 上达到 93.75 PDMS，单步推理逼近十步扩散/流匹配性能。
AI.motivation: 端到端规划的轨迹解码存在两难：坐标回归快但会把多种合理 maneuver 混合成一条都不符合的轨迹；扩散与流匹配能建模分布但需多步推理。drifting 模型把迭代移入训练、实现单步生成，但原为类条件图像生成设计，每类有大量正样本；而规划中每个场景即一个条件，池化场景会错误吸引到无关场景的 GT，逐场景计算又只剩专家轨迹一个正样本，互相排斥使生成轨迹落在其周围的"壳"上，导致单条采样偏离真值。
AI.method: 提出 DriftingPlanner：逐场景计算 drifting 场的吸引-排斥损失，完全去除坐标回归项。推理时去除壳层偏移——将每个噪声向量与其相反数配对，在一次批量前向中解码，并对每对反对称样本取平均，从而抵消来自壳层中心的位移线性分量。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM navtest 上取得 93.75 PDMS 的最优（state-of-the-art）成绩；单步推理的 drifting 解码器与需十步推理的最佳扩散/流匹配配置仅差 0.13 PDMS。
AI.conclusion: Drifting 损失可独立支撑高质量轨迹规划，配合对偶噪声平均可消除单正样本排斥造成的壳层偏差，实现单步、近多步扩散精度的规划解码。

title: RLiD: Reinforcement Learning in the Decision Plane for Language Agents and LLMs
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has improved the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) across a wide range of tasks. However, token-level RL assigns an action's advantage to the entire generated response, including tokens specifying the parsed action, reasoning chains, and malformed content. Although the environment executes only the parsed action, variation in how the action is expressed in natural language can introduce additional variance into policy-gradient estimates. We propose RLiD (Reinforcement Learning in the Decision plane), a framework that directly optimizes the probabilities of executable action options. RLiD compiles observations, an optional compact memory, and a labeled action menu into the model input, and uses a large decision model (LDM) to select an action in a single forward pass. By eliminating autoregressive token generation and bypassing action parsing, RLiD avoids invalid action outputs and improves RL rollout efficiency. Our analysis shows that, within a fixed text policy, marginalizing over alternative realizations of the same action removes a zero-mean gradient component without changing the expected update. We further distill trained LDM policies into generative LLMs through supervision on their action trajectories. Experiments on ARC, Countdown, and Sokoban demonstrate improved performance or lower computational cost across several settings. On ALFWorld, the complete training and distillation pipeline reaches 99.3% success in 12.7 H100 GPU-hours, compared with 86.6% in 17.3 GPU-hours for token-level RL of the same LLM. With compiled memory, our strongest Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM and distilled generative LLM achieve 100% success on all 134 unseen and 140 seen ALFWorld evaluation games.

AI.tldr: 提出RLiD框架，直接在决策空间优化可执行动作选项的概率，避免token级RL的无效输出与方差，并在多个任务上取得更好性能或更低成本。
AI.motivation: token级RL将动作优势分配给整个生成响应（含推理链、格式错误内容），且动作的自然语言表达差异会引入政策梯度估计的额外方差，同时需要动作解析、易产生无效输出。
AI.method: 将观测、可选紧凑记忆与带标签的动作菜单编译为模型输入，用大规模决策模型(LDM)单次前向选择动作，消除自回归生成与动作解析；理论上通过在同一文本策略内对同一动作的多种表述做边际化去除零均值梯度分量；再将训练好的LDM策略通过动作轨迹监督蒸馏回生成式LLM。
AI.result: 在ARC、Countdown、Sokoban上性能提升或计算成本降低；ALFWorld完整训练+蒸馏流程12.7 H100 GPU小时达99.3%成功率，对比token级RL 17.3小时仅86.6%；结合编译记忆，最强Qwen2.5-1.5B LDM及蒸馏生成式LLM在134个未见和140个已见评估游戏中均达100%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 在决策平面而非token级进行RL可提升rollout效率、消除无效动作并降低梯度方差，且可蒸馏回生成式LLM，是一种高效且性能优越的替代方案。

title: Sonny-ENS: demystifying machine-learning ensemble weather forecasting
comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 7 Extended Data figures and 3 Extended Data tables; Supplementary Information (4 figures, 2 tables) included
summary: Every weather forecast is uncertain, and decisions from flood warnings to energy trading depend on how well that uncertainty is quantified. Machine-learning (ML) ensembles now quantify it better than the best physics-based ensemble, yet two things about them remain opaque: whether their skill requires hundreds to thousands of accelerator-days of training, and how a network with a simple source of randomness produces a spread that follows the flow. Here we introduce Sonny-ENS, an ensemble of three 68.9-million-parameter networks with Monte Carlo dropout, trained on the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) in 2.7 A40 GPU-days. On 2022, it has a lower CRPS than the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts ensemble (ENS) on 96% of 570 targets and an 8.3% lower mean CRPS at lead times of 1-10 days. It outperforms the operational GenCast on 69% of the targets, and a 51-member, 15-day forecast takes 69 s on one GPU. Ablations identify the ingredients of this skill, and a Kolmogorov-Arnold sparse autoencoder shows that dropout injects uncertainty mainly in the tropics, whereas the spread grows where the atmosphere is baroclinically unstable (spatial correlation 0.91 with the Eady growth rate). Skillful probabilistic weather forecasts are therefore within reach of a single GPU server.

AI.tldr: Sonny-ENS：三个6890万参数网络、Monte Carlo dropout、按CRPS训练，仅用2.7个A40 GPU天即超越ECMWF ENS与GenCast，单GPU 69秒完成51成员15天预报。
AI.motivation: 天气预报本质不确定，洪水预警、能源交易等决策依赖不确定性的量化。ML集合已优于最好的物理集合，但两点不透明：(1) 其技巧是否必须耗费数百至数千加速器天的训练；(2) 简单随机源如何产生随流场演化的离散度(空间结构)。
AI.method: 构建Sonny-ENS：3个68.9M参数网络组成的集合，采用Monte Carlo dropout引入随机性，以CRPS为训练目标，总计2.7 A40 GPU天。进行消融实验识别技巧来源；并用Kolmogorov-Arnold稀疏自编码器解析dropout注入不确定性的空间位置与离散度增长机制。
AI.result: 2022年，在570个目标中96%的CRPS低于ECMWF ENS，1–10天平均CRPS低8.3%；在69%目标上优于业务化GenCast；51成员15天预报单GPU耗时69秒。可解释性分析显示dropout主要在对流层热带注入不确定性，而离散度在斜压不稳定区增长，与Eady增长率空间相关0.91。
AI.conclusion: 高质量概率天气预报可由单台GPU服务器实现，且训练成本远低于此前认知；简单dropout即可自发产生物理上合理的离散度增长结构。

title: An Experimental Study of Hybrid Retrieval, NLI and Open-source LLMs for Scientific Claim Verification
summary: Claim verification is the task of deciding whether a source text supports a claim, contradicts it, or lacks sufficient evidence. Natural Language Inference (NLI) models can judge whether a single sentence supports or contradicts a claim, but they struggle when the evidence is spread across several sentences. Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) can reason across sentences, but may draw conclusions the text does not support. In this experimental study, we test whether a conservative fusion rule, labeling a claim Support or Contradict only when both models agree and defaulting to Not Enough Evidence otherwise, combines their strengths. We construct a benchmark of 2,035 claims from SciFact and CliniFact (858 Support, 152 Contradict, 1,025 Not Enough Evidence). We retrieve the top five most relevant sentences per claim using a hybrid of semantic and lexical (BM25) retrieval, which slightly outperforms either method alone. These retrieved sentences are then provided to every verification model. We then compare a DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli NLI baseline against Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen3 8B, and Mistral 7B. Qwen3 achieves the highest Macro-F1 (0.7937), followed by Llama 3.1 (0.7204) and Mistral (0.6388), while the NLI baseline reaches only 0.3157. Contrary to our hypothesis, fusion degrades performance, dropping Macro-F1 to 0.7392, 0.6730, and 0.5991, respectively. To understand this decline, we analyze agreements, disagreements, and common error patterns between the NLI and LLM verifiers. Our error analysis shows that NLI and LLM disagreements often result in correct LLM predictions being overturned.

AI.tldr: 该实验研究用"保守融合规则"（NLI与LLM一致才判Support/Contradict，否则Not Enough Evidence）结合DeBERTa NLI与多个LLM做事实核查，结果融合反而降低性能，因NLI错误地否决了LLM的正确预测。
AI.motivation: NLI模型擅长单句判断但难以跨句整合证据；LLM可跨句推理但可能得出文本不支持的结论。作者希望用保守融合规则兼取二者之长。
AI.method: 从SciFact与CliniFact构建2,035条claim基准（858 Support/152 Contradict/1,025 NEE）；用语义+BM25混合检索每条claim的Top-5句子并输入所有模型；对比DeBERTa-v3 NLI基线与Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen3 8B、Mistral 7B，比较单独与融合效果，并做一致性/分歧与错误模式分析。
AI.result: 单独LLM显著优于NLI：Qwen3 Macro-F1 0.7937、Llama 3.1 0.7204、Mistral 0.6388，NLI仅0.3157；混合检索略优于单一检索。融合后性能下降至0.7392、0.6730、0.5991，与假设相反。
AI.conclusion: 保守融合未能带来增益，NLI与LLM的分歧常导致LLM正确预测被推翻；在跨句证据的事实核查中，简单融合规则不适用，NLI作为"守门人"存在风险。

title: [Re] Pure Noise to the Rescue of Insufficient Data
comment: Reproducibility study of Zada et al. (arXiv:2112.08810). Published in ReScience C 9(2), #45 (2023), ML Reproducibility Challenge 2022. 15 pages. Code: https://github.com/seungjaeryanlee/pure-noise
summary: We examine the main claims of Zada, Benou, and Irani (2021), which states that in an image classification task with imbalanced training data, (i) using pure noise to augment minority-class images encourages generalization by improving minority-class accuracy. This method is paired with (ii) a new batch normalization layer that normalizes noise images using affine parameters learned from natural images, which improves the model's performance. Moreover, (iii) this improvement is robust to varying levels of data augmentation. Finally, the authors propose that (iv) adding pure noise images can improve classification even on balanced training data. We implemented the training pipeline from the description of the paper using PyTorch and integrated authors' code snippets for sampling pure noise images and batch normalizing noise and natural images separately. We reproduced the main claims that (i) oversampling with pure noise improves generalization by improving the minority-class accuracy, (ii) the proposed batch normalization (BN) method outperforms baselines, (iii) and this improvement is robust across data augmentations. Our results also support that (iv) adding pure noise images can improve classification on balanced training data. However, additional experiments suggest that the performance improvement from OPeN may be more orthogonal to the improvement caused by a bigger network or more complex data augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文重现已发表于ICLR 2021的OPeN方法，验证其主要论断，并发现其性能提升与更大网络或更强数据增强带来的提升可能是正交的。
AI.motivation: Zada等(2021)提出的OPeN方法声称：在类别不平衡图像分类中，(i)用纯噪声过采样少数类可提升泛化；(ii)用从自然图像学到的仿射参数对噪声做批归一化可提升性能；(iii)该提升对数据增强变化鲁棒；(iv)在平衡数据上加入纯噪声也能改善分类。作者需独立验证这些论断的可靠性。
AI.method: 依据论文描述用PyTorch实现训练流程，并集成作者提供的纯噪声采样、以及分别对噪声与自然图像进行批归一化的代码片段，复现上述四项主要论断。
AI.result: 复现成功支持(i)纯噪声过采样通过提升少数类精度改善泛化、(ii)所提BN方法优于基线、(iii)提升在多种数据增强下鲁棒、以及(iv)在平衡数据上加入纯噪声仍可提升分类。补充实验则显示OPeN带来的性能提升可能与更大网络或更复杂数据增强所带来的提升更为正交。
AI.conclusion: OPeN的主要论断得到独立复现验证，但其增益来源可能与网络容量或数据增强的增益相互独立（正交），提示该方法并非简单替代更强模型或更强增强。

title: Think Globally, Generate Personally: Multi-View Thinking with Adaptive Generation for Generative Recommendation
summary:
Semantic-ID-based (SID) generative recommendation (GR) represents each item as a sequence of discrete tokens and predicts the next item through autoregressive SID generation. However, existing methods face two challenges. First, insufficient shared context modeling for user sequences: full-history and recent behaviors provide overlapping yet complementary evidence, but modeling them within a single sequence may dilute current cues, whereas processing them through separate streams may fail to coordinate them. Second, insufficient personalized adaptation in progressive SID decisions: although decoder states evolve with generated prefixes, existing models typically use a shared output-side transformation across recommendation instances, without explicitly selecting a transformation suited to the current user need.
  To address these challenges, we propose Multi-View Thinking with Adaptive Generation (MV-Thinker), a framework that Thinks Globally and Generates Personally. First, Multi-View Temporal Thinking uses view-specific thinking queries and readers over overlapping full-history and recent-history views, coordinating both sources into complementary user-conditioned contexts before SID generation. Second, Hierarchical Residual Adaptation organizes lightweight adapters into nested residual paths before a shared vocabulary projection, adaptively transforming context-bearing decoder states for SID decisions. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that MV-Thinker consistently outperforms strong discriminative and generative recommendation baselines across multiple ranking metrics. The implementation code and datasets are available on: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MV-Thinker

AI.tldr: MV-Thinker：多视图时序思考+分层残差适配，实现SID生成式推荐的"全局思考、个性化生成"。
AI.motivation: 现有SID生成式推荐存在两大问题：(1) 用户序列共享上下文建模不足——全历史与近期行为互补但单序列建模会稀释当前线索，分流失效难协调；(2) 渐进式SID决策缺乏个性化适配——各推荐实例共用输出端变换，未按当前用户需求选择合适变换。
AI.method: 提出MV-Thinker框架。(1) 多视图时序思考：在重叠的全历史与近期历史视图上使用视图专属thinking queries和readers，协调两源为互补的用户条件上下文，再生成SID。(2) 分层残差适配：在共享词表投影前将轻量适配器组织为嵌套残差路径，自适应变换携带上下文的解码器状态以做SID决策。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集上，MV-Thinker在多个排序指标上持续优于强判别式与生成式推荐基线。
AI.conclusion: 多视图上下文协调与个性化输出端残差适配可有效提升SID生成式推荐效果，代码与数据已开源（匿名仓库）。

title: Meet Students Where They Are: Student-Prefix Teacher Adaptation for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) mitigates the student's exposure bias by optimizing on student-generated trajectories. However, student-generated prefixes may contain reasoning errors or follow patterns unfamiliar to the teacher, undermining the reliability of its token-level supervision.
