This degradation becomes more pronounced as prefixes grow longer. To address this teacher-side distribution mismatch, we propose Student-Prefix Teacher Adaptation (SPTA), which adapts the teacher to the states on which it is queried during distillation. Specifically, before OPD starts, we collect student rollout prefixes with random lengths and continually train the teacher to continue from the prefixes using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). By treating each prefix as context and rewarding correct final answers, the teacher learns to recover from student-induced states rather than imitate the student's reasoning. Then, the adapted teacher is used for standard OPD, with no changes to the distillation objective. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that our SPTA improves average student performance over standard OPD and OPD with task-level RLVR-adapted teachers. These results highlight the importance of adapting teachers not only to solve problems independently, but also to provide reliable guidance on the states their students actually visit.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SPTA（学生前缀教师适配），通过在 OPD 开始前用学生随机长度前缀持续训练教师（RLVR），使教师适配学生实际访问的状态，从而提升蒸馏可靠性。
AI.motivation: On-policy distillation 虽缓解学生曝光偏差，但学生生成的前缀可能含推理错误或教师不熟悉的模式，导致教师逐 token 监督不可靠，且前缀越长越严重（教师侧分布不匹配）。
AI.method: 在 OPD 前，收集学生随机长度的 rollout 前缀，将每个前缀作为上下文、以最终答案正确性为奖励，用 RLVR 持续训练教师，使其学会从学生引发的状态中"恢复"而非模仿学生推理；随后用适配后的教师进行标准 OPD，蒸馏目标不变。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上，SPTA 相较标准 OPD 及使用任务级 RLVR 适配教师的 OPD，平均学生性能均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明：适配教师不仅要能独立解题，还需能在学生实际访问的状态上提供可靠指导。

title: IMPACT: Image-Conditioned Motion with Physics-Aware Collision and Trajectory Guidance for Video Generation
summary: Visually realistic video generation does not guarantee physically consistent motion. Generated objects may exhibit implausible collision responses or rebounds without energy dissipation, while even physically valid motion predictions may not be faithfully realized during synthesis. We propose \textbf{IMPACT}, a physics-state-driven image-to-video framework that addresses these challenges by coupling explicit dynamics prediction with complementary sparse--dense physical guidance. A learnably calibrated Physics State Generator unifies continuous free-flight dynamics with discrete collision responses, linking impact timing, post-impact velocity, rebound attenuation, and eventual settling within a coherent physical-state sequence. To translate this evolution into effective generative constraints, IMPACT derives sparse trajectories and dense region-level motion priors from the same physical rollout. Sparse trajectories constrain global object displacement, while dense priors guide diffusion sampling to encourage coherent object-region motion and suppress unwanted background changes. Their shared physical basis coordinates global and local motion guidance to reduce prediction--generation mismatch. Experiments on 100 controlled sphere--plane collision scenes spanning different material combinations and visual environments demonstrate improved physical plausibility over representative general-purpose, physics-grounded, and motion-controllable baselines. The project repository is available at https://weiweiwiewei.github.io/impact

AI.tldr: IMPACT 是一个物理状态驱动的图生视频框架，将显式动力学预测与稀疏-稠密物理引导耦合，提升生成视频的物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 视觉逼真不等于物理一致：生成物体可能出现不合理的碰撞响应、无能量耗散的反弹，且即使预测出物理正确运动也难以在合成中被忠实实现。
AI.method: 引入可学习校准的 Physics State Generator，统一连续自由飞行与离散碰撞响应（冲击时刻、碰撞后速度、反弹衰减、最终静止），形成连贯物理状态序列；由同一物理推演导出稀疏轨迹（约束全局位移）与稠密区域级运动先验（引导扩散采样，保持物体区域运动连贯、抑制背景变化），二者共享物理基础以协调全局与局部引导。
AI.result: 在覆盖不同材质组合与视觉环境的 100 个受控球-平面碰撞场景上，物理合理性优于通用、物理接地及运动可控的代表性基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式物理状态预测与互补的稀疏-稠密引导相结合，可有效缓解"预测-生成"不匹配，提升视频生成的物理可信度。

title: MAGAR: Multimodal Agents for GUI-Based 3D Mechanical Assembly and Minimal Rework
summary: A GUI command can be correct at the interface level yet still produce an incorrect assembly. An agent must identify the relevant components, respect their structural relationships, and determine which parts should move during recovery. We introduce MAGAR-Bench, a benchmark of 4,000 multimodal samples from 26 assembly families that separates Assembly Decision, Atomic Action, and Minimal Rework. For rework, the objective counts distinct moved parts within the validated recovery candidate set for each state, rather than the number of actions. We also introduce MAGAR, a selective correction framework built on a frozen policy obtained by supervised fine-tuning. Its key design matches correction granularity to output dependencies. Structured candidates revise assembly fields and rework scope, while complete action candidates keep native GUI primitives coupled with their parameters. A learned selector retains the original prediction unless a candidate passes a task-specific intervention threshold. On recorded states from held-out assembly families, MAGAR improves Overall, the task-balanced aggregate, from 37.50 to 41.39, with gains on all three tasks. Across 209 interventions, 70 correct an error and 22 introduce one. These results support task-specific correction while highlighting the remaining tradeoff between fixing errors and preserving reliable predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出MAGAR-Bench基准（26类装配族、4000多模态样本）将装配任务拆分为装配决策、原子动作与最小返工三部分，并给出选择性纠错框架MAGAR，在冻结SFT策略上按输出依赖匹配纠错粒度，使任务均衡总体分由37.50提升至41.39。
AI.motivation: GUI命令在界面层面正确，仍可能生成错误的装配结果：智能体需识别相关部件、遵守结构关系并确定返工时哪些部件应移动。现有评测未区分这些能力，也未以"被移动部件数"衡量返工代价。
AI.method: 构建MAGAR-Bench，将任务分为Assembly Decision、Atomic Action、Minimal Rework；返工目标按每个状态下验证通过的恢复候选中不同被移动部件数计数而非动作数。MAGAR则建立在冻结的监督微调策略之上：结构化候选改写装配字段与返工范围，完整动作候选保持原生GUI图元与其参数耦合；学习的选择器在候选未通过任务特定干预阈值时保留原预测。
AI.result: 在留出装配族的状态上，任务均衡总体分从37.50升至41.39，三项任务均有提升；209次干预中70次纠正错误、22次引入新错误。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持任务特定的纠错设计，同时显示"修正错误"与"保留可靠预测"之间仍存在权衡。

title: DepthGraft: Structural Regularization through Hierarchical Cross-Layer KV Reconstruction
summary: Scaling depth is a key route to stronger large language models, but Pre-LN architectures often suffer from depth-wise information dilution, limiting the effective use of deep layers. While cross-layer connectivity has proven effective at mitigating this problem, existing designs usually introduce additional computation or memory access. We revisit cross-layer KV sharing as an efficient form of such connectivity. Beyond cache compression, each KV reuse edge creates a direct gradient path from deep layers to source KV projections, turning KV sharing into an implicit structural regularizer for KV representation geometry. We provide a systematic analysis of this mechanism, showing that proper sharing topologies sharpen key retrieval directions while enriching the value content subspace, whereas existing adjacent or global-anchor designs do not fully exploit this effect. Motivated by this, we propose DepthGraft, a hierarchical KV-sharing architecture that reconstructs deep-layer KV from stride-aligned shallow-middle source pairs. DepthGraft distributes non-local gradient flow across source layers, while preserving prefill early completion and reducing KV cache by roughly one third. Experiments on dense and MoE models from 0.5B to 16B parameters show consistent downstream improvements under both GQA and MLA. Notably, on the 16B MoE model, DepthGraft achieves a 7.0% absolute improvement on MMLU-Pro, along with gains of 6.6% on CMMLU and 6.4% on C3. These results validate the potential of DepthGraft as a scalable design for large-scale pretraining. The project page is available at https://github.com/jianke0604/DepthGraft.

AI.tldr: DepthGraft提出层次化跨层KV共享架构，通过重建深层KV隐式正则化KV几何并减少约1/3缓存，在0.5B–16B模型上一致提升下游性能。
AI.motivation: Pre-LN架构扩展深度时存在深层信息稀释问题，跨层连接虽有效但通常带来额外计算或访存开销；现有相邻或全局锚点式KV共享未充分利用共享带来的正则化效应。
AI.method: 从梯度路径视角重新审视跨层KV共享：每条KV复用边为深层到源KV投影提供直接梯度通路，构成隐式结构正则。分析表明合适的共享拓扑可锐化key检索方向并丰富value内容子空间。据此提出DepthGraft，用步幅对齐的浅-中层源对重建深层KV，分散非局部梯度流，同时保留prefill早完成特性。
AI.result: 在0.5B–16B稠密与MoE模型、GQA与MLA下均取得一致下游提升：16B MoE上MMLU-Pro绝对提升7.0%，CMMLU提升6.6%，C3提升6.4%；KV缓存减少约1/3。
AI.conclusion: DepthGraft是一种高效、可扩展的深层KV共享设计，兼顾性能提升与缓存压缩，适合大规模预训练。

title: Vocabulary Aligned Explanations for Computer Vision Models
summary: Optimizing vision models for accuracy does not force the model to learn and utilize human-understandable and domain-specific concepts and rules. We propose explaining image classifications through domain-specific concepts, visual evidence, and expert knowledge expressed as logical rules. We introduce FLUENT (Framework for Localized, Uncertainty-Aware Explanations in Normative Terminology), a post-hoc framework that ranks expert-authored rules combining jointly required, alternative, and absent concepts. To account for prediction errors, FLUENT combines predicted labels and concept states with empirically estimated likelihoods and concept priors. It scores each rule by calculating support over satisfying assignments to the concepts mentioned in that rule, then normalizes these scores to express relative confidence among candidate explanations. The selected rule is illustrated through occlusion-based highlights for positive concept mentions in the query image and localized examples in retrieved reference images for negative mentions. These illustrations are intended to show end users unfamiliar with the domain what the concepts named in an explanation look like. FLUENT combines domain knowledge and model accuracy, and delivers visual concept highlights and explicit rule confidence to explain an image in the vocabulary of an application domain.

AI.tldr: 提出FLUENT后验框架，用领域专用概念（正向、可选、缺失概念）与专家逻辑规则解释图像分类，并结合预测似然与概念先验进行不确定性感知打分，最后用遮挡高亮和参考图局部示例可视化规则。
AI.motivation: 高精度视觉模型并不必然学到可利用、人类可理解且领域相关概念与规则；需要以应用领域术语（概念、视觉证据、专家逻辑规则）解释图像分类，并对预测错误做不确定性处理。
AI.method: FLUENT为事后（post-hoc）框架：对专家撰写的规则排序，规则由联合必需概念、替代概念与缺失概念组合；结合预测标签与概念状态、经验估计似然及概念先验以应对预测错误；对每条规则在其涉及概念的满足赋值上计算支持度，再归一化为候选解释之间的相对置信度；对被选规则，正向概念在查询图上用遮挡高亮，负向概念在检索参考图中给出局部示例。
AI.result: 输出相对置信度归一化的规则解释，提供视觉概念高亮与显式规则置信度；可视化面向不熟悉该领域的终端用户，展示解释中所命名概念的具体样貌。
AI.conclusion: FLUENT将领域知识与模型精度结合，用应用领域词汇给出图像解释，兼顾可理解性、规则置信度与不确定性感知。

title: Benchmark of THReD: Evaluating an LLM Agent and Its Preprocessing Tools for Turning Electronic Health Records into AI-Ready Datasets
comment: 35 pages, 3 figures, and 22 tables. Code, task definitions, and per-episode results are available on Zenodo via the DOI provided in the DOI field
summary: LLM agents are increasingly built into data-analysis software, yet little evidence shows how reliably they preprocess clinical data or whether the tools they invoke give correct, reproducible output. We report a benchmark of THReD, a web-based system that turns electronic health record (EHR) extracts into AI-ready datasets through a chat agent whose proposed steps run only after user confirmation. The agent benchmark has 141 tasks (100 templates) in seven categories, including goal-level requests, failure recovery, requests calling for no action, schema variation and prompt injection through the data, on synthetic tables calibrated to a regional health information exchange; success is judged by checks on the produced data. Over 2,550 episodes with Claude Haiku 5.5 in four context configurations, the deployed agent completed 92.7% (95% CI 88.1-96.4) of tasks on its first answer, abstained on every advice request, recovered from every injected fault, and never proposed an action requested by planted text. Without the data profile, completion fell to 58.0%; goal-level requests were hardest (80.6%). Six experiments on real records of two chronic-disease cohorts and on synthetic data at scale validate the tools: 91-92% of inferred patient classes and 99.7-99.8% of inferred vital-sign labels were correct in masked reconstruction; a dictionary builder combining curated dictionaries with LLM suggestions mapped 99.0% of 2,208 raw variants correctly; all 2,176 replays of 128 saved pipelines gave byte-identical files under pinned dependencies; subgroup differences in inference accuracy vanished within facility and lookup key; and the same-day consolidation rule changed 90-day emergency revisit rates by up to 3.2 points without shifting cohort composition by more than one point. Processing time grew roughly linearly to 5.5 million records while the prompt stayed at about 13 thousand tokens.

AI.tldr: THReD 是一个把 EHR 抽取数据转为 AI-ready 数据集的聊天式系统，其基准显示部署智能体首答完成率 92.7%，且工具箱在正确性、可复现性与规模上均得到验证。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体已广泛嵌入数据分析软件，但缺乏证据说明它们能否可靠地预处理临床数据，以及所调用工具的输出是否正确、可复现。
AI.method: 构建 141 任务（100 模板）、7 类（含目标级请求、故障恢复、无需行动请求、模式变化、数据内提示注入等）的智能体基准，基于对齐区域健康信息交换的合成表，以产出数据的检查判定成功；用 Claude Haiku 5.5 在四种上下文配置下跑 2,550+ 回合。另做六项实验：两个慢病队列的真实病历与大规模合成数据上的掩码重建、字典构建、管线重放、亚组差异、同日合并规则影响，以及规模扩展测试。
AI.result: 首答完成率 92.7%（95% CI 88.1–96.4）；对建议类请求全部弃答；所有注入故障均恢复；从未执行植入文本要求的动作。无数据画像时完成率降至 58.0%；目标级请求最难（80.6%）。掩码重建中患者类别与生命体征标签推断正确率分别为 91–92% 与 99.7–99.8%；字典构建映射 99.0% 的 2,208 个原始变异；128 条管线共 2,176 次重放在固定依赖下字节完全一致；设施与查找键内亚组差异消失；同日合并规则使 90 天急诊再访率变化最多 3.2 个百分点，队列构成变动不超过 1 个百分点；处理 550 万条记录时时间近线性增长，提示词约稳定在 1.3 万 token。
AI.conclusion: 用户确认后执行的智能体在临床数据预处理上可靠、安全且可复现，其工具输出经真实与合成数据验证；但数据画像对性能至关重要，目标级请求仍是薄弱环节。

title: Yielding Fairness: Coupled Learning and Fairness for Value-Weighted Ranking
summary:
Risk screening and recommendation systems pass or block accounts that generate both value and loss. Under a blocked-value budget, a cap on expected value forgone through blocking, the optimal ranking orders accounts by expected value per unit expected loss, a ratio of conditional expectations. This rule can conflict with accepted harm or net-harm criteria, blocking accounts that another criterion would pass at the same budget. We call these cases account-level objections and define group complaint disparity as the difference between groups' normalized realized objections.
  Weighted binary cross-entropy (W-BCE) implements the value-per-loss order with one score. Objection penalties modify the ranking, while group multipliers scale those penalties differently by group, tracing tradeoffs between loss capture and complaint disparity. This preserves the value-budgeted ranking structure and makes the cost of reducing contestable blocks explicit.
  Across public recommendation, insurance, credit, and mortgage datasets, we compare undamped W-BCE with ordinary BCE using yield Gini, an area summary of loss capture versus blocked value. Logarithmic weight damping is evaluated separately. Held-out evaluations measure capture-disparity tradeoffs. Validation-selected group-aware complaint penalties improve complaint closure in some cohorts. A corrected comparison normalizes and enlarges candidate policy banks using validation-only price sweeps and retains all ten applicable sources. The source-level results do not establish a statistically significant average advantage over group-blind pricing at the fixed minimum retained loss capture. We also compare with blocked-count, blocked-value, and protected-loss parity postprocessors, which do not directly constrain realized objections, and measure objections in candidate-count and loss units.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在"被阻止价值预算"约束下的风险筛选与推荐排序，提出按期望价值/期望损失（条件期望之比）排序的规则，并指出该规则可能与伤害准则冲突而产生"账户级异议"；用W-BCE实现该排序，并用异议惩罚与群体乘子权衡损失捕获与群体投诉差异。
AI.motivation: 风险筛选系统会通过或拦截既产生价值又产生损失的账户。在预算约束下，最优排序是按价值损失比排序，但该规则与公认的伤害/净伤害准则可能冲突（同一预算下某准则会放行却被拦截）。作者希望量化并缓解这类"账户级异议"以及群体间的投诉差异。
AI.method: 提出以加权二元交叉熵（W-BCE）用单一分数实现价值-损失排序；引入异议惩罚修改排序、群体乘子按群体差异化缩放惩罚，以追踪损失捕获与投诉差异的权衡；另评估对数权重阻尼。在推荐、保险、信用、房贷等公开数据集上，用yield Gini（损失捕获 vs 被阻价值的面积摘要）比较W-BCE与普通BCE，并用验证集选择群体感知惩罚、价格扫描扩大候选策略库，与阻断数、阻断价值、受保护损失均等后处理比较。
AI.result: W-BCE相较普通BCE在yield Gini等指标上有差异；对数权重阻尼单独评估。留出评估显示验证集选择的群体感知异议惩罚在部分群体中改善投诉闭合。经校正的比较（验证集价格扫描、扩大候选策略库、保留全部十个适用来源）表明：在固定最低保留损失捕获水平下，相对群体盲定价没有统计学显著的平均优势。对照的阻断数/阻断价值/受保护损失均等后处理并不直接约束已实现异议。
AI.conclusion: 价值-损失比排序能实现预算约束下的最优排序，但需显式管理与伤害准则的账户级异议及群体投诉差异；所提惩罚机制能把降低争议性拦截的代价显式化，但现有证据不足以证明显著优于群体盲定价，需更大规模或更强证据。

title: ACTOR: Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents
summary: Large language agents for literary role-playing are typically modeled around dialogue generation, leaving characters' non-dialogue behaviors and their dynamic evolution over story time underrepresented. In this paper, we propose ACTOR (Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents), an automated framework for constructing such behavior trajectories from raw novel texts. ACTOR extracts dialogue and persona-relevant non-dialogue behaviors, represents each behavior using a Thought-Action-Observation structure, and organizes behavior trajectories according to the internal temporal order of the story. We build a behavior dataset from 143 diverse literary works. For each source behavior, we generate counterfactual behaviors that are contextually plausible yet inconsistent with the character's persona. We find that existing models struggle to reliably infer character-consistent actions from historical behaviors and evolving character states. Using these behavior pairs, we train models with Regularized Preference Optimization (RPO), which augments DPO with a negative log-likelihood loss on the source behavior to jointly optimize behavior preference and generation. We further design a four-way next-behavior selection task to evaluate the model's ability to faithfully mimic character actions. Across 17,560 evaluation instances, the model trained on ACTOR's preference pairs achieves substantially improved accuracy. This result demonstrates that structured, temporally organized supervision enables models to leverage character profiles and prior behaviors to infer subsequent actions, greatly advancing literary role-playing beyond mere dialogue imitation. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SilentStar233/ACTOR.

AI.tldr: ACTOR框架从小说原文提取对话与非对话行为，用Thought-Action-Observation结构并按故事内部时间组织行为轨迹，构建含反事实行为对的143部作品数据集，用RPO微调提升角色一致性动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有文学角色扮演智能体多围绕对话生成建模，忽视角色非对话行为及其随故事时间的动态演化，导致角色建模不完整。
AI.method: 提出ACTOR自动框架：抽取对话与人物相关的非对话行为，以Thought-Action-Observation结构表示，并按故事内部时间顺序组织轨迹；为每个源行为生成"情境合理但不符合人设"的反事实行为对；用Regularized Preference Optimization（RPO，DPO加源行为负对数似然损失）联合优化偏好与生成；并设计四选一"下一行为选择"任务评测。
AI.result: 在17,560个评测实例的四路选择任务上，基于ACTOR偏好对训练的模型准确率显著提升，表明模型能结合角色档案与历史行为推断后续动作。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、按时间组织的监督可推动文学角色扮演超越单纯对话模仿，实现忠于角色的行为模拟。代码与数据已开源。

title: SpecUltra: A Unified Foundation Model for Heterogeneous Spectral Images
summary: Spectral imagery, including hyperspectral image (HSI) and multispectral image (MSI), exhibits substantial heterogeneity in band numbers, wavelengths, spectral resolutions, hindering unified modeling and cross-sensor transfer. From the perspective of imaging physics, these heterogeneous observations can be regarded as discrete measurements of an underlying continuous spectrum acquired through different sampling processes. Motivated by this perspective, we propose SpecUltra, a unified foundation model for heterogeneous spectral images. Specifically, SpecUltra employs 3D convolutional tokenization and wavelength-aware 3D RoPE to encode relative wavelength and spatial relationships, enabling fine-grained spatial-spectral modeling within a shared coordinate system. We further construct MultiHyper-200K, a large-scale multi-sensor HSI dataset, and pretrain SpecUltra using auxiliary-token-assisted mask image modeling (MIM), where a level token indicates the radiometric product type and register tokens absorb sensor- and acquisition-dependent variations. To bridge the spectral-granularity gap between HSI and MSI, we introduce Spectral Kernel Transformation (SKT), which transfers pretrained knowledge in parameter space by constructing MSI embedding kernels from fine-grained HSI-pretrained kernel slices. This design preserves pretrained spectral priors while maintaining compatibility with the pretrained backbone. Experiments on HSI and MSI classification and segmentation benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art or competitive performance across disparate sensors and downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的异构光谱图像基础模型SpecUltra，将不同波段/传感器观测视为连续光谱的离散采样，用3D卷积分词与波长感知3D RoPE实现跨传感器统一建模，并构建MultiHyper-200K数据集与谱核变换(SKT)桥接HSI与MSI。
AI.motivation: 高光谱(HSI)与多光谱(MSI)图像在波段数、波长和光谱分辨率上差异巨大，导致难以统一建模和跨传感器迁移。作者从成像物理出发，把异构观测看作同一连续光谱经不同采样过程得到的离散测量，从而寻求在共享坐标系统中统一表示。
AI.method: 1) 3D卷积分词+波长感知3D RoPE，编码相对波长与空间关系，实现共享坐标下的细粒度空谱建模；2) 构建大规模多传感器HSI数据集MultiHyper-200K；3) 用辅助token(level token标识辐射产品类型、register token吸收传感器与采集差异)辅助的掩码图像建模(MIM)预训练；4) 提出谱核变换SKT，用细粒度HSI预训练核切片构造MSI嵌入核，在参数空间迁移知识。
AI.result: 在HSI与MSI的分类和分割基准上，跨不同传感器与下游任务取得SOTA或具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 以"连续光谱离散采样"为统一视角，SpecUltra实现了异构光谱图像的统一预训练与跨传感器迁移，SKT有效缓解HSI-MSI光谱粒度鸿沟并保留预训练光谱先验。

title: Towards Multi-Value Alignment via Value Localization in LLMs
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with multiple, potentially conflicting human values remains challenging, as existing multi-objective alignment methods often require costly fine-tuning and provide limited insight into the internal mechanisms underlying value-related behaviors. In this work, we investigate multi-value alignment from a mechanistic interpretability perspective by identifying value-sensitive attention heads (value heads) in LLMs. Using a probing-based value localization framework, we discover sparse sets of attention heads associated with diverse dimensions, spanning both human values (e.g., harmlessness, honesty) and stylistic preferences (e.g., coherence, complexity). Analyses across multiple LLM families reveal functional specialization and structured interactions among value heads, including conflicts between certain values. Targeted head ablations further induce substantial, value-specific behavioral changes, providing causal evidence of their functional importance. Building on these findings, we propose an inference-time activation steering strategy that enables controllable alignment with individual values or combinations of values without updating the underlying model parameters, supported by theoretical analysis. Experiments across multiple value alignment benchmarks demonstrate effective single- and multi-value control while largely preserving non-target model performance. Our findings connect mechanistic interpretability with flexible multi-value alignment, offering a foundation for more interpretable and pluralistic LLM behavior. The code is available at https://github.com/sihuo-design/ValueHeads.

AI.tldr: 本文从机制可解释性视角识别LLM中的"价值敏感注意力头"(value heads)，发现其对人类价值和风格偏好存在功能专门化与冲突，并据此提出无需更新参数的推理时激活引导策略，实现单值或多值对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有多目标对齐方法需要昂贵的微调，且对价值相关行为的内部机制缺乏理解，难以同时对齐多个可能冲突的人类价值。
AI.method: 基于探针的价值定位框架识别稀疏的value heads（覆盖无害性、诚实等人类价值及连贯性、复杂性等风格偏好）；通过针对性head消融验证因果作用；提出带理论分析的推理时激活引导(activation steering)策略，实现单值/多值可控对齐而不更新模型参数。
AI.result: 跨多个LLM家族发现value heads的功能专门化与结构化交互（含价值间冲突）；head消融引起显著的价值特异性行为变化，提供因果证据；多基准实验显示可实现有效的单值与多值控制，同时基本保持非目标性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究将机制可解释性与灵活的多值对齐相连接，为更可解释、更包容多元价值的LLM行为奠定基础，代码已开源。

title: Near-Optimal $\sqrt{K}$-Regret for Online Learning in Uninformed Markov Games
summary:
We study online learning in two-player uninformed Markov games, where the opponent may follow an arbitrary, unknown policy in each episode and the learner does not observe the opponent's actions. [TWYS21] showed that achieving sublinear external regret requires an exponential dependence on the episode length $H$. Motivated by this limitation, they studied the weaker notion of Nash-value regret and obtained an $\widetilde{O}(K^{2/3})$ regret bound, where $K$ is the number of episodes. More recently, [LLZR26] introduced a stronger notion called empirical Nash-value regret and achieved an $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{K})$ bound when the opponent's non-stationarity is moderate, including the case where the opponent follows a fixed policy. However, whether the $\sqrt{K}$ rate is achievable in the worst case remained open.
  In this paper, we resolve this open question by developing an algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{O}(H^{3/2}S\sqrt{AK})$ empirical Nash-value regret against arbitrary opponent policies, where $S$ is the number of states and $A$ is the number of learner's actions. Specifically, our algorithm combines global and local planning by maintaining a collection of candidate predictions of future losses, each associated with a policy. Global planning learns which candidates to favor across episodes, while local planning combines their policies differently at each state to make decisions. A key ingredient is to coordinate these two components to control the discrepancy between local loss estimates and the total loss of the executed policy, using only the learner's observed trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两人非完全信息马尔可夫博弈中的在线学习问题，解决了在对手策略任意未知且不可观测情况下，经验Nash值遗憾能否达到$\sqrt{K}$速率这一公开问题。作者提出结合全局与局部规划的新算法，实现了$\widetilde{O}(H^{3/2}S\sqrt{AK})$的经验Nash值遗憾。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明，在非完全信息马尔可夫博弈中实现sublinear外部遗憾需要$H$的指数依赖；即使较弱的Nash值遗憾，[TWYS21]也只得到$\widetilde{O}(K^{2/3})$；[LLZR26]在对手非平稳性适中时达到$\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{K})$，但最坏情况下$\sqrt{K}$速率是否可达仍未知。本文旨在解决这一开放问题。
AI.method: 算法同时使用全局规划与局部规划：维护一组未来损失的候选预测，每个候选关联一个策略；全局规划在回合间学习偏好哪些候选，局部规划在每个状态以不同方式组合候选策略来决策。关键是通过协调两个组件，仅利用学习者的观测轨迹，控制局部损失估计与实际执行策略总损失之间的偏差。
AI.result: 针对任意对手策略，算法取得$\widetilde{O}(H^{3/2}S\sqrt{AK})$的经验Nash值遗憾，其中$S$为状态数、$A$为学习者动作数、$H$为回合长度、$K$为回合数，从而在常数$H,S,A$时达到$\sqrt{K}$速率。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了非完全信息马尔可夫博弈中最坏情况下经验Nash值遗憾能否达到$\sqrt{K}$的开放问题，给出了正面答案，表明通过全局与局部规划的结合可在任意对手策略下实现次线性遗憾。

title: Written Once, Read Differently How Language Models Own Answers Steer Their Next Ones
summary: When a language model answers a yes/no question, that answer changes how it answers a different question about the same entity. We study this \emph{self-commitment} in 22 open-weight models from four families (0.5B--72B parameters), fixing the model's first answer and measuring the shift in its second across 3,600 question pairs about 120 entities. Each answer writes a \emph{commitment direction} into the residual stream. The similarity of two questions' directions predicts their coupling on held-out entities ($ρ= 0.43$--$0.85$), and ablating a single direction shared across topics leaves at most 17\% of the effect in every model. How this direction is read is far less stable: the reading circuit spreads across more attention heads as models grow, instruction tuning makes more questions read it in the opposite sense, and in one model changing only the system prompt reverses the circuit's sign. Ablating the direction while sparing the attention sink removes most of the coupling at under 1.3\% perplexity cost in 18 of 19 instruction-tuned models, though it shifts standalone answers in two. Without the sink spared, the direction's alignment with the leading principal component of ordinary text predicts which models pay a high cost. Written once, the commitment is read differently across scale, training and prompt.

AI.tldr: 语言模型回答yes/no问题后会形成"承诺方向"，该方向改变其对同一实体的后续回答；方向的写入高度一致，但读取方式随规模、训练和提示而变化。
AI.motivation: 研究模型的"自我承诺"(self-commitment)现象：第一个问题的答案会如何影响模型对一个实体的另一个问题的回答，并探究其机制。
AI.method: 在4个家族共22个开放权重模型(0.5B–72B)上，固定第一个答案，测量第二个答案的变化，覆盖120个实体的3600个问题对；识别残差流中的"承诺方向"，用方向相似度预测问题耦合，并通过消融、注意力头分析及系统提示操控来检验机制。
AI.result: 两问题方向相似度可预测其在留出实体上的耦合(ρ=0.43–0.85)；消融跨主题共享的单一方向可去除大部分效应(各模型残留≤17%)；读取电路随规模扩大分散到更多注意力头，指令微调使更多问题反向读取，系统提示可翻转符号；保留attention sink时消融，18/19个指令微调模型在<1.3%困惑度代价下去除大部分耦合，但2个模型独立答案发生偏移；方向与普通文本主成分的对齐程度可预测高代价。
AI.conclusion: 承诺方向一旦写入则高度一致，但其读取方式在模型规模、训练方式和提示条件下差异显著，体现"写一次、读多样"的机制。

title: RadPose: ISAC-based RF 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Human pose estimation under adverse lighting and occlusion conditions remains challenging for camera- and LiDAR-based systems. Although mmWave radars provide robustness to illumination and occlusion, they rely on dedicated hardware and licensed spectrum, limiting scalability. In this paper, we present RadPose, a learning-based monostatic integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework that enables mmWave communication devices to perform 3D human pose estimation. Unlike specialized radars, RadPose leverages monostatic full-duplex operation to extract channel impulse responses (CIRs) directly from standard OFDM communication signals, generating 3D radio point clouds without additional sensing hardware. To address the sparsity and noise of RF observations, RadPose employs a cross-frame transformer-based pose inference network with semantic-guided spatial attention and target-driven temporal attention for robust spatio-temporal aggregation. It further adopts a joint-aware inverse kinematics refinement module based on graph convolution to enforce skeletal topology, bone-length consistency, and anatomical plausibility. Extensive experiments demonstrate RadPose achieves competitive accuracy compared to state-of-the-art radar-based approaches while maintaining robust performance in unseen and occluded scenarios. The dataset and source code are available at https://github.com/Geo-Chou/RadPose.

AI.tldr: RadPose 是一个基于单站全双工 ISAC 的学习型框架，利用标准 OFDM 通信信号提取 CIR 生成 3D 无线电点云，无需专用雷达硬件即可实现 3D 人体姿态估计，在恶劣光照与遮挡场景下仍具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 相机和 LiDAR 在恶劣光照与遮挡下姿态估计困难；mmWave 雷达虽鲁棒但依赖专用硬件与授权频谱，难以规模化。作者希望借助通信设备本身完成感知。
AI.method: 采用单站全双工 ISAC 从 OFDM 通信信号中提取 CIR 并生成 3D 点云；设计跨帧 Transformer 姿态推断网络，含语义引导空间注意力与目标驱动时间注意力；并引入基于图卷积的关节感知逆运动学细化模块，约束骨架拓扑、骨长一致性与解剖合理性。
AI.result: 实验表明，RadPose 精度可与 SOTA 雷达方法媲美，且在未见场景和遮挡场景下保持鲁棒性能；数据集与代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: RadPose 证明通信设备可复用为人体姿态感知器，兼顾精度与可扩展性，为无专用硬件的 ISAC 人体感知提供可行方案。

title: AttentionIndex: Accelerating Learned Sparse Attention with a Causal Inverted-File Index
summary: Learned sparse attention, used in production models such as DeepSeek-V4 and GLM-5, lets each query attend to only k keys chosen by a lightweight indexer, but the indexer still scores every key in the prefix. At one million tokens, this selection takes more than half of prefill time. Two-stage selection over contiguous blocks, as in HiSA, reduces this cost, but its recall declines as context grows at a fixed candidate budget. We present AttentionIndex, which routes each query over an inverted-file index that groups indexer keys by similarity and refines the candidates with the native indexer score. AttentionIndex builds the index during prefill, making new keys searchable immediately, reusing previous clustering to keep maintenance cheap, and exposing each query only to clusters built from its own prefix. On GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash at one million tokens, AttentionIndex delivers 1.3-1.8 times the prefill throughput of exhaustive selection, and at throughput within 5% of HiSA, it recovers 17.0 and 10.0 percentage points more of the exhaustive top-k, respectively. AttentionIndex also improves accuracy on long-context benchmarks by up to 18.4 percentage points over HiSA at the same candidate budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 AttentionIndex，用倒排索引按相似度聚类 indexer keys 进行查询路由，并以原生 indexer 分数精炼候选，显著加速长上下文稀疏注意力选择并提升召回。
AI.motivation: 学习式稀疏注意力中的 indexer 虽只为每 query 选 k 个 key，但仍需对全前缀打分，百万 token 下选择占 prefill 时间过半；HiSA 的两阶段块选择虽降本，但固定候选预算下召回随上下文增长而下降。
AI.method: 构建基于倒排文件的索引，将 indexer keys 按相似度聚类分组；query 先路由到相关簇得到候选，再用原生 indexer 分数精炼。索引在 prefill 期间增量构建，新 key 立即可检索，复用已有聚类以降低维护成本，并保证每个 query 只看到由其自身前缀构建的簇。
AI.result: 在百万 token 下的 GLM-5.3 与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上，prefill 吞吐为穷举选择的 1.3–1.8 倍；吞吐与 HiSA 相差 5% 以内时，对穷举 top-k 的召回分别多恢复 17.0 与 10.0 个百分点；同等候选预算下长上下文基准精度较 HiSA 最高提升 18.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 倒排索引导航结合分数精炼可在保持接近 HiSA 效率的同时显著提升召回与长上下文精度，是长序列稀疏注意力选择的可扩展方案。

title: Physics-Informed One-Step Generation on Long-short flow maps
summary: Physics-informed generative models should produce samples that are both data-aligned and physically valid, yet existing methods are often iterative and too slow for practical use. Achieving this with a one-step flow-map model is difficult because both data-distribution and physics-constraint learning are enforced only indirectly through surrogate objectives, making their joint learning fragile for long-range flow maps. We propose \textbf{Physics-Informed Long-Short Flow Maps with Direct Guidance (LSFM-DG)}, which makes direct target computation feasible by decomposing one-step generation into a long flow map for global evolution and a near-terminal short flow map with computable closed-form solutions and physics potentials. As the short flow map shrinks to zero, it provides both direct distributional and physical targets for learning the long flow map. This yields a unified one-step flow-map model that removes Jensen's gap, improves training stability, and achieves stronger data fidelity and physical consistency without distillation.

AI.tldr: LSFM-DG 将一步生成分解为"长流映射（全局演化）+ 近终点短流映射（有闭式解与物理势）"，以短流映射极限提供直接的分布目标与物理目标，从而训练出无蒸馏、无 Jensen 间隙的一步物理信息流映射模型。
AI.motivation: 物理信息生成模型需同时满足数据对齐与物理有效，但现有方法多为迭代式、速度慢、难以实用；而用一步流映射实现时，数据分布与物理约束都只能通过代理目标间接学习，长程流映射的联合学习非常脆弱。
AI.method: 把一步生成拆成两段：长流映射负责全局演化，短流映射靠近终点且具备可计算的闭式解与物理势。让短流映射收缩至零，即可为长流映射直接给出分布目标与物理目标，构成统一的一步流映射训练框架（直接引导，Direct Guidance）。
AI.result: 消除了 Jensen 间隙，提升训练稳定性，并在无需蒸馏的情况下获得更强的数据保真度与物理一致性，同时保持一步生成的效率。
AI.conclusion: 直接目标是让一步物理信息流映射可行的关键；长-短流映射分解为直接计算目标提供了实用途径，兼顾速度、数据对齐与物理有效性。

title: Specificity Bias and the Wikipedia Paradox: An xAI Analysis of AI Text Detectors under Domain Shift
summary: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) demands reliable detection of human-authored versus synthetic text. However, current Transformer-based detectors often experience severe performance degradation during domain shifts and operate as opaque classifiers. This paper investigates the robustness and interpretability of fine-tuned Transformer models (DistilBERT, RoBERTa) by evaluating them against a custom out-of-distribution (OOD) dataset of hyper-local news synthesized via open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma). To analyze model decision boundaries, we apply a tripartite Explainable AI (xAI) framework using SHAP. Our analysis reveals three key phenomena: First, detectors often rely on a "Call-to-Action" syndrome inherent to instruction-tuned LLMs rather than generic machine text. Second, we observe a "Specificity Bias," where LLMs successfully bypass detection by hallucinating specific named entities and mimicking conversational imperfection. Finally, we illustrate the "Wikipedia Paradox," wherein formal, objective human writing is frequently misclassified as AI due to its low statistical burstiness. These findings demonstrate that purely statistical detection paradigms face systematic limitations in highly structured human domains, emphasizing the critical need for semantically-aware, interpretable detection architectures.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究微调Transformer检测器（DistilBERT、RoBERTa）在域外新闻文本上识别人写vs.LLM生成文本的鲁棒性与可解释性，通过SHAP三重xAI框架揭示"行动号召综合征""特异性偏见"和"维基百科悖论"三类现象，指出纯统计检测范式在高结构化人类文本领域的系统局限。
AI.motivation: LLM大规模应用使人类文本与合成文本的可靠检测变得重要，但现有Transformer检测器在域偏移下性能严重下降，且作为不透明分类器缺乏可解释性；作者希望同时评估其鲁棒性与可解释性，理解模型决策边界及失效原因。
AI.method: 构建由开源LLM（Llama 3、Mistral、Gemma）合成的超本地新闻域外（OOD）数据集；用该数据检验微调后的DistilBERT与RoBERTa；采用基于SHAP的三方xAI框架分析模型决策边界与依赖特征。
AI.result: 发现三种现象：(1) 检测器常依赖指令微调LLM固有的"行动号召"（Call-to-Action）模式而非通用机器文本特征；(2) "特异性偏见"——LLM通过虚构具体命名实体、模仿对话式不完美来规避检测；(3) "维基百科悖论"——形式化、客观的人类写作因统计突发性低而被误判为AI。
AI.conclusion: 纯统计检测范式在高结构化人类领域中存在系统性局限，亟需语义感知、可解释的检测架构。

title: ContactCut: A Partition-Aware Contact Selection Framework for False-Merge Correction in Connectomics
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to the IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI) 2027
summary: Localized false-merge correction in connectomics requires converting an identified error into an executable native 3D partition. Still, neither intermediate correction predictions nor seeded graph solvers alone determine which native source-sink constraints should define that partition. We formulate this problem as a 3D-native partition-aware contact selection problem: selecting candidate contacts based on the complete partitions they induce. Our solution comprises two components: ContactCut (CC)-Auto, which uses learned single-contact selection, and ContactCut (CC)-Search, which enables bounded paired-contact search, generates compact alternatives, and applies learned panel ranking. On historical two-way false-merge corrections from MICrONS and FlyWire, CC-Auto improves failure-aware 3D partition (FA-3D Part.) mIoU by 5.9 and 3.4 points over the strongest graph-based controls and by 12.5 and 10.0 points over the best learned baselines. A MICrONS-trained ranker transfers to FlyWire with negligible degradation. CC-Search expands oracle reachability and prioritizes near-oracle alternatives. The code is available at https://github.com/bentake/ContactCut.

AI.tldr: 论文将连接组学中局部误合并修正形式化为"3D原生分割感知的接触选择"问题，提出ContactCut框架（CC-Auto学习式单接触选择与CC-Search有界配对搜索+学到的候选排序），在MICrONS与FlyWire上显著提升失效感知3D分割mIoU。
AI.motivation: 局部误合并修正需把已识别错误转化为可执行的3D原生分割，但中间修正预测或种子图求解器本身都无法确定应使用哪些原生源-汇约束来定义该分割。
AI.method: 将问题表述为3D原生、分割感知的接触选择：依据候选接触所诱导的完整分割来选接触。CC-Auto采用学到的单接触选择；CC-Search进行有界配对接触搜索、生成紧凑备选并用学到的panel排序器排序。
AI.result: 在MICrONS与FlyWire历史双向误合并修正上，CC-Auto的FA-3D Part. mIoU较最强图方法基线分别高5.9与3.4个点，较最佳学习基线高12.5与10.0个点；MICrONS训练的排序器迁移至FlyWire几乎无退化；CC-Search扩大oracle可达范围并优先给出近oracle备选。
AI.conclusion: 以完整分割效果驱动接触选择优于仅用中间预测或图求解器；学到排序可跨数据集迁移，CC-Search进一步提升上限可达性。代码已开源。

title: A balloon effect: ban one channel and a hidden trait finds another
comment: 30 pages, 9 figures, 2 Extended Data figures, 8 Extended Data tables; Supplementary Information included. Code and data: https://github.com/kkt94/balloon-effect
summary: Language models trained on the outputs of other models can acquire traits that those outputs never mention, such as a preference for an animal carried by lists of numbers. Such subliminal learning can pass on unwanted traits. The intuitive defence is to find and forbid the tokens through which a trait shows, but how a trait's trace behaves under such bans, and what of it a student learns, has not been resolved. We closed a trait's outlets one by one in two stress tests, a preference chain and a name chain, across two models, six output formats and 16 traits. Bans did not remove the trait. Much as squeezing a balloon in one place makes it bulge in another, the trait moved to wherever the format still allowed, an effect we call the balloon effect. Decomposing this transfer, which bans on surface features cannot stop, down to single heads and neurons, we show that it can be cut at the circuit that writes the trait into the output. Patching that circuit while the teacher writes numbers stopped the chains, sharply reduced the overt name leak and halved the trait passed to a student, whereas the same number of random heads produced no detectable reduction. These results give a mechanistic account of how unwanted hidden traits are transferred and a route to preventing it.

title: A Hybrid Anomaly Detection Method for Electric Vehicle Identification from Smart Meter Recordings
summary: In recent years, electric vehicles (EVs) have attracted much attention due to their potential to decarbonize the transport system. EV charging imposes challenges on power grids, such as load imbalance and voltage instability. Therefore, electricity distributors need to identify which users have an EV. Smart meter recordings can be effectively used for this purpose. The major issue associated with such data is the imbalance problem, where the majority of the data belongs to users without EVs. The existing methods for EV identification from smart meter recordings have framed it as a classification task. In this paper, we frame the problem as an unsupervised problem and propose a hybrid anomaly detection method that combines the power of prediction-based and reconstruction-based anomaly detection methods. The proposed model considers temporal and stochastic representation information of smart meter time series via prediction-based and reconstruction-based components, respectively. The performance of the proposed model is compared with state-of-the-art supervised and unsupervised methods. Its superiority is verified on real-world data.

AI.tldr: 论文将智能电表数据中的电动汽车识别问题重构为无监督异常检测任务，提出融合预测型与重建型异常检测的混合方法，在真实数据上优于现有监督与无监督方法。
AI.motivation: 电动汽车充电给电网带来负荷不平衡和电压不稳定等挑战，配电公司需要识别哪些用户拥有电动汽车。智能电表记录可用于此目的，但数据存在严重的不平衡问题——大多数用户没有电动汽车。现有方法将其视为分类任务，难以应对这一问题。
AI.method: 将EV识别问题框架化为无监督问题，提出一种混合异常检测方法，结合预测型（prediction-based）与重建型（reconstruction-based）异常检测的能力。模型通过预测分量和重建分量分别捕获智能电表时间序列的时间信息和随机表示信息。
AI.result: 将所提模型与最先进的监督和无监督方法进行比较，在真实世界数据上验证了其优越性。
AI.conclusion: 无监督混合异常检测框架能有效缓解数据不平衡问题，并为基于智能电表数据的电动汽车识别提供了优于现有方法的解决方案。

title: MultiInpaintCOCO: Fine-Grained Visual Understanding in Multiple Languages
summary: Previous research shows that vision-language (VL) models struggle to understand fine-grained image details and tend to focus on the overall layout. Moreover, any weakness in English tends to be further amplified in the multilingual setting. To study that, we extend InpaintCOCO, an English dataset focused on fine-grained visual details, to 13 typologically diverse languages across five language families, creating MultiInpaintCOCO - a new multilingual benchmark of 953 minimal-pair examples. We further test several state-of-the-art models in multilingual multimodal retrieval, considering both light VL CLIP-like encoders and large language models. Our results show that performance degrades substantially for lower-resource languages, with the strongest predictor being the data resources available for the languages rather than typological similarity to English. In cross-lingual retrieval, most models exhibit a systematic bias toward English: when given a correct caption in a non-English language and an incorrect one in English, models preferentially select the English caption. This bias varies considerably across architectures. Among the tested models, Gemma 3 shows the strongest English preference while Qwen 3 is the least biased, despite both reaching similar monolingual accuracy across languages. The code is available at https://github.com/ufal/multi-inpaint-coco.

AI.tldr: 将InpaintCOCO扩展为13种语言的多语言基准MultiInpaintCOCO（953个最小对），发现VL模型在低资源语言上性能大幅下降（主因是数据资源而非类型学相似性），且跨语言检索中存在系统性英语偏好，Gemma 3最偏、Qwen 3最轻。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明视觉语言模型难以理解细粒度图像细节、偏向整体布局，且英语能力不足在多语言场景下会被放大。为此需一个多语言细粒度视觉基准来系统考察该问题。
AI.method: 把聚焦细粒度视觉细节的英语数据集InpaintCOCO扩展到涵盖5个语系、13种类型学差异明显的语言，构建953个最小对样本的MultiInpaintCOCO；并在多语言多模态检索任务上评测多种SOTA模型（轻量CLIP类编码器与大语言模型）。
AI.result: 低资源语言性能显著下降，预测性能的最强因素是语言可获得的数据资源而非与英语的类型学相似度；跨语言检索中多数模型存在系统性英语偏好（正确非英语描述对错误英语描述时优先选英语），该偏好在不同架构间差异显著：Gemma 3英语偏好最强，Qwen 3最弱，尽管两者单语准确率相近。
AI.conclusion: 多语言VL模型在细粒度视觉理解上受数据资源制约严重，并存在架构相关的英语偏置；构建的多语言基准与代码（github.com/ufal/multi-inpaint-coco）为后续研究提供支撑。

title: Resolve, Clear, or Defer: Training-Free Active Prototype Triage for Ecological Detection Pipelines
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027), Main Conference. 27 pages including supplementary material
summary: Ecological monitoring increasingly relies on camera traps and aerial surveys that generate large image collections. High-recall animal detectors can localize candidate animals at scale. However, they also produce many detections that still require expert review, including false positives, ambiguous cases, and animals difficult to identify at the species level. Since exhaustive review requires substantial effort, we propose training-free active prototype triage, where reviewed detections become reusable evidence to (1) Resolve supported foreground classes, (2) Clear likely background false positives, or (3) Defer insufficiently supported cases for expert review. Across camera-trap and aerial datasets, foreground recognition and false-positive rejection benefit from different pretrained representations: BioCLIP2 provides foreground evidence while DINOv3 provides background evidence, reducing erroneous foreground clearing while improving automatic foreground recovery. Deferring unsupported cases avoids the higher error rates caused by forced decisions. Compared with confidence-thresholded multiclass k-NN and uncertainty-sampling logistic regression, prototype triage improves foreground recovery while maintaining competitive or lower review burden. Acquisition goes beyond class discovery: even after classes are represented, prototype choice determines how reliably evidence propagates through the remaining detections. Our results suggest that once animal localization reaches high recall, the challenge shifts from finding animals to deciding which examples to review, how to reuse them, and when evidence does not support an automatic decision.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的主动原型分诊（active prototype triage），把人工已审检测当作可复用证据，对高召回动物检测结果进行自动支持、清除或延后审阅。
AI.motivation: 生态监测依赖相机陷阱与航空巡测，产生大量图像；高召回检测器虽能定位候选动物，但仍包含误检、模糊案例及难辨物种的情况，需专家逐一复核，成本过高。
AI.method: 免训练主动原型分诊：以已审检测为原型证据，将新检测分为三类——支持的前景类别、可能的背景误检、证据不足需专家复核。结合BioCLIP2提供前景证据、DINOv3提供背景证据，并与置信度阈值多类k-NN、不确定性采样逻辑回归对比。
AI.result: 前景识别与误检剔除受益于不同预训练表征（BioCLIP2前景、DINOv3背景），减少错误清除并提升自动前景回收；延后不支持案例可避免强制决策带来的更高错误率；相较基线在提升前景回收的同时保持相当或更低的复核负担；原型选择方式影响证据在剩余检测中的传播可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 当动物定位达到高召回后，核心挑战从"找到动物"转向"决定审阅哪些样本、如何复用、以及证据何时不足以支撑自动决策"。

title: When Prediction Shapes the Future: A BlueSky Agenda for Reflexive Time Series Analysis
comment: Accepted to the ICDM 2026 BlueSky Track
summary: Time-series models are increasingly deployed in operational systems (e.g., inventory management and clinical care) where predictions trigger interventions that alter future observations, producing records we term AI-shaped trajectories. This sequence-prediction coupling deepens as such systems evolve into agents that autonomously predict, act, and remember across long horizons. Such AI-shaped trajectories support immediate performance monitoring, but turn ambiguous once reused as passive data. An algorithm may then misread a prediction-prevented stockout as naturally stable demand, or an averted medical crisis as a false alarm. This ambiguity then propagates into everything built on the record, from retraining and agent memory to downstream predictive tasks. As a result, systems may internalize these intervention effects as natural phenomena, drifting further from the truth at every closed-loop cycle. In this Blue Sky paper, we advocate an agenda for reflexive time-series analysis that shifts the analytical object from the intervention-agnostic sequence to the prediction-action-observation loop. The agenda requires closed-loop provenance to track the operational context (e.g., predictions, policies, and actions), sequence identification to estimate how those actions affect future values under explicit causal assumptions, and closed-loop evaluation to separate intrinsic process prediction from policy-driven effects. This foundation is essential for integrating autonomous agents into such loops at scale, enabling the joint learning of intervention effects and intrinsic dynamics for robust temporal representations.

AI.tldr: 时序预测会触发干预、改变未来观测，形成"AI塑造轨迹"，若被当作被动数据重用会产生歧义并逐循环累积偏差；论文提出"反思性时序分析"议程，将分析对象从序列转向"预测-行动-观测"闭环。
AI.motivation: 时序模型已部署于库存管理、临床护理等运维系统，预测会触发干预从而改变后续观测；系统向自主智能体演进后，此类"AI塑造轨迹"更长更多。这类记录用于即时监控尚可，但被当作被动数据重用时会产生歧义（如预测避免了缺货被误读为需求自然稳定、避免的病情危机被误判为误报），且歧义会传播到再训练、智能体记忆和下游任务，使系统把干预效应内化为自然现象，每轮闭环不断远离真值。
AI.method: 蓝海/立场论文，提出研究议程"反思性时序分析"（reflexive time-series analysis），包含三项支柱：1）闭环溯源（closed-loop provenance），追踪预测、策略、行动等运行上下文；2）序列识别（sequence identification），在明确因果假设下估计行动如何影响未来取值；3）闭环评估（closed-loop evaluation），分离过程的内禀预测与策略驱动效应。
AI.result: 论文为立场/议程性工作，未报告实验或定量结果；其论证为：现有干预无关（intervention-agnostic）的序列建模存在系统性偏差风险，而三项支柱可为此提供基础。
AI.conclusion: 反思性时序分析是将自主智能体规模化接入闭环的关键基础，可实现干预效应与内禀动力学的联合学习，获得更稳健的时序表征，减少闭环中的真值漂移。

title: A Hybrid Anomaly Detection Method for Multivariate Time Series
summary: Multivariate time series are ubiquitous in monitoring smart systems such as power plants, smart houses, and servers. These systems use multiple sensors to collect the system's status over time. Those sensors represent the status of the whole system as one entity. Anomaly detection in such smart systems is of critical importance to prevent system failure and maintain functionality. But anomaly detection in such multivariate time series data is very challenging since this type of data includes both temporal and spatial information. Capturing both of these pieces of information is important to detect anomalies. In this paper, we propose a hybrid deep learning-based anomaly detection method, which captures both temporal and spatial information. We propose to take advantage of the feature extraction capabilities of 2d convolutional network in a variational autoencoder, alongside a prediction-based deep neural network of 2d convolutional networks and a gated recurrent unit network to capture both spatial and temporal information. Experiments on public data against state-of-the-art show the potential of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合深度学习的多变量时间序列异常检测方法，结合2D卷积变分自编码器与2D卷积+GRU的预测网络，同时捕获时空信息。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列广泛用于电厂、智能家居、服务器等智能系统的多传感器监测，异常检测对防止系统故障至关重要。但这类数据同时含时间与空间信息，如何同时有效捕获两者是难点。
AI.method: 采用混合深度学习方法：一方面在变分自编码器（VAE）中利用2D卷积网络的特征提取能力；另一方面构建由2D卷积网络与GRU组成的预测式深度神经网络，共同捕获空间与时间信息。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上与当前最优方法对比实验，结果表明所提方法具有潜力。
AI.conclusion: 融合2D卷积VAE与CNN-GRU预测网络的混合模型能有效刻画多变量时间序列的时空特征，为智能系统异常检测提供了可行方案。

title: Steering with Multilingual Lexicons for Sentiment Control in Low-Resource Languages
summary: Activation steering offers a lightweight mechanism for controlling model behavior, but existing methods depend on sentence-level contrastive data that is unavailable for most of the world's languages. We show that multilingual sentiment lexicons are a viable substitute across three model families: aggregated multilingual lexicons outperform English-derived steering vectors for mid- and low-resource languages, while monolingual lexicons remain stronger for languages a model has specialized in during pre-training. The steering efficacy is mechanistically dictated by both representational density and pre-training priors. Large-magnitude English vectors overwhelm the compact representations of low-resource languages, causing "linguistic collapse." This fragility is mitigated by the norm-dampening of multilingual aggregation. Architectural biases, including bilingual specialization penalty and latent numerical rigidity, also heavily constrain cross-lingual steering responsiveness. Ultimately, our work establishes lexicons as a practical steering signal and offers a comprehensive mechanistic account of cross-lingual steering dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用多语言情感词典替代句级对比数据来构建激活引导向量，并在三个模型族上验证其跨语言有效性：聚合多语言词典对中低资源语言优于英语派生向量，但模型预训练专精语言的单语词典仍更强；引导效果由表征密度和预训练先验共同决定，英语大范数向量会导致"语言坍缩"，而多语言聚合的范数衰减可缓解此问题。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法依赖句级对比数据，而全球大多数语言缺乏此类数据，导致引导技术难以扩展到多语言场景。
AI.method: 以多语言情感词典作为引导信号来源，构建并聚合词典派生向量，在三个模型族上与英语派生向量及单语词典向量进行对比实验，并从表征密度与预训练先验角度进行机制分析。
AI.result: 聚合多语言词典在中低资源语言上优于英语派生向量；单语词典在模型预训练专精语言上更优；英语大范数向量会淹没低资源语言的紧凑表征造成"语言坍缩"，多语言聚合的范数衰减可缓解；双语专精惩罚与潜在数值刚性等架构偏差限制跨语言引导响应。
AI.conclusion: 词典可作为实用的引导信号，为跨语言激活引导动态提供了全面的机制性解释，同时揭示了架构偏差对跨语言可控性的约束。

title: See, Think, Use: Diagnosing Perception and Reasoning Failures in VLMs
summary: We present See, Think, Use, a protocol that traces each answer of a vision-language model to perception, reasoning or the use of perception. The diagnosis shows a developer which stage to improve and directs test-time compute to the stage that fails. Benchmarks score the final answer, and an answer that rests on the image earns the same credit as a guess or a memorized prior. The protocol asks the model two extra questions per item and needs no access to its weights. A localization probe asks for a box around every instance and measures seeing, and a text-replacement probe answers from a description and measures thinking. Use is the rate at which the answer follows the model's own perception across counterfactual image pairs. The rate needs no answer labels, because the question and its prior are the same on both images. On two model families and six datasets the protocol shows that the knob that helps follows the task family. Answers follow the model's perception except on images that contradict a common prior, and asking the model to localize first repairs this failure when its boxes are right. Allocating compute by the measured stages comes close to the best uniform policy at lower cost and beats a random allocation of the same compute wherever a knob raises the short stage. We will release the code, the prompts and the per-question outputs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"See, Think, Use"（看-思-用）协议，将视觉语言模型的每个答案归因到感知、推理或对感知的利用三个阶段，从而诊断短板并指导测试时计算分配。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只评分最终答案，导致基于图像的正确答案与猜测或记忆先验得到同等分数，开发者无法知道模型究竟在哪个阶段失败，也难以针对性改进。
AI.method: 测试时无需权重访问，每题额外问两个问题：定位探针要求框出每个实例以度量"看"；文本替换探针让模型根据描述作答以度量"思"；"用"则通过反事实图像对测量答案跟随模型自身感知的比率，因问题与先验在两图相同故无需答案标签。
AI.result: 在两个模型家族、六个数据集上验证：有效的调节手段随任务类型而变；模型答案通常跟随感知，但当图像违背常见先验时会失败，先做定位可修复此失败（框正确时）；按测得阶段分配计算接近最优统一策略且成本更低，并在调节手段提升短板时优于同等算力的随机分配。
AI.conclusion: 该协议提供可解释的阶段级诊断并指导计算分配，作者将开源代码、提示词及逐题输出。

title: Cumulative and Audited Guardrail Tool Evolution for LLM Agent Safety
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in open-world environments where safety risks cannot be fully predefined. However, most existing guardrail mechanisms remain static, relying on fixed rules, prompts, or classifiers that generalize poorly to emerging risks. Here we present EVOLVE, a tool-level self-evolving defense framework that formulates agent security as a process of cumulative security evolution. Inspired by how human societies transform experiences into transferable protective knowledge, EVOLVE externalizes security knowledge into executable guardrail tools that are continuously inherited, independently audited, and iteratively refined through lifelong interaction. Across multiple benchmarks, backbone models, and embodied environments, EVOLVE consistently outperforms existing defenses across diverse risk scenarios with +22\% average F1 score. We further validate the framework in real-world robotic and autonomous agent systems. Our results suggest that scalable agent safety may require continuously evolving defense systems rather than static guardrails.

AI.tldr: 提出EVOLVE，一个工具级自演化防御框架，将智能体安全建模为累积演化的过程，通过可执行护栏工具的持续继承、独立审计与迭代精炼来应对开放世界的新型风险。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在开放世界中运行，安全风险无法完全预定义；现有护栏机制多为静态（固定规则、提示或分类器），对新出现的风险泛化能力差。
AI.method: 借鉴人类社会将经验转化为可迁移保护知识的思路，将安全知识外化为可执行的护栏工具，使其在终身交互中被持续继承、独立审计并迭代精炼，形成累积式的安全演化机制。
AI.result: 在多个基准、多种骨干模型和具身环境中，EVOLVE在多样风险场景下均优于现有防御方法，平均F1提升22%；并在真实机器人及自主智能体系统中得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的智能体安全可能需要持续演化的防御系统，而非静态护栏。

title: Stand-In Effects and Pooling Amplification: Design-Based Tests of Whether Biological World Models Use Actions
comment: 54 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. Preregistrations: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/ZXAR3 (M4) and https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/QEZBX (M5). Primary category cs.LG: a test for learned action-conditioned models; cross-listed for the statistical method (stat.ME) and the biological application (q-bio.QM)
summary: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly trained on data from randomized experiments, and whether their predictions respond to actions is usually checked by replacing or removing the actions and measuring the loss in accuracy. We show that such diagnostics report action effects where there are none: under autocorrelated designs, future actions stand in for history the model does not see, and a better model learns the stand-in better. When the design law is known, a conditional randomization test written as an e-value is valid in finite samples whatever the model, provided the resampler conditions on the full state the design used; resampling from a simpler law reproduces the false effect. We identify a second failure, specific to world models: when many sites share one action sequence (cells in a microscope field, pixels in a frame), the natural pooled score turns small model errors along the action contrast into overwhelming evidence against a true effect. In a pixel world, its median log e-value fell from $-17.3$ to $-6832$ as frames grew from 64 to 4096 pixels, while the oracle's rose. Tempering the score by a design effect estimated on training data changes the bet, not the validity. Our own preregistered analysis of optogenetic ERK experiments failed in exactly this way; a tempered statistic, selected on synthetic data and registered before the data were obtained, then rejected the null on a never-opened field ($E\approx 1.1\times10^{10}$). Every analysis is preregistered, fixed in a dated protocol before it was run, or labelled exploratory, and every reported result is generated from hashed result files.

AI.tldr: 动作条件世界模型的"移除/替换动作后看误差"诊断会在无因果效应时报告效应；论文给出有效的条件随机化e-value检验，并揭示共享动作序列下合并分数把微小模型误差放大为压倒性证据的第二类失效。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件世界模型是否真的响应动作，通常靠替换或删除动作并测量精度损失来判断。作者指出这种诊断在自相关设计下会产生虚假的动作效应：未来动作充当了模型看不到的历史的替代品，模型越好越能学到这一替代关系。此外世界模型中多个位点共享同一动作序列时，合并分数会放大模型误差。
AI.method: 在设计规律已知时，把条件随机化检验写成e-value，只要重采样器以设计所使用的完整状态为条件，该检验有限样本有效且不依赖模型；从更简单的分布重采样则重现虚假效应。针对各位点共享动作的情形，分析合并分数的放大失效；用训练数据估计设计效应做tempering只改变赌注而不修复有效性。作者用预注册的光遗传ERK实验做自己的分析。
AI.result: 按照常规诊断，作者自己的预注册光遗传ERK分析出现了完全相同的失效；在合成数据上选定并在取数据前注册的tempered统计量，随后在一个从未打开过的视野上拒绝了零假设（E≈1.1×10^10）。在像素世界模型中，随着帧从64像素增至4096像素，合并分数的中位对数e-value从−17.3降到−6832，而oracle的却上升。
AI.conclusion: 常用的动作消融/替换诊断不能证明动作效应；需用基于正确条件重采样的e-value条件随机化检验。共享动作序列导致的分数放大是独立且严重的失效，tempering无法解决。所有分析均预注册、以带日期的协议固定或标为探索性，结果由哈希结果文件生成，强调可复现与透明度。

title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
summary: Research taste, the judgment of what to read, which problems to pursue, and which methods to try, increasingly shapes the work of AI scientists, yet it remains far less understood than their ability to execute research. We introduce IdeaTaste, a benchmark that scores an LLM by how closely the research proposals it writes from a literature snapshot frozen at 2025 match the work the same communities published in 2026. Our experiments span six contemporary language models and four research areas from established to emerging fields, covering more than 90{,}000 proposals in total. LLM agents fall well short of human communities in both the literature they cite and the ideas they state, reaching about 26\% of the human level on citation matching and only 18\% on idea matching. Their populations can cite as diversely as a community and take up its tasks and methods, yet rarely arrive at the concrete approaches and research plans it pursues. Neither richer field context nor larger populations substantially close this gap. In blinded expert review, AI proposals trail the 2026 papers least in presentation and most in expected success, echoing their gap in concrete approaches, and those whose ideas no human paper shares fare worst, suggesting weaker directions rather than overlooked opportunities. These results indicate that the main bottleneck in AI research taste lies less in finding the directions a community works on than in turning them into the concrete approaches it goes on to pursue. We release IdeaTaste as an open, continuously updated leaderboard (https://cxcscmu.github.io/IdeaTaste) that benchmarks contemporary AI proposals against future publication cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IdeaTaste 基准，用"冻结在2025年的文献快照"让 LLM 生成研究提案，再与同一社区2026年真实发表的工作比对，衡量 AI 的"研究品味"（选题与判断力），而非执行能力。实验覆盖6个语言模型、4个研究领域、9万余份提案，发现 AI 在引用匹配上仅达人类约26%、在想法匹配上仅18%。
AI.motivation: 研究品味（决定读什么、追什么问题、试什么方法）对 AI 科学家的工作日益关键，但其理解程度远落后于对"研究执行能力"的评估；现有基准缺乏对"前瞻性选题质量"的可量化度量。
AI.method: 构建 IdeaTaste 基准：将文献快照冻结于2025年，让 LLM 据此撰写研究提案，再与各社区2026年实际发表的论文进行比对打分（引用匹配、想法匹配）。实验涵盖6个当代语言模型、4个研究领域（从成熟到新兴），共超90,000份提案；另辅以盲审专家评审，评估展示、预期成功率等维度。
AI.result: LLM 智能体在引用匹配上约为人类水平的26%，想法匹配仅18%。其生成群体的引用多样性、任务与方法覆盖面可与真实社区相当，但很少落到社区实际采用的具体方案与研究计划上。更丰富的领域上下文或更大规模群体均未显著缩小差距。盲审中 AI 提案在"展示表达"上差距最小、"预期成功"上差距最大；无人类论文共享的想法表现最差，说明是方向偏弱而非机会被忽视。
AI.conclusion: AI 研究品味的主要瓶颈不在于找不到社区所关注的方向，而在于把方向转化为社区后续真正采用的具体方法。作者将 IdeaTaste 作为开放、持续更新的排行榜发布，以滚动发表周期评估当代 AI 提案。

title: Label-Free Localization and Test-Time Suppression of CLIP's Typographic Circuits
summary: CLIP-based Vision-Language Models have become cornerstones of modern multimodal systems. The cross-modal contrastive objective equips the CLIP vision encoder to both see objects and read text. These two abilities induce an entanglement between the encoding of lexical and semantic shapes, creating a distinctive vulnerability to typographic attacks, in which rendered text overrides an image's semantic content with its literal meaning. The black-box nature of these encoders has prevented a mechanistic interpretation of such entanglement. We introduce a head-decomposed Sparse Dictionary Learning (SDL) architecture that, by design, decomposes individual attention heads into interpretable, head-specific latents. Based on this inductive disentanglement, we re-purpose Clarity Score and propose normalized Text Attribution Score, which are both label-free, to identify attention heads that carry typographic information. As a causal validation of successful circuit separation, we perform a mechanistic intervention that reweighs attention away from the patch tokens in the identified lexical heads at test-time. Experiments show that the intervention effectively recovers object classification under typographic attack and, across five CLIP variants and four typographic benchmarks, achieves up to 46.9% improvement while incurring up to 1% accuracy loss in general image perception, outperforming prior supervised and training-free methods. Expanding on the mechanistic intervention, we propose a test-time adaptive attention head routing to further reduce the impact on performance at matched robustness, pushing beyond the Pareto frontier of current robustness-perception tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出按注意力头分解的稀疏字典学习（SDL）架构，将CLIP注意力头拆解为可解释的头部专属隐变量，以无标签指标定位承载排版信息的"词汇头"，并通过测试时重加权注意力实现因果验证的机制干预，有效恢复排版攻击下的物体分类。
AI.motivation: CLIP跨模态对比目标使视觉编码器同时具备"看物体"和"读文本"两种能力，导致词形与语义编码纠缠，产生对排版攻击（typographic attack）的脆弱性；而编码器的黑箱特性阻碍了对这种纠缠的机制性理解，现有方法缺乏可解释的电路分离手段。
AI.method: 1）设计head-decomposed Sparse Dictionary Learning（SDL）架构，将单个注意力头分解为可解释的头部专属latents，实现归纳式解缠；2）复用Clarity Score并提出归一化Text Attribution Score，均为无标签指标，用于识别携带排版信息的注意力头；3）通过因果验证，在测试时降低已识别"词汇头"对patch token的注意力权重；4）进一步提出测试时自适应注意力头路由（adaptive head routing）。
AI.result: 机制干预可有效恢复排版攻击下的物体分类，在5个CLIP变体和4个排版基准上实现最高46.9%的提升，同时通用图像感知仅损失至多1%的准确率，优于先前有监督与免训练方法；自适应头路由在相同鲁棒性下进一步降低性能影响，突破现有鲁棒性-感知权衡的Pareto前沿。
AI.conclusion: CLIP的"读文本"能力可被定位到特定注意力头的可解释子电路；对其进行机制性干预与自适应路由，能在几乎不损通用感知的前提下显著提升排版攻击鲁棒性，为黑箱视觉编码器的可解释性与鲁棒性改进提供了新路径。

title: FORGE: Fault-Oriented Rework Code Generation for Executable Interlocking Assembly
summary: Large language models have demonstrated strong capabilities in structured reasoning and code generation, yet identifying an assembly fault does not guarantee the ability to generate executable rework programs. In interlocking assemblies, a locally plausible repair program may violate blocking dependencies, omit required recovery operations, or terminate in an incorrect configuration. We identify this challenge as fault-conditioned executable rework generation, where models must jointly reason about structural failures and generate programs that restore constrained assembly states. To benchmark this capability, we introduce FORGE-Bench, containing 4,000 tasks across 26 interlocking assemblies with five assemblies held out for evaluating generalization to unseen structures. We further propose FORGE (Fault-Oriented Rework Code Generation for Executable Interlocking Assembly), a structured state-to-program framework that decomposes rework generation into Rework Structuring and Action Grounding. Rework Structuring captures fault-induced recovery dependencies, while Action Grounding maps these dependencies into state-conditioned executable actions. Experiments show that locally reasonable repair code is insufficient for reliable assembly recovery, and that connecting structural recovery reasoning with executable action realization is essential for verified target restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"故障条件下的可执行返工生成"任务，并构建FORGE-Bench基准（4000任务、26种互锁装配、5种留出用于泛化评估），同时提出FORGE框架，将返工生成分解为返工结构化与动作接地两步，实现经验证的目标状态恢复。
AI.motivation: 大模型虽具备结构化推理与代码生成能力，但识别装配故障并不等于能生成可执行的返工程序。在互锁装配中，局部看似合理的修复程序可能违反阻塞依赖、遗漏必要的恢复操作或终止于错误构型。因此需要专门评测并建模"故障条件下的可执行返工生成"能力。
AI.method: 构建FORGE-Bench基准，包含26种互锁装配、4000个任务，其中5种装配留出以评估对未见结构的泛化。提出FORGE框架，将返工生成分解为两个阶段：Rework Structuring负责捕获故障引发的恢复依赖关系；Action Grounding负责将这些依赖映射为状态条件下的可执行动作。
AI.result: 实验表明，局部合理的修复代码不足以实现可靠的装配恢复；将结构恢复推理与可执行动作实现相连接，对于经验证的目标状态恢复至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠局部合理的修复代码无法保证互锁装配的可靠恢复，必须把结构化恢复推理与可执行动作落地结合起来。FORGE框架验证了该分解思路的有效性，并提供了面向未见结构的泛化评估平台。

title: Wave Physics as Representation: Tensor-Structured Neural Reconstruction for Ocean Acoustic Fields
summary: Reconstructing three-dimensional (3D) complex ocean acoustic fields from sparse measurements is challenging due to highly oscillatory wave structures and restricted sensing patterns/routes. Learning-based approaches fall into two categories. First, purely data-driven models can learn complex field patterns, but do not explicitly exploit wave physics that may enhance interpretability and reduce training costs. Second, physics-informed methods impose a specified physical equation as a reconstruction constraint, but often require environment-dependent parameters that are difficult to acquire. As a result, practical 3D acoustic field reconstruction that is both physically grounded and robust to uncertain environmental information remains largely unexplored. This work takes an alternative route: instead of solving a fully specified wave equation, it extracts a structured representation from wave physics and learns its components from data. From the Helmholtz equation and normal mode propagation, we derive a structured spatial-angular tensor representation, termed the S/c representation. Under a low-rank specialization, it takes the form of a rank-(L,L,1) block-term tensor decomposition, which connects structured sampling patterns/routes used in ocean sensing to sufficient conditions for field recovery. Building on this tensor representation, we propose TIDAL, a neural reconstructor that uses the S/c representation as an inductive bias for structured decoding and aligns information aggregation with the sampling geometry. The neural learner removes the need for known model parameters required by conventional physics-based recovery methods. Experiments across three structured sampling geometries show that TIDAL achieves the best reconstruction performance and fastest inference among baselines, with benefits from the physics-derived representation under limited data and model capacity.

AI.tldr: 提出基于波物理结构化表示（S/c表示）的神经重建器TIDAL，实现稀疏采样下三维海洋声场的高效重建。
AI.motivation: 稀疏测量下重建三维复杂海洋声场困难：纯数据驱动模型缺乏物理可解释性、训练成本高；物理信息方法依赖难以获取的环境相关参数。因此需要兼顾物理基础与环境不确定鲁棒性的重建方法。
AI.method: 从Helmholtz方程与简正波传播出发，推导结构化空间-角度张量表示（S/c表示），在低秩特化下化为rank-(L,L,1)块项张量分解，将结构化采样模式与场恢复的充分条件联系起来；据此提出神经重建器TIDAL，以S/c表示为归纳偏置进行结构化解码，并使信息聚合与采样几何对齐。
AI.result: 在三种结构化采样几何下，TIDAL在重建性能与推理速度上均优于基线；在数据与模型容量受限时，物理导出的表示带来显著收益。
AI.conclusion: 无需已知模型参数即可实现物理上有依据的3D声场重建，验证了将波物理结构作为归纳偏置的有效性。

title: VIAS: Value-Isolating Activation Steering for Multi-Value Alignment and Compliance for Organisations
summary: Organisations increasingly deploy large language model agents that must follow organisational values. We check whether activation steering, which adds vectors to a model's internal activations during generation without changing its weights, can improve compliance beyond prompting alone. Since most scenarios involve several values at once, we focus on multi-value steering. A simple way to build these vectors is to contrast responses that follow all values relevant to a scenario with responses that violate them. However, this gives nearly identical vectors for different values: they capture a general compliance signal rather than individual values, which limits their use when combining several values. We propose Value-Isolating Activation Steering (VIAS), which contrasts responses to the same scenario under two prompts, one listing all relevant values and one omitting a single target value. We keep a pair only if the target value changes from compliant to non-compliant and both responses still meet a minimum compliance level on the other values. We evaluate VIAS on PROTECT, a workplace compliance dataset where each scenario is tagged with relevant values from a 21-value taxonomy. VIAS reduces overlap between value vectors, making them better suited for multi-value steering, although this alone does not lead to independent control over each value. Combined with prompting, VIAS complies with every tagged value on 69.6% of scenarios for Qwen2.5-7B, 75.2% for Mistral-7B, and 72.6% for Phi-3.5-mini, outperforming prompting alone for all three models.

AI.tldr: 提出VIAS激活引导方法，通过对比"包含全部价值观"与"省略单一目标价值观"两种提示下的回答来构建隔离性更好的价值观向量，结合提示在多价值观合规任务上优于单用提示。
AI.motivation: 组织部署LLM智能体需遵循组织价值观，仅靠提示不够；激活引导（不改权重、加激活向量）可增强合规。但多价值观场景下，常用对比法生成的向量几乎相同，只捕捉通用合规信号而非具体价值观，难以组合使用。
AI.method: VIAS（Value-Isolating Activation Steering）：同一场景下用两种提示对比——一种列出所有相关价值观，一种省略单一目标价值观；仅当目标价值观从合规变为不合规、且两回复在其他价值观上仍达最低合规水平时保留该样本对，以此构建价值观隔离的引导向量。在PROTECT工作场合规数据集（21价值观分类体系）上评估。
AI.result: VIAS降低了价值观向量间的重叠，更适合多价值观引导，但仅此不能实现每个价值观的独立控制。与提示结合后，所有标签价值观全部合规的场景比例为：Qwen2.5-7B 69.6%、Mistral-7B 75.2%、Phi-3.5-mini 72.6%，三个模型均超过单用提示。
AI.conclusion: 通过价值观隔离的对比构建引导向量能有效提升多价值观场景的合规性，与提示互补；但向量间仍存在纠缠，尚未实现各价值观的独立控制，是未来改进方向。

title: VLMs Read Aloud: The Gap Between Recognizing and Using Visual Text
summary: Visual-text compression renders long contexts as images and is engineered around how much of the text a vision-language model (VLM) can recover. Yet recovered text is not usable text. VLMs can transcribe the text in an image word for word and still fail to answer from it; given back their own transcript, they answer nearly as well as from the original text. We call this difference the read-use gap. Recognizing and using visual text have different resolution requirements: Qwen3-VL-8B's recognition saturates at 15-pixel characters while use catches up only at 24 pixels, and scaling from 2B to 32B raises recognition without narrowing the gap. Putting the evidence into words closes it: thinking VLMs recite the evidence in their thinking, and their own transcript, written without seeing the question, recovers most of what thinking adds. In a preregistered held-out test, the gap ranks how much eight VLMs gain from their own words over pixels (Spearman $ρ$ = 0.86), which recognition rates do not. We propose ALOUD, which spends visual resolution on finding and recognizing evidence and language tokens on using it. Without keeping the source text, it doubles the accuracy of a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B on long documents compressed 5x and 10x: at 5x, from 27.7% to 54.8%, near the original text's 58.5%, with a context smaller than the compressed pages themselves. For less than the cost of reading the original text, it leads at equal budget every method that does without it, at every level, and beats AGAR and VERA, which paste the original text back; at 5x it also beats LensVLM-9B, which is trained and keeps the original text. Visual-text compression is limited not by how much text a model can recover, but by how much it can use.

AI.tldr: 视觉-文本压缩（把长上下文渲染成图片）的瓶颈不是VLM能"识别"多少文字，而是能"使用"多少文字，作者称之为read-use gap，并提出ALOUD方法用视觉分辨率找证据、用语言token做推理。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-文本压缩研究只以"模型能从图中恢复多少文本"为工程目标，但作者发现：VLM可以逐字转录图片中的文字却仍无法据此作答；把模型自己的转录稿还给它，答题水平几乎与原文相当。这一"读-用差距"说明恢复文本≠可用文本，压缩的优化目标需要重新定义。
AI.method: 1) 实验刻画read-use gap：测量识别饱和度（15px字符）与使用饱和度（24px字符）的分辨率需求差异，并比较2B到32B规模效应。2) 机制分析：thinking型VLM在思维链中复述证据，其"未见问题"下写出的转录稿能恢复大部分思考带来的增益，说明"把证据转成词"可闭合差距。3) 预注册held-out测试中验证gap对8个VLM"自有文字相对像素的增益"的预测力（Spearman ρ=0.86），而识别率无此预测力。4) 提出ALOUD：将视觉分辨率用于定位和识别证据，将语言token用于使用证据，且不保留源文本。
AI.result: 冻结的Qwen3-VL-8B在5倍、10倍压缩长文档上准确率翻倍：5倍下从27.7%升至54.8%，接近原文的58.5%，且上下文比压缩页面本身更小。在低于阅读原文成本的情况下，等预算下在所有层级领先所有不使用原文的方法，并超过需回贴原文的AGAR与VERA；5倍下还超过经训练且保留原文的LensVLM-9B。
AI.conclusion: 视觉-文本压缩的极限不取决于模型能恢复多少文本，而取决于它能使用多少文本；识别与使用具有不同分辨率需求，且规模扩大只提升识别、不缩小差距，而将证据转为语言可有效闭合差距，ALOUD据此取得显著效果。

title: EEFA: A Framework for the Ethical Evaluation of AI Agents
summary: The rapid deployment of autonomous AI agents across consequential domains including healthcare, legal services, nancial management, and enterprise workows has created an urgent governance challenge. While the eld of AI evaluation has produced sophisticated benchmarks for measuring agent capability, these frameworks measure exclusively what agents can do rather than how they do it. The ethical dimensions most critical to responsible agent deployment, in- cluding respect for human autonomy, harm avoidance, transparency and non-deception, privacy compliance, and accountability, are systematically absent from current evaluation practice. This paper addresses that gap through three contributions. First, a structured literature review of twelve leading AI agent benchmarks characterizes the ethical dimensions those bench- marks do and do not measure. Second, the Ethical Evaluation Framework for AI Agents (EEFA) is introduced as a comprehensive, operationalizable instrument for ethical agent evaluation, grounded in established AI ethics principles and designed for use by developers, auditors, and regulators. Third, a reproducible validation protocol is specied for applying the EEFA to deployed agent systems, with illustrative test scenarios across all ve framework dimensions. The EEFA is organized across ve primary dimensions: Autonomy Preservation, Harm Avoid- ance, Transparency and Non-Deception, Privacy Compliance, and Accountability and Traceabil- ity. The framework maps directly onto the requirements of the EU AI Act and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, positioning it as a practical compliance assessment instrument for high-risk AI applications. Empirical application of the framework across diverse benchmarks and agent systems is identied as a priority direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 现有AI智能体基准测试只衡量"能做什么"，忽视伦理维度。本文提出EEFA框架，从自主性、无害、透明、隐私、问责五维度评估智能体伦理表现，并给出可复现验证方案。
AI.motivation: 自主AI智能体已广泛部署于医疗、法律、金融、企业流程等高风险领域，急需治理。然而当前AI评估领域虽有成熟的能力基准，却只测量智能体"能做什么"，而非"如何去做"；对责任部署至关重要的伦理维度（尊重人类自主、避免伤害、透明不欺骗、隐私合规、问责）在评估实践中系统性缺失。
AI.method: 三项贡献：(1) 对12个主流AI智能体基准做结构化文献综述，刻画其测量与未测量的伦理维度；(2) 提出EEFA（AI智能体伦理评估框架），基于既有AI伦理原则构建，面向开发者、审计者与监管者，含五个一级维度：自主性保全、伤害避免、透明与不欺骗、隐私合规、问责与可追溯；(3) 制定可复现的验证协议，并对五个维度给出示例测试场景。框架直接对应EU AI Act与NIST AI RMF要求。
AI.result: 文献综述表明主流基准普遍缺失伦理维度；EEFA提供可操作化的伦理评估工具，可直接映射到EU AI Act与NIST AI风险管理框架，作为高风险AI应用的合规评估工具。本文未报告实证评估结果。
AI.conclusion: EEFA填补了智能体伦理评估的空白，具备合规适配性；在不同基准与智能体系统上的实证应用被列为未来工作重点。

title: Direct Covariance-to-Beamformer Mapping for Low-Latency Hybrid ISAC Beamforming with Subsequent DoA Estimation
summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems typically employ a two-stage beamforming pipeline, in which target directions are first estimated from the received covariance matrix and then used to compute the beamforming weights by solving non-convex optimization problems. Although effective, this approach introduces processing latency that can limit beam adaptation in dynamic environments. This letter proposes a beamforming deep neural network (BFDNN) for direct covariance-to-beamformer learning in ISAC systems. BFDNN is a compact regression network that maps covariance-matrix features directly to the hybrid beamforming weights produced by a hybrid ISAC beamformer, eliminating the direction-of-arrival (DoA) estimation stage during inference. Compared with MUSIC, classification-DNN, and regression-DNN based beamforming pipelines, BFDNN generates comparable beam patterns and higher effective spectral efficiencies while reducing the beamforming prediction latency by 25-30 times on the evaluated platform, demonstrating the potential of direct covariance-to-beamformer learning for low-latency ISAC beam updates. Moreover, the target directions can be inferred indirectly from the generated radiation pattern, yielding DoA accuracy competitive with that of dedicated learning-based methods in the evaluated scenario.

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑回归网络BFDNN，直接从协方差矩阵映射到混合波束赋形权重，跳过DoA估计环节，实现低延迟ISAC波束更新。
AI.motivation: 传统ISAC两阶段波束赋形流程（先估计目标方向，再求解非凸优化得到权重）存在处理延迟，难以在动态环境中快速调整波束。
AI.method: 设计BFDNN：一种紧凑的回归式深度神经网络，将协方差矩阵特征直接映射为混合ISAC波束成形器输出的混合波束赋形权重，推理时省去DoA估计阶段。
AI.result: 与基于MUSIC、分类DNN和回归DNN的流程相比，BFDNN产生相当的波束图样和更高的有效频谱效率，波束预测延迟降低25–30倍；并可从辐射图样间接推断目标方向，DoA精度与专用学习方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 直接"协方差→波束赋形器"学习在低延迟ISAC波束更新方面具有潜力，且可兼顾DoA估计精度。

title: Can LLM Agents Be Forward-Deployed Engineers? Requirement Discovery and Delivery for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
summary: LLM coding agents can increasingly automate model post-training, but whether they can act as forward-deployed engineer (FDE) agents, discovering customer requirements and turning them into deployment decisions, remains unclear. We study this on a real enterprise text-to-SQL engagement: a simulated customer, grounded in the real use case's requirements, starts with an ambiguous request. An agent must discover acceptance criteria, data permissions, and hardware constraints in the discovery phase, then plan and execute a post-training recipe in the delivery phase. Across 15 models, the strongest discover over 80% of withheld requirements and open-weight models discover 40-50%; in the delivery phase, only 25% of runs across eight coding-agent configurations pass all acceptance criteria. We identify four bottlenecks in this engagement: (1) incomplete discovery, with 40% of withheld requirements missing or misrepresented; (2) unreliable execution; (3) underused compute budgets and a lack of systematic comparisons across base models and post-training methods; and (4) benchmark accuracy does not guarantee production readiness. We suggest human review of discovered requirements, monitoring of the agent's plan during execution, and an explicit experiment-environment specification covering hardware, budget scope, and production checks.

AI.tldr: 在真实企业文本到SQL场景中评估LLM编码智能体能否胜任"前向部署工程师"角色，发现多数能发现需求但仅少数能通过全部验收标准，存在四类瓶颈。
AI.motivation: LLM编码智能体已能自动化模型后训练，但其能否像前向部署工程师(FDE)那样发现客户需求并转化为部署决策尚不明确，本文对此展开研究。
AI.method: 构建模拟客户（基于真实用例需求），从模糊请求出发；智能体先在发现阶段获取验收标准、数据权限与硬件约束，再在交付阶段规划并执行后训练方案；评测15个模型及8种编码智能体配置。
AI.result: 最强模型发现超80%的隐藏需求，开源权重模型为40-50%；交付阶段仅25%的运行通过全部验收标准。识别出四类瓶颈：发现不完整（40%隐藏需求缺失或表述错误）、执行不可靠、算力预算利用不足且缺乏系统性比较、基准准确率不等于生产就绪。
AI.conclusion: 建议对发现的需求进行人工复核、在执行过程中监控智能体计划，并明确涵盖硬件、预算范围与生产检查的实验环境规范。

title: AR-RRG: Anatomy-Guided Retrieval-Driven Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) streamlines clinical workflows and alleviates the burden of radiologists' documentation. Standard vision-language models capture global visual cues and lack fine-grained alignment between anatomical regions and diagnostic text. Most retrieval-augmented methods retrieve complete historical reports, introducing redundant noise and severe vision-text mismatches that trigger clinically risky hallucinations and missed lesions. In this paper, we introduce AR-RRG, an anatomy-guided retrieval-driven method for the generation of radiology reports. AR-RRG consists of two core modules: the anatomy-aware self-training lesion detection network (ASLDNet) and the retrieval-driven radiology report generation (RRRG). ASLDNet leverages anatomy-aware spatial verification (ASV) and class-adaptive dynamic thresholding (CDT) via self-training, delivering accurate lesion localization to support subsequent generation. As the generative branch of AR-RRG, RRRG eliminates clinical hallucinations through dual-granularity retrieval (DR) and complements missing lesions with a neighborhood consensus (NC) mechanism. A parallel continuous visual perception (PCVP) stream converts radiographs into visual tokens through fixed medical encoding and resampling. Multi-scale text and visual features are fused, followed by LoRA-efficient large language model tuning to generate clinically consistent, visually grounded radiology reports. Extensive evaluations on MS-CXR, MIMIC-CXR, and IU X-Ray demonstrate that AR-RRG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across mainstream metrics. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: AR-RRG：一种解剖引导的检索驱动放射报告生成方法，通过解剖感知病灶检测与双粒度检索抑制幻觉、补全漏检，在多数据集上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 标准视觉-语言模型仅捕捉全局视觉线索，缺乏解剖区域与诊断文本的细粒度对齐；现有检索增强方法检索完整历史报告，引入冗余噪声和严重视觉-文本错配，导致临床风险性幻觉与漏检病灶。
AI.method: 包含两个核心模块：ASLDNet（解剖感知空间验证ASV + 类自适应动态阈值CDT，经自训练实现精准病灶定位）与RRRG（双粒度检索DR消除幻觉，邻域共识NC机制补全漏检病灶，并行连续视觉感知PCVP流将X光转为视觉token，多尺度文本与视觉特征融合后经LoRA高效微调LLM生成报告）。
AI.result: 在MS-CXR、MIMIC-CXR和IU X-Ray上，于主流指标上持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 解剖引导检测与检索驱动的联合设计可有效提升放射报告生成的临床一致性与视觉接地性，代码将公开。

title: Probing Local Conditional Fit for Diffusion Model Membership Inference
