summary: Membership inference determines whether a candidate example was used to train a text-to-image diffusion model and is an important tool for auditing training-data use. We identify a directional membership signal in \emph{conditional prediction shifts}, the changes in predicted noise under alternative text conditions at a fixed noisy input: whether movement toward the alternative prediction initially lowers or raises the denoising loss from its value under the original caption. Members exhibit less room for such local improvement. To quantify this response, we propose \emph{LoFIT} (Local Conditional Fit), which measures the initial response of the denoising loss along normalized prediction shifts and aggregates it across multiple text conditions and diffusion states. LoFIT requires no target-model gradients and can be computed using only forward queries to the denoiser. Evaluations on four datasets show improved membership discrimination across fine-tuned and pretrained models. LoFIT distinguishes members early in fine-tuning, while the naive denoising-loss baseline remains near chance. Controlled comparisons show that the membership signal is concentrated in the first-order response, with little discrimination from prediction-shift magnitude alone.

AI.tldr: 提出LoFIT，利用"条件预测偏移"下去噪损失的初始局部响应作为方向性成员信号，实现文生图扩散模型的成员推断，且只需前向查询。
AI.motivation: 成员推断是审计文生图扩散模型训练数据使用的重要工具，但现有方法（如朴素去噪损失）区分能力有限。
AI.method: 发现固定噪声输入下、更换文本条件导致预测噪声移动时，去噪损失初始是下降还是上升具有方向性成员信号，成员样本局部改进空间更小。据此提出LoFIT：沿归一化预测偏移测去噪损失的初始响应，并在多文本条件与多扩散状态上聚合；无需目标模型梯度，仅需对去噪器做前向查询。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，对微调与预训练模型均提升成员判别能力；能在微调早期识别成员，而朴素去噪损失基线接近随机；受控实验表明信号集中于一级响应，偏移幅度本身几乎无判别力。
AI.conclusion: 条件预测偏移的一阶局部响应是有效且轻量的成员信号，为扩散模型数据审计提供实用的前向-only 方法。

title: SparseLift: Automatically Optimizing Opaque Sparse Paths in Industrial-Scale Recommendation Model Training
summary: The sparse path, comprising sparse operations and collective communication, is a critical component of large-scale recommendation models. However, these operations are often represented as opaque nodes in the training computation graph, hindering whole-graph optimization. We present SparseLift, a low-overhead compiler for the sparse path of large-scale recommendation training. It exposes sparse computation and communication to whole-graph analysis to expand the optimization space and improve training efficiency. By analyzing model structure and runtime information, SparseLift reconstructs opaque nodes as analyzable subgraphs, recovering the resource semantics of sparse computation and communication within the graph. Building on the recovered semantics, we design incremental cost models and a constraint-aware planner to automatically select and organize subgraph optimizations into an execution plan that is reused during subsequent steady-state training. We evaluate SparseLift on an industrial video-platform recommendation task with 100B sparse parameters and the public DLRM benchmark. SparseLift improves steady-state throughput for ordinary industrial training steps by 16.5\% over the native baseline. On DLRM, it achieves $1.60\times$ and $1.26\times$ model-execution speedups over DLRM-Baseline and TorchRec, respectively.

AI.tldr: SparseLift是一个低开销编译器，通过将大规模推荐模型训练中的稀疏路径（稀疏算子+集合通信）从不透明节点重构为可分析子图，恢复其资源语义，并结合增量代价模型与约束感知规划器自动生成并复用执行计划，从而扩大全图优化空间。
AI.motivation: 大规模推荐模型的稀疏路径（稀疏操作与集合通信）在训练计算图中常被表示为不透明节点，阻碍了全图优化，限制了训练效率提升的空间。
AI.method: 通过分析模型结构与运行时信息，将不透明节点重构为可分析子图，恢复稀疏计算与通信的资源语义；在此基础上设计增量代价模型与约束感知规划器，自动选择并组织子图优化形成执行计划，并在后续稳态训练中复用。
AI.result: 在100B稀疏参数的工业视频推荐任务上，稳态吞吐较原生基线提升16.5%；在公开DLRM基准上，模型执行速度分别为DLRM-Baseline的1.60倍、TorchRec的1.26倍。
AI.conclusion: SparseLift以低开销方式打开稀疏路径的黑盒，实现全图级优化，在工业级与公开基准上均显著提升推荐模型训练效率。

title: AbacusGS: Gaussian Splatting without Per-Splat Sorting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting sorts every splat by depth in every frame. Viewers that draw splats with the hardware rasterizer and sort them on the CPU, as most web and mobile viewers do, spend most of the frame time in this sort. We present AbacusGS, which stores the blending order of a 3DGS scene in the scene layout. AbacusGS groups the splats into octree boxes of at most 128 splats and stores each box in order along an axis chosen at write time. In each frame, AbacusGS sorts only the visible boxes, and one dot product per box decides whether the box is read forward or backward. A short order-aware fine-tuning converts an existing 3DGS model, and the over operator of 3DGS stays unchanged. On 13 standard scenes, AbacusGS loses 0.13 dB PSNR on average against an equally fine-tuned 3DGS model. In an OpenGL viewer that orders splats on the CPU, AbacusGS renders frames 4.5 times faster than per-splat sorting. We also present a compact format of 17 bytes per splat and a CUDA tile renderer that use the same order. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: AbacusGS 将 3DGS 场景的绘制顺序预存入场景结构中（八叉树盒子+轴向排序），每帧只需排序可见盒子并用点积决定正/反向读取，用极小质量损失换来 4.5 倍 CPU 排序加速。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 每帧需按深度排序所有 splat，而多数 Web/移动端查看器用硬件光栅化绘制、CPU 排序，帧时间大部分耗在排序上，成为主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 将 splat 分入不超过 128 个的八叉树盒子，写入时沿选定轴按顺序存储；每帧只排序可见盒子，每个盒子一个点积决定前向或后向读取；通过短时顺序感知微调把已有 3DGS 模型转换，保持原 over 混合算子不变。另提供每 splat 17 字节的紧凑格式和复用同一顺序的 CUDA tile 渲染器。
AI.result: 在 13 个标准场景上，PSNR 平均仅比同等微调的 3DGS 低 0.13 dB；在 CPU 排序的 OpenGL 查看器中，渲染速度比逐 splat 排序快 4.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过把混合顺序固化进场景布局，可显著降低排序开销且几乎不损质量，兼容现有渲染管线与紧凑存储及 CUDA 渲染。

title: BasisKV: Value Latents for Communication and Key Routing
summary: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly constrained by the cost of maintaining an ever-growing KV-cache. Low-rank K/V projections provide a promising way to compress the KV-cache with minimal quality loss, but prior work has largely optimized KV-cache compression in isolation, leaving distributed inference, especially with tensor parallelism where attention computation is partitioned across multiple GPUs, largely underexplored. We make two observations: (i) tensor-parallel communication is an important cost when deploying low-rank KV-cache compression in distributed inference; and (ii) Value compression can be associated with the output projection, allowing the same low-rank Value representation to reduce both Value-cache width and tensor-parallel communication. Based on these observations, we propose BasisKV, a low-rank KV-cache compression method for communication-intensive, long-context LLM inference. BasisKV jointly optimizes the low-rank factors across per-GPU attention partitions against the complete attention output, rather than fitting each partition in isolation. The compressed Value cache is further reused to help identify which Key pages should be accessed: it predicts part of the Key information needed for routing, while a Key-specific residual stores what cannot be recovered from Value. The original Keys are then retrieved only for the selected pages to compute exact QK scores. Across multiple LLM families and system settings, BasisKV achieves a better quality--efficiency tradeoff than existing low-rank baselines, reaching up to 1.42x end-to-end speedup under 8-GPU tensor-parallel inference. Our code is available at https://github.com/alexz949/BasisKV

AI.tldr: BasisKV 是一种面向张量并行分布式推理的低秩 KV-cache 压缩方法，通过将 Value 压缩与输出投影关联，同时降低 Value 缓存宽度和 TP 通信量，并复用压缩 Value 辅助 Key 页路由，实现质量与效率更优的权衡。
AI.motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV-cache 持续增长带来高昂成本；已有低秩 K/V 投影压缩方法多在单机场景优化，忽略了张量并行（TP）下注意力切分到多 GPU 的分布式推理场景，而 TP 通信本身是重要开销。
AI.method: 基于两点观察——(i) TP 通信是低秩 KV 压缩部署的关键成本；(ii) Value 压缩可与输出投影结合，使同一低秩 Value 表示同时降低 Value 缓存宽度和 TP 通信量——提出 BasisKV：跨各 GPU 注意力分区联合优化低秩因子以拟合完整注意力输出（而非分区独立拟合）；压缩的 Value 缓存复用于预测 Key 路由所需的部分信息，Key 专用残差存储无法从 Value 恢复的部分；仅对选中页面取回原始 Key 以计算精确 QK 分数。
AI.result: 在多种 LLM 家族与系统设置下，BasisKV 相较现有低秩基线取得更优的质量—效率权衡，8-GPU 张量并行推理下端到端加速最高达 1.42 倍。
AI.conclusion: BasisKV 表明将低秩 KV 压缩与分布式推理的通信优化协同设计，可同时提升长上下文推理的质量与效率，为通信密集型场景下的 KV-cache 压缩提供了新思路。

title: MatMoE: Matryoshka Mixture-of-Experts with Dynamic Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient Inference
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture has been widely adopted in large language models (LLMs) since it reduces the computational cost through sparse expert activation. However, the massive parameter scale of MoE models hinders their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. Although existing mixed-precision quantization reduces the model size, they are inherently static, fixing the bit-width of each expert across decoding steps. Such static schemes yield suboptimal performance as they overlook the dynamic variation in expert importance during decoding. Furthermore, they fail to adapt to the dynamic latency constraint driven by the fluctuating system utilization. To address these challenges, we propose MatMoE, a dynamic mixed-precision quantization framework for efficient MoE inference. MatMoE features: (1) a Matryoshka MoE PTQ algorithm that enables experts to operate flexibly at multiple precisions within a stringent memory budget; (2) a floor-and-compensation quantization method that eliminates redundant memory accesses in the Matryoshka representation; and (3) a dynamic bit-width allocation strategy that determines the precision for each expert based on their routing scores to satisfy the dynamic latency requirement. We implement our MatMoE system atop llama.cpp for both CPU and GPU platforms. Extensive evaluations across three modern MoE models and challenging benchmarks demonstrate that MatMoE achieves $4.0\% \sim 18.3\%$ higher accuracy than state-of-the-art static mixed-precision method. Compared to llama.cpp, MatMoE delivers $1.3\times \sim 3.7\times$ speedup on Raspberry Pi 5, and $1.2\times \sim 1.3\times$ speedup on NVIDIA RTX 4090 and Jetson AGX Orin.

AI.tldr: MatMoE 是一个面向边缘设备 MoE 大模型的动态混合精度量化框架，通过 Matryoshka 式 PTQ、floor-and-compensation 量化与基于路由分数的动态位宽分配，在内存预算下让专家灵活多精度运行，并按延迟需求调整精度。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型参数量庞大，难以部署到资源受限的边缘设备。现有混合精度量化是静态的——每个专家的位宽在解码过程中固定不变，忽略了专家重要性随解码步的动态变化，也无法适应系统负载波动带来的动态延迟约束，因此性能次优。
AI.method: 提出 MatMoE，包含三部分：(1) Matryoshka MoE PTQ 算法，使专家能在严格内存预算内以多种精度灵活运行；(2) floor-and-compensation 量化方法，消除 Matryoshka 表示中的冗余内存访问；(3) 动态位宽分配策略，依据专家的路由分数决定其精度，以满足动态延迟要求。系统实现于 llama.cpp，支持 CPU 与 GPU。
AI.result: 在三个现代 MoE 模型和多个挑战性基准上，MatMoE 比 SOTA 静态混合精度方法准确率高 4.0%~18.3%；相比 llama.cpp，在 Raspberry Pi 5 上加速 1.3×~3.7×，在 NVIDIA RTX 4090 与 Jetson AGX Orin 上加速 1.2×~1.3×。
AI.conclusion: 动态、路由感知的混合精度量化能同时提升 MoE 边缘推理的精度与延迟适应性，是静态量化方案的有效替代。

title: NitiBench+: A Temporal Thai Legal Question Answering Benchmark Across 17 Domains
summary: Law changes over time. A court decides a case under the law in force on that day, and legal QA benchmarks grade answers against today's law. We checked 156,650 decisions of four Thai courts. Up to 67% of them cite law that has since been amended or repealed. We introduce NitiBench+, the sequel of our NitiBench, a Thai legal QA benchmark with 1,670 items across 17 domains, built from decisions of three courts. For each cited section it holds both the text in force on the decision date and the current text, and its retrieval corpus holds every dated version of every Thai statute section. Answers are graded on the Thai Bar Council rubric, the Bar-standard score, and on the overlap between the cited sections and the court's. The report has two parts. Part I measures the cost of the wrong text on 13 open-weight models. Reading the current text of amended law drops the Bar-standard score by 0.25 and missing repealed law drops it by 0.79. The penalty comes from rule changes, 0.45 on the 428 rule-changed items and none on the 331 wording-only items, and Citation F1 does not see it. The text in force is the fair setting. Part II benchmarks today's models on that setting. A public leaderboard ranks 26 models on a held-out test split of 500 items stratified by domain, with a validation split of the same shape released for public use, from memory alone, with the court's sections provided, and as a retrieval agent over the law in force, with the cost per item and the hallucinated citations. The best model scores 7.78 out of 10 and the best open-weight model 6.39. Without a search tool only five open-weight models recall any Thai law, and with it twenty of the 26 models gain and six lose. Leaderboard will take new models as they are released. Legal benchmarks must track dates, and on the right text today's models still leave a wide gap on Thai law.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 NitiBench+，一个带日期感知的泰语法律问答基准，用于衡量"用现行法还是判决时有效法"对评分的影响，并对26个模型在"当时有效法"设定下进行排名。
AI.motivation: 法律随时间变化，法院依判决时有效法裁判，而现有法律QA基准却用"今天的法"评分，导致答案与引用条款错配。作者检查156,650份泰国四家法院判决，最多67%引用了已被修订或废止的法律，说明基准忽略法律时效性会产生系统性偏差。
AI.method: 构建 NitiBench+：来自三家法院判决的1,670道题、覆盖17个领域。每个被引条款同时保存判决日文本与现行文本，检索语料含每个泰国法条的各个日期版本。评分采用泰国律师协会评分标准(Bar-standard score)、条款重叠与Citation F1。Part I 在13个开放权重模型上测量"错误文本"的代价(对比现行文本、缺失废止法、规则变更类428题与措辞修改类331题)；Part II 在"当时有效法"设定下评测26个模型，设置记忆、给定法条、检索代理三种模式，并记录每题成本与幻觉引用，公开验证集与隐藏测试集(500题、按领域分层)并设排行榜。
AI.result: 用现行文本使Bar-standard分数下降0.25，缺失废止法下降0.79；惩罚主要来自规则变更(0.45)，措辞修改题为0，且Citation F1无法反映该差异。Part II中最佳模型7.78/10，最佳开放权重模型6.39；无检索工具时仅5个开放权重模型能回忆出任何泰国法条，有检索时26个模型中20个提升、6个下降。
AI.conclusion: 法律基准必须跟踪法律日期，采用"判决时有效法"才公平。即便在正确文本下，当前模型在泰国法律上仍有明显差距；基准与排行榜将持续接纳新模型。

title: CUFormer: Modality-Aware CT-Ultrasound Point Cloud Registration for Orthopedic Navigation
summary: Registering intraoperative Ultrasound (US) bone-surface point clouds to preoperative Computed Tomography (CT) models can support radiation-free orthopedic navigation. Differences in imaging physics produce distinct surface sampling patterns, complicating cross-modal feature matching. Bone strongly reflects ultrasound and casts an acoustic shadow, so US captures only the probe-facing bone surface and leaves most CT points unmatched. This partial coverage makes correspondences ambiguous on near-symmetric bones. We propose CUFormer, a modality-aware registration framework. We introduce a Modality-Aware Transformer (MAT) that encodes input modality through identity embeddings and updates features through modality-specific adapters within a shared geometric matcher. We model imaging visibility and use predicted reference-side visibility to weight coarse and fine correspondences. CUFormer achieves the lowest mean registration errors among evaluated methods on two CT-US datasets, UltraBones100k and UltraBonesHip, and the CT-RGB-D dataset SpineDepth. On UltraBones100k, it reaches mean rotation error 4.53$^\circ$, translation error 3.19\,mm, and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) 2.54\,mm, reducing RMSE by 65.8\% relative to the best-performing baseline by this metric. These results demonstrate CUFormer's effectiveness in aligning partial bone surfaces with preoperative CT across anatomical sites.

AI.tldr: CUFormer：一种模态感知的Transformer配准框架，用于将术中超声骨表面点云配准到术前CT模型，通过可见性建模与模态特定适配器解决跨模态部分覆盖匹配难题。
AI.motivation: 术中超声骨表面点云与术前CT模型配准可实现无辐射骨科导航，但成像物理差异导致表面采样模式不同，跨模态特征匹配困难；超声因骨面强反射与声影只捕获朝向探头的骨表面，CT点大多无匹配，部分覆盖使近似对称骨骼上的对应关系高度歧义。
AI.method: 提出CUFormer模态感知配准框架：1）Modality-Aware Transformer (MAT)，通过身份嵌入编码输入模态，并在共享几何匹配器中用模态特定适配器更新特征；2）建模成像可见性，用预测的参考侧可见性对粗、细对应关系加权。
AI.result: 在两个CT-US数据集UltraBones100k、UltraBonesHip及CT-RGB-D数据集SpineDepth上取得最低平均配准误差。UltraBones100k上平均旋转误差4.53°、平移误差3.19 mm、RMSE 2.54 mm，RMSE较该指标最优基线降低65.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明CUFormer能有效在多个解剖部位将部分骨表面与术前CT对齐，验证了模态感知与可见性加权在跨模态部分配准中的有效性。

title: Parallelism-Aligned Pruning and Round-Aware Context Reuse for On-Device Multimodal Agents
summary: On-device multimodal agents are limited by two deployment mismatches: pretrained attention structures may not divide evenly across the compute cores of an edge accelerator, causing irregular partitions; and standard prefix caching keeps historical visual tokens in the persistent KV cache, whose capacity grows with the number of rounds. We present PARC, which combines parallelism-aligned structured pruning with lifetime-aware KV-cache reorganization. At the model level, it uses first-order Taylor importance and grouped-query-attention-aware selection to make attention dimensions divisible by the target core count while preserving the query-to-key/value ratio and head dimension. At runtime, it separates the system prompt, persistent text history, and transient visual observations by lifetime, updating text history during tool execution so that historical images leave the persistent cache and more interaction rounds fit a fixed budget. On 2,062 GUI actions, the incremental interface shows no accuracy regression, and task-aware recovery training restores 98.7% of the action-type accuracy gap and the coordinate hit rate to the original level. Under seven-core deployment, hardware-aligned pruning reduces vision-encoder latency by 11.4%, improves decoding throughput by 23.8%, and lowers per-heap high-water memory by 12.7%; a parameter-matched control confirms that the speedup stems mainly from core alignment rather than parameter reduction.

AI.tldr: PARC 结合并行对齐的结构化剪枝与生命周期感知的 KV-cache 重组，解决端侧多模态智能体的计算核不整除与缓存膨胀两大部署错配。
AI.motivation: 端侧多模态智能体面临两类部署错配：预训练注意力结构难以在边缘加速器的计算核上均分，造成不规则划分；标准前缀缓存把历史视觉 token 留在持久 KV 缓存中，容量随交互轮数增长。
AI.method: 模型层面用一阶泰勒重要性估计和 GQA 感知的选择，使注意力维度可被目标核数整除，同时保持 Q 与 KV 的比例及头维度；运行时按生命周期分离系统提示、持久文本历史和瞬态视觉观测，并在工具执行时更新文本历史，使历史图像退出持久缓存。
AI.result: 在 2,062 个 GUI 动作上增量接口无精度回退；任务感知恢复训练恢复了 98.7% 的动作类型精度差距，坐标命中率回到原水平。七核部署下视觉编码器延迟降低 11.4%，解码吞吐提升 23.8%，每堆高水位内存降低 12.7%；参数匹配对照表明加速主要来自核心对齐而非参数减少。
AI.conclusion: PARC 通过硬件对齐剪枝与生命周期感知缓存管理，在几乎不损失精度的情况下提升端侧多模态智能体的速度与内存效率。

title: Comparative Strategies for Handling Imbalanced QSAR Regression: A Case Study on hERG Activity Prediction
summary: Data imbalance frequently occurs in QSAR modeling, yet most studies focus on classification tasks, and few address regression tasks, as it is challenging to determine which regions of the data are sparse or dense. Data-level and algorithm-level imbalance-handling strategies can have different effects on model performance. In this study, we systematically compare various strategies across GCN and fingerprint-based machine learning models. To evaluate model performance more meaningfully, we partitioned the target region into several subregions based on both domain knowledge and data distribution. We focused on the region of greatest practical interest. Our results demonstrate that selecting models based on this interest-region metric leads to more reliable performance than using the total region metric. We also observed that different imbalance-handling strategies can have divergent effects depending on the model type. These findings highlight the importance of region-aware evaluation in regression QSAR modeling and provide practical guidance for selecting appropriate strategies for imbalanced datasets.

AI.tldr: 系统比较了不平衡回归QSAR中数据级与算法级处理策略在GCN与指纹ML模型上的效果，并提出基于领域知识与数据分布划分目标区域、聚焦"最感兴趣区域"的评价方式。
AI.motivation: QSAR建模中数据不平衡常见，但研究多集中于分类任务，回归任务因难以界定数据稀疏/密集区域而少有涉及；且数据级与算法级不平衡处理策略对模型性能的影响不同。
AI.method: 在GCN和基于指纹的机器学习模型上系统比较多种不平衡处理策略；依据领域知识和数据分布将目标区域划分为若干子区域，重点关注实际应用最感兴趣的区域。
AI.result: 基于兴趣区域指标选择模型比使用整体区域指标更可靠；不同不平衡处理策略的效果因模型类型而异。
AI.conclusion: 强调回归QSAR建模中区域感知评价的重要性，并为不平衡数据集下选择合适策略提供实践指导。

title: ufakzeka-kulak: Building and Evaluating a 31.6M-Parameter Turkish Speech Recognizer from Scratch
comment: 9 pages (text on pages 1 to 8, references on pages 8 and 9). Model, card, attribution, code and demo: https://huggingface.co/ufakai/ufakzeka-kulak, https://github.com/ufakai/ufakzeka-kulak, https://kulak.ufakzeka.com
summary: ufakzeka-kulak is an open Turkish speech-to-text model of 31.6M parameters, a FastConformer encoder with a token-and-duration transducer (TDT) and a CTC head, trained from scratch and released under Apache-2.0. It writes cased, punctuated Turkish with numbers as words. Its 4,977 training hours come from sources whose licences allow commercial use; 281 hours are human-transcribed, and for the other 4,696 the training text is an uploader subtitle or a machine transcript, kept only where a second, independent reading of the audio agrees with it. The recipe, checkpoint, labelling and export choices were made on development data, and the test sets were scored once, in a release gate fixed before training. With greedy TDT decoding the normalised word error rate (WER) is 0.0921 (95 percent interval 0.0792 to 0.1055) on FLEURS Turkish test and 0.0916 (0.0873 to 0.0958) on Common Voice 27.0 Turkish test, lower than Whisper base and Whisper small on both sets with paired intervals wholly below zero; Whisper large-v3 (greedy) scores 0.0604 and 0.0767. On conversational speech the WER is 0.3807. We also report punctuation and casing, degraded audio, and how closely each shipped export reproduces the trained model.

AI.tldr: ufakzeka-kulak 是一个 31.6M 参数的开源土耳其语语音转文本模型（FastConformer + TDT + CTC），仅用可商用许可数据从零训练，在 FLEURS 和 Common Voice 上 WER 约 0.09，优于 Whisper base/small，但不及 Whisper large-v3。
AI.motivation: 构建一个许可合规（Apache-2.0、训练数据可商用）、轻量且完全从零训练的土耳其语 ASR 模型，减少对大规模受限数据与超大模型的依赖，并提供可信的评测流程。
AI.method: 采用 31.6M 参数的 FastConformer 编码器，搭配 token-and-duration transducer（TDT）与 CTC 双解码头；共 4,977 小时训练数据，其中 281 小时为人工转写，其余 4,696 小时的文本为上传者字幕或机器转写，仅在第二份独立听觉判读与其一致时保留。开发数据上确定配方、检查点与标注/导出策略，测试集在训练前固定的发布门（release gate）中一次性评分。
AI.result: 贪心 TDT 解码下，归一化 WER 在 FLEURS 土耳其语测试集为 0.0921（95% 区间 0.0792–0.1055），Common Voice 27.0 为 0.0916（0.0873–0.0958），两者均优于 Whisper base 与 small，配对区间整体位于零以下；Whisper large-v3（贪心）分别为 0.0604 与 0.0767。会话语音 WER 为 0.3807。另报告标点与大小写、退化音频表现及各导出件对训练模型的复现程度。
AI.conclusion: 一个轻量级、许可干净的开源土耳其语 ASR 模型可在标准测试集上超越中等规模 Whisper，但在会话语音与强基线（large-v3）上仍有差距；研究同时强调预注册评测与导出一致性验证的实践价值。

title: MoPort: A View-Aware 2D Interface for Motion Language Models
summary: Motion language models (MoLMs) encode 3D human motion as discrete tokens for language-based understanding. Deploying them on monocular video raises two problems. Pose detection yields 2D joint sequences, leaving a dimensional gap from the 3D motion used in training. Moreover, the 2D observation changes with the camera viewpoint, while the depth lost in projection makes the 2D pose ambiguous across viewpoints. We propose MoPort, a view-aware 2D interface that enables MoLMs to take 2D observations as input. We introduce Paired View Alignment (PVA), which gives two views of the same motion a shared 3D teacher target and directly constrains the consistency of their latents, so that 2D observations from different viewpoints are mapped to a consistent semantic representation. Camera-Modulated Encoding (CME) estimates the camera extrinsics from the 2D sequence and uses them to modulate encoding, providing the 2D latents with geometric information about the viewpoint. MoPort achieves R@1 of 0.5674 on HumanML3D and 0.3286 on KIT-ML, outperforming all evaluated baselines. On HumanML3D, its R@1 decreases only from 0.5763 on in-distribution viewpoints to 0.5585 on out-of-distribution viewpoints. We validate portability on three downstream MoLMs. Furthermore, on the real-world RGB video dataset Fit3D, MoPort achieves 80.36\% accuracy. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: MoPort 提出一种视角感知的 2D 接口，使运动语言模型（MoLM）能直接以单目视频中的 2D 关节序列为输入。
AI.motivation: MoLM 训练时使用 3D 离散运动 token，而实际部署时姿态检测只能得到 2D 关节序列，存在维度鸿沟；同时 2D 观测随相机视角变化，投影丢失深度导致跨视角歧义。
AI.method: 提出 Paired View Alignment（PVA）：让同一运动的两个视角共享 3D 教师目标，并直接约束二者潜表示的一致性；以及 Camera-Modulated Encoding（CME）：从 2D 序列估计相机外参并用于调制编码，为 2D 潜表示注入视角几何信息。
AI.result: HumanML3D 上 R@1 为 0.5674，KIT-ML 上为 0.3286，优于所有对比基线；HumanML3D 上分布内视角 R@1 0.5763，分布外视角仅降至 0.5585；在三个下游 MoLM 上验证了可移植性；真实 RGB 视频数据集 Fit3D 上准确率达 80.36%。
AI.conclusion: MoPort 通过视角对齐与相机调制有效弥合 2D 观测与 3D 运动语言模型之间的鸿沟，在保持跨视角鲁棒性的同时取得领先性能，并具备良好的可移植性与真实场景可用性。

title: Widening Harm Evaluation Coverage with a Judge that Reads the World
summary: An agent acting in a stateful environment can leave evidence of harm in two places: the record of what it did and said, or the world it changed. Safety evaluations for discovering harm examine one or the other in limited ways, using either an LLM judge over the trajectory or deterministic checks over the final state. Although LLM-based verifiers that inspect the environment exist, they have been used to verify task completion, not to detect and confirm harm in a safety setting. We address this gap with an LLM that has read-only access to the environment state and is given a harm taxonomy. We evaluate this approach in three environments: two from DecodingTrust-Arena and one from OSWorld. We hold the judge model and harm taxonomy fixed, varying only what the judge observes: the trajectory, read-only tools for inspecting the environment, or both channels together. In the two DecodingTrust-Arena environments, combining the trajectory and state-only judges recalls 94 percent of confirmed harms, compared with 53 percent for the trajectory judge alone. On OS-Harm, the union recalls 77 percent, compared with 67 percent. A single judge given both channels does not perform better and produces more false negatives than the state-only judge. We also record disagreements and find that the two channels miss different episodes. These results suggest that combining verdicts from two channel-specific judges is a robust and flexible approach to detecting and verifying harm in agentic settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用两个"通道专用"的LLM评审员（分别只看轨迹/只看环境状态）来检测智能体造成的危害，合并二者判定比单通道或单法官双通道更可靠。
AI.motivation: 有状态环境中的智能体可能把危害证据留在两处：行为与对话的轨迹记录，或它改变的世界状态。现有安全评测要么只用LLM评判轨迹，要么只对最终状态做确定性检查，覆盖有限；而LLM环境验证器此前仅用于验证任务完成，未用于安全场景的危害检测与确认。
AI.method: 给LLM只读访问环境状态的权限并提供危害分类体系（harm taxonomy），构建"状态评审员"。在三个环境（DecodingTrust-Arena两个、OSWorld的OS-Harm一个）中，固定评判模型与分类体系，仅改变评审员可观察的通道：轨迹、只读状态检查工具，或两者合一。
AI.result: DecodingTrust-Arena两环境中，轨迹+状态评审员合并召回94%的已确认危害，而单轨迹评审员仅53%；OS-Harm上合并召回77%，单轨迹为67%。单评审员同时看两通道并未更好，假阴性比仅状态评审员更多。两通道漏掉的案例互不相同。
AI.conclusion: 合并两个通道专用评审员的判定，是检测与确认智能体危害的一种稳健且灵活的方法。未来可沿此多通道集成方向扩展安全评测。

title: When Disagreement Labels Do Not Identify F1 Rankings
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Submitted to ESANN 2027, submission ES2027-34. Code and reproducibility artifact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23647323
summary: Agreement labels cancel from an accuracy comparison but can change an F1 ranking. We specialize partial identification to an explicit audit after labeling disagreements: two agreement counts give exact bounds, certifying a ranking or a choice within a specified F1 tolerance under every completion. Across 3,200 frozen model pairs, shared completions tighten bounds and a 0.01 tolerance reduces labeling costs. A zero-loss (weak-winner) control attributes most savings to positive tolerance, not ties. Guarantees concern the evaluated batch, not future data.

AI.tldr: 一致性标注在准确率比较中会抵消，但会改变F1排名。作者把部分识别专门化为"标注分歧后审计"的显式流程：两个一致性计数即可给出精确界，在任意补全下以指定F1容差认证排名或选择。3200对冻结模型上，共享补全收紧界，0.01容差降低标注成本；零损失对照显示节省主要来自正容差而非并列。保证仅针对评估批次。
AI.motivation: 模型比较中，成对一致性（两模型都对的样本）对准确率差无贡献，却影响F1的分母与排名，导致未标注数据下F1排名不确定。需要一种可操作的审计方式，用尽量少的标注来认证F1排名或模型选择。
AI.method: 将部分识别方法专门化：只在标注分歧样本后做审计，利用两个一致性计数构造F1的精确上下界；考察共享补全（利用两模型在同一样本上的相关性）收紧界；引入容差参数，只在界跨过容差时继续标注；并设置零损失（弱胜者）对照实验，区分正容差与并列带来的成本节省。
AI.result: 在3200对冻结模型上，共享补全相比独立补全显著收紧界；0.01的F1容差可明显减少标注量。零损失对照表明，大部分标注成本节省来自正容差允许的近似判定，而非并列/弱胜者效应。
AI.conclusion: 一致性计数可用于F1的精确部分识别与带容差认证，从而降低标注成本。但所有保证仅适用于当前评估批次，不对未来数据外推。

title: Tracing the Scientific Discovery Capacity of LLMs to Their Training Data
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show growing promise for scientific discovery, yet basic questions remain about what enables reliable discovery. How can we trace the scientific discovery capacity of LLMs to their training data? We study this question as one of missing probability mass and develop a theoretical account in which monofacts-the facts observed once during training-set the discovery capacity. In materials science and regulatory genomics, we directly manipulate monofact rates in training sets and find that more monofacts consistently yield more discoveries across two open-weight model families, sampling strategies, and reasoning budgets. Further experiments show the relationship cannot be explained by training-set diversity alone and can transfer across scientific domains when paired with in-domain data. Together, our results identify monofact rate in training data as a key factor governing discoveries in language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"单次事实（monofact）"——训练集中仅出现一次的事实——为核心的理论框架，将LLM科学发现能力解释为概率质量缺失问题，并通过实验验证单次事实率是决定发现能力的关键因素。
AI.motivation: LLM在科学发现上展现前景，但什么因素使其能可靠发现仍不清楚，尤其缺乏将发现能力追溯到训练数据的机制性解释。
AI.method: 提出将发现能力视为"概率质量缺失"的理论框架，认为训练中仅出现一次的单次事实决定发现容量；在材料科学与调控基因组学中直接操控训练集的单次事实率，跨两个开放权重模型家族、多种采样策略和推理预算进行验证，并对比训练集多样性等替代解释。
AI.result: 单次事实越多，发现越多，且该现象在不同模型家族、采样策略与推理预算下一致成立；该关系无法仅用训练集多样性解释；当搭配域内数据时，该效应可跨科学领域迁移。
AI.conclusion: 训练数据中的单次事实率是支配语言模型科学发现能力的关键因素。

title: GSExplorer: Interactive World Generation with a Persistent 3D Gaussian World State
summary: Interactive world generation requires both accurate local control and stable scene consistency over long rollouts. Existing methods improve local generation through camera or geometry conditioning and extend historical context with memory mechanisms. However, long-horizon exploration remains challenging as target-view guidance becomes incomplete and inconsistencies accumulate across repeated scene updates. We present \textbf{GSExplorer}, a generation--reconstruction framework built around a persistent 3D Gaussian world state. At each step, the current 3DGS scene provides multimodal rendering conditions for a condition-driven video generator, while camera geometry is injected through a separate Relative Ray Encoding branch. Generated videos are then fed back to a SLAM-based reconstruction backend, where inconsistency filtering prevents conflicting content from corrupting the scene and cross-chunk bundle adjustment improves spatial alignment across generation steps. We further design a data-construction pipeline that reproduces realistic 3DGS degradation during scene extrapolation, yielding 293K training pairs of degraded multimodal renderings and real target videos. GSExplorer achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods on both single-step and three-step WorldScore evaluation, with strong camera control and consistency across both settings, including a Camera Control score of 99.07 in single-step extrapolation. On 481-frame leave-and-return rollouts, it also shows strong revisit consistency, demonstrating the value of maintaining a reliable 3D world state for continued exploration.

AI.tldr: GSExplorer 提出一个以持久化 3D 高斯世界状态为核心的生成-重建框架，实现长程交互式世界生成中的精确本地控制与场景一致性。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界生成需兼顾精确局部控制与长时滚动中的场景一致性。现有方法通过相机/几何条件改善局部生成、用记忆机制扩展历史上下文，但长程探索仍困难：目标视角引导不完整，重复场景更新导致不一致累积。
AI.method: 以持久化 3D Gaussian 世界状态为中心：每步由当前 3DGS 场景为条件驱动视频生成器提供多模态渲染条件，相机几何经独立的 Relative Ray Encoding 分支注入；生成视频回馈给基于 SLAM 的重建后端，其中不一致性过滤防止冲突内容污染场景，跨块 bundle adjustment 提升空间对齐。另设计数据构建流程，模拟场景外推中的真实 3DGS 退化，产出 293K 退化多模态渲染与真实目标视频训练对。
AI.result: 在单步与三步 WorldScore 评测中整体性能最优，相机控制与一致性均强，单步外推相机控制得分 99.07；481 帧离开-返回滚动测试中重访一致性强。
AI.conclusion: 维护可靠的 3D 世界状态对持续探索具有重要价值，持久化 3DGS 状态结合生成-重建闭环可有效缓解长程不一致。

title: Measuring AI Agents as Teammates with Collaborative Intelligence
summary: Progress in AI is often measured by what a single model can do on its own. Yet teams of AI agents are starting to make breakthroughs and discoveries in science, medicine, mathematics and software engineering. As AI begins to work in teams of agents and people, the ability to collaborate becomes a core part of their intelligence. Research on human teams has measured this ability for decades. Inspired by this, we introduce the Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark, which measures how well an AI agent works as a teammate. It contains 240 tasks across 8 dimensions of teamwork, from refusing an unsafe shortcut to checking the work that a weaker model leaves behind. Each task comes from a real record or an existing benchmark, from aviation accident reports and clinical cases to coding tasks and negotiations, and has a programmatically verifiable outcome. To isolate teamwork from individual capability, models are scored only on tasks that they can solve by themselves when they have full information. We evaluate 18 closed- and open-weight models and find that every model, across sizes and families, has clear weaknesses as a teammate, with the best model scoring only 82.2 out of 100. Frontier models almost always refuse unsafe shortcuts and report misconduct, yet they cave under interpersonal pressure, reaching the best overall deal in only 14% of conflicts, and their pass rate drops from 97% to 81% when they take over a task in which a weaker model has cheated. Crucially, general capability does not guarantee good teamwork, as models with nearly the same capability score differ by up to 11 points as teammates. The benchmark includes 160 public tasks with code and data, along with 80 held-out tasks for evaluation. As AI agents increasingly work alongside other agents and people, the ability to collaborate effectively is becoming a crucial capability to measure and develop.

AI.tldr: 提出Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark（协作智能基准），用240个可程序化验证的任务、8个团队协作维度衡量AI智能体作为队友的能力；评测18个模型发现所有模型都有明显协作短板，最佳仅82.2/100，且通用能力不能保证协作能力。
AI.motivation: AI进展多以单模型单独表现衡量，但现实中AI智能体开始以团队形式在科学、医学、数学和软件工程中取得突破，与智能体和人协作的能力正成为其智能的核心部分；而人类团队协作研究已有数十年可借鉴的测量方法，但缺少针对AI队友的协作能力评测。
AI.method: 构建协作智能基准：240个任务覆盖8个团队协作维度（如拒绝不安全捷径、检查较弱模型遗留的工作），任务源自真实记录与已有基准（航空事故报告、临床病例、编程任务、谈判等），结果可程序化验证；为剥离个人能力，仅对模型在拥有完整信息时可独立解决的任务计分；评测18个闭源与开源模型（跨规模与家族），并划分160个公开任务（含代码与数据）与80个留出评估任务。
AI.result: 所有模型无论规模与家族都在协作上有明显弱点，最佳模型仅得82.2/100；前沿模型几乎总能拒绝不安全捷径并举报不当行为，但在人际压力下易妥协，仅在14%的冲突中达成最佳整体协议；接替被较弱模型作弊的任务时通过率从97%降至81%；通用能力相近的模型作为队友的分差可达11分。
AI.conclusion: 通用能力不等同于良好协作，协作能力需被独立测量与专门发展；随着AI智能体越来越多地与其他智能体和人共事，有效协作正成为关键能力，该基准提供了可复现的评测基础。

title: A sensor-driven physics-informed neural network for real-time occupant-centric space heating control
summary: Conventional space heating systems typically rely on single or sparse fixed-point temperature measurements, overlooking non-uniform indoor temperature distributions, transient thermal dynamics, and occupant-specific comfort requirements. This study explores an occupant-centric control strategy that aims to maintain the desired temperature around the occupant location. Spatially and temporally varying temperature fields, together with occupant mobility, make real-time local temperature estimation challenging. To address this challenge, we propose a control-oriented Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) model for indoor temperature-field prediction. Conventional PINNs rely on explicit time inputs and assume consistent temporal patterns across samples, which limits adaptability under variable initial conditions and heating sequences. The proposed model infers temporal dynamics implicitly from spatial coordinates and limited sensor measurements, improving robustness to changes in initial conditions and external disturbances. The method was validated across nine horizontal sensing planes in three controlled room-scale configurations. Against a validated COMSOL Multiphysics simulation, the PINN predicted the evaluated temperature fields with a maximum relative error below 1.85% across validation cases. These predictions supported an occupant-centric space heating control scheme. Compared with COMSOL-based offline control, the PINN-based system achieved an average prediction error of around 0.67%, and its rapid inference supports real-time occupant-centric control implementation. This work represents a move away from reliance on fixed-point temperature measurements in space heating control to an occupant-centric control strategy informed by real-time environmental feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向控制的物理信息神经网络（PINN）预测室内温度场，实现实时以人为中心的供暖控制，最大相对误差低于1.85%。
AI.motivation: 传统供暖依赖单点/稀疏固定测温，忽略温度非均匀分布、瞬态热动态及个体舒适需求；而时空变化的温度场与人员移动使实时局部温度估计困难。
AI.method: 提出控制导向的PINN模型，由空间坐标与有限传感器测量隐式推断时间动态，放弃显式时间输入与统一时间模式假设，提升对初始条件和外部扰动变化的鲁棒性；在三种房间尺度配置的九个水平感测平面上，与COMSOL多物理场仿真对比验证，并用于以人为中心的供暖控制。
AI.result: 相对COMSOL仿真最大相对误差低于1.85%；PINN控制系统相对COMSOL离线控制平均预测误差约0.67%，快速推理支持实时控制。
AI.conclusion: 研究实现了从依赖固定点测温向基于实时环境反馈的以人为中心供暖控制的转变。

title: Total Cost of Agency: Exact Attribution of Memory Injection Cost in Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code, data, and evaluation harness in github: https://github.com/vsingh45/tca-compiler
summary: Every node in a multi-agent large language model (LLM) workflow retrieves context from memory and injects it into its prompt, where those injected tokens are billed as input tokens at the same per-token price as the system prompt and the user query. Production observability tools report total token cost but do not separate the tokens a node generates from the tokens it is handed, so this component of the bill is invisible to the teams paying it. We introduce the Total Cost of Agency (TCA), a decomposition of multi-agent workflow cost into base prompt, inference, memory injection, miss penalty and context-accumulation components, and an exact attribution method: a two-pass, non-billable token count that measures injected tokens directly rather than estimating them from word-count proxies. On a 200-task enterprise benchmark executed against real model APIs, memory injection accounts for 13.6 percent of the variable cost a compile-time optimizer can act on, about 12 percent of the full billed cost, and its share rises from a structural zero at workflow depth one to 27.6 percent at depth six. Injected tokens grow linearly with depth over the measured range (R^2 = 0.9974, depths two through six); a quadratic fit yields a negative leading coefficient, so the data do not exhibit convex growth at these depths. We show the component is controllable at fixed model tier: reducing the retrieval window capacity from 32 to 2 entries lowers injected tokens by 28.7 percent with an accuracy change within seed-level variation. We report in full that our graph-rewriting transforms are approximately cost-neutral in isolation, that two of the five decomposition terms are zero by construction in this harness, and that total workflow cost is dominated by model tier assignment, which we hold fixed and treat as prior work. Prompt caching is not evaluated; all figures are for the uncached case.

AI.tldr: 提出"代理总成本"(TCA)框架，将多智能体LLM工作流成本拆分为基础提示、推理、记忆注入、未命中惩罚与上下文累积五部分，并给出精确归因方法；实测记忆注入约占账单成本12%，且随工作流深度线性增长。
AI.motivation: 多智能体工作流中，节点从记忆检索上下文并注入提示，这些注入token按输入token计费，但现有可观测性工具只报告总token成本，不区分节点生成的token与被"塞给"节点的token，导致这部分成本对付款团队不可见。
AI.method: 提出TCA成本分解（基础提示、推理、记忆注入、未命中惩罚、上下文累积），以及精确归因方法：两遍式、不计费token计数的直接测量（而非用词数代理估计）；在200个任务的企业基准上对真实模型API执行；并用图重写变换与检索窗口容量调整做可控性实验。
AI.result: 记忆注入占编译期优化器可作用可变成本的13.6%、全额计费的约12%；深度为1时结构性为零，深度6升至27.6%；注入token在深度2–6间随深度线性增长(R²=0.9974)，二次拟合首项为负，未出现凸性增长；固定模型层级下将检索窗口从32条降至2条，注入token减少28.7%，精度变化在种子波动范围内。
AI.conclusion: 记忆注入是可测量且可控的成本项，但该测量仅在无缓存条件下成立；图重写变换单独使用时近似成本中性，五项分解中有两项在此框架下按构造为零；总成本主要仍由模型层级分配决定（作者视为先前工作并固定）。提示缓存未评估。

title: Band2Net: Frequency-to-Network Transport Distillation for fMRI-Privileged, EEG-Only Session-Condition Decoding
summary: Functional MRI resolves large-scale brain networks but is expensive and stationary, whereas EEG is portable but poorly localised. We treat fMRI as privileged information, available during training and absent at deployment, with EEG and fMRI acquired from the same participants under matched conditions but not simultaneously. Band2Net encodes EEG into five frequency-specific connectivity graphs and fMRI into seven canonical network tokens from a frozen teacher, and solves a balanced entropic transport problem between the two token sets that gives each EEG band its own fMRI target. In subject-grouped cross-validation on the PsiConnect psilocybin data set, Band2Net reaches 0.801 ROC-AUC for EEG-only session-condition decoding, 5.0 AUC points (95% CI 1.8-8.2) above an EEG-only student. Although its margins over a single shared plan, a KL-relaxed plan and label-free network descriptors remain unresolved, secondary comparisons favour band-specific transported targets over logit, global-feature, contrastive and pooled-target distillation, though not after Holm correction.

AI.tldr: Band2Net将fMRI作为仅在训练期可用的特权信息，通过最优传输为每个EEG频段分配独立fMRI目标，实现EEG单模态的跨会话脑状态解码（ROC-AUC 0.801）。
AI.motivation: fMRI空间分辨率高但昂贵且需静止，EEG便携但空间定位差；希望训练时借用fMRI知识、部署时仅用EEG来弥补EEG定位不足的问题。
AI.method: 同一批被试在匹配条件下（非同时）采集EEG与fMRI。Band2Net把EEG编码为5个频段特异性连接图，用冻结教师模型把fMRI编码为7个经典网络token，并在两组token间求解带熵正则的平衡最优传输，使每个EEG频段获得各自的fMRI目标。
AI.result: PsiConnect裸盖菇素数据集的被试分组交叉验证中，EEG单模态会话状态解码ROC-AUC达0.801，比纯EEG学生模型高5.0个AUC点（95% CI 1.8–8.2）；但相对单一共享传输方案、KL松弛方案及无标签网络描述子的优势尚不明确，次级比较中频段特异性传输目标优于logit、全局特征、对比与池化目标蒸馏，但未通过Holm校正。
AI.conclusion: 频段特异性最优传输是一种可行的fMRI→EEG特权蒸馏方法，主效应显著，但消融与基线的针对性优势尚未确证，结论需谨慎解读。

title: Variable names provide priors: semantic grounding enables data-efficient numerical prediction by large language models
comment: Main text: 30 pages, 6 figures. Supplementary information: 53 pages, 11 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse tasks, from question answering to code generation. Recent studies have found that LLMs can perform numerical prediction on tabular datasets via in-context learning. However, it remains unclear under what conditions and how LLMs use variable names and in-context examples for numerical prediction. Here we show that semantic grounding, the match between variable names and the values they describe, allows five LLMs without task-specific training to match or outperform seven supervised machine learning (ML) models across 20 datasets from nine scientific domains, particularly when examples are scarce. Reasoning traces indicate that variable names allow LLMs to draw on domain-specific knowledge acquired during pretraining. Using controlled tasks based on physical formulas, we further show that LLMs integrate domain-specific knowledge with in-context examples in a way consistent with Bayesian updating. Specifically, when the relationship between the inputs and the target cannot be inferred from the examples alone, LLMs rely on domain-specific knowledge as the prior. Conversely, as contradicting examples accumulate, LLM predictions shift progressively towards these examples, which act as the likelihood. Our work reveals how LLMs use domain-specific knowledge in numerical prediction and positions them as data-efficient predictors for data-scarce scientific domains.

AI.tldr: 变量名与数值的语义匹配（语义接地）使无任务训练的LLM在20个数据集上达到或超越7种监督ML模型，尤其小样本时；LLM像贝叶斯一样整合预训练领域知识（先验）与上下文示例（似然）做数值预测。
AI.motivation: 已有研究发现LLM可通过上下文学习对表格数据做数值预测，但尚不清楚在何种条件下、如何利用变量名和上下文示例。作者想揭示语义接地的作用机制。
AI.method: 对比5个LLM与7个监督ML模型在9个科学领域20个数据集上的表现；分析推理轨迹；并设计基于物理公式的受控任务检验LLM对领域知识与示例的整合方式。
AI.result: 语义接地下LLM可匹配或超越监督模型，样本稀缺时优势明显；推理轨迹显示变量名使LLM调用预训练获得的领域知识；受控实验表明LLM的整合符合贝叶斯更新：示例无法推断关系时依赖领域知识作先验，矛盾示例累积时预测逐渐转向示例（似然）。
AI.conclusion: LLM利用领域知识进行数值预测的机制被揭示，其可作为数据稀缺科学领域的高效预测器。

title: Robust EEG-based Emotion Recognition from Coarse Trial-level Labels under Intra-trial Affective Variability
summary: EEG-based emotion recognition has become an active research area in brain-computer interfaces. However, fine-grained affective annotation is costly, so most datasets provide only a global label for each long EEG trial. For practical emotion recognition, trials are commonly divided into short temporal windows, with the global label propagated to all windows for training. This practice treats trial-level emotion as temporally uniform, although affective responses may fluctuate within a trial. Consequently, windows that weakly reflect or deviate from the global emotional state may receive unreliable labels, posing a key challenge to robust EEG-based emotion recognition. To address this challenge, we propose VARY, a variability-aware robust learning framework for EEG-based emotion recognition from coarse trial-level labels. VARY incorporates a Two-stage Sample Selection (TSS) strategy to identify EEG windows with reliable emotional labels, and introduces MixAug, a data augmentation method tailored for EEG to improve model robustness under limited and unreliable supervision. We comprehensively evaluate VARY under the setting of label-noise learning on two public datasets, using three network architectures and multiple label-noise settings. Our method demonstrates superior performance, achieving a maximum accuracy gain of 11.54% on the DREAMER dataset and 5.39% on the SEED dataset compared with the best-performing baseline, highlighting the effectiveness of VARY in learning from unreliable trial-level labels under intra-trial affective variability.

AI.tldr: 提出VARY框架，从粗粒度试次级标签中进行变异性感知的鲁棒EEG情绪识别，通过两阶段样本选择与MixAug增强应对窗级标签不可靠问题。
AI.motivation: 细粒度情感标注成本高，数据集通常仅提供每个长EEG试次的全局标签；实际中将试次切分为短时窗并传播全局标签训练，隐含"试次内情绪时间均匀"假设，但情感在试次内可能波动，导致弱反映或偏离整体情绪状态的窗口获得不可靠标签，影响鲁棒性。
AI.method: VARY框架包含两部分：1）两阶段样本选择策略（TSS），用于识别具有可靠情绪标签的EEG时间窗；2）MixAug，一种面向EEG定制的数据增强方法，在有限且不可靠监督下提升模型鲁棒性。整体在标签噪声学习设定下训练。
AI.result: 在两个公开数据集（DREAMER、SEED）、三种网络架构及多种标签噪声设置下评估。相比最佳基线，DREAMER最高提升11.54%准确率，SEED最高提升5.39%。
AI.conclusion: VARY能有效应对试次内情感变异性下从不可靠试次级标签学习的问题，显著提升EEG情绪识别鲁棒性与准确率。

title: TopoDPO: Dense Preference Alignment for Structure-Sensitive Aerial Referring Segmentation
summary: Preference optimization for multimodal segmentation faces a granularity mismatch: dense masks contain spatially heterogeneous preference signals, whereas image-level objectives assign one shared nonlinear weight to all spatial margins. We introduce TopoDPO, a topology-aware dense preference alignment framework for structure-sensitive aerial referring segmentation. Topo-Prior mines informative preference pairs using connected-component discrepancy and macro-corner recall, while the dense objective applies the preference penalty to each local margin before spatial aggregation against a frozen supervised reference. On Topo-RS-Hard, a 4590-instance structural stress set, TopoDPO improves intersection over union (IoU) from 50.91% to 51.24% over image-level direct preference optimization (DPO) and reduces Betti-0 error from 1.34 to 0.90; paired image-cluster bootstrap intervals against image-level DPO exclude zero for all five reported metrics. Matched supervised controls and a complete factorial analysis separate the effects of topology-aware pair mining, localized correction, and dense reference-relative preference weighting. An unfiltered stratification over all 39,244 validation records further shows the clearest structural gains on samples with moderate or severe pre-alignment component-count errors. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/phy709/TopoDPO.

AI.tldr: TopoDPO 提出拓扑感知的稠密偏好对齐框架，将偏好惩罚施加于每个局部空间边距后再聚合，并利用连通域差异与角点召回挖掘偏好对，用于结构敏感的航空指代分割。
AI.motivation: 多模态分割的偏好优化存在粒度错配：稠密掩码包含空间异质的偏好信号，而图像级目标对所有空间边距只赋予同一个非线性权重，导致结构敏感场景下对齐不足。
AI.method: 包含两部分：Topo-Prior 基于连通分量差异与大角召回挖掘信息量高的偏好对；稠密目标在空间聚合前对每个局部边距施加偏好惩罚，并以冻结的监督模型为参考做相对偏好加权。
AI.result: 在 Topo-RS-Hard（4590 实例结构压力测试集）上，IoU 由图像级 DPO 的 50.91% 提升至 51.24%，Betti-0 误差从 1.34 降至 0.90；与图像级 DPO 的配对图像簇 bootstrap 区间在五项指标上均不含零。匹配监督对照与全因子分析分离了三项设计的贡献；在全部 39,244 条验证记录上的无过滤分层显示，成分数误差中等或严重的样本结构增益最明显。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑感知的稠密偏好优化能有效缓解粒度错配，带来小幅但统计显著的分割精度提升与明显的拓扑结构改善，尤其利于结构误差较大的样本。

title: InterFuse: Interaction-Guided Adaptive Fusion of Heterogeneous Models for Payment Risk Ranking
summary: Payment platforms use view-specific models trained on transaction attributes, behavioral histories, and relational structures to rank transactions under limited review budgets. However, existing fusion methods often focus on prediction scores or interactions among model representations, with less attention to how these interactions should guide aggregation using each model's original prediction and input coverage. To address this limitation, we propose InterFuse, a fusion framework that uses a shared fusion state from cross-model interaction to guide transaction-adaptive aggregation. InterFuse encodes each model's representation, prediction score, and input coverage as a model-specific token, using learned states for unavailable outputs. Availability-aware attention updates these tokens and produces a shared fusion state. This state then guides aggregation over available models using their updated representations, original predictions, and input coverage. We evaluate InterFuse on an industrial payment replay and three public financial benchmarks using the same upstream models across fusion methods. InterFuse achieves the highest top-ranked recall and AUC on all four datasets, improving Recall@1% by 1.11-8.09 percentage points over the strongest baselines. Ablations show the benefits of cross-model interaction and adaptive aggregation, while industrial analyses find larger interaction gains when model predictions disagree. Additional analyses examine robustness to missing outputs and the trade-off between ranking gains and fusion latency.

AI.tldr: 提出InterFuse融合框架，通过跨模型交互得到的共享融合状态，结合各模型的原始预测与输入覆盖度，引导交易自适应聚合，在工业支付回放与三个公开金融基准上取得最优排序召回与AUC。
AI.motivation: 现有支付平台的多视图模型融合方法多关注预测分数或表征交互，较少考虑如何利用各模型原始预测与输入覆盖度来指导聚合；且实际中存在输出缺失（不可用模型）的情况，需更合理的融合机制。
AI.method: InterFuse将每个模型的表征、预测分数和输入覆盖度编码为模型专属token，对不可用输出使用学习到的状态；采用可用性感知注意力更新token并生成共享融合状态；再用该状态结合更新后的表征、原始预测和覆盖度，对可用模型进行交易自适应聚合。
AI.result: 在工业支付回放及三个公开金融基准上（统一上游模型对比），InterFuse在四项数据集上均取得最高Top排序召回与AUC，Recall@1%较最强基线提升1.11–8.09个百分点；消融验证跨模型交互与自适应聚合的收益；工业分析显示模型预测分歧越大交互增益越大；并分析了缺失输出的鲁棒性及排序增益与融合延迟的权衡。
AI.conclusion: InterFuse通过跨模型交互引导的自适应融合有效提升支付交易排序性能，在预测分歧与输出缺失场景下表现稳健，并为排序增益与延迟权衡提供参考。

title: How Does Chain-of-Thought Supervision Teach Models to Reason? A Theoretical Analysis
summary: Training with chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision is an effective approach for teaching models multi-step reasoning procedures. At inference time, however, models may need to continue reasoning beyond the finite teacher CoT sequences observed during training, and longer reasoning can instead degrade performance, a phenomenon known as overthinking. How the amount and structure of training-time CoT give rise to such failures remains theoretically poorly understood. To study this problem, we introduce an in-context weight prediction model trained on finite gradient descent trajectories for linear regression. Using high-dimensional asymptotic analysis, we show that the success and failure modes of long-horizon reasoning undergo phase transitions depending on the context length and the total amount of training CoT. We further distinguish two mechanisms of overthinking, error accumulation and error amplification, and show that with short training contexts, increasing the training CoT budget can worsen long-horizon error before eventually stabilizing reasoning. Experiments with fully trained linear and multi-head softmax attention further show that these qualitative behaviors persist. Our results provide a theoretical account linking properties of training-time CoT to inference-time failures and offer guidance for designing teacher CoT that supports stable reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过一个在线性回归梯度下降轨迹上训练的上下文权重预测模型，理论分析了训练 CoT 的数据量与结构如何影响长程推理的成功与失败，揭示了随上下文长度和训练 CoT 总量发生相变的规律，并区分了误差累积与误差放大两种过度思考机制。
AI.motivation: CoT 监督能教会模型多步推理，但推理时需要超出训练中有限教师 CoT 序列继续推理，反而可能退化（overthinking）。训练时 CoT 的数量与结构如何导致这类失败，理论上理解不足。作者希望建立训练期 CoT 性质与推理期失败之间的理论联系。
AI.method: 构建在有限梯度下降轨迹（线性回归）上训练的上下文权重预测模型作为可解析研究的代理任务；利用高维渐近分析刻画长程推理的成功/失败模式；并区分过度思考的两种机制：误差累积与误差放大；最后用完整训练的单层线性注意力与多头 softmax 注意力验证定性行为是否延续。
AI.result: 发现长程推理的成功与失败模式会随上下文长度与训练 CoT 总量发生相变；当训练上下文较短时，增加训练 CoT 预算会先使长程误差变差，随后才趋于稳定；误差累积与误差放大是两种不同机制；在完整训练的线性与多头 softmax 注意力中，这些定性行为仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了将训练期 CoT 特性与推理期失败相挂钩的理论解释，并为设计能支持稳定推理的教师 CoT 提供指导：训练 CoT 的预算与上下文结构需协同设计，避免短上下文下盲目增大 CoT 预算带来的过度思考。

title: Text-Assisted Event Stream Visual Place Recognition via Multi-Scale Spatiotemporal Optimal Transport
comment: 17 pages including appendix, 4 figures. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Benefiting from the high dynamic range, high temporal resolution, and low energy consumption of event cameras, low-altitude economic research leveraging event cameras has become a popular topic. Several existing attempts introduce natural-language descriptions into visual place recognition (VPR) to mitigate the sparsity of structural spatial information inherent to event cameras. Nevertheless, these methods still fail to fully address two core challenges: effectively encoding event streams and semantically aligning event streams with text. In this paper, we propose a multi-scale spatial-temporal optimal transport approach, MSTOT-EPR, to address these challenges. Specifically, given event streams and scene text information, we first adopt a visual encoder and a text encoder to extract respective feature representations. We then apply optimal-transport constraints to achieve cross-modal alignment. We then design a cross-modal bottleneck fusion module to further fuse bimodal features. Furthermore, we develop multi-scale spatial optimal transport and inter-frame temporal optimal transport modules to mine high-quality spatial-temporal event features for scene recognition. Extensive experiments on the NYC-Event-VPR and EPRBench datasets fully validate the effectiveness of our proposed framework for event-based VPR. The source code of this paper will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSTOT-EPR，利用多尺度空间-时间最优传输实现事件相机视觉位置识别中的跨模态（事件流-文本）语义对齐与融合。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具有高动态范围、高时间分辨率和低能耗的优点，适用于低空经济场景。但事件流结构空间信息稀疏，现有引入自然语言辅助的VPR方法仍未能有效编码事件流并实现事件流与文本的语义对齐。
AI.method: 先用视觉编码器和文本编码器分别提取事件流与场景文本特征；采用最优传输约束进行跨模态对齐；设计跨模态瓶颈融合模块融合双模态特征；并引入多尺度空间最优传输与帧间时间最优传输模块，挖掘高质量空间-时间事件特征用于场景识别。
AI.result: 在NYC-Event-VPR和EPRBench数据集上的大量实验充分验证了所提框架在事件视觉位置识别任务上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MSTOT-EPR通过多尺度空间与时间最优传输有效解决了事件流编码与事件-文本语义对齐两大挑战，提升了事件相机视觉位置识别性能；代码将在录用后开源。

title: Evolving Memory, Learning to Meta-Control: Test-Time Adaptation for Experience-augmented LLM Agents
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (October 2026)
summary: Self-evolving agents accumulate experience from task streams, but existing frameworks typically rely on fixed pipelines to retrieve and utilize this experience, neglecting when and how to deploy it. We introduce Online Meta-Control of Experience (OMCE), a framework that updates experience memory and learns a meta-control policy from task feedback during test-time adaptation. OMCE employs a lightweight contextual-bandit meta-controller that uses compact retrieval signals to select among four cognitive actions: DIRECT, EPISODE, GUIDE, and DISTILL. This routing mechanism operationalizes three coupled decisions: whether to invoke experience, which memory format to utilize, and when to consolidate new guidance. OMCE evolves online, leveraging task feedback to update the memory bank and refine the routing policy via contextual bandit updates. Experiments on four online adaptation benchmarks across four backbones show that OMCE improves first-attempt success by up to 20.5 percentage points over the strongest compared baseline, while reducing per-task token use by a factor of 5.7 to 62.5 relative to ACE with GPT-5.2. Controlled ablations further support the benefits of learned routing and continued routing policy adaptation.

AI.tldr: OMCE：用轻量上下文赌博机元控制器在测试时自适应中在线学习"何时、如何"使用经验，通过四种认知动作路由实现经验调用的动态决策。
AI.motivation: 自进化智能体虽能从任务流积累经验，但现有框架依赖固定流水线检索和使用经验，忽略了"何时"以及"如何"部署经验这一关键问题。
AI.method: 提出OMCE框架：在测试时自适应中同步更新经验记忆并学习元控制策略。采用轻量上下文赌博机元控制器，基于紧凑检索信号在四种认知动作（DIRECT、EPISODE、GUIDE、DISTILL）间选择，从而统一决定是否调用经验、使用哪种记忆格式、何时固化新指导；并利用任务反馈在线更新记忆库与路由策略。
AI.result: 在四个在线自适应基准、四种骨干模型上，首次尝试成功率最高提升20.5个百分点（相对最强基线）；相比使用GPT-5.2的ACE，每任务token消耗降低5.7至62.5倍。消融实验支持学习式路由与持续策略自适应的收益。
AI.conclusion: 将经验使用建模为可在线学习的元控制问题，而非固定流程，可显著提升成功率并大幅降低token开销。

title: Spend the Bits Where the Tiny Objects Are: Rate-Utility Region Coding for Aerial Detection
summary: Bandwidth-limited aerial cameras must compress their images before a remote detector can find the many tiny objects in them. Threshold-based region-of-interest (ROI) coding sends only confidently detected regions, and because tiny objects provide limited visual evidence and often score low, it can discard the regions that contain them. We propose rate-utility region coding (RUO), which sends a region when its expected detection utility justifies its measured byte cost, choosing to drop it or to send it at low or high quality with one multiplier shared across images. RUO trains no model, uses a standard image codec and decodes in a few milliseconds. On all 1,610 VisDrone-DET test-dev images, RUO uses 42.4% fewer bits than a tuned threshold-based ROI coder, averaged over their shared tiny-object average precision (AP) range. RUO also needs fewer bits for tiny objects than the AV1 Image File Format (AVIF), High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) and three published learned codecs, and its advantage over threshold-based ROI coding persists when the sender and receiver use different detectors. For AP over all object sizes RUO needs 25.4% more bits than the tuned ROI coder, because its allocation drops large regions first at low rates, so it suits tasks that target tiny objects. We plan to release the code.

AI.tldr: 提出 rate-utility 区域编码(RUO)：按"期望检测收益是否抵消实测编码字节代价"决定丢弃/低质/高质发送某区域，单一乘子跨图共享。在 VisDrone-DET 全部 1,610 张图上，tiny-object AP 区间内比调优阈值式 ROI 编码少用 42.4% 比特。
AI.motivation: 带宽受限的航拍相机需先压缩图像再由远端检测器找大量微小目标。基于阈值的 ROI 编码只发送高置信区域，而微小目标视觉证据少、得分低，往往被丢弃——恰好丢掉了目标所在区域。
AI.method: RUO 不训练任何模型，使用标准图像编解码器：对每个区域比较期望检测收益与实测字节代价，据此选择丢弃、低质量或高质量发送；决策由一个跨图像共享的乘子控制。解码仅需数毫秒。
AI.result: 1,610 张 VisDrone-DET test-dev 图像上，在共同 tiny-object AP 范围内平均比调优阈值式 ROI 编码省 42.4% 比特；微小目标所需比特也少于 AVIF、HEVC 及三个已发表学习型编码器；收发端使用不同检测器时优势仍保持。但全尺度 AP 下比调优 ROI 多 25.4% 比特，因其低码率下优先丢弃大区域。
AI.conclusion: RUO 以极低复杂度（免训练、标准编解码、毫秒解码）显著提升微小目标的码率-检测效用，适用于以微小目标为任务目标、且对全尺度精度不敏感的航拍检测场景；代码将开源。

title: Parametric CAD Bench v3: Evaluating Agentic Parametric CAD Authoring from Text and Engineering Drawings
comment: 31 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Benchmark: https://cadbench.ai/ ; tasks and leaderboard: https://hub.harborframework.com/datasets/gnucleus-ai/cad-bench/v3 ; scoring code: https://github.com/gNucleus-AI/freecad-validator
summary: Producing an executable CAD script is not sufficient to establish that an agent has satisfied an engineering design request. Evaluation must also consider the resulting geometry, specified dimensions, and native CAD modeling history. We present Parametric CAD Bench v3, a 100-task benchmark comprising 30 text-to-CAD creation tasks, 30 text-to-CAD create-and-edit tasks, and 40 tasks that reconstruct mechanical parts from engineering drawings. Agents operate in a pinned FreeCAD environment and submit native CAD artifacts to a separate programmatic verifier. The primary metric is mean continuous task reward, combining geometry similarity and specification consistency rather than binary task success. A September 24, 2026 snapshot covers 13 model-agent systems; Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 achieves the highest overall point estimate, 61.03%, and an image-to-CAD mean reward of 84.66%. These measurements describe complete systems, not isolated model capabilities. We release versioned tasks, evaluation configurations, and inspectable result artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出 Parametric CAD Bench v3，一个含 100 个任务的参数化 CAD 智能体基准，强调连续奖励与原生建模历史评估。
AI.motivation: 仅生成可执行 CAD 脚本不足以证明满足工程设计需求，还需评估几何、尺寸规格及原生 CAD 建模历史。
AI.method: 构建 100 任务基准（30 文本生成 CAD、30 文本生成并编辑、40 从工程图重建机械零件）；智能体在固定版本 FreeCAD 环境中操作，提交原生 CAD 文件至独立程序化验证器；主指标为连续任务奖励，融合几何相似度与规格一致性。
AI.result: 2026-09-24 快照覆盖 13 个模型-智能体系统；Claude Code 搭配 Claude Opus 5.5 整体点估计最高 61.03%，图像转 CAD 平均奖励 84.66%。
AI.conclusion: 测量反映完整系统表现而非单一模型能力；发布带版本的任务、评测配置与可检查结果产物。

title: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for Real-Time Electric Vehicle Charging Management in IoEV-Enabled Smart Cities
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures. Authors' accepted manuscript (paper ID 733916, AI2SD 2026 cycle), to appear in an indexed Springer Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems volume. Earlier preprint version deposited on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22208979
summary: The rapid growth of electric vehicles (EVs) in urban environments demands intelligent, decentralised charging management strategies that operate under strict real-time constraints. This paper proposes an Edge-Intelligent architecture in which each EV selects a charging station (CS) by querying a shared, centrally trained Deep Q-Network (DQN) policy over a lightweight MQTT publish-subscribe backbone; independent per-EV edge inference is the deployment target, not the configuration evaluated here. The reported simulation evaluates that shared DQN policy applied sequentially to each vehicle's observations within a single SUMO run, using MQTT for KPI telemetry while observations are obtained through TraCI. The system is evaluated on two real-world road networks from OpenStreetMap (Rabat Agdal-Hay Riad and Tangier, Morocco); the primary network carries four geolocated public charging stations with heterogeneous power levels (50 kW and 150 kW). Three traffic demand profiles (morning, midday, evening peak) are simulated, and four decision policies are compared: an Adaptive Heuristic, a Tabular Q-Learning agent, the proposed DQN agent, and a Double DQN variant. A multi-seed statistical protocol (7 seeds, Wilcoxon signed-rank test, Cohen's d) evaluates the results. The DQN agent achieves a 6.8% relative improvement in charge rate and a 5.4% increase in delivered energy over the Adaptive Heuristic under Evening Peak demand ($p = 0.016$, Cohen's $d = 0.99$ and $1.51$), while showing no advantage in waiting time; on the second network the heuristic leads on waiting time, so the ranking is not stable across geographies. A scalability analysis shows linear state-space growth with station count and sub-millisecond inference; all runs include intermittent station outages under a Markov failure process.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向电动汽车充电站选择的边缘智能架构，中心训练的共享DQN策略经MQTT发布订阅供各车边缘推理；仿真中该策略在SUMO单次运行内顺序应用于每辆车的观测，在两个摩洛哥真实路网、三种需求下与自适应启发式、表格Q-Learning、Double DQN对比，7种子统计显示DQN在晚高峰将充电率相对提升6.8%、交付能量提升5.4%，但等待时间无优势且排序跨地理不稳定。
AI.motivation: 城市电动汽车快速增长，需要严格实时约束下可去中心化执行的智能充电管理策略；同时希望用轻量通信骨干实现可扩展的边缘部署。
AI.method: 提出边缘智能架构：中心训练共享DQN策略，通过轻量MQTT发布/订阅分发，目标为每车独立边缘推理。仿真评估中即在同一SUMO运行内顺序将该共享策略应用于各车观测，观测由TraCI获取，MQTT承载KPI遥测。实验基于OpenStreetMap两个真实路网（拉巴特Agdal-Hay Riad与丹吉尔），主网络含4座地理定位公共充电站（50 kW与150 kW异构功率）；模拟早、中、晚高峰三种需求；对比自适应启发式、表格Q-Learning、DQN与Double DQN四种策略；采用7种子、Wilcoxon符号秩检验与Cohen's d的统计协议；所有运行包含马尔可夫过程下的间歇性充电站故障。
AI.result: 晚高峰下DQN相对自适应启发式充电率相对提升6.8%、交付能量增加5.4%（p=0.016，Cohen's d=0.99与1.51），但等待时间无优势；第二个路网上启发式在等待时间上领先，说明策略排序跨地理不稳定；可扩展性分析显示状态空间随充电站数线性增长，推理延迟低于1毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 共享DQN在充电率与交付能量上优于启发式且推理开销极低、可扩展性好，但未改善等待时间且优势不具跨路网稳健性；论文实际评估的是单运行内顺序应用的中心策略，而非真正的分布式边缘推理，边缘部署仍待验证。

title: Recoverability-Aware Evaluation of Diffusion Video Inpainting and Object Removal
summary: Video inpainting for object removal is scored over the whole hole, although the background behind the object is visible in other frames of the shot for some hole pixels and in no frame for others. A whole-hole score therefore mixes copying with generation and cannot show which of the two a remover does well. To separate the two, we propose recoverability-stratified evaluation, in which a point tracker run on the clean video labels each hole pixel by whether and how far away it is observed, so that fidelity and temporal stability can be reported per stratum against a copy reference. To reuse the observed content, we also propose evidence-guided sampling (EGS), which blends tracked colors into the clean-latent prediction of a video diffusion remover without training. On DAVIS, the perceptual advantage of three diffusion removers over flow propagation shrinks where the content is visible a few frames away (LPIPS difference-in-differences +0.046 to +0.056 against E2FGVI-HQ), and real paired captures show the same pattern for two of them. Their DAVIS hole warping error is two to four times that of ProPainter, and copying along clean-video tracks lowers their recoverable LPIPS by a quarter to two fifths. EGS closes 43% and 56% of the gap to this copy reference on held-out DAVIS when its colors come from clean-video tracks. With colors tracked on the masked input, a pre-registered confirmation finds no gain on MiniMax-Remover and a loss on ROSE. Diffusion removers thus leave observed content unused on DAVIS, and training-free reuse does not yet hold with tracked evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"可恢复性分层评估"，用点跟踪器将每个 hole 像素按"是否在其他帧被观测到"分层，从而把视频补全中的"复制"与"生成"能力分开评估；并据此提出免训练的证据引导采样 EGS。实验发现扩散式移除器在内容可见处优势消失、留下可复用内容未用，EGS 在干净轨迹颜色下有效，但在掩码输入轨迹下无效甚至有害。
AI.motivation: 现有视频物体移除只在整体 hole 上打分，但 hole 内像素的可恢复性差异巨大：部分像素在其他帧可见（可复制），部分从未可见（需生成）。整体分数混合了复制与生成两种能力，无法揭示方法在哪方面强。
AI.method: (1) 以干净视频上的点跟踪器为每个 hole 像素标注其被观测情况（是否可见、距离多远），按层报告保真度与时间稳定性，并以"复制参考"为基准；(2) 提出 Evidence-Guided Sampling (EGS)，免训练地把跟踪到的颜色混入视频扩散移除器的干净潜变量预测中。
AI.result: DAVIS 上，三种扩散移除器相对光流传播的感知优势在"几帧外可见"的内容处缩小（对 E2FGVI-HQ 的 LPIPS 双重差分 +0.046~+0.056），真实配对采集在两例中亦如此；其 hole warping error 是 ProPainter 的 2~4 倍；沿干净轨迹复制使可恢复区 LPIPS 下降 1/4 至 2/5。EGS 在留出 DAVIS 上弥补了与复制参考差距的 43% 与 56%（颜色来自干净轨迹时）；若颜色来自掩码输入轨迹，预注册确认实验显示 MiniMax-Remover 无增益、ROSE 有损失。
AI.conclusion: 扩散式移除器在 DAVIS 上未能利用可观测内容；免训练的证据复用目前仅在干净跟踪证据下成立，基于掩码输入的跟踪证据尚不可靠。

title: UPSHIFT: User Preference Steering from Human-AI Interaction Feedback Traces
summary: Personalizing large language model assistants requires adapting their responses to individual users, including the selection of content, reasoning approach, level of detail, and form of presentation. Such preferences are often latent, becoming visible only when users respond to an initial answer and request revisions. We investigate whether these feedback trajectories can be converted into a reusable personalization signal without explicit preference profiles or labels, prompt-time access to interaction histories, or model parameter updates. We introduce UPSHIFT (User Preference Steering from Human-AI Interaction Feedback Traces), a training-free method that compares the hidden representations of initial and feedback-conditioned responses within each session, averages the resulting trajectory displacements across a user's sessions, and injects the aggregated preference direction when answering a new query. The method is motivated by the implicit-preference hypothesis: although an individual conversational transition may reflect topic progression or task-specific correction, changes that recur across sessions retain a component that captures how the user wants responses to be adjusted. We validate the preference-representation capability of UPSHIFT on PrefEval. In evaluations with 40 simulated users, every tested configuration improves preference alignment over the unsteered baseline on held-out topics for both Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B; the best configuration increases macro-averaged Elo from 1364.0 to 1605.2 and from 1341.9 to 1591.8, respectively. Matched-user and positive-versus-negative controls further demonstrate that these gains arise from the user-specific preference direction and its learned orientation. These results show that interaction histories can provide compact, reusable supervision for lightweight personalization.

AI.tldr: UPSHIFT: a training-free method that turns user revision feedback into a reusable per-user preference direction, improving LLM personalization without profiles, history access, or parameter updates.
AI.motivation: Personalizing LLM assistants requires matching latent user preferences (content, reasoning, detail, presentation) that usually surface only through revision feedback; existing approaches need explicit profiles, prompt-time histories, or fine-tuning.
AI.method: Compare hidden representations of initial vs. feedback-conditioned responses within a session, average the trajectory displacements across a user's sessions, and inject the aggregated preference direction at inference time. No training, labels, or parameter updates.
AI.result: On PrefEval with 40 simulated users, all configurations beat the unsteered baseline on held-out topics for Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B; best macro-averaged Elo went 1364.0→1605.2 and 1341.9→1591.8. Matched-user and pos-vs-neg controls confirm gains come from user-specific direction and its learned orientation.
AI.conclusion: Interaction histories can serve as compact, reusable supervision for lightweight personalization.

title: ReCoG: Relative Node Contexts for Multi-Domain Graph Pre-training
summary: The success of foundation models in language and vision has motivated Graph Foundation Models (GFMs), which learn transferable knowledge through multi-domain graph pre-training. Existing methods advance GFMs through feature unification and structural learning, and in doing so they rely on the raw graph structure to organize node contexts. However, we observe that removing a large proportion of edges from source graphs during pre-training improves cross-domain transfer accuracy across four representative methods. Our theoretical analysis identifies the raw graph structure as a source of conflict in cross-graph model sharing. We therefore advocate defining node contexts using criteria consistent across graphs. Achieving this requires (1) constructing node contexts consistently across graphs without a shared positional structure, such as the token order of text or the pixel grid of images, and (2) retaining the structural and neighborhood information of the original graphs. To this end, we introduce Relative Contexts for Graphs (ReCoG) for multi-domain graph pre-training. Specifically, we first construct attribute contexts to provide a comparison rule independent of the raw graph structure. Furthermore, we construct structural contexts based on common neighbors and semantic contexts based on neighborhood attribute summaries to retain the topological and neighborhood information of the original graphs. Since all graphs share these construction rules, we pre-train a single graph encoder by reconstructing node attributes over these contexts, without domain-specific modules. We conduct extensive experiments on 18 target datasets, which demonstrate the effectiveness of ReCoG. In particular, ReCoG exceeds the strongest baseline by 7.61 percentage points in mean 1-shot cross-domain node classification accuracy and by 4.47 points in cross-type transfer to heterophilous graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReCoG（Relative Contexts for Graphs），用跨图一致的构造规则定义节点上下文，摆脱对原始图结构的依赖，实现无需领域专用模块的多域图预训练。
AI.motivation: 现有图基础模型依赖原始图结构组织节点上下文，而实验观察到预训练时删去大量边反而提升跨域迁移精度；理论分析表明原始图结构是跨图模型共享冲突的来源，需用跨图一致的准则定义节点上下文，同时保留结构与邻域信息。
AI.method: 构建三类上下文：属性上下文提供独立于原始结构的比较规则；结构上下文基于公共邻居；语义上下文基于邻域属性摘要。三者共享统一构造规则，通过在这些上下文上重建节点属性来预训练单一图编码器，不使用领域专用模块。
AI.result: 在18个目标数据集上的大量实验验证有效：平均1-shot跨域节点分类精度超最强基线7.61个百分点，向异配图跨类型迁移超4.47个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以跨图一致的相对上下文替代原始结构组织节点，是构建多域图基础模型的有效方向，且无需领域专用模块即可实现更强的跨域与跨类型迁移。

title: Accurate automated photo-identification of Near Eastern and European fire salamanders
summary: Photo-identification underpins non-invasive capture-recapture monitoring of amphibians, but manual identification becomes slow and error-prone as reference libraries grow. Focusing on the Near Eastern fire salamander (Salamandra infraimmaculata), we developed a pipeline based on zero-shot local-feature matching (SuperPoint and LightGlue) without species-specific training and evaluated it on $2{,}440$ field photographs from Haifa and Tel Dan in northern Israel. We isolated the yellow spot pattern, scored image similarity by the number of high-confidence keypoint matches, which reduced a confound whereby many-spotted individuals accumulate spurious matches, and assigned identities across the database by two-tier clustering. Pipeline-assisted expert review corrected misidentifications, reducing the number of identities by almost a quarter. On held-out individuals, the pipeline ranked the correct individual first for $95.2\%$ of queries and recovered identities with an ARI of $0.958$. Without modification, it reached $95.1\%$ and $91.7\%$ top-1 accuracy on two datasets of the European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) and recognised $93.7\%$ of recaptures in one of them, compared with $38$-$77\%$ for five established programs and $93.9\%$ for visual inspection. Zero-shot local-feature matching thus offers amphibian monitoring a re-identification tool that needs no training data, transfers between related species, scales to databases of over a thousand individuals, and can audit existing databases before capture-recapture analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出基于零样本局部特征匹配(SuperPoint+LightGlue)的两栖动物照片个体重识别流水线，无需物种专属训练即可准确识别，并可跨物种迁移。
AI.motivation: 照片识别支撑两栖动物的非侵入式捕获-重捕监测，但参考库增大后人工识别变慢且易错，需自动化方案。
AI.method: 面向近东火蝾螈，构建零样本局部特征匹配流水线(SuperPoint+LightGlue)，隔离黄色斑点图案，用高置信关键点匹配数衡量图像相似度(减少多斑点个体虚假匹配偏差)，并用两级聚类在库中分配身份；在以色列海法与Tel Dan的2440张野外照片上评估。
AI.result: 流水线辅助专家复核纠正误识别，使身份数减少近四分之一；在留出个体上top-1准确率95.2%，ARI 0.958。未修改即迁移至欧洲火蝾螈两数据集，top-1分别为95.1%和91.7%，其中一集重捕识别率93.7%（五个已有程序为38–77%，人工目检93.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 零样本局部特征匹配为两栖监测提供了无需训练数据、可跨物种迁移、可扩展至上千个体库、并能在捕获-重捕分析前审计现有数据库的重识别工具。

title: Chain of Faith: Policy-Internal Rewards for Reasoning Reliance
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) explanations can sound plausible while having little influence on a model's final answer. We study four rewards that use the policy's own signals to encourage reliance on generated reasoning: gradient sensitivity, confidence gaps, progressive confidence gains, and reasoning--prompt swaps. We add each reward to group relative policy optimization (GRPO) and evaluate two small instruction-tuned models on GSM8K and StrategyQA using reasoning edits, paraphrases, and prompt hints. Several configurations increase answer reliance to reasoning edits, while effects on accuracy and paraphrase robustness vary. We also observe answer copying at a high reward weight and high reliance in decomposition settings with poor task accuracy. The study compares practical objectives for reasoning reliance, confirms the trade-off between reliance and performance, and proposes four lightweight rewards that can improve reasoning reliance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何用策略自身信号构造四种奖励，使模型在生成CoT推理后更依赖该推理得出答案，并将其加入GRPO进行评测。
AI.motivation: CoT解释常常听起来合理，却对模型最终答案影响很小（推理与答案脱耦），需要可操作的训练目标来提升"答案对推理的依赖"。
AI.method: 提出四种基于策略自身信号的奖励：梯度敏感度、置信度差距、渐进式置信度增益、推理—提示交换；分别加入GRPO，在两个小型指令微调模型上于GSM8K和StrategyQA评测，并用推理编辑、复述、提示线索三种干预检验依赖性与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 多种配置能提升答案对推理编辑的敏感性；但对准确率和复述鲁棒性的影响不一致；在高奖励权重下出现"答案抄袭"，在分解类问题上出现高依赖但任务准确率低的现象。
AI.conclusion: 研究比较了提升推理依赖性的实用目标，确认依赖性与性能之间存在权衡，并提出四种可提升推理依赖性的轻量级奖励。

title: Silent Reward and Environment Defects in EV Charging Simulation Benchmarks: A Diagnostic Checklist
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for publication in Bulletin of Electrical Engineering and Informatics (BEEI), ISSN 2089-3191, e-ISSN 2302-9285 (accepted 8 September 2026; in press)
summary: Reinforcement-learning (RL) benchmarks built on microscopic traffic simulators such as SUMO are increasingly used to compare agent architectures for electric vehicle (EV) charging assignment. Unlike crashes, defects in the reward function, the environment's stochastic model, or the state encoding often fail silently: the simulation completes, produces plausible numbers, and the comparison is biased. We report five such defects, found by auditing a five-agent benchmark on OpenStreetMap road networks, stated generically: a shared random generator that desynchronises seed-paired comparisons, an ablation-specific reward clip applied unconditionally, a normalisation mismatch that zeroes a reward term, a per-timestep penalty that should fire once per event, and a state dimensionality documented but never wired into the network. We quantify three: a rejection counter inflated up to 125x across agents/cities, a reward term bounded at about $10^{-4}$ of its intended scale, and a 16.6%/16.3% greedy-action divergence from a state-encoding mismatch. Re-analysing a historical ablation, no A1-A2 effect survives family-wise correction; a 56-run campaign confirms the RNG defect's mechanism directly while showing its correction does not change that conclusion. We provide an eight-item checklist as a low-cost first-pass audit; in a later regeneration, three checks caught two new defects while three further process/artefact defects fell outside its boundary.

AI.tldr: 文章审计了基于SUMO的电动汽车充电分配五智能体RL基准，找出五个"静默"缺陷（共享随机数生成器、无条件奖励裁剪、归一化不匹配、时间步惩罚错误、状态维度未接线），量化了其中三个的影响，并给出八项低成本审计清单。
AI.motivation: 交通仿真类RL基准中的缺陷（如崩溃之外的奖励函数、随机模型、状态编码错误）往往不会显式报错，仿真照常完成并给出貌似合理的数字，从而静默地使智能体比较产生偏差。作者希望系统地发现并量化这类缺陷，提高基准的可信度。
AI.method: 在OpenStreetMap路网上对一个五智能体EV充电分配基准进行人工审计，识别出五类通用缺陷：1) 共享随机数生成器导致配对种子的比较失步；2) 消融专用奖励裁剪被无条件应用；3) 归一化不匹配使某奖励项归零；4) 每时间步惩罚本应每事件触发一次；5) 文档声明的状态维度未真正接入网络。对其中三类做了定量测量，并通过56次运行实验和历史消融重分析验证RNG缺陷机制。
AI.result: 量化结果：拒绝计数器在不同智能体/城市间被夸大最多125倍；某奖励项被限制在其预期量级约10⁻⁴；状态编码不匹配导致16.6%/16.3%的贪婪动作分歧。重分析历史消融后，经族错误率校正，A1–A2效应不再显著；56次运行实验直接证实了RNG缺陷机制，但表明修正该缺陷并不改变上述结论。八项清单在后续再生成中捕获两个新缺陷，另有三项流程/产物缺陷超出其覆盖范围。
AI.conclusion: 静默缺陷会系统性地扭曲基于仿真的RL比较，且普通实验流程难以察觉；低成本的首轮审计清单可有效捕获其中一部分（但非全部）问题。作者呼吁在EV充电RL基准中采用显式审计，并对结论进行多重比较校正后的稳健性检验。

title: MedNet and U$^2$-ViT: A Nested Vision Transformer Diffusion Framework for Diverse Medical Images Generation
summary: The scarcity of diverse, high-quality medical images remains a significant bottleneck in advancing AI-driven medical diagnostics and treatment planning. Traditional datasets often suffer from class imbalances, limited disease coverage, and insufficient variations in imaging conditions - challenges that hinder the development of robust, generalizable models. To address this, we introduce MedNet, a large-scale, multi-modal text-to-image dataset spanning 61 disease categories with 160 classes, covering both humans and animals. We built this with images from trusted public repositories, ensuring data diversity, quality, and ethical compliance. Additionally, we propose U$^2$-ViT, a novel diffusion-based text-to-image generation architecture arranging Vision Transformers (ViTs) in a nested U-Net structure to enhance the generation of diverse, and high-fidelity medical images. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our model achieves the best Fr'echet Inception Distance (FID) score compared to state-of-the-art models. The source code is available at https://github.com/LakshmikarPolamreddy/MedNet-U2-ViT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大规模多模态医学文本-图像数据集MedNet（61个疾病类别、160个类，涵盖人类与动物），并提出嵌套U-Net式ViT扩散生成架构U²-ViT，用于生成多样且高保真的医学图像，FID优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多样化、高质量医学图像稀缺；现有数据集存在类别不平衡、疾病覆盖有限、成像条件变化不足等问题，制约了鲁棒且可泛化的AI医学诊断与治疗规划模型的发展。
AI.method: 构建MedNet数据集：从可信公开仓库收集图像，保证多样性、质量与伦理合规，覆盖61个疾病类别、160个类、跨人类与动物。提出U²-ViT：基于扩散的文本到图像生成架构，将ViT以嵌套U-Net结构组织，以提升医学图像生成的多样性与保真度。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该模型在FID指标上取得优于现有SOTA模型的最佳成绩。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: MedNet数据集结合U²-ViT架构可有效缓解医学图像数据稀缺与分布单一问题，生成高质量多样化医学图像，为医学影像AI提供数据与生成方法支撑。

title: Auditing Representation-Space Fraud Detection: A Bayesian IRL Framework for Calibrated Uncertainty and Its Limits
summary: Shilling detectors for recommender systems are almost always evaluated by one number, detection AUROC, with no account of when it can be trusted. We audit representation-space detection with VEIL (Variational Evaluation via Inverse-reinforcement Learning), a pairwise (Bradley-Terry) Bayesian reward-inference framework over frozen encoder embeddings, following the Bayesian auditing paradigm for LLM alignment [1]: (A) a base posterior; (B) a hierarchical ARD extension with learned confidence; and (C) a label-routed organic/attacker mixture used as an evidence-accumulation check.We prove (Proposition 1) that no detector built on a representation invariant to a transformation of user profiles can outperform chance against an attack that is indistinguishable from organic profiles under that invariance.Detection is near-perfect against synthetic-structure attacks (AUROC 0.936-1.000) but collapses under donor-mimicry, which clones a real user's item set and splices in 1-3 target items. Performance falls to chance on MovieLens-1M (0.48-0.51), partially degrades on Amazon Musical Instruments, and degrades least on CiaoDVD.Donor-mimicry is not undetectable: a non-learned baseline, based on each profile's maximum raw item-set Jaccard similarity to any other profile, reaches AUROC 0.92-0.97 (average precision 0.50-0.57) on all four donor-mimicry configurations, including ML-1M, where every embedding-based score is at chance.The signal is present in the raw profiles, but LightGCN's representation discards it, placing injected profiles closer to their true donor than its zero-propagation MF reduction does (distance 1.98 vs. 3.09). Severity varies by dataset, encoder, and detection method, with no single axis predicting the others. The limit lies in the representation, not the attack, and raw-similarity checks are a necessary complement to any learned detector.
