AI.tldr: 论文通过VEIL贝叶斯奖励推断框架审计推荐系统托攻击检测，发现基于表征的检测器在"捐赠者模仿"攻击下失效，证明局限在于表征本身而非攻击，并提出原始相似度检测作为必要补充。
AI.motivation: 现有托攻击检测器几乎只用单一AUROC数值评估，缺乏对其可信时机与条件的分析；作者希望审计表征空间检测方法在何种攻击下会失效及其根本原因。
AI.method: 提出VEIL（基于Bradley-Terry成对比较的贝叶斯奖励推断）框架，在冻结编码器嵌入上运行三种变体：A基础后验、B带学习置信度的分层ARD扩展、C标签路由的有机/攻击者混合；并给出命题1（对某变换不变的表征无法在该不变性下超越随机）；同时用原始物品集Jaccard相似度作为非学习基线对照。
AI.result: 对合成结构攻击检测近乎完美（AUROC 0.936–1.000），但在捐赠者模仿攻击下崩溃：MovieLens-1M降至随机水平（0.48–0.51），Amazon Musical Instruments部分退化，CiaoDVD退化最小。原始Jaccard基线在所有四种配置达AUROC 0.92–0.97（AP 0.50–0.57），含ML-1M。LightGCN表征丢弃了信号（注入profile距真实捐赠者1.98，而零传播MF为3.09）。
AI.conclusion: 检测的严重程度随数据集、编码器和检测方法变化，无单一轴可预测其他轴；根本限制在于表征而非攻击，原始相似度检查应作为任何学习型检测器的必要补充。

title: Spectral Signatures of Memorization Basins in Diffusion Trajectories
summary: Diffusion models are known to reproduce individual examples from their training data as a form of memorization with implications for generalization, privacy, and downstream use. Recent work demonstrated that memorized training samples reside inside contiguous regions of the data/latent space known as basins of memorization -- once a denoising trajectory enters a basin, under finite perturbations it irreversibly reproduces a memorized example. Prior empirical work on such basins in trained models has primarily focused on classifier-free guidance based detection and mitigation strategies in text-to-image models, leaving basin entry and their formation largely uncharacterized. In this paper, we present a geometric characterization of memorization basins for conditional, unconditional, and rectified-flow-based diffusion models. We observe a characteristic signature in the local spectrum of the function geometry that distinguishes basin entry: the emergence of a dominant singular mode followed by a sharp spectral recovery. This signature appears at two timescales: along denoising trajectories during inference and over the course of training. We further investigate whether these geometric signatures can be used to intervene on memorization. During training, we suppress memorization by acting on the dominant mode. At inference, we develop methods to identify trajectories entering memorization basins and steer them away. We find that these interventions remain effective even with low-dimensional approximations of the underlying geometry, and demonstrate that geometry-informed steering extends to large-scale text-to-image diffusion models. Together, our results corroborate that local spectral geometry provides a common basis for characterizing memorization and for suppressing, detecting, and steering away from it across training and generation.

AI.tldr: 本文从局部谱几何角度刻画扩散模型的记忆盆地（memorization basins），发现盆地进入时函数几何局部谱出现"主导奇异模态涌现+谱急剧恢复"的特征签名，并据此在训练与推理阶段实现记忆抑制、检测与规避。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型会复现训练样本（记忆化），带来泛化、隐私与下游使用风险。已有工作发现记忆样本位于数据/隐空间的连续"记忆盆地"内，但此前研究多集中于文生图模型中的无分类器引导检测与缓解，对盆地如何进入及其形成机制缺乏刻画。
AI.method: 对有条件、无条件及基于rectified flow的扩散模型进行记忆盆地的几何刻画；分析函数几何的局部谱，识别盆地进入的签名（主导奇异模态出现后谱急剧恢复），并在去噪轨迹（推理）与训练过程中两个时间尺度上验证；训练时作用于主导模态抑制记忆，推理时识别进入记忆盆地的轨迹并将其导离；进一步用低维近似和几何引导的steering方法。
AI.result: 发现局部谱签名可稳定区分盆地进入，且在推理去噪轨迹和训练过程两个时间尺度上均出现；低维几何近似下的干预仍有效；训练中对主导模态的作用可抑制记忆化；推理中的几何引导可检测并规避记忆盆地，且可扩展至大规模文生图扩散模型。
AI.conclusion: 局部谱几何为刻画记忆化提供了统一基础，可贯穿训练与生成阶段实现记忆的抑制、检测与导离，说明几何视角是理解与干预扩散模型记忆的有效途径。

title: NatureFusion: Rethinking Infrared and Visible Image Fusion as Natural Complementary Enhancement
summary: In the absence of ground truth, most existing infrared and visible image fusion methods pursue fidelity to the source images and directly superimpose two physically distinct modalities. As a result, salient infrared targets appear as bright patches of thermal radiation pasted onto the scene. These patches obscure the original color and texture of the targets, so the fused images look unnatural to human observers and deviate from the data distribution learned by vision models pretrained on visible images. Therefore, we redefine infrared and visible image fusion as natural complementary enhancement rather than source fidelity, and propose NatureFusion, which exploits cross-modal complementary cues to infer a clear and natural visible-style image from low-quality visible and infrared image pairs. Specifically, to address the lack of ground truth, we employ a generative foundation model as the teacher to directly generate visually natural fused images for supervision. Furthermore, to fully distill the teacher's generative capability while reducing computational cost, we fine-tune a pretrained generative model with conditional flow matching through a light-weight fusion adapter. Last but not least, to further improve downstream performance without sacrificing natural appearance, we freeze the fusion adapter and introduce a detector-supervised task adapter that strengthens the complementary contribution of infrared. Extensive comparisons with seven multi-modal fusion and seven single-modality enhancement methods demonstrate that NatureFusion generates visually natural fused images with the best perceptual quality. Detection and segmentation models pretrained on visible images achieve substantially higher accuracy on our fused images than on those of any competing method.

AI.tldr: NatureFusion 将红外与可见光图像融合重新定义为"自然互补增强"，用生成式基础模型作为教师、以轻量融合适配器通过条件流匹配微调生成模型，并从视觉自然性与下游任务性能两方面超越多种融合与增强方法。
AI.motivation: 现有融合方法追求对源图像的保真并直接叠加两种物理特性不同的模态，导致红外显著目标呈现为亮色热辐射斑块，遮盖原目标的颜色与纹理，融合结果不自然，且偏离可见光预训练视觉模型的数据分布。作者由此质疑"源保真"这一目标本身。
AI.method: 1) 重新定义任务为自然互补增强：由低质量可见光与红外图像对推断清晰、自然的可见光风格图像；2) 因缺乏真值，采用生成式基础模型作为教师直接生成视觉自然的融合图像以提供监督；3) 为充分蒸馏教师生成能力并降低算力，通过轻量融合适配器以条件流匹配微调预训练生成模型；4) 冻结融合适配器，引入检测器监督的任务适配器以增强红外的互补贡献，且不牺牲自然外观。
AI.result: 与 7 种多模态融合方法和 7 种单模态增强方法的广泛比较表明：NatureFusion 生成的融合图像具有最佳的感知质量；在可见光图像上预训练的检测与分割模型在其融合图像上的精度显著高于所有对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 红外与可见光融合应追求自然互补增强而非源保真；借助生成式基础模型蒸馏、流匹配轻量适配器与检测器监督的任务适配器，可同时获得视觉自然且对下游视觉模型友好的融合结果。

title: Reap: Uncovering Monte Carlo proof search with a lightweight model
summary: We present Reap, an open framework for learning and analyzing formal proof search in Lean4. Reap implements policy-value-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search directly in Lean, sharing proof-state transitions, AND-OR search, and replay verification between inference and training rollouts. Structured action logs expose how neural predictions and tactic execution interact during search. Using this framework, we train Reaper-1, a 1.7B-parameter policy-value model, through continued pre-training, supervised tactic learning, and iterative search-based reinforcement learning. Using a separate premise selector, the final system solves 79.9% of miniF2F-test at pass@32, establishing state-of-the-art performance among open provers of comparable size while remaining competitive with substantially larger models. Beyond improved solve rates, our results suggest that RL strengthens the prover's ability to organize proofs around useful intermediate results, favoring substantial advances over repeated local adjustments. This more directed proof construction is accompanied by increasingly elaborate tactic programs: fewer explicit search decisions are needed, while more work is performed within each decision. The resulting trade-off between search effort and tactic execution cost provides insight into how learning changes the prover's problem-solving strategy.

AI.tldr: Reap 是直接在 Lean4 中实现的策略-价值引导 MCTS 框架，并据此训练 1.7B 的 Reaper-1，在 miniF2F-test pass@32 上达到 79.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有形式化证明搜索缺少统一的开源框架，使推理与训练过程割裂，难以观察神经预测与 tactic 执行在搜索中的交互，也难以分析学习如何改变证明搜索策略。
AI.method: Reap 框架：在 Lean 中实现 policy-value 引导的 MCTS，推理与训练 rollout 共享证明状态转移、AND-OR 搜索与重放验证；结构化 action log 暴露搜索过程。训练流程为继续预训练、监督式 tactic 学习、迭代式基于搜索的 RL，外加独立的 premise 选择器。
AI.result: miniF2F-test 上 79.9% pass@32，同等规模开源证明器中 SOTA，可与更大模型竞争。分析显示 RL 使证明更倾向于围绕有用中间结果组织（大跨步推进而非局部微调），tactic 程序更复杂：显式搜索决策更少，单次决策内完成更多工作。
AI.conclusion: 学习改变了证明器的求解策略，体现为搜索努力与 tactic 执行成本之间的权衡；Reap 提供了可复用的分析与训练基础设施。

title: ReFrame: Silence-Aware Compute Reclamation for Full-Duplex Speech Models
summary: Full-duplex speech models execute dense model inference for every audio frame throughout a live interaction. This uniform framewise schedule creates sustained GPU load across dialogue states whose computation has strong, reusable temporal structure. ReFrame formulates full-duplex inference as a silence-aware computation problem. Mutual Silence Speculation (MSS) operates when both participants are silent: it evaluates multi-frame Temporal continuations, verifies text and hidden-state stability, and applies batched Mimi audio-token correction. Listening Frame Folding (LFF) operates while the user speaks and the agent listens: it processes already-arrived user frames through parallel Temporal execution and frame-batched audio-token generation while accepting only the verified prefix. Frame-Budget Reinvestment (FBR) assigns the released frame intervals to resumable external retrieval and language-model workers, then injects timely references through Moshi's conditioning interface. We instantiate ReFrame on five full-duplex models spanning Moshi-family, phase-structured, and flattened autoregressive generation. Across the complete 1,225-conversation FDBench, ReFrame reduces measured GPU execution time by 18.80-31.01% and retains 96.92-100% non-PAD text agreement on five different models. On HaluEval tests, FBR increases the number of correct generated spoken answers from 86 to 205 under the same auxiliary-service budget. ReFrame turns recurring dialogue structure into lower inference cost and higher end-to-end service capability.

AI.tldr: ReFrame将全双工语音推理重新定义为"沉默感知计算"问题，在双方沉默或用户说话/智能体倾听时利用对话的时间结构跳过或批量执行冗余帧计算，并回收释放的算力用于检索等辅助任务，在多种全双工模型上显著降低GPU时间同时保持文本一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有全双工语音模型对每个音频帧都执行稠密推理，无论对话处于何种状态，造成持续的GPU负载；而对话状态（如双方沉默、一方倾听）本身具有强且可复用的时间结构，这种统一逐帧调度是冗余的。
AI.method: 提出三个机制：1) Mutual Silence Speculation (MSS)——双方沉默时对多帧时间延续进行推测，验证文本与隐状态稳定性并批量修正Mimi音频token；2) Listening Frame Folding (LFF)——用户说话、智能体倾听时，用并行Temporal执行与帧批量化音频token生成处理已到达帧，仅接受验证过的前缀；3) Frame-Budget Reinvestment (FBR)——将释放的帧间隔分配给可恢复的外部检索与语言模型worker，并通过Moshi conditioning接口注入及时引用。
AI.result: 在Moshi系列、phase-structured和扁平化自回归共5个全双工模型上，于完整1,225轮FDBench对话中减少GPU执行时间18.80-31.01%，并保持96.92-100%非PAD文本一致率；在HaluEval上，相同辅助服务预算下FBR将正确生成的口语答案数从86提升至205。
AI.conclusion: ReFrame表明，将反复出现的对话结构转化为计算优化可同时降低推理成本并提升端到端服务能力。

title: Special and General Computational Aesthetics
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Presented at the 2026 CCF Chinese Conference on Computational Art (CCAC 2026), Jinan, China, October 2026; to appear in the conference proceedings
summary:
Computational aesthetics is a field at the intersection of computer science, artificial intelligence, aesthetics, and other disciplines. As AI has developed, the field has formed relations of inclusion, intersection, or support with computational art, AI art, AI aesthetics, AI-generated content (AIGC), computational creativity, affective computing, and neuroaesthetics. Without distinguishing scope, objectives, and methods, it may be narrowed to image aesthetic quality assessment or expanded into an umbrella term for AI's involvement in art.
  We analyze its internal structure and its relations with neighboring concepts, and propose a two-level scope: special computational aesthetics (SCA) and general computational aesthetics (GCA). SCA centers on aesthetic measurement and aesthetic process modeling. The former primarily corresponds to "Aesthetic Perception": computationally identifying and representing aesthetic attributes and predicting human aesthetic evaluations; the latter primarily to "Aesthetic Understanding": computationally describing, testing, and explaining how human aesthetic perception and judgment are formed. GCA extends this core to include "Aesthetic Generation," namely artistic generation guided by computational aesthetic models. Some computational aesthetic tasks can also use non-AI methods. Research in this scope using AI algorithms and models we define as AI aesthetics, which may involve the special core and the general extension. "Aesthetic Generation" intersects with AIGC, AI art, and computational creativity, but belongs to the general extension defined here only when computational aesthetic models substantively constrain, guide, or optimize artwork generation. We also draw on Feng Peng's discussion of the computability of beauty, aesthetic experience, and art as a theoretical reference for clarifying boundaries between computational aesthetics and related concepts.

AI.tldr: 论文厘清计算美学与AI艺术、AIGC、计算创造力等邻近概念的关系，提出"特殊计算美学（SCA）"与"一般计算美学（GCA）"两层范围界定，并将使用AI算法的该范围研究定义为AI美学。
AI.motivation: 当前计算美学与计算艺术、AI艺术、AI美学、AIGC、计算创造力、情感计算、神经美学等概念关系混乱；若不区分范围、目标与方法，该领域易被窄化为图像美学质量评估，或被泛化为"AI介入艺术"的伞形术语。
AI.method: 概念分析与结构分析：剖析计算美学的内部结构及与邻近概念的关系；借鉴Feng Peng关于美、审美体验与艺术可计算性的讨论作为划定边界的理论参照；据此提出两层范围框架。
AI.result: 提出两级范围：SCA以审美测量与审美过程建模为核心，分别对应"Aesthetic Perception"（计算识别与表征审美属性、预测人类审美评价）与"Aesthetic Understanding"（计算描述、检验与解释人类审美感知与判断的形成）；GCA将核心扩展至受计算美学模型引导的"Aesthetic Generation"。SCA任务亦可采用非AI方法；用AI方法的该范围研究定义为AI美学。
AI.conclusion: "Aesthetic Generation"与AIGC、AI艺术、计算创造力相交，但仅当计算美学模型实质性地约束、引导或优化作品生成时，才属于此处定义的一般扩展；该两层框架为区分计算美学与相关概念提供了边界。

title: Human-Oriented World Model
summary: Supporting a person over repeated interactions requires interpreting their current state in context and anticipating its subsequent evolution. We formulate the \emph{Human-Oriented World Model} (HOWM) as a conceptual framework centered on task-relevant human states and their evolution. HOWM connects current observations and individual history with environmental and social context to organize continuing state estimation, personalized dynamics prediction, and action support. Dynamic expectations and new observations jointly inform the current estimate, which in turn anchors personalized forecasts based on shared knowledge and individual experience. An external policy relates forecasts under alternative conditions to the person's goals, preferences, and constraints when considering support. Actual responses and outcomes provide evidence for revising the state estimate and personal dynamic patterns, thereby informing subsequent estimation, prediction, and support. We illustrate the framework through hypothetical training and learning scenarios. Our research agenda asks whether accumulated interaction experience improves subsequent estimation and prediction, and whether using the model helps the person pursue their goals over time.

AI.tldr: 提出"以人为中心的世界模型"(HOWM)概念框架，围绕任务相关的人类状态及其演化，统一持续状态估计、个性化动态预测与行动支持，并通过交互反馈闭环自我修订。
AI.motivation: 在长期重复交互中支持人，需要结合情境理解其当前状态并预判其后续演化，而现有工作缺乏一个将状态估计、个性化预测与支持决策整合起来的统一概念框架。
AI.method: 以概念框架形式构建HOWM：将当前观测与个体历史同环境、社会情境关联；动态期望与新观测共同更新当前状态估计；估计结果锚定基于共享知识与个体经验的个性化预测；外部策略结合人的目标、偏好与约束，把不同条件下的预判转化为支持行动；实际反应与结果作为证据，反向修正状态估计与个人动态模式。
AI.result: 属概念性研究，未报告实证结果；通过假设性的训练与学习场景对框架进行说明，并给出研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 核心研究问题为：积累的交互经验能否改善后续估计与预测，以及使用该模型能否帮助个体随时间更好地实现目标。

title: Missingness-Aware Prior-Data Fitted Network for Irregular Clinical Time-Series
summary: Clinical time series are irregularly observed with laboratory measurements recorded at uneven intervals and observation patterns often reflecting patient state, clinical concern, and site-specific practice. Consequently, missingness is not merely a nuisance factor but an informative signal for prediction. We propose a Missingness-Aware Prior-Data Fitted Network (MA-PFN) for irregular clinical time-series prediction. MA-PFN first learns a diffusion-based prior over joint laboratory value and observation-mask trajectories from source-domain electronic health records, capturing both physiological dynamics and measurement processes. Synthetic trajectories sampled from this prior are then transformed into context-query tasks to train a PFN-style conditional predictor. Once trained, the model performs prediction for new admissions in a single forward pass, requiring neither retraining nor parameter adaptation on target datasets. The framework naturally supports both imputation and forecasting through different context-query constructions. We conduct internal validation on a held-out MIMIC-III test set and external validation on eICU, evaluating both imputation and forecasting and assessing cross-domain generalization under shifts in patient populations, clinical practices, and observation mechanisms. MA-PFN achieves the best performance across all evaluated settings, with Overall/Macro nRMSD ranging from (0.193/0.186) for internal imputation to (0.297/0.297) for external forecasting, without target-domain adaptation. These results demonstrate that learning missingness-aware task priors enables accurate and transferable clinical time-series prediction under informative missingness.

AI.tldr: MA-PFN 通过学习含观测掩码的扩散先验并转化为 PFN 上下文-查询任务，实现无需目标域重训练的临床不规则时序插补与预测。
AI.motivation: 临床时序观测不规则，缺失模式本身反映患者状态、临床关注与站点习惯，是信息性信号而非纯噪声，但现有方法多未显式建模这一过程。
AI.method: 先用扩散模型在源域 EHR 上学习化验值与观测掩码的联合轨迹先验，采样合成轨迹并构造 context-query 任务，训练 PFN 风格条件预测器；推理时单次前向完成预测，通过不同构造同时支持插补与预测。
AI.result: 内部（MIMIC-III 留出集）与外部（eICU）验证中，插补与预测全部设置最优；Overall/Macro nRMSD 从内部插补 (0.193/0.186) 到外部预测 (0.297/0.297)，且无目标域适配。
AI.conclusion: 学习缺失感知的任务先验可在信息性缺失下实现准确、可迁移的临床时序预测，并具备跨人群、临床实践与观测机制的泛化能力。

title: EgoMo3R: Joint Egocentric Motion and Scene Reconstruction
summary: Understanding holistic 3D human motion and the surrounding environment from egocentric video is fundamental for applications in AR/VR and robotics. Although these tasks are inherently coupled, existing methods treat them separately. In particular, egocentric motion reconstruction methods typically assume access to metric, gravity-aligned camera trajectories from specialized inertial sensors. Recovering such trajectories from monocular egocentric video remains a significant challenge due to rapid head movements and motion blur. We present EgoMo3R, a joint optimization framework that simultaneously reconstructs 3D human motion and scene geometry from casual egocentric video. It leverages the robustness of low-level visuo-geometric primitives, including monocular depth, optical flow, and point tracks, integrated with a diffusion-based human motion prior via first-order optimization. We propose an alternating optimization scheme that establishes a synergistic feedback loop: scene reconstruction provides physical grounding and trajectory conditioning for the motion prior, while the motion prior regularizes the camera trajectory and anchors the scene in a metric, gravity-aligned world frame. We evaluate EgoMo3R on the highly dynamic sequences of the EgoExo4D and Nymeria datasets and show that it outperforms specialized baselines in both 3D scene reconstruction and egocentric motion estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoMo3R，一个联合优化框架，从随意的第一人称视频中同时重建3D人体运动和场景几何。
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频中整体3D人体运动与环境理解对AR/VR和机器人至关重要，但现有方法将二者分开处理；运动重建方法通常依赖惯性传感器提供度量、重力对齐的相机轨迹，而仅凭单目视频恢复此类轨迹因头部快速运动和运动模糊而极具挑战。
AI.method: 利用单目深度、光流、点轨迹等低层视觉几何基元的鲁棒性，与基于扩散的人体运动先验通过一阶优化结合；提出交替优化方案建立协同反馈循环——场景重建为运动先验提供物理约束与轨迹条件，运动先验反过来正则化相机轨迹并把场景锚定到度量、重力对齐的世界坐标系。
AI.result: 在EgoExo4D和Nymeria数据集的高动态序列上评估，3D场景重建和第一人称运动估计均优于专用基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化人体运动与场景几何可相互促进，无需专用惯性传感器即可从单目第一人称视频获得度量、重力对齐的重建结果。

title: GeoGuesser Bench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Agents on Interactive Geolocation
summary: Vision-language model (VLM) agents that act in the open world need two abilities: world knowledge to interpret what they see, and exploration to find what they cannot yet see. We study how agents combine the two through interactive visual geolocation. GeoGuesser Bench contains 282 tasks in an offline Street View environment where agents rotate, zoom, and move between real panoramas. Its three task types shift the balance from knowledge to exploration: agents (1) report the coordinates of their starting location, (2) name the enclosing street, city, state, or country, or (3) find, read, and count nearby objects. The coordinate tasks in (1) also include 42 real GeoGuessr World Championship rounds, whose expert guesses provide a human reference. We evaluate 23 VLMs: the best accuracy is 62.5% on place naming and 35.0% on object finding, and the best agent averages 4352.4 GeoGuessr points on the championship rounds, against 4770.3 for the better expert in each round. Beyond these headline numbers, world knowledge and exploration are only weakly correlated across models: agents that localize well do not necessarily explore well. To understand where agents fail, we categorize their errors into vision, navigation, and tool-use failures. Further ablations show that the strongest agents, such as Claude Opus 4.8, still perform well with limited views, while weaker agents degrade; customizing the environment thus adjusts task difficulty. The environment's verifiable rewards and restorable state also support training, and our Planner-Worker-Compressor harness cuts planner tokens by 57-61% by compacting the interaction history. We hope GeoGuesser Bench and its environment serve as a high-quality foundation for simulating real-world exploration at scale.

AI.tldr: 提出 GeoGuesser Bench：282 个离线街景交互式视觉地理定位任务，评测 23 个 VLM agent 的世界知识与探索能力，发现二者仅弱相关。
AI.motivation: 开放世界中的 VLM agent 需同时具备"世界知识"（理解所见）与"探索"（寻找未见）两种能力，但现有基准少有能在交互环境中联合考察二者的。
AI.method: 构建离线 Street View 环境（可旋转、缩放、移动真实全景图）与 282 个任务，分三类：报告起点坐标、命名街道/城市/州/国家、查找并计数附近物体；其中坐标类含 42 个真实 GeoGuessr 世锦赛回合作人类参照。评测 23 个 VLM，并将错误分为视觉、导航、工具使用三类；另做多视角消融与 Planner-Worker-Compressor 框架实验。
AI.result: 最佳地点命名准确率 62.5%，物体查找 35.0%；最佳 agent 在世锦赛回合平均 4352.4 分（专家 4770.3 分）。世界知识与探索跨模型仅弱相关；环境难度可调；Planner-Worker-Compressor 使 planner token 减少 57-61%。
AI.conclusion: GeoGuesser Bench 具备可验证奖励与可恢复状态，支持训练，可作为规模化模拟真实探索的高质量基础。

title: Privacy-Preserving ECG-HRV Emotion Classification for Mood Swing Detection using Federated Learning on Constrained Edge Devices
summary: This paper presents a privacy-preserving mood monitoring framework that classifies emotional states from ECG-derived heart rate variability (HRV) features. The framework is evaluated on three public datasets comprising 74 participants and further validated using a wearable device in a pilot study. Leave-One-Participant-Out cross-validation (LOPO-CV) is used to assess generalization to unseen individuals. A series of experiments investigates the impact of temporal windowing, HRV feature selection, and class balancing on both four-class valence-arousal and binary valence classification. Results show that class balancing substantially improves minority-class recall, while Logistic Regression consistently outperforms five alternative classifiers and achieves competitive performance against HRV-based baselines. Pilot validation using a Polar H10 wearable achieves 75% binary valence accuracy on an unseen individual without calibration, demonstrating the feasibility of real-world deployment. To preserve privacy, the framework is also implemented using federated learning on a six-node Raspberry Pi cluster. Federated Logistic Regression achieves performance comparable to centralized training without sharing raw physiological data. These results demonstrate the potential of interpretable and privacy-preserving mood monitoring for continuous mental health assessment in clinical and community settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于ECG衍生HRV特征的情绪监测隐私保护框架，通过时序窗口、特征选择与类别平衡实验，并在Polar H10可穿戴与六节点树莓派联邦学习部署上验证可行性。
AI.motivation: 连续心理健康评估需要可从生理信号推断情绪的手段，但生理数据敏感，集中式训练存在隐私风险，且跨个体泛化与少数类识别仍是难题。
AI.method: 从ECG提取HRV特征做效价-唤醒四分类与效价二分类；在3个公开数据集（74名被试）上用LOPO-CV评估跨被试泛化；系统考察时序窗口划分、HRV特征选择与类别平衡的影响；用Polar H10开展无校准被试试点验证；并以联邦学习在六节点Raspberry Pi集群上实现框架。
AI.result: 类别平衡显著提升少数类召回；逻辑回归在六种分类器中稳定最优，且与HRV基线相比具有竞争力；Polar H10在未见个体无校准条件下二分类效价准确率达75%；联邦逻辑回归性能接近集中式训练且不共享原始生理数据。
AI.conclusion: 可解释、隐私保护的情绪监测在临床与社区场景的连续心理健康评估中具备落地潜力。

title: Zero-shot evaluation of open vision-language models as System 1 decision models on radiology tasks
summary: Purpose: We compared two multimodal System 1 decision models, Clef 27B and d1 3B, with a traditional LLM (Qwen 3.8-27B) on seven radiology tasks covering text, radiographs, CT and MRI. Methods: Three models were compared: Clef, Qwen3.8-27B and d1. Three tasks were interpretation of text and 4 were detection of finding in images. The tasks were: 1. finding presence of finding in CT-RATE chest CT reports; 2. Presence of finding in PadChest chest radiograph reports; 3. the same 18 findings on CT-RATE chest CT but 3D volumes; 4. MR safety status of devices from AccessGUDID device records; 5. line and tube position on RANZCR CLiP chest radiographs; 6. motion-artifact severity on MR-ART T1-weighted brain MRI and 7. sequence identification on BraTS 2021 brain MRI. The primary endpoint was AUROC. There was no fine-tuning of the models on the tasks. Results: All models completed all tests without a failed request. All retrieved findings from reports almost perfectly (AUROC >0.95). Clef ranked higher than its Qwen backbone on CT-RATE volumes and RANZCR lower on MR-ART. The two did not differ on BraTS, GUDID or PadChest, and differed by 0.002 on CT-RATE reports. On BraTS, Clef correctly identified 90 of 100 FLAIR volumes while Qwen never chose it. d1 ranked lower than Clef on six of seven tasks. No model performed well on motion severity. Clef was faster per request than Qwen on tasks with many questions per input. d1 used 3 to 9 times less energy per request than Clef. Conclusions: System 1 models can perform important tasks in radiology with high accuracy, at lower compute cost than LLMs used in the usual way. When an LLM is constrained to a single answer token, its cost and performance is similar to System 1 models unless multiple questions are asked. A 3B System 1 model was close to the 27B models on report text but not on images. No model performed well on motion severity.

AI.tldr: 研究比较两个多模态System 1决策模型（Clef 27B、d1 3B）与传统LLM（Qwen3.8-27B）在7项放射学任务上的表现（AUROC为主终点），结果显示System 1模型能以更低算力达到高准确率，但在图像类任务与运动伪影严重度评估上仍有局限。
AI.motivation: 探索System 1式决策模型能否在放射学任务中以更低计算成本替代常规使用的LLM，并与LLM骨干模型及小模型进行系统性对比。
AI.method: 对比Clef、Qwen3.8-27B与d1三个模型，在7项任务（3项文本报告解读＋4项图像检测：CT-RATE胸部CT报告与3D体积、PadChest胸片报告、GUDID器械MR安全性、RANZCR CLiP导管/管线位置、MR-ART运动伪影严重度、BraTS 2021序列识别）上零样本测试，以AUROC为主要终点，并统计每请求耗时与能耗。
AI.result: 全部请求无失败；报告类findings检索AUROC均>0.95。Clef在CT-RATE体积、RANZCR优于Qwen骨干，在MR-ART较差，BraTS/GUDID/PadChest及CT-RATE报告无差异（差0.002）；BraTS上Clef正确识别90/100 FLAIR而Qwen从未选中。d1在7项中6项低于Clef。无模型在运动伪影严重度上表现良好。Clef在多问题输入任务中更快，d1每请求能耗为Clef的1/3~1/9。
AI.conclusion: System 1模型可在放射学重要任务上以更低算力实现高准确率；LLM受限为单答案token时性能与成本接近System 1模型（除非需多问题并行）；3B System 1模型在报告文本上接近27B模型但图像任务不佳；运动伪影严重度评估仍是共同短板。

title: Beyond Answers, Traces, and Efficiency: Evidence for Adaptive Reasoning
summary: Current AI systems are evaluated as reasoners through final-answer accuracy, reasoning traces, process supervision, and computational or human-relative efficiency. Yet these measures do not establish whether reasoning adapts when tasks or evidence change. We distinguish across-task adaptivity, where acquired abstractions transfer or recombine across novel problems, fromwithin-task adaptivity, where hypotheses and actions are revised in response to new observations, feedback, or counterexamples. Using ARC-AGI as a diagnostic case study rather than an alignment benchmark, we examine what existing measures leave unresolved when test-time search, sampling, or adaptation affects performance. We propose intervention-oriented evaluation that tests abstraction transfer and hypothesis revision under controlled changes to tasks and evidence, with explicit reporting of test-time procedures and budgets. This perspective supports evaluating systems for robustness, responsiveness to corrective feedback, and auditability under changing conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前AI推理评测（最终答案准确率、推理链、过程监督、效率）无法判断推理是否随任务或证据变化而自适应，区分跨任务自适应与任务内自适应，以ARC-AGI为诊断案例，提出"干预导向评测"：在受控改变任务与证据下检验抽象迁移与假设修正，并明确报告测试时流程与预算。
AI.motivation: 现有评测指标无法区分模型是真正适应性推理，还是靠测试时搜索、采样或工程化流程刷出高分；因此无法回答"推理是否随任务或证据变化而调整"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 提出概念区分（跨任务自适应 vs. 任务内自适应）；以ARC-AGI为诊断性案例（而非对齐基准）分析现有度量的盲区；提出干预导向评测框架，对任务和证据做受控干预，检验抽象迁移与假设修正，并要求显式披露测试时程序与计算预算。
AI.result: 这是一篇视角/立场型论文，主要产出为对现有评测局限的诊断与新的评测框架设计，并论证该框架可支撑对鲁棒性、纠错反馈响应性与可审计性的评估，而非报告具体实验结果。
AI.conclusion: AI推理评测应从结果导向转向干预导向，关注适应性、纠错响应与可审计性，并通过透明报告测试时流程与预算来避免性能归因混淆。

title: Quantizing Recurrent Language Models Is Easier Than You Think
summary: Linear recurrences are becoming an increasingly common building block in large language models, replacing the growing KV cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state that enables efficient decoding. However, the quantization stack has largely been developed around softmax Transformers, whose numerical properties and inference state differ from those of recurrent models. Our goal is to understand these differences and study the design space of quantization methods for recurrent models. In our analysis, we differentiate between two targets. First, extra-state quantization concerns weights and activations outside the recurrent state, whose distributions are shaped indirectly by the sequence mixer during training. In controlled 1.3B parameter models, we find that decayed recurrences develop weaker residual outlier channels than softmax attention and are therefore easier to quantize without incoherence processing. Second, intra-state quantization concerns the recurrent state itself during decode, where repeated updates create a different numerical problem from KV cache quantization. We instantiate our findings as LoReS, a state quantization pipeline combining value-axis scale grouping to match output channel magnitude, decay-based mixed-precision to protect slowly decaying heads or channels, and stochastic rounding to limit error accumulation under repeated requantization. Across Qwen-3.5 9B, Nemotron-H 8B, and Kimi-Linear 48B-A3B, LoReS supports robust 8-bit state quantization and lower effective precision on shorter decode horizons. We implement LoReS in vLLM and demonstrate end-to-end decode speedups.

AI.tldr: 该文分析线性递归模型与softmax Transformer在量化数值特性上的差异，提出将量化分为恢复状态外量化与状态内量化两类，并据此设计LoReS状态量化流水线，实现8位递归状态量化与端到端解码加速。
AI.motivation: 线性递归正逐步替代softmax注意力的KV cache，但现有量化体系主要针对softmax Transformer，其数值属性与推理状态与递归模型不同，缺乏针对递归模型的量化设计研究。
AI.method: 作者区分两类量化目标：（1）状态外量化，针对递归状态之外的权重与激活，受序列混合器间接影响分布；（2）状态内量化，针对解码时反复更新的递归状态。LoReS由三项技术组成：按值轴进行尺度分组以匹配输出通道幅度、基于衰减的混合精度以保护衰减较慢的头或通道、随机舍入以抑制反复重量化带来的误差累积；并在vLLM中实现。
AI.result: 在1.3B参数受控模型中，衰减型递归的残差离群通道比softmax注意力更弱，无需非相干处理即可更易量化；在Qwen-3.5 9B、Nemotron-H 8B、Kimi-Linear 48B-A3B上，LoReS支持稳健的8位状态量化，并在较短解码视界下支持更低的有效精度；vLLM端到端解码实现加速。
AI.conclusion: 递归模型的量化需区分状态外与状态内两个目标，LoReS的尺度分组、衰减感知混合精度与随机舍入组合可有效缓解递归状态量化的误差累积，为线性递归模型的实际高效部署提供可行方案。

title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Urdu Nastaliq Handwriting Recognition
summary: Handwritten Urdu is hard to recognize because the cursive Nastaliq script has no fixed baseline and no clear character boundaries. We benchmark six systems on the Urdu Nastaliq Handwritten Dataset (UNHD): Tesseract (default configuration), a script-specific recognizer trained on printed Urdu (UTRNet-Large), two open-source vision-language models (VLMs), and two commercial VLMs. All six systems are evaluated without fine-tuning on 2,465 single-line images (Part A), and the four VLMs receive the same fixed prompt (decoding uses temperature 0 where configurable, except for Claude Sonnet 5, whose decoding cannot be configured). Both commercial VLMs reach lower error than the printed-Urdu recognizer and the open-source VLMs. We do not compare against handwriting-trained recognizers, which would likely do better in-domain; we characterize zero-shot behavior, not state of the art. We also describe three distinct failure modes among the ranked systems. In one of them, a commercial model explicitly declines to transcribe a few very hard-to-read images instead of guessing. In a second study (Part B), VLMs correct the output of a separate OCR system using both the source image and the noisy text. Once separated from each model's own reading ability, the benefit is small on Tesseract's output (0.7% to 7.4%) and larger (17.9% and 21.9%) only for the two commercial correctors given UTRNet's text. It appears to depend on how legible the supplied text already is, and a weaker corrector can make a more legible text worse.

AI.tldr: 本文在 UNHD 数据集上零样本评测六种系统（Tesseract、UTRNet-Large、两个开源 VLM、两个商业 VLM）识别手写乌尔都语 Nastaliq 文本，并额外研究 VLM 作为 OCR 后处理纠错器的效果。
AI.motivation: 手写乌尔都语 Nastaliq 字体无固定基线、字符边界不清，识别困难；需要弄清现有 OCR 系统与通用 VLM 在零样本条件下的实际表现及其失败模式。
AI.method: 在 2,465 张单行图像（Part A）上不做微调统一评测六系统，VLM 使用相同固定提示词（temperature 0，Claude Sonnet 5 无法配置）；Part B 中让 VLM 结合源图像与含噪文本对另一 OCR 系统的输出进行纠错。
AI.result: 两个商业 VLM 错误率低于印刷体乌尔都语识别器和开源 VLM；归纳出被排名系统的三类失败模式，其中一个商业模型会明确拒答极难辨认图像；纠错收益在 Tesseract 输出上仅 0.7%–7.4%，仅在两商业模型纠正 UTRNet 文本时达 17.9% 和 21.9%。
AI.conclusion: 本文刻画的是零样本行为而非 SOTA；纠错收益取决于所给文本的可读性，较弱的纠错器甚至会让更清晰的文本变差。

title: Human-Supervised Artificial Intelligence Researchers in Electric Power Systems: Knowledge, Physics, Simulation, and Governance for Large Language Models
summary: Conclusions in power-system research require a clear evidential basis. Researchers need to understand the data sources, modelling assumptions, and solution procedures to assess the conditions under which a conclusion holds. Large language models (LLMs) can help researchers extract information from documents and translate research requests into code and tool calls, but their outputs still require physical validation. Focusing on human-supervised artificial intelligence (AI) researchers, this review examines power-system LLM applications and related scientific workflows, together with physics-grounded power AI studies, to discuss the conditions for using LLMs in scientific research. In the proposed knowledge-physics-simulation-governance framework, LLMs translate information and coordinate tasks, simulators and validation tools test models, and experts retain authority over critical assumptions, safety boundaries, and final conclusions. Research processes should preserve materials for review so that claims can be traced to their sources, computations can be reproduced, and failed attempts and approvals can be examined. On this basis, a staged development roadmap and requirements for research reporting are proposed. Evaluation should focus on research artifacts and their validation to assess whether LLMs can improve the efficiency of power-system research within clearly defined permissions.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，围绕"人监督的AI研究者"提出知识-物理-仿真-治理（knowledge-physics-simulation-governance）四要素框架，主张LLM负责信息翻译与任务协调、仿真器负责验证、专家保留关键假设与最终结论的权威，并给出分阶段发展路线与研究报告要求。
AI.motivation: 电力系统研究的结论需要明确证据基础，读者须了解数据来源、建模假设与求解过程才能判断结论成立条件。LLM可辅助文献信息抽取、将研究请求转为代码与工具调用，但其输出仍缺乏物理验证，因此需要界定LLM在科研中可被信任使用的条件。
AI.method: 综述性研究：结合电力系统LLM应用与相关科学工作流、以及物理驱动的电力AI研究，提出"知识—物理—仿真—治理"框架，并在此基础上构建分阶段发展路线图与科研报告规范要求。
AI.result: 提出四要素分工框架：LLM做信息翻译与任务协调，仿真与验证工具检验模型，专家掌控关键假设、安全边界与最终结论；并强调研究过程须留存可追溯材料（可溯源、可复现、可审查失败与批准记录），评估应聚焦研究产出物及其验证。
AI.conclusion: LLM在电力系统研究中的价值应以研究工件及其验证为评价对象，在明确权限边界内提升研究效率；物理验证与人类监督不可省略。

title: The (Butter)fly Dream: Linear Separability of World-Model Rollouts in a Connectome-Constrained Visual Model
summary: Zhuangzi dreamt he was a butterfly and, on waking, could not tell which was the dream. We ask a version of his question of a model of the fly brain: placed inside a world generated by a world model, can a fixed brain tell that the world is a dream? We treat it as a question about what a connectome-constrained model trained on one task makes available beyond that task: do its responses make the defects of a dream linearly decodable? The observer is a published model of the fly visual system trained only for optic-flow estimation; reality is the MPI-Sintel movie on the model's 721-column retina; dreams are continuations of five real frames by three small world models (a persistence random walk, an MDN-RNN and an RSSM) at three temperatures. The judge is a classifier two-sample test on temporal statistics of cell-type responses, with sequence-level cross-validation. In the trained observer's responses all nine dreams are separable from reality (AUC 0.85-0.99, mean over 50 trained models), in those of the same network before training much less so (0.58-0.75 for the learned world models; paired difference 0.20-0.37), equally on sequences the observer never saw, and in an order unrelated to pixel error. Because these AUCs are near ceiling, we add graded probes made of each window's own real frames with only their order broken. Swapping one adjacent pair of the 14 generated frames gives 0.73 on the trained responses against 0.54 before training and 0.56 for pixel statistics; the trained curve reaches 0.75 at 1.1 swapped pairs of seven, the pixel statistics at 4.7, and the untrained network not at all. A detection horizon, the test on the first k generated frames, orders the world models where the full-length AUC saturates.

AI.tldr: 用果蝇视觉系统模型做"庄周梦蝶"测试：训练后的网络响应能让"梦境"（世界模型生成的视频）与"现实"（真实视频）线性可分，且该能力源于任务训练而非架构本身。
AI.motivation: 借用庄周梦蝶之问，探讨连接组约束、仅在单一任务（光流估计）上训练的模型，其响应是否"额外"编码了超出该任务的信息——即能否让生成世界的缺陷变得线性可解码。
AI.method: 观察者=已发表的果蝇视觉系统模型，仅训练光流估计，输入为721列视网膜；现实=MPI-Sintel影片；梦境=五种真实帧经三种小型世界模型（persistence随机游走、MDN-RNN、RSSM）在三个温度下续生成的序列。判别器为基于细胞类型响应时间统计的双样本检验分类器，采用序列级交叉验证；并加入"打乱相邻帧顺序"的渐变探针与"前k帧检测地平线"实验。
AI.result: 训练后的观察者对全部九种梦境均可与真实区分（AUC 0.85–0.99，50个训练模型平均）；未训练网络区分度低得多（学习型世界模型0.58–0.75，配对差0.20–0.37），在未见序列上表现相同，且AUC顺序与像素误差无关。打乱一对相邻帧：训练后0.73 vs 训练前0.54、像素统计0.56；训练曲线在7对中换1.1对时达0.75，像素统计需4.7对，未训练网络始终达不到。检测地平线可在全长AUC饱和处区分世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 任务训练使固定连接组的果蝇脑模型获得了对"梦境"缺陷的线性可解码敏感性，这种判别力源于学习而非架构/连接组本身，并可被渐变探针与检测地平线细粒度量化，为连接组约束模型的表征能力提供新证据。

title: UA-Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Depth Restoration for Material-Agnostic Object Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation requires accurate metric depth, yet commodity RGB-D cameras often fail on non-Lambertian objects such as transparent, reflective, and translucent materials, producing holes, structured noise, and biased depth. Most restoration methods produce only a single depth map, treating noisy and reliable regions uniformly for downstream tasks while ignoring regional uncertainty. We present UA-Depth, an uncertainty-aware depth restoration framework that iteratively co-refines depth and pixel-wise uncertainty, and uses uncertainty-gated features to suppress unreliable cues for stable updates. To strengthen zero-shot behavior, UA-Depth leverages a frozen depth foundation model as a prior to initialize missing or unreliable depth, and applies two-stage MAD-weighted log-depth scale normalization to reduce outlier bias in relative-to-metric alignment. We introduce an eight-dataset zero-shot benchmark across diverse scenes, materials, and sensors. Across these benchmarks, UA-Depth achieves the best mean rank among representative baselines, with particularly strong gains on datasets dominated by transparent and reflective objects. Beyond depth metrics, we demonstrate downstream improvements in category-level 6D pose estimation and 6D grasp synthesis by exploiting the predicted uncertainty. \emph{Code, models, and data for training and evaluation will be released upon publication.}

AI.tldr: UA-Depth：一种不确定性感知的深度修复框架，迭代联合精化深度与像素级不确定性，并用冻结深度基础模型作先验，在八个数据集零样本基准上取得最佳平均排名，并提升下游6D位姿估计与抓取合成。
AI.motivation: RGB-D相机在透明、反射、半透明等非朗伯物体上易出现空洞、结构化噪声与深度偏差；现有修复方法只输出单一深度图，对噪声区与可靠区一视同仁，忽略区域不确定性，不利于下游任务。
AI.method: 1) 迭代共精化深度与逐像素不确定性，并用不确定性门控特征抑制不可靠线索以稳定更新；2) 用冻结的深度基础模型作为先验，初始化缺失/不可靠深度以增强零样本能力；3) 采用两阶段MAD加权对数深度尺度归一化，降低相对深度到度量深度对齐中的离群值偏差。
AI.result: 构建覆盖多场景、多材质、多传感器的八数据集零样本基准；UA-Depth在代表基线中取得最佳平均排名，在透明与反射物体为主的数据集上提升尤为显著；利用预测不确定性，在类别级6D位姿估计与6D抓取合成上获得下游性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性建模与基础模型先验相结合可有效改善非朗伯物体的度量深度修复，且不确定性本身是下游任务的有用信号；代码、模型与数据将随论文发布。

title: MURFormer: Attention-Based Lightweight Multi-Scale Uncertainty-Guided Refinement Framework for PPG Denoising
comment: Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI) on 11 May 2026; currently under review
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is a widely used physiological signal for its convenience but is highly susceptible to motion artifacts that degrade waveform quality and limit downstream analysis. This paper proposes MURFormer, a lightweight multi-scale uncertainty-guided refinement framework for PPG denoising through noisy-to-clean PPG mapping. MURFormer employs a newly proposed Multi-Scale Attention-Conv Fusion (MACF) block, which is designed to efficiently capture multi-scale temporal dynamics of PPG, as the fundamental building block and performs uncertainty-guided two-pass refinement prioritizing unreliable regions. The method was evaluated on the publicly available CIME dataset and on a Daily Activities dataset collected in this work, comprising paired noisy-clean PPG recordings from 24 subjects. Experimental results show that MURFormer improves both signal quality and physiological fidelity over the raw noisy input, yielding 129\% and 105\% relative signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) improvements, and 66\% and 81\% relative reductions in heart-rate mean absolute error (MAE), on the Daily Activities and CIME datasets, respectively. MURFormer also outperforms an existing denoising baseline on both datasets with a relatively small parameter count while preserving beat-level timing and waveform morphology. In addition, the model maintains strong denoising performance across varying input window lengths, suggesting that MURFormer is an effective and robust framework for practical PPG denoising. The implementation of MURFormer is publicly available at https://github.com/k-hram/MURFormer.git

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级多尺度不确定性引导的PPG去噪框架MURFormer，通过噪声到干净的映射显著提升信号质量与心率精度。
AI.motivation: PPG信号便捷但易受运动伪影干扰，严重降低波形质量并限制下游分析，需要有效的去噪方法。
AI.method: 采用噪声到干净PPG映射；核心为多尺度注意力-卷积融合(MACF)块捕捉多尺度时间动态，并进行不确定性引导的两遍精炼，优先处理不可靠区域。在公开CIME数据集及自采Daily Activities数据集(24名受试者配对噪声-干净记录)上评估。
AI.result: 相较原始噪声输入，两个数据集上SNR相对提升129%和105%，心率MAE相对下降66%和81%；以较小参数量优于现有去噪基线，并保留逐拍时序与波形形态；在不同输入窗口长度下均保持稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: MURFormer是有效且鲁棒的实用PPG去噪框架，代码已开源。

title: A Self-Generated Floor on Adam's $\varepsilon$: Evidence from Power-Law Matrix Sensing
summary: In nonconvex Burer--Monteiro low-rank matrix sensing of $U^\ast \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times D}$ under power-law covariance $Σ= \mathrm{diag}(j^{-s})_{j=1}^V$, the precision-wall approximation predicts that Adam stalls when the smallest non-gauge Hessian eigenvalue drops below its denominator floor, giving $s^\ast(V,D) = [\log(1/\varepsilon_{\mathrm{eff}}) - \log V]/\log(VD) + δ_{\mathrm{Adam}}$. If $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{eff}}$ were set by $\varepsilon_0$, lowering $\varepsilon_0$ from $10^{-10}$ to $10^{-12}$ would raise $s^\ast$ by $0.95\text{--}1.33$. Instead, across six values of $\varepsilon_0$ two decades apart, $10^{-2}$ to $10^{-12}$, the boundary follows the $\varepsilon_0$ slope down to $10^{-6}$, bends near $10^{-8}$, and is flat below $10^{-8}$, while warm-started L-BFGS and Gauss--Newton reach machine precision on stalled instances. We trace this saturation to a self-generated dynamical floor $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{dyn}} \propto α$: high-curvature modes oscillate persistently near the adaptive edge of stability with amplitude $\propto α(1-β_1)/(1+β_1)$ and leak gradient fluctuations of scale $κα$ into rare modes via measurement coupling, pinning $\sqrt{\hat{v}_V} \approx κα\gg \varepsilon_0$. Fitting a single threshold-crossing wall parameter $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{dyn}} = 4.76\times 10^{-9}$ (with the detection lag frozen at its companion calibration) predicts the saturated failure boundary for $D \ge 4$ across five $(V,D)$ scales to RMS $0.098$ (breaking down at $D = 2$), while shrinking $\varepsilon_0$ below $10^{-8}$ is ineffective and lowering the step size $α$ reduces the floor directly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非凸 Burer–Monteiro 低秩矩阵感知中 Adam 的"精度墙"，发现实际失效边界由自生成的动力学下限 ε_dyn∝α 决定，而非 Adam 分母中的 ε0，且 ε0 低于约 1e-8 后再减小无效。
AI.motivation: 精度墙理论预测：降低 Adam 分母常数 ε0 可使可解幂律指数阈值 s* 提升（10^-10→10^-12 应升 0.95–1.33），但这一预测是否与实际失效边界一致尚不清楚，需实验检验并解释失效的真实机制。
AI.method: 在幂律协方差 Σ=diag(j^{-s}) 下的低秩矩阵感知中，扫描六档 ε0（10^-2 到 10^-12）定位 Adam 失效边界；用热启动 L-BFGS 与 Gauss–Newton 检验停滞实例是否仍可优化。进一步分析动力学：高曲率模态在自适应稳定边缘持续振荡（幅度∝α(1-β1)/(1+β1)），经测量耦合向稀有模态泄漏 κα 量级梯度噪声，使 √v̂_V≈κα。最后拟合单一阈值穿越墙参数 ε_dyn 进行预测验证。
AI.result: 失效边界随 ε0 变化至约 1e-6，在 1e-8 附近弯折、以下完全平坦，与零损失的经典"精度墙"预测不符；L-BFGS/GN 可达到机器精度，说明停滞是优化器动力学所致而非问题本身。单一拟合参数 ε_dyn=4.76e-9（检测滞后沿用配套标定）在五个 (V,D) 尺度、D≥4 上以 RMS 0.098 预测饱和失效边界，D=2 时失效。减小 α 可降低该动力学地板。
AI.conclusion: Adam 的实际精度下限是自生成的 ε_dyn∝α，而非超参数 ε0；将 ε0 降至 1e-8 以下无效，降低步长 α 才是直接手段。这修正了对 Adam"精度墙"的理解，并给出可预测的失效边界模型（D≥4）。

title: dKV Forcing: Separating Generation and Memory Representations through a Differentiable KV Cache
summary: A causal video generator produces two key--value (KV) states for every segment: the KV it uses while denoising that segment, and the KV it writes into the cache for later segments to read. In a pretrained generator the two already differ substantially, later segments attend to them differently, and replacing the written KV with the generation KV degrades the continuation. We propose dKV Forcing (dKV denotes differentiable KV) to learn a dedicated memory representation from its future use: a writer-specific low-rank residual on the shared backbone separates memory writing from generation and is trained through the future reads of what it writes. Learning a write from its future use needs gradients through the cache, which the mutable cache in common use cannot provide. dKV Forcing replaces the training-time cache by persistent differentiable pages with local rematerialization and, in one temporal traversal, computes exactly the gradient that a two-pass reconstruction of the same objective computes. One traversal computes the full memory gradient at $7\%$ generator-update overhead over detached-write training, with $28\%$ less resident memory and $20.8\%$ shorter training cycles than the two-pass reconstruction. Over Self Gradient Forcing (SGF), the same objective trained with the same traversal, writer adaptation raises VBench-Long aesthetic quality by $6.6$ points at 60\,s and $8.5$ points at 240\,s with the highest subject and background consistency, and rollout dropout of the residual keeps most of this gain while restoring the motion of training without write gradients.

AI.tldr: 提出 dKV Forcing，通过学习专用写入记忆表示来训练因果视频生成器的 KV 缓存，实现一次遍历得到精确记忆梯度。
AI.motivation: 因果视频生成器中，每段既产生用于去噪的 KV，也产生写入缓存供后续段读取的 KV，二者差异显著，现有训练未区分。要为"写入"学习表示需梯度穿过缓存，但常用可变缓存无法提供。
AI.method: 在共享主干上加写入专用低秩残差分离记忆写入与生成，通过未来读取反向训练；用持久可微页替代训练期可变缓存，并配合局部重计算，在一次时间遍历中精确复现两遍重建的梯度。
AI.result: 单次遍历以 7% 生成器更新开销得到完整记忆梯度，常驻内存减少 28%，训练周期比两遍重建缩短 20.8%；相比 SGF，VBench-Long 美感质量在 60s 提升 6.6 分、240s 提升 8.5 分，主体与背景一致性最高，rollout dropout 保留大部分增益。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆写入作为独立可学习表示、并以未来读取为监督，是提升长视频因果生成质量的高效途径。

title: AffToM: Benchmarking Recursive Affective Theory of Mind in Dynamic Multi-Party Interactions
summary: Understanding emotion in realistic social interactions requires more than recognizing facial expressions or assigning affective labels. The same event can elicit different emotions depending on what each participant knows, what they believe others know or feel, and how these nested mental states evolve over time. Existing benchmarks largely study higher-order epistemic Theory of Mind (ToM) and multimodal emotion reasoning in isolation, leaving recursive affective reasoning under asymmetric and dynamically changing information underexplored. Therefore, we introduce AffToM, a benchmark for affective ToM with 1,922 test pairs and 19,759 training pairs. AffToM evaluates Individual Affective Reasoning (IAR), which infers emotions from events and socio-cognitive context, and Multi-party Affective Reasoning (MPAR), which recursively tracks participants' nested beliefs and emotions as new evidence emerges. We develop an event-driven multi-agent generation pipeline grounded in dynamic character interaction graphs that explicitly capture event sequences, interpersonal relations, and mental-state updates. Furthermore, we propose AffToM-R1, a two-stage post-training framework combining supervised fine-tuning with perspective-aware rubric-guided reinforcement learning. Experiments show that MPAR remains challenging, with even the strongest evaluated MLLM achieving less than 60% accuracy, while AffToM-R1 improves MPAR accuracy by 13.38 percentage points over its base model. Our dataset is available at: https://github.com/MindIntLab-HFUT/AffToM.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AffToM基准，用于评估非对称、动态信息下的递归情感心智理论推理，并配套提出AffToM-R1训练框架，显著提升多主体情感推理性能。
AI.motivation: 真实社会互动中的情绪理解不仅依赖面部表情或情感标签，还取决于各方所知、所信他人所知所感，以及这些嵌套心理状态随时间的演化。现有基准多将高阶认知ToM与多模态情感推理割裂研究，缺乏对非对称、动态变化信息下递归情感推理的探索。
AI.method: 构建AffToM基准（1,922测试对、19,759训练对），包含个体情感推理（IAR）与多主体情感推理（MPAR）两项任务；开发基于动态人物交互图的事件驱动多智能体生成流水线，显式建模事件序列、人际关系与心理状态更新；并提出AffToM-R1两阶段后训练框架，结合监督微调与视角感知的评分标准引导强化学习。
AI.result: 实验表明MPAR任务仍具挑战性，最强被测多模态大模型准确率不足60%；AffToM-R1相比基座模型在MPAR准确率上提升13.38个百分点。
AI.conclusion: AffToM填补了递归情感ToM在非对称动态信息下评估的空白，揭示了当前MLLM在多主体嵌套心理状态推理上的明显不足，而视角感知的强化学习后训练可有效缓解该差距。

title: Robust Remote ECG Monitoring under Energy Constraints: Anomaly Filtering versus Predictive Uncertainty
summary: Machine learning for remote electrocardiogram monitoring must handle noise and diseases absent from training under tight resource constraints. We investigate whether upstream unsupervised anomaly detection can improve monitoring decisions more efficiently than classifier-derived uncertainty. We evaluate five detectors on PTB-XL and BUT QDB and compare a two-stage filter-classifier system with Monte Carlo Dropout and deep ensembles under unseen-disease and noise conditions. Performance is averaged over five training seeds. We measure single-pass energy, latency, and graph memory on a microcontroller's central processing unit (CPU) and neural processing unit (NPU). Per-score neural network costs account for repeated evaluations but exclude scoring outside deployed graphs. Energy equations relate filtering and rejection to avoided classifier execution. Across four disease scenarios, Deep Support Vector Data Description (Deep SVDD) achieves the highest mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve within all tested finite CPU energy budgets. On the NPU, it leads at 1 mJ, while Monte Carlo Dropout has slightly higher means at 10 and 100 mJ. With a narrow CPU classifier, the Deep SVDD two-stage system increases the fraction of correctly classified or correctly rejected inputs by 15.0-19.4 percentage points over classification without rejection. Estimated energy per input is 1.93-6.99 mJ, compared with 52.53 mJ for Monte Carlo Dropout and 8.76-17.51 mJ for deep ensembles, at each method's retrospectively selected test accuracy peak. These results support upstream filtering for efficient remote monitoring, while independent validation and complete-system measurements remain necessary.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在资源受限的远程心电监测中，上游无监督异常检测（以Deep SVDD为代表）能否比分类器派生的不确定性（MC Dropout、深度集成）更高效地改进监测决策。在PTB-XL与BUT QDB上比较两阶段过滤-分类系统与基线方法，结果表明Deep SVDD在CPU有限能耗预算下取得最高平均AUROC，且估计能耗显著低于MC Dropout和深度集成。
AI.motivation: 远程心电监测的机器学习系统需在紧约束资源下处理训练中未出现的噪声与疾病类型。作者希望探究上游无监督异常检测是否能以比分类器派生不确定性更低的成本改善监测决策。
AI.method: 在PTB-XL和BUT QDB上评估五种检测器，将两阶段过滤-分类系统与Monte Carlo Dropout、深度集成在未见疾病和噪声条件下对比；性能取五个训练种子平均。在微控制器CPU与NPU上测量单次推理能耗、时延与图内存，并按能量方程把过滤与拒识映射为对分类器执行的避免。
AI.result: 在四个疾病场景中，Deep SVDD在所有测试的有限CPU能耗预算下取得最高平均AUROC；NPU上在1 mJ领先，而MC Dropout在10与100 mJ略高。配窄CPU分类器时，Deep SVDD两阶段系统将"正确分类或正确拒绝"的比例提升15.0-19.4个百分点。每次输入估计能耗为1.93-6.99 mJ，MC Dropout为52.53 mJ，深度集成为8.76-17.51 mJ（各自回溯选取的测试准确率峰值处）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用上游过滤以实现高效远程监测；但独立验证与完整系统级测量仍需开展。

title: GatedVLA with Camera-Based Emergency Braking: AlpaSim E2E Closed Loop Challenge Technical Report
summary: This report presents GatedVLA, our entry for the Physical AI AV (PAI-AV) track. Our learned vision-language-action (VLA) policy pairs the driving-pretrained Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B vision-language model with a layer-wise flow-matching action expert that outputs a 2.5 s horizon of acceleration and curvature controls, augmented with a soft visual mask applied to the expert's cross-attention. Compared to an identically trained baseline, the masked policy achieves comparable overall open-loop error while reducing error on left turns. In local closed-loop evaluation across the same 150 scenes (two rollouts per scene), the visual mask increases the mean scene score from 0.479 to 0.517 (paired difference +0.038, 95% bootstrap CI [-0.018, +0.093], wins/losses 37/26, sign test p = 0.21). Incorporating a rule-based automatic emergency braking (AEB) module at deployment further increases the mean score to 0.599 (+0.082, CI [+0.023, +0.143]) and reduces the mean number of scenes with at-fault collisions from 34.0 to 11.0.

AI.tldr: GatedVLA 将驾驶预训练的 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B 与逐层流匹配动作专家结合，并在交叉注意力上加软视觉掩码，闭环评测中配合规则式 AEB 显著提升得分与安全性。
AI.motivation: 面向 Physical AI AV（PAI-AV）赛道，探索将预训练驾驶 VLM 与流匹配动作专家结合，并通过视觉掩码与部署期安全模块提升策略表现。
AI.method: 以驾驶预训练 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B 为 VLM 骨干，配逐层 flow-matching 动作专家输出 2.5 秒时域的加速度与曲率控制；在专家 cross-attention 上加软视觉掩码；部署时叠加规则式 AEB。在 150 个场景、每场景 2 次 rollout 的闭环评测中用配对 bootstrap 与符号检验评估。
AI.conclusion: 视觉掩码在开环与左转上有效、闭环趋势正向但统计不显著；AEB 带来显著且大幅的安全提升。整体结果基于单一赛道自评测，样本量与显著性有限。

title: Is your LLM an Agressive Narcissist with Depression? Analyzing Psychological Portraits of Large Language Models
summary: Nowadays, interaction with AI requires caution not only regarding the factual reliability of generated content but also regarding personality markers that models may implicitly transmit during dialogue that can subtly influence users' perception of information. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale experimental study in which 22 large language models complete 11 psychological inventories. Furthermore, we investigate correlations between human and model responses to track the adjustments made for the users who interact with them on a daily basis. The results show that LLMs exhibit coherent and relatively stable psychological patterns. Personality traits remain largely consistent, whereas emotional and symptomatic dimensions are more variable, with anxiety and neuroticism emerging as dominant tendencies. Model explanations further suggest that LLMs generate internally consistent and safety-oriented profiles while also reflecting correlations with the users they regularly interact with.

AI.tldr: 该研究对22个大语言模型进行11项心理量表测试，发现LLM呈现连贯且相对稳定的心理特征画像，焦虑与神经质倾向突出，且其解释反映出与日常交互用户的相关性。
AI.motivation: 用户与AI交互时不仅需关注内容事实可靠性，还需关注模型在对话中隐式传递的人格标记，这些标记会微妙影响用户对信息的感知。
AI.method: 大规模实验研究：让22个大语言模型完成11项心理量表，并分析人类与模型响应之间的相关性，以追踪模型为日常交互用户所做的调整。
AI.result: LLM表现出连贯且相对稳定的心理模式；人格特质基本保持一致，而情绪与症状维度更易变化，焦虑和神经质成为主导倾向；模型解释显示其生成内部一致且安全导向的画像，同时反映与常交互用户的相关性。
AI.conclusion: LLM具有可测量的、稳定的心理特征画像，这些隐式人格标记值得关注，并可能在与用户交互中产生相互影响。

title: Machine Learning Beyond Statistical Consistency for Hybrid AI
summary: We propose a new definition of machine learning, according to which a machine learns a function when it computes the function successfully, that is, when the value it returns for each input has a proper derivation in a formal system. We extend Gödel's Representability Theorem, which equates computation with derivation, to empirical targets in two ways: the theorem is extended to the computable reals, and the data are admitted into the system as empirical definitions that record what has been observed. We prove that a machine learns a true probability if and only if two conditions are met. The Truth Condition is that its estimate converges to the true probability, which is statistical consistency. The Assurance Condition is that the machine properly derives its own convergence inside the system. Learning thus lies beyond statistical consistency, for it requires a derivation of the convergence from the record. A global assumption about the data, such as the i.i.d. assumption, does not supply such a derivation, because it leads only to a circular one, as we show for PAC learning. On the other hand, the two conditions are met for the probability of a sentence over a finite ideal corpus. A real machine can approximate a true probability only if an ideal machine can learn it precisely, that is, only in a domain that meets the two conditions. Modern AI works in such a domain, and we offer this as a clue to its success. Modern AI is hybrid as well, in two senses: First, it performs two kinds of tasks, namely probabilistic ones such as predicting the next word and deductive ones such as proving and coding. Second, it combines two parts of different kinds, a statistical proposer and a deductive verifier, for proving and coding. Our framework explains both senses of hybridity in one formal system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出机器学习的新定义：当机器成功计算某函数、即其返回的每个值在形式系统中有恰当推导时，即为"学会"该函数；并证明学习真概率当且仅当满足统计一致性的"真理性条件"与机器在系统内推导自身收敛性的"保证性条件"。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习以统计一致性（收敛）为标准，但这不足以刻画"学习"。作者希望借助哥德尔可表示性定理把计算与推导等同，将学习理解为在形式系统中对数据的推导，从而解释为何全局假设（如i.i.d.）无法提供非循环的学习保证，并解释现代AI混合性（概率任务+演绎任务、统计提议器+演绎验证器）的成功。
AI.method: 将哥德尔可表示性定理向经验目标扩展：一是扩展到可计算实数，二是把数据作为记录观测的"经验定义"纳入系统。据此证明机器学习真概率的充要条件（真理性条件=估计收敛即统计一致性；保证性条件=机器在系统内恰当推导自身收敛）。并对PAC学习分析指出i.i.d.等全局假设只能导致循环推导。
AI.result: 证明了学习真概率的充要条件为上述两条；指出全局数据假设（如PAC中的i.i.d.）只能给出循环推导，不构成学习的推导；而在有限理想语料上关于句子的概率满足两条件。进一步论证真实机器只能在满足两条件的领域中逼近真概率，即须存在能精确学习它的理想机器。
AI.conclusion: 学习超越统计一致性，需要在形式系统中从数据记录推导出收敛性。现代AI之所以成功，可能因其工作在满足两条件的领域；其"混合性"（概率与演绎两类任务、统计提议器与演绎验证器的组合）可在同一形式系统中得到统一解释。

title: MMCoT$^3$: Empowering 3D Scene Understanding with 3D-Text Interleaved Multi-Modal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Understanding and reasoning over 3D scenes from point clouds is essential for a broad range of AI applications. Recent 3D large language models have shown promising results, yet they still face two fundamental limitations: (i) insufficient capability for grounded multi-step reasoning in complex 3D scenes, and (ii) a text-centric inference paradigm that lacks effective interaction between textual reasoning and visual evidence. As a result, these models often fail to verify intermediate inferences, disambiguate similar object instances, and avoid hallucinations. To address these limitations, we propose MMCoT$^3$, the first 3D-Text Interleaved Chain-of-Thought (CoT) framework for 3D scene understanding. The core idea is to explicitly interleave textual reasoning with task-relevant 3D evidence, enabling the model to consult scene observations throughout the reasoning process. In addition, since a textual mention in 3D scenes may correspond to multiple candidate objects, naive object-mention alignment can inject incorrect evidence and mislead subsequent reasoning. To mitigate this multi-instance ambiguity, we design an ambiguity-aware evidence aggregation mechanism that uses query-guided cross-attention to fuse candidate object tokens and inject both evidence and ambiguity cues into the reasoning process. To better equip the model with multi-step reasoning capability, we further develop PointCoT, a large-scale 3D-specific CoT instruction tuning dataset with approximately 176.2K instances spanning captioning, question answering, dialogue, and planning tasks. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks show that our method consistently improves performance and achieves state-of-the-art results, validating the effectiveness of our proposed ambiguity-aware 3D-text interleaved reasoning for 3D scene understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出首个3D-文本交错思维链(CoT)框架MMCoT$^3$，通过将文本推理与任务相关3D证据显式交错，并设计歧义感知证据聚合机制处理对象多实例歧义，配合176.2K规模的3D专用CoT指令数据集PointCoT，在六个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有3D大语言模型存在两大局限：(1)在复杂3D场景中缺乏有依据的多步推理能力；(2)以文本为中心的推理范式缺乏文本推理与视觉证据的有效交互，导致无法验证中间推断、难以区分相似物体实例、易产生幻觉。
AI.method: 1) 3D-文本交错CoT框架，将文本推理与任务相关3D证据显式交错，使模型在推理全程可查询场景观测；2) 歧义感知证据聚合机制，用查询引导的交叉注意力融合候选对象token，并将证据与歧义线索注入推理过程，缓解单文本提指对应多候选物体造成的错误证据注入；3) 构建PointCoT大规模3D专用CoT指令微调数据集（约176.2K实例，涵盖描述、问答、对话、规划任务）。
AI.result: 在六个基准上的大量实验表明方法性能持续提升并达到SOTA，验证了歧义感知3D-文本交错推理对3D场景理解的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过交错文本推理与3D视觉证据、显式建模对象级歧义并结合大规模CoT指令数据，可有效提升3D场景理解中的多步推理可靠性，减少幻觉与实例混淆。

title: Stage-aware Multimodal Brain Graph Contrastive Learning for Neurodegenerative Disorder Diagnosis
summary: Neurodegenerative disorders are characterized by their progressive nature, with distinct stages that require precise identification and tracking of progression trajectories for accurate diagnosis. However, existing diagnostic methods often fail to fully capture the unique brain patterns associated with different stages, limiting their ability to effectively target specific stages of the disorders. To address this issue, we propose a Stage-aware Multimodal Brain Graph Contrastive Learning (smBGC) method. Specifically, smBGC introduces a stage-aware feature enhancement strategy to capture stage-specific features across all progression stages, enabling the generation of stage-aware multimodal brain graph representations. In addition, smBGC incorporates a stage-adaptive brain graph augmentation approach within a graph contrastive learning framework, facilitating multimodal fusion and improving the model's capability to distinguish between different disorder stages. Experiments on two real-world datasets demonstrate the superior performance of smBGC in various neurodegenerative disorder diagnosis tasks compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出阶段感知多模态脑图对比学习（smBGC），通过阶段感知特征增强与阶段自适应图增强融合多模态脑图，提升神经退行性疾病不同阶段的诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 神经退行性疾病具有渐进性和分阶段特点，需精确识别各阶段并追踪进展轨迹；现有诊断方法难以充分刻画不同阶段特有的脑部模式，导致对特定阶段的诊断能力受限。
AI.method: smBGC包含两部分：1）阶段感知特征增强策略，在所有进展阶段捕获阶段特异性特征，生成阶段感知的多模态脑图表示；2）在图对比学习框架中引入阶段自适应脑图增强，促进多模态融合并增强模型区分不同疾病阶段的能力。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，smBGC在多种神经退行性疾病诊断任务上优于现有先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 阶段感知与自适应增强相结合的多模态脑图对比学习可有效提升神经退行性疾病分阶段诊断性能。

title: Watch Your Step: Adam's Margin Maximization Bias Depends on the Learning Rate Schedule
summary: We study the implicit bias of Adam and its similarity to sign gradient descent on homogeneous models in binary classification tasks. Perhaps surprisingly, we uncover that these depend on the learning rate schedule. While previous works studied strongly decaying learning rate schedules $η(t)=\mathrm o \left(t^{1/L-1}\right)$, where $L$ is the homogeneity degree, and showed $\ell_\infty$-margin-maximization biases, we focus on the more common complementary regime, including constant and weakly decaying schedules. For a polynomial schedule $t^α$ and homogeneity degree $L$, we show that when $α> \frac 1L - \frac12$, Adam has no trajectory-independent margin-maximization bias for deep linear networks (in the KKT sense): first, there is no non-trivial, locally Lipschitz, convex implicit regularizer in this setting, including any squared norm. Second, on width-$1$ networks, the result holds without requiring convexity, implying that any implicit regularizer for wide networks must be trivial when restricted to a width-$1$ network. Nevertheless, we positively characterize the implicit bias in this regime as maximizing a trajectory-dependent weighted-$\ell_2$ margin for any $L$-homogeneous model. The fundamental mechanism behind our results is convergence of Adam's preconditioner to a trajectory-dependent vector, which also allows showing that the limiting parameter direction depends on initialization. In the intermediate regime $\frac 1L - 1 \leq α\leq \frac1L - \frac12$ we prove an $\ell_\infty$ bias, conditional on gradient directional convergence to a full-support vector. Of independent interest, we establish a loss decay rate for full batch Adam on general homogeneous models, whose leading order depends only on the second-moment parameter.

AI.tldr:
本文研究Adam在齐次模型二分类中的隐式偏差，发现其取决于学习率调度；对多项式调度t^α（α>1/L-1/2），Adam不存在轨迹无关的间隔最大化偏差。

（T L;DR用中文）
AI.motivation: 以往工作只研究了强衰减学习率下的ℓ∞间隔最大化偏差，但常数和弱衰减等常见调度下的隐式偏差尚不清楚，需要更完整地刻画Adam的收敛方向偏好。
AI.method: 针对L-齐次模型与多项式学习率t^α，分析Adam预条件子收敛到轨迹相关向量，区分不同α区间，讨论KKT意义下的隐式正则化器（含凸与非凸情形）。
AI.result: 当α>1/L-1/2时，Adam在深度线性网络（KKT意义）下无轨迹无关的间隔最大化偏差：不存在非平凡的局部Lipschitz凸隐式正则器（含任意平方范数）；宽度1网络上结论无需凸性。但证明隐式偏差是最大化轨迹相关的加权ℓ2间隔；极限方向依赖初始化。在1/L-1≤α≤1/L-1/2中间区间，在梯度方向收敛到满支撑向量的条件下证明ℓ∞偏差。另给出全批量Adam在一般齐次模型上的损失衰减率，其主导阶仅依赖二阶矩参数。
AI.conclusion: Adam的隐式偏差强烈依赖学习率调度；常见调度下并无普遍的最小范数/最大间隔偏好，而表现为轨迹相关加权间隔，且方向受初始化影响。

title: Leveraging 2D Foundation Priors for Generalized Category Discovery under Test-Time Adaptation in 3D LiDAR Segmentation
summary: In autonomous driving, 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation is expected to adapt to evolving environments and recognize previously unseen categories, making generalized category discovery under test-time adaptation (GCD-TTA) an important problem. However, existing works treat GCD and TTA separately, while the limited semantic information in 3D point clouds makes GCD-TTA under domain shift more prone to feature collapse when combining GCD with TTA. To address this issue, we propose a two-stage framework for GCD-TTA in 3D LiDAR semantic segmentation. Specifically, in the first stage, we adaptively aggregate local 3D features according to geometric density variations and obtain reliable pseudo labels under a global class-wise prototype consistency constraint. In the second stage, we cast category discovery as an optimal transport assignment process for globally consistent grouping of novel categories. Meanwhile, semantic features from 2D vision foundation models are fused with 3D point cloud features to enrich 3D semantic information and promote a more separable feature space. Extensive experiments on Synth4D to SemanticKITTI, SynLiDAR to SemanticKITTI, and Synth4D to nuScenes demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. Under a unified evaluation protocol, our method achieves the best overall mIoU on 9 out of 10 benchmark splits and improves the overall mIoU by up to 12.21 points over the strongest re-implemented baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架解决3D LiDAR语义分割中的广义类别发现与测试时自适应（GCD-TTA）联合问题，通过2D视觉基础模型特征融合缓解特征坍缩，在多个跨域基准上取得最佳整体mIoU。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中3D LiDAR语义分割需适应变化环境并识别未见类别。现有工作将GCD与TTA分开处理，而3D点云语义信息有限，在域偏移下联合GCD与TTA时更易发生特征坍缩。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段按几何密度变化自适应聚合局部3D特征，并在全局类别原型一致性约束下获取可靠伪标签；第二阶段将类别发现建模为最优传输分配过程，实现新类别的全局一致分组；同时融合2D视觉基础模型的语义特征与3D点云特征以丰富语义信息、提升特征可分性。
AI.result: 在Synth4D→SemanticKITTI、SynLiDAR→SemanticKITTI、Synth4D→nuScenes上验证有效性；统一评测协议下，在10个基准划分中的9个取得最佳整体mIoU，相比最强复现基线最高提升12.21个点。
AI.conclusion: 统一处理GCD与TTA并结合2D-3D特征融合，可有效缓解域偏移下的特征坍缩，显著提升3D LiDAR语义分割的跨域泛化与开放类别发现性能。

title: DrawOffer: Evidence-Grounded Longitudinal User-State Modeling for Career Support
comment: 9 pages, 4 tables. Evaluation code and aggregate results: https://github.com/ql-link/DrawOffer-Eval . Core engine private; not all experiments independently reproducible
summary: Career-support assistants must distinguish user claims from evidence of current ability and withhold judgments when evidence is insufficient. DrawOffer separates language-model observation extraction from deterministic inference over source-linked records to maintain uncertain ability estimates, experience assessments, and revisable issues. We evaluate 102 fictional personas with 580 scored checkpoints, a historical full-context and Mem0 comparison, and three auxiliary knowledge-tracing datasets. On 37 test personas, DrawOffer passes 169/210 checkpoints; checkpoint-defined issue precision and recall are 0.875 and 0.636. Across three development simulations, 87.0% of checkpoint verdicts agree, including persistent failures. A cache-only development ablation replacing answer-evidence requirements with confidence-only settlement reduces majority-vote passes from 306 to 293 of 370 and issue precision from 0.927 to 0.725. Equalizing positive source weights improves predictive metrics without changing total passes; removing decay gives mixed results. These findings support an exploratory systems contribution centered on evidence sufficiency. Developer-authored scenarios, unmatched baseline models, historical test exposure, and incomplete public artifacts limit generalization and independent reproduction.

AI.tldr: DrawOffer 将语言模型用于观测抽取、确定性推断用于基于来源记录的能力判断，以在证据不足时保留不确定性而非强行下结论；在 37 个测试人设的 210 个检查点上通过 169 个，问题精确率/召回率为 0.875/0.636，属探索性系统贡献。
AI.motivation: 职业支持助手需要区分"用户声称"与"当前能力证据"，在证据不足时应拒绝判断；纯上下文或记忆式 LLM 方案容易在证据薄弱时给出过度确定的结论。
AI.method: 架构上将 LLM 观测抽取与确定性推断分离：LLM 只负责从对话中抽取可观测证据，推断层在带来源链接的记录上运行，维护不确定的能力估计、经验评估与可修订问题项。评估使用 102 个虚构人设、580 个评分检查点，含"历史全上下文"与 Mem0 对比，以及 3 个辅助知识追踪数据集；另做三次开发模拟一致性检验和仅缓存消融（用置信度替代答案—证据要求、等权正向来源、去除衰减）。
AI.result: 37 个测试人设中通过 169/210 检查点；检查点定义的问题精确率 0.875、召回率 0.636。三次开发模拟中 87.0% 判定一致（含持续失败项）。缓存消融：多数投票通过数从 306/370 降至 293/370，问题精确率从 0.927 降至 0.725；等化正向来源权重改善预测指标但通过总数不变；去除衰减结果混合。
AI.conclusion: 核心贡献在于"证据充分性"驱动的系统设计：证据门槛与来源链接确实承担关键作用（消融显著退化）。但作者自述局限明显——场景由开发者编写、基线模型未匹配、历史测试暴露、公开工件不完整，泛化性与独立复现均受限，应视为探索性系统工作。

title: ReWY: Faster Gradient Computation for Delta-Rule Attention Family
summary:
Delta-rule linear attention underlies language models such as Kimi Linear and Qwen3-Next. Chunkwise implementations expose matrix parallelism, but their backward passes compute unnecessary auxiliary adjoints. We present ReWY, an algebraic reformulation that reduces this work before optimizing accelerator execution. Differentiating the chunk correction as one triangular residual system eliminates the inverse adjoint and reduces seven local WY matrix products to three. Two complementary transformations expose further reuse: centered matrix contractions replace pairwise vector-gate processing, and scalar-gate reductions reuse key-gradient products instead of forming a key Gram matrix. These identities simplify backward computation for DeltaNet, GDN, KDA, and GDN2 while preserving the recurrence and gradients in exact arithmetic, without changing the architecture or training objective.
  We implement the reduced graph on GPUs and Ascend NPUs. Under matched recomputation and full-saving policies, precision-qualified six-shape comparisons with frozen FLA references yield 1.15-1.81$\times$ geometric-mean complete low-level backward speedups on NVIDIA GPUs. All four operators achieve 1.18-1.70$\times$ on H100 and H200 while retaining original FP32 working matrices. A separate public-autograd evaluation on Ascend 950DT, including gradient conversions, yields 1.09-2.89$\times$ under available matched policies. Paired ablations establish further ReWY gains after optimizing the complementary contractions. Complete-gradient checks validate the recorded operator cases; supplementary full-model backward measurements assess integration into community FLA models and a GDN2 layer port. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/flashserve/ReWY.

AI.tldr: ReWY 通过代数重构简化 Delta-rule 线性注意力（DeltaNet/GDN/KDA/GDN2）的反向传播：消除逆伴随、减少 WY 矩阵乘积，并在 GPU 与 Ascend NPU 上实现 1.15–1.81× 的反向加速。
AI.motivation: Chunkwise 实现虽有矩阵并行性，但其反向传播计算了大量不必要的辅助伴随量（如逆伴随、七个局部 WY 矩阵乘积），浪费算力，且未从代数层面优化。
AI.method: 将 chunk 修正的微分视为一个三角残差系统，从而消除逆伴随并将七个 WY 局部矩阵乘积降为三个；进一步用中心化矩阵收缩替代逐对向量门处理，用标量门归约复用 key-梯度乘积以避免构建 key Gram 矩阵。保持递推与梯度在精确算术下不变。
AI.result: 在 GPU 上完整低层反向达到 1.15–1.81× 几何平均加速，H100/H200 上四种算子 1.18–1.70×，保持 FP32 工作矩阵；Ascend 950DT 上 1.09–2.89×。消融实验与完整梯度校验验证正确性。
AI.conclusion: ReWY 是一种不改架构与训练目标的精确代数重构，能有效降低 Delta-rule 线性注意力反向计算成本，并已在 GPU 与 NPU 上验证可集成至 FLA 社区模型。

title: GaitFM: A Cross-Modal Foundation Model for Wearable Gait Assessment
summary: Gait assessment supports the diagnosis, monitoring, and prognosis of diverse movement-related conditions, such as neurological and musculoskeletal disorders. Recent advances in deep learning using everyday wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs) offer an accessible and low-cost approach to automated gait assessment. However, IMU measurements vary substantially across individuals, body locations, and device configurations, while existing deep learning models are typically developed using small, homogeneous datasets for specific clinical tasks, limiting their robustness and generalizability in diverse real-world contexts. Here we present GaitFM, a cross-modal foundation model for gait assessment using IMU sensors. GaitFM improves the generalizability of gait assessment by transferring knowledge from large vision models and pretraining on unlabeled IMU sensor data. We pretrain GaitFM on a large curated dataset comprising about 4,000 participants and 1.23 million gait windows across diverse clinical and daily conditions, sensor modalities, and body locations. GaitFM demonstrates strong performance across 18 gait-related tasks, including 3 gait parameter estimation tasks, 14 disease and gait abnormality detection tasks, and 1 clinical outcome prediction task. Furthermore, GaitFM generalizes across different sensor configurations and body locations, including those commonly used in clinical settings and everyday wearable devices. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of transferring visual knowledge in improving sensor-based gait assessment performance, offering a new promising pathway for addressing data scarcity in the sensor and medical domains.

AI.tldr: GaitFM 是一个跨模态步态评估基础模型，通过从大型视觉模型迁移知识并在大规模无标注 IMU 数据上预训练，实现跨传感器配置与佩戴部位的泛化步态评估。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 IMU 的深度学习步态评估模型多在规模小、同质化的数据集上为特定临床任务开发，而 IMU 测量在个体、佩戴部位和设备配置间差异巨大，导致模型鲁棒性和泛化性不足。
AI.method: 提出 GaitFM 跨模态基础模型：从大型视觉模型迁移知识，并在约 4,000 名参与者、123 万个步态窗口的大规模无标注 IMU 数据上预训练，数据覆盖多种临床与日常场景、传感器模态和身体部位。
AI.result: 在 18 项步态相关任务上表现强劲，包括 3 项步态参数估计、14 项疾病与步态异常检测、1 项临床结局预测；并在不同传感器配置和身体部位（含临床常用与日常可穿戴设备）间保持泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 视觉知识迁移可有效提升基于传感器的步态评估性能，为解决传感器与医疗领域的数据稀缺问题提供了新途径。

title: SelfImprove-Bench: Evaluating Generalization in Self-Improving Agents
summary: Recursively self-improving (RSI) systems are increasingly viewed as a promising means of accelerating progress toward artificial general intelligence. They aim to autonomously improve their capabilities by refining their working pipelines and recursively improving the strategies that guide subsequent refinements, with gains generalizing to unseen scenarios.However, existing evaluations lack reliable metrics to distinguish capability gains from scenario fitting, sustainable and extensible protocols for unseen tasks and difficulties, and fine-grained attribution of improvement to evolution traces. To this end, we propose SelfImprove-Bench,an RSI evaluation framework that organizes tasks into three primary capabilities (i.e., Exploring, Planning, Reasoning) as scenarios for guiding model evolution. We instantiated the tasks on games for controllability and reproducibility, and pairs them with scalable generation and orchestration driven by task templates and difficulty coefficients. Beyond task-level scores, SelfImprove-Bench organizes evaluation into generalization ladder levels G0 to G4 that measure how far gains transfer from training conditions. Experiments reveal that the evolutionary gains of existing RSI methods are inconsistent across generalization levels.

AI.tldr: 提出 SelfImprove-Bench，一个针对递归自我改进（RSI）系统的评测框架，用游戏任务组织探索/规划/推理三类能力，并按 G0–G4 泛化阶梯衡量改进能否迁移到训练分布之外。
AI.motivation: 现有 RSI 评测缺乏可靠指标区分"能力提升"与"场景拟合"，缺少可持续、可扩展到未见任务与难度的协议，也无法细粒度归因改进来源于哪一步演化轨迹。
AI.method: 将任务按三类主能力（Exploring、Planning、Reasoning）组织为引导模型演化的场景；用游戏实例化任务以保证可控与可复现；借助任务模板与难度系数实现可扩展的任务生成与编排；把评测分为 G0–G4 泛化阶梯，衡量收益从训练条件迁移的距离；并结合任务级得分与对演化轨迹的细粒度归因。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有 RSI 方法在能力增益上呈现不一致性：演化收益在不同泛化层级间表现波动，即部分"改进"难以迁移到未见场景，暴露场景拟合问题。
AI.conclusion: SelfImprove-Bench 为 RSI 提供了可复现、可扩展、可分层归因的评测基准，揭示当前 RSI 方法的泛化缺陷，为后续区分真实能力增益与过拟合提供度量基础。

title: OC-OPD: Observation-coordinated Supervision for On-Policy Distillation
summary: Reverse and forward Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergences provide complementary supervision in on-policy distillation: reverse KL refines the student's active token rankings, and forward KL allocates mass to teacher-supported candidates. At student-generated prefixes, we form a four-observation matrix by treating the student and teacher as both candidate sources and evaluators. The diagonal self-observations measure uncertainty, while source-centered cross-observations recover the two KL objectives. We establish an exact identity equating the Fisher inverse-metric coupling of their logit gradients with the sum of these contrasts, yielding a common local descent direction for distinct positive distributions. Observation-coordinated on-policy distillation (OC-OPD) uses observations to set preferences, closed-form bargaining to coordinate gradients, and distributional discrepancy to scale the update. Across three heterogeneous student settings (non-thinking generation, thinking generation, and base-model initialization), OC-OPD achieves strong gains in mathematical reasoning and transfers effectively to out-of-distribution scientific question answering and code generation. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/RuoranXu/OC-OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OC-OPD（Observation-coordinated on-policy distillation），通过构建"四观测矩阵"统一刻画学生与教师互为学生源/评估器的四种情形，并用精确恒等式将反向与正向KL的Fisher逆度量耦合表示为对比项之和，进而协调两类KL梯度，实现在多种学生设置下数学推理及OOD迁移（科学问答、代码生成）的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 在on-policy蒸馏中，反向KL优化学生主动token排序，正向KL将概率质量分配到教师支持的候选，二者提供互补监督，但缺乏统一的理论框架来协调它们并指导更新方向。
AI.method: 在学生生成的prefix处，将学生与教师分别作为候选来源和评估器，构建4个观测组成的矩阵；对角线自观测度量不确定性，源中心交叉观测恢复两种KL目标。建立精确恒等式，将二者logit梯度的Fisher逆度量耦合等价为这些对比之和，得到共同局部下降方向。OC-OPD据此用观测设定偏好、用闭式bargaining协调梯度、用分布差异缩放更新。
AI.result: 在三种异构学生设置（非思考生成、思考生成、基座模型初始化）下均取得数学推理的显著提升，并有效迁移到OOD科学问答与代码生成任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过观测矩阵与Fisher几何的精确恒等式，反向与正向KL可在统一框架下协调为共同下降方向，OC-OPD是一种有效且可迁移的on-policy蒸馏方法，代码已开源。

title: SEALECT: Scene-Conditioned Pose Priors for Plausible Maritime Vessel Retrieval
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 (Applications Track). 22 pages: 11-page main paper including references, plus 11 pages of supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/fossil-ai/SEALECT
summary: We address scene-conditioned object retrieval for compositional augmentation in maritime imagery, where strong geometric constraints make appearance-only retrieval produce physically implausible vessel insertions. We propose SEALECT, a retrieval framework that jointly models visual compatibility, vessel pose, scale, and scene geometry through a unified score combining neural similarity, scene-conditioned pose priors, and observed-pose consistency. We construct a maritime scene-pose library and model the pose and scale priors nonparametrically, as a kernel that conditions each prior continuously on the scene with no learned parameters. Across seven maritime benchmarks, our trained scene-conditioned retriever exceeds the strongest appearance encoder (SigLIP 2) in recall (+0.14), and the training-free prior raises geometric plausibility further at negligible recall cost, more than halving the constraint violations of appearance retrieval and outperforming learned foreground-search baselines (GALA-style, DiscoFOS). In a blind study of end-to-end composites (BootPlace placement, DiffHarmony harmonization), SEALECT ranks first among six methods, ahead of random and GALA-style selection and statistically tied with CLIP, DiscoFOS, and DINO.

AI.tldr: 提出SEALECT，一个面向海事图像的场景条件目标检索框架，联合建模视觉相似性、船体姿态、尺度与场景几何，用于生成物理合理的合成增强图像。
AI.motivation: 在海事图像合成增强中，仅依赖外观的检索会产生几何上不合理的船只插入，因为场景存在强几何约束（如姿态、尺度、场景结构），需要检索到与场景几何兼容的目标。
AI.method: SEALECT使用统一得分融合神经相似度、场景条件姿态先验和观测姿态一致性；构建海事场景-姿态库，并以无参数的核方法非参数化地对姿态和尺度先验按场景连续条件建模。
AI.result: 在七个海事基准上，场景条件检索器召回率超越最强外观编码器SigLIP 2（+0.14）；无训练先验以极小召回代价进一步提升几何合理性，将外观检索的约束违反减少一半以上，并优于GALA式与DiscoFOS等学习式前景搜索基线。在端到端合成盲测中（BootPlace+DiffHarmony），六方法中排名第一，与CLIP、DiscoFOS、DINO统计相当。
AI.conclusion: 联合场景几何与姿态先验的检索显著提升合成增强的物理合理性，且无参数先验高效实用，为场景条件目标检索提供了有效方案。

title: Analysing the Narrative Paradox through Formal Models and Properties in Interactive Narrative
summary: Interactive narratives aim to let players influence the unfolding of a story while preserving a coherent and satisfying narrative progression. This creates a central tension, commonly described as the narrative paradox, between player autonomy and narrative control. Experience Managers (EMs) manage the story by determining how the narrative progresses in response to player behaviour. Although this paradox is widely discussed, it is rarely modelled in a way that supports systematic analysis, simulation, and comparison across management strategies. This paper proposes a formal framework for modelling and analysing the narrative paradox as a trade-off between interdependent properties shaped by EM decisions. We represent interactive narrative behaviour through an extended state-transition system in which world states are connected by player actions and system events. From this model, we formalize key properties involved in the paradox such as the player agency, EM controllability, author intent, and robustness, and define quantitative indicators derived from simulated plans. These indicators make it possible to compare EM strategies according to their ability to balance freedom, control, and narrative satisfaction.
