A case study compares different EM policies, showing how simulations can reveal correlations and conflicts between properties and identify compromise zones in the design space. This work contributes a reusable modelling and analysis framework for studying the narrative paradox and evaluating heterogeneous interactive narratives on shared formal grounds, with a focus on supporting the comparison and testing of EM strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个形式化框架，将互动叙事中的"叙事悖论"建模为玩家能动性与叙事控制之间的权衡，并用扩展状态转移系统与仿真指标比较不同经验管理器（EM）策略。
AI.motivation: 叙事悖论（玩家自主 vs 叙事控制）虽被广泛讨论，但缺少可支持系统化分析、仿真与跨策略比较的建模方式。
AI.method: 用扩展状态转移系统表示互动叙事行为（世界状态由玩家行动与系统事件连接）；形式化玩家能动性、EM可控性、作者意图、鲁棒性等属性，并从仿真计划中导出量化指标以比较EM策略。
AI.result: 案例研究比较多种EM策略，仿真揭示了属性之间的相关性与冲突，并能识别设计空间中的折中区域。
AI.conclusion: 提供一个可复用的建模与分析框架，用于研究叙事悖论并在共同形式基础上评估异构互动叙事，重点支持EM策略的比较与测试。

title: Large-Scale Bayesian Optimisation Using Uncertainty-Calibrated Product-of-Experts Gaussian Process Models with Trust Regions
summary: The use of collections of independent local Gaussian processes (GP-ind) combined with trust regions is a widely adopted approach for large-scale and high-dimensional Bayesian optimisation (BO). However, this approach suffers from several limitations, including discontinuities at the boundaries of disjoint regions, an inability to capture long-range spatial correlations, potential information loss, and abrupt increases in computational overhead. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a novel BO algorithm, termed BO-pro-c-tr. The proposed method employs a product-of-experts Gaussian process model with uncertainty calibration (GP-pro-c) as its surrogate model and incorporates a one-to-many association strategy for integrating GP-pro-c with trust regions. Empirical results suggest that, when combined with the GP-LCB acquisition function, BO-pro-c-tr achieves an average reduction of 2.6% in simple regret and 34.9% in computational overhead relative to BO algorithms based on independent local GP models coupled with trust regions.

AI.tldr: 提出新算法 BO-pro-c-tr，用带不确定性校准的专家乘积高斯过程（GP-pro-c）作代理模型，并引入一对多关联策略与信赖域结合，用于大规模高维贝叶斯优化，降低简单遗憾与计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模高维 BO 普遍采用独立局部 GP（GP-ind）加信赖域的方法，但存在区域边界不连续、无法捕捉长程空间相关性、信息损失以及计算开销骤增等问题。
AI.method: 构建带不确定性校准的专家乘积高斯过程模型 GP-pro-c 作为代理模型；设计一对多关联策略，将 GP-pro-c 与信赖域机制相集成，形成 BO-pro-c-tr 算法。
AI.result: 结合 GP-LCB 采集函数时，相比基于独立局部 GP 加信赖域的 BO 算法，简单遗憾平均降低 2.6%，计算开销平均降低 34.9%。
AI.conclusion: 专家乘积 GP 加校准与一对多信赖域关联能有效克服局部独立 GP 方法的缺陷，在精度与效率上均更优，适用于大尺度高维贝叶斯优化。

title: Restoring Semantic Fidelity for Training-Free High-Resolution Image Generation in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based text-to-image models have recently achieved remarkable success in image synthesis. However, when directly applied beyond their training resolution, these models often suffer from severe semantic degradation, where meaningful semantic content disappears. Although existing training-free high-resolution generation methods can mitigate this issue, the inherent semantic degradation at high resolutions remains largely unresolved, leading to degraded fine-grained details. Furthermore, widely used structural guidance methods lack modeling of the structure and details in the intermediate trajectory, which degrades the quality of the generated results. In this paper, we propose a training-free framework for high-resolution image generation to address these challenges. First, we propose a text-visual scale-decoupled attention (TVSDA) module, which restores the model's ability to generate semantically meaningful content at high resolutions by preserving the global receptive field of text tokens while aligning the receptive field of image tokens with the training resolution. Second, we propose a structure-detail guidance (SDG) strategy that explicitly models structural information and fine details through scale-wise and temporal-wise guidance, overcoming the limitations of conventional low-resolution guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves both structural coherence and detail fidelity over existing training-free DiT-based high-resolution generation approaches. The code is available at https://github.com/ljjcoder/Restoring-Semantic-Fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架：TVSDA 恢复高分辨率语义与全局感受野，SDG 显式建模结构与细节，提升 DiT 文生图高分辨率生成的结构一致性与细节保真度。
AI.motivation: DiT 文生图模型超出训练分辨率时出现严重语义退化，语义内容消失；现有免训练高分辨率方法只能缓解，细粒度细节仍受损；常用结构引导方法缺乏对中间轨迹结构与细节的建模。
AI.method: 1) 文本-视觉尺度解耦注意力 TVSDA：文本 token 保留全局感受野，图像 token 感受野对齐训练分辨率，恢复高分辨率语义生成能力；2) 结构-细节引导 SDG：通过尺度维与时间维引导显式建模结构与细节，弥补传统低分辨率引导的不足。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，相比现有免训练 DiT 高分辨率生成方法，本方法在结构连贯性和细节保真度上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过尺度解耦注意力与跨尺度/时间引导，可在无需训练的情况下有效恢复 DiT 高分辨率文生图的语义保真，代码已开源。

title: Creating Hybrid Interactive Narrative Systems with LLM: From Formal Description to Evaluation
summary: Interactive narratives let users shape a story while an Experience Manager (EM) keeps it coherent, balancing player freedom against authorial control. Large Language Models now enable a new generation of hybrid EMs, which combine run-time generation from free-text input with symbolic narrative control. However, their heterogeneity makes them hard to compare: A manager's behaviour is generally tied to the unique and specific scenario in which it operates, and much of its decision-making takes place outside of any explicit and verifiable structure. We address this with an LLM-based narrative platform whose managers are interchangeable modules operating over a shared symbolic world model of facts, operations, and goals. Because every applied operation carries explicit preconditions and effects, each session can be analysed as a plan through a common state-transition representation and evaluated, independently of how the manager works internally, with shared indicators of four properties: player agency, EM controllability, author intent, and robustness. We implement three contrasting managers, based respectively on open generation, Monte Carlo repair, and autonomous characters, and compare them through functional analysis on an interactive Little Red Riding Hood scenario. The results show that no manager dominates on every property, giving authors and EM designers a concrete basis to select a manager according to their priorities.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的基于LLM的交互叙事平台，将不同Experience Manager（EM）作为可互换模块运行在共享符号世界模型（事实-操作-目标）上，从而可用统一状态转移表示与四项共享指标（玩家能动性、EM可控性、作者意图、鲁棒性）对异构管理器进行可比较评估。
AI.motivation: LLM催生的混合型EM结合了运行时自由文本生成与符号化叙事控制，但各EM行为高度绑定具体场景、决策过程缺乏显式可验证结构，导致难以横向比较。
AI.method: 构建LLM叙事平台，EM为共享符号世界模型上的可互换模块；每个操作带显式前置条件与效果，使每次会话可表示为规划并通过共同状态转移表示分析；实现三种对照EM：开放生成、蒙特卡洛修复、自治角色，并在"小红帽"交互场景中做功能分析比较。
AI.result: 功能分析实验表明，没有任何一个EM在四项属性上全面占优，各管理器在不同指标上各有优劣。
AI.conclusion: 该平台提供了与EM内部实现无关的统一评估基准，使作者与EM设计者可依据自身优先级（能动性、可控性、作者意图、鲁棒性）具体地选择合适的叙事管理器。

title: MIRA: Mutual Information guided calibration for Reliable Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates a deployed model using only unlabeled target data, but standard entropy-based methods often rely on deterministic confidence and can reinforce overconfident errors under distribution shift. We propose MIRA, Mutual Information guided calibration for Reliable Test-Time Adaptation, a source-free online adaptation method that uses lightweight last-layer Gaussian perturbations to probe prediction reliability. For each target batch, MIRA reuses a single feature extraction pass and samples perturbed classifiers around the source classifier, forming an efficient local predictive distribution. Rather than fitting a Bayesian posterior, MIRA treats the perturbation scale as a local probing radius and selects a batch-specific scale using mutual information (MI) and prediction agreement. The resulting perturbation-sensitivity signal identifies predictions that are confident and locally stable under classifier perturbations, while suppressing brittle predictions with high stochastic disagreement. MIRA then performs adaptation with an MI-confidence weighted entropy loss, which down-weights perturbation-sensitive or low-confidence samples before they drive entropy minimization. This weighted loss reduces the influence of brittle predictions that can otherwise cause harmful adaptation under distribution shift. The method requires no source data, retraining, model ensembles, or offline posterior fitting, and can be applied as a plug-and-play modification to entropy-minimization TTA. Experiments on distribution-shift benchmarks show improvements in accuracy, calibration, and negative log-likelihood, suggesting that mutual-information-guided perturbation probing and weighted adaptation yield more robust online TTA than deterministic confidence.

AI.tldr: MIRA是一种源无关的在线测试时自适应方法，通过轻量级末层高斯扰动探测预测可靠性，用互信息选择批级扰动尺度，并以MI-置信度加权熵损失进行适应。
AI.motivation: 标准基于熵的TTA方法依赖确定性置信度，在分布偏移下会强化过度自信的错误预测。
AI.method: 对每个目标批次复用一次特征提取，在源分类器周围采样扰动分类器形成局部预测分布；将扰动尺度视为局部探测半径，用互信息与预测一致性选择批次特定尺度；以MI-置信度加权熵损失进行适应，降权对扰动敏感或低置信的样本。无需源数据、重训练、模型集成或离线后验拟合，可作为即插即用模块。
AI.result: 在分布偏移基准上，准确率、校准性和负对数似然均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 互信息引导的扰动探测与加权适应比确定性置信度带来更鲁棒的在线TTA。

title: Fréchet Oral Distance: A Coordinate-Free Metric and Benchmark for Speech-Driven Oral Animation
summary: Recently, speech-driven facial and oral animation technologies have been used in various fields such as education, speech therapy, and healthcare. But methods to objectively evaluate the quality of generated results are still limited. Accordingly, we propose the Fréchet Oral Distance (FOD), which uses embeddings from an Oral Motion Encoder (OME) and a TIMIT-Vis reference distribution. In experiments, FOD reproduced model rankings similar to the coordinate-based metric, Lip Vertex Error (LVE), and showed trends consistent with user preference. Our framework provides objective and reproducible benchmarking without relying on expensive equipment or subjective evaluation, and it can be extended to compare a variety of 2D/3D models.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fréchet Oral Distance (FOD)，用 Oral Motion Encoder (OME) 的嵌入和 TIMIT-Vis 参考分布来客观评价语音驱动的面部/口部动画质量。
AI.motivation: 语音驱动的面部与口部动画已广泛用于教育、言语治疗和医疗等领域，但缺少客观、可复现的生成质量评价方法。
AI.method: 构建 Oral Motion Encoder 提取口部运动嵌入，并以 TIMIT-Vis 数据集构建参考分布，据此计算 Fréchet Oral Distance（类似 FID 的分布距离）。
AI.result: FOD 复现出与基于坐标的 Lip Vertex Error (LVE) 相近的模型排名，并与用户偏好趋势一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需昂贵设备或主观评测即可实现客观、可复现的基准测试，并可扩展到多种 2D/3D 模型的比较。

title: Offline Approximate Value Iteration: A Reinforcement Learning Approach for Satellite Constellation Deployment
summary: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning-based approximate dynamic programming approach to optimize the deployment of Walker-type satellite constellations under uncertainties, including launch failures and satellite malfunctions. We formulate the problem as a Markov Decision Process that incorporates low-injection orbit launches, continuous low-thrust orbit raising, and variable satellite loads. We adopt the offline approximate value iteration solution method, using linear function approximation with basis functions and action pruning strategies to substantially reduce the computational and memory requirements for finding optimal decision policies. Preliminary results demonstrate convergence to policies with low expected costs and deployment times, both of which are lower than those of a rolling-horizon baseline, showcasing a novel application of approximate dynamic programming in space logistics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的近似动态规划方法，用于在发射失败和卫星故障等不确定性下优化Walker型卫星星座的部署。
AI.motivation: Walker型星座部署面临发射失败、卫星故障等不确定性，传统方法（如滚动时域）难以高效求得低成本的部署策略，且精确DP计算与存储开销过大。
AI.method: 将问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，纳入低注入轨道发射、连续低推力轨道抬升和可变卫星载荷；采用离线近似值迭代，结合线性函数逼近（基函数）与动作剪枝，大幅降低计算和内存需求。
AI.result: 初步结果显示策略收敛，且期望成本和部署时间均低于滚动时域基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了近似动态规划在空间物流中的新颖应用，为不确定性下的星座部署优化提供了有效手段。

title: Uncertainty-Aware 3D Position Reconstruction in CZT Drift-Strip Detectors
summary: Accurate three-dimensional interaction-position reconstruction is important for CZT drift-strip detectors, but conventional methods can suffer from degraded performance in challenging detector regions, while learned models provide limited information about prediction reliability. We investigate two uncertainty-aware approaches: deep ensembles of point-estimation networks and simulation-based inference (SBI), which estimates a posterior distribution over interaction position. Both approaches are trained on physics-based simulations and evaluated on both synthetic and experimental data. On synthetic data, uncertainty from both methods correlates with positioning error, with SBI showing a substantially stronger relationship. On experimental measurements, the deep ensemble achieves improved $z$-position resolution, while SBI provides more informative uncertainty estimates that highlight regions of reduced positional information and discrepancies between simulation and the physical detector. These results demonstrate the complementary strengths of ensemble-based reconstruction and posterior inference for uncertainty-aware detector position reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了深度集成点估计网络与基于模拟的推理(SBI)两种不确定性感知方法，用于CZT漂移条探测器三维相互作用位置重建，并证明二者优势互补。
AI.motivation: 精确的三维相互作用位置重建对CZT漂移条探测器很重要，但传统方法在探测器的困难区域性能下降，而学习模型又缺乏对预测可靠性的信息（不确定性）。
AI.method: 研究两种不确定性感知方法：(1) 点估计网络的深度集成；(2) 基于模拟的推理(SBI)，用于估计相互作用位置的后验分布。两者均用基于物理的模拟数据训练，并在合成数据和实验数据上评估。
AI.result: 合成数据上，两种方法的不确定性与定位误差均相关，其中SBI的相关性明显更强；实验测量中，深度集成取得了更好的 z 位置分辨率，而SBI提供了更具信息量的不确定性估计，能突出位置信息减少的区域以及模拟与物理探测器之间的差异。
AI.conclusion: 集成式重建与后验推理在不确定性感知的探测器位置重建中具有互补优势。

title: Deep Learning for Cervical Cytology Screening: Methods, Algorithms, Challenges and Prospects
summary: Cervical cancer remains a leading cause of cancer death among women, with more than 90\% of deaths occurring in low- and middle-income countries, where cytology screening is constrained by a shortage of trained cytopathologists. Deep learning has made automated cytology screening increasingly feasible, but the literature is fragmented across cell, patch and whole-slide-image scales, task formulations and supervision regimes, hindering comparison and clinical translation. This Review synthesizes the deep learning literature for cervical cytology screening, organizing the field along three axes---data scale, functional task and supervision---and distinguishing two clinical roadmaps: whole-slide-image confidence aggregation and cell-level detection with Bethesda classification. We examine 16 publicly available or publicly documented cytology datasets alongside the CAISHI histopathology dataset, compare quantitative performance while exposing incomparable metrics and data leakage, and assess commercial systems, regulatory status, HPV-era screening pathways and low-resource deployment. Single-cell accuracy on Herlev and SIPaKMeD has plateaued, but this reflects benchmark saturation rather than clinical readiness; prospective and randomized evidence is emerging but remains limited. We consolidate the evidence into five challenge areas---data and benchmarks, architecture and label-efficient learning, trustworthy AI, clinical translation and health economics, and evaluation and reproducibility---and provide an evidence-to-agenda map and a deployment decision matrix. Progress now depends on multi-center benchmarks, externally validated label-efficient methods, calibrated and fair predictions, and pragmatic clinical trials rather than further gains on saturated single-cell benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了深度学习用于宫颈细胞学筛查的研究，按数据规模、功能任务与监督方式三轴组织领域，指出单细胞基准（Herlev、SIPaKMeD）已饱和而非临床可用，并提出五大挑战与部署决策矩阵。
AI.motivation: 宫颈癌死亡90%以上发生在中低收入国家，这些地区缺乏训练有素的细胞病理医师，细胞学筛查受限；深度学习使自动筛查可行，但文献分散在细胞、patch、全切片等尺度及不同任务与监督范式上，缺乏可比性，阻碍临床转化。
AI.method: 综述性研究：沿数据规模、功能任务、监督方式三轴组织文献；区分全切片置信度聚合与细胞级检测+Bethsa分类两条临床路线；考察16个公开细胞学数据集及CAISHI组织病理数据集；定量比较性能并揭示指标不可比与数据泄漏问题；评估商业系统、监管现状、HPV时代筛查路径与低资源部署。
AI.result: 单细胞准确率在Herlev与SIPaKMeD上已停滞，反映基准饱和而非临床就绪；前瞻性与随机证据仍有限；文献中存在度量和数据泄漏等可比性问题。
AI.conclusion: 归纳为数据与基准、架构与标签高效学习、可信AI、临床转化与卫生经济学、评估与可重复性五大挑战，给出证据-议程图谱与部署决策矩阵；未来进展依赖多中心基准、外部验证的标签高效方法、校准且公平的预测及务实临床试验，而非继续在饱和的单细胞基准上刷分。

title: Predictive Safety Guardrails Do Not Always Make LLM Agents Safer
summary: Large language model agents increasingly take consequential actions in digital and physical environments, where safety risks may emerge only after multiple interaction steps. This has motivated world-model-driven predictive safety guardrails, which anticipate future consequences before execution. However, existing evaluations largely focus on end-to-end safety outcomes, leaving unclear whether safety gains arise from reliable prediction and faithful use of predicted risks. In this work, we systematically diagnose the prediction-to-action pipeline along three dimensions: how world-model predictions are integrated into decision making, whether the predictions themselves are reliable, and whether their content is faithfully used. Across seven policy models and two safety environments, we find that stronger prediction involvement does not yield monotonic safety gains and can reduce task completion while substantially increasing inference cost. We further find that world-model predictions remain insufficiently reliable, especially over longer horizons, where safety prediction degrades substantially relative to near-term forecasting. Finally, we find that safety gains can persist even under corrupted predictions, while locally verified predictions still leave subsequent safety violations, showing that predictive content is not faithfully incorporated into the decision process. Together, these findings expose a fundamental prediction-to-action gap in current predictive guardrails: producing more or seemingly accurate foresight is insufficient unless that foresight is both reliable and faithfully translated into safer decisions.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统诊断"世界模型预测→安全行动"流程，发现预测更多并不单调提升安全，预测可靠性随horizon变长显著下降，且预测内容未被忠实用于决策，揭示"预测—行动鸿沟"。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在多步交互中才显现安全风险，催生基于世界模型的预测式安全护栏；但现有评估只看端到端安全结果，无法判断安全收益究竟来自可靠预测还是风险预测的忠实使用。
AI.method: 沿三个维度诊断预测到行动链路：(1)世界模型预测如何整合进决策；(2)预测本身是否可靠；(3)预测内容是否被忠实使用。实验覆盖7个策略模型、2个安全环境，并对比不同预测介入强度、长horizon与损坏预测/局部验证等设定。
AI.result: 预测介入更强并未带来单调安全提升，反而降低任务完成率并显著增加推理成本；世界模型预测可靠性不足，长horizon下安全预测相对近期预测大幅退化；即使在损坏预测下安全收益仍可存在，而经局部验证的预测之后仍出现安全违规，说明预测内容未被忠实纳入决策。
AI.conclusion: 当前预测式护栏存在根本性的"预测—行动鸿沟"：仅产出更多或看似准确的预见并不够，预见必须既可靠又被忠实转化为更安全的决策，评估应关注预测质量与其在决策中的实际使用。

title: SensOFormer: Foundation Models for Particle Accelerators
summary: Large-scale scientific facilities, such as particle accelerators, are complex systems composed of thousands of interacting components that must operate collectively to support diagnostics and control, and ensure safe, reliable operation. These facilities rely on extensive sensor networks that generate large volumes of heterogeneous, incomplete, and noisy telemetry, often sampled at different rates across subsystems. In this paper, we adopt the foundation-model paradigm to learn general-purpose sensor representations from historical accelerator data through self-supervised pretraining. We introduce SensOFormer, a denoising masked transformer with a Perceiver-style encoder-decoder architecture designed to handle variable sensor sets, accommodate heterogeneous sampling rates, and learn robust representations from noisy measurements. The model is pretrained on multiple particle-accelerator datasets and transferred to downstream tasks, including missing-data imputation, anomaly detection, cavity identification, and fault identification. Through extensive evaluations and comparisons, we demonstrate that a single self-supervised model can learn reusable representations for diverse operational tasks in large-scale scientific facilities. Project page: https://mahindrautela.github.io/sensoformer.

AI.tldr: 提出SensOFormer：基于Perceiver式编码器-解码器的去噪掩码Transformer，自监督学习加速器传感器通用表征，单模型迁移至插补、异常检测、腔体识别与故障识别等多任务。
AI.motivation: 大型科学设施（如粒子加速器）由数千组件构成，依赖大规模传感器网络，产生异构、不完整、含噪且采样率不一的海量遥测数据；现有方法多为任务专用，缺乏可复用的通用传感器表征。
AI.method: 采用基础模型范式，在历史加速器数据上自监督预训练；模型为去噪掩码Transformer，编码器-解码器采用Perceiver式结构，以处理可变传感器集合、异构采样率并从噪声测量中学习鲁棒表征；在多个粒子加速器数据集上预训练后迁移至下游任务。
AI.result: 在缺失数据插补、异常检测、腔体识别和故障识别等任务上进行了广泛评估与对比，表明单一自监督模型可学到可复用表征。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型范式可为大型科学设施的多类运行任务提供统一、可复用的传感器表征，减少任务专用建模需求。

title: RSI-Env: An Open-Ended Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agents
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) envisions agent systems that autonomously improve their own models and harnesses, with each updated system continuing to improve itself. Existing approaches typically restrict optimization objectives, editable components, or evaluation procedures, limiting open-ended exploration and continuity across generations. We introduce RSI-Env, a persistent environment for coordinated model-harness improvement, supporting autonomous training, harness modification, and retention of research state. An independent Host Controller manages services, evaluation, and versioning. Under Self, each accepted model-harness version takes over the next improvement round. We define three settings that vary goal specificity and access to benchmark feedback: Open-General, Capability-Directed, and Benchmark-Guided. Across these three settings, we compare Self with two fixed external Teachers on seven tasks, starting from Qwen3.8-27B with a minimal harness. Without benchmark feedback, Open-General Self raises GPQA Diamond accuracy from 65.2% to 73.2% and AIME 2026 accuracy from 53.3% to 56.7%. All three Capability-Directed Self runs achieve target-aligned gains. Knowledge Self demonstrates continued improvement across system updates, with SimpleQA accuracy rising from 82.0% to 85.0% and then 88.0%. Benchmark guidance and Teacher benefits vary by task. These results demonstrate RSI-Env's support for open-ended exploration and sustained recursive improvement within the studied runs, while highlighting challenges in preserving gains across capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出RSI-Env：一个支持模型与运行框架协同自我改进的持久化环境，含独立Host Controller管理服务、评测与版本；Self模式下每个被接受的版本接管下一轮改进。三种设置下与固定外部Teacher对比，Open-General使GPQA Diamond 65.2→73.2%，AIME 2026 53.3→56.7%；Capability-Directed三次均获目标对齐增益；知识Self跨版本持续提升SimpleQA 82→85→88%。
AI.motivation: 现有递归自我改进(RSI)研究往往限制优化目标、可编辑组件或评测流程，妨碍开放式探索与跨代连续性，缺少能协调模型与harness共同改进的持久化环境。
AI.method: 构建RSI-Env持久环境：支持自主训练、harness修改与研究状态留存；独立Host Controller负责服务、评测与版本管理；Self机制下每个被接受版本接管下一轮改进。定义Open-General、Capability-Directed、Benchmark-Guided三种设置，在七个任务上与两个固定外部Teacher对比，起点为Qwen3.8-27B加极简harness。
AI.result: 无基准反馈的Open-General Self将GPQA Diamond从65.2%提至73.2%、AIME 2026从53.3%提至56.7%；三次Capability-Directed Self均取得目标对齐收益；Knowledge Self跨系统更新持续提升，SimpleQA 82.0%→85.0%→88.0%；基准引导与Teacher的作用因任务而异。
AI.conclusion: RSI-Env在所研究运行中支持开放式探索与持续递归改进，但跨能力保持增益仍存挑战。结果说明模型-harness协同的持久化框架可行，且外部监督的收益依赖任务。

title: RxnMiner: A Multimodal Agent for Structured Reaction Data Extraction from Chemistry Figures
comment: 54 pages, 4 figures in the main text. Homepage: https://rxnminer.github.io/RxnMiner/ ; Code: https://github.com/rxnminer/RxnMiner ; Benchmark: https://huggingface.co/datasets/UniParser/RxnMiner-Benchmark ; Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/UniParser/RxnMiner-Dataset
summary: Reaction data underpin machine learning for reaction prediction, condition recommendation, and retrosynthetic planning, yet extracting these data from literature figures still requires substantial manual effort. Many figures encode multiple experiments through shared templates, substituent tables, and product grids. Recovering concrete reaction records therefore requires molecular recognition, association of evidence with individual experimental entries, and reconstruction of indirectly specified participants. We present RxnMiner, a multimodal agent system that combines an expert-informed extraction procedure with a chemistry toolbox to coordinate these operations. The agent reads molecular structures, resolves shared and entry-specific evidence, and instantiates participants from templates to assemble source-linked reaction records. We also introduce ChemRxn-Bench, a benchmark of 603 reaction figures with 8,547 manually annotated and reviewed reaction records, evaluated under a common protocol for exact molecular identity and reactant-product pairing. On this benchmark, with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next as the backbone, RxnMiner raises stereochemistry-aware reaction macro-F1 from 21.0% under direct prediction to 71.0%, compared with 25.0% for the strongest existing extraction system. Across five backbones, it also outperforms the same base agent without the extraction procedure and chemistry toolbox by 9.4 to 25.5 points. Applied without human intervention to 10,107 literature figures, RxnMiner produces a silver corpus of 88,202 source-linked reaction records.

AI.tldr: RxnMiner是结合专家提取流程与化学工具箱的多模态智能体系统，用于从文献图表中自动抽取结构化反应记录，并配套发布ChemRxn-Bench基准，显著提升立体化学感知的反应抽取性能。
AI.motivation: 从文献图表提取反应数据仍需大量人工，因图表通过共享模板、取代基表和产物网格编码多组实验，需分子识别、证据与单个实验条目关联、以及间接指定反应物的重构。
AI.method: 提出RxnMiner多模态智能体，融合专家式提取流程与化学工具箱，完成分子结构识别、共享/条目特异证据解析、模板实例化生成反应物并组装可溯源的反应记录；同时构建ChemRxn-Bench基准（603张反应图、8547条人工标注记录），统一按精确分子身份和反应物-产物配对评估。
AI.result: 以Qwen3.8-Flash-Next为骨干，立体化学感知反应macro-F1由直接预测的21.0%提升至71.0%，远超最强现有系统25.0%；在五种骨干上较无流程与工具箱的基线提升9.4–25.5点；无人工干预应用于10107张图，产出88202条可溯源反应记录的银语料。
AI.conclusion: RxnMiner有效实现文献图表反应数据的大规模结构化抽取，并可通过基准与银语料推动反应机器学习数据构建。

title: Scalar Smoothness Is One Point on a Besov Spectrum
summary: Studies of neural network generalization and robustness often summarize smoothness with a single number, such as a Lipschitz constant or a Hessian curvature statistic. However, Lipschitz constants summarize global worst-case sensitivity and Hessian statistics summarize local curvature; neither captures how model responses vary with the size, direction, and location of perturbations encountered in real-world deployment. To measure smoothness under these perturbations, we introduce a finite-difference roughness spectrum that profiles model responses across these conditions. Our roughness spectrum generalizes scalar smoothness measures, bringing Lipschitz sensitivity and directional Hessian curvature into a common framework across perturbation scales. We connect this spectrum to classical Besov theory, which describes how a function's variation changes with scale. Our theoretical analysis also proves that a larger output shift can cause less task damage than a smaller one, and that local curvature alone can miss the blocks most vulnerable to finite perturbations. In image classification, Roughness Source Control (RSC) suppresses margin roughness along noise directions and improves noise robustness in a comparison of 80 checkpoints across four model--dataset combinations. In post-training quantization, we identify blocks that need higher precision by measuring task-loss increases from perturbations matched to the size and direction of each block's quantization error. Our mixed-precision allocation achieves lower perplexity than the Hessian-based HAWQ-V2 baseline under the same GPTQ weights and bit budgets in all 14 settings across seven held-out large language models.

AI.tldr: 提出有限差分粗糙度谱（roughness spectrum），在尺度、方向、位置上刻画模型响应的平滑性，统一推广Lipschitz与Hessian统计，并用于噪声鲁棒性与混合精度量化。
AI.motivation: 现有平滑性/鲁棒性研究常用单一数值（Lipschitz常数、Hessian曲率）总结，但前者只是全局最坏灵敏度、后者只是局部曲率，均无法反映真实部署中不同大小、方向和位置的扰动下模型响应的变化。
AI.method: 引入有限差分粗糙度谱，跨扰动尺度刻画模型响应；将其与经典Besov理论联系（描述函数变化随尺度如何改变）；理论上证明输出偏移更大不一定任务损伤更大、局部曲率会漏掉最易受有限扰动影响的块。应用上：分类中提出Roughness Source Control（RSC）抑制沿噪声方向的margin粗糙度；量化中以匹配各块量化误差大小与方向的扰动引起的任务损失增量来挑选需高精度块，实现混合精度分配。
AI.result: 图像分类上，RSC在4个模型-数据集组合的80个checkpoint对比中提升噪声鲁棒性；量化上，在7个held-out大模型共14个设置中，相同GPTQ权重与比特预算下混合精度分配困惑度低于Hessian-based HAWQ-V2基线。
AI.conclusion: 粗糙度谱提供了比标量平滑度量更细粒度的扰动敏感度刻画，理论揭示全局/局部度量与有限扰动的错配，并在鲁棒性增强和混合精度量化两项任务上取得一致经验收益。

title: Teleoperation System for Service Robots using Virtual Reality Headset and Pose Estimation
summary: This paper presents a teleoperation system for service robots that integrates human pose estimation with virtual reality (VR) to enable intuitive remote control. By using the Mediapipe framework for 2D pose detection and extending it with RGB-D data from the Intel RealSense D455 camera, a comprehensive 3D human pose estimation is achieved. This data is then mapped to the robot's kinematics, allowing the operator to control the robot's movements naturally. A VR interface was developed to provide an immersive perspective, enhancing the operator's situational awareness. Real-world experiments were conducted using the CHARMIE service robot to validate the system's effectiveness in tasks involving object manipulation. While the current system successfully demonstrates the potential of VR-based teleoperation, challenges remain in accurately capturing certain joint angles (e.g., wrist yaw) and ensuring precise mapping between human and robot movements. Future work includes the integration of inertial measurement units (IMUs) for improved rotational tracking and the implementation of more advanced control algorithms. Overall, this research contributes to the development of more intuitive and effective teleoperation systems for service robots, facilitating their deployment in complex and dynamic environments. This work further introduces a novel approach to teleoperation by combining RGB-D sensing with an innovative algorithm for real-time joint angle computation using Mediapipe, enhancing the precision of human-robot motion mapping and enabling immersive control through a VR interface. These contributions represent significant advancements in the field of human-robot interaction, particularly for service robot applications.

AI.tldr: 提出融合人体姿态估计与VR的遥操作系统，通过Mediapipe+RGB-D实现3D姿态映射到机器人运动学，并用VR界面增强沉浸感与情境感知。
AI.motivation: 为服务机器人在复杂动态环境中提供更直观、有效的远程操控方式，提升操作者的情境感知与人机运动映射精度。
AI.method: 以Mediapipe做2D姿态检测，结合Intel RealSense D455的RGB-D数据扩展为3D人体姿态估计；用实时关节角计算算法将姿态映射到机器人运动学；开发VR界面提供沉浸式视角；在CHARMIE服务机器人上做真实物体操作实验验证。
AI.result: 真实场景物体抓取/操作任务验证了系统可行性，展示了VR遥操作潜力；但某些关节角（如腕部偏航）捕捉不准，人机运动映射精度仍有限。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于RGB-D感知与实时关节角算法的结合及VR沉浸式控制，推进了人机交互与服务机器人遥操作研究；未来将引入IMU改善旋转跟踪并采用更先进控制算法。

title: Think with Skills: Pseudocode Planning Before Execution for Advanced Reasoners
summary: Language model agents often struggle with complex tasks even when equipped with expert-written skills. Such skills encode declarative knowledge, whereas successful execution requires procedural knowledge tailored to the task at hand. Natural language skills may leave conditions and dependencies implicit, and tasks involving multiple skills further require agents to coordinate intermediate results and execution order. We introduce Think with Skills, a method that trains reasoning models to turn relevant skill descriptions into task-specific pseudocode plans before execution. The pseudocode explicitly represents operations, conditions, intermediate results, and dependencies, providing a structured bridge from skill descriptions to agent actions. We construct training data that pairs tasks and skills with pseudocode plans and execution trajectories, use supervised fine tuning to initialize this behavior, and further optimize end-to-end task performance with Group Relative Policy Optimization. On SkillsBench, Think with Skills raises task success from 35.0% to 62.0%. These results show that proceduralizing expert knowledge before execution substantially improves skill use.

AI.tldr: 提出"Think with Skills"方法，训练推理模型在执
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体即便拥有专家编写的技能，仍难以完成复杂任务。技能只编码陈述性知识，而成功执行需要针对任务的程序性知识；自然语言技能的条件和依赖常隐含，多技能任务还需协调中间结果与执行顺序。
AI.method: 训练推理模型在执
AI.result: 在SkillsBench上，任务成功率从35.0%提升到62.0%。
AI.conclusion: 在执行前将专家知识"程序化"能显著提升技能使用效果。

title: ECGJev: Question-Conditioned Option Scoring for 12-Lead ECG Interpretation
comment: 5 pages (4 pages plus ethics statement and references), 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027. Zhuoyuan Li and Xidong Wu contributed equally
summary: Clinical interpretation of a 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) often requires answering targeted diagnostic questions with clear, quantifiable decisions. We introduce ECGJev, the first ECG framework built on a decision decoder, a pretrained language model trained to return a probability for every listed option. A question-conditioned bridge compresses frozen waveform and spectrogram features into 16 ECG tokens, and a two-stage procedure adapts the bridge and low-rank adapters on the decoder's native option readout using diagnostic labels alone, scoring all options for a question in one forward pass. Evaluated across four ECG benchmarks, ECGJev achieves the highest macro-F1 on CPSC2018 (80.46%), PTB-XL (71.68%) and Chapman (96.86%), and generalizes competitively to the small-sample PTB cohort. Concept probes and perturbation analyses further show that its predictions rely directly on the ECG input, remain stable under option-order and wording variations, and transfer zero-shot to unseen waveform concepts. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhuoyuanli-lab/ECGJev.

AI.tldr: ECGJev 是首个基于决策解码器（decision decoder）的12导联心电图诊断框架：将冻结的波形与频谱特征经问题条件桥压缩为16个ECG token，用两阶段流程在解码器原生选项读出上仅凭诊断标签微调，实现单次前向为所有选项打分，在多个基准上取得领先 macro-F1。
AI.motivation: 临床12导联ECG解读本质上需要针对明确的诊断问题给出可量化的决策，而现有方法多局限于固定标签分类，难以灵活回答多样化、可量化的诊断问询。作者希望把ECG诊断转化为"给定问题、对所有候选选项打分"的决策式问题，并避免大规模配对文本监督的依赖。
AI.method: 提出 ECGJev：①采用预训练语言模型作为决策解码器，为问题下列出的每个选项输出概率；②设计问题条件桥（question-conditioned bridge），把冻结的波形与频谱特征压缩为16个ECG token 注入解码器；③两阶段训练：先适配桥接模块、再训练低秩适配器（LoRA），二者均利用解码器原生的选项读出、仅依赖诊断标签；④推理时一次前向即可为某问题的全部选项打分。
AI.result: 在四个ECG基准上评估，macro-F1 分别为 CPSC2018 80.46%、PTB-XL 71.68%、Chapman 96.86%，均为最高；在小样本 PTB 队列上也具备有竞争力的泛化表现。概念探针与扰动分析显示：预测直接依赖ECG输入，对选项顺序与措辞变化保持稳定，并能零样本迁移到未见过的波形概念。
AI.conclusion: ECGJev 表明以决策解码器为核心、结合问题条件特征桥与轻量标签驱动适配，可在无需文本标注的情况下实现灵活、可量化且鲁棒的ECG诊断问答，并具备良好的可解释性与零样本概念迁移能力。代码已开源。

title: FinishStrong: Learning to End Well after Imperfect Start in Video Temporal Grounding
summary: A poor start lowers the ceiling, but does not negate the value of finishing well. In autoregressive video temporal grounding, models systematically exhibit an endpoint performance asymmetry, predicting ends significantly worse than starts. A committed flawed start acts as an immutable physical constraint, irreversibly capping the attainable overlap as a sunk loss. While models should minimize the remaining conditional regret, standard post-training paradigms fail to teach this adaptation. Specifically, teacher-forced SFT suffers from strict prefix exposure bias, and holistic trajectory evaluation in standard GRPO inadvertently penalizes conditionally optimal ends if they follow a poor start. To address this, we introduce FinishStrong, a novel two-stage post-training framework explicitly designed to teach optimal continuations. First, Online-start SFT exposes the end prediction to the model's own generated contexts. Second, Conditional-tree GRPO restructures the sampling topology, centering end rewards exclusively within the same-start branch to mathematically isolate the conditional end quality from the inherited start penalty. FinishStrong-9B achieves a state-of-the-art 61.7\% overall IoU on TimeLens-Bench, remarkably outperforming flagship closed-source models like Gemini-3.8-Flash and Qwen3.8-Max. Crucially, when forced to continue from imperfect starts, it reduces the subsequent end prediction error by 36.5\%, proving its exceptional ability to end well after flawed starts. Code will be open.

AI.tldr: 提出 FinishStrong 两阶段后训练框架（Online-start SFT + Conditional-tree GRPO），解决自回归视频时序定位中"起点差导致终点预测被迫惩罚"的问题，在 TimeLens-Bench 达 61.7% IoU SOTA。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频时序定位模型存在端点性能不对称：终点预测显著差于起点。一旦起点已定且不佳，它是不可改变的物理约束，会以"沉没损失"形式压缩可达重叠上限；此时模型应最小化剩余条件遗憾，但标准后训练范式无法教会这种适应能力——teacher-forced SFT 有严格前缀暴露偏差，而标准 GRPO 的整体轨迹评估会误罚"在差起点后条件最优的终点"。
AI.method: 两阶段后训练框架：1) Online-start SFT，让终点预测在模型自身生成的上下文上训练，缓解前缀暴露偏差；2) Conditional-tree GRPO，重构采样拓扑，将终点奖励仅在相同起点分支内做中心化，从数学上把条件终点质量与继承的起点惩罚解耦。
AI.result: FinishStrong-9B 在 TimeLens-Bench 上达到 61.7% 总体 IoU 的 SOTA，优于 Gemini-3.8-Flash、Qwen3.8-Max 等闭源旗舰模型；在被迫从较差起点继续时，后续终点预测误差降低 36.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作指出并形式化了时序定位中的端点不对称与"沉没起点约束"问题，通过改进训练暴露方式与强化学习奖励拓扑，使模型学会在不良起点下仍能良好收尾，验证了"起手不佳不等于终局无价值"的主张。代码将开源。

title: CARE: Grounded Recursive Self-Improvement for Production Customer-Service Agents
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in production agents involves transforming accumulated experience into reliable model updates while adapting to evolving business policies. We present CARE (Customer-service Agent Retrospective and Evolve), a grounded RSI framework that operationalizes this process in customer service. Its goal is to replace a frontier proprietary incumbent with an in-house mid-sized model that continues learning after deployment. After a one-time cold start on governed production traces, the current model serves production traffic alongside the incumbent, and its own failures drive the next update. A 24/7 inspection process establishes failures through evidence-blinded, independently reviewed judgments. Attribution separates model errors from defects in Skills, tools, or the harness, routing component failures to repair. Model-attributable trajectories are truncated at the first erroneous decision and paired with verified repairs. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) then updates the model using the same model as teacher, with the diagnosis and repair supplied as privileged information unavailable to the student. To support continued evolution as business requirements change, training mixes failures from different Skill/SOP versions, each judged against the policy in force when it occurred. Candidates run an executable simulation test compiled from the latest SOP and then frozen, followed by offline inspection of the resulting traces. Promotion requires a combined simulation-and-inspection score at least at parity with the deployed version, confirmation through an online comparison with the incumbent, and human approval.

AI.tldr: CARE 是一个面向客服场景的递归自我改进（RSI）框架，用"失败驱动+在策略自蒸馏"的方式把生产经验转化为可靠的模型更新，逐步替代前沿专有模型。
AI.motivation: 生产智能体需要把累积经验转化为可靠更新，同时适配不断变化的业务政策。目标是让自研的中等规模模型在部署后持续学习，并替代前沿专有 incumbent 模型。
AI.method: 一次性冷启动于受治理的生产轨迹后，当前模型与 incumbent 并行服务生产流量，其自身失败驱动下一轮更新。7×24 检查流程通过"证据盲审+独立复核"确认失败；归因区分模型错误与 Skill/工具/harness 缺陷，组件问题转修复。模型可归因轨迹在首个错误决策处截断并配以已验证修复，采用在策略自蒸馏（OPSD），以同一模型为教师、诊断与修复作为学生不可见的特权信息。训练混合不同 Skill/SOP 版本的失败，按当时生效政策判定，以适配政策变化。
AI.result: 候选模型先通过依据最新 SOP 编译后冻结的可执行仿真测试，再对生成轨迹离线检查；晋升要求仿真+检查综合分不低于在部署版本、与 incumbent 在线对比确认，并经人工批准。摘要未给出量化指标。
AI.conclusion: CARE 给出了一套可落地的 RSI 闭环：以严格归因、特权信息自蒸馏和多道晋升闸门，保证经验驱动更新在业务政策演进下仍可靠可审计。

title: METER: Matched-Event Calibration for Short-Event EEG Microstate Transition Analysis
comment: 36 pages. Supplementary material (16 pages) included as an ancillary file. Abdul Basit and Eklavya Tomar contributed equally
summary: Short cognitive events contain unequal and often sparse transition evidence, so raw EEG microstate distances can reflect finite sampling rather than neural reconfiguration. We introduce METER (Matched-Event Transition Estimation against a Reference), a participant-relative framework that separates marginal occupancy from conditional next-state choice and evaluates each event against duration-conditioned events from a fixed participant-specific reference bank. METER-Jump integrates uncertainty in sparse target and reference transition tables, returning a randomized event rank for testing and a continuous standardized coordinate for association analysis. Using a reproducible three-state representation selected by spatial criteria, we evaluated METER with participant-fitted simulations, estimator ablations, map perturbations, and preprocessing sensitivities. Event-level false-positive rates were 0.044-0.056 across four heterogeneous null mechanisms. By contrast, global cutoffs learned under the participant-fitted null and transferred unchanged to other regimes produced false-positive rates from 0.004 under rare transitions to 0.234 under map perturbation; duration-conditioned ranks remained near 0.05. Detection probability was approximately 0.69 with fixed maps but fell to 0.22 after bootstrap-derived map-assignment perturbation. In 4,175 natural-reading events from 18 participants, no linguistic association survived multiplicity correction in the primary 30-ms analysis, although a 20-ms sensitivity changed one within-stream max-$T$ decision. METER therefore calibrates finite-event departures conditional on a defined microstate sequence, while map assignment, filtering, temporal smoothing, and reference construction remain separate sources of measurement uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出METER框架，将EEG微状态的边际占用与条件性下一状态选择分离，用参与者自身参考库的时长条件事件评估每个事件，METER-Jump对稀疏转移表的不确定性做随机化，实现校准的事件级检验。
AI.motivation: 短时认知事件携带的转移证据不均衡且稀疏，原始EEG微状态距离可能反映有限采样而非神经重构，全局阈值在不同零机制下泛化不佳。
AI.method: METER以参与者相对方式比较每个事件与固定参考库中时长条件事件；METER-Jump整合目标与参考转移表的不确定性，输出随机化事件秩（用于检验）和连续标准化坐标（用于关联分析）；采用空间准则选出的可复现三状态表示，经参与者拟合仿真、估计器消融、地图扰动与预处理敏感性评估。
AI.result: 事件级假阳性率在四种异质零机制下为0.044–0.056；全局截断在参与者拟合零模型学习后跨机制迁移时FPR从0.004（稀有转移）升至0.234（地图扰动），而时长条件秩保持约0.05；检测概率固定地图约0.69，bootstrap地图分配扰动后降至0.22。18名参与者4,175个自然阅读事件中，30ms主分析无语言关联通过多重校正，20ms敏感性改变一项within-stream max-T判定。
AI.conclusion: METER能在给定微状态序列条件下校准有限事件偏离；地图分配、滤波、时间平滑与参考库构建仍是独立的测量不确定性来源。

title: OCBI: Order-Sensitive Cross-Branch Interaction for Image Manipulation Localization
summary: Image manipulation localization combines semantic structure with forensic traces to identify modified pixels. Within-branch spatial mixing and RGB-guided cross-branch mixing can produce different messages when composed in opposite orders. We propose OCBI, an extension of Co-Transformers that models the discrepancy between these two composition orders for localization. A local cross-branch fusion module uses the commutator of RGB-guided cross-attention and forensic self-attention to add a learnable signed correction to feature transfer. Pixelwise adaptive multiscale aggregation then combines spatial contexts before prediction. OCBI uses the Co-Transformers backbone and supervision. We compare OCBI with retrained Co-Transformers using CASIA-only task training, a 50-epoch budget, and final-epoch evaluation. Across five clean test datasets, OCBI achieves a macro PixelF1 of 0.5773, exceeding the baseline by 0.43 percentage points. Under JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and resizing on three datasets, its average PixelF1 over 21 dataset-transformation conditions exceeds the baseline by 0.95 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出OCBI，在Co-Transformers骨架上用交换子建模跨分支混合与分支内空间混合两种组合顺序的差异，以提升图像篡改定位性能。
AI.motivation: 图像篡改定位需结合语义结构与取证痕迹。分支内空间混合与RGB引导的跨分支混合在相反顺序下组合会产生不同消息，而现有方法未显式建模这种顺序差异。
AI.method: OCBI：局部跨分支融合模块用RGB引导交叉注意力与取证自注意力的交换子，为特征传输加入可学习的带符号修正；再用逐像素自适应多尺度聚合融合空间上下文后预测。沿用Co-Transformers骨干与监督方式。
AI.result: 与重训的Co-Transformers（仅CASIA任务训练、50轮、末轮评估）对比：五个干净测试集上宏平均PixelF1达0.5773，超基线0.43个百分点；在JPEG压缩、高斯模糊、缩放三类变换、三数据集共21种条件下，平均PixelF1超基线0.95个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模跨分支混合顺序差异可有效改进篡改定位，且在干净与退化条件下均获提升，但绝对增益较小。

title: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by reducing the sequential cost of token-by-token generation. Advanced SD methods reduce proposal cost with parallel drafters that predict entire blocks in one forward pass, but overall speedup still depends on acceptance length. On-policy distillation (OPD) can push well-trained drafters beyond acceptance-length plateaus, yet conventional pipelines collect supervision through sequential draft-and-verify rollouts. Our key insight is that on-policy supervision need not inherit these dependencies: a draft block can be supervised using only its reference prefix and draft-sampled history. We propose SpecOPD, a branch-parallel OPD framework that parallelizes draft sampling and target supervision across independent branches drawn from the evolving drafter policy at reference anchors. We pack these branches into proposal trees to share target-prefix computation, using tree masks for full attention, branch-consistent indexer groups for sparse attention, and indexed state replay for linear attention to preserve each branch's history. We train the drafter with an E2E-TV surrogate that directly targets acceptance length. Our study spans 8B full-attention (GQA), 27B full-linear (GQA--GDN), and 125B sparse-linear (QSA--GDN) targets, three parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark, and DFlash V2), and four task domains (dialogue, coding, mathematics, and agentic). SpecOPD achieves up to 41.45% higher mean acceptance length, $16.09\times$ supervised-token throughput over sequential-rollout OPD under native configurations, and up to $3.56\times$ generation speedup over autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: SpecOPD 提出分支并行的同策略蒸馏框架，将草稿采样与目标监督在各独立分支上并行化，并用树形打包复用计算，显著提升投机解码的接受长度与生成速度。
AI.motivation: 投机解码（SD）的整体加速受限于接受长度；同策略蒸馏（OPD）能突破接受长度平台期，但传统流程需通过串行的 draft-and-verify  rollout 收集监督信号，存在依赖瓶颈。作者洞察到：草稿块的监督只需参考前缀和草稿采样历史，无需继承串行依赖。
AI.method: 提出 SpecOPD：在参考锚点上从演化中的草稿策略采样多个独立分支，将草稿采样与目标监督跨分支并行；把分支打包成 proposal 树以共享目标前缀计算，并分别用树掩码（full attention）、分支一致的 indexer 分组（sparse attention）、索引式状态重放（linear attention）来保持各分支历史；用直接面向接受长度的 E2E-TV 代理目标训练草稿模型。
AI.result: 在 8B 全注意力（GQA）、27B 全线性（GQA–GDN）、125B 稀疏线性（QSA–GDN）目标模型上，覆盖三种草稿架构（DFlash、DSpark、DFlash V2）与四个任务域（对话、代码、数学、Agent）。平均接受长度最高提升 41.45%，监督 token 吞吐较串行 rollout OPD 提升 16.09×，相对自回归解码最高 3.56× 生成加速。
AI.conclusion: SpecOPD 通过去掉 OPD 对串行 draft-and-verify 的依赖，实现分支并行监督，在大规模多架构多任务场景下同时提升接受长度、训练吞吐与端到端推理速度，验证了并行同策略蒸馏的可行性与可扩展性。

title: Beliefs in feedback: Factored representations of interacting agents in transformers
summary: Complex systems, from ecosystems to brains, are usually modeled as modular components coupled through feedback rather than as indivisible wholes. Can a transformer trained on the joint behavior of a group of interacting agents be understood in the same way? In this work, we develop a computational-mechanics framework to study agents interacting in feedback loops. We formally prove that any joint stochastic process can be presented as resulting from the behavior of agents interacting in feedback, and the resulting process is generated by a hidden Markov model whose Bayesian beliefs factorize into separate components per agent. Furthermore, our experiments show that transformers trained on such feedback sequences make use of this separability, disentangling the beliefs about the underlying factors into separate subspaces of their residual stream. This representation is found to scale linearly (instead of exponentially) with the number of agents. Moreover, interventions show that these representations are causally efficacious, allowing for targeted steering of individual agents' beliefs by selectively inserting counterfactuals. However, coarse-graining the behavior is found to disrupt the factorization, and can force a higher-dimensional representation. Together, the results establish both the dimensional advantage of a factorized representation and the ability of transformers to exploit it, laying the groundwork for investigating traces of compositional predictive architecture in pretrained models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"计算力学"框架，证明任意联合随机过程都可表示为反馈交互智能体的行为，其隐马尔可夫模型的贝叶斯信念可按智能体分解。实验表明Transformer会利用这种可分性，将各因子信念解耦到残差流的不同子空间，表征随智能体数量线性而非指数增长，且因果有效；但粗粒化会破坏分解。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统通常被建模为通过反馈耦合的模块化组件，而非不可分的整体。作者希望探究：在多个交互智能体的联合行为上训练的Transformer，是否也能以这种模块化、可分解的方式来理解。
AI.method: 构建计算力学框架研究反馈回路中交互的智能体；形式化证明任意联合随机过程可呈现为反馈交互智能体的产物，且该过程由隐马尔可夫模型生成、其贝叶斯信念按智能体分解；在反馈序列上训练Transformer，分析其残差流表征，并进行反事实插入等干预实验。
AI.result: Transformer确实利用可分性，将各底层因子的信念解耦到残差流的不同子空间；表征随智能体数量线性而非指数增长；干预实验表明这些表征具因果效力，可通过选择性插入反事实定向操控单个智能体的信念；但行为粗粒化会破坏分解，迫使表征维度升高。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了分解表征的维度优势以及Transformer利用该优势的能力，为研究预训练模型中的组合式预测架构痕迹奠定基础。

title: Detection Instead of Inversion: T1-T2 Microstructure Quantification With Detection Transformers
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, 1 table; For submission to IEEE ISBI 2027; Code: https://github.com/SebastianEndtTHI/t1t2-detr
summary: T1-T2 correlation MRI has strong potential to quantify microstructural compartments without imposing a biological model. Traditionally, full T1-T2 spectra per voxel are reconstructed with an ill-conditioned and time-consuming Inverse Laplace Transform. We propose to view this challenge as an object detection task: A Detection Transformer (DETR) takes 64 TI/TE signals and directly predicts a set of compartments specified by T1, T2, and signal fraction. We achieve a mean average precision mAP@10 of 76.8% on simulated data, outperforming both our previous model design (53.8%) and regularized NNLS (66.1%). We show that our DETR approach outperforms NNLS in almost every setting across compartment count, compartmental signal fraction, and SNR. Reconstruction is orders of magnitude faster than NNLS. The results are fully reproducible from our public code: github.com/SebastianEndtTHI/t1t2-detr

AI.tldr: 将T1-T2相关MRI的谱重建问题转化为目标检测任务，用DETR从64个TI/TE信号直接预测以T1、T2和信号占比表示的组织组分集合，mAP@10达76.8%，优于NNLS(66.1%)且速度快数个数量级。
AI.motivation: 传统方法需对每个体素重建完整T1-T2谱，需解病态且耗时的逆拉普拉斯变换，限制其实际应用。作者希望绕开完整谱重建，直接得到有意义的组分参数。
AI.method: 把谱反演视为"目标检测"：将每个微结构组分看作一个"目标"，用Detection Transformer（DETR）输入64维TI/TE衰减信号，直接输出一组组分（T1、T2、信号占比）。与正则化NNLS及先前模型设计作对比。
AI.result: 仿真数据上mAP@10为76.8%，高于先前模型设计的53.8%和正则化NNLS的66.1%；在不同组分数、组分信号占比与SNR的几乎所有设置下均优于NNLS；重建速度比NNLS快数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 用DETR做端到端组分检测可无需生物模型、避免病态逆变换，兼顾精度与速度，代码公开可复现，具备临床/科研应用潜力。

title: Same Function, Different Gradients: Evaluating Gradient Reliability under Reparameterization
summary: Gradients are no longer used only to train models: Gradient magnitudes are now measurement instruments, used to rank attention heads for pruning, to decide per-example clipping in private training, to allocate adapter rank budgets, and to debug models. Across these workflows, larger gradient magnitudes are taken to mean greater importance. Even for a fixed input--output function, these gradients are computed in one of many possible parameter coordinate systems. For example, attention scores depend on the query and key projections only through the paired product $W_QW_K^\top$. Scaling a head's query projection by $c$ and the corresponding key projection by $1/c$ therefore leaves every output logit unchanged. This change in parameter coordinates rescales the corresponding query and key gradient norms by $1/c$ and $c$, respectively. To test whether gradient-based decisions remain unchanged under these coordinate changes, we introduce Gradient Reliability under Reparameterization (GRR). GRR rewrites a trained model in new parameter coordinates that compute exactly the same function, verifies that predictions are unchanged, and then tests whether the decisions derived from the gradients are unchanged too. Our audits span GLUE classifiers, a ViT on CIFAR-10, GPT-2-medium and GPT-2-large, a 1.1B-parameter Llama-style model on WikiText-2, and six trained LoRA adapters. Empirically, predictions are preserved throughout, but both the gradients and the gradient-based decisions change. Across 66 GLUE attention audits, the median top-3 overlap of raw head-gradient rankings is only $1/3$, and rankings and pruning masks change even under the mildest rescalings we test. In the largest of 14 global-pruning audits, the shifted ranking selects head masks that differ in four of 22 pruned heads and reach $50.92\%$ and $94.84\%$ validation accuracy on one ELECTRA SST-2 model.

AI.tldr: 提出GRR（重参数化下梯度可靠性）审计框架，揭示梯度幅值作为重要性度量在不同参数坐标系下并不稳健：可保持模型函数完全不变，却显著改变梯度及基于梯度的决策（如注意力头排序、剪枝掩码）。
AI.motivation: 梯度幅值如今被广泛当作“测量仪器”用于头部排序剪枝、逐样本裁剪、LoRA秩预算分配与调试，默认“梯度越大越重要”。但即便输入-输出函数固定，梯度也在众多等价参数坐标系之一中计算（如W_Q与W_K仅通过W_Q W_K^T的乘积起作用），按c与1/c缩放会相应把查询、键梯度范数分别缩放1/c与c，因此梯度的意义值得质疑。
AI.method: 引入GRR审计：将训练好的模型改写为新的参数坐标，使其计算完全相同的函数，先验证预测不变，再检验由梯度导出的决策是否不变。审计覆盖GLUE分类器、CIFAR-10上的ViT、GPT-2-medium/large、WikiText-2上1.1B参数Llama式模型以及六个训练好的LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 所有情形下预测均保持不变，但梯度与梯度决策发生变化。66个GLUE注意力审计中，原始头梯度排名的top-3重叠中位数仅为1/3，即便最温和的缩放也改变排序与剪枝掩码。在14个全局剪枝审计中最大的一次，偏移后的排名在22个被剪头中有4个不同，某ELECTRA SST-2模型的验证准确率分别为50.92%与94.84%。
AI.conclusion: 梯度幅值对参数重参数化不具不变性，基于梯度的“重要性”判断可能被任意坐标选择所左右，因此依赖梯度大小的决策流程需要审慎对待，应采用对重参数化稳健的度量或显式规范坐标。

title: RIFT: Residual-Informed Flow Transfer for One-Step Generative Video Compression
summary: Recent advances in video generation have enabled generative video compression to reconstruct details lost during coding using pretrained spatiotemporal priors. However, a substantial gap remains between codec-induced degradation and the perturbation trajectories learned by flow-matching models. In this paper, we identify a compression-dependent directional mismatch that degradation-strength-based timestep calibration alone cannot resolve. Compressed latents remain strongly aligned across codec operating points, while their reconstruction residuals vary substantially in magnitude and direction. To bridge this gap, we propose RIFT, a Residual-Informed Flow Transfer framework for one-step generative video compression. At its core, RIFT introduces a Residual Geometry Inducer (RGI) that converts the pretrained flow prediction into a content-adaptive restoration update using decoder-visible codec cues. RGI integrates flow-timestep conditioning with a learned full-band residual-strength estimate and content-conditioned direction and gain modulation, aligning the orientation and magnitude of the update with the compression-dependent residual geometry. Extensive experiments on three public video compression benchmarks show that RIFT outperforms competing generative video compression methods. The code is publicly available on RIFT.

AI.tldr: RIFT提出一种基于残差信息引导的流迁移框架，利用解码端可见的编解码线索将预训练flow prediction转化为内容自适应的单步生成式视频压缩复原更新。
AI.motivation: 生成式视频压缩虽能借助预训练时空先验恢复编码丢失细节，但codec引起的退化与flow-matching模型学习的扰动轨迹之间存在显著方向性错位，仅靠基于退化强度的timestep校准无法解决。
AI.method: 提出RIFT框架，核心是Residual Geometry Inducer (RGI)：融合flow-timestep条件、学习的全频带残差强度估计，以及内容条件的方向与增益调制，使复原更新的方向与幅度对齐压缩相关的残差几何。整体实现一步生成式复原。
AI.result: 在三个公开视频压缩基准上，RIFT优于其他生成式视频压缩方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 压缩latent在不同codec工作点大致保持对齐，但重建残差的幅度与方向差异较大；显式建模残差几何可有效弥合生成先验与压缩退化之间的鸿沟。

title: Value-Conditioned Proposal Acquisition for Test-Time Reasoning
summary: Sampling and selection spend test-time compute inside a candidate pool, but they cannot recover a correct answer that never enters it. We introduce ValueFormation, a test-time policy that decides after each primary-model draw whether to stop, continue sampling, or acquire one proposal from a heterogeneous reasoning specialist. The three actions are compared on one cost-regularized value scale learned from vote-state features; the calibration is frozen across tasks and primary models, and acquired proposals are accepted only through a frozen posterior comparison. On held-out MATH-500, one Llama-fitted calibration improves over the strongest of eight identically evaluated baselines by more than fifteen points for each of three 8B primaries and transfers unchanged to Qwen3-14B. Removing acquisition lowers Llama MATH accuracy by 20.43 points, while same-trace and same-access replays attribute the gain to state-conditioned acquisition rather than specialist access alone. Where primary coverage is high, as on GSM8K, acquisition is rare and gains mainly come from cheaper allocation; on MBPP, a fixed code route attains the top accuracy at the lowest interaction cost. Varying the token price monotonically reduces calls without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 ValueFormation，一种在每次主模型采样后决定「停止／继续采样／调用一个异构推理专家」的测试时策略，通过统一成本正则化价值尺度做三选一决策。在 MATH-500 上相比八个基线提升超 15 点，且可跨任务、跨主模型迁移。
AI.motivation: 采样与选择只能消耗测试时算力在候选池内寻优，若正确答案从未进入候选池则无法补救（覆盖不足问题）。
AI.method: 将停止、继续采样、从异构专家获取一个提案三种动作放在同一成本正则化的价值尺度上比较；价值由投票状态特征学习得到，校准冻结且跨任务与主模型不变；获取的提案需通过冻结的后验比较才被接受。
AI.result: 在留出 MATH-500 上，一套 Llama 拟合的校准对三个 8B 主模型均较最强基线提升 15+ 点，并原样迁移到 Qwen3-14B；去掉获取环节使 Llama 准确率下降 20.43 点；同轨迹与同访问重放证明增益来自状态条件化的获取而非单纯专家访问。GSM8K 上获取罕见、增益来自更省的分配；MBPP 上固定代码路线以最低交互成本取得最高准确率；调整 token 价格可单调减少调用而无需重训。
AI.conclusion: 以状态条件化的专家获取弥补覆盖缺口，是可迁移、成本可控的测试时策略；其收益依赖任务覆盖特性，需按任务类型权衡获取与分配。

title: Fragility Is Not Reducible to Hardness: Conditional Causal Difficulty for LLMs
summary:
Large language models show large and seemingly arbitrary performance drops when a task is rewritten in ways that leave its requirements untouched. We recast task difficulty as a causal quantity: the treatment effect of meaning-preserving perturbations on a model. A meaning-preserving rewrite can only be observed to hurt a task the model can already solve, so we place the estimand on the principal stratum where the degradation occurs: the conditional causal difficulty (CCD), the probability that a randomly drawn twin breaks a solvable task. Because harder tasks tend to be more phrasing-sensitive, complexity enters as an effect modifier rather than a confounder, and we residualize it out to obtain complexity-residualized difficulty (CRD); zero for a task exactly as fragile as its complexity predicts, positive for anomalously fragile ones. Current benchmarks do not supply the data CCD requires, so we introduce GlassGSM and GlassMATH, augmenting GSM8K and MATH with twins built from perturbation families, raising fragility on GlassGSM by $\approx 12\times$ over GSM-IC-style distractors on the same problems ($3.7\%\to44.9\%$) while keeping the answer key unchanged. Our predictor Frail learns the per-perturbation break probability and reaches $0.613{\pm}0.023$ of the suite reliability ceiling on GlassGSM and $0.557{\pm}0.023$ on GlassMATH, against $0.171$/$0.401$ for a surface-feature baseline and $0.444$/$0.463$ for supervised baselines such as VAP3, and, at a $5\%$ curation budget on GlassGSM, doubles random recall of fragile items, matching an oracle ranking. Additionally, cross-fitted residualization leaves CRD uncorrelated with the declared proxy in practice.
  Code is available at https://github.com/upwork/Conditional_Causal_Difficulty_for_LLMs

AI.tldr: 将任务难度重定义为因果量：保持语义的改写对模型的处理效应，并通过对复杂度残差化得到"异常脆弱"度量CRD，同时构建GlassGSM/GlassMATH基准与预测器Frail。
AI.motivation: 大模型在语义不变但表述被改写时会出现大幅且看似随机的性能下降，现有基准既无法提供估计这种"脆弱性"所需的数据（缺少成对孪生样本），也把复杂度与措辞敏感性混淆。
AI.method: 把难度写成因果量：只在模型本可解的主分层上定义条件因果难度CCD（随机抽取的孪生样本使可解任务失败的概率）；因更难任务更措辞敏感，将复杂度作为效应修饰而非混杂，做交叉拟合残差化得到CRD（恰好按复杂度预期的脆弱度=0）。用扰动族为GSM8K/MATH扩增孪生对，构建GlassGSM与GlassMATH（答案不变）；训练Frail预测每种扰动的破坏概率。
AI.result: GlassGSM上脆弱性较GSM-IC式干扰项提升约12倍（3.7%→44.9%）；Frail在GlassGSM/GlassMATH达到可靠性上限的0.613±0.023/0.557±0.023，优于表面特征基线（0.171/0.401）与VAP3等监督基线（0.444/0.463）；5%预算下脆弱样本召回翻倍并逼近oracle排序；交叉拟合残差化使CRD与所声明代理在实测中不相关。
AI.conclusion: 任务措辞脆弱性可作为可估计、可预测的因果量来度量和预测，脱离复杂度后能识别"异常脆弱"任务，支持高效的基准策展。

title: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
comment: 28 pages, 12 figures, 25 tables. Accepted at the World Models in Physical AI Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Prediction errors from video world models are often treated as physical surprise, but they can also reflect appearance, static content, motion, or ordinary prediction difficulty. We present an evaluation framework that separates what frozen representations contain, how they organize appearance and physical differences, and what changes a model's own prediction error. On IntPhys2, a benchmark of physically possible and impossible events, we compare representations from latent prediction, masked pixel reconstruction, and simple visual statistics. Appearance remains easy to decode, while V-JEPA2 exposes modest information about whether events are possible or impossible. Looking at the latent geometry, appearance changes become smaller compared with differences between videos, their directions line up more consistently across scenes, and their overlap with physical changes decreases in deeper layers. Across action-conditioned models, incorrect actions raise prediction error, while appearance changes also produce substantial responses. In Physion++ video clips, repeating a single frame can produce higher error than the original clip, while changing color throughout the clip can lower it. Using Kubric, a simulation and rendering framework, we find that impossible events can produce lower error than possible events. A fixed error threshold also incorrectly flags many possible events as impossible. A model can therefore represent physical information and respond to incorrect actions without its native prediction error reliably measuring physical surprise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个评估框架，将"表征中包含什么""表征如何组织外观与物理差异""模型自身预测误差如何变化"三层问题分开，发现视频世界模型的预测误差不能可靠衡量物理惊讶。
AI.motivation: 社区常将视频世界模型的预测误差直接视为"物理惊讶"（physical surprise），但误差同时可能来源于外观、静态内容、运动或普通的预测难度，这一假设缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 构建三层评估框架：在IntPhys2上比较隐空间预测表征、掩码像素重建表征与简单视觉统计量；分析潜空间几何（外观变化的相对幅度、跨场景方向一致性、与物理变化方向的重叠度随层深变化）；在动作条件模型、Physion++与Kubric模拟数据上操纵外观/运动/可能性，考察预测误差响应及固定阈值判定的误报。
AI.result: 外观信息易于解码，V-JEPA2仅暴露有限的"可能/不可能"信息；深层中外观变化相对更小、方向更一致、与物理变化重叠更少。动作条件模型中错误动作抬高误差，但外观变化也引起明显响应；Physion++中重复单帧误差高于原片段、整体变色反而降低误差；Kubric中不可能事件误差可低于可能事件；固定阈值将大量可能事件误判为不可能。
AI.conclusion: 模型可以在表征中编码物理信息并对错误动作作出反应，但其原生预测误差并不能可靠度量物理惊讶，需区分表征能力与误差信号。

title: Integrating Domain Adaptation and Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Saline-Alkali Land Reclamation Planning
summary: Reclamation of saline-alkali land requires management plans that account for soil and water conditions, treatment evidence, and financial constraints. This study develops Wenyao, an agricultural decision-support system integrating domain adaptation with retrieval-augmented generation. A bilingual corpus of 8,664 research papers was processed using a 110-indicator schema to construct SA-Bench, comprising 4,860 paper-level planning instances. A QwQ-32B model was adapted through low-rank supervised fine-tuning and combined with case retrieval for budget-conditioned planning. Evidence extraction achieved an F1-score of 0.83 on 300 expert-annotated papers. Without retrieval, Wenyao achieved 95.83% accuracy on 936 source-disjoint multiple-choice questions, compared with 87.93% for the strongest general-purpose baseline; removing explanatory supervision reduced accuracy to 89.42%. Matched-evidence comparisons across 69 region-budget cases supported complementary contributions from adaptation and retrieval. In a blind assessment by 31 experts, Wenyao with retrieval obtained the highest mean scores for objectives and projected outcomes, whereas GPT-5 scored highest for cost estimates. These findings support literature-informed reclamation planning with professional review, while ongoing field monitoring will assess soil and crop responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Wenyao 农业决策支持系统，结合领域适配与检索增强生成（RAG），从双语文献库构建盐碱地复垦规划基准 SA-Bench，并实现预算约束下的复垦规划。
AI.motivation: 盐碱地复垦需要兼顾土壤与水分条件、治理证据及资金约束的管理方案，而现有通用模型难以可靠利用专业文献证据支撑规划决策。
AI.method: 构建 8,664 篇双语论文语料，按 110 项指标模式生成含 4,860 个论文级规划实例的 SA-Bench；以 QwQ-32B 为基础，采用低秩监督微调进行领域适配，并结合案例检索实现预算条件下的规划。
AI.result: 证据抽取在 300 篇专家标注论文上 F1 达 0.83；无检索条件下在 936 道源不重叠选择题上准确率 95.83%，高于最强通用基线 87.93%；去除解释性监督后降至 89.42%；69 个区域-预算案例的匹配证据对比表明适配与检索贡献互补。31 位专家盲评中，带检索的 Wenyao 在目标与预期结果上得分最高，但 GPT-5 在成本估算上最优。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持“文献驱动+专业复核”的复垦规划路径，成本估算仍为薄弱环节，需持续田间监测以评估土壤与作物响应。

title: Large Geometry Models Are Priors For Fast Physics Pretraining
summary: Language and vision models became data-efficient by pretraining on plentiful unlabelled data; physical field models have such data, over ten million 3D shapes, but geometry pretraining designs its targets rather than deriving them from the physics. Euler-Lagrange geometry pretraining derives them: for attached flow, a shape enters the flow's Euler-Lagrange equation only through coefficients that distance and normal line (the normal up to sign) fix to first order. Their reconstruction error therefore bounds what a representation loses about any field, and fine-tuning on costly simulations need only assemble the global field. We realise it in AREALS, a masked surface autoencoder whose areal tokens carry position, normal and area, pretrained self-supervised and sign-free on 61,822 raw meshes. Because the operating condition enters only through the far field, sensors can supply it: AREALS completes a hidden field in one forward pass without condition labels. It matches the accuracy of the same architecture trained from scratch with half the simulations on DrivAerML and DrivAerNet++ and about a quarter on WindsorML. On DoubleDelta wings, 20 sensors give $3.9\times$ and $4.0\times$ lower field and force error than GABI, a Bayesian inversion method with a learned prior, and beyond the training angles pretraining halves the error.

AI.tldr: 提出欧拉-拉格朗日几何预训练与AREALS模型，在原始网格上自监督预训练，实现无标签条件输入的高效物理场预测。
AI.motivation: 现有物理场模型缺乏类似语言/视觉模型的数据高效预训练设计；几何预训练的目标多为人为设计，而非从物理规律推导。
AI.method: 从欧拉-拉格朗日方程推导：形状仅通过距离与法向（法向差符号）确定的一阶系数进入流场。据此构建AREALS——掩码表面自编码器，areal token携带位置、法向与面积，在61,822个原始网格上做无符号自监督预训练；运行条件仅通过远场进入，故可由传感器提供。
AI.result: 在DrivAerML/DrivAerNet++上以一半仿真量、WindsorML上约四分之一仿真量达到从零训练精度；DoubleDelta翼型上20个传感器较GABI的场/力误差低3.9×与4.0×，超出训练角度时预训练使误差减半。
AI.conclusion: 理论上重构误差可界定表示对任意场的损失；实践上实现数据高效、单次前向、无需条件标签的物理场补全。

title: RCFormer: Reliability-aware Context Transformer for Occlusion-Robust Facial Landmark Detection
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Facial landmark detection has advanced substantially under regular imaging conditions, yet occlusion, poor illumination, and large pose changes remain major sources of error because local facial evidence can become incomplete or misleading. Context-guided latent patch recovery offers a promising way to address this issue by inferring unreliable patch representations from surrounding facial context before heatmap prediction. However, the recovered context can itself be unreliable when it is weakly adapted to the input face, influenced by corrupted neighboring patches, or blended without preserving local spatial coherence. We propose RCFormer, a Reliability-aware Context Transformer for occlusion-robust facial landmark detection. RCFormer strengthens latent patch recovery with three reliability-oriented components: visible-context conditioning (VCC), which adapts the context representation using a visibility-weighted global facial summary; visibility-guided context aggregation (VGCA), which reduces the influence of unreliable source patches during attention; and spatial residual correction (SRC), which refines blended latent features using neighboring patch information. The recovered heatmaps are then used as reliability-aware structural cues for existing landmark detection networks. Experiments show that RCFormer improves heatmap recovery and achieves strong landmark localization results on the WFLW, COFW, and 300W datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出RCFormer，一种可靠性感知的上下文Transformer，通过潜在图块恢复提升遮挡、低照度、大姿态下的面部关键点检测鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有面部关键点检测在遮挡、光照差、大姿态时局部证据不完整或误导；上下文引导的潜在图块恢复虽有前景，但恢复出的上下文本身可能不可靠（对输入适配弱、受损坏邻块影响、混合时缺乏局部空间连贯性）。
AI.method: RCFormer包含三个可靠性导向组件：可见性上下文条件化（VCC，用可见性加权的全局人脸摘要适配上下文表示）、可见性引导上下文聚合（VGCA，在注意力中降低不可靠源块影响）、空间残差校正（SRC，用邻块信息精炼混合后的潜在特征）；恢复的热图作为可靠性感知结构线索接入现有关键点检测网络。
AI.result: 在WFLW、COFW、300W数据集上改进热图恢复，取得较强的关键点定位结果。
AI.conclusion: 将可靠性感知的潜在图块恢复作为结构线索，可有效缓解遮挡等困难条件下的关键点检测误差，且可即插即用于现有关键点检测网络。

title: JABER: Sequential Quality Control for Human-AI Data Annotation under Shared Bias
summary: High-quality annotations are essential for training and evaluating artificial intelligence (AI) systems. Quality control (QC) often acquires additional human or AI judgments before accepting a label. Nevertheless, shared biases can cause correlated judgments, leading conventional methods to mistake repeated agreement for independent evidence of correctness. To address this challenge, we propose JABER (Joint Alias-Preserving Belief for Evidence Routing), a bias-aware sequential QC framework that maintains a joint Bayesian posterior over label correctness and shared biases to guide evidence acquisition and termination decisions. Building on this posterior, we develop a finite-horizon algorithm that selects evidence-acquisition and termination actions to minimize expected QC loss under resource constraints. Our theoretical analysis shows that conditional-independence updating can become arbitrarily confident in an incorrect label under persistent shared bias. We further identify when repeated inspections cannot distinguish a correct label from an incorrect label supported by shared bias, when obtaining a new label can resolve this ambiguity, and why modeling the dependence between label correctness and shared bias can be necessary for QC decisions. Our experiments show that JABER reduces expected QC loss by an average of 4.65% compared with a method maintaining separate label correctness and bias probabilities when shared bias makes repeated inspections unreliable. Further, JABER's finite-horizon planning, which evaluates outcomes of successive QC actions, reduces expected QC loss by an average of 10.05% compared with a one-step lookahead method. In real-API experiments on FEVER, JABER achieves zero labeling errors while reducing QC costs by 2.67% and 16.99% compared with marginal-based belief modeling and one-step lookahead methods, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出JABER，一个偏差感知的序贯质量控制框架，用联合贝叶斯后验同时建模标签正确性与共享偏差，指导证据获取与终止决策。
AI.motivation: 标注质量控制常需额外的人工或AI判断来确认标签，但共享偏差会让判断相互关联，导致传统方法把"重复一致"误当成独立证据而过早接受错误标签。
AI.method: JABER维护关于标签正确性与共享偏差的联合贝叶斯后验，并基于该后验设计有限视野算法，在资源约束下选择证据获取与终止动作以最小化期望QC损失；同时给出理论分析。
AI.result: 理论分析表明：在持续共享偏差下，条件独立更新可能对错误标签产生任意高的置信度；并刻画了重复检查无法区分正确标签与受共享偏差支持的错误标签的情形。实验显示JABER相比分离建模方法平均降低期望QC损失4.65%，相比单步前瞻平均降低10.05%；在FEVER真实API实验中实现零标注错误，QC成本分别降低2.67%和16.99%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模标签正确性与共享偏差之间的依赖关系，并结合多步有限视野规划，可显著提升共享偏差场景下的QC可靠性与成本效率。

title: HQNN-CL: Regime-Aware Hybrid Quantum Neural Network with Continual Learning for Financial Forecasting
summary: Financial time-series forecasting is still difficult owing to the non-stationary nature of the market, regime changes, and catastrophic forgetting, which makes conventional deep learning models hard to adapt in the long term. To achieve uncertainty-aware robust financial forecasting in the face of changing market conditions, this study proposes a Hybrid Quantum-Classical Neural Network with Continual Learning (HQNN-CL). The proposed framework combines Gaussian Hidden Markov Model (HMM) based regime detection, BiLSTM temporal encoding, adaptive-depth parameterized quantum circuits, Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), experience replay, and probabilistic forecasting in a single architecture. The framework was tested on four real-time stock datasets: Microsoft, Systems Limited, Teradata and Tata Consultancy Services, and compared with seven state-of-the-art forecasting models, including recurrent and Transformer-based models. The experimental results show that HQNN-CL has outperformed other methods on the Systems Limited (RMSE = 3.0149) and Teradata (RMSE = 0.8909) datasets and is within 0.32% and 0.40% of the best baseline method for Microsoft and Tata Consultancy Services, respectively. The proposed framework also generates well-calibrated probabilistic forecasts within the range of 89.5% to 96.5% empirical coverage rate, has zero catastrophic forgetting (BWT = 0.0000) for all sequential learning tasks, and consistently shows positive forward transfer. Ablation and statistical significance analyses also validate the performance of adaptive quantum feature learning and continual adaptation under heterogeneous market conditions, regime-wise.

AI.tldr: 提出混合量子-经典神经网络结合持续学习（HQNN-CL）框架，用于非平稳金融时间序列的不确定性感知稳健预测，在四个股票数据集上优于七个基线，并实现零灾难性遗忘与良好校准的概率预测。
AI.motivation: 金融时间序列具有非平稳性、市场状态切换和灾难性遗忘问题，传统深度学习模型难以长期适应变化的市场环境，且缺乏不确定性量化能力。
AI.method: 单一架构整合：高斯隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）状态检测、BiLSTM 时序编码、自适应深度参数化量子电路、弹性权重巩固（EWC）、经验回放与概率预测。
AI.result: 在 Microsoft、Systems Limited、Teradata、TCS 四个真实股票数据集上与七个SOTA模型对比：在 Systems Limited（RMSE=3.0149）和 Teradata（RMSE=0.8909）上最优，在 Microsoft 与 TCS 上与最佳基线仅差 0.32% 与 0.40%；概率预测经验覆盖率 89.5%–96.5%；所有顺序学习任务 BWT=0.0000（零灾难性遗忘），并持续呈现正向前迁移。
AI.conclusion: 消融与统计显著性分析验证了自适应量子特征学习与持续适应在异构市场状态下的有效性，HQNN-CL 能实现稳健、可校准且不遗忘的金融预测。

title: LUMEN: Geometry-Guided Diffusion Model for Spatially-Varying HDR Illumination Estimation
summary: Estimating scene illumination from images is challenging as lighting is inherently spatially varying, depending on geometry, occlusion, and light sources. Existing methods incorporate geometric cues by deriving local environment maps or probe-based representations, but largely rely on regression or parametric models, resulting in over-smoothed lighting and limited realism. We revisit spatially-varying illumination estimation from a generative perspective and introduce LUMEN, a geometry-conditioned diffusion framework for synthesizing high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment maps at arbitrary spatial locations from single or multi-view images. Specifically, we reconstruct a coarse 3D scene from input images and render partial environment maps at arbitrary locations to encode visibility and spatial structure. These signals are fused with multi-view image features and fed into a diffusion transformer to generate full HDR environment maps. To train the model, we build a synthetic dataset of 700 indoor scenes with dense spatial supervision, including multi-view RGB images, depth, and HDR illumination at multiple sampled locations. This dataset enables the model to learn spatially consistent lighting distributions across diverse scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LUMEN significantly improves visual fidelity and spatial coherence compared to prior approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出LUMEN，一个几何条件扩散框架，从单/多视图图像在任意空间位置合成HDR环境贴图，实现空间变化的场景光照估计。
AI.motivation: 光照本质上是空间变化的（受几何、遮挡和光源影响），现有方法通过局部环境贴图或探针表示结合几何线索，但依赖回归或参数模型，导致光照过度平滑、真实感有限。
AI.method: 从生成式视角重新审视空间变化光照估计：1）从输入图像重建粗3D场景，在任意位置渲染部分环境贴图以编码可见性与空间结构；2）将这些信号与多视图图像特征融合，输入扩散Transformer生成完整HDR环境贴图；3）构建包含700个室内场景的合成数据集，含多视图RGB、深度及多采样位置的HDR光照监督。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LUMEN在视觉保真度和空间一致性上显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 将空间变化光照估计建模为生成任务，并借助几何条件的扩散模型与密集空间监督数据，可有效克服回归/参数化方法的过度平滑问题，生成更真实、空间一致的光照。

title: Bernoulli On-Policy Distillation: Don't Ignore High-Confidence Student Tokens
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own trajectories using token-level supervision from a stronger teacher. We show that standard sampled reverse-KL OPD systematically suppresses updates to high-confidence tokens, such that their weak gradient contribution does not necessarily imply weak or uninformative teacher supervision. We introduce Bernoulli On-Policy Distillation (Bernoulli OPD), which directly matches the teacher and student probabilities for that token. This yields a bounded probability space correction that preserves teacher-student disagreement while avoiding the additional confidence-dependent suppression induced by vanilla OPD. Fixed-rollout analyses show that Bernoulli OPD substantially restores optimization signal to high-confidence tokens while remaining sensitive to teacher-student disagreement. We further analyze the resulting model behavior through confidence distributions, answer calibration, policy movement, and training dynamics, showing that Bernoulli OPD's gains cannot be explained simply by longer reasoning, larger optimization steps, or more uniform imitation of the teacher. Code is available at https://github.com/duterscmy/Bernoulli-OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文指出标准采样式reverse-KL在线策略蒸馏会系统性抑制高置信度token的更新，提出Bernoulli OPD直接匹配师生概率以恢复优化信号。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏(OPD)用强教师对学生的自采样轨迹做token级监督，但标准sampled reverse-KL OPD会抑制高置信度token的梯度贡献，而这些token的弱梯度并不意味着教师监督弱或无效，因此需要修正这一问题。
AI.method: 提出Bernoulli On-Policy Distillation，对该token直接匹配教师与学生的概率，形成有界概率空间的校正；它保留师生分歧，同时避免vanilla OPD中额外的置信度相关抑制。通过固定rollout分析、置信度分布、答案校准、策略移动和训练动态进行考察。
AI.result: 固定rollout分析显示Bernoulli OPD显著恢复高置信度token的优化信号，且对师生分歧保持敏感；实验表明其收益不能简单归因于更长推理、更大优化步长或更均匀的教师模仿。
AI.conclusion: 标准OPD的高置信度token抑制是系统性缺陷，Bernoulli概率匹配可有效校正并带来可解释的行为改进。

title: Z-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers via Self-Reflection
summary: Diffusion transformers have become the most powerful models for visual generation, but still suffer from massive computation costs. To solve this problem, feature caching has been proposed to cache the features of diffusion models in the previous computation steps and then reuse them in the following caching steps, which brings significant acceleration but also degradation in generation quality. To address this problem, this paper proposes Z-cache as a feature caching method that can maintain high-quality generation through self-reflection. Concretely, we observe that the error from feature caching tends to be sharply reduced after each full computation. Based on this observation, Z-Cache is designed to first predict the features in the future caching steps and then perform a full computation. After that, Z-Cache returns to the caching steps and re-predicts them based on the previous and the current computation steps, which brings correction in features. Experiments demonstrate that with Z-Cache, diffusion transformers achieve comparable generation quality to the original model but with faster inference speed, for instance, 6.22X acceleration on FLUX-dev for text-to-image generation. Our code is released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: Z-Cache：通过“自反思”式特征缓存让扩散Transformer在保持生成质量的同时加速推理，FLUX-dev上实现6.22倍加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer是视觉生成最强的模型，但计算开销巨大。特征缓存可缓存前序步骤特征并复用，带来显著加速，但会导致生成质量下降，需要在加速与质量之间取得更好平衡。
AI.method: 基于“每次完整计算后缓存误差会急剧减小”的观察，设计Z-Cache：先预测未来缓存步骤的特征，再执行一次完整计算，然后返回缓存步骤，基于前一次与当前计算步骤重新预测，从而对特征进行修正（self-reflection）。
AI.result: 实验表明Z-Cache使扩散Transformer达到与原模型相当的生成质量，同时推理更快，例如在FLUX-dev文生图任务上实现6.22倍加速；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过“先预测—完整计算—回退重预测”的自反思缓存机制，可有效纠正特征缓存误差，在几乎不损失质量的前提下大幅加速扩散Transformer推理。

title: What makes a theorem interesting? Operationalizing interestingness for open-ended exploration
summary: An agent that explores, whether it generates conjectures or research ideas, must decide which of them are worth keeping. This judgment of interestingness is usually delegated to a hand-picked proxy or to a language model, neither of which is known to correspond to what humans actually value. I study it for mathematical theorems, by observing which results mathematicians single out in formal libraries and in papers. I model each way of singling out results as an evaluator that weights features of a result's statement, its proof and dependencies, and split its weights into a shared and a subjective part. In formalized mathematics, ex-ante features predict these selections as well as a large language-model judge, and the two complement each other. Interestingness is also largely shared. One set of weights, carried mostly by structural features such as the length of the statement and of the proof and the subfields the proof draws on, accounts for most of the signal and transfers in part across formal libraries. What remains subjective depends on practices and individual authors more than on subfields. The judge's advantage lies in its knowledge of the canon, and neither the judge nor the features rely on memory of the papers. The approach, which infers what a community finds interesting from what it singles out, can be applied to other sciences.

AI.tldr: 研究 mathematician 如何判断定理"有趣"，用形式库与论文中被人挑出的结果作为监督信号，将判断建模为对陈述、证明与依赖特征的加权评价器，分为共享权重与主观权重；发现共享权重占主导，结构特征可预测选择且与 LLM 判断互补。
AI.motivation: 探索型 agent（生成猜想或研究想法）必须判断哪些值得保留，但现有做法依赖人工挑选的代理指标或语言模型，二者与人类实际重视的东西是否一致并不清楚。
AI.method: 以数学定理为对象，观察数学家在形式化库和论文中如何"单挑"出结果；把每种挑选方式建模为一个评价器，对定理陈述、证明及其依赖的特征加权，并将权重分解为共享部分与主观部分，比较先验（ex-ante）特征与 LLM 评判者的预测能力。
AI.result: 在形式化数学中，先验特征预测这些选择的效果与大型 LLM 评判者相当，且两者互补；有趣性很大程度上是共享的——一组主要由结构特征（陈述长度、证明长度、证明所涉子领域）承载的权重解释了大部分信号，并在形式库间部分可迁移；剩余的主观部分更多取决于研究实践与个体作者，而非子领域。LLM 的优势在于其对"正典"的知识，且两者都不依赖对论文的记忆。
AI.conclusion: 提出"从社区挑出的结果反推其有趣之处"的方法框架，可推广到其他科学领域。

title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
summary: Scaling computer-use agents from individual actions to complex software work requires experience that connects decisions to complete outcomes. We present NorthCUA, an integrated system for turbocharging computer-use agents through experience at scale. Its Experience Flywheel supplies diverse executable tasks to the NorthCUA Harness, which sustains long interactions, records decisions, and checks task outcomes. The Flywheel uses these records to curate verified trajectories. For unsolved tasks, recursive self-improvement evolves reusable skills and preserves verified milestones so later attempts build on earlier progress. Staged Learning combines this experience with grounding data from the Flywheel to develop GUI competence through mid-training and long-horizon supervised fine-tuning. The policy then learns from fresh attempts in the same Harness through joint desktop-web reinforcement learning, closing the loop between experience production and policy improvement.
