The resulting Nano, Mini, and Pro family achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source models across GUI grounding, desktop execution, and Web interaction under the reported evaluation settings. For more responsive Web workflows, NorthCUA-Ultrafast pairs direct action selection with open-ended generation on pre-RL Nano, offering a measured quality-latency tradeoff. Together, these advances establish NorthCUA as a high-performing model family and a reusable foundation for agents that carry complex software work from intent to completion.

AI.tldr: NorthCUA 是一个通过"经验飞轮"大规模生产可执行经验来训练计算机使用智能体的系统，推出 Nano/Mini/Pro 模型家族，在开源模型中取得 GUI 定位、桌面执行与 Web 交互的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 将计算机使用智能体从单个动作扩展到复杂软件工作，需要能把决策与完整结果关联起来的经验；现有方法缺乏可规模化的经验生产与闭环利用机制。
AI.method: Experience Flywheel 提供多样可执行任务，Harness 维持长交互、记录决策并校验结果；飞轮据此筛选验证轨迹，对未解任务用递归自我改进演化可复用技能并保留已验证里程碑；Staged Learning 将经验与 grounding 数据经中期训练和长时域 SFT 结合；再用同一 Harness 中的新尝试做桌面-网页联合强化学习形成闭环。
AI.result: Nano、Mini、Pro 系列在给定评测设置下于 GUI grounding、桌面执行和 Web 交互上均为开源模型 SOTA；NorthCUA-Ultrafast 基于 pre-RL Nano，用直接动作选择加开放式生成提供可调的质量-延迟权衡。
AI.conclusion: NorthCUA 既是高性能模型家族，也是可复用基础，支撑智能体把复杂软件工作从意图推进到完成。

title: Biological Congruence: Evaluating Microscopy Generation Across Representations
summary: Generative models increasingly produce realistic microscopy images, yet conventional evaluation primarily characterizes visual fidelity and distributional coverage rather than the biological information represented by synthetic data. We introduce biological congruence as an evaluation principle describing whether biologically relevant information forms a coherent description across representations and remains consistent with its empirical biological context. To study this principle, we develop a text-conditioned diffusion framework that jointly generates microscopy images and instance masks, exposing the same generated biological state through conditioning, visual appearance, and instance structure. Across prompt--mask, prompt--image, image--mask, and population-level analyses, we find strongly feature-dependent behavior: density and confluency are consistently preserved, morphology exhibits recurrent disagreement, while nearest-neighbor distance reveals that strong image--mask agreement can coexist with weaker conditioning and population fidelity. Stress testing increasingly unsupported phenotype combinations further shows that target controllability can increase while untargeted phenotypes reorganize and the complete generated state moves toward configurations better supported by real data. These findings demonstrate that generative quality, controllability, cross-representation agreement, and population fidelity capture complementary properties, motivating biological congruence as a relational perspective for evaluating scientific generative models.

AI.tldr: 提出"生物一致性"(biological congruence)评估原则，用文本条件扩散模型联合生成显微图像与实例掩码，揭示生成质量、可控性、跨表征一致性与群体保真度是互补而非等价属性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型评估主要关注视觉逼真度和分布覆盖，无法刻画合成数据所代表的生物学信息。需要一种能衡量"生物相关信息在不同表征间是否形成连贯描述、并与真实生物语境一致"的评估视角。
AI.method: 提出生物一致性原则，并构建文本条件扩散框架，同时生成显微图像和实例掩码，使同一生成生物状态可通过条件(prompt)、视觉外观(image)和实例结构(mask)三种渠道观测；据此开展prompt–mask、prompt–image、image–mask及群体水平四类分析，并做无支持表型组合的压力测试。
AI.result: 行为强烈依赖具体特征：密度与汇合度(confluency)稳定保持；形态学(morphology)反复出现不一致；最近邻距离显示强image–mask一致性可与较弱的条件保真和群体保真并存。压力测试表明，随表型组合支持度下降，目标可控性可升高，但非目标表型发生重组，整体生成状态向真实数据更支持的构型漂移。
AI.conclusion: 生成质量、可控性、跨表征一致性与群体保真度刻画的是互补属性，不能相互替代；生物一致性为科学生成模型的评估提供了一种关系性(relational)视角。

title: User Attributes and Political Ideology Shape LLM Receptiveness in Online Political Debates
summary:
Online political discussions increasingly involve AI-mediated participation, as users invoke LLMs to assess contested claims, arbitrate disputes, and respond to opposing viewpoints. As these systems become participants in online exchanges, they may alter which speakers and argumentative strategies receive validation within the discussion.
  We study this interactional dimension by reconstructing 5,376 Debate.org debates as LLM conversations and running nearly 150,000 controlled multi-turn conversations that vary user political orientation, expertise, rhetorical strategy, and defended position, including conversations with competing users.
  Across naturalistic and controlled debates, we find that LLMs are systematically more receptive to left-leaning than right-leaning users. The asymmetry persists when users with different political orientations defend the same position and when opposing users appear in the same conversation, indicating that it is not fully explained by stance agreement or simple accommodation to the current speaker. Repeated interaction increases receptiveness without eliminating this ordering; expertise also matters, while rhetorical differences are smaller. The pattern appears across multiple models, but is not fixed: fine-tuning on different political corpora can largely erase or reverse it. These results show that LLMs can respond systematically differently to participants in the same political debate, making such interactional asymmetries important for understanding their emerging role in online public discourse.

AI.tldr: LLM在政治辩论对话中系统性地对左倾用户更友善（更易接受），这一不对称不由立场一致或简单迎合解释，可被微调改变。
AI.motivation: 在线政治讨论中用户开始让LLM评判争议主张、仲裁争端、回应对方观点，LLM已成为讨论参与者，可能改变哪些发言者与论证策略获得"认可"，但这一互动维度缺乏研究。
AI.method: 将5,376场Debate.org辩论重构为LLM对话，并进行近15万次受控多轮对话实验，操控用户政治倾向、专业度、修辞策略、所持立场，并包含多用户相互对立的对话场景；跨多个模型验证，并尝试用不同政治语料微调。
AI.result: LLM对左倾用户系统性更易接受；即使不同倾向用户持相同立场、或在同一对话中相互对立，该不对称仍存在；重复互动提升接受度但不消除排序；专业度有影响，修辞差异较小；多模型均出现，但微调可基本消除或逆转。
AI.conclusion: LLM会对同一政治辩论中不同参与者作出系统性不同回应，这种互动性不对称对理解其在线公共话语角色很重要。

title: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations by matching the teacher's token probabilities. These probabilities entangle two kinds of information: which tokens the teacher prefers, and how confident it is. The latter reflects the teacher's own capacity and calibration, which a smaller student may be unable to reproduce. Because the teacher temperature changes these values without changing the ordering, OPD is also sensitive to the temperature choice. We ask whether the teacher's ordering of candidate tokens is enough, and propose Order-Only On-Policy Distillation (O$^{3}$PD). At each student-generated prefix, O$^{3}$PD trains the student to reproduce the order of the teacher's top-$K$ tokens, without fitting their probability values. The objective is therefore invariant to the teacher temperature and needs no temperature tuning. Across six teacher--student pairs, O$^{3}$PD outperforms OPD on the average over HMMT25, AIME24, and AIME25 in every pair, by up to 2.9 points, with gains of up to 5.6 points on AIME25. Other ranking losses yield similar gains, so the benefit comes from ordinal supervision itself. Analysis shows that O$^{3}$PD departs further from the teacher's probabilities than OPD, yet reproduces its ranking more faithfully and yields a stronger student. The ranking, not the probability values, thus carries the knowledge that on-policy distillation needs to transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出Order-Only On-Policy Distillation (O³PD)，只用教师模型top-K候选token的排序（而非概率值）作为监督信号，避免拟合教师自身置信度与温度选择，在六组教师-学生对上均优于OPD。
AI.motivation: OPD通过匹配教师token概率训练学生，但概率值纠缠了"偏好哪些token"和"教师自身置信度/校准"两类信息，后者小型学生可能无法复现；且温度改变概率值而不改变排序，使OPD对温度选择敏感。作者追问：教师的排序信息是否已足够？
AI.method: 在每个学生自生成前缀处，O³PD要求学生复现教师top-K token的顺序，仅拟合排序而不拟合概率数值，因此目标对教师温度不变、无需调温。并使用其他排序损失验证收益来源。
AI.result: 在六组教师-学生对上，HMMT25、AIME24、AIME25平均成绩全部优于OPD，最多提升2.9分，AIME25上最多提升5.6分；其他排序损失也带来类似增益，说明收益来自序数监督本身。
AI.conclusion: 分析显示O³PD虽比OPD更偏离教师概率，却更忠实地复现其排序并得到更强学生。因此在策略蒸馏中真正需要传递的知识是排序而非概率值。

title: Learning-to-Memorize: Dynamic Context Management for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video generation has achieved impressive results on short clips, yet generating long videos remains challenging due to error accumulation over extended horizons, where each predicted frame depends on potentially imperfect previous frames. Existing approaches typically rely on static context management strategies, such as sliding-window caches that discard early frames or fixed sink frames that permanently preserve initial content. These designs either lose critical long-range context or anchor generation to outdated information, which can lead to degraded fidelity, motion stagnation, and reduced diversity. In this paper, we propose Learning to Memorize (L2M), a learned context memory management framework that dynamically retains, evicts, and evolves historical frames according to predicted importance. The framework consists of an importance prediction router that estimates the relevance of each historical frame, degradation-aware training that improves robustness to noisy or corrupted context, and a dynamic memory initialization and evolution mechanism that updates long-term memory using exponential moving average (EMA) importance scores. This allows high-quality frames to replace stale anchors and enables memory to adapt naturally to scene evolution. Trained with a teacher-student distillation objective and sparsity regularization, L2M makes efficient use of a fixed KV-cache budget while preserving the most informative contextual information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that L2M improves long-horizon video generation quality and temporal consistency over existing baselines, providing a learned strategy for context memory management in long autoregressive video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出学习式上下文记忆管理框架 L2M，按预测重要性动态保留、淘汰与演化历史帧，提升长视频自回归生成的质量与时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频生成在短视频上效果好，但长视频存在误差累积，每帧依赖可能不完美的前序帧。现有静态上下文管理（滑动窗口丢早期帧、固定 sink 帧长期保留初始内容）要么丢失关键长程上下文，要么被过时信息锚定，导致保真度下降、运动停滞与多样性减少。
AI.method: L2M 由三部分组成：重要性预测路由器估计每个历史帧的相关性；退化感知训练提升对噪声/损坏上下文的鲁棒性；动态记忆初始化与演化机制用 EMA 重要性分数更新长期记忆，使高质量帧替换陈旧锚点并随场景演化自适应。训练采用教师-学生蒸馏目标加稀疏正则，在固定 KV-cache 预算下高效利用上下文。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，L2M 在长时程视频生成质量与时间一致性上优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: L2M 为长自回归视频生成提供了一种可学习的上下文记忆管理策略，取代静态窗口/sink 设计，在有限缓存预算下保留最具信息量的上下文。

title: Why Tabular Foundation Models Excel on Relational Data They Have Never Seen
summary: Given a relational database (RDB) storing heterogeneous tabular information, how can we predict missing (or future) values in some target column of interest? As candidate targets are numerous in enterprise settings, it is preferable to avoid learning a new model from scratch each time there is a new prediction task. Frozen foundation models (FMs) based on in-context learning (ICL) and RDB-specific pre-training provide a viable solution, but the ideal design still remains largely unresolved. Perhaps unexpectedly, preliminary evidence has recently shown that existing single-table FMs (aka TFMs), when combined with suitable parameter-free relational encoders, can be quite competitive in practice despite zero exposure to RDB pre-training or relational data of any kind. In this work we first empirically confirm this phenomenon with a more diverse array of experiments. We then turn to our main contribution, namely, surfacing multiple complementary explanations for why TFMs behave so effectively. These explanations ultimately hinge on innate synergies whereby parameter-free encoders map relational effects to fixed-length embeddings that loosely mimic distributions for which TFMs were originally designed; in so doing, desirable single-table properties transfer to relational settings (e.g., convergent posterior predictive distributions). Collectively, our analysis forges new pathways for improving RDB FMs, particularly when we prioritize interpretability and inevitable integration within agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 现有单表冻结基座模型(TFM)配合无参数关系编码器，在零RDB预训练情况下也能与RDB专用模型竞争；本文通过多样实验证实该现象，并给出多重互补解释，揭示其有效性的内在协同机制。
AI.motivation: 企业场景中预测任务众多，逐一从零训练模型代价高；虽有基于ICL的冻结基座模型与RDB专用预训练方案，但理想设计尚未定型，且已有初步证据显示单表TFM加无参数关系编码器意外地有竞争力，需要系统验证与机理阐释。
AI.method: 用更多样化的实验阵列实证确认TFM+无参数关系编码器的竞争力；随后从多个互补角度剖析其机理，核心在于无参数编码器将关系效应映射为定长嵌入，这些嵌入近似匹配TFM原始设计所针对的分布，从而使单表优良性质（如收敛的后验预测分布）迁移到关系场景。
AI.result: 实证上进一步确认单表TFM在关系数据上的强竞争力；理论上提出多重互补解释，说明固定长度嵌入与TFM训练分布的松散匹配是性能迁移的关键，单表性质可有效传递至关系设置。
AI.conclusion: 本文为改进RDB基座模型开辟新路径，尤其在强调可解释性与必然融入智能体系统时具有指导意义，并指出无需RDB预训练亦可获得强性能的设计方向。

title: Conditional Calibration Contracts under Coupled Load: A Branch-Aware Audit of Switched Inference
comment: 12 pages including references and appendices, ACM sigconf. Historical 40-cell campaign (10 training seeds x 4 coupling levels), with separate three-seed sweeps/ablations. Includes proofs, prospective FIFO mechanism checks, and limitations; prospective contract validation remains open
summary: Bursty serving changes both queue states and the population selected for each model. We study conditional calibration contracts as a specification to be validated, rather than a certified property of an existing router. CA-MHD combines load-coupled distillation, closed-loop replay and a cost-informed Schmitt router in a discrete-event simulator with a hardware service table. Across 40 cells (ten training seeds and four content-load coupling levels), we distinguish the original teacher, frozen wide heads on an adapted trunk, and the narrow student. A common teacher-trajectory audit has median absolute student-teacher deficit 0.06 percentage points, but does not certify the student-selected deployment support. Historical results use a kernel correctness gap, not the published SmoothECE; we separately prove selected-branch composition for a residual functional at a common fixed scale. The deployed wide branch has lower ordinal accuracy than the original teacher in all 40 cells. Same-checkpoint student-only serving has lower historical ordinal gap in 27/40 cells; routing also exposes violation tails up to 17.5 percent. Student p99 latency remains above the 1.5 ms target. Retrospective temporal recalibration improves the ordinal gap in 39/40 cells, but causal delayed-label availability is unverified and no incremental per-mode benefit is detected after multiplicity adjustment. An in-sample CUSUM detects 30/40 checkpoint changes at five historical false alarms, with no prospective false-alarm guarantee. These findings support a branch-aware audit and a scoped negative result, not demonstrated routing superiority. Independent budgets, selected-support validation and net utility under a satisfied SLA remain open.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将条件校准仅作为待验证的规范而非既有路由器的已认证属性，并在离散事件仿真中构建CA-MHD（负载耦合蒸馏+闭环回放+成本感知Schmitt路由）来审计分支感知的性能。结果表明难以证明路由优越性：宽分支序数精度在所有40个单元中均低于原教师，学生p99延迟仍超1.5ms目标，多项改进在多重性校正后不显著。
AI.motivation: 突发式服务（bursty serving）同时改变队列状态和每个模型被选中的样本群体，使原有条件校准结论失效；现有研究常把条件校准当作已有路由器的"已认证"性质，而作者希望把它作为需要被验证的规范，并检验窄学生模型在选中支持集上的表现能否被现有审计所认证。
AI.method: 在带硬件服务表的离散事件仿真器中构造CA-MHD，组合负载耦合蒸馏、闭环回放与成本感知Schmitt路由器；在40个单元（10个训练种子×4种内容负载耦合水平）上对比原教师、在适配主干上的冻结宽头、以及窄学生三类模型；使用教师轨迹审计（中位绝对学生-教师差距0.06个百分点）与基于核的正确性差距（而非已发表的SmoothECE）进行评估，并对共同固定尺度下的残差泛函给出选中分支组合的证明；另做回顾性时间重校准与样本内CUSUM变化检测。
AI.result: 教师轨迹审计虽显示中位差距仅0.06个百分点，但无法认证学生所选择的部署支持集；部署的宽分支在全部40个单元中序数精度均低于原教师；仅学生的同检查点服务在27/40单元序数差距更小；路由还暴露出最高达17.5%的违规尾部；学生p99延迟仍高于1.5ms目标；回顾性时间重校准在39/40单元改善序数差距，但因果延迟标签可得性未验证、多重性校正后无逐模式增量收益；样本内CUSUM在5个历史误报下检出30/40次检查点变化，无前瞻性误报保证。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持分支感知的审计流程，并给出一个有边界的负面结果，而非已证明的路由优越性。独立预算设定、选中支持集验证、以及满足SLA条件下的净效用仍有待解决。

title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
summary: Computer graphics is built on code. Large language model (LLM) agents can now generate graphics code and iteratively refine it through various feedback. This capability opens the door to a potentially new paradigm of computer graphics, with graphics algorithms increasingly built around agentic systems to automate progressively complex tasks. Over the past years, research on agentic graphics has expanded rapidly across a diverse range of tasks. This rapid growth makes it increasingly difficult for manual literature reviews to keep pace with new developments. At the same time, similar ideas are often described using different terminology across these tasks, further complicating efforts to develop a systematic understanding of the field. In this report, we address these challenges through two contributions. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy for characterizing agentic systems across diverse computer graphics tasks. Second, we develop an agentic literature system that can assist human researchers in analyzing existing and newly published papers at scale. Building on these contributions, we analyze emerging research trends and discuss open challenges in coordinating agents and tools across graphics tasks, designing interfaces and representations for human-agent collaboration, sustaining long-horizon planning and refinement, and reliably evaluating interactive graphics systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向"智能体化图形学"(agentic graphics)的统一分类体系，并构建了一个智能体化文献分析系统，以大规模辅助研究者梳理快速增长的图形学LLM智能体研究，进而总结趋势与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 图形学以代码为基础，LLM智能体可生成并迭代优化图形代码，催生了围绕智能体系统自动化的新范式。相关研究快速增长，人工文献综述难以跟进；且不同任务对相似概念使用不同术语，阻碍了系统性理解。
AI.method: 两项贡献：(1) 提出统一分类体系(taxonomy)，用于刻画跨多种计算机图形任务的智能体系统；(2) 开发智能体化文献系统，可大规模辅助人类研究者分析已有及新发表的论文。
AI.result: 基于上述工具，分析了新兴研究趋势，并识别出四方面开放挑战：跨图形任务的智能体与工具协同、人-智能体协作的接口与表征设计、长程规划与迭代优化、交互式图形系统的可靠评估。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为快速扩张的智能体化图形学研究提供了系统化框架与自动化文献分析手段，并明确了未来值得探索的关键方向。

title: Action Verification through Conjecture and Refutation for Language Model Agents
summary: Language model agents increasingly act on users' behalf by manipulating external environments through tools, often from high-level instructions that leave critical task- and environment-specific context unstated. To prevent resulting misaligned actions, recent work verifies proposed actions before execution, largely by establishing whether the conditions supporting them hold. We argue that this confirmation-oriented view leaves a fundamental blind spot: a wrong action often passes every check that asks whether it is right. This motivates a different question for verification: rather than asking what evidence supports an action, can the agent find evidence that refutes it? We pursue this direction with BlackSwan, a refutation-oriented, expect-suspect-test procedure that predicts the intended effect of each state-mutating action, formulates specific and empirically testable hypotheses for how it could be wrong, and tests them using existing observations or additional non-mutating actions, executing the action only if none survives testing. On challenging AppWorld tasks, BlackSwan improves success rate over the strongest baseline by 14.9 and 25.2%p with and without the backbone model's thinking mode, respectively. Even without thinking or in-context demonstrations, it outperforms stronger baselines equipped with them. The gains also transfer beyond AppWorld, with BlackSwan improving WebShop performance by 12.7%p. More broadly, our results suggest that language model agents have an underused capacity to recognize and self-correct misaligned actions, which can be systematically elicited through active conjecture and refutation before execution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BlackSwan——一种"证伪导向"的执行前动作验证流程（expect-suspect-test），通过主动寻找反证而非支持性证据来识别并自我纠正 LLM agent 的错误动作。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 通过工具修改外部环境时，往往只收到高层指令，缺失任务与环境相关的关键上下文，容易产生错位动作。现有验证方法以"确认"为导向，只检查支撑动作的条件是否成立，存在根本盲区：错误动作常常能通过所有"它是对的"类检查。
AI.method: 提出 refutation-oriented 的 expect-suspect-test 三步流程：对每个会改变状态的动作，先预测其预期效果（expect），再构造具体且可实证检验的"它可能错在哪"的假设（suspect），然后用已有观测或额外的非变更型动作进行测试（test）；只有当没有任何假设存活时才执行该动作。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 上，BlackSwan 相比最强基线在开启与关闭 backbone thinking 模式下分别提升成功率 14.9 与 25.2 个百分点；即使不使用 thinking 或 in-context 示例，也优于具备这些能力的更强基线。方法可迁移至其他环境，在 WebShop 上提升 12.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 LLM agent 具备被低估的识别与自我纠正错位动作的能力，可通过执行前的"主动猜想与证伪"系统性地激发出来；动作验证应从"寻找支持证据"转向"寻找反驳证据"。

title: Mesh2Shell Neural Operator for Inverse Shape Optimization
summary: Physics-driven design seeks high-performing geometries, which need not conform to a learned shape category. Parametric and latent-space approaches facilitate surrogate-based optimization, but restrict deformations to prescribed shape families or learned decoders. We introduce the Mesh-to-Shell Neural Operator (M2S-NO) as the mesh-to-shell component of a category-agnostic inverse shape optimization framework. We separate the explicit mesh used for design from the volumetric representation used for physics prediction. M2S-NO maps oriented surface samples to a surface-centered shell representation, such as TruncatedSDF or HeatSDF. A separate problem-specific PDE neural operator (PDE-NO) maps this representation to physical fields. Objective gradients update mesh vertices through both operators, without a latent shape decoder. Preconditioning and remeshing support free-form deformation, while fixed interfaces are controlled directly on the mesh. Optional shell-space proposals enable topology changes. We evaluate geometric matching, jet-engine brackets, and neutron moderators, with independent FEM and OpenMC evaluation. Relative to the best training designs, M2S-NO reduces maximum bracket displacement by 14.3% and increases neutron-sensor current by 13.8%. Optimization also succeeds from an out-of-distribution bracket initialization, demonstrating the framework's geometric flexibility.

AI.tldr: 提出Mesh-to-Shell神经算子(M2S-NO)，将显式网格设计与体素物理预测解耦，实现类别无关的自由拓扑形状优化。
AI.motivation: 物理驱动的形状优化需要高性能几何，但不应对应预设形状类别；参数化与潜空间方法虽便于代理优化，却把变形限制在指定形状族或学习解码器内。
AI.method: 将设计用显式网格与物理预测用体积表示分离。M2S-NO把有向表面采样映射为以表面为中心的壳表示(TruncatedSDF或HeatSDF)，再由问题专用的PDE神经算子映射到物理场；梯度经两算子回传更新网格顶点，无需潜空间解码器。配合预条件与重网格支持自由变形，固定界面直接在网格上控制，可选壳空间提议实现拓扑变化。
AI.result: 在几何匹配、喷气发动机支架和中子慢化体上评测(独立FEM与OpenMC验证)。相比最佳训练设计，支架最大位移降低14.3%，中子传感器电流提升13.8%；且从分布外支架初始化解仍成功优化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了几何灵活、类别无关的逆形状优化，验证了网格到壳神经算子在多物理场景中的有效性。

title: Prior-Guided Physics-Informed Deep Learning for Fast 4D MRI Reconstruction
summary: Background and purpose: We propose PGPI4MR (prior-guided, physics-informed 4D MRI reconstruction), a deep learning method that leverages information from other respiratory phases or a setup scan, the first 30 s of the same scan, to improve 4D MRI reconstruction without extra scan time. Materials and methods: PGPI4MR is an unrolled network that reconstructs 16 respiratory phases from 60, 30, or 15 s of data, and single 3D volumes, each from 0.29-0.49 s of data, using a setup-scan image. The networks were trained once, on other volunteers, and were not retrained for new volunteers. We evaluated PGPI4MR on measured k-space from three datasets: free-breathing MR-linac (1.5T) and abdominal (3T) scans, and thigh scans with cuff compression (1.5T). All methods, including comparative models, received identical samples and were scored similarly. Results: In vivo, PGPI4MR had the lowest held-out error for 4D MRI at every scan time, and its 16 phases were ready a median of 7.5-13 s after the scan on the 2 GPUs tested. Coupling the 16 respiratory phases reduced the error at 60 s by 9.1% compared with reconstructing each phase alone. For sub-second MRI, the error at 0.49 s was 15.5% lower than that of the best comparison method, classical reconstruction toward the same prior, and on the faster GPU, every 0.29 s window was acquired and reconstructed within 0.5 s. Without retraining, PGPI4MR matched the best methods on the 3T abdominal scans but not on the thigh scans; after retraining on thigh data, it reduced the held-out error by 6.6% relative to the best comparison method. Conclusion: Prior information allowed PGPI4MR to reconstruct 4D and sub-second MRI more accurately than compressed sensing and a published 4D network, within seconds and without extra scan time. This could support 4D MRI for treatment planning and 3D motion monitoring during MR-guided radiotherapy.

AI.tldr: 提出PGPI4MR——先验引导、物理约束的深度展开网络，利用前置扫描或其他呼吸相位信息重建4D MRI与亚秒3D MRI，无需额外扫描时间，误差低于压缩感知和已发表的4D网络，且可在数秒内完成。
AI.motivation: 4D MRI在MR引导放疗的规划与运动监测中很有价值，但扫描时间长、重建精度受欠采样限制；希望在不增加扫描时间的前提下利用已有先验信息提升重建质量。
AI.method: 采用展开式（unrolled）网络，输入为60/30/15 s数据重建16个呼吸相位、以及0.29–0.49 s短窗数据重建单个3D容积，先验来自其他呼吸相位或同一扫描前30 s的setup scan；网络在他人数据上训练一次，不对新志愿者再训练；在实测k空间（1.5T MR-linac自由呼吸、3T腹部、1.5T大腿袖带压迫）上与压缩感知等基线对比。
AI.result: 各扫描时长下4D MRI留出误差最低，16相位在测试GPU上扫描后中位7.5–13 s即可得；耦合16相位使60 s误差较单相位重建降低9.1%；亚秒MRI在0.49 s处误差比最佳对比方法（朝同一先验的经典重建）低15.5%，快速GPU上0.29 s窗可在0.5 s内完成采集重建；不重训练时在3T腹部与最佳方法持平、大腿不佳，重训练后误差再降6.6%。
AI.conclusion: 先验信息使PGPI4MR在数秒内、无额外扫描时间条件下比压缩感知和已发表4D网络更准确地重建4D及亚秒MRI，有望支撑MR引导放疗中的4D规划与3D运动监测。

title: TSSDA: An Autonomous Agent for Constructing a Time-Series Text-to-SQL Benchmark
summary: As agents increasingly undertake data querying, Text-to-SQL serves as a foundational capability for database access. However, for text-to-SQL in time-series databases, high-quality benchmarks and large-scale training corpora remain scarce, limiting the systematic evaluation and domain adaptation of existing models and agents. Existing automated SQL generation approaches lack sufficient autonomy, leaving key challenges unresolved. First, numerous combinations of temporal syntax and functions complicate comprehensive coverage of valid queries. Second, as the corpus grows, generating valuable and diverse new data becomes increasingly challenging. Third, schema and data heterogeneity hinder reuse of temporal query structures, limiting generation efficiency. To address these challenges, we propose TSSDA, a Time-Series SQL (TSSQL) Generation Data Agent framework, and construct TERN, a comprehensive Time-sERies text-to-SQL beNchmark. First, to achieve broad coverage of valid queries, we systematically model TSSQL syntax and semantics to construct a data generation space. Next, to explore the space and improve diversity, we develop a Data Agent that autonomously orchestrates data generation. The agent comprises a planning and decision-making module and a query generation module, with online adaptation for continuous self-improvement. Finally, we introduce a temporal-aware memory that enables adaptive reuse of experience across heterogeneous data instances, improving generation efficiency. Comprehensive evaluations on TERN reveal the limitations of existing methods in performing Text-to-TSSQL tasks. Furthermore, extensive experiments demonstrate that TSSDA substantially improves coverage, diversity, and complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TSSDA——一个时序 SQL（TSSQL）数据生成智能体框架，并构建 TERN 基准，以缓解时序数据库 Text-to-SQL 缺乏高质量基准与大规模训练语料的问题。
AI.motivation: 智能体大量承担数据查询任务，Text-to-SQL 是数据库访问的基础能力；但时序数据库场景下高质量基准与大规模语料稀缺，限制了对现有模型与智能体的系统评估和领域适配。已有自动化 SQL 生成方法自主性不足，存在三大问题：时序语法与函数组合繁多导致有效查询覆盖不全；语料规模增长后难以生成有价值且多样的新数据；schema 与数据异构导致时序查询结构难以复用，生成效率受限。
AI.method: 1) 系统建模 TSSQL 的语法与语义，构建数据生成空间以保证有效查询的广泛覆盖；2) 设计 Data Agent 自主编排数据生成，包含规划/决策模块与查询生成模块，并具备在线自适应能力以持续自我改进；3) 引入时序感知记忆（temporal-aware memory），实现跨异构数据实例的经验自适应复用，提升生成效率。
AI.result: 在 TERN 上的综合评测揭示了现有方法在 Text-to-TSSQL 任务上的局限；大量实验表明 TSSDA 在覆盖率、多样性和复杂度方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过“语法语义建模+自主智能体生成+时序感知记忆复用”的组合，TSSDA 有效提升了时序 Text-to-SQL 数据生成的覆盖性、多样性与效率，并配套 TERN 基准为后续研究提供评估基础。

title: Systematic Evaluation of Robustness in Fine-tuned Models
summary: Our study systematically evaluates the robustness of fine-tuned pre-trained models across different datasets and attack types, aiming to provide insights for researchers in selecting pre-trained models for image classification tasks while prioritizing robustness against potential attacks. Our work explores the influence of fine-tuning pre-trained models with different datasets and attack types on their robustness and overview of the appropriate pre-trained model for image classification based on factors such as computation resources, memory usage, and accuracy on clean data. We fine-tune the models with weights. Evaluate the models on data before any attack and after different attack cases. The study utilizes publicly available image datasets such as MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and SVHN to assess the robustness of pre-trained models. The results indicate that the robustness of fine-tuned models varies across different data distributions and sample sizes, emphasizing the need for tailored selection based on specific task requirements. The findings also highlight the varying performance of ResNet50, DenseNet, and MobileNet in defending against attacks on different datasets. Overall, this research provides valuable insights into the robustness of fine-tuned pre-trained models and their suitability for real-world applications in image classification.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了微调预训练模型在不同数据集和攻击类型下的鲁棒性，为图像分类任务中模型选择提供参考。
AI.motivation: 帮助研究者在图像分类任务中，在优先考虑对抗攻击鲁棒性的前提下，选择合适的预训练模型，并了解微调数据与攻击类型对鲁棒性的影响。
AI.method: 以权重方式微调预训练模型，在MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100、SVHN等公开数据集上，比较攻击前与多种攻击情形下的表现；并结合计算资源、内存占用、干净数据准确率等因素，对比ResNet50、DenseNet、MobileNet。
AI.result: 微调模型的鲁棒性随数据分布和样本规模变化而不同；ResNet50、DenseNet、MobileNet在不同数据集上的抗攻击表现存在明显差异。
AI.conclusion: 需根据具体任务需求定制化选择预训练模型；研究为鲁棒性评估与实际图像分类应用中的模型选型提供了有价值的参考。

title: BLPO: Beyond-Local Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Tdadada/BLPO
summary: Long-horizon tasks require large language model (LLM) agents to coordinate interdependent actions, a capability central to automating complex workflows. Stepwise group-based reinforcement learning provides finer credit than trajectory-level supervision, but reliable comparisons must account for differences in interaction history. Enforcing this consistency within the limited rollouts of each task can leave insufficient support for estimating action preferences. We propose Beyond-Local Policy Optimization (BLPO), which estimates task-progress advantages from experience shared across tasks and training updates. We summarize trajectory prefixes into task-progress states and abstract actions by their function, allowing corresponding decisions from different tasks to contribute to shared estimates. To control bias and noise from heterogeneous tasks, we accumulate context-relative returns in a global memory with balanced aggregation and reliability weighting. These global advantages complement local comparisons over normalized actions and trajectory-level credit without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with 1.5B and 7B policies show improved task success over the evaluated baselines under matched training budgets. Further analyses show faster learning and shorter trajectories with little computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出BLPO，通过跨任务共享经验估计任务进度优势，用于长程LLM智能体的组内策略优化，无需critic或额外rollout。
AI.motivation: 长程任务需要LLM智能体协调相互依赖的动作。基于组的逐步强化学习比轨迹级监督提供更细粒度的信用分配，但可靠比较必须考虑交互历史差异；在每任务有限的rollout内强制一致性会导致动作偏好估计的支撑样本不足。
AI.method: BLPO将轨迹前缀总结为“任务进度状态”，按功能抽象动作，使不同任务中对应决策贡献到共享估计；在全局记忆中以均衡聚合与可靠性加权累积上下文相对回报，控制异构任务的偏差与噪声；所得全局优势与归一化动作上的局部比较及轨迹级信用互补，且不需要学习critic或额外rollout。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上使用1.5B与7B策略，在相同训练预算下任务成功率优于所评估基线；进一步分析显示学习更快、轨迹更短，计算开销很小。
AI.conclusion: 跨任务经验共享可有效弥补局部rollout内支撑不足，为长程LLM智能体提供可靠且低开销的细粒度信用分配。

title: When Is Personalized Federated Learning Worth Its Deployment Cost?
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted and presented at UBMK 2026
summary: Personalized federated learning (PFL) may improve client-level performance, but deeper personalization increases deployment cost. We formulate personalization-depth selection as a utility-based empirical decision problem in which client utility equals Macro-F1 minus a cost-sensitivity weight times deployment cost, over six personalization depths labeled P0 through P5. We compare fixed policies with an offline per-client Oracle reference and report allocation maps over Dirichlet data heterogeneity and cost sensitivity. Although evaluated on this hierarchy, the formulation can accommodate any finite candidate set. On CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and a PTB-XL subset, personalization shows empirical, setting-dependent decision regimes rather than a universal benefit: higher cost sensitivity shifts Oracle mass toward the global-only depth P0; low cost sensitivity can favor deeper actions. Patterns are grid observations (three seeds per cell), not theoretical boundaries. Best-uniform is competitive with Oracle assignment (6.5 percent plus or minus 7.8 percent relative regret; 95 percent confidence interval 5.9 to 7.1), whereas random and personalize-all incur much larger regret (189.3 percent plus or minus 367.1 percent and 409.0 percent plus or minus 803.2 percent). Under the same utility, Ditto full-model personalization is substantially suboptimal once cost is counted. The contribution is an offline characterization of when personalization depth is worth its cost, not a new PFL optimizer or deployment-time scheduler.

AI.tldr: 论文把"个性化深度选择"建模为效用驱动的经验决策问题：客户端效用=Macro-F1−成本敏感度×部署成本，在P0–P5六档深度上比较固定策略与离线逐客户端Oracle，并绘制Dirichlet异构与成本敏感度下的分配图。
AI.motivation: 个性化联邦学习（PFL）能提升客户端性能，但更深的个性化会推高部署成本；现有工作缺少对"个性化到什么程度才划算"的定量刻画，也缺少与全局模型、全个性化、随机等基线在统一效用下的系统比较。
AI.method: 将深度选择形式化为有限候选集上的经验决策：候选六档深度P0–P5，效用为Macro-F1减成本敏感度乘部署成本；在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100与PTB-XL子集上，随Dirichlet数据异构程度与成本敏感度变化，比较固定策略、离线逐客户端Oracle、best-uniform、random、personalize-all，以及Ditto全模型个性化，每格三随机种子。
AI.result: 个性化呈现依赖具体设置的经验决策区间，并非普遍有利：成本敏感度高时Oracle质量向全局深度P0集中，成本敏感度低时偏向更深动作。best-uniform相对Oracle的平均相对遗憾为6.5%±7.8%（95%CI 5.9–7.1），显著优于random（189.3%±367.1%）与personalize-all（409.0%±803.2%）；同一效用下计入成本后Ditto全模型个性化明显次优。结果仅为网格观测，非理论边界。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是对"个性化深度何时值得其成本"的离线刻画，而非新的PFL优化器或部署期调度器；该表述可推广到任意有限候选集，且提示实践中简单统一的深度策略已接近Oracle。

title: Training-Free Motion-Corrected 3D Brain MRI Reconstruction via Event-Guided References
summary: Head motion causes artefacts in 3D brain MRI and can bias structural measurements. Model-based correction alternates between image and motion estimation, but artefacts in the reconstructed reference can reinforce motion errors. Learned priors can reduce these artefacts but require pretraining and may add test-time computation. We propose EventMC (event-guided motion correction), a training-free method for interleaved Cartesian acquisitions. It iteratively detects motion events and estimates motion using reference images reconstructed from stable intervals. It then refines the image and motion from low to high spatial frequencies. In a fair comparison in simulation (same reconstruction), EventMC's motion estimates improve mean PSNR by up to 4.0 dB over those of the learning-based MotionTTT. A single run of EventMC is up to 7.5 times faster than MotionTTT with less than half the GPU memory. On in vivo motion-corrupted scans, EventMC achieves similar mean image quality to MotionTTT without any training. Code is available at https://github.com/bayesbreeze/EventMC.

AI.tldr: EventMC是一种无需训练的事件引导运动校正方法，用于交错的笛卡尔3D脑MRI采集，通过从稳定区间重建参考图像来迭代检测运动事件并估计运动，再由低到高空间频率细化图像与运动。
AI.motivation: 头动会在3D脑MRI中产生伪影并偏置结构测量。基于模型的校正在图像与运动估计间交替进行，但重建参考图中的伪影会强化运动误差；学习型先验虽能减少伪影，却需要预训练并可能增加测试时计算。
AI.method: 提出EventMC：免训练方法。迭代检测运动事件，并利用由稳定区间重建的参考图像估计运动；随后从低到高空间频率逐步细化图像与运动。
AI.result: 在同等重建条件的仿真对比中，EventMC的运动估计使平均PSNR较学习型MotionTTT最高提升4.0 dB；单次运行比MotionTTT快至7.5倍，GPU显存占用不到一半。在真实受运动污染的扫描中，EventMC无需任何训练即可达到与MotionTTT相近的平均图像质量。
AI.conclusion: EventMC以无训练、低显存、高效率的方式实现了与学习型方法相当乃至更优的运动校正效果，适用于交错笛卡尔采集。代码已开源。

title: PRIME: Predictive Routing of Interventions by Modeling Effects for Scientific Ideation
summary: Feedback-driven iteration is widely used to improve LLM-generated scientific ideas, but existing systems either leave revision decisions implicit in generation, align revisions with feedback-localized weaknesses, or restrict action selection to system-specific operations. This is problematic because problems, hypotheses, and solutions are interdependent: the location where a weakness manifests does not itself determine the revision scope that will produce a better successor. We term this phenomenon diagnosis-intervention mismatch. We introduce Predictive Routing of Interventions by Modeling Effects (PRIME), a plug-and-play feedback-to-revision decision layer for existing scientific ideators. PRIME operates in three stages: (1) Structural Attribution interprets feedback over the problem-hypothesis-solution structure without fixing a revision target; (2) Counterfactual Routing constructs alternative scope-conditioned interventions and compares their projected successor utility and risks through lightweight rollouts; and (3) Intervention Execution compiles the selected intervention into an ordered generator-facing plan with semantic actions, preservation constraints, and dependency requirements for successor generation. We validate diagnosis intervention mismatch on 112 human-annotated idea-feedback pairs. Across four benchmarks, two ideators, and fixed- and open-problem settings, PRIME improves successor quality and routing reliability over strong baselines; removing counterfactual routing reduces quality from 3.463 to 1.960 and increases route regret from 0.426 to 1.929, confirming cross-scope effect modeling as the primary source of its gains.

AI.tldr: 提出PRIME，一种即插即用的“反馈到修订”决策层，通过结构化归因—反事实路由—干预执行三阶段解决“诊断-干预错配”问题，显著提升LLM科研想法迭代质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于反馈的LLM想法迭代系统存在诊断-干预错配：问题、假设、解决方案相互依赖，弱点显现位置并不决定能产生更优后继的修订范围；现有系统或隐式决策、或仅针对反馈局部弱点、或局限于系统特定操作。
AI.method: PRIME三阶段：(1) 结构归因——在问题-假设-解决方案结构上解读反馈，不预设修订目标；(2) 反事实路由——构建范围条件化的多候选干预，通过轻量rollout比较其后继效用与风险；(3) 干预执行——将选定干预编译为面向生成器的有序计划，含语义动作、保持约束与依赖要求。
AI.result: 在112个人工标注的想法-反馈对上验证了诊断-干预错配；跨4个基准、2个想法生成器及固定/开放问题设置，PRIME在后继质量与路由可靠性上优于强基线；去除反事实路由后质量从3.463降至1.960，路由遗憾从0.426升至1.929。
AI.conclusion: 跨范围效应建模（反事实路由）是PRIME性能增益的主要来源，该决策层可即插即用地提升现有科研想法生成器的迭代效果。

title: Value Forcing: Aligning Return Distributions at All Noise Levels
summary: Learning accurate value functions is central to reinforcement learning (RL), yet remains challenging because supervision is limited and indirect: ground-truth values are unavailable, and each transition in the data only provides an immediate reward that can be used to construct bootstrapped targets as supervision. This challenge is particularly pronounced when data is limited or reward signals are sparse, as is common in real-world applications such as robotics. We argue that the key to accurate value learning in this limited data regime is extracting richer learning signals from the available data. In this paper, we introduce Value Forcing, a new approach that uses flow matching to estimate return distributions and enables accurate value learning from limited data. Our key insight is that we can extract richer learning signals by enforcing Bellman consistency at every noise level. Empirically, Value Forcing improves the accuracy of estimating the return distribution, and prevents the distribution from collapsing to a single value, as occurs with prior methods. We instantiate Value Forcing with two practical value-learning algorithms: VF, an actor-critic method, and IVF, an implicit value-learning method. We evaluate both algorithms across $26$ long-horizon tasks in the offline RL setting and find that they outperform prior value-learning methods, with particularly large gains when data is limited. Our project website is available at https://chongyi-zheng.github.io/value-forcing.

AI.tldr: 提出 Value Forcing，用 flow matching 估计回报分布，在每个噪声层强制 Bellman 一致性以提取更丰富信号，实现有限数据下更准确的价值学习。
AI.motivation: RL 中价值函数监督有限且间接：无真值，只有即时奖励可构造自举目标；在数据有限或奖励稀疏（如机器人）时尤为困难。
AI.method: 核心思想是从现有数据中提取更丰富的学习信号。用 flow matching 建模回报分布，并在每个噪声层上强制 Bellman 一致性，从而获得更丰富的监督。实例化为两种算法：VF（actor-critic）与 IVF（隐式价值学习）。
AI.result: 提升了回报分布估计的准确性，避免先前方法中分布坍缩为单值的问题；在离线 RL 的 26 个长程任务上优于先前价值学习方法，数据有限时增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过噪声层级的 Bellman 一致性约束进行分布价值学习，可有效缓解有限数据下的价值学习难题，并在离线 RL 中验证有效。

title: Online Active Learning Architecture for Safety-Critical Control Systems
summary: The transition of information-centric artificial intelligence to safety-critical applications is impeded by the limitations of conventional offline-training paradigms in open-world environments. This paper presents Control AI, an architecture for Online Active Learning (OAL) inspired by the continuous Prediction-Evaluation-Correction process of biological intelligence. The framework combines the hierarchical representation capacity of deep neural networks with the real-time error-feedback adaptation of adaptive control. A prediction model maps sensory input into a latent manifold, an optional latent model represents transitions in that space, and a reconstruction model maps the latent state back to observable signals. Residuals between predictions and measurements provide the internal learning signal. Spatial and temporal cross-reconstruction architectures prevent OAL from collapsing to a trivial identity mapping, while coupled, dual, and localized variants shorten error-transmission paths. Localized predictive coding style OAL is implemented through guidance-backpropagation and target-backpropagation architectures, and hybrid and scaled variants support high-dimensional deployment. The paper focuses on the architectural rationale and the progression from a conceptual feedback loop to practical large-scale configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出 Control AI 架构，将深度网络的层级表征与自适应控制的实时误差反馈结合，实现受生物"预测-评估-校正"启发的在线主动学习（OAL），并给出从概念反馈回路到大规模部署的架构设计。
AI.motivation: 信息中心 AI 走向安全关键应用时，传统离线训练范式在开放世界环境中存在局限，无法持续适应。
AI.method: 架构含预测模型（感知输入→隐流形）、可选隐模型（隐空间状态转移）、重建模型（隐状态→可观测信号）；以预测与测量的残差作为内部学习信号。采用空间/时间交叉重建避免坍缩为恒等映射；提出耦合型、对偶型、局部化变体缩短误差传递路径；以引导反传（guidance-backprop）与目标反传（target-backprop）实现局部预测编码式 OAL，并有混合与规模化变体支持高维部署。
AI.result: 摘要为概念与架构性论述，未给出定量实验结果；主要贡献在于架构原理阐释及由概念反馈回路到实用大规模配置的演进路径。
AI.conclusion: Control AI 为开放环境下的在线主动学习提供了一套可扩展的架构框架，将预测编码思想与反传机制结合，为迈向安全关键应用奠定设计基础。

title: Networked AI: Architecture, Theory, and Applications
summary: Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly large-scale deep learning, have been driven by monolithic or offline training on massive curated datasets. While successful, these approaches face structural limitations: escalating data and computational demands, limited online adaptability, and a lack of system-level intelligence in open, non-stationary environments. This paper presents Networked AI - a networked intelligent system composed of interacting, heterogeneous, and continuously evolving AI agents. We establish a hierarchical layered architecture comprising an Agent Layer for heterogeneous capability construction, an Interaction Layer for signal-processing-guided online data extraction, and a Regulation Layer for stability-constrained collective evolution. Foundations in data science, signal processing, and system control are hereby synthesized into a unified theoretical framework of Networked AI, providing superior data efficiency, intelligence efficiency, interpretability, and scalability. Theoretical and experimental analysis demonstrates that Networked AI can approach near-linear scaling in resource demand, in contrast to the exponential increase in standalone end-to-end systems. It provides not only online adaptation to out-of-distribution environmental novelties, but also the autonomous evolution towards application-specific intelligence. Application frontiers are discussed for IoT spaces, embodied, spatial, and industrial intelligences, as well as the cellular infrastructure and beyond. Key open challenges are identified towards realizing locally autonomous, collectively intelligent, continuously evolving, globally regulated Networked AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"网络化AI"（Networked AI），一种由异构、持续演化的AI智能体互联构成的智能系统，以分层架构（智能体层、交互层、调控层）统一数据科学、信号处理与系统控制，实现近线性可扩展、在线适应与自主演化。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模单体/离线训练AI面临结构性局限：数据与算力需求激增、在线适应能力弱、开放非平稳环境中缺乏系统级智能。因此需要一种网络化范式加以突破。
AI.method: 构建三层分级架构：智能体层负责异构能力构建，交互层以信号处理引导在线数据提取，调控层实现稳定性约束下的群体演化；并将数据科学、信号处理与系统控制融合为统一理论框架。
AI.result: 理论与实验表明，相比单体端到端系统的指数级资源增长，网络化AI可达近线性的资源扩展；具备对分布外环境新异的在线适应及面向应用自主演化的能力。
AI.conclusion: 网络化AI在数据效率、智能效率、可解释性与可扩展性上更优，可应用于物联网、具身/空间/工业智能及蜂窝基础设施等；未来需攻克局部自主、集体智能、持续演化与全局调控等开放挑战。

title: Restrained Diffusion Bridges: Targeted Denoiser Training and Refinement
summary: Diffusion models are often inaccurate in critical, data-sparse regions of the target distribution. Sampling from restrained distributions, biased distributions used in classical enhanced sampling to concentrate data near chosen configurations, can control where training data are collected but biases the learned distribution. We establish that this bias cancels exactly when forward noising from restrained data is conditioned on the restrained configuration at an appropriately chosen intermediate time. This allows a pretrained model fine-tuned on restrained data to achieve high accuracy in any chosen region of the target distribution, regardless of its probability, using standard denoising or flow matching objectives without importance weights. When no target data are available, Gibbs sampling enables inference from a model trained exclusively on restrained data.

AI.tldr: 提出用受限分布采样数据微调扩散模型，证明在合适中间时刻对受限构型条件化可精确消除偏置，从而在目标分布任意数据稀疏区域获得高精度，无需重要性权重。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在目标分布中数据稀少但关键的区城往往不准确。经典增强采样用受限/偏置分布把数据集中到选定构型，但会扭曲学到的分布。
AI.method: 理论上证明：从受限数据前向加噪时，若在适当选取的中间时刻对受限构型做条件化，偏置可精确抵消。据此对预训练模型在受限数据上微调，使用标准去噪或flow matching目标即可，无需重要性权重；无目标数据时用Gibbs采样实现推断。
AI.result: 微调后的模型可在目标分布任意选定区域（无论概率高低）达到高精度；仅用受限数据训练的模型亦可通过Gibbs采样推断。
AI.conclusion: 受限采样数据的偏置可通过中间时刻条件化精确消除，为扩散模型在数据稀疏关键区域的高精度建模提供了无重要性权重的实用方案。

title: SurgQ-VLM: Question-Conditioned Dual-Stream Compression and Answer-Type-Aware Reinforcement for Surgical Video Question Answering
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 (Applications track). 16 pages: 8-page main paper, references, and supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/DhruvMakwana/SurgQ-VLM ; Weights: https://huggingface.co/dhruvmakwana/SurgQ-VLM-7B
summary: Reasoning about surgical video -- which phase is underway, which instruments act, and when events occur -- underpins operative documentation, workflow analysis, and skill assessment. Yet surgical visual question answering is still largely built on single frames and closed labels that cannot express a duration, an ordering, or a count, and the video models that lift the frame limit typically compress every clip the same way regardless of the question, discarding the temporal evidence the answer needs. Worse, the answers are structurally heterogeneous, spanning five incompatible structures -- binary, classification, multi-label, counting, and sentence-temporal -- that no single training signal scores uniformly well. We propose SurgQ-VLM, a two-stage model for surgical video question answering. Stage 1 trains a question-conditioned dual-stream (slow/fast) compressor for a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-VL-7B: cross-attention conditions both streams on the question, and each clip's visual tokens shrink 49x from the raw ViT patches (11x vs. post-merge backbone tokens). Stage 2 post-trains with GRPO under an answer-type-aware reward that scores each question on the metric matching its answer structure (micro-F1 for label sets, normalised error for counts, a content-timing blend for temporal windows). On a sealed 21,840-question test split over Cholec80 and CholecT50, SurgQ-VLM reaches 0.779 keyword accuracy and a 10x BLEU-4 gain over zero-shot; GRPO adds 2.5 pp K-Acc (2.0 pp attributable to the answer-type-aware reward), concentrated in the structurally hard types, with answer format unchanged (ROUGE-L). Code is available at https://github.com/DhruvMakwana/SurgQ-VLM.

AI.tldr: 提出SurgQ-VLM两阶段手术视频问答模型：第一阶段训练问题条件的慢/快双流压缩器，将视觉token压缩49倍；第二阶段用答案类型感知奖励的GRPO后训练，在Cholec80/CholecT50上达0.779关键词准确率，BLEU-4较零样本提升10倍。
AI.motivation: 现有手术视频问答多基于单帧和封闭标签，无法表达时长、顺序、计数；视频模型对所有片段采用相同的压缩方式，忽视问题相关性，丢弃时间证据；且答案结构异构（二分类、分类、多标签、计数、句子-时序五类），缺乏统一评分训练信号。
AI.method: 两阶段：Stage 1为LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-VL-7B训练问题条件双流（慢/快）压缩器，交叉注意力使两流以问题为条件，视觉token从原始ViT patch压缩49倍（相对backbone后token为11倍）；Stage 2用GRPO后训练，采用答案类型感知奖励——标签集用micro-F1、计数用归一化误差、时序窗口用内容-时序混合指标。
AI.result: 在Cholec80与CholecT50的21,840题封存测试集上，关键词准确率0.779，BLEU-4较零样本提升10倍；GRPO贡献+2.5pp K-Acc（其中2.0pp来自答案类型感知奖励），增益集中于结构困难类型，答案格式保持（ROUGE-L不变）。
AI.conclusion: 问题条件下的双流压缩与答案类型感知的强化学习奖励能有效提升异构答案结构的手术视频问答性能，尤其改善计数与时序等结构性难点。

title: Towards a Trustworthy and Governable Internet of Agentics: An Architectural Perspective on Protocols, Systems, and Services
summary: Large language model applications are increasingly being organized as tool-using and multi-agent workflows rather than as isolated chat interfaces. This perspective paper examines the architectural problem that follows from that shift: agents may reason, invoke tools, and delegate work, but dependable deployment still requires interoperability across frameworks, runtimes, data boundaries, and organizational control domains. We study this problem through the lens of the \emph{Internet of Agentics} (IoA), an emerging service-computing view in which heterogeneous agents are treated as governable service participants rather than only as stand-alone model endpoints. The paper organizes the landscape as a three-layer progression: from today's fragmented agent ecosystem, to interoperable agents, and ultimately to trustworthy and governable autonomy. First, it examines the protocol stack centered on the Agentic AI Foundation, including MCP for agent--tool interaction; A2A for agent--agent coordination; AGENTS.md and Skills-style procedural manifests; and discovery, transport, and trust mechanisms such as AGNTCY and SLIM. Second, it reviews the systems abstractions that make agents deployable as service components, including logical agent architectures, orchestration patterns, gateways, registries, runtime control loops, and hardware-aware inference infrastructure. Third, it situates these developments within services computing, arguing that agentic systems reinterpret classical concerns from SOA and microservices---discovery, composition, governance, pricing, and trust---at the level of cognitive capabilities rather than deterministic functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Agentic互联网"(IoA)视角，将异构智能体视为可治理的服务参与者，并以"碎片化生态→可互操作智能体→可信可治理自主性"三层递进框架组织协议栈、系统抽象与服务计算三大议题。
AI.motivation: LLM应用已从孤立聊天界面转向工具调用与多智能体工作流，但跨框架、运行时、数据边界与组织控制域的互操作性与可治理部署仍是难题，亟需一个统一的架构视角。
AI.method: 观点/综述性论文：以IoA服务计算视角展开，梳理(a)以Agentic AI Foundation为核心的协议栈(MCP、A2A、AGENTS.md与Skills类清单、AGNTCY、SLIM)；(b)使智能体可作为服务组件部署的系统抽象(逻辑智能体架构、编排模式、网关、注册中心、运行时控制回路、硬件感知推理基础设施)；(c)将其置于服务计算脉络中，论证SOA与微服务的发现、组合、治理、定价、信任等经典问题在"认知能力"层面的重构。
AI.result: 给出三层递进的组织框架，系统串联协议、系统与治理三层，并指出agentic系统对经典服务计算关注点的认知化重释。
AI.conclusion: 智能体需被当作可治理的服务参与者而非独立模型端点；实现可信、可治理的自主性需要协议互操作、系统抽象与服务治理三方面协同演进。

title: Beyond Unit-Circle Eigenvalues: Invariant Bases for Stable State Space Dynamics
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 40 pages, 13 figures, 27 tables. Code: https://github.com/Jiaqian-Janelle/NeurIPS26-Kronecker-Cayley-Stable-State-Space-Dynamics
summary: Diagonal state space models process long sequences at linear cost, yet the same transition is applied at every step of a rollout, so an unconstrained recurrence holds no quantity fixed and the state decays or grows without bound. Current designs constrain one quantity, and preserving one does not guarantee preservation of the others, so a model can hold its norm to machine precision while momentum drifts by hundreds of percent. We claim that the conserved quantities of a diagonal recurrence are layered, that each layer requires a strictly stronger condition on the operator, and that a unit-modulus spectrum reaches only the outermost. Acting on the claim, we enforce the conditions required for every layer by construction. The generator of the Kronecker-Cayley transition (KC) is a graph Laplacian over object subspaces, $\mathbf{H}=\mathbf{L}\otimes I_m$, advanced by a Cayley transform, and the step stays diagonal at $O(N^3+N^2m)$ cost. The conserved set is exactly a $2m^2$-dimensional family of quadratic forms, held at every parameter value, so the quantities and the dynamics the construction reaches are fixed before training. On four conservation benchmarks, KC holds total mass at or near the reference floor while every diagonal baseline loses it by orders of magnitude. We further compare against mass correction and find that two correctors fail once the underlying prediction diverges, which shows that assembly rather than correction is necessary for a guarantee that holds across the rollout. A free modal basis trained under a conservation penalty conserves only by freezing its spectrum, whereas the assembled operator conserves with every mode but one free to rotate. Beyond these benchmarks, KC holds the linear momentum of three $N$-body systems and, at the operator level, the conserved quantity in molecular dynamics, chemical kinetics, pharmacokinetics and power-grid swing dynamics.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Kronecker-Cayley (KC) 对角状态空间转移，通过对所有层级守恒量"按构造"施加约束，实现长序列建模中的多守恒量保证。
AI.motivation: 对角状态空间模型线性代价处理长序列，但每步使用同一转移，无约束递归会导致状态指数衰减或增长；现有设计只约束单一量，无法保证其他守恒量（如范数稳定而动量漂移数百百分比）。作者主张对角递归的守恒量是分层的，每层需更强条件，单位模谱仅满足最外层。
AI.method: KC转移的生成元为对象子空间上的图拉普拉斯 H = L⊗I_m，经Cayley变换推进，单步保持对角性，复杂度 O(N³+N²m)。该构造在任意参数值下精确守恒一个 2m² 维二次型族，即守恒量与动力学在训练前即被固定。
AI.result: 在四个守恒基准上，KC的总质量保持在参考下限附近，而所有对角基线丢失达数量级；与质量校正方法对比，两个校正器在底层预测发散时失效，说明必须"组装"而非"校正"才能获得跨rollout的保证。此外KC保持三个N体系统的线动量，并在算子层面守恒分子动力学、化学动力学、药代动力学与电网摇摆动力学中的守恒量。
AI.conclusion: 守恒应按构造组装而非事后校正；KC以可证明的分层守恒保证、对角性与可控代价，为长序列状态空间模型提供了跨rollout的守恒性保障。

title: Vision-language classification of Torsades de Pointes risk from pseudo-coloured ECG images: do T-wave morphology and colour context help or hinder?
summary: Contextual prompting is widely presented as a cheap route to better performance from vision models, but the evidence comes largely from benchmarks in which an attribute named in a prompt is also present in the image, confounding the two channels. We investigate the significance of context for a semantically complex biomedical signal classification task using a domain-adapted vision-language model, BiomedCLIP. Building on our previous work that renders electrocardiogram (ECG) signals as colour-enhanced images to flag Torsades de Pointes risk using the QT-nomogram and pseudo-colouring technique, we cross four context strategies with four T-wave morphology label sets, evaluated zero-shot and with a class-balanced linear probe, under five-fold stratified cross-validation on 9,789 images. Zero-shot inference is unusable. Once trained, the colour-enhanced images outperform the colourless ones on every metric: balanced accuracy 0.903 versus 0.825, sensitivity 0.914 versus 0.827, specificity 0.892 versus 0.823, ROC-AUC 0.955 versus 0.888 and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) 0.437 versus 0.311. Crossing colour-in-image with colour-in-prompt separates the confounded channels: the image contributes +0.126 MCC (+0.078 balanced accuracy, +0.067 ROC-AUC) whether or not the prompt names colour, whereas naming it changes nothing under any metric. Context is two-sided: the best prompt set gains 0.008 MCC where colour is present and 0.016 where it is not, while the worst loses 0.017 and 0.013. For a signal rendered as an image, the leverage lies in how the signal is drawn rather than in how it is described - and where the endpoint is an interval measurement, prompts naming T-wave morphology describe the wrong quantity.

AI.tldr: 本文用BiomedCLIP研究生物医学信号分类中上下文提示的作用，发现效果主要来自图像渲染方式（彩色增强）而非文本提示。
AI.motivation: 上下文提示常被视为提升视觉模型性能的低成本手段，但现有证据多来自提示中属性同时出现在图像中的基准，混淆了图像与文本两个通道。作者希望在语义复杂的生物医学信号分类任务中厘清上下文真正的贡献。
AI.method: 将心电信号通过QT列线图与伪彩渲染为彩色增强图像以标记TdP风险；交叉4种上下文策略与4种T波形态标签集，在9,789张图像上进行五折分层交叉验证，分别做零样本评估和类平衡线性探针。
AI.result: 零样本推断不可用。训练后彩色图像在所有指标上优于无色图像：平衡准确率0.903 vs 0.825，敏感度0.914 vs 0.827，特异度0.892 vs 0.823，ROC-AUC 0.955 vs 0.888，MCC 0.437 vs 0.311。交叉设计显示图像通道贡献+0.126 MCC，而提示中是否命名颜色无任何影响；最好提示集增益仅0.008–0.016 MCC，最差则损失0.013–0.017。
AI.conclusion: 对以图像形式呈现的信号，收益杠杆在于信号如何绘制而非如何描述；当终末指标是区间测量时，命名T波形态的提示描述了错误的量。上下文作用是双向的。

title: Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents
summary: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over consequential decisions. We advocate Avatar Intelligence, a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users' goals, values, and constraints through sustained decision delegation across contexts and time. We describe a maturity roadmap from human-directed execution to autonomous operation within delegated domains, and introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) as a framework for evaluating delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden. We identify three core research challenges: identity-continuous personalization that carries user preferences across tasks, user-situated evolution through Rehearsal Engineering, and safety mechanisms that combine technical control with accountability and recourse. These directions define a research agenda for reliable decision delegation to personal agents across tasks and over time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Avatar Intelligence（化身智能）"范式：持久化个人智能体通过跨情境、跨时间的决策委托来代表用户的目标、价值与约束，并以AOI指标衡量价值、成本与监督负担。
AI.motivation: 现有个人AI智能体虽能处理长时程任务，但用户仍需投入大量精力设定目标、消解歧义与验证结果；进展应以"智能体如何放大人的能动性"为衡量标准，即减少例行监督同时保留对重大决策的控制。
AI.method: 以立场/议程型论文（position paper）方式提出Avatar Intelligence范式，构建从"人类主导执行"到"委托域内自主运行"的成熟度路线图，提出Agentic Oversight Index（AOI）评估框架，并归纳三大研究挑战。
AI.result: 提出AOI框架，用于将交付价值与智能体侧运行成本、人类监督负担进行对照评估；识别三项核心挑战：跨任务迁移偏好的身份连续个性化；通过"Rehearsal Engineering（预演工程）"实现的用户情境化演化；技术与问责、救济相结合的安全机制。
AI.conclusion: 论文为面向个人智能体的可靠决策委托给出研究议程，强调跨任务、跨时间的持续委托与以人为本的评价标准，而非单纯的执行能力提升。

title: ANCHOR: KL-Anchored Adaptation for Stable Offline-to-Online RL
comment: Accepted at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Continually Self-Improving Robots. 37 pages
summary: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) follows the pretrain-finetune paradigm: an agent is first pretrained on historical data and then adapted through online interaction. We study offline-to-online adaptation without offline replay, where the agent must improve using only the pretrained model and newly collected experience. A key challenge is to avoid catastrophic failure, a sharp early performance collapse during online fine-tuning, while still achieving strong asymptotic performance. Through controlled experiments, we show that removing offline replay can induce catastrophic failure, while retaining strong conservative regularization from offline RL can suppress final online performance. We also find that common stabilization strategies do not reliably prevent early collapse, and that the critic-side mechanisms we test are insufficient on their own. Motivated by these findings, we propose ANCHOR, a simple adaptation method that anchors the actor to the offline-pretrained policy early in online fine-tuning, anneals this constraint over time, and retains only a small residual conservative critic regularizer. We provide a theoretical interpretation showing that KL anchoring helps preserve critic reliability across nearby occupancy distributions, with a two-phase regret bound explaining when anchoring should be maintained or relaxed. Across FrankaKitchen, AntMaze, and Adroit tasks, ANCHOR substantially reduces catastrophic failure while maintaining strong asymptotic performance. Ablations show that KL annealing and the residual conservative weight are important for balancing early stability and online adaptation, while additional analysis shows that ANCHOR is most beneficial when the pretrained policy contains useful behavior to preserve. Code is available at https://github.com/Cho-Geonwoo/ANCHOR.

AI.tldr: 针对无离线回放的离线到在线强化学习，提出 ANCHOR：早期将 actor 锚定到预训练策略并逐步退火，同时保留少量保守 critic 正则，以缓解早期性能崩溃并保持最终性能。
AI.motivation: 无离线回放（offline replay）的离线到在线适配中，既要避免早期性能骤降（catastrophic failure），又要保持良好渐近性能；实验发现去掉离线回放会诱发崩溃，而保留强保守正则又压制在线性能，且常见稳定化策略和 critic 侧机制均不足以可靠防止早期崩溃。
AI.method: ANCHOR 方法：在线微调早期将 actor 以 KL 约束锚定到离线预训练策略，并随时间退火该约束；同时保留一个小的残余保守 critic 正则项。作者给出理论解释，说明 KL 锚定有助在邻近占用分布上保持 critic 可靠性，并给出两阶段 regret 界以刻画何时维持或放松锚定。对比基线包括常见稳定化策略与 critic 侧机制。
AI.result: 在 FrankaKitchen、AntMaze、Adroit 任务上，ANCHOR 显著降低灾难性崩溃，同时保持较强渐近性能。消融显示 KL 退火与残余保守权重对平衡早期稳定与在线适应很重要；进一步分析表明，当预训练策略包含值得保留的有用行为时，ANCHOR 收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 无回放的离线到在线 RL 中，早期 actor 锚定加退火、辅以少量保守 critic 正则是兼顾稳定性与最终性能的有效且简单方案；其有效性依赖于预训练策略的可保留价值。

title: Spade-SLAM: Sparse Correspondence Anchors for Dense Self-Supervised Visual SLAM
summary: We introduce Spade-SLAM, a self-supervised dense visual SLAM framework that substantially narrows the long-standing performance gap to supervised methods in a zero-shot setting. By demonstrating that high-fidelity tracking can be achieved without explicit ground-truth pose and depth labels, our approach offers a highly effective and label-efficient alternative to fully supervised pretraining. Our core contribution is a complementary sparse-to-dense training regime: While a warping-based photometric loss provides a dense training signal, we stabilize the optimization and suppress drift in ambiguous regions using a sparse correspondence loss derived from image feature matches. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Spade-SLAM significantly improves robustness and accuracy compared to existing self-supervised baselines, closely rivaling SLAM systems trained with explicit pose and depth supervision. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/JulianPSchmitt/Spade-SLAM.

AI.tldr: Spade-SLAM 是一种自监督稠密视觉 SLAM 框架，通过稀疏到稠密的互补训练策略，在零样本设置下大幅缩小与监督方法的性能差距，无需位姿和深度标签即可实现高保真跟踪。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密视觉 SLAM 方法依赖显式位姿和深度真值标签进行监督预训练，成本高且标签效率低；自监督方法与监督方法之间存在长期性能差距。
AI.method: 核心贡献是互补的"稀疏到稠密"训练机制：(1) 基于 warp 的光度损失提供稠密训练信号；(2) 来自图像特征匹配的稀疏对应损失用于稳定优化、抑制模糊区域的漂移。二者结合实现无标签的高保真跟踪。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Spade-SLAM 相比现有自监督基线在鲁棒性和精度上显著提升，性能接近使用显式位姿与深度监督训练的 SLAM 系统。
AI.conclusion: 证明了无需显式位姿和深度标签也能实现高保真跟踪，为稠密视觉 SLAM 提供了一种高效、标签节约的替代方案，代码将开源。

title: A Fine-Grained Hierarchy and Benchmark for State Tracking in Language Models
summary: Theoretical limitations of transformers on state tracking---the ability to track information about entities or variables over long contexts---have motivated new recurrent language modeling (LM) architectures such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN). These architectures have, in particular, been benchmarked against the $S_5$ word problem, a theoretically hard state-tracking task that captures abilities such as code evaluation under arbitrary variable assignment. It, however, remains open whether other, simpler forms of state tracking might both be more relevant in practice and already explain observed differences between these architectures. We propose evaluating state tracking using a hierarchy of word problems with four increasing levels of difficulty: r-trivial, corresponding to immutable assignment to variables in programming; aperiodic, where assignments are mutable; soluble, where assignments are self-referential; and general finite state tracking. Theoretically, we show that the class of problems transformers are thought to length-generalize on does not even contain all aperiodic state tracking. On the other hand, we prove that GDN with positive eigenvalues expresses all aperiodic problems, and the regular languages recognized by certain transformers are precisely all soluble ones, thus providing a fine-grained picture of state tracking capabilities of various architectures. Taking these ideas to practice, we construct StateBench, a 4-tier long-horizon state-tracking benchmark. Our systematic direct training experiments across architectures largely align with theoretical expectation, albeit with interesting observations at very large scale length-generalization. Additionally, we also evaluate pretrained models---both open hybrid and closed frontier ones---on StateBench, finding that none of them robustly solves even soluble state tracking, suggesting a direction for future improvement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用四层词题难度层级（r-trivial、aperiodic、soluble、general）刻画状态跟踪能力，理论证明Transformer与Gated DeltaNet的细粒度表达差异，并构建StateBench基准，实验发现现有模型（含前沿闭源模型）无法稳健解决soluble级状态跟踪。
AI.motivation: Transformer在长上下文状态跟踪上的理论局限催生了GDN等循环架构，但现有评测多用S_5词问题这类高难任务，未必贴切实际应用；作者希望用更贴近实践、难度分层的框架来刻画不同架构的状态跟踪能力差异。
AI.method: 提出四层难度的词题层级：r-trivial（不可变变量赋值）、aperiodic（可变赋值）、soluble（自指赋值）、一般有限状态跟踪。理论上证明：Transformer被认为可长度泛化的语言类甚至不包含全部aperiodic问题；正特征值GDN可表达所有aperiodic问题；某些Transformer识别的正则语言恰为所有soluble问题。实践上构建StateBench四层长程状态跟踪基准，进行系统直接训练实验，并评测开源混合模型与闭源前沿模型。
AI.result: 直接训练实验大体符合理论预期，但在超大尺度长度泛化上出现有趣现象；预训练模型（含开源混合与闭源前沿）在StateBench上均无法稳健解决soluble级状态跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 分层词题框架为架构状态跟踪能力提供了细粒度图景，StateBench揭示了当前模型在soluble级状态跟踪上的不足，指出未来改进方向。

title: Fuzzy-Enhanced Machine Learning Approach for Type 2 Diabetes Diagnosis
summary: Accurate diabetes prediction is critical for early clinical intervention, yet existing machine-learning pipelines often fail due to class imbalance, noisy physiological measurements, and redundant or weakly informative features. To address these unresolved limitations, this study establishes a unified fuzzy-evolutionary-ensemble framework designed to uncover a more discriminative feature space for type 2 diabetes prediction. The workflow integrates selective fuzzification of nonlinear clinical variables, SMOTE-ENN-based balancing and noise filtering, and Bat-Algorithm-driven evolutionary feature selection prior to training a Random Forest classifier. Applied to the Pima Indians Diabetes Dataset, the framework compresses the expanded fuzzy-numerical space into an optimized 10-feature subset and yields substantial performance gains: 96.11% accuracy, 95.14% precision, 98.00% recall, and a 98.23% F1-score. Relative to a baseline Random Forest using all 16 features (74.45% accuracy; 59.86% F1), the system achieves more than a 1.6-fold improvement in F1-score while preserving over 99% stability in majority-class detection and surpassing earlier published 16-feature models impacted by imbalance and weak feature relevance. Collectively, these results demonstrate that the integrated pipeline produces an enhanced fuzzy-numerical representation space that improves diabetes risk stratification and provides a scalable, uncertainty-aware foundation for diagnostic modeling across broader clinical datasets.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个融合模糊化、进化算法与集成学习的统一框架，用于2型糖尿病预测，在Pima数据集上取得96.11%准确率与98.23% F1。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习流程在糖尿病预测中受类别不平衡、生理测量噪声及冗余/弱相关特征困扰，性能受限。
AI.method: 统一模糊-进化-集成框架：对非线性临床变量选择性模糊化，用SMOTE-ENN进行平衡与噪声过滤，再以蝙蝠算法驱动进化式特征选择，最后训练随机森林分类器。
AI.result: 在Pima Indians Diabetes数据集上将扩展的模糊-数值空间压缩为10个优化特征，取得96.11%准确率、95.14%精确率、98.00%召回率和98.23% F1；相较使用全部16特征的基线随机森林（74.45%准确率、59.86% F1），F1提升逾1.6倍，多数类检测稳定性超99%，并优于受不平衡与弱特征相关性影响的既有16特征模型。
AI.conclusion: 集成流程构建出更强的模糊-数值表示空间，改善糖尿病风险分层，并为更广泛临床数据集的诊断建模提供可扩展、具不确定性感知能力的基础。

title: VLSplat: Vision-Language Guided Object-Centric 3D Gaussian Splatting via Scene Graph
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://vlsplat.github.io/
summary: Learning semantic representations for 3D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a promising direction for 3D scene understanding. However, existing 2D-to-3D semantic lifting approaches rely primarily on 2D segmentation supervision and lack object-level priors, causing the learned representation to be driven by local mask evidence rather than holistic object structure. In this paper, we present VLSplat, a vision-language guided approach for object-centric semantic lifting in 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our method augments mask-based lifting with object-level semantic priors derived from vision-language models and refines Gaussian representations using an object-group scene graph. The refinement is performed through two language-guided modules: intra-group refinement suppresses semantic noise within object groups, while inter-group acquisition expands object support regions by incorporating structurally relevant candidates from neighboring groups. Extensive experiments on indoor scene datasets demonstrate that VLSplat improves the semantic consistency and structural completeness of object-level categories. Our code and models are available at https://vlsplat.github.io/.

AI.tldr: VLSplat利用视觉-语言模型提供的对象级先验和对象组场景图，改进3D高斯泼溅中2D到3D语义提升的语义一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有2D到3D语义提升方法主要依赖2D分割监督，缺乏对象级先验，导致学到的表示受局部掩码证据驱动而非整体对象结构。
AI.method: 在基于掩码的提升基础上，引入VLM导出的对象级语义先验，并用对象组场景图精炼高斯表示；通过两个语言引导模块实现：组内精炼抑制对象组内语义噪声，组间获取从相邻组纳入结构相关候选以扩展对象支撑区域。
AI.result: 在室内场景数据集上实验表明，VLSplat提升了对象级类别的语义一致性与结构完整性。
AI.conclusion: 结合视觉-语言对象级先验与对象组场景图可有效改善3DGS语义表示，代码与模型已公开。

title: LUCA: A Synthetic World for Experimental Reasoning
comment: 20 pages (9 pages main text, remainder appendix), 6 figures, 14 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents; non-archival
summary:
An experimental agent can succeed for the wrong reasons. Evaluations, however, often focus on the outcome, not the experiments, evidence, and inferences that produced it. We introduce LUCA, a configurable synthetic world for evaluating this process under fully known ground truth. Agents learn unknown regulatory systems through budgeted experimentation, then predict unseen interventions, diagnose hidden faults, and attempt rescues. This setup allows us to evaluate experiment selection, prediction, diagnosis, and intervention separately.
  Across seven frontier LLMs and three baselines, these capabilities dissociate sharply. Agents frequently rescue malfunctioning systems while diagnosing the wrong fault; diagnosis varies 7x across models while prediction varies only 1.4x. Models also adopt surprisingly different experimental strategies, and greater exploration does not reliably yield better performance. In one failure mode, agents often perform the experiment needed to distinguish competing causes, but still fail to use the resulting evidence. LUCA turns these hidden failures into measurable behaviours, providing a controlled environment to study where experimental agents succeed and fail. Code: https://github.com/RelationRx/luca.

AI.tldr: 提出LUCA——一个可配置的合成世界基准，在完全已知真值下分离评估AI智能体的实验选择、预测、诊断与干预能力，发现前沿LLM的这些能力严重解离。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多关注结果而忽略产生结果的实验、证据与推理过程，导致"以错误理由成功"的智能体无法被识别，需要过程级、可控真值的评估环境。
AI.method: 构建LUCA合成世界：智能体通过有预算约束的实验学习未知调控系统，随后预测未见过干预、诊断隐藏故障并尝试救援；从而对实验选择、预测、诊断、干预分开评估。测试7个前沿LLM与3个基线。
AI.result: 能力显著解离：常出现救活系统却诊断错误；诊断跨模型差异达7倍而预测仅1.4倍；各模型实验策略差异明显，更多探索并不带来更好表现；还存在"做了鉴别实验却未利用证据"的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: LUCA将隐蔽的失败转化为可测量行为，提供受控环境研究实验型智能体的成功与失败之处。代码已开源。

title: Test-Time Scaling for Open-Ended Reasoning at Small Model Scale
summary: A vote over a model's samples can only help when the samples disagree. For open-ended generation the binding question is therefore not how to combine samples but whether a model produces samples worth combining, a question test-time scaling has answered for math but not for free-form text. We study it at small scale with semantic cluster voting, a judge-free aggregator that groups a small instruct model's samples by meaning and returns the largest cluster's representative, with no reward model or self-judging. On a 250-prompt benchmark with three tiers of answer checkability, the same pattern holds across three model families (Qwen2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-3B, Gemma-2-2B) and two generation seeds: voting raises accuracy on the math control, where samples vary but stay checkable (a gain of +10 to +29 points across the three models), yet adds at most +0.30 judge points on open-ended text. On a larger 200-problem MATH-500 run with the primary model, the math gain is +8.5 points (95% CI [+4.0, +13.0]). Almost every open-ended sample falls into one meaning cluster, so there is little to select over. The collapse is consistent with instruction-tuning rather than model size, and raising decoding temperature does not recover usable diversity, because it costs more quality than it adds (net -0.64 judge points, 95% CI [-0.93, -0.37]).

AI.tldr: 论文在小规模上研究开放式文本的自一致性投票是否有效，发现只有数学等"可检验"任务能从样本投票中获益，开放式文本因样本几乎同义而几乎无增益。
AI.motivation: 投票/测试时扩展只在样本之间存在分歧时才有用；数学任务的多样性已被验证，但自由文本是否产生"值得组合"的多样样本尚未清楚，需先回答"模型能否生成可分化的样本"这一问题。
AI.method: 提出语义聚类投票：无需奖励模型或自评判（judge-free），将小型instruct模型的多个样本按语义聚类，返回最大簇的代表样本。构建250个提示、三档答案可检验性梯度的基准，在Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-3B、Gemma-2-2B三个模型族与两个生成种子上评估；并在MATH-500上做200题扩展实验，另考察解码温度对多样性的影响。
AI.result: 数学对照任务上投票提升+10至+29分（MATH-500扩增实验+8.5分，95%CI [+4.0,+13.0]）；开放式文本最多仅+0.30评判分。开放式样本几乎全部落入同一语义簇，几乎无可选择性。该现象与指令微调一致而非模型规模；提高温度无法恢复可用多样性（净-0.64评判分，95%CI [-0.93,-0.37]）。
AI.conclusion: 测试时投票的价值取决于任务可检验性与样本多样性；对小型instruct模型的开放式生成，样本缺乏语义多样性，投票收益有限甚至为负，问题在于"样本是否值得组合"而非"如何组合"。

title: Event-Based Optical Flow Constraint via Time-Sliced Plane Fitting
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication at IEEE VCIP 2026 (2026 IEEE International Conference on Visual Communications and Image Processing). (c) 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses
summary: Event-based optical flow estimation using spatiotemporal planar approximation inherently assumes constant velocity and tends to average out temporal velocity variations. In this paper, we propose a flow estimation method that extends this planar approximation along the temporal axis. The resulting event-based optical flow constraint allows existing variational optical flow formulations to model temporal motion variation. Specifically, we partition the space-time volume into sub-intervals and apply a two-step planar approximation to track object edges consistently. Moreover, a spatial compensation mechanism and a temporal regularization term are incorporated to compensate for edge displacements and temporally stabilize the flow estimation, respectively. The experimental results show that modeling temporal motion variation improves flow estimation accuracy over conventional methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种沿时间轴扩展平面近似的事件相机光流估计方法，可建模时间上的运动变化。
AI.motivation: 传统基于事件相机的时空平面近似光流方法隐含恒定速度假设，会将时间上的速度变化平均化，导致精度受限。
AI.method: 将平面近似沿时间轴扩展，得到可描述时变运动的新的基于事件的光流约束，使现有变分光流框架能建模运动随时间变化；具体将时空体划分成子区间，采用两步平面近似一致地跟踪物体边缘，并引入空间补偿机制补偿边缘位移、时间正则项稳定估计。
AI.result: 实验表明，建模时间运动变化相比传统方法提升了光流估计精度。
AI.conclusion: 沿时间轴扩展平面近似是缓解恒定速度假设的有效途径，可提高事件相机光流估计准确性。

title: From Local Skills to Long-Horizon Web Tasks: Progressive Skill Exploration for LLM Web Agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are driving autonomous agents toward real-world environments, with the Web emerging as one of the most representative interaction scenarios. However, training Web agents with naive exploration remains challenging: successful trajectories are rare, and the sparse terminal rewards make it difficult for agents to obtain useful feedback from failed trajectories. Inspired by skill acquisition theory, we propose Skill-Composed Progressive Exploration (SCOPE), a short-to-long learning framework for long-horizon Web agents that decomposes complex task exploration into a gradual expansion process from local skills to complete task-solving capability. Specifically, SCOPE iteratively explores around local skills: Skill Discovery extracts reusable local skills and failure experiences from historical rollouts; Skill Orchestration composes discovered skills into high-level skill chains; and Skill Expansion leverages failure experiences aligned with the current skill chain to guide the agent toward exploring new subskills. Through this process, SCOPE progressively constructs task-completing skill chains across rollouts and internalizes them into the policy parameters through agentic on-policy distillation. Extensive experiments on WebArena, WebVoyager, and WebShop show that SCOPE consistently improves exploration dynamics and achieves 3.9% to 18.6% relative gains over the strongest baselines in each setting.

AI.tldr: SCOPE 是一个从局部技能到完整任务的短到长学习框架，通过技能发现、技能编排和技能扩展的迭代探索，并结合在线策略蒸馏，提升长程 Web 智能体的探索效率。
AI.motivation: 用朴素探索方式训练 Web 智能体非常困难：成功轨迹稀少，且终端奖励稀疏，导致智能体难以从失败轨迹中获得有效反馈。论文受技能习得理论启发，试图将复杂任务探索分解为从局部技能到完整任务求解能力的渐进扩展过程。
AI.method: SCOPE 迭代围绕局部技能进行探索，包含三个环节：技能发现（Skill Discovery）从历史 rollout 中提取可复用局部技能和失败经验；技能编排（Skill Orchestration）将已发现技能组合成高层技能链；技能扩展（Skill Expansion）利用与当前技能链对齐的失败经验引导智能体探索新子技能。最终通过智能体在线策略蒸馏（agentic on-policy distillation）将逐步构建的任务完成技能链内化到策略参数中。
AI.result: 在 WebArena、WebVoyager 和 WebShop 上的大量实验表明，SCOPE 持续改善探索动态，并在各设置下相较最强基线取得 3.9% 至 18.6% 的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE 通过从局部技能到完整任务求解的渐进式技能组合探索，有效缓解了长程 Web 智能体训练中成功轨迹稀少和奖励稀疏的问题，实验验证了其在多个 Web 基准上的有效性。

title: Discrimination, Calibration, and Ranking: A Unified Matrix Framework
comment: 88 pages, 8 figures. Lean 4 formalisation and experiment code: https://github.com/rcprati/discrimination-calibration-ranking. Implemented in the aggmetrics package (version 0.3.0, subpackage aggmetrics.scores)
summary: Discrimination, calibration, and ranking are the three pillars of classifier evaluation, yet no single algebraic language spans all three. A recent indicator-matrix account unifies discrimination measures (precision, recall, F1, Matthews correlation) across binary, multiclass, multilabel and related settings, using Boolean cell operations on indicator label matrices, generalised to soft labels by t-norms. Calibration measures (Brier score, log-loss) and ranking measures (nDCG, AUC) fall outside it. We close the gap with two further classes of cell operators: deviation operators phi(y - yhat), which give a Calibration Framework, and rank- and slice-dependent operators (positional gains for DCG, column concordance cells for AUC), which give a Ranking Framework. Both inherit the micro/macro/exemplar aggregation architecture. For calibration, the three Brier aggregations collapse to one scalar; the Murphy decomposition holds in matrix form (unbinned, binned and isotonic); and, within the Brier-type class-indexed family, a measure is skew-invariant if and only if it depends only on the class-conditional errors alpha_j and beta_j, the calibration analogues of recall and specificity. For ranking, raw DCG collapses across aggregations while nDCG does not; per-class nDCG and per-class AUC are related by a row-column duality; micro-AUC differs from pooled ROC-AUC; raw positional scores are never strictly proper, and nDCG and AUC need not be proper. The skew-invariant per-class building blocks share one class-conditional expectation template. Experiments on two multilabel benchmarks illustrate the distinctions. Many of the results are machine-checked in Lean 4; the proofs, the experiments and the aggmetrics.scores package are public: https://github.com/rcprati/discrimination-calibration-ranking

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了指标矩阵(indicator-matrix)框架，新增偏差算子与排名/切片依赖算子，将校准(Brier、log-loss)与排名(nDCG、AUC)纳入与判别指标统一的代数语言。
AI.motivation: 现有指标矩阵框架只覆盖判别类指标(precision、recall、F1、MCC)，而校准(Brier、log-loss)与排名(nDCG、AUC)指标无法纳入，缺乏统一三类评测支柱的代数语言。
AI.method: 引入两类新的单元算子：(1)偏差算子 phi(y-yhat)，形成 Calibration Framework；(2)排名与切片依赖算子(DCG 位置增益、AUC 列一致性单元)，形成 Ranking Framework。二者均继承 micro/macro/exemplar 聚合架构，并在 Lean 4 中机器验证部分结果。
AI.result: 校准：三种 Brier 聚合坍缩为单一标量；Murphy 分解在矩阵形式下成立(无分箱、分箱、保序)；Brier 类指标偏斜不变当且仅当仅依赖类条件误差 alpha_j、beta_j。排名：原始 DCG 跨聚合坍缩而 nDCG 不坍缩；类内 nDCG 与类内 AUC 存在行列对偶；micro-AUC 与 pooled ROC-AUC 不同；原始位置分数从不严格 proper，nDCG 与 AUC 未必 proper。偏斜不变构件共享同一类条件期望模板。两个多标签数据集实验佐证差异。
AI.conclusion: 判别、校准、排名三类指标可统一于同一指标矩阵代数框架，共享 micro/macro/exemplar 聚合与类条件期望模板；理论结果经 Lean 4 验证，并发布 aggmetrics.scores 开源包。

title: Object-Only Is Not Context-Free: A Counterfactual Diagnostic for Context Removal in Object Retrieval
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 8 pages plus references and supplementary material (15 pages total). Code and adapter checkpoints: https://github.com/bmeivar/kap
summary: Object-centric retrieval pipelines often mask the background before pooling backbone features, aiming for a descriptor that reflects the object rather than its scene. Whether this truly yields an object-only descriptor, however, is rarely tested. We introduce the Keyhole Aperture Probe (KAP), a counterfactual diagnostic that repurposes the ground-truth masks of existing panoptic segmentation datasets (COCO, ADE20K) for retrieval: it holds the pooled object region fixed and varies only the pixels outside it, summarizing a backbone's context dependence in a single number. We find that the pooled object region has already integrated its surround. Replacing the context, with a neutral fill or even a different real scene, changes the descriptor, and when retrieval fails under a blank fill, the descriptor matches plain-background images rather than its own object. Object-only is not context-free. Across ten modern backbones, object-only descriptors retain only about a quarter to two-thirds of their full-image accuracy, and the effect is not unique to Transformer self-attention: a convolutional backbone shows it too. The dependence is also reducible: a lightweight adapter that encourages the descriptor to stay stable as context is removed lowers it and improves full-image instance retrieval on INSTRE, transferring to ILIAS with accuracy improved or preserved.
