A matched contrastive-fine-tuning control does not reproduce those gains. We release KAP as a simple, backbone-agnostic evaluation protocol to measure and reduce this dependence before deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出 Keyhole Aperture Probe (KAP)，用反事实探测量化"仅目标描述子"对上下文的依赖，发现池化的目标区域已整合了周围场景，且该依赖可通过轻量适配器降低。
AI.motivation: 以目标为中心的检索流程通常在池化主干特征前屏蔽背景，期望得到只反映目标而非场景的描述子；但这种"仅目标描述子"是否真正脱离上下文，鲜有检验。
AI.method: KAP 复用 COCO、ADE20K 全景分割的真值掩码：固定池化的目标区域，仅改变区域外像素（中性填充或换成另一真实场景），把主干对上下文的依赖压缩为单一指标；并在十个现代主干（含 Transformer 与卷积）上评估。作者进一步训练轻量适配器，鼓励描述子在上下文被移除时保持稳定。检索评估使用 INSTRE，并迁移到 ILIAS；另设匹配的对比式微调对照。
AI.result: 池化的目标区域已整合周围信息：替换上下文会改变描述子；空白填充导致检索失败时，描述子更匹配纯背景图像而非自身目标。十个主干上仅目标描述子仅保留全图精度约 1/4 至 2/3，且卷积主干同样存在该效应。轻量适配器可降低依赖，并提升 INSTRE 全图实例检索，迁移到 ILIAS 精度提升或保持；匹配的对比微调对照未能复现该提升。
AI.conclusion: "仅目标"不等于"无上下文"。KAP 作为简单、与主干无关的评估协议，可在部署前测量并降低这种上下文依赖。

title: ComplianceAtlas: A Taxonomy-Driven Agentic AI Framework for Automated AI Act Gap Analysis and Remediation
summary: Assessing regulatory compliance for high-risk AI systems requires systematic identification of technical gaps such as missing controls, in- adequate processes, or shallow evaluation of practices. Compliance officers typically admin- ister structured questionnaires collecting evi- dence of current practices, where organizations respond with descriptions of their existing pro- cesses, technical capabilities, and architectural choices. However, translating these compli- ance questionnaire responses into typed, ac- tionable gap diagnoses remains unsystematic. In this paper, we present a literature-grounded taxonomy of technical compliance gaps cover- ing areas such as accuracy, robustness, logging, and human oversight, and embed it in GapTo- Compliance, a two-stage agentic framework coordinating two specialized agents: a Gap Extraction Agent that performs hierarchical rea- soning from compliance areas to specific gap types, and a Remediation Planning Agent that ranks remediation actions from a remediation catalog via multi-signal scoring combining se- mantic similarity, regulatory alignment, and effort estimation. We evaluate this framework against four automatic compliance gap detec- tion baselines across 9 AI systems and 6 AI families. Our approach achieves a gap-type F1 of 0.831 (vs. 0.533 for the strongest baseline) and remediation P@5 of 0.872 (vs. 0.635 for retrieval methods), demonstrating promising potential for automated compliance workflows. The structured agent coordination reveals a path toward human-in-the-loop compliance systems where automated gap extraction reduces expert burden while maintaining auditability, and the taxonomy-driven design enables extension to emerging regulatory frameworks beyond

AI.tldr: 提出文献依据的技术合规差距分类法，并嵌入 GapToCompliance 两阶段智能体框架，实现从问卷回答到类型化差距诊断的自动化。
AI.motivation: 高风险 AI 合规评估需识别缺失控制、流程不足等差距，但把合规问卷回答转化为类型化、可执行的差距诊断仍缺乏系统方法。
AI.method: 构建覆盖准确性、鲁棒性、日志、人工监督等的差距分类法；两阶段智能体框架：Gap Extraction Agent 做从合规领域到具体差距类型的层次推理，Remediation Planning Agent 通过语义相似度、法规对齐度与工作量估计的多信号打分对补救措施排序。
AI.result: 在 9 个 AI 系统、6 个 AI 家族上与四种自动差距检测基线对比：差距类型 F1 达 0.831（最强基线 0.533），补救 P@5 达 0.872（检索方法 0.635）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化智能体协作可支撑人在环合规系统，降低专家负担并保持可审计性；分类法驱动设计便于扩展至新兴监管框架。

title: Who Should Score the Cache? Mid-Depth Layers Are the Best Judges of KV-Cache Eviction
summary: Key-value (KV) cache eviction methods rank tokens by attention scores, and each layer scores its own cache. To our knowledge, no eviction method asks which layer should score. We find, across twenty-one models, that the depth of the scoring layer governs eviction quality. On the eighteen models with per-layer caches, spanning 0.5B to 109B, long-context retrieval accuracy collapses at shallow layers, peaks between 0.4 and 0.75 of depth, and degrades at the last layer. The curve arises because a layer judges tokens well only once it has used the question to find the answer, which takes several layers. Modeling eviction as a top-$k$ cut, we compute answer survival probability from prefill attention and reproduce the measured curves. This approach selects the scoring layer using calibration prompts with known answers, and the selected layer is the best layer measured on most models and never significantly below it. It improves on the own-layer default on sixteen of the eighteen models, with significant gains on seven, all at 14B or below, while on larger models the default is already close to the best mid-depth layer. Scoring every cache from the selected layer while keeping one set of tokens for all heads also beats per-head SnapKV by 18 to 43 points on five models up to 14B under tight budgets. This gain carries over to financial filings at 32K context, all at the same memory budget, with no extra forward pass. The same curve explains a penalty in shared-cache models, where several layers read one cache and the layer that writes it scores by default. On Gemma-4-E2B the writer is shallow and loses 28 points to a mid-depth reader at a 10% budget. We also find that in open-book question answering (LongBench) no mid-depth layer beats the own-layer default.

AI.tldr: KV cache eviction scoring layer depth matters: accuracy peaks at 0.4–0.75 of model depth.
AI.motivation: Existing KV cache eviction methods let each layer score its own cache, but no method questions which layer should do the scoring. The authors investigate whether the depth of the scoring layer governs eviction quality.
AI.method: Across 21 models (0.5B–109B), they measure long-context retrieval accuracy as a function of scoring-layer depth. They model eviction as a top-k cut and compute answer survival probability from prefill attention to reproduce the observed curves. They then select the scoring layer via calibration prompts with known answers, and score every cache from that selected layer while keeping one shared token set for all heads.
AI.result: Retrieval accuracy collapses at shallow layers, peaks at 0.4–0.75 depth, and degrades at the last layer. The calibrated selection is best or near-best on most models and beats the own-layer default on 16 of 18 per-layer models (significant on 7, all ≤14B). Shared-layer scoring beats per-head SnapKV by 18–43 points on five models up to 14B under tight budgets, carries over to 32K financial filings with no extra forward pass, and explains a 28-point penalty in shared-cache Gemma-4-E2B. However, no mid-depth layer beats the own-layer default on LongBench open-book QA.
AI.conclusion: Scoring-layer depth is a first-order factor in KV eviction quality, tied to when a layer has used the question to locate the answer. Calibrated mid-depth scoring improves eviction on small-to-mid models and shared-cache models, but offers no gain in open-book QA, where the own-layer default remains preferable.

title: Knowledge-Guided Floodwater Level Reasoning for Cloud-Edge Collaborative Monitoring
summary: Frequent urban floodwater poses a serious threat to the safety and efficiency of intelligent transportation systems. Existing vision-based methods for floodwater level detection face two main limitations. First, the lack of explicit reasoning leads to poor detection performance and little interpretability. Second, these methods struggle to generalize to the complex and varied real-world road scenes seen from different viewpoints. To address this, we reformulate the task as an explicit visual reasoning problem and propose HydroReasoner, a floodwater level reasoning framework designed for cloud-edge collaboration. HydroReasoner builds on Qwen2.5-VL and is trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization. To address the scarcity of reasoning process annotations, we build a floodwater domain knowledge graph HydroKG and design a novel KG path reward. Through deterministic graph traversal over HydroKG, this reward supervises the model's reasoning process at a fine granularity, which improves both reasoning and generalization. For edge deployment, we apply 4-bit quantization to the model, cutting GPU memory usage by 57% and inference latency by 43% while out-of-domain accuracy drops by only 0.2 percentage points. We also propose a confidence-based cloud-edge routing mechanism, which improves system safety and eases the computational load on the cloud. In addition, we build HydroLevel, a floodwater benchmark dataset of 3,000 images, for training and evaluating the model. Experimental results show that HydroReasoner achieves detection accuracy 4.0 and 13.6 percentage points higher than conventional vision baselines in the in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations respectively, with performance dropping by only 4.4 percentage points out of domain.

AI.tldr: 论文将积水水位检测重构为显式视觉推理任务，提出基于Qwen2.5-VL+GRPO训练的HydroReasoner框架，借助积水领域知识图谱HydroKG的路径奖励监督推理过程，并结合4-bit量化与置信度云边路由实现部署，检测精度显著优于传统视觉基线。
AI.motivation: 城市积水威胁智能交通系统的安全与效率。现有视觉检测方法存在两大局限：一是缺乏显式推理，检测性能差且可解释性低；二是难以泛化到不同视角下的复杂真实道路场景。
AI.method: 将积水水位检测重构为显式视觉推理问题；基于Qwen2.5-VL并以GRPO训练；构建积水领域知识图谱HydroKG，设计知识图谱路径奖励，通过确定性图遍历对推理过程进行细粒度监督；边缘侧采用4-bit量化；提出基于置信度的云边路由机制；构建包含3000张图像的HydroLevel基准数据集。
AI.result: 域内与域外检测精度分别比传统视觉基线高4.0和13.6个百分点，域外性能仅下降4.4个百分点；4-bit量化使GPU显存降低57%、推理时延降低43%，域外精度仅下降0.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式推理结合知识图谱路径奖励可有效提升积水水位检测的精度与泛化能力，量化与云边路由机制使其适合边缘部署并提高系统安全性、降低云端计算负载。

title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
summary: Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level, an outer world-data-model flywheel continuously incorporates open-world corpus and leverages evolving model weaknesses to guide subsequent data construction and optimization iterations. At the data level, an inner flywheel couples open-world seeding and autocatalytic propagation. The former mines authentic workflows as seed tasks from instructional videos, and employs visual-semantic dual-path trajectory reconstruction; The latter transforms these seeds into reusable primitives for controllable synthesis of diverse, complex, and verifiable tasks. To enable efficient and reliable trajectory collection, we further introduce a feedback-guided snapshot-rollback retry mechanism in various real environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CUA-Master-27B achieves competitive performance across GUI-only and GUI-CLI hybrid benchmarks, scoring 80.2 on OSWorld Verified, 36.9 on OSWorld 2.0, 43.9 on WeaveBench, and 25.0 on Agents' Last Exam. Our framework also substantially improves the quality and efficiency of data synthesis, and exhibits continuous gains across recursive iterations.

AI.tldr: 提出 CUA-Master 嵌套双环递归改进框架，通过外层"世界-数据-模型"飞轮与内层数据飞轮，解决 CUA 交互数据多样性、可控性与可靠性不足及现有自迭代方法收益递减问题。
AI.motivation: CUAgent 发展受限于交互数据多样性、可控性、可靠性差；传统优化流程缺乏迭代反馈，而现有递归改进方法依赖自生成经验，能力扩展受限、收益递减。
AI.method: 嵌套双环递归改进框架：系统级外层"世界-数据-模型"飞轮持续引入开放世界语料，并用模型弱点引导后续数据构建与优化；数据级内层飞轮结合开放世界播种（从教学视频挖掘真实工作流作种子任务，采用视觉-语义双路径轨迹重建）与自催化传播（将种子转化为可复用原语，可控合成多样、复杂、可验证任务）；并引入反馈引导的快照回滚重试机制以在真实环境中高效可靠采集轨迹。
AI.result: CUA-Master-27B 在纯 GUI 与 GUI-CLI 混合基准上具竞争力：OSWorld Verified 80.2、OSWorld 2.0 36.9、WeaveBench 43.9、Agents' Last Exam 25.0；同时显著提升数据合成质量与效率，且随递归迭代持续增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过双层递归飞轮与可验证任务合成，可实现数据与模型能力的持续协同进化，突破自生成经验的瓶颈。

title: Iterative Gumbel Planning for Continuous Control
summary: Search-based planning remains a powerful policy improvement paradigm in reinforcement learning, driving milestone successes in discrete domains. However, extending this paradigm to continuous control exposes a structural mismatch: search evaluates a finite set of action candidates, whereas continuous RL typically relies on Gaussian policies. We show that winner-action distillation into a continuous Gaussian induces a \textit{projection error} and a stepwise variance-expanding gradient tendency when the selected action is sufficiently far from the current mean. Empirically, this tendency is associated with elevated terminal variance and a return gap on the evaluated tasks. To address this, we propose \textbf{Iterative Gumbel Planning (IGP)}. By adopting a per-dimension factorized categorical policy, IGP naturally aligns the policy support with the search candidates, eliminating the projection error and reducing the residual approximation to a bounded discretization error. To bypass the combinatorial explosion of high-dimensional discrete action spaces, IGP pairs Gumbel Top-$K$ candidate sampling with an MPPI-style multi-round iterative search to refine the policy at each state. Empirically, IGP achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance and sample efficiency on DMControl and HumanoidBench. Furthermore, it produces more stable action sequences with lower temporal variance, demonstrating its practical potential for real-world robotic deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文指出将搜索式规划的动作蒸馏进连续高斯策略会带来投影误差与方差扩张问题，提出按维度因子化的类别策略 Iterative Gumbel Planning (IGP)，结合 Gumbel Top-K 采样与 MPPI 式多轮迭代搜索，在 DMControl 和 HumanoidBench 上取得 SOTA 的性能与样本效率。
AI.motivation: 搜索式策略改进在离散域很成功，但迁移到连续控制时存在结构性错配：搜索只在有限候选动作中评估，而连续 RL 用高斯策略。作者发现把胜出动作蒸馏进高斯策略会产生投影误差；当被选动作离当前均值较远时，梯度会逐步扩大方差，导致终端方差偏高并带来回报差距。
AI.method: 提出 Iterative Gumbel Planning (IGP)。采用逐维度因子化的类别分布策略，使策略支撑集与搜索候选对齐，从而消除投影误差，把残余近似误差限制为有界的离散化误差。为规避高维离散动作空间组合爆炸，IGP 用 Gumbel Top-K 候选采样，并配合 MPPI 风格的多轮迭代搜索在每个状态上精化策略。
AI.result: 在 DMControl 和 HumanoidBench 上，IGP 取得 SOTA 的综合性能与样本效率；同时生成更稳定的动作序列、更低的时间方差，显示其在真实机器人部署上的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 用因子化类别策略替代高斯策略，能从根本上对齐搜索与策略的表达形式，解决投影误差和方差扩张问题；配合 Gumbel Top-K 与迭代搜索，可在控制基准上实现更优、更稳定的连续控制表现。

title: MUPA${}^2$S: Multimodal Unified Perception with Asymmetric Attention for Stress Assessment
summary: Stress is a leading contributor to long-term physical and mental health decline. The automatic assessment of stress is a promising approach for continuous monitoring and mitigating human biases. However, the development of automated systems remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of physiological and behavioral signals. This paper presents MUPA${}^2$S, a multimodal framework for automatic stress assessment that combines facial video and ECG signals within a unified perception architecture. Both modalities are mapped into a shared token representation without modality-specific components, and processed through asymmetric attention comprising segment-local cross-attention and global self-attention across segment states. Experiments on a newly collected 58-subject stress dataset, evaluated under a stratified subject-level protocol, show that facial video achieves 69.44% test accuracy, while ECG-only performance remains close to chance under the proposed representation. Unified Video-ECG fusion achieves a test accuracy of 69.58% at approximately half the number of parameters of feature-level fusion, with negligible additional computational cost. Feature-level fusion does not exceed the video-only baseline, while unified input-level integration provides a parameter-efficient mechanism for jointly processing the two modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出MUPA²S多模态压力评估框架，将面部视频与ECG映射为共享token并用以非对称注意力处理；在58人数据集上视频单独69.44%，视频-ECG统一融合69.58%且参数约为特征级融合一半。
AI.motivation: 压力是长期身心健康下降的主要诱因，自动评估有望实现持续监测并减少人为偏差；但生理与行为信号异质性强，自动系统开发仍具挑战。
AI.method: MUPA²S在统一感知架构中结合面部视频与ECG；两模态映射到无可模态专属组件的共享token表示，并通过非对称注意力（段内局部交叉注意力+跨段状态的全局自注意力）处理。在新采集的58名受试者数据上采用分层受试者级协议评测。
AI.result: 面部视频测试准确率69.44%；仅ECG在该表示下接近随机水平。统一视频-ECG融合达69.58%，参数约为特征级融合的一半，额外计算开销可忽略；特征级融合未超过仅视频基线。
AI.conclusion: 统一输入级融合为联合处理两种模态提供了参数高效机制，优于特征级融合；但ECG信息利用不足、整体准确率仍有限，跨模态增益不明显。

title: Toward Knowledge-Centric AI: Discovering, Internalizing, and Using Explicit Knowledge Across Agents and Generations
summary: Knowledge is how understanding accumulates across people and generations: durable records that outlive their producers and that others can check, combine, teach, and correct. AI agents are now built and run by many independent users and organizations, and each agent is upgraded, replaced, or retired within months. Yet what an agent learns stays trapped in model parameters, a transient context window, or a system-specific memory store that is appended to and retrieved from rather than processed. We argue that the next generation of AI should be knowledge-centric, built around an explicit, continuously evolving knowledge layer independent of any single agent. In this loop, agents discover knowledge from their environments and trajectories; the layer internalizes it by turning fragmented, heterogeneous records and experience into composable, revisable understanding; and agents across systems and generations use the result and return new outcomes for revision. While discovery and use have advanced rapidly with large language model agents, internalization remains the bottleneck. We argue that internalization should become a persistent object of training and maintenance-centered on condition-preserving conceptualization of events and deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning across noisy, heterogeneous representations (text, tables, graphs, rules, and programs). To power this layer, we call for knowledge foundation models that provide shared neural capacity for knowledge computation, and outline a research agenda showing how an explicit knowledge layer delivers reuse, cost efficiency, auditability, and continuity across agent generations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出下一代AI应以"知识为中心"，构建独立于任何单一智能体、显式且持续进化的知识层；其中"内化"（将碎片化记录与经验转化为可组合、可修正的理解）是当前瓶颈，应成为训练与维护的持久对象，并呼吁发展"知识基础模型"以提供共享神经容量。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体由众多独立用户/组织构建且数月即被升级或淘汰，其学到的知识被困在模型参数、短暂上下文窗口或系统专属记忆库中，只能追加与检索而无法被加工处理；智能体生命周期短，知识无法跨代传承。
AI.method: 立场/议程性论文：论证知识循环的三环节——发现（智能体从环境与轨迹中获取知识）、内化（知识层将碎片化异构记录与经验转化为可组合、可修正的理解）、使用（跨系统跨代智能体使用并回馈新结果以供修正）；主张内化聚焦"保条件的事件概念化"与在噪声异构表示（文本、表格、图、规则、程序）上的演绎、归纳、溯因推理；并呼吁建设知识基础模型作为知识计算的共享神经容量。
AI.result: 属观点性文章，无实验数据；指出发现与使用两环节随大模型智能体已快速推进，而内化仍是瓶颈；提出显式知识层可带来复用、成本效率、可审计性与跨代连续性。
AI.conclusion: AI应从以模型为中心转向以知识为中心，把内化确立为独立于智能体的持久训练与维护目标，并配套知识基础模型与相应研究议程。

title: Multimodal BVP and Respiration for Automated Pain Recognition with Hankel-FCN
summary: Automated pain recognition is a fundamental challenge for the advancement of clinical care and empathetic human-computer interaction, due to the subjective and dynamic nature of pain. In this study, we propose a deep learning framework for objective pain assessment based on multimodal physiological signals from the AI4Pain dataset. The approach focuses on Blood Volume Pulse (BVP) and Respiration (RESP), capturing complementary aspects of autonomic responses to nociceptive stimulation. To explicitly model their temporal dynamics, the signals are transformed into structured trajectory representations using Hankel matrix embeddings, enabling the learning of dynamical patterns beyond conventional time-series representations. These embeddings are processed by modality-specific Fully Convolutional Networks, and their outputs are integrated through a late fusion strategy for three-class classification (No Pain, Low Pain, High Pain). Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an accuracy of 67.09% and an F1-score of 66.41%, providing competitive performance compared to existing approaches, while relying on no handcrafted feature engineering. Multimodal fusion significantly outperformed either modality alone, and the Hankel embedding showed a trend towards further improvement. Further validation is required to establish generalisability to broader populations and clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于多模态生理信号的深度学习框架用于客观疼痛评估：将BVP与呼吸信号通过Hankel矩阵嵌入转换为轨迹表示，用模态专属全卷积网络处理并晚融合，实现无痛/低痛/高痛三分类。
AI.motivation: 疼痛具有主观性和动态性，自动化疼痛识别是临床护理与共情式人机交互的关键挑战，需要客观、无需手工特征的评估方法。
AI.method: 基于AI4Pain数据集的血容量脉搏(BVP)与呼吸(RESP)信号，用Hankel矩阵嵌入构建结构化轨迹表示以显式建模时间动态；各模态分别输入全卷积网络，最后通过晚融合完成三分类。
AI.result: 准确率67.09%、F1分数66.41%，与现有方法相比具竞争力；多模态融合显著优于单模态，Hankel嵌入呈现进一步提升的趋势。
AI.conclusion: 方法在无手工特征工程下实现有竞争力的客观疼痛评估，多模态融合有效；泛化到更广泛人群与临床场景仍需进一步验证。

title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
summary: Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decides actions, delegation, and acceptance, while the runtime maintains state and feedback. Its three-layer architecture enables direct execution or delegation to Subagents, synchronously or asynchronously, under stable responsibilities. Through a shared application layer, humans and agents inspect and revise the same evolving documents, presentations, CAD models, and Blender scenes, so human-in-the-loop participation can enter both through conversation and through direct modification of the work itself. To sustain continuity across agents and sessions, CoworkOS further introduces hierarchical workspaces and persistent semantic memory, so working files, key decisions, and long-running Job logs remain shareable, reusable, and resumable after interruption. Across 12 benchmarks and 6 categories of real-world applications, CoworkOS proves highly competitive with frontier agent applications such as Codex and DeepSeek Harness. As a sustained-work case study, CoworkOS uses GLM-5.3 as its backbone to conduct RSI-driven automated post-training on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Over five rounds, the model's average score across eight benchmarks rose from 33.19 to 42.95 (+9.76). Looking ahead, we believe CoworkOS opens a meaningful path toward general cowork-agent intelligence.

AI.tldr: CoworkOS 是一个面向长周期协作工作的通用 harness，将任务策略与执行管理分离，通过三层架构、共享应用层、分层工作区与持久语义记忆，支持人机协同、子代理委派与跨会话续接；在 12 个基准与 6 类真实应用中比肩 Codex、DeepSeek Harness，并以 GLM-5.3 驱动对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 做 RSI 自动后训练，五轮从 33.19 提升到 42.95。
AI.motivation: 协作型（cowork）代理正从人机协作走向真实世界自动化，但生产力任务要求既高质量交付复杂产物，又需在长周期内持续监控与决策，二者兼得仍是开放难题。
AI.method: 提出 CoworkOS：策略与执行管理分离，模型负责动作、委派与验收，运行时维护状态与反馈；三层架构支持直接执行或同步/异步委派 Subagents；共享应用层让人与代理共同查看与修改同一份文档、演示、CAD 模型与 Blender 场景；分层工作区与持久语义记忆保证文件、关键决策与 Job 日志可共享、复用、中断后恢复。
AI.result: 在 12 个基准、6 类真实应用中与 Codex、DeepSeek Harness 等前沿代理应用具高度竞争力；案例中以 GLM-5.3 为骨干对 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 进行 RSI 自动后训练，五轮后八个基准平均分由 33.19 升至 42.95（+9.76）。
AI.conclusion: CoworkOS 为通向通用协作代理智能提供了一条有意义的路径。

title: Metamorphic Testing for Evaluating Robustness of Sentiment Analysis Models
summary: Machine learning systems are challenging to test using traditional software testing methods because their behavior is learned from data rather than explicitly programmed. This challenge is particularly significant in natural language processing (NLP), where small input variations can lead to unexpected model behavior. Conventional evaluation metrics, such as accuracy and F1-score, often fail to capture such inconsistencies. Metamorphic testing addresses this limitation by evaluating expected relationships between original and transformed inputs. With the increasing prevalence of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) and language-based AI systems, the need for systematic robustness testing has become even more pronounced. Motivated by this growing need, this paper presents a lightweight, batch-based metamorphic testing approach for evaluating the robustness of such systems. In particular, we consider sentiment analysis as a representative NLP task and evaluate a pretrained classifier under four transformations: synonym replacement, typo injection, word-order variation, and negation. Using consistency score, flip accuracy, and confidence change, we identify strengths in handling semantic variations and vulnerabilities to textual noise and logical transformations. These findings highlight the value of metamorphic testing in identifying behavioral inconsistencies beyond conventional performance metrics and demonstrate its potential as a systematic framework for evaluating the robustness of language-based AI systems and guiding performance improvements before deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种轻量级、批量式的蜕变测试方法，用于评估生成式AI/语言模型系统（以情感分析为代表任务）的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 机器学习系统行为源于数据学习而非显式编程，传统软件测试难以适用；NLP中微小输入变化即可引发意外行为，而准确率、F1等常规指标无法捕捉此类不一致，随着GenAI普及，系统性鲁棒性测试需求日益迫切。
AI.method: 将蜕变测试引入NLP鲁棒性评估，以情感分析为代表性任务，对预训练分类器施加四种变换（同义词替换、拼写错误注入、语序变化、否定），并用一致性分数、翻转准确率和置信度变化三项指标加以度量。
AI.result: 实验识别出模型在语义变化方面的优势，同时暴露其对文本噪声和逻辑变换（如否定）的脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 蜕变测试能揭示常规性能指标之外的行为不一致，可作为评估语言类AI系统鲁棒性的系统性框架，并指导部署前的性能改进。

title: SurgStream: A Workflow-Anchored Proactive Streaming Framework and Benchmark for Real-Time Surgical Video Understanding
summary: Surgical video understanding is essential for intraoperative assistance such as workflow monitoring, instrument preparation and procedural documentation. Delivering such assistance in real time requires a model to jointly perceive the ongoing scene, remember past surgical events, and respond before clinically relevant moments pass. Existing approaches provide limited support for jointly retaining procedural evidence and deciding when to respond in streaming surgical video. In this work, we propose SurgStream, a workflow-anchored proactive streaming framework for real-time surgical video understanding. We first introduce Workflow-Anchored Memory (WAM) to record structured instrument-action-target observations and fold them into phase-level summaries, providing compact and queryable surgical memory. Deadline-aware Transition Learning (DTL) is then devised to supervise response states within clinical windows, enabling timely responses before procedural deadlines. We further introduce SurgStream-Bench, comprising 11.7K streaming interactions across various tasks covering real-time perception, backward memory queries, forward proactive QA, proactive alerts and caption memory. Experiments on SurgStream-Bench show gains over state-of-the-art methods, especially in memory and forward proactive QA. The source code will be available.

AI.tldr: 提出SurgStream，一个以工作流为锚点的主动式流式框架，实现实时手术视频理解：联合完成场景感知、手术事件记忆与及时响应。
AI.motivation: 手术视频理解对术中辅助很关键，但实时辅助要求模型同时感知当前场景、记住历史手术事件，并在临床相关时刻过去前及时响应；现有方法难以同时保留过程证据并决定何时响应。
AI.method: 1) Workflow-Anchored Memory（WAM）：记录结构化的器械-动作-目标观察，并折叠为阶段级摘要，形成紧凑可查询的手术记忆；2) Deadline-aware Transition Learning（DTL）：在临床时间窗内监督响应状态，使响应在流程截止前及时触发；3) 构建 SurgStream-Bench 基准。
AI.result: SurgStream-Bench 包含 11.7K 条流式交互，覆盖实时感知、回溯记忆查询、前向主动问答、主动告警与字幕记忆等任务；实验中优于现有最先进方法，尤其在记忆与前向主动问答上提升明显。
AI.conclusion: SurgStream 通过工作流锚定记忆与截止感知的转换学习，实现流式手术视频的实时感知、记忆与主动响应，并提供了配套基准；源码将公开。

title: Auto-Research Agent on MSA Organization to Improve Protein-Protein Complex Structure Prediction
summary: Protein-complex structure prediction with AlphaFold 3 depends on MSA content, depth, and cross-chain pairing. Current pipelines apply uniform recipes, typically maximizing depth and pairing by species, yet even whether cross-chain pairing helps AF3 remains contested. We show that the value of both depth and pairing is strongly target-dependent, so no single recipe is optimal across interfaces. We introduce an autonomous agent that treats a frozen AF3 as a black-box experimental instrument. For each target, the agent formulates biological hypotheses, analyzes and reorganizes the MSA, and iteratively refines sequence selection and pairing using predictor label-free signals alone. On 1{,}015 protein--protein interfaces from three benchmarks released after AF3's training cutoff, the agent improves overall interface DockQ over AF3's default pipeline and fixed MSA recipes on every benchmark, while using on average 60\% fewer MSA sequences than the default. Gains are largest for inter-species heteromers, where species-based pairing is unreliable: mean DockQ increases from 0.465 to 0.612 on FoldBench and from 0.482 to 0.562 on HD439. The improvements arise from both sequence construction and pairing policy, including deliberate non-pairing.These results recast MSA design as a target-specific problem and show that an autonomous agent can adapt it at test time through biological reasoning and self-directed, confidence-guided experimentation.

AI.tldr: 提出一个自主智能体，把冻结的AF3当作黑盒实验仪器，针对每个靶点自适应设计MSA（序列选择与跨链配对），在三个新基准共1015个蛋白-蛋白界面上平均用更少序列取得更高DockQ。
AI.motivation: AF3预测蛋白复合物结构依赖MSA的深度与跨链配对，但现有流程采用统一配方（最大化深度、按物种配对），且跨链配对是否有益本身仍有争议。作者主张深度与配对的价值强烈依赖具体靶点，不存在通用最优配方。
AI.method: 构建自主智能体，将冻结AF3作为黑盒预测器。对每个靶点：提出生物学假设→分析与重组MSA→仅利用无标签的预测置信度信号迭代优化序列选择与配对策略（包括有意不配对）。
AI.result: 在AF3训练截止后发布的三个基准、1015个蛋白-蛋白界面上，各基准的整体界面DockQ均优于AF3默认流程与固定MSA配方，且平均少用60%的MSA序列。种间异源多聚体上提升最大：FoldBench均值DockQ 0.465→0.612，HD439 0.482→0.562。
AI.conclusion: MSA设计应视为靶点特异问题；自主智能体可通过生物学推理与置信度引导的自主实验在测试时自适应调整，收益来自序列构建与配对策略两方面。

title: Synthetic Realities: Evaluating Human Ability to Distinguish AIGenerated Videos from Real Footage
summary: Recent advances in generative AI have enabled multiple pathways for high-fidelity video synthesis: text-to-video, image-to-video animation, and video outpainting. Empirical side-by-side evaluations of how untrained viewers perceive and distinguish these outputs from real footage remain scarce. In this study, we systematically compare human detection accuracy across these three AI generation techniques within three thematic contexts: historical footage, film and media content, and natural environments. We constructed a balanced stimulus set comprising equal amounts of real and AI-generated videos (18 each). The AI clips were evenly distributed across the three generation methods using Google's Veo 3, Lightricks LTX Video, and Wan VACE. All videos were produced and standardized within the ComfyUI framework to ensure consistent quality and duration. 87 participants judged every clip in a binary forced-choice task ("real" vs. "AI-generated"). Participants correctly identified videos 60% of the time on average. Image-to-video clips were recognized most accurately (79%), followed by real footage (64%), outpainting (49%), and text-to-video (43%). Accuracy also varied by theme: film and historical scenes yielded higher detection rates than environmental clips, which were frequently mistaken for AI. Logistic regression confirmed significant effects of both technique and theme as well as their interaction (p < 0.001), indicating that detection success depends jointly on how the content was generated and what it depicts. Findings reveal a consistent bias toward assuming synthetic origins and highlight that perceptual realism in AI video is shaped more by context than by model type, underscoring the importance of media-literacy approaches and context-aware evaluation tools for navigating increasingly synthetic visual media.

AI.tldr: 研究比较87名参与者对三类AI视频生成技术（文生视频、图生视频、视频外扩）在不同主题下的真假辨别能力，平均准确率60%，并发现检测难度取决于技术类型与内容主题的交互。
AI.motivation: 尽管文生视频、图生视频动画和视频外扩等生成技术快速发展，但缺乏普通观众（未经训练）如何感知并区分这些AI视频与真实素材的系统性并排评估，且以往研究少有同时考虑生成方法与内容主题的影响。
AI.method: 构建平衡刺激集（真实与AI视频各18段），AI片段均匀分布于三种生成方法（Google Veo 3、Lightricks LTX Video、Wan VACE），统一在ComfyUI中制作以标准化质量与时长；主题涵盖历史影像、影视媒体内容与自然环境。87名参与者对每个视频做"真实 vs. AI生成"的二选一强制判断，并用逻辑回归分析技术与主题及交互效应。
AI.result: 总体正确率60%；图生视频识别率最高（79%），其次为真实素材（64%）、外扩（49%）、文生视频（43%）。主题也有影响：影视与历史场景检测率高于环境视频（后者常被误判为AI）。逻辑回归显示技术与主题主效应及交互效应均显著（p < 0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 观众存在倾向于假设内容为合成来源的系统性偏差；AI视频的感知真实感更多由内容语境而非模型类型决定，提示需重视媒介素养教育与语境感知的评估工具，以应对日益合成的视觉媒体。

title: Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
summary: We introduce Axion 1.0, a fully open agent foundation model that combines strong and broad agentic capabilities with a remarkably simple training recipe. Axion 1.0 is trained in only three stages: two lightweight supervised fine-tuning stages followed by reinforcement learning, without dedicated mid-training, direct preference optimization (DPO), or on-policy distillation (OPD). The first SFT stage develops strong self-contained reasoning through model-aware data construction, where we synthesize challenging problems and adversarially strengthen them based on the base model's own successful solution strategies. The second stage extends these capabilities to tool-dependent reasoning through a scalable pipeline for constructing diverse and automatically verifiable tasks grounded in real-world data sources and deterministic computation. Finally, reinforcement learning further strengthens long-horizon reasoning and interaction with external tools and environments. Despite this compact training recipe, Axion 1.0 achieves strong performance across a broad suite of agentic benchmarks and is competitive with leading commercial models on several of them. Equally importantly, Axion 1.0 is open beyond model weights: we release the complete recipe, including data construction, generation, filtering, verification, prompts, and training code, enabling the entire development process to be reproduced and extended. Axion 1.0 demonstrates that strong agent foundation models can be both open and simple, offering a practical and reproducible path toward advancing open agentic intelligence.

AI.tldr: Axion 1.0 是一个完全开放、训练配方极简的 Agent 基座模型，仅通过两阶段 SFT + 强化学习即获得强而广的智能体能力，性能可媲美商业模型，并开源全部数据与训练流程。
AI.motivation: 现有 Agent 基座模型训练流程复杂（中训、DPO、在线蒸馏等），且多为闭源。作者希望证明强 Agent 基座模型既可开放也可简单，提供可复现的开放智能体发展路径。
AI.method: 三阶段训练：(1) 第一阶段 SFT 通过"模型感知数据构建"，基于基座模型自身成功解法合成高难题并做对抗性强化，培养自足推理能力；(2) 第二阶段 SFT 用可扩展流水线，基于真实数据源与确定性计算构建多样且自动可验证的工具依赖任务；(3) 强化学习强化长程推理及与外部工具/环境的交互。不含中训、DPO 或 OPD。
AI.result: 在广泛智能体基准套件上表现强劲，多个基准上与领先商业模型相当。
AI.conclusion: Axion 1.0 证明强 Agent 基座模型可以既开放又简单；除权重外还开源数据构建、生成、过滤、验证、提示与训练代码，实现全过程可复现与可扩展。

title: Overcoming Demand Censoring through Randomization for Risk-Sensitive Newsvendor Learning
comment: 30 pages of main text and 4 figures
summary: We study online newsvendor learning with bounded demand, censored observations, and convex nonlinear shortage costs. Because stockouts can conceal the shortage magnitudes needed by gradient-based algorithms, we use randomized ordering to construct unbiased subgradient estimates. We characterize admissible randomization distributions within this framework and develop an online inventory policy that combines the resulting subgradient estimates with gradient-based updates. Our regret analysis quantifies the cost of randomization via the estimation variance and an additional loss term. We characterize the randomization distributions that minimize this objective. For piecewise-linear shortage costs, the optimal distribution is computed through a linear-time recursion; for costs with bounded curvature density, it is characterized by a scalar ordinary differential equation. The policy achieves expected regret of $O(T^{2/3})$ against the best fixed order in hindsight over $T$ periods. Under independent demand and suitable curvature of expected losses, the bound improves to $O(\sqrt{T})$. Matching minimax lower bounds establish rate optimality over the corresponding classes with a fixed marginal-cost bound. Both rates extend to nonperishable inventory under uniformly positive conditional expected demand. Numerical experiments on synthetic and retail data show improvements over alternative policies using censored observations.

AI.tldr: 研究有界需求、删失观测和凸非线性缺货成本下的在线报童学习，用随机订货构造无偏次梯度估计，得到 O(T^{2/3}) 与 O(√T) 的后悔界并证明最优性。
AI.motivation: 缺货会隐藏梯度类算法所需的缺货幅度，导致观测删失、次梯度不可直接构造；同时现有研究多限于线性缺货成本，凸非线性缺货成本下的在线学习缺乏理论保证。
AI.method: 采用随机订货（randomized ordering）生成无偏次梯度估计；刻画可行的随机化分布并量化随机化代价（估计方差+额外损失项）；在此基础上结合梯度更新设计在线库存策略；对分段线性缺货成本用线性时间递推求最优分布，对有界曲率密度成本用标量 ODE 刻画。
AI.result: 策略对最优固定订货的期望后悔为 O(T^{2/3})；在需求独立且期望损失满足适当曲率时改进为 O(√T)；匹配的极小极大下界证明在固定边际成本界下速率最优；结论可推广至非易腐库存（条件期望需求一致为正）；合成与零售数据实验优于使用删失观测的替代策略。
AI.conclusion: 随机化是处理删失反馈与非线性缺货成本的有效手段，其代价可被显式优化并纳入后悔分析，所得速率最优且具实践价值。

title: NAS-PO: Native Attention-Strategy Policy Optimization for Vision-Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective post-training paradigm for vision-language models (VLMs). Standard RLVR, however, assigns identical outcome-derived credit to all generated tokens regardless of their perceptual relevance. Recent perception-aware methods estimate visual reliance through image perturbation or masking. These indirect proxies require perturbation branches, while corruption sensitivity does not necessarily identify the visual evidence used for reasoning. We instead shape model perception through native attention, an intrinsic model signal. Rather than treating attention as a post-hoc explanation, we formulate it as a reward-anchored, token-aligned routing signal that encourages attention patterns supporting visually grounded reasoning. To this end, we propose NAS-PO, a Native Attention-Strategy Policy Optimization framework. NAS-PO analyzes native attention with a visual mass policy that quantifies visual allocation and a conditional visual policy that captures spatial routing over visual tokens, making the optimization well-posed. Based on this, Native Attention-Strategy Advantage Shaping (NAS-AS) draws on the visual-mass policy to redistribute signed policy-gradient credit for visually engaged rollouts. The Adaptive Attention-Coupled (AAC) loss then aligns the visual-mass policy on all response tokens and the conditional visual policy on visually active ones, consolidating the visual-routing patterns that drive successful trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that NAS-PO substantially surpasses leading RL-tuned VLMs across 7 out-of-domain reasoning and perception benchmarks, with its effectiveness consistently validated across 8B and 32B. Visual-Routing Sensitivity (VRS) analysis further indicates that the optimized attention prioritizes visually load-bearing regions.

AI.tldr: 提出NAS-PO，将VLM的原生注意力作为可奖励的路由信号进行策略优化，替代图像扰动等间接代理，在7个域外基准上显著超越现有RL调优VLM（8B与32B均验证）。
AI.motivation: 标准RLVR对所有生成token赋予相同的结果信用，忽视感知相关性；现有感知感知方法依赖图像扰动或掩码估计视觉依赖，需额外扰动分支，且损坏敏感度不一定反映推理真正使用的视觉证据。
AI.method: 以原生注意力作为内在信号：用visual mass policy量化视觉分配、conditional visual policy刻画视觉token上的空间路由，使优化良定；NAS-AS依据视觉质量重新分配带符号的策略梯度信用；AAC损失在所有响应token上对齐视觉质量策略、在视觉活跃token上对齐条件视觉策略。
AI.result: 在7个域外推理与感知基准上大幅超越领先的RL调优VLM，8B和32B规模均一致有效；VRS分析显示优化后的注意力更关注视觉承载区域。
AI.conclusion: 原生注意力可作为奖励锚定、token对齐的路由信号有效塑造VLM感知，无需扰动分支即可提升视觉 grounding 的推理表现。

title: ScienceCUA: Resource-to-Skill Construction and Execution-Guided Skill Evolution for Scientific Computer Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents for scientific software require application-specific expertise. Much of this expertise is documented in human-authored software manuals and web pages. However, turning these resources into executable, reusable skills remains challenging due to mismatches between documented and deployed software versions and differences in scope between documentation coverage and task requirements. We introduce ScienceCUA, a two-stage framework combining resource-to-skill construction with execution-guided skill evolution. First, ScienceCUA identifies tasks supported by the software from its documentation, infers operational trajectories, and generalizes them into reusable Skills. Command catalogs, syntax constraints, and shortcuts are organized separately as References for on-demand lookup. Then, ScienceCUA uses execution feedback to drive skill self-evolution by contrasting successful and failed trajectories for the same task, identifying deficiencies, revising existing skills or adding new ones, and updating the skill library only after repeated validation in real environments. To enable reliable evaluation without benchmark noise or task leakage, we introduce two improved benchmarks. ScienceBoard-Verified provides an audited and corrected basis for measuring task performance, while ScienceBoard-VE separates skill evolution from final testing through disjoint evolution and test tasks and further supports native-agent evaluation. Experiments show that the initial Skills and References improve average task success rate by up to 7.23 percentage points over the base model, while skill self-evolution increases the total gain over the baseline to as much as 17.12 percentage points. ScienceCUA turns software documentation into an evolving set of executable skills and queryable references, offering a practical way for general-purpose agents to use scientific software reliably and at scale.

AI.tldr: ScienceCUA是一个两阶段框架，将科学软件文档转化为可复用技能并借助执行反馈实现技能自进化，在改进后的基准上显著提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 科学软件需要应用专门知识，这些知识多记录在人工编写的软件手册和网页中。但文档与实际部署版本存在不匹配，文档覆盖范围与任务需求也存差异，使这些资源难以转化为可执行、可复用的技能。
AI.method: 框架分两阶段：1）资源到技能构建——从文档中识别软件支持的任务，推断操作轨迹并泛化为可复用Skill，命令目录、语法约束和快捷方式单独组织为Reference供按需查询；2）执行引导的技能进化——对比同一任务的成功与失败轨迹，识别缺陷，修订或新增技能，经真实环境反复验证后更新技能库。同时提出两个改进基准：ScienceBoard-Verified（审计纠正以减少噪声）和ScienceBoard-VE（用不相交的进化任务与测试任务分离技能进化与最终评测，并支持原生智能体评估）。
AI.result: 初始Skill与Reference相比基础模型最高提升7.23个百分点平均任务成功率；技能自进化将相对基线的总增益提升至最高17.12个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ScienceCUA将软件文档转化为可进化的可执行技能与可查询参考，为通用智能体可靠、大规模地使用科学软件提供了实用途径。

title: Hinted Scaling Laws
summary: Scaling laws predict the outcome of large, expensive training runs by extrapolating trends from smaller, cheaper runs. On downstream accuracy evaluations, these predictions fail when the weaker models produced by the cheaper runs score near zero accuracy, because these scores give no trend to extrapolate to larger scales. We introduce hinted scaling laws, which use privileged information to turn a benchmark into a continuum of easier versions so that even the small models score above zero. We find that accuracy rises smoothly and predictably with the hint level, enabling new types of scaling laws that operate below the noise threshold. On the Delphi pretraining ladder, a hinted scaling law fit on models trained with at most $10^{20}$ FLOPs forecasts the GSM8K accuracy of a $10^{23}$ FLOP model (25.9%) to within 3 percentage points; a standard scaling law under-forecasts it by 13 percentage points when fit on the same models and by 12 even with models up to $10^{22}$ FLOPs in the fit. Across both this pretraining ladder and a collection of post-trained model families, hinted scaling laws reduce the median forecasting error on GSM8K, AIME and HLE from 21 percentage points to 4.3. Hinting also reduces the number of test examples needed to tell whether one model is better than another by widening the accuracy gaps between models while approximately preserving their order: a single hinted rollout per problem ranks nearly indistinguishable models as accurately as five unhinted rollouts. Our results suggest that hinting is a general primitive for improving the accuracy and cost of downstream scaling laws and other prediction tasks in model development.

AI.tldr: 提出"提示缩放律"(hinted scaling laws)：用特权信息把基准转化为一系列更简单的版本，使小模型也能得到非零分数，从而在下游准确率上实现可预测外推，显著降低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 缩放律通过小规模训练外推大规模结果，但在下游准确率评估中，小模型分数接近零（噪声阈值以下），没有可供外推的趋势，导致预测失效。
AI.method: 利用特权信息（提示）为基准构造连续难度的简化版本，使弱模型也能拿到高于零的分数；在提示层级上拟合准确率随难度平滑变化的规律，形成可在噪声阈值以下工作的新缩放律。
AI.result: 在Delphi预训练阶梯上，仅用≤1e20 FLOPs的模型拟合的提示缩放律，预测1e23 FLOPs模型的GSM8K准确率(25.9%)误差在3个百分点内；标准缩放律同样条件下低估13个百分点。跨预训练阶梯与后训练模型族，GSM8K/AIME/HLE中位预测误差从21个百分点降至4.3。提示还放大模型间准确率差距，单次提示 rollout 的模型区分力≈五次无提示 rollout。
AI.conclusion: 提示是提升下游缩放律准确性与降低评估成本的一种通用基本手段，也可用于模型开发中的其他预测任务。

title: Reconstruction as Spatial Evaluation: Diagnosing Cross-View Spatial Intelligence in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: The spatial intelligence of large vision-language models (LVLMs) requires the ability to combine local visual observations into a geometrically consistent representation of the physical world. Many static benchmarks assess isolated spatial judgments, such as relative direction or distance, while interactive embodied evaluations combine perception with exploration, planning, control, and simulator-specific execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce RECONSPATIAL, a benchmark centered on multi-view 3D scene reconstruction across indoor, tabletop, and outdoor environments. Given real multi-view images and target-object queries, LVLMs are required to jointly predict oriented 3D bounding boxes in a shared, camera-anchored metric coordinate frame. Reconstructions are evaluated along two complementary axes: Structure for relative layout and Metric for physical scale and camera-anchored placement. Nine atomic spatial QA tasks, grouped into Geometric Perception and Spatial Relations, probe spatial capabilities involved in joint reconstruction. Offline navigation extends evaluation to path planning. Evaluation of 18 frontier LVLMs reveals a consistent gap between relative scene structure and metric reconstruction; even GPT-6-Astra scores 81.4% on Structure but only 58.7% on Metric. Tracing this gap, diagnostic analyses link atomic spatial capabilities to reconstruction quality and show that relational consistency alone does not ensure metric accuracy. Experiments with 3D map injection further separate scene construction from path planning, revealing how these geometric errors limit navigation success. Finally, spatial fine-tuning yields broad transfer across both spatial and general vision-language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 RECONSPATIAL 基准，用多视角 3D 场景重建（预测相机锚定的有向 3D 包围盒）来评测 LVLM 的空间智能，发现模型相对结构强、度量精度弱。
AI.motivation: 现有静态基准只测孤立的空间判断（方向、距离），而交互式具身评测混杂了探索、规划、控制与仿真器执行等因素，缺少一个能纯粹衡量"把局部视觉观测整合为几何一致世界表征"能力的中间层评测。
AI.method: 构建 RECONSPATIAL：覆盖室内、桌面、室外场景，输入真实多视角图像与目标物体查询，要求 LVLM 在统一相机锚定的度量坐标系中联合预测有向 3D 包围盒。评测分 Structure（相对布局）与 Metric（物理尺度与相机锚定位置）两维度；含 9 个原子空间 QA 任务（几何感知、空间关系），并以离线导航延伸至路径规划。共评测 18 个前沿 LVLM，并进行诊断分析、3D 地图注入实验与空间微调实验。
AI.result: 18 个模型普遍存在"结构—度量"落差，GPT-6-Astra 在 Structure 上达 81.4%，Metric 仅 58.7%。诊断分析显示关系一致性并不保证度量准确；3D 地图注入实验将场景构建与路径规划解耦，表明几何误差会限制导航成功率；空间微调在空间与通用视觉语言基准上均有广泛迁移。
AI.conclusion: LVLM 的空间智能短板主要在度量重建而非相对布局，而该短板会实质影响下游导航；RECONSPATIAL 提供了可诊断、可迁移的评测框架，空间微调有望成为通用改进手段。

title: Top-$k$ Retrieval Leaves Memory Value Undetermined
summary: A memory-augmented agent must decide which memories to keep, merge and retrieve, and its only evidence of their value is its retrieval log: the memories it retrieved in each episode and whether it succeeded. Existing methods assign every memory a value from this log, even when the log cannot separate one memory's contribution from another's. We treat the log as an experiment that nobody designed and ask which memory values it determines. Two counts answer this before any outcome is observed: how often each memory was retrieved, and how often each pair was retrieved together. From these counts, we prove that top-$k$ retrieval leaves every memory value undetermined, however many episodes are logged, and that a question with its own memories, asked once, determines at most one of their values. On fourteen standard memory benchmarks, no memory value is determined in any of 55 configurations. Both causes are choices about retrieval. We introduce LEDGER, which estimates each determined Shapley value in closed form with a confidence interval and reports every other value as undetermined. It merges memories with identical histories without losing a determined value, and it retrieves so that the next log determines more. On pooled HotpotQA, LEDGER raises the fraction of memories determined from 0.001 to 0.797, at a cost of 2.6 accuracy points on HotpotQA and with a gain of 2.7 on LoCoMo.

AI.tldr: 记忆增强智能体无法可靠地从检索日志中推断记忆价值：现有方法在日志无法区分记忆贡献时仍强行赋值。作者将日志视为"未被设计的实验"，提出LEDGER，只估计可确定的Shapley值并明示其余为未确定。
AI.motivation: 现有方法从检索日志（每次检索了哪些记忆、是否成功）中为每个记忆赋予价值，但当日志无法将某记忆的贡献与他人区分时，这种赋值缺乏依据。作者希望回答：这样的日志究竟能确定哪些记忆价值，并据此改进检索设计。
AI.method: 仅凭两个无需观测结果的计数——每个记忆被检索的频次、每对记忆被共同检索的频次——进行可识别性分析并给出理论证明。基于此提出LEDGER：以闭式解估计每个可确定的Shapley值并附置信区间，其余报告为未确定；合并历史相同的记忆而不丢失可确定值；并主动调整检索策略，使下一次日志能确定更多记忆价值。
AI.result: 理论证明：top-k检索下每个记忆价值均不可确定（无论记录多少episode）；含专属记忆的问题只问一次时至多确定其中一个价值。实证：14个标准记忆基准的55种配置中，无一记忆价值被确定。引入LEDGER后，在合并的HotpotQA上记忆确定比例从0.001升至0.797，代价为HotpotQA准确率下降2.6分，而在LoCoMo上提升2.7分。
AI.conclusion: 检索日志的可识别性受检索策略选择限制，价值"不可确定"是常态而非例外。识别可确定值并设计能提高可识别性的检索，是比盲目赋值更严谨有效的方向；LEDGER在可识别性与任务性能间实现了可控权衡。

title: Invertible Graph Aggregation Can Increase ReLU Readout Width
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Code and reproducibility materials: https://github.com/usamihiroyasu/invertible-graph-readout-width
summary: An invertible graph aggregation preserves the complete feature table, but can increase the size of a classifier that reads one node at a time. For every even $N\ge4$, we construct a labeled tree with $2N$ vertices and maximum degree three. A shared one-hidden-layer rectified linear unit (ReLU) classifier needs one hidden unit on the raw scalar features and exactly $N$ units after one lazy neighborhood mean. All aggregate values are distinct, and the mixing matrix has condition number at most 8. We determine the complete error curve for heads with a free affine term. The width separation persists under scalar perturbations. Under a specified bounded uniform-noise model with one nuisance coordinate, every one-unit aggregate head has expected error at least $1/12$, while a fixed $N$-unit head has zero error. Controlled fits compare trained heads with these explicit feasible scores. On Roman-empire and Tolokers, aggregation improves fitted prediction, and retaining raw features helps at the largest tested parameter budget. Training-only diagnostics include conditional output-layer optimality bounds for eight fixed runs.

AI.tldr: 该论文构造了顶点数无界的标记树例子，证明可逆的邻域均值聚合会让逐节点ReLU分类器所需的隐藏单元数从1增加到N，并给出完整误差曲线与噪声下的分离界。
AI.motivation: 可逆图聚合（如惰性邻域均值）保留了完整特征表，理论上不损失信息，但作者关心它是否会增大了逐节点读取特征的分类器的规模，即聚合在"宽度"上的代价。
AI.method: 对每个偶数N≥4构造含2N个顶点、最大度为3的标记树；使用共享的单隐层ReLU分类器；比较原始标量特征与一次惰性邻域均值后的所需隐单元数；分析所有聚合值互异、混合矩阵条件数≤8的情形，给出带自由仿射项头部的完整误差曲线，并在有界均匀噪声（一个冗余坐标）模型下分析期望误差；同时在Roman-empire与Tolokers数据集上做受控拟合实验。
AI.result: 原始特征只需1个隐单元，而聚合后恰好需要N个单元，宽度分离在标量扰动下仍存在；噪声模型下每个单单元聚合头期望误差≥1/12，而固定的N单元头误差为0；真实数据集上聚合改善了拟合预测，在最大参数预算下保留原始特征有益；此外给出八次固定运行的仅训练诊断，包括输出层条件最优性界。
AI.conclusion: 信息保持不等于分类器规模保持：可逆聚合会造成可证明的宽度分离，且该分离具鲁棒性；理论上刻画了聚合头部的性能极限，并在实际图数据上得到一定印证。

title: Concise-9B: Removing the Slack from a Reasoning Model's Thinking
summary: Reasoning models answer better when they think longer, but a thinking trace keeps going well after its answer has formed. We measure this slack in Qwen3.5-9B and remove most of it with concise self-training: two rounds of on-policy rejection-sampling fine-tuning that keep the shortest correct samples, plus a small share of answer-synthesis targets, giving Concise-9B. On 8,983 held-out problems (competition and hard mathematics, SuperGPQA, a five-area confirmation set and MMLU-Pro), Concise-9B generates 0.66x the tokens of Qwen3.5-9B at a 32K thinking budget, with accuracy equivalent within +/-1 point (-0.20 [-0.77, +0.36] points). Forcing each trace on the hard and confirmation sets to answer every 2,048 thinking tokens, we find that 54-64% of Qwen3.5-9B's thinking tokens come after the point from which every forced answer equals the final one (41-48% for Concise-9B). Stopping there would keep every answer at 0.35-0.44x the base model's tokens, but finding that point takes hindsight: stopping when three consecutive forced answers agree costs the base model 2.4-9.2 points. Concise self-training removes slack without that cost: 86% [83, 90] of the thinking tokens it saves come after the answer has formed. It has a limit: with traces continued to 80K tokens, Concise-9B solves 25 fewer of 1,276 hard problems (-25 [-49, -1]), mostly in competition mathematics. The measurement also yields a cheap commit signal for adaptive sampling that matched two-sample escalation within +/-1 point at 0.67x its tokens in a pre-registered test. Results on Qwen3.5-4B, on which the recipe was developed, and a replication on Olmo-3-7B-Think suggest that the saving depends on how verbose the base model is.

AI.tldr: 推理模型在答案形成后仍会产生大量冗余思考token。作者提出简洁自训练(Concise-9B)，将token量降至0.66倍而精度基本不变，并量化了这类"松弛"占54-64%的思考token。
AI.motivation: 推理模型"想得越久答得越好"，但思考踪迹在答案已形成后仍持续很长，存在大量无效冗余（slack）。作者希望测量这种松弛的规模，并用低成本方法去除它而不牺牲准确率。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.5-9B上用"简洁自训练"：两轮on-policy拒绝采样微调，保留最短的正确样本，并混入少量答案合成目标；同时在困难/确认集上每2048个思考token强制作答，定位"强制答案已等于最终答案"的临界点来度量松弛。
AI.result: 在8,983道留出题上，Concise-9B为0.66倍token，精度差-0.20点（±1点内）。54-64%的思考token出现在答案形成之后（Concise-9B为41-48%）。后见之明式截断可达0.35-0.44倍token，但"三次连续一致"的实用停止策略使base损失2.4-9.2点；简洁自训练的节省中86%来自答案形成后。局限：续写至80K时Concise-9B在1,276难题上少解25题。测量还给出可用于自适应采样的廉价commit信号，0.67倍token达到两样本升级的精度。
AI.conclusion: 简洁自训练能在几乎不损精度下大幅去除答案后松弛，且无实用的停止规则带来的代价；但存在长思考预算下难题性能下降的局限，节省幅度取决于base模型冗余程度（Qwen3.5-4B、Olmo-3-7B-Think复现支持此点）。

title: 4D Triangle Splatting Reconstruction of Dynamic Endoscopic Scenes from Monocular Videos
summary: Robust 4D reconstruction of deformable endoscopic scenes from monocular videos remains challenging due to non-rigid tissue deformation, illumination changes, occlusions, and unknown camera trajectories. Reliable dynamic reconstruction of endoscopies could significantly enhance visualization, diagnostic accuracy and intraoperative guidance of minimally invasive procedures. We propose SurgicalTS, a self-supervised triangle-splatting framework for dynamic endoscopic scene reconstruction from static monocular cameras. The scene is represented by a canonical set of triangles jointly optimized with a deformation network. We introduce a quaternion-based deformation model, an improved color parametrization, spatio-temporal priors, and a redefined initialization strategy that improves completeness under occlusions. Extensive evaluation on challenging in-vivo endoscopy videos from diverse procedures shows that SurgicalTS successfully models soft-tissue deformations and tool-tissue interactions over time, while consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Our method also reduces training times while maintaining competitive geometric and photometric accuracy results, highlighting the effectiveness of quaternion-based deformation modelling with physical consistency for robust and efficient 4D reconstruction of endoscopic scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出SurgicalTS，一种自监督三角splatting框架，用于单目内窥镜视频的动态4D重建，借助四元数形变模型、改进颜色参数化、时空先验与初始化策略，在活体内窥镜视频上超越现有方法并缩短训练时间。
AI.motivation: 单目内窥镜场景的鲁棒4D重建面临非刚性组织形变、光照变化、遮挡和未知相机轨迹等挑战；可靠的动态重建可提升微创手术的可视化、诊断准确性与术中引导。
AI.method: 以规范三角面片集合与形变网络联合优化表示场景，自监督；引入基于四元数的形变模型、改进的颜色参数化、时空先验，以及新的初始化策略以提升遮挡下的完整性。
AI.result: 在多种手术的挑战性活体内窥镜视频上，SurgicalTS成功建模软组织形变与器械-组织交互，几何与光度精度具竞争力且持续优于SOTA，同时减少训练时间。
AI.conclusion: 结合物理一致性的四元数形变建模能实现鲁棒高效的内窥镜场景4D重建。

title: Atom-Wise Allocation of Message-Passing Scale for Molecular Property Prediction
summary: Molecular properties depend on chemical structure at different ranges, from local polar groups governing solvation to extended substructures shaping bioactivity, yet graph neural networks usually fix one propagation scale for every atom. We present PRISM (Per-atom Routing over Intermediate States of Message Passing), in which each atom's encoded features produce a bounded scalar that positions a unimodal distribution over retained message-passing states and matching circular-fingerprint radii. Because one coordinate translates the whole profile, allocated depth responds to the routing scalar in closed form: at fixed temperature it is nondecreasing, its sensitivity scales with the profile variance, and it saturates in the clipped regions. Beyond providing closed-form analyzability, this constrained one-parameter profile matches or significantly outperforms parameter-matched, unconstrained node-wise gates and Jumping Knowledge attention. Under scaffold partitions with equal tuning budgets against eight graph, fingerprint, and geometric baselines, PRISM trained from scratch without three-dimensional coordinates achieves the lowest mean error on aqueous solubility and hydration free energy and strong accuracy on BACE and BBBP. As a general layer-combination rule, PRISM transfers directly to GCN, GIN, and GAT backbones, reducing hydration free energy error by up to 29% relative to last-layer readout. Applied to a pre-trained GIN, it improves on last-layer readout on four of six endpoints and gives the lowest lipophilicity error overall. In trained models, allocated depth differs systematically between atom types in a task-dependent way, and permuting profiles among a molecule's atoms raises prediction error on several endpoints, so the rule acts as a learned counterpart of atom typing.

AI.tldr: PRISM 让每个原子通过一个标量路由其消息传递深度，用单峰分布实现闭式可分析的逐原子感受野分配，在多个分子性质预测任务上优于固定感受野与参数匹配的逐节点门控。
AI.motivation: 分子性质依赖不同尺度的化学结构（局部极性基团到延伸子结构），但现有图神经网络对所有原子固定同一传播尺度，无法按原子自适应调整感受野。
AI.method: 每个原子编码特征产生一个有界标量，该标量定位一个关于保留消息传递状态与环形指纹半径的单峰分布；由于单参数平移整个分布，分配深度以闭式形式随路由标量变化（固定温度下非递减、敏感度随分布方差缩放、在截断区饱和）。该规则作为通用层组合方式，可直接接入 GCN/GIN/GAT。
AI.result: 在 scaffold 划分、等调参预算下对比八个图/指纹/几何基线，PRISM 不使用三维坐标、从头训练，在水溶性（ESOL）与水合自由能上取得最低平均误差，BACE 与 BBBP 上精度较高。迁移到 GCN/GIN/GAT 时，相比末层读出将水合自由能误差最多降低 29%；用于预训练 GIN 时在六个端点中四个优于末层读出，并取得整体最低脂溶性误差。还发现分配深度在原子类型间存在系统性差异，且打乱原子间分布会提高多个端点的预测误差。
AI.conclusion: PRISM 以受约束的单参数分布实现可解释、可迁移的逐原子深度自适应，效果等效于一种学习到的原子类型（atom typing）对应物。

title: Unified Loss-Aware Density Control for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: The efficiency and fidelity of 3D Gaussian Splatting critically depend on adaptive density control, which grows and suppresses Gaussian primitives throughout optimization. However, the standard pipeline still relies on heuristic view-space gradients, scale thresholds, and global opacity resets, rather than explicitly assessing the loss-reducing effect of each split, clone, or opacity update. This mismatch can allocate primitives to already-sufficient regions, miss under-reconstructed structures, and destabilize training through blanket opacity changes. In this work, we recast adaptive density control as a collection of local loss-reduction decisions. We derive efficient Taylor-based per-Gaussian surrogates that predict the objective change caused by three primitive-level operations: splitting, cloning, and opacity decay. This yields a unified loss-aware framework with three components. First, we extend second-order splitting to a normalized joint position-scale space, enabling children to adapt not only their locations but also their anisotropic extents. Second, we formulate duplicate cloning as a surrogate minimization problem, selecting only Gaussians whose duplicated contribution is predicted to improve reconstruction and assigning each child a principled opacity. Third, we replace global opacity reset with selective soft opacity decay that weakens harmful primitives while preserving useful ones. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, our method produces more targeted primitive allocation and achieves improved rendering quality with comparable or smaller Gaussian budgets compared to baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文将3DGS的自适应密度控制重构为基于泰勒近似的局部损失下降决策，统一处理分裂、克隆与不透明度衰减，在标准基准上以更少或相当的高斯数量获得更好渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS的密度控制依赖启发式视图空间梯度、尺度阈值与全局不透明度重置，未显式评估每次分裂、克隆或不透明度更新的降损失效果，导致原语分配到已充分重建区域、遗漏欠重建结构，且全局重置会破坏训练稳定性。
AI.method: 推导每个高斯的三类操作（分裂、克隆、不透明度衰减）对应的泰勒近似损失代理；(1)将二阶分裂扩展到归一化联合位置-尺度空间，使子节点同时自适应位置与各向异性尺度；(2)把重复克隆形式化为代理最小化问题，只选择复制后能预测改善重建的高斯，并为子节点分配有原则的不透明度；(3)以选择性软不透明度衰减替代全局重置。
AI.result: 在标准3DGS基准上实现更有针对性的原语分配，相比基线在相当或更小的高斯预算下取得更优渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 显式的损失感知代理可作为启发式密度控制的有效替代，实现统一、可解释且高效的原语增长与抑制框架。

title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
comment: Submitted to Future Generation Computer Systems
summary: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive. Each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so energy grows non-linearly along a sequence whose tokens look identical. No analytical model states what a token costs, and the most accurate SOTA model is a fit, not a law: it absorbs architecture into fitted coefficients, requiring per-LLM fitting. We derive closed-form expressions of the computational and memory-access complexity of LLM inference in terms of architectural hyperparameters, covering MHA and GQA, and compare a family of analytical models of increasing granularity. From these, we obtain the SIMPLE Inference Model to Predict LLMs Energy (SIMPLE), a four-parameter law that separates prefill from decode, and decode into KV-cache cost and next-token computation. Over traces of 13 dense LLMs from six families on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it attains R2 = 0.969 and 11.97% MAPE, 3.1-3.5x below the SOTA, without per-LLM calibration. The SIMPLE law explains as well as predicts: prefill energy grows quadratically with the hidden dimension, so larger LLMs suffer most from long inputs; and more aggressive GQA KV grouping reduces the per-token energy by up to 3x relative to standard MHA. Increasing the reasoning token budget pushes output length beyond the analytically derived energy minimum, driving super-linear energy growth; although accuracy grows with the budget, energy grows faster, so Intelligence per Joule peaks at an intermediate budget and falls by up to 3.14x across a 4.0x reasoning-budget range. Agentic serving raises energy per request by 13.0x relative to non-agentic ones, driven by the growth of both the prefill and the KV-cache terms with input length; while prefix caching removes most of the prefill cost (-93%), the KV-cache term is unaffected, so even a cached agentic request costs 4.8x more.

AI.tldr: 提出SIMPLE四参数解析律，从架构超参数推导LLM推理的计算与访存复杂度（覆盖MHA与GQA），将预填充与解码能耗分离建模，在13个稠密LLM上无需逐模型校准即达R²=0.969、MAPE=11.97%，较SOTA误差低3.1–3.5倍。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI按token计费，但token的真实能耗并不相同：每个token进入KV-cache后会抬高后续token的成本，能量沿序列非线性增长。现有最准确的SOTA能耗模型只是拟合而非定律，把架构信息吸收进拟合系数，必须对每个LLM单独校准，缺乏可解释的解析表达。
AI.method: 以架构超参数为自变量，推导LLM推理计算量与访存量的闭式复杂度表达式，覆盖MHA与GQA，并比较由粗到细的一系列解析模型；据此得到SIMPLE——一个四参数定律，将能耗拆为预填充、解码中的KV-cache开销与下一token计算三部分。在NVIDIA H100上对六个家族、13个稠密LLM的trace上进行验证。
AI.result: 无需逐LLM校准即达到R²=0.969、MAPE=11.97%，比SOTA低3.1–3.5倍。规律揭示：预填充能耗随隐藏维二次增长，大模型受长输入影响最大；更激进的GQA分组相对MHA可将单token能耗降低至多3倍；推理预算超出解析导出的能耗最优点后能耗超线性增长，"每焦耳智能"在中等预算处达到峰值，4倍预算区间内下降至多3.14倍；智能体服务使单请求能耗增至13.0倍，前缀缓存可削减93%预填充成本但KV-cache项不受影响，缓存后仍高4.8倍。
AI.conclusion: token成本可由架构超参数决定的解析定律刻画，兼具预测与解释能力，可用于指导模型设计（GQA分组、隐藏维）、推理预算选择、智能体服务与缓存策略的能效优化。

title: UniGS-SLAM: Monocular Gaussian SLAM with Enhanced Geometry and Open-Vocabulary Semantics
summary: Monocular semantic SLAM aims to reconstruct scene geometry and build semantic maps from RGB observations. Existing Gaussian-based methods often attach semantic labels or features to evolving Gaussian primitives, making semantic fusion difficult to maintain and increasing reconstruction overhead. Hybrid Gaussian--voxel representations provide more stable semantic support, but often rely on RGB-D input or known poses and do not revise historical semantic evidence after geometry updates. We present UniGS-SLAM, an RGB-only framework that decouples open-vocabulary semantics from Gaussian reconstruction while preserving bidirectional interaction. Foundation priors enhance monocular depth and pose estimation, while semantic observations are fused into an independent sparse voxel map with observation provenance, enabling historical contributions to be revised as reconstruction evolves. The fused semantics further guide Gaussian filtering and local surface refinement. Experiments on Replica, ScanNet, and KITTI-360 show leading tracking, rendering, and geometric reconstruction performance among representative RGB-only methods, together with strong open-set semantic mapping on Replica and ScanNet. We also achieve a 2.37-fold reconstruction speedup over the fastest compared semantic SLAM baseline. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/UniGS-SLAM/.

AI.tldr: UniGS-SLAM 是一个仅用 RGB 输入的框架，把开放词汇语义与高斯重建解耦，并通过带观测溯源的稀疏体素图融合语义，实现历史语义证据的可修订与双向交互。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯的方法把语义标签/特征附着在不断演化的高斯基元上，语义融合难以维护且重建开销大；高斯-体素混合表示虽语义支持更稳定，但往往依赖 RGB-D 输入或已知位姿，且几何更新后不修正历史语义证据。
AI.method: 用基础模型先验增强单目深度与位姿估计；将语义观测融合进独立的稀疏体素图并保留观测溯源，使重建演化时可修正历史贡献；再将融合语义用于引导高斯滤波与局部表面细化，从而解耦语义与高斯重建但保持双向交互。
AI.result: 在 Replica、ScanNet、KITTI-360 上，跟踪、渲染与几何重建在代表性 RGB-only 方法中领先，Replica 与 ScanNet 上开放集语义建图表现强；相比最快的语义 SLAM 基线实现 2.37 倍重建加速。
AI.conclusion: 解耦式语义表示加可溯源的体素语义融合，是提升单目语义 SLAM 稳定性与效率的有效途径，兼顾几何精度、语义质量与重建速度。

title: Mixed-Methods Exploration of Sociotechnical Factors to Improve Adoption of Crime-Reporting Apps in Urban Communities
summary: Crime-reporting mobile applications can enhance community safety and engagement in urban areas, yet their adoption remains low, partly because developers prioritize technological features over residents' social realities. This study used an exploratory sequential mixed-methods design to identify and validate the sociotechnical factors that drive adoption. Two focus groups and an analysis of 660 app reviews revealed that users' initial sense of usefulness fades, whereas sustained engagement depends on perceived value (PV), comprising six dimensions: safety, anonymity, recency, autonomy, camaraderie, and accessibility. A survey of 505 urban residents, analyzed with PLS-SEM, validated PV as a formative higher-order construct formed by four of these dimensions (safety, anonymity, autonomy, and camaraderie). PV was the strongest predictor of behavioral intention, ahead of effort expectancy, facilitating conditions, and performance expectancy, and behavioral intention strongly predicted actual use. The model explained 75% of the variance in behavioral intention and 51% in actual use. The findings offer design principles for community-centered crime-reporting technologies.

AI.tldr: 该研究采用探索性序贯混合方法，识别并验证驱动犯罪举报移动应用采纳的社会技术因素，提出"感知价值(PV)"构念（含安全、匿名、时效、自主、社群、可及六维度），并证明其是行为意向的最强预测因子。
AI.motivation: 犯罪举报应用可提升社区安全与参与度，但采纳率低；原因在于开发者重技术功能而忽视居民的社会现实。研究旨在找出并验证真正驱动采纳的社会技术因素。
AI.method: 探索性序贯混合方法：两个焦点小组+660条应用评论分析提出PV六维度；对505名城市居民问卷调查，用PLS-SEM验证PV为形成性高阶构念（由安全、匿名、自主、社群四维构成），并与其他因素比较预测力。
AI.result: PV被验证为形成性高阶构念；PV是行为意向的最强预测因子，强于努力期望、便利条件和绩效期望；行为意向强预测实际使用。模型解释行为意向75%、实际使用51%的方差。
AI.conclusion: 持续参与取决于感知价值而非初始有用性感知；研究为以社区为中心的犯罪举报技术提供设计原则，强调社会性因素与技术功能并重。

title: FactorSpec: Serving Exact Relational Constraints as Speculative Drafts
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up LLM serving by drafting tokens that the target model verifies in one pass, and its gain grows with the drafts the target accepts. Structured outputs should be an ideal case, because much of a record follows from relations among its fields: an itinerary's days follow from its cities' stays and flights. Serving engines, however, draft such text by proposing it from the prompt or a learned head, and their grammar masks enforce only syntax, so the model must satisfy the relations, which it violates: on NATURAL PLAN's trip problems, Qwen3-8B writes a valid itinerary for 10%, and retries that name the violated relation raise this to 14%. We present FactorSpec, which serves exact relational constraints as speculative drafts. FactorSpec compiles a JSON Schema and its relations into a factor graph with an exact feasibility check, drafts every token the constraint determines as certain, verifies each request at a width chosen for it, and computes the masks in worker processes outside the scheduler while the GPU runs. In SGLang, its drafts yield up to 10.5 tokens per verify step, up to 1.9x those of the fastest n-gram drafter, and it decodes up to 1.43x faster than speculators tuned per load, at a grammar mask's cost; it also leads in vLLM. Because every record is also valid, it serves up to 13.9x the valid records per GPU-second of syntax-only baselines.

AI.tldr: FactorSpec 将 JSON Schema 及其关系约束编译为因子图并做精确可行性检查，把约束确定的 token 作为"确定性草稿"进行投机解码，在 SGLang/vLLM 中显著提升结构化输出的解码吞吐与有效记录产出。
AI.motivation: 结构化输出中大量 token 由字段间关系（如行程的天数由城市停留与航班决定）决定，本应是投机解码的理想场景；但现有服务引擎仅从 prompt 或学习头生成草稿，语法掩码只保证语法合法性，关系约束仍由模型自行满足，导致违反率高（Qwen3-8B 在 NATURAL PLAN 行程任务上仅 10% 合法，重试后 14%）。
AI.method: 1) 将 JSON Schema 及其关系编译为因子图，并配备精确可行性检查；2) 对约束确定可推的 token 直接作为"确定"草稿；3) 按每个请求自适应选择验证宽度；4) 在 worker 进程中、调度器之外计算掩码，与 GPU 执行重叠。
AI.result: SGLang 中每次验证最多产出 10.5 个 token，为最快 n-gram drafter 的 1.9 倍，解码最快比按负载调优的投机器快 1.43 倍，代价与语法掩码相当；在 vLLM 中同样领先；因输出全部合法，每 GPU-秒有效记录数是纯语法基线的最高 13.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将关系约束作为精确可计算的投机草稿来源，可同时获得高效解码与高合法率，且开销接近语法掩码，具备跨引擎的可移植性。

title: When Does Adaptive Halting Win? Selection Rules Matter in Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models can stop iterating early, and recent work shows that post-hoc readouts of the loop trajectory often rival the learned exit gate of the looped model Ouro. Such comparisons reduce each method to one operating point chosen by a selection rule. We ask whether that rule decides the outcome. On a frozen Ouro-1.4B with four loops, we compared a trained stability probe ($π_1$-x) with Ouro's native gate, adapted to a per-question stopping decision, in pre-registered studies; the confirmatory study was designed after an exploratory finding on development data and evaluated once on a sealed test set of 8,517 questions. In the pre-registered confirmatory comparison, which selected operating points with a bootstrap-screened 1 pp accuracy-loss rule, the probe saved more of the four-loop budget than the native gate (+0.053 gross macro saving over three benchmarks, 95% CI [+0.049, +0.057]), mostly from CommonsenseQA, where the probe's test upper bound on accuracy loss exceeded 1 pp. Under a point-only rule, a pre-specified secondary analysis on the same test set reversed the preference (-0.022 [-0.026, -0.018]), with operating points that exceeded the budget. In pre-specified secondary comparisons, the probe showed no demonstrated advantage over an untrained KL divergence between successive loops (+0.00125 [-0.0041, +0.0065]); we emphasise this result post hoc and claim no equivalence. The probe also broke its budget on one of two out-of-distribution benchmarks (3.26 pp loss on Social IQa). Savings are estimated from stored full-depth traces, not measured inference time, and our screen carries no formal risk-control guarantee. We conclude that halting methods should be compared as signals together with selection procedures, with strong untrained baselines and out-of-distribution checks.

AI.tldr: 在冻结的 Ouro-1.4B 上比较训练稳定性探针与原生门控的逐题停止决策：在 bootstrap 筛选的 1pp 精度损失规则下探针更省预算，但换用仅点估计规则结论反转，且优势相对无训练 KL 基线不成立，结论强依赖选择规则。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型可提前停止迭代，已有工作显示事后读取循环轨迹常可媲美 Ouro 学习到的退出门控。但这类比较把方法压缩为"由选择规则选定的单一工作点"，本文追问：是规则本身决定了结论吗？
AI.method: 在冻结的 Ouro-1.4B（4 次循环）上，将训练好的稳定性探针（π₁-x）与原生门控都适配为逐题停止决策；采用预注册研究设计，其中确证性研究基于开发集探索性发现设计，并在 8,517 题密封测试集上一次性评估。主比较用 bootstrap 筛选的 1pp 精度损失规则选工作点，次要分析用仅点估计规则，并与无训练基线（相邻循环 KL 散度）及两个 OOD 基准对比。
AI.result: 确证性比较中探针更省四循环预算（+0.053 宏平均节省，95% CI [+0.049, +0.057]），但主要来自 CommonsenseQA，其测试精度损失上界超 1pp；仅点估计规则下次要分析反转偏好（-0.022 [-0.026, -0.018]）且工作点超预算。对无训练 KL 基线无显著优势（+0.00125 [-0.0041, +0.0065]），并在一项 OOD 基准 Social IQa 上超预算 3.26pp。
AI.conclusion: 停止/早退方法应以"信号+选择过程"整体比较，需包含强无训练基线与 OOD 检验；节省量来自存储的完整深度轨迹而非实测推理时间，且筛选程序无形式化风险控制保证。

title: Learning to Look: A Foundation for Visual Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) suffer from visual hallucination, such as saying an object that is not present in an image. We ask a more fundamental question: whether a VLM is even aware of where it is looking before understanding the semantic meaning in the image. We formulate this question as a LOOK task: identifying which parts of its visual input were available to the model. We construct the task in a self-supervised way without manually labeling the available region to the model. Our experiments show that existing VLMs fail to localize the visible region. We further show that fine-tuning VLMs on the proposed LOOK task improves a model's awareness of visual input.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"LOOK"任务：让VLM识别其视觉输入中哪些区域实际可见，以探究模型是否具备对视觉输入的感知意识。实验发现现有VLM无法定位可见区域，而通过自监督方式在该任务上微调可提升模型的视觉感知意识。
AI.motivation: VLM存在视觉幻觉（如描述不存在的物体），论文追问更根本的问题：模型在理解图像语义之前，是否知道自己在"看"哪里。即在语义理解之前，模型是否对可用视觉输入有感知意识。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为LOOK任务：识别视觉输入中哪些部分对模型可用。采用自监督方式构建任务，无需人工标注可见区域。
AI.result: 实验表明现有VLM无法定位可见区域；在LOOK任务上微调可提升模型对视觉输入的感知意识。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM缺乏对可用视觉输入的感知意识，是视觉幻觉的可能根源之一；自监督LOOK任务可作为提升模型视觉感知能力的有效手段。

title: Same Outputs, Different Scores: Auditing the Unchecked Graders of Multimodal LLM Benchmarks
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). Code and data: https://github.com/ahmadhasan2k8/grader-audit
summary: Every multimodal-LLM multiple-choice benchmark ends with a scoring rule that converts a model's response, often free-form text rather than a clean option letter, into a right/wrong verdict, buried in its code. Unlike the dataset, this rule is chosen without justification and left unexamined, yet it sets the published number. We reproduce the official scorers of eight peer-reviewed benchmarks on five open vision-language models (VLMs) that fit a single 16 GB GPU, and introduce a blinded human-plus-LLM-judge adjudication (Cohen's kappa=0.956) that recovers what the model actually answered. The scoring rule alone moves accuracy by up to 22 points on identical outputs, yet exactly 0 wherever a model emits clean option letters, so it hides on strong-model leaderboards. It is the fallback and not the rambling that does the damage: the benchmark with the highest non-compliance we measure has an artifact of exactly zero, because its scorer abstains instead of guessing; a reasoning model with non-compliance 0.000 still swings 9.5 points with which regex match of its trace the parser keeps. No standard rule is reliable: snapping a non-answer to its closest option credits answers never given yet buries correct ones, abstention discards answers stated in words, and likelihood scoring follows answer-token priors, so a single grade conflates capability with luck rather than measuring either. We release all code, labels, and the protocol, and argue benchmarks should report a non-compliance rate and at least two rules, not one unexamined grade.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示多模态LLM选择题基准中被忽视的"评分规则"本身会显著影响准确率，呼吁基准报告不合规率并采用至少两种评分规则。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM选择题基准的评分规则内嵌于代码、缺乏论证，却决定了最终发布的分数指标，这一问题从未被审视。
AI.method: 复现八个同行评审基准的官方评分器，在五款可单卡16GB运行的开源VLM上测试；引入盲化的人+LLM裁判判定协议（Cohen's kappa=0.956），还原模型真实作答以便对照评分规则影响。
AI.result: 仅评分规则本身就能使相同输出上的准确率变动高达22分；当模型输出干净选项字母时差异为零，因此该问题被强模型排行榜掩盖。问题主要来自兜底逻辑而非模型啰嗦：非合规率最高的基准偏差恰为零（因其弃答不猜测），而某推理模型非合规率为0.000却因正则匹配哪段trace而摆动9.5分。最近选项吸附、弃答、似然打分均不可靠，会把能力与运气混淆。
AI.conclusion: 基准应报告非合规率并至少采用两种评分规则，而非单一未审视的分数；论文开源代码、标注与协议。

title: CytoWave: Perturbation-Centric Pretraining for Single-Cell Response Prediction
summary: Predicting gene expression under perturbations from single-cell data is a fundamental task for modeling cellular responses, with applications in discovering gene function and designing therapeutics. However, existing methods often struggle to generalize across datasets due to differences in experimental protocols, biological contexts, and species. We present \textbf{CytoWave}, a perturbation-centric pretraining framework for single-cell genetic perturbation response prediction. We leverage large-scale cross-species perturbation datasets unified via orthology and train CytoWave in a two-stage manner. In the first stage, we learn reference control cell states via masked gene expression recovery on unperturbed cells. In the second stage, we pretrain the model to predict perturbed gene expression given control states and perturbation signals, together with a contrastive objective that aligns latent representations of perturbation responses with perturbation signals. We perform strict dataset-held-out evaluation across multiple condition combinations and case studies of pathway activity changes, demonstrating consistent and effective performance of CytoWave in predicting single-cell genetic perturbation responses.

AI.tldr: CytoWave 是一个以扰动为中心的预训练框架，通过同源基因统一跨物种大规模扰动数据，并采用两阶段预训练（掩码基因表达恢复 + 扰动响应预测与对比对齐），在严格留出数据集评估中稳定提升单细胞遗传扰动响应预测性能。
AI.motivation: 预测扰动下的基因表达是建模细胞响应、发现基因功能与设计疗法的关键任务，但现有方法受实验流程、生物学背景和物种差异影响，难以跨数据集泛化。
AI.method: 利用同源映射统一大规模跨物种扰动数据集；两阶段预训练：第一阶段在未扰动细胞上以掩码基因表达恢复学习参照对照细胞状态，第二阶段在给定对照状态与扰动信号时预测扰动后表达，并加入对比目标使扰动响应的隐表示与扰动信号对齐。
AI.result: 在多种条件组合下进行严格的留出数据集评估，并通过通路活性变化的案例研究，展示出一致且有效的单细胞遗传扰动响应预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 以扰动为中心的跨物种预训练有助于克服数据异质性、提升扰动的基因表达响应预测的泛化能力。

title: When Rewards Depend on the Group, GRPO Plays a Tournament
summary: Rewards for diversity, coverage and distribution matching make the reward of each sampled response depend on the rest of its group, and they are now routinely optimized with GRPO and RLOO. We prove that in this setting the group-relative baseline changes the objective. The expected update equals each response's own reward gradient plus $α$ times its effect on its groupmates' rewards, with $α=-1/(K-1)$ for groups of size $K$, so GRPO trains every response to beat its groupmates in a zero-sum tournament. It cannot see a pairwise diversity bonus when K=2, sees less than half of it at any K, and often does worse than using no baseline at all. Setting $α=+1$ gives Team-GRPO, an unbiased estimator for any group-dependent reward that works with two samples per prompt and requires no extra model calls for pairwise rewards. The theory predicts training quantitatively. It locates the fixed points of a 9B policy to within 0.02 in $\ell_1$ and predicts how concentrated trained policies become with Pearson r=0.995. On GlobalOpinionQA, GRPO collapses onto the majority answer and ends further from human opinion than the untrained model, while Team-GRPO cuts the error from $0.20$ to $0.08$. On NoveltyBench, Team-GRPO avoids the diversity collapse of GRPO and significantly improves set utility.

AI.tldr: 论文理论证明GRPO/RLOO的组内相对基线会改变多样性/覆盖/分布匹配类奖励的目标，使其退化为零和博弈，并提出α=+1的Team-GRPO无偏估计器，实验上修复GRPO的多样性坍塌问题。
AI.motivation: 多样性、覆盖度、分布匹配类奖励依赖同组其他回答，而GRPO/RLOO的group-relative baseline在这种组耦合奖励下不再是公平的基线，导致优化目标被扭曲，论文要揭示并修正这一问题。
AI.method: 理论推导：期望更新=每条回答自身奖励梯度 + α×(其对组内同伴奖励的影响)，GRPO为α=-1/(K-1)。据此提出Team-GRPO，设α=+1，得到对任意组依赖奖励的无偏估计，K=2即可用且成对奖励不需额外模型调用。
AI.result: 理论能定量预测训练：9B策略不动点ℓ1误差<0.02，集中度预测Pearson r=0.995。GlobalOpinionQA上GRPO坍缩到多数答案、比未训练模型更偏离人类意见，Team-GRPO把误差从0.20降到0.08；NoveltyBench上Team-GRPO避免多样性坍塌并显著提升集合效用。
AI.conclusion: 组相对基线对组依赖奖励是有偏的，会让GRPO训练成“打败同伴”的零和竞赛；改为α=+1的Team-GRPO可无偏优化并实际改善多样性相关指标。

title: Scene-Adaptive Readout and Decoding in Diffusion Driving VLAs
summary: Diffusion driving vision-language-action models repeatedly execute the backbone at every denoising stage, incurring substantial inference cost, while it remains unclear whether all scenes require the same decoding computation. To distinguish when a trajectory becomes readable from how much further refinement it requires, we analyze trajectory readout across network depth and decoding progress. We identify a depth-decoding dissociation in which late-layer representations already support useful trajectory readout after the first forward sweep, whereas early-layer representations benefit more from continued decoding. We further find that both the preferred readout layer and decoding depth vary across scenes. Based on these observations, we propose a scene-adaptive readout and decoding framework. A scene-conditioned readout MoE adaptively weights and combines trajectory predictions from layer-specific late-layer representations after a single backbone sweep, while an adaptive decoding policy applies additional native refinement only when required by the scene. We evaluate our framework on two diffusion driving VLAs across the Waymo E2E and nuScenes benchmarks. Our method improves validation RFS by up to 0.56 while also improving test performance, and achieves an end-to-end speedup of up to $6.0\times$ on Waymo E2E, while consistently reducing trajectory error on nuScenes. These results demonstrate that scene-level readout and decoding allocation improves planning quality while avoiding unnecessary decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/sjyu001/SARD

AI.tldr: 提出场景自适应的读出与解码框架（SARD），通过场景条件读出MoE在单次骨干前向中融合多层表示预测轨迹，并按需触发额外去噪，从而在自动驾驶VLA中提升质量并加速最高6.0倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散式视觉-语言-动作模型在每个去噪阶段都重复执行骨干网络，推理代价高昂；但不同场景是否都需要相同的解码计算尚不清楚，存在大量可省去的冗余计算。
AI.method: 分析轨迹读出在网络深度与解码进度上的表现，发现"深度-解码解耦"现象：首轮前向后深层表示已可支持有效轨迹读出，而浅层表示更依赖继续解码；且最优读出层与解码深度因场景而异。据此设计场景条件读出MoE，对单次骨干前向后的多个层特异深层表示预测做自适应加权融合；并设计自适应解码策略，仅在场景需要时执行额外的原生精化。
AI.result: 在两个扩散驾驶VLA、Waymo E2E与nuScenes基准上评测：验证集RFS最高提升0.56，测试性能同时提升；Waymo E2E端到端加速最高6.0倍；nuScenes上轨迹误差持续降低。
AI.conclusion: 场景级的读出与解码计算分配可在避免不必要去噪的同时提升规划质量，说明统一的固定解码预算并非最优。

title: Can We Stop the Backtest Yet? Anytime-Valid Promotion Tests for Adaptive Financial Research Agents
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at ICAIF 2026, Milan, Italy
summary: Financial research agents can generate and monitor trading rules faster than a human can document the resulting selection process. Candidates appear at data-dependent times, weak rules are abandoned, and promising ones are watched until they cross a reporting threshold.
