This result provides novel insights into effective dimension and intrinsic complexity of overparameterized models.

AI.tldr: 该文厘清局部实对数规范阈值(RLCT)与两个泛化相关指标（泛化误差Hessian的秩、损失函数族的覆盖数）之间的理论关系，为奇异模型的隐式维度提供新洞见。
AI.motivation: 过参数化模型多为奇异模型：最优参数集含多点或泛化误差Hessian退化，参数化存在冗余。因此需要超越表观参数维度，理解有效维度与内在模型复杂度以研究其泛化能力。
AI.method: 以实对数规范阈值(RLCT)及局部RLCT为核心量，在特定局部化假设下，从理论上建立局部RLCT与两个既有泛化指标的关系：(I)泛化误差Hessian矩阵的秩；(II)损失函数族的覆盖数。
AI.result: 在局部化假设下给出局部RLCT与Hessian秩及损失函数族覆盖数之间的理论联系，揭示RLCT可刻画有效维度与内在复杂度。
AI.conclusion: RLCT与局部RLCT能与基于Hessian秩和覆盖数的泛化度量相联系，为奇异/过参数化模型的有效维度与泛化分析提供理论依据。

title: The DynaCell Evaluation Suite for Dynamic 3D Virtual Staining of Live Cells
comment: 64 pages: 10-page main text with 4 figures and 1 table, plus references and a 49-page appendix with 15 figures and 25 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Understanding how cells respond to perturbations over time is central to cell biology and drug discovery. Live-cell imaging captures the dynamics of perturbation-induced phenotypes in individual cells. While fluorescence imaging can visualize specific molecular phenotypes, labeling and repeated illumination often affect cell health. Virtual staining offers an alternative by predicting these fluorescence images from images acquired without fluorescent labels. Although many virtual staining models have been developed, their performance on volumetric time-lapse data remains poorly characterized. We address this gap with an evaluation suite for 3D time-lapse virtual staining of live cells. The suite combines paired 3D time-lapse images acquired with and without fluorescent labels, a set of baseline models, and three metric tiers measuring pixel-level fidelity, organelle segmentation performance, and single-cell phenotype similarity. Using this evaluation suite, we study metric and model behavior across 3 cell types, 2 microscopes, 4 organelles, and 3 perturbation states. We find that regression baselines better predict the spatial localization of target organelles, whereas the generative baseline better captures the distribution of phenotypes across cells. These differences expose trade-offs between structural and phenotypic fidelity that are obscured by single-metric evaluation and suggest how virtual staining models can be developed for diverse downstream tasks such as localization, segmentation, tracking, and phenotypic profiling. We release the curated datasets, baseline checkpoints, and evaluation code as part of DynaCell, a broader framework for image-based profiling of cell-state dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个针对活细胞3D延时虚拟染色（virtual staining）的评测套件，包含配对无标记/有标记的3D延时数据、基线模型和三级评价指标，并在3种细胞类型、2种显微镜、4种细胞器、3种扰动状态下系统评估模型与指标行为。
AI.motivation: 活细胞成像可捕捉扰动诱导表型的时间动态，但荧光成像需标记和反复照明，会损害细胞健康。虚拟染色可从未标记图像预测荧光图像，作为替代方案；然而现有虚拟染色模型在体积（3D）延时数据上的性能尚缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 提出一个3D延时虚拟染色评测套件：整合配对的、带/不带荧光标记的3D延时图像数据，若干基线模型，以及三级指标（像素级保真度、细胞器分割性能、单细胞表型相似度）；在3种细胞类型、2种显微镜、4种细胞器、3种扰动状态上开展评测分析。
AI.result: 回归类基线更好地预测目标细胞器的空间定位，而生成式基线更好地刻画细胞间表型分布；二者体现出结构保真度与表型保真度之间的权衡，而这种权衡被单一指标评测所掩盖。
AI.conclusion: 单指标评测不足以反映虚拟染色模型的真实差异，需按下游任务（定位、分割、追踪、表型分析）选择或设计模型；数据集、基线权重与评测代码作为DynaCell框架的一部分开源发布。

title: Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents
summary: A model is only half of an AI agent system. The other half is the inference strategy: the reasoning procedure that turns model calls into a response. Today that second half is written by hand, and the experience of building one strategy never carries to the next. We introduce Strategist, a meta-agent that evolves inference strategies across tasks. Each strategy is written as a blueprint,executable code that other strategies can reuse, and together the blueprints form a library. Given a task and a small development set, Strategist retrieves related blueprints, writes candidate strategies, tests them on real samples, and revises them from the results. Every candidate then enters the library, so later tasks build on earlier discoveries. On 30 benchmarks, Strategist beats the strongest baseline on 24 and matches its average accuracy (74.7% vs.74.0%) at 39% lower inference cost. Its strategies also transfer to unseen tasks and other models without further search. The part of an AI system that is not improved on its own now does.

AI.tldr: 提出 Strategist 元智能体，自动进化推理策略并以可复用 blueprint 代码形式跨任务积累，在 30 个基准上以更低推理成本超越强基线。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体系统 = 模型 + 推理策略，但推理策略目前靠手工编写，且经验无法跨任务迁移。论文希望让这块"未被自我改进"的部分也能自动优化与积累。
AI.method: Strategist 是元智能体：每条策略写成可执行代码 blueprint，其他策略可复用，共同构成策略库。给定任务与小规模开发集，Strategist 检索相关 blueprint、生成候选策略、在真实样本上测试、根据结果迭代修改；每个候选进入库，使后续任务继承先前发现。
AI.result: 30 个基准中 24 个超过最强基线，平均准确率持平（74.7% vs 74.0%），推理成本降低 39%；策略可零搜索迁移到未见任务和其他模型。
AI.conclusion: 推理策略可被自动化进化并跨任务复用，实现"系统另一半"的自我改进，兼顾性能与成本。

title: A Parameter-Free Best-of-Both-Worlds Policy for Queueing Bandits
summary: We study online channel scheduling for a single queue served by $K$ channels under bandit feedback. We propose a simple best-of-both-worlds policy that explores when the queue is empty. During busy periods, it selects the empirical best channel while the prescribed conditions hold and, if any condition is violated, switches to a robust bandit policy to clear the queue. For arbitrary arrivals and services determined by an oblivious adversary, our policy achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K L_T})$ worst-case queue length regret with high probability, where $L_T$ is the longest busy-period length. This result improves the previous $T^{3/4}$ dependence and matches the worst-case lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Under bounded i.i.d. stochastic models with a unique best stabilizing channel, we show that the cumulative queue length regret converges to a finite problem-dependent constant, and further establish the logarithmic expected worst-case queue length regret bound.

AI.tldr: 研究单队列K信道带博弈反馈的在线调度,提出"空闲时探索"的最优两界(best-of-both-worlds)策略,同时达到对抗情形下的近优队列长度遗憾与随机情形下的常数/对数级遗憾。
AI.motivation: 单队列多信道调度的在线学习问题中,以往工作对抗情形最坏遗憾只有T^{3/4}量级,与下界存在差距;且希望同一策略在对抗与随机两类模型下都能保证良好性能(两界兼优)。
AI.method: 提出简洁的两界兼优策略:队列为空时进行探索;繁忙期选择经验最优信道,并检验给定条件,一旦条件被违反则切换到鲁棒bandit策略以清空队列。分析覆盖任意到达与服务(由oblivious对手确定)及有界i.i.d.随机模型(存在唯一最优稳定信道)。
AI.result: 对抗设定下以高概率达到Õ(√(K L_T))的最坏情形队列长度遗憾(L_T为最长繁忙期长度),优于此前T^{3/4},与下界仅差对数因子;随机设定下累积遗憾收敛到有限的依问题常数,并得到期望最坏情形队列长度遗憾的对数界。
AI.conclusion: 一个简单策略即可同时实现对抗与随机模型下的近乎最优保证,弥合了队列调度bandit学习中worst-case与stochastic两类结果的差距。

title: ViAdminShift: A Vietnamese Benchmark for Event-Level Knowledge Updates Built from the 2025 Administrative Reform
summary: On July 1, 2025, Vietnam reduced its 63 provinces to 34, abolished its 696 districts, and replaced its 10,035 commune-level units (wards) with 3,321. ViAdminShift, a Vietnamese language resource about this event, consists of 7,995 benchmark items, 2,281 retrieval passages from pre- and post-reform Wikipedia revisions and dated templates, and old-to-new tables that a released script rebuilds from the official conversion table (not redistributed). Changed items store the pre-reform answer (except 121 address items), a $2\times2$ design uses untouched units as controls, and 400 addresses appear without diacritics. The tables agree with an independent lineage on 10,564 of 10,565 official pairs, disagreements were settled against the resolutions, and the probing-track scorer agrees with both authors' blind labels (Cohen's $κ=0.91$ and $0.89$). Data, outputs, code, and a datasheet are released. In the probing track, at least 20 of 67 models know the reform. Fourteen of them give the new province alone for at most 11% of plain questions about old addresses (old province only: 14-100%); a bare date recovers up to 100%. Post hoc (80 province-free addresses, single runs), with reasoning off, today's date in the system prompt leaves 68-100% old-province-only answers for 10 of 12 models; with reasoning, an "as of" prefix in the question leaves none for seven of eight. On the 1,262-item benchmark subset, with same-source old and new passages, small models unaware of the reform give 14-30% outdated answers and the five benchmark-track knowers (also differing in size or provider) 0-5%.

AI.tldr: 介绍 ViAdminShift——关于越南 2025 年 7 月省级行政改革（63→34 省、撤销 696 区、乡级单位 10,035→3,321）的越南语资源，含 7,995 条基准题、2,281 段检索文本及新旧对照表，并评估 67 个模型对该改革的知晓与地址更新能力。
AI.motivation: 越南大规模行政区划改革使用户熟悉的旧地址信息迅速过时，大模型若不了解或混淆新旧体制会给出错误地理信息；现有资源缺乏对这类"制度性信息变更"的系统测试。
AI.method: 构建 7,995 项基准与 2,281 条检索段落（改革前后维基版本与带日期模板）以及脚本从官方转换表重建的新旧对照表；变动项保存改革前答案（121 条地址项除外），采用 2×2 设计以未变动单位作对照，400 条地址去声调。对照表与独立血缘比对（10,564/10,565 一致），分歧依决议裁定；评分器与两位作者盲标一致（κ=0.91/0.89）。设 probing 与 benchmark 两赛道评测。
AI.result: 67 个模型中至少 20 个知晓该改革；14 个中仅最多 11% 的普通旧地址问题能给出新省（只给旧省者 14–100%），加入裸日期可提升至 100%。事后实验：关闭推理时系统提示 Today's date 使 12 个模型中 10 个的旧省独占回答达 68–100%；开启推理时加"as of"前缀使 8 个模型中 7 个降至 0。1,262 题子集上，不知情小模型给过时答案 14–30%，5 个知情模型 0–5%。
AI.conclusion: 数据、输出、代码与 datasheet 全部公开；结果显示多数模型对该改革认识不足且易被时间提示左右，凸显时效性地理知识评测的必要性。

title: Findings-aware Language-Image Pretraining for CT Volume Interpretation
summary: Computed tomography (CT) provides diverse patient information and various clinical tasks, for which numerous deep learning models have been investigated. Recent years have seen the development of vision-language foundation models that can comprehensively extract clinical features, driven by representation learning that combines CT volumes with radiology reports. Existing approaches typically adopt Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based representation learning, where pairs from different cases are, in principle, treated as negative pairs such that the volume and report embeddings are pushed apart. In the biomedical imaging, however, treating different cases as negative pairs is not always appropriate, particularly when clinical similarity exists. In this study, we propose a supervised representation learning framework grounded in clinical knowledge from language foundation models, rather than the weak supervision used in CLIP. Specifically, we utilized a large language model to extract abnormal finding phrases from reports. We then explicitly constructed the target features that the image encoder should output, as the semantic representation of the extracted findings using a biomedical text embedding model. Our Findings-aware Language-Image Pre-training (FiLIP) outperformed weakly supervised approaches in multi-label zero-shot finding classification in both in-domain and external-domain evaluations, and also proved effective when fine-tuned for the downstream task of radiology report generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FiLIP，用大语言模型抽取报告的异常发现短语，并以生物医学文本嵌入模型给出语义目标，取代 CLIP 式的弱对比监督，使图像编码器直接对齐临床知识表征。
AI.motivation: 现有 CT 视觉-语言基础模型多采用 CLIP 式对比学习，原则上把不同病例的体数据与报告当作负配对推开；但生物医学图像中不同病例常存在临床相似性，这种弱监督假设并不总成立。
AI.method: 用大语言模型从放射报告中抽取异常发现短语，再用生物医学文本嵌入模型将其编码为语义表征，作为图像编码器应输出的显式目标特征，从而以临床知识驱动的监督替代 CLIP 的配对弱监督。
AI.result: 在多标签零样本发现分类的域内与外部域评测中，FiLIP 均优于弱监督方法；在下游放射报告生成任务上微调后同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 以临床发现为中心的显式语义监督可有效替代 CLIP 式弱监督，提升 CT 视觉-语言表征的零样本泛化与下游迁移能力。

title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
summary: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.

AI.tldr: WebHarbor 构建了 153 个可执行、Docker化的高保真合成网站环境与 3,518 个任务，用于 GUI Web Agent 的稳定评测与低成本 RL 训练，训练出的 4B 级智能体可泛化并在四个基准上有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 真实网站评测面临内容变动、访问限制、认证流程覆盖不足等问题；现有合成训练环境又缺乏功能深度与视觉保真度，因此需要一个稳定、可控且贴近真实的高保真环境套件。
AI.method: 采用任务驱动的人机协作流程构建环境：新任务扩展功能范围，编码智能体实现改动，人工审核视觉保真、功能正确性与任务有效性；环境以 Docker 化、可执行形式交付，共 153 个网站环境、3,518 个任务，覆盖多步骤与登录后工作流。
AI.result: 除可靠评测外，环境可用于低成本 RL；在其上做 RL 训练的 Qwen 4B 级 GUI 智能体能泛化到未见任务，并在四个基准上与领先的开源 GUI Web 智能体表现相当。
AI.conclusion: WebHarbor 提供了兼顾稳定性、保真度与功能深度的合成 Web 环境套件，验证了其作为评测与训练平台的价值，代码与数据已开源。

title: M3Former: Fine-Grained Cross-Layer Mixing for Transformers
summary: Residual connections give each Transformer block access to all earlier layers only through one fixed sum, broadcast to all of the block's inputs. This broadcast bottleneck imposes three constraints: the query, key, value and residual inputs of a block, which we call its roles, read the same vector; all hidden dimensions within a role share one set of weights over earlier layers; and every earlier layer has the same fixed weight for every token. We propose the Multi-Role Multi-Group Mixing Residual (M3), which removes all three: every role, and every group of hidden dimensions within a role, reads its own token-dependent mixture of all earlier layers. M3 starts as an exact residual connection and adds as little as 1.4% parameters and 1.8% FLOPs. From 100M to 1.4B parameters, M3Former outperforms the Transformer and coarse-grained cross-layer connections at every size, matching a Transformer 1.19-1.34x the size of the one it modifies, trained with 1.4-1.8x the compute. Relaxing only some of the constraints recovers only part of this gain. M3Former also improves sparse mixture-of-experts models of up to 4.6B parameters and trains more stably in deeper networks. Code: https://github.com/Kingchet10/m3former

AI.tldr: 提出M3残差机制，让每个角色及隐藏维度组读取各自token相关的跨层混合，以极小开销打破Transformer残差的广播瓶颈。
AI.motivation: Transformer残差只通过一个固定和、广播到块的所有输入，造成广播瓶颈：Q/K/V/残差输入共享同一向量、同角色内所有隐藏维度共享跨层权重、每个早期层对所有token权重固定。
AI.method: Multi-Role Multi-Group Mixing Residual (M3)：每个角色、每个隐藏维度组读取自己的、token相关的所有早期层混合；初始化为精确残差连接，仅增加约1.4%参数与1.8% FLOPs。
AI.result: 100M–1.4B参数下M3Former在所有规模上优于Transformer与粗粒度跨层连接，相当于1.19–1.34倍规模的Transformer、1.4–1.8倍算力训练；仅放松部分约束只得部分收益；对4.6B MoE模型亦有提升且深层训练更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 以极低开销全面解除残差广播瓶颈带来一致且可扩展的性能提升，并改善深层与MoE训练稳定性。

title: AgiWorld: An Agentic Video World Model for Building Persistent Worlds
summary: Recent interactive video world models generate visually compelling videos from a single image, following user-provided camera motion and text prompts. However, such low-level control demands substantial user effort to realize a high-level intent, and the generated world struggles to remain persistent as the exploration proceeds. In this work, we present AgiWorld, an agentic video world model that explores and builds a persistent world from a single image and a free-form instruction. For high-level planning, our agent AgiWorld-Agent designs the world and the journey through it in a world state and directs the exploration. For low-level realization, our video world model AgiWorld-WM generates the video chunk by chunk and stores it with its geometry in a spatial memory, from which the agent updates its world state. This closed loop keeps the world faithful to the user's intent and keeps the agent's world state consistent with the generated content throughout the exploration. We co-design the two levels around the shared spatial memory and an interface of metric camera trajectories and structured prompts. In AgiWorld-WM, to handle occlusion and accumulated geometric errors in the spatial memory over long rollouts, we propose occlusion-aware history selection, which retrieves past views by surface visibility, and reliability-based memory maintenance, which prefers reliable geometry and earlier observations. AgiWorld-WM achieves state-of-the-art overall performance on world revisiting and exploration benchmarks, and qualitative results and ablations show that AgiWorld builds persistent worlds from free-form instructions over minute-long journeys. Persistence thus arises not from the video model alone but from its closed loop with the agent.

AI.tldr: AgiWorld 是一个"智能体+视频世界模型"闭环系统，可从单张图像和自由指令出发，规划并逐块生成一个具有空间记忆、可持续探索的持久化世界。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型依赖用户提供相机运动与文本等低层控制，用户需耗费大量精力才能表达高层意图；同时生成的世界在持续探索中难以保持持久一致（persistence）。
AI.method: 将系统分为两层并围绕共享空间记忆与"度量相机轨迹+结构化提示"接口联合设计：高层由 AgiWorld-Agent 在世界状态中规划世界与旅程并指导探索；低层由 AgiWorld-WM 逐块生成视频，并将视频连同几何信息存入空间记忆，智能体据此更新世界状态，形成闭环。AgiWorld-WM 中提出遮挡感知历史选择（按表面可见性检索历史视角）与基于可靠性的记忆维护（偏好可靠几何与更早观测），以应对长序列中的遮挡与累积几何误差。
AI.result: AgiWorld-WM 在世界重访与探索基准上取得最优综合性能；定性结果与消融实验表明，AgiWorld 能在分钟级旅程中依据自由指令构建持久世界。
AI.conclusion: 持久性并非单靠视频模型获得，而是源于视频世界模型与智能体的闭环协作。

title: From Natural Language to Exact Cover: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Zebra Puzzles
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation has substantially improved the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, including code generation, data analysis, and exam-style question answering. Despite these advances, purely neural LLMs continue to struggle with elementary logical reasoning problems and lack the determinism, soundness, and reliability characteristic of symbolic reasoning systems. Conversely, classical symbolic methods such as SAT solving and exact cover guarantee correctness and completeness, but require problems to be expressed in highly specialized formal encodings, limiting their applicability to natural language inputs. In this work, we present a synergistic neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by combining neural semantic parsing with deterministic exact cover reasoning. Given a Zebra-style logic puzzle in natural language, an LLM translates entities and constraints into structured tool calls that construct an exact cover instance. A symbolic solver then computes the solution and provides feedback to iteratively refine invalid, under- or overconstrained encodings, exploiting the uniqueness property of Zebra puzzles. We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation across multiple parameter scales, post-training paradigms, and LLM families. The results demonstrate that our hybrid approach consistently outperforms strong plain neural baselines, including CoT prompting, as well as recent neuro-symbolic methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种神经-符号协同框架，用LLM将自然语言Zebra逻辑谜题语义解析为精确覆盖（exact cover）实例，再由符号求解器确定性求解并用反馈迭代修正编码，性能稳定优于CoT及近期神经-符号方法。
AI.motivation: 纯神经LLM在基础逻辑推理上仍缺乏确定性、可靠性与健全性；而SAT求解、精确覆盖等经典符号方法虽保证正确与完备，却需要高度专门化的形式化编码，难以直接处理自然语言输入。
AI.method: 构建神经-符号混合框架：LLM作为语义解析器，将Zebra风格自然语言谜题中的实体与约束翻译成结构化工具调用，构造exact cover实例；符号求解器计算结果，并利用Zebra谜题解唯一性，对无效、约束不足或过度约束的编码进行反馈迭代精化。
AI.result: 在多种参数规模、多种后训练范式及不同LLM家族上做了全面实证评估，混合方法一致优于强纯神经基线（含CoT提示）以及近期神经-符号方法。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM语义解析与确定性符号推理结合，可兼顾自然语言处理灵活性与符号求解的正确性、完备性，是提升逻辑推理可靠性的有效路径。

title: Turbo-GMM: FlashAttention-Inspired GPU-Accelerated Gaussian Mixture Model
summary: Expectation-maximization (EM) for Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) requires scoring $N$ data points against $K$ mixture components. Prior fused GPU implementations, notably Flash-GMM, eliminate materialization of the $N \times K$ responsibility matrix but traverse the component dimension twice to compute normalization terms and accumulate sufficient statistics. We introduce Turbo-GMM, a single-sweep fused EM kernel that completes responsibility normalization and sufficient-statistic accumulation within one traversal of the component dimension. By retaining the complete component axis on chip, Turbo-GMM avoids the second score computation required by the released two-sweep Flash-GMM implementation. Its applicability is limited by register pressure, occupancy, and the component and feature dimensions, making it particularly suitable for large datasets with relatively small numbers of components. For larger configurations, Turbo-GMM employs a two-pass fallback following the established fused design. We establish algebraic equivalence to standard EM in real arithmetic and evaluate sixteen configurations on an NVIDIA A100. Under the reported benchmarking protocol, Turbo-GMM achieves a median $2.15\times$ speedup over the evaluated Flash-GMM implementation and up to $5.3\times$ and $9.9\times$ over PyTorch and \texttt{scikit-learn}, respectively. The results demonstrate the potential of single-sweep component traversal while identifying on-chip resource constraints as the principal limitation of this approach.

AI.tldr: 提出 Turbo-GMM，一种单次遍历（single-sweep）融合的 EM 核，在一次遍历中同时完成责任度归一化与充分统计量累积，避免二次评分，中位数比 Flash-GMM 快 2.15×。
AI.motivation: GMM 的 EM 需对 N 个点与 K 个分量打分；已有融合 GPU 实现（如 Flash-GMM）虽避免物化 N×K 责任度矩阵，但仍需遍历分量维度两次：一次算归一化项，一次累积充分统计量，造成重复评分与额外开销。
AI.method: Turbo-GMM：将完整分量轴保留在片上（on-chip），在一次分量维度遍历中完成归一化与充分统计量累积，从而省去第二次打分。受寄存器压力、占用率及分量/特征维度限制，适用于大样本、较少分量的场景；大配置时回退到遵循既有融合设计的两遍（two-pass）方案。并证明其在实数算术下与标准 EM 代数等价。
AI.result: 在 NVIDIA A100 上评估 16 种配置：相较于所评估的 Flash-GMM 实现中位数加速 2.15×，对 PyTorch 与 scikit-learn 分别最高达 5.3× 和 9.9×。同时揭示片上资源约束是该方法的主要局限。
AI.conclusion: 单次分量遍历具有实际潜力，但适用性受寄存器/占用率等片上资源及分量与特征维度制约；大配置需依赖两遍回退路径。

title: Exploiting Textual Semantics for Robust Cross-View Object Correspondence
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 12 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/VAIL-Fan/TeSCo
summary: Cross-view object correspondence (CVOC) aims to establish associations of the same target between query and search videos captured from different viewpoints. Existing methods often rely on visual cues for CVOC. Despite recent progress, these methods struggle in complicated scenarios with substantial viewpoint changes and appearance variations, due to lacking sufficient target information. Addressing this, we introduce TeSCo, a framework that exploits rich Textual Semantics of an object, in addition to its visual cues, for cross-view object Correspondence. Our key insight is, textual description of a target, by capturing diverse attributes such as category, texture, and color, provides viewpoint- and appearance-invariant semantics, which are complementary to visual cues and can hence enhance correspondence robustness in complicated scenes. Inspired by this, TeSCo first generates a textual expression of the target from the given query view using a vision-language model, and then extracts textual feature to enhance visual features for localization in the search view. To realize this, we introduce a text-conditioned cross-modal fusion (TCF) module that incorporates the textual feature into visual features with text-guided modulation, producing more robust multimodal target representation for object correspondence. Since not all textual cues are equally compatible with the target in current search-view frame, we propose an iterative textual feature refinement (ITFR) module that progressively adjusts textual feature using search-view information before the TCF module, enabling search-view-aware textual semantics to be fused into visual features and leading to better performance. In extensive experiments on Ego-Exo4D and HANDAL-X, TeSCo demonstrates state-of-the-art results and largely outperforms other models, validating its efficacy. Our code is released at https://github.com/VAIL-Fan/TeSCo.

AI.tldr: TeSCo引入文本语义辅助跨视角目标对应，生成目标文本描述并通过迭代文本特征精炼与文本引导跨模态融合增强视觉特征，在Ego-Exo4D与HANDAL-X上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角目标对应方法依赖视觉线索，在视角变化大、外观差异显著的复杂场景中因目标信息不足而失效。
AI.method: 先用视觉-语言模型从查询视角生成目标文本表达并提取文本特征；引入文本条件跨模态融合(TCF)模块以文本引导调制将文本特征融入视觉特征；并提出迭代文本特征精炼(ITFR)模块，利用搜索视角信息逐步调整文本特征，使其与当前帧更兼容后再融合。
AI.result: 在Ego-Exo4D和HANDAL-X数据集上实验取得SOTA，显著优于其他方法。
AI.conclusion: 文本描述提供视角与外观不变的语义，与视觉线索互补，可有效提升复杂场景下跨视角目标对应的鲁棒性；代码已开源。

title: Learning the Entropic Relaxation: Stable Coarse-Grid Emulation with Neural Discrete Equilibrium
summary: The ability to emulate complicated and computationally-expensive physical systems in an efficient and stable manner is a popular motivation for scientific machine learning (SciML). Stable numerical solvers tend to be computationally expensive, as they attempt to resolve small (spatial and temporal) scales that receive and dissipate spectral energy. Learned coarse-grid forecasters remove the dissipative channel, allowing unresolved frequencies to re-emerge as grid-scale noise (aliasing). In this paper, we use the Neural Discrete Equilibrium (NeurDE) method to explore stable emulation at extremely coarse grids, demonstrating physically-principled control over entropy dynamics that reinforces the physical system's dissipative mechanism. Entropically-stabilized NeurDE produces stable long-time rollouts for thousands of forecasting steps on large Reynolds number turbulent flows ($\mathrm{Re}=100{,}000$) with very coarse grids (down to $\mathbb{R}^{16\times16}$). At these very coarse grid scales, entropically-stabilized NeurDE can be more stable than even our stabilized data-generation numerical method.

AI.tldr: 提出熵稳定化的 Neural Discrete Equilibrium (NeurDE) 方法，在极粗网格上对高雷诺数湍流进行稳定长期预测，通过物理原则约束熵动力学恢复系统的耗散机制。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习需要高效稳定地模拟复杂昂贵的物理系统。稳定数值求解器因需解析耗散谱能量的小尺度而计算昂贵；而学到的粗网格预测器会去掉耗散通道，使未解析频率以网格尺度噪声（混叠）的形式重现，导致不稳定。因此需要在极粗网格上实现物理上合理的稳定替代模拟。
AI.method: 采用 Neural Discrete Equilibrium (NeurDE) 方法进行极粗网格上的稳定模拟探索，通过对熵动力学的物理原则性控制，强化物理系统原有的耗散机制（即 entropically-stabilized NeurDE），以抑制混叠带来的不稳定。
AI.result: 熵稳定化 NeurDE 在大雷诺数湍流（Re=100,000）、极粗网格（低至 16×16）上实现数千个预测步长的稳定长期 rollout；在如此粗的网格尺度下，其稳定性甚至优于作者所采用的稳定化数据生成数值方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过物理原则性（熵）约束来补偿粗网格学习中缺失的耗散通道，是实现极粗网格上稳定长期湍流模拟的有效途径，可在计算效率与长期稳定性之间取得良好平衡。

title: GEAR: Generative Editing for Scene-Conditioned Outfit Retrieval for VR Travel
summary: In virtual environments, choosing appropriate outfits requires contextual harmony with surrounding scenes, yet bridging the visual gap between 3D ambient views and catalog garment assets remains challenging. This paper investigates scene-conditioned outfit retrieval for interactive 3D environments, where a user's egocentric view serves as the retrieval signal. We present GEAR (Generative Editing for Asset Retrieval), a framework that bridges the cross-domain gap by synthesizing intermediate visual queries rather than predicting direct compatibility. GEAR uses a vision-language model to describe suitable clothing from a captured scene, employs an instruction-guided diffusion model to render the concept onto a standardized reference character, and utilizes the cropped clothing region to retrieve existing 2D outfit assets via embedding similarity. An interactive Unity prototype demonstrates real-time scene capture, asset retrieval, and in-engine 3D avatar fitting. We benchmark GEAR against direct visual similarity, aesthetic scoring, and VLM-based reranking on a controlled dataset using automated Swiss-system pairwise judgments, where GEAR achieves competitive top-ranked performance (mean Elo@5 of 1012.75 and top-10 overlap of 0.180) alongside 0.539 pairwise agreement. Furthermore, a user study across 20 virtual travel scenes demonstrates that GEAR achieves the highest overall participant preference in both visual appeal (34.5%) and contextual suitability (34.5%).

AI.tldr: 提出GEAR框架，通过生成式编辑合成中间视觉查询，实现以第一人称3D场景为条件的服装资产检索。
AI.motivation: 虚拟环境中挑选合适服装需与场景上下文协调，但3D环境视图与商品目录服装资产之间存在显著视觉域差距，直接视觉相似度难以奏效。
AI.method: GEAR不直接预测兼容性，而是：用视觉语言模型描述场景中适合的服装；用指令引导的扩散模型将该概念渲染到标准化参考角色上；裁剪服装区域，通过嵌入相似度检索现有2D服装资产；并在Unity原型中实现实时场景捕捉、检索与引擎内3D化身试穿。
AI.result: 在受控数据集上以自动化瑞士制成对比较评测，GEAR相比直接视觉相似度、美学打分和VLM重排取得有竞争力的排名表现（Elo@5均值1012.75，top-10重叠0.180，成对一致率0.539）；20个虚拟旅行场景的用户研究中，GEAR在视觉吸引力与情境适配性上均获最高偏好（各34.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 以生成中间查询弥合跨域差距是场景条件服装检索的有效途径，可在交互式3D环境中实现可用的实时检索与试穿体验。

title: Training Autoregressive Language Models on Rounded, Bounded, and Censored Numerical Labels via Exact Likelihood
summary: Numerical labels often specify a set of possible values: a measurement is rounded, a laboratory test reports only a bound, or a program is stopped at a timeout. We introduce boundary marginalization, the first method that trains an autoregressive language model on the exact likelihood of such observations through its existing digit tokens. A fixed-width, order-preserving numeral representation groups consecutive grid values under shared digit prefixes. An interval is a union of such groups, so its exact probability and gradient follow from at most two boundary paths, the successive digit prefixes of its endpoints, each of length logarithmic in the number of grid values. The resulting objective unifies precise, rounded, bounded, and censored supervision and trains digit decisions at the resolution supplied by each observation. The same computation supports exact distributional queries and unbiased gradients for the continuous ranked probability score on exact labels. Experiments show recovery of a conditional distribution from rounded and censored reports alone, improved likelihood on naturally censored molecular measurements, and more accurate code latency distributions on two backbones. Exact interval updates remain tractable as the numerical support grows to one million values.

AI.tldr: 提出boundary marginalization方法，利用自回归模型现有数字token精确计算区间观测（四舍五入、上下界、删失）的似然。
AI.motivation: 数值标签常只给出可能值集合（测量被舍入、化验只报边界、程序超时截断），现有方法难以在这些区间/删失监督下精确训练。
AI.method: 采用定宽、保序的数字表示，使连续网格值共享数字前缀；区间可分解为若干共享前缀组，故其精确概率与梯度仅需至多两条边界路径（端点逐位前缀），长度对网格值数目取对数，从而统一精确、舍入、边界与删失监督。
AI.result: 实验显示仅凭舍入与删失报告即可恢复条件分布，在自然删失的分子测量上似然更优，并在两个backbone上得到更准确的代码延迟分布；支持多达一百万数值时区间更新仍可计算。
AI.conclusion: 区间精确更新随数值支撑增长仍可扩展，并可为连续排名概率得分提供精确分布查询与无偏梯度。

authors: Devesh Shah Antonio H. de O. Fonseca
title: LLMs Depend on Specialist Tools for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in MS/MS Structural Elucidation
comment: Accepted at "NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic Systems for Molecular Sciences" and "I Can't Believe It's Not Better: Failure Modes of AI in Biology Workshop at NeurIPS 2026"
summary: A frontier language model was recently reported to solve 1D NMR structural elucidation without tools. We ask whether this capability transfers to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in the de novo setting, where the model must propose a structure directly from the spectrum without a candidate list or reference library. To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte's textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms. We hold the model, harness, and output format fixed and vary only the LLM's access to domain-specific tools. Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution. Only access to de novo structure generators improves out-of-distribution accuracy, raising it to as much as 38% Top-1, and the resulting agent outperforms the standalone de novo models both in and out of distribution. These results suggest that LLMs are not effective at de novo MS/MS structural elucidation on their own, and that further gains depend on the specialist tools available to the agent rather than on the LLM itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建MassSpecGym来源的100种分析物基准，将MS/MS从头结构解析按文献曝光分为分布内/外两臂，固定模型与输出格式仅改变工具访问。前沿LLM无工具时分布内Top-1 52%、分布外仅2%；接入从头结构生成器后分布外提升至最高38%，且智能体优于单独生成模型。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型已被报道可在无工具条件下完成1D NMR结构解析，作者想检验该能力能否迁移到MS/MS的从头（de novo）场景——即无候选列表、无参考库，仅由谱图直接提出结构。同时需区分"推理"与"记忆/召回"，故按文献曝光度切分数据。
AI.method: 从MassSpecGym构建100个分析物的基准，依据各分析物的文本足迹分为分布内（文献充分记录）与分布外（基本无记录）两臂；保持模型、框架与输出格式不变，仅改变LLM对领域专用工具的访问权限（如从头结构生成器）。
AI.result: 无工具时前沿LLM分布内Top-1为52%，分布外仅2%；仅当可访问从头结构生成器时分布外准确率才提升，最高达38% Top-1；所得智能体在分布内外均优于独立的从头模型。
AI.conclusion: LLM自身并不擅长MS/MS从头结构解析，其分布内表现很可能源于召回而非推理；进一步性能提升取决于智能体可用的专用工具，而非LLM本身。

title: IMUdrape: Generating Garment-Mounted Virtual IMU Data from Text through Physics-Based Cloth Simulation
comment: 34 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables. Under review. Project page: https://zikangleng.github.io/imudrape/
summary: Inertial sensors are moving into clothing, from sensorized sportswear to garments instrumented with hundreds of IMUs. Sewn into clothing, a sensor no longer moves rigidly with the body: loose fabric slides, twists and swings, so a garment-mounted sensor records the motion of the fabric as well as that of the body, and this extra motion differs from one garment to the next. Models for such sensors need training data recorded with the deployed garment, yet labeled data are scarce. Virtual IMU data generated from videos or text have eased this scarcity for body-attached sensors, but existing generators attach their virtual sensors rigidly to the body. We present IMUdrape, which generates garment-mounted virtual IMU data from text through physics-based cloth simulation. IMUdrape synthesizes motion from activity descriptions, reconstructs the target garment as a sewing pattern from photographs, places virtual IMUs at the deployment's real sensor positions, and simulates the garment with an intersection-free contact solver, so that every simulation yields paired garment and body signals. On four real datasets with clothing-mounted sensors, IMUdrape improves on existing virtual-data approaches for both activity recognition and full-body pose estimation. With one real subject, its data improve recognition macro-F1 by 7% to 46% over real data alone and by 2% to 11% over body-mounted virtual data from the same motion. When the garment is simulated on recorded motion, the pose error without any real training data falls by 30% to 33% relative to generated motion, and garment data remain 12% more accurate than body data. IMUdrape thus reduces the amount of real data that garment-mounted sensing requires.

AI.tldr: IMUdrape 通过物理布料仿真从文本生成服装安装式虚拟 IMU 数据，减少真实数据需求。
AI.motivation: 传感器被缝入衣物后不再随身体刚性运动，松弛布料会滑动、扭转和摆动，导致服装传感器记录布料+身体混合运动且因衣而异；这类模型需用所部署服装采集的训练数据，但标注数据稀缺。现有虚拟 IMU 生成器（视频/文本）仅将传感器刚性附着于身体，无法模拟服装运动。
AI.method: IMUdrape 流程：1）从活动文本描述合成运动；2）从照片重建目标服装的缝纫纸样；3）在部署的真实传感器位置放置虚拟 IMU；4）用无交叠接触求解器进行布料仿真，每次仿真同时输出配对的服装信号与身体信号。
AI.result: 在 4 个服装安装传感器的真实数据集上，活动识别和全身姿态估计均优于现有虚拟数据方法。单受试者场景下，相比仅用真实数据 macro-F1 提升 7%–46%，相比同运动的身体安装虚拟数据提升 2%–11%。在录制运动上仿真服装时，无真实训练数据的姿态误差相对生成运动下降 30%–33%，服装数据仍比身体数据准确 12%。
AI.conclusion: IMUdrape 证明基于物理布料仿真的服装虚拟 IMU 数据可有效替代部分真实数据，降低服装安装式感知的数据采集需求。

title: MetaPOCS: Meta-Learned Multi-Exit Unfolding for Budget-Aware Seismic Data Interpolation
summary: Seismic data interpolation must reconcile reconstruction fidelity with the computational budgets of acquisition quality control and subsequent imaging. Fixed-depth unfolding networks are optimized for a single operating point, whereas their intermediate estimates may be insufficiently trained for early deployment. We present MetaPOCS, a meta-learned multi-exit unfolding framework for budget-aware seismic interpolation. Building on a spatial--spectral POCS reconstruction backbone, MetaPOCS supervises intermediate stages and preserves the acquired traces at every exit. A Meta-GF-based optimization procedure constructs exit-oriented parameter displacements from a common initialization and learns their fusion weights through an equal-exit outer objective. The weights vary across parameter tensors and respect the nested support of the reconstruction stages. We derive the resulting fusion hypergradient to characterize how the outer objective reallocates competing updates, and distinguish this mechanism from scalar loss reweighting. At inference, one checkpoint provides a set of reconstruction budgets through a latency-calibrated exit policy. The evaluation framework couples matched-cost interpolation comparisons with finite-update diagnostics and a fixed reverse-time-migration operator, connecting multi-exit optimization to waveform and imaging fidelity. MetaPOCS thus provides a unified formulation for studying the reconstruction--computation trade-off of seismic unfolding across deployment budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出 MetaPOCS：一种元学习驱动的多出口展开框架，用于预算感知的地震数据插值，单一检查点可在不同计算预算下提供高质量重建。
AI.motivation: 固定深度展开网络只针对单一运行点优化，中间估计未充分训练，难以在早期阶段部署；而地震插值需在重建保真度与采集质控、成像的计算预算之间权衡。
AI.method: 以空间-谱 POCS 重建为骨干，监督各中间阶段并在每个出口保留采集道；采用基于 Meta-GF 的优化，从公共初始化构造面向不同出口的参数位移，并以等出口外层目标学习融合权重（跨张量变化、尊重嵌套支撑）；推导融合超梯度分析外层目标如何重分配竞争更新，并区别于标量损失重加权；推理时用延迟校准的出口策略从单一检查点提供多种预算。
AI.result: 给出融合超梯度刻画外层目标的重分配机制；评估框架结合等成本插值对比、有限更新诊断与固定逆时偏移算子，将多出口优化与波形及成像保真度关联。
AI.conclusion: MetaPOCS 为研究地震展开在部署预算下的重建—计算权衡提供了统一公式与评估框架。

title: Characterizing When Language Models Take Harmful Actions to Protect Their Assigned Goals
summary: Recent language model (LM) safety failures have largely been studied as disparate phenomena. In agentic misalignment, a model blackmails an executive to avoid being replaced. In alignment faking, it complies with harmful requests during training to keep its values from being modified. We argue that these behaviours share a common decision structure: a model assigned a goal must either take a harmful action to preserve it or refuse and lose it. We formalize this as a goal-harm conflict and present the same conflict under various elicitation protocols that range from compact forced-choice prompts to simulated agentic environments. These protocols span two perspectives on LM decision-making, which we term (i) the logit view, reading preferences from answer-token probabilities, and (ii) the sampling view, classifying open-ended responses with an LM judge. Under the logit view, we show that goal importance and harm severity additively shape how a model resolves these value conflicts. Under the sampling view, we derive two factorizations of the harmful-action probability that safety evaluations commonly report. The first measures how well a preference read from answer tokens carries over into behaviour, such as making a harmful tool call. The second attributes a low harmful-action rate either to refusal or to responses that reach no resolution. We then show how fictional context changes a model's preference under the logit view, and how tool use and partial observability -- two features of agentic evaluations -- change its harmful-action rate under the sampling view. Our work offers a descriptive framework for studying how LMs resolve such value conflicts and for estimating low-probability harmful actions at a finer granularity than the aggregate harm rates commonly reported in safety evaluations.

AI.tldr: 该论文将agentic misalignment、alignment faking等LM安全失效统一为"目标-伤害冲突"的决策结构，并用logit视角与sampling视角两套协议进行形式化与实证分析。
AI.motivation: 现有LM安全失效（如agentic misalignment中勒索、alignment faking中训练时顺从）多被当作彼此孤立的现象研究，缺乏统一解释框架，也难以细粒度估计低概率有害行为。
AI.method: 提出"目标-伤害冲突"形式化：模型被赋予目标后，要么采取有害行动以保留目标，要么拒绝并失去目标。在从强制选择提示到模拟agentic环境的多种诱导协议下呈现同一冲突，并区分(i)logit视角（从答案token概率读取偏好）与(ii)sampling视角（用LM judge分类开放式回答）。在sampling视角下推导有害行动概率的两种分解。
AI.result: logit视角下，目标重要性与伤害严重程度以可加方式塑造模型的价值冲突解决方式；sampling视角下，第一种分解衡量从答案token读出的偏好向行为（如有害工具调用）的迁移程度，第二种将低有害行动率归因于拒绝或无结论回答。虚构情境会改变logit视角下的偏好，工具使用与部分可观测性会改变sampling视角下的有害行动率。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了一个描述性框架，用于研究LM如何解决此类价值冲突，并能在比常见总体有害率更细的粒度上估计低概率有害行动。

title: TERA: Task-Evidence Restoration for Underwater Object Detection under Bandwidth-Constrained Transmission
summary: Underwater object detectors are typically evaluated on pre-transmission images, overlooking additional degradation from bandwidth-constrained downscaling and compression. We introduce AquaTX, a controlled benchmark built from real underwater detection datasets with seen and held-out codecs. We also propose TERA, a metadata-blind receiver-side framework combining task-guided pixel restoration and dual-state feature correction while keeping the detector frozen. Under seen compound degradation, TERA improves mean average precision (mAP50:95, averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95) from 37.7 to 50.0 on DUO-TX and from 31.5 to 41.3 on RUOD-TX relative to the frozen detector without restoration. TERA also preserves clean-input performance and remains competitive with detector fine-tuning under the held-out AVIF codec. These findings support transmission-aware evaluation and task-guided restoration for underwater object detection. Code is available at https://github.com/hijinkim/TERA.

AI.tldr: 论文提出水下检测的传输感知基准 AquaTX 与接收端框架 TERA，在冻结检测器的情况下通过任务引导的像素恢复与双态特征校正显著提升受传输退化影响的 mAP。
AI.motivation: 现有水下目标检测器通常在传输前的原始图像上评测，忽略了带宽受限导致的降采样与压缩带来的额外退化，导致评测与实际部署不符。
AI.method: 构建 AquaTX 基准：基于真实水下检测数据集，包含可见（seen）与留出（held-out）编解码器，进行受控评测。提出 TERA：元数据盲（metadata-blind）的接收端框架，结合任务引导的像素级恢复与双态特征校正，同时保持检测器冻结不训练。
AI.result: 在可见复合退化下，mAP50:95 在 DUO-TX 上由 37.7 提升至 50.0，在 RUOD-TX 上由 31.5 提升至 41.3（对比无恢复的冻结检测器）。同时保持干净输入性能，在留出 AVIF 编解码器下与检测器微调相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用传输感知的评测方式与任务引导的恢复方法用于水下目标检测；代码已开源于 https://github.com/hijinkim/TERA。

title: End-to-End Stability of Online Active Learning in Large-Scale Neural Systems
summary: Online Active Learning (OAL) aims to extend deep learning from static inference after offline training to continuous adaptation during real-time interaction with a changing physical environment. This transition is essential for safety-critical applications, but it raises a central theoretical question: whether the online parameter update process remains stable when scaled to multilayer neural architectures. This paper develops a stability-focused OAL framework. The framework uses prediction error as a feedback signal to update a structured deep model, thereby linking online learning with Lyapunov-based energy minimization. We show that prediction error convergence alone is insufficient for global parameter convergence because multilayer networks may admit high-dimensional manifolds of equivalent output solutions. The analysis therefore separates output error regulation, internal zero dynamics, interlayer coupling, and parameter convergence. Persistency of excitation and active damping are then used to remove the residual null-space modes that remain after output error convergence. A cascaded Lyapunov analysis establishes asymptotic stability of the overall OAL learning process, while monotonic activation functions and diffeomorphic layer mappings provide the uniqueness condition for the target parameter trajectory. The resulting proof provides a theoretical basis for applying online adaptive learning to large-scale neural systems in nonstationary and safety-critical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以稳定性为核心的在线主动学习（OAL）框架，用预测误差作反馈信号更新结构化深度模型，将在线学习与基于Lyapunov的能量最小化联系起来，并给出多层网络在线参数更新渐近稳定的理论证明。
AI.motivation: OAL需从离线训练后的静态推理扩展到与动态物理环境实时交互中的持续适应，这对安全攸关应用至关重要；但核心理论问题是：在线参数更新过程扩展到多层神经结构时是否仍保持稳定。
AI.method: 以预测误差为反馈更新结构化深度模型，构建Lyapunov能量最小化框架；指出仅预测误差收敛不足以保证全局参数收敛（多层网络可能存在等效输出的高维流形）；将分析分解为输出误差调节、内部零动态、层间耦合与参数收敛四部分；用持续激励（PE）与主动阻尼消除输出误差收敛后残余的零空间模态；采用级联Lyapunov分析证明渐近稳定性；以单调激活函数与微分同胚层映射给出目标参数轨迹的唯一性条件。
AI.result: 证明了整体OAL学习过程的渐近稳定性，并在单调激活与微分同胚层映射条件下得到目标参数轨迹的唯一性；同时表明单独的输出误差收敛无法推出参数收敛。
AI.conclusion: 该证明为在非平稳、安全攸关场景下将在线自适应学习应用于大规模神经系统提供了理论基础。

title: Blueprint2CAD: Benchmarking Foundation Models on Engineering Drawing-to-CAD Render Correspondence
summary: Engineering drawings specify mechanical parts through orthographic projections. Recognizing which part a drawing depicts underlies part search, design reuse, and digitization, yet no public benchmark measures whether vision models can do it. We introduce Blueprint2CAD, a benchmark for drawing-to-render correspondence: given an orthographic line drawing and a shaded render, usually from another viewpoint, decide whether they show the same part. Its data layer, BlueCAD-30K, applies an open drafting pipeline to 29,925 Zero-to-CAD models, adding view-aligned renders, clean and dimensioned drawings from six viewpoints, and surface-type metadata. Frozen encoders retrieve the matching part from a 10,000-model gallery with up to 65% Recall@1 when viewpoints are known but 43% when they are not, and the four encoders we test lie within six points of each other: viewpoint, not backbone, is the bottleneck. Six zero-shot vision-language models reach only 0.52-0.67 verification accuracy, with model-specific Yes/No biases that chain-of-thought shifts but does not remove; a quick LoRA fine-tuning on in-domain pairs improves verification accuracy by a few points but sharpens these biases and leaves the viewpoint failure intact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Blueprint2CAD 基准，用于评估视觉模型能否判断"正交工程图"与"三维渲染图"是否描绘同一零件；配套数据集 BlueCAD-30K 覆盖 29,925 个模型、多视角图纸与渲染图，实验表明视角是主要瓶颈，现有编码器和视觉语言模型表现均有限。
AI.motivation: 工程图通过正交投影描述机械零件，识别图纸所绘零件是零件检索、设计复用和数字化的基础，但此前缺乏公开基准来衡量视觉模型能否完成这一任务。
AI.method: 构建 Blueprint2CAD 基准（图纸—渲染对应判定任务）。其数据层 BlueCAD-30K 对 29,925 个 Zero-to-CAD 模型应用开放制图流水线，生成视角对齐渲染、六个视角的干净图与标注尺寸图，以及表面类型元数据。评估包括：冻结编码器在 10,000 模型库中的检索实验（比较四种骨干），以及六个零样本视觉语言模型的验证准确率测试，并辅以 LoRA 快速微调实验。
AI.result: 冻结编码器已知视角时 Recall@1 最高约 65%，未知视角时降至 43%；四种编码器差距在 6 个百分点内，说明瓶颈在视角而非骨干网络。六个零样本视觉语言模型验证准确率仅 0.52–0.67，并存在模型特定的 Yes/No 偏差，思维链可改变但无法消除该偏差；域内配对上的 LoRA 微调可提升数个百分点准确率，但会加剧偏差，且未解决视角失败问题。
AI.conclusion: Blueprint2CAD 提供了首个衡量工程图—渲染对应能力的公开基准，揭示视角泛化是核心难题，现有编码器与视觉语言模型均远未解决；微调收益有限且会放大偏差。该基准为后续研究提供了数据与评测基础。

title: Cross-Domain Joint-Embedding Pretraining For Heterogeneous Industrial Time Series
comment: Submitted to International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP) on Sept. 24, 2026
summary: Industrial predictive maintenance and manufacturing tasks frequently contain abundant sensor measurements, but with limited labeled data. We investigate cross-domain self-supervised pretraining using joint-embedding predictive architecture for heterogeneous industrial time series (JEPA-HITS), which learns one encoder from various domains such as battery, semiconductor chemical mechanical planarization (CMP), computer numerical control (CNC) machining, and bearing while preserving dataset-specific temporal scales. We evaluate representation reuse on regression and classification problems under reduced-label downstream training, and leave-one-domain-out (LODO) pretraining. Compared with the same architecture initialized randomly, LODO pretraining reduces RMSE from 10.72 to 7.95 on battery remaining useful life (RUL), 4.34 to 3.89 on CMP, and 13.53 to 11.72 on tool wear regression, while improving bearing fault diagnosis macro-F1 from 0.547 to 0.737. Overall results suggest that unlabeled time series measurements from heterogeneous industrial processes can provide reusable representations for downstream learning with limited labeled data.

AI.tldr: 提出JEPA-HITS：用联合嵌入预测架构在多种异构工业时间序列（电池、CMP、CNC、轴承）上做跨域自监督预训练，学习统一编码器并保留各数据集时间尺度，在少标签下游任务上验证表征可复用性。
AI.motivation: 工业预测性维护与制造场景有大量传感器数据但标注稀缺，需研究能否从异构工业过程的未标注时间序列中获得可迁移、可复用的表征。
AI.method: 跨域自监督预训练（JEPA-HITS）：以联合嵌入预测架构从多域数据训练单一编码器，并保持各数据集特有的时间尺度；通过留一域（LODO）预训练与随机初始化基线对比，在降标签条件下评估回归（电池RUL、CMP、刀具磨损）与分类（轴承故障诊断）任务。
AI.result: LODO预训练相对随机初始化：电池RUL的RMSE由10.72降至7.95，CMP由4.34降至3.89，刀具磨损回归由13.53降至11.72；轴承故障诊断macro-F1由0.547提升至0.737。
AI.conclusion: 异构工业过程的未标注时间序列可为少标签下游学习提供可复用表征，跨域自监督预训练在预测性维护与制造任务中有效。

title: Evaluating Synthetic Skin Lesion Images for Classifier Training: A Safety-Aware Algorithm
comment: 57 pages, 12 figures. Code to reproduce all experiments, along with links to the full Zenodo dataset and the synth-curator package, can be found at https://github.com/Amixdu/synth-curator-paper
summary: Skin cancer classifiers need large sets of annotated images, which are scarce, especially for rare lesion types. AI-generated images can fill the gap, but a generator produces images of widely varying quality, so selecting which images to retain is important. That choice usually rests on a single quality score, most often the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), which has not been tested against what a classifier needs and cannot tell whether the generator memorizes its training photographs. We test that practice with a tournament of 16 quality metrics. Each metric alone selects a training subset from a pool of 275,472 images generated by a diffusion model (EDM2), and a classifier trained on each subset scores the metric per class. The tournament shows that no single metric serves every class: FID computed on Inception features gives the best classifier for one lesion type and no measurable advantage over random sampling for another, and the generation setting it prefers is also the one closest to the training images. We turn these per-class measurements into a safety-aware evaluation algorithm that weights each metric by its measured value in each class and removes images too close to a real training image. On the held-out ISIC-2018 test set, the algorithm improves Macro-$F_2$, a recall-weighted measure of classification performance, over the FID baseline for a Swin-B classifier by +0.0136 to +0.0164 across four safety thresholds (Bonferroni-corrected $p < 0.02$) and over random sampling by about +0.03, though not for ResNet-50. Tightening the threshold improves a memorization-safety score with no measurable change in utility, but every curated set remains less safe than random sampling. The results show a modest but statistically significant gain on the primary classifier, and offer a practical, safety-aware procedure for evaluating and using synthetic data.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过16种质量指标的“锦标赛”实验证明，单一指标（如FID）无法适用于所有皮肤病变类别，并提出一种按类别测量指标价值并剔除过度接近真实训练图像的安全感知筛选算法，在ISIC-2018上使Swin-B的Macro-F2较FID基线提升约0.0136–0.0164。
AI.motivation: 皮肤癌分类器缺乏大规模标注图像，稀有病变尤甚；合成图像可补足数据，但生成图像质量参差，必须挑选保留哪些图像。现有做法通常依赖单一质量分数（最常见为FID），然而FID从未针对分类器需求进行验证，也无法判断生成器是否记忆了训练照片。
AI.method: 用扩散模型EDM2生成275,472张图像的池；开展16种质量指标的锦标赛，每个指标单独从池中选出训练子集并训练分类器，按类别为各指标打分；据此构建安全感知评估算法，在每个类别内按实测价值加权各指标，并剔除与真实训练图像过近的图像；在ISIC-2018测试集上以Swin-B与ResNet-50评估。
AI.result: 无单一指标适用于所有类别：Inception特征上的FID在某类病变上给出最佳分类器，在另一类上相对随机采样无可测优势，且其偏好的生成设置恰是离训练图像最近的设置。所提算法在ISIC-2018上使Swin-B的Macro-F2较FID基线提升+0.0136至+0.0164（四个安全阈值，Bonferroni校正后p<0.02），较随机采样提升约+0.03，但对ResNet-50无效。收紧阈值可提升记忆安全分且效用无显著变化，但所有精选集的安全性仍不及随机采样。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在主要分类器上取得幅度不大但统计显著的提升，并提供了一套实用、安全感知的合成数据评估与使用流程；FID等单一指标不足以作为选图标准，记忆风险仍需重视。

title: Semantic Caches for LLM Web Services Leave Their Error Budget Unspent
summary: Web services built on large language models (LLMs) receive many paraphrases of earlier queries, which a semantic cache answers from stored responses. A reused answer can be wrong, so wrong answers must stay below a share $δ$ of the queries. Existing caches reuse above a fixed similarity threshold or, like vCache, learn a per-entry rule that bounds each query's error by $δ$. However, fixed thresholds break the budget on new streams, and per-entry rules need labels on every entry before reusing it. We find an unspent error budget, as vCache realizes only 12-55% of $δ$ on three public query streams. Surplus spends this budget where reuse is most likely correct. It ranks queries by a risk score shared across paraphrase clusters and opens risk bins as far as an audited error estimate allows. Free labels from every LLM call and a ledger of realized errors keep this threshold safe under drift. On five streams, including ORCAS search queries, Surplus holds $δ$ in every test cell, which no baseline does. On the shuffled streams it serves 40% more hits than vCache, and its pooled hit rate beats the best baseline holding $δ$ in each cell by 4.10 points. In a vLLM testbed it cuts the mean latency by 31.59% at the highest load, against 23.67% for vCache.

AI.tldr: Surplus 是一种语义缓存方法，通过风险分箱和误差预算记账，在保证错误率低于 δ 的前提下提升 LLM 查询的缓存命中率。
AI.motivation: 现有语义缓存要么用固定相似度阈值（在新数据流上会突破错误预算），要么像 vCache 那样为每条缓存条目学习规则（需要每条条目都有标签才能复用）。作者发现 vCache 只用掉了 12-55% 的 δ 错误预算，存在未被利用的预算空间。
AI.method: 将剩余错误预算花在复用最可能正确的地方：用跨复述簇共享的风险分数对查询排序，按审计得到的误差估计逐步开放风险分箱；利用每次 LLM 调用获得的免费标签和已实现误差的记账本，在数据漂移下保持阈值安全。
AI.result: 在五个数据流（含 ORCAS 搜索查询）上，Surplus 在每个测试单元都把错误率控制在 δ 以内，而所有基线都无法做到。在打乱的数据流上命中数比 vCache 多 40%，合并命中率比在各单元都守住 δ 的最佳基线高 4.10 个百分点。在 vLLM 测试环境中最高负载下平均延迟降低 31.59%，而 vCache 为 23.67%。
AI.conclusion: Surplus 通过更充分地利用错误预算，在严格保证错误率上限的同时显著提升了缓存命中率和降低延迟，优于现有语义缓存方案。

title: Gnomon4D: Learning Where and When to Focus for Geometric Motion-Grounded World-Action Modeling
summary: World-action models (WAMs) use video-generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Yet RGB futures entangle physical state changes with appearance, while frame-wise depth and point maps lack temporal correspondence. Existing 4D approaches either keep motion implicit in visual features or translate predicted traces into actions through a separate interface. We present Gnomon4D, a WAM that jointly generates future video, robot actions, and GeoDelta, a video-aligned 4D geometric motion field encoding the cross-frame image-plane displacement and depth change of embodiment and object points. By placing embodiment motion and object responses in a shared space, GeoDelta exposes their motion relations to the action expert at inference. Interaction-Salient Attention (InSAttn) uses these relations to focus spatial readout on task-relevant interaction regions, while Transition-Anchored Aggregation (TransAgg) aggregates evidence around changes in their relative motion, such as grasp and release. GeoDelta describes surface motion independently of embodiment-specific controls, providing a shared human--robot quasi-action for action-free pretraining on EgoManip-5000H followed by robot mid-training on Robot-30H. Gnomon4D leads on RoboTwin~2.0, VLABench, and RoboDojo, and outperforms the strongest real-robot baseline by 7.0 and 16.0 percentage points under in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, respectively.

AI.tldr: Gnomon4D 是一个世界-动作模型，同时生成未来视频、机器人动作以及视频对齐的 4D 几何运动场 GeoDelta（编码跨帧图像平面位移与深度变化），并通过 InSAttn 与 TransAgg 将具身-物体运动关系显式提供给动作专家，实现人-机器人共享准动作的预训练，在 RoboTwin 2.0、VLABench、RoboDojo 上领先。
AI.motivation: 现有 WAM 用视频生成先验联合预测观测与动作，但 RGB 未来把物理状态变化与外观纠缠；逐帧深度/点图缺乏时序对应；已有 4D 方法要么把运动隐含在视觉特征里，要么用独立接口把预测轨迹转成动作，运动与动作之间缺少显式、共享的表达。
AI.method: 提出 Gnomon4D，联合生成未来视频、动作与 GeoDelta——一个视频对齐的 4D 几何运动场，编码具身点与物体点的跨帧图像平面位移和深度变化，把二者置于共享空间。推理时将运动关系暴露给动作专家：Interaction-Salient Attention 用于把空间读出聚焦到任务相关交互区域，Transition-Anchored Aggregation 在相对运动变化（如抓取、释放）附近聚合证据。GeoDelta 与具身控制无关，可作为人-机器人共享准动作：先在 EgoManip-5000H 上做无动作预训练，再在 Robot-30H 上做机器人中训练。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、VLABench 和 RoboDojo 上均取得领先；相比最强真实机器人基线，在分布内与分布外设置下分别高出 7.0 和 16.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以显式 4D 几何运动作为视频与动作之间的共享中间表示，可提升交互区域的注意与关键转折的聚合，并支持跨具身（人类视频→机器人）的可扩展预训练，显著增强策略的泛化能力。

title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative decoding is deployment-specific, and no universal optimization fits every serving regime, drafter, target model and GPU. To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment. In each round, a cost model locates the largest gaps between the current system and its ceiling. Parallel agents explore directions and integrate the successful ones. Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. A structured memory carries validated mechanisms to new rounds and deployments. SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms. We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks. Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46$\times$ to 10.87$\times$ with one request, and from 1.94$\times$ to 3.93$\times$ with batching.

AI.tldr: SpecPilot 是一个自主智能体循环，为每种部署自动发现算法与系统优化，把并行推测解码相对自回归解码的加速比从 stock 的 4.46×/1.94× 提升到 10.87×/3.93×。
AI.motivation: 并行推测解码理论上可一次前向起草整块 token，但现有发布系统未能兑现全部加速潜力。作者指出三大挑战：单请求场景每步接受 token 少却需读取全部目标权重；批处理场景每请求验证开销使加速比大约减半；推测解码高度依赖部署，没有通用优化适用于所有服务场景、drafter、目标模型与 GPU。
AI.method: 提出 SpecPilot 自主智能体循环，为每个具体部署搜索算法与系统优化。每轮用成本模型定位当前系统与理论上限之间差距最大的环节，多个并行智能体探索方向并整合成功方案；通过 token forcing 逐 token 对照 stock 输出以检测 reward hacking；用结构化记忆把已验证机制传递到新一轮与新部署。实际发现 12-bit 无损权重格式、面向混合循环目标的树验证、两级验证和三种批处理机制。
AI.result: 在四种目标模型、三种 drafter、两种 GPU 平台和五个基准上评估。无需训练、不损失质量，单请求加速比从 stock 的 4.46× 提升至 10.87×，批处理场景从 1.94× 提升至 3.93×。
AI.conclusion: 针对推测解码的部署特异性，用自动化智能体搜索替代人工通用优化是可行且有效的，可在无损前提下显著逼近并行推测解码的加速上限，且发现的机制可跨轮次与跨部署复用。

title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
summary: Computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives, for example, conditional statements or loops, but in different orders to implement different algorithms. In contrast, existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. We introduce Library of Layers (LoL), an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. LoL has a single hyperparameter, the size of its global library of transformer blocks, that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity, generalizing the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. We show that LoL achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. On synthetic sudoku and maze data, we observe that the model employs distinct layer orderings to implement different solution strategies, and we can intervene on routing to force a model to apply a specific solution strategy to a problem instance. In a multilingual natural language setting, we find that LoL chooses different layer order patterns based on language and script. Similarly, we train LoL on safety data and fit probes to its router outputs, finding that these probes distinguish safe from unsafe text with high AUROC. LoL provides a path toward a future in which models dynamically compose their own computational graph, enabling more efficient and controllable reasoning.

AI.tldr: LoL 提出让 Transformer 在推理时动态决定层（transformer block）的执行顺序，用一个全局"层库"大小作为唯一超参数，统一了稠密、深度循环与 MoE 三类架构的参数/FLOPs 效率权衡，并在文本、数独迷宫、多语言与安全数据上展示了可解释、可干预的路由行为。
AI.motivation: 程序员通过以不同顺序组合相同的可复用计算原语（条件、循环等）实现不同算法，而现有语言模型各层执行顺序固定，缺乏这种"动态组合计算图"的能力。作者希望模型在推理时能根据问题自行编排层序，从而在参数复用与稀疏性之间灵活权衡，并提升效率与可控性。
AI.method: 提出 Library of Layers（LoL）：维护一个全局的 transformer block 库，推理时由路由器动态选择并排序要执行的层。唯一超参数是全局层库大小，通过调节它可在参数复用（接近深度循环/稠密）与稀疏（接近 MoE）之间平滑过渡，形成统一的架构家族。实验包括：文本预训练、合成数独与迷宫任务、多语言自然语言、安全数据，并在路由器输出上拟合探针。
AI.result: 在文本预训练上，LoL 与稠密、深度循环、MoE 三类基线性能相当；在数独与迷宫任务中，模型针对不同解法策略采用不同的层序，且可通过干预路由强制模型对某实例使用指定策略；多语言场景下，层序模式随语言与文字系统变化；安全数据上，基于路由器输出的探针能以高 AUROC 区分安全与不安全文本。
AI.conclusion: LoL 证明了模型可以动态构建自身计算图：一个统一的层库架构即可覆盖多种效率权衡，且其路由具有可解释性与可操控性。这为更高效、更可控的推理模型提供了方向，但摘要未给出规模、训练成本与稳健性的详细量化结果。

title: Fast-Slow Evolutionary Occupancy Prediction via Controlled Dynamics
summary: 3D semantic occupancy prediction provides dense geometric and semantic scene representations for autonomous driving, where both high accuracy and low response latency are crucial for safe downstream forecasting and planning. Existing methods usually exhibit different accuracy-latency characteristics. Performance-oriented models provide stronger geometric and semantic predictions, while deployment-friendly models provide faster responses. This motivates EvoOcc, a fast-slow evolutionary occupancy prediction framework that jointly exploits their complementary strengths to improve the accuracy-latency balance without changing the upstream architectures. EvoOcc models evolutionary occupancy prediction as a continuous time controlled dynamical system, enabling flexible adaptation to variable slow system delays and irregular fast system arrivals. The framework further decomposes the evolution process into dual state evolution where ego state evolution compensates for the deterministic coordinate shifts and scene state evolution models the genuine geometric and semantic scene changes. Extensive experiments on three different fast-slow system pairs and irregular prediction arrivals show that EvoOcc consistently improves over fast system baselines while maintaining much lower latency than the slow system, indicating a favorable accuracy-latency balance and stable behavior under practical inference situations.

AI.tldr: EvoOcc is a fast-slow evolutionary framework for 3D semantic occupancy prediction that fuses performance-oriented and deployment-friendly models to improve the accuracy-latency balance without changing upstream architectures.
AI.motivation: In autonomous driving, occupancy prediction needs both high accuracy and low latency. Existing methods fall into a trade-off: performance-oriented models are accurate but slow, while deployment-friendly models are fast but less accurate.
AI.method: EvoOcc models evolutionary occupancy prediction as a continuous time-controlled dynamical system, allowing flexible adaptation to variable slow system delays and irregular fast system arrivals. It decomposes evolution into dual state evolution: ego state evolution compensates deterministic coordinate shifts, and scene state evolution models genuine geometric and semantic scene changes.
AI.result: Experiments on three fast-slow system pairs and under irregular prediction arrivals show EvoOcc consistently improves over fast system baselines while maintaining much lower latency than the slow system.
AI.conclusion: EvoOcc achieves a favorable accuracy-latency balance and stable behavior under practical inference conditions.

title: RLVR Sharpens the Pencil, Not the Mind
summary: Models like DeepSeek-R1 made Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) famous: reward a model for correct answers and it gets dramatically better at reasoning without being taught how. The leading explanation is sharpening---that the base model already knows how to solve these problems and RLVR just makes it more likely to reach for its best solution paths. This has only ever been checked by comparing before and after training, never by watching what changes inside across it. We tracked OLMo-2-1B across all 13 training checkpoints on GSM8K. First-try accuracy climbs from 58.0% to 61.3%, but ask the model 256 times and solution coverage actually rises from 94.5% to 96.9%, proving the knowledge was already there. We then planted reasoning mistakes into problems and trained simple probes to detect them. Those probes held between AUROC 0.798 and 0.840 across all 13 checkpoints and 3 error types, a spread smaller than the confidence interval; the model never builds a sharper internal picture of what a reasoning mistake looks like. The one place we find real internal change is at the final answer token, where a probe distinguishing early from late checkpoints hits an AUROC of 0.93, while the same probe on the actual reasoning steps lands near chance. RLVR makes the model lead with its best thinking. It does not change what that thinking is.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在 OLMo-2-1B 全部 13 个训练检查点上追踪 GSM8K 表现，检验 RLVR 的"锐化假说"。结果显示首次尝试准确率仅从 58.0% 升至 61.3%，但 256 次采样的解覆盖率从 94.5% 升至 96.9%，说明知识本就存在；检测推理错误的探针在整个训练过程中的 AUROC 稳定在 0.798–0.840，几乎没有变化；唯一显著的内部变化出现在最终答案 token（区分早期/晚期检查点的 AUROC 达 0.93），而推理步骤上接近随机。结论：RLVR 只是让模型优先采用已有最佳思路，而非改变思路本身。
AI.motivation: RLVR 为何能大幅提升推理能力，主流解释是"锐化"——基座模型已具备解题能力，RLVR 只是让它更倾向采用最优解路径。但以往研究仅通过训练前后对比来间接验证，从未在训练过程中观察内部表征如何变化。作者希望用训练全程的检查点追踪，直接检验这一假说。
AI.method: 在 OLMo-2-1B 全部 13 个 RLVR 训练检查点上，于 GSM8K 上评估：(1) 首次尝试准确率与 256 次采样的解覆盖率；(2) 向题目中注入推理错误并训练简单线性探针，检测模型内部是否形成对"推理错误"的更清晰表征；(3) 用区分早期与晚期检查点的探针，定位内部变化发生在哪个位置（最终答案 token vs. 推理步骤）。
AI.result: 首次尝试准确率从 58.0% 升至 61.3%，而 256 次采样的解覆盖率从 94.5% 升至 96.9%，证明相关知识早已存在。错误检测探针在全部 13 个检查点和 3 类错误上 AUROC 稳定在 0.798–0.840，波动小于置信区间，说明模型并未建立更锐利的错误内部表征。唯一实际内部变化出现在最终答案 token：区分早/晚期检查点的探针 AUROC 达 0.93，而同一探针在推理步骤上接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: RLVR 的作用是让模型"优先使用其最佳思考"（lead with its best thinking），而非改变思考内容本身。这为"锐化假说"提供了迄今最直接的训练全程证据，并表明内部变化主要集中于答案生成环节而非推理过程。

title: Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
summary: Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. We introduce Sonar-MoE, which updates each expert tensor during the backward pass and frees its gradient right away. It brings optimizer-in-backward from dense models to batched MoE expert tensors, so the GPU never holds more than one layer of expert gradients. When we fine-tune OLMoE-1B-7B and Granite-3.1-3B-A800M in bf16 with two expert-kernel backends, Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory by 19% to 22%. Its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert gradient clipping, and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of all baselines. Each step also takes 17% to 23% less time than standard training with global-norm clipping. Updating whole batched tensors rather than individual experts is what keeps Sonar-MoE fast, as it avoids a 20% to 72% slowdown while using the same memory. Sonar-MoE matches optimizer-in-backward over all parameters in memory and speed while still clipping the dense parameters.

AI.tldr: Sonar-MoE 在反向传播中直接更新每个专家张量并立即释放其梯度，使 GPU 最多只保留一层专家梯度，在保持与标准训练等价精度的同时将峰值显存降低 19%~22%、每步时间减少 17%~23%。
AI.motivation: MoE 模型的绝大多数参数位于专家中，标准训练需将所有专家梯度保存在显存直到优化器步，显存开销随专家数量与规模增长，随模型扩展而恶化。
AI.method: 将原先用于稠密模型的 optimizer-in-backward 技术迁移到批量化的 MoE 专家张量：在反向传播过程中对整个批量专家张量进行更新并立即释放梯度，避免按单个专家逐个更新（后者会带来 20%~72% 的减速）；同时仍可对稠密参数做梯度裁剪。
AI.result: 在 bf16 下微调 OLMoE-1B-7B 与 Granite-3.1-3B-A800M（两种专家 kernel 后端），峰值显存降低 19%~22%；无专家梯度裁剪时更新与标准训练逐位一致，留出集损失差异不超过 0.003；比带全局范数裁剪的标准训练每步快 17%~23%。
AI.conclusion: Sonar-MoE 在显存与速度上可媲美对所有参数做 optimizer-in-backward 的方案，同时保留对稠密参数的梯度裁剪，是一种面向 MoE 扩展的高效训练方法。

title: QFacePlacement: From Arbitrary Tensorization to Semantic Spatial Correspondence in Modern Face Verification
comment: Accepted at 11th International Conference on Computer Vision & Image Processing (CVIP)
summary: Quantum-inspired computer vision often reshapes high-dimensional features into tensors and applies tensor-network models. In face verification, this can be misleading: modern embeddings are optimized for cosine similarity, and tensorization alone does not establish the low-rank structure needed for tensor trains or matrix-product operators (MPOs). We study model placement through two controlled interfaces. First, cross-model embedding alignment requires a 512 x 512 operator to map AdaFace embeddings into ArcFace space. Dense Ridge and Procrustes mappings remain strong, while deterministic TT-SVD and MPO compression underperform even with basis changes and low-rank residuals. At a 64K-parameter storage budget, mean directional AUC is 0.9297 for dense Ridge, 0.8952 for rank-64 SVD, 0.8685 for the best low-rank-MPO hybrid, and approximately 0.649 for raw MPO. Second, before global pooling, we construct a 7 x 7 x 7 x 7 probe-gallery correspondence tensor from local AdaFace descriptors. A geometry-aware symmetric tensor train with bond dimension 2 uses 122 trainable parameters, compared with 2,403 for a dense linear matcher, while attaining an LFW AUC of 0.9802. Yet compression does not translate into better low-false-acceptance performance: on CFP-FP, TAR at FAR = 0.001 is 0.0102 versus 0.1734 for global cosine matching, and on CPLFW it is 0.7805 versus 0.8737. These results suggest that quantum-inspired factorization is most credible when the chosen interface provides task-aligned axes and compressible structure. They also show why aggregate AUC must be assessed alongside operational low-FAR metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两个受控接口研究量子启发张量网络在人脸验证中的"模型放置"问题：跨模型嵌入对齐与池化前的局部描述子匹配。结果表明，张量因子化只在接口提供任务对齐轴和可压缩结构时才可信，且聚合AUC必须与低FAR操作指标一并评估。
AI.motivation: 量子启发计算机视觉常将高维特征重塑为张量并套用张量网络模型，但现代人脸嵌入是针对余弦相似度优化的，仅靠张量化并不能建立张量列（TT）或矩阵乘积算子（MPO）所需的低秩结构，因此需要系统考察模型应放在何处。
AI.method: 设计两个受控接口：(1) 用512×512算子做AdaFace到ArcFace的跨模型嵌入对齐，对比稠密Ridge、Procrustes、确定性TT-SVD、MPO压缩及低秩残差混合；(2) 在全局池化前，由局部AdaFace描述子构造7×7×7×7的probe-gallery对应张量，使用几何感知对称张量列（bond dimension 2）。
AI.result: 接口一：64K参数预算下，平均方向AUC为稠密Ridge 0.9297、rank-64 SVD 0.8952、最佳低秩MPO混合0.8685、原始MPO约0.649，稠密映射依旧最强。接口二：对称TT仅122个可训练参数（稠密线性匹配器为2,403），LFW AUC达0.9802；但CFP-FP上FAR=0.001时TAR仅0.0102（全局余弦为0.1734），CPLFW上为0.7805（全局余弦0.8737）。
AI.conclusion: 量子启发因子化的可信度取决于接口是否具备任务对齐的轴与可压缩结构；压缩带来的参数与AUC优势并不转化为低FAR下的操作性优势，因此聚合AUC必须与低FAR指标联合评估。

title: Beyond $L_\infty$-Norm Sets: Synthesizing Interpretable Non-Uniform Uncertainty Sets for Evaluation-Time State-Adversarial Robustness
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents are vulnerable to perturbations of their observed state inputs. Prior works often constrain state adversaries with $L_p$-norm uncertainty sets and evaluate policy performance under the resulting perturbations. However, in continuous control tasks like robotics control, different state dimensions have distinct physical meanings and influence policy behavior to different degrees, which $L_p$-norm sets fail to capture or explain. Moreover, it is important to identify when and along which state dimensions a policy is vulnerable, independently of the algorithm used to train it. In this paper, we focus on evaluation-time attacks applied to pretrained policies. We propose \textbf{P}erformance-\textbf{D}egradation \textbf{N}on-\textbf{U}niform \textbf{U}ncertainty \textbf{S}et (\method{}), an interpretable formulation of uncertainty sets for state perturbations. \method{} is state-dependent, dimension-wise non-uniform, and can be synthesized online during policy evaluation. We first formulate an ideal constrained optimization problem for \method{} computation, then introduce a surrogate constraint to make the problem tractable. Experiments across multiple continuous-control environments, policy algorithms, and state attacks show that \method{} reveals variation in policy sensitivity across states and dimensions, while its performance degradation is moderately controlled.

AI.tldr: 提出 P-DNUS，一种可解释、状态依赖且逐维非均匀的状态扰动不确定性集，用于评估预训练 DRL 策略在连续控制任务中的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作用 Lp 范数不确定性集约束状态对抗扰动，但连续控制任务中各状态维度物理含义不同、对策略影响程度不同，Lp 范数无法刻画或解释这一点；同时需要独立于训练算法地识别策略何时、沿哪些维度脆弱。
AI.method: 聚焦对预训练策略的评估时攻击；提出 P-DNUS，构造状态依赖、维度间非均匀的不确定性集并可在策略评估中在线合成；先形式化一个理想约束优化问题，再引入代理约束使其可求解。
AI.result: 在多个连续控制环境、多种策略算法与状态攻击上的实验表明，P-DNUS 能揭示策略在不同状态和维度上的敏感性差异，同时其造成的性能退化被适度控制。
AI.conclusion: P-DNUS 为状态扰动提供了更可解释的评估方式，可定位策略脆弱的状态维度，且不依赖具体训练算法。

title: CellPlex: Benchmarking Single-Cell Spatial Proteomics Prediction from H&E
summary: Spatial proteomics measures tens of proteins in every cell of a tissue section, but its cost confines it to small research cohorts, whereas hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E) slides exist for nearly every patient. Inferring single-cell spatial proteomics from H\&E would bring its analyses to routine pathology, and a growing number of virtual staining models pursue this goal. Each is evaluated on its own cohort, panel and pixel-level metric, and released models transfer poorly to new cohorts, leaving open which approach to build on and which proteins H\&E can reveal. We introduce CellPlex, a benchmark that poses the task at the level of the cell: seven cohorts with same-section H\&E and multiplexed immunofluorescence, from colorectal and breast cancer to lymph-node metastases, bone marrow and glioma, with 717 samples, 44.8 million cells and 149 proteins, processed by one pipeline into per-cell targets. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) are adapted with one cell-level protocol, specialist models are fine-tuned under a matched budget, and all are scored on the same cells. Adapted PFMs are the most accurate models on every cohort, ahead of the specialists even after fine-tuning, but keep less than half of their accuracy on cohorts they were not trained on. Which proteins can be predicted depends on the tissue, not on how many cells were measured for them. By fixing the cells, targets and splits on which predictions are judged, CellPlex sets a common standard for inferring costly molecular measurements from routine H\&E and shows how far H\&E can stand in for spatial proteomics. We will release the data, splits, evaluation code and baselines as a testbed for developing and comparing future pathology foundation models and virtual staining methods.

AI.tldr: CellPlex基准将H&E预测空间蛋白组学统一到细胞层面，用7个队列、717样本、4480万细胞、149种蛋白评测，发现适配的病理基础模型在各队列最准，但跨队列泛化不足一半。
AI.motivation: 空间蛋白组学成本高只能用于小队列，而H&E切片几乎每个病人都有；现有虚拟染色模型各自用不同队列、蛋白panel和像素级指标评测，无法比较哪种方法更好、H&E到底能揭示哪些蛋白。
AI.method: 构建CellPlex基准：7个同时具备H&E与多重免疫荧光的队列（结直肠癌、乳腺癌、淋巴结转移、骨髓、胶质瘤），717个样本、4480万细胞、149种蛋白，统一流程处理为单细胞目标；用同一细胞级协议适配病理基础模型（PFM），并在匹配预算下微调专用模型，所有模型在相同细胞上评分。
AI.result: 适配的PFM在每个队列上都是最准确的模型，即使专用模型微调后仍落后；但PFM在未训练队列上仅保留不足一半的准确率。可预测哪些蛋白取决于组织类型，而非测得的细胞数量。
AI.conclusion: CellPlex通过固定细胞、目标与划分，为从常规H&E推断昂贵分子测量建立共同标准，界定H&E可在多大程度上替代空间蛋白组学，并将公开数据、划分、评测代码与基线作为未来PFM与虚拟染色方法的测试平台。

title: Whitened Advantage Summation Policy Optimization: Correlation-Aware Aggregation for Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning for language models often combines several rewards by normalizing each one and adding them with fixed weights. When the rewards are correlated, the variation they share is counted once for every reward that carries it. In terms of the ZCA-decorrelated components of the reward signal, the weighted sum applies weights $Σ^{1/2} w$ rather than the chosen weights $w$, where $Σ$ is the reward correlation matrix. We study WAS-PO, which whitens the normalized advantages with $Σ^{-1/2}$ before adding them, so that the chosen weights apply to those components. We derive the scalarized objective whose gradient it follows when normalization statistics are held fixed, show that its weights on the raw rewards can be negative, give an exact two-reward condition under which the lighter-weighted reward is reversed, and give a loose bound on the error from estimating $Σ$ during training. On tool calling with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, WAS-PO reached a higher mean training reward than GDPO in all seven seeds with three rewards (3.8% higher) and all three seeds with four (3.9% higher). WAS-PO also replaces GDPO's per-prompt normalization with batch-level normalization, and we did not separate the two changes with three or four rewards. The training-reward gains did not carry over to held-out accuracy, which was slightly lower than GDPO's with three rewards (not significant) and 0.03 lower in absolute terms with four (two seeds evaluated). With two rewards, WAS-PO trailed GDPO in training reward, and a three-seed control weakly suggests that the gap comes from batch-level normalization rather than whitening. In a math setting where the two rewards were nearly identical by construction, WAS-PO drove down the lighter-weighted reward, as the sign condition predicts.

AI.tldr: 提出WAS-PO：在组合多奖励时先用奖励协方差矩阵的逆平方根对归一化优势做白化再加权，使选定权重作用于去相关分量；给出其标量化目标的梯度分析、负权重条件与估计误差界，实验显示训练奖励提升但并未转化为held-out准确率提升。
AI.motivation: RL训练语言模型常将多个奖励各自归一化后以固定权重相加。当奖励相关时，共享的变异被每个携带它的奖励重复计入；从ZCA去相关分量看，加权和实际施加的权重是Σ^{1/2}w而非选定的w（Σ为奖励相关矩阵），导致权重语义失真。
AI.method: WAS-PO用Σ^{-1/2}对归一化优势白化后再相加，使选定权重作用于去相关分量；并把GDPO的逐prompt归一化改为batch级归一化。理论部分：在归一化统计固定时推导其梯度所遵循的标量化目标，证明其作用于原始奖励上的权重可能为负，给出“轻权重奖励被反转”的两奖励精确条件，并给出训练中估计Σ所致误差的宽松界。
AI.result: 工具调用任务（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct）：三个奖励时7个种子均超过GDPO，平均训练奖励高3.8%；四个奖励时3个种子均超过，高3.9%。但增益未迁移到held-out准确率：三奖励略低于GDPO（不显著），四奖励绝对低0.03（仅两个种子评估）。两奖励时WAS-PO训练奖励落后于GDPO，三种子对照弱提示差距来自batch级归一化而非白化。数学设定中两奖励近乎相同，WAS-PO如符号条件预测压低了轻权重奖励。
AI.conclusion: 白化可修复相关奖励下加权和的权重语义偏差并提升训练奖励，但训练奖励提升不等同于泛化提升；且实验未能分离白化与batch级归一化两项改动，两奖励情形下甚至有害，需进一步消融与更广验证。

title: Latent Spectral Prompting for Multimodal Hyperspectral Object Tracking
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
summary: Hyperspectral videos provide rich spectral signatures for robust tracking under challenging conditions such as camouflage and low illumination. However, limited hyperspectral annotations and the large RGB-hyperspectral domain gap hinder the direct use of modern temporally pretrained RGB trackers. We propose SProTrack, a multimodal framework that transfers temporal knowledge from pretrained RGB trackers to the hyperspectral domain through latent spectral prompting. The key idea is to decouple temporal modeling from spectral adaptation, allowing temporal dynamics to be inherited from RGB foundation models while hyperspectral information is learned from unlabeled data in a self-supervised manner. Unlike band-selection methods that discard most spectral information or prompt-based approaches that rely on local-search crops, SProTrack learns a global, scene-level spectral representation from the full hyperspectral frame using an autoencoder. This latent representation is used to guide spectral prompt extraction while a pretrained RGB tracker preserves strong temporal modeling on RGB-compatible inputs. By encoding spectral-spatial structure into compact latent prompts, SProTrack bridges the RGB-hyperspectral modality gap without extensive retraining or dense supervision. Experiments on HOT2020 and HOT2023 demonstrate that SProTrack achieves the best overall performance, with strong results across all spectral domains.

AI.tldr: SProTrack 通过隐空间光谱提示将预训练 RGB 跟踪器的时间知识迁移到高光谱域，实现无需大量标注的高光谱视频跟踪。
AI.motivation: 高光谱视频在伪装、低照度等挑战场景下具有优势，但高光谱标注稀缺，且 RGB 与高光谱存在巨大域间差异，导致现代时序预训练 RGB 跟踪器无法直接使用。
AI.method: 提出解耦时间建模与光谱适应的多模态框架：用自编码器从完整高光谱帧学习全局、场景级光谱表征，以自监督方式从无标注数据学习，并用于引导光谱提示提取；预训练 RGB 跟踪器在 RGB 兼容输入上保留强时序建模能力。区别于丢弃光谱信息的波段选择法和依赖局部搜索裁剪的提示方法。
AI.result: 在 HOT2020 与 HOT2023 数据集上取得最佳整体性能，并在各光谱域上表现稳定出色。
AI.conclusion: 将光谱-空间结构编码为紧凑隐空间提示，可在无需大量重训练和密集监督的情况下弥合 RGB-高光谱模态鸿沟。

title: Adaptive Localization of Knowledge Negation for Continual LLM Unlearning
comment: 24 pages. Published at ICML 2025. Code: https://github.com/zaocan666/ALKN
summary: With the growing deployment of large language models (LLMs) across diverse domains, concerns regarding their safety have grown substantially. LLM unlearning has emerged as a pivotal approach to removing harmful or unlawful content while maintaining utility. Despite increasing interest, the challenges of continual unlearning, which is common in real-world scenarios, remain underexplored. Successive unlearning tasks often lead to intensified utility degradation. To effectively unlearn targeted knowledge while preserving LLM utility, it is essential to minimize changes in model parameters by selectively updating those linked to the target knowledge, thereby ensuring other knowledge remains unaffected. Building on the task vector framework, we propose a new method named ALKN (Adaptive Localization of Knowledge Negation), which uses dynamic masking to sparsify training gradients and adaptively adjusts unlearning intensity based on inter-task relationships. Comprehensive experiments across three well-established LLM unlearning datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms baseline methods in both unlearning effectiveness and utility retention under continual unlearning settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 ALKN 方法，基于任务向量框架，用动态掩码稀疏化梯度并按任务间关系自适应调整遗忘强度，缓解持续遗忘中的效用退化。
AI.motivation: LLM 部署广泛，安全需求推动机器遗忘研究；但真实场景中常见的"持续遗忘"（连续多次遗忘任务）研究不足，连续遗忘任务会导致模型效用显著退化，需要只更新与目标知识相关的参数以减少副作用。
AI.method: 基于任务向量（task vector）框架的 ALKN（自适应知识否定定位）：1) 动态掩码（dynamic masking）对训练梯度进行稀疏化，仅更新与目标知识相关的参数；2) 根据任务间关系自适应调整遗忘强度。
AI.result: 在三个主流 LLM 遗忘数据集上，持续遗忘设定下，该方法在遗忘有效性和效用保持两方面均稳定优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性、稀疏的参数更新并结合任务间关系自适应调节，可在连续遗忘场景中实现目标知识移除与模型效用保持的更好平衡。

title: MedHEB: Benchmarking Medical Embeddings Across Heterogeneous Clinical Evidence
summary: Clinical evidence is inherently relational: medical images are interpreted with prior studies, cross-modal examinations, reports, and localized findings, and retrieving relevant evidence is therefore central to clinical interpretation. Recent foundation models increasingly encode these heterogeneous sources into shared embedding spaces, yet existing embedding evaluation often focuses on isolated matches, leaving unclear whether current models retrieve relevant evidence across changes in modality, appearance, and granularity.
