We introduce MedHEB, a unified benchmark with 107 retrieval tasks from 54 datasets, including both in-distribution and held-out-source evaluation, across three axes: evidence form (2D images, 3D volumes, text), pairing type (image--image, image--text, text--text, and modality-bridging visual matching), and relevance granularity (global, question-conditioned, region-level). Under a single ranking protocol, MedHEB varies clinically relevant evidence definitions to test whether embedding proximity remains meaningful across heterogeneous evidence, including modality-bridging visual retrieval and region-level text-to-region retrieval. Across representative models, performance is uneven across retrieval families: models strong on conventional image--text or text--text retrieval are less reliable on modality-bridging and region-level tasks. Current embedding spaces capture some clinical relationships well but do not yet provide balanced retrieval across heterogeneous evidence. We further provide MedEmb, an MLLM-based reference embedding model trained on the MedHEB ID split, as a reproducible baseline for unified 2D--3D--text medical retrieval. We release MedHEB with preprocessing scripts, evaluation code, access manifests, and MedEmb to support research on clinically meaningful medical embeddings.

AI.tldr: 提出MedHEB：54个数据集、107个检索任务的统一医学嵌入评测基准，覆盖证据形式、配对类型、相关性粒度三维度，并给出参考嵌入模型MedEmb。
AI.motivation: 临床证据本质上是关系性的（需结合既往影像、跨模态检查、报告与局部病灶），基础模型虽将异构来源编码到共享嵌入空间，但现有评测多聚焦孤立匹配，难以判断模型能否在模态、外观与粒度变化下检索到相关证据。
AI.method: 构建统一基准MedHEB：107个检索任务、54个数据集，含同分布与留出源评测；三轴划分——证据形式（2D图像、3D体数据、文本）、配对类型（图-图、图-文、文-文、跨模态视觉匹配）、相关性粒度（全局、问题条件化、区域级）。在单一排序协议下变化临床相关证据定义（含跨模态视觉检索与文本到区域检索）。另训练MLLM参考嵌入模型MedEmb（用MedHEB ID划分训练）。
AI.result: 代表模型在各检索族上表现不均：在常规图-文与文-文检索上强的模型，在跨模态桥接与区域级任务上可靠性下降；现有嵌入空间能捕捉部分临床关系，但尚不能实现跨异构证据的均衡检索。
AI.conclusion: 现有医学嵌入在异构证据上检索能力不均衡，需面向临床有意义检索进一步研究；作者开源MedHEB（预处理脚本、评测代码、访问清单）及MedEmb作为统一2D–3D–文本检索的可复现基线。

title: Susceptibilities for Neural Networks Learning from Physical Data
summary: Neural networks that are trained on data arising from a physical system must somehow learn regularities induced by the underlying physical laws. In this setting, concepts from statistical physics provide powerful tools for analysing how physical laws influence the learning process. In this paper we explain how susceptibilities --- which measure the response of a neural network to perturbations of a parameter of the data distribution --- can be applied when learning from physical data. We show that such susceptibilities can identify the conditions under which specific input features are most informative for learning, guiding data selection, a prediction we validate experimentally. For distributions lacking a natural parameter, we propose introducing one via a physically meaningful scalar function of the physical state, and demonstrate that susceptibilities track the emergence of specific capabilities (such as collision detection) during training.

AI.tldr: 本文将统计物理中的"磁化率/敏感度"概念引入物理系统数据的神经网络学习分析，用以识别最具信息量的数据特征并追踪训练中特定能力（如碰撞检测）的涌现。
AI.motivation: 物理系统数据训练的神经网络需学习物理规律带来的规律性，但缺乏分析物理规律如何影响学习过程的工具；作者希望利用统计物理工具刻画网络对数据分布参数扰动的响应。
AI.method: 定义敏感度（susceptibility）为神经网络对数据分布参数扰动的响应；用其识别特定输入特征最具信息性的条件以指导数据选择；对缺乏自然参数的分布，引入物理状态的有意义标量函数作为参数。
AI.result: 敏感度能识别输入特征最富信息性的条件并指导数据选择，且该预测经实验验证；引入标量函数参数后，敏感度可追踪训练中特定能力（如碰撞检测）的出现。
AI.conclusion: 统计物理中的敏感度是分析物理数据学习过程的有效工具，可指导数据选择并监测能力涌现；对无自然参数分布可通过物理标量函数构造参数。

title: INTERACT: Learning Interaction-Aware World Dynamics from Driving Videos for Autonomous Driving
summary: Safe autonomous driving requires more than recognizing the current scene: the ego vehicle must anticipate how surrounding traffic participants will evolve under its own motion. However, existing end-to-end driving models typically encode scenes into dense visual or BEV features, leaving object-level interactions implicit. We propose (INTERACT INTERaction-aware Action-Conditioned Trajectory learning), a three-stage framework that learns a slot-based object-centric world model from unlabeled driving videos and transfers it to trajectory planning. INTERACT first learns recurrent slots that group dense visual features into temporally structured scene-entity representations without object annotations. It then infers latent ego actions from slot context and video transitions, and uses them to condition future slot prediction, capturing how ego motion and surrounding entities co-evolve. Finally, the learned slots, latent actions, and future slot predictions are distilled into a trajectory planner to guide trajectory generation and selection. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM and nuScenes validate the effectiveness of INTERACT. In particular, it achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM, with improvements in safety-critical collision metrics.

AI.tldr: INTERACT 是一个三阶段框架，从无标注驾驶视频学习基于 slot 的以对象为中心的世界模型，并蒸馏到轨迹规划器，在 NAVSIM 上取得 SOTA 尤其碰撞等安全指标提升。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端驾驶模型把场景编码为稠密视觉或 BEV 特征，对象级交互是隐式的；而安全自动驾驶需要自车在自身运动条件下预判周围交通参与者的演化。
AI.method: 三阶段：(1) 从无标注视频学习循环 slot，将稠密视觉特征聚为时序结构化的场景实体表示，无需对象标注；(2) 从 slot 上下文与视频转移中推断潜在自车动作，用以条件化未来 slot 预测，刻画自车运动与周围实体的协同演化；(3) 将 slot、潜在动作与未来 slot 预测蒸馏进轨迹规划器，指导轨迹生成与选择。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM 与 nuScenes 上广泛实验验证有效性；NAVSIM 上达到 SOTA，安全关键的碰撞指标有所改善。
AI.conclusion: 以对象为中心、动作条件化的世界模型可从无标注视频中获得，并有效迁移至规划，提升自动驾驶的安全性与交互建模能力。

title: Evolving Explanations: Complexity-Adaptive Refinement of Faithful Explanations for Symbolic Regression
summary: Natural-language explanations generated by large language models (LLMs) for machine learning models often seem fluent but are not necessarily faithful to the underlying model. We formalize this mismatch as a faithfulness gap and propose a complexity-adaptive refinement framework for symbolic regression that iteratively generates and validates explanations until numerical agreement with the target expression is achieved. The approach follows a two-stage pipeline: an explainer LLM produces textual descriptions at increasing levels of detail, while an independent validator LLM extracts a symbolic expression that is compared against the original model. This process is framed as a discrete search over explanation space, where complexity is minimized subject to a faithfulness constraint. We evaluate the method on real-world and synthetic datasets, with a total of 250 runs across varying model complexities. The explanation refinement loop achieves an overall pass rate of 84.0%, with most explanations converging at low complexity levels and only a small fraction requiring detailed descriptions. Our results demonstrate that faithful explanations can be obtained with minimal necessary complexity by explicitly closing the explanation loop through symbolic validation.

AI.tldr: 提出复杂度自适应的解释细化框架，通过"解释器LLM生成文本+验证器LLM提取符号表达式"的闭环迭代，最小化复杂度同时保证忠实性，250次运行总通过率84.0%。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的机器学习模型自然语言解释虽流畅，却未必忠实于底层模型（忠实性缺口），需要显式闭环验证来弥合。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为受忠实性约束的离散搜索：解释器LLM逐级生成更详细的文本描述，独立验证器LLM提取符号表达式并与原模型数值比对，迭代至数值一致为止。
AI.result: 在真实与合成数据集上共250次运行（不同模型复杂度），解释细化循环总通过率84.0%，多数解释在低复杂度层级即收敛，仅少数需要详细描述。
AI.conclusion: 通过符号验证显式闭合解释循环，可在最小必要复杂度下获得忠实的解释。

title: Where Is a Prediction Model Miscalibrated, and for Whom? Local Audits in Outcome-Learned Pockets
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables; supplement (15 pages) as an ancillary file. Code: https://github.com/modenesi/pocket-audit
summary: Overall and group-level averages, and ranking metrics such as the AUC, can hide sets of observations for which a prediction model systematically over- or under-predicts. We present an audit that asks where a model is miscalibrated (in which sets of similar observations it over- or under-predicts on average) and for whom (whether its average prediction error differs between demographic groups, such as by race or sex, within the same set). It groups observations into pockets using random-forest similarity, which weighs each feature by its importance for predicting the outcome, with a ridge-regression grouping alongside. Pockets are learned on one sample and tested on another, with simultaneous confidence intervals that allow for correlation within units such as hospitals; the audit needs only features, outcomes and fixed predictions. In 17 simulation scenarios with an error planted for one group, the combined audit located it better than the strongest alternative grouping in 15, with false-alarm rates near or below 5%; with a local error planted for everyone, it won in 12 of 15 scenarios at the smaller error size and lost when the error was unrelated to the outcome. In public synthetic data from the care-management algorithm studied by Obermeyer et al., it found no detectable overall error but under-prediction of illness in the sickest pockets and over-prediction elsewhere, and distinguished Black patients' concentration where the score under-predicted for everyone from a Black-White gap within pockets. For APACHE IVa, an exploratory analysis located its previously reported over-prediction of ICU mortality in a mostly ventilated pocket and a low-risk pocket, with none detected in a moderate-risk one. Two chest X-ray classifiers showed offsetting local errors behind no detectable overall error. Code: https://github.com/modenesi/pocket-audit

AI.tldr: 提出"口袋审计"(pocket audit)：用随机森林相似度（以特征重要性加权）加岭回归分组，将观测聚成"口袋"，在独立样本上检验模型在哪些相似观察集合中系统性偏差、以及同一口袋内不同人群（种族/性别）的预测误差差异，并提供考虑医院等单位相关性的同时置信区间。
AI.motivation: 总体与分组平均值、AUC等排序指标会掩盖模型在某些观察子集上系统性高估或低估的问题；现有公平性审计也难以区分"局部误差与人群集中重叠"和"同一情境内真实的人群差距"。
AI.method: 仅需特征、结局与固定预测。用随机森林相似度（按对结局的预测重要性加权特征）加岭回归作为辅助分组，学习"口袋"；在一个样本上学习、另一个样本上检验，并构建允许单位内（如医院）相关的同时置信区间。17个模拟场景（单群体植入误差）+ 局部误差场景评估。
AI.result: 单群体误差：15/17场景优于最强替代分组，误报率约≤5%；局部误差：小误差规模下12/15胜，误差与结局无关时失败。Obermeyer等护理管理算法（公开合成数据）：总体无显著误差，但最严重的口袋低估病情、其余高估，并能区分"低估对所有人群"与"口袋内黑白差距"。APACHE IVa：将已报告的ICU死亡率高估定位在主通气口袋与低风险口袋，中风险口袋未检出。两个胸X光分类器显示总体无误差但存在相互抵消的局部误差。
AI.conclusion: 该审计能在保留总体指标视角之外定位局部误校准并区分群体差异的来源，且仅需特征、结局与预测即可应用；局限在于当局部误差与结局无关时检出能力下降。

title: Flat Features, Detailed Images? Simple Detail Control for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Prompt engineering is commonly used to encourage text-to-image models to generate more detailed images. However, it does not provide reliable, continuous, or disentangled control. We analyze feature tokens produced with and without detail-enhancing prompts across six diffusion transformers and observe a common pattern: these prompts tend to increase the entropy of each token's energy distribution while largely preserving its ordering. That is, flattening the distribution increases the level of detail. Motivated by this counter-intuitive finding, we introduce a simple training-free approach that continuously adjusts the level of detail according to a scalar. Specifically, it shifts the squared channel magnitudes of each token toward a higher entropy distribution with a time-aware scheduler to concentrate the intervention at intermediate sampling steps. Across extensive experiments on different types of diffusion transformers, we show that our approach provides continuous control over detail metrics while largely preserving image quality and semantic structure. It requires only a few lines of code and adds negligible inference time overhead.

AI.tldr: 提示工程可提升文生图细节，但缺乏可靠、连续、解耦的控制；本文发现"展平token能量分布可增加细节"，并提出一种无需训练、仅几行代码的标量式细节控制方法。
AI.motivation: 提示工程虽能让文生图模型生成更细节的图像，但无法提供可靠、连续、解耦的控制。作者希望找到提示影响细节的机制，从而实现可控的细节调节。
AI.method: 分析六种Diffusion Transformer在有无细节增强提示下的feature token，发现提示会提高每个token能量分布的熵，但基本保持其排序不变。据此提出training-free方法：用时间感知调度器，将每个token的通道幅值平方朝高熵分布偏移，并把干预集中在采样中间步骤。
AI.result: 在多种Diffusion Transformer上实验表明，该方法可对细节指标实现连续控制，同时较好保持图像质量与语义结构；仅需少量代码，推理开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 细节水平与token能量分布的熵相关，展平分布即可增强细节；基于此的简单无训练干预提供了一种实用、连续且低成本的细节控制手段。

title: SeMo3D: Unifying 3D Generation, Editing, and Completion via Selective Modeling
summary: 3D generation, editing, and completion are typically treated as regenerating the complete 3D asset under task-specific constraints, even when only a local region needs modification. This leads to task isolation, inconsistency in content that should remain unchanged, and dependence on task-specific paired data. We address these issues with a key observation: the three tasks all synthesize a designated region while keeping the rest intact---the full region for generation, the target region for editing, and the missing region for completion. We term this paradigm Selective Modeling and build SeMo3D upon it; it naturally unifies the three tasks, preserves unchanged content by construction, and enables training without paired editing or completion data, since any 3D asset can be partitioned into a selected region and its context. For training, we propose region-selective denoising, which randomly selects regions of varying sizes on standard 3D assets and applies noise and loss only to them, jointly learning all three tasks. For architecture, we propose Omni3DiT, a multi-condition 3D diffusion transformer that distinguishes regions to create from those to retain and fuses image, text, and point guidance for fine-grained control. Experiments across three benchmarks show SeMo3D surpasses state-of-the-art methods on all tasks, delivering multimodal controllability in generation and strong consistency and accuracy in editing and completion. SeMo3D further serves as a unified modeling tool for agents, enabling efficient 3D creation through natural-language interaction. Project page: https://xiaokunsun.github.io/SeMo3D.github.io/.

AI.tldr: SeMo3D 提出 Selective Modeling 范式，把3D生成、编辑、补全统一为"合成指定区域、保留其余部分"的问题，并用区域选择性去噪和 Omni3DiT 架构实现三任务统一建模。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成/编辑/补全通常把任务当作"重新生成完整资产"来处理，即使只需局部修改。这导致任务割裂、未修改内容不一致，且依赖任务特定的配对数据。
AI.method: 核心观察：三任务均是"合成指定区域并保持其余不变"（生成=全区域，编辑=目标区域，补全=缺失区域）。训练上提出区域选择性去噪：在标准3D资产上随机选取不同大小区域，仅对这些区域加噪和计算损失，从而联合学习三任务且无需配对数据。架构上提出 Omni3DiT，一种多条件3D扩散Transformer，可区分"待生成区域"与"待保留区域"，并融合图像、文本、点云引导实现细粒度控制。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，SeMo3D 在所有任务上均超过SOTA：生成具备多模态可控性，编辑与补全具有强一致性与准确性；还能作为agent的统一建模工具，支持自然语言交互式3D创作。
AI.conclusion: 通过将3D生成、编辑、补全统一为区域选择性建模，SeMo3D 消除了任务隔离、保证了未修改内容一致性、摆脱了对配对数据的依赖，并可作为交互式3D创作agent的通用工具。

title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
comment: Presented at 3rd Workshop on Multi-modal Foundation Models and Large Language Models for Life Sciences (ICML 2026)
summary: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

AI.tldr: 提出早期融合视觉Transformer架构HistoTx，将转录组token与图像patch token在共享Transformer中联合处理，从预训练病理基础模型继续自监督预训练，使模型既可在仅图像推理时保持基线水平，又能在双模态推理时超越单模态。
AI.motivation: 现有空间转录组+WSI的多模态方法中，转录组仅作为对比对齐或监督微调的训练信号，而非真正的输入模态，导致推理本质上仍是图像驱动的，无法在推理时利用分子信息。
AI.method: 构建早期融合ViT：在任意空间分辨率上构造转录组token，与图像patch token合并后送入共享Transformer堆栈进行深度跨模态交互；以仅视觉的病理基础模型为起点，在配对的图像—空间转录组数据上继续自监督预训练。
AI.result: 1) 仅图像推理时，多数任务性能与基线持平，并在基因表达预测等天然受益于分子知识的任务上有所提升；2) 双模态同时可用时，图像+转录组联合输入优于任一单模态。
AI.conclusion: 将转录组作为真正的输入模态进行早期融合是可行且有效的，HistoTx在保持图像单模态性能的同时实现了模态互补增益，为空间转录组与病理图像的多模态建模提供了新范式。

title: Accelerating LLM Pretraining with Zeroth-Order Curvature on Idle Serving Compute
summary: LLM pretraining is increasingly compute-intensive, while substantial inference serving compute remains idle during off-peak periods. However, such serving hardware is difficult to use for conventional first-order training due to its memory, networking and other system requirements. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a natural interface to this forward-only compute resource, but its gradient estimates break down in pretraining. Unlike fine-tuning, which can confine updates to a small parameter subspace, pretraining must update every parameter, and the alignment of a ZO gradient estimate with the true gradient shrinks as the number of updated parameters grows. We make a different observation: noisy ZO estimates can still provide useful curvature information, even when they are too inaccurate to serve as gradients. Based on this insight, we propose ZO-Curv, which leverages idle forward-only devices to estimate curvature and uses it to adapt and refine the update used during first-order training, thereby accelerating the process. We provide convergence guarantees that characterize the effect of finite-query curvature estimation. Experiments on LLMs from 125M to 1.5B parameters show that ZO-Curv consistently accelerates pretraining. At 770M parameters, ZO-Curv reaches AdamW's 20K-step validation loss in 3.9 hours instead of 7.5 hours, while achieving a lower final loss of 2.70 versus 2.84 under the same step budget. These results show that idle model serving compute can accelerate LLM pretraining when zeroth-order queries are used to estimate curvature rather than gradients directly.

AI.tldr: ZO-Curv利用闲置的前向推理算力做零阶曲率估计，辅助一阶训练加速LLM预训练，770M模型达同等验证损失从7.5小时降至3.9小时。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练算力需求大，而推理服务在低峰期有大量闲置算力；但这类硬件难以用于常规一阶训练（内存/网络等要求）。零阶优化可直接利用前向算力，但预训练需更新全部参数，ZO梯度估计与真实梯度的对齐随参数规模增大而迅速变差，故不能直接作为梯度。
AI.method: 提出ZO-Curv：观察到即使ZO估计噪声大、无法当梯度用，仍蕴含有用的曲率信息。用闲置的前向设备估计曲率，并据此调整、精化一阶训练的更新量以加速收敛；同时给出刻画有限查询曲率估计影响的收敛性保证。
AI.result: 125M–1.5B参数LLM实验中ZO-Curv稳定加速预训练；770M模型达AdamW的20K步验证损失用时3.9小时（AdamW为7.5小时），且同等步数预算下最终损失2.70 vs 2.84。
AI.conclusion: 闲置的模型服务算力可用于加速LLM预训练，关键在于将零阶查询用于曲率估计而非直接估计梯度。

title: AVID: A 5T fMRI Dataset for Benchmarking Auditory-induced Visual Mental Imagery Decoding
comment: This is the camera-ready version accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Abstract shortened to respect the arXiv limit of 1920 characters. Please see the PDF for the full abstract
summary: Visual mental imagery (VMI) decoding uses brain activity to reconstruct internally generated visual scenes, providing a potential pathway for externalizing internal experiences and developing neuroprosthetic communication interfaces. However, progress is limited by the lack of dedicated, training-scale VMI datasets. Current VMI paradigms often rely on visual prompts or short-term memory images, introducing visual and mnemonic confounds that make it difficult to disentangle neural activity associated with endogenous image construction from signals driven by prior or concurrent visual input. Furthermore, existing VMI datasets offer limited descriptive control over individual visual attributes, making it difficult to systematically assess fine grained visual details. To address these gaps, we introduce AVID, the first dedicated training-scale 5.0 Tesla functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) resource for auditory-induced VMI decoding. AVID comprises approximately 67 hours of dense recordings from nine participants. The dataset is structured into two complementary splits: a scene-level complex split using naturalistic Mandarin descriptions and a controlled simple split with explicitly specified visual attributes. We further formalize a standardized evaluation protocol that decouples source-image consistency from semantic alignment, allowing for a more nuanced assessment of imagery reconstruction. Baseline qualitative and quantitative results show that current reconstruction pipelines remain limited on AVID, although the most successful reconstructions preserve recognizable scene level semantics from spoken descriptions. By combining dedicated training-scale neural recordings and standardized evaluation resources, AVID provides both a data foundation for imagery-specific model development and a benchmark for evaluating VMI decoding with substantially reduced sensory contamination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVID，首个面向听觉诱发视觉心理意象(VMI)解码的训练规模5.0T fMRI数据集，含9名受试者约67小时记录，分为自然语言场景复杂子集与属性受控简单子集，并给出解耦"源图像一致性"与"语义对齐"的标准化评测协议。
AI.motivation: VMI解码有望将内部视觉体验外化并用于神经假体通信接口，但缺乏专用、训练规模的数据集。现有范式依赖视觉提示或短期记忆图像，引入视觉与记忆混淆，难以区分内源性意象构建相关神经活动与先前/并行视觉输入信号；且现有数据对视觉属性的描述控制有限，无法系统评估细粒度视觉细节。
AI.method: 构建AVID：5.0 Tesla fMRI采集，9名受试者约67小时密集记录，通过听觉（普通话描述）诱发VMI，避免视觉输入混淆。数据分两个互补子集：场景级复杂子集（自然化普通话描述）与受控简单子集（显式指定视觉属性）。同时提出标准化评估协议，将源图像一致性与语义对齐解耦。
AI.result: 基线的定性与定量结果显示，现有重建流程在AVID上仍表现有限；表现最好的重建能保留来自语音描述的可识别场景级语义，但整体重建质量不足。
AI.conclusion: AVID通过训练规模的专用神经记录与标准化评测资源，为意象专用模型开发提供数据基础，并提供显著降低感觉污染的VMI解码基准，推动该领域向更严谨的评测方向发展。

title: Hindsight Credit Assignment over Trees for Agentic RL
summary: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon LLM agents faces a fundamental dilemma: successful experiences are essential for policy improvement, yet limited policy capabilities make such experiences difficult to discover. Sparse outcome rewards compound this challenge, leaving sampled trajectories with little relative feedback for learning. In this paper, we propose TriGRPO, a tree-based reinforcement learning framework that turns scarce successes into exploration and learning signals through hindsight credit assignment within and across rollout trees. TriGRPO constructs rollout trees through hindsight-guided branching: when an ongoing trajectory reaches a matched decision state, a successful action discovered during rollout initiates a sibling branch that continues autonomously, enabling further exploration and parent-sibling comparisons. Three complementary groups organize policy optimization over these trees: root groups capture within-prompt relative returns, node groups assign credit from parent-sibling outcome differences, and cross groups supplement sparse feedback with historical performance on related tasks. Experimental results demonstrate consistent gains in task performance and rollout efficiency across model scales, highlighting structured hindsight credit assignment as an effective approach to long-horizon agent learning.

AI.tldr: 提出树式强化学习框架TriGRPO，利用hindsight信用分配将稀缺成功经验转化为探索与学习信号，缓解长程LLM智能体的稀疏奖励困境。
AI.motivation: 长程LLM智能体RL存在根本矛盾：策略改进离不开成功经验，但策略能力有限又难以发现成功经验；稀疏的结果奖励进一步使轨迹缺乏相对反馈。
AI.method: 构建rollout树并进行hindsight引导分支：当进行中的轨迹到达匹配决策状态时，由rollout中发现的成功动作发起兄弟分支并自主延续，实现进一步探索与父子对比。用三类组组织策略优化：root组捕捉同提示内相对回报，node组依据父子结果差异分配信用，cross组用相关任务的历史表现补充稀疏反馈。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模上，任务性能与rollout效率均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的hindsight信用分配是长程智能体学习的有效方法。

title: BGD-SF PolySegNet: boundary-guided dynamic selective fusion network for robust polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images
comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 8 tables, Submitted to PLOS ONE
summary: Effective polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images is crucial for early detection of colorectal cancer, a leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide. While current deep learning models perform well on traditional Dice benchmarks, border segmentation remains difficult. Most methods use boundary information only as an additional loss signal during training, which prevents the network from explicitly learning border-guided feature selection or mask refinement. This paper introduces BGD-SF PolySegNet, a boundary-guided encoder-decoder architecture that controls three phases of the segmentation pipeline: dynamic multi-scale context aggregation, selective skip-feature fusion, and final mask refinement. The architecture comprises a pretrained EfficientNet-B4 backbone and three proposed modules: Boundary-Guided Dynamic Cascaded Multi-Scale Context Aggregation (BGD-CMSCA), Boundary-Guided Selective Attention Fusion (BG-SAGF), and a Multi-Level Boundary Guidance Head (MBGH). The model is trained on 3,535 annotated images from Kvasir-SEG, BKAI-IGH NeoPolyp-Small, and PolypGen, and evaluated on four held-out benchmark datasets. On the internal test set, BGD-SF achieves a Dice of 0.887, IoU of 0.839, mask-derived Boundary F1 of 0.531, HD95 of 30.32, and ASSD of 18.10, improving Boundary F1, HD95, and ASSD by 15.7%, 27.5%, and 34.6% over the strongest CNN baselines. External validation on CVC-ClinicDB, CVC-ColonDB, ETIS-Larib, and CVC-300 yielded Dice scores of 0.891, 0.776, 0.863, and 0.885, respectively. The model runs at 35 FPS with 22.51M parameters. Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm statistically significant mask-derived Boundary F1 improvements over six of seven ablation variants (p < 0.001; small-to-moderate effect sizes, r = 0.215-0.434), demonstrating that integrating boundary guidance as an active architectural component measurably advances polyp boundary delineation.

AI.tldr: 提出BGD-SF PolySegNet，将边界信息作为主动架构组件（而非仅训练损失）嵌入分割流程三个阶段，显著提升结肠镜息肉边界分割精度。
AI.motivation: 现有深度模型在Dice指标上表现良好，但边界分割仍困难；多数方法仅把边界信息当作训练的额外损失信号，网络无法显式学习边界引导的特征选择或掩码细化。
AI.method: 边界引导的编码器-解码器架构，控制三阶段：动态多尺度上下文聚合、选择性跳跃特征融合、最终掩码细化。含预训练EfficientNet-B4骨干及三个模块：BGD-CMSCA、BG-SAGF、多层边界引导头MBGH。训练用Kvasir-SEG、BKAI-IGH NeoPolyp-Small、PolypGen共3535张标注图像。
AI.result: 内部测试集Dice 0.887、IoU 0.839、边界F1 0.531、HD95 30.32、ASSD 18.10，边界F1/HD95/ASSD较最强CNN基线提升15.7%/27.5%/34.6%。外部验证CVC-ClinicDB、CVC-ColonDB、ETIS-Larib、CVC-300的Dice分别0.891/0.776/0.863/0.885。35 FPS，22.51M参数。Wilcoxon检验显示7个消融变体中6个边界F1显著提升（p<0.001，r=0.215-0.434）。
AI.conclusion: 将边界引导作为主动架构组件可测量地推进息肉边界描绘，兼顾精度与实时性。

title: The Staged Pandora's Box: Reservation Indices for Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization
summary: A staged search must decide which candidate to advance next and when to stop. Some observations only inform later decisions; others can be kept as results. We formulate these choices as a staged Pandora's box with a designated set of collectable stages. For independent finite-stage candidates with bounded readings and positive bounded own-history costs, an exact covered-call recursion gives the reservation index, the optimal value and the loss of every advance or stop; advancing an index-maximal candidate while its index exceeds the incumbent is optimal. The representation recovers classical single-stage search, nested inspection and the all-collectable Markov setting, and prices changes in the problem: enlarging the collectable set or lowering costs raises the value by an explicit covered-call overshoot. Resumption can be valuable even when future reward laws do not change, but has no value for deterministic readings. With information sharing across candidates, no rule using only their separate remaining-reading laws is universally optimal, and making an intermediate reading collectable can change which candidate is inspected first. Under a coherent joint path law with own-history costs, an approximate-planning bound controls the recomputed index's regret by changes in untouched candidates' local values; a common-component specialization bounds those changes through predictive total-variation dispersion. Exact finite-law experiments check the representation, the loss accounting and the bounds.

AI.tldr: 将分阶段搜索中"推进哪个候选、何时停止"的决策建模为带可收藏阶段的分阶段潘多拉魔盒，给出精确的 covered-call 递推与保留价指数规则。
AI.motivation: 分阶段搜索中，有些观测仅用于指导后续决策，有些则可作为结果留存；现有理论（单阶段 Pandora、嵌套检查、全可收藏设定）无法统一刻画这种"可收藏阶段"结构及相关最优策略。
AI.method: 对独立有限阶段、读数有界、自历史成本正有界的候选，构造精确 covered-call 递推，导出保留价指数、最优值与每次推进/停止的损失；证明当指数最大者的指数超过现任值时推进它最优；用 covered-call 超额价量化可收藏集扩大与成本降低带来的收益。进一步在信息共享下给出与联合路径律一致的近似规划界，并用预测全变差离散度刻画共同分量。
AI.result: 该表示涵盖经典单阶段搜索、嵌套检查与全可收藏 Markov 设定；揭示续检在奖励律不变时仍有价值但确定性读数下无价值；信息共享下仅依赖各自剩余读数律的规则普遍非最优，且使中间读数可收藏会改变首个被检查的候选；近似规划界以未触及候选局部值变化控制重算指数的遗憾，实验验证了表示、损失核算与界。
AI.conclusion: 为分阶段搜索提供统一的指数型最优策略框架与可解释的敏感性/近似分析，但信息共享下的普遍最优规则不存在，需依赖联合路径结构。

title: Latent Diffusion-GAN: Adversarial Learning in the Autoencoded Latent Space
summary: Diffusion models are powerful generative frameworks for producing high-quality images by denoising latent variables from random noise. However, training with likelihood-based objectives, such as denoising score matching, can lead to locally over-smoothed high-frequency details, including fine textures and sharp edges, thereby limiting perceptual fidelity and structural detail. Adversarial training with GANs enhances sharpness but typically requires additional discriminator networks, increasing computational costs and destabilizing training. To this end, we propose Latent Diffusion Generative Adversarial Networks (LD-GAN), a novel framework that seamlessly integrates adversarial learning into diffusion models without modifying their original pipeline. LD-GAN leverages the pretrained variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent diffusion models as an energy-based discriminator, enabling adversarial training without extra parameters and preserving the structured latent priors learned from large datasets. We also introduce a structural consistency energy that aligns encoder and decoder feature representations, thereby enhancing perceptual quality and compatibility with the pretrained latent space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LD-GAN significantly improves sample fidelity, perceptual sharpness, and diversity over state-of-the-art baseline methods across various generation tasks while ensuring efficient training dynamics.

AI.tldr: LD-GAN 将对抗学习无缝嵌入潜在扩散模型，复用预训练 VAE 作为能量式判别器，无需额外参数即提升高频细节、感知锐度与多样性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的似然类目标（如去噪分数匹配）会导致高频细节局部过平滑（纹理、边缘），限制感知保真度；而 GAN 虽提升锐度，却需额外判别器网络，增加计算开销并使训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 LD-GAN 框架：在不改变原扩散流程的前提下，将预训练 VAE 用作基于能量的判别器，从而无需额外参数即可实现对抗训练，并保留大数据预训练得到的结构化潜先验；同时引入结构一致性能量，对齐编码器与解码器特征表示，提升感知质量并与预训练潜空间兼容。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在多种生成任务上，LD-GAN 相比 SOTA 基线显著提升样本保真度、感知锐度与多样性，同时保持高效训练动态。
AI.conclusion: 对抗学习可与扩散模型的原生管线融合，借助 VAE 能量判别与结构一致性约束实现高质量生成，且不牺牲训练效率。

title: Feature extraction for LSTM-based finger-joint angle estimation from sEMG
summary: Continuous estimation of finger-joint angles from surface electromyography (sEMG) is a promising approach for controlling dexterous myoelectric prostheses. Deep time series models have been applied successfully in this context, typically relying on feature extraction rather than raw signals, given limited subject-specific data. Various time-domain and frequency-domain features can be used, extracted for a given window and step size. This study systematically investigates these three design choices for Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) regression on the Ninapro DB2 dataset. Window sizes from 300 to 1200 ms and step sizes from 10 to 100 ms were evaluated in combination with six time- and frequency-domain features. Models were evaluated using regression performance metrics, inference time, and memory footprint to assess feasibility on embedded microcontroller hardware suitable for a prosthetic device. A 300 ms window with a 100 ms step, paired with either the Mean Absolute Value (MAV) or Root Mean Squared (RMS) feature, yielded the best performance (test PCC of 0.779 +/- 0.080 / 0.779 +/- 0.085). Window size, step size, and feature choice were found to interact non-trivially: jointly tuning them can improve both accuracy and computational feasibility for real-time, embedded myoelectric control.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统考察LSTM回归在Ninapro DB2上做手指关节角度连续估计时，窗口大小、步长与特征选择三项设计的影响（兼顾精度与嵌入式可行性）。
AI.motivation: 从sEMG连续估计手指关节角度是灵巧肌电假肢控制的关键，但受限于受试者特定数据不足，深度时序模型通常依赖特征提取而非原始信号；窗口大小、步长与特征类型等设计选择缺乏系统研究，且需满足嵌入式微控制器的实时性要求。
AI.method: 在Ninapro DB2数据集上训练LSTM回归模型，系统组合测试300–1200 ms的窗口大小、10–100 ms的步长以及六种时域/频域特征，并用回归指标、推理时间与内存占用评估性能。
AI.result: 300 ms窗口配100 ms步长，结合MAV或RMS特征取得最佳性能，测试PCC分别为0.779±0.080与0.779±0.085；窗口、步长与特征之间存在非平凡的交互作用。
AI.conclusion: 联合调优窗口大小、步长与特征选择可同时提升精度与计算可行性，有助于实现实时的嵌入式肌电控制。

title: UniCross3D: Unified Cross-View and Cross-Domain Diffusion for Consistent Single-Image 3D Generation
summary: Reconstructing detailed geometry and realistic appearance from a single RGB image is essential yet fundamentally challenging due to inherent ambiguities such as occlusion, lighting variations, and texture-geometry entanglement. While recent diffusion-based generative models have significantly improved novel view synthesis, existing approaches suffer from two critical limitations: lack of cross-view geometric consistency and insufficient cross-domain semantic alignment. To address these issues, we introduce UniCross3D, a unified cross-view and cross-domain diffusion framework designed explicitly for consistent and physically coherent 3D generation. UniCross3D features two novel contributions: (1) a cross-view latent regularization that enforces cross-view geometric consistency across synthesized viewpoints by penalizing latent variance, and (2) a cross-domain mutual information objective grounded in the physics of image formation, explicitly aligning synthesized color and normal maps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UniCross3D achieves significantly improved view consistency and semantic alignment over state-of-the-art methods and yields higher-fidelity reconstructions, particularly under challenging textures and ambiguous viewpoints.

AI.tldr: UniCross3D：统一的跨视角与跨域扩散框架，通过跨视角隐变量正则化与跨域互信息目标，提升单图三维重建的几何一致性与语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 从单张RGB图像重建几何与外观存在遮挡、光照变化、纹理-几何纠缠等固有歧义。现有扩散生成式新视角合成方法存在两个关键缺陷：缺乏跨视角几何一致性，以及跨域语义对齐不足。
AI.method: 提出统一扩散框架UniCross3D，包含两项贡献：(1) 跨视角隐变量正则化，通过惩罚隐变量方差来强制合成视角间的几何一致性；(2) 基于图像成像物理的跨域互信息目标，显式对齐合成的颜色图与法线图。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，UniCross3D在视角一致性和语义对齐上显著优于现有方法，并在复杂纹理和歧义视角下取得更高保真度的重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过在统一扩散框架中同时引入跨视角一致性与跨域语义对齐约束，可有效缓解单图三维重建的歧义问题，实现更物理一致、高保真的三维生成。

title: Beyond Monotonicity: Stochastic Online Optimization under Semi-Bandit Feedback
summary: We study stochastic online optimization (SOO) under semi-bandit feedback: in each of $T$ rounds, a policy adaptively observes $n$ independent random variables with unknown distributions, learning only from observed values. First-order stochastic dominance (FSD) monotonicity enables general reductions for learning SOO, but can fail when observations change future feasibility, resource use, or reference points. Our algorithm runs the dynamic program for the optimal policy, replacing each expectation by its most optimistic value over a confidence set of distributions. Its regret depends on the level-set complexity $s_i$ of the computed values as functions of the $i$th variable: the number of intervals needed to describe their superlevel sets. For rewards in $[0,1]$, the regret is $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{ST})$ without this monotonicity, where $S=\sum_{i=1}^n\min\{s_i,k_i\}$ and $k_i$ is the support size of the $i$th distribution, which may be infinite when $s_i$ is finite. For constant level-set complexities, regret is $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nT})$, even for continuous distributions. The algorithm requires no knowledge of $s_i$, $k_i$, or the supports, and it also achieves regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nkT})$ for supports of size at most $k$ without any level-set condition, which improves the previous bound $\tilde{O}(n(\sqrt{kT}+k))$ for FSD-monotone problems. We also prove a lower bound of $Ω(\min\{T,\sqrt{ST}\})$ for all positive integers $s_1,\ldots,s_n$ with $k_i=2s_i+1$, which holds even under full feedback and matches the upper bound up to logarithmic factors. We obtain $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nT})$ regret for these problems, all nonmonotone under FSD: stochastic Boolean function evaluation, the full-information secretary problem, optimal stopping with loss aversion, scheduling with deadlines and correlated stochastic knapsack with unimodal rewards, and overbooking with group reservations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究半强盗反馈下的随机在线优化（SOO），提出一种基于动态规划与乐观置信集的算法，在无需FSD单调性的情况下达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{ST})$ 遗憾，依赖层级集复杂度 $s_i$；并在多种非单调问题上达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nT})$ 遗憾。
AI.motivation: 以往一阶随机占优（FSD）单调性可用于SOO的一般化归约，但当观测会影响未来可行性、资源使用或参考点时该性质失效。作者希望在不依赖FSD单调性的前提下，仍能得到类似的低遗憾界。
AI.method: 对最优策略的动态规划进行“乐观”执行：将每个期望替换为置信集内分布上的最乐观值。遗憾界取决于计算值作为第 $i$ 个变量函数的层级集复杂度 $s_i$（描述其超水平集所需区间数）。算法无需知道 $s_i$、$k_i$ 或支撑集。
AI.result: 对 $[0,1]$ 奖励，遗憾为 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{ST})$，其中 $S=\sum_i \min\{s_i,k_i\}$；层级集复杂度为常数时达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nT})$（即使连续分布）；支撑规模至多 $k$ 时无需层级集条件即得 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nkT})$，改进此前 FSD 单调问题的 $\tilde{O}(n(\sqrt{kT}+k))$。下界为 $\Omega(\min\{T,\sqrt{ST}\})$（$k_i=2s_i+1$，全反馈下亦成立），与上界仅差对数因子。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一处理多个FSD非单调问题（随机布尔函数求值、全信息秘书问题、损失厌恶最优停止、带截止期调度与相关随机背包、团体预订超额预订），均取得 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nT})$ 遗憾，展示了方法的通用性与紧致性。

title: ReinSeg: Retrieval-Guided Bounded Multimodal Refinement for 3-D Road Anomaly Segmentation
summary: 3-D road anomaly segmentation is essential for risk-aware perception in autonomous driving. Its central challenge is to rank sparsely observed hazards ahead of abundant normal road structures while preserving point-wise metric localization. LiDAR provides accurate 3-D point support, whereas surround-view imagery offers complementary semantic context for separating unexpected hazards from challenging normal structures. We propose ReinSeg, a retrieval-guided bounded multimodal refinement framework for point-wise road anomaly segmentation. Occupied LiDAR bird's-eye-view cells retrieve scene-specific context from a shared memory of eight surround-view images without supplying calibration variables to the retrieval module. A relative-norm-bounded residual returns this context to the LiDAR point features, so the frozen LIDO anomaly-scoring interface is preserved, and the refinement is optimized with in-distribution semantic labels only. On the Spotting the Unexpected (STU) benchmark, ReinSeg improves validation average precision from 27.54\% to 35.67\% and reduces the false-positive rate at 95\% anomaly recall from 34.85\% to 10.61\%, shrinking the high-recall screening set from 67.54 to 20.55 million points. Relative to REL, AP is 24.99 percentage points higher and FPR95 is 0.99 points lower. Matched interfaces and component isolation show that retrieved scene imagery and the relative-norm bound are both essential, and ReinSeg stays above LiDAR-only performance under missing, corrupted, or misaligned camera inputs while running at 21.8 frames per second. These results establish bounded retrieval of scene-specific visual evidence as an effective route to reliable 3-D road-hazard perception.

AI.tldr: ReinSeg 是一个检索引导、有界多模态精化的三维道路异常分割框架：用 LiDAR BEV 占用格从共享环视图像记忆中检索场景上下文，并以相对范数有界残差注入点特征，在保持冻结 LIDO 评分接口的前提下显著提升 STU 基准的异常检测精度并大幅降低误报。
AI.motivation: 三维道路异常分割的核心难点在于：稀疏观测的异常/危险目标需排在大量正常道路结构之前，同时要保留逐点度量定位能力。LiDAR 提供精确三维点支撑，环视图像提供补充语义上下文以区分意外危险与"困难的正常结构"，但如何在不破坏已有异常评分接口的情况下融合两者仍是挑战。
AI.method: 1) 以被占用的 LiDAR BEV 网格单元为查询，从八路环视图像构成的共享记忆中检索场景特定上下文，检索模块不使用标定参数；2) 通过相对范数有界残差将检索到的上下文回注到 LiDAR 点特征，从而保留冻结的 LIDO 异常评分接口；3) 仅使用分布内语义标签优化精化模块。
AI.result: STU 基准上验证集 AP 从 27.54% 提升至 35.67%；95% 异常召回下的误报率由 34.85% 降至 10.61%，高召回筛选集从 6754 万点缩减至 2055 万点。相比 REL，AP 高 24.99 个百分点、FPR95 低 0.99 个百分点。组件隔离实验表明检索到的场景图像与相对范数约束均不可或缺；在相机输入缺失、损坏或错位时仍优于纯 LiDAR 基线，运行速度 21.8 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 对场景特定视觉证据的有界检索是通往可靠三维道路危险感知的有效路径，兼具精度、鲁棒性与实时性。

title: Computer Vision Applications for Art History: Reflections and paradigms for future research
comment: 8 pages. Published in the Proceedings of EVA London 2021 (Electronic Visualisation and the Arts), BCS Electronic Workshops in Computing (eWiC), under CC BY 4.0
summary: One of the contributing factors to the continuing debate among art historians over the use of computational methods in art history research is that they do not consider the core of today's art history research questions. The lack of close collaboration between the two involved research communities makes the definition of contemporary art-historical methods as well-defined computer vision problems extremely difficult. For that purpose, it is devised as a methodology to study articles in art history journals from a computer science perspective. The objective is to identify which image features art historians utilise within their research and describe them in immediate and meaningful terms to the computer vision research community. Finally, some paradigms that could serve as a new starting point for exploring how computer vision applications for art history can address the core of today's art history research are given.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种方法论，从计算机科学视角分析艺术史期刊论文，识别艺术史学家真正使用的图像特征，并转化为计算机视觉可理解的问题定义，为跨学科合作提供新范式。
AI.motivation: 艺术史学家与计算机视觉研究者之间缺乏紧密合作，导致计算方法的定义难以对齐艺术史研究的核心问题，双方关于计算方法在艺术史中应用的争论持续不断。
AI.method: 设计一种方法论，从计算机科学视角系统研究艺术史期刊中的文章，提取并归纳艺术史学家在研究中所使用的图像特征，用直接且有意义的术语向计算机视觉社区描述这些特征。
AI.result: 识别出艺术史研究实际依赖的图像特征类型，并将其对应到可描述、可计算的视觉问题上，同时提出若干可作为新起点的方法范式。
AI.conclusion: 计算机视觉应用于艺术史需从艺术史研究问题核心出发，通过术语对齐与跨学科协作，才能让计算方法真正服务于艺术史研究。

title: What Drives the Zero-to-One Jump? Diagnosing and Steering Hard-Prompt Learning in RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved mathematical reasoning, yet progress on hard prompts often stalls: a prompt can remain unsolved for many training steps before abruptly transitioning to solved--a discrete "zero-to-one" jump whose underlying dynamics and steerability remain poorly understood. We investigate two questions: what drives this transition, and can it be steered? Through event-based analysis measuring the time-to-first-positive (TTFP), we find that negative rollouts preceding successful transitions consistently retain higher early-stage generation entropy, distinguishing near-solvable failures from dead ends. This signal motivates NAPO (Negative-Augmented Policy Optimization), a method integrated with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that ranks negatives in unsolved groups via an early-branching driver and assigns graded advantages, injecting informative gradients precisely where standard group-relative updates vanish. Under fixed rollout budgets, NAPO accelerates early solution discovery and improves Pass@256 by 10.0 points on AIME24 and 6.6 points on AIME2025, demonstrating that zero-to-one transitions are diagnosable and steerable through driver-guided negative learning. Our code is available at https://github.com/jameszhu-pixel-time/Z2O.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RLVR中硬样本"零到一"突变的机制，发现成功前的负样本具有更高的早期生成熵，并提出NAPO方法对负样本分级分配优势，加速求解发现。
AI.motivation: RLVR虽提升数学推理，但难提示常长期未解后才突然被解出，这种"零到一"离散跃迁的机制与可操控性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 基于事件分析测量time-to-first-positive(TTFP)，发现成功跃迁前的负rollout持续保留更高的早期生成熵，可区分"接近可解"的失败与死路；据此提出NAPO，与GRPO集成，用early-branching driver对未解组内负样本排序并赋予分级优势，在标准group-relative更新消失处注入有效梯度。
AI.result: 固定rollout预算下，NAPO加速早期解发现，AIME24的Pass@256提升10.0点，AIME2025提升6.6点。
AI.conclusion: 零到一突变可被诊断与操控，通过driver引导的负样本学习可有效利用此类信号。

title: Probe-Guided Gradient Balancing for Multimodal Learning
summary: Jointly trained multimodal networks frequently underutilize weaker modalities, as faster-learning modalities dominate the shared fusion objective and suppress gradients reaching slower ones. Most existing approaches throttle dominant modalities, whereas directly boosting weaker modalities often fails because monitoring signals derived from the joint loss remain dominated by stronger modalities. We propose Probe-Guided Gradient Boosting (PGGB), a gradient modulation approach that boosts weaker modalities while preserving the strength of dominant ones. PGGB attaches lightweight linear classifiers to stop-gradient features from each modality to estimate representation quality independently. The gap between these scores, termed the utilization gap, provides an imbalance signal used to adaptively scale weaker-modality gradients through bounded and smoothed modulation. PGGB is composable with throttling methods, as it leaves the loss function and fusion architecture unchanged. Experiments across eight benchmarks spanning four domains and 2-4 modalities demonstrate that PGGB outperforms state-of-the-art methods on highly imbalanced multimodal datasets while remaining competitive under low or negligible imbalance. We further establish bounded scaling, self-attenuation, and a descent bound for standard SGD under smoothness and bounded-variance assumptions. Code is available at https://github.com/VuVoCodes/PGGB.

AI.tldr: PGGB 通过在每种模态的 stop-gradient 特征上附加轻量线性分类器独立评估表示质量，利用"利用率差距"作为失衡信号，自适应放大弱模态梯度（有界且平滑），同时保留强模态强度，可与抑制类方法组合。
AI.motivation: 联合训练的多模态网络中，学习快的模态主导共享融合目标并压制慢模态的梯度，导致弱模态被低度利用。现有做法多为抑制主导模态；而直接增强弱模态往往失败，因为来自联合损失的监控信号仍被强模态主导。
AI.method: 为每个模态的 stop-gradient 特征接线性分类器，独立估计各模态表示质量；用这些分数的差距（利用率差距）作为失衡信号，通过有界、平滑的调制自适应缩放弱模态梯度。不改变损失函数与融合结构，故可与 throttling 方法叠加。理论上给出有界缩放、自衰减及标准 SGD 在平滑性与有界方差假设下的下降界。
AI.result: 在覆盖四个领域、2–4 种模态的八个基准上，PGGB 在高度失衡的多模态数据集上超过 SOTA，在低失衡或几乎无失衡时保持竞争力；并提供有界缩放、自衰减与 SGD 下降界的理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 从"独立探测表示质量"而非依赖联合损失获取信号，是放大弱模态梯度的更可靠途径；该方法通用、可组合，且具理论保障。代码已开源。

title: Investigating the effects of the patch size in Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Patch size is a central design choice in patch-based time-series foundation models, controlling temporal resolution, sequence length, and computational cost. We study how this choice interacts with transformer architecture through a controlled comparison of encoder-only and decoder-only forecasting models trained with the same data mixture and optimization budget. Across 97 GIFT-Eval tasks, encoder-only models consistently benefit from smaller patches, whereas decoder-only performance follows a U-shaped trend, with an intermediate patch size performing best in aggregate. Dataset-level results further show that the preferred decoder patch size increases with the forecasting horizon. For encoder-only models, increasing context length improves performance across patch sizes, although the gains diminish beyond a context length of 2048. Finally, training-compute and CPU-latency Pareto analyses reveal complementary regimes: decoder-only models provide efficient low-cost alternatives, while encoder-only models attain the highest overall accuracy. These results show that the choice of patch size and architecture should be made depending on the forecasting horizon and deployment constraints.

AI.tldr: 在统一数据与算力条件下比较encoder-only与decoder-only时间序列基础模型，发现patch大小与架构存在交互：encoder-only偏好小patch，decoder-only呈U型且随预测跨度增大而偏好更大patch。
AI.motivation: Patch size是patch-based时间序列基础模型的核心设计选择，影响时间分辨率、序列长度与计算成本，但其与Transformer架构（encoder-only vs decoder-only）的交互作用尚缺乏受控研究。
AI.method: 在相同数据混合与优化预算下训练encoder-only和decoder-only预测模型，进行受控对比；在97个GIFT-Eval任务上评估patch size（及上下文长度）的影响，并开展训练算力与CPU时延的Pareto分析。
AI.result: encoder-only模型一致受益于更小patch；decoder-only性能呈U型，中等patch总体最佳；数据集层面，decoder偏好的patch随预测跨度增大；encoder-only增大上下文长度在2048以内有效、之后收益递减；Pareto分析显示decoder-only为低成本高效方案，encoder-only达到最高精度。
AI.conclusion: patch size与架构的选择应依据预测跨度与部署约束共同决定，两类架构各有互补适用场景。

title: VerdictAD: Few-Shot Anomaly Detection via Decision-Guided Refinement
comment: Preprint with 5 tables and 7 figures. Code and experimental logs available at https://github.com/sgstq0811/VerdictAD-Jev-AD
summary: Detecting defects in real-world industrial inspection often requires learning from only a few normal images per category. Recent few-shot anomaly detection methods have achieved strong performance by measuring feature differences between query images and normal references. However, visual differences do not always indicate genuine defects, as normal appearance variations can also produce high anomaly scores. Conversely, structural or logical anomalies may not produce strong local feature differences, making them difficult to detect. To address this limitation, we introduce VerdictAD, a training-free framework that refines existing anomaly detectors through visual decisions. Rather than replacing existing detectors, VerdictAD adopts a typed decision model to assess the query image and its local regions against a few normal references. By directly producing structured decision probabilities without text generation, the model provides complementary evidence for refining anomaly responses at different spatial scales. Building on this capability, we introduce two modules: Global Verdict Refinement (GVR) uses image-level decisions to refine the overall anomaly score, while Local Verdict Refinement (LVR) aggregates regional decisions to refine the anomaly map. Combined with a simple DINOv2-based detector, VerdictAD achieves competitive performance in one-shot and few-shot anomaly detection. More importantly, as a plug-and-play framework, it consistently improves existing anomaly detectors across MVTec AD, VisA, and MVTec LOCO AD, achieving strong results across one-shot and few-shot settings. Our code and experimental logs are publicly available at https://github.com/sgstq0811/VerdictAD-Jev-AD.

AI.tldr: VerdictAD是一个免训练框架，用类型化决策模型对查询图像及局部区域与少量正常参考做视觉判定，产出结构化决策概率，从而细化现有异常检测器的异常分数与异常图。
AI.motivation: 少样本工业异常检测靠特征差异衡量异常，但正常外观变化也会产生高异常分，而结构/逻辑异常又可能缺乏明显局部特征差异，导致误判与漏检。
AI.method: 不替换现有检测器，而是引入免训练的类型化决策模型，将查询图像及其局部区域与少量正常参考比对，直接输出结构化决策概率（不做文本生成）；据此设计全局判定细化GVR（用图像级决策修正整体异常分）与局部判定细化LVR（聚合区域决策修正异常图），并与基于DINOv2的简单检测器结合，可即插即用。
AI.result: 与简单DINOv2检测器结合即在一/少样本检测上具竞争力；作为即插即用框架，在MVTec AD、VisA、MVTec LOCO AD上稳定提升现有检测器，单样本与少样本设置均取得较好结果。
AI.conclusion: 以视觉判定作为互补证据细化异常响应是有效方向，能在不改动原检测器的情况下普遍提升少样本异常检测性能。

title: DIKT: A Diagnostic and Interpretable Knowledge Tracing Framework for Prediction and Model-based Learning Analysis
summary: Knowledge tracing is a key component of intelligent educational systems. However, most existing methods mainly focus on response prediction, providing limited support for explaining predicted outcomes and improving students'learning states. This paper proposes Diagnostic and Interpretable Knowledge Tracing (DIKT), which integrates response prediction, skill-level diagnosis, and model-based learning analysis. DIKT generates bounded cognitive-state trajectories and decomposes the final response probability into skill-wise probabilities. The trajectories reveal students'evolving strengths and weaknesses, while the skill-wise probabilities identify the skills that most strongly constrain the prediction. Based on these diagnostic results, DIKT supports direct cognitive-state intervention and effective-learning-duration-based what-if analysis to examine how hypothetical adjustments affect current predictions and subsequent state evolution. DIKT combines Bayesian multi-head attention, conditional variational recurrent inference, a logistic-growth decoder, and multiplicative skill-wise prediction. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that DIKT outperforms all evaluated baselines, with an average absolute AUC gain of 2.04 percentage points. Other experiments further demonstrate that DIKT supports educationally meaningful diagnostic analysis and provides informative diagnostic indicators for downstream applications, extending knowledge tracing from response prediction to interpretable diagnosis and model-based learning analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出DIKT模型，将知识追踪拓展为"答题预测+技能级诊断+基于模型的学习分析"，兼具可解释性与干预能力，在三个基准数据集上平均AUC提升2.04个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有知识追踪方法多聚焦于答题结果预测，对预测结果的解释以及学生知识状态改进的支持有限，难以用于教育诊断与教学干预。
AI.method: DIKT融合四部分：贝叶斯多头注意力、条件变分循环推断、logistic增长解码器、乘性技能级预测。模型生成有界认知状态轨迹，并将最终答题概率分解为各技能概率：轨迹刻画学生强弱项的演化，技能概率识别对预测最关键约束的技能。基于诊断结果支持直接认知状态干预，以及基于有效学习时长的反事实（what-if）分析。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上优于所有对比基线，平均绝对AUC增益2.04个百分点；其他实验表明DIKT能支持有教育意义的诊断分析，并为下游应用提供有信息量的诊断指标。
AI.conclusion: DIKT把知识追踪从单一答题预测扩展为可解释诊断与基于模型的学习分析，兼具预测性能与教育实用性。

title: OctreeSplat: Hierarchical Octree-Guided Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has shown considerable potential for novel view synthesis (NVS) and 3D reconstruction. Feed-forward methods avoid costly per-scene optimization, but fixed image or spatial resolutions limit their ability to allocate primitives according to local complexity. We present OctreeSplat, a hierarchical octree-guided feed-forward Gaussian splatting. OctreeSplat extracts multi-view features and geometric priors from a frozen visual foundation model (VFM), constructs a hierarchical octree, and predicts densification scores. The resulting representation allocates Gaussian primitives at spatially varying densities according to local complexity. Stochastic solids volume rendering improves depth rendering, strengthens geometric supervision, and supports surface reconstruction. When camera parameters are available, an optional test-time optimization (TTO) module improves agreement between predicted and ground-truth parameters. Training updates only 76 million additional parameters and requires 35 GPU-hours. Experiments on Replica, TUM, Tanks and Temples, and DTU demonstrate competitive RGB view synthesis, depth synthesis, and surface reconstruction. OctreeSplat reduces the number of Gaussian primitives while maintaining high reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: OctreeSplat: 一种基于八叉树引导的前馈 3D 高斯泼溅方法，按局部复杂度自适应分配高斯基元，实现高效新视角合成与表面重建。
AI.motivation: 前馈式 3DGS 避免了逐场景优化，但固定的图像或空间分辨率限制了高斯基元按局部复杂度分配的能力，导致表示效率不高。
AI.method: 从冻结的视觉基础模型（VFM）提取多视角特征与几何先验，构建层次化八叉树并预测稠密化分数，从而在空间上以变化的密度分配高斯基元；引入随机实体体积渲染改进深度渲染与几何监督，支持表面重建；相机参数可用时加入可选的测试时优化（TTO）模块。
AI.result: 仅训练 7600 万额外参数、消耗 35 GPU 小时；在 Replica、TUM、Tanks and Temples、DTU 上，RGB 视图合成、深度合成与表面重建均具竞争力，并在保持高质量的同时减少高斯基元数量。
AI.conclusion: 通过八叉树引导的自适应基元分配，OctreeSplat 在保持重建质量的前提下提升了前馈 3DGS 的表示效率，是一种高效且通用的方案。

title: LipLingo: CNN Model for Lip Reading
summary: Lip reading plays a crucial role in applications such as speech recognition, assistive technologies for the hearing-impaired, and biometric authentication. However, performance often degrades when the speaker varies and when certain speech sounds are visually similar. To address these challenges, we propose LipLingo, a robust lip-reading system based on the LipNet architecture, enhanced with a standardized preprocessing pipeline for consistent mouth-region representation, a rotational validation strategy for improved generalization to unseen speakers, and a flexible similarity evaluation for more reliable sentence-level assessment. The model architecture combines 3D convolutional layers for spatio-temporal feature extraction and bidirectional recurrent layers for sequence modeling, optimized using the Adam optimizer and Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) loss. On the GRID dataset, LipLingo achieved 95.0\% character-level accuracy (CER 4.99\%) and 87.2\% sentence-level accuracy. At the corpus level, the system obtained a (WER 13.1\%), outperforming the baseline LipNet and demonstrating competitive performance relative to recent 3D-ResNet + Bi-GRU + MixUp approaches. These results provide insights into strategies that enhance lip-reading robustness and highlight directions for future work toward real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: LipLingo 基于 LipNet 架构，通过标准化预处理、旋转验证策略和灵活相似度评估提升唇读鲁棒性，在 GRID 上达到 95.0% 字符准确率与 87.2% 句子准确率。
AI.motivation: 唇读在语音识别、听障辅助和生物认证中很重要，但说话人变化和视觉相似音素会导致性能下降，需提升鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.method: 以 LipNet 为基础：标准化预处理管线保证嘴部区域表示一致；3D 卷积提取时空特征 + 双向循环层建模序列；Adam 优化与 CTC 损失；引入旋转验证策略提升未见说话人泛化，并用灵活相似度评估做句子级评测。
AI.result: GRID 数据集上字符级准确率 95.0%（CER 4.99%）、句子级准确率 87.2%、语料级 WER 13.1%；优于 LipNet 基线，并与近期 3D-ResNet + Bi-GRU + MixUp 方法具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明所提策略能有效增强唇读鲁棒性，为实际部署指明方向，未来需进一步向真实场景推广。

title: PriCBMs: Multi-granular Concept Bottleneck Vision-Language Models for Visual Privacy Recognition
summary: Widespread image sharing on social media has increased the need for visual privacy recognition to identify inadvertently exposed privacy information. However, multi-label visual privacy recognition presents two challenges. First, privacy categories represent high-level semantic attributes and do not have a one-to-one correspondence with visual objects. Different visual objects may involve the same privacy category, while the same type of object may contain different types of privacy-sensitive information. In this setting, direct prediction methods generally lack explicit guidance for identifying category-relevant privacy cues, leaving this process implicit in the learned image-to-label mapping and potentially limiting classification performance. Second, privacy cues are often distributed across image regions and may not be adequately represented by whole-image features. To address these challenges, we propose Privacy Concept Bottleneck Models (PriCBMs). By introducing privacy-related concepts as intermediate semantic representations, PriCBMs first identify category-relevant privacy cues through visual-concept matching and then predict privacy categories based on concept responses. This process makes privacy predictions more interpretable. To improve the quality of these concepts, we design a concept selection strategy based on target-category relevance, cross-category discriminability, and semantic diversity. Meanwhile, we introduce a global-region modeling module to capture localized privacy evidence while retaining global context. Experiments on VISPR and FineViP show that PriCBMs outperform evaluated competitors across all four multi-label metrics. Ablation studies and concept-quality analyses support the effectiveness of the proposed design. Code is available at https://github.com/sun2293674491-dotcom/PriCBMs.

AI.tldr: 提出Privacy Concept Bottleneck Models (PriCBMs)，通过引入隐私相关概念作为中间语义表示，结合视觉-概念匹配与概念响应预测，提升多标签视觉隐私识别的性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 社交媒图像广泛分享带来视觉隐私识别需求。多标签视觉隐私识别面临两大挑战：(1) 隐私类别是高层语义属性，与视觉对象非一一对应，直接预测缺乏对类别相关隐私线索的显式引导；(2) 隐私线索分散于图像多区域，整图特征难以充分表达。
AI.method: 提出PriCBMs，引入隐私相关概念作为中间语义表示，先通过视觉-概念匹配识别类别相关隐私线索，再基于概念响应预测隐私类别；设计基于目标类别相关性、跨类别区分性和语义多样性的概念选择策略；引入全局-区域建模模块，在保留全局上下文的同时捕获局部隐私证据。
AI.result: 在VISPR和FineViP数据集上，PriCBMs在全部四项多标签指标上均优于对比方法；消融实验与概念质量分析验证了各设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 概念瓶颈结构使隐私预测更具可解释性并提升多标签识别性能，概念选择策略与全局-区域建模是关键有效设计，代码已开源。

title: Spectral Degeneration of Self-Attention under Isotropic Score Geometry
summary: We study the spectral structure of the self-attention matrix in Transformer models through an idealized spectral model for the pre-softmax score matrix. Motivated by the rotational isotropy of query and key representations, our model replaces the random token-space orientation of the score matrix by its canonical singular-value representative with a logarithmic spike--bulk separation. Empirical diagnostics on pretrained vision and language transformers motivate this model: token-space singular matrices have nearly uniform eigen-angle distributions, and score spectra are dominated by a small number of effective directions. We then prove that the row-wise softmax map transforms this structure into a degenerate attention matrix: dominant modes are preserved, whereas the bulk spectral distributions concentrate at zero. Stable rank remains bounded for bidirectional attention but grows logarithmically for causal attention. Within the canonical model, these results explain how attention can preserve a small number of dominant directions while compressing the remaining bulk modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个理想化谱模型刻画Transformer自注意力矩阵的谱结构：将pre-softmax打分矩阵的随机token空间方向替换为其规范奇异值代表（对数尖峰—体部分离），并证明softmax将该结构转化为退化注意力矩阵——主模态保留、体部谱向零集中，稳定秩在双向注意力下有界、在因果注意力下呈对数增长。
AI.motivation: 动机来自对预训练视觉与语言Transformer的经验诊断：token空间奇异矩阵的特征角分布近似均匀（旋转各向同性），打分谱由少量有效方向主导。作者希望用简洁可分析的谱模型解释注意力矩阵为何能"保留少数主方向而压缩其余体部模态"。
AI.method: 1) 构建pre-softmax打分矩阵的理想化谱模型，用规范奇异值代表替代随机方向，具有对数尖峰—体部分离；2) 在预训练视觉/语言模型上做经验诊断（特征角分布、谱主导性）以佐证模型；3) 理论分析行级softmax映射对谱的作用，证明主模态被保持、体部谱分布向零集中，并分别推导双向与因果注意力下稳定秩的界。
AI.result: 证明softmax将结构化打分矩阵变换为退化注意力矩阵：主导模态被保留，体部谱集中在零；稳定秩在双向注意力下有界，在因果注意力下对数增长。经验诊断显示token空间奇异矩阵特征角近似均匀、打分谱由少量有效方向主导，与模型假设一致。
AI.conclusion: 在规范模型框架下，结果解释了注意力"保留少量主方向、压缩其余体部模态"的机制，并为双向/因果注意力的秩行为差异提供理论解释。

title: TME-ContextNet: Class-Conditioned Spatial Supervision and Grouped Decoding for Joint Nuclei Instance Segmentation and Classification
summary: Joint nuclei instance segmentation and classification requires precise boundaries and neighborhood information that helps distinguish morphologically similar cell types. We present TME-ContextNet, a multi-task framework that learns class-conditioned spatial context from existing nuclear annotations and organizes decoding into geometry-related and semantic task groups. Class-conditioned spatial supervision extends nuclear labels into a dense target using Euclidean distance transforms, requiring no additional tissue-region annotation. We derive its nearest-region interpretation and characterize its stability to small annotation perturbations. A local--global context module combines dilated convolution and self-attention, while a grouped task decoder reduces redundant computation. The spatial head supplies training supervision and is omitted during inference. Experiments on PanMix, CoNSeP, and PanNuke yield Dice scores of 80.23%, 65.32%, and 79.13%, and mean multi-class panoptic quality (mPQ+) scores of 67.62%, 35.50%, and 43.74%, respectively. PanNuke results are averaged across three test folds. Target and decoder controls support the combination of distance-based supervision and grouped decoding while identifying their dependence on task configuration. The framework uses 36.40 million parameters, compared with 54.74 million for HoVer-Net. These findings support a compact, context-aware formulation for joint nuclei analysis in computational pathology.

AI.tldr: TME-ContextNet：多任务框架，用类条件空间监督（欧氏距离变换）与分组解码器联合完成细胞核实例分割与分类，参数更少、性能有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 细胞核实例分割与分类需要精确边界和邻域信息以区分类似细胞类型，现有方法对空间上下文利用不足且计算冗余。
AI.method: (1) 类条件空间监督：将核标注通过欧氏距离变换扩展为稠密目标，无需额外组织区域标注；(2) 推导其最近区域解释并分析对标注扰动的稳定性；(3) 局部-全局上下文模块：膨胀卷积+自注意力；(4) 分组任务解码器：将任务分为几何相关组与语义组，减少冗余计算；空间头仅训练时使用。
AI.result: PanMix/CoNSeP/PanNuke上Dice为80.23%/65.32%/79.13%，mPQ+为67.62%/35.50%/43.74%（PanNuke为三折平均）；参数36.40M，低于HoVer-Net的54.74M。
AI.conclusion: 消融验证了距离监督与分组解码的组合有效，但效果依赖任务配置；整体提供了紧凑、上下文感知的细胞核联合分析方案。

title: Geometry-Constrained Dynamic Hypergraph Convolutional Network with Contrastive Score Refinement for Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
summary: Skeleton-based action recognition is a pivotal task in computer vision; however, conventional Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) are often constrained by pairwise joint modeling, which fails to capture the intricate high-order interactions inherent in human movement. While recent hypergraph-based methods attempt to address this limitation, they typically rely on static structures derived from anatomical priors, lacking the flexibility to capture dynamic, action-specific joint correlations. To this end, we propose DyGCN, a Geometry-Constrained Dynamic Hypergraph Convolutional Network for skeleton-based action recognition. At the core of DyGCN is the Dynamic Hypergraph Construction Network with Contrastive Score Refinement (DyGCT) block, which comprises two novel components: the Geometry-Constrained Dynamic Hypergraph Construction (GeoHC) module and the Contrastive Score Refinement (CSR) module. Specifically, GeoHC dynamically constructs action-specific hyperedges by leveraging geometry-constrained second-order compatibility, transcending the limitations of static hyperedge structures. Furthermore, CSR explicitly refines the pairwise compatibility scores during hypergraph construction through prototype-based contrastive learning, fostering more discriminative action-specific hyperedges, with zero inference-time overhead as CSR operates only during training. Extensive experiments on NTU RGB+D, NTU RGB+D 120, and Northwestern-UCLA validate the effectiveness of DyGCN, achieving state-of-the-art performance on widely used benchmarks. The source code is available at https://github.com/marvineta0405/DyGCN.

AI.tldr: DyGCN：几何约束的动态超图卷积网络，用动态构建动作特定超边并对兼容性分数做对比精炼，实现骨架动作识别SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统GCN只能建模关节对(pairwise)关系，难以捕捉人体运动中的高阶交互；已有超图方法依赖解剖先验的静态超边，缺乏对动态、动作特定关节关联的灵活性。
AI.method: 提出DyGCN，核心是DyGCT块，含两个模块：(1) GeoHC，利用几何约束的二阶兼容性动态构建动作特定超边，突破静态结构限制；(2) CSR，用基于原型的对比学习精炼超图构建中的成对兼容性分数，获得更具判别性的超边，且仅在训练阶段使用，推理零开销。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D、NTU RGB+D 120和Northwestern-UCLA上大量实验验证有效性，在常用基准上达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 动态、几何约束的超图构建结合对比分数精炼是建模高阶关节交互的有效方案，且推理无额外开销，代码已开源。

title: SynForecast: Controlled Synthetic Time Series for Forecasting Research
summary:
Synthetic time series constitute a substantial share of the training corpora of several recent forecasting foundation models. Existing studies report benefits at small data budgets and modest synthetic proportions, but each evaluates individual combinations of model and generator. Studying these benefits systematically requires generators that support controlled configuration, perturbation, reproducibility and mechanism-level ablation, and the 11 existing generators we review show gaps in this combined support.
  We present SynForecast, an open-source Python library with 32 generators, 19 of which implement named mechanisms with a published source in econometrics, quantitative finance, statistical physics and point-process theory. Perturbations and mechanism families can be varied while everything else is held fixed, output comes in the long format that forecasting libraries accept, and output does not depend on the number of parallel workers.
  We evaluate SynForecast on M4 at five frequencies with a neural network and a gradient-boosted ensemble. A classical baseline attains the lowest error in nine of ten frequency-history combinations. A synthetic prior outperforms the same network trained from scratch at a fixed budget by up to 34% with a few dozen observations, but loses to it at full history at every frequency, and none of three pre-specified rescalings of history predicts where the sign changes. At the hourly frequency, where the prior fails at every history, the corpus lacks daily cycles; adding them reduces zero-shot error by 43 to 63% for both models. Fine-tuning outperforms training from scratch by up to about 15%, but at short histories a fixed 300-step fine-tune is worse than the pretrained model used as is. Removing the classical mechanism family costs about 2% for both models; every other family has a smaller effect outside the hourly frequency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出开源库 SynForecast（32个生成器，19个实现有文献来源的命名机制），支持受控配置、扰动、可复现与机制级消融，并在 M4 五频率上系统评估合成时序先验的效果。
AI.motivation: 近期预测基础模型的训练语料含大量合成时序，但已有收益报告仅针对单一模型-生成器组合，缺乏可控、可复现、可做机制级消融的生成器工具，现有11个生成器在组合支持上存在缺口。
AI.method: 构建 SynForecast 库；在 M4 五频率上用神经网络与梯度提升集成评估；在固定预算下对比合成先验与从头训练，测试三种预设历史缩放、小时频率日周期补全，以及微调与机制家族消融。
AI.result: 经典基线在9/10频率-历史组合中误差最低；合成先验在几十个观测时最多优于从头训练34%，但在完整历史下各频率均更差，三种缩放均无法预测符号变化点；小时频率补日周期后零样本误差降43–63%；微调最多提升约15%，但短历史下300步微调劣于直接用预训练模型；移除经典机制家族约损失2%。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据的收益高度依赖数据预算、频率与生成器机制构成，不能简单外推；提供可控可复现的生成器工具是系统研究该类收益的前提。

title: Discovering Semantic Granularity in Images through Clustering of Pretrained Visual Representations
summary: Semantic granularity, which refers to the levels at which visual representations organize image content into meaningful entities, is fundamental to image understanding. However, whether pretrained visual representations inherently encode semantic structures at multiple granularities remains poorly understood. This paper presents a representation-driven approach for discovering semantically meaningful image regions at different granularities through clustering of pretrained visual representations without semantic supervision. Specifically, we concatenate selected feature maps extracted from a pretrained visual model and apply a singular value decomposition (SVD)-based projection to derive pixel-wise principal representation maps (PRMs). The resulting PRMs capture implicit semantic structures embedded in pretrained visual representations, making them accessible to subsequent semantic clustering. We then introduce the semantic continuity rate (SCR), based on the silhouette principle, to quantify the coherence of pixel-wise representations within and between clusters at different candidate granularities. Furthermore, we analyze the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of SCR profiles to assess representation suitability for discovering semantic regions at multiple granularities. Our results indicate that PRMs exhibiting higher SNR values over an initial range of cluster numbers tend to yield more semantically meaningful regions across multiple granularities. We evaluate the proposed approach on the COCO-2017 and VOC-2012 validation datasets using Hungarian-matched intersection over union (HIoU). The results demonstrate competitive segmentation performance among the compared methods, supporting the feasibility of discovering useful semantic granularities through clustering PRMs without semantic supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督方法，通过聚类预训练视觉表征（结合SVD投影得到像素级主表征图PRM），发现图像中多粒度的语义区域，并用语义连续性率（SCR）及其SNR评估表征的适用性。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉表征是否天然编码了多粒度的语义结构仍不清楚，本文旨在探究能否在无语义监督下从这些表征中发现有意义的多粒度语义区域。
AI.method: 拼接预训练模型的特征图，用基于SVD的投影得到像素级主表征图（PRM）；再对PRM做语义聚类，并引入基于轮廓系数的语义连续性率（SCR）来量化不同候选粒度下簇内/簇间像素表征的一致性，同时分析SCR剖面的信噪比（SNR）以评估表征对多粒度语义区域发现的适用性。
AI.result: 在COCO-2017和VOC-2012验证集上用匈牙利匹配IoU（HIoU）评估，分割性能与对比方法具有竞争力；在初始簇数范围内SNR较高的PRM往往能在多个粒度上产生更有语义意义的区域。
AI.conclusion: 无需语义监督、仅通过聚类PRM即可发现有用的多粒度语义结构，验证了从预训练视觉表征中发现多粒度语义区域的可行性。

title: CARE: Contrastive Representation Learning with Environment-Invariance Regularization for Behavioural Intention Prediction
summary: Trajectory-based behavioural intention prediction faces environmental variation, and representations learned with a pooled contrastive objective may retain environment-specific regularities. We present CARE, a self-supervised trajectory-learning framework that couples temporally asymmetric contrastive views with an invariant-risk-minimisation (IRM)-style gradient penalty on environment-wise contrastive risks. Each input window yields an anchor, a partially masked positive view, and a temporally perturbed negative view. Masked reconstruction and observability-aware evidence consistency complement this objective by promoting temporal information retention under partial input. On an IMPTC-derived four-class intention task, CARE achieves 0.840 accuracy and 0.023 expected calibration error (ECE) under IID fine-tuning, and 0.806 accuracy with a Brier score of 0.308 on the reported held-out environment. Under frozen-encoder linear probing, reconstruction provides the largest individual held-out accuracy gain, whereas the complete objective yields the lowest held-out ECE (0.049) among tested variants. These results support the combined objective as a competitive representation-learning approach under the evaluated shift, while the IRM-style regulariser is not taken as evidence of formal invariance.

AI.tldr: 提出CARE自监督轨迹表示学习框架，结合时间非对称对比视图与IRM式梯度惩罚，在IMPTC四类意图任务上取得0.840准确率与0.023 ECE，跨环境泛化0.806。
AI.motivation: 基于轨迹的行为意图预测受环境变化影响，而池化对比目标学到的表示可能保留环境特有的规律性，损害跨环境泛化。
AI.method: CARE框架：每个输入窗口生成锚点、部分掩码正视图与时间扰动负视图，采用时间非对称对比；对环境级对比风险施加IRM式梯度惩罚；辅以掩码重建与可观测性感知的证据一致性目标，促进部分输入下的时间信息保留。
AI.result: IMPTC派生四类意图任务：IID微调下准确率0.840、ECE 0.023；留出环境上准确率0.806、Brier 0.308。冻结编码器线性探测下，重建单项带来最大留出准确率增益，完整目标取得最低留出ECE（0.049）。
AI.conclusion: 组合目标在所评估的分布偏移下是具竞争力的表示学习方法；IRM式正则项不视为形式化不变性的证据。

title: 3L-D: A Low-Light Level Dataset from a Sensor-Agnostic, Alignment-Preserving Acquisition Framework
summary: Supervised low-light image and video enhancement has achieved remarkable progress, yet current models remain fundamentally constrained by the limitations of existing datasets. Prevailing methods typically rely on uncontrolled ambient captures, camera parameter manipulation (e.g., exposure or ISO adjustments), or neutral density filters, failing to replicate authentic night-sky near-infrared spectral content and genuine low-photon noise distributions. Furthermore, capturing dynamic paired sequences without introducing warping artifacts or sensor-specific biases remains an open challenge. In this paper, we introduce 3L-Dataset, a physically calibrated low-light image and video dataset generated using a modular, sensor-agnostic acquisition framework. Our test bench faithfully reproduces the standardized Midavaine night level scale from Level 1 (full moon, approximately 1000 mlx) down to Level 5 (overcast moonless night, approximately 0.1 mlx), spanning the visible to near-infrared spectrum across diverse realistic environments, including countryside, forest, urban, and desert scale models. Using high-precision programmable mechanical actuation, our acquisition framework guarantees sub-pixel spatial alignment across synchronized sextuplets, each composed of one reference image and five corresponding images acquired at the five standardized night levels, without post-processing image warping. We evaluate multiple representative deep learning baselines across varying night levels, revealing critical trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity, perceptual quality, and inference latency under severe photon starvation. The modular acquisition framework can be adapted to different cameras, optical systems, sensor technologies, and resolutions, enabling the dataset to be continuously expanded.

AI.tldr: 本文提出3L-Dataset，一个物理标定、模块化采集的低光照图像与视频数据集，覆盖Midavaine夜间照度1–5级（约1000 mlx至0.1 mlx）及可见到近红外光谱，提供无需后处理扭曲的亚像素对齐六元组配对数据。
AI.motivation: 现有低光照数据集依赖非受控环境拍摄、相机参数调整或中性密度滤镜，无法复现真实夜空近红外光谱内容与真实低光子噪声分布；且动态配对序列采集易引入扭曲伪影与传感器偏差。
AI.method: 构建传感器无关的模块化采集框架与测试台，复现标准化Midavaine夜间照度等级（Level 1 满月约1000 mlx 至 Level 5 阴天无月约0.1 mlx），覆盖乡村、森林、城市、沙漠沙盘等场景及可见—近红外波段；利用高精度可编程机械驱动实现同步六元组（1张参考图+5个照度级对应图）的亚像素空间对齐，无后处理图像扭曲；并适配不同相机、光学系统、传感器与分辨率以支持持续扩展。
AI.result: 在多个代表性深度学习基线于不同夜间等级上的评测表明，在严重光子匮乏条件下，重建保真度、感知质量与推理延迟之间存在关键权衡。
AI.conclusion: 3L-Dataset为低光照图像与视频增强提供了物理标定、光谱真实、无扭曲伪影的可扩展数据基础，并揭示了极端低光下多项性能指标间的权衡关系。

title: When Is Tracking Affordable? A Movement-Budget Feasibility Threshold for Dynamic Regret
summary: Dynamic regret measures an online learner against a moving comparator, and standard analyses assume the learner may move freely at every round. We study what happens when it may not: the learner is given a hard budget $S$ on its total movement $\sum_t \|x_t - x_{t-1}\|$. Our main result is that a movement budget creates a feasibility barrier. On a domain of diameter $D$ with $G$-Lipschitz convex losses, for every comparator path length $P_T \in [D, DT]$ we exhibit a deterministic adversary that forces $R_d = Ω(GDT)$ on every budget-feasible algorithm whenever $S \le c P_T$ for a universal constant $c>0$. This barrier is caused by the budget rather than by a volatile environment: for fixed $D$, it applies when $P_T = o(T)$, where the unconstrained minimax rate $Θ(G\sqrt{D(D+P_T)T})$ is sublinear, so the same instances are learnable with an unbounded budget and unlearnable without one. Conversely, projected online gradient descent with a budget-aware step size is budget-feasible and attains $o(GDT)$ once $S = ω(D + P_T)$. Thus the critical movement scale is $D+P_T$: linear regret is unavoidable below a sufficiently small constant multiple of $P_T$, while sublinear regret is achievable when $S/(D+P_T)\to\infty$ in the learnable regime. The construction rests on a distinction we make explicit: what makes a comparator expensive to track under a movement budget is the distance it forces the learner to travel, not its path length. Above the threshold we give a budget-dependent upper bound and identify the tight minimax rate in this region as an open problem rather than claiming a product law. Experiments support the predicted transition location and the $1/S$ decay.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带总移动预算约束的在线学习动态遗憾，发现移动预算会造成可行性障碍：当预算低于比较器路径长度的常数倍时，任何可行算法都会被确定型对手逼至线性遗憾Ω(GDT)。
AI.motivation: 标准动态遗憾分析假设学习器每轮可自由移动，但实际系统常有移动总量限制。作者希望刻画硬移动预算S如何改变可实现的学习-跟踪权衡，并区分"环境波动"与"预算约束"两种困难来源。
AI.method: 在直径D、G-Lipschitz凸损失设定下，构造确定型对手：对任意满足S≤c·P_T的预算可行算法强制线性遗憾。同时分析带预算感知步长的投影在线梯度下降(POGD)，给出预算相关的上界；并通过实验验证相变位置与1/S衰减。
AI.result: 对每个P_T∈[D,DT]存在对手使R_d=Ω(GDT)（当S≤cP_T）。即便P_T=o(T)、无约束minimax率Θ(G√(D(D+P_T)T))为次线性，同一实例有无限预算可学、无预算不可学。反之POGD在S=ω(D+P_T)时达到o(GDT)。关键移动尺度为D+P_T。
AI.conclusion: 移动预算产生临界尺度D+P_T：低于P_T的充分小常数倍时线性遗憾不可避免，S/(D+P_T)→∞时可达次线性。关键在于比较器迫使学习器"行走的距离"而非其路径长度。阈值以上的紧minimax率仍为开放问题。

title: Attention Residual U-Net for Enhanced Cross-Dataset Polyp Localization in Endoscopy
summary: Precise localization of pathologies in endoscopy is a critical task in medical imaging, with deep learning (DL) frameworks now serving as the primary methodology for automated lesion detection. Today, generic object detection methods, such as YOLO, provide state-of-the-art performance in this context. However, their robustness often decreases under real-world clinical conditions due to variations across endoscopic devices, intestinal content, dataset bias, and the presence of small or low-contrast lesions. Motivated by these challenges, we propose a novel polyp detection framework based on a Attention Residual U-Net offering enhanced polyp localization. Instead of directly regressing bounding boxes from global feature representations, the proposed method learns lesion-focused spatial representations and converts them into bounding-box predictions during inference. Unlike conventional encoder-decoder localization frameworks that directly propagate all encoder activations into the decoding pathway, the proposed method selectively suppresses irrelevant background responses before feature reconstruction. This encourages the network to focus on lesion-relevant spatial evidence under heterogeneous imaging conditions. To achieve this, the framework integrates residual feature propagation, attention-guided encoder filtering, and multi-scale contextual learning. The proposed framework was evaluated on multiple public endoscopic datasets acquired using different devices. The comparative experimental results validate its effectiveness over the relevant state-of-the-art methods, with an improvement up to 22.0% in terms of the area under the receiving operating characteristic (AUC).

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于注意力残差U-Net的息肉检测框架，通过选择性抑制背景响应学习病灶空间表征并转化为边界框，在多个公开内镜数据集上优于现有方法，AUC最高提升22.0%。
AI.motivation: 内镜病灶精准定位至关重要，YOLO等通用目标检测方法虽为当前主流，但在真实临床条件下因设备差异、肠道内容物、数据集偏置及小/低对比度病灶而鲁棒性下降。
AI.method: 基于Attention Residual U-Net的息肉检测框架：不直接从全局特征回归边界框，而是学习病灶聚焦的空间表征并在推理时转化为框预测；在特征重建前用注意力引导的编码器滤波选择性抑制无关背景响应，结合残差特征传播与多尺度上下文学习。
AI.result: 在多个不同设备采集的公开内镜数据集上评估，对比实验显示其优于相关SOTA方法，AUC最高提升22.0%。
AI.conclusion: 注意力引导的背景抑制与残差多尺度结构可提升异构成像条件下的息肉定位鲁棒性与准确性。

title: In-context learning of solution to simple linear regression task using transformer with masked linear self-attention
summary: In-context learning is a remarkable property of transformers and has recently received a lot of interest. In many studies of in-context learning, it has been shown that transformers are capable of implementing solvers for linear and non-linear regression problems, in which the most of them implement gradient descent algorithm. However, it is still unclear whether those implementations have actually been acquired through training. In this paper, we constructed a transformer with masked linear self-attention, which in-context learns the least squares estimate in a simple regression task. The point here is that the closed form (analytical) solution is obtained by using layer normalization rather than an approximate solution based on the gradient descent algorithm. Then, we showed an experimental example, in which, by taking the non-uniqueness of the transformer representation into account, our implementation for a closed form solution is used in the transformer trained with the l1 regularization when the target output is the least squares estimate.

AI.tldr: 构造带掩码线性自注意力的Transformer，通过LayerNorm实现上下文内最小二乘的闭式解，而非梯度下降近似解，并在l1正则训练中验证该实现被采用。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多表明Transformer在上下文学习中实现的是梯度下降类求解器（线性/非线性回归），但这些梯度下降实现是否真的由训练获得仍不清楚；且多数工作只得到近似解。
AI.method: 设计一个带掩码线性自注意力的Transformer，在简单回归任务中做上下文内学习；关键点是利用LayerNorm得到最小二乘的闭式（解析）解，而不是基于梯度下降的近似解。随后考虑Transformer表示的非唯一性，用实验检验该闭式解实现是否出现在以最小二乘为目标输出、用l1正则训练的Transformer中。
AI.result: 实验示例表明，在考虑表示非唯一性后，所构造的闭式解实现被l1正则训练的Transformer所采用（当目标输出为最小二乘估计时）。
AI.conclusion: Transformer可通过LayerNorm在上下文内实现最小二乘的精确闭式解而非梯度下降近似；训练得到的Transformer确实可能采用该闭式解，提示以往将ICL归为梯度下降的解释并非唯一。

title: MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy
summary: Long-form multi-shot video editing requires an intended edit to remain coherent across abrupt changes in scene, viewpoint, and subject appearance, while processing substantially longer visual context than conventional single-shot editors. We introduce MoviEdit, an end-to-end framework for scalable long-form multi-shot video editing that jointly addresses the challenges of data, modeling, and evaluation. To provide cross-shot supervision data at scale, we develop automatic data-generation pipelines spanning synchronized multi-view footage, real-world multi-shot videos, and generated multi-shot content, yielding 87K paired editing videos without manual annotation.
