Architecturally, MoviEdit employs a cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive design: a lightweight bidirectional stage first establishes a globally coherent editing draft over a spatiotemporally compressed representation, which is then autoregressively propagated and refined over the full video. We further introduce MoviEdit-Bench, a dedicated benchmark for systematic evaluation of long-form multi-shot video editing. Extensive experiments show that MoviEdit substantially outperforms existing open-source models and performs on par with industry frontier models across text-guided and image-guided editing. Visit our project page for complete results and to access the benchmark: https://multi-shot-edit.github.io/

AI.tldr: MoviEdit 是面向长时长多镜头视频编辑的端到端框架，通过自动数据构建、级联双向-自回归建模与专用基准，实现跨镜头编辑一致性。
AI.motivation: 长视频多镜头编辑需在场景、视角、主体外观突变时保持编辑意图连贯，并处理远超单镜头编辑器的长视觉上下文；现有方法缺数据、建模与评估手段。
AI.method: 三条自动数据生成流水线（同步多视角素材、真实多镜头视频、生成式多镜头内容），产出 87K 成对编辑视频；架构为级联双向-自回归设计：轻量双向阶段在时空压缩表示上构建全局一致的编辑草稿，再自回归传播并精修至完整视频；并提出 MoviEdit-Bench 基准。
AI.result: 在文本引导与图像引导编辑上显著优于现有开源模型，与工业前沿模型表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 数据、建模、评估三方面协同设计可有效支撑可扩展的长时长多镜头视频编辑，并提供了公开基准与项目资源。

title: Efficient Detailed Scheduling of Multiproduct Pipelines using Action-Decoupled Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multiproduct pipelines transport refined products to delivery stations in sequential batches, and their detailed scheduling must meet market demand while respecting nonlinear hydraulic constraints. Retaining the full hydraulic nonlinearity yields a mixed-integer nonlinear program that is computationally intractable, while the linearization commonly adopted for solver-based optimization degrades hydraulic accuracy without resolving the heavy computational burden. This paper develops an action-decoupled proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework that efficiently produces detailed schedules while preserving hydraulic fidelity. The scheduling process is cast as a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP) with flexible action durations. To handle the discrete-continuous hybrid action space, a cascaded dual-actor architecture decouples the discrete operating duration from the continuous flow decisions, eliminating the gradient interference that destabilizes conventional coupled-action policies and thereby yielding high-quality schedules far more efficiently. Validated on a real-world multiproduct pipeline in China and benchmarked against a single-actor baseline and a linearized MILP solved by Gurobi, the proposed framework achieves delivery accuracy close to the exact optimum while substantially improving flow rate stability and substantially reducing solution time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动作解耦的PPO框架，将成品油管道详细调度建模为带柔性时长的半马尔可夫决策过程，用级联双actor结构分离离散时长与连续流量决策，在保留完整水力非线性的同时高效生成调度方案。
AI.motivation: 成品油管道按批次顺序输送，调度需满足市场需求并遵守非线性水力约束。完整保留水力非线性会导致混合整数非线性规划难以求解；常用的线性化虽便于求解，却损失水力精度且计算负担依然沉重。
AI.method: 将调度过程建模为半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDP），动作时长可变；针对离散-连续混合动作空间，采用级联双actor架构，将离散操作时长与连续流量决策解耦，消除耦合动作策略中的梯度干扰，采用PPO训练。
AI.result: 在中国某实际成品油管道上验证，并与单actor基线及Gurobi求解的线性化MILP对比：交付精度接近精确最优解，流量稳定性显著提升，求解时间大幅缩短。
AI.conclusion: 动作解耦的PPO框架能够在保留水力保真度的前提下高效生成管道详细调度方案，兼顾精度、稳定性与计算效率，优于线性化MILP与耦合动作基线。

title: Subspace Representations for Synthetic-to-Real Transfer in 3-D Surface Inspection
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to the ACCV 2026 Workshop on Subspaces in the Era of Foundation Models. Website: https://abdullah-nasir-chowdhury.github.io/projects/accv2026/
summary: This paper studies what subspace representations contribute to synthetic-to-real transfer in 3-D surface inspection, where models learn from synthetic defects and the only real data before deployment are scans of good parts. We use three classical constructions as instruments: the nearest-subspace classifier, one-class template subspaces and the generalized difference subspace (GDS). On 1,197 MVTec 3D-AD scans without target annotation we find that every decision rule ranks real defects at a similar window AUC, that image-level detection stays at chance, and that no rule keeps its in-domain threshold. We show that the margin of a nearest-subspace rule moves by at most the part of the feature shift outside its class subspaces, and that this leakage, measured from unlabeled good scans, bounds the displacement observed on unseen scans. On 597 Real3D-AD objects, a one-class subspace of registered templates evaluated at every location on frozen features reaches point AUROC 0.957 on pre-registered scans and a category-mean object AUROC of 78 to 81 with no training on the benchmark. Our results suggest that a subspace helps under shift in proportion to the shift it spans, and that in reference-based inspection the reference and its registration matter more than the subspace.

AI.tldr: 研究子空间表示在合成到真实(t2r)三维表面检测迁移中的作用，发现子空间帮助程度取决于其span的shift，且参考与其配准比子空间本身更重要。
AI.motivation: 合成缺陷训练的模型部署前只有正常件扫描，缺少真实缺陷标注，需理解子空间表示在domain shift下对t2r迁移究竟贡献什么。
AI.method: 以三种经典构造为工具：最近子空间分类器、单类模板子空间、广义差分子空间(GDS)；用无标注正常扫描测量特征shift向类子空间外的"泄漏"，并理论界定其与margin位移的关系。
AI.result: MVTec 3D-AD 1197扫描上各决策规则窗口AUC相近、图像级检测近随机、无规则保持域内阈值；偏margin位移≤子空间外泄漏量并可作为未见扫描位移上界；Real3D-AD 597对象上单类配准模板子空间在冻结特征上点AUROC 0.957、对象AUROC 78–81（未训练）。
AI.conclusion: 子空间在shift下的收益与其所span的shift成正比；参考式检测中参考及其配准比子空间本身更关键。

title: GraTED: Graph--Tensor EEG Decoding for Passenger Hazard Perception in Autonomous Vehicles
comment: Yuxuan Gu and Yingkai Yang contribute equally to this work
summary: Passenger electroencephalography (EEG) can reveal road risk through anticipatory responses before hazardous events and neural reactions around their onset. However, existing EEG decoding methods often map physiologically meaningful arrangement of electrodes onto artificial 2D grids and thus flatten the higher-order time-feature representations into matrices, obscuring meaningful structure in the data. To preserve and exploit the spatial and time-feature structure of EEG recordings, we propose the Graph-Tensor EEG Decoding Model (GraTED) for passenger risk prediction (RP) and danger identification (DI) in autonomous-vehicle scenarios. GraTED models the electrode arrangement as an undirected graph based on their scalp locations, using graph convolution to capture spatial dependencies and low-rank tensor classification to preserve the multidimensional time-feature structure, while controlling model complexity. Evaluated on the PassengerEEG dataset, comprising 11 participants and 45 hours of recordings, GraTED achieves the highest balanced accuracy, compared to the state-of-the-art, across all three evaluation settings, while requiring the fewest learnable parameters among seven baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Graph-Tensor EEG解码模型GraTED，用电极图卷积+低秩张量分类保留EEG的时空结构，在乘客风险预测与危险识别任务上取得最高平衡准确率且参数最少。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG解码方法把具有生理意义的电极布局映射到人工2D网格，并将高阶"时间-特征"表示展平为矩阵，破坏了数据中的有意义结构。
AI.method: 基于头皮位置将电极排列建模为无向图，用图卷积捕获空间依赖；用低秩张量分类保留多维时间-特征结构，同时控制模型复杂度。
AI.result: 在PassengerEEG数据集（11名参与者、45小时记录）上，于三种评估设置下平衡准确率均优于SOTA，且七种基线方法中可学习参数最少。
AI.conclusion: 保留电极空间图结构与时间-特征张量结构能在降低参数量的同时提升乘客EEG风险预测与危险识别性能。

title: Pair-Relative Partial Equivariance for Rotation-Robust Keypoint Descriptor Matching
summary: Learned keypoint descriptors trained on upright imagery often fail under large in-plane rotation. Steerers address this by applying a single exact SO(2) representation to the descriptor space, but this global group constraint can be too rigid for keypoint descriptors, whose angular responses need not follow a single group representation. We propose pair-relative partial equivariance, which measures equivariance under the empirical distribution of relative rotations in image pairs, and PaSteer, a relaxed descriptor-steering framework that allows the steering map to leave the exact representation manifold while retaining the lightweight, backbone-free design of steering. PaSteer instantiates this relaxation with two variants: an identity-preserving residual steerer (PaSteer-soft) and a free-form Fourier steerer (PaSteer-free). We show that the per-angle optimal linear steerer for a fixed non-equivariant descriptor generally does not obey the group composition law, explaining why exact representations can be suboptimal in the frozen-descriptor regime. On Roto-360, MegaDepth-1500, AIMS, and IMC-PT, PaSteer consistently improves rotation-robust matching over an exact steerer on frozen DeDoDe descriptors, especially under large relative rotations, with minimal upright degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出"配对相对部分等变性"及PaSteer框架，放宽steering的严格SO(2)表示约束，在冻结描述子上提升大旋转下的匹配鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 基于正立图像训练的关键点描述子在大角度平面旋转下性能下降。Steerer通过施加单一精确SO(2)表示来缓解，但全局群约束对描述子过于死板——描述子的角度响应未必服从单一群表示，精确表示可能次优。
AI.method: 定义pair-relative partial equivariance，以图像对中相对旋转的经验分布来衡量等变性；提出PaSteer松弛式steering框架，允许steering映射离开精确表示流形，同时保留轻量、无需backbone的设计。实例化两种变体：保恒等残差steerer（PaSteer-soft）与自由形式Fourier steerer（PaSteer-free）；并分析固定非等变描述子的逐角度最优线性steerer一般不满足群复合律。
AI.result: 在Roto-360、MegaDepth-1500、AIMS、IMC-PT上，PaSteer在冻结DeDoDe描述子上持续优于精确steerer，尤其在大相对旋转下，且正立场景性能退化极小。
AI.conclusion: 描述子层面无需严格群等变，适度松弛的配对相对部分等变性更契合关键点描述子的实际角度响应，是可插拔的轻量旋转鲁棒匹配增强方案。

title: DINOFAS: Bonafide-Centric Representation Learning for Face Anti-Spoofing
summary: Face anti-spoofing (FAS) models often learn attack- and dataset-specific cues that degrade performance under unseen acquisition conditions and presentation attacks. We present DINOFAS, a DINOv3-based framework that formulates FAS as bonafide-centric representation learning. The proposed framework combines parameter-efficient DINOv3 adaptation using low-rank adaptation (LoRA), an attention style-content disentanglement (ASCD) module for reducing domain-specific appearance variations, and a dual-branch architecture that separates prototype-based liveness learning from attack-semantic supervision. The model is jointly optimized using a bonafide-centric prototype objective, an attack-semantic classification loss applied to detached features, and orthogonality regularization. DINOFAS achieves an average HTER of 9.09\% under the standard OCIM leave-one-domain-out protocol, where training is performed on three source datasets and evaluation is conducted on the held-out unseen domain. We further evaluate synthetic-to-real generalization by training exclusively on SynthASpoof and testing on four unseen real-world datasets, where DINOFAS achieves the lowest average HTER of 21.41\% and the highest average AUC of 86.14\% among the compared methods. Evaluations on OULU-NPU and SiW-Mv2 additionally demonstrate robustness to variations in acquisition conditions, devices, and unseen presentation attacks.

AI.tldr: DINOFAS：基于DINOv3的"真脸中心"表示学习框架，用于提升人脸反欺骗（FAS）在未见采集条件和攻击类型下的泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有FAS模型常学到与特定攻击和数据集相关的线索，导致在未见采集条件与呈现攻击下性能下降，需提升跨域泛化能力。
AI.method: 采用DINOv3骨干，结合LoRA参数高效微调、注意力风格-内容解耦模块（ASCD）以减少域相关外观变化，并设计双分支架构：一支做基于原型的活体学习，另一支做攻击语义监督；联合优化包含真脸中心原型目标、作用于分离特征的攻击语义分类损失及正交正则。
AI.result: OCIM留一域协议平均HTER 9.09%；SynthASpoof训练、四个真实数据集测试的平均HTER最低21.41%、平均AUC最高86.14%；在OULU-NPU和SiW-Mv2上对采集条件、设备及未见攻击变异表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: 将FAS重构为真脸中心表示学习并结合风格-内容解耦，可有效提升跨域与合成到真实的泛化性能。

title: NIR: Approximate Neural Instance Retrieval for ALCIQ
summary: Instance retrieval is the main bottleneck of concept-learning systems based on refinement operators. We present NIR, a family of neural instance retrievers for ALCIQ that output graded membership scores from knowledge graph embeddings. We compare tokenization-based encoders (GRU, LSTM, Transformer) with a Compositional encoder that mirrors DL operators via primitive sub-networks. On eight benchmarks, all variants approximate Pellet closely on complete knowledge bases, while the Transformer model is most robust under incompleteness. The source code of our approach is at https://github.com/dice-group/owlapy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出NIR——面向ALCIQ描述逻辑的一族神经实例检索器，通过知识图谱嵌入输出分级隶属度分数，以替代精化算子概念学习系统中的实例检索瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 基于精化算子（refinement operators）的概念学习系统主要瓶颈在于实例检索，传统方法依赖如Pellet等推理机，成本高且在知识库不完整时表现受限。
AI.method: 将实例检索转化为从知识图谱嵌入中预测分级隶属度的问题；对比基于分词（tokenization）的编码器（GRU、LSTM、Transformer）与一种通过对原始子网络镜像DL算子的组合式编码器（Compositional encoder）。
AI.result: 在八个基准上，完整知识库下所有变体均能较好地逼近Pellet；在知识库不完整情况下，Transformer模型最为鲁棒。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 神经实例检索可作为精化算子学习中实例检索的可行替代方案，Transformer在信息不完整场景下具有最佳稳健性。

title: Trace4D: Grounded Spatiotemporal Reasoning via 4D State Sequences
summary: Understanding how objects and their spatial relationships evolve in 3D space over time remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs), particularly under changing viewpoints. Recent approaches incorporate geometric information into reasoning, but explicit supervision for temporally ordered 4D state evolution and its use as intermediate evidence remains limited. We introduce \textbf{Trace4D}, which trains VLMs to predict 4D state sequences and reason over their inter-timestep changes alongside temporal visual observations. Its 4D-grounded chain-of-thought (CoT) explicitly represents 4D states, analyzes temporal visual context, and connects both as evidence for the answer. We construct Trace4D-Train from in-the-wild videos with 600K 4D perception examples and approximately 70K grounded QA examples, and train with joint supervised fine-tuning followed by geometry-aware GRPO. At inference, Trace4D predicts 4D states and reasoning directly from video without reference annotations or an external geometric model. Experiments on Trace4D-Bench and VLM4D show improved QA accuracy over the base VLMs and benefits from reasoning over 4D state changes and temporal visual observations.

AI.tldr: Trace4D 训练视觉语言模型预测4D状态序列并推理其时序变化，构建60万4D感知与7万接地图QA数据，结合SFT与几何感知GRPO，在Trace4D-Bench和VLM4D上提升QA准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在视角变化下难以理解物体及其空间关系在3D空间中的时序演化；已有方法虽引入几何信息，但缺乏对时间有序4D状态演化的显式监督，且未将其作为中间证据使用。
AI.method: 提出Trace4D：训练VLM预测4D状态序列并推理跨时间步变化；设计4D接地的思维链（CoT），显式表示4D状态、分析时序视觉上下文并作为答案证据。构建Trace4D-Train数据集（60万4D感知样本、约7万接地QA），先用监督微调再用几何感知GRPO联合训练。推理时直接从视频预测4D状态与推理，无需参考标注或外部几何模型。
AI.result: 在Trace4D-Bench与VLM4D上，QA准确率相对基线VLM均有提升，并验证了对4D状态变化与时序视觉观测进行推理带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 将4D状态演化作为显式中间证据嵌入VLM推理链，可在无外部几何模型条件下有效增强动态三维场景的时空理解。

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks vs. Multi-Layer Perceptrons: A Rigorous Statistical Benchmark on Clinical Tabular Data
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have recently been proposed as a promising alternative to Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs). However, empirical evaluations on structured medical datasets remain scarce, and commonly reported metrics like AUROC can yield overly optimistic performance estimates on imbalanced clinical cohorts. In this study, we present a standardized benchmark comparing eleven architectures - nine KAN variants (FastKAN, WavKAN, ReLUKAN, ChebyKAN, TaylorKAN, GramKAN, JacobiKAN, LegendreKAN, and TabKAN), a tuned StandardMLP, and a Random Forest baseline - across seven heterogeneous medical tabular datasets spanning oncology, cardiology, nephrology, neurology, endocrinology, and obstetrics. Our experimental protocol employs a 3x5 Repeated Stratified K-Fold cross-validation scheme with nested Bayesian hyperparameter optimization and evaluates discrimination via Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC), calibration through the Brier Score, and computational efficiency. Formal equivalence testing is conducted using the Bayesian Correlated t-Test with a Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE) at +/- 0.01. The results indicate that on datasets with severe class imbalance, dedicated KAN architectures (particularly TabKAN and ReLUKAN) can improve minority-class detection and achieve higher AUPRC than standard MLPs. Nevertheless, across pooled datasets, KAN variants demonstrate comparable overall predictive discrimination rather than a systematic advantage, while requiring 1.20x to 1.48x longer inference latency per sample and up to 12.5x more trainable parameters. Consequently, StandardMLP remains a strong baseline on the efficiency Pareto frontier, while KAN variants provide a viable alternative when precision on rare positive cases is the primary clinical objective. The code for reproducing the results is available at https://github.com/rafalwodzinski/kan_mlp_comparison.

AI.tldr: 该研究在7个异构医学表格数据集上标准化对比11种架构（9种KAN变体、调优MLP、随机森林），采用3x5重复分层交叉验证、嵌套贝叶斯优化、AUPRC/Brier/效率指标及ROPE等价检验，发现KAN仅在严重类别不平衡时提升少数类检测，整体判别力无系统性优势且推理更慢、参数更多。
AI.motivation: KAN被提出作为MLP的潜在替代方案，但其在结构化医学数据集上的实证评估稀缺；且常用的AUROC指标在类别不平衡的临床队列中会产生过于乐观的性能估计，因此需要标准化的、以AUPRC与校准为核心的基准比较。
AI.method: 构建标准化基准，覆盖肿瘤、心血管、肾脏、神经、内分泌、产科7个异构医学表格数据集，比较11种架构（FastKAN、WavKAN、ReLUKAN、ChebyKAN、TaylorKAN、GramKAN、JacobiKAN、LegendreKAN、TabKAN、调优StandardMLP、随机森林）。实验协议为3x5重复分层K折交叉验证＋嵌套贝叶斯超参优化，评估判别力（AUPRC）、校准（Brier Score）与计算效率，并用贝叶斯相关t检验与ROPE（±0.01）进行正式等价性检验。
AI.result: 在严重类别不平衡数据集上，专用KAN架构（尤其TabKAN与ReLUKAN）可提升少数类检测并取得高于标准MLP的AUPRC；但在汇总数据集上，各KAN变体仅表现为总体判别力相当，而非系统性优势，同时单样本推理延迟高1.20–1.48倍、可训练参数最多多12.5倍。
AI.conclusion: StandardMLP仍处于效率帕累托前沿、是强基线；当临床目标聚焦于罕见阳性病例的精确识别时，KAN变体是可行的替代方案。代码已开源。

title: GaussFlaw: Fine-Grained Perceptual Diagnosis for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic novel- view synthesis with real-time rendering, yet fine-grained di- agnosis of its rendering artifacts remains challenging. These artifacts are typically spatially localized and exhibit diverse degradation patterns, making them difficult to character- ize using global quality metrics and image-level assessment benchmarks, which provide no explicit indication of where they occur or what types of artifacts they represent. To ad- dress this limitation, we introduce GaussFlaw-80K, the first large-scale dataset for fine-grained perceptual diagnosis in 3DGS. Constructed through a model-assisted human-in-the- loop pipeline, GaussFlaw-80K contains 80,049 artifact re- gions across 14,289 rendered images, each annotated with a pixel-level mask and one of eight flaw labels spanning ge- ometric, blending, and photometric degradations. These an- notations turn 3DGS artifact diagnosis into an explicit and measurable task. Building on this dataset, we propose Ge- oCritic, a geometry-guided multi-task model that integrates RGB appearance with depth-derived cues to jointly localize artifacts and classify their flaw types. Beyond evaluation, we further demonstrate the downstream benefits of fine-grained diagnosis through three complementary targeted operations: Gaussian densification, attribute correction, and outlier prun- ing. Experiments show that GeoCritic achieves an AUC-J of 0.9507 and an Acc@1 of 80.08%, while diagnosis-guided re- finement improves all reported global and crop-level metrics across diverse datasets and 3DGS backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向3DGS渲染伪影细粒度感知诊断的大规模数据集GaussFlaw-80K（80,049个伪影区域、14,289张图像、八类缺陷标签、像素级掩码），并构建几何引导多任务模型GeoCritic联合定位与分类伪影，进而用诊断结果指导致密化、属性校正与离群点剪枝，显著提升渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽能实时高保真新视角合成，但其渲染伪影空间局部、退化模式多样，全局质量指标与图像级评估基准无法指出伪影位置与类型，难以进行细粒度诊断。
AI.method: 以模型辅助、人机回环流程构建GaussFlaw-80K数据集，标注像素级掩码与几何、混合、光度三大类共八种缺陷标签；提出GeoCritic几何引导多任务模型，融合RGB外观与深度线索，同时定位伪影并分类缺陷类型。
AI.result: GeoCritic取得AUC-J 0.9507、Acc@1 80.08%；基于诊断的三类定向操作（高斯致密化、属性校正、离群点剪枝）在多种数据集与3DGS骨架上均提升全局与裁剪级指标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将3DGS伪影诊断转化为显式可测任务，数据集与模型不仅提供评估手段，还能指导下游修复，验证细粒度诊断的实际价值。

title: TensorLOB: Structure-Preserving Tensor Learning for Limit Order Book Forecasting
summary: The limit order book (LOB) records outstanding buy and sell orders across multiple price levels. Its state evolves over time across market side, price level, and order attribute, naturally forming a multiway structure. However, existing LOB models typically flatten these dimensions into a matrix model, thus obscuring the existing structural relationships. Starting from first principles and the market-microstructure intuition of the LOB, we design TensorLOB to operate entirely in the tensor domain. TensorLOB uses mode-wise tensor contractions for feature extraction and directly contracts the learned representation with low-rank class-weight tensors for prediction, retaining the distinct roles of time, side, level, and attribute modes. Experiments on the FI-2010 benchmark show that TensorLOB achieves the highest accuracy, recall, and F1 score across all four evaluated horizons. This proof of concept highlights the potential of high-dimensional modelling of multi-way latent information intrinsic to financial markets, which has so far been largely overlooked.

AI.tldr: 提出TensorLOB，完全在张量域中建模限价订单簿（LOB）的多路结构（时间、市场方向、价格档位、订单属性），在FI-2010基准上于四个预测视界均取得最优的准确率、召回率和F1分数。
AI.motivation: LOB状态天然具有多路（multiway）结构，跨越市场方向、价格档位和订单属性等维度演化。但现有LOB模型通常将这些维度展平为矩阵，破坏了原有结构关系，且金融市场的多维潜在信息长期被忽视。
AI.method: 从第一性原理和市场微观结构直觉出发设计TensorLOB：(1) 使用按模态（mode-wise）的张量收缩进行特征提取；(2) 将学习到的表示与低秩类权重张量直接收缩以完成预测，从而保留时间、方向、档位和属性各模态的独立角色。
AI.result: 在FI-2010基准的四个评估视界上，TensorLOB的准确率、召回率和F1分数均为最高。
AI.conclusion: 该概念验证展示了金融市���多路潜在信息的高维建模潜力，为LOB建模提供了突破矩阵扁平化的新方向。

title: Unlocking the Potential of Vision Foundation Models for Multi-Task Dense Prediction via Mixture of Task Adapters
summary: Multi-task dense prediction seeks a single, coherent representation that supports simultaneously discriminative semantic recognition and regularized geometric/structural inference. For vision foundation models, pretrained semantic invariances conflict with the frequency and smoothness biases of dense objectives; joint fine-tuning and single-route adapters therefore compress competing gradients into one update channel, causing negative transfer and unstable cross-task agreement. We frame this as two-level adaptation: task-generic alignment that preserves priors, and task-aware specialization that resolves late-stage conflicts. Based on this principle, we propose D2MoE , a Mixture of Task Adapters that explicitly factorizes these roles within a frozen DINOv3 backbone. D2MoE introduces Task-Generic Low-Rank Adaptation (TG-LoRA) in attention projections throughout the network to provide a stable, shared adaptation channel, and a Task-Adaptive Mixture of Experts (TA-MoE) injected only at the final attention block of each stage to enact sparse, task-conditioned perturbations of token mixing in a single forward pass. A Semantic Prior Injector further couples multi-level task features with frozen foundation priors to reinforce semantic coherence while preserving boundary and structural fidelity. Experiments across diverse benchmarks substantiate that this structured factorization yields robust multi-task improvements with a small trainable footprint, establishing a principled and scalable route to prior-preserving, foundation-centric multi-task dense perception.

AI.tldr: 提出D2MoE，在冻结DINOv3骨干上用"任务通用LoRA + 阶段末端任务自适应MoE"两层适配结构解决多任务密集预测中的负迁移与任务冲突，并以小参数量取得稳健提升。
AI.motivation: 多任务密集预测需同时支持判别性语义识别与几何/结构推理。但视觉基础模型的预训练语义不变性与密集目标所需的频率/平滑偏置相冲突；联合微调或单路适配器把竞争梯度压进同一更新通道，导致负迁移和跨任务一致性不稳定。
AI.method: 提出两层适配框架：任务通用对齐（保留先验）+任务感知特化（解决后期冲突）。具体为D2MoE：(1) TG-LoRA插入全网注意力投影，提供稳定共享适配通道；(2) TA-MoE仅注入每个stage最后一个注意力块，在前向中实现稀疏、任务条件化的token mixing扰动；(3) Semantic Prior Injector将多层级任务特征与冻结基础先验耦合，强化语义一致性并保持边界与结构保真。骨干全程冻结。
AI.result: 在多样基准上的实验表明，该结构化分解在小可训练参数开销下带来稳健的多任务性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为以基础模型为中心、保持预训练先验的多任务密集感知提供了有原则且可扩展的技术路线。

title: Identifiable Signed Causal Learning via Latent Stochastic Differential Equations for Inferring Brain Dynamic Effective Connectivity
summary: Understanding how brain regions interact to support cognitive tasks requires characterizing directed causal influences among them, known as effective connectivity (EC). As inter-regional coupling changes over time, a dynamic EC (dEC) estimate is required to track this temporal variation. Existing dEC learning methods typically lack a causal rationality guarantee or an identifiability analysis, and output unsigned connectivity that cannot distinguish excitatory from inhibitory influences, which limits further study of brain mechanisms. We propose ISCL, a latent stochastic differential equation framework that derives dEC from latent dynamics through a causal influence operator defined in observation space. As established by a rationality theorem, the operator captures a directed interventional response at each brain state, and under invariance assumptions the operator is identifiable from data, with its signed output separating excitatory from inhibitory influences. On synthetic benchmarks, \model recovers the causal structure on Lorenz96 and achieves the lowest mean structural Hamming distance among compared methods on NetSim, while preserving signed influence structures that distinguish excitatory from inhibitory interactions. Applied to HCP Social Cognition task-fMRI, ISCL reveals a signed architecture whose stability across seeds supports the identifiability guarantee, identifies dominant source and target networks consistent with social-cognition systems, and shows that condition-specific training strengthens causal outflow from the default-mode and frontoparietal networks during theory-of-mind processing. In this task, the recovered signed structure reveals network-level excitatory and inhibitory organization, with the dorsal-attention network as the only consistently positive out-strength source.

AI.tldr: ISCL：基于潜随机微分方程的动态有效连接学习框架，通过观测空间定义的因果影响算子给出有符号、可识别的dEC，并在合成数据与HCP社会认知任务fMRI上验证。
AI.motivation: 脑区间定向因果影响（有效连接）随时间变化，需要动态dEC估计；但现有dEC方法缺乏因果合理性保证与可识别性分析，且输出无符号连接，无法区分兴奋性/抑制性影响，限制机制研究。
AI.method: 提出ISCL潜在随机微分方程框架：由潜动态经观测空间中定义的因果影响算子导出dEC；给出合理性定理证明该算子刻画每个脑状态下的定向干预响应，并在不变性假设下证明其可从数据中识别，其有符号输出区分兴奋性与抑制性影响。
AI.result: 合成基准上，ISCL在Lorenz96上恢复因果结构，在NetSim上取得最低平均结构汉明距离，并保留可区分兴奋/抑制的有符号影响结构；应用于HCP社会认知任务fMRI，得到跨随机种子稳定的有符号架构（支持可识别性），识别出符合社会认知系统的主导源/靶网络，并显示条件特异性训练在心理理论加工中增强默认模式与额顶网络的因果外流；背侧注意网络是唯一持续为正的外强度来源。
AI.conclusion: ISCL为动态有效连接提供了具备因果合理性与可识别性保证的有符号估计方法，可揭示网络层面的兴奋-抑制组织，具备神经机制研究价值。

title: Risk-Constrained Evaluation of Financial Document Recognition: A Formal Framework for Evidence, Critical Errors, and Selective Automation
summary: Financial document recognition is commonly evaluated using character and word error rates, which do not adequately represent the consequences of errors in financial workflows. This paper formalizes financial document recognition as a risk-constrained evidence-recovery problem. It defines typed, evidence-linked financial facts and a multi-layer quality model spanning text, layout, tables, fields, semantic relations, calibration, robustness, and operational performance. It introduces non-compensatory acceptance gates based on upper confidence bounds for critical-field errors, and formulates selective automation as a constrained risk-coverage problem with review-capacity limits. The paper also specifies annotation requirements, leakage-resistant benchmark splits, statistical estimands, and a reproducibility card. Formal propositions establish why aggregate scores cannot certify critical-field reliability and why zero observed errors do not imply zero risk. A synthetic example illustrates the decision rule. The work is theoretical; no empirical benchmark or model performance claim is presented.

AI.tldr: 论文将金融文档识别重新形式化为"风险约束下的证据恢复问题"，提出多层质量模型与非补偿性验收门，把选择性自动化建模为受审阅容量限制的风险-覆盖率约束优化，并给出理论与规范建议（纯理论工作，无实证）。
AI.motivation: 现有金融文档识别常用字符错误率（CER）和词错误率（WER）评估，但这些指标无法反映错误在金融业务流程中的真实后果，也无法保证关键字段的可靠性；聚合分数与"零观测错误"都不能证明风险可控。
AI.method: 1) 定义带类型、与证据链接的金融事实；2) 构建覆盖文本、版面、表格、字段、语义关系、校准、鲁棒性与运营表现的多层质量模型；3) 基于关键字段错误率的上置信界设置非补偿性验收门；4) 将选择性自动化表述为带审阅容量约束的风险-覆盖率问题；5) 规定标注要求、抗泄漏的基准划分、统计估计量与可复现性卡片。
AI.result: 通过形式化命题证明：聚合评分无法认证关键字段可靠性；观测到零错误并不意味着零风险。并以一个合成示例说明决策规则的使用方式。论文为理论性工作，未提供实证基准或模型性能结论。
AI.conclusion: 金融文档识别的评估应从平均错误率转向风险约束的证据恢复与选择性自动化框架，强调关键字段的非补偿性门槛、审阅容量约束与统计保证，为后续实证基准与可复现评估提供规范基础。

title: Extending Aircraft Coverage of the Poll Schumann Model Using Public Data
summary: The Poll Schumann model requires airframe and engine parameters, but published tables cover only part of the fleet. Applications must obtain missing parameters, substitute another aircraft type or exclude unrepresented types. We reconstruct parameters using geometry from certification documents and manufacturer manuals, together with ICAO engine records. Published equations supply the physical parameters, regression estimates the propulsion efficiency scale. The inventory covers 90 type designators, including 22 absent from the direct pycontrails table and 18 without a listed substitute. Across 68 types, mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) against pycontrails was 7.38% for drag and 3.14% for design Mach. Across 66 types in 21 families, efficiency regression achieved 3.91% MAPE with the evaluated family excluded from input selection and fitting. On 100 recorded A320 flights, a type already represented in the published tables, cruise fuel flow MAPE for reconstructed and published parameter sets was 4.50% versus 4.68%, while mean absolute percentage error in integrated fuel over covered airborne intervals was 7.19% versus 6.82%. Public technical records can therefore extend Poll Schumann parameter coverage, with quantified agreement against published coefficients and comparable fuel prediction errors on the evaluated A320 flights.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用适航文件和厂商手册的几何数据及ICAO发动机记录重建Poll Schumann模型缺失的机体与发动机参数，使参数库存扩展至90个机型代码，并在A320实飞数据上验证重建参数与公开参数的燃油预测误差相当。
AI.motivation: Poll Schumann模型需要机体和发动机参数，但已发表表格仅覆盖部分机队，导致应用时需获取缺失参数、替换机型或排除未收录机型。
AI.method: 用适航认证文件与厂商手册的几何数据结合ICAO发动机记录重建参数；已发表公式给出物理参数，回归估计推进效率标度；并在100架次A320实飞数据上对比重建参数与公开参数的巡航燃油流与积分燃油误差。
AI.result: 库存覆盖90个型号代码（22个不在pycontrails表中，18个无替代机型）；68型对pycontrails的阻力MAPE为7.38%，设计马赫数3.14%；66型21族效率回归MAPE为3.91%（留族验证）；A320巡航燃油流MAPE 4.50% vs 4.68%，积分燃油7.19% vs 6.82%。
AI.conclusion: 公开技术记录可扩展Poll Schumann参数覆盖范围，重建系数与公开系数一致且燃油预测误差相当。

title: Lookahead Prediction-Guided Adaptive Visual Refocusing for Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Interleaved multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning improves the visual reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models by dynamically incorporating visual evidence during reasoning. However, existing methods primarily select evidence from historical context. When the reasoning focus shifts, history-guided evidence may remain focused on prior regions and fail to cover the visual information required by the next step. We refer to this lag between visual evidence and subsequent reasoning demands as Temporal Evidence Myopia. To address this issue, we propose Lookahead Prediction-guided Adaptive Visual Refocusing (LPAVR), a training-free test-time framework. LPAVR transforms Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) from a decoding acceleration mechanism into a lookahead signal for anticipating upcoming reasoning intent. During MTP decoding, the draft head generates multiple future tokens, while the target model verifies them in parallel and retains the longest prefix consistent with its decoding trajectory. This target-verified prefix contains near-future semantics, which LPAVR uses to construct lookahead-guided visual evidence and assess whether history-guided evidence covers the indicated regions. If the coverage is sufficient, the history-guided evidence is retained; otherwise, LPAVR switches to the lookahead-guided evidence. This better aligns the visual context with upcoming reasoning and improves consistency between draft predictions and target-model decoding. Experiments on multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that LPAVR improves both reasoning accuracy and the acceptance rates of MTP speculative tokens, jointly enhancing visual reasoning and speculative decoding efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练测试时框架LPAVR，利用多Token预测（MTP）的未来语义作为前瞻信号，解决交错多模态思维链中视觉证据滞后于推理需求（时序证据近视）的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有交错多模态思维链推理主要从历史上下文中选取视觉证据。当推理焦点转移时，基于历史选取的证据仍停留在先前区域，无法覆盖下一步所需的视觉信息，即"时序证据近视"（Temporal Evidence Myopia）。
AI.method: LPAVR为免训练测试时框架。将MTP从解码加速机制改造为前瞻信号：MTP解码时，草稿头生成多个未来token，目标模型并行验证并保留与其解码轨迹一致的最长前缀。该目标模型验证的前缀含近期未来语义，用于构建前瞻引导的视觉证据，并评估历史引导证据是否覆盖所指区域；覆盖充分则保留历史证据，否则切换为前瞻证据。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上，LPAVR同时提升了推理准确率与MTP投机token的接受率，实现了视觉推理与投机解码效率的联合增强。
AI.conclusion: 以未来推理意图引导视觉重聚焦，可更好地对齐视觉上下文与后续推理，并提升草稿预测与目标模型解码的一致性，同时改善推理质量与解码效率。

title: A Universal Policy Wrapper With Guarantees
summary: Many control tasks require driving the system into a prescribed goal set and subsequently keeping it there. The considered setting assumes that a working controller is available that provably reaches and maintains the goal, albeit with suboptimal performance. This controller is referred to as the fallback policy. Conversely, although state-of-the-art reinforcement-learning (RL) algorithms can discover policies with impressive empirical performance, the neural networks at their core act as opaque black boxes learned through data-driven exploration and, as such, provide no theoretical mechanism to guarantee that the system will ever reach---and stay within---the prescribed goal set. This article presents CALF-Wrapper, a method that combines the fallback policy with a pretrained RL base policy and uses the critic estimate associated with the base policy to select between them during deployment. The theoretical analysis establishes that CALF-Wrapper inherits the goal-reaching property of the fallback policy under the stated assumptions and provides probability bounds for the settling time and the maximum distance from the goal set over a prescribed time interval. The experimental study evaluates CALF-Wrapper in four simulated control environments of different complexity. Comparisons include the base policy, fallback policy, and constrained reinforcement-learning methods formulated for the same objective. Sensitivity and ablation studies provide direct hyperparameter recommendations. The experiments show how CALF-Wrapper can provide effective task performance while attaining the maximum possible observed goal-reaching rate. CALF-Wrapper requires no additional dynamics model, online learning, or constrained optimization during execution.

AI.tldr: 提出 CALF-Wrapper，将可证明到达目标集的 fallback 策略与预训练 RL 策略结合，用 critic 估计在线选择，既保证目标可达又保留 RL 性能。
AI.motivation: RL 策略经验性能好但神经网络黑箱，无法从理论上保证系统到达并保持在目标集内；而 fallback 策略虽可证明到达并保持，性能次优。
AI.method: CALF-Wrapper：部署时用 RL base policy 的 critic 估计在两个策略间做切换选择；无需额外动力学模型、在线学习或在线约束优化。理论分析给出到达/保持性质的继承性，以及 settling time 与目标集最大距离的概率界。
AI.result: 在四个不同复杂度的仿真控制环境中与 base policy、fallback policy 及面向同目标的约束 RL 方法对比；敏感性与消融实验给出直接超参建议；实现有效任务性能并取得观测到的最大目标到达率。
AI.conclusion: CALF-Wrapper 在给定假设下继承 fallback 策略的目标到达保证，同时保持 RL 的高性能，且执行时开销低、无需额外模型或在线优化。

title: History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent Continuations for Long-Horizon Video World Models
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient generation, yet maintaining consistency over long rollouts remains challenging, especially when subjects or scenes reappear after going out of sight. Despite progress in fidelity and rollout robustness, existing distillation methods do not fully exploit richer historical information to constrain the student's current prediction. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{History Forcing}, a unified on-policy distillation framework that strengthens historical supervision for few-step autoregressive video generators. The framework uses the residual between teacher predictions with and without informative historical context to decouple this supervision. Such a historical context can be obtained using earlier generated chunks with less accumulated drift or a fixed-view teacher rollout that keeps the scene visible while the student looks away. The residual is then weighted and added to the score or velocity prediction used for distillation, forming a corrected target. By aligning the student with this corrected target through distillation, History Forcing incorporates long-range historical constraints into autoregressive generation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among 1.3B models, with a VBench quality score of 85.07 for 15s video generation and a VBench-Long aggregate score of 79.82 for 60s generation. For out-of-sight world modeling, evaluations further demonstrate more plausible scene evolution and more consistent states when the camera returns, with Evolution Quality improving from 2.35 to 2.70 on PlayWorld and Object Consistency from 58.43 to 62.18 on MemoBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 History Forcing，一种统一的 on-policy 蒸馏框架，通过引入富含历史信息的监督，增强少步自回归视频生成器在长时推演中的一致性，尤其改善"物体/场景离开视野后重现"的建模。
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散能高效生成，但长时推演难保持一致性，特别是主体或场景离开视野后再次出现时。现有蒸馏方法虽在保真度和鲁棒性上有进展，却未充分利用更丰富的历史信息来约束学生模型的当前预测。
AI.method: 利用"带/不带信息性历史上下文"的教师预测之间的残差来解耦历史监督。历史上下文可来自累计漂移更小的早期生成片段，或固定视角的教师推演（学生视角移开时保持场景可见）。该残差经加权后加到用于蒸馏的 score/velocity 预测上，形成修正目标，再通过蒸馏让学生对齐该目标，从而把长程历史约束注入自回归生成。
AI.result: 在 1.3B 模型中达到 SOTA：15s 视频 VBench 质量分 85.07，60s 视频 VBench-Long 总分 79.82。在视野外世界建模评测中，场景演化更合理、镜头返回时状态更一致：PlayWorld 的 Evolution Quality 由 2.35 提升至 2.70，MemoBench 的 Object Consistency 由 58.43 提升至 62.18。
AI.conclusion: 通过残差式历史监督构造修正目标，History Forcing 有效将长程历史约束融入少步自回归视频蒸馏，在长视频质量与视野外一致性上均取得领先效果。

title: Gibbs Variational Last Layers for Long-Horizon Dynamics Learning
summary: Accurate long-horizon probabilistic predictions of dynamical systems are a prerequisite for model-based decision-making. Variational Bayesian last layers (VBLLs) are an attractive model class for this setting, offering tractable uncertainty at near-deterministic cost, yet they are trained exclusively with single-step likelihood objectives that may be insufficient for reliable multi-step rollouts. We revisit VBLLs through the lens of Gibbs variational inference, which decouples posterior inference from the choice of training loss. Building on this perspective, we introduce a family of multi-step training losses that progressively incorporate long-horizon structure, robustness via continuous ranked probability scores (CRPS), and training on full autoregressive rollouts. Our approach retains the simplicity of VBLLs while directly optimizing for multi-step predictive quality. Across illustrative synthetic environments, a diverse suite of chaotic dynamical systems, and real-world data, we show that multi-step, CRPS-based objectives substantially improve long-horizon accuracy and distributional fit, consistently outperforming single-step likelihood training.

AI.tldr: 通过 Gibbs 变分推断视角重新审视 VBLL，提出多步训练损失族（含 CRPS 与自回归全 rollout），在合成、混沌动力系统和真实数据上显著提升长时程预测精度与分布拟合。
AI.motivation: VBLL 能以接近确定性模型的成本提供可处理后验不确定性，但只用单步似然训练，难以保证多步 rollout 的可靠性，而这正是基于模型决策的前提。
AI.method: 以 Gibbs 变分推断解耦后验推断与训练损失，据此设计一系列多步训练目标：逐步引入长时程结构、基于 CRPS 的鲁棒性、以及在完整自回归 rollout 上训练，同时保持 VBLL 结构简洁。
AI.result: 在示意性合成环境、多个混沌动力系统及真实数据上，多步 CRPS 目标显著改善长时程精度与分布拟合，一致优于单步似然训练。
AI.conclusion: 训练损失与变分推断可分离，多步/CRPS 损失是提升 VBLL 长期概率预测的有效手段，为模型决策提供更可靠的不确定性。

title: Local-Global Joint Modeling for Point Cloud Super-Resolution Guided by Multi-Scale Spatial Priors
summary: Range-image-based point cloud super-resolution provides an effective way to reconstruct sparse outdoor point clouds by projecting low-resolution LiDAR scans into a regular 2D representation. However, current methods still face three challenges. First, range images exhibit pronounced vertical nonuniformity, with sparse observations in distant regions and denser observations in nearby regions. Some cross-scale fusion mechanisms do not account for the varying reliability of features at different vertical positions, allowing invalid values and noise from distant sparse regions to propagate into the decoder. Second, a single convolutional or sequence-modeling architecture often struggles to preserve both local high-frequency geometric details and global long-range dependencies, resulting in over-smoothed reconstructions. Third, smooth transition depths near foreground-background boundaries can produce spike artifacts when the 2D range image is back-projected into 3D. To address these issues, we propose a point cloud super-resolution method based on multi-scale spatial priors and joint local-global modeling. The design comprises a spatially gated fusion module, a multi-granularity local-global cooperative perception module, and 2D median-residual denoising. Experiments on KITTI-360 and nuScenes demonstrate effective reconstruction, with IoU scores of 0.4703 and 0.3593, respectively, supporting the feasibility of the proposed method for range-image super-resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于多尺度空间先验与局部-全局联合建模的range图像点云超分辨率方法，通过空间门控融合、多粒度局部-全局协同感知和2D中值残差去噪解决垂直非均匀、细节过平滑和边界尖刺问题，在KITTI-360和nuScenes上取得IoU 0.4703/0.3593。
AI.motivation: 现有range图像点云超分辨率存在三方面问题：(1) range图像垂直方向分布非均匀，远处稀疏近处密集，部分跨尺度融合未考虑不同垂直位置特征可靠性差异，导致远处无效值和噪声传入解码器；(2) 单一卷积或序列建模难以同时保留局部高频几何细节与全局长程依赖，结果过度平滑；(3) 前后景边界深度平滑过渡，反投影回3D时产生尖刺伪影。
AI.method: 将低分辨率LiDAR扫描投影为规则2D range图像进行超分，网络包含三个核心设计：空间门控融合模块（spatially gated fusion，抑制远处稀疏区域噪声）、多粒度局部-全局协同感知模块（结合局部细节与全局依赖）、以及2D中值残差去噪（缓解反投影尖刺伪影）。
AI.result: 在KITTI-360和nuScenes数据集上实现有效重建，IoU分别为0.4703和0.3593。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了该方法在range图像超分辨率任务上的可行性与有效性，多尺度空间先验与局部-全局联合建模能有效改善室外稀疏点云重建质量。

title: Unimodal Augmentation-based SSL Objectives Induce Cross-Modal Alignment
summary: Recent works have observed implicit cross-modal alignment between independently trained unimodal models. However, the mechanisms underlying the emergence of this phenomenon remain unresolved. In this paper, we demonstrate that unimodal augmentation-based self-supervised objectives implicitly induce cross-modal alignment. We show that low unimodal losses force high cross-modal alignment, whereas a high unimodal loss prevents such alignment. We theoretically connect the widely used InfoNCE loss to local CKA, the popular measure of cross-modal alignment. We further provide extensive empirical evidence supporting this claim, both in controlled settings and across 53 unconstrained frozen text, vision, and audio unimodal encoders. In both cases, unimodal augmentation-based objectives control cross-modal alignment. Overall, our results provide a theoretical and empirical foundation for understanding the emergence of implicit cross-modal alignment by establishing a direct connection between unimodal training objectives and cross-modal structure.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示独立训练的单模态模型间隐式跨模态对齐的成因：单模态增强型自监督目标（InfoNCE）会隐式诱导跨模态对齐，并从理论上将其与局部CKA联系起来。
AI.motivation: 已有工作观察到独立训练的单模态模型之间存在隐式跨模态对齐，但其产生机制尚未被解释清楚。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明单模态增强型自监督目标隐式诱导跨模态对齐，并将常用的InfoNCE损失与局部CKA对齐度量建立理论联系；辅以控制实验以及覆盖53个无约束冻结的文本、视觉、音频单模态编码器的广泛实证。
AI.result: 单模态损失低会强制产生高跨模态对齐，而单模态损失高则阻止对齐；在受控设置和53个冻结的单模态编码器上均验证了单模态目标对跨模态对齐的调控作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过建立单模态训练目标与跨模态结构之间的直接联系，为理解隐式跨模态对齐的产生提供了理论与实证基础。

title: OmniOPD: Stable On-Policy Distillation for Joint Audio-Video Generation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) elevates joint audio-video generation, but optimizing heterogeneous, modality-specific audio and video rewards often introduces cross-modal interference. On-policy distillation (OPD) alleviates this issue by transferring the capabilities of specialized audio and video RL teachers into a single student model. However, a significant imbalance in cross-modal token counts leaves audio with sparse supervision, causing unstable distillation. We observe that naively increasing the audio loss weight fails to solve this problem since audio learning relies heavily on visual context, indicating richer visual cues are crucial to offset sparse audio signals. To address this, we propose OmniOPD, a modality-wise on-policy distillation framework designed for balanced and stable audio-video generation. First, we construct privileged visual information using asymmetric noise scheduling, allowing the audio teacher to generate more informative targets from cleaner video context. Second, we introduce grouped multi-noise sampling to expand audio supervision coverage and stabilize training. Third, we introduce timestep-wise importance weighting based on teacher-student transition divergence, preserving reliable supervision while down-weighting unreliable learning signals, to stabilize fluctuations in audio learning. Evaluated on JavisBench and VBench demonstrate OmniOPD preserves audio quality while significantly enhancing video generation, achieving effective joint distillation.

AI.tldr: OmniOPD提出模态级on-policy蒸馏框架，通过特权视觉信息、分组多噪声采样和时序重要性加权，解决音视频联合生成中音频监督稀疏导致的蒸馏不稳定问题。
AI.motivation: RL可提升音视频联合生成，但异构的模态专属奖励优化会引入跨模态干扰。OPD通过将专门的音频、视频RL教师能力迁移到单一学生模型来缓解该问题，但跨模态token数量严重不平衡使音频监督稀疏、蒸馏不稳定；简单增大音频损失权重无效，因为音频学习高度依赖视觉上下文。
AI.method: 提出OmniOPD框架：(1)利用非对称噪声调度构造特权视觉信息，使音频教师从更干净的视觉上下文中生成更有信息量的目标；(2)引入分组多噪声采样，扩大音频监督覆盖范围并稳定训练；(3)引入基于教师-学生转移散度的时序重要性加权，保留可靠监督、降低不可靠信号权重。
AI.result: 在JavisBench和VBench上评估，OmniOPD在保持音频质量的同时显著提升视频生成效果，实现了有效的联合蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对模态不平衡的蒸馏设计，OmniOPD实现了平衡、稳定的音视频联合蒸馏，兼顾音频质量与视频生成性能。

title: ILR-SMO: Iterative Latent Refinement for Robust Spatial Multi-Omics Integration
comment: Author-corrected version of the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 paper. Four numerical typographical errors in Table 1 have been corrected, and the caption has been clarified regarding V-measure and NMI. The method rankings and conclusions remain unchanged
summary: Spatial multi-omics technologies jointly profile diverse molecular modalities with spatial context, providing a comprehensive view of cellular heterogeneity and tissue organization. To integrate spatial multi-omics data and identify spatial domains, a wide range of unsupervised methods has been proposed. However, recent approaches rely on single-step fusion, directly aggregating heterogeneous modalities into a shared representation, making embeddings sensitive to modality imbalance and measurement noise that are inherent to spatial multi-omics data, as well as unstable optimization under weak supervision. Here, we propose ILR-SMO (Iterative Latent Refinement for Spatial Multi-Omics), a unified self-supervised framework that reformulates multimodal integration as a stability-aware refinement process over a shared latent representation. Instead of single-step plain fusion, ILR-SMO progressively integrates modality-specific information through sequential updates, allowing information to be injected in a controlled manner. This incremental refinement enables later updates to correct or compensate for earlier deviations, resulting in more stable and robust representation learning under heterogeneous and noisy modalities. ILR-SMO further incorporates reliability-aware modality gating for adaptive modulation of modality contributions, and employs a joint objective to enforce spatial coherence while preventing representation collapse. Extensive experiments on five spatial multi-omics benchmarks demonstrate that ILR-SMO consistently outperforms seven state-of-the-art methods and exhibits strong robustness across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 提出ILR-SMO，一种自监督框架，将空间多组学数据融合重构为在共享潜在表征上的迭代精炼过程，实现更稳定鲁棒的空间域识别。
AI.motivation: 现有空间多组学整合方法依赖单步融合，直接聚合异质模态到共享表征，导致嵌入对模态不平衡和测量噪声敏感，且弱监督下优化不稳定。
AI.method: 将多模态整合重构为对共享潜在表征的稳定性感知迭代精炼过程，逐步（顺序更新）注入各模态信息以受控方式融合，使后续更新能校正早期偏差；同时引入可靠性感知的模态门控自适应调节模态贡献，并采用联合目标函数保证空间一致性与防止表征塌缩。
AI.result: 在五个空间多组学基准上，ILR-SMO一致优于七个SOTA方法，并在多种设置下表现强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 迭代精炼式的多模态融合比单步融合更能应对异质与噪声模态，ILR-SMO为空间多组学整合与空间域识别提供了稳定鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Disen-Forcing: Disentangling Semantic Anchoring from Motion for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models (AR-VDMs) enable real-time, long-horizon video generation but degrade rapidly once the inference horizon outruns the training horizon, due to compounding exposure bias. To stabilize long rollouts, recent methods heuristically adopt frame sink, keeping initial frames as a persistent model context, inspired by attention sinks in LLMs. We revisit this design and find that the mechanism by which initial frames stabilize long-range consistency in AR-VDMs is not an LLM-style attention sink; instead, long-range consistency is anchored through a sparse subset of attention heads, while the majority of heads predominantly capture local temporal dynamics. This observation reveals an over-conditioning pathology in existing frame-sink strategies: by universally exposing every head to the pinned initial-frame context, the model becomes prone to collapsing motion toward the low-dynamic modes of the teacher during model distillation. We propose Disen-Forcing, a distillation-time plug-in for AR-VDMs that disentangles and reinforces this head specialization through disentangled context routing and motion-disentangling regularization. On long-horizon video generation benchmarks, Disen-Forcing simultaneously improves long-range consistency and motion dynamics of base AR-VDMs, a trade-off that sink-based methods fail to balance.

AI.tldr: 论文重新审视AR-VDM中的frame sink机制，发现长程一致性由稀疏注意力头群锚定而非LLM式注意力汇聚，提出Disen-Forcing蒸馏插件，通过解耦上下文路由与运动解耦正则缓解过度条件化，兼顾长程一致性与运动动态。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型在推理长度超过训练长度后因复合曝光偏差而快速退化。现有方法借鉴LLM注意力汇，启发式地将初始帧作为持久上下文（frame sink）以稳定长 rollout，但机制尚未被检验，且可能带来副作用。
AI.method: 首先从机制层面分析初始帧的作用：发现只有稀疏子集的注意力头负责长程一致性锚定，多数头主要捕捉局部时间动态。据此指出frame sink的"过度条件化"病态：对全部头统一暴露初始帧上下文，会让模型在蒸馏中把运动收缩到教师的低动态模式。提出Disen-Forcing——面向AR-VDM的蒸馏期即插即用方法，含两个组件：解耦上下文路由（disentangled context routing）以按头分工分配上下文，以及运动解耦正则（motion-disentangling regularization）强化头部专门化。
AI.result: 在长时程视频生成基准上，Disen-Forcing同时提升基础AR-VDM的长程一致性与运动动态性，解决了sink类方法无法平衡的权衡问题。
AI.conclusion: frame sink的稳定作用并非LLM式注意力汇聚，而是来自少数头的专门化；显式解耦并强化这种头部专门化，可在蒸馏阶段同时改善长程一致性与运动表现。

title: Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier for Urban Photogrammetric Point Cloud Segmentation
summary: Urban photogrammetric point clouds are commonly processed as local 3D patches, limiting the context available for distinguishing geometrically similar categories. Orthographic projection of the same data yields a co-registered digital orthophoto map (DOM)/RGB-D representation that supports efficient large-context modeling but compresses vertical geometry. Existing projection--point methods mainly fuse these two representations at the feature level while retaining a classifier shared across all samples. We present the Aerial Content-Aware Sample-Adaptive Classifier (ACASAC), which complements feature fusion with decision-level adaptation. A point-aligned aerial region bridges the full aerial crop and local 3D patch. ACASAC models scene-to-local variation within the projection and the representation discrepancy between aligned 2D and 3D supports, then transfers both relations to refine the local point class representation. The refined representation, scene-level aerial context, and fixed fused-head prior jointly form a classifier for the current sample. ACASAC improves the fixed dual-representation head by 2.1 and 2.7 mIoU points on SensatUrban and UrbanBIS, respectively, and by 2.1--2.3 points across four tested encoder combinations.

AI.tldr: 提出ACASAC，通过决策级样本自适应分类器弥补特征级融合不足，在SensatUrban和UrbanBIS上分别提升2.1和2.7 mIoU。
AI.motivation: 城市摄影测量点云通常按局部3D块处理，上下文受限，难以区分几何相似的类别；正射投影虽提供大范围上下文但压缩了垂直几何。现有投影—点方法主要在特征级融合两种表示，且所有样本共享同一分类器，缺乏样本适应性。
AI.method: 提出空中内容感知样本自适应分类器（ACASAC）。用点对齐的空中区域连接完整空中裁剪图与局部3D块；在投影内部建模场景到局部的变化，并对齐2D与3D支撑之间的表示差异；将两种关系迁移以精炼局部点类别表示；最终由精炼表示、场景级空中上下文与固定融合头先验共同构成当前样本专属分类器。
AI.result: 相比固定双表示头，在SensatUrban和UrbanBIS上分别提升2.1和2.7 mIoU；在四种测试的编码器组合上均提升2.1–2.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 决策级自适应可有效补充特征级融合，且提升在多种编码器组合上稳定，表明该方法的通用性与鲁棒性。

title: SHq: Learnable Grids for LLM Weight Quantization
summary: Block-scaled lookup-table (LUT) formats, which represent weights as indices into a small value set (the grid), have become standard for low-bit LLM quantization, ranging from NF4 and BOF4 to the 3-bit LUT instruction in NVIDIA Rubin. While these formats leave the grid definition flexible, existing implementations rely on fixed grids derived either from numerical data types (INT, FP) or assumed weight distributions (NF, BOF). We demonstrate that no single fixed grid is universally optimal; the best fixed grid varies with bit-width: BOFS at 2 bits, NF at 4 and 5 bits, and INT at 6 bits. We introduce SHq, a closed-form family of grids parameterized by two critical degrees of freedom: a companding strength α that interpolates level spacing from uniform to floating-point-like, and an offset c that introduces asymmetry. This offset allows the sign bit of the FP8 block scale, otherwise unused, to select between the grid and its mirror image, up to doubling the number of distinct values available per block. SHq modifies only the lookup table contents and serves as a drop-in replacement for the grid in any such format. Across five models ranging from 3B to 35B parameters, including a mixture-of-experts architecture, evaluated at 2-6 bits using RTN and GPTQ, SHq achieves the lowest KL divergence in every setting at 3 and 4 bits and in most settings at 2, 5 and 6 bits. It outperforms the best fixed grid by up to 34% and remains superior under mixed-precision configurations. At 4.5 bits per weight, the SHq format reduces the KL divergence of NVFP4 by 41-67% while improving downstream accuracy. Grid families incorporating both spacing and offset parameters perform comparably, whereas those lacking an offset exhibit clearly higher error, confirming that these two degrees of freedom drive the observed gains. We therefore propose SHq as the standard grid for block-scaled lookup-table formats.

AI.tldr: SHq：一种由companding强度α与偏移c两参数定义的闭式网格族，可即插即用替换块缩放LUT量化格式的网格，在2–6比特下普遍优于NF4/BOF4/INT等固定网格，4.5比特处使NVFP4的KL散度降低41–67%。
AI.motivation: 块缩放查找表（LUT）格式（NF4、BOF4、NVIDIA Rubin的3比特LUT指令等）虽允许自定义网格，但现有实现都依赖由数值类型（INT/FP）或假设权值分布（NF/BOF）导出的固定网格。作者指出不存在普适最优的固定网格：最优固定网格随比特数变化（2比特BOFS、4–5比特NF、6比特INT），因此需要一种可自适应、免搜索的网格设计。
AI.method: 提出SHq——一类闭式参数化网格族，含两个关键自由度：1）companding强度α，使电平间距在均匀分布与类浮点分布之间连续插值；2）偏移c，引入非对称性，并利用FP8块缩放中原本闲置的符号位在网格与其镜像之间选择，从而使每块可用不同值数目最多翻倍。SHq只修改查找表内容，可直接替换任意此类格式中的网格，无需结构改动。
AI.result: 在3B–35B的五个模型（含MoE架构）上，用RTN与GPTQ在2–6比特评测：SHq在3、4比特的所有设置及2、5、6比特的多数设置下取得最低KL散度，最多优于最佳固定网格34%；混合精度配置下仍占优。4.5比特/权值时，SHq使NVFP4的KL散度下降41–67%并提升下游准确率。含间距与偏移的网格族表现相当，而缺少偏移的参数族误差明显更高，证实这两个自由度是增益来源。
AI.conclusion: SHq以极小改动（仅改LUT内容）实现随比特宽度自适应的非对称网格，消除固定网格的次优性，并提出将SHq作为块缩放LUT格式的标准网格。

title: Scaling Action-Free Video Latent Prediction for Transferable Representations in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving policies require effective visual representations that capture both spatial scene structure and temporal dynamics. Video latent prediction has emerged as an effective paradigm for learning spatiotemporal visual representations, yet it remains unclear whether scaling this objective with action-free driving videos can yield representations that benefit end-to-end planning. We study action-free video latent prediction as a scalable pretraining objective and introduce ScaleDrive, a driving-oriented framework pretrained exclusively on large-scale internet open-world driving videos, without action annotations or benchmark-specific data. We keep the pretrained video encoder frozen during downstream end-to-end planning training to isolate the transferability of representations learned from internet driving videos. Ego-motion and depth probes show that scaling action-free video pretraining progressively strengthens the temporal and geometric information encoded in the frozen representation. We systematically study the visual representation transfer across different end-to-end driving policies and closed-loop benchmarks, where ScaleDrive consistently improves downstream performance and demonstrates that scaling action-free video latent prediction yields representations that generalize across both planning policy architectures and evaluation scenarios and protocols.

AI.tldr: ScaleDrive：仅用大规模互联网无动作驾驶视频做视频潜表示预训练，冻结编码器迁移到端到端规划，随规模增加表示的时间与几何信息增强并提升闭环表现。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶需要同时捕捉空间场景结构与时间动态的视觉表示；视频潜预测虽有效，但"用无动作驾驶视频扩展该目标能否带来有利于规划的可迁移表示"尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出 ScaleDrive 框架，仅在大规模开放世界互联网驾驶视频上预训练（无动作标注、无基准特定数据），采用无动作视频潜预测目标；下游规划训练时冻结预训练视频编码器，以隔离表示的可迁移性；并用 ego-motion 与深度探针评估表示质量。
AI.result: 随预训练规模扩大，冻结表示中的时间与几何信息逐步增强；在多种端到端驾驶策略与闭环基准上，ScaleDrive 一致提升下游性能，表明该表示可跨策略架构与评测场景/协议泛化。
AI.conclusion: 无动作视频潜预测是可扩展的预训练目标，其学到的表示具有良好的可迁移性与通用性，可作为端到端驾驶规划的通用视觉骨干。

title: Utility-Aware Generative Recommendation: Utility-Enriched Semantic Codes and Utility-Guided Decoding
summary: Generative recommendation has been widely adopted in large-scale industrial recommendation systems, where multimodal item embeddings are quantized into offline semantic identifiers (SIDs) and items are retrieved by autoregressively generating their SIDs. However, conventional SID construction often underrepresents item utility reflected in post-exposure behaviors such as shares, long views, and video completion, making semantically similar items with different utility insufficiently distinguishable while struggling to accommodate rapidly changing utility signals. Moreover, generation likelihood may be misaligned with downstream utility, causing high-utility candidates to be prematurely pruned during beam search before post-generation reranking or training-time reward alignment can effectively compensate. To address these limitations, we propose UAGR, which aligns both SID construction and decoding with downstream multi-objective utility. Our Utility-Enriched Semantic Codes preserve the original semantic information while incorporating item-level utility without increasing SID length or vocabulary size, supporting incremental utility updates with no additional tokenization or sequence-decoding cost. Meanwhile, our Utility-Guided Decoding estimates candidate utility by combining predictions of multiple post-exposure outcomes and incorporates these estimates into beam scoring, reducing the risk of prematurely pruning high-utility paths while enabling flexible utility control without interfering with generative backbone training. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B tests under real-world traffic demonstrate the effectiveness and deployability of UAGR, which has been fully deployed on Kuaishou and increases video watch time by 0.206\% online.

AI.tldr: UAGR通过对齐SID构建与解码过程到下游多目标效用，提升生成式推荐的工业效果。
AI.motivation: 传统SID构建忽略曝光后行为反映的物品效用，语义相似但效用不同的物品难以区分，且难适应快速变化的效用信号；同时生成似然与下游效用不一致，导致beam search过早剪枝高效用候选。
AI.method: 提出UAGR：1) Utility-Enriched Semantic Codes，在保留原语义信息的同时融入物品级效用，不增加SID长度或词表大小，支持增量效用更新且无额外分词/解码开销；2) Utility-Guided Decoding，结合多曝光后行为预测估计候选效用并融入beam评分，减少高效用路径被过早剪枝，支持灵活效用控制且不干扰生成骨干训练。
AI.result: 大量离线实验与真实流量在线A/B测试验证有效性，已在快手全量部署，在线视频观看时长提升0.206%。
AI.conclusion: UAGR证明将SID构建与解码同时对齐下游效用可有效提升生成式推荐性能，并具备良好的工业可部署性。

title: Task Adaptation Through Guidance in Frozen Feature Upsampling
summary: Adapting features before upsampling can improve dense prediction, but the gains may arise from changes in feature values, spatial aggregation, or both. We investigate this ambiguity by comparing matched residual adapters before and after a frozen JAFAR upsampler under a shared parent. We construct a readout-null intervention that preserves a frozen linear classifier's coarse logits while allowing spatial attention weights to adapt. Guidance/value exchanges on trained models and retrained fixed-guidance controls test the utility of this adaptation route. In three-seed experiments on PASCAL Visual Object Classes (VOC) and Cityscapes, adaptation before upsampling improves mean intersection over union (mIoU) by 0.807 and 1.413 percentage points, respectively, over adaptation after upsampling. Across both datasets and the JAFAR and AnyUp upsamplers, readout-null adaptation produces mean gains of 1.379-1.987 points over the corresponding frozen linear baselines. Retrained controls further support the benefit of adaptive spatial guidance. These findings explain how dense predictions can improve despite unchanged coarse classifier outputs and identify spatial guidance as a useful target when adapting frozen feature upsampling systems.

AI.tldr: 论文比较了在冻结上采样器之前与之后进行适配的差异，并构造“readout-null”干预，证明稠密预测增益主要来自空间聚合（注意力引导）的自适应变化，而非特征数值改变。
AI.motivation: 在冻结特征上采样器前做适配能提升稠密预测，但增益来源不明：究竟是特征数值变化、空间聚合变化，还是两者兼有。作者希望厘清这一歧义，并识别出适配时应针对的有效目标。
AI.method: 在共享父模型下，比较冻结 JAFAR 上采样器前后的匹配残差适配器；设计 readout-null 干预，保持冻结线性分类器的粗粒度 logits 不变而仅允许空间注意力权重自适应；并做 guidance/value 交换实验与固定引导的重训练对照。数据集为 PASCAL VOC 与 Cityscapes，三随机种子，覆盖 JAFAR 与 AnyUp 两种上采样器。
AI.result: 上采样前适配相比上采样后适配，mIoU 分别提升 0.807 与 1.413 个百分点；在两个数据集与两种上采样器上，readout-null 适配相对冻结线性基线平均提升 1.379–1.987 个百分点；重训练对照进一步支持自适应空间引导的收益。
AI.conclusion: 稠密预测可在粗粒度分类器输出不变的情况下改善，说明增益来自空间引导/聚合的自适应；在适配冻结特征上采样系统时，空间引导是有价值的目标。

title: Comparative study of global pooling for pre-departure ship fuel consumption prediction: Advantages over per-ship and adaptation-based approaches
summary: Most fuel oil consumption (FOC) models for voyage planning are per-ship models and thus generalize poorly beyond each vessel's records. Transfer and federated learning have been reported to perform better, but under different protocols that often use inputs unavailable before departure or random data splits. It therefore remains unclear which approach performs best. In this study, we compare 11 per-ship, adaptation-based, and global methods on 21 vessels. To prevent leakage, all methods receive identical inputs known or forecast before departure, excluding engine RPM and shaft power, and are tested on intact voyage legs after all training records of each vessel. Global pooling, in which one model describes each vessel by its ship identity and seven ship specifications, performs best overall in every setting examined. For in-fleet vessels, Global LightGBM reaches an overall MAPE of 8.92%, against 11.14% for Per-Ship LightGBM, and outperforms every per-ship and adaptation-based model. Global models of five architectures, including a Transformer, all outperform the per-ship and federated models. Fine-tuning a global model for each vessel, even by low-rank adaptation of the Transformer, adds no accuracy. Without any records of a vessel, the global model reaches a median MAPE of 11.20% and outperforms a per-ship model trained on that vessel's records for 14 of 21 vessels. Adding its first records to the pooled data is as accurate as vessel-specific adaptation. Ship identity and specifications are largely interchangeable for in-fleet vessels, but only the specifications support zero-shot prediction. Its error grows as a vessel's specifications differ from the fleet's. Per-ship models and vessel-specific adaptation are therefore unnecessary under fair comparison. One global model can serve a whole fleet, including newly delivered vessels with similar specifications.

AI.tldr: 在统一、无泄漏的评估协议下，对比21艘船的11种油耗预测方法，发现将所有船数据合并训练的全局模型（用船身份+7项船舶规格作为输入）全面优于逐船模型、自适应方法和联邦学习，可单模型服务整个船队乃至新交付船舶。
AI.motivation: 现有航次规划油耗模型多为逐船模型，泛化差；迁移学习与联邦学习虽被报告更优，但所用协议不一致，常使用出发前不可获得的输入（如RPM、轴功率）或随机划分数据，导致无法判断哪种方法真正更好，亟需公平比较。
AI.method: 在21艘船上比较11种方法（逐船模型、基于自适应的迁移方法、全局方法）。所有方法使用相同的、出发前已知或可预报的输入，剔除发动机RPM与轴功率以防泄漏；在各船全部训练记录之后的完整航段上测试。全局池化模型以船舶身份和7项船舶规格描述各船。
AI.result: 全局池化在各设定下最优：船队内Global LightGBM总体MAPE 8.92%，优于Per-Ship LightGBM的11.14%；含Transformer在内的5种全局架构均胜过逐船与联邦模型；对全局模型做逐船微调（含LoRA）无精度提升。零样本时中位MAPE 11.20%，在14/21艘船上优于该船自身训练的逐船模型；加入首批记录后与逐船自适应效果相当。规格差异越大误差越大。
AI.conclusion: 在公平比较下，逐船模型与船级自适应是不必要的；单个全局模型即可服务整个船队，包括规格相近的新交付船舶。船身份与规格对船队内船舶基本可互换，但只有规格支持零样本预测。

title: Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver
summary: Classical structure-from-motion reconstruction proceeds iteratively, refining camera poses and scene geometry from a current estimate. This allows maps to easily expand without recomputing already computed views, or geometry estimates to improve as more observations are provided. Most geometric foundation models, however, predict entire geometry in a single forward pass or update a recurrent state as frames arrive sequentially, making this expansion and refinement non-trivial. We introduce Solv3R, a looped transformer that learns to continue solving multi-view geometry from its current state. Importantly, its update operator is independent of the iteration count, allowing previously refined and newly introduced views to be jointly updated regardless of how ``solved'' they are. We train the operator to preserve accurate reconstructions under continued iteration and correct inaccurate states, enabling refinement of fixed image collections and integration of new observations. Representations of solved views can also be cached once and reused as geometric context across iterations, enabling compact and efficient key-value caching. We analyze the solver dynamics and compare it with the state-of-the-art, demonstrating that a single learned solver supports offline reconstruction, incremental reconstruction, relocalization, and streaming without task-specific training or modules. The code and models will be made publicly available at https://ubc-vision.github.io/solv3r/.

AI.tldr: Solv3R 提出一种循环 Transformer，把多视图几何求解当作可从当前状态继续迭代的迭代式求解器，支持增量重建、精化与缓存复用 KV，一个模型覆盖离线/增量/重定位/流式任务。
AI.motivation: 经典 SfM 是迭代式的，可增量扩展地图并随观测增多而精化；而多数几何基础模型一次性前向预测全部几何或仅靠循环状态顺次更新，难以扩展与精化。
AI.method: 设计与迭代次数无关的更新算子，持续从当前状态求解多视图几何；训练算子使其在持续迭代下保持正确重建并纠正错误状态；已解视图表示可缓存，作为几何上下文的紧凑 KV 缓存跨迭代复用。
AI.result: 分析求解器动力学并与 SOTA 比较；单一学习求解器无需任务特定训练或模块，即支持离线重建、增量重建、重定位与流式重建。
AI.conclusion: 将迭代求解思想引入几何基础模型，使单一循环求解器统一多种重建范式，并兼顾效率（KV 缓存）与可扩展性。

title: The Tower of Babel in artificial intelligence: who should speak, and when it pays to listen
summary: Two machines can each recognize an object well and still fail together. We study classifiers that see different parts of one object and send short messages to a receiver that identifies its class. Coordination asks how to design messages together; cooperation asks whether the team outperforms one sender given the whole budget. On three digit datasets, messages designed together beat messages designed apart by 18.07 to 22.68 percentage points on average with two-bit messages, with gains in all 24 configurations. A fixed agreement, you report the row and I the column, recovers about half this gain, with only the receiver learned. Senders that draw the same distinctions waste a narrow vocabulary, and senders whose distinctions cross multiply it. A team has no more possible messages than one sender with the same budget, so a partner must bring evidence the first lacks. A solvable model shows individual statistics alone cannot determine whether a partnership helps. On MNIST digits, six shared bits remove 49.54 percent of the strongest tested solo's errors on average. Paired measurements correctly predicted most sensor teams would reduce average accuracy on new participants. Who should speak is a property of the pair, and must be measured in pairs.

AI.tldr: 研究两个分别看物体不同部分的分类器通过短消息协作识别的效果：共同设计的消息显著优于分别设计，且配对测量是判断协作价值的关键。
AI.motivation: 两个机器各自都能很好地识别物体，却可能一起失败。想探究多个分类器通过短消息协作时，消息该如何协调设计（coordination），以及团队能否超越单个拥有全部预算的发送者（cooperation）。
AI.method: 让各分类器观察同一物体的不同部分，各自向接收者发送短消息，由接收者判定类别。在三组数字数据集上比较"共同设计"与"分别设计"的消息；测试固定约定（如我报行、你报列）的恢复效果；分析发送者区分维度相同/交叉的影响；并构建可解模型与 MNIST 传感器团队实验进行配对测量。
AI.result: 两比特消息下，共同设计比分别设计平均高 18.07–22.68 个百分点，24 种配置全部改善；固定约定仅需学习接收者即可挽回约一半增益。MNIST 上六比特共享消息平均消除最强单人模型 49.54% 的错误；配对测量正确预测多数传感器团队会降低新参与者平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 发送者区分相同会浪费有限词表，区分交叉则使收益相乘；团队的可能消息数不超过同等预算的单人，因此伙伴必须提供对方缺失的证据。单人统计量无法判断伙伴是否有帮助，"谁该发言"是配对属性，必须在配对中测量。

title: Performance evaluation of super-resolution techniques for characterization and phenotyping of commodity crops using multispectral imagery
summary: Multispectral imagery provides spectral information beyond the visible range for vegetation monitoring, but it typically suffers from limited spatial resolution, which can obscure fine crop structures and affect vegetation-index (VI) estimates.} This study evaluates whether single-image super-resolution (SISR) methods developed for red, green, and blue (RGB) imagery can enhance the spatial resolution of red, green, and near-infrared (RGN) crop images while preserving spectral fidelity. Eight pretrained methods are applied directly to RGN images without fine-tuning: bicubic and nearest-neighbor interpolation, Real-ESRGAN, HAT, HiT-SR, SRFormer, ResShift, and StableSR. Reconstruction at $4\times$ and $16\times$ is evaluated for whole images and manually segmented leaf regions. Reconstruction quality is assessed using mean absolute error (MAE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), spectral angle mapper (SAM), and erreur relative globale adimensionnelle de synthèse (ERGAS). Eight VIs, computed from reference and super-resolved images, are evaluated using MAE, PSNR, and SSIM. Transformer-based methods \modification{significantly} outperform GAN- and diffusion-based approaches in both evaluation settings \modification{($p < 0.001$)}, with \modification{HAT, HiT-SR, and SRFormer forming the highest-performing statistical tier}. These findings indicate that RGB-trained SISR can enhance spatial detail in RGN crop imagery while maintaining spectral consistency and VI reliability for high-resolution crop phenotyping.

AI.tldr: 评估8种RGB预训练单图超分辨率方法直接用于RGN作物图像的效果，发现Transformer类方法在4×和16×放大下最优，可保持光谱一致性并提升植被指数可靠性。
AI.motivation: 多光谱影像具有可见光之外的光谱信息，有利于植被监测，但空间分辨率有限，会模糊精细作物结构并影响植被指数（VI）估计。作者希望验证：为RGB图像开发的SISR方法能否在不微调的情况下迁移到RGN作物图像。
AI.method: 将8种预训练SISR方法（双三次、最近邻插值、Real-ESRGAN、HAT、HiT-SR、SRFormer、ResShift、StableSR）直接应用于RGN图像，不进行微调；在4×和16×放大下，对整幅图像与人工分割的叶片区域分别重建；用MAE、PSNR、SSIM、SAM、ERGAS评估重建质量，并对8种植被指数用MAE、PSNR、SSIM评估。
AI.result: Transformer类方法在两种评估场景下均显著优于GAN和扩散模型方法（p<0.001），其中HAT、HiT-SR和SRFormer构成统计上表现最高的层级。
AI.conclusion: RGB训练的SISR能够增强RGN作物图像的空间细节，同时保持光谱一致性和VI可靠性，可用于高分辨率作物表型分析。

title: Improved regret bounds in tabular RL under local differential privacy
summary: We study regret minimization for time-homogeneous episodic tabular reinforcement learning with $S$ states and $A$ actions under non-interactive $ε$-local differential privacy (LDP). In each episode $k \in [K]$, the decision-maker sends a policy to a user, the user executes the policy for $H$ steps, and sends an $ε$-locally differentially private message back to the decision-maker. When $H=1$, the problem reduces to an LDP contextual bandit with $S$ contexts, $A$ arms and horizon $K$. We prove that the minimax regret is $\min\bigg(K, \frac{ \sqrt{\max( S, \exp(ε) + 1) S A K (\exp(ε) + 1)}}{\exp(ε) - 1}\bigg)$, up to constants and a $\sqrt{\log(A)}$ factor. The upper bound is achieved by an adaptation of EXP3 and a unary encoding mechanism. When $H > 1$, and for small $ε$, we show a lower bound in $Ω(HS\frac{\sqrt{A K}}ε)$ and an upper bound in $\tilde{O}(H^2 S^2 \frac{\sqrt{ AK}}ε)$. The upper bound is achieved by an algorithm based on UCBVI and a unary encoding mechanism. For small $ε$, these bounds improve the previously known lower bound by a factor $\sqrt{S}$ and the previously known upper bound by a factor of $H \sqrt{A}$.

AI.tldr: 研究非交互ε-局部差分隐私(LDP)下时间齐次分段表格强化学习的遗憾最小化问题，给出H=1(即LDP上下文bandit)的精确minimax遗憾，以及H>1时的上下界改进。
AI.motivation: 在LDP约束下隐私保护强化学习的理论遗憾极限尚不清晰，已有界限在S、H、A等因子方面不够紧，需刻画minimax遗憾并改进上下界。
AI.method: 建模为非交互ε-LDP：每轮决策者下发策略、用户执行H步并回传ε-LDP消息。H=1时用EXP3的自适应变体+一元编码(unary encoding)机制得upper bound。H>1时基于UCBVI+一元编码机制构造算法，并给出小ε下的下界分析。
AI.result: H=1时minimax遗憾为 min(K, √{max(S, e^ε+1)·S·A·K·(e^ε+1)}/(e^ε−1))（忽略常数与√log A）。H>1且小ε时：下界Ω(HS√{AK}/ε)，上界Õ(H²S²√{AK}/ε)，较已有下界改进√S倍、上界改进H√A倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了LDP表格RL的minimax遗憾刻画及更紧的界；H=1时界限基本紧，H>1在H、S因子上仍存在上界与下界的差距，留待未来缩小。

title: ProtoFusion: Protocol-Guided Prompt Refinement for Generative Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
summary: Infrared and visible image fusion integrates complementary information from both modalities to provide a more comprehensive representation of the scene. We propose ProtoFusion, a protocol-guided generative framework for infrared and visible image fusion. Instead of relying on fixed fusion operators, hand-crafted objectives, or manually specified one-shot prompts, ProtoFusion formulates fusion as protocol-constrained generation. It represents fusion intent with a structured protocol, consisting of environment state cards, grounding principles, and a style profile, which explicitly specifies which evidence should be preserved or suppressed and which properties the fused result should satisfy. To optimize this protocol, we introduce protocol-guided prompt refinement, a closed-loop learning framework that iteratively performs generation, evaluation, and revision under multimodal evidence. Once learned, the optimized protocol is fixed at inference time and directly guides fusion generation. To address residual source inconsistencies, we further incorporate structured belief construction, which organizes modality reliability, scene evidence, and cross-modal conflicts into a structured representation for conservative correction after generation. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that ProtoFusion improves quantitative performance, achieves favorable results in aesthetic evaluation, and produces visually coherent fusion outputs. Project Page: {https://erfect2020.github.io/ProtoFusion/}.

AI.tldr: ProtoFusion 将红外与可见光图像融合建模为"协议约束的生成"任务：用结构化协议显式表达融合意图，并通过闭环提示精炼学习协议，推理时以固定协议引导生成，再用结构化信念做保守校正。
AI.motivation: 现有红外与可见光融合方法依赖固定融合算子、手工设计目标或一次性人工提示，无法灵活、显式地表达"保留/抑制哪些证据、融合结果应满足何种性质"的融合意图。
AI.method: 1) 结构化协议：由环境状态卡、接地原则与风格配置组成，显式规定保留或抑制的证据及结果属性；2) 协议引导的提示精炼：闭环学习框架，在多模态证据下迭代执行生成—评估—修正以优化协议；3) 结构化信念构建：组织模态可靠性、场景证据与跨模态冲突，用于生成后的保守校正以缓解残余源间不一致。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，ProtoFusion 提升了定量指标，在美学评价上取得良好结果，并生成视觉上连贯的融合输出。
AI.conclusion: 以协议约束生成替代固定算子与手工目标，是一种可行且有效的红外—可见光融合范式；学习后固定的协议可直接指导推理，配合保守校正可兼顾性能与视觉质量。

title: Hybrid Federated Learning for Multimodal Fusion under Missing Modalities and Site Heterogeneity
summary: Multimodal fusion is studied under hybrid federation, where data are partitioned across samples and feature blocks. The proposed two-dimensional federated smooth multiple-kernel large-margin learning method (2D-FedSMKL) integrates availability-corrected modality scores, group-kernel regularization, and smooth worst-site risk aggregation. For fixed maps and propensities, the objective is convex and smooth. Curvature bounds and exact synchronous block-gradient equivalence are established for binary and multiclass scores, giving a conditional accelerated rate. An oracle-propensity binary risk bound and a propensity-perturbation result are also derived. Simulations and two public activity-recognition benchmarks assess site heterogeneity and modality absence. Worst-site aggregation improves worst-site performance under heterogeneity, including reversed and size-balanced designs. On the benchmarks, validation selects the correction; the selected model is not significantly worse than the strongest reference at the worst site, and group-regularization benefits vary by dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出二维联邦平滑多核大间隔学习方法(2D-FedSMKL)，在样本与特征块双重划分的混合联邦下融合多模态数据，结合可得性校正模态得分、组核正则与平滑最差站点风险聚合。
AI.motivation: 多模态融合面临"混合联邦"场景：数据同时按样本和特征块划分，且站点间存在异质性、模态缺失问题，现有方法难以同时处理这两类划分与缺失。
AI.method: 构建含可得性校正模态得分、组核正则化与平滑最差站点风险聚合的目标函数；固定映射与倾向时目标凸且光滑；给出曲率界及二分类/多分类下精确同步块梯度等价性，导出条件加速率；并推导oracle倾向下的二分类风险界与倾向扰动结果。
AI.result: 仿真与两个公开活动识别基准显示：最差站点聚合在异质性（含反转与规模均衡设计）下改善最差站点性能；基准上验证集能选出校正方案，所选模型在最差站点不显著劣于最强参照，组正则收益随数据集而异。
AI.conclusion: 2D-FedSMKL为混合联邦多模态融合提供了具理论保证（凸性、加速率、风险界）且实证有效的最差站点鲁棒方法，可得性校正可由验证集可靠选择，组正则效果依赖数据。

title: PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360$^{\circ}$ View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments
summary: Traditional image cropping assumes the photograph already contains the composition worth keeping, and asks only where to crop. A full 360$^{\circ}$ scene offers no such guarantee: the viewing direction in a scene has to be discovered before anything can be framed. We present PhotoGuider, a measure-then-frame method that answers both questions with compact learned scorers over one shared set of composition-aware features. The designed features are extracted using foundation and task-specific vision models and structured into four photographic tokens: Subject, Composition, Aesthetics, and Integrity. Our MLLM explainer is fine-tuned to generate composition-related explanations conditioned on images and measured token assessments. To our knowledge, PhotoGuider is the first method to combine explicit composition-based direction selection in 360$^{\circ}$ panoramas with refined framing, camera-parameter output for native re-rendering, and measurement-conditioned explanations. On two standard 2D cropping benchmarks, PhotoGuider achieves the highest average mIoU performance against ground-truth crops. In a blind ranking study, 120 participants ranked three cropping methods over 100 panoramic scenes from the public Poly Haven HDRI library, placing our framings first in 53.2% of cases, against 27.3% and 19.5% for two strong alternatives. Project page: https://ntuneillee.github.io/research/photoguider/

AI.tldr: PhotoGuider 提出"先测量后构图"的 360° 全景取景方法，用四个摄影令牌（主体、构图、美学、完整性）共享特征同时完成"往哪看"（方向选择）与"怎么裁"（精细取景），并输出相机参数与基于测量的解释。
AI.motivation: 传统图像裁剪默认照片中已有值得保留的构图，只解决"裁剪位置"问题；但 360° 全景中观看方向本身未知，必须先发现可看的方向再取景。现有方法缺少将方向选择、精细取景、原生重渲染参数与可解释性结合的方案。
AI.method: 1) 用基础视觉模型与任务专用模型提取构图感知特征，结构化为 Subject、Composition、Aesthetics、Integrity 四个摄影令牌；2) 在这些共享特征上训练紧凑的学习型打分器，同时解决方向选择和裁剪框回归；3) 微调 MLLM 解释器，以图像和令牌测量结果为条件生成构图解释；4) 输出相机参数以支持原生重渲染。
AI.result: 在两个标准 2D 裁剪基准上，相对真值裁剪取得最高平均 mIoU。盲评中 120 名参与者在 Poly Haven HDRI 的 100 个全景场景上比较三种方法，本方取景以 53.2% 的比例排名第一，另两种强基线分别为 27.3% 和 19.5%。
AI.conclusion: PhotoGuider 是首个在 360° 全景中结合显式构图方向选择、精细取景、相机参数输出与测量条件化解释的方法，在定量指标与主观盲评上均优于强基线。

title: When Does Design Thinking Work? A Convergence Theorem for the Iterate-Test Core
comment: Under review at Journal of Product Innovation Management (JPIM)
summary: Design thinking is widely taught as an iterative loop of ideation, prototyping, and testing, yet conditions under which such a loop must improve innovation outcomes remain unspecified. Taking problem framing as given, we formalize the iterate-test core as search over a finite prototype space whose utility is learned through noisy evaluations. We prove that the prototype a team believes to be best converges almost surely to a local optimum under five conditions: finite framing, local ideation, non-summable discovery rates, unbiased repeated testing, and retention of tested prototypes. Bounded test bias or criteria drift degrades the guarantee by a bounded amount, and multiple stakeholders yield convergence to a locally Pareto-optimal set. Finite-horizon simulations across three landscape classes (additive valuation, NK rugged landscapes, and clustered modular architectures) show that asymptotic limits are rarely reached in practice. Teams face an optimizer's curse, overestimating their chosen concept by 4-8% and frequently discarding superior prototypes. Testing every prototype once proves to be the worst allocation; optimal performance requires building one to three prototypes per five tests and repeatedly re-testing leaders. Pre-screening concepts yields greater performance gains than tuning testing policies.

AI.tldr: 论文将设计思维的"迭代-测试"核心形式化为有限原型空间上的带噪搜索，证明其收敛到局部最优需五条件，并经仿真揭示实践中的优化者诅咒与测试分配悖论。
AI.motivation: 设计思维被广泛教授为"构思-原型-测试"的迭代循环，但这一循环在何种条件下能真正改善创新结果从未被明确规定，缺乏理论刻画。
AI.method: 将问题界定视为给定，把迭代-测试核心建模为有限原型空间上的搜索，效用通过带噪评估学习；从理论上证明收敛条件并分析测试偏差、标准漂移与多利益相关者的影响；再在加性估值、NK崎岖地形、聚类模块化架构三类景观上做有限期仿真。
AI.result: 证明团队所信最优原型几乎必然收敛到局部最优，需满足五条件（有限框架、局部构思、不可和发现率、无偏重复测试、保留已测原型）；有界测试偏差或标准漂移使保证按有界量退化；多利益相关者收敛到局部帕累托最优集。仿真显示渐近极限极少达到，存在优化者诅咒（高估所选概念4-8%）、常丢弃更优原型；每个原型只测一次是最差分配，每五次测试配1-3个原型并反复重测领先者最优；预筛选概念比调整测试策略收益更大。
AI.conclusion: 迭代-测试循环的有效性依赖明确条件，实践中有限期行为远偏离渐近保证；应以预筛选概念和"少造多测"的分配策略为核心，而非只优化测试政策。

title: TailorRig: Controllable and Structured Auxiliary Skeleton Generation for Garment-Aware Rigging
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
summary: Humanoid rigging for modern characters with complex garments remains challenging due to the need for dense auxiliary skeletons and precise skinning control. Existing automatic methods primarily recover rigs from geometry, providing limited artist control over auxiliary articulation and often lacking explicit semantic or kinematic-chain structure for dense garment bones, leading to instability and weight bleeding. We present TailorRig, a framework that reformulates garment-aware humanoid rigging as a structured, controllable full-rig generation problem. This formulation shifts the goal from automatic rig recovery to artist-driven rig authoring, where both body-template compatibility and auxiliary articulation are explicit design choices. TailorRig exposes two explicit axes of artist control within a unified framework: a user-specified body skeleton template that preserves body-rig compatibility, and artist-provided semantic labels that drive an autoregressive generator to synthesize requested category-specific auxiliary bone chains. To robustly assign skinning weights under dense skeletal configurations, we further introduce a hierarchical chain-to-bone formulation: vertices are first associated to a kinematic chain, and bone weights are then refined within that chain, reducing weight bleeding between spatially adjacent but semantically unrelated structures.
