We evaluate TailorRig on a diverse set of characters and introduce Human-Mix, a large-scale dataset of over 38,000 humanoid models curated for garment-aware rigging. Experiments show that TailorRig improves skeleton accuracy, deformation stability, controllability, and practical usability over existing methods.

AI.tldr: TailorRig 将服装感知的人形角色绑定重新表述为结构化、可控的全骨架生成问题，通过用户指定身体骨架模板和语义标签驱动自回归生成器合成服装辅助骨骼链，并采用链-骨分层蒙皮，显著提升骨架精度与变形稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现代复杂服装角色的人形绑定需要密集辅助骨骼与精细蒙皮控制。现有自动方法仅从几何恢复骨架，对辅助关节的艺术家控制有限，且缺乏显式语义与运动链结构，导致密集服装骨骼不稳定和权重串扰（weight bleeding）。
AI.method: 提出统一框架，暴露两个显式艺术家控制轴：(1) 用户指定的身体骨架模板，保证与身体绑定兼容；(2) 艺术家提供的语义标签，驱动自回归生成器合成所需类别的辅助骨骼链。针对密集骨架下的蒙皮权重，引入分层链-骨（chain-to-bone）公式：先将顶点关联到运动链，再在链内精化骨骼权重，减少空间相邻但语义无关结构间的权重串扰。同时构建 Human-Mix 大规模数据集，含 38,000+ 人形模型。
AI.result: 在多样化角色上与现有方法对比，TailorRig 在骨架精度、变形稳定性、可控性和实际可用性方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 将绑定问题从自动恢复转向艺术家驱动的骨架创作是可行且有效的；显式模板与语义控制结合分层蒙皮可稳健处理密集服装骨骼，Human-Mix 数据集为服装感知绑定研究提供支撑。

title: TSB-SEG: A Systematic Time-Series Segmentation Benchmark
comment: NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets. Code and results: https://github.com/fchavelli/TSB-SEG
summary: Time-series segmentation, studied as either Change Point Detection (CPD) or State Detection (SD), underpins a broad range of monitoring and diagnostic applications. However, the field suffers from a persistent divide between the statistical community (focusing on CPD) and the machine learning and data mining communities (focusing on SD). Consequently, the literature remains fragmented: evaluations typically cover narrow methodological families, datasets are often small or homogeneous, and CPD and SD are rarely evaluated together. We address these gaps with TSB-SEG, a unified benchmark comprising 592 univariate and multivariate time series from 8 heterogeneous datasets and surveying 26 algorithms that span five decades of progress. To ensure a fair comparison, we introduce a two-pool design: a scalable main pool of tractable detectors used for the aggregate ranking, and an extended-scope pool for computationally intensive methods. All methods are unified under tsseg, an open-source library to ensure full reproducibility. Our systematic evaluation yields three insights: (a) no single detector dominates across domains, and per-dataset hyperparameter tuning remains decisive for performance, (b) CPD accuracy is a useful, though imperfect, proxy for SD accuracy, and (c) data characteristics should guide method selection. We provide actionable guidance based on data properties, error tolerances, and tuning budgets, identify impactful hyperparameters, and characterize algorithm robustness to these choices.

AI.tldr: 提出 TSB-SEG 统一基准，涵盖 8 个异构数据集共 592 条单/多变量时间序列、26 种算法，统一比较时间序列分割中的变点检测（CPD）与状态检测（SD），并给出方法选择的实用建议。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分割研究长期分裂为统计学的 CPD 与机器学习/数据挖掘的 SD 两大阵营，导致文献碎片化：评测覆盖面窄、数据集小且同质、CPD 与 SD 很少同台比较。
AI.method: 构建 TSB-SEG 基准：592 条单/多变量序列、8 个异构数据集、26 种算法（跨五十年）；采用"双池"设计——可扩展的主池（用于总体排序）与计算密集方法的扩展池；全部方法统一实现于开源库 tsseg 以保证可复现。
AI.result: 三项发现：(a) 没有单一检测器在所有领域占优，按数据集调参对性能仍具决定性；(b) CPD 精度是 SD 精度的有用但不完美的代理；(c) 数据特性应作为方法选择的依据。此外给出基于数据属性、误差容忍度与调参预算的选型指南，识别关键超参数并刻画算法对其的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CPD 与 SD 应统一评估；方法选择需结合数据特征、容错与调参成本，并提供开源基准与可操作建议推动该领域标准化比较。

title: Unlocking the Potential of Contrastive Regularization for Diffusion Transformer Training
summary: Representation regularization has emerged as an effective way to improve diffusion transformer training. Yet one of the most canonical regularizers--InfoNCE-style contrastive learning--remains largely underexplored in this setting. We naturally ask a question: can standard contrastive learning serve as an effective regularizer for diffusion transformers? Surprisingly, we find that naive InfoNCE regularization brings only marginal gains. Our analysis reveals that the objective is easily dominated by a shortcut: near-orthogonal noise components in diffusion inputs provide a bypass for enlarging negative-pair distances while weakening positive-pair alignment, especially at high noise levels. To unlock the benefit of contrastive regularization, we propose Clean Representation-ANchored Contrastive (CRAN) regularization. Specifically, CRAN anchors contrastive dispersion with clean-sample representation distances, transferring clean relational semantic structure to noisy diffusion representations to suppress the noise shortcut. Extensive experiments on ImageNet show that CRAN consistently improves diffusion transformer training across model scales and training budgets, outperforming internal feature-alignment and dispersive regularization baselines while matching external DINO-guided REPA. These results re-establish InfoNCE-based contrastive learning as an effective regularizer for diffusion training, once its noise-driven over-dispersion is properly constrained.

AI.tldr: 本文发现标准InfoNCE对比正则在扩散Transformer中仅带来微小收益，原因是扩散输入的近正交噪声成分提供了"捷径"，抑制了正对对齐；作者提出CRAN（以干净表征为锚的对比正则），用干净样本表征距离锚定对比离散度，从而抑制噪声捷径。
AI.motivation: 表征正则是提升扩散Transformer训练效果的有效手段，但最经典的InfoNCE式对比学习在此设定下仍缺乏充分探索。作者追问：标准对比学习能否作为扩散Transformer的有效正则器？实验发现朴素InfoNCE只带来微弱提升，需要先厘清其失效原因。
AI.method: 通过分析发现，目标函数容易被噪声捷径主导：扩散输入中近正交的噪声成分在负对距离拉大的同时削弱正对对齐，尤其在高噪声水平下。为此提出CRAN（Clean Representation-ANchored Contrastive）正则：以干净样本的表征距离来锚定对比离散度，将干净样本的关系语义结构迁移到含噪扩散表征上，从而抑制噪声捷径。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上的大量实验表明，CRAN在不同模型规模和训练预算下均能稳定改进扩散Transformer的训练，优于内部特征对齐与离散性正则基线，并可与外部DINO引导的REPA相媲美。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：只要恰当约束由噪声驱动的过度离散，InfoNCE式对比学习就能重新被确立为扩散训练的有效正则器。

title: Optimal Subgroup Discovery at Every Support Threshold
summary: Subgroup discovery aims to identify regions of the feature space where a target variable deviates from its marginal distribution. A fundamental challenge in this problem is the trade-off between a subgroup's deviation and its support: small subgroups can be highly deviating but statistically meaningless, while large ones cannot deviate much by construction. Existing methods tackle this challenge by collapsing the two into a single scalar quality measure, implicitly committing to one particular trade-off and making it difficult to recover the most deviating subgroup under a user-specified support constraint. We instead provide the first theoretical and structural characterization of optimal subgroups with maximum Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence under arbitrary support constraints. Under a partition-based generative model, where the feature space decomposes into regions of homogeneous conditional distributions of the target variable called atoms, we prove that every point on the deviation-support Pareto front is a union of whole atoms together with at most one fractional atom. This reduces an uncountable search to a finite combinatorial problem. Guided by this theory, we propose a simple two-step recipe: learn a homogeneous partition, then select atoms greedily. Across 19 benchmark datasets, it finds the most deviating subgroups at a range of support thresholds, and reliably improves subgroups returned by existing methods when applied as a post-processing step. These results empirically validate the sufficiency and necessity of our theoretical contributions.

AI.tldr: 论文对「任意支持度约束下最大化KL散度的最优子群」给出首个理论与结构刻画：在基于划分的生成模型下，Pareto前沿上任一点都是若干完整原子加至多一个分数原子的并集，从而把不可数搜索化为有限组合问题，并提出「先学同质划分、再贪心选原子」两步法。
AI.motivation: 子群发现的核心难点是偏差与支持度的权衡：小子群偏差大但无统计意义，大子群偏差受限。现有方法把二者压成单一标量质量度量，隐含固定了某一种权衡，难以在用户指定支持度约束下找回偏差最大的子群。
AI.method: 在基于划分的生成模型（特征空间分解为条件分布同质的"原子"区域）下，对最大KL散度子群做理论刻画，证明偏差-支持度Pareto前沿上每个点都是整原子并集加至多一个分数原子；据此设计两步算法：学习同质划分，然后贪心选择原子。
AI.result: 在19个基准数据集上，该方法在多个支持度阈值下都能找到偏差最大的子群；作为后处理步骤应用于现有方法时，能稳定改进其返回的子群，经验上验证了理论的充分性与必要性。
AI.conclusion: 刻画了支持度约束下最优KL散度子群的结构性质，将不可数优化转化为有限组合选择，给出简洁有效的两步流程，并验证其跨数据集的有效性与对现有方法的增益。

title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Monocular and Multi-view 3D Human Pose Estimation Models for Fitness Exercise Analysis
summary: Three-dimensional human pose estimation has become a fundamental component of computer vision systems for sports analytics, rehabilitation, and motion understanding. Although recent deep learning approaches have achieved remarkable accuracy on standard benchmarks, their performance under realistic sports scenarios remains insufficiently studied. Furthermore, the trade-offs between recent monocular and multi-view approaches, as well as the benefits of post-processing techniques for improving temporal consistency, have not been systematically evaluated on fitness-oriented datasets. This paper evaluates recent state-of-the-art 3D human pose estimation methods on Fit3D, a dataset of synchronized multi-view recordings of a wide variety of fitness exercises with accurate ground-truth annotations. We study two recent monocular lifting approaches, TCPFormer and PoseMamba-L, and a multi-view model, MVGFormer, under a unified evaluation protocol. To investigate the influence of the input data, monocular methods are evaluated using ground-truth keypoints and detections generated by recent 2D pose estimators, RTMPose and YOLO-Pose. Additionally, we analyze the effectiveness of three temporal filters for reducing prediction jitter while preserving motion dynamics. Experimental results provide a detailed comparison of accuracy, temporal consistency, and robustness to imperfect 2D detections across the evaluated methods. Our analysis highlights the impact of detector quality on lifting-based approaches, compares transformer- and state-space-based temporal architectures, and discusses the practical trade-offs between monocular and multi-view systems for fitness motion analysis. Our results show that 2D detection quality, temporal modeling, and post-processing must be considered jointly in pose estimation pipelines for exercise analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文在Fit3D健身数据集上统一评测了单目方法TCPFormer、PoseMamba-L与多视角方法MVGFormer，考察2D检测质量、时序建模与后处理滤波的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人体姿态估计在标准基准上精度很高，但在真实健身/运动场景下表现研究不足；单目与多视角方法的权衡、以及提升时序一致性的后处理收益，尚未在健身类数据集上系统评估。
AI.method: 采用同步多视角录制且带精确真值的Fit3D数据集，建立统一评测协议，对比两个单目lifting方法（TCPFormer、PoseMamba-L）与多视角模型MVGFormer；单目方法分别使用真值关键点与RTMPose、YOLO-Pose检测的2D输入；并分析三种时序滤波在减少抖动同时保持运动动态方面的效果。
AI.result: 实验给出了各方法在精度、时序一致性和对不完美2D检测鲁棒性上的详细对比；表明2D检测质量对lifting类方法影响显著，并比较了基于transformer与状态空间的时序架构。
AI.conclusion: 在健身运动分析的姿态估计流程中，2D检测质量、时序建模与后处理必须联合考虑；并讨论了单目与多视角系统的实用权衡。

title: Diagonal Equivalence in State Space Models: Characterization, Retrieval Rank, and Selective Extensions
summary: We classify real and complex state-space models (SSMs) with linear transitions, distinguishing fixed-basis diagonal equivalence from input-output equivalence and tracking coefficient-conditioning windows under coordinate changes. We characterize diagonal equivalence through commuting transition families whose members are diagonalizable over the chosen field. With time-shared token-local matrix maps, we identify this class's state-mediated kernels with unnormalized scalar-mode linear attention with multiplicative masks. Mamba 3's multiple-input, multiple-output (MIMO) construction lifts one value per local interface; SSD-MIMO routes independent values for local retrieval rank above one. HybridMamba combines Mamba 1's per-coordinate decay, Mamba 2-style heads and Mamba 3's complex rotations and two-endpoint writes, mixing real and rotating state blocks with different decay laws. They recover Mamba 1-3 single-input, single-output (SISO) configurations as exact special cases. On five large H100 bfloat16 workloads, our fused GPU kernels improve geometric-mean training time over official Mamba 1/3 in matched SISO recoveries, with Mamba 2 near parity at SSM-core scope. Memory tradeoffs depend on the baseline and metric: saved-for-backward versus peak allocation. In small-model multi-token recall experiments, both designs outperform Mamba 1-3 on the hardest tier; higher routing ranks perform best in gated or phase-diverse configurations. In single-seed language models with about 500M parameters, both improve on Mamba 1/2 in test loss at 2B tokens, but the routing gains do not translate into lower language-model loss. Our best configurations approach Mamba 3 SISO through 10B tokens while remaining behind it and Mamba 3 MIMO in language-model loss.

AI.tldr: 本文对线性转移的实/复状态空间模型（SSM）进行等价性分类，区分固定基对角等价与输入-输出等价，并给出对角等价的可交换转移族刻画；在此框架下提出统一 SISO/复杂旋转/多路由价值的 Mamba 变体（SSD-MIMO、HybridMamba），配合融合 GPU 核，在训练效率与检索任务上取得改善。
AI.motivation: 现有 Mamba 1/2/3 等 SSM 变体在结构（实衰减、复旋转、单/多值接口）上彼此割裂，缺乏统一的等价性理论来判定何种结构差异真正影响输入-输出行为、何种只是坐标变换，也缺少在相同条件下比较其效率与表达力的系统性证据。
AI.method: 1）理论：对含线性转移的实/复 SSM 按"固定基对角等价 vs 输入-输出等价"分类，用可对角化、相互可交换的转移族刻画对角等价，并追踪坐标变换下系数条件数窗口；2）在时间共享的 token 局部矩阵映射下，将该类状态中介核等同于带乘性掩码的未归一化标量模态线性注意力；3）构造 SSD-MIMO（每局部接口路由多个独立 value，提升检索秩）与 HybridMamba（混合 Mamba1 逐坐标衰减、Mamba2 多头、Mamba3 复旋转与双端点写，实/旋转块不同衰减律），并证明可精确退化到 Mamba1-3 SISO；4）在 H100 bfloat16 上实现融合 GPU 核，做训练时间/显存基准；5）多 token 召回小模型实验与约 500M 参数单种子语言模型实验（至 10B token）。
AI.result: 五类 H100 bf16 工作负载上，融合核在匹配 SISO 配置下相对官方 Mamba1/3 改善几何平均训练时间，Mamba2 在 SSM 核范围接近持平；显存权衡依基线与指标（反向保存 vs 峰值分配）而异。多 token 召回中两种设计在最难档优于 Mamba1-3，高路由秩在门控或相位多样配置下最佳。约 500M 参数语言模型在 2B token 时测试损失优于 Mamba1/2，但路由收益未转化为更低 LM 损失；最佳配置至 10B token 接近但未超越 Mamba3 SISO，且落后于 Mamba3 MIMO。
AI.conclusion: 该等价性框架能清晰界定 SSM 中结构性差异的实质，并统一重现 Mamba1-3；所提 MIMO/混合设计在效率与合成召回上有效，但多值路由的表达力优势在语言建模损失上未体现出增益，最优配置仍不及 Mamba3（尤其 MIMO）。

title: Training-Time Domain Transfer for Generator-Free Diagnostics on Novel Modalities in Computational Pathology
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027
summary: Novel imaging modalities promise improved diagnostics, but AI development is constrained by scarce training data. Inference-time domain transfer can address this by mapping novel modalities to established ones, enabling reuse of existing diagnostic models. However, this introduces hallucination risks, computational overhead, and regulatory complexity. Inspired by sim-to-real transfer, we propose training-time domain transfer, generating synthetic target-domain training data from archived routine samples to enable direct diagnosis on real inputs without inference-time generation. Using unstained prostate histopathology as a proof-of-concept, we compare this approach with inference-time virtual staining and conventional H&E-based cancer detection. Training-time transfer achieved higher concordance with the conventional benchmark than virtual staining for both raw (Cohen's $κ$=0.59 vs. 0.37; Gwet's AC1=0.73 vs. 0.29) and deparaffinized tissue ($κ$=0.66 vs. 0.61; AC1=0.73 vs. 0.64), supporting its potential for emerging diagnostic modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出"训练时域迁移"：从存档常规样本生成合成的目标模态训练数据，使模型可直接诊断真实新模态输入，在无染色前列腺病理上优于推理时虚拟染色。
AI.motivation: 新影像模态诊断潜力大，但训练数据稀缺；推理时域迁移虽可复用已有诊断模型，却带来幻觉风险、计算开销和监管复杂性。
AI.method: 受sim-to-real迁移启发，在训练阶段将存档常规样本（H&E）转换为合成的目标域数据（无染色图像）用于训练；以无染色前列腺组织病理为概念验证，与推理时虚拟染色及传统H&E检测对比。
AI.result: 训练时迁移与常规基准的一致性高于虚拟染色：原始组织 κ=0.59 vs 0.37，AC1=0.73 vs 0.29；去石蜡组织 κ=0.66 vs 0.61，AC1=0.73 vs 0.64。
AI.conclusion: 训练时域迁移可避免推理时生成，支持在新兴诊断模态上直接诊断，具备应用潜力。

title: Controlling Sharpening in LLM Post-Training
summary: LLM post-training via reinforcement learning has shown consistent improvements in accuracy at the cost of reducing behavioral coverage - a phenomenon known as sharpening that can stall progress on difficult tasks. Repeated sampling objectives such as $\mathrm{pass@k}$ and $\mathrm{max@k}$ are known to mitigate sharpening, but the mechanism behind it remains poorly understood. Moreover, existing approaches for $\mathrm{@k}$ optimization use dedicated algorithms, and no general framework exists for adapting established policy optimization methods from $\mathrm{@}1$ to $\mathrm{@k}$. We derive the optimal policies for KL-regularized $\mathrm{pass@k}$ and $\mathrm{max@k}$ objectives in closed form. Our explicit solutions reveal that $\mathrm{@k}$ optimization naturally redistributes learning pressure based on prompt difficulty, directing it toward harder problems. Crucially, we show that standard $\mathrm{@}1$ objectives achieve these exact same optimal policies through prompt-adaptive regularization or reward transformation. Ultimately, this yields an optimizer-independent explanation for why $\mathrm{@k}$ objectives reduce sharpening on easy tasks while prioritizing success on harder ones. Building on these insights, we introduce $\mathrm{@k}$ Adaptive Pressure for Policy Optimization (KAPPO). Following a one-time reference calibration, KAPPO seamlessly adapts existing $\mathrm{@}1$ methods to $\mathrm{@k}$ via prompt-adaptive regularization or reward transformation, without otherwise altering their training procedures. Experiments with several RL methods on mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that KAPPO provides direct control over sharpening. Crucially, we demonstrate that $\mathrm{@k}$ pressure can be fully realized with single completion training, matching the performance of multi-completion $\mathrm{@k}$ optimizers at a fraction of the cost.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了KL正则化pass@k与max@k目标的最优策略闭式解，揭示@k优化本质是按题目难度重分配学习压力；提出KAPPO框架，仅通过提示自适应正则或奖励变换即可将现有@1方法转为@k优化，无需专用算法，且单次采样即可实现多采样@k的性能。
AI.motivation: LLM强化学习后训练虽提升准确率却导致"锐化"（sharpening），即行为覆盖度下降，使困难任务进展停滞。pass@k、max@k等重复采样目标可缓解锐化，但其机制不清；且现有@k方法依赖专用算法，缺乏将成熟@1策略优化方法推广到@k的通用框架。
AI.method: 推导KL正则化pass@k和max@k目标的最优策略闭式解；证明@1目标通过提示自适应正则化或奖励变换可达到完全相同的@k最优策略；据此提出KAPPO（@k Adaptive Pressure for Policy Optimization），经一次性参考校准后用提示自适应正则/奖励变换把现有@1方法适配为@k，不改变原训练流程。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成上，多种RL方法验证KAPPO可对锐化实现直接控制；@k压力可通过单次补全训练完全实现，以极小成本匹配多补全@k优化器的性能。
AI.conclusion: @k优化的作用来源于按难度重分配学习压力，且与优化器无关，可用@1目标的提示自适应修改等价实现；KAPPO提供了通用、低成本且可控的@k优化途径。

title: RouteREPA: Routed Representation Alignment for Just Image Transformers
summary: Representation alignment (REPA) is widely used to accelerate the training of latent-space diffusion transformers (DiTs). However, applying it to pixel-space models such as Just Image Transformers (JiT) is challenging. Our analysis reveals a pronounced representation conflict between discriminative alignment and pixel-space generation. Compared with its latent counterpart, JiT learns representations that are substantially less aligned with DINOv2. Applying REPA to JiT consistently reduces the reconstructability of its intermediate representations, whereas this effect is not observed in Latent JiT. We attribute this conflict to JiT directly reconstructing pixels, which requires its representations to hierarchically encode discriminative semantics and reconstruction-relevant visual information across network depths. To address these challenges, we propose Routed Representation Alignment (RouteREPA), which uses lightweight, representation-dependent routers to adaptively route task-oriented representations for alignment and generation. We further apply routing across multiple network depths to accommodate their depth-dependent representation requirements. Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K at 256x256 resolution show that RouteREPA consistently improves JiT across model scales and training budgets, outperforming standard REPA. On JiT-H/16, RouteREPA further surpasses PixelREPA using only one-third of its training epochs without classifier-free guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出 RouteREPA，用表示相关的轻量路由器在多个网络深度上分别路由面向任务的特征，从而在像素空间 JiT 上实现有效的表示对齐，缓解判别性对齐与像素重建之间的表示冲突。
AI.motivation: REPA 能加速隐空间 DiT 训练，但直接用于像素空间模型（如 JiT）困难。作者分析发现 JiT 的表示与 DINOv2 对齐程度明显低于隐空间版本，且施加 REPA 会持续降低其中间表示的可重建性；原因是 JiT 直接重建像素，需要在不同深度同时编码判别语义与重建相关视觉信息，从而与单一判别性对齐产生冲突。
AI.method: 提出 Routed Representation Alignment（RouteREPA）：使用轻量、表示依赖的路由器，自适应地为每个表示选择/分配用于对齐和生成的任务导向特征；并将路由扩展到多个网络深度，以适配不同深度的差异化表示需求。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K、256×256 上，RouteREPA 在不同模型规模和训练预算下稳定提升 JiT，优于标准 REPA；在 JiT-H/16 上，仅用 PixelREPA 三分之一的训练轮数即超过其效果，且无需 classifier-free guidance。
AI.conclusion: 判别性对齐与像素空间生成存在本质表示冲突，单一对齐方式不足；通过表示依赖的多深度路由，可同时满足语义判别与像素重建需求，为像素空间扩散 Transformer 提供有效的训练加速方案。

title: FlowBatt: Flow Matching for Probabilistic Battery Degradation Prediction
comment: 29 pages, including references, appendices, and the checklist
summary: Battery degradation remains a central challenge in the development and broad application of sustainable energy technologies. Accurate degradation prediction is challenging, as battery aging emerges from complex and heterogeneous interactions among cycling behavior, operating conditions, and cell chemistry. Existing machine-learning approaches typically focus on deterministic end-of-life predictions or modeling degradation curves within fixed chemistry settings, leaving probabilistic state of health (SOH) trajectory modeling across heterogeneous chemistries underexplored. We introduce FlowBatt, a use-inspired conditional generative framework that adapts flow matching with a diffusion transformer (DiT) backbone to battery degradation trajectory modeling. FlowBatt models full SOH trajectories as probabilistic degradation processes conditioned on early-cycle capacity data. To strengthen this conditioning pathway, we use explainable AI analysis to diagnose and improve the encoder that maps early-cycle capacity matrices into conditioning vectors. We evaluate FlowBatt on five public benchmark settings spanning diverse chemistries and aging conditions, comparing it with supervised and diffusion-based trajectory models as well as established baselines for remaining useful life (RUL) prediction under shared data splits. FlowBatt achieves the best trajectory-wise SOH prediction performance on all five datasets, with errors below 2.5%, and delivers competitive RUL prediction performance. By generating multiple plausible trajectories, FlowBatt provides empirical prediction intervals for battery degradation modeling. These results indicate that flow-matching-based trajectory modeling is a promising framework for probabilistic battery health prediction.

AI.tldr: FlowBatt：基于flow matching与DiT骨干的条件生成框架，用早期循环容量数据为条件对完整SOH轨迹进行概率建模，在五个公开基准上取得最优轨迹级SOH预测（误差<2.5%）。
AI.motivation: 电池老化由循环行为、工况与电芯化学等多因素复杂异质交互引起，精确退化预测困难；现有机器学习方法多聚焦确定性寿命终点预测或固定化学体系下的退化曲线建模，跨异质化学体系的概率性SOH轨迹建模尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 提出FlowBatt，将flow matching与diffusion transformer（DiT）骨干结合，以早期循环容量数据为条件，对完整SOH轨迹这一概率退化过程建模；并借助可解释AI分析诊断并改进将早期容量矩阵映射为条件向量的编码器，以强化条件通路。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种化学体系与老化条件的五个公开基准上，与监督式、扩散式轨迹模型及成熟RUL基线在统一数据划分下比较，FlowBatt在全部五个数据集上取得最佳轨迹级SOH预测（误差低于2.5%），RUL预测具竞争力；多轨迹采样可给出经验预测区间。
AI.conclusion: 基于flow matching的轨迹建模是电池健康概率预测的有前景框架。

title: Balancing Representations by Identifying and Generating Under-represented Data
summary: Self-supervised learning inherits the coverage of its source data. When an unlabeled corpus is long-tailed, the representation becomes dense around frequent modes and thin where coverage is weak. Objectives for long-tailed SSL reweight the images already in the corpus and add no new ones. We introduce BRIDGE (Balancing Representations by Identifying and Generating Under-represented Data), a label-free feedback loop around the source set. The current encoder scores every source image by its mean kNN distance, and a budgeted acquisition rule selects images from a band of that score distribution where support is thin and the generator still produces faithful variants. A frozen image-to-image diffusion model then adds local variants of the selected anchors, and pretraining continues on the enlarged source set. We formulate acquisition as recoverability-weighted allocation of local support and derive when a finite budget should favor a sparse band that excludes the extreme tail and when reallocation after each repair is optimal under a fixed objective. Across five long-tailed, web-scraped and synthetic source regimes, BRIDGE has the highest seven-task linear-probe and kNN average of the compared methods, and paired experiments extend the gain to ViT-S under contrastive and self-distillation objectives, to low-label fine-tuning and to semantic segmentation. The linear-probe gain is smaller under masked reconstruction. Generated repair matches an oracle that restores the withheld real images, and under a frozen encoder the inserted images shrink the neighborhoods of the selected anchors about twice as much as those of matched unselected images. BRIDGE needs no labels and leaves the pretraining objective unchanged, so it can be added to pretraining on uncurated web data, where the encoder decides which images to generate.

AI.tldr: BRIDGE 提出一个无标签反馈闭环：用当前编码器的 kNN 距离对源图像打分，在支持稀疏但生成仍可靠的分数带内按预算挑选锚点，用冻结的图生图扩散模型生成局部变体并扩充源集继续预训练，从而在不改变预训练目标的前提下缓解长尾自监督学习的表征不均。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习继承源数据的覆盖偏差；当无标签语料呈长尾分布时，表征在频繁模式附近稠密、覆盖薄弱处稀薄。现有长尾 SSL 方法只是对语料中已有的图像重新加权，无法补充新样本，因此覆盖缺陷无法被真正修复。
AI.method: 1) 用当前编码器对每张源图像计算平均 kNN 距离作为支持度分数；2) 设计带预算的采集规则，从分数分布中"支持稀疏但生成器仍能生成忠实变体"的带状区间选锚点，排除极端长尾；3) 用冻结的图像到图像扩散模型为选中锚点生成局部变体，扩充源集后继续预训练；4) 将采集形式化为"可恢复性加权的局部支持分配"，推导有限预算下何时应偏向稀疏带、以及固定目标下每次修复后重新分配是否最优。
AI.result: 在五种长尾、网络爬取和合成源数据场景下，BRIDGE 取得七任务线性探测与 kNN 平均的最高分；在对比学习和自蒸馏目标下的 ViT-S、低标签微调以及语义分割上配对实验同样带来增益。掩码重建目标下线性探测增益较小。生成修复的效果可媲美恢复被扣留真实图像的 oracle；冻结编码器下，插入图像使被选锚点邻域收缩的幅度约为匹配的未选图像的两倍。
AI.conclusion: BRIDGE 无需标签、不改变预训练目标，可直接附加到非精选网络数据的预训练流程中，由编码器自身决定生成哪些图像，是一种可插拔的长尾自监督表征均衡方案。

title: From PID to Reinforcement Learning in Building HVAC Control: A Control-Architecture Review of Tuning Strategies, Formulations, and Deployment Trade-offs
summary: This paper reviews control architectures for building heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems, addressing the tension among energy demand, occupant comfort and equipment operability, and situating proportional-integral-derivative (PID) regulation within a layered control stack that also includes rule-based and model-based supervisory control and data-driven reinforcement learning (RL). It examines the thermostat-PID layer from two-position and scheduled setpoint control through proportional, PI and PID regulation and their tuning, then formulates RL for building control as a Markov decision process. Its central contribution is a taxonomy of where RL meets PID: RL as a gain tuner for an existing loop, as a direct replacement for the regulatory controller, as a hybrid with model predictive control, and as supervisory setpoint and schedule generation. Across these classes, the review establishes that the physical loop remains invariant while the intervention point changes, and that the classes differ in their requirements for actuation authority, state information, modelling, commissioning and constraint handling. It further establishes that PID is inexpensive and well codified but limited by nonlinearity, time variation, discrete mode switching, loop interaction and slow plant dynamics, while RL's admissible position must be argued rather than assumed. The paper concludes that these architectures are not competing philosophies of control but nested points of attachment on one HVAC plant, with hybrid implementations possible, and that deployment trade-offs must be assessed according to the specific control interface and scaffolding required.

AI.tldr: 该综述梳理了建筑HVAC控制架构，将PID置于分层控制栈中，并系统给出“RL与PID相遇”的四种分类：RL作增益整定、直接替代调节器、与MPC混合、以及作为监督层生成设定点与调度。
AI.motivation: HVAC控制需在能耗、舒适性与设备可运行性之间权衡；PID廉价成熟但受非线性、时变、离散模式切换、回路耦合与慢动态限制，而RL的适用位置常被默认而非论证。因此需要厘清二者在控制栈中的关系与部署要求。
AI.method: 文献综述与概念性分类框架：先梳理恒温器-PID层（双位、日程设定点、P/PI/PID及其整定），再将建筑控制中的RL形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，最后按干预点建立RL-PID分类学，并从执行权限、状态信息、建模、调试与约束处理等维度比较各类别。
AI.result: 识别出RL-PID的四种结合方式，并指出物理回路保持不变而干预点改变；各类别在权限、信息、建模、调试与约束处理要求上存在差异；PID的局限与RL的适用性需以论证而非假设确定。
AI.conclusion: 这些架构并非相互竞争的控制哲学，而是同一HVAC设备上嵌套的接入点，混合实现可行；部署权衡应按具体控制接口与所需支撑框架来评估。

title: One Image Is Enough: Self-Generated Supervision for Personalizing Human Video Diffusion at Test Time
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 23 pages (8 main + 3 references + 12 supplementary), 11 figures, 19 tables. Code: https://github.com/SadmanPinon/one-image-is-enough
summary: Pose-driven human video diffusion animates a person from a single reference image and a target pose sequence, yet it struggles to preserve identity, rendering the face and garments unfaithfully as the pose departs from it. Personalization is the standard remedy, but its supervision is missing: one image fixes identity at a single pose, while a multi-pose subject video cannot be assumed in practice. Instead, we synthesize the missing supervision. A domain-tuned, pose-conditioned generator produces pseudo-ground-truth frames at selected key poses. An inference-time reference-only sampler steers these candidates toward the subject and keeps the most identity-consistent. A per-subject low-rank adapter then trains on static clips of them, configured from the reference alone, with no subject video, ground truth, or labels. Although lower in fidelity, these synthetic frames supervise more effectively than real ones. Real frames as captured carry motion that erodes the temporal prior, while a static clip conveys appearance alone. On TikTok and UBC Fashion, the adapted model improves the base on every metric, inverts the identity-versus-motion trade-off, and matches or surpasses adaptation on five real frames despite using none. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/SadmanPinon/one-image-is-enough.

AI.tldr: 提出"合成缺失监督"方案：仅用单张参考图，通过域微调的姿态条件生成器合成关键姿态伪真值帧，再用推理期参考引导采样器筛选身份一致帧，最后训练逐主体低秩适配器，实现无需人物视频的身份保持人类视频动画。
AI.motivation: 姿态驱动的人类视频扩散在姿态偏离参考图时难以保持身份，面部与服装失真；个性化是标准补救手段，但其监督信号缺失——单图仅固定单一姿态下的身份，而多姿态人物视频在实际中无法假设存在。
AI.method: 1) 域微调的姿态条件生成器在选定关键姿态合成伪真值帧；2) 推理时用仅参考图采样器将候选帧引向目标主体并保留身份最一致者；3) 逐主体低秩适配器仅凭参考图配置，在合成静态片段上训练，无需真实视频、真值或标签。
AI.result: 在 TikTok 与 UBC Fashion 上，适配后模型在所有指标上优于基线，逆转了身份与运动的权衡，并且尽管未使用任何真实帧，仍达到甚至超过用五张真实帧适配的效果。合成帧保真度虽低，但监督效果优于真实帧。
AI.conclusion: 低保真合成静态帧比真实帧更适合作监督：真实帧自带运动，会侵蚀时序先验，而静态片段只传达外观信息，因此适配更有效；作者已公开代码与权重。

title: PaddleMaterials: An End-to-End Deep Learning Toolkit for Materials Science
summary: Machine learning supports materials design, atomistic simulation and experimental characterization, yet models and workflows remain fragmented. We present PaddleMaterials, an open-source framework integrating heterogeneous materials-learning tasks while preserving task-specific representations and scientific semantics. It unifies data processing, training, evaluation, pretrained-model management and workflows across six task classes: property prediction, structure generation, machine-learning interatomic potentials, electronic-structure fields, spectrum elucidation and microscopy image processing. Task interfaces record physical quantities, units, aggregation conventions and references, making cross-task composition verifiable. A shared compiler backend enables switching from dynamic-graph to compiled execution through one setting, using graph optimization, operator fusion and hardware-targeted code generation without changing model definitions. Across 65 model instances in 11 groups, compiled execution accelerated every instance in eight groups, with group median speedups of 11%-224% and group maximum speedups of 11%-336%. Case studies on LiMnO2 and toluene link structure generation or spectrum elucidation, interatomic-potential relaxation, property prediction and electron-density prediction, using same-geometry density functional theory (DFT) calculations as references. For LiMnO2, predicted formation energies for generated and relaxed structures differed from same-geometry PBE+U references by at most 7 meV per atom, while the computational cost of model steps was less than one-twentieth of a DFT single-point calculation. PaddleMaterials extends unified materials workflows beyond conventional property, potential and structure-generation tasks while supporting verifiable cross-task operations and compiled execution.

AI.tldr: PaddleMaterials是一个开源材料学习框架，统一六类任务的数据处理、训练、评估、预训练模型与工作流，支持可验证的跨任务组合和编译执行加速。
AI.motivation: 现有材料机器学习模型与工作流高度碎片化，缺少统一框架；同时跨任务组合缺乏可验证性，动态图执行效率不足。
AI.method: 框架覆盖属性预测、结构生成、机器学习原子间势、电子结构场、光谱解析、显微图像处理六类任务；任务接口记录物理量、单位、聚合约定与参考值以实现跨任务可验证；共享编译器后端通过一次设置切换动态图/编译执行，采用图优化、算子融合和面向硬件的代码生成，无需改动模型定义。
AI.result: 在11组共65个模型实例中，8组全部实例获得加速，组中位加速11%–224%，组最大加速11%–336%。LiMnO2与甲苯案例以同构型DFT为参考：LiMnO2生成与弛豫结构形成能误差不超过7 meV/atom，模型步骤成本低于DFT单点计算1/20。
AI.conclusion: PaddleMaterials将统一材料工作流扩展至传统属性、势与结构生成之外，并支持可验证跨任务运算与编译执行。

title: ILLRAW: Illumination-Aware RAW Object Detection
summary: Existing RAW-based detectors typically introduce learnable ISP modules to convert RAW inputs into sRGB-like formats to fit off-the-shelf detectors. However, this RAW-to-sRGB paradigm decouples representation learning from the downstream detection task. Crucially, it forces the network to inherit human-centric visual priors while discarding intrinsic RAW advantages, such as linear sensor responses and high-bit-depth, minimally processed scene cues. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ILLRAW}, an \textbf{ILL}umination-aware end-to-end \textbf{RAW} object detection framework. Instead of reconstructing visually plausible sRGB images, ILLRAW directly learns detection-oriented RAW features through a lightweight feature adapter inserted at the input stage of existing detectors. ILLRAW estimates an illumination mask and introduces channel-sensitive embeddings to model Bayer-channel responses. These features are fused by an illumination attention fusion module. Experiments show clear improvements on the diverse AODRaw benchmark and competitive performance on LOD and PascalRAW, with particularly strong results under dark exposure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ILLRAW，一种光照感知的端到端RAW目标检测框架，绕过RAW-to-sRGB重建，直接学习面向检测的RAW特征。
AI.motivation: 现有基于RAW的检测器通常引入可学习ISP模块将RAW转换为类sRGB格式以适配现成检测器，但这使表示学习与检测任务解耦，并迫使网络继承以人为中心的视觉先验、丢弃RAW固有的线性传感器响应与高位深、少处理的场景线索等优势。
AI.method: 在现有检测器输入端插入轻量级特征适配器，直接学习检测导向的RAW特征；估计光照掩码，引入通道敏感嵌入建模Bayer各通道响应，并通过光照注意力融合模块融合上述特征。
AI.result: 在多样化AODRaw基准上有明显提升，在LOD与PascalRAW上具有竞争力，且在暗光曝光条件下表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 验证了跳过RAW-to-sRGB重建、直接进行RAW端到端检测的可行性，说明保留RAW本征信息并显式建模光照与Bayer通道响应能有效提升检测性能。

title: Dissecting Geometric Constraints in Grokking: Interaction-Dependent Acceleration in Modular Arithmetic
summary: Spherical transformer configurations can accelerate grokking through simultaneous modifications of several model properties. The present study investigated the contributions of these modifications in the published Sphere+Fourier configuration using 960 controlled modular-arithmetic runs. A complete factorial analysis varied residual projection, readout weight normalization, logit scale, and weight decay. Across four matched settings with weight decay, the successful-run mean crossing times without projection were 8-37 times those observed with projection. However, residual projection was insufficient to induce grokking without additional interventions. Various other unprojected configurations also generalized. Since projection altered the magnitude entering the readout, these comparisons could not separate geometry from output scale. A separate 100-run fixed-horizon study demonstrated faster first crossing for the complete configuration across five train/test partitions. Faster crossing did not necessarily correspond to greater persistence over extended training. Control experiments demonstrated rapid grokking without Fourier initialization. Task and depth sweeps also identified conditions in which the configuration failed to reach the criterion by 50K epochs. Accordingly, the observed acceleration depended on interactions among the components and did not extend uniformly across the tested tasks or depths.

AI.tldr: 通过960次受控模运算实验做全因子分析，考察Sphere+Fourier球面Transformer各组件对grokking加速的贡献，发现加速依赖组件间交互而非单一因素。
AI.motivation: 已有研究报告球面Transformer配置通过同时修改多个模型属性可加速grokking，但这些修改各自贡献多少、是否可分离尚不清楚，需拆解验证。
AI.method: 960次受控模运算实验，对残差投影、读出权重归一化、logit缩放与权重衰减做完整因子分析；另做100次固定视野实验（5组训练/测试划分）及对照实验（无Fourier初始化）与任务、深度扫描。
AI.result: 有权重衰减的四个匹配设置中，无投影的成功运行平均穿越时间为有投影的8–37倍；但仅靠残差投影不足以诱发grokking，其他未投影配置也能泛化。投影改变进入读出的幅值，故无法区分几何与输出尺度。完整配置首次穿越更快但未必更持久；无Fourier初始化也可快速grokking；部分任务与深度在50K轮内未达标。
AI.conclusion: grokking加速源于各组件间的交互作用，且不能均匀外推到所测任务与深度。

title: Q-CamTuning: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Fine-Grained Quality Reasoning in Livestreaming Camera Tuning
summary: With the popularization of livestreaming applications, automatic camera tuning has become indispensable for ordinary users to enjoy high Quality of Experience (QoE). However, the existing Image Quality Assessment (IQA) methods face two challenges in camera tuning. First, they struggle to identify subtle quality difference between images, which is common in camera tuning. Second, the ability to explain fine-grained differences and to provide suggestions for camera tuning are even more lacking. To address these challenges, we first construct FGLive-Comments, an instruction tuning dataset with rich annotations of both preferences for fine-grained image pairs and quality reasoning from global and local visual evidence, which supports selective adjustment recommendations of camera parameters. Based on FGLive-Comments, we develop Q-CamTuning, a multimodal large language model for livestreaming camera tuning. Its progressive perception-evidence-guidance framework learns quality-aware visual representations, enhances fine-grained reasoning with global-local evidence, and maps quality issues to camera-parameter adjustment directions. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that Q-CamTuning outperforms existing IQA models in both quality scoring and fine-grained image pair ranking. User study also validates its ability to recommend camera tuning suggestions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对直播相机调优中的图像质量评估难题，构建了细粒度偏好与质量推理标注数据集FGLive-Comments，并提出多模态大模型Q-CamTuning，通过"感知-证据-引导"渐进框架实现质量评分、细粒度图像对排序与相机参数调整推荐。
AI.motivation: 直播普及使自动相机调优成为普通用户获得高QoE的必需能力，但现有IQA方法存在两大不足：一是难以区分相机调优中常见的细微质量差异，二是缺乏对细粒度差异的解释能力及面向调优的建议生成能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建FGLive-Comments指令微调数据集，包含细粒度图像对的偏好标注以及基于全局与局部视觉证据的质量推理，并支持相机参数的选择性调整建议；2) 提出多模态大模型Q-CamTuning，采用渐进式"感知-证据-引导"框架：学习质量感知视觉表征、利用全局-局部证据增强细粒度推理、将质量问题映射到相机参数调整方向。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Q-CamTuning在质量评分和细粒度图像对排序两项任务上均优于现有IQA模型；用户研究进一步验证了其推荐相机调优建议的能力。
AI.conclusion: 将IQA与多模态大模型及可解释推理结合，可有效应对相机调优场景下的细粒度质量判别与可解释调参需求，为直播相机自动调优提供了新范式。

title: LaBraM at Scale: Scaling Data and Models for EEG Pretraining
summary: LaBraM, an early EEG foundation model, demonstrated that large-scale EEG pretraining can yield strong representations for diverse downstream tasks. Building on this foundation, we expand pretraining data and model capacity while retaining its core encoder and objective. We train ten encoders with 5.8 million to 1.97 billion parameters on three EEG collections spanning 25,067 to 79,910 hours, adapting signal preparation and training to heterogeneous recordings. Across 23 tasks, Atom-L* reaches 59.05% mean balanced accuracy at its best evaluated full fine-tuning (Full-FT) checkpoint, 3.61 percentage points above the strongest baseline EEG foundation model. Quark-G leads linear probing (LP) at 54.33%, a 1.24-point margin. Both also lead average task rank. At the last evaluated checkpoints, larger encoders improve Full-FT more consistently than LP, and stronger LP does not guarantee stronger Full-FT. Preserving patch structure improves LP over average pooling. Data-fraction experiments suggest capacity-dependent saturation, while checkpoint trajectories show that downstream performance can decline as pretraining loss falls. Joint classification with a shared Qwen3 readout reaches 50.50% with Molecule-H and Qwen3-8B; increasing language-model size provides no consistent gain. These results demonstrate the value of scaling LaBraM and the importance of matching pretraining scale to downstream adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文在 LaBraM 基础上扩展预训练数据与模型容量（5.8M–1.97B 参数、25k–80k 小时 EEG 数据），并在 23 个任务上系统研究规模律与适配方式（全微调 Full-FT、线性探测 LP、与 Qwen3 联合分类）。
AI.motivation: LaBraM 已证明大规模 EEG 预训练能产生强表征，但尚不清楚继续扩大数据与模型规模能带来多少收益，以及不同下游适配方式（Full-FT vs LP）与预训练规模如何匹配。作者希望回答"规模扩展是否仍然有效、如何扩展"这一问题。
AI.method: 保留 LaBraM 的核心编码器与训练目标，训练 10 个 5.8M–1.97B 参数的编码器，覆盖 3 个 EEG 数据集共 25,067–79,910 小时，并针对异构记录调整信号预处理与训练流程。在 23 个任务上评估 Full-FT 与 LP，并额外做数据比例实验、检查点轨迹分析、patch 结构 vs 平均池化对比，以及共享 Qwen3 读出层的联合分类实验（Molecule-H + Qwen3-8B）。
AI.result: 最佳 Full-FT 检查点下 Atom-L* 达 59.05% 平均平衡准确率，比最强基线 EEG 基础模型高 3.61 个百分点；Quark-G 在 LP 上以 54.33% 领先 1.24 个百分点，二者平均任务排名也最优。发现：大模型在全微调上收益更稳定而 LP 不一定；LP 强不代表 Full-FT 强；保留 patch 结构优于平均池化；数据比例实验显示容量相关的饱和现象；预训练损失下降时下游性能可能反而下降；联合分类达 50.50%，增大语言模型规模无一致收益。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了扩展 LaBraM 的价值，但更关键的是预训练规模必须与下游适配方式相匹配：更大容量主要利好全微调，LP 与 Full-FT 的排序并不一致，且预训练损失并非可靠的下游性能代理指标。

title: Efficient Hybrid Distillation: Synergizing Score and Adversarial Objectives for One-Step Diffusion
comment: This paper is accepted by NeurIPS 2026
summary: Numerous distillation methods have been developed to accelerate diffusion models. Recent research indicates that hybrid strategies---blending different paradigms---yield superior results compared to single-method approaches. However, current works predominantly rely on a simple combination of objectives, leaving the question of how to effectively synergize them largely underexplored. In this paper, we specifically investigate the synergy between Score Distillation and Adversarial Distillation. We reveal that their operating zones are distinct and complementary: Score Distillation is effective in high-noise regimes for capturing the global distribution yet lacks fine-grained supervision in low-noise regions. Conversely, Adversarial Distillation is effective in low-noise regions but is prone to instability and suffers from discriminator failure when applied to high-noise intervals. Leveraging this insight, we propose Efficient Adversarial Score Distillation (EASD), a framework that synergizes these objectives via a regime-adaptive sampling strategy, directing each objective to focus on its effective interval. We further apply this paradigm to DiT-based Flow Matching models. Empirically, our method achieves a promising one-step FID of 1.39 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 using the SiT-XL/2+REPA model. This work provides a concrete guideline for maximizing the potential of hybrid distillation. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/pf0607/EASD .

AI.tldr: 提出EASD框架，通过区域自适应采样策略协同分数蒸馏与对抗蒸馏，并成功应用于DiT流匹配模型。
AI.motivation: 现有混合蒸馏方法多简单叠加目标函数，未深入探究如何有效协同，如何最大化混合蒸馏潜力尚不明晰。
AI.method: 揭示分数蒸馏与对抗蒸馏作用区间互补：分数蒸馏擅长高噪声区捕获全局分布，对抗蒸馏擅长低噪声区但有稳定性与判别器失效问题。据此提出EASD，用区域自适应采样将各目标导向其有效区间，并推广至DiT流匹配模型。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，SiT-XL/2+REPA模型单步FID达1.39。
AI.conclusion: 为最大化混合蒸馏潜力提供了具体指导准则，代码与模型已开源。

title: VizDAGuide: Misleading Chart Question Answering in Compact Vision Language Models via DAG-Structured Supervision
summary: Misleading charts can lead vision-language models to conclusions that conflict with underlying data. Existing work focuses on inference-time strategies, while training-time supervision remains less explored. We present VizDAGuide, a DAG-structured supervision method for misleading-chart question answering. The method represents intermediate reasoning states and their dependencies as a directed acyclic graph, assigns supervision weights according to their roles, and serializes the graph into a unified training target for open-ended and multiple-choice QA with single-pass inference. Experiments on two benchmarks across Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5 models show improvements over a content- and weight-matched Linear CoT-SFT baseline on both answer formats. Process-level evaluation shows gains in grounding and operation execution, while ablations indicate that dependency structure and weighted supervision are most effective when combined. These results support DAG-structured weighted supervision for misleading-chart question answering.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VizDAGuide，一种基于 DAG 结构的训练期监督方法，用于误导性图表问答，在 Qwen3-VL 与 InternVL3.5 上优于内容与权重匹配的线性 CoT-SFT 基线。
AI.motivation: 误导性图表会使视觉语言模型得出与底层数据相悖的结论；现有工作多聚焦推理时策略，训练期监督研究不足。
AI.method: 将中间推理状态及其依赖表示为有向无环图，按各节点角色分配监督权重，并将图序列化为统一训练目标，支持开放题与多选题且单次前向推理。
AI.result: 在两个基准、多个模型上，开放型与选择题两种答案格式均优于内容与权重匹配的线性 CoT-SFT 基线；过程级评估显示在grounding与操作执行上有提升；消融表明依赖结构与加权监督结合时最有效。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将 DAG 结构化加权监督用于误导性图表问答。

title: CISA: Retrofitting Dense Attention Models with Chunk-Indexed Sparse Attention
summary: Long-context LLM inference is costly because attention repeatedly reads a growing key-value (KV) history. We introduce Chunk-Indexed Sparse Attention (CISA), which retrofits pretrained dense attention models without gradient updates. CISA selects fixed-size KV chunks using compact summaries of existing keys, avoiding token-level indexing and a separate full-length index cache. It uses one indexing query per KV group and shares selected chunks across queries in that group. During prefill, QShare reuses selections across adjacent queries to reduce indexing cost and improve KV reuse and GPU utilization. We evaluate CISA on NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano and Ultra, and Inkling-Small. In one-layer BF16 benchmarks at batch size 32 using Ultra's per-device attention dimensions, core attention is 11.7x faster for prefill queries near the end of a 1M-token prompt and 13.0x faster during decode. Including chunk scoring, selection, and all other measured GPU work, speedups are 8.6x and 3.0x. On Ultra NVFP4 with a 4,096-chunk budget, aggregate scores stay within 1.5 percentage points of dense attention on MRCR, LongBench v2, and GraphWalks. RULER sweeps on Nano and Ultra BF16 up to one million tokens show scores within 2.05 percentage points of dense attention with 8-16x fewer KV reads. Serving million-token prompts with 32 concurrent requests and 4K output tokens per request, CISA achieves 2.29x the end-to-end throughput of dense attention using Nemotron 3 Ultra NVFP4 on four NVIDIA B300 GPUs. Selecting fewer chunks increases throughput to 2.61x; in separate GraphWalks evaluations, the smaller budget widens the aggregate score gap from 1.49 to 3.59 percentage points. These results expose a practical quality-speed tradeoff without sparse training.

AI.tldr: CISA 通过对已有 key 的紧凑摘要实现 chunk 级稀疏注意力，无需梯度更新即可改造预训练稠密模型，在百万 token 长上下文下把 core attention 提速 11.7x/13.0x，端到端吞吐达 2.29x 且精度损失约 1.5 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 长上下文 LLM 推理昂贵，因为 attention 需反复读取不断增长的 KV 历史。现有稀疏注意力多依赖 token 级索引或需训练，作者希望不训练即可改造稠密模型。
AI.method: 提出 Chunk-Indexed Sparse Attention（CISA）：以固定大小 KV chunk 为单位，用现有 key 的紧凑摘要进行选择，避免 token 级索引与额外全长度索引缓存；每个 KV group 仅用一个索引 query，并在组内共享所选 chunk；prefill 阶段用 QShare 在相邻 query 间复用选择以降低索引开销、提升 KV 复用与 GPU 利用率。无需梯度更新。
AI.result: 在 Nemotron 3 Nano/Ultra 与 Inkling-Small 上评估：1M token prompt 末端的单层 BF16（batch 32）core attention prefill 提速 11.7x、decode 13.0x；含 chunk 打分与选择等全部 GPU 开销后为 8.6x/3.0x。Ultra NVFP4、4096-chunk 预算下 MRCR/LongBench v2/GraphWalks 综合分与稠密差距 ≤1.5pp；Nano/Ultra BF16 的 RULER 至 1M token 差距 ≤2.05pp，KV 读取减少 8-16x。四块 B300、32 并发、4K 输出下端到端吞吐为稠密的 2.29x；更少 chunk 可达 2.61x，但 GraphWalks 差距由 1.49 扩大到 3.59pp。
AI.conclusion: CISA 提供了一种免训练的长上下文加速方案，揭示出明确的质量-速度权衡：更激进的稀疏预算换吞吐需付出精度代价。

title: VLM-as-a-Judge for Person Re-Identification
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment (VLM4RWD)
summary: Cloth-changing person re-identification (CC-ReID) is still very challenging, and no method clearly dominates: methods that lead on one benchmark collapse on the others, because they rest on different identity cues. We show that a general-purpose vision-language model (VLM), used zero-shot as a judge for reranking a short candidate list, beats the expert retrieval models it reranks by a wide and consistent margin. On the four scenarios of CHIRLA, a long-term CC-ReID benchmark that no publicly released Re-ID model is trained on, reranking the candidates of two frozen experts raises rank-1 on every scenario, by 12.9 points on average over the best expert and 9.4 over the best naive ensemble of the two, with no component fine-tuned on the target data. Merging both experts' shortlists matches or beats reranking the stronger expert's shortlist alone, at lower cost. Introducing a VLM does, however, come at a cost: almost all of the pipeline's FLOPs are spent on it. We therefore borrow a criterion from ensembling and invoke the VLM judge only where the two experts disagree at rank 1. This threshold-free gate removes 40% of the calls, and a comparable share of total compute, with no significant drop in rank-1, trading 1.8 to 3.8 points of mAP. Judging remains the dominant cost, but on a benchmark where dedicated experts stall, we find a frozen general-purpose model to be the strongest judge of identity. The code is available at https://github.com/bdager/JudgeReID.

AI.tldr: 在换装行人重识别（CC-ReID）上，用通用视觉语言模型（VLM）零样本作为"裁判"对专家模型的短候选列表重排，可显著且稳定地超过被重排的专家；并提出仅在两专家rank-1分歧时调用VLM的无阈值门控，减少40%调用与算力，rank-1几乎不降。
AI.motivation: CC-ReID仍很困难，现有方法各自依赖不同的身份线索，在某个基准领先的方法换到其他基准就失效，没有明确占优者；作者希望找到一种不依赖单一身份线索、且无需在目标数据上微调的通用判别手段。
AI.method: 将通用VLM零样本用作身份裁判，对两个冻结专家模型各自/合并的短候选列表进行重排（模型组件均未在目标数据上微调）；并引入集成学习中的判据，仅在两专家rank-1结果不一致时调用VLM（无阈值门控）。
AI.result: 在CHIRLA长期CC-ReID基准的四个场景上（无公开Re-ID模型在其上训练），重排两冻结专家候选使每个场景rank-1都提升，平均比最佳专家高12.9点、比最佳朴素集成高9.4点；合并两专家短列表可持平或优于仅重排强者短列表且成本更低；门控移除40%的VLM调用与约同等总计算，rank-1无显著下降，代价是mAP下降1.8–3.8点。
AI.conclusion: 在专用专家模型停滞不前的基准上，冻结的通用VLM是最强的身份判别者；但其计算开销占主导（几乎全部FLOPs），故按分歧触发的门控是有效的成本-性能折中。

title: On the Convergence of Vanilla Adam under Heavy-Tailed Noise and Index Sampling
summary: Understanding how stochastic gradient noise affects the convergence of Adam is an important problem in stochastic optimization, particularly when the noise exhibits heavy-tailed behavior. In this paper, we investigate the convergence of vanilla Adam in both the expected risk and the empirical risk minimization, focusing on the effects of heavy-tailed noise and its relationship to index sampling. For the expected risk minimization, we establish convergence guarantees under Hölder smoothness and bounded $\mathfrak{p}$-th moment assumptions, allowing stochastic gradient noise with infinite variance. Our analysis provides explicit upper bounds on the expected squared gradient norm and shows that the iteration-dependent convergence term decays more slowly as $\mathfrak{p}$ decreases. For the empirical risk minimization, we establish asymptotic and non-asymptotic convergence guarantees and demonstrate that heavy-tailed population noise can deteriorate convergence bounds through dataset-dependent constants as the dataset size increases. Furthermore, under Lipschitz smoothness, we formulate multistage Adam with practical learning rate schedules and demonstrate that increasing batch sizes can reduce index-sampling noise and improve convergence guarantees and SFO complexity. Numerical experiments support our theoretical findings on the effects of heavy-tailed noise and the computational benefits of increasing batch sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在重尾随机梯度噪声下 vanilla Adam 的收敛性，分别针对期望风险与经验风险最小化建立收敛保证，并分析索引采样噪声与增大 batch size 的作用。
AI.motivation: 随机梯度噪声（尤其重尾、无穷方差情形）如何影响 Adam 收敛尚不清楚；同时经验风险中索引采样噪声随数据集规模增大的影响也需要刻画。
AI.method: 在 Hölder 光滑与有界 p 阶矩（允许无穷方差）假设下分析期望风险收敛；对经验风险给出渐近与非渐近保证；在 Lipschitz 光滑下设计多阶段 Adam 与实用学习率调度，并结合增大 batch size 降低索引采样噪声。
AI.result: 给出期望平方梯度范数的显式上界，迭代相关收敛项随 p 减小而衰减更慢；证明重尾总体噪声会通过依赖数据集的常数随数据规模增大而恶化收敛界；增大 batch size 可改善收敛保证与 SFO 复杂度，数值实验予以验证。
AI.conclusion: 重尾噪声显著影响 Adam 收敛速度，索引采样噪声是经验风险分析的关键因素，增大 batch size 的多阶段 Adam 在实践中可提升收敛性与计算效率。

title: GPU-Native Real-Time Textured Mesh Reconstruction with Seam-Aware Multi-View Radiometric Correction
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 20 pages including appendix
summary: We present a GPU-native volumetric-video system for real-time reconstruction of graphics-compatible textured triangle meshes from multiple RGB-D sensors. Existing TSDF systems accelerate fusion and mesh extraction, but extending them to per-frame textured meshing adds CPU mesh processing, CPU-side texturing work, or extra CPU-GPU transfers between stages. After input staging, our method keeps the reconstruction and texturing stages (TSDF fusion, Marching Cubes, connected-component noise removal, view-based texture mapping, inpainting, and radiometric seam correction) resident on the GPU; no intermediate mesh or image data returns to the host between these stages. A fixed-size-array representation of mesh topology gives constant-time neighbor access on the GPU and makes the downstream mesh-level operations data-parallel. Because we texture each face from a single camera, exposure seams that vary smoothly across each image remain; we estimate a per-camera low-frequency gain field and bake it into the atlas on the GPU. On the CMU Panoptic dataset, our method is faster than the baselines at every tested voxel resolution and number of sensors, achieves peak speedups of more than an order of magnitude over CUDA-accelerated nvblox and CPU-based Open3D, and approaches an offline textured-meshing baseline in perceptual re-rendering quality.

AI.tldr: 提出GPU原生体视频系统，在GPU上完成从多RGB-D传感器到带纹理三角网格的实时重建与纹理化，全程避免中间数据回到CPU。
AI.motivation: 现有TSDF系统虽加速了融合与网格提取，但扩展到逐帧带纹理网格时需额外的CPU网格处理、CPU端纹理工作或阶段间CPU-GPU数据传输，成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 将TSDF融合、Marching Cubes、连通分量去噪、基于视角的纹理映射、修补和辐射接缝校正等阶段全部常驻GPU，中间网格/图像数据不回传主机；用固定大小数组表示网格拓扑，实现GPU上常数时间邻居访问并数据并行化网格级操作；针对单相机逐面纹理产生的曝光缝隙，估计每相机低频增益场并烘焙进纹理图集。
AI.result: 在CMU Panoptic数据集上，各体素分辨率与传感器数量下均快于基线，相对CUDA加速的nvblox和CPU版Open3D峰值加速超过一个数量级，重渲染感知质量接近离线纹理网格基线。
AI.conclusion: 全GPU流水线可高效实现实时带纹理体视频重建，兼顾速度与渲染质量。

title: CERBO: Certified Recourse at a Requested Rate for Gradient-Boosted Trees
summary: Recourse-aware learning trains models so that people who receive an adverse decision can reverse it with an affordable change. For gradient-boosted decision trees (GBDTs), the existing method, RABIT, exposes a single recourse weight whose effect on the recourse rate is abrupt and data-dependent, and its training bound cannot certify recourse for any rejected individual. We present Certified Recourse Boosting (CERBO), which takes a requested recourse rate and returns a GBDT with certified actions: it tracks exact additive effort along tree paths, trains against committed boxes (a family of bounds that contains RABIT's and certifies a within-budget action for each training sample) and adjusts the weight after every tree until the certified rate meets the request. A calibration step guarantees the rate on new individuals, and the certifier runs on any tree ensemble, including XGBoost and LightGBM, in milliseconds per person without a solver. In RABIT's own experimental protocol, at equal accuracy, CERBO raises the recourse ratio from 0.90 to 0.99 on FICO and from 0.64 to 0.77 on Bail. Under additive costs on six data sets, it raises the area under the accuracy-recourse frontier in all 12 settings, and in simulated deployments it guarantees recourse to 70% of rejected individuals in 11 of 12 settings, against 2 for RABIT.

AI.tldr: CERBO 提出一种"认证式追索提升"方法，按请求的追索率训练 GBDT，并可用毫秒级认证器任意检验树集成模型对个体是否给出预算内可执行动作。
AI.motivation: 现有 GBDT 追索方法 RABIT 只有单一追索权重，其对追索率的影响突变且依赖数据，训练界也无法为任何被拒个体认证追索可行性。
AI.method: 沿树路径精确追踪可加努力量；针对"承诺盒"（包含 RABIT 界的一族界，可对每个训练样本认证预算内动作）训练；每棵树后调整权重直至认证追索率达标；加入校准步骤保证新个体的追索率；认证器无需求解器，可对任意树集成（含 XGBoost、LightGBM）毫秒级运行。
AI.result: 在 RABIT 原实验协议下等精度时，追索率 FICO 由 0.90 升至 0.99，Bail 由 0.64 升至 0.77；六个数据集加性成本下，12 个设置中全部提升精度-追索前沿下面积；模拟部署中 12 个设置里 11 个保证 70% 被拒个体获得追索，RABIT 仅 2 个。
AI.conclusion: CERBO 将追索从数据依赖的软权重转为可认证、可控的追索率保证，且认证高效通用。

title: Bayesian Sequential Optimal Experimental Design for Single-Pixel Imaging using Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Adaptive compressed sensing (CS) aims to select the most informative measurements sequentially, which is crucial for many modern imaging systems. This task can be formulated as a Bayesian sequential optimal experimental design (sOED) problem, where each new acquisition is chosen to maximally reduce uncertainty about the unknown image given prior information and subsequent data provided by acquisitions. However, in single-pixel imaging (SPI), the large design space consists of all possible binary illumination patterns. Directly optimizing the Bayesian sOED objective over this space using conventional methods is generally challenging.
  In this work, we reformulate sOED for SPI as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem. In RL, an agent learns a policy through repeated experimental trials to maximize a reward, here given as the expected information gain, the most complete measure of uncertainty reduction in Bayesian OED. This avoids the need to directly optimize complex information-theoretic objectives during a measurement to obtain the next design. Instead, the result is a learned policy function that directly maps the current posterior belief about the image to the next optimal binary measurement pattern, in a computationally efficient way.
  Using a simple yet representative SPI imaging scenario, this work evaluates the scalability of the learned policy under two different policy parameterizations. Furthermore, we investigate how performance deteriorates when only approximate posterior information is available or the measurements are impaired by noise, and propose several strategies to introduce additional design constraints motivated by biomedical applications. The numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed Bayesian sOED-RL framework remains robust and can be extended to more complex, large-scale SPI scenarios.

AI.tldr: 将单像素成像的自适应压缩感知设计问题重构为强化学习问题，学习从当前后验信念直接映射到下一最优二值照明图案的策略，实现高效自适应测量。
AI.motivation: 自适应压缩感知需序贯选择最有信息量的测量，可建模为贝叶斯序贯最优实验设计(sOED)。但单像素成像中设计空间为所有二值照明图案，规模巨大，用传统方法直接优化贝叶斯sOED目标十分困难。
AI.method: 将SPI的sOED重构为强化学习问题：智能体通过反复试验学习策略，以期望信息增益为奖励；避免在每次测量时直接优化复杂的信息论目标，转而得到直接由当前后验信念输出下一最优二值测量图案的策略函数。在两二种策略参数化下评估可扩展性，并研究仅有近似后验或测量受噪声影响时的性能退化，提出若干引入设计约束的策略。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，所提贝叶斯sOED-RL框架保持稳健，并能扩展到更复杂、大规模的单像素成像场景。
AI.conclusion: 用RL求解SPI中的贝叶斯序贯实验设计是可行且高效的，学习策略可高效映射后验到测量设计，并在近似后验、噪声及附加设计约束下保持鲁棒性。

title: What Structurally Breaks an Agent? Auditing Difficulty in Stateful Tool-Use Workflows
summary: An aggregate task score does not distinguish failures of scheduling, state retention, and candidate selection. We develop a small executable instrument that varies dependency depth, candidate count, active state width, and access to current-state snapshots while holding the number of required operations fixed. Two dependency-graph families show that increasing depth at fixed work changes both scheduling freedom and the number of reachable completion states, so these controls are coupled, and we quantify the coupling. The primary study contains 49,152 generated tasks and 393,216 reference-controller rollouts. A separately frozen follow-on design adds 295,936 rollouts covering retention strategy, snapshot cadence, hidden state resampling, recovery, query locality, candidate indexing, and relabeling. Residue caches and precomputed plans solve tasks that defeat limited raw-value caches, and indexed selection removes the serial-scan branching deficit. Hidden resampling imposes an exact success ceiling that additional state tracking cannot overcome. The contribution is an executable diagnostic instrument, analytic calibration, and an audit of its assumptions. A small local CPU study with a 0.5B model completed no workflows, and a 16-episode Copilot-routed fractional factorial is descriptive only. Neither supports general capability claims.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个小型可执行诊断工具，通过解耦并控制依赖深度、候选数量、活跃状态宽度与快照访问等维度，分别诊断调度、状态保持与候选选择三类失败，而非依赖单一聚合分数。
AI.motivation: 聚合任务分数无法区分调度失败、状态保持失败与候选选择失败，导致评估结论笼统且不可归因，需要可执行、可控的实验仪器来分离这些能力维度。
AI.method: 构建小型可执行仪器，在固定所需操作数下变化依赖深度、候选数、活跃状态宽度和当前状态快照访问；用两类依赖图族量化深度与可达完成状态数的耦合；主研究含49,152个生成任务与393,216次参考控制器rollout，另设冻结的后续设计增加295,936次rollout，覆盖保持策略、快照频率、隐藏状态重采样、恢复、查询局部性、候选索引与重标注。
AI.result: 残差缓存与预计算计划能解决有限原始值缓存失败的任务；索引化选择消除串行扫描导致的候选选择缺陷；隐藏状态重采样构成精确成功上限，额外状态追踪无法突破。
AI.conclusion: 贡献为可执行诊断仪器、解析标定及对假设的审计；0.5B模型的本地CPU小研究与16回合Copilot路由分数因子实验仅具描述性，均不支持通用能力主张。

title: VideoEditor-MoE: Scaling Complex Video Editing with Mixture of Experts
summary: Complex video editing requires understanding complex instructions while jointly fulfilling multiple editing requests. Meeting these demands through dense model scaling substantially increases computational cost. We introduce VideoEditor-MoE, the first open-source mixture-of-experts framework for video editing. Beyond sparse MLP-MoE layers, MoE-Attention expands attention capacity through routed key--value experts while preserving global interactions among video tokens. Initialized from a 5B video editing model, VideoEditor-MoE scales to 14B and 56B parameters, with approximately 8B parameters activated per token in both variants. Comparisons with existing methods and two complementary baselines, Explicit-MoE and MLP-MoE, assess its benefits over explicit expert guidance and MLP-only expert architectures. Further analyses demonstrate that all experts remain active and reveal that learned routing responds more strongly to sample content and diffusion noise levels than to human-defined editing categories. Spatial analysis further indicates sensitivity to object-level semantic features. We also identify decoupled weight decay as a strategy for stabilizing expert scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出首个开源视频编辑混合专家(MoE)框架VideoEditor-MoE，含MoE-Attention，从5B模型扩展到14B/56B而每token仅激活约8B参数。
AI.motivation: 复杂视频编辑需理解复杂指令并同时完成多项编辑请求，但通过稠密模型缩放会大幅增加计算成本。
AI.method: 除稀疏MLP-MoE层外，提出MoE-Attention，通过路由的key-value专家扩展注意力容量，同时保留视频token的全局交互；模型从5B视频编辑模型初始化，扩展到14B和56B，每token激活约8B参数；设Explicit-MoE和MLP-MoE两个基线对比。
AI.result: 与现有方法及两个基线对比验证了优势；所有专家均保持活跃；学习到的路由对样本内容与扩散噪声水平的响应强于人工定义的编辑类别；空间分析显示对物体级语义特征敏感；发现解耦权重衰减可稳定专家扩展。
AI.conclusion: MoE路线能在可控激活参数下有效扩展视频编辑模型能力，注意力级专家与解耦权重衰减是可行的关键设计。

title: Forecasting How RLHF Responds to Reward-Model Edits Before Training
summary: Responses with headers, lists and greater length receive high scores from reward models (RMs), and RLHF policies learn to produce these features even when true quality does not improve. Practitioners therefore edit their RMs, but they learn whether an edit works only after an RL run. We show that the response of a policy to an RM edit can be forecast before training, from samples of the current policy and the scores of the old and new RM. If we read the RM as a set of prices, the first-order theory of KL-regularized RL implies that each feature moves in proportion to its within-prompt covariance with the change in reward. We implant controlled price changes into retrained RMs under a 2^(4-1) fractional factorial design with a self-distilled placebo, run 54 RL runs from six parent policies, and fix every forecast before the runs. With the covariance predictor, we predict the direction of all 20 changes in supply whose forecast has the same sign at every parent and explain 82% of the standardized change. With counterfactual prices, the classical alternative, we explain 50%. The forecast also holds under GRPO and for real RM upgrades, where we explain 66% out of sample with a coefficient frozen from the factorial runs. For rent, the gap between the proxy reward and a gold reward from stronger judges, we rank RM edits correctly with the same covariance over the first 30 steps (Spearman 0.94). This measures the horizon of the forecast: by step 200, the ranking of the factorial edits reverses under both RLOO and GRPO, while the real upgrades keep their order. When we vary the KL coefficient beta, the initial response does not depend on beta, and the response saturates below the KL equilibrium. In one experiment, the long-run response to a price rise is consistent with an additional implicit regularizer beta_0 of about 0.003 to 0.007.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种在RL训练前预测策略对奖励模型(RM)编辑反应的方法：将RM视为价格体系，基于KL正则化RL的一阶理论，用特征与奖励变化的组内协方差预测各特征的变化方向与幅度。
AI.motivation: 实践中RM会对响应长度、列表、标题等表面特征给出高奖励，导致RLHF策略习得这些特征而非真正质量提升。从业者只能通过跑完整RL后才知道RM编辑是否有效，成本高。
AI.method: 将RM解读为价格集合，由KL正则化RL一阶理论导出每个特征变化正比于其与奖励变化在prompt内的协方差。用2^(4-1)分数析因设计植入受控价格变化并设自蒸馏安慰剂，从六个父策略跑54次RL，所有预测在实验前冻结；与反事实价格基线对比，并在GRPO及真实RM升级上验证。
AI.result: 对全部20个供给变化方向预测正确，解释82%标准化变化；反事实价格基线仅50%；真实RM升级样本外解释66%（系数由析因实验冻结）；用同一协方差在前30步对RM编辑排序Spearman 0.94。第200步时析因编辑排序在RLOO和GRPO下反转，真实升级保持顺序。响应初期不依赖β，且在KL均衡前饱和；某实验中长期响应对应约0.003–0.007的隐式正则化β₀。
AI.conclusion: RM编辑对策略的反应可在训练前从当前策略样本与新旧RM得分预测，协方差预测器显著优于传统替代方案；预测有明确时间尺度，且暗示策略存在额外隐式正则化。

title: MuCHMDPoser: Multiview RGB-Camera Full-Body Pose Tracking for Virtual Reality
summary: Accurate full-body tracking in Virtual Reality (VR) is heavily underconstrained when relying solely on consumer-grade sparse sensors, such as Head-Mounted Displays (HMDs) and handheld controllers. Indeed, the self-avatar full-body pose must be inferred based on the 3 available upper-body joints tracked by these devices. This leads to significant tracking error, especially in lower-body pose. To overcome this issue, we propose to extend the tracking setup with external multiview RGB cameras. We show that integrating RGB-based pose estimation this framework is able to significantly decrease lower-body tracking errors, even under common artifacts in RGB-based estimates. Additionally, we evaluate a only-once HMD-camera calibration procedure that does not require any physical markers. We finally propose an implementation of the overall framework, achieving an end-to-end animation at 60 FPS on a Nvidia RTX3080 GPU. Codes are available at https://github.com/antmaio/MuCHMDPoser.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用外部多视角RGB相机增强VR全身追踪，结合RGB姿态估计显著降低下半身追踪误差，并给出60FPS的端到端实现。
AI.motivation: 消费级VR仅靠HMD和手柄只能追踪3个上半身关节，全身（尤其下半身）姿态严重欠约束，追踪误差大。
AI.method: 将追踪设备扩展为外部多视角RGB相机，把RGB姿态估计整合进全身姿态推断框架；并评估一种无需物理标记的一次性HMD-相机标定流程。
AI.result: 即使RGB估计存在常见伪影，整合RGB姿态估计仍能显著降低下半身追踪误差；在Nvidia RTX3080上实现60FPS端到端动画。
AI.conclusion: 多视角RGB相机可有效缓解稀疏传感器下的全身追踪欠约束问题，且无标记标定与实时性能使其具备实用价值，代码已开源。

title: A Common Language for Dynamic Graphs: Interaction Tokenization Enables Foundation Models
summary: Dynamic graphs capture evolving interactions in Web systems, including online communication, user engagement, and recommendation. Graph foundation models aim to reuse predictive capabilities across networks, but extending this capability to dynamic graphs faces two challenges. First, node identities are graph-specific, and similar interaction patterns can appear at different temporal and activity scales, making histories difficult to represent consistently across networks. Second, the predictive roles of historical patterns vary across interaction dynamics, limiting transfer from a narrow range of training processes. In this paper, we show that a common interaction language, combined with learning across diverse interaction processes, offers a basis for dynamic graph foundation modeling. We propose CL-DGFM, a Common Language Dynamic Graph Foundation Model for temporal link prediction. Its Dynamic Interaction Tokenizer encodes interaction memory, historical connectivity, and ordered destination transitions into calibrated tabular inputs, making dynamic histories accessible to existing predictors without an additional trainable graph encoder. Its Dynamic Interaction Prior trains a pretrained tabular foundation predictor across diverse synthetic dynamics. Labeled historical context guides prediction, with a Contextual Value Adapter modulating attention values. The model transfers to real graphs without target-graph parameter updates. Experiments on TGB and TGB-Seq demonstrate competitive performance. Further comparisons show that the common language supports basic machine learning and neural models, and enables direct use of frozen tabular foundation models on dynamic graphs.

AI.tldr: 提出 CL-DGFM，用统一的"交互语言"（表格化 token 表示）+ 跨多样动态过程的预训练，实现无需目标图参数更新的动态图基础模型，用于时序链路预测，在 TGB/TGB-Seq 上具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 将图基础模型的能力扩展到动态图面临两大挑战：(1) 节点身份是图特定的，相似交互模式可能出现在不同时间与活跃尺度上，历史难以跨网络一致表示；(2) 历史模式的预测作用随交互动态变化，仅从有限训练过程难以迁移。
AI.method: 提出 CL-DGFM：(a) 动态交互分词器（Dynamic Interaction Tokenizer）将交互记忆、历史连通性和有序目标转移编码为校准的表格输入，无需额外可训练图编码器；(b) 动态交互先验（Dynamic Interaction Prior）在多样合成动态上预训练表格基础预测器；(c) 用带标签历史上下文引导预测，并用上下文值适配器（Contextual Value Adapter）调制注意力值。
AI.result: 在 TGB 与 TGB-Seq 基准上取得有竞争力的性能；在无目标图参数更新的情况下即可迁移到真实图。进一步实验表明该统一"交互语言"也支持基础机器学习与传统神经模型，并可直接把冻结的表格基础模型用于动态图。
AI.conclusion: 统一的交互语言加上跨多样交互过程的学习，可作为动态图基础建模的基础，实现强迁移性与通用性。

title: VL-Dedup: Graded Multimodal Entity Resolution for Image-Text Data Deduplication
summary: Image-text corpora contain copies of one image, captions that describe one image in different ways, captions reused for different images, and captions that do not match their images. Each case calls for a different curation action. Deduplication and multimodal entity resolution (ER) only decide whether records are the same, and they are evaluated on labeled pairs. Yet pair scores do not tell which records end up in the same cluster or which useful captions get deleted. We therefore formulate image-text deduplication as graded multimodal ER, which decides visual identity, caption handling, and mismatches for each pair, and we evaluate it at three levels: pairs, clusters, and the retained set. Our method, VL-Dedup, groups records of the same visual entity into clusters and caps the size of each cluster. Within each cluster, a vision-language model (VLM) and CLIPScore decide which captions to keep and which to flag. We also build VL-DedupBench, with 50,000 COCO and SOP records and 66,788 labeled pairs. On it, a classifier that selects no false edge among the labeled pairs still joins millions of record pairs from different entities. Spending VLM calls on the pairs inside clusters, rather than on pairs with uncertain scores, gives better caption decisions from the same model. Even when almost all clusters are correct, keeping one record per cluster loses facts in many deletions, while the deletions of VL-Dedup lose much less information.

AI.tldr: 将图文去重重新表述为分级多模态实体解析（graded multimodal ER），提出VL-Dedup及其评测基准VL-DedupBench，在配对、簇、保留集三级评估。
AI.motivation: 图文语料中存在同一图像的多份拷贝、同一图像的不同描述、被复用到不同图像的描述、图文不匹配等情况，每种需不同处理；而传统去重/多模态ER只判断记录是否相同且仅在标注配对上评估，无法反映簇结果与有用描述被误删的问题。
AI.method: VL-Dedup先把同一视觉实体的记录聚成簇并限制簇大小；簇内用VLM与CLIPScore决定保留/标记哪些描述。构建VL-DedupBench（5万条COCO与SOP记录、66,788标注配对），在配对、簇、保留集三级上评估。
AI.result: 在基准上，即便某分类器在标注配对上零误边，仍会把数百万来自不同实体的记录对连到一起；将VLM调用用于簇内配对（而非分数不确定的配对）能用同一模型得到更好的描述决策；即使簇几乎全对，每簇保留一条记录也会在大量删除中丢失事实，而VL-Dedup的删除损失信息少得多。
AI.conclusion: 配对级指标不足以衡量图文去重质量，需从簇与保留集层面评估；分级多模态ER与簇内VLM决策能更少丢失有用信息。

title: Rethinking Fairness Metrics for Multi-Class and Multi-Group Assessment: Not Everything is Binary
comment: Submitted to ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology (TIST)
summary: Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning in general, is becoming pervasive across all domains and disciplines. By means of this data-driven approach, algorithms can learns complex task just by learning from samples. However, if the data-set is biased, they might lead to the development of unfair computer systems, that is, characterised by a prejudice towards specific individuals or groups, which might get an unmotivated output from the system. This circumstance lead to the development of multiple metrics designed to quantify the level of unfairness of an algorithm. However, a generalised assumption in the literature is that the sensitive features and the output labels are binary. When the data is not binary, it is forcefully binarized using a one-versus-the-rest simplification. In this work, we discuss the limitations of existing metrics and propose novel, mathematically sound, and generalized multi-group and multi-class formulations of the metrics. Ultimately, our results highlight the empirical assessment distortion caused by binarization strategies, which reveals the limitations of binary fairness metrics in the multi class setting.

AI.tldr: 本文指出既有公平性度量默认敏感属性与输出标签为二值，多值数据被迫做一对多二值化；作者批判现有度量局限并提出数学上严谨的多组、多类公平性度量推广，实证表明二值化会造成评估失真。
AI.motivation: AI/ML 已渗透各领域，但带偏见的数据会导致不公平系统。现有公平性度量普遍假设敏感特征和输出标签为二值，非二值数据只能强制二值化，这可能扭曲公平性评估，因此需要推广到多组、多类情形。
AI.method: 讨论并分析现有公平性度量的局限性；提出数学上严谨的多组（multi-group）与多类（multi-class）度量形式化推广；通过实证对比二值化策略与所提推广度量的评估结果。
AI.result: 实证结果揭示了二值化策略导致的评估失真，说明二值公平性度量在多类场景下存在明显局限。
AI.conclusion: 二值化会扭曲公平性评估，应使用多组、多类推广度量；本文为多类公平性评估提供了更严谨的理论与实证依据。

title: MIRA: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Deceptive Contextual Augmentation
summary: While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced multimodal reasoning, existing frameworks suffer from a critical "perception-reasoning gap." Due to an over-reliance on seemingly relevant visual tokens, even minor perceptual perturbations can propagate through the reasoning process, leading to compounding hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose MIRA, a training framework that improves robustness to erroneous visual contexts while enhancing logical reasoning ability. By injecting filtered, deceptive visual contexts during training, we construct challenging "hard traps" that stress-test the model's robustness to misleading information. Furthermore, we introduce a group-wise reflection-triggering mechanism that enables the model to autonomously detect and rectify inconsistencies between visual cues and logical constraints, which is ultimately internalized as an intrinsic policy behavior. Importantly, MIRA does not rely on human annotations. Experimental results across multiple reasoning and perception benchmarks show that MIRA yields an average 7% improvement on in-domain benchmarks, with consistent improvements on vision-centric benchmarks. These findings highlight that active error recovery is essential for robust multimodal reasoning. Comprehensive ablation studies and analyses further provide insights into why MIRA is effective.

AI.tldr: 提出MIRA训练框架，通过注入过滤后的欺骗性视觉上下文构造"硬陷阱"，并引入组内反思触发机制，使多模态模型自主检测并纠正视觉线索与逻辑约束的不一致，无需人工标注，平均提升约7%。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR多模态推理存在"感知-推理鸿沟"：模型过度依赖看似相关的视觉token，微小感知扰动会在推理链中传播并累积成幻觉。
AI.method: MIRA框架：1) 训练中注入过滤后的欺骗性视觉上下文，构造高难度"硬陷阱"压力测试鲁棒性；2) 组内反思触发机制（group-wise reflection-triggering），让模型自主发现并修正视觉线索与逻辑约束的矛盾，并内化为内在策略行为；不依赖人工标注。
AI.result: 在多个推理与感知基准上，域内基准平均提升7%，视觉中心基准上也有一致提升；消融与分析验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 主动错误恢复对鲁棒多模态推理至关重要；MIRA以无需标注的方式缓解感知-推理鸿沟，提升抗误导与逻辑推理能力。

title: The Cost of Mismatch: Noise Amplification in Zeroth-Order Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Poster). 31 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization has emerged as a promising approach for memory-efficient large language model (LLM) post-training, yet its reliable application to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) remains largely unexplored. Motivated by the distinct data regimes of on-policy RL and fixed-data optimization, we develop a generic variance-theoretic framework to investigate what limits the reliability of ZO gradient estimation. Our analysis reveals that estimation reliability is structurally determined by whether the two finite-difference evaluations are performed on matched data. On-policy reinforcement learning (RL) under the mismatched-data regime produces a $1/μ^2$ oracle-noise amplification that sets an irreducible noise floor as the perturbation scale $μ$ decreases, whereas Boltzmann Targeted SFT (BOLT) under the matched-data regime eliminates this amplification via noise cancellation. We further derive convergence guarantees with explicit constants that cleanly separate the two regimes. These results naturally lead to ZO-BOLT, which applies ZO optimization to BOLT's RLVR-aligned weighted-SFT objective. Controlled perturbation-scale sweeps and matched-versus-mismatched end-to-end comparisons validate the predicted effect of data matching. Experiments across three model variants and two mathematical reasoning benchmarks further show that ZO-BOLT consistently improves over the pretrained baseline while retaining a near-inference memory footprint. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出方差理论框架分析零阶(ZO)优化用于RLVR的可靠性，发现估计可靠性取决于两次有限差分评估是否在匹配数据上进行，据此提出ZO-BOLT方法。
AI.motivation: ZO优化是内存高效的大模型后训练方法，但其在可验证奖励强化学习(RLVR)中的可靠应用尚未被充分探索。在线策略RL与固定数据优化的数据机制不同，需要厘清什么限制了ZO梯度估计的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建通用的方差理论框架，区分"匹配数据"与"不匹配数据"两种机制：分析在线策略RL（不匹配）下的噪声放大，与BOLT（匹配数据）下的噪声抵消；推导具有显式常数的收敛保证；并据此将ZO应用于BOLT的RLVR对齐加权SFT目标，形成ZO-BOLT。
AI.result: 理论上：不匹配数据机制产生1/μ²的oracle噪声放大，随扰动尺度μ减小形成不可约噪声下限；匹配数据机制通过噪声抵消消除该放大。实验上：扰动尺度扫描与匹配/不匹配端到端对比验证了数据匹配效应；在三个模型变体和两个数学推理基准上，ZO-BOLT稳定优于预训练基线，且保持接近推理的内存占用。
AI.conclusion: 数据匹配是ZO梯度估计可靠性的结构性决定因素；ZO-BOLT通过匹配数据机制实现内存高效的RLVR后训练，兼顾效果与内存效率。代码已开源。

title: DeepWaveRL: Self-Supervised Full Waveform Inversion via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) is a fundamental inverse problem in geophysics to estimate subsurface properties, such as velocity, from seismic measurements. Recently, self-supervised learning methods remove the need for ground-truth velocity maps during training by leveraging a forward operator to simulate seismic data from predictions and backpropagate the gradients of reconstruction loss through it. In this work, we consider a more challenging setting without accessing such gradients. To this end, we incorporate reinforcement learning into self-supervised FWI and propose a framework named DeepWaveRL. Specifically, we reformulate FWI as a policy learning problem, where the policy network predicts velocity maps as actions, and a forward operator is used solely for simulation. A global scalar reward is computed based on data misfit for each prediction and used to weight policy gradients. Thus, learning proceeds without accessing the gradients from the forward operator. Given the indirect and coarse supervision signals, we further identify key strategies to stabilize learning and mitigate the spatial credit assignment bottleneck. Experimental results show that, despite relying entirely on a single scalar reward, DeepWaveRL achieves competitive performance compared to supervised and self-supervised baselines. These findings suggest that our framework offers a flexible and complementary learning paradigm for the FWI research community.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeepWaveRL：将全波形反演(FWI)重构为策略学习问题，用强化学习结合自监督，在不访问正演算子梯度的情况下仅凭单一标量奖励训练速度模型预测，性能与监督/自监督基线相当。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督FWI虽免去真值标签，但仍需通过正演算子反传重建损失梯度；本文考虑更困难的设定——无法获得该梯度，为此需寻找新的学习范式。
AI.method: 把FWI改写为策略学习：策略网络输出速度图作为动作，正演算子仅用于模拟地震数据；基于数据残差计算全局标量奖励并对策略梯度加权，从而无需正演算子梯度。针对监督信号间接粗粒度问题，提出稳定训练与缓解空间信用分配瓶颈的关键策略。
AI.result: 仅依赖单一标量奖励，DeepWaveRL 在实验中取得与监督和自监督基线相当的性能，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DeepWaveRL 为FWI提供了一种灵活、互补的学习范式，表明强化学习可在无正演梯度条件下支撑自监督FWI，对FWI研究社区有启示意义。

title: Ray-SCR: Generalizing Scene Coordinate Regression Across Camera Models
summary:
Among visual localization strategies, scene coordinate regression (SCR) has emerged as an attractive approach for its compactness, accuracy, and speed. Despite these advantages, SCR models generalize poorly across substantially different camera models, such as omnidirectional or strongly rectified imagery. This limitation arises because, changes in field of view, lens distortion, or rectification-induced resampling can make the same scene content appear differently depending on its pixel position, degrading localization accuracy. To cope with this limitation, we introduce Ray-SCR, a lightweight extension to existing SCR architectures that conditions local visual features on their calibrated viewing rays and refines neighboring ray-conditioned features with a shallow local Transformer. We further formulate supervision directly in ray space and use sparse SfM points as metric anchors that link observations across views and camera models. Taken together, these components enable a single scene representation built from a panoramic mapping sequence to accurately localize query images captured with very different cameras, including pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras.
  We evaluate Ray-SCR across multiple SCR architectures and on datasets with pinhole, fisheye, and omnidirectional cameras. The proposed ray conditioning substantially improves generalization across cameras and leads to state-of-the-art localization performance in these challenging cross-camera settings. The project page is available at https://jaeminch0.github.io/ray-scr-generalizing-scene-coordinate-regression-across-camera-models/.

AI.tldr: Ray-SCR 通过将局部视觉特征以标定光线（viewing rays）为条件、并用浅层局部 Transformer 精化邻域光线条件特征，使场景坐标回归（SCR）模型可跨相机模型（针孔、鱼眼、全景）泛化。
AI.motivation: SCR 虽紧凑、准确、快速，但跨相机模型（全景、鱼眼、强矫正图像）泛化差。原因是视场角、镜头畸变或矫正重采样会使同一场景内容因像素位置不同而呈现不同外观，从而降低定位精度。
AI.method: 提出 Ray-SCR：作为现有 SCR 架构的轻量扩展，1) 用标定光线对局部视觉特征进行条件化（ray-conditioned features）；2) 用浅层局部 Transformer 对邻域光线条件特征进行精化；3) 直接在光线空间构建监督，并用稀疏 SfM 点作为度量锚点，跨视角与相机模型连接观测。
AI.result: 在多种 SCR 架构及针孔、鱼眼、全景数据集上评估，光线条件化显著提升跨相机泛化，并在这些挑战性跨相机设置下取得 SOTA 定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 由全景建图序列构建的单一场景表示，可准确定位由差异极大的相机（针孔、鱼眼、全景）拍摄的查询图像，验证了光线空间建模对齐跨相机观测的有效性。

title: A Human-Verified AI Workflow for Annotating Environmental Sound Data
summary: Large-scale annotation of environmental sound recordings presents significant challenges under time and resource constraints, particularly when sound categories are imbalanced and only part of a dataset has been labeled.
