This paper describes the development and evaluation of a human-AI workflow used during annotation of the Kenya Forest Sounds Dataset (KFSD), using a project-stage working collection of 7,531 audio recordings across 21 categories. We investigated zero-shot classification, a feature-based ensemble, and a fine-tuned Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST). The fine-tuned AST achieved 89.36% accuracy, 85.98% precision, 89.24% recall, and 87.58% F1 on held-out test data for binary classification of Person talking. Because this result remained below the predefined 95% threshold for autonomous annotation, model predictions were used as suggestions and subjected to human verification. Of the 5,026 initially unlabeled recordings, 2,337 were routed to a speech-verification queue and 2,689 remained for ordinary manual annotation. The verifier reviewed all 2,337 machine-labeled files and detected zero false positives, yielding 100% verification accuracy. The observed average verification time was approximately 4.2 seconds per file. At an average rate of 35 seconds per file for manual annotation, the hybrid workflow reduced work on the remaining queue from approximately 48.9 to 28.9 person-hours, saving about 20.0 hours (41%). The study documents the model-selection process, provenance-aware file organization, verification procedure, observed errors, practical limitations, and opportunities for extending AI assistance beyond one category.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并评估了一种人在回路(Human-AI)标注流程，用于肯尼亚森林声音数据集(KFSD)的标注，通过微调AST模型辅助筛选语音样本，将人工标注工作量减少约41%。
AI.motivation: 大规模环境声音标注在时间与资源受限条件下困难重重，尤其当类别不平衡且仅有部分数据已被标注时。作者希望在保证质量的前提下减少人工标注负担。
AI.method: 基于7,531段音频、21个类别的working collection，比较了零样本分类、基于特征的集成方法以及微调的Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST)。由于模型未达95%自主标注阈值，将预测作为建议交由人工核验（provenance-aware文件组织与验证队列）。
AI.result: 微调AST在"Person talking"二分类上达到89.36%准确率、85.98%精确率、89.24%召回率、87.58% F1。5,026条未标注音频中，2,337条进入语音核验队列、2,689条走常规人工标注；核验2,337条机器标注文件误检为零（100%核验准确），平均每文件约4.2秒，而人工标注约35秒/文件。
AI.conclusion: 混合工作流将剩余队列工作量从约48.9人时降至28.9人时，节省约20.0小时(41%)。研究记录了模型选择过程、溯源感知文件组织、验证流程、观察到的错误、实际局限及将AI辅助扩展到更多类别的机会。

title: Multimodal Prompt Learning with Dual-Granularity Contrastive Alignment for Preoperative Prediction of Lung Adenocarcinoma Invasiveness Using 3D CT
summary: Accurate preoperative prediction of lung adenocarcinoma invasiveness is important for surgical planning and individualized treatment. However, overlapping CT appearances make it challenging to distinguish invasive adenocarcinoma (IAD) from Pre-IAD lesions. We propose a multimodal prompt-learning framework with dual-granularity image-text alignment for 3D CT-based IAD classification. A 3D ResNet-CBAM encoder extracts global and spatial visual features. A frozen RadBERT backbone is adapted with separate learnable prompts for report-level and keyword-level text encoding. These prompts are initialized using semantic representations derived from real-world clinical reports. Global contrastive alignment connects whole-volume CT representations with reports generated from clinician-annotated radiological attributes to provide overall semantic supervision. A multiple instance learning-based local alignment module associates spatial CT features with vascular-focused radiological keywords, to capture local imaging characteristics potentially associated with tumor invasion. The framework jointly optimizes classification and alignment objectives, while inference requires only CT images. Experiments included 1,593 pathologically confirmed nodules. On the test set, the proposed method achieved an accuracy of 87.92%, F1-score of 87.78%, and AUC of 0.9499. Its AUC significantly exceeded that of the image-only Res-CBAM baseline with the same visual backbone (0.9297; DeLong test, p = 0.0078). Ablation analyses supported the complementary contributions of global and local alignment and the benefit of report-based prompt initialization. Qualitative visualizations showed activation within nodules and adjacent vascular structures. These findings suggest that dual-granularity radiological supervision can enhance CT-based invasiveness prediction while preserving a CT-only inference workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出双粒度图文对齐的多模态提示学习框架，用于3D CT肺腺癌浸润性（IAD vs Pre-IAD）分类，推理时仅需CT。
AI.motivation: 术前准确预测肺腺癌浸润性对手术规划与个体化治疗至关重要，但IAD与Pre-IAD在CT表现上高度重叠，难以区分。
AI.method: 3D ResNet-CBAM编码器提取全局与空间视觉特征；冻结RadBERT，用报告级与关键词级独立可学习提示编码文本，提示由真实临床报告语义表示初始化；全局对比对齐将全肺容积CT表示与基于临床标注放射属性的生成报告对齐；基于多实例学习的局部对齐模块将空间CT特征与血管相关放射关键词关联；联合优化分类与对齐目标，推理仅用CT。
AI.result: 在1593例病理确诊结节上测试，准确率87.92%、F1 87.78%、AUC 0.9499；AUC显著优于同视觉骨干的纯图像Res-CBAM基线（0.9297，DeLong p=0.0078）。消融验证全局/局部对齐互补性及报告提示初始化收益；可视化显示结节及邻近血管结构激活。
AI.conclusion: 双粒度放射监督可提升CT浸润性预测，同时保持仅CT推理流程。

title: Strictly proper scoring rules for node selection tasks on graphs
summary: In node selection tasks, the goal is to identify a single unknown target node in a graph. We consider probabilistic supervised node selection, where the estimator outputs a probability distribution over the nodes of the graph and the ground-truth node is available for evaluation. Classical evaluation metrics for such tasks are either statistically ill-conceived or blind to the graph structure. To fill this gap, we introduce two strictly proper scoring rules that are explicitly graph-aware: the Resistance score, which is parameter-free, and the Diffusion score, which operates at an adjustable coarse-graining resolution. We show that the Diffusion score interpolates between the multi-category Brier score and a cluster-level weighted Brier score. The Resistance score generalises two classical scoring rules: the multi-category Brier score and the Ranked probability score. Applied to rooted trees, it also serves as the strictly proper version of the improper Hierarchical error distance used in hierarchical classification. In the same setting, we furthermore establish strict propriety of the Hierarchical cross-entropy family, a recently introduced separate class of hierarchy-aware scoring rules. Experiments on epidemic source detection and on ImageNet classification confirm that the proposed scores detect meaningful differences in estimation quality that classical metrics miss.

AI.tldr: 本文针对图上的节点选择任务（从图中找出唯一未知目标节点），提出两种显式考虑图结构的严格恰当评分规则：无参数的 Resistance score 和具有可调粗粒化分辨率的 Diffusion score，并证明后者在多类别 Brier 分数与簇级加权 Brier 分数之间插值，前者推广了 Brier 分数与 Ranked probability score。
AI.motivation: 节点选择任务的经典评价指标要么在统计上不合理（非严格恰当），要么对图结构视而不见，缺乏既统计合理又图感知的评分规则。
AI.method: 提出 Resistance score（基于图电阻、无参数）与 Diffusion score（基于扩散、可调粗粒化分辨率）两种严格恰当评分规则；证明 Diffusion score 在 Brier 与簇级加权 Brier 之间插值，Resistance score 推广 Brier 与 RPS；在 rooted tree 上给出其与 Hierarchical error distance 的关系，并证明 Hierarchical cross-entropy 族的严格恰当性。
AI.result: 理论上建立了两种评分的严格恰当性与插值/推广关系；实验（传染病源头检测与 ImageNet 分类）表明所提评分能检测到经典指标遗漏的估计质量差异。
AI.conclusion: 图感知的严格恰当评分规则填补了节点选择任务评价的空白，可更敏感地反映估计质量差异，适用于流行病溯源与层次分类等场景。

title: 3D Gaussian Splatting within Self-Learned Neural View-Dependent Color Fields
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a vital tool in novel view synthesis. 3D Gaussian functions with attributes like color, opacity, and scale are stacked together to explicitly model a radiance field. However, discrete 3D Gaussians usually produce poor depth with few geometry details but lots of floaters, which hinders the effective modeling of smooth radiance fields. To address this issue, we propose to learn a radiance field within a continuous view-dependent color field parameterized by neural networks. With continuous constraints in color, the bias on low-frequency signals of neural networks can highly encourage the geometry modeling to contribute to high-frequency color variations on images, getting rid of solely relying on the color attribute itself. Moreover, we impose a constraint to improve the Lipschitz continuity of the neural color field, making large changes of each Gaussian's color also match with large changes of its position in terms of a ratio. To this end, we additionally introduce novel self-learning strategies to improve the learning of the neural view-dependent color field without any external knowledge or priors, aiming for better generalization on unseen scenes. Our numerical and visual comparisons on widely used benchmarks justify our idea and show better ability of high fidelity geometry recovery in 3DGS. Project page: https://github.com/yangyixi21/Neural-Color-Fields-3DGS.

AI.tldr: 提出将3DGS的颜色属性替换/约束为神经网络参数化的连续视角相关颜色场，利用网络低频偏置与Lipschitz连续性约束提升几何建模，改善深度与高频细节，在多个基准上实现更高质量几何恢复。
AI.motivation: 离散3D高斯产生的深度质量差、几何细节少且存在大量漂浮物（floaters），阻碍了平滑辐射场的有效建模。
AI.method: 在由神经网络参数化的连续视角相关颜色场中学习辐射场；通过颜色连续约束使网络低频偏置促使几何承担图像高频颜色变化，而非仅依赖颜色属性；加入利普希茨连续性约束，使高斯颜色变化与位置变化成比例匹配；并提出无需外部知识或先验的自学习策略以提升对未见场景的泛化。
AI.result: 在常用基准上的数值与视觉对比验证了该思路，3DGS在高保真几何恢复方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 连续神经颜色场与Lipschitz约束能有效缓解离散高斯的几何缺陷，提升3DGS几何重建质量与泛化能力。

title: ENGINE: Endogenous Variational MultiScale Optimization for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient large language model (LLM) fine-tuning, and recent methods incorporate curvature-aware strategies. However, in the high-dimensional parameter space of LLMs, these methods inherently suffer from exploding gradient variance and prohibitive costs. Conversely, confining updates to a low-dimensional subspace reduces variance but discards critical high-dimensional information, degrading performance. This creates a fundamental dilemma: full-space optimization is informative but has high variance, while subspace optimization has low variance but loses information. To break this trade-off, we propose ENGINE (Endogenous Variational MultiScale). Inspired by computational mechanics, we adapt static Variational MultiScale (VMS) theory to dynamic optimization, treating low- and high-dimensional spaces as resolved coarse and unresolved fine scales. Through a multigrid-style V-cycle, ENGINE alternates between spaces, dynamically probing fine-grained information in the high-dimensional space and injecting it to correct the efficient low-dimensional sampling process. Under appropriate assumptions, statistical analysis characterizes variance reduction and correction of curvature-induced bias, and convergence analysis establishes a stationarity bound for the corrected coarse updates. Evaluations on standard LLM benchmarks show that ENGINE achieves higher accuracy and faster convergence than existing ZO methods, achieving up to a $2.61\times$ speed-up in forward passes with zero additional peak memory overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/AI4Science-WestlakeU/ENGINE.

AI.tldr: 提出 ENGINE（内蕴变分多尺度）零阶优化方法，借鉴计算力学的变分多尺度理论，在低维子空间与高维空间之间交替采样，兼顾低方差与信息完整性，实现高效低内存的 LLM 微调。
AI.motivation: 零阶优化适合内存受限的 LLM 微调，但全空间优化存在梯度方差爆炸和计算开销大的问题；子空间优化虽降方差却丢失高维关键信息，导致性能下降。二者构成"全空间信息全但高方差、子空间低方差但信息缺失"的根本困境。
AI.method: 受计算力学中静态变分多尺度（VMS）理论启发，将其推广到动态优化：把低维与高维空间分别视作已解析粗尺度与未解析细尺度。采用多重网格式 V-cycle，在两种空间间交替，动态探测高维细粒度信息并注入以校正低维采样过程。
AI.result: 理论分析刻画了方差降低与曲率偏差校正效果，并给出校正后粗更新的平稳性界。在标准 LLM 基准上，精度更高、收敛更快，前向传播最多加速 2.61 倍，且峰值内存零额外开销。
AI.conclusion: ENGINE 通过多尺度交替机制打破全空间与子空间优化的固有权衡，在保持零额外内存的同时显著提升效率与性能，为零阶 LLM 微调提供了有理论保障的新范式。

title: KAUSTics-Net: Diffusion-Based Through-Water UAV Restoration with a Semi-Synthetic Dataset
summary: Accurate mapping of shallow-water environments using unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenged by water-induced distortions, including refraction, caustics, and wavelength-dependent attenuation. The scarcity of paired distorted and reference imagery further limits the development of supervised restoration methods. To address this challenge, we introduce KAUSTics, a semi-synthetic dataset combining 1,280 reference patches derived from 32 high-resolution UAV images with 12,800 degraded observations generated through Blender-based water-surface rendering and empirical color and blur augmentations. We further propose KAUSTics-Net, a pixel-space conditional diffusion framework integrating a multi-scale conditional encoder, feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), cross-attention, and a composite reconstruction objective to restore shallow-water imagery. We evaluated the framework against eight image-restoration methods, complemented by architectural ablations and cross-dataset experiments. On KAUSTics, KAUSTics-Net achieved a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 31.715 +/- 0.439 dB, structural similarity index (SSIM) of 0.849 +/- 0.002, and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) of 0.145 +/- 0.007 across three training seeds. On the independent Sea-Undistort dataset, sampler-aware fine-tuning improved restoration fidelity, reaching 19.469 +/- 0.332 dB PSNR and 0.554 +/- 0.005 SSIM under combined water-surface distortions, although perceptual trade-offs remained. Additional experiments on real UAV imagery examined feature preservation and segmentation behavior. These findings demonstrate the potential of semi-synthetic training and conditional diffusion for shallow-water image restoration while highlighting the importance of evaluating both reconstruction fidelity and downstream remote-sensing utility.

AI.tldr: 提出半合成数据集KAUSTics与像素空间条件扩散框架KAUSTics-Net，用于修复UAV浅水影像的水致畸变，在自建集达PSNR 31.715dB，并在Sea-Undistort上验证泛化性。
AI.motivation: UAV浅水成像受折射、焦散和波长相关衰减影响导致失真，且缺乏成对的失真—参考影像，限制了监督式修复方法的发展。
AI.method: 构建KAUSTics半合成数据集（32幅高分辨率UAV图像切出1280个参考块，经Blender水面渲染及经验颜色/模糊增强生成12800个退化观测）；提出KAUSTics-Net像素空间条件扩散框架，含多尺度条件编码器、FiLM、交叉注意力和复合重建损失。
AI.result: KAUSTics上三随机种子平均PSNR 31.715±0.439 dB、SSIM 0.849±0.002、LPIPS 0.145±0.007，优于八种对比方法；跨数据集Sea-Undistort上经采样器感知微调达19.469±0.332 dB PSNR、0.554±0.005 SSIM，但存在感知权衡。
AI.conclusion: 半合成训练与条件扩散在浅水图像修复上具潜力，同时需兼顾重建保真度与下游遥感可用性（特征保持、分割表现）。

title: Inferring Transferable Rewards via Active Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) aims to recover expert rewards that transfer across environments with differing dynamics. Prior work has shown that such transfer is possible when gathering expert demonstrations across sufficiently different dynamics. In practice, however, expert demonstrations are costly, making it critical to select the right dynamics to reduce the quantity of expert data required for learning transferable rewards. We propose a two-phase approach: we first cycle through the available dynamics to obtain a reliable reward estimate, then actively select dynamics to reduce our uncertainty about the expert reward. Crucially, this yields novel sample complexity guarantees on transfer that hold for any dynamics, with a rate independent of the number of available dynamics. Empirically, our method significantly reduces the number of expert demonstrations needed to learn a transferable reward.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段方法：先轮换可用动力学获得可靠奖励估计，再主动选择动力学以降低对专家奖励的不确定性，从而减少学习可迁移奖励所需的专家示范数量。
AI.motivation: 逆强化学习希望恢复可跨不同动力学环境迁移的专家奖励；已有工作表明需在足够不同的动力学上采集示范，但专家示范代价高昂，因此关键在于选择恰当的动力学以降低专家数据需求。
AI.method: 两阶段主动采样框架：第一阶段依次遍历可用动力学，得到较为可靠的奖励估计；第二阶段主动选择动力学，以最小化对专家奖励的不确定性。
AI.result: 给出适用于任意动力学的新型迁移样本复杂度保证，其收敛速率与可用动力学数量无关；实验上显著减少了学习可迁移奖励所需的专家示范数。
AI.conclusion: 通过合理选择动力学，可有效降低学习可迁移奖励的专家数据成本，并获得理论上与动力学池规模无关的样本效率保证。

title: SurgPace: Complexity-Aware Progressive Distillation for Surgical Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, Accepted by Medical Image Analysis
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential in robotic surgery for question answering, scene understanding, and grounded assistance, but their high computational cost limits real clinical deployment. Knowledge distillation provides a practical way to build compact surgical MLLMs, yet direct distillation is not well suited to surgical data because surgical samples vary greatly in difficulty, visual ambiguity, and required clinical context, making uniform teacher-student transfer unstable. In addition, the role of supervision changes during training: early stages require stronger teacher guidance for multimodal alignment, while later stages rely more on task supervision for effective optimization. To address these challenges, we propose SurgPace, a complexity-aware continuous curriculum framework for progressive distillation of surgical vision-language models. SurgPace estimates sample complexity using predictive confidence and Lorentz geometric consistency, and uses the fused score to guide a continuous easy-to-hard training process. We further introduce hierarchical representation alignment, which aligns the student with the teacher at the feature, logit, and probability levels, while gradually shifting the training focus from teacher imitation to task supervision. This design separates sample-level curriculum from objective-level scheduling, leading to more stable and effective distillation. We evaluate SurgPace on Surg-396K, a benchmark built from four public surgical datasets and covering five dialogue paradigms. SurgPace consistently outperforms strong MLLM distillation baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness for building compact, memory-efficient surgical MLLMs with faster decoding under controlled benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/hezhicheng2002/SurgPace.

AI.tldr: 提出SurgPace——面向手术视觉语言模型蒸馏的复杂度感知连续课程框架，结合样本级课程与目标级调度实现稳定的由易到难蒸馏。
AI.motivation: MLLM在机器人手术中潜力大但计算开销高，知识蒸馏可构建紧凑模型；然而手术样本在难度、视觉模糊性和临床上下文上差异极大，均匀的师生迁移不稳定，且监督角色随训练阶段变化（早期需强教师引导做多模态对齐，后期更依赖任务监督）。
AI.method: 用预测置信度和Lorentz几何一致性估计样本复杂度并融合成得分，引导连续由易到难训练；引入分层表示对齐，在特征、logit、概率三层面对齐师生，并逐步将训练重心从教师模仿转向任务监督，从而将样本级课程与目标级调度分离。
AI.result: 在基于四个公开手术数据集、覆盖五种对话范式构建的Surg-396K基准上，SurgPace一致优于强MLLM蒸馏基线，构建出紧凑、省内存且在受控基准下解码更快的手术MLLM。
AI.conclusion: SurgPace通过复杂度感知的连续课程与分层目标调度，有效解决了手术数据异构导致的蒸馏不稳定问题，为临床可部署的紧凑手术MLLM提供了实用方案。

title: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents are controllable, are central to real-world domains such as smart grids, yet lack a principled foundation for reinforcement learning algorithm design. We study this setting through n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), a recent framework for learning in open multi-agent environments. We propose an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity), treating them as structural constraints rather than heuristic design choices. This formulation builds on a novel NAHT decomposition, which characterises the fundamental difference between open and fully controllable multi-agent systems, and establishes a cooperative game-theoretic foundation for learning. We further show that enforcing these axioms on learning individual value functions recovers the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs, providing a principled bridge between reinforcement learning and classical cooperative game theory. Building on this framework, we introduce Shapley Machines and Banzhaf Machines, two generic algorithmic templates that can be instantiated with standard reinforcement learning methods. When applied to strong base algorithms such as IPPO and POAM, our methods consistently improve learning efficiency and generalisation to unseen agent types and conventions across NAHT benchmark tasks. The code of experiments is published on https://github.com/hsvgbkhgbv/axiomatic-rl-naht.

AI.tldr: 本文为开放式多智能体系统（部分可控）的强化学习提出公理化框架，从Shapley公理推导价值函数学习，并提出Shapley Machines与Banzhaf Machines两种通用算法模板。
AI.motivation: 真实场景（如智能电网）中仅部分智能体可控，但开放式多智能体系统缺乏有原则的RL算法设计基础。作者希望以合作博弈论公理为结构性约束，取代启发式设计。
AI.method: 基于n-agent ad hoc teamwork（NAHT）框架，提出一种新的NAHT分解刻画开放与完全可控系统的本质差别；将Shapley公理（有效性、对称性、线性）作为价值函数学习的结构约束，并证明对个体价值函数施加这些公理会恢复Dec-POMDP的Shapley值。据此设计Shapley Machines与Banzhaf Machines两种可实例化于标准RL方法的算法模板。
AI.result: 在NAHT基准任务上，将方法应用于IPPO和POAM等强基线，学习效率以及对未见智能体类型和约定的泛化能力均得到一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为开放式多智能体RL建立了合作博弈论基础，在RL与经典合作博弈论之间架起有原则的桥梁，且方法通用、可与现有算法组合。

title: Behavioral Affinity Transduction for Zero-Shot Vision-Language Classification
summary: An image that is hard to classify on its own may have a helpful neighbor in the same unlabeled batch. Zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) score images independently and leave this evidence unused. We study small unlabeled query batches with no labeled examples. Visual similarity can reflect pose or background, so it may connect images from different classes. Each image's scores over the class vocabulary offer another way to choose neighbors. We introduce Behavioral Affinity Transduction (BAT), which builds a sparse graph from these class-response profiles. The graph supplies neighbor evidence during prediction. For EM-Dirichlet, it also screens candidate classes and initializes assignments. BAT plugs into direct and iterative readouts of a frozen VLM. Across diverse datasets, BAT improves the mean accuracy of every tested readout. In the main RN50 comparison, soft and hard EM-Dirichlet gain $4.22$ and $2.72$ percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出Behavioral Affinity Transduction (BAT)，用无标签小批量中样本的"类响应画像"构建稀疏图，为冻结VLM的预测提供邻居证据，提升零样本分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 零样本VLM对每张图独立打分，忽略了同一无标签批次中邻居图像可提供的证据；而纯视觉相似度易受姿态、背景干扰，可能连接不同类别的图像，因此需要更可靠的邻居选择依据。
AI.method: 对每个样本，用其在类词表上的得分分布（class-response profile）衡量相似度，据此构建稀疏图；将该图作为标签传播式（transduction）邻居证据注入预测过程。对EM-Dirichlet，图还用于筛选候选类并初始化分配。BAT可即插即用地接入冻结VLM的直接与迭代读出方式。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，BAT使所有测试读出的平均准确率均提升；在以RN50为主实验中，soft与hard EM-Dirichlet分别提升4.22与2.72个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 相比视觉相似度，基于类响应画像的行为相似度更适合在无标签批次中选邻居；BAT作为一种轻量、通用的转导模块，可有效增强冻结VLM的零样本预测。

title: Calibrated Multiaccuracy: Deterministic and Randomized Sample Complexity
summary:
Calibrated multiaccuracy asks that a predictor be globally calibrated and multiaccurate with respect to a bounded test family $G$; that is, its residuals should be uncorrelated with every test $g(x)\in G$. This weakening of multicalibration suffices for many applications. Its sample complexity was not known to improve on that of full multicalibration, which is $\widetildeΘ\left(\frac{\log|G|}{\varepsilon^2} + \frac{1}{\varepsilon^{3}}\right)$ when $|G|$ is at least a sufficiently large power of $\log(1/\varepsilon)$. We resolve the sample complexity of $\varepsilon$-calibrated multiaccuracy, showing that it scales as $$ \widetildeΘ\left(\frac{\log|G|}{\varepsilon^2} + \frac{1}{\varepsilon^{5/2}}\right), $$ separating it from the complexity of multicalibration. The upper bound is obtained by an algorithm that outputs a randomized predictor.
  For deterministic predictors, we establish the tight rate $$
  \widetildeΘ\left(
  \frac{\log|G|}{\varepsilon^2}
  +
  \frac{(\log|G|)^{1/3}}{\varepsilon^{8/3}}
  \right) $$ whenever $\log|G|=Ω(\log(1/\varepsilon))$. When $\log|G|\le\varepsilon^{-1+κ}$ for any fixed $κ\in(0,1)$, this rate is polynomially larger than the rate for randomized predictors. Thus, unlike for multicalibration, calibrated multiaccuracy exhibits a genuine sample-complexity separation between deterministic and randomized predictors. The matching upper and lower bounds show that the unusual cube-root dependence on $\log|G|$ is intrinsic. At $\log|G|\asymp\varepsilon^{-1}$, the minimax rates for randomized and deterministic calibrated multiaccuracy both coincide with the minimax rate for multicalibration.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了ε-校准多准确（calibrated multiaccuracy）的样本复杂度：随机预测器为 Õ(log|G|/ε² + 1/ε^{5/2})，确定性预测器为 Õ(log|G|/ε² + (log|G|)^{1/3}/ε^{8/3})，从而将其与多重校准（multicalibration）分离。
AI.motivation: 校准多准确是多重校准的一种弱化（要求残差与G中每个测试不相关），已足够支撑许多应用，但其样本复杂度此前未被证明优于完整多重校准（Õ(log|G|/ε² + 1/ε³)）。作者希望厘清其真实样本复杂度，并考察随机与确定性预测器之间是否存在本质差异。
AI.method: 证明随机预测器的上界，其算法输出随机化预测器；同时给出确定性预测器的紧致上下界（含匹配的构造性下界论证），表明 log|G| 的三次根依赖是内在的。结果显示在 log|G| ≲ ε^{-1+κ} 时确定性速率比随机速率多项式级更差，体现随机/确定性的真实样本复杂度分离；而在 log|G| ≍ ε^{-1} 时两者均与多重校准的极小极大速率一致。
AI.result: 随机预测器达到 Õ(log|G|/ε² + 1/ε^{5/2})；确定性预测器达到 Õ(log|G|/ε² + (log|G|)^{1/3}/ε^{8/3})（当 log|G|=Ω(log(1/ε))），且上下界匹配。
AI.conclusion: 校准多准确的样本复杂度严格低于多重校准，且随机与确定性预测器之间存在真实分离；三次根依赖为内在性质。

title: Znaki: A Russian Fingerspelling Recognition Dataset
comment: Proceedings of the Second Workshop on Sign Language Processing, https://aclanthology.org/2026.wslp-1.20/
summary: Fingerspelling - the sequential signing of letters that compose proper names, technical terms, and out-of-vocabulary words - is an integral component of any sign language. Despite Russian Sign Language (RSL) being used by more than 150,000 native signers, no public fingerspelling dataset for RSL exists, in contrast to American, British, German, and several other sign languages. We introduce Znaki the first open RSL fingerspelling dataset: 37,252 video recordings (35.4 hours) of 1,593 unique sequences - proper names sampled from 16 domain categories - recorded by 68 native RSL signers (37 Deaf, 29 hard-of-hearing, and 2 certified interpreters) through a crowdsourcing pipeline with a two-stage signer qualification procedure and expert validation. The dataset covers all 33 Cyrillic handshapes, and its letter-frequency distribution matches the Russian National Corpus. As reference points for future research, we establish two baselines adapted from American Sign Language fingerspelling recognition: a Squeezeformer-based encoder-decoder, reaching a character-level accuracy ($1-\mathrm{CER}$) of 0.932 and a sequence accuracy of 0.596, and Fingerspelling-PoseNet, reaching 0.886 and 0.545, respectively.

AI.tldr: 首个公开的俄语手语（RSL）指文字数据集Znaki，含37,252段视频（35.4小时、1,593个序列、68位母语者），并给出两个基线识别结果。
AI.motivation: 俄语手语使用者超15万，但此前没有公开的RSL指文字数据集（美、英、德等手语已有），缺乏研究与基准。
AI.method: 通过众包流程采集，配合两阶段签名者资格审核与专家校验；覆盖33个西里尔手型，字母频率与俄罗斯国家语料库一致。建立两个源自ASL指文字识别的基线：Squeezeformer编码器-解码器与Fingerspelling-PoseNet。
AI.result: Squeezeformer基线字符级准确率(1-CER)为0.932、序列准确率0.596；Fingerspelling-PoseNet分别为0.886与0.545。
AI.conclusion: Znaki填补了RSL指文字数据空白，为后续研究提供公开数据与参考基线。

title: When Optimization Meets Human Intent: Human-Centered Diffusion Model Optimization
summary: Diffusion models are evolving from general tools into personalized systems that adapt to user needs through fine-tuning and guidance. However, diffusion optimization mainly targets measurable objectives such as aesthetics, rarely examining whether they align with human intent. Human needs are multidimensional, contextual, and dynamic, whereas existing methods approximate them with fixed metrics. Because these metrics capture human needs only partially and may amplify deviations from true intent during optimization, higher scores need not yield results better matching human expectations. To understand how human needs enter and influence optimization, we systematically analyze how human intent is expressed, translated into optimizable objectives, applied to model behavior or generation, and evaluated through outputs. We further discuss trade-offs affecting human-intent alignment in personalized image generation and gaps between automated metrics and real user judgments. This human-centered synthesis reorganizes diffusion optimization and provides a systematic reference for personalized generation systems designed for human preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文综述个性化扩散模型优化中"人类意图对齐"问题，系统分析人类意图如何表达、转化为可优化目标、作用于模型或生成、并通过输出来评估，指出固定指标只能部分刻画人类需求且优化中可能放大偏差，高分不等于更符合人类期望。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型正从通用工具走向个性化系统，但优化目标多为美学等可量化指标，很少检验其是否与人类意图一致。人类需求具有多维、情境化、动态性，现有方法却用固定指标近似，这些指标只能部分捕捉需求，优化中甚至会放大对真实意图的偏离，导致分数更高却未必更符合用户期待。
AI.method: 采用系统性的以人为中心的综述与分析框架：沿"人类意图表达→翻译为可优化目标→应用于模型行为或生成过程→通过输出进行评估"这一链条梳理现有工作，并分析影响人机意图对齐的权衡关系以及自动化指标与真实用户判断之间的差距。
AI.result: 梳理出人类需求进入并影响扩散优化的完整路径，揭示了固定指标在个性化图像生成中的局限性，明确了优化过程中的权衡因素以及自动评估指标与真实用户判断之间的鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 该以人为中心的综述重新组织了扩散优化研究，为面向人类偏好的个性化生成系统提供了系统性参考，并强调需要超越可量化指标、更贴近真实人类意图的对齐与评估方式。

title: FLAMIA: FLAsh MIcroscaling Attention for Fast and Causally Safe Training on Blackwell
summary: Attention remains a substantial computational cost in Transformer training, particularly at long context lengths. NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs provide high-throughput low-precision matrix multiplication, but exploiting it in attention requires addressing quantization overhead, causal information leakage through shared scales, and numerical inconsistencies between the forward and backward passes. We present FLAMIA, a family of attention kernels for Blackwell with MXFP8 and mixed NVFP4/FP8 training paths. Our design combines token-block scaling that reuses quantized operands across matrix orientations, targeted safeguards against scale-induced leakage, and consistent forward and backward computations. Fused quantization and architecture-specific kernel optimizations reduce overhead, while document-local scaling and workload-aware scheduling support variable-length documents directly in packed layouts without repacking. Across various causal packed-document workloads, the MXFP8 path accelerates the combined forward and backward attention call, including quantization, by factors of $1.10$--$1.40\times$ on B200 and $1.06$--$1.42\times$ on B300 relative to the fastest evaluated baseline for each workload. We validate training stability and quality preservation on pretraining Llama-style models. These results show how jointly designing quantization, training numerics, and document scheduling translates low-bit hardware throughput into practical attention acceleration.

AI.tldr: FLAMIA 是面向 NVIDIA Blackwell GPU 的注意力内核家族，提供 MXFP8 与混合 NVFP4/FP8 训练路径，通过 token-block 缩放复用、防泄漏保护、前后向一致的数值方案及文档局部缩放，将低精度硬件吞吐转化为注意力训练的实际加速。
AI.motivation: 注意力在长上下文下计算开销巨大。Blackwell 提供高吞吐低精度矩阵乘法，但直接用于注意力面临三大障碍：量化开销、共享缩放因子导致的因果信息泄漏，以及前向与反向传播之间的数值不一致。
AI.method: 提出 FLAMIA 注意力内核：1) token-block 缩放，使量化操作数可在不同矩阵方向间复用；2) 针对缩放引发泄漏的定向防护措施；3) 保证前向与反向计算一致；4) 融合量化与架构专属内核优化以降低开销；5) 文档局部缩放与工作负载感知调度，无需重排即可在打包布局中处理变长文档。
AI.result: 在多种因果打包文档负载下，MXFP8 路径将包含量化的前向+反向注意力调用加速 1.10–1.40×（B200）和 1.06–1.42×（B300），对比各自最快基线；在 Llama 式模型预训练中验证了训练稳定性与质量保持。
AI.conclusion: 联合设计量化、训练数值与文档调度，可将低比特硬件吞吐转化为实用的注意力加速。

title: Visual-to-Executable Procedural Reconstruction of Buildings
summary: Procedural modeling offers compact, editable, and reusable representations for architectural content, but building such models still depends heavily on manually authored grammars. We study image-based procedural building reconstruction from in-the-wild images, with the goal of recovering an executable procedural description that can be instantiated as an editable 3D building asset. Because a single image provides only partial and view-dependent evidence, we focus on recovering the dominant visible facade(s) and attach the recovered facade program to a simple mass model for building-level instantiation. Our method decomposes this task into two structured prediction stages. First, a Global Structure Layout Tree recovers facade-scale split-and-repeat organization through a fine-tuned layout model with render-guided visual-symbolic reflection. Second, a Component Parameterization schema maps representative facade tiles to structured procedural attributes for local architectural component synthesis. These two representations are then deterministically compiled into executable Computer Generated Architecture (CGA) programs, avoiding the brittleness of direct low-level program generation. Experiments show that the proposed framework handles both regular facades and challenging in-the-wild images, while maintaining high structural consistency, procedural executability, and fine-grained architectural detail. The recovered programs further enable controllable and reusable 3D building asset generation.

AI.tldr: 提出从单张野外图像重建可执行程序化建筑描述的两阶段结构化预测方法：先生成立面分割-重复布局树，再参数化构件，最终编译为CGA程序生成可编辑3D建筑资产。
AI.motivation: 程序化建模虽紧凑可编辑可复用，但依赖人工编写语法；单张图像证据部分且依赖视角，直接生成低层程序脆弱。
AI.method: 两阶段：1) 全局结构布局树，用微调布局模型加渲染引导的视觉-符号反射恢复立面尺度split-and-repeat组织；2) 组件参数化模式，将代表性立面瓦片映射为结构化属性以合成局部构件；两表示确定性编译为CGA程序，并附着于简单体量模型实例化。
AI.result: 实验表明框架可处理规则立面与挑战性野外图像，保持高结构一致性、程序可执行性和细粒度建筑细节，生成的程序支持可控、可复用的3D资产生成。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化中间表示替代直接低层程序生成，实现图像到可执行程序化建筑资产的稳健重建。

title: NormMoX: A Normative Mixture of Experts for Explainable Autism Classification from Structural and Functional MRI
summary: While structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI, fMRI) offer profound potential for researching autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and understanding individual neurodivergence, current classifiers lack the explanatory power needed for scientific study, clinical use and personal-level insights. Most models learn from imaging features that also vary with age, sex, scanner site and head motion. They fuse the two modalities without a common reference and explain decisions against arbitrary reference inputs rather than a typical brain. We present NormMoX, a normative mixture of experts that makes the typical brain the shared reference for prediction, fusion and explanation. Normative models trained on large healthy cohorts give the value each brain measure is expected to take for a person's age and sex. NormMoX learns from each person's deviations from these expected values. For each modality, a neural network expert turns the deviations into a score of evidence for ASD. A fusion head, MoX, compares each score with those of typical controls before combining them. It therefore needs no imputation when a modality is missing and shows in which modality each person is atypical. On 1,035 participants of ABIDE I, NormMoX reached an AUROC of $0.728 \pm 0.004$ in repeated cross-validation, above linear, single-modality and deep fusion baselines. NormMoX thus shows not only whether a person is likely to have ASD, but where, and in which modality, their brain departs from typical. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Novelex/NormMox.

AI.tldr: 提出NormMoX，一种规范混合专家模型，以"典型大脑"为共同参照进行预测、融合与解释，用于ASD的sMRI/fMRI分类。
AI.motivation: 现有ASD分类器缺乏解释力，受年龄、性别、扫描站点和头动等混杂影响，且融合两模态时无共同参照，解释基于任意参照输入而非典型大脑。
AI.method: 在大规模健康队列上训练规范模型，得到各脑指标在给定年龄性别下的期望值；从个体偏离量学习。每个模态一个神经网络专家将偏离转为ASD证据分数；MoX融合头将各分数与典型对照比较后再融合，缺失模态无需插补，并可显示个体在哪个模态异常。
AI.result: 在ABIDE I的1,035名参与者上，重复交叉验证AUROC为0.728±0.004，优于线性、单模态及深度融合基线。
AI.conclusion: NormMoX不仅判断个体是否可能患ASD，还能指出其大脑在何处、以何种模态偏离典型；代码已开源。

title: MoSoLoco: Monocular 3D Human Localization through Visual Latent Features and Social Context
summary: Estimating the metric 3D position of people from a monocular camera is important for robot navigation and motion prediction. Lightweight pose-based localizers are attractive for robotic hardware with limited computational resources because they operate on compact 2D keypoints. However, they typically discard the richer visual representations computed by the pose estimator. We introduce MoSoLoco, a per-frame monocular 3D human localizer that combines the pose detector's internal visual features with the detected 2D skeleton, without requiring an additional RGB or depth encoder. MoSoLoco can further incorporate sparse same-frame multi-person context to refine individual position estimates. Experiments on JRDB and NuScenes show that reusing pose-detector representations improves localization, reducing the best JRDB error by approximately 23 percent relative to the strongest evaluated keypoint-based baseline. A sparse social-interaction module incorporates nearby detections from the same image for further refinement. Controlled trajectory-forecasting experiments show downstream benefits, while the complete pipeline remains suitable for efficient Jetson AGX Xavier inference.

AI.tldr: MoSoLoco提出一种轻量级逐帧单目3D人体定位方法，复用姿态检测器内部视觉特征与2D骨骼，并可融合稀疏同帧多人上下文，无需额外RGB/深度编码器。
AI.motivation: 机器人导航与运动预测需要单目3D人体定位，但基于姿态的轻量定位器通常丢弃姿态估计器的丰富视觉特征，且计算资源受限的硬件难以承受额外编码器。
AI.method: 将姿态检测器内部视觉特征与检测到的2D骨架结合进行逐帧3D定位，不增加额外RGB或深度编码器；并引入稀疏同帧多人社交交互模块，利用同图邻近检测结果精化个体位置。
AI.result: 在JRDB和NuScenes上，复用姿态检测器特征提升定位精度，JRDB最优误差相较最强关键点基线约降低23%；稀疏社交交互模块进一步精化；受控轨迹预测实验显示下游收益，完整流程可在Jetson AGX Xavier上高效推理。
AI.conclusion: 复用姿态检测器表征并结合稀疏多人上下文，可在不增加编码器开销的前提下显著提升单目3D人体定位并惠及下游任务，适合资源受限机器人平台。

title: Certifying Graph Neural Networks Against Label and Structure Poisoning
comment: Published at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
summary: Robust machine learning for graph-structured data has made significant progress against test-time attacks, yet certified robustness to poisoning - where adversaries manipulate the training data - remains largely underexplored. For image data, state-of-the-art poisoning certificates rely on partitioning-and-aggregation schemes. However, we show that these methods fail when applied in the graph domain due to the inherent label and structure sparsity found in common graph datasets, making effective graph-partitioning difficult. To address this challenge, we propose a novel semi-supervised learning framework called deep Self-Training Graph Partition Aggregation (ST-GPA), which enriches each graph partition with informative pseudo-labels and synthetic edges, enabling effective certification against node-label and graph-structure poisoning under sparse conditions. Our method is architecture-agnostic, scales to large numbers of partitions, and consistently and significantly improves robustness guarantees against both label and structure poisoning across multiple benchmarks, while maintaining strong clean accuracy. Overall, our results establish a promising direction for certifiably robust learning on graph-structured data against poisoning under sparse conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出半监督框架 ST-GPA，通过伪标签与合成边丰富图划分，实现稀疏条件下节点标签和图结构投毒的认证鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 图数据对抗训练投毒（训练数据操纵）的认证鲁棒性研究不足；图像领域的分区-聚合认证方案直接用于图会因标签与结构稀疏导致划分失效。
AI.method: ST-GPA（Self-Training Graph Partition Aggregation）：半监督式深度自训练，对每个图划分补充信息性伪标签和合成边，再按分区-聚合方案进行认证；方法架构无关，可扩展到大量分区。
AI.result: 在多个基准上显著且一致地提升对标签投毒和结构投毒的鲁棒性保证，同时保持较强的干净准确率。
AI.conclusion: 为稀疏条件下图结构数据的可认证抗投毒学习提供了有前景的方向。

title: AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds
summary: Most image-based 3D reconstructors primarily recover visible surfaces, producing partial point clouds with large holes and leaving unobserved geometry unresolved. To address this limitation, we introduce AnchorComplete, a framework that reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds while preserving observed geometry and supporting scenes of varying scales. Building on TRELLIS.2, our method combines partial-point conditioning, which integrates global scene tokens with local spatial evidence to anchor generation to the input, and metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation, which progressively refines scene geometry within fixed-size windows while maintaining global structural consistency. Experiments on Replica and SCRREAM demonstrate that AnchorComplete consistently outperforms strong baselines in complete-scene reconstruction, particularly under sparse-view settings.

AI.tldr: AnchorComplete 提出一个从部分点云重建完整场景网格的框架，在保留已观测几何的同时支持不同尺度场景，在 Replica 和 SCRREAM 上优于强基线，稀疏视角下优势明显。
AI.motivation: 现有基于图像的三维重建方法主要恢复可见表面，生成的部分点云存在大洞，未观测几何无法解析。需要一种能补全场景并保持已观测几何一致性的方法。
AI.method: 基于 TRELLIS.2 构建，包含两部分：(1) 部分点云条件化，将全局场景 token 与局部空间证据结合，把生成锚定到输入；(2) 度量尺度的由粗到细生成，在固定大小窗口内逐步精化几何，同时保持全局结构一致性。
AI.result: 在 Replica 和 SCRREAM 数据集上，完整场景重建持续优于强基线，尤其在稀疏视角设置下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: AnchorComplete 能有效从部分观测生成完整场景网格，兼顾几何保真与尺度适应性，适用于稀疏视角下的场景补全任务。

title: Multidimensional Suicide Risk Assessment with Machine Learning using Electronic Health Records
summary: Suicide prevention remains a critical public health challenge, and electronic health records (EHRs) provide an opportunity to characterize suicide-related risk indicators using documented clinical, behavioral, medical, and social-contextual information. This paper presents a multidimensional machine learning framework to model and estimate suicide-related outcomes using MIMIC-IV EHR data. We construct clinically motivated diagnosis categories and define a composite outcome from documented codes corresponding to suicidal ideation, suicide attempt, prior suicidal behavior, and intentional self-harm. To address severe class imbalance and reduce age-related confounding, we apply age-matched resampling that retains all positive patients and samples comparison-cohort patients from the same age group. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost classifiers are evaluated before and after resampling with isotonic calibration. The calibrated XGBoost model achieves the strongest matched-cohort performance, outperforming the other evaluated classifiers. SHAP-based interpretation shows that diagnostic burden, depression-related features, age, personality-disorder history, social determinants related to violence, and medical comorbidity contribute to elevated predicted probabilities. Our results demonstrate that combining broad EHR-derived features, age-matched cohort construction, calibration, and feature-level interpretation provides a practical framework for retrospective suicide-related risk modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文基于MIMIC-IV电子健康记录构建多维机器学习框架，通过年龄匹配重采样与等渗校准，用XGBoost对自杀相关结局进行建模，并用SHAP解释风险因素。
AI.motivation: 自杀预防是重要公共卫生挑战，而电子健康记录（EHR）中的临床、行为、医疗与社会背景信息为刻画自杀相关风险指标提供了机会；同时需应对严重的类别不平衡与年龄混杂问题。
AI.method: 基于MIMIC-IV构建有临床意义的诊断类别，并以自杀意念、自杀未遂、既往自杀行为及故意自伤相关编码定义复合结局；采用保留全部阳性病例、从同年龄组抽取对照的年龄匹配重采样；评估逻辑回归、随机森林与XGBoost在重采样前后及等渗校准下的表现，并用SHAP解释特征贡献。
AI.result: 校准后的XGBoost在匹配队列上表现最佳，优于其他评估的分类器；SHAP显示诊断负担、抑郁相关特征、年龄、人格障碍史、与暴力相关的社会决定因素及医疗共病会提升预测概率。
AI.conclusion: 结合广泛EHR特征、年龄匹配队列构建、概率校准与特征级解释，为回顾性自杀相关风险建模提供了实用框架。

title: CL3DOD: Understanding the Stability-Plasticity Dilemma in Outdoor Class-Incremental 3D Object Detection
summary: Class-incremental learning (CIL) for outdoor 3D object detection remains largely underexplored. Existing outdoor studies are limited to single-benchmark evaluations, with SDCoT++ considering KITTI and CL2OD considering nuScenes under different incremental settings. This makes it difficult to assess whether observed continual-learning behavior generalizes across autonomous-driving benchmarks. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first unified cross-benchmark analysis of outdoor class-incremental 3D object detection across multiple autonomous-driving benchmarks, covering both two-task and multi-stage settings. We investigate: (1) how severely existing 3D detectors forget previously learned classes, (2) how incremental training exposes the stability-plasticity dilemma between knowledge retention and new-class acquisition, and (3) which forms of supervision are most effective for balancing these objectives. We introduce CL3DOD, a class-incremental 3D detection framework that restores missing supervision for previous classes using predictions from the previous-stage detector, preserves old-class responses through query-wise knowledge distillation, and employs EMA-based temporal consistency regularization. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes reveal a consistent stability-plasticity dilemma across both benchmarks. CL3DOD generally achieves a more favorable stability-plasticity balance than controlled incremental baselines and improves upon published prior methods in the reported benchmark comparisons. This advantage persists across multiple incremental stages, demonstrating strong retention of previously learned knowledge while maintaining effective new-class acquisition. Our code, evaluation setup, and incremental task splits will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出首个跨基准（KITTI、nuScenes）户外类增量3D目标检测统一分析框架CL3DOD，通过伪标签恢复旧类监督、查询级知识蒸馏与EMA时序一致性正则，缓解稳定性-可塑性困境。
AI.motivation: 户外3D检测的类增量学习研究不足，已有工作（SDCoT++用KITTI、CL2OD用nuScenes）各自在单基准、不同增量设置下评估，无法判断持续学习行为能否跨自动驾驶基准泛化，也缺乏对遗忘程度、稳定性-可塑性权衡及有效监督形式的系统认识。
AI.method: CL3DOD框架：1）用上一阶段检测器的预测为旧类恢复缺失的监督信号；2）通过查询级知识蒸馏保留旧类响应；3）采用基于EMA的时序一致性正则。并在KITTI与nuScenes上以两任务和多阶段设置统一对比。
AI.result: 两基准上均观察到一致的稳定性-可塑性困境；CL3DOD在稳定性-可塑性平衡上总体优于受控增量基线，并在已报道的基准比较中优于已发表方法，多增量阶段下仍保持对旧类知识的良好保留与新类有效获取。
AI.conclusion: 给出首个户外类增量3D检测跨基准分析，表明该困境具有跨基准一致性，CL3DOD提供更优权衡；代码、评测设置与增量任务划分将公开。

title: Calibrating Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation under Reliability and Availability Modality Shifts
summary: Multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) enables pretrained multimodal models to accommodate distribution shifts during inference using only unlabeled test data, without recourse to the original training data. Compared with unimodal adaptation, multimodal adaptation is further complicated by the coexistence and interaction of multiple representation perspectives. This complexity is particularly pronounced under modality reliability shifts, which preserve modality availability but degrade information quality, and modality availability shifts, which render the corresponding modality entirely inaccessible. Category-conditional Gaussian modeling offers a natural starting point for handling such distributional variations, having proven effective in unimodal test-time adaptation for characterizing representation distributions, yet its extension to multimodal settings requires a more elaborate formulation. To this end, we propose Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration (AdaPGC), which extends category-conditional Gaussian modeling across modality-specific and multimodal fusion representations for probabilistic calibration under multimodal distribution shifts. AdaPGC continuously updates category-conditional Gaussian models over modality-specific and fusion representations, using the resulting probabilistic predictions to calibrate source model predictions and guide reliability based rectification, while exploiting their joint distributions to recover unavailable fusion representations. Extensive experiments under diverse modality corruption and missingness conditions demonstrate that AdaPGC effectively improves robustness under both modality reliability and availability shifts. Our source code will be released at https://github.com/XuJinglinn/AdaPGC-plus.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaPGC，将类别条件高斯建模扩展到多模态TTA，通过对各模态与融合表示的持续高斯建模与概率校准，提升模态可靠性/可用性偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 多模态测试时适应比单模态更复杂：多种表示视角共存且交互，且面临模态可靠性偏移（模态存在但信息质量下降）与模态可用性偏移（模态完全缺失）两类挑战。单模态中有效的类别条件高斯建模需更精细的扩展才能用于多模态场景。
AI.method: AdaPGC对模态特定表示与多模态融合表示统一建立类别条件高斯模型并持续更新；用其概率预测校准源模型预测并指导基于可靠性的修正；利用联合分布恢复不可用的融合表示。
AI.result: 在多种模态损坏与缺失条件下的大量实验表明，AdaPGC在模态可靠性偏移和可用性偏移下均有效提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 类别条件高斯建模可自然扩展至多模态TTA，形成统一概率校准框架，显著增强多模态模型在推理阶段应对分布偏移的能力。

title: RangeFinder: Predicting Ligand Property Ranges from Protein Pockets
comment: Accepted at the AI for Drug Discovery workshop --- NeurIPS 2026
summary: Identifying ligands for a protein target requires searching a vast chemical space for a comparatively small set of compatible molecules. Existing machine learning approaches primarily address this problem by generating candidate ligands or scoring individual protein-ligand pairs, but provide limited information about the broader chemical space compatible with a binding pocket. We introduce RangeFinder, an SE(3)-equivariant transformer pocket-level model, trained and evaluated on BioLiP2 data, that predicts ranges over nine physicochemical ligand properties directly from pocket structure, chemistry, and evolutionary context. Using an intersection-over-union objective and evaluation metric (range-IoU), RangeFinder achieves a range-IoU of $0.464 \pm 0.002$, outperforming all deployable baselines while requiring only $12.2$ ms per pocket. We also quantify our method's ability to reduce the ligand search space while retaining compatible binders; in this regard, RangeFinder achieves a Reduction-Recall F-Score of $0.543 \pm 0.011$ --- once again outperforming all deployable baselines. Ablation experiments indicate that RangeFinder's performance depends more strongly on the density and quality of ligand supervision than on any individual input modality or specialized training strategy. Together, these results position RangeFinder as an inexpensive and effective molecular filtering prior, with demonstrated potential in narrowing the ligand search space of target pockets before docking, generation, or synthesis. The code for this project can be found at: https://github.com/alannadels/RangeFinder.

AI.tldr: RangeFinder是一个SE(3)等变Transformer口袋级模型，直接从口袋结构、化学与进化上下文预测九种配体理化性质的范围，以低成本作为分子筛选先验来缩小配体搜索空间。
AI.motivation: 为蛋白靶点寻找配体需在巨大化学空间中搜索少量兼容分子；现有机器学习方法多为生成候选配体或对单个蛋白-配体对打分，对与口袋兼容的整体化学空间提供信息有限。
AI.method: 提出RangeFinder，基于BioLiP2训练与评估的SE(3)等变Transformer口袋模型，直接从口袋结构预测九种理化配体性质的范围；采用intersection-over-union目标与range-IoU评测指标。
AI.result: range-IoU达0.464±0.002，每口袋仅需12.2 ms，优于所有可部署基线；Reduction-Recall F-Score为0.543±0.011，同样领先。消融显示性能更依赖配体监督的密度与质量，而非单一输入模态或专门训练策略。
AI.conclusion: RangeFinder是一种廉价有效的分子过滤先验，可在对接、生成或合成前缩小靶点口袋的配体搜索空间。

title: HyperFlow: Class-Incremental Semantic Change Detection via Hyperbolic Flow
summary: Semantic change detection in remote sensing aims to identify and characterize land-cover transitions observed in pairs of satellite or aerial images. Existing methods assume a fixed set of change categories, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where changes of interest may vary, for example across geographies or over time. In this work, we tackle the problem of class-incremental semantic change detection, where a model progressively learns to detect new types of semantic change. To do so, we exploit the hierarchical structure of land-cover semantics, where newly introduced categories correspond to fine-grained refinements of existing ones, and represent said semantic categories in hyperbolic space, which is particularly well suited to represent such hierarchical relationships. To capture semantic changes, we introduce HyperFlow, a method relying on Busemann prototypes, modeling change as an anomaly in a learned semantic flow within the hyperbolic embedding space induced by segmentation. HyperFlow couples change detection to class-incremental semantic segmentation, enabling class-incremental semantic change detection. We also present HiChange, a new large-scale, high resolution remote sensing dataset with detailed, fine-grained hierarchical labels. Experimental results demonstrate that HyperFlow achieves both strong change detection and semantic segmentation performance across incremental steps. In particular, we show that progressively refining semantic categories, rather than considering them all directly, yields improved change detection, highlighting the benefits of incremental learning for semantic change detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究类别增量式语义变化检测(CISCD)，利用地物语义的层级结构，在双曲空间中表示语义类别，提出HyperFlow方法以Busemann原型建模变化为语义流中的异常，并发布大规模高分辨率数据集HiChange。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感语义变化检测方法假设变化类别集合固定，难以适应现实中因地域或时间不同而变化类型各异的情况，需要模型能逐步学习检测新的语义变化类型。
AI.method: 利用地物语义的层级结构(新类别是已有类别的细粒度细分)，在双曲空间中表示语义类别以契合层级关系；提出HyperFlow，基于Busemann原型，将变化建模为由分割诱导的双曲语义流中的异常；将变化检测与类别增量语义分割耦合，实现类别增量语义变化检测；同时构建带细粒度层级标签的HiChange数据集。
AI.result: HyperFlow在各增量步骤上均取得较强的变化检测和语义分割性能；实验表明逐步细化语义类别(而非一次性学习全部类别)能带来更好的变化检测效果。
AI.conclusion: 双曲空间表示结合类别增量学习可有效支持开放动态场景下的语义变化检测，层级化增量细化优于直接全类别学习，凸显增量学习对语义变化检测的价值。

title: A Geometry-Informed Neural Operator surrogate of LISFLOOD-FP for rapid pluvial-fluvial flood forecasting: the case of Forlì, Italy
summary: Physically based two-dimensional hydraulic models are too slow for real-time inundation forecasting and large ensembles. We present a time-dependent geometry-informed neural operator (GINO) surrogate of LISFLOOD-FP for the municipality of Forlì (Italy), severely affected by the May 2023 Emilia-Romagna floods. The surrogate is designed for an operational setting in which only river stage gauges and rain gauges are available. A reproducible pipeline turns public regional observations into a physically based training set: each river inflow is driven by the first stage gauge downstream of it through a calibrated water-surface boundary condition, and rain enters as SCS-CN effective rainfall. The surrogate is an autoregressive GINO trained on 216 simulations of 24 observed events with scaled forcing. It predicts volume-conserving polygon-mean depths on an exposure-based Voronoi mesh of 659 nodes, with a 20 min step over 72 h. The surrogate is tested on 38 independent observed events that it never saw during training. On these events it reaches a critical success index (CSI) of 0.934 at 0.05m and 0.844 at 0.3 m, a depth RMSE of 0.008m and an $R^2$ of 0.984 for maximum-depth maps. On one NVIDIA A10G GPU a 72-h forecast takes 1.7 s instead of 55 s with LISFLOOD-FP, and a 50-member ensemble, computed in a single batched rollout, takes 6.2 s instead of about 46 min, which makes probabilistic flood forecasting practical. These results show that neural-operator surrogates can deliver accurate pluvial-fluvial flood forecasts driven by river stage for operational early warning.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了面向意大利Forlì市的GINO神经算子代理模型以替代水动力模型LISFLOOD-FP，仅用河位与雨量站观测驱动，实现高精度、秒级的洪水实时预报与集合预报。
AI.motivation: 基于物理的二维水动力模型计算过慢，难以支撑实时洪水预报与大集合概率预报（如LISFLOOD-FP单次72h需55s、50集合需约46分钟）。同时实际业务中往往只有河道水位站和雨量站数据，缺乏完整边界条件。
AI.method: 以LISFLOOD-FP为真值，构建可复现流水线将公共区域观测转为物理训练集：各河流入流由下游首个水位站经率定的水面边界条件驱动，降雨以SCS-CN有效降雨输入。模型为自回归GINO，在24场观测事件、216次模拟上训练，预测暴露度加权Voronoi网格（659节点）上的体积守恒多边形平均水深，时间步20分钟、跨度72小时。
AI.result: 在38场独立未见事件上，CSI为0.934（0.05m）和0.844（0.3m），最大水深图RMSE 0.008m、R²=0.984。单张A10G GPU上72h预报仅1.7s（对比55s），50成员集合批处理仅6.2s（对比约46min）。
AI.conclusion: 神经算子代理模型可在仅有水位站驱动下给出准确的雨洪-河洪联合预报，使概率性洪水预报在业务早期预警中变得可行。

title: R$^2$-Omni: Reducing Structural and Precision Redundancy in Omni-LLMs for Long-Form Generation
summary: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) typically process large numbers of multimodal tokens from audio-visual inputs, incurring substantial computational costs and a large memory footprint for the key-value (KV) cache. Aggressive token pruning can alleviate this problem while maintaining competitive performance on multiple-choice tasks, which require only a single option as output. However, we observe substantial quality degradation when generating long-form, open-ended responses. We attribute this gap to query-guided selection, which can retain sufficient evidence for answer selection while discarding details needed for comprehensive generation. This motivates reducing overlapping information across tokens, termed structural redundancy, while preserving diverse content. However, the retained representations may still contain precision redundancy due to unnecessarily high numerical precision in their cached values. To address these two levels of redundancy in token representations, we introduce a training-free framework named R$^2$-Omni. First, Structure-Aware Token Consolidation (STC) consolidates redundant representations using spatiotemporal similarity in video and local continuity in audio. Then, Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation (SSPA) allocates value precision to the retained representations according to the estimated reduction in attention-output error under quantized keys, with query attention and audio-visual alignment providing a semantic prior. Extensive experiments on long-form generation benchmarks demonstrate an average 5.0$\times$ reduction in the memory footprint while preserving 97.98% of baseline generation quality and achieving a 1.48$\times$ end-to-end speedup, highlighting the benefits of jointly reducing structural and precision redundancy.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架R²-Omni，从结构冗余与精度冗余两个层面压缩Omni-LLM的KV缓存，在长文本生成中实现平均5.0×内存降低，保留97.98%生成质量并带来1.48×端到端加速。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLM处理大量音视频多模态token，KV缓存计算与内存开销巨大。激进token剪枝在选择题任务上尚可，但长文本开放式生成质量明显下降，原因是query引导的选取消除了生成所需的细节信息；同时被保留的表示仍存在数值精度上的冗余。
AI.method: 免训练框架R²-Omni，两步：（1）Structure-Aware Token Consolidation（STC）利用视频时空相似性与音频局部连续性合并冗余表示；（2）Semantic-Sensitivity Guided Precision Allocation（SSPA）依据量化键下注意力输出误差的估计降幅，为保留的表示分配value精度，并以query注意力和音视频对齐作为语义先验。
AI.result: 在长文本生成基准上平均内存占用降低5.0×，保留基线生成质量的97.98%，端到端加速1.48×。
AI.conclusion: 联合削减结构冗余与精度冗余优于单纯的query引导剪枝，可在免训练条件下显著降低Omni-LLM的KV缓存开销并保持长文本生成质量。

title: Low-Rank Clebsch--Gordan Coupling for Equivariant Spherical Forecasting
summary: Spherical-harmonic neural operators provide an efficient representation for global forecasting, but their discretized pointwise nonlinearities can break rotational equivariance through aliasing. Clebsch-Gordan (CG) tensor products provide exactly equivariant interactions between spherical-harmonic representations, but their computational cost grows rapidly with spectral bandwidth and has limited their use at forecasting scale. We introduce LCG-SFNO, which combines low-rank CG interactions within a controlled low-degree band with coefficient-space residual propagation and an exactly projected quadratic nonlinearity, preserving SO(3) equivariance throughout the learned operator. To make the CG interaction practical, we further develop SSHCG, a sparse GPU implementation with a factorized alternative for wider coupled bands. On spherical shallow-water dynamics and the ERA5-based WeatherBench benchmark, LCG-SFNO reduces rotational error to numerical precision (more than three orders of magnitude below SFNO on shallow water and five orders of magnitude below it on WeatherBench), while matching SFNO on shallow-water forecasting and substantially improving forecast skill relative to SFNO on WeatherBench. Matched ablations show that CG coupling accelerates convergence, while SSHCG keeps the coupling to about 10 percent of a training step at the operating bandwidth, making exact equivariant coupling practical at forecasting scale.

AI.tldr: LCG-SFNO结合低秩CG张量积与系数空间残差传播，保持SO(3)等变性，并配套稀疏GPU实现SSHCG，在浅水方程与WeatherBench上大幅降低旋转误差且提升预报技巧。
AI.motivation: 球谐神经算子（如SFNO）适合全球预报，但其离散化的逐点非线性会因混叠破坏旋转等变性；CG张量积虽能精确等变，但计算成本随带宽快速增长，难以用于预报规模。
AI.method: 提出LCG-SFNO：在受控低阶带内使用低秩CG交互，结合系数空间残差传播与精确投影的二次非线性，全程保持SO(3)等变；并开发SSHCG稀疏GPU实现及宽耦合带分解替代方案以降低CG成本。
AI.result: 在球面浅水动力学与基于ERA5的WeatherBench上，旋转误差降至数值精度（浅水比SFNO低三个数量级以上，WeatherBench低五个数量级以上）；浅水预报与SFNO相当，WeatherBench上显著提升预报技巧；消融显示CG耦合加速收敛，SSHCG使耦合开销仅约训练步的10%。
AI.conclusion: 精确等变的CG耦合在预报规模下是可行且实用的，能同时改善旋转等变性与预报性能，为等变全球天气预报模型提供高效方案。

title: ReVA-HPE: Relative 6DoF Head Pose Estimation with Synthetic Pose Supervision and Personalized Virtual Anchors
summary: Monocular head pose estimation is usually formulated as absolute regression from a single face crop, yet many applications observe the same person over time and can supply an explicit anchor image. Recently, relative head pose estimation was proposed, which casts the problem as estimation of the relative geometric change between an anchor and a query image. However, existing methods still require the anchor image pose to be known at inference, significantly limiting their practical use. We first extend relative head pose estimation to full 6DoF by additionally predicting a depth-normalized relative translation, which composes with the anchor to recover metric query pose in the camera frame. To eliminate the need for a ground-truth anchor pose, we reconstruct a personalized avatar from a single unlabeled enrollment image and render a bank of virtual anchors with known poses. The bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while the real enrollment image serves as the real anchor in the translation branch via landmark PnP. We also introduce an efficient variant that amortizes the bank cost once at enrollment, after which each query requires a single real-to-real relative prediction, with limited accuracy sacrifice. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on synthetic face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, domain adaptation, or fine-tuning on the evaluation sets. On real 6DoF benchmarks, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision. Project page and code: https://vasilikivas.github.io/ReVA-HPE/

AI.tldr: ReVA-HPE将相对头部姿态估计扩展到完整6DoF（含深度归一化相对平移），并利用单张无标注注册图像重建个性化avatar生成已知姿态的虚拟锚点库，从而无需在推理时提供锚点真实姿态，且仅用合成数据训练即在BIWI/FaMoS上取得SOTA旋转精度。
AI.motivation: 现有相对头部姿态估计需在推理时已知锚点图像的姿态，严重限制实际应用；单张人脸裁剪的绝对回归也缺乏时序/锚点信息利用。
AI.method: 1) 将相对HPE扩展到6DoF，预测深度归一化相对平移，与锚点组合恢复相机系下度量姿态；2) 从单张无标注注册图像重建个性化avatar，渲染已知姿态的虚拟锚点库，通过多锚点共识产生稳健旋转假设，真实注册图像经landmark PnP用于平移分支；3) 提出高效变体：注册时一次性摊销锚点库成本，查询时仅做单次real-to-real相对预测；4) 相对姿态估计器仅用合成人脸渲染训练，无真实姿态监督、伪标签、域适应或微调。
AI.result: 在真实6DoF基准上，ReVA-HPE在BIWI上取得SOTA旋转精度，在FaMoS上使用接近正脸的注册图像时同样SOTA；尽管仅依赖合成姿态监督，度量平移仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过avatar虚拟锚点库消除对GT锚点姿态的依赖，可将相对HPE落地于实际6DoF头部姿态估计，并验证纯合成监督的可行性。

title: Finite-Memory Control of POMDPs: Fundamental Limits and Efficient Design
summary: Optimal control of partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs), in general, requires a complete history. The belief state, a distribution over hidden states, summarizes this history and provides the classical sufficient statistic to control POMDPs. However, the continuous nature of the belief space generally prevents a finite-memory controller from maintaining it exactly. This raises the question we address in this work: what must the available finite memory preserve to achieve near-optimal control performance? We study this question through an information-theoretic converse that gives a fundamental lower bound on the loss of any finite-memory controller. The analysis introduces the concept of a decision witness that characterizes belief states whose confusion would lead to unavoidable loss. Motivated by this bound, we propose RECAP, a constructive quantization method for designing representative memory states. We prove an upper bound on the optimality gap of any RECAP codebook and use the components of this bound together with the converse analysis to define the codebook objective. Experiments on 11 POMDP benchmarks demonstrate that RECAP improves over finite-memory representation baselines under the same memory budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息论下界与RECAP量化方法，刻画有限记忆控制器需保留何种信息才能接近最优，并在11个POMDP基准上优于基线。
AI.motivation: POMDP最优控制通常依赖完整历史，信念状态虽为充分统计量但其连续本质使有限记忆控制器无法精确维护。核心问题：有限记忆必须保留什么才能达到近最优控制？
AI.method: 提出信息论逆定理，给出任意有限记忆控制器损失的fundamental下界；引入"决策见证"(decision witness)概念，刻画一旦混淆即导致不可避损失的信念状态；据此提出RECAP——一种构造性的量化方法，设计代表性记忆状态，并证明其码本最优性间隙的上界，利用该上界分量结合逆定理定义码本目标。
AI.result: 在11个POMDP基准上，RECAP在相同记忆预算下优于有限记忆表示基线。
AI.conclusion: 有限记忆的关键在于保留与决策相关的信念区分信息；决策见证为量化设计提供理论与算法依据，RECAP验证了该思路的有效性。

title: Mesh-Agnostic Refinement Models for Latent Space Encoding of 3D Human Body Shapes
summary: Parametric human body models such as the Skinned Multi-Person Linear (SMPL) model provide compact representations of human shape and pose, but their reconstructions remain affected by both errors in estimated latent parameters and limitations in the decoder's expressive capacity. We propose a framework for refining these reconstructions by exploiting the geometric discrepancy between an initial decoded surface and a target mesh, without requiring vertex correspondences between them. The framework comprises three complementary approaches. Latent-VaRefine uses varifold-distance gradients to correct the estimated latent code while preserving the original parametric representation. Vertex-VaRefine processes multiscale varifold-gradient features with a DiffusionNet backbone to predict vertex displacements in a canonical pose, yielding an approximately pose-equivariant refinement pipeline. ElaOpt directly optimizes surface deformations under elastic regularization and normal-direction constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出一个无需顶点对应、利用初始解码曲面与目标网格间几何差异来精化参数化人体模型（如SMPL）重建的框架，包含Latent-VaRefine、Vertex-VaRefine和ElaOpt三种互补方法。
AI.motivation: SMPL等参数化人体模型虽提供紧凑的形状与姿态表示，但其重建仍受两类误差影响：估计的隐参数误差，以及解码器表达能力有限。作者希望在不依赖顶点对应关系的情况下修正这些误差。
AI.method: 框架包含三条互补路线：(1) Latent-VaRefine：用varifold距离梯度修正隐编码，同时保留原参数化表示；(2) Vertex-VaRefine：用DiffusionNet主干处理多尺度varifold梯度特征，在标准姿态下预测顶点位移，形成近似姿态等变的精化流程；(3) ElaOpt：在弹性正则化与法向约束下直接优化表面形变。整个框架基于初始解码曲面与目标网格的几何差异，无需顶点对应。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果，仅说明三种方法可分别从隐空间修正、顶点位移预测和直接形变优化角度实现曲面精化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过varifold几何差异驱动，提供从隐编码、顶点位移到直接形变的多层次精化方案，可在无需顶点对应的条件下提升参数化人体模型的重建质量，兼顾保持参数化表示与增强解码器表达力两类需求。

title: Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Clinical Time-Series Models
summary: Deep learning models for electronic health records achieve strong predictive performance but provide little insight into what clinical concepts they represent internally. Post-hoc attribution methods produce per-cell importance scores that lack temporal coherence, cross-variable structure, and reusability across patients. We introduce the Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder (TI-SAE), which learns a backbone-specific, patient-shared clinical concept dictionary from a frozen predictive model's representations. Each dictionary entry (latent) is defined by learned temporal Gaussian islands (specifying when the concept is active) and a sparse variable-composition vector (specifying which variables are involved). A decoupled selector then identifies which dictionary entries drive each patient's prediction, separating representation learning from attribution. We evaluate TI-SAE across five backbone architectures spanning different representation strategies on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV (three prediction tasks each). TI-SAE produces structured clinical concepts that go beyond transient attribution heatmaps while achieving strong performance on standard faithfulness benchmarks.

AI.tldr: TI-SAE 从冻结的 EHR 预测模型中学习"时间岛"式的稀疏自编码概念字典，得到可复用的结构化临床概念，并用解耦选择器定位驱动单个患者预测的概念。
AI.motivation: 现有 EHR 深度学习模型预测性能强但内部可解释性差；事后归因方法只给出逐单元的、缺乏时间连贯性、跨变量结构和跨患者复用性的重要性分数。
AI.method: 构建 Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder：每个字典条目(隐变量)由学习到的时间高斯"岛"(表示概念激活时段)与稀疏变量组成向量(表示涉及哪些变量)共同定义，从冻结模型表示中学习骨干特定、患者共享的概念字典；再用解耦选择器识别驱动各患者预测的字典条目，将表示学习与归因分离。
AI.result: 在 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 上、跨五种不同表示策略的骨干架构(各三个预测任务)评估，TI-SAE 产生超越瞬时归因热图的结构化临床概念，同时在标准忠实性基准上取得强性能。
AI.conclusion: TI-SAE 提供了比传统归因更具时间结构与变量结构、且可跨患者复用的可解释性方案，兼顾忠实性与概念可读性。

title: ArabGeoText: Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Models for Arabic Geospatial Text Spotting
summary: Geospatial text spotting involves locating and transcribing geographic labels, such as road names, district names, and landmarks, in raster maps. These labels are often small, densely arranged, and arbitrarily oriented. Although Arabic text recognition has been studied extensively in documents and natural scenes, Arabic geospatial text spotting remains underexplored. We introduce ARABGEOTEXT, an Arabic-centric benchmark covering 970 geographic locations in Riyadh and Jeddah, with 17,875 manually annotated text instances per view type. For each location, we pair an OpenStreetMap (OSM) rendering with a composite created by overlaying that rendering on the corresponding remote sensing (RS) imagery. The paired views preserve label content and pixel geometry, allowing evaluation across different backgrounds. Geographic partitions support in-city and city-disjoint evaluation of detection, recognition, and end-to-end spotting. Experiments with direct Qwen3.5-4B spotting show difficulties in recovering all labels within a tile. We therefore propose a tool-augmented vision-language framework that combines YOLO26 localization and crop rectification with Qwen3.5-4B recognition adapted through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The framework outperforms direct LoRA-adapted Qwen3.5-4B spotting across both image views and test cities. With localization held fixed, reader adaptation further improves recognition over the pretrained zero-shot reader. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yakoubbazi/ArabGeoText.

AI.tldr: 提出阿拉伯语地理空间文本识别基准 ARABGEOTEXT 及工具增强视觉语言框架。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语地理空间文本识别（如道路名、区域名、地标）研究不足，这类标签小而密集、方向任意。
AI.method: 构建 ARABGEOTEXT 基准（利雅得和吉达 970 个地点，每视图类型 17,875 条人工标注实例），每个地点配对 OSM 渲染图与叠加遥感影像的合成图，并按地理分区支持城内/跨城评估；提出结合 YOLO26 定位与裁剪矫正、LoRA 微调 Qwen3.5-4B 识别的工具增强框架。
AI.result: 直接 Qwen3.5-4B 难以恢复图块内所有标签；所提框架在两种图像视图和两个测试城市上均优于直接 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3.5-4B；在定位固定的情况下，读者适配较零样本预训练读取器提升识别效果。
AI.conclusion: 建立阿拉伯语地理空间文本识别基准并提供有效工具增强框架，数据与代码将公开。

title: A Living Leaderboard for Graph Machine Learning
comment: The leaderboard is available at https://graphlearningbenchmarks.github.io , the code at https://github.com/martinalex000/benchmarking_website
summary: Graph machine learning benchmarking results are scattered across papers that use quite different sets of datasets and baseline methods, making it difficult to tell whether a reported gain reflects architectural progress or merely an outdated comparison or weakly tuned baseline. We introduce a living, graph-learning-specific leaderboard that organizes reported results by dataset, putting new results into context. As of 15 October 2026 our LLM-based extraction pipeline extracted 27,723 eligible results across 111 datasets from 885 peer-reviewed papers. Our analysis of these results quantifies concerns about graph-learning benchmarking: legacy datasets are still actively used and many result tables contain baseline results that are drastically lower than those already available in the literature, e.g. 45% Amazon-ratings tables and 37% for Peptides-struct. The leaderboard allows to quickly compare new results against compatible prior results, aiming to improve the overall quality of graph learning benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 作者提出一个针对图学习的"活"排行榜，按数据集组织已发表结果，并通过基于LLM的抽取流水线从885篇同行评审论文中抽取了111个数据集上的27,723条有效结果，用其量化了图学习基准测试中的比较基准陈旧问题。
AI.motivation: 图机器学习论文的基准测试结果散布在数据集与基线方法各异的论文中，很难判断某篇论文报告的提升是真正的架构进步，还是源于过时的对比或调参不足的弱基线。
AI.method: 构建一个面向图学习的、持续更新的专用排行榜，按数据集组织结果；采用基于LLM的结果抽取流水线，从同行评审论文中自动抽取结果条目，并将新结果置于已有结果的语境中进行对比。
AI.result: 截至2026年10月15日，从885篇同行评审论文中抽取了覆盖111个数据集的27,723条有效结果；分析发现遗留数据集仍被大量使用，且许多结果表中基线数值远低于文献中已有的水平，例如Amazon-ratings有45%、Peptides-struct有37%的结果表存在此问题。
AI.conclusion: 排行榜可让研究者快速将新结果与可比的既有结果进行比较，从而改善图学习基准测试的整体质量。

title: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
summary:
**Purpose:** Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity.
  **Methods:** We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses.
  **Results:** On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance.
  **Conclusion:** These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio.

AI.tldr: Kev-Bio：用视觉语言模型生成决策查询，匹配超声密集特征输出空间概率图，从而定位测量端点并给出临床测量值，在九视图数据集上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 超声生物测量依赖手动放置卡尺，存在操作者间差异；专用预测头缺乏灵活性，而视觉语言模型直接回归坐标又不显式建模空间似然分布，难以表达定位歧义。
AI.method: 以临床测量问题作为文本指令引导，借鉴System One决策模型，用语言模型的决策表示生成每个卡尺端点的查询，与共享的超声密集特征匹配产生空间概率图，再由概率图导出关键点坐标与测量值；端到端联合训练定位损失与测量损失。
AI.result: 在九视图FU/GU Biometry 2026数据集上，平均径向误差MRE为22.50像素，临床测量平均绝对误差MAE为15.38，整体优于对比基线。
AI.conclusion: Kev-Bio有效实现跨不同解剖视图的超声关键点检测与临床测量，代码与模型已开源。

title: Bridging Neural Tangent Kernel Analysis and Reinforcement Learning for Deep Function Approximation
summary: Despite their widespread success across machine learning, the learning dynamics and generalization properties of neural networks remain poorly understood. The neural tangent kernel (NTK) provides an analytical characterization of the learning dynamics of infinitely wide neural networks and serves as a useful proxy for finite-width networks in supervised learning. In this work, we extend the NTK framework to reinforcement learning (RL) by introducing a temporal-difference (TD) flow formulation that accommodates time-varying mini-batches and TD targets, yielding a closed-form solution for value function evolution in an overparametrized setting. We also devise an optimization-based state-space exploration method that leverages the closed-form solution, coupled with constraints on the environment, to model the set of feasible states. On a deterministic grid environment, we validate that the proposed RL-based NTK formulation is indeed learning efficiently and adapting to the distribution shift in the training data distribution, and we demonstrate that the resulting exploration strategy improves sample efficiency. To our knowledge, this is the first work to extend NTK theory to characterize the learning dynamics of RL training with time-varying mini-batches and TD updates.

AI.tldr: 本文将神经正切核（NTK）框架扩展到强化学习，提出 TD flow 形式以刻画含时变小批量与 TD 目标的训练动态，得到过参数化下值函数演化的闭式解，并据此设计基于优化的状态空间探索方法，在确定性网格环境中验证了高效学习与探索带来的样本效率提升。
AI.motivation: 神经网络虽在机器学习中广泛成功，但其学习动态与泛化性质仍不清楚。NTK 已能解析无限宽网络在有监督学习中的动态，但尚缺乏对强化学习中时变小批量与 TD 更新动态的 NTK 理论刻画，这限制了对其训练过程的理解与利用。
AI.method: 提出 TD flow 形式，兼容时变小批量与时变 TD 目标，在过参数化设定下推导值函数演化的闭式解；基于该闭式解并结合环境约束，设计一种基于优化的状态空间探索方法，用于刻画可行状态集合。
AI.result: 在确定性网格环境中验证：所提 RL-NTK 形式能够高效学习，并能适应训练数据分布的偏移；基于该解的探索策略提升了样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个将 NTK 理论扩展到刻画含时变小批量与 TD 更新的 RL 训练动态的工作，为 RL 训练过程提供了理论刻画，并展示了理论驱动的探索方法的实用价值。

title: Fuse To Align: Multimodal Representation Learning for Retrieval via Hypergraph Regularization
summary: Multimodal retrieval must integrate complementary evidence from views that may be missing, noisy, or unequally informative. When a sample provides limited reliable evidence, learning from its views alone can hinder the acquisition of useful retrieval representations. Semantically related training samples may provide complementary observations, yet existing volume-based objectives jointly align modalities within each sample without explicitly enabling information exchange across samples. We therefore propose a training-time hypergraph fusion framework that connects observed modalities both within samples and across semantically related samples, allowing representation learning to draw on evidence beyond an individual sample while leaving the retrieval pipeline unchanged at inference. The framework includes HyVol as a special case and introduces two configurations: wHyVol learns view contribution weights and symmetric semantic affinities, whereas wRHG additionally models typed interactions and participant roles through relational propagation. Missing modalities are omitted rather than imputed, and the hypergraph is discarded after training, incurring no additional inference cost. Experiments on eleven zero-shot video-text and audio-text retrieval benchmarks demonstrate broad improvements with both GRAM and HyperGRAM. Across 17 video benchmark-modality settings evaluated in both retrieval directions, wRHG outperforms GRAM in all 34 comparisons and HyperGRAM in 33 of 34. Mean text-to-video R@1 increases from 63.4 to 68.2 with GRAM and from 64.8 to 68.4 with HyperGRAM, while the largest video-to-text gain reaches 13.3 percentage points on ActivityNet. Under missing-modality evaluation, both weighted configurations retain positive text-to-video gains over GRAM across seven benchmarks at every evaluated missingness rate, even when 90% of clips lack one modality.

AI.tldr: 提出训练时超图融合框架，跨样本连接观测模态以增强多模态检索表示学习，推理阶段无额外开销。
AI.motivation: 多模态检索需整合可能缺失、噪声或信息量不等的视图证据。当单样本可靠证据有限时，仅从自身视图学习难以获得有效检索表示；现有基于volume的目标只在样本内对齐模态，未显式实现跨样本信息交换。
AI.method: 训练时超图融合框架：在样本内及语义相关样本间连接已观测模态。含HyVol特例，两种配置——wHyVol学习视图贡献权重与对称语义亲和度；wRHG额外通过关系传播建模类型化交互与参与者角色。缺失模态直接省略而非填补，超图训练后丢弃。
AI.result: 在11个零样本视频-文本与音频-文本检索基准上，GRAM与HyperGRAM均有广泛提升。17个视频基准-模态设置双向共34项比较中，wRHG全部34项优于GRAM、33项优于HyperGRAM。平均T2V R@1：GRAM 63.4→68.2，HyperGRAM 64.8→68.4；ActivityNet上V2T最大提升13.3个百分点。缺失模态评估下，七个基准各缺失率均保持正向T2V增益，即使90%片段缺一模态。
AI.conclusion: 跨样本超图融合可在不改变推理流程、不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升零样本多模态检索，并对高缺失率具有鲁棒性。

title: Improving Hamiltonian Learning through Local Energy Decomposition
summary: Hamiltonian neural networks provide a principled framework for learning conservative dynamics. A scalar Hamiltonian is parameterized by a neural network and the vector field is derived using Hamilton's equations. However, preserving Hamiltonian structure does not guarantee that the energy function itself is represented accurately. When modeled by a conventional multilayer perceptron, the Hamiltonian inherits the spectral bias of coordinate-based neural representations, favoring smooth over fine-scale structure. These fine-scale errors can be amplified by differentiation when computing the dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Local Multiscale Hamiltonian Neural Network (LM-HNN), which restructures the Hamiltonian according to its physical interaction structure. LM-HNN decomposes the energy into kinetic and potential components and represents them as sums of shared local functions over multiple interaction neighborhoods. This replaces a single high-dimensional approximation problem with lower-dimensional, reusable interaction laws, making fine-scale energy structure easier to resolve while preserving Hamiltonian dynamics. Across low-dimensional, interacting, and fast--slow systems, LM-HNN consistently achieves more accurate Hamiltonian derivatives and long-horizon rollouts than competing structure-preserving models, while substantially extending the effective spectral range of the learned energy. The same structured representation also generalizes more reliably to energy levels not observed during training. These results show that accuracy depends on the Hamiltonian representation as well as its structure, and that incorporating locality, decomposition, and shared interaction laws provides a simple and effective route to more accurate and generalizable Hamiltonian learning.

AI.tldr: LM-HNN将哈密顿量按照物理相互作用结构分解为动能与势能之和，并用多个相互作用邻域上共享的局部函数表示，从而缓解谱偏置、提升能量导数与长期预测精度。
AI.motivation: Hamiltonian神经网络虽保持哈密顿结构，但用MLP参数化的哈密顿量继承坐标型网络的谱偏置，偏向平滑结构、难以刻画细尺度能量结构，且在微分计算动力学时误差被放大。
AI.method: 提出Local Multiscale HNN：把哈密顿量分解为动能与势能分量，并表示为在多个相互作用邻域上共享的局部函数之和，将单一高维逼近问题转化为低维、可复用的相互作用律，同时保持哈密顿动力学结构。
AI.result: 在低维、相互作用及快慢系统中，LM-HNN比同类保结构模型给出更准确的哈密顿导数与长期轨迹，显著扩展所学能量的有效谱范围，并对训练中未见的能级有更好的泛化。
AI.conclusion: 精度不仅取决于哈密顿结构，也取决于哈密顿量的表示方式；引入局部性、分解与共享相互作用律是提升哈密顿学习精度与泛化性的简单有效途径。

title: EO-Jev: Decision Model for Earth Observation
summary: Earth observation (EO) workflows require selecting among known outcomes, estimating confidence, and processing large volumes of imagery. Generative vision-language models can address these tasks, but autoregressive decoding is computationally costly and their confidence estimates are unreliable. Decision models offer an alternative, returning probabilities over candidate answers in a single forward pass. However, their accuracy, calibration, and transfer across EO tasks remain insufficiently understood. We investigate these properties through a diagnostic study of d3-flash (8.4B parameters) across 30 settings from 23 public EO benchmarks. We find that compositional reasoning transfers well and calibration improves over its Qwen3.5-9B backbone on 24 settings, while counting, change quantification, damage grading, and absent-object recognition remain challenging. To address these limitations, we adapt d3-flash through low-rank fine-tuning on public EO training splits, producing EO-Jev. EO-Jev improves significantly over d3-flash on 26 of 30 settings and matches or exceeds specialist references on 20 of 28. It also achieves an average gain of 8.0 points across 12 held-out settings and lower expected calibration error than specialists on 21 of 28 settings. These improvements come at a modest cost of 1.8 points in general decision performance. Our results demonstrate the potential of adapting general decision models into competitive EO generalists while highlighting persistent challenges in quantitative perception, option-order consistency, and calibration under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 对决策模型d3-flash在23个EO基准的30个设置上做诊断研究，并通过低秩微调得到EO-Jev，在26/30设置上提升，20/28匹配或超过专家模型。
AI.motivation: 地球观测工作流需要从已知结果中选择、估计置信度并处理大量影像。生成式视觉语言模型虽可胜任，但自回归解码计算开销大、置信估计不可靠；决策模型单次前向即返回候选答案概率，但其精度、校准与跨EO任务迁移性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 以d3-flash（8.4B）为对象，在23个公开EO基准的30个设置上开展诊断研究；随后利用公开EO训练划分进行低秩微调，得到EO-Jev。
AI.result: 组合推理迁移良好，24个设置上校准优于Qwen3.5-9B骨干；但计数、变化量化、损毁分级与缺席物体识别仍困难。EO-Jev在26/30设置上显著提升，20/28匹配或超过专家参考，12个留出设置平均提升8.0分，21/28设置ECE低于专家，通用决策性能仅下降1.8分。
AI.conclusion: 将通用决策模型适配为具竞争力的EO通用模型是可行的，但定量感知、选项顺序一致性和分布偏移下的校准仍是持续挑战。

title: Online Class Posteriors for Interpretable and Controllable Discrete Diffusion
